<1.1>
paraṃbrahmāṃḍaparaṃbrahma śriyaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim |
sarvāntaryāmiṇaṃ vande devaṃ sarvāvatāriṇam || 1 ||
śrīśca lakṣmīśca yatpatnyau viprāgnī yanmukhaṃ matam |
santo yaddhṛdayaṃ śaśvat tasmai cānvayine namaḥ || 2 ||
diviṣadbarhiṣat triṣat pitṛsadbhūtasacca yaḥ |
dhyānalabhyasvarūpāya tasmai śaṃvarṣiṃṇe namaḥ || 3 ||
himavacchikhare ramye svāśrame parvatottame |
nārāyaṇena vai lakṣmyai yā proktā nijasaṃhitā || 4 ||
badrikāśramatīrthe tāṃ tato labdhvādirūpadhṛk |
śvetavyāso divyadṛṣṭiścatuḥśiṣyānuvāca ha || 5 ||
śvaitiṃ ca suśikhaṃ cāpi śvetāśvaṃ śvetalohitam |
catvāraste mahātmāno brahmiṣṭhā brahmapāragāḥ || 6 ||
bhūtvā dhāma hareḥ prāpuḥ punarāvṛttivarjitam |
anādiśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇapatnyastu tāḥ kathāḥ || 7 ||
patiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ premṇā papracchurlomaśāśrame |
saurāṣṭre kuṃkumavāpīkṣetre’śvapaṭṭasārase || 8 ||
nārāyaṇaśca tābhyo vai jagādemāṃ hi saṃhitām |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyāṃ sarvārthasaṃbhṛtām || 9 ||
pañcaviṃśatisāhasrādhikalakṣaṃ hi vartate |
ślokānāṃ yatra saṃkhyānaṃ mokṣadaṃ pāṭhamātrataḥ || 1.1.10 ||
ekadā nāradaḥ prāyāt kartuṃ vaikuṇṭhidarśanam |
sabhā tena samāsīnā dṛṣṭā śrīviṣṇvadhiṣṭhitā || 1 1||
divyā muktāstvakṣarākhyā golokasthāstathāpare |
vaikuṇṭhavāsino muktāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ || 1 2||
avyākṛtāmṛtavāsāḥ śrīlakṣmīdhāmavāsinaḥ |
badrīkṣīrābdhimāścāpi tadanyaddhāmavartinaḥ || 13||
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devāḥ siddhā gāndharvacāraṇāḥ |
lokapālāśca manavastāpasāḥ sādhavaśca ye || 14||
munayo divyagatayo divyāhatasuvigrahāḥ |
āsan sarve tatra yoge nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 15||
lakṣayojanavistīrṇāprāntasaṃkulitā sabhā |
nāradena tu saṃdṛṣṭā hyardhā puṃbhiḥ prakāśitā || 16||
vāmabhāge yatra lakṣmīstatra devyastu saṃsthitāḥ |
muktānyo vāsudevānyo gopyaḥ sakhyastathā parāḥ || 17||
īśvariṇyo bhagavatyaḥ pārṣadāṇyaśca sevikāḥ |
brahmāṇyo mātaro devyo mānavyaḥ siddhavigrahāḥ || 18||
nāradena sabhā dṛṣṭā hyardhā nārīprakāśitā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 19 ||
śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ mahāmāyāṃ nāradaḥ prāṇaman mudā |
sarvāṃ sabhāṃ praṇamyātha viṣṇudatte suviṣṭare || 1.1.20 ||
nyaṣīdannāraṭastatra taiḥ sarveḥ satkṛtaḥ ṛṣiḥ |
vyāso’haṃ śvetasaṃjño vai sūtaḥ suśikhanāmakaḥ || 21 ||
vyākhyātārastathā cānye bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ |
divyarūpāstu te sarvai nārāyaṇasamīhayā || 22||
kathāstu vividhāstatra cakrurbhaktivivardhanāḥ |
tatra nārāyaṇenoktaṃ nārado’yaṃ mahāmuniḥ ||2 3 ||
bahuśruto bahujñātā samākhyānanidhirmahān |
lokavṛttāntakuśalaḥ praṣṭavyo vṛttavittaye || 24||
lakṣmīruvāca
bho tapasvin mahāyogin viṣṇoraṃśa mahāmune |
kutastādāgamyate kiṃ vartate viṣṇusṛṣṭiṣu || 25 ||
kathaṃvratā janā bhūmau samayaścāpi kīdṛśaḥ |
tīrthānāṃ susatāṃ pṛthvyāṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ gavāṃ tathā || 26 ||
dīnānāṃ sukṛtasyāpi sādhvīnāṃ nyāsināṃ sthitiḥ |
kīdṛśī sāmprataṃ cāsti mokṣādhvā kaccidakṣataḥ ||27||
jñānaṃ vijñānasahakṛt kaccidvipreṣu rājate |
nārāyaṇasya sadbhaktirlokaṣu vartate nviti || 28 ||
śrīnārada uvāca
pitarau sarvadā vande kṛpālū muktidāyakau |
svalpaṃ nāviditaṃ cāpi pitroḥ sarvajñayoḥ kila || 29 ||
tathāpi śiṣyadharmatvāt kathayāmi yathākramam |
paryaṭan subahūn lokān dṛṣṭvā kṛtayugasthitim ||1.1.3 0 ||
vilokya viṣṇusṛṣṭau vai viṣṇubhaktiyutān janān |
hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmātaḥ pātivratyaparāḥ prajāḥ || 31 ||
dhanyo’yaṃ bhagavān vipṇurdhanyā mā parameśvarī |
yatpratāpād dhruvā muktirlabhyate mānavaiḥ kila || 3 2||
śravaṇātkīrtanādviṣṇoḥ smaraṇātpādasevanāt |
arcanādvandanāt sakhyāddāsyādvātmānivedanāt || 33 ||
jñānājñānakṛtādvāpi saṃsāramalavarjanāt |
sadyaḥ saṃprāpyate mokṣastasmādbhāgyaṃ nu kiṃ param || 34||
sakṛjjapanti ye jāpyaṃ gṛṇanti nāma vā hareḥ |
divyabhāvanayā mātarmuktiṃ yānti tu te dhruvām || 35||
sāmānyāmathavā mukhyāṃ viṣṇordīkṣāṃ hi ye janāḥ |
gṛhṇantyābālavṛddhādyāste syurvaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ || 36 ||
ānukūlyaṃ sadā viṣṇoḥ prātikūlyavivarjanam |
viṣṇau pūrṇo hi viśvāsastavāsmītivareṣaṇā || 37||
dehendriyamanaḥ prāṇābhimatidhīṣaṇātmanām |
nyāso viṣṇau tathā dīnādhīnatā ca hareḥ sadā || 38 ||
sarvasvaṃ me hariḥ sākṣānnānyaśceti matiḥ sthirā |
ityevaṃ ṣaḍvidhā viṣṇau prapantiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ || 39 ||
tadekaṃ vā samāsādya nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ |
bhāvaikyaṃ vā kriyaikyaṃ vā hyātmaikyaṃ vā prasādhayet ||1.1.40 ||
tathā tu śrīhareraikyaṃ yathā yāvatprajāyate |
tāvattathā svayaṃ nārāyaṇānandaṃ samaśnute || 41 ||
prematattvaṃ dravarūpaṃ cātmāpi dravatāṃ bhajet |
dravadvayaṃ samāsādya svayaṃ viṣṇurdravo bhavet ||42 ||
ānandaghanacidghanavijñānaghanamiṣṭatāḥ |
nityatṛptanityaśaityanityasukhasupuṣṭatāḥ || 43 ||
nārāyaṇaikyamāpannaḥ sarvān kāmān samaśnute |
kvacitpārśve kvacinmūrtau kvacittasmin pralīyate ||44 ||
kvacinmuktaḥ kvacillakṣmīḥ kvaciddāsaḥ pravartate |
śarīravaccendriyavanmanovattasya jāyate ||45||
ahaṃ tu nārado mātarviṣṇormana itīritaḥ |
tvaṃ tu lakṣmīstasya cārdhaṃ śarīrātmeti kathyase ||46 ||
sanpadārthaṃ hariḥ sākṣāccidardhastvaṃ nu sammatā |
tayordrave mahānandaḥ saccidānanda ucyate || 47||
yena kenāpi bhāvena tvātmā vai dravatāṃ vrajet |
tadbhāvadravamāsādya muktiṃ viṣṇumayī vrajet |||48 ||
śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca
ityuktvā dravarūpeṇa nārado līnatāṃ gataḥ
viṣṇau premaparākāṣṭhāsukhānubhavavāridhau ||49 ||
paśyatāṃ tu sabhāsthānāṃ sarveṣāmidamadbhutam |
camatkṛtikaraṃ jātam aho bhaktasya bhaktatā ||1.1.5 0||
lakṣmīrjijñāsamānā vai nārāyaṇaparāyaṇā |
papraccha paramātmānaṃ lokopakārasattaye ||5 1 ||
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
aho bhaktāstu bahavā dṛṣṭāste paramātmanaḥ |
na kaścidīdṛśo dṛṣṭo yo’yaṃ tvayi gato dravam |||52||
manye tu kāraṇaṃ tatra karuṇā śrīmatastava |
yasyopari bhaved deva niḥsīmānugrahastava ||53 ||
tasyaiva nātha no bhinno bhavasīti matirmama |
etādṛśātmalābhārthe yathā yad bhavato matam ||54||
yadvānugrahalabdhyarthaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ tvayeṣyate |
śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca
nārāyaṇastu tacchrutvā sarveṣāṃ hitakāmyayā ||55||
uvāca paramaprītyā svalpamapyatulārthabhṛt |
yena sādhāraṇā jīvā api yāntīdṛśīṃ gatim ||56||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaikuṇṭhe lakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasabhāyāṃ nāradīyadravībhāvabhakticamatkṛtinirūpaṇātmakaḥ prathamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||

<1.2>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi bhaktasya dravalabdhaye |
yathā me’nugrahaḥ prāpyastadvidhāraya tattvataḥ || 1 ||
mukta sṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭāvapi prabhuḥ |
asṛjatsākṛtīnsarvān śarīriṇa iti sthitiḥ || 2 ||
ātmā tvindra itiproktaḥ sarvaśaktiguṇāśrayaḥ |
manaścittamahaṃbuddhistasya karaṇamāntaram || 3 ||
indrasya śaktayaścaitāścatasraḥ samudāhṛtāḥ |
śrotratvaṅnetrarasanāghrāṇavākpādapāṇayaḥ || 4 ||
pāyūpasthe cendriyāṇi bahiḥkaraṇakāni hi |
daśāpi śaktayaścaitā indrasyaiva bhavanti vai || 5 ||
grāhyeṣu tāstu gacchanti padārtheṣu bahirbahiḥ |
grāhyākāreṇa tā bhūtvā grāhyākāraṃ bhajanti ca || 6 ||
parāvṛtya tu tāḥ sarvā dhāryākāraṃ bhajanti ca |
vidhvāntaḥkaraṇānyetā ātmānaṃ yānti vai yadā || 7 ||
bhogyākāraṃ gatāstāśca tā indrānubhavaṃ gatāḥ |
aparokṣānubhāvo’yaṃ svātmanyeva bhavatyatha || 8 ||
ahamindre sthitaḥ sākṣātsarvaśaktiprapūrakaḥ |
indro madyogataḥ pūrṇaśaktyāśraya itisthitiḥ || 9 ||
āgrāhyāttu madantaṃ vai prematattvaṃ dravo mataḥ |
sarvatra nihitaṃ tadvai tena snihyanti mūrtayaḥ || 1.2.10 ||
snehapūrṇānandapūrṇapremapūrṇaḥ sukhāśrayaḥ |
dravapūrṇo hyahaṃ viṣṇurmadyogāddravavān hi saḥ || 11 ||
sarvaṃ sthūlaṃ tathā sūkṣmaṃ cetanaṃ cānyadeva vā |
maddravāddravitaṃ sarvaṃ me’nugraho’tra kāraṇam || 1 2||
ayaṃ tu dravito bhūyāditime’nukṛpā bhavet |
tadā dravati tatkālaṃ nānyathā tu kadācana || 13 ||
matkṛpāyāḥ sādhanaṃ tu sarvasvātmārpaṇaṃ matam |
sarvadāhaṃ kṛpāpūrṇaḥ kṛpāluḥ karuṇodadhiḥ || 14||
bhaktollāsātkṛpāvṛṣṭiṃ karomi kṛpayānvitaḥ |
yathā yathā kṛpāyā me pravāho viśati dhruve || 15||
bhakte tathā tathā tattvaṃ dravatāṃ yātyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
eka evādvitīyo’haṃ sthito’smyakṣaradhāmani || 1 6||
manmūrtau tatra me muktā brahma cākṣaramityapi |
dravanti premabāhulyānme’nugrahabalādapi || 17||
tadā samrāḍvirāje’haṃ na kiñcidvyatiricyate |
muktiṃ seyaṃ tadaikyātmāpyate tatsthitivedibhiḥ || 18||
sa ekākī na ramate cecchaddvitīyamātmanaḥ |
brahma taccākṣaraṃ tasmātprādurbhūtaṃ mahātmanaḥ || 1 9||
dvedhābhūttannirākāraṃ sākāraṃ ceśavāñcchayā |
nirākāraṃ paraṃ dhāma yasmād dhāmāni jajñire || 1.2.20 ||
sākāraṃ svasamākāraṃ mūrtaṃ mūrtyanurūpakam |
sa haristu punaraicchannaikarūpatvamātmanaḥ || 21 ||
muktā anādinastasmātprādurbhūtā anantaśaḥ |
tatrāsam̐stanmaṇḍalāni tripāde divi cāmṛte|| 22||
muktā brahma parabrahma brahmasṛṣṭistrikaṃ matam |
rūpānurūpāvayavā divyāḥ sarve sarūpiṇaḥ || 23 ||
ātmarūpāṇīndriyāṇi tattvābhinnāni santi vai |
upacārāttu nāmāni rasaśaktyātmakāni hi || 24||
manaḥ śrotraṃ ca vāk cakṣustvag rasādīni tāni vai |
pūrṇe cinhe’pi guptā na tadratirvāsanā na ca || 25||
amātṛjaṃ yatastatra kośaṣaṭkaṃ na vidyate |
prāṇastatrātmanaḥ śaktiḥ kāśo’nāvaraṇātmatā || 26||
suhiraṇyakeśanakhadantā naiva viyoginaḥ |
saccidrūpaikamānāste svātmakāḥ pravibhānti hi || 27||
divyāḥ sarve prakāśāste rājante divyadhāmani |
ityayaṃ brahmalokastu aupaniṣad ucyate || 28 ||
brāhmī muktistanurbrāhmī brahmānandānubhogyatā |
so’śnute sarvakāmām̐stu saha śrīhariṇā sadā || 29||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne akṣaradhāmni parabrahmabrahmamuktādīnāṃ dravamuktyāpi sākāratādarśakodvitīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 2 ||

<1.3>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
athākṣarasvarūpasya harervāmāṅgasaṃsthiteḥ |
vāmārūpeṇa sevecchā saphalāṃ kartumicchatā || 1 ||
nārāyaṇeva vāmāṃgātsvātmaśaktimayaṃ śubham |
sarvamāṃgalyasaubhāgyapremasnehadravāśrayam || 2 ||
rūpānurūpaṃ svādhānaṃ svakṣetraṃ svāśrayaṃ svakam |
svaguṇaiśvaryasāmarthyarajobalaguhāśrayam || 3 ||
mūrtaṃ lakṣmyātmakaṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ ratiguṇāśrayam |
amogharatisāphalyaṃ lakṣmyā icchan kṛpānidhiḥ || 4 ||
amoghavīryavadrūpaṃ vāsudevākhyamādadhat |
so’yaṃ nārāyaṇo vāsudevaḥ śrīharirīritaḥ || 9 ||
dvedhābhavat sa lakṣmīnārāyaṇetisamāhvayaḥ |
lakṣmīrdṛṣṭvā brahmaloke sarvānmuktām̐stu pūruṣān || 6 ||
svāṃ tvekāṃ svasamākārāṃ nānyāṃ tatra vyalokayat |
tadā tvaprārthayad devaṃ svapatiṃ śrīhariṃ mudā || 7 ||
patipatnīkṛte sthānaṃ yogyaṃ prakalpaya prabho |
tasyā bhāvaṃ samājñāya priyāyāḥ śubhavāṃcchayā || 8 ||
vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ dhāma divyaṃ brahmalokaṃ hyakalpayat |
sevārthaṃ dāsadāsīśca tatrāpyavāsayatprabhuḥ || 9 ||
tadarthaṃ divyabhogām̐śca divyopakaraṇānyapi |
divyāṃ tadīśvarīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ pūrṇāṃ pūrṇamanorathām || 1.3.10 ||
sarvasādhanasampannāṃ smṛddhisaukhyasamanvitām |
cakāra śrīhariḥ sākṣānmene tadīyapūrṇatām || 11 ||
so’haṃ sā tvamayaṃ lokau vaikuṇṭhaścāvayoriti |
dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ mahāyogaṃ patipatnīmayaṃ navam ||
triguṇājā hareḥ śaktirnityā yā tattvasūtikā || 12 ||
anādinidhanā māyā cakame śrīhariṃ patim |
yathā tattvātmikā sṛṣṭirjāyate yatra līyate || 13 ||
sā vai lakṣmīsamaṃ rūpaṃ dhartumiṣṭaṃ tadārthayat |
prabhuṃ sarveśvaraṃ nāthaṃ śrīhariṃ tu tadā punaḥ || 14||
prabhuṇā tu samājñaptā rūpaṃ mohakaraṃ navam |
rādhārūpaṃ hi subhagaṃ hyasaṃkhyaratibhājanam || 15 ||
dadhārābhinnapatnītve sthitā cāpi tadicchayā |
śrīharistu tadarthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇarūpo babhūva ha || 1 6||
sarvakāmāśrayaḥ sarvarasavarṣī pumānparaḥ |
amoghāmeyavīryaśrīsaundaryabalakāntimān || 17||
rādhāramaṇayogyārthayuvamūrtidharaḥ prabhuḥ |
rādhā vilokya subhagaṃ svānuyogyaṃ varaṃ patim || 18 ||
svāvāsamārthayad divyaṃ svatantraṃ tatra dhāmani |
madvihārakṛtodyānaṃ madratyarthamahāśrayam || 19 ||
madvibhūtiparākāṣṭhaṃ matsāmagrīsamāhitam |
saccidānandarūpāṇi sarvopaskaraṇāni ca || 1.3.20 ||
śrīkṛṣṇasya kṛte tatra sarvāṇi saṃbhavantviti |
rādhābhilāṣayā sarvaṃ jātaṃ dāsyaśca koṭiśaḥ || 21 ||
susmṛddhaṃ tatparaṃ divyaṃ dhāma golokamakṣaram |
prasīmnā lokyate yattad brahmaloke samāyatam ||22 ||
cāru golokasaddhāma rādhākṛṣṇo hyakalpayat |
śrīhariṇā samājñaptaṃ rādhākṛṣṇasabhājitam || 23 ||
śāśvataṃ brahmaloke taddhāma golokamāhitam |
tatra rādhākṛtāṃ sevāṃ gṛhṇāti kṛṣṇarūpadhṛk || 24 ||
brahmaloke ca goloke vaikuṇṭhe bhogyasañcayāḥ |
samānāḥ śrīhareḥ santi bhaktānandakarāḥ sadā || 25||
yathāliṃgaṃ yathārūpaṃ yathāyogaṃ yathārhaṇam |
yathājoṣaṃ yathāpekṣaṃ hareḥ kāmādbhavanti tai || 26 ||
divyaṃ ratisukhaṃ nitya divyānandastadātmanām |
divya prema hareryogānnityaṃ tatrābhijāyate || 27||
svapriyāsu sadā nātho vaikuṇṭhe ramate yathā |
goloke’pi tathā bhartā preyasīṣu pramodate || 28 ||
akṣare tu pare dhāmni mukteṣu ramate hariḥ |
muktān bhaktān sakhīn dāsīḥ svayaṃ krīḍayati prabhuḥ || 29 ||
ekaṃ vā yugalaṃ rūpaṃ yathā māṃ samupāsate |
tathā te māṃ prapadyante svāminaṃ sukhadaṃ patim || 1.3.30 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīrādhākṛte vaikuṇṭhagolokadhāmadvayaklṛptinirūpaṇanāmā tṛtīyo’dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||

<1.4>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sa aikṣata prajāyeya paramātmā svayaṃ hariḥ |
mahākālaṃ svakāṃ śaktiṃ sasarja vibhurātmanaḥ || 1 ||
sarveṣāmantakartāraṃ māyākṣobhakaraṃ param |
ājñāṃ cakre haristasmai māyāṃ saṃkṣobhayeti hi || 2 ||
māyāṃ tatkṣobhitāṃ dṛṣṭvā pumānmuktastu vai hareḥ |
ājñākaro’paraḥ kaścinmāyayā yuyuje tadā || 3 ||
sā māyā prakṛtirmūlā pumām̐stu puruṣaḥ patiḥ |
iti prakṛtipuruṣau sargaṃ sasarjatuḥ svakam || 4 ||
tābhyāṃ pradhānapuruṣā jajñire koṭiśaḥ khalu |
pradhānaṃ tu mahattattvaṃ triguṇaṃ kṣetramucyate || 5 ||
pūruṣastatpatiḥ prokto yugalāni bhavanti vai |
pūruṣā īśvarāḥ sarve līnā ye prakṛtau tu prāk || 6 ||
prādurbhūtāśca te sarve jāyāpatisarūpiṇaḥ |
pradhānapuruṣābhyāṃ tu mahāviṣṇuḥ prajāyata || 7 ||
ahaṃkāraḥ sa vai proktaḥ svarṇapūruṣa ityapi |
pradhānāyāḥ suputrī sā tvahaṃkṛtiriti smṛtā || 8 ||
hiraṇyā sā mahālakṣmīrmahāviṣṇoḥ sahāyinī |
mahālakṣmīrmahāviṣṇuryugalaṃ tatprakīrtitam || 9 ||
mahāviṣṇormahālakṣmyāṃ yo garbhaḥ samajāyata |
hiraṇyagarbha ityuktastaccāṇḍaṃ samajāyata || 1.4.1 0||
hiraṇyāṇḍaṃ dvidhā bhinnaṃ tato jajñe virāḍayam |
vairājyapi pramadā ca virāṭpatnī tu sā matā || 1 1||
ahaṃkṛtermahāviṣṇostattvāni ṣoḍaśo’bhavan |
sāttvikāttu samanaskānīndriyāṇi daśābhavan || 12||
tāmasāttanmātravargo taddevā rājasāttathā |
śrotratvaṅnetrarasanā vākpāṇipādapāyavaḥ || 12||
upasthaṃ cetīndriyāṇi manaḥ karaṇamāntaram |
pañcajñānendriyaṃ bodhyaṃ pañca karmendriyaṃ matam || 14||
śrotrādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ jñānotpādanaśaktitaḥ |
vāgādīnāṃ tu pañcānāṃ karmotpādanaśaktitaḥ || 15||
jñānakarmendriyākhyā vai manaḥ syādubhayātmakam |
digvātārkapraceto’śvivahnīndropendramitrakāḥ || 16||
candraśceti matā devā īśasṛṣṭimayā ime |
īśvarāṇāṃ śarīreṣu golakeṣu vasanti te || 17||
manaścaikaṃ caturdhā tu jāyate vṛttibhedataḥ |
mano’haṃcittabuddhyākhyaṃ procyate tattvavedibhiḥ || 18||
tāni virāṭsvarūpeṇa saṃhatānīśavāñcchayā |
tathāpi prāṇaśūnyaṃ tannodatiṣṭhad yadā virāṭ || 19||
śrīhariḥ prāṇarūpo vai bhūtvā tatra viveśa ha |
prāṇaśaktirjīvanākhyā yena nyastāntare tataḥ ||
prāṇātmanaścetanasya śrīharestatsamanvayāt |||1.4.20||
vairājaṃ rūpamityarthe kārye’nvarthaṃ babhūva ha |
tasya nābhimahānālapadmādbrahma vyajāyata ||21 |
rājasaḥ sarjakaḥ so’tha rudrastadbhālato’bhavat |
tāmasaḥ sa tu saṃhartā hṛdo viṣṇurbabhūva ha ||22|
sāttvikaḥ poṣakaḥ proktaste svaśaktisamanvitāḥ |
brahmaṇastu śarīrasthā brāhmī proktā tadaṃganā ||23
sṛṣṭiriti samākhyātā brahmaṇo’rdhāṃganā hi sā |
rudraśaktistu rudrāṇī śivā harāṃganā satī || 24||
vaiṣṇavī viṣṇuśaktiryā sāpi lakṣmīriti smṛtā |
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tisrastāḥ sṛṣṭivinaṣṭipuṣṭidāḥ || 25||
patnyastadātmikāstattatkāryasāhāyyadā matāḥ |
pagbrahmājñayā sṛṣṭipravāhaṃ vāhayanti te ||26||
āmūlapuruṣātsarve keśāntā īśvarāḥ smṛtāḥ |
śuddhasattvaśarīrāste sattvaṃ bhūtistu sā hareḥ || 27||
tasmānīśāstu te sarve parabrahmavibhūtayaḥ |
tatreśvareṣu sarveṣu praviṣṭau dīvyati prabhuḥ || 28 ||
teṣāṃ tūpāsyamūrtidhṛk śrīhariḥ saṃbabhūva ha |
vāsudevaḥ sa vai proktaḥ īśvarāṇāṃ niyāmakaḥ || 29||
īśvarāṇāṃ mahārāja īśvareḍyapadāmbujaḥ |
svaśaktyā vāsudevyā sa sahito bhagavānayam || 1.4.30 ||
dhāmnyakṣare svavāsāya śvetaṃ nirmāya dhāma tat |
śvete divye svake dhāmni nivāsamakarotprabhuḥ || 31 ||
amṛtākhye pare dhāmni vāsudevaḥ sa eva hi |
vāsudevaḥ svayaṃ svasyeśvarasṛṣṭikṛte punaḥ ||
janmapuṣṭilayārthaṃ svaṃ rūpatrayamadhārayat || 32||
īśasṛṣṭisamunnetā hyaniruddho vyajāyata |
īśasṛṣṭestu sampoṣṭā pradyumnaḥ samajāyata || 33 ||
īśasṛṣṭerviloptā sa saṃkarṣaṇo’nujāyata |
tisrastu mūrtayaḥ sākṣādvāsudevasya santi hi || 34||
śrīhariṇā svayaṃ prohya dhṛtaṃ rūpacatuṣṭayam |
vyūhacatuṣṭayaṃ tasmātprocyate śāstravedibhiḥ || 35 ||
vyūhādhīnāstatra kecidīśāścaturmukhāḥ pare |
aṣṭamukhāstathā cānye ṣoḍaśāsyāḥ śatānanāḥ || 36||
sahasrāsyā ayutāsyā niyutāsyāstathā pare |
arbudāsyāḥ koṭimukhāstāvaccaraṇapāṇayaḥ || 37||
viṣṇostatrāṇḍagolāstu canurdaśasamīritāḥ |
sadāśivasya rudrasya tvaṣṭāviṃśatigolakāḥ || 38 ||
aṇḍāḥ pradhānamāyāyāḥ ṣaṭpañcāśatsamīritāḥ |
mahāviṣṇoḥ śate dve ca tathā dvādaśa golakāḥ ||39 ||
prakṛtipuruṣāṇḍāni santi pañcaśatāni vai |
mahākālasya lokāstu sahasraṃ parikīrtitāḥ ||1.4.40 ||
vāsudevasya kṛṣṇasya nārāyaṇasya bhūmayaḥ |
divyānantā asaṃkhyātāḥ santi vācāmagocarāḥ ||41 ||
īśvarāṇāntu sarveṣāṃ manobuddhīndriyādayaḥ |
ātmabhūtāḥ śaktayaḥ svāḥ śuddhasattvānvitā matāḥ ||42||
bhogyabhogopakaraṇabhogasādhanabhūmayaḥ |
śuddhasattvātmikāḥ santi paramānandamiśritāḥ ||43||
paramātmā haristatra prāvirbhavatyabhīkṣṇaśaḥ |
yathākāryaṃ yathā tattadīśaprārthanabhāvanam ||44||
īśvarāṇāṃ tu kāryāṇi nirvartya śrīharistataḥ |
tattadīśāyuṣā sthitvā tirobhāvamupaiti hi ||45||
tattatsvarūpasadbhaktyā te’pi yānti parāṃ gatim |
pūrṇamaiśvaryamābhuktvā te gacchantyapunarbhavam ||46||
tadā muktastu te sarve śrīhariṃ samupāsate |
īśvarāṇāmapi muktirevaṃ bhavati śāśvatī ||47||
svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmām̐steṣāṃ muktikaraḥ prabhuḥ |
niyāmakaḥ parabrahmānvito’pi vyatirekavān ||48||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāsudevādibrahmānteśvarāṇāṃ sṛṣṭikathananāmā caturtho’dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||

<1.5>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
vāsudevaḥ samutpannaḥ svaprayojanamārthayat |
kiṃ mamātra vidheyaṃ syāt kathamīdṛksvarūpavān || 1 ||
iti sañcintya sasmāra paramaṃ mūlarūpiṇam |
śrīharistu tadā tasmai rūpatrayamadarśayat || 2 ||
vāsudevāt samutpannā vāsudeve’pyayaṃ gatāḥ |
aniruddhaśca pradyumnastathā saṃkarṣaṇo’paraḥ || 3 ||
vāsudevo harāvāste vāsudeve tvime trayaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā jñātvā punastāvadvicāraṃ kṛtavān hi saḥ || 4 ||
kiṃ mamaibhistribhī rūpairanuṣṭheyaṃ bhavediti |
śrīhariṇā tatastasmai īśasṛṣṭestu netṛtā || 5 ||
darśitā bhūsthairyabhaṃgamayī sā tryadhinīkṛtā |
sṛṣṭistu kīdṛśī kāryā kīdṛśo lokavistaraḥ || 6 ||
iti sañcintane tasmai vāsudevāya vai hariḥ |
svamūrtau tatkṛtīḥ sarvāḥ kalāḥ sarvā adarśayat || 7 ||
anantāyāmamāyāyāmagādhāyāṃ harestanau |
svasvadhāmānyapaśyam̐śca sarve svasvavibhūtibhiḥ || 8 ||
mahākālaṃ ca prakṛtipūruṣaṃ bhūmapūruṣam |
pradhānapuruṣaṃ cāpi mahāpūruṣamityapi || 9 ||
mahāviṣṇuṃ tathā tadvad vairājapuruṣaṃ hyapi |
tathā hiraṇyagarbhaṃ ca brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarān || 1.5.1 0||
golokaṃ cāmṛtaṃ vaikuṇṭhakaṃ śvetaṃ ca dhāma yat |
avyākṛtaṃ tathā dhāma śriyā viṣṇośca dhāma yat || 11 ||
sadāśivakṛtaṃ dhāma mahāmāyāpramaṇḍalam |
caturviṃśatitattvānāṃ dhāmāni vividhāni ca || 12||
sanniveśo yathā yasya yathāśaktibalodayāḥ |
yathā vyavasthayā yatra yādṛśī divyatā parā || 1 3||
yādṛśāni samāścaryaprakārāṇi bhavanti ca |
aiśvaryāṇi camatkārā brahmarasasarāṃsi ca || 14||
iṣṭamiṣṭalatā sampat sviṣṭamiṣṭavibhūtayaḥ |
brahmarasapravāhārthā atyāścaryāṇi yāni vai || 15||
rūpānurūpaghaṭanāḥ kalpānukalpavallayaḥ |
modapramodataravo nandānunandabhūmayaḥ || 16||
tṛptyanutṛptapānāsvādanasaugandhikārcanam |
śaityānuśaityanivahā hrādānuhrādarañjanam || 17||
ye ca yāni yatra yatra citrāścaryāṇi tāni vai |
darśayāmāsa bhagavān śrīhariḥ svatanau tadā || 18||
vāsudevastu bhagavānīśalokānusaṃkṛtīḥ |
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā tu tatpāraṃ nāyān neti jagau tadā || 19||
svavibhūteḥ svayamantaṃ neyāya vāsudevarāṭ |
jagād haraye tāvadananto’si niyāmakaḥ ||1.5.20||
śaśaṃsa bahudhā rūpaṃ vavre jñānaṃ ca naityakam |
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha vaheśasṛṣṭibhāvanam ||21||
prāvirbhāvaya puṃsastrīn īśabhāravahān svakān|
ityājñāṃ samabhigṛhya vāsudevena cātmataḥ ||22||
aniruddhaśca pradyumnaḥ saṃkarṣaṇa iti trayaḥ |
īśvarāṇāntu sarvoṣāṃ sṛjipuṣṭivirāmakāḥ ||23||
samāvirbhāvitāḥ svasmād rājādhirājarājakāḥ |
teṣāmaṃśāstrayo devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||24||
vairājadehotpannānāṃ brahmāṇḍānāṃ niyāmakāḥ |
avarāṇḍapraṇetāro jīvasṛṣṭipraśāsakāḥ ||25||
aniruddhādayastasmādīśatuṣṭipraśāsakāḥ |
parasṛṣṭipraṇetāraḥ paramātmasvarūpakāḥ ||26||
ityevaṃ sṛṣṭivaicitryamīśvarāṇāmanusmṛtam |
tattadīśvarabhāvatvaṃ parabrahmānvayānmatam ||27||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vāsudevasyeśasṛṣṭipradarśananāmā pañcamo’dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||

<1.6>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
vairājasya nābhideśāt kamalaṃ yadajāyata |
tatra caturmukho brahmā samajāyata prāg yathā || 1 ||
tatastannābhideśādvai dvitīyaṃ padmamutthitam |
tatra brahmā dvitīyo’bhūdaṣṭānana iti śrutaḥ || 2 ||
tatastṛtīyapadme tu brahmā ṣoḍaśamastakaḥ |
caturthe kamale brahmā dvātriṃśanmastako hyabhūt || 3 ||
pañcame kamale brahmā pañcāśanmukhavānabhūt |
ṣaṣṭhe jāte tu kamale brahmā śatamukho hyabhūt || 4 ||
tatastu saptame padme brahmā pañcaśatānanaḥ ||
aṣṭame paṃkaje vedhāḥ sahasrānana ityabhūt || 5 ||
brahmā pañcasahasrāsyo jāto vai navame kaje |
daśame hyabhavadbrahmā daśasāhasramastakaḥ || 6 ||
ekādaśe kaje pañcāśatsāhasrānano hyajaḥ |
samudbhūtastathā tu dvādaśe lakṣamukho hyajaḥ || 7 ||
trayodaśe tu kamale dvilakṣamukhavānajaḥ |
padme caturdaśe pañcāśallakṣamukhavānajaḥ || 8 ||
jātaḥ pañcadaśe padme koṭyāsyaśca prajāpatiḥ |
ṣoḍaśe kamale brahmā jajñe hyarbudamastakaḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ saptadaśe padme viśvasṛḍabjamastakaḥ |
aṣṭādaśe tathā padme brahmā kharvapramastakaḥ || 1.6.10 ||
ekonaviṃśake tatra padmāsyaḥ samabhūddhi saḥ |
viṃśake kamale vedhāḥ parārdhamukhavānabhūt || 1 1||
ityevaṃ tatra tatraikakamale brahmakoṭayaḥ |
samudbhūtāḥ sajātīyāḥ saṃkhyāsteṣāmanantakāḥ || 1 2||
tathaiva viṣṇurudrāṇāṃ koṭayaśca tathāvidhāḥ |
tattatsthānātsamutpannāsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || 13||
īśasṛṣṭau yathaiṣāṃ vai pāro nāsti tathā punaḥ |
vairājānāṃ na cāstyantastatpitṝṇāṃ mahātmanām || 14||
mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtīnāmasaṃkhyānāṃ tu tatra vai |
saṃkhyāpāramapārāṇāṃ kenāpyāptuṃ na śakyate || 15||
atha teṣāṃ caturāsyaprabhṛtivedhasāṃ kṛte |
adhikāraḥ sunirṇītaścaturdaśastarātmake || 16||
aṣṭāsyānāṃ tu sattā syādaṣṭāviṃśatibhūstare |
brahmāṇḍe’tha tathā bodhyā ṣoḍaśānanavedhasām || 17||
ṣaṭpañcāśadvivarātmabrahmāṇḍeṣvādhikāritā |
dvātriṃśanmastakānāntu śatastarāṇḍanenṛtā || 18||
śatadvayaprabhūmidhṛgbrahmāṇḍeṣvadhikāritā |
saṃsthāpitā virājeṇa pañcāśanmukhavedhasām || 19||
śatāsyabrahmaṇāṃ paṃcāśatastarāṇḍanetṛtā |
pañcaśatamukhājasya sahasrabilake’ṇḍake ||1.6.20 ||
netṛtādhikṛtā cātha sahasrānanavedhasaḥ |
dvisahasrastarāṇḍeṣu netṛtā vihitā tathā ||21 ||
pañcasahasramukhavadvedhaso netṛtā tathā |
catuḥsahasrakakṣāṇḍe virājeṇa sthirīkṛtā ||22||
daśasahasramukhavadvedhaso’pyadhikāritā |
daśasāhasrakakṣāṇḍe virājeṇa suniścitā ||23||
adhikāripadaṃ pañcāśatsāhasrānanasya tu |
kṛtaṃ viṃśatisāhasravivarāṇḍeṣu tena vai ||24||
lakṣāsyasya catuścatvāriṃśadbilāṇḍakeṣu tat |
dvilakṣamukhavān vedhā lakṣabhūmyaṇḍakāryakṛt |||25||
pañcāśallakṣamukhavān dvilakṣabilakāṇḍake |
kṛto netātha koṭyāsyaḥ pañcalakṣastarāṇḍake ||26||
kṛto netārbudāsyastu daśalakṣastarāṇḍake |
abjāsyo viṃśatilakṣabilāṇḍanetṛtāṃ gataḥ ||27||
kharvāsyastu kṛtaḥ pañcāśallakṣabilakāṇḍake |
netātha padmasakhyāsyaḥ kṛtaḥ koṭistarātmake |||28||
parārdhamukhavān brahmā koṭidaśastarātmake |
brahmāṇḍe sthāpitaścaite hyevamanye’pi cāhitāḥ ||29||
svasvakāryaṃ prakurvanti svādhikārānusārataḥ |
athaikadā virājasya rājasūyamahotsave || 1.6.30 ||
virājasya gṛhe ceśāḥ samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ |
naikabhujā viṣṇavo’pi rudrā vibhinnanetriṇaḥ ||
samājagmuśca vairājā tathānye’pīśvareśvarāḥ ||3 1 ||
tatrotsave samāje vai ko yāyādagrapūjyatām |
itijāte vicāre tu mahān kolāhalo’bhavat || 32
kecidāhuḥ parārdhāsyo brahmāgrapūjyatāṃ labhet |
anye’pyāhuḥ parārdhadṛk śaṃbhuragrārhaṇāṃ labhet ||33 ||
pare tvagrārhaṇāṃ viṣṇuḥ parārdhabhujavām̐llabhet |
itivāde vivāde ca nirṇayaṃ naiva lebhire ||34||
tadā vicāritaṃ sarvairvāde jāte parasparam |
vṛddhānāṃ vacanaṃ grāhyaṃ kārye vādādivibhrame || 5||
vṛddhastu prapitā teṣāṃ mahāviṣṇustu buddhimān |
yaṃ vai nirṇayamāsthāya darśayet sa bhavenmataḥ ||36||
iti te samayaṃ kṛtvā mahāviṣṇoḥ samantike |
natvā nivedayāmāsuḥ sarvaṃ vṛttāntamīśvarāḥ || 37||
mahāviṣṇuḥ kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā prāha pautrān vicāritam |
bhavantastu trayastulyāḥ samānabalaśālinaḥ || 38 ||
samapūjyāḥ samaśreṣṭhāḥ samakāryavahāstathā |
parasparaṃ na vai nyūnāḥ pūjanārhāstrayo’pi hi || 29 ||
tathāpi rājasūye tu pūjaikasya bhavediti |
vicāryaiva bhavanto vai nirṇayaṃ yāntu ceśvarāḥ ||1.6.40 ||
ekasmai pūjyatā deyā dvābhyāṃ grāhyānuvṛttitā |
ityājñāpya mahāviṣṇurmaunamāsthāya saṃsthitaḥ ||4 1 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bahuvidhabrahmādīnāmadhikārādivarṇananāmā ṣaṣṭho’dhyāyaḥ ||6 ||

<1.7>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tatasteṣāṃ trayāṇāntu syāgrapūjyatvalabdhaye |
durāgraheṇa mahatā jātaḥ kolāhalaḥ paraḥ || 1 ||
ahaṃ pūrvaṃ tu pūjyaḥ syāṃ na tvaṃ nānya itīśvarāḥ |
svasya pūjyatvasaṃprāptyai kalahaṃ samacakrire || 2 ||
tiraskurvanti cānyonyamadhikṣepaṃ dadhatyapi |
duruktairvākprabāṇaiśca vidhyanta iva marmasu || 3 ||
kalahaṃ cakrire yāvattāvatteṣāṃ matānugāḥ |
koṭiśo viṣṇavo rudrā brahmāṇaḥ samudāyudhāḥ || 4 ||
yuyudhurbhṛśamatyugramardanaṃ tadabhūnmahat |
yadaikasya prapūjyatve nirṇayo na kṛtaśca taiḥ || 5 ||
tadā vairājapuruṣairmahāviṣṇusamanvitaiḥ |
īśo devo hariḥ sākṣānnirṇayāya samarthitaḥ || 6 ||
paraṃbrahma svayaṃ teṣāmarthanāmavagatya vai |
nyāyālayaṃ paraṃ sthānamavyākṛtasudhāma yat || 7 ||
viracayyākṣare dhāmni nyāyakartāpi ca svayam |
bhūmapūruṣarūpeṇa nyāyādhīśo virājitaḥ || 8 ||
nyāyasampādakāścānye īśvarāstena yojitāḥ |
bhūmnā svasya vāmabhāgād bhūmnī lakṣmīḥ prasaṃkṛtā || 9 ||
sāpi nyāyaparādhīśā nyāyakartrī pareśvarī |
avyākṛtaṃ ca taddhāma bhūmabhūmnyoḥ paraṃ kṛtam || 1.7.10 ||
nyāyakartryastathā nyāyādhīśāstatrāpyanekaśaḥ |
upanirṇayadāḥ santi parāvaraniyāmakāḥ || 11 ||
santi prakṛtipuruṣapradhānapuruṣātmakaḥ |
mahāviṣṇuvirājādīśvarāṇāṃ nirṇayapradāḥ || 12||
tatra tatra teṣu teṣu sthāneṣvīśvarakoṭayaḥ |
nyūnātiriktasukhadaiśvaryavatyo bhavanti hi || 13 ||
parārdhabhujavān viṣṇuḥ pūjyo rājasusammataḥ |
bhūmnā nyāyaḥ kṛtastadvad rājasūyo’pi nirvṛtaḥ || 14||
nyāyājñayā kṛtanyāyaprotasarveśasṛṣṭibhiḥ |
phalantu nyāyakāryasya tatra tatra hyavāpyate || 15||
ekarājakṣaye’nyasya paṭṭābhiṣekasūtsavaḥ |
kārye vinimaye prāpte netṝṇāṃ parivartanam || 16||
yuddhakāle vināśe vā cākasmika upadrave |
vyūhāṃśavibhavāveśavibhūtīnāṃ prakāśane || 17||
brahmāṇḍeṣvavatārāṇāṃ preṣaṇe ca vikarṣaṇe |
sarvathāpyadhikāro’sti bhūmno bhagavataḥ sadā || 18 ||
śrīharistu svayaṃ sākṣādbhūmūpūruṣarūpataḥ |
avyākṛte svake dhāmni nyāyakāryārthamāsthitaḥ || 1 9||
brahmāṇḍe ca yadā yarhi yasmin yasmin sthale sthale |
hānirdharmasya budhyeta tadāṃśaṃ prerayatyayam ||1.7.20||
rāmakṛṣṇādayaḥ sarve vibhinnā vai yuge yuge |
avatārā anantā vai bhavantyaṇḍe pṛthakpṛthak ||21|||
īśvarāṇāṃ ca lokeṣu hyavatārā anantakāḥ |
bhavanti samaśīlāstatsamarūpāḥ samakriyāḥ ||22||
śrīhareravatārāṇāṃ nāntaḥ saṃkhyā na vidyate |
kālānantyātsṛṣṭyapārātkāryānantyācca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 23 ||
atheśvarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvadā sukhalabdhaye |
śrīhariṇā hṛdi dhyātaṃ tapaścātha bṛhadvratam || 24||
sarveśvarāḥ sadā santu sukhinaḥ sattvasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
prakṛtipūruṣaścātha pradhānapuruṣastathā ||25|||
bhūmapūruṣalokasthā mahāviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
hiraṇyagarbhā vairājā aṣṭāvaraṇakeśvarāḥ ||26|||
golokasthā vikuṇṭhasthāḥ śvetadvīpasthitāstathā |
avyākṛtasthitā viṣṇurudramāyākṣarasthitāḥ ||27||
sarve bhavantu sukhinaḥ sadā mattapasā tviti |
dayayā hariṇā caivaṃ kṛtaṃ dhāma tapaḥkṛte ||28||
akṣarākhyapradeśe taddivyaṃ badarikāśramam |
tapastyāgamayaṃ ramyaṃ śāntyānandamayaṃ sadā ||29||
bṛhadvratadharaṃ rūpaṃ divyaṃ śrīhariṇā dhṛtam |
sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī divyaṣoḍaśavārṣikaḥ ||1.7.3 0||
akṣareṇa tadā tasya sevārthaṃ rūpamarthitam |
narākāraṃ ca tadrūpa dhṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśavārṣikam || 3 1||
sevakaḥ sa naraḥ svāmī nārāyaṇa iti hariḥ |
naranārāyaṇaḥ so’yamakṣarādiparaḥ prabhuḥ ||32||
rājate tatra tejasvī brahmavarcasvavāridhiḥ |
ūrdhvasrotā brahmacārī naranārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||33||
īśvarāstatra gacchanti darśanārthaṃ harermuhuḥ |
muktāstatra hyasaṃkhyātā kāśyo naiṣṭhikāḥ sthitāḥ ||34||
te vai dayālavaḥ śāntāḥ sādhavo munayo matāḥ |
īśānāntu gṛhasthānāmuddhārakaraṇāya vai ||35||
bhramantīśvaralokeṣu śaraṇāgatarakṣakāḥ |
mantraṃ nārāyaṇasyaiva datvā mokṣaṃ nayantyapi ||36 ||
upāsanāṃ hareḥ sākṣātparabrahmaṇa ityapi |
pravartayanti ceśeṣu mokṣayanti ca tām̐stataḥ ||37||
goloko’pyatha vaikuṇṭhaḥ śvetadvīpo’tha divyakaḥ |
avyākṛtaśca badarikāśramaśceti nāmabhiḥ || 38||
kīrtyamānāni dhāmāni dīvyānyakṣaradhāmani |
akṣarasya pradeśeṣu hariṇā racitāni hi || 39||
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīrāmacandraḥ śrīnārāyaṇaṃ ityayam |
śrībhūmā śrīnaranārāyaṇaḥ śrīharireva ca ||1.7.40 ||
svayaṃ brahmeśvaraḥ sākṣādakṣarādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ |
brahmalokeśvarastāni rūpāṇi dhārayatyataḥ ||41||
puruṣottamasaṃjño yo bhagavānparameśvaraḥ |
sarvatra saṃsthitaḥ so’yaṃ bhinnarūpeṇa rājate ||42||
dhāmnastvakṣarasaṃjñasya pradeśeṣu kṛtāni vai |
dhāmānyanyāni tatteṣu sarvatrākṣaramasti hi ||43||
tasmād golokādimadhye dhāma vyāpakamakṣaram |
paraṃdhāma brahmalokaḥ sarvatrāstīti varṇyate ||44||
īśvarāṇāṃ ca lokānāṃ sīmā prakṛtirucyate |
sīmni dhāmāni caitāni brahmalagnāni santi hi ||45||
tasmādakṣarasaṃjñāste’kṣaravyāpyā bhavanti ca |
prakṛteḥ sparśarahitāḥ prakṛterupari sthitāḥ ||46||
lokā mokṣabhūmayaste gadyante marmavedibhiḥ |
itīśasṛṣṭisaṃsthānaṃ lakṣmi saṃjñeyamañjasā ||47||
tavaiva sarvasāmarthyaṃ tavaivaitatprabhāvajam |
sarvamīśvarasaṃsthānaṃ tvāṃ vinā naiva śobhate ||48||
tvaṃ cāhaṃ ca sadā tatra sarvātmarūpadhārakau |
tvāṃ vinā na mameśatvaṃ māṃ vinā na ratistvayi |||49||
saccitoḥ sarvathā tatra prānandaḥ sukhamucyate |
sarve lokā īśvarāścāśnuvate sukhamāvayoḥ ||1.7.50 ||
tasmānnārāyaṇalakṣmyātmakamīśvaramaṇḍalam |
prādurbhūtaṃ tadāvābhyāṃ tirobhavati cāvayoḥ ||51 ||
ātyantike laye līnaṃ prāraṃbhe punarutthitam |
bhavatīti vicāryaiva bhajantīśāḥ sadā nu mām ||52||
madaiśvaryaṃ samāpannā īśvarā madadhiṣṭhitāḥ |
madyogādīśvarā jātā madvinā neśvarā iti ||63||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’vyākṛtadhāmabadarikāśramadhāmapradarśananāmā saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ||7||

<1.8>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
namaḥ parasmai devāya bhūmne śaktitrayāya ca |
sākṣiṇe dehināṃ madhye’nupalakṣyātmavartmane || 1 ||
namo bhūyaḥ satāṃ gottre’satāṃ nāśāptabhūtaye |
namo nirastasāmyātiśayāya dhāmni raṃsyate || 2 ||
kuyogināṃ vidūrāya sannikṛṣṭāya te namaḥ |
nārāyaṇaparā vedā nārāyaṇaparā makhāḥ || 3 ||
nārāyaṇaparaṃ jñānaṃ sṛjirnārāyaṇātmikā |
nārāyaṇa idaṃ sarvaṃ nārāyaṇaparā gatiḥ || 4 ||
guṇatrayaṃ samāgṛhya nirguṇo’pi hariḥ svayam |
vairājapuruṣo bhūtvā sasarjāpaḥ svadehataḥ || 5 ||
āpo nārā iti bodhyā āpastu naraputrikāḥ |
kṛtvā tāsvayanaṃ śete tato nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 ||
jale tatra śayānasyātītāḥ sahasravatsarāḥ |
tadā tannābhito nālaṃ pādmaṃ prādurbabhūva ha || 7 ||
padmoparyabhavadbrahmā nārāyaṇasamīhayā |
sa dadarśābhito vāri nānyatsa pramumoha ca || 8 ||
kathaṃ kasmātkutaścāhaṃ kiṃ karomyatra kevale |
tasmānmūlaṃ madīyaṃ vai didṛkṣāmyanunālataḥ || 9 ||
niścityaivaṃ svayaṃ nāle brahmā saṃpraviveśa ha |
caturyugasahasraṃ taccacālāntaṃ na cāptavāna || 10 ||
tadā viśramya tannāle nyavartata yadā tu saḥ |
yogasiddhisahāyena vegādupari saṃsthitaḥ || 11 ||
kimarthaṃ vā kathaṃ cāhaṃ samutpanno jale kaje |
vicārayati yāvatsa vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 1 2||
tapaḥ kuru sthitastatra kāle jñānaṃ bhaviṣyati |
vetsyasi svajanerarthaṃ śrutvā tāṃ tapa āsthitaḥ || 13||
tato jñānaṃ hyabhūttasya sṛṣṭyarthaṃ me janistviyam |
sṛṣṭistu kīdṛśī kāryā mayetyarthe mano dadhau || 14||
tāvannārāyaṇamūrtau sṛṣṭiṃ pūrvāṃ dadarśa ha |
pūrvātpūrvatarāṃ cāpi dṛṣṭvā saṃmumude sa ca || 15||
tapomahimnā svaguruṃ hariṃ sa vai samādhimāpyānudadarśa kāraṇam |
kṛtvā jale vai śayanaṃ mahāprabhuṃ samastasṛṣṭyanvitacitrarūpakam | 16|
divyena cakṣuṣā tatra vairāje jaḍacetanam |
bhāvi sṛṣṭyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭavān nāmarūpakam || 17||
pādamūle’sya pātālaṃ pārṣṇibhāge rasātalam |
dadarśa gulphayorasya lokaṃ brahmā mahātalam || 18||
talātalaṃ tathā lokaṃ jaṃghayoḥ sa dadarśa vai |
jānvostu sutalaṃ lokamurvostu vitalātale || 19||
bhūtalaṃ sakthimūle’tha nābhau bhuvardivaṃ hṛdi |
grīvāyāntu maharlokamāsye janaṃ dadarśa saḥ ||1.8. 20|||
lalāṭe’sya tapolokaṃ satyaṃ śirṣṇi vyacaṣṭa saḥ |
bāhvorindrādidevām̐śca karṇayordiśa eva ca ||21||
śrotre śabdaṃ ca nāsatyau nāsārandhre dadarśa saḥ |
ghrāṇe gandhaṃ mukhe vahniṃ dyāṃ tu netradvayāṇḍayoḥ ||22||
cakṣuṣoḥ sūryacandrau tatpakṣmaṇordivasaṃ niśām |
bhrūvilāse parameṣṭhipadaṃ tālau jalaṃ tathā ||23||
jihvāyāntu rasām̐stasya daṃṣṭrāyāṃ yamamityapi |
medhāyāṃ cāsya chandāṃsi kaṭākṣe kālaviplavam ||24||
uttarauṣṭhe tathā vrīḍāmadharauṣṭhe tu gardhanam |
stanayorubhayordharmaṃ pṛṣṭhe’dharmaṃ tu dṛṣṭavān |||25||
śiśne prajāpatiṃ mitrāvaruṇau tu tadaṇḍayoḥ |
kukṣiṣvasya mamudrām̐śca girīnasthiṣu dṛṣṭavān |||26 ||
nadīrnāḍīsu vṛkṣām̐stu vyācaṣṭe sa hi romasu |
śvāse vāyuṃ gatau kālaṃ meghānkeśeṣu tasya vai ||27||
sandhyāṃ vāsasi hṛdaye māyāṃ manasi candrakam |
citte mahadahaṃkāre rudraṃ nakhe gajāśvakān || 28||
naipuṇye pakṣiṇaḥ sarvān buddhau svāyaṃbhuvaṃ manum |
nitambayormṛgānsarvānsmṛtau gandharva gāyakān ||25||
vīrye tvāsurasainyāni mukhe’sya brāhmaṇām̐stathā |
bhujayoḥ kṣatriyānūrvorvaiśyānaṃghrau tu śūdrakān |||1.8.3 0 ||
sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ yāvat sṛjya svenaṃ bhavettu yat |
sarvaṃ vairājadehe’yaṃ brahmā samyak dadarśa ha ||3 1 ||
kāryaṃ yasya yathā yāvat karaṇaṃ yasya yad yathā |
kāryayogasamākṛṣṭiśleṣāvirbhāvavaibhavam ||32||
hastāmalakavatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭavān sa prajāpatiḥ |
tattvādhīnāṃ mano’dhīnāṃ dvedhā jñātvātha padmajaḥ ||33 ||
bījajāṃ mānasī ceti sṛṣṭiṃ pratiṃ mumoda ha |
pūrvaṃ naṣṭāṃ smṛtiṃ labdhvā brahmā tuṣṭāva keśavam ||34||
namaḥ sṛṣṭisvarūpāya namo vairājamūrtaye |
namo’vāntarasargāya namo brahmādirūpiṇe |||35||
namo hiraṇyagarbhāya mahāviṣṇutvarūpiṇe |
namaḥ pradhānapataye prakṛtisvāmine namaḥ ||26||
namo bhūmne’niruddhāya pradyumnāya ca te namaḥ |
namaḥ saṃkarṣaṇākhyāya vāsudevāya te namaḥ ||27||
namo mahāpūruṣāya mahākālāya te namaḥ |
namo’kṣaranivāsāya muktāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||30||
vyāpakāya pareśāya naikarūpāya te namaḥ |
sati tvayi viparyāso vivartaḥ pariṇāmakaḥ ||29||
jagato’sya bhavennūnaṃ tadabhinnāya te namaḥ |
sākṣiṇe sarvanetrāya svarāje ca namo namaḥ ||1.8.40 ||
nānāścaryanivāsāya nānārūpadharāya ca |
bhinnātmadarśine pūrvaṃ paścādekātmadarśine ||41||
anvitānanvitārthāya namaḥ sadasadātmane |
paramāṇusvarūpāya vyāpakāya ca te namaḥ || 42||
tridhācchedavihīnāya srīpuṃrūpātmane namaḥ |
namo jñānāya divyāya jñeyāya jñātṛrūpiṇe ||43 ||
namo mānasvarūpāya mānāya mitaye namaḥ
pramātre ca namaste’stu satkāryāya ca te namaḥ |44||
phalavyāptisvarūpāya śrutivādāya te namaḥ |
vaptivaśrāntisvarūpāya namo jñaptilayātmane ||47||
prakāśākāśatanave divyādivyaguṇātmane |
sarve yasmādyatra sarva yaśca sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ ||46||
svapnāsvapnobhayārthāya śāstre te’stu namo namaḥ |
tvayā kṛpālunā deva hṛtkapāṭa pravodhitam ||47||
yadartha tatkariṣye’haṃ tatra mā vismara prabho |
tvatpradattaprabodhena kariṣye sargaghaṭṭanām ||48||
tatra me bandhanaṃ mā syātsāhāyyaṃ prārthaye tava |
sarvakāryasamutpāde klṛptidarśakaro bhava ||49||
iti stutvā svayaṃ brahmā tūṣṇīmāsa kṣaṇāntare |
tāvannārāyaṇenāpi saṃhṛtaṃ naikabhāvanam ||1.8.50 ||
vairājasya svarūpantu yāvatpaśyati padmajaḥ |
tāvadvairājahṛddeśādviṣṇuḥ prādurbabhūva ha |||51||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇaḥ saṣṭijñānaprāptyādinirūpaṇanāmā aṣṭamo’dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||

<1.9>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
viṣṇuḥ sarvaguṇopetaḥ sarvapoṣaṇaśaktimān |
sarvāścaryanidhiḥ śrīmān kundanābhimahojjvalaḥ || 1 ||
prāntabhugnapiśaṃgābhasnigdhakeśāktamastakaḥ |
naikaratnamaṇiprotasauvarṇamukuṭāvahaḥ || 2 ||
śaṣkulyākṛtisatkarṇadhṛtasauvarṇakuṇḍalaḥ |
viśālojjvalarekhātrayayugbhālasthacandrakaḥ || 3 ||
kaisaraṃ tilakaṃ bibhrat lalāṭe’gurucandanaḥ |
kāmabāṇaprarohārhavakrabhrūkuṭibhaṃguraḥ || 4 ||
aravindadalāśubhraprāntaraktābhanetrakaḥ |
kajjalāñjanasaṃsiktākarṇāntākṣiprakoṇakaḥ || 5 ||
tilapuṣpapraphullābhanāsiko dīrghagaṇḍakaḥ |
suvartulasamākāraraktadvayakapolakaḥ || 6 ||
sugandhapadmakeyūro divyapuṣpāvataṃsakaḥ |
śuddhacāmīkarakarṇapūrakarṇaṭibhūṣaṇaḥ || 7 ||
sūkṣmanīlahiraṇyāgrodbhavacchmaśruprasundaraḥ |
raktabimbābhasaddhāsyasamāśritasamauṣṭhakaḥ || 8 ||
kambukaṇṭhaḥ sucibukastejomaṇḍalakaṃdharaḥ |
dedīpyamānavapuṣā hṛttimirapraṇāśakaḥ || 9 ||
pauṣpān hārām̐śca sauvarṇān gale bibhratsukaustubham |
supuṣṭāṃsaḥ supralambabhogapūvārdhabāhukaḥ || 1.9.10 ||
ājānulambahastaśca suprakoṣṭhaścaturbhujaḥ |
vidyotaccandrasadṛśanakharaktakaradvayaḥ || 11 ||
svarṇāṃgulīyasattejoratnanaddhasupadmakaḥ |
dhanuścakradhvajasvastikenamīnāṃkahastakaḥ || 12||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmahetirhāradharaḥ prabhuḥ |
śrīvatsāṃkaḥ suraśanaḥ kundadantaḥ supṛṣṭhakaḥ || 13|
viśālonnatasadvakṣāḥ puṣṭakaṭisuliṅgakaḥ |
karihastoruyugalaḥ samavartulajānukaḥ || 14||
kramavṛttāpuṣṭajaghaḥ samanimnasupattalaḥ |
madhyanimnonnataraktacārudṛśyapadāmbujaḥ || 15||
sarvatīrthāśrayapuṇyaprapadaḥ pāṇḍuracchaviḥ |
aṅgulyuparisatsūkṣmaromarājivirājitaḥ || 16 ||
sūkṣmaromāvalirājattattadvīryasukukṣikaḥ |
trigulphacaraṇaḥ śrīmān sarvābharaṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || 17 ||
amlānamadhusatsaurabhārdravividhapuṣpayā |
virājito vaijayantyā divyayā vanamālayā || 18 ||
padmaketvaṃkuśavajrasvastikajavajambavaḥ |
aṣṭakoṇordhvarekhe’ṅkāni pade dakṣiṇe nava || 1 9||
mīnārdhacandrakalaśatrikoṇavyomagoṣpadam |
dhanuśceti pade vāme sapta cihnāni saṃdadhat || 1.9.20 ||
āprāntadvayasaṃlagnavistīrṇabhālarekhayā |
ṣaḍvidhaṃ bhagamaiśvaryaṃ vyañjayan sāttvikīṃ janim || 21 ||
vāme sakthini sattejaḥpāṇḍurāṃkaṃ tu sundaram |
sahajāyāstu lakṣmyāstaccandrābhaṃ cihnamudvahan || 22||
etādṛśo’bhavadviṣṇurbahurūpaguṇāśrayaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā brahmā svayaṃbhūstaṃ sṛṣṭinetrabhimānavān || 23 ||
ko’yamanyo’bhavadrūpaguṇavīryabalādhikaḥ |
itikṛtvāpṛcchadenaṃ viṣṇuṃ lokaprapoṣakam || 24||
kastvametādṛśo vidvan matpratidvandvarūpakaḥ |
sṛṣṭeḥ kartāhameko’smi sarvaiśvaryavibhūtimān || 25||
sarvadhātā sarvapoṣṭā sarvanetṛtvamāvahan |
matto nānyo’sti kaścidvai sṛṣṭeḥ saṃhārapoṣakaḥ || 26||
ko vai hetustavotpattau kiṃkartā kiṃvidhāyakaḥ |
madvirodhaṃ prakurvan vai na kaścitsukhabhāgbhavet || 27||
bhūtvā prahasya viṣṇustaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pratyuvāca ha |
sṛṣṭirmayi tvaha sṛṣṭau cāhaṃ sṛṣṭimayo vibhuḥ || 28 ||
tvādṛśāḥ padmajā naike mayi līnāḥ samāsate |
ahamanādinidhano dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ || 29||
vyāpyavyāpakabhāvena viśvamāvṛtya yaḥ sthitaḥ |
sarvasṛṣṭimayo devo’nantabrahmādisaṃstutaḥ || 1.9.30 ||
so’haṃ nārāyaṇo viṣṇurnānyaḥ kaścitparaḥ samaḥ |
gaccha dūramito no cedvināśaṃ yāsyasi dhruvam || 31 ||
iti viṣṇuvacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
prāha viṣṇuṃ ca mā garva kuru darśanabāliśaḥ || 32||
māvamaṃsthāśca māṃ deva eṣa tvāṃ nāśayāmyaham |
ityuccārya tu saṃrabdhau parasparajighāṃsayā || 33 ||
ahameva varo natvamahamekaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
itibruvau hantukāmau cakraturyuddharaṃbhaṇam || 34||
yuyudhāte parau vīrau mānavyājau mahāyudhau |
ahaṃkāraniveśādvai yuddhaṃ tayorbabhūva ha ||25 ||
īśvarāstatsamakakṣāḥ samājagmurdidṛkṣavaḥ |
kṣipantaḥ puṣpavarṣāṇi paśyanto yuddhavartinau |||36||
tāvat kruddho haristatra bāṇānmumoca duḥsahān |
astrāṇi vividhān kṣepān brahmavakṣasi pāragān ||37||
atha brahmā paraṃ kruddhau viṣṇorvakṣasi duḥsahān |
bāṇān vidyutsatejaskānastrāṇi vividhāni ca ||38||
mumoceti tayoryuddhaṃ drāgāścaryakaraṃ hyabhūt |
prasamīkṣyeśvarāḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ samākulāḥ |||3 9 ||
viṣṇurvegavaśo bhūtvāgnyastraṃ mumoca vedhase |
parjanyāstreṇa vidhinā tadastraṃ sannivāritam || 1.9.40||
viṣṇunā preritaṃ tatra vidyudastraṃ sameghakam |
brahmaṇā nāśitaṃ tadvai vāyvastreṇa mahāmbare || 41 ||
viṣṇuryuyoja giryastraṃ ko vajrāstraṃ mumoca ha |
harirnāgāstramasṛjad brahmā cikṣepa gāruḍam ||42||
hariṇā prahitaṃ bhāraṃ laghimnā brāhmaṇā hṛtam |
viyogaśaktimudyamya viṣṇurjaghāna korasi |||43 ||
brahmā śūlena tāṃ chitvā jṛmbhaṇāstraṃ mumoca ha |
viṣṇurnidrāpramantreṇa jṛmbhaṇaṃ pravilayya ca || 44||
jagrāha yāvadbrahmāstraṃ brahmā cāpi ca tad dadhe |
dvayorbrahmāstrayoryuddhaṃ praghoraṃ cāmbare’bhavan ||45||
mahānalāstato jātā īśasṛṣṭipradāhakāḥ |
viṣṇustvāvat svakaṃ cakraṃ saṃjagrāha sudarśanam || 46||
koṭisūryasamānograṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ vināśakam |
īśāstāvattu santrastā hāhākāraṃ pracakrire || 47||
brahmaṇastu vināśāya yāvatprerayati prabhuḥ |
tāvad brahmā viṣṇunāmabhaktyākhyaṃ kavacaṃ dadhau || 48||
viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devo mayyāvasatu duḥkhahāḥ |
paraṃbrahma śiraḥ pātu brahma pātu galaṃ mama || 49||
vāsudeva uraḥ pātu kaṭiṃ pātvaniruddhakaḥ |
pradyumna udaraṃ pātu saṃkarṣaṇastu pṛṣṭhakam |||1.9.50||
bhūmā śiśnaṃ tu me pātu mahāviṣṇustu sakthinī |
hiraṇyagarbho me jānū jaṃghe vairājapūruṣaḥ ||5 1 ||
gulphau pradhānapuruṣaḥ pādau prakṛtipūruṣaḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ pūrvaṃ hariḥ paścād vaikuṇṭhaścottare’vatu ||52||
nārāyaṇastu paścānme’ntaryāmī sarvato’vatu |
viṣṇustvaṃ mayi sarvāṃge praviśyāvatu māṃ vibho ||53||
sattvāśrayastu me sattvaṃ pātu nārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
raktāśrayastu me raktaṃ pātu śrībhagavān svayam |||54||
bhayāśrayaṃ tu māṃ pātu cakrī cābhayadānadaḥ |
nālasthitaṃ tu māṃ pātu nālodbhavakaraḥ prabhuḥ ||55||
ākasmikamahāduḥkhātpāhi māṃ śaraṇāgatam |
brahmāstre śāntaya cakraṃ saṃharādya dyāṃ kuru ||56 ||
stutvetthaṃ paramaṃ devaṃ brahmā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha |
brahmabhaktiṃ samajñāya viṣṇuścakraṃ mumoca na ||57||
paraṃ brahmāstrayostejaḥ saṃhārārthaṃ mano dadhe |
saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpo yaḥ paraṃbrahma janārdanaḥ ||58 ||
mahājyotirmayastambho dvayormadhye babhūva saḥ |
brahmāstre cāpi te tāvatsarvasaṃhārasakṣame ||99 ||
nililyāte kṣaṇenaiva mahājyotirmaye’nale |
astraśāntikaraṃ tejaḥ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā tadadbhutam ||1.9.6 0 ||
brahmā viṣṇustatheśā ye tatra santi samāgatāḥ |
lebhire vismayaṃ mugdhāḥ kimetajjyotirityaho ||6 1 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaviṣṇvorvivādabhaktikavacādinirūpaṇanāmā navamo’dhyāyaḥ || 9||

<1.10>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ahau tejomayaṃ bimbaṃ staṃbhākāraṃ kimutthitam |
asyordhvaṃ ca tathādhastād brahmatejomayaṃ nvidam || 1 ||
ititarkayatostatra paśyatośca kṣaṇāntare |
tayostu devayoryuddhyad brahmāstre dve layaṃ gate || 2 ||
staṃbhatejasi līnatvādastrayorbrahmarūpiṇoḥ |
dvayormadhye mahān kaḥ syādityanirṇayataḥ punaḥ || 3 ||
brahmāstragrāsasāmarthyāśrayasyāsya tu yo dvayoḥ |
adhaḥprāntaṃ paraṃ prāntaṃ nayet so’stu mahāniti || 4 ||
evaṃ saṃketamāsthāya militau vīramāninau |
pratasthāte’tha kāryantu dvayorekaṃ na saṃbhavet || 5 ||
vicāryeti harirviṣṇuḥ gāruḍaṃ rūpamāptavān |
brahmā haṃsatanurbhūtvā tadantaṃ vīkṣituṃ gataḥ || 6 ||
viṣṇurvarṣaśataṃ divyaṃ dūrād dūrataraṃ gataḥ |
nāpaśyattu yadā tasya staṃbhasya mūlamityataḥ || 7 ||
atiśrāntaśca nirviṇṇaḥ prāpa pūrvaṃ raṇājiram |
brahmā varṣaśataṃ divyamūrdhvādūrdhvataraṃ gataḥ || 8 ||
agatvāntaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā cintāmagno hyajāyata |
tadānīmeva samaye jyotirūpaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ || 9 ||
vyacintayadaho devau kīdṛśau bālavanmatau |
anantasyāprameyasya me mānaṃ kartumudyatau || 1.10.10 ||
naikasyāpi gabhasterme prāntaṃ prāptumapi svayam |
vāsudevo’pi saṃśaktaḥ kā vārtānyeśamāninām || 11 ||
parihāsaṃ vidhāyetthaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ cakāra ha |
tāvajjyotiśśirobhāgātpuṣpaṃ vai patitaṃ śubham || 12||
ketakyāḥ saurabhaṃ puṣpaṃ divyayugaśatacyutam |
brahmā dadarśa tatpuṣpaṃ patamānaṃ tadagrataḥ || 13 ||
papraccha ca vidhiḥ kiṃ tvaṃ kasmātpatasi puṣparāṭ |
śrutvā prāha vidhiṃ puṣpaṃ dhṛto’haṃ paramātmanā || 14 ||
svena jyotiḥsvarūpeṇa mūrdhni tasmātpatāmyaham |
vyatītaṃ me yugaśataṃ patatastasya mūrdhataḥ || 15 ||
tathāpyalpapramāṇo vai mārgaḥ prollaṃghito mayā |
na paśyāmi gabhastestu kadā prānto bhaviṣyati || 1 6||
tasmāttvamapi jahyāśāmanantasyāntadarśane |
parāvṛtya tadā brahmā ketakyā saha mantraṇām || 17||
kṛtavān yat sakhe me’dya tvayā kartavyamīpsitam |
viṣṇostu sannidhau vācyaṃ tvayaitadvai mayā saha || 18||
dhātrā dṛṣṭo jyotiṣo’ntastatra sākṣyahamacyuta |
itikṛtvā ketakaṃ tu brahmā nanāma vai muhuḥ || 19 ||
asatyamapi śastaṃ syādāpatkāle hi śāsanāt |
brahmapuṣpe samāyāte yatrābhūdvai raṇāṃgaṇam || 1.10.20 ||
brahmā samīkṣya viṣṇuṃ ca jayahīnaṃ nanarta ha |
uvāca kapaṭī ṣaṇḍhaḥ satyādhāraṃ tu keśavam || 21 ||
jyotiḥsvarūpasya paraṃ tu cāntaṃ
dṛṣṭvā nu devātra samāgato’ham |
athātra sākṣī khalu ketako’yaṃ
papracchaviṣṇo nu mahānahaṃ hi || 22 ||
kūṭasākṣye kṛtaṃ tadvai ketakena mṛṣāpi san |
brahmā cāntaṃ jagāme’ti viṣṇuḥ satyamamanyata || 23 ||
namaskṛtvā vedhase ca matvā svasya śiromaṇim |
ṣoḍaśairupacāraiśca pūjayāmāsa vedhasam || 24||
brahmaṇā tu prasahyāptaṃ mahattvaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇā |
brahmaketakayostatra daṇḍaṃ kartuṃ mahāprabhuḥ || 25||
parabrahma svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svajyotīrūpamadhyataḥ |
prādurbabhūva sākāraḥ sa sadāśivarūpadhṛk || 26 ||
saṃkarṣaṇāṃśa ityukto layakṛtsa sadāśivaḥ |
parabrahmasvarūpasya saṃkarṣaṇamahātmanaḥ || 27||
śirasaḥ kiraṇaṃ caikaṃ jyotiḥstaṃbho’bhavat khalu |
tasya bāṇasvarūpatvaṃ liṃgarūpatvamityapi ||28|||
brahmatejaḥsvarūpatvamarcimārgatvamityapi |
suṣumṇātejaso rāśirbrahma cāpi nirākṛti || 29||
anākāraṃ śaṃbhutattvaṃ kīrtyate bahunāmabhiḥ |
parabrahmalalāṭotthakiraṇāntarato janeḥ |||1.10.3 0||
lalāṭācchivasaṃbhūtiriti vedaḥ pravaktyapi |
sākāraṃ saccidānandaṃ śivaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu padmajaḥ |||3 1 ||
sakampaḥ prāṃjalirbhūtvā parigṛhya ca tatpadam |
satriśūlaṃ śivaṃ prāha kṣamasva parameśvara ||32|||
mama kalmaṣanāśāya bhavān daṇḍadharaḥ prabhuḥ |
prādurbhūto mahādeva prasīda karuṇākara || 33||
śādhi māṃ mohamāpannaṃ mṛṣā gauravamāśritam |
śaraṇya śaraṇāyātaṃ trāhi māṃ bhrātaraṃ tava ||34||
mohabuddhyā mayā tatra kṛtaṃ viṣṇoramānanam |
viṣṇurasti parabrahma mahān mānyo’sti me sadā || 35||
tasmāt kṣamasva deveśānṛtaṃ māṃ daṇḍamāvaha |
parabrahmasvarūpatvaṃ parabrahmātmako hariḥ ||36||
dvayorbhedaṃ na kurvīta bhedadraṣṭā patatyadhaḥ |
ajānatā mayā cedṛṅmahimā śrījanārdanaḥ ||37||
atīvāvamataścāpyanṛtaṃ proktaṃ tathā punaḥ |
atastaddoṣapātratvād daṇḍyo’haṃ bhagavam̐stvayā|| 38||
śiraśchindhyanṛtaṃ chindhi chindhi vā kalmaṣaṃ mama |
bhedadṛṣṭiṃ ca me chindhi yatheṣṭaṃ kuru śaṃkara || 39||
tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ pareśānastvaṃ devaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
tvaṃ jyotistvaṃ nirākāro vyāpako brahma ityapi ||1.10.40||
tvaṃ sākāraḥ parabrahma jyotiṣo mūlameva ca |
tava brahmanmukhatejaḥparidheḥ kiraṇaṃ tu yat ||41 ||
anantapāraṃ sandṛṣṭaṃ tasya te mahimā mahān |
śāntiṃ dehi kṣamāṃ dehi trāhi tvaccharaṇāgatam ||42||
prārthayitvetthamīśeśaṃ brahmajyotiḥsthamacyutam |
parabrahmākṛtiṃ devaṃ mahādevaṃ sadāśivam ||43 ||
namaskṛtya punarnatvā muhurnatvāpatat pade |
tūṣṇīmāsa yadā brahmā tamutthāpyābravīcchivaḥ ||44||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tejomayabrahmaliṃgāvirbhāvapūrvakaśaṃkaraprāvirbhāvavarṇananāmā daśamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 0||

<1.11>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
līnamarthaṃ yato gacchettato liṃgamudīritam |
līno brahmaparaḥ śrīmān puruṣottamakeśavaḥ || 1 ||
taṃ vai gamayate tasya tejomaṇḍalamātrakam |
tadvai tejo bhavelliṃgaṃ bāṇaṃ ceti prakīrtitam || 2 ||
tejastejasvinostatrābhedāttejo hariḥ svayam |
tasmācchivastathā liṅgaṃ parabrahmeti vaidikāḥ || 3 ||
vadantyapunarāvṛttipradaḥ svecchāttavigrahaḥ |
śivaḥ provāca namraṃ taṃ vidhiṃ mā bhaiṣṭa cāgraja || 4 ||
śiraśchedādvaraṃ manye mahatāmavamānanam |
mānahānirmahābhaṃgo mahatāṃ maraṇaṃ matam || 5 ||
śiraśchedasamaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāsye tvāṃ kalmaṣāpaham |
brahmam̐stvaṃ pūjyatākāṃkṣī kitavatvaṃ samagrahīḥ || 6 ||
tato loke na vai te syādiṣṭadevotsavādikam |
iṣṭadevatayā tvaṃ vai pūjyo naiva bhaviṣyasi || 7 ||
kintu yajñeṣu gṛhyeṣu bhavatsthānaṃ bhaviṣyati |
sarvāṃgadakṣiṇo yajñastvadṛte niṣphalo bhavet || 8 ||
ato daivabaliprāptau yajñe bhāgastavāstviti |
pitāmahaṃ hi sarveṣāṃ mānyasthānasthitaṃ tvayi || 9 ||
tvaṃkāreṇa vyavahariṣyanti tvāṃ tu janā vidhe |
athāha bhagavān devaḥ ketakaṃ kūṭasākṣiṇam || 1.11.1 0 ||
matpūjāyāmanarhastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ |
nāpi devāḥ svapūjāyāṃ tvāṃ grahīṣyanti kecana || 11 ||
iti śrutvā mahādevaṃ ketakaḥ samatoṣayat |
devadeva mahādeva namaste’khilanāyaka || 12 ||
prasādaṃ kuru deveśa kṣamasva kilbiṣaṃ mama |
vidhehi saphalaṃ nātha janma me te namo namaḥ || 12 ||
prāha śaṃbhustadā taṃ tu karuṇālaya īśvaraḥ |
madgaṇāstvāṃ dhariṣyanti janma te saphalaṃ bhavet || 14||
madālaye vitāne te sthānaṃ dāsyāmi śaṃ labha |
ityādiśya mahādevo yāvadviramate svayam || 15 ||
tāvajjyotirmayaṃ liṃgaṃ śanaiḥ saṃkocatāṃ gatam |
svalpaṃ bhūvāviśat tatra sadāśivatanau sphuṭam || 16 ||
tadā tu vedhasā caiva viṣṇunā ca sadāśivaḥ |
sākāraḥ pūjito devaḥ parabrahmasvarūpakaḥ || 17||
brahmākṛtimayaṃ liṅgaḥ nirākārasvarūpakam |
parabrahmapratīkākhyaṃ tābhyāṃ tatra prapūjitam || 18 ||
sthāpitaṃ cāpi tatraiva yatra ceśvarasṛṣṭayaḥ |
tamādikālamārabhyaḥ liṅgapūjā pravartitā || 1 9||
brahmaviṣṇūbhayābhyāṃ vai viṣṇupūjā tu vedhasā |
śivapūjāpyubhābhyāṃ vai tadānīmevamāsthitā || 1.11.20 ||
asadvāgvedhasaḥ pūjā na kenāpyādṛtā yataḥ |
viṣṇuśivau prapūjyete na vedhāstu kadācana || 21 ||
tatra sthitaistadeśairvai śivaviṣṇū prapūjitau |
bhaviṣyatsṛṣṭilābhāya pūjanaṃ tatpravartitam || 22||
atha jyotirmayaṃ liṅgaṃ yadā cādṛśyatā gatam |
tāvajjijñāsitaṃ mūlaṃ puṃrūpaṃ samadṛśyata || 23 ||
dvibhujaṃ saccidānandaṃ parabrahmākhyameva yat |
tattejaḥparidhipreryaliṃgākhyakiraṇāttu vai || 24||
prakṛtipuruṣastasmātpradhānapuruṣastataḥ |
mahāviṣṇustataḥ sākṣādvairājapuruṣaḥ pitā || 25|
dṛṣṭo devatrayeṇāpi trayo yatra samāsate |
nābhau brahmā hṛdi viṣṇurlalāṭe śaṃkaraḥ svayam || 26||
svaṃ svaṃ vyalokayanpaścād bhrātaraśceti menire |
prasammīlya pariṣvajya trayo devāstamīḍire || 27||
namo’dbhutasvarūpāya janakāya namo namaḥ |
svecchayā cātidūrāya kṛpayāntikavartine || 28 ||
nārāyaṇāya vairājapūruṣāya namo namaḥ |
vayaṃ trayo bhavatputrā bhavadājñāvahā yataḥ || 29||
śādhi tātetikartavyaṃ kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ |
vairājena tadā kāya sṛṣṭikārye samarpitam || 1.11.30 ||
viṣṇave sṛṣṭipuṣṭyākhyaṃ śivāya pralayastviti |
tadālokya tadānīṃ vai samasteśvarakoṭibhiḥ || 31 ||
abhiṣiktāstathā te’pi tattaddhiṣṇyeṣvavasthitāḥ |
kirīṭahāranupūrakeyūramaṇikuṇḍalaḥ || 32 ||
kṣaumamālyottarīyasragyajñasūtrāṃgulīyakaiḥ |
puṣpatāmbūlakarpūracandanāttarabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 33 ||
dhūpakuṃkumadīpācchacchatravyañjanacāmaraiḥ |
rājādhirājasaccihnadhvajadivyopahārakaiḥ || 34||
divyaistattadvyaktiyogyairvāṅmano’tītavaibhavaiḥ |
pūjitāste trayo devāḥ sarvaiḥ samyak sabhājitāḥ || 3 5 ||
viṣṇostu vaiṣṇavī lakṣmīḥ śaṃkarasya tu śāṃkarī |
brahmāṇī brahmaṇaścaivotpannā teṣāṃ tu vāmataḥ || 36 ||
viṣṇubrahmamaheśānāṃ svapatnīsahitātmanām |
nivāsā īśalokeṣu vairājenāpi kalpitāḥ || 37||
viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhamanyattat kailāso’nyo harasya saḥ |
vedhasaḥ satyadhāmānyat svasvadhāmni gatāśca te || 38 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parameṣṭhiketakayorapūjyatāśikṣākaraṇaliṅgamūladarśanādināmā ekādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 ||

<1.12>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu padme pravakṣyāmi brahmāṇḍāni yathākarot |
caturviśatitattvātmavairājatanumadhyataḥ || 1 ||
brahmā karāñjalī piṇḍaṃ gṛhītvaikaṃ ca taṃ punaḥ |
mardayitvāsaṃkhyabhāgānaṇurūpānakalpayata || 2||
tām̐śca hastatale dhṛtvā phutkāreṇodaḍīḍayat |
sattvātmakamahākāśe samantāduḍḍitāstu te |||3 ||
aṇḍasvarūpagolātmabrahmāṇḍānyabhavan priye |
tadānīṃ brahmaṇā tatra saṃkalpā bahavaḥ kṛtā ||4||
mahāmbare pratiṣṭhantu sarve’saṃkhyāṇavaḥ pṛthak |
parasparaṃ sadā tatrāghaṭṭayantaḥ sthirāḥ iti ||5||
sarve tathaiva vartante parasparamanāhatāḥ |
atha pratyekamadhye’stu mahākāśo’vakāśadaḥ || 6||
iti saṃkalpamātreṇa madhyākāśāstadābhavan |
tatra canurdaśādyāśca bhūmikāḥ saṃbhavantviti ||7||
tādṛksaṃkalpamātreṇa caturdaśādibhūmikāḥ |
pratyekāṇḍe nu jātā santamovyāptā hi sarvaśaḥ ||8 ||
teṣu praveśanārthāya brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
yogaśaktyāsaṃkhyasūkṣmasvasvarūpāṇyadhārayan || 9 ||
tattaṇḍe tatra tatra devāḥ praviviśustrayaḥ |
tatrālokya tamastīvraṃ vedhāḥ saṃkalpamācarat || 1.12.1 0 ||
sarveṣvatra prabileṣu tejodravyāṇi santviti |
tadā sarvapare loke satyadīpaḥ prakāśitaḥ || 11 ||
satyasaṃyamajo dīpo yatastatra prakāśate |
atastadbhūmikāyāstu satyaloka iti prathā || 1 2 ||
tato’dhobhūmikāyāntu tapasaśca prakāśanāt |
tatolokaitikhyātirbrahmaṇā parikalpitā || 1 3||
tato’pyadhastare pitṛjanānāṃ puṇyayogataḥ |
prakāśaḥ samabhūttasmājjanalokābhidhā kṛtā || 14||
tato’dho bhūmikāyāṃ vai mahardīpaḥ prakāśitaḥ |
pitṛdehotthasattejo mahaścetyabhiniścitam || 15 ||
mahaḥpradīpayogādvai maharlokābhidhā kṛtā |
tato’dhastāttathā loke sūryapradīpasaṃgamāt || 16 ||
svargalokastathā tārādyotanāda dyauriti prathā |
tato’dhastādantarāle nakṣatrekṣaṇadīpanāt || 17||
antarīkṣamiti khyātirbhuvarbhūvivarāḍhapi |
ato’dhastādbhūmikāyāṃ pṛthoragneḥ prakāśanāt || 18 ||
agnināmā pṛthivīti bhūriti bhrājanādapi |
tato’dhastāttalānā tu saptānāṃ sapta dīpakāḥ || 19 ||
maṇayaḥ maṇi divyārthāstattadādyakṣarādiyuk |
tattannāma kṛtaṃ samyak tattannāmāni me śṛṇu || 1.12.20 ||
oṣadhayastvadholoke prakāśante’talaṃ tataḥ |
vaidūryamaṇitejastvād vitalaṃ tadadhaḥ smṛtam || 2 1 ||
kaustubhastomakāntyā ca sutalaṃ tadadho matam |
phaṇātālumaṇidīpāt talātalamitīritam ||22 ||
mārakatamaṇīnāṃ tu prakāśāttanmahātalam |
ratnānāṃ tu vibhinnānāṃ prakāśāttad rasātalam || 23 ||
puṣparājamaṇīnāṃ ca prakāśāt pattalasthiteḥ |
pātālamiti tatsaṃjñā kṛtā vai brahmaṇā svayam || 24||
maharjanatapasatyaprastarāḥ puṇyatattvajāḥ |
svarge tejasstaro vāyoḥ staro bhuvaritīritaḥ || 25 ||
pṛthivyāstu kṛtā bhūścātalādyāstu tamasstarāḥ |
ityevaṃ tatstarāṇāṃ vai klṛptanaṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam || 26||
teṣvapi pārthivā bhāgā dārḍhyārthaṃ svalpamātrakāḥ |
kvacittejomayā bhāgā dhātavaḥ staramiśritāḥ || 27||
kvacijjalīyabhāgāśca sudṛḍhāstāmasā api |
starāḥ prajāsamādhārā vivarākhyā bhavanti hi || 28 ||
atha brahmā starādhāraṃ staṃbhaṃ madhye’pyakalpayat |
sauvarṇaḥ sa tu pātālādāsatyaṃ suvyavasthitaḥ || 29||
satyaloke svakaṃ dhāma brahmā vai samakalpayat |
madhyaloke tu kailāsaṃ śaṃbhuḥ svaṃ samakalpayat || 1.12.30 ||
viṣṇustu śeṣaśāyī svaṃ pātālādho jale svakam |
kṣīre tu sāgare vāsaṃ svayogyaṃ samakalpayat || 31 ||
yogināṃ darśanārthaṃ vai nāradādi mahātmanām |
devānāṃ cāpi siddhānāṃ gatiryatra bhavatyapi || 32 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca gatiryatra ruciraṃ dhāma tanmatam |
anyeṣāṃ divyadehānāṃ yatra vai sugatirbhavet || 33 ||
dvitīyaṃ tādṛśaṃ śvetadvīpākhyaṃ samarocayat |
kṣīrābdheścottare bhāge divyo dvīpaḥ sa vai smṛtaḥ || 34||
tataścāpi tṛtīyaṃ svaṃ mānavairgamyamarthadam |
bhūmau himagireḥ śṛṃge badrikāśramanāmakam ||35||
naranārāyaṇamūrtyā tapastapati tatra saḥ |
lokakṣemakarā devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ ||36 ||
prayatante sadaivaṃ te rakṣārthaṃ tatsthitā yataḥ |
teṣāṃ dhāmāni cāṇḍe’tra bhautikānyavarāṇi ca ||37||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne’saṃkhyabrahmāṇḍotpattistaravyavasthātridevavāsādinirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 12||

<1.13>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
etadbrahmāṇḍamānaṃ tu pañcāśatkoṭiyojanam |
bhūmyāvaraṇamityetat kaṭāhaṃ prathamaṃ matam || 1. ||
athotpanneṣvasaṃkhyeṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca teṣu vai |
madhyotpannoṣmaṇā bhaumaṃ kaṭāhaṃ śīrṇatonmukham || 2 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu brahmaṇā tattacchāntyarthaṃ cāparaṃ tataḥ |
tādṛgguṇaṃ kaṭāhaṃ tu salilāvaraṇātmakam || 3 ||
āhitaṃ tatsamāvṛttaṃ pañcābjayojanāvṛtam |
jalātiśaityaniyamakṛte taijasamāvṛtam || 4 ||
tṛtīyaṃ jalatastadvai daśottaraguṇaṃ matam |
tanniyamakṛte vāyostato’pi daśapuṣṭikam || 5 ||
tasyākāśaṃ tatastasyāhaṃkārastasya vai mahān |
mahataḥ prakṛtiḥ proktā cāṣṭamāvaraṇātmikī || 6 ||
etānyaṣṭakaṭāhāni brahmāṇḍāvaraṇāni vai |
pratyekaṃ tatra lagnāni teṣāṃ dārḍhyakarāṇi hi || 7 ||
brahmāṇḍānāṃ ca sṛṣṭīnāṃ vairājādeśca kṛtsnaśaḥ |
āyuṣyaniyamārthaṃ tu parabrahma svayaṃ hariḥ || 8 ||
mahākālaṃ svamūrtestu prakaṭīkṛtavām̐stataḥ |
mahākālasya rūpaṃ vai samayaḥ parikathyate || 9 ||
kālaḥ kalayate lokān kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ |
kṣaṇādārabhya ca mahāpralayāvadhikāryakṛt || 1.13.10 ||
sa evāyuṣyasaṃkṣeptā hariṇā parikalpitaḥ |
kṣaṇaḥ syād yā paramāṇvorvibhāgajanikā kriyā || 11 ||
kriyāviśiṣṭakālaḥ saḥ kṣaṇākhyāṃ labhate tataḥ |
vibhāgenāpyabhivyāptaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇo dvitīyakaḥ || 1 2||
pūrvasaṃyoganāśāḍhyaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇastṛtīyakaḥ |
uttaradeśasaṃyogavyāptaḥ kṣaṇaścaturthakaḥ || 1 3|||
caturbhiśca kṣaṇaiḥ kālaḥ kūṭa ityabhidhīyate |
tribhiḥ kūṭaistruṭiḥ proktā tisrastruṭayo lavo mataḥ || 14||
lavatrayaṃ nimeṣaḥ syānnimeṣā daśa paṃca ca |
kāṣṭhā proktā tathā pañcadaśakāṣṭhāstu nāḍikā || 15||
te dve muhūrtaḥ saṃproktaḥ praharaḥ ṣaṇmuhūrtakāḥ |
praharāḥ sapta yāmaḥ syāt divā yāmacatuṣṭayam || 16||
tathā yāmāśca catvāro niśā rātryahanī hyubhe |
pañcadaśa bhavetpakṣaḥ dvau pakṣau māsa ucyate || 17||
māso’yantu manuṣyāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tadaharniśam |
dvau tāvṛtuḥ ṣaḍayanaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ matam || 18||
dakṣiṇantu niśā proktottaraṃ tu divaso divi |
ayane dve tu māsānāṃ dvādaśa vatsaro’pi saḥ || 19||
divyavarṣapramāṇena yugāḥ samanukīrtitāḥ |
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśceti yugāḥ smṛtāḥ ||1.13.20||
catvāri trīṇi dve caikaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tu yathākramam |
tattadyugānāṃ samayo varṣadaśasahasrakam |||2 1 ||
tathā sandhyaṃśayosteṣāṃ samayo dvisahasrakam |
aṣṭa ṣaḍatha catvāri dve varṣāṇi yathākramam |||22||
tādṛśaṃ yugasāhasraṃ brahmaṇo dinamucyate |
tāvatyeva niśā tasya yatra triloki naśyati ||23||
prātaḥ punaḥ samudeti sāyaṃ nāśo yathākramam |
brahmaṇastu dine yānti manavo vai caturdaśa ||24||
manuḥ svaṃ samayaṃ bhuṃkte catuṣkīmekasaptatim |
indro’pi samayaṃ bhuṃkte svacatuṣkyekasaptatim ||25||
brahmaṇo’pi svadivasaiḥ paramāyurvayaḥśatam |
pañcāśadvarṣamānantu pūrvārdhamiti tanmatam ||26||
evameva parārdhaṃ tatpañcāśadvarṣamānakam |
brahmaṇo yadbhavedvarṣaṃ vairājasya divā hi saḥ ||27||
vairājasya ca yadvarṣaṃ mahāviṣṇordivā tu saḥ |
mahāviṣṇostu yadvarṣaṃ pradhānapuruṣasya saḥ ||28||
divaso’thāsya yadvarṣaṃ prakṛtipūruṣasya saḥ |
divasastatpramāṇena varṣāṇāṃ śatamityayam |||29||
sṛṣṭimayaḥ samayaḥ sa unmeṣo’kṣarabrahmaṇaḥ |
tasya pratinimeṣastu mahāpralaya ucyate ||1.13.3 0 ||
nimeṣonmeṣayostasya sṛṣṭayo’nantarītayaḥ |
vilīyante ca jāyante tatpravāhasya nāditā || 3 1||
athavā kālamānaṃ tu sūkṣmaṃ kṣaṇacatuṣṭayam |
ṣaṣṭiḥ kṣaṇacatuṣkāṇāṃ vipalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ 32||
vipalānāṃ tu yā ṣaṣṭiḥ palaḥ sa samayo mataḥ |
palānāṃ tu ca yā ṣaṣṭiḥ sā ghaṭiketi sammatā ||33||
sārdhadvayaghaṭikānāṃ ghaṇṭākālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
caturviśatighaṇṭānāṃ rātridinaṃ tu mānuṣam |||34||
varṣantvahnāṃ ca rātrīṇāṃ pañcaṣaṣṭiḥ śatatrayam |
evaṃ kālaḥ sadā sarvān svāyattīkṛtya vartate ||35||
pakṣo yo mānuṣaścātra cāndraḥ sa divaso mataḥ |
rātriśca tādṛśī lambā māso rātridivaṃ tataḥ || 36|||
cāndraṃ bodhyaṃ tathā sauryaṃ rātriśūnyaṃ tu maṇḍalam |
dhruve’ti divaso nityo yataḥ sṛṣṭarvibhinnagā ||37||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āyuḥpramāpakasamayavyavacchedādinirūpanāmā trayodaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 3|

<1.14>
śrī nārāyaṇa uvāca
atha brahmā mānasīṃ tu sṛṣṭiṃ caicchat sarūpiṇīm |
mṛdyamardakabhāvena guṇasṛṣṭimakalpayat || 1 ||
brahmā svavittivibhavādbahuvītidhārāḥ svecchāpravāhavibhavādabhilāṣadhārāḥ |
yatnāt svakīyaguṇato vahuyatnakūṭānutpādya sṛṣṭikaraṇāya purukriyāśca || 2 ||
svasmānmanāṃsyaparimāṇaguṇāni kṛtvā 
saṃkhyāṃ parārdhaguṇitāṃ ca tato’pyasaṃkhyām |
mānaṃ ca hrasvamaṇu dīrghamatho mahacca
sṛṣṭvā viyoganu suyogamataḥ paraṃ ca || 3 ||
jyeṣṭhatvamarthasukaniṣṭhakatāntikatve
dūratvamarthagurutāṃ dravatāṃ tato’nyam |
snehaṃ tathā kamalajo viracayya naijāt dehād guṇān
bahuvidhān samatiṣṭhipattān || 4 ||
māyāṃ nigṛhya nijamānasasaṃsthitāṃ saḥ
tasyāstamo’pi ca vimohamapi dvitīyam |
mohaṃ mahāntamapi turyasuparvasaṃjñaṃ
tāmisramandhatamasaṃ ca sasarja pañca || 5 ||
ajñānavṛttaya iti sma bhavanti sṛṣṭāvālambya yā bhavavahāḥ subhavanti jīvāḥ |
tā eva rūpavivareṇa vibhinnasaṃjñā āvidyamasmibhavanaṃ samarāgakaśca || 6 ||
dveṣo bhayaṃ ta iti sarvaśarīrisaktā
brahmā sasarja punarapyatha satpramāṇam |
vaikalpakaṃ ca nu viparyayamugranidrāṃ
svapnaṃ suṣuptimatha ghoratarāṃ nu vṛtim || 7 ||
mauḍhyaṃ ca narma hasanaṃ kapaṭaṃ ca māyāṃ
vedhāstataḥ samasasarja nu saṃśayaṃ ca |
tarkaṃ ca vādamatha jalpamatho vitaṇḍāṃ
kāpaṭyacauryamatha tacchalamāmṛṣātvam || 8 ||
laulyaṃ tṛṣāmapi tathāsurabhāvanāṃ ca
nāstikyamugrataranirdayatāmaśāntim |
asnigdhatāṃ paramarukṣataratvamārtiṃ
ghātaṃtiraskṛtimathārdhagaḍutvamugram || 9 ||
sṛṣṭiṃ samānāṃ samupadravānvitā
dṛṣṭvā vicāryyātha tamomayīṃ muhuḥ |
pāpīyasīṃ svasya viruddhayāminīṃ
na cittaśāntiṃ samavāptavānajaḥ || 1.14.10 ||
aśāntasya vidheḥ pṛṣṭhādadharmaḥ samajāyata |
anītistena sākaṃ vai protpannā sahacāriṇī || 1 1||
bhāryāstathābhavaścintāsūyerṣyā mamatā mṛṣā |
āśāhantā tathā tṛṣṇā duṣṭatā nikṛtiḥ spṛhā || 12||
hiṃsā duruktiraśraddhāśāntinirdayatā tathā |
amedhā cāpyatuṣṭiścāpuṣṭyamaitryakriyāstathā || 13||
abuddhiragatiścāpyatitikṣāthāgatistathā |
anunnatiramūrtiścānuparaktistathākṣamā || 1 4||
asmṛtiśca suṣuptiścājāyanta saṃsṛtipradāḥ |
tatputrāstu mado lobho raso mohaśca matsaraḥ || 15||
daṃbhaḥ kāmastathā krodho darpaḥ pāruṣyamanṛtam |
sneho mānaṃ ca kāluṣyaṃ droho’śaucaṃ kalistathā || 16||
aśaucaṃ cāpyaviśvāsaścauryaṃ pānaṃ dyutaṃ tathā |
garvo nāstikyamevāpi pramādo rāga eva ca || 17||
paiśunyaṃ vyasanaṃ duḥkha dveṣo’jñānaṃ bhayaṃ tathā |
pāpaṃ mṛtyuranaiśvaryaṃ kauṭilyaṃ cāpyanigrahaḥ || 18||
amārdavamasantoṣo’dhairyaṃ caivāpyanarthakaḥ |
atyāgaścāpyayogaścāprasādo’praśrayastathā || 19||
alābho’nudyamaścāpyadamo vighnamiti smṛtāḥ |
putryaścaivāpyadharmasya jātā bahvyo hi duḥkhadāḥ ||1.14.20||
ghṛṇā nindā ca kutsā ca jugupsā kūṭatā tathā |
pratāraṇā chalānyāyā prasahyatā ca dhikkṛtiḥ ||21||
chicchikārā hyararrāṭī hāhākārā ca vedanā |
pīḍā hṛdayadāhā ca kālimā mohinī tathā ||22||
hṛtphālā prabhayā yonirmaladā phaṭprakāṇḍikā |
kāmanā ca rajasrotā liṭkarī kṣuvatī tathā ||23||
kudṛṣṭiśca kuśīlā ca praguhyāśāṅgaliṅgikā |
kṛpaṇatā parādhīnā malinatā daridratā ||24||
ariṣṭā cāpaśakunā duritā pāpiṇī tathā |
kuṇapā raktapā śukrapāyinī pātinī tathā |||25||
parasvabhedikā ṣaṇḍhā māriṇī vihvalā tathā |
abhānā ca tamaskarī ghorā digvibhramā tathā ||26||
āḍambarā viḍambānā cākasmikī mṛtaṃkarī |
etāḥ proktā adharmasya putrya udvejikāḥ sadā ||27||
sāpatyaṃ tu tamadharmaṃ dṛṣṭvā vedhāstutoṣa na |
tadā śāntipradāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kartumaicchad hṛdā punaḥ ||28||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇo mānasasṛṣṭau guṇājñānādharmasṛṣṭinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||

<1.15>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
lakṣmī prajānāṃ sukhadā sṛṣṭiḥ kāryā mayā punaḥ |
padmajena vicāryetthaṃ dharmaḥ svahṛdayātkṛtaḥ || 1 ||
śubhravarṇaḥ suprakāśo vidyāśaktisamanvitaḥ |
sukhasvargapramokṣādiphaladaḥ sāttvikapriyaḥ || 2 ||
dharmasyāpi tathā patnyaḥ śraddhā śāntirdayā gatiḥ |
medhā tuṣṭistathā puṣṭirmaitrī lajjā kriyonnatiḥ || 3 ||
mūrtirbuddhistitikṣā ca bhaktirārādhanādikāḥ |
dharmeṇa saha sañjātā hṛdayādvedhasastu tāḥ || 4 ||
tāsāṃ prajāstu saumyāsyāḥ saumyarūpāḥ sukhapradāḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ cārjavaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyamabhayaṃ tapaḥ || 55 ||
sthairyaṃ dhairyaṃ sukhaṃ kṣemaḥ satyaṃ śaucaṃ ca mārdavam |
tyāgo yogo damo yajñaḥ santoṣo nigrahaḥ śamaḥ || 6 ||
āstikyaṃ ca prasādaśca tejaḥ svādhyāya udyamaḥ |
praśrayodhyānamarthaśca sāmyaṃ lābhaśca vedanam || 7 ||
alobho’matsaro’daṃbho’kāmo’krodho’rasastathā |
amoho nirmado’darpo’sneho’māno’kaliḥ ṛtam || 8 |
apāruṣyamaśaucaṃ ca viśvāso’cauryameva ca |
agarvo’dyutamabhayamadveṣo’rāgameva ca || 9 ||
apaiśunyamapāpaṃ ca puṇyaṃ satkarma ityapi |
ṛjutvaṃ cāśaṭhatvaṃ cāvyasanaṃ dānamityapi || 1.15.10 ||
ityete dharmaputrā vai jajñire’tha kumārikāḥ |
dayā sūktirahiṃsā ca kṛtiḥ smṛtiśca dakṣatā || 11 ||
kṣamā coparatirvidyā ratiḥ smṛtiśca sāmyatā |
kāntiḥ komalatā cātha dakṣatā ca svatantratā || 12||
gaṃbhīratātha sthiratā nirbhayatā pragalbhatā |
agarvatāpyahiṃsā ca nirmānitāpyadaṃbhatā || 13 ||
asteyatā tathā sevā śuśrūṣā ca śaraṇyatā |
brahmaṇyatā rakṣatā ca niṣparigrahatā tathā || 14||
rūpatā mitratā tṛptiḥ pavitratā prasannatā |
śuddhatā svacchatā caiva nirmalatā prakāśitā || 18||
divyatā ceśatā cātha sevyatā sānukūlatā |
smṛddhirdhavalatā sampat sukhatā mohatā tathā || 16||
līlā pramodatā cāpyujjvalatā rasatā tathā |
viṣayārthā dhanavatī ratnavatī vibhūṣikā || 17||
śaradvatī sasyavatī dhānyavatī pragāyanā |
rāgiṇī miṣṭatā cāpi lāvaṇyatā madhuratā || 18||
mādhavī ramaṇārāmā ramaṇī ramaṇīyatā |
sundaratā camatkārā sāmarthyā phalatā tathā || 19||
poṣikā śaktidā cāpi vilāsā pravilāsikā |
īśvariṇyaśca divyāśca mūrtāścāmūrtikāstathā |||1.15.20 ||
sahasraśo dharmaputryaḥ samutpannāḥ kumārikāḥ |
tābhistaiśca svayaṃ vedhāḥ santuṣṭaḥ svas mānase |||21||
dharmasargamimaṃ dṛṣṭvātmānaṃ siddhamamanyata |
paraṃ pariśramo jātastenājo vikalo’bhavat ||22||
tāvattasya lalāṭādvai svedabinduḥ papāta ha |
bindustu patito yāvat tatra rudro babhūva ha |||23||
śvetarūpaḥ sukumāro bālo’pyadbhūtadarśanaḥ |
pañcaśirāstrinetraśca daśahastastamoguṇaḥ || 24||
śarīravyāptaromā ca vikarālo digambaraḥ |
raktanetro jaṭādhārī tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraḥ kapardavān || 25||
ḍhakkātriśūlarudrākṣapinākadaṇḍapāśadhṛk |
lalāṭaśaśisallekho netraprāntāruṇaprabhaḥ ||26||
utpannaḥ san rurodāyaṃ mā rodīrabravīdajaḥ |
tasmād rudra iti proktastaṃ brahmāha prajāḥ sṛja || 27||
rudraḥ piturnideśaṃ svīkṛtyāsṛjadatha prajāḥ |
tāmasīḥ svasamānāśca hyupadravakarī bhṛśam ||28||
ulbaṇā vyagracittāśca kṣudhāroṣasamanvitāḥ |
bahurūpā virūpāśca kṛṣṇā lauhitikāstathā ||29||
caturdaśeṣu lokeṣu vyāptā rudrasya tāḥ prajāḥ |
sarvāstā rudrajātīyā abhavan sarvatodiśi || 1.15.30||
kecanāsan kṛśadehāḥ sthūlakaṃdharanāsikāḥ |
āsaṃśca kecana dīrghaghoṇāḥ pīvaraśroṇayaḥ || 3 1||
pīnāśca vāmanā eke kharvārdhā lambanordhvakāḥ |
hrasvottamā lambapādā mañjuṣākārapṛṣṭhakāḥ || 32||
anye ṛkṣā mahodarāsstambhahastā guhānanāḥ |
kṛṣṇādrisadṛśāścānye mahākālasamāḥ pare ||33||
yatra tatrābhavan rudrāḥ koṭirarbudameva ca |
caturdaśasu lokeṣu rudrā rudrā na cetare ||34||
krūrāḥ kruddhā yuyudhānā bhoktuṃ brahmāṇamāyayuḥ |
rudraṃ sveṣāṃ prasraṣṭāraṃ cāpi jagdhuṃ pradudruvuḥ || 35||
tadā brahmā svaputraṃ taṃ prāhemān drāk prasaṃhara |
nedṛśī tu prajā kvāpi lokaśāntikarī bhavet || 36||
rūpeṇāpyapratimā ca guṇena kṣayakāriṇī |
rudrān bhayaṃkaraṃ karma kurvāṇān bhakṣakānimān ||37||
śīghraṃ nāśaya putra tvaṃ nedṛśī sṛṣṭiriṣyate |
rudreṇa pitṛvākyaṃ tatsamāgṛhya kṣaṇāntare ||38||
svāṭṭahāsād bibhatso nā kṛtāntākhyo mahābalaḥ |
pāśakhaḍgakaro daṃṣṭrācūrṇitāṇḍa ivādvayaḥ || 39||
samutpādita evāyaṃ dhṛtahastāṃjalirmuhuḥ |
kasmādutpāditaścāhaṃ kiṃ kāryaṃ me’nuśādhi mām ||1.15.40||
rudraḥ prāha tvimāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kāpathamanugāminīm |
raudrāṃ bhayaṃkarīṃ sarvalokasaṃsthāsu saṃsthitām ||41 ||
śīghraṃ nāśaya bhadraṃ te mama prītyā bhaviṣyati |
kṛtāntastāṃ janakājñāṃ samādāya pracakrame ||42|||
kṣayaṃ kartuṃ hi rudrāṇāmagnimutpādya vaktrataḥ |
netrebhyaśca tathā jvālānalamutpādya sarvaśaḥ ||43||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu yatra yatrābhavan prajāḥ |
raudryastatra hi sarvatra vināśaṃ kṛtavān param ||44||
netravaktraśarīrebhyo jvālākarṣaṇavidyutaḥ |
utpannā dīrghapravahā brahmāṇḍe ca sthale sthale ||45||
gatvā gatvā ca rudrām̐stānanviṣyāviṣya kṛtsnaśaḥ |
prasaṃjahruraśeṣām̐stān hāhākāro mahānabhūt ||46||
vidravanti pradravanti cotpatanti tatastataḥ |
prakrośanti sakaruṇaṃ trāyasveti vadanti ca ||47||
tathāpi yatra gacchanti tatra jvālāstadagragāḥ |
vināśārthamathāyānti nāsti trāṇasthalaṃ manāk ||48||
kutrāpyalabdhatrāṇāste parāvṛtya patanti vai |
jvālānale mahākāye kṣayaṃ rudrāḥ prapedire ||49||
yadā catudarśabileṣveko’pi nahi śeṣitaḥ |
tadā kṛtānto virataḥ śāntaścājo’bhavattadā ||1.15.50 ||
rudraścātha svaputreṇa kṛtāntena samaṃ sadā |
nivāsārthaṃ svakaṃ sthānaṃ yayāce svasya pitṛtaḥ ||51||
dattaṃ ca brahmaṇā tasmai dhāma satyasthamaiśvaram |
nāmnā raudraṃ tu divyaṃ tatkhyātaṃ lokaṃ tu vai mahaḥ ||52||
yatra brāhmāstu saṃkalpāḥ satyā bhavanti sarvadā |
yadicchanti satyasthāste phalanti ca tattathā ||53||
satyalokasya māhātmyaṃ satyameva bhavatyapi |
satyetibrahmaṇaḥ śabdaḥ sattāmātrastu sammataḥ ||54||
brahmalokastataḥ satyo brahmaṇaiva prabhāsvaraḥ |
brahmaṇaḥ sa tu sāmarthyādapratīghātalakṣaṇaḥ ||55||
tasmādayaṃ satyaloko hyapunarbhavagāmiṇām |
tatrāpi nyāyahīnānāṃ kṛtānto daṇḍadaḥ smṛtaḥ ||56||
nāmnā kṛtapuraṃ ceti tasya nyāyālayaḥ smṛtaḥ |
brahmaṇo’pi sudharmākhyā sabhā lokottarā matā ||57||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dharmarudrayoḥ sṛṣṭyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 15||

<1.16>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tato vai brahmaṇā svayam |
kṛtaṃ lokanivāsārtha yadyat tuṣṭyarthameva ca || 1 ||
tatastu sāttvikīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā kartuṃ mano dadhe |
sakalpaṃ kṛtavān sarvaṃ sāttvikāḥ saṃbhavantviti || 2 ||
tāvadrudrātsamutpannā rudrā vai sāttvikāḥ śivāḥ |
śuddhāḥ śuddhatamāḥ sarve vidvāṃso ghanamūrtayaḥ || 3 ||
sarve sūkṣmaśarīrāste sthiralokasthitāḥ sadā |
prakāśāḥ śuddhabuddhisthāḥ siddhāśca yogadharmiṇaḥ || 4 ||
sarve te brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ samaiśvaryāvasāyinaḥ |
śāntāḥ sukhadatanavaḥ sarve te bhāvanāmayam || 5 ||
ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāmṛtatvāya te gatāḥ |
sarve vai sukhadātmāno buddhaśuddhatayā matāḥ || 6 ||
ānandaṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpyāmṛtānandaṃ bhajantyuta |
dvandvaistairnābhibhūyante bhāvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ || 7 ||
ādhipatyaṃ vinā tulyā brahmaṇaste mahaujasaḥ |
prabhāvavijayaiśvaryasthitivairāgyadarśanaiḥ || 8 ||
te brāhmalaukikāḥ sarve brāhmīṃ prāpya gatiṃ śubhām |
vītarāgā jitakrodhā nirmohāḥ satyavādinaḥ || 9 ||
svasmin praṇihitātmāno dayāvanto jitendriyāḥ |
niḥsaṃgā śucayaścaiva brahmasāyujyagāḥ smṛtāḥ || 1.16.10 ||
akāmayuktairye vīrāstapobhirdagdhakilbiṣāḥ |
teṣāmabhraṃśino lokā aprameyasukhāḥ smṛtāḥ || 11 ||
etadbrahmapadaṃ divyaṃ paramaṃ vyomni bhāsvaram |
yatra gatvā na śocanti hyamarā brahmaṇā saha || 12 ||
cyavante na yato bhūyo brahmāṇaṃ ta upāsate |
apunarmārakāmānāṃ brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate || 13 ||
purastād brahmalokasya tvaṇḍādarvāk ca vedhasaḥ |
madhye divyaṃ puraṃ ramyaṃ sthānaṃ rudramanomayam || 14||
tadvigrahavataḥ sthānamīśvarasyāmitaujasaḥ |
śivaṃ nāma puraṃ tatra śaraṇaṃ brahmavāsinām || 1 5||
sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrṇaṃ yojanānāṃ suvistaram |
ābhyantare viśālaṃ tad vyāsamaṃḍalasaṃsthitam || 16 ||
bahumadhyāhnasūryādiparatejo’timardinā |
śātakauṃbhena mahatā prākāreṇārkavarcasā || 17||
maṇḍitaṃ cātha sauvarṇairmuktādāmavibhūṣitaiḥ |
caturdvāraiḥ śubhairgamyaṃ divyaṃ sukṛtarūpakam || 18 ||
taccākāśe mahadvyomni satye loke sthitaṃ puram |
na tatra kramate mṛtyurna tāpo na jarā śramaḥ || 19 ||
na taccānyaiḥ puraiḥ kvāpi rūpamāptuṃ hi śakyate |
tādṛśaṃ tattu nagaraṃ govṛṣāṃkasya taijasam || 1.16.20 ||
bhāvena mānasī bhūmirvinyastā kanakātmikā |
ratnavālukayā pūrṇā tejasā vyāpya vartate || 21 ||
śāradenduprakāśāni vālasūryanibhāni ca |
ardhaśvetārdharaktāni sauvarṇāni tathaiva ca || 22||
rathacakrapramāṇāni nālairmarakataprabhaiḥ |
sukumāreṇa rūpeṇa gandhināpratimena ca || 23 ||
tatra divyāni padmāni vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca |
bhṛṃgapatranikāśāni tapanīyāni yāni ca || 24||
ardhakṛṣṇārdharaktāni sukumārāntarāṇi hi |
ātapatrapramāṇāni paṃkajāni bhavanti vai || 25||
puṇyāmṛtapravāhāśca nadyo divyā vahanti ca |
padmotpaladalonmiśraṃ phenādyavarttavigraham || 26||
jalaṃ maṇidalaprakhyamāvahanti saridvarāḥ |
tadvai ye dhyānamavyagrā suyuktā vijitendriyāḥ || 27||
paśyantīha mahātmānaḥ puraṃ tadgovṛṣātmanaḥ |
madhye puravarendrasya divyo bhadraśriyā vṛtaḥ || 28 ||
sahasrapādaḥ prāsādastapanīyamayo mahān |
anupamaiśca ratnaiśca sarvataḥ sa vibhūṣitaḥ |
sphaṭikaiścandrasaṃkāśairvaidūryaiḥ somasaṃprabhaiḥ || 29||
bālasūryaprabhaiścaiva sauvarṇaiścāgnisannibhaiḥ |
rājataiścāpi śuśubhe hīndranīlamayaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 1.16.30 ||
dṛḍhairvajramayaiścaiva nirmitaḥ sumahattaraiḥ |
jalaiśca vividhākārairdīpyadbhiradhivāsitam || 31 ||
puraṃ candraprakāśābhiḥ patākābhiralaṃkṛtam |
rukmaghaṃṭādinādaiśca nityamutsavasaṃśritam || 3 2||
rudradāsāstu gāndharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sutamāgadhāḥ |
stuvantīśaṃ mahārudraṃ parivārasametakam ||33||
rudraprāsādarājo’sau śatabhūmivirājate |
vāsantīpratimā yatra tryambakasya niveśane || 34||
rudrāṇī śāmbhavī śaktirdevī rūpaguṇānvitā |
sugandhitaśarīrā sā rudraṃ devaṃ hi sevate || 35||
śrīśca lakṣmīśca māyā ca kīrtiḥ śobhā sarasvatī |
devyā vai sahitā etā rūpagandhasamanvitāḥ || 36||
nityāścāparisaṃkhyātāḥ parasparaguṇādhikāḥ |
bhūṣā vai sarvaratnānāṃ devyaḥ kāntivilāsayoḥ || 37||
koṭīśataṃ mahābhāgyā vibhajyātmānamātmanā |
bhagavantaṃ mahārudraṃ pratimodantyatandritāḥ || 38 ||
tāsāṃ sahasraṃ cānyāstatpṛṣṭhataḥ paricārikāḥ |
rūpiṇyaśca śriyāyuktāḥ sarvāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || 3 9||
līlāvilāsasaṃyuktabhāvairatimanoharaiḥ |
rudraistāḥ saha modante yuvabhiḥ pāvakottamaiḥ ||1.16.40 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sāttvikarudrarudrāṇībhavanādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||

<1.17>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
nibodha lakṣmi vakṣyāmi bahūpāsanatatparāḥ |
rudrasyāsaṃkhyadāsīśca gaṇām̐ścāyudharūpiṇaḥ || 1 ||
ramyāḥ saumyāḥ surūpāḥ sudṛḍhabandhanagātrikāḥ |
samasakthikaṭijaṃghāḥ samasūkṣmasumadhyamāḥ || 2 ||
kāścit kubjā vāmanikā varagātrāḥ śubhānanāḥ |
puṇḍrāśca vikaṭāścaiva karālāścipiṭānanāḥ || 3 ||
lagbodarā hrasvabhujāstrinetrāśca hayānanā |
mṛgendravadanā hrasvapādikāśca gajānanāḥ || 4 ||
gajavaktrodarāścānyāḥ siṃhavyāghrānanāstathā |
lohitākṣā mahāstanyaḥ subhagāścārulocanāḥ || 5 ||
hrasvakuṃcitakeśāśca sundaryaścārugaṇḍakāḥ |
sarvāstāḥ kāmarūpiṇyo dṛḍhamadhyā varāḥ striyaḥ || 6 ||
pūrṇapriyasusadbhāṣā hāvabhāvānvitāḥ sadā |
ramate bhagavām̐stābhirdaśabāhurmaheśvaraḥ || 7 ||
nandinā ca gaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ viśvarūpairmahātmabhiḥ |
tathā rudragaṇaiścāpi tulyaudāryaparākramaiḥ || 8 ||
pāvakātmajasaṃkāśairyūpadaṃṣṭrotkaṭānanaiḥ |
vandyamāno vimānasthaiḥpūjyamānaśca tatparaiḥ || 9 ||
sarvartukusumāṃ mālāṃ prasaṃjighrannurasthitām |
nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ pṛthutāmrāyatekṣaṇam || 1.17.10 ||
iṣatkarālalamboṣṭhaṃ tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭragaṇāśritam |
ṣaḍūrdhvanetraṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ ruciraṃ divyavāsasam || 11 ||
āhaveṣvaparikliṣṭaṃ sarveṣāmarināśanam |
bāhunā bāhumāveśya pārśve savye’ntare sthitam || 12 ||
rājate paṭṭiśaṃ tasya vāmāgrakaragocaram |
mahābhairava nirghoṣaṃ balenāpratimaujasam || 13 ||
daśavarṇadhanuścaiva vicitraṃ śobhate’dhikam |
triśūlaṃ vidyutābhāsamamoghaṃ śatrunāśanam || 14||
jājvalyamāno vapuṣā paraśustattviṣāyutaḥ |
asiścaivaujasāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ śītaraśmiḥ śaśī tathā || 15||
tejasā vapuṣā kāntyā deveśasya mahātmanaḥ |
sthitaḥ purastād devasya śātakuṃbhamayo mahān |
śobhate ruciraḥ śrīmān sarvārisukamaṇḍaluḥ || 1 6||
asimāveśya kośe ca pāṇḍurāmbaradhāriṇī |
vakṣaḥsthitena mahatā mauktikena virājitā ||
caturbhujā mahābhāgā vijayā lokasammatā || 17||
devyā ādyapratīhārī śrīrivāpratimā parā |
bhrājamānā sthitā caiva kṛtvā devasya cāṃjalim || 18||
tasyā pṛṣṭhānugāścānyāḥ striyo’psarogaṇānvitāḥ |
tāḥ khalvabhinavaiḥ kāntairupatiṣṭhanti śaṃkaram || 19||
sarvalakṣaṇasampannā vāditrairupabṛṃhitāḥ |
upagāyanti deveśaṃ gaṇā gandharvayonayaḥ |||1.17.20||
abhyunnato mahoraskaḥ śaranmeghasamadyutiḥ |
śobhate nadamānaśca gopatistasya veśmani ||21 ||
parivārayutaḥ skandaḥ putro’syāmitavīryavān |
raktāmbaradharaḥ śrīmān varāmbujadalekṣaṇaḥ ||22||
tasya śākho viśākhaśca naigameyaśca cāṣṭavān |
vyapetavyasanāḥ śiṣyāḥ prajānāṃ pālane ratāḥ ||23||
taiḥ sārdhaṃ sa mahāvīryaḥ śobhate śikhivāhanaḥ |
bālakrīḍanakaiḥ saṃkrīḍati vai viśvatomukhaḥ ||24||
vyāghrāścaivānugāstatra kāñcanābhāstarasvinaḥ |
svacchandacāriṇaḥ sarve svayaṃ devena nirmitāḥ ||25||
mṛtyormṛtyusamāste tu yamadarpāpahāriṇaḥ |
siṃhā rudragaṇāḥ santi rudrecchāvaśavartinaḥ ||26||
mandarādriprakāśānāṃ balenāpratimaujasām |
hārakundenduvarṇānāṃ vidyudghananinādinām ||27||
cūḍāmaṇidharāṇāṃ vai meghasannibhavāsasām |
śrīvatsāṃkitavajrāṇāmaṃgulīśūlapāṇinām ||28||
evaṃvidhasurūpāṇāṃ devānāṃ daivaśālinām |
siṃhānāṃ tasya prāsādamukhyastaṃbheṣvavasthitiḥ |||29||
yadvai sahasra siṃhānāmīśvareṇa mahātmanā |
nija krodhātkṛtaṃ krodhāste sarve siṃhavigrahāḥ ||1.17.30 ||
atha rudramaheśasya bhaktiryairanukalpitā |
hrīmantaḥ sūrjitā dāntāḥ śauryayuktā hyalolupāḥ ||3 1||
karmaṇā manasā vācā viśuddhenāntarātmanā |
ananyamanaso bhūtvā prapannā ye maheśvaram ||32|||
tairlabdhaṃ rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam |
bhavasya rūpasādṛśyaṃ nītāścaiva hyanuttamam || 33||
sarve vaiśvānaramukhyā viśvarūpāḥ kapardinaḥ |
nīlakaṇṭhāḥ sitagrīvāstīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāstrilocanāḥ ||34||
ardhacandrakṛtoṣṇīṣā jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇaḥ |
sarve daśabhujā vīrāḥ padmāntarasugandhinaḥ ||35||
taruṇādityasaṃkāśāḥ sarve te pītavāsasaḥ |
pinākapāṇayaḥ sarve śvetagovṛṣavāhanāḥ ||36||
śriyānvitāḥ kuṇḍalino muktāhāravibhūṣitāḥ |
tejaso’pyadhikā daivātsarvajñāḥ sarvadarśinaḥ ||37|
vibhajya bahudhātmānaṃ jarāmṛtyuvivarjitāḥ |
krīḍanti vividhairbhāvairbhogānprāpya sudurlabhān |||38|
svacchandagatayaḥ siddhāḥ siddhaiścānyairvibodhitāḥ |
ekādaśānāṃ rudrāṇāṃ koṭyo’nekāstataḥ kṛtāḥ || 39||
ebhiḥ saha mahātmā sa devadevo maheśvaraḥ |
bhaktānukampī bhagavān modate bhaktasatpatiḥ ||1.17.40 ||
ābhūtasaṃplave ghore sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ kṣaye |
mahābhūtavināśānte pralaye samupasthite ||41 ||
anekarudrakoṭyaścānekadāsīgaṇāstathā |
anekagaṇavyāghrādyā naikasiddhādayaśca ye |||42||
rudralokagatāḥ sarve mahātmāno maheśvare |
rudre yānti layaṃ sarve rudro brahmaṇi līyate |||43 ||
prapadya parayā bhaktyā jñānayuktena cetasā |
prāpnoti rudrasālokyaṃ śāśvataṃ padamavyayam ||44||
ajaputrasya rudrasya sṛṣṭī rudrātmikī tviyam |
dāsadāsīgaṇavyāghrayānavāhanarūpiṇī ||45||
āyudhasiddhagandharvāpsaromāgadhasevikāgṛhodyānamahāsaudhanadīpadmādimaṇḍanā ||46 ||
sarvā sattvamayākārā sattvarūpā susaukhyadā |
rudrasya raudrabhāvo yaḥ sa na vai vartate’tra yat ||47||
tasmāttu brahmaṇā ceyaṃ satyalokanivāsinī |
raudrī tu sāttvikī sṛṣṭiḥ sarvadā vai sthirīkṛtā ||48||
dṛṣṭvemāṃ sukhadāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā tuṣṭiṃ jagāma ha |
kintu sāttvikadevāste rudrāstaddāsadāsikāḥ ||49||
sukhaṃ sāttvikamāsādya prāpyaiśvaryāṇi kṛtsnaśaḥ |
aiśvaryeṣu sukheṣvāsan līnā vai vodhadurbalāḥ ||1.17.50||
ataste vañcitā yatsyurjñānena pāramārthinā |
tathāsati kadācidvā mokṣamārgasya rodhanam ||51 ||
āpatteścānarthaprāptirityevaṃ mā bhavediti |
vicāryyaiva svayaṃ brahmā sṛṣṭiṃ jñānabharāṃ śubhām |||52||
mokṣadāṃ brahmasaṃlagnāṃ mānasīṃ brahmarūpiṇīm |
kartuṃ mano dadhe paścāt dhyātuṃ cakrāma siddhaye ||53||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sāttvikarudradāsadāsīgaṇādisṛṣṭikathananāmā saptadaśo’dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||

<1.18>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
brahmaṇā yogamāsthāya samādhimadhigamya ca |
ātmānaṃ śrīharau sākṣāt pare dhāmni tadā prabhau || 1 ||
tādātmyena prayatnena samaikīkṛtya cārthitam |
śāntipradā yathā sṛṣṭirbhavecchāntāśca pūruṣāḥ || 2 ||
mokṣadāśca tathānyeṣāṃ brahmabhānapariplutāḥ |
sarveṣāṃ bodhakartāro nirlepā sāttvikottarāḥ || 3 ||
brahmarūpāḥ sadā brahmabhāvanāparisaṃbhṛtāḥ |
brahmānandaparisnātā brahmamūrtivicintakāḥ || 4 ||
guravo lokasṛṣṭīnāṃ dharmasampatsamāśrayāḥ |
daiveśvarasamakakṣā ābrahmāhata sarpaṇāḥ || 5 ||
putrā bhaveyurme nātha yairlokā sukhinaḥ sadā |
ityabhyarthanamājñāya pareṇa brahmaṇā tadā || 6 ||
muktāścatvāra ājñaptāḥ putrārthaṃ parameṣṭhinaḥ |
saṃkalpajñāścaturmuktā akṣarabrahmadhāmataḥ || 7 ||
lokānatītya caiśām̐śca satyalokamupāgatāḥ |
brahmāpi vyutthito yogād dṛṣṭvā muktām̐ścatuḥsamān || 8 ||
ime me mānasāḥ putrā bhavantu mokṣahetavaḥ |
iti saṃkalpya muktām̐stān surūpān pañcahāyanān || 9 ||
jātamātrān brahmarūpān brahmānandamayān parān |
tejomaṇḍalakṛcchubhravastrān sthalābjasatprabhān || 1.18.10 ||
divyān sadaikamārnauṃścābrahmāṇḍasthitijīvanān |
labdhvā putrām̐stu caturo bahutoṣamavāpa ha || 11 ||
nāmnā te mānasāḥ putrā lokakalyāṇahetavaḥ |
sanakaśca sanandaśca sanataśca sanātanaḥ || 12||
sādhavaste sādhudharmāḥ puṇyāḥ puṇyamayāḥ sadā |
darśanād doṣahartāro duḥkhaśokalayaṃkarāḥ || 13 ||
dayālavaḥ kṣamāśīlāḥ sarvasṛṣṭihitecchavaḥ |
titikṣavaśvānasūyāḥ śāntā anuditārayaḥ || 14||
anīrṣyavaśca nirvairā nimānāśca vimatsarāḥ |
mānyāśca mānadāḥ sarvapriyasatyagiraḥ sadā || 15||
nirmadāḥ krodhalobhādidoṣahīnā nirañjanāḥ |
ahantāgamatāśūnyā jitakāmapravartanāḥ || 1 6||
nirdaṃbhāḥ śucayo dāntāḥ ṛjavo mitabhāṣiṇaḥ |
nirdvandvāścāpramattāśca dhīrāścaiva jitendriyāḥ || 17||
bodhapūrṇā ātmaniṣṭhā aparigrahaśālinaḥ |
sarvopakāriṇaḥ śraddhāstikyabhaktiguṇāśrayāḥ || 18 ||
udārāśca taponiṣṭhā nirapekṣaparigrahāḥ |
paiśunyastainyarahitāḥ paraguptāprakāśakāḥ || 19||
jitaśārīrabhāvāśca santuṣṭāḥ sthirabuddhayaḥ |
sukhaduḥkhasamāstṛṣṇārahitāstoṣaṇānvitāḥ ||1.18.20 ||
paranindādirahitā ātmavṛttisamāśritāḥ |
