svarg divaḥ samudrāśca nadāḥ śailā drumā latāḥ ||
oṣadhīnāṃ tathātmāno hyātmāno vṛkṣavīrudhām || 3 ||
lavaḥ kāṣṭhā kalā sandhirmuhūrt ca divāniśam ||
māsārdhamayanaṃ māsaścābdaṃ yugaśca sādhikā || 4 ||
sthānābhimānino devā ityetānasṛjat tvajaḥ ||
nakṣatragrahatārāṇāmabhimantrīśca devatāḥ ||5||
aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭīṃśca sasarja sukṛtātmanām |
vaimānikāstu tāḥ proktā devaloke divaukasaḥ || 6 ||
devāśca pitaraścaiva munayo manavastathā ||
teṣāmanucarā ye ca manuputrāstathaiva ca || 7 ||
prasaṃkhyayā trīṇyabjāni koṭyo dvinavatistathā |
saptalakṣāṇi ca tathā sahasrāṇyaṣṭa santi hi || 8 ||
devā hyete’bhimantārastattadgolakadevatāḥ |
ādhipatyaṃ vinā te vai aiśvaryeṇājasannibhāḥ || 9 ||
jaṃgamāḥ sthāvarāścaite brahmaṇo mānasīprajāḥ |
tuṣitānmarutaḥ sādhyān viśvedevām̐śca vidyutaḥ ||1.46.10||
stanayitnūm̐śca bhānūm̐śca vasūnaṣṭau tathaiva ca | 1
droṇaprāṇadhruvāgnidoṣavasuvibhāvasūn ||11||
siddhān yakṣām̐śca gandharvānasurān rākṣasām̐stathā ||
apsarasaścāraṇām̐śca piśācapretabhūtakān ||12||
vidyādharān kiṃpuruṣānaśvamukhām̐śca kinnarān |
vetālān ḍākinīṃ caiva śākinīṃ yoginīstathā ||13||
vināyakaॉśca kūṣmāṇḍān vetālām̐śca grahānapi | 
yātudhānām̐stathonmādānmātṝrguhyakacāraṇān ||14||
prajāpatīnṛṣīṃścaiva nāgānsarpāṃstathoragān |
khagānmṛgānpaśūnvṛkṣān girīnmartyānsarīsṛpān ||15||
sūtamāgadhabandīṃśca bhāṭṭamindraṃ yamaṃ tathā |
varuṇaṃ ca kuberaṃ ca hīśānaṃ niṛtiṃ tathā ||16||
aṣṭasiddhīrnavanidhīn rudrānekādaśāpi ca |
daityāśca dānavaॉścaiva mānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ ||17||
yajñānpuṇyajanān devavāhanāni paśūnapi |
gaurajo mahiṣaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sūkaro gavayo ruruḥ ||18||
aviruṣṭrādayaścaite dviśaphāḥ paśavastathā |
kharo’śvaḥ śarabho gauraścamaryekaśaphā ime ||19||
śvā śṛgālo vṛko vyāghro mārjāraḥ śaśaśallakau ||
siṃha kapirgajaḥ kūrmo godhā ca makarādayaḥ ||1.46.20||
kaṃkagradhravaṭaśyenabhāsabhallukabarhiṇaḥ |
haṃsasārasacakrāhvakākolūkasakukkuṭāḥ ||21||
evamādīn nāmatastānmānasānasṛjat tvajaḥ |
ādyaṃ sargaṃ mahattattvaṃ guṇavaiṣamyamasṛjat ||22||
dravyajñānakriyākṛdahamaṃ dvitīyamasṛjat |
tanmātrāṇi tṛtīyaṃ tu dravyaśaktaṃ samasṛjat ||23||
indriyāṇi caturthaṃ tu jñānakarmātma cāsṛjat ||
pañcamaṃ tu manodevān ṣaṣṭhamāvidyamasṛjat ||24||
saptamaṃ sthāvaraṃ sargaṃ vānaspatyamavāsṛjat |
aṣṭamaṃ tu gavādīnvai tiryañcaḥ samavāsṛjat ||25||
martyaṃ tu navamaṃ devasargaṃ daśamamasṛjat |
tatra tatrāpekṣitaṃ ca gauṇasargamathāsṛjat ||26||
dravyaṃ karma svabhāvaṃ ca saha ojo balaṃ tathā |
prāṇaṃ daśavidhaṃ cakre mānasān sa pitāmahaḥ ||27||
aśanāpipāse tālūṃ jihvāṃ vācaṃ hutāśanam |
ghrāṇaṃ ca nāsikāṃ netre śrotre caiva diśo daśa ||28||
romāṇīndraṃ karaṃ pādau gatimānandaśiśnakam |||
rajo yoniṃ ca vāyuṃ ca mitraṃ yajñaṃ sahavyakam ||29||
pāyūṃ ca mitrakaṃ caiva bījaṃ vīryaṃ ca raktakam ||
nābhimapānaṃ mṛtyuṃ ca kukṣimantrāṇi nāḍikāḥ ||1.46.30||
tuṣṭiṃ nadīḥ samudrām̐śca puṣṭiṃ hṛdayamityapi ||
manaścandraṃ ca saṃkalpaṃ kāmaṃ tvacaṃ ca carma ca ||31||
māṃsaṃ raktaṃ ca medaṃ ca majāmasthi tu bhūtajān |
ityetānmānasām̐ścakre prāk sṛṣṭau tatra viśvasṛk ||32||
tatra tatra tadāvāse devām̐stām̐stānatiṣṭhipat ||
āsye tvagniṃ lokapālaṃ vāṇyādevamatiṣṭhipatu ||33||
tālau tatra varuṇaṃ tu jihvādevamatiṣṭhipat ||
nasyaśvinīkumārau tu ghrāṇadevāvatiṣṭhipat ||34||
mahattattve tu vāgīśaṃ buddhidevamatiṣṭhipat ||
caraṇayostathā viṣṇu pādadevamatiṣṭhipat ||35||
akṣṇi tvaṣṭāramādityaṃ cakṣurdevamatiṣṭhipat ||
karayorindraṃ vārtārthaṃ hastadevamatiṣṭhipat ||36||
carmaṇyanilaṃ prāṇāya tvaco devamatiṣṭhipat ||
karṇayordik yathāyogyaṃ śrotradevamatiṣṭhipat ||37||
gude mitraṃ visargāṇaṃ pāyudevamatiṣṭhipat ||
tvaci kaṇḍūkṛte yāvadoṣadhīn samatiṣṭhipat ||38||
guhye meḍhraṃ mahānandaṃ brahmadevamatiṣṭhipat ||
hṛdi mano vikārāya candramasamatiṣṭhipat ||39||
mahattattve mahatsattvamahaṃkāre’bhimānakam ||
citte vijñānamādhatta mānasān tānakalpayat ||1.46.40||
mukhāttu brāhmaṇaṃ brahma bāhvostrāṇaṃ tu rājakam ||
urvorvṛttiṃ viśaṃ paddhayāṃ sevāṃ śūdrānakalpayat ||41||
brahmā svasya śarīre vai sṛṣṭiṃ sasmāra mānasīm ||
indrādayo bāhavo me diśaḥ karṇau dhvaniḥ śrutiḥ ||42||
nāsatyadasrau nāse cākṣiṇī dyauścakṣuraryamā ||
pakṣmāṇyahanī cobhe bhūvijṛmbho hyajadhiṣṇyakam ||43||
apastālū raso jihvā chandaḥ śirṣṇastathaiva ca ||
yamo daṃṣṭrā dvijāḥ snehakalonmādastu hāsyakam ||44||
apāṃgamokṣaḥ sargo’yaṃ vrīḍā cottara oṣṭhakaḥ ||
lobhastvadhara oṣṭhaḥ syāt stanau dharmo matastathā ||45||
pṛṣṭhamadharmaḥ ko meḍhraṃ vṛṣaṇau mitrakāviti ||
kukṣiḥ samudrā girayo’sthisaṃghāḥ śvasitaṃ jagat ||46||
nadyo nāḍyastanuruhāṇi bhūruhā gatirvayaḥ ||
guṇapravāhaḥ karma syāt keśā meghā manaḥ śaśī ||47||
avyaktaṃ hṛdayaṃ vāsaḥ sandhyā jñānaṃ mahattvakam 
giritramantaḥkaraṇaṃ nakhānyaśvoṣṭrahastinaḥ ||48||
śroṇirmṛgā vayāṃsi tu śaṣphāṇi manīṣā manuḥ |
martyo nivāso gandharvavidyādhrāpsarasaḥ svaraḥ ||49||
smṛtivīryaṃ brāhmaṇāstu mukhaṃ kṣatrā bhujāstathā ||
viḍūruraṃghriḥ śūdro vai nānādravyāṇi karma ca ||1.46.50||
havyakavyāmṛtānnādiraso jihvā manastu hṛt ||
vikramo bhūrbhuvaḥ svaśca chandāṃsi saptadhātavaḥ ||51||
tīrthāni nāḍyaḥ kāmāptiścaraṇaṃ hyudaraṃ mṛtiḥ ||
kośaśmaśrunakhyāneva śilālohābhravidyutaḥ ||52||
śiśna ānandaparjanyajalavīryasravā iti |
pāyuryamaparimokṣamitra ityapi mānasīm ||53||
hiṃsā niṛtirnirayo mṛtyurgudamiti pradhīḥ |
tamo’dharmaparābhūtiḥ pṛṣṭho’sthīni tu parvatāḥ ||54||
rakte’vyaktarasāḥ sarve prāk dhyātā mānasā ime |
svātmanyevaṃ paraṃ dhyātvā mānasīṃ sṛṣṭimityataḥ ||55||
yogyasthānāni teṣāṃ vai kṛtvā datvā ca tānyapi |
tebhyo hyavāsayatsarge devān tārāgrahādikān ||56||
bhūvarī yakṣarakṣaḥprabhūtapretapiśācakān |
rudrān rudragaṇām̐ścāpi gaṇikāḥ samavāsayat |
bhuvi martyānpaśūnpakṣigaṇān jantūnanekaśaḥ ||57||
parvatādau mahāraṇye gandharvāścāraṇām̐stathā |
kinnarān kiṃpuruṣām̐śca vidyādharavihaṃgamān ||58|| atalādipañcaloke’suradānavadaityakān |
mahātale kādraveyān sarpāṃśca pannagām̐stathā ||59||
pātāle tu mahānāgān brahmā vāsamadāpayat |
eṣā sarvā mahāsṛṣṭirmānasī prathame yuge ||1.46.60||
yadyathāpekṣyate kāryaṃ tathā sṛṣṭistu kalpyate ||
brahmā vikalpya sarvaṃ tanmānasād vyākarottadā ||61||
aiśvaryasrotasaścātra īśvarāḥ satyalokajāḥ ||
saṃprajñāsrotasaścātra ṛṣayo jñānino’malāḥ || 62 ||
saṃtṛptisrotasaścātra pitaraḥ śrāddhatṛptijāḥ ||
saṃpuṇyasrotasaścātra devāḥ puṇyādisampadaḥ || 63 ||
sadhyānassrotasaścātra pretā vāsanadhyānajāḥ ||
samūrdhvasrotasaścāpi rākṣasā daityadānavāḥ ||64||
arvākprasrotasaḥ pṛthvyāṃ manuṣyā rājasāḥ sadā |
tiryasrotasa evātra paśukīṭaprapakṣiṇaḥ ||65||
tamaḥsrotasa evātra nāgasarpādayo matāḥ |
avidyasrotasaścātra parvatāstarugulmakāḥ ||66||
ityevaṃ daśasrotaskānsargān dhyānakṛtānpunaḥ ||
tatra tatra sthale loke brahmā samyagatiṣṭhipat ||67||
teṣāṃ tu bhojanaṃ svasmāccharīrātsamakalpayat |
ṛṣīṇāṃ tu payaḥ chandomayaṃ bhojyamakalpayat ||68||
pitṝṇāṃ bhojanaṃ kavyaṃ siddhānāṃ siddhayo’danam ||
daiteyānāṃ surā proktā dānavānāmathāsavam ||69||
gandharvāṇāṃ tu saṃgītamapsarasāṃ tu saubhagam ||
vidyādhrāṇāṃ nabhovidyāṃ māyināmapyadarśanam ||1.46.70||
yakṣarākṣasabhūtādipretānāṃ māṃsaraktakam |
sarpodīnāṃ tu garalaṃ paśūnāṃ yavasaṃ tathā ||71||
daṃṣṭriṇāṃ palalaṃ vṛkṣavallīnāṃ vividhaṃ rasam ||
girīṇāṃ bhinnadhātūm̐śca devānāmamṛtaṃ tathā ||72||
manuṣyāṇāṃ godhūmādi pakṣiṇāṃ ca vanaspatīn |
jalajānāṃ jalajantūn sarveṣāṃ pāñcabhautikam ||73||
brahmaiva kalpayāmāsa yasya yādṛgapekṣitam |
teneyaṃ lokayātrā cā nirvahatbhūtasaṃplavam ||74||
evaṃ yuge tu prathame sāṃgopāṃgaṃ tu sarjanam |
sarva tu mānasaṃ kṛtvā virarāma pitāmahaḥ ||75||
sṛṣṭirvivardhate naiva navīnā jāyate nahi |
yathā yādṛk tathā tāvat tāvadeva hi vartate ||76||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne devayakṣamānuṣapaśupakṣidaityadānavanāgasarpasthāvarādisṛṣṭitadabhimānidevādipradarśananāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||46||

<1.47>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
mayā sṛṣṭeḥ sabhāraṃbhe divase prathame priye |
sṛṣṭistu mānasī proktā satyayugamayī hi sā || 1 ||
sthānābhimāninaścaiva sthānāni ca pṛthaka pṛthak |
sthānātmanaḥ sa sṛṣṭvā vai yugāvasthāṃ vinirmame || 2 ||
kṛtaṃ tretāṃ dvāparaṃ ca kaliṃ caiva tathā yugam ||
kalpasyādau satyayuge’sṛjatsa mānasīṃ prajām || 3 ||
catvāri tu sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ tatkṛtaṃ yugam |
sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni śatānyaṣṭau ca saṃkhyayā ||4||
abdānāṃ trisahasrāṇi tathā tretāyugaṃ matam |
sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni ṣaṭśatāni tu saṃkhyayā ||5||
varṣāṇāṃ dvisahasrāṇi yugaṃ dvāparamucyate ||
sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni catuḥśatāni saṃkhyayā || 6 |||
varṣāṇāmekasāhasraṃ yugaṃ kalimathocyate |
sandhyāṃśau tasya divyāni dviśatāni tu saṃkhyayā || 7 ||
dvādaśābdasahasrāṇi caturyugaṃ vyadhādajaḥ |
tatra kṛtayuge lakṣmi prajā mānasasiddhayaḥ ||8||
dharmādharmau na tāsvāstāṃ nirviśeṣāḥ prajāstu tāḥ |
tulyamāyuḥ sukhaṃ rūpaṃ tāsāṃ tasminkṛte yuge || 9 ||
saritsaraḥsamudrām̐śca sevante parvatānapi |
tadānātyambuśītoṣṇā yuge tasmiṃścaranti vai ||1.47.10||
manaḥsiddhyudbhavaṃ miṣṭamāhāramāharanti tāḥ ||
sarvaśaḥ kāmacāriṇyo mānasīṃ siddhimāsthitāḥ ||11||
na tāsāṃ pratighāto’sti na dvandvaṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ ||
viśokāḥ satvabahulā ekāntasukhitāḥ sadā ||12||
paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaścaiva nityaṃ muditamānasāḥ ||
sarvakāmasukhaḥ kālo mano’bhilaṣitapradaḥ ||13||
uttiṣṭhanti pṛthivyāṃ vai tābhirdhyātā rasādayaḥ ||
balarūpapradāstāsāṃ siddhiḥ sā roganāśinī ||14||
dṛḍhapuṣṭaśarīrāstāḥ prajāḥ susthirayauvanāḥ ||
tadā satyamalobhaśca kṣamā tuṣṭiḥ sukhaṃ damaḥ ||15||
nirviśeṣāstu tāḥ sarvā rūpāyuḥśīlaceṣṭitaiḥ |
satyādhāro vyavahāraḥ prajānāṃ jāyate svayam ||16||
apravṛttiḥ prajānāṃ tu karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ |
varṇāśramavyavasthāśca na tadāsan na saṃkaraḥ ||17||
rāgadveṣavihīnāstā vartayanti parasparam |
tulyasiddhyāyuṣaḥ sarvā adhamottamavarjitāḥ ||18||
sukhaprāyā aśokāśca mahotsāhā mahotsavāḥ ||
nityaprahṛṣṭamanaso mahāsatvā mahābalāḥ ||19||
lābhālābhau na tāsvāstāṃ mitrā mitre priyāpriye ||
manasā viṣayastāsāṃ nirīhāṇāṃ pravartate ||1.47.20||
anyonyaṃ naiva lipsanti nānugṛhṇanti caiva tāḥ ||
akṛṣṭapacyaṃ vai sarvamavṛṣṭisalilaṃ bhuvi ||21||
aprayatnakṛtaṃ bhojyamanāyāptasadrasam |
tatra prasavaduḥkhaṃ na na garbhadhāraṇaṃ tathā ||22||
nārīṇāṃ nārtavaṃ tatra nṝṇāṃ na vīryasaṃsravaḥ ||
sarvāḥ kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvāḥ saṃkalpasiddhayaḥ ||23||
catudarśasu lokeṣu nirviśeṣāstu sampadaḥ ||
gatayo’vyāhatāḥ sarvā vācaḥ paricitāstathā ||24||
vaimānikā avimānā yogasiddhitapobalāḥ |
īśvarā eva sarve te pūrṇakāmā iveti ca ||25||
dhyānaṃ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate |
pravṛtto dvāpare yajño dānaṃ kaliyuge varam ||26||
sattvaṃ kṛtaṃ rajastretā rajastamasī dvāparam ||
kalistamastu vijñeyo yugavṛttavaśena te ||27||
pādāvaśiṣṭo bhavati yugadharmastu sarvaśaḥ ||
satye yuge tu niḥśeṣe siddhistvantardadhe hi sā ||28||
siddhiranyā yuge tasmiṃstretāyāmabhavatpunaḥ ||
āpāṃ saukṣmye vinaṣṭe tu tadā meghātmanā punaḥ ||29||
meghebhyaḥ stanayitnubhyaḥ pravṛttaṃ varṣaṇaṃ sakṛt |
sakṛdeva tayā vṛṣṭyā plāvite pṛthivītale ||1.47.30||
prādurāsam̐stadā hyāpaḥ kalpavṛkṣā gṛhasthitāḥ ||
sarvapratyupabhogastu tebhyastāsāṃ prajāyate ||31||
kalpadrumairvartayanti tretāyugamukhe prajāḥ |
tadā rājasabhāvena tāsāmeva viparyayāt ||32||
rāgalobhātmako bhāvastadā hyākasmiko bhavat |
yattadbhavati nārīṇāṃ jīvitānte tadārtavam ||33||
satye mānasasṛṣṭānāṃ mithunānāṃ sahasrakam |
pratyekaṃ prāṇināṃ yattadidānīmārtavaṃ vyadhāt ||34||
tato vai harṣamāptāste dvandvībhūtāstu jantavaḥ |
anyonyahṛcchrayāviṣṭā maithunāyopacakramuḥ ||35||
tataḥ prabhṛti tretāyāṃ mithunotpattirucyate |
āyuṣo’nte hyekavāramārtavaṃ tatra yoṣitām ||36||
jāyate kāmabhogārthaṃ sugarbhadhāraṇāya ca |
tattadā na suṣuvire sevitairapi maithunaiḥ ||37||
āyuṣo’nte prasūyante mithunānyeva tāḥ sakṛt |
samaṃ janma ca rūpaṃ ca mriyante cāpi tāḥ saha ||38||
tasmin kṣīṇe kṛtāṃśe tu tretāyāṃ kāladharmataḥ ||
kṣīyante mānasīsiddhitapaḥśrutabalāyuṣaḥ ||39||
kṣīyante ca tadā yāvatkṛtadharmāḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ ||
pādanyūnabalatattvasāmarthyasukhavaibhavāḥ ||1.47.40||
athendreṇa hate vṛtre brahmahatyātmakaṃ malam ||
nārīvṛkṣābilāsvetaccaturbhāgaṃ prasañjitam ||41||
tataḥ prabhṛti nārīṇāṃ jīvitāntaṃ yadārtavam |
tadeva tāsāṃ pravṛttaṃ māse māse tadārtavam ||42||
tatastenaiva yogena vartatāṃ mithune tadā |
tāsāṃ tatkālabhāvitvānmāsi māsyupagacchatām ||43||
akāle hyārtavotpattirgarbhotpattirajāyata |
viparyayeṇa kālena tāsāṃ vikalanena ca ||44||
kalpavṛkṣāḥ praṇaṣṭā vai sarve sarvagṛhasthitāḥ |
kvacitkvacit tvavaśiṣṭā āśrayāgatasiddhidāḥ ||45||
kalpavṛkṣeṣu naṣṭeṣu vibhrāntā vyākulendriyāḥ ||
gatvā kvācitkakalpadrūn abhidhyāyanti vastukam ||46||
tadā vastrāṇi sūyante phalānyābharaṇāni ca ||
teṣveva jāyate tāsāṃ gandhamiṣṭarasādikam ||47||
amākṣikaṃ mahāvīryaṃ puṭake puṭake madhu ||
evaṃ sarvaparikarāḥ pravartante prayatnataḥ ||48||
tena tā vartayanti sma sukhaṃ tretāyugārdhake ||
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāstathā tuṣṭāḥ kalpavṛkṣairgatajvarāḥ ||49||
atha kāle gamyamāne punarlobhāvṛtāḥ prajāḥ ||
vṛkṣām̐stānjagṛhusteṣāṃ balānmadhuphalādikam ||1.47.50||
tāsāṃ tenāpacāreṇa tathā kālabalena ca |
praṇaṣṭāḥ kalpavṛkṣāste prajāstu nirupāśrayāḥ ||51||
śītavātātapaistīvraistatastā duḥkhitā bhṛśam |
dvandvaiśca pīḍyamānāstu cakrurāvaraṇāni ca ||52||
kṛtvā dvandvapratīkāraṃ niketāni hi bhejire |
yathāyogyaṃ niketāni sasyakṣetrāṇi bhejire ||53||
marutvatsu pranimneṣu parvateṣu nadīṣu ca ||
saṃśrayanti sma durgāṇi pradeśa śāśvatodakam ||54||
yathāyogaṃ yathākāmaṃ sameṣu viṣameṣu ca ||
ārabdhāste niketā vai kartuṃ śītoṣṇavāraṇam ||55||
ārabdhāni ca sasyānāṃ kṛṣikṣetrāṇi pārśvataḥ |
tatra saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ kheṭāni ca purāṇi ca ||56||
grāmam̐ścaivaṃ yathājoṣaṃ tathaivāntaḥpurāṇi ca ||
saṃpramāpyāṃgulaiḥ svīyairgrahādyaṃ cakrire tataḥ ||57||
kaniṣṭhāṃguṣṭhavitastirdvādaśāṃgula ucyate |
caturviṃśatibhiścaiva hastaḥ syādaṃgulairatha ||58||
caturhastaṃ dhanurdaṇḍo dvihasto bāṇa ucyate |
dhanuḥsahasre dve tatra gavyūtiḥ parikīrtitāḥ ||59||
gavyūtīnāṃ catuṣṭayaṃ yojanaṃ parikīrtitam ||
etena pṛthunā rājñā sanniveśo’pi vai kṛtaḥ ||1.47.60||
dhanūm̐ṣi daśa vistīrṇaḥ śrīmān rājapathaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
nṛvājirathanāgānāmasaṃbādhaḥ susaṃcaraḥ ||61||
amito daśadhānuṣkaṃ gṛhaṃ madhyamavargakṛt ||
śatadhanuṣkaṃ nṛpateḥ samrājastu sahasrakam ||62||
ityevaṃ vartamānānāṃ gṛhaprāsādakeṣu ca ||
kalpavṛkṣeṣu naṣṭeṣu vārtāpāyo vicintitaḥ ||63||
vṛṣṭerjalāni khātebhyo nimnagāni kṛtāni vai |
apāṃ bhūmeśca saṃśleṣādoṣadhyastāsu cābhavan ||64||
ṛtupuṣpaphalāścaiva vṛkṣā gulmāḥ prajajñire |
kaṇā aphālakṛṣṭāśca prasaṃpūrṇā prajajñire ||65||
tenauṣadhena vartante prajāstretāyuge tadā |
tataḥ punarabhūtteṣāṃ rāgo lobhaśca kālataḥ ||66||
tatastā jagṛhuścāpi nadīkṣetrāṇi parvatān ||
vṛkṣān gulmauṣadhīṃścaiva prasahya tu yathābalam ||67||
balātprasahya bhoktāraḥ kṛtvā svakīyameva ca |
haṭhātprabalā gṛhṇanti cālpatejobhya eva hi ||68||
balaiśca prabalaiścaiva svakīyā vai kṛtā kṣitiḥ ||
alpabalāstadā teṣāṃ sevayā nirvahanti vai ||69||
te tu śūdrāstadā jātāḥ paricaryāparāyaṇāḥ |
kṛṣiṃ kṛṣṭvā tu jīvanto vaiśyā jātāstathā pare ||1.47.70||
balāt pṛthvyāḥ praśāstāraḥ kṣattrā jātāstathā pare |
śāntāstu sāttvikāstatra bhikṣāṃ yācanta eva ye ||71||
brāhmaṇāste tathābhūtā mahātmānaḥ śubhāśayāḥ ||
ityevaṃ karmato varṇā brāhmaṇebhyo vijajñire ||72||
evaṃ vipratipanneṣu mānaveṣu parasparam |
tena doṣeṇa teṣāṃ tā oṣadhyo miṣatāṃ tadā ||73||
praṇaṣṭā hriyamāṇāśca nīrasā hyabhavan punaḥ ||
patrapuṣpaphalairhīnā śuṣkāyante samagrataḥ ||74||
prajā bhojyavihīnāstu vibhrāntāśca samantataḥ ||
svāyaṃbhuvaṃ prabhuṃ jagmuḥ kṣudhāviṣṭāḥ prajāpatim ||75||
vṛttyarthamarthitaṃ jñātvā brahmā samyag vicārya ca |
kṛtvā vatsaṃ sumeruṃ ca dudoha pṛthivīmimām ||76||
tadā prajajñire grāmyāraṇyā oṣadhayaḥ punaḥ |
vrīhayaśca yavāścaiva godhūmā aṇavastilāḥ ||77||
priyaṃgavo hyudārāśca kāruṣāśca satīnakāḥ |
māṣā mudgā masūrāśca niṣpāvāḥ sakulatthakāḥ||78||
āḍhakyaścaṇakāścaiva śyāmākāḥ sagavedhukāḥ |
kuruvindā veṇuyavā nivārā jartilāstathā ||79||
markaṭakāścetyaphālakṛṣṭāḥ sarvā matāḥ śubhāḥ ||
vṛkṣā gulmalatāvallīvirudhastṛṇajātayaḥ ||1.47.80||
ṛtupuṣpaphalāḥ sarvā oṣadhyo jajñire tviha |
yadā prasṛṣṭā oṣadhyo na prarohanti tāḥ punaḥ ||81||
tadā brahmā prarohārthaṃ vārtopāyaṃ cakāra ha ||
kṛṣyā tu vārtayā tāstu kṛṣṭapacyā hi jajñire ||82||
karṣukāstatra vaiśyāśca rakṣakāḥ kṣatriyāstathā |
paricarantaḥ śūdrāśca brahmārpaṇāstu brāhmaṇāḥ ||83||
gurutvaṃ tu kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ kriyāvatām |
rājyaṃ sthānaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ saṃgrāmeṣvapalāyinām ||84||
vaiśyānāṃ bhūmijaṃ sthānaṃ kṛyādiyatnajīvinām |
grāmāntakaṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ sevayā dhṛtam ||85||
tataḥ sthiteṣu varṇeṣu sthāpayāmāsa cāśramān |
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca vānaprasthaśca bhikṣukaḥ ||86||
cāturvarṇyātmakaḥ pūrvo gṛhasthaścāśramo mahān |
trayāṇāmāśramāṇāṃ sa pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca ||87||
svasvadharme sthitānāntu sthānāni brahmaṇā svayam |
kalpitāni ca tānyeva kathayāmi nibodha me ||88||
gṛhasthānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ prājāpatyaṃ mataṃ param ||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ bhavedaindraṃ nyāsināṃ brahmaṇo gṛham ||89||
satyaṃ tu brahmacārāṇāṃ vānaprasthagatāyuṣām ||
vaiśyānāṃ mārutasthānaṃ gāndharvaṃ śūdrasatkṛte ||1.47.90||
panthāno devayānāya teṣāṃ dvāraṃ raviḥ smṛtaḥ ||
tathaiva pitṛyānānāṃ candramā dvāramucyate ||91||
ityeṣādau tu tretāyāṃ sṛṣṭiḥ sarvābhyavartata ||
tretānte dvipādahrāsabalavīryasujīvanāḥ ||92||
dvāpare tripādahrāsabalavīryādijīvanāḥ ||
kalau yathākathaṃcijjīvanā vai sakalāḥ prajāḥ ||93||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yugavarṣasaṃkhyākṛtayugasiddhipādahrāsamithunasṛṣṭinagarādimānabhakṣyauṣadhivarṇāśramasthāpanādināmā saptacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||47||

<1.48>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
indrasya brahmahatyā tu kathaṃ jāteti me hṛdi |
paraṃ kutūhalaṃ prāptaṃ tatkathāṃ kathaya prabho || 1 ||
pṛthunā ca kadā pṛthvī samīkṛteti kīrtaya |
tatpūrvaṃ kīdṛśī devī samāsītpṛthivī prabho || 2||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi hyāditastāṃ kathāṃ śubhām |
yā śrutā bhagavadyogātpāpahantrī bhavatyapi || 3 ||
brahmaṇo marīciḥ putrastasya vai kaśyapaḥ sutaḥ |
kaśyapasya tvadityāṃ ca tvaṣṭā putro hyabhūcchubhaḥ || 4 ||
tvaṣṭā patnyāṃ racanāyāṃ viśvarūpamajījanat ||
viśvarūpo’bhavattatra devānāṃ tu purohitāḥ || 5 ||
ekadendrasabhāyāṃ tu bṛhaspatirupāgamat |
abhyutthānādinā cendraḥ satkāraṃ tasya nācarat || 6 ||
tata ārabhya gururāḍ bṛhaspatirdivaukasām |
paurohityaṃ tu tatyāja devānāmityataḥ param || 7 ||
paurohityaṃ dadāvindro viśvarūpāya tatparam ||
indreṇa tu kṛte yajñe viśvarūpaḥ purohitaḥ || 8 ||
devebhyastu baliṃ datvāsurebhyo’pi dadau rahaḥ |
daityāstu mātulāstasya tasmācchannaṃ baliṃ dadau || 9 ||
pracchannaṃ tatpradattaṃ vai baliṃ jñātvā tu devarāṭ |
cukrodha jagṛhe śastraṃ ciccheda tacchirastrayam ||1.48.10||
ekaṃ tu mastakaṃ tasya somapānakaraṃ hyabhūt ||
tacchedane tu sañjātāḥ pakṣiṇo vai kapiñjalāḥ ||11||
dvitīyaṃ mastakaṃ tasya kvāthapānakaraṃ hyabhūt ||
tacchedane tu sañjātāḥ kalaviṃkāstu pakṣiṇaḥ ||12||
tṛtīyaṃ mastakaṃ tasya cānnabhojanakṛt tvabhūt ||
tacchedane tu sañjātāstittirākhyāstu pakṣiṇaḥ ||13||
purohitacchiraśchede brahmahatyā babhūva sā ||
raktā kṣārā harit kṛṣṇā bhayadā citrarūpiṇī ||14||
vavalge sā mahendraṃ tu citravarṇo’bhavaddhi saḥ ||
tato devairmilitvā tāṃ caturbhāgairvibhajya ca ||15||
yajñānte’śrāvayatspaṣṭaṃ deyā vinimayena hi ||
brahmahatyāturyabhāgaṃ gṛhṇantu vyaktayastu yāḥ ||16||
tābhyo deyo varastāsāmiṣṭa eva na saṃśayaḥ ||
śrutvā tu kāmatṛptyarthaṃ nārībhirīpsito varaḥ ||17||
arthitaḥ kāmabhoge vai bahumaithuna sevane |
kṛte’pi na śramo nityakāmabhogo’stu caicchikaḥ ||18||
devairevaṃ varaṃ datvā brahmahatyā caturthakaḥ ||
bhāgo’rpitastu nārībhyastadraktamārtavaṃ hyabhūt ||19||
tata ārabhya nārīṇāṃ kāmadevo navo navaḥ ||
māsi māsi rajolābhaḥ puṣpaṃ garbhadhṛgapyabhūt ||1.48.20||
atha bhūmyārthitaṃ yatra yatra me nimnatā bhavet |
khātatā vā tatra tatra prapūrtirme sadā bhavet ||21||
imaṃ varaṃ dharāyai tu datvā bhāgaṃ caturthakam ||
bhūmeḥ khātapradeśāstu pūryante tatsvabhāvataḥ ||22||
tatra tatra kṣārabhāgo bhavatīti tu tatphalam |
athavṛkṣādibhistatrārthitaṃ hyākasmikasthitau ||23||
kṣate chinne ca bhugne ca punaḥ saṃrohaṇaṃ bhavet ||
datvā drubhyo varastatra hatyābhāgacaturthakaḥ ||24||
drubhyo dattaśca teṣāṃ vai kṛṣṇagundrasravaśca yaḥ ||
na bhakṣyate sa vai kīṭo brahmahatyāphalātmakaḥ ||25||
athādbhiḥ svepsitastatra varo’pyarthita udgame ||
jalapūrtirbhavetprasravaṇādyeṣu samantataḥ ||26||
yatra dravye jalakṣepastasya vṛddhirbhavet sadā ||
tatra vāso rasarūpeṇāsmākaṃ bhavatāditi ||27||
tādṛgvarastu tebhyo vai hatvā hatyācaturthakam |
datte tena jale bhūmau sarvadā pūrtirīkṣyate ||28||
jale hatyāsvarūpantu śaivālaḥ phenabudbudāḥ ||
ityevaṃ brahmahatyānāṃ bhāgāścatvāra īritāḥ ||29||
icchukebhyaśca dattāste hīndraḥ śuddhiṃ jagāma ha |
tata ārabhya devendro yajñānkārayati prathān ||1.48.30||
athendrasya vivadhārthaṃ putraniṣkrayalabdhaye ||
hataputrastadā tvaṣṭā juhāvāgnau samantrakam ||31||
indraśātṛ vivardhasva jahīndraṃ cātra satvaram |
iti homena tatraiva puruṣo ghoradarśanaḥ ||32||
samutpede mahākāyaḥ kālasannibharūpadhṛk ||
nityaṃ sahasra hastānāṃ vardhamāno’gradhūmrabhaḥ ||33||
kāntyā sandhyābbhrasadṛśaḥ triśūlaṃ bhrāmayan sthitaḥ ||
tāmrāmakeśajaṭilo madhyāhnārkogranetravān ||34||
garjaṃśca kampayan pṛthvīmākāśaṃ saṃlihanniva |
prakāśaṃ bhakṣayannagre’ndhaṃ tama udvamanniva ||35||
andhakārasvarūpeṇa tena lokāḥ samāvṛtāḥ |
sa vai vṛtra iti nāmnā tvaṣṭrāhūtastu dāruṇaḥ ||36||
taṃ devāḥ samabhidrutya nijaghnurdivyahetibhiḥ |
astraśastrāṇi sarvāṇi so’grasatsarvataḥ svayam ||37||
vismitāśca tadā devā viṣaṇṇā naṣṭatejasaḥ ||
antaḥsthitaṃ prabhu devamastuvan bhagnavṛttayaḥ ||38||
namo’stu te śrīpuruṣottamāya brahmādhidevāya parātparāya |
brahmātmane muktatanusthitāya namo’stu te trāhi bhayāvṛtānnaḥ ||39||
śrīvāsudevaprabhṛtīśvarāṇāṃ vaikuṇṭhadhāmādipatīśvarāṇām |
sadāśivādīśvarakoṭikānāṃ śāstre namastrāṇamatho kuru tvam ||1.48.40||
tvayāsvapṛṣṭhe vidhṛtastu śailaḥ śrṛṃge svakīye’vadhṛtā tu naukā |
tvayāsvadante’vadhṛtā vasundhrā sa eva devaḥ prakarotu rakṣām ||41||
vayaṃ visṛṣṭāḥ paripālanāya tannaśyāma īkṣāndhatamaḥ suviklavāḥ ||
śastrāstrahīnā ariṇārditā muhurdevādhidevo’raṇamārtihā kriyāt ||42||
iti stutvā viraramurdevā brahmapurogamāḥ |
bhagavān śrīharistatrāvirbabhūva dhṛtāyudhaḥ ||43||
sarvāvayavasaundaryadivyadhyeyamanoharaḥ |
daṇḍavatpatitā devāḥ punarutthāya tuṣṭuvuḥ ||44||
pāhi nātha mahāghorād vṛtrāsuramahābhayāt |
hare tvāṃ vai prapannāḥ sma trātāramacyutaṃ prabhum ||45||
śrīhariruvāca
indra yāhi svasti vo’stu dadhyaṃcaṃ yoginamṛṣim |
vidyātapomayaṃ gātraṃ yācateti pradāsyati ||46||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ityuktvā śrīharistāvat tatraivāntardadhe tataḥ ||
devā gatvā tu dadhyañcamayācata muhustanum ||47||
dadhyañcā suprasannena paropakṛtiśālinā |
śarīraṃ yogamāsthāya parityaktaṃ tadaiva hi ||48||
tadasthikāritaṃ vajramindraścādāya harṣataḥ ||
vṛtramabhyadravaddhantuṃ harṣayandevamaṇḍalam ||49||
tatra devā rudravasvādityāgnivāyavastathā |
pitaraḥ ṛbhavaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ kumārakāḥ ||1.48.50||
anye ca devatāstatra militā raṇagāminaḥ ||
asurāścāpi vṛtrasthā vṛtrapakṣaprapātinaḥ ||51||
namuciśaṃbarānarvaṃdvimūrdharṣabhakālayaḥ |
hayagrīvaśaṃkuśiravipracittisvayomukhāḥ ||52||
pulomavṛṣaparvādihetiprahetidānavāḥ|
yakṣāśca rākṣasāścāpi siṃhagarjanakārakāḥ ||53||
sarvaśastrakarāste vai gadāparighapāṇayaḥ |
bāṇatomaramudgaprāsaśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ ||54||
khaḍgaiḥ śastraistathāstraiśca śataghnībhūśuṇḍibhirhi saḥ ||
sarvato’vākirankrodhāttumulaṃ vibudharṣabhān ||55||
teṣāṃ śastrāṇi devaistu bhagnānyeva sahasradhā ||
vṛtrapakṣāḥ palāyitā devāḥ svāsthyaṃ pralebhire ||56||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvarūpasya hatyāyāścaturdhā vitaraṇaṃ vṛtrotpattirvṛtranāśāya dadhyaṃcāsthinirmitavajreṇa yuddhamiti nirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo’dhyāyaḥ ||48||

<1.49>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
vṛtraḥ prāha prabhagnām̐stānpalāyato vihasya vai ||
he vipracitte namuce puloman śambarādayaḥ || 1||
dhruvo janmajuṣāṃ mṛtyuḥ śūrāṇāmapi dehinām ||
āgatasya svabhāvasya pratīkāro na vidyate || 2 ||
śūrāṇāṃ raṇamadhye vai śatrūṇāṃ prativakṣasi ||
kathaṃ mṛtyurna vai pūjyo yaśase śreyase tathā || 3 ||
mokṣadau tu matau mṛtyū dvāveva niyatau yathā |
yogināṃ yogarandhreṇa śūrāṇāṃ śastrarandhrataḥ || 4 ||
ityevaṃ bodhyamānāpi vṛtrasenā palāyitā ||
nāgṛhṇāt taddharmavacaḥ prāṇāpattrastamānasā || 5 ||
tadā kruddhaḥ punarvṛtro vyājahāra sabhartsanam ||
kiṃ mātṛhantṛbhiḥ kṣudrairnāmadhāmavināśibhiḥ || 6 || 
pṛṣṭhamṛtyusamāsadbhirmātṛdugdhaviḍambibhiḥ
na vai palāyane kīrtirna loko na parāgatiḥ || 7 ||
nāyaṃ dravadraṇaḥ ślāghyaḥ kṣullakānāmivārtidaḥ ||
svasthā bhavantu sammukhā jayaṃ yāntu mamāgrataḥ ||8||
iti śrutvā balaṃ prāptāḥ parāvṛtya tadā ca te ||
bhīṣayantaḥ surān śastrairardayāmāsurulbaṇāḥ || 9 ||
vṛtrastvindrebhakuṃbhe vai gadāṃ cikṣepa dhātavīm ||
gajaḥ prahāraghātena saptadhanurapāsarat ||1.49.10||
indro jagrāha vajraṃ tad daityabhrātṛhaṇaṃ yadā |
vṛtraḥ prāha paraṃ kruddho diṣṭyā me samavasthitaḥ ||11||
brahmahā guruhā me ca bhrātṛhā śiṣyahā tathā |
diṣṭyānṛṇo bhavāmyeṣa śūlena sādito mayā ||12||
śrotrīyaṃ ca guruṃ bālaṃ viśvastaṃ dīkṣitaṃ dvijam ||
khaḍgena hatvā te nūnaṃ kā gatiḥ saṃbhaviṣyati ||13||
hrīśrīdayādihīnaṃ tvāṃ gradhrāḥ khādantu bhūtale |
mama śūlena nirbhinnamaspṛṣṭavahnikaṃ śavam ||14||
yadi vajreṇa naṣṭo’haṃ gatiṃ yāsyāmi śūragām ||
yadi śūlena naṣṭastvaṃ padamaindraṃ mama dhruvam ||15||
athavā kinnu rājyena nirayeṇa matena vai |
rāgadveṣau na me syātāṃ śrīharirme prasīdatu ||16||
dāsānudāso bhavitā tava vajreṇa nāśitaḥ |
saṃsārapāśaduḥkhābdhermocitaḥ syāmahaṃ tvayā ||17||
seviṣye bhagavatpādaṃ kariṣye bhaktasevanam ||
kimanena vinaśvarakāyalokapadādinā ||18||
mā bhūyānmama cittasya saṃgo gehātmajādiṣu ||
sarvadā mama saṃbhūyād vāsastaccaraṇādiṣu ||19||
ityevaṃ katthamānāya vṛtrāya prāhiṇod gadām ||
gurvīṃ parvatasaṃkāśāmindro vajradharastadā ||1.49.20||
līlayeva gadāṃ tāṃ tu vṛtro jagrāha pāṇinā |
tāvadindraḥ svakaṃ vajraṃ prāhiṇod vṛtraśāntaye ||21||
taṃ ca lohamayaṃ vajramagrasanmukhagartayā |
vṛtro’thendravināśāya triśūlaṃ samavāsṛjat ||22||
jagādādya hato’syatra pāpa yāhi yamālayam |
indraḥ śatāravajreṇācchinat kṣaṇāt triśūlakam ||23||
yāvadvṛtro dvitīyaṃ tu śūlaṃ jagrāha pāṇinā | 
tāvadindro’nyavajreṇācchinatsabhujaśūlakam ||24||
ekena hastena tadā ca vṛtro vegena jagrāha ca śūlamanyat ||
cikṣepa cendrāya punastadānīṃ saṃgṛhya cānyaṃ parighaṃ tamāha ||25||
mṛto’sīndra gato’sīndra pūrvajānāṃ gamisthale |
kṛtvā tu garjanāṃ ghorāṃ tatāḍendraṃ hanau pragham ||26||
hastāttu nyapatadvajraṃ maghavāpi bhramiṃ gataḥ ||
devāḥ siddhāśca śūrāśca hā heti cukruśurbhṛśam ||27||
vṛtraścendraṃ tadā prāha vajraṃ gṛhāṇa pāṇinā |
raṇabhūmau gatānāṃ tu kā hrīrbalatulāpaṇe ||28||
āyuḥ śrīḥ kīrtiraiśvaryaṃ gṛhadārāsusampadaḥ
naiva santīti kṛtvaiva viharasva raṇāṃgaṇe | 29||
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ mṛtyujīvī mānāmāne jayājayau |
sarvaṃ māyāmayaṃ jñātvā viharasva raṇāṃgaṇe ||1.49.30||
raṇāsanaśca śastrākṣaḥ prāṇaglaho’yamucyate |
akasmādvijayaḥ kasya yāte prāṇe prapatsyate ||31||
śrutvedantu bhāgavataṃ vacanaṃ vṛtranoditam |
tutoṣa paramaṃ tasmai vajramādāya pāṇinā ||32||
cikṣepa yāvad vṛtrāya tāvat sa daityarāṭ drutam ||
kṛtvādharāṃ hanuṃ bhūmau vṛtro divyuttarāṃ hanum ||33||
śīghraṃ savajramindrantu vṛtro jagrāsa tatkṣaṇam |
hāhākāro mahānāsīccukruśuśca maharṣayaḥ ||34||
tāvadindraḥ svavajreṇodaraṃ tadvajrakartitam |
bhittvā kukṣiṃ viniṣkramya hyuccakarta śirastataḥ ||35||
papāta bhūmau yāvadvai vṛtracchinnamahātanuḥ ||
nedurdundubhayo devamārge hṛṣṭā maharṣayaḥ ||36||
jagurgandharvasiddhāścāpsaraso nanṛturmudā |
puṣpavṛṣṭistadā devaiḥ kṛtā vijayagītikā ||37||
vṛtrātmā paśyatāṃ tatra līno mahasi brahmaṇaḥ |
hate vṛtre tadā lokā vijvarā hyabhavannatha ||38||
pratijagmuḥ svadhiṣṇyāni devā brahmādayaḥ punaḥ ||
vṛtraghātasamutpannahatyayendrastu duḥkhitaḥ ||39||
na ca śarma manāk lebhe hatyāṃ nāśayituṃ tataḥ |
maharṣīn prārthayāmāsa hatyāṃ kva mārjayāmyaham ||1.49.40||
prāhustu ṛṣayastaṃ vai hayamedhena yājaya ||
iṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ mokṣyase pāparāśitaḥ ||41||
brahmahā pitṛhā gohā mātṛhā guruhā tathā |
śuddhyati yajanād yasya nāmakīrtanasevanāt ||42||
evaṃ prerita indrastu brahmahatyāparādrutaḥ |
udīciṃ diśamāśritya mānasākhye sarovare ||43||
varṣamekaṃ mahānāle hyuvāsa tāpapīḍitaḥ |
cāṇḍālī ghorakṛṣṇā sā raktavastrāntracarviṇī ||44||
durgandhā paritastatra saraso’pyanvavartata ||
ṛṣayastaṃ samāhūya hayamedhena sarvaśaḥ ||45||
yathāvad dīkṣayāṃcakruḥ puruṣārādhanena ca |
pūrṇe’śvamedhe saṃjāte hatyānāśaṃ gatā tathā ||46||
indro vidhūtapāpaḥ san svargarājyamagātpunaḥ ||
katheyaṃ lakṣmi divyāsti sūkṣmarūpeṇa matkṛtā ||47||
sthūlākhyānena te devi darśitā sukhasaṃśravā |
sūryādigrahagatidā śaktirindraḥ samucyate ||48||
jalaprakāśarodhāḍhyā śaktirvṛtraḥ samucyate ||
jalaprakāśasāmarthyād grahāḥ sugatikāḥ sadā ||49||
vṛtro’ndhakārarūpaḥ sa gatirodhaṃ karoti vai ||
tannāśāya mahānindro yuddhaṃ karoti nityaśaḥ ||1.49.50||
viśeṣeṇa tu śaradi hīndro hantyasuraṃ tadā |
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ hatyāphalamaniṣṭadam ||51||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vṛtranāśottarabrahmahatyāvināśakahayamedhakaraṇādinirūpaṇanāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||49||

<1.50>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha pṛthvyāḥ samīkāraḥ kathaṃ vai pṛthunā kṛtaḥ |
tatte vacmi mahālakṣmi katheyaṃ brahmadāyinī || 1 ||
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ |
tasya tāsvayanaṃ yasmāttato nārāyaṇo virāṭ || 2 ||
virājo nābhipadyādvai padmaṃ yadabhavanmahat |
tatra brahmā svayaṃ jajñe dadarśa jālapūritam || 3 ||
kamalaṃ tu svakīyaṃ tajjale kardamarūpiṇī |
pṛthivīkledimāvyāptā na raukṣyaṃ tatra dṛśyate || 4 ||
vinā raukṣyaṃ kathaṃ tatra pārthivajanisevinām |
nivāso vṛkṣavallīnāmudbhavaścāpi saṃbhavet || 5 ||
tatastu brahmaṇā nārāyaṇasya stutirīritā |
nārāyaṇa dayāsindho sarvādhāra prapoṣaka || 6 ||
vinā pṛthulabhāvaṃ vai jale sthāsyanti kāḥ prajāḥ |
tasmājjale sthitāmārdrāṃ sūkṣmakardamarūpiṇīm || 7 ||
sthūlāvasthāṃ samānayya pṛthvīrūpaṃ kuru prabho |
tadvinā mānavī sṛṣṭiścatuḥkhanyabhirūpiṇī || 8 ||
kutra sthāsyanti bhakṣyaṃ vā kasmātprāpsyanti ityapi |
namo’nantasvarūpāya namo dharmadharāya ca || 9 ||
namaḥ sthūlasvarūpāya namaḥ sūkṣmasvarūpiṇe |
namo’nvayasvarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||1.50.10||
namo’kṣarasvarūpāya namo muktātmakāya te |
namo vyūhasvarūpāya namaḥ kālasvarūpiṇe ||11||
namaḥ kṛṣṇādirūpāya namo hiraṇmayāya ca |
namo vairājarūpāya namo golokavāsine ||12||
namo vaikuṇṭhavāsāya namo’vyākṛtavartine |
namo devāya śāntāya sūkṣmatatvāntarātmane ||13||
namaḥ kāryasvarūpāya namaḥ kāraṇarūpiṇe |
namo nārīsvarūpāya namo bījapradāyine ||14||
namaḥ pṛthusvarūpāya namaḥ salilaśāyine |
namo’gnyarkasvarūpāya namo yajñamayāya ca ||15||
kṛpāṃ kuru kṛpānātha jalātsthaulyaṃ vibhāvaya |
ityevaṃ stūyamānaḥ sa devadevo janārdana ||16||
divyaṃ śvetaṃ saumyarūpaṃ dadhāra kāryasiddhaye |
sahasravadano devaḥ sahasralambadanturaḥ ||17||
sahasraghoṇanāsāsyaḥ sahasrakhurapādukaḥ |
dvisahasramahānetro mahāromāñcagātrakaḥ ||18||
sahasrapucchavālardhiḥ sahasradvayakarṇakaḥ |
mahāmerusamastatra babhūva kṣaṇamātrataḥ ||19||
prahasyājaṃ svayaṃ prāha jalānme vai pratāpataḥ |
pṛthvīṃ sthūlāṃ kariṣye’hamānayiṣye tatastadut ||1.50.20||
mama vaktreṣu danteṣu lambamāneṣu sarvathā |
amblamākarṣakaṃ piṇḍīkāraṃ sāmarthyamābhṛtam ||21||
mama dantasamāśleṣājalāni nirmalāni ca |
bhaviṣyantyacirāt tatra sthūlabhāvaḥ pṛthagbhavet ||22||
kardamānāṃ piṇḍībhāvasāmarthyena tu danturāḥ |
piṇḍān vidhāpya tānsarvānekīkṛtya samagrataḥ ||23||
kāṭhinyabhāvamāpannāṃ pṛthvīṃ golakarūpiṇīm ||
kṣaṇataścānayiṣyanti jalordhvasthāṃ tavāgrataḥ ||24||
brahmam̐statra nivāsastu sarveṣāṃ sugamo bhavet |
ityāmantrya gato devo vārāhaḥ śvetarūpavān ||25||
jalamālokya kṛtsnaṃ tatsthaulyakardamasaṃstarān |
piṇḍānkṛtvā svake ghoṇe sthāpayāmāsa koṭiśaḥ ||26||
ekīkṛtya ca tānsarvāngolakaṃ saṃvidhāya ca |
dhṛtvā ghoṇadatormadhye hyājagāma jalopari ||27||
golaṃ pṛthvīmahāpiṇḍaṃ nidhāya ca jalopari |
virarāma mahābhūtaḥ śūkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ ||28||
brahmā ca ṛṣayaḥ sarve nāradādyā munīśvarāḥ |
tuṣṭuvuḥ kṛtakāryaṃ taṃ saumyaṃ pṛthvīdharaṃ harim ||29||
namo yajñasvarūpāya citīmukhāya te namaḥ |
vedapādyupadaṃṣṭrāya tatkratuvakṣase namaḥ ||1.50.30||
analajihvāya darbharomṇe tapasvine namaḥ |
brahmaśirṣṇe namo vedatadaṃgaśratisragviṇe ||31||
ahorātrakṣaṇadhṛge namaḥ sruvasutuṇḍine |
namaḥ sadājyanāsāya sāmaghoṣasvanāya ca ||32||
mahate satyadharmāya namo vikramaśāline |
prāyaścittarathāya oṃ ghorāya paśujānave ||33||
udgātrantrāya devāya homaliṃgāya te namaḥ |
sthānabījāya devāya sanmahauṣadhaye namaḥ ||34||
namo mantrasphije bhūmne namo vedyāntarātmane |
nama ājyaspṛje somaśoṇitāya ca te namaḥ ||35||
vedaskandhāya śāntāya havirgandhāya te namaḥ |
havyakavyātivegāya namaḥ prāgvaṃśadehine ||36||
namo dyutimate nānādīkṣānvitāya te namaḥ|
namaste dakṣiṇāhṛde yogine satrarūpiṇe ||37||
namaḥ pravargyavittādibhūṣaṇāya mahātmane |
upākarmeṣṭirucirabrahmaṇe prabhave namaḥ ||38||
nānāchandogatipathajuṣe prāṇāya te namaḥ |
namo guhyopaniṣadāsanāya savanāya te ||39||
iti stutaḥ paro devo hyāśīrdatvā tirodadhe |
vārāhasya tirodhāne pṛthvīṃ dṛṣṭvā svayaṃ tvajaḥ ||1.50.40||
cintayāmāsa satataṃ sarvataḥ śikharānvitām |
kvāpi nimnāṃ ca khātāṃ ca kvāpi pāṣāṇaparvatām ||41||
samyagālocya vedhāḥ sa punaḥ sasmāra taṃ prabhum |
tadā pṛthusvarūpeṇa sadhanuṣkaḥ sa ābabhau ||42||
tasya dakṣakare cakradhanuṣościhnamīkṣitam ||
brahmaṇā niścito devo bhagavānayamityatha ||43||
pṛthivyāḥ pravibhāgīya pṛthvīṃ nātha samīkuru |
ityarthitaḥ pṛthurdevastadā saṃvartakāgninā ||44||
dāhayāmāsa bhūtuṇḍān viśīrṇā bhasmasaṃcayāḥ |
jātāḥ sarve mṛdavaste mṛttikāstāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||45||
samīkṛtya mahīṃ sarvāṃ mṛttikāstaraśobhanām |
bījānyādhāya tatsthalyāṃ sasyasampatkarīṃ vyadhāt || 46||
yatrādagdhāstu pāṣāṇāstatra tatparvatānvyadhāt |
yatra nimnapradeśāstu tatra sārasakān vyadhāt ||47||
pṛthunā tu bhagavatā nārāyaṇamahātmanā |
svena kṣetrāṇyaraṇyāni grāmanagarakharvaṭāḥ ||48||
khātākhātāḥ samudrāśca nadyo nadamahāplavāḥ |
kṛtāḥ samayamālokya yatrāvaśyakatā yathā ||49||
lokānprakalpayitvā ca prajāsargaṃ sasarja saḥ |
pṛthuḥ rājyaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā vyavasthāṃ vāsadāyinīm ||1.50.50||
kṛtvā ca brahmaṇe datvā svayamantarbabhūva ha ||
tata ārabhya sapaṭā samānā ca samasthalī ||51||
babhūva mahatī devī pṛthvī yogyavasānakā |
punarnāśe punardevaḥ pṛthurbhūtvā hariḥ svayam ||52||
kariṣyati samāṃ pṛthvīṃ rājā bhūtvā muhurmuhuḥ |
brahmaṇaḥ khalu kalpānte daśalokātmikā tu bhūḥ ||53||
layaṃ jale yadā yāyāt tadā tatra muhurmuhuḥ |
svayaṃ hariḥ pṛthurbhūtvā pṛthvīṃ samīkariṣyati ||54||
kadācit pṛthuścāhaṃ mānasaḥ saṃbhavāmi ha |
kadācittu ṛṣibhyo vā rājabhyo vā janigrahaḥ ||55||
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ pṛthurūpaṃ mayā dhṛtam |
atha vai dvāparānte tu kimabhūt kathayāmi te ||56||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaśāyinārāyaṇena vārāharūpeṇa pṛthvyuddhāraḥ pṛthurūpeṇa pṛthvīsamīkaraṇādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||

<1.51>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi prajā yāstu syurvai mithunadharmajāḥ |
vedhaso’bhidhyāyato vai patiḥ patnī babhūvatuḥ || 1 ||
prāk ca svāyaṃbhuvamanuḥ śatarūpā ca tadvadhūḥ |
tābhyāṃ mithunadharmeṇa prajā hyedhāmbabhūvire ||2||
labdhvā svāyaṃbhuvaḥ patnīṃ reme sārdhaṃ tayā muhuḥ |
prathamaṃ samprayogaḥ saḥ kalpādau samavartata || 3 ||
priyavratottānapādau tayoḥ putrau babhūvatuḥ |
ākūtiśca prasūtiśca dve kanye ca babhūvatuḥ || 4 ||
dadau prasūtiṃ dakṣāya ākūtiṃ rucaye dadau |
ākūtyāṃ mithunaṃ jajñe yajñaścāpi ca dakṣiṇā || 5 ||
tābhyāṃ prajāstu yāmākhyā devā dvādaśa jajñire|
dakṣātprasūtyāṃ kanyāstu caturviṃśatijajñire || 6 ||
sarvāstā brahmavādinyo yoginyo lokamātaraḥ |
śraddhā lakṣmīrdhṛtistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭirmedhā kriyā tathā || 7 ||
buddhirlajjā vapuḥ śāntiḥ siddhiḥ kīrtistrayodaśī |
etāstu pratijagrāha dharmaḥ patnyarthameva hi || 8 ||
tābhyaḥ śiṣṭā yavīryasya ekādaśa sulocanāḥ |
khyātiḥ satyatha saṃbhūtiḥ smṛtiḥ prītiḥ kṣamā tathā || 9 ||
sannatiścānasūyā ca ūrjā svāhā svadhā tathā |
tāstataḥ pratyapadyanta ekādaśa maharṣayaḥ ||1.51.10||
bhavo bhṛgurmarīciśca hyaṃ girāḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
pulastyo’trirvaśiṣṭhaśca pitaro’gnistathaiva te ||11||
satī bhavāya prāyacchatkhyātiṃ ca bhṛgave tathā |
marīcaye tu saṃbhūtiṃ smṛtimaṃgīrase dadau ||12||
prītiṃ dadau pulastyāya kṣamāṃ tu pulahāya ca |
kratave sannatiṃ caiva hyanasūyāṃ tathātraye ||13||
ūrjāṃ dadau vaśiṣṭhāya svāhāṃ ca hyagnaye dadau |
svadhāṃ caiva pitṛbhyastu tāsvapatyāni maithunāt ||14||
śraddhāṃ kāmaṃ vijajñe vai darpo lakṣmyāḥ sutaḥ smṛtaḥ |
dhṛtestu niyamaḥ putrastuṣṭyāḥ santoṣa ucyate ||15||
puṣṭyā lābhaḥ sutaścāpi medhāputraḥ śrutastathā |
kriyāyāstu nayaḥ prokto daṇḍaḥ samaya ityapi ||16||
buddherbodhaḥ sutaścāpi hyapramādaśca tāvubhau |
lajjāyā vinayaḥ putro vyavasāyo vapuḥsutaḥ ||17||
kṣemaḥ śantisutaścāpi sukha siddhervyajāyata |
yaśaḥ kīrteḥ sutaścāpi hītyete dharmasūnavaḥ ||18||
kāmasya harṣaḥ putrau vai devyāṃ ratyāṃ vyajāyata |
ityeṣo vai sukhodarkaḥ sargo dharmasya maithunāt ||19||
bhavaḥ satyāmasaṃkhyātān rudrān raudrānsamasṛjat |
brahmaṇā mā sṛjetyukte hyūrdhvaretāḥ sthito haraḥ ||1.51.20||
tataḥ prabhṛti śaṃbhustu prāsūyata na vai prajāḥ |
brahmacārī sthitaḥ sthāṇuryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ||21||
jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ |
sṛṣṭṛtvamātmasaṃbodhastvadhiṣṭhātṛtvameva ca ||22||
aiśvaryāṇi daśaitāni nityaṃ tiṣṭhanti śaṃkare |
sarvadā bhānayuktatvād yuktayogī maheśvaraḥ ||23||
maheśvaraprasādādvai trīdaṇḍī jāyate naraḥ |
vākdaṇḍaḥ karmadaṇḍaśca manodaṇḍaśca te trayaḥ ||24||
yasyaite niyatā daṇḍāstridaṇḍī mukta eva saḥ |
ariṣṭāni svayaṃ jñātvā mṛtyu paśyati cātmanaḥ ||25||
śṛṇu lakṣmi prasaṃgādvai tāni vakṣyāmi kṛtsnaśaḥ |
vijñāyeta yadaivaṃ tajjñātavyaṃ maraṇaṃ svakam ||26||
arundhatīṃ dhruvaṃ caiva somacchāyāṃ sitampatham |
yo na paśyet sa no jīvennaraḥ saṃvatsarātparam ||27||
araśmivantamādityaṃ raśmivantaṃ ca pāvakam |
yaḥ paśyenna sa jīvedvai māsādekādaśātparam ||28||
vamenmūtraṃ purīṣaṃ vā suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā |
pratyakṣamathavā svapne daśamāsān sa jīvati ||29||
agrataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi khaṇḍaṃ yasya padaṃ bhavet |
pāṃsule kardame vāpi saptamāsān sa jīvati ||1.51.30||
kākaḥ kapoto gṛdhro vā nilayed yasya mūrdhani |
kravyādo vā khagaḥ kaścit ṣaṇmāsān nātivartate ||31||
badhyeta vāyasapaṃktyāṃ pāṃśuvarṣeṇa vā punaḥ |
chāyāṃ vā vikṛtāṃ paśyeccatuḥ paṃca sa jīvati ||32||
anabhre vidyutaṃ paśyed dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritām ||
udakendradhanurvāpi trayo dvau vā sa jīvati ||33||
apsu vā yadi vādarśe ātmānaṃ yo na paśyati |
aśiraskaṃ tathātmānaṃ māsādūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||34||
śavagandhi bhavedgātraṃ vasāgandhi hyathāpi vā |
mṛtyurhyupasthitastasya cārdhamāsaṃ sajīvati ||35||
yasya vai snātamātrasya hṛtpādau vāvaśuṣyataḥ |
dhūmaṃ vā mastakātpaśyed daśāhaṃ na sa jīvati ||36||
saṃbhinno māruto yasya marmasthānāni kṛntati ||
adbhiḥ spṛṣṭo na hṛṣyecca tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||37||
ṛkṣājavānarayuktarathenāśāṃ tu dakṣiṇām |
gatyannatha vrajet svapne vidyānmṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||38||
kṛṣṇāmbaradharā śyāmā gāyikā vātha cāṃganā |
yaṃ nayed dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ svapne so’pi na jīvati ||39||
chidraṃ vāsaśca kṛṣṇaṃ ca svapne yo bibhṛyānnaraḥ |
bhagnaṃ vā śravaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā vidyānmṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||1.51.40||
āmastakatalād yastu nimajjetpaṃkasāgare |
dṛṣṭvā tu tādṛśaṃ svapnaṃ sadya eva na jīvati ||41||
bhasmāṃgārām̐śca keśām̐śca nadīṃ śuṣkāṃ bhujaṃgamān |
paśyed yo daśarātraṃ tu na sa jīvettu tādṛśaḥ ||42||
kṛṣṇaiśca vikaṭaiścaiva puruṣairudyatāyudhaiḥ |
pāṣāṇaistāḍyate svapne yaḥ sadyo na sa jīvati ||43||
sūryodaye pratyūṣasi pratyakṣaṃ yasya vai śivā |
krośantī sammukhābhyeti sa gatāyurbhavennaraḥ ||44||
yasya vai snātamātrasya hṛdayaṃ pīḍyate bhṛśam |
jāyate dantaharṣaśca taṃ gatāyuṣamādiśet ||45||
bhūyo bhūyaḥ śvased yastu rātrau vā yadi vā divā |
dīpagandhaṃ ca no vetti vidyānmṛtyumupasthitam ||46||
rātrau cedrāyudhaṃ paśyed divā nakṣatramaṇḍalam |
paranetreṣu cātmānaṃ na paśyenna sa jīvati ||47||
netramekaṃ sraved yasya karṇau ca bhraśyataḥ sthalāt|
nāsā tu vakrā bhavati sa jñeyo gatajīvitaḥ ||48||
yasya kṛṣṇā kharā jihvā paṃkabhāsaṃ ca vai mukham |
gaṇḍe cipiṭake rakte tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||49||
muktākeśo hasaṃścaiva gāyannṛtyam̐śca yo naraḥ |
yāmyāśābhimukho gacchettadantaṃ tasya jīvitam ||1.51.50||
yasya svedasamudbhūtāḥ śvetasarṣabhasannibhāḥ|
svedā bhavanti hyasakṛt tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ ||51||
uṣṭrā vā rāsabhā vāpi yuktāḥ svapne rathe’śubhāḥ |
yasya so’pi na jīvedvai dakṣiṇābhimukho gataḥ ||52||
ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇuyātkarṇe jyotirnetre na paśyati |
dūraṃ dṛṣṭirna ca yāti raktaṃ dṛśyeta maṇḍalam ||53||
mukhe coṣmākṛṣṭanābhiḥ proṣṇamutro na jīvati |
śvabhre yo nipatet svapne dvāraṃ cāsya na vidyate ||54||
na cottiṣṭhati yaḥ śvabhrāt tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam |
divā vā yadi vā rātrau pratyakṣaṃ yo’bhihanyate ||55||
taṃ paśyedatha hantāraṃ sa hatastu na jīvati |
agnipraveśaṃ kurute svapnānte yastu mānavaḥ ||56||
smṛtiṃ nopalabheccāpi tadantaṃ tasya jīvitam |
yastu prāvaraṇaṃ śuklaṃ svakaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ||57||
raktaṃ kṛṣṇamapi svapne tasya mṛtyurupasthitaḥ |
raktaikavastrāṃ nagnāṃ vā snāpayantīṃ striyaṃ tu yaḥ ||58||
svapne paśyatyāliṃgantīmatha vā sa na jīvati |
svapne karālakṛṣṇaṃ tu dūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā na jīvati ||59||
chinnaṃ svamastakaṃ haste nītvā gacchati yo raṇe |
svapne paśyati śūrātmā tasyāvaśyaṃ mṛtiḥ smṛtā ||1.51.60||
vātavege jalaughe vā jvālāmukhe ca bhūtale |
yantre vṛkṣe paśau saudhe praveśaḥ patanaṃ ca vā ||61||
mardanaṃ mūrchanā vāpi svapne paśyettu yo naraḥ ||
tasyāsannamṛtirbodhyā vidyatpātābhimarśinaḥ ||62||
pravāse śakune kṛṣṇasarpasammukhadarśanam |
maraṇāpādakaṃ mṛtyusamakaṣṭapradaṃ ca vā ||63||
agre tu rajako yāti pṛṣṭhe cāyāti nāpitaḥ |
madhye kadā na gantavyaṃ mṛtirvā kāryanāśanam ||64||
svapne rauti sveṣṭadevaḥ pitā mātā virautyapi |
mahāduḥkhaṃ bhaved yadvā mṛtistatra hyupasthitā ||65||
patet siṃhāsanādrājā rudanti devamūrtayaḥ |
dhūmraketorudayanaṃ tvasaṃkhyajananāśakāḥ ||66||
kākaḥ siṃhāsane rauti rauti śvā sanmukhaṃ sthitaḥ |
gavādīnāṃ vihvalatā jñāpayanti bhayaṃ drutam ||67||
prasthāne hyalūkadṛśiḥ kṛṣṇasarpadṛśistathā |
chinnanaso dṛśiśceti jñāpayanti mṛtiṃ muhuḥ ||68||
cihnānyevaṃ parijñāya mṛtiṃ niścitya cātmanaḥ |
ātmānaṃ brahmaṇā yujyād harermūrtiparo bhavet ||69||
bhogyaṃ dehaṃ tu nāryuktā nara ātmā svayaṃ mataḥ |
nārīṃ tyaktvā naro bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ samaśnute ||1.51.70|
nānyamālocayet kiṃcinnānyavṛttiṃ vibhāvayet |
ātmavṛttyā parātmānaṃ svaṃ nijaṃ samabhāvayet ||71||
na kasmaicidbhayaṃ dadyātsarvasyābhayakṛdbhavet |
bhayaṃ drohaśca hiṃsā ca pāpameva hi sarvathā ||72||
ahiṃsā paramo dharmaḥ paralokasahāyakṛt |
bhayaṃ hiṃsā na vai dharmaḥ paralokātprapātakaḥ ||73||
vasoruttānapādaistu hiṃsāyajñasya kīrtanāt ||
svargāt pāto’bhavacchīghraṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca layo’bhavat ||74||
tasmād dveṣaṃ yathā tadvad rāgaṃ caiva parityajet |
ātmanātmānamālambya brahmamārgaṃ parivrajet ||75||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mithunīsṛṣṭimaraṇasūcakasvapnādipradarśananāmaikapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||51||

<1.52>
śrī lakṣmīruvāca
kadā yajñaḥ pravṛttaḥ sa kimabhūttatra pāpakṛt |
kena kṛtaḥ kathaṃ vasoḥ patanaṃ samabhūtkutaḥ || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
prathame tu yuge tretānāmake rājacihnavān |
uttānapādaputrastu vasunāmābhavannṛpaḥ || 2 ||
viṣṇoraṃśena jāyante pṛthivyāṃ cakravartinaḥ |
ājānubāhavaścaiva dhanurhastā vṛṣāṃkitāḥ || 3 ||
tāmraprabhauṣṭhadantauṣṭhāḥ śrīvatsāścordhvaromaśāḥ |
keśasthitā lalāṭorṇā jihvā caiṣāṃ pramārjanī || 4 ||
nyagrodhapariṇāhāśca siṃhaskandhāḥ sumehanāḥ |
gajendragatayaścaiva mahāhanava eva ca || 5 ||
aiśvaryeṇāṇimādyena prabhuśaktyā balena ca |
annena tapasā caiva ṛṣīnabhibhavanti vai || 6 ||
nayena tapasā caiva devadānavamānuṣān ||
abhibhavanti yogena viṣṇupradattaśaktibhiḥ || 7 || |
pādayoścakramatsyau ca śaṃkhapadme tu hastayoḥ |
dhanurbhuje hyurau chatraṃ rekhāstāścakravartinām || 8 ||
cakraṃ ratho maṇiḥ khaḍgaṃ dhanūratnaṃ ca paṃcamam |
keturnidhiśca saptaite ratnaśreṣṭhā acetanāḥ || 9 ||
rājñī purohitaścaiva senānī rathasārathiḥ |
mantryaśvaḥ kalabhaścaite ratnaśreṣṭhāḥ sacetanāḥ ||1.52.10||
divyaitāni caturdaśa sarveṣāṃ cakravartinām |
antarikṣe samudre ca pātāle parvateṣu ca || 11 ||
ahatā gatayasteṣāṃ catasraścakravartinām |
cakravartī bhavedaṃśastasya śrīparamātmanaḥ ||12||
tena tasya prajāyāṃ vai prādurbhavanti śaktayaḥ |
divyāśca laukikāścāpi rājyasīmāntabodhikāḥ ||13||
dūraśravaṇayantrāṇi dūrabhyo dūradarśanāḥ |
kālamānasuyantrāṇi dūravācakaraśmayaḥ ||14||
dūramūrtidarśakāni divyakācāni bhūriśaḥ |
dehānāvaraṇadṛṣṭipradavidyutprasādhanam | ||15||
dhātutantudhṛtividyutprakāśāḥ supradīpakāḥ |
agniyantrodbhavodyogā jalayantrāṇi bhūriśaḥ ||16||
jalāntargatiyānāni vyomayānāni cāpyatha |
vimānāni hyasaṃkhyāni kācikā dūradarśinī ||17|| 
vāyutantudhvanigrāhyaśabdaśaktiniyantraṇā
pravāsayānayantrāṇi bhūvimānāni bhūriśaḥ ||18||
jalapravāsayantrāṇi meghotpādakaśaktayaḥ |
sainikā vyomagatikā jalāntargatikā api ||19||
dhūmrayānāni bāṣpāṇāṃ śakaṭāni rathāstathā |
mohamāraṇadravyāṇi saṃhārāṇḍāni bhūriśaḥ ||1.52.20||
cakradrāvaṇagatayaścauṣadhīnāṃ suśaktayaḥ |
grahāntaragatiścāgnau gatiḥ pṛthvyudarekṣaṇam ||21||
rūpāntaradhṛtiścāpi hayadṛśyabhavanādikam |
bhautikyaḥ śaktayaścaitāḥ sahāgacchanti tena vai ||22||
tattacchaktimayā devā mānuṣā vā bhavanti ca |
tattadāviṣkṛtairbhaumairjalīyaistaijasairapi ||23||
dhātujairmānasaiścaiva sādhanaiścakravartinaḥ |
mānavā rājyabhāraṃ nirvahanti cālayanti ca ||24||
lokāntaragataṃ rājyaṃ dvīpāntaragataṃ ca vā |
samudrāntaritaṃ rājyaṃ karoti nikaṭe iva ||25||
paśyati ca śṛṇotyapi spṛśatyapi prajighrati |
vadati cānubhavati svagṛhe iva saṃsthitam ||26||
cakravartiprajāḥ sarvāstatsamā bhāgyaśālinī |
tatsamānaprabhogā ca puṇyayugabalādbhavet ||27||
uttānapādatanujo vyomagāmī vasurnṛpaḥ |
cakravartyabhavaddharmasatyejyādānasattapāḥ ||28||
tadā viśvabhugindraśca yajñaṃ prāvartayacchubham |
devaistu sahitaiḥ sarvairmunibhiḥ ṛṣibhistathā ||29||
pitṛbhiryakṣarākṣasagandharvakinnaroragaiḥ |
mānuṣairnadanadībhiḥ samudraistīrthaparvataiḥ ||1.52.30||
nakṣatradaityadānavasādhusādhvīsutattvakaiḥ |
jalasthalacarairvṛkṣavallīgulmalatādibhiḥ ||31||
sātvikairmanubhiścāpi rājasairnaramānavaiḥ |
tāmasairdevadevībhiḥ sahitaścākaronmakham ||32||
mānasī maithunī sṛṣṭiḥ sarvā tatrāgamanmudā |
athāśvamedhe vitate tāmasāścārdhatāmasāḥ ||33||
yajante paśubhirmedhyairhutvā māṃsapriyāśanāḥ |
karmavyagreṣu ṛtvikṣu santate yajñakarmaṇi ||34||
saṃpragīteṣu teṣvevamāgameṣvatha susvaram |
parikrānteṣu laghuṣu cādhvaryuvṛṣabheṣu ca ||35||
āhuteṣu ca deveṣu yajñabhāṃkṣu mahātmasu |
ālabdheṣu ca medhyeṣu tathā paśugaṇeṣu vai ||36||
haviṣyagnau hūyamāne devānāṃ devahotṛbhiḥ |
ya indriyātmakā devā yajñabhājastathā tu ye ||37||
kalpādiṣu ca ye devāstān yajante hyadhvaryavaḥ |
tadā tu sātvikāḥ praiṣakāle ye vai maharṣayaḥ ||38||
vīkṣyotthitā adhvaryavo dīnānpaśugaṇān sthitān |
papracchurindraṃ saṃbhūya ko’yaṃ yajñavidhistava ||39||
adharmo balavāneṣo hiṃsākāryecchayā tava |
neṣṭaḥ paśuvadhastveṣastava yajñe surottama ||1.52.40||
adharmo dharmaghātāya prārabdhaḥ paśubhistvayā |
nāyaṃ dharmo hyadharmo’yaṃ na hiṃsā dharma ucyate ||41||
hiṃsā nāma śarīrasya sajīvasya vighānatam |
sarveṣāṃ dehināṃ tādṛk duḥkhaṃ nānyattu vidyate ||42||
yathākasmācchastraghātād duḥkhaṃ bhavati prāṇinām |
yatkarmaṇā bhaved duḥkhaṃ pāpaṃ tattu prakīrtitam ||43||
tasmānna hiṃsayā puṇyaṃ kasyāpi ca kadāpi ca |
kathaṃ tvaṃ kuruṣe pāpaṃ devo bhūtvā surādhipa ||44||
nirāgasāṃ ca maunānāṃ parādhīnaprajīvinām |
hiṃsanaṃ mā kuru cendra karmaitannindyameva yat ||45||
ṛṣīnindrastadā prāha yajñe hiṃsā sukhapradā |
yajñe hutā ime jīvā yāsyanti svargamīpsitam ||46||
mokṣo’tha bhavate teṣāṃ yān bhuṃkte’gnimukho hariḥ |
paśuyoneśca mokṣo’pi duḥkhabāhulyanibhṛteḥ ||47||
ṛṣayaḥ prāhurindraivaṃ yajñe homācca mokṣaṇam |
duḥkhanāśastathā svargaṃ sukhaṃ tādṛk na ko labhet ||48||
sarpasatre bhāviyuge kuhakena saha dvijāḥ |
tava homaṃ kariṣyanti tadā te śikṣaṇaṃ bhavet ||49||
pārameṣṭhyaṃ caindrapadaṃ sārvabhaumaṃ rasātalam ||
vairājaṃ tattvadhāmāni prākṛtaṃ lokaghaṭṭanam ||1.52.50||
sarve māyāphenajanyā nirayā brahmaṇo hareḥ |
tavāpīndra padaṃ tādṛṅ niraya eva nāparam ||51||
duḥkhadaṃ kleśabahulaṃ paśuprāyaṃ vibhāti naḥ |
tasmādindra imaṃ dehaṃ padaṃ caindraṃ parityaja ||52||
yajñe svayaṃ paśurbhūtvā homaṃ kuru nijasya vai |
yadi svahome trāsaste svaṃ homaṃ na kariṣyase ||53||
vayaṃ tu ṛṣayastvāṃ vai juhmo’vyagraḥ sthiro bhava |
tena homena te rājan paraṃ svargaṃ bhaviṣyati ||54||
yadvai brahmapadaṃ prāhurmokṣasthānamanuttamam |
tatra gantāsi cāgaccha tvāṃ prajuhmo hare’dya vai ||55||
tava māṃsena yajñeśaḥ prasannaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati |
asmākamapi puṇyaṃ syānmāṃsahomena te matam ||56||
annasyendratvalābhaḥ syātpaśavaḥ syuḥ sujīvinaḥ |
lābhāḥ subahavaścendra hate tvayi bhavanti hi ||57||
tata āgaccha devendra bhavān huto bhavatviti |
ityevamṛṣibhiścote śacyā hyākrandanaṃ kṛtam ||58|| |
indro’pi trāsamāpanno maraṇakṣaṇadarśanāt |
maṇḍape ca sadasyeṣu mahānkolāhalo’bhavat ||59||
indro hūyate ṛṣibhirbahvaniṣṭaṃ bhavediti |
indrastu maraṇaśrāvāt mukhena śyāmalo’bhavat ||1.52.60||
tejastimiratāṃ yātaṃ śuṣkāsyo hyabhavatkṣaṇāt |
trāsāt hṛdayakaṃpaśca vepathurdehajo’bhavat ||61||
śaktihīnāni gātrāṇi hyabhavanmaraṇaśravāt |
athavā ṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ mā te homo’stu devarāṭ ||62||
bahavaḥ santi hotārasteṣāṃ homo bhavatvatha ||
adhvaryavaḥ ṛtvijāśca hotāraśca sadasyakāḥ ||63||
aneke santyupasthitāste hutāḥ saṃbhavantviti |
tenādya prīyatāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paśavaḥ santu rakṣitāḥ ||64||
hutāḥ sarve gamiṣyanti brahmaṇaḥ padamavyayam |
devamānuṣanirayāt prayāsyanti pramokṣaṇam ||65||
śrutvaitadindraḥ svastho’bhūtkathaṃcijjīvanāśayaḥ || 
adhvaryuhotṛpramukhāścintāmagnāstadābhavan ||66||
aho kaṣṭamiti procurnecchāmo mokṣaṇaṃ jaguḥ ||
na ca muktiṃ na vai homaṃ na bhojyaṃ na ca dakṣiṇām ||67||
vastu kimapi necchāmastava sarvaṃ bhavatviti |
na sthāsyāmo vayaṃ cātra maraṇaṃ kasya vai priyam ||68||
gamiṣyāmo gṛhānsvānsvān homadravyāṇi no vayam | .
ityevaṃ trāsamāptānāṃ mahān kolāhalo hyabhūt ||69|
tāvattatra samāyāto rājoparicaro vasuḥ ||
vimānātsa samuttīrya yajñamaṇḍapamāgamat ||1.52.70||
indrādibhiḥ satkṛtaḥ sannyaṣīdanmadhyamāsane |
ṛṣibhistu tadā proktaṃ hiṃsāyajño na vaidikaḥ ||71|
āgamena sadā yajñaṃ karotu yadihecchasi ||
vidhidṛṣṭena yajñena dharmamavyayahetunā ||72||
yajñabījaiḥ suraśreṣṭha yeṣu hiṃsā na vidyate |
trivarṣaparamaṃ kālamuṣitairaprarohibhiḥ ||73||
eṣa dharmo mahānindra svayaṃ vicārya sādhyatām |
evaṃ viśvabhugindrastu munibhistattvadarśibhiḥ ||74||
proktaste tu vivādena khinnā divyā maharṣayaḥ ||
saṃdhāya paśumubhayaṃ papracchuśceśvaraṃ vasum ||75||
vaso rājankathaṃ dṛṣṭastvayā yajñavidhirnṛpa |
auttānapāde prabrūhi saṃśayaṃ chindhi naḥ prabho ||76||
śrutvā sarvamubhayeṣāmavicārya balābalam |
vedaśāstramanusṛtya yajñatattvamuvāca ha ||77||
indrasya ca sureśasya chāyāmāśritya pakṣataḥ |
rāgāccāpyavirodhena kṣattrāṃśaprabalena ca ||78||
yathopadiṣṭairyaṣṭavyamiti hovāca pārthivaḥ |
yaṣṭavyaṃ paśubhirmedhyairatha bījaiḥ phalaistathā ||79||
hiṃsāsvabhāvo yajñasya iti me darśayatyasau |
yathehasaṃhitāmantrā hiṃsāliṃgā maharṣibhiḥ ||1.52.80||
dīrgheṇa tapasā yuktairdarśanaistārakādibhiḥ ||
tatprāmāṇyānmayā coktaṃ tasmānmāṃ mantumarhatha ||81||
yadi pramāṇaṃ tānyeva mahāvākyāni vai dvijāḥ ||
tadā prāvartatāṃ yajño hyanyathā no’nṛtaṃ vacaḥ ||82||
evaṃ prāptottarāste vai yuktātmānastapodhanāḥ ||
bhūtvā hyadhomukhā vasuṃ prāhurmā vada pārthiva ||83||
vedārthastalasparśitvabuddhyā naivāhṛtastvayā |
vedasya nahi tātparyaṃ kadāpi hiṃsane matam ||84||
svabhāvaprāptahiṃsāyā nivṛttau yuktikṛdvacaḥ |
anāloḍyocyate hiṃsā vidhiścetyanṛto bhavān ||85||
mithyāvādī vasuḥ so’yaṃ satyaṃ naiva bravītyapi ||
ityuktamātre nṛpatiḥ praviveśa rasātalam ||86||
ūrdhvacārī vasustvāsīd rasātalacaro’bhavat |
vasudhādhaḥ sadāvāsī mithyāvākyena so’bhavat ||87||
tasmānna vācyamekena bahujñenāpi saṃśayāt |
bahudvārasya dharmasya sūkṣmāt sūkṣmatarā gatiḥ ||88||
tasmānna niścayādvaktuṃ dharmaḥ śakyastu kenacit |
tato na hiṃsā dharmasya dvāraṃ bhavati karhicit ||89||
patraṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ śākaṃ munyannaṃ paya eva ca |
yajñe datvā mahīyante svarge loke tapodhanāḥ ||1.52.90||
adrohaścāpyalobhaśca damau bhūtadayā tapaḥ |
brahmasevā ca satyaṃ ca hyupakāraḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ ||9 1||
sanātanasya dharmasya mūlānyetāni sarvathā |
tasmād drohaṃ mā kuru tvaṃ paśūnmocaya yajñataḥ ||92||
phalānnādidravyahavyairyajñaṃ kuru sureśvara |
ityetadvākyamādṛtya śakreṇa hatapāyasaiḥ ||93 ||
yajñaḥ kṛtastataḥ paścād yajñāstu sāttvikāḥ sadā |
vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvathā tretāyāṃ prāvartanta cādruhaḥ ||94||
ṛṣayastu tadārabhya śaṃ prākurvan susattapaḥ |
yajñām̐śca vaiṣṇavām̐ścakrurahiṃsādharmasaṃbhṛtān ||95||
ajena tu yajete’ti ajastraivārṣiko brihiḥ |
na jāyateṃ’kuro yasya taddhānyamaja ucyate ||96||
maithune mādake māṃse tāmasānāṃ svabhāvajā |
pravṛttirbhavatīti tannirodhāya vidhirmataḥ ||97||
maithunecchā yadi tīvrā vivāhena praśāmyatu |
yadīcchā māṃsarasane yajñenaiva praśāmyatu ||98||
yadīcchā mādake pāne sautrāmaṇyā praśāmyatu |
kathaṃcidanubhūyaitānnivṛttāḥ saṃbhavantviti ||99||
vidhipūrvo niṣedhaḥ sa na vidhistattraye’pi vai |
madyamāṃsamithunairyo nākrānto mukta eva saḥ || 1.52.100 ||
ahiṃsā paramo dharmo brahmacaryaṃ mahattapaḥ |
amādakaṃ parā śuddhistribhirbrahma suvindati || 101 ||
athāpi kālavegāśca tāmasāhāramiśraṇāt |
annādilābhavaidhuryād rasanārasalolanāt || 102||
tāmasaistāmasī rītirgṛhyate tattrayātmikā |
teṣāṃ daṇḍapradānārthaṃ dharmo vaivasvato yamaḥ || 1 03||
vartate nyāyakartā śrīnārāyaṇasamīhayā |
tadanyāyaparā śuddhiryamaloke karoti saḥ || 1 04||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne cakravarticihnamahendrayajñasambandhihiṃsāpratipādakoparicaravasuprapatanādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||52||

<1.53>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
prāṇapriya trikālajña sarpasatra kadābhavan |
kathaṃ kasmād yataścendrastatra huto mahādvijaiḥ || 1 ||
yamo vaivasvataścāpi kadāsīt kiṃ karoti saḥ |
kīdṛśo yamalokaśca brūhi te’haṃ yadi priyā || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu kathāṃ tāṃ surasāṃ sarpasatramayīṃ priye |
ādye tu dvāpare jātāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 3 ||
jāte tretāyuge kṣīṇe dvāparaḥ pratipadyate |
praṇaśyanti prajānāṃ vai tretāyāḥ siddhayastu yāḥ || 4 ||
udbhavanti tadā doṣā adhairyaṃ lobha ityapi |
vāṇijyaṃ ca tathā yuddhaṃ tattvajñānāvinirṇayaḥ || 5 ||
varṇānāṃ svārthasaṃbhedo kāryāṇāṃ cāpyanirṇayaḥ |
yāñca vadhaḥ paṇo daṇḍo mado daṃbho’kṣamābalam || 6 ||
eṣā rajastamaḥprāyā pravṛttirdvāpare tadā |
dharmabhedo’bhavattena rāgadveṣau kṣaṇe kṣaṇe || 7 ||
karaṇānāṃ tu vaikalyāt kāraṇānāmaniścayāt |
doṣāṇāṃ darśanāccaiva matibhedāstadā nṛṇām || 8 ||
karmaṇā manasā vācā kṛcchrādvārtā prasiddhyati |
kāyakleśastu bahulo dharmāṇāṃ saṃkarastathā ||9||
varṇāśramaparidhvaṃsāḥ kāmadveṣau mahābalau |
svamānaṃ cāparāmānaṃ doṣī hyāsan mahābalāḥ ||1.53.10||
asatyavācanaṃ prāyo vyāpāre vyavahārake |
svasvodarabharatvaṃ ca prāyaśaḥ parivartate ||11||
etādṛśadvāparasya samayasya prabhāvataḥ |
gṛhavanto janāḥ svīyaṃ svatvaṃ kartuṃ samudyatāḥ ||12||
kṣetraṃ gṛhaṃ samudyānaṃ vāṭikā paśavo drumāḥ |
vāpyaḥ khanyo vanānyārdrāraṇyāni ca sarāṃsi ca ||13||
yeṣāṃ svatvāvṛtāsteṣāṃ bhogyā bhavanti te tadā |
ityevaṃ mānasīṃ vṛtti saṃkocapravaṇāṃ sadā ||14||
manujānāṃ vilokyaiva satyaṃ vilīnatāṃ gatam |
pṛthvyā rasaḥ kṣayaṃ yāto drumā naiva phalāni ca ||15||
kalpavṛkṣā na dṛśyante kāmanā pūryate nahi |
gāvaḥ kāmadudhā naiva dṛśyante dvāpare tadā ||16||
pralīnāścintāmaṇayaḥ kāmavṛṣṭirna varṣati |
na phalantyārtavā vṛkṣāḥ sasyānyapi phalanti na ||17||
tadā tatra balaṃ yasya bhuṃkte sa balavānamum |
ityevaṃ hrāsa āpannastadā vai dvāpare bahuḥ ||18||
rājāpi dveṣavān mānī brahmāvamānanādaraḥ |
prajā svārthasādhikā ca kiṃ vācyaṃ kālaparyaye ||19||
evaṃ kāle pravṛtte vai sarpasatramayī kathā |
pravṛttābhūcchṛṇu lakṣmi bhavabandhavimocinīm ||1.53.20||
haryārādhanasaṃdātrīṃ gāthāṃ jagatsupāvanīm |
śrutvā tāṃ tu kathāṃ ramyāṃ pūyante śravaṇādarāḥ ||21||
svāyaṃbhuvamanoḥ putraḥ priyavrata itīritaḥ |
tasya raivatanāmābhūtputraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ||22||
ābālyācca tapoyogabhaktisevāparāyaṇaḥ |
snānaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ kurvan sandhyāvandanatatparaḥ ||23||
prātastu pitarau natvā vṛddhānnatvā ca bhūsurān |
gavāṃ ca pūjanaṃ kṛtvā pitṝn jalāṃjalīn dadau ||24||
agnāvājyaṃ ca havyaṃ ca datvā tato nijāśritān |
bhojayitvātithīn viprān svaṃ āda devatārpitam ||25||
śeṣaṃ tu samayaṃ sarvaṃ mālayā bhajanena ca |
sārthakayan svakaṃ janma sarvān bhajanamādiśat ||26||
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa svāminmādhava satpate |
vāsudeva parabrahmāntaryāmin pāhi sarvadā ||27||
ityevaṃ bhajatastasya nārado’gād yadṛcchayā |
raivatenādṛtaṃ tasya svāgataṃ cāsanādikam ||28||
pādāvanejya ca ṛṣeḥ kṛpākāṃkṣyavadat sa tam |
dayālo lokajīvānāṃ samuddhāraka divyadṛk ||29||
svayaṃ brahma tvamevokto nārāyaṇamanojaniḥ |
tvādṛgbrahmavido yogo hareryogasamo mataḥ ||1.53.30||
nispṛhāṇāṃ satāṃ naiva mādṛśātsyānnu vāñchitam |
tathāpi karuṇāḥ santo hyāyānti parabhūtaye ||31||
avaśyaṃ me karagataṃ śreyo bhavati niścitam |
nānyathā bhagavaddṛśāṃ darśanaṃ saṃbhaved drutam ||32||
śādhi śiṣyaṃ cānukūlaṃ sevādāsaṃ praśādhi mām |
nārado vādayan vīṇāṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gṛṇan ||33||
prāha raivata dhanyo’si bālyādbhajasi keśavam |
ko’nyalābho janimataḥ prākṛtātkardamādbhavet ||34||
saditi brahmaṇaḥ śabdastadvanto ye bhavantyuta |
sāyujyaṃ brahmaṇo’tyantaṃ tena santaḥ pracakṣate ||35||
tādṛśā ca satā bhāvyaṃ nāsatā tu kadācana |
satsu satāṃ virāmaḥ syānna tvasatsu kadācana ||36||
tava niṣkāmasadbhaktyā lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
prasannaḥ san prerayanmāṃ kiñcidāvedyamasti yat ||37||
brahmadhāmādhipaḥ śrīmān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
prabhurdāmodaro bhūtvā pṛthvyāmāgantumicchati ||38||
brahmadhāmapradeśaṃ svavāsāyānetumicchati |
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ rājan pṛthvyāṃ paścimabhūtale ||39||
suratrāsapathaṃ chidraṃ śatagavyūtirāyatam |
vartate tadvivareṇātalād daityaprakoṭayaḥ ||1.53.40||
svargaṃ gatvā surānsarvān trāsayanti nirāgasaḥ |
suratrāsakaraṃ chidraṃ śatagavyūtivistaram ||41||
pūraṇīyaṃ mayā tatra vastavyaṃ cāpi sarvadā ||
raivatāya tadarthaṃ vai dāsye’kṣarapradeśakam ||42||
śatagavyūtivistāraṃ divyaṃ samṛddhaṃ sukhapradam |
yatra svarṇarasāḥ kūpāḥ svarṇarakṣā sarittathā ||43||
saṃjīvanī śalyahartrī chedasandhā hyamūrchanā |
raktadā dhārahantrī ca kṣutṛṇnirodhinī tathā ||44||
vividhauṣadhayastatra bhaviṣyanti mayā saha |
yatra bhadrā subhadrā me patnī bhadrāvatī nadī ||45||
yatra corjā mama patnī tatra ojasvatī bhavet |
yatrārdrakuṃkumaṃ lakṣmyāḥ siktaṃ kuṃkumavāpikā ||46||
yatra patnīvrato vipro madaṃśaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati |
yatrā vāḍavamādāya sarasvatī samudragā ||47||
yatra me plakṣachāyāyāṃ kṣaṇaṃ vāso bhaviṣyati |
yatra svarṇapurī ramyā dvīpāntarme bhaviṣyati ||48||
yatra khaṭvāṃgado rājā tava putro bhaviṣyati |
yatra someśvaro devo mahādevo bhaviṣyati ||49||
yatra talasya nāśādvai talaśyāmo bhaviṣyati |
yatra guptatayā yāgāt prayāgo’pi bhaviṣyati ||1.53.50||
yatra bhakto mahānme vai dāmanāmā bhaviṣyati |
yatraikatadvītatrītāḥ bhaviṣyantyṛṣayastrayaḥ ||51||
yatra tapaḥpriyo dattātreyaḥ sthāsyāmyahaṃ nage|
yatronmattā ca gaṃgā sā madarthaṃ pravahiṣyati ||52||
yatra bhaveśvarapatnyāḥ siṃhāḥ sthāsyanti vāhanam |
yatra sarvasvadātā me bhaktimārgo bhaviṣyati ||53||
yatra jayā lalitā me rādhā lakṣmīrbhaviṣyataḥ |
yatra sūryo’rkavṛkṣasya rūpaṃ janma grahīṣyati ||54||
yatra śatrūṃjitā devī nadīrūpā bhaviṣyati |
yatrānartaḥ punā rājā tapase saṃgamiṣyati ||55||
yatra sarpagararodhānnagaraṃ ca nivatsyati |
yatra kṛṣṇo dhanuścihnaḥ sādhurūpo bhaviṣyati ||56||
gopālakambhare me ca pitarau saṃbhaviṣyataḥ |
yatra mamāvatārāśca bhaviṣyanti maharṣayaḥ ||57||
yatra madrājyadeṣṭāro bhaviṣyanti mamāṃśinaḥ |
yatra nṛpābhiṣektā ca devānīko bhaviṣyati ||58||
yatra me niyatasthānaṃ rajikuṭṭaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tatra me yugalaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ saṃsthāpayiṣyati ||59||
anādinidhanaṃ tanme sthānaṃ divyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
kṛṣṇamuktipradaḥ so’yaṃ dvīpo divyo bhaviṣyati ||1.53.60||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvāparadharmarevatagṛhanāradāgamapaścimabhūtalavivarapūrakabrahmapradeśānayanamatibhaviṣyattattvoddeśādipradarśananāmā tripaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||53||

<1.54>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pradeśaḥ sa vivarātmā kva vidyate |
abriktākhyapradeśāttu pūrvaṃ kacchācca dakṣiṇam || 1 ||
narmadāyāḥ paścimaṃ tat siṃhāraṇyata uttaram |
pradeśaḥ sa suratrātā surāṣṭraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 2 ||
pratīcyāṃ malayādreśca prācyāmabriktadeśataḥ |
āyato vistṛto viśvak paṃcasāhasrayojanaḥ || 3 ||
siṃhāraṇyamiti khyāto deśo’vicchinnabhūmikaḥ |
siṃhāraṇyādudagdeśo devadamanasaṃjñakaḥ || 4 ||
devadamanabhūdeśāt śatagavyūtiruttaram |
mahābhūvivaraṃ cāsti tasya vai pūraṇāya ca ||5||
śrīhariste yathāpekṣaṃ pradeśaṃ svaṃ pradāsyati |
samāgaccha mayā sākaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ prati cānagha || 6 ||
deyaṃ deśaṃ tu saurāṣṭraṃ nītvā tvāyāhi bhūtale|
vivaraṃ tatsamprapūrya divyaṃ tadbhūtalaṃ kṛthāḥ || 7 ||
suratrātari taddeśe saurāṣṭre tvaṃ sthiro bhava |||
tatra deśe maṇisvarṇamayo brahmagirirmahān || 8 ||
somabhadrāmadhyadeśe svanivāsāya kalpaya |
raivatasya nivāsātte parvato’pi ca raivataḥ || 9 ||
revatācalasaṃjñaḥ syād divyo brahmagirirmahān ||
revatasya svakanyāyā revatītisamāhvayā ||1.54.10||
tatra sthāsyati tīrthākhyā golokasthāpi sarvadā |
raivato bhagavadbhaktaściraṃ tatra nivatsyati ||11||
pañcamastvaṃ manurbhūtvā punastatra nivatsyasi |
raivatācalatīrthaṃ tanmahattīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati ||12||
yatra dāmodaraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ śaṃbhuryatra bhaveśvaraḥ |
brahmā yatra svayaṃbhūśca tatra kiṃ nāma māyikam ||13||
kṛṣṇayogātsadā divyā bhūmiḥ kṛṣṇā rasānvitā |
vāsanāyāḥ karṣaṇācca vaikuṇṭhaṃ nayanāttathā ||14||
saurāṣṭraḥ kṛṣṇa ākhyāto nāmnā rūpeṇa caujasā |
kṛtasmaro giriścāpi raivatācalapaścime ||15||
tena lagno mahān bhāvī kadācidvaḍavānalam |
nītvā sarasvatī devī tanmārgeṇa gamiṣyati ||16||
mahāsamudre kṣepārthaṃ tadā smaragiriḥ svayam |
utthāya tatsamīpe ca nirodhaṃ saṃkariṣyati ||17||
tadā kruddho vaḍavāgnirgiriṃ bhasmīkariṣyati |
tadbhasmastarapāṣāṇā mṛduśvetā bhavantyapi ||18||
śilpibhistaiḥ kariṣyante prāsādāḥ śvetabhūmayaḥ |
cūrṇaṃ śvetaṃ saudhadravyaṃ vahnipākāt tato bhavet ||19||
atharṣayaḥ pitṛsiddhā devāḥ sādhvyaśca sādhavaḥ |
yogino yatayo bhaktāḥ sthāsyanti raivate girau ||1.54.20||
daśaparvataprākāro lakṣmyambāsaudhaśobhitaḥ |
koṭiyātrālubhaktaughaiḥ kārtikyāṃ kṛtpradakṣiṇaḥ ||21||
śroṇyāṃ meghasamākīrṇaḥ śrṛṃge devarṣisevitaḥ |
mūle kṛṣṇajanākīrṇaḥ pārśve vimānasatpathaḥ ||22||
pūrve śatruṃjitā vārgā caturyojanataḥ param |
tīrthaṃ kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ yojanatrayataḥ param ||23||
yasyottare ca bhadrākhyā sarit dviyojanātparam |
yasyāvācyāṃ somatīrthaṃ caturyojanataḥ param ||24||
yasya pratīcyāṃ yoginīparvatasyaiva chāyayā |
rakṣitoccabhuvo deśastvāyataḥ krośavistaraḥ ||25||
tatra tvayā svakaṃ nirmātavyaṃ vai raivataṃ puram |
tatastava suto nāmnā khaṭvāṃgado bhaviṣyati ||26||
sa dvitīyaḥ śaśī bhūtvā naiśaṃ tamo hariṣyati |
tannāmnā tatpuraṃ khaṭvāṃgadasaṃjñaṃ bhaviṣyati ||27||
tadvaṃśe hāṭako rājā bhaviṣyati tu bhaktarāṭa |
hāṭakeśamahādevaṃ pātālādānayiṣyati ||28||
tannāmnā tatpuraṃ hāṭakeśapuraṃ bhaviṣyati |
tadvaṃśe maṇimān rājā śaṃbhorgaṇo bhaviṣyati ||29||
tannāmnā tatpuraṃ maṇipuraṃ khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati |
prācīnānāṃ tu durgāṇāṃ darśanānmānavāstadā ||1.54.30||
jīrṇadurgapuraṃ nāmnā khyāpayiṣyanti kālataḥ |
tatastatra gate kāle pārṣado vijayaḥ prabhoḥ ||31||
prāvirbhaviṣyati tatra rājyaṃ so’pi kariṣyati |
tannāmnā vijayapuramityākhyāṃ saṃgamiṣyati ||32||
sādhvyaśca sādhavastatra mokṣadā brahmamūrtayaḥ |
sarvadā tu nivatsyanti lokakalyāṇahetavaḥ ||33||
camatkārā bhaviṣyanti tatra bhūmau yuge yuge |
daivāstu puruṣāstatra bhaviṣyanti yuge yuge ||34||
bhuvo rakṣaṇakartāro dharmasya sthāpakāstathā |
kṛṣṇadāmodarāvāsādgopyaścāpi muhurmuhuḥ ||35||
tatra tatra bhaviṣyanti mānavyo vai mahāvratāḥ |
sādhvyo bhūtvā bhajiṣyanti kṛṣṇaṃ santaṃ pratāpinam ||36||
tadāśrayaṃ sukurvāṇā narā nāryo mṛgāḥ khagāḥ |
mokṣyante saṃsṛteḥ pāśāttādṛśī bhūmikā bhavet ||37||
atha bhāvī raivato’yaṃ mlecchāśrayaḥ samantataḥ |
tadā kalpasya sāyaṃ vai kalkerantimajanmanaḥ ||38||
netrakrodhāt kvathito vai jvālāmukho bhaviṣyati |
jvālābhī rasasantapto deśo’pi rasatāṃ vrajet ||39||
raso vaikuṇṭhamāsādya yathāpūrvo bhaviṣyati |
saurāṣṭro vaikuṇṭhajanirvaikuṇṭhaṃ punareṣyati ||1.54.40||
atha kalpāntare cāpi yathāpūrvaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tasmādāgaccha rājendra vaikuṇṭhaṃ tu mayā saha ||41||
dāsyati śrīharistubhyaṃ pradeśaṃ vai surāṣṭrakam |
ityāmantrya gatastatra raivato nāradena ca ||42||
saha vaikuṇṭhamabhyetya praṇipatya prabhuṃ harim |
nanāma śirasā daṇḍavacca tuṣṭāva sāṃjaliḥ ||43||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prapūritabhūvivarabhāvitīrthādinirdeśanirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 54 ||

<1.55>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi raivatākhyo manurvaikuṇṭhamāptavān |
tuṣṭāva ca mahāpremṇā dayāluṃ māṃ tvayānvitam || 1 ||
namaḥ| saccitsvarūpāyānandasandohavārdhaye |
namastvekasvarūpāyobhayarūpāya te namaḥ || 2 ||
namo hiraṇyakeśāya śmaśrvaśmaśrumate namaḥ |
namaḥ stanyāstanyavate bījābījadhṛte namaḥ || 3 ||
namo bahiḥ pracihnāyāṃbahiścihnāya te namaḥ |
namo viśvakpravālāya kvacidvālāya te namaḥ || 4 ||
namo dakṣiṇasattvāya . vāmasattvāya te namaḥ |
nama ūrdhvasvarūpāyānūrdhvarūpāya te namaḥ || 5 ||
nama ādheyarūpāyādhārarūpāya te namaḥ |
namo dvidalarūpāyāṅkuraprasūtaye namaḥ || 6 ||
namo vaikuṇṭhavāsāya kuṇṭhavāsāya te namaḥ |
namo mānasarūpāya bhaktarūpāya te namaḥ || 7 ||
namaste karuṇāsindho namaḥ saurāṣṭravardhine |
namo raivatavāsāya dāmodarāya te namaḥ || 8 ||
namaḥ patnīvratākhyāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya viṣṇave |
namo’nantasvarūpāya mamāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ || 9 ||
svatantrastvaṃ mahāviṣṇo na jāne tvaṃ kimicchasi |
bhakto yadarthamāhūtastadvai vidhātumarhasi ||1.55.10||
dāso’yaṃ kṛpayā viṣṇo neyaḥ pāraṃ bhavādhvanaḥ |
yatra te caraṇau stastaddeśo me hyaraṇaṃ bhavet ||11||
na vai tyājyaḥ kṛpānātha dāso’yaṃ śaraṇāgataḥ |
karuṇayā gṛhīto’yaṃ na vai taṃ tyaktumarhasi ||12||
yadiṣṭaṃ kṣemakṛlloke tadiṣṭaṃ saṃvidhīyatām |
iti stutvā virarāma raivato bhaktasattamaḥ ||13||
prāha taṃ bhagavān śrīmān vaikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ prabhuḥ |
gṛhāṇemāṃ cāṇurūpāṃ mama vaikuṇṭhabhūmikām ||14||
svayaṃbhvākhyacaturvaktrabrahmaṇo golake tava |
priyavratasya bhūrājye paścimaṃ vivaraṃ mahat ||15||
suratrāsapathaṃ chidraṃ śatagavyūtirāyatam |
pūraṇīyaṃ bhūmikayā vikasantyā tvayaiva tat ||16||
suratrāṇaṃ bhavettena saurāṣṭrasaṃjñatāṃ vrajet |
tatrāhaṃ śrīsamāyukto nivatsye tava kāraṇāt ||17||
anyad yannāradenoktaṃ vidhāsye tatra coṣitaḥ |
ityabhidhāya devena vaikuṇṭhāṇuḥ samarpitaḥ ||18||
tamādāyājñayā viṣṇoḥ raivataḥ punarāgataḥ|
yathoktaṃ tamaṇuṃ yāvadvivare nyastumicchati ||19||
tāvadvipulatāṃ yātaṃ śatagavyūtirāyatam |
jāḍye bhūstaratulyaṃ tad divyaṃ paṃcaguṇātmakam ||1.55.20||
yathāpekṣaṃ yathāsthānaṃ sthitaṃ chidraṃ prapūritam |
adivye divyasaṃmiśrāt sandhiḥ śvetaraṇātmakaḥ ||21||
śvetākhātaśca bhūḥ śvetā vyāvartayati maṇḍalam |
śatagavyūtimātraṃ tanmaṇḍalaṃ śyāmapāṇḍuram ||22||
divyatyakhaṇḍabhūmadhyaṃ surāṣṭraṃ raivatārjitam |
raivatastanmadhyabhāge viṣṇuṃ dhyeyaṃ vidhāya ca ||23||
sarvadārādhanaparo hyāste visṛjya māyikam |
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tasmai datte sakaruṇekṣaṇam ||24||
dadau cāsmai maṇeḥ svasya sahasrāṃśaṃ tadā hariḥ |
sa vai sthaulyaṃ samāpannaḥ śailarūpaṃ paraṃ dadhau ||25||
so’yaṃ saṃsthāpito madhye surāṣṭrasyātha nāmataḥ |
neturnāmnā hyabhūt khyāto raivatācala ityayam ||26||
raivatena puraṃ tatra nirmitaṃ raivatāhvayam |
raivataḥ sarvadā viṣṇoḥ smaraṇe kīrtane śrave ||27||
sevane hyarcane stotre dāsye sarvanivedane |
hyavartata mahābhakto jāgratsvapnasuṣuptiṣu ||28||
rājyabhāre vyavahāre bhojane śayane tathā|
sarvathā devadeveśa nārāyaṇaṃ samābhajat ||29||
tatraikadā mahāmaṃce śayāno yoganidrayā|
ātmani śrīhariṃ dhyāyan samādhiṃ tvagamaddhi saḥ ||1.55.30||
nārāyaṇecchayā tasya dakṣiṇasya bhujasya ca |
svarṇāṃgado dravo bhūtvā patito maṃcake’bhavat ||31||
svarṇavarṇaḥ kiśoro’bhūt śvetakāntiḥ śaśīva ha |
śītaśvetaprakāśasya paridhiḥ sarvato’bhavat ||32||
sarvataḥ śvetakiraṇairvyāpto’bhūdityakhaṇḍitaḥ |
prāsādaṃ nagaraṃ deśaṃ dugdhadhavalatejasā ||33||
kurvan vitimiraṃ sarvamāste sma maṃcake tu saḥ |
yadṛcchayā mahābhakto raivato jāgrato’bhavat ||34||
khaṭvāyāṃ svāṃgadotpannaṃ kumāraṃ pratyapadyata |
candramasamiva śuklaṃ saumyaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham ||35||
dikṣu vidikṣu dhavalīkurvantamakhilaṃ jagat |
jātamātraṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ ṣoḍaśābdaṃ sadāprabham ||36||
cakravartidhanuścihnaṃ kuśalaṃ jñaptisaṃbhṛtam |
jñātvā rājyāsanaṃ datvā raivato raivatācale ||37||
viśālāyāṃ kandarāyāṃ jagāmopāsanākṛte |
tatra samādhimāpanno raivataḥ sarvadā harau ||38||
ekātmanā sthito yāvatpaṃcamo manurābhavet |
athottare mahākāle kalpe kalpe tu sa svayam ||39||
satye mahāvibhūtyākhye vartiṣyata iti sthitiḥ |
tatra tatra tasya vaṃśe khaṭavāṃgadanṛpādayaḥ ||1.55.40||
bhūmicakrapraśāstāro bhaviṣyantyabdakoṭiṣu ||
khaṭvāyāmaṃgadājjāto nāmnā khaṭvāṃgadaḥ kṛtaḥ ||41||
ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ svarṇarekhaṃ lalāṭe tilakaṃ tvaci |
svābhāvikamabhūttasya madhyaraktābhabindukam ||42||
kaṇṭhe svarṇamayī mālā tvaci svābhāvikī hyabhūt |
sarvaiśvaryāśrayo bhūbhṛt tejasā timiraṃ haran ||43||
vimānamadhiruhyāthāntarīkṣe vyacaranmuhuḥ |
dūrāddūrataraṃjñātaṃ amādau timiraṃ niśi ||44||
yatra candraśūnyadeśe tatrāgacchad vihāyasā |
timiraṃ nāśayan sarvaṃ dvitīyaścandramā iva ||45||
māsi māsi bhraman vyomni śūnyadikṣu niśāpateḥ |
lokān karoti sālokān śītaraśmīn prasārayan ||46||
athaivaṃ tu kṛte tatra samudrāḥ pārvaṇāḥ sadā |
kṣubdhā bhūmistaraplāvā velābhirabhavanmuhuḥ ||47||
velā ūrdhvaṃ samāyānti nivartante na vai tathā |
bhūmayastu jalākrāntā jāyante sma tadā tadā ||48||
ekadvitrikalāpoṣyā auṣadhyaḥ prāyaśastadā |
poṣyātiśaityasaṃghātādajīrṇatvātkṣayaṃ yayuḥ ||49||
ityevaṃ hānimālokya vimānaṃ svaṃ nyavārayat |
tādṛśo’bhūnmahādivyaḥ śītatejomayaḥ svarāṭ ||1.55.50||
karoti śrīharerbhaktiṃ kārayatyaparān janān |
udghoṣayati prātaḥ sa viṣṇuḥ pūjyaḥ sadā janaiḥ ||51||
puṇḍraṃ sacandrakaṃ kāryaṃ bhojyaṃ prārpyaṃ harau sadā |
sāyaṃ viṣṇorgṛhe gatvā stutyo devo janārdanaḥ ||52||
sādhvyaḥ santaścātimānyā bhojyapānādidāpanaiḥ |
hotavyamanale deyaṃ devebhyo bhaktipūrvakam ||53||
nārāyaṇaparo yo vai bhajennārāyaṇaṃ sadā |
na mayā tu karastasmād grahītavyaḥ kadācana ||54||
evaṃ tena kṛtā bhūmiḥ sarvā vaiṣṇavamaṇḍitā |
nābhakto hyabhavat kaściccakre tasminpraśāsati ||55||
evaṃ bhaktiyute cakre śāntaḥ khaṭvāṃgado nṛpaḥ |
rājyacintāṃ parityajya bhagavantaṃ sadāsmarat ||56||
vimānaṃ kandare sthāpya svayamārādhane’bhavat |
kāle bahvarbude krānte tapase hyakaronmataḥ ||57||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīśastutimaṇibhūmyaṇugrahaṇabhūvivarapūraṇasatejaskāparacandrībhavanatejaḥprasāraṇabhaktividhāpanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcapañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||55||

<1.56>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato rājā vairāgyāvegajṛṃbhitaḥ |
raivatācalataḥ pūrvaṃ yojanatrayataḥ param || 1 ||
aśvapaṭṭaṃ saroramyaṃ vyāghrāraṇye mahattaram |
akhaṇḍasalilaṃ mūlaphalavṛkṣādipārśvakam || 2 ||
nirjanaṃ cāpi nirupadravaṃ jñātvā sa bhūpatiḥ |
jagāmāśvapaṭṭatīre nātidūre’tha nirjane || 3 ||
śītachāyāmayaṃ deśaṃ dṛṣṭvā khaṭvāṃgado nṛpaḥ|
badrīdāḍimajambūdruciṃcāguṃdrādisudrumaiḥ || 4 ||
vyāpte deśe ca pātālajalavāpīsamanvite |
vāpyā jalaṃ tu satataṃ nirjharaṇasvarūpataḥ || 5 ||
sravaddhyuparito yāti hyaśvapaṭṭasarovaram |
tatra vāpyupakaṇṭhasthabadrīmūle bhuvastale || 6 ||
śālagrāmaṃ puraskṛtya tapaḥ khaṭvāṃgado’tapat |
varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karojjāmbūprabhakṣaṇam || 7 ||
dvitīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod guṃdraprabhakṣaṇam |
tṛtīyaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod dāḍima bhakṣaṇam || 8 ||
caturthaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod badarabhakṣaṇam |
paṃcamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karot ciṃcāmblabhakṣaṇam || 9 ||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ cātha sahasraṃ so’karot kandaprabhakṣaṇam |
saptamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karot patraprabhakṣaṇam ||1.56.10||
aṣṭamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karot salilabhakṣaṇam |
navamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’karod vāyuprabhakṣaṇam ||11||
daśamaṃ tu sahasraṃ so’nāhāro’ṅguṣṭhasaṃsthitaḥ |
tiṣṭhandhyāyan śālagrāme kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ gurum ||12||
cintayan satataṃ devaṃ viṣṇuṃ śrīmantameva ca |
japan lakṣmīpate śrīmannārāyaṇāya te namaḥ ||13||
tāvattadasya mūrdhno vai prādurbhūto’nalo mahān |
dhūmastasya mahājvālaḥ saṃvyāpnod bhuvanatraye ||14||
devāndaityān mānavādīn prājvālayannabhaḥsthitān |
cakampe pṛthivī devī cukṣubhuḥ sāgarāstathā ||15||
dāvānalo mahām̐statra tapo’gniprasamudgataḥ |
tatra dāvānale vyāpte lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||16||
dayālustapato dehabhānahīnasya tasya vai |
rakṣaṇāyāgamattatra mūrdhnyasiñcattadamṛtam ||17||
tena śāntastu mūrdhno’gnirdāvāgniśca nyavartata |
prāha nārāyaṇastasmai bhakta bhaktyā vaśīkṛta ||18||
khaṭvāṃgada mahābhakta bhakti kurvanpraśobhase |
tapo bhaktimayaṃkurvanprajāśreyo vidhāsyasi ||19||
viramedṛśatapaso darśanaṃ kuru me’nagha |
niḥspṛhasya tu bhaktasya kiñcinnādeyamasti me ||1.56.20||
kiṃ te’pekṣyaṃ vṛṇu rājan dadāmi yadabhīpsitam |
ityādiśya hariḥ śrīmān maunamāste tadā tu saḥ ||21||
netre uddhāṭya caṣṭe taṃ nārāyaṇamupasthitam |
aho bhāgyamahobhāgyamiti snehaprapūritaḥ ||22||
nartanaṃ darśanāccakre padrajo śirasā vahan |
viluṇṭhito muhurlakṣmīnārāyaṇapadeṣu saḥ ||23||
pādasevāṃ sadā vavre dāso bhūtvā sa cakrarāṭ |
yatra tapaḥ kṛtaṃ tatra svasya mūrteśca sannidhau ||24||
lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇaṃ vavre sadā darśanakāṃkṣayā |
nārāyaṇājñayā tatra tadā lakṣmyā tathāstviti ||25||
uktvā kuṃkumārdracandrastasya bhāle kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ |
lakṣmyāḥ karagatārdrasya kuṃkumasya ca bindavaḥ ||26||
bahavaḥ patitā vāpyāṃ tathā prakṣālitau karau |
pītvā jalaṃ tathā snātvā pāyayitvā nṛpaṃ tathā ||27||
śālagrāme śāśvataṃ svaṃ nivāsamakarotprabhuḥ |
śrīsārthaśca sadā nārāyaṇaścāste mahāprabhuḥ ||28||
tata ārabhya sā vāpī kuṃkumavāpikābhidhā |
tatra tena nṛpatinā śrīnārāyaṇamandiram ||29||
sāptabhaumaṃ kāritaṃ ca sevāṃ tasyākarot svayam |
sā ca lakṣmīḥ sukhaṃ kaṃ vai bibhratīti tu kambharā ||1.56.30||
goḥ pṛthivyāḥ pālakaṃ tu nṛpaṃ khaṭvāṃgadaṃ sadā |
śaraṇe lāti gṛhṇāti gopālaḥ śrīharirhi saḥ ||31||
ucyete kambharāgopālākhyau lakṣmīnarāyaṇau |
tayoḥ patnīvrataḥ putraḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ ||32||
tatraiva tapa ātiṣṭhannāste kalpe prakalpake ||
dhyāyan svapitarau devau sutastu kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ ||33||
tīrthe kuṃkumavāpyākhye śritamokṣaprade śubhe |
āste divyaśarīreṇa sarvatra vyāpako’pi san ||34||
etadaśvasaro divyaṃ vyāghrāraṇyaṃ ca vistṛtam |
divyā kuṃkumavāpī kambharāgopālamandiram ||35||
patnīvratadvijatīrthaṃ khaṭvāṃgadakṛtaṃ puram |
ramyaṃ kuṃkumavāpyākhyaṃ hyāsan deśe surāṣṭrake ||36||
sarvavaikuṇṭhasāmagrī dāsadāsīgaṇaṃ tathā |
ṛddhimaiśvaryamādāya kṛṣṇastatra virājate ||37||
tasya yāvadrajaḥkaṇāḥ pavitrā mokṣadāyakāḥ |
divyā bhūmirdivyajalā divya vaikuṇṭhasannibhā ||38|| 
yāgaśrāddhavratadānapuṇyasthalīpramuktidā |
tatra nārī naro vāpi yāṃ kāṃcidyonimāsthitaḥ ||39||
tyajandehaṃ parāṃ yāti muktiṃ brahmākṣarābhidhām |
tatra bhūmau narā ye vai te sarve haripārṣadāḥ ||1.56.40||
nāryaścāpi vasanti yāstāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇacārikāḥ |
paśupakṣyādayaḥ sarve vṛkṣavallyādayastathā ||41||
muktā vaikuṇṭhadhāmasthā nānye bodhyā nṛcakṣuṣā |
divyadṛṣṭyā bhālanīyā na tu vai cārmacakṣuṣā ||42||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne aśvapaṭṭasarovare khaṭvāṃgadatapaścaraṇena lakṣmīnārāyaṇapratyakṣadarśanaṃ kuṃkumacandrakakaraṇe bindukṣaraṇāt kuṃkumavāpītitīrthapuraṃ kaṃbharāgopālarūpeṇa lakṣmīnārāyaṇanivāsaścetinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ || 56 ||

<1.57>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
khaṭvāṃgadasya putro vai barhiṣāṃgada īritaḥ |
mayūrāstapatastasya tiṣṭhantyāgatya mastake || 1 ||
barhāṇi mocayantyatra na cāyaṃ tattu paśyati |
tatra mayūrapicchānāṃ samūhe samupasthite || 2 ||
patnīvratena teṣāṃ vai mārjanī mahatī kṛtā |
mandiramārjanakārye rakṣitā mūrtisannidhau || 3 ||
khaṭvāṃgadena sā dṛṣṭā gṛhītā karayoryadā |
mārjanāya pravṛttaḥ sa tāvadvṛṣṭirabhūcca khāt || 4 ||
mārjanīṃ tāṃ gṛhītvā sa kuṭyāṃ praviśya tiṣṭhati |
divārātrau mahāvṛṣṭiḥ samabhūd bahuvarṣaṇā ||5||
mārjanīpūlakaṃ coṣṇaṃ snigdhaṃ saṃkomalaṃ tathā |
citraṃ tathaiva susparśaṃ śītasaṃhārakaṃ tathā || 6 ||
pārśve nidhāya śayyāyāṃ nīdrādhīno’bhavattadā |
tatrecchayā hareḥ rūpaṃ cāpsarasaṃ vyalokayat || 7 ||
svāpnaḥ srāvo’bhavattasya dhātorbarhiṣu teṣu ca |
tasya drāgeva putro’bhūt prātaryāvadvipaśyati || 8 ||
taṃ tu putraṃ mahāsiddhaṃ jātamātrasya yauvanam |
vīkṣya tadābhidhāṃ cakre bahiṣāṃgada ityayam || 9 ||
tadrājye tvabhiṣiktaśca mānī śūro dhanurdharaḥ |
khaṭvāṃgadapure ramye rājadhānyāṃ tu pūjitaḥ ||1.57.10||
bhaktaḥ sa ekadāraṇye parimeyānugaḥ śuciḥ |
vicaran svapiturdivye vyāghrāraṇye paribhraman ||11||
kuṃkumavāpīsattīrthe patnīvratadvijāśrame |
samāgacchattadā tatra darśanārthaṃ dvijanmanām ||12||
gurūṇāṃ ca piturlakṣmīnārāyaṇasvarūpayoḥ |
devayordarśanaṃ kṛtvā yāvadāyāti sadguroḥ ||13||
samīpe tatra samaye samādhau saṃsthito guruḥ |
nāvait rājña akasmāccāgamanaṃ cāntarasthiteḥ ||14||
svāgataṃ cāpi sanmānaṃ cāsanaṃ cādaraṃ tathā |
naiva lebhe sa rājarṣirāśrame janavarjite ||15||
rājā kṣaṇaṃ ca sanmānaṃ nādhyagacchad yadā tadā |
mānādhīno naṣṭabuddhiḥ kṣudraṃ svārthamakalpayat ||16||
aho hyasmaddhānyabhoktā bhikṣuko no’vamanyate |
vāṇyāpi naiva satkāraṃ karoti brahmamānyayam ||17||
netre nimīlya kapaṭāt kīdṛśaṃ dhyānamāsthitaḥ |
yadi jāgarmi nṛpateḥ sammānaṃ kartumāpatet ||18||
tasmātsamādhimāsthāya sthātavyamiti vañcanām |
puraskṛtya dvijo’yaṃ me’vamānaṃ tu karoti vai ||19||
tasmānnaivedṛśo vipro hyupekṣitavya ityayam |
bahiṣāṃgadanṛpatirmahāsarpaṃ mṛtaṃ gale ||1.57.20||
patnīvratasya nikṣipya gatavān svapuraṃ prati |
tāvattasya ṛṣeḥ brahmavrataḥ samāgataḥ ||21||
ṛṣeḥ śiṣyaiḥ svayaṃprakāśādibhiḥ sahitaḥ sthitaḥ |
ṛṣergale mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ dṛṣṭvā jñātvā samādhinā ||22||
rājñā sarpo mṛtaḥ kṣiptastaṃ śāpaṃ prairayatkhalam |
aho śvā vai gṛhapatiṃ bhaṣan padabhyāṃ vimānayan ||23||
dhulīṃ prakṣipatītyetad vaicitryaṃ viṣamaṃ mahat |
brāhmaṇairabhiṣikto vai malakīṭo bhujaṃgatām ||24||
nītastāneva daśati kīdṛśīyaṃ kupātratā |
mūṣako bhayamāpanno siṃhatve yena yojitaḥ ||25||
samīhate tamovāttuṃ kā nāma kṣudratāparā |
śveva balibhuk pāpātmā patnīvrataṃ nirāgasam ||26||
avigaṇayya pitaraṃ pūjanīyaṃ sudaivatam |
gale’kṣipat śavaṃ sārpamavaśyaṃ daṇḍamarhati ||27||
punarevaṃ kukurāste kuryurnaiva vimānanam |
ityāmatya jalaṃ dhṛtvā kare dakṣe’vadatsutaḥ ||28||
yena sarpo gale kṣiptaḥ kuhakānmṛtyumetu saḥ |
māsābhyantara eveti salilaṃ vyasṛjadbhuvi ||29||
datvā brahmavrataḥ śāpaṃ satīrthyaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |
yāvad roditi gurvagre samādherutthito guruḥ ||1.57.30||
paśyati sma gale svasya mṛtasarpaśavaṃ yadā |
rudantaṃ cāśṛṇotsvīyaṃ sutaśiṣyasumaṇḍalam ||31||
sāntvayāmāsa tān sarvān patnīvrato gurustadā |
yūyaṃ sarve kimarthaṃ vai rudathātra nibodhata ||32||
śave mānuṣadehe vai śavaḥ sarpo dhṛto yataḥ |
hāraḥ sa vai tu mantavyaḥ śavasya śavapūjane ||33||
nātra hānirna vā doṣo hyeṣaḥ snānaṃ karomyaham |
śuddhirvai snānamātreṇa kimarthaṃ rudatha bhṛśam ||34||
śāntistu sarvadā rakṣyā kṣamā rakṣyā ca sarvathā |
śāntyā ca kṣamayā sarve ṛṣayaḥ pūjyatāṃ gatāḥ ||35||
satyaṃ śīlaṃ tapo dhyānaṃ svādhyāyaḥ śaṃ titikṣaṇam |
kṣamā ceti dhanaṃ divyaṃ maurdhanyaṃ no mataṃ sadā ||36||
tanna tyājyaṃ kadācidvai tadasmākaṃ tu daivatam |
kṣamā tu paramaṃ śastraṃ krodhaśastranibarhaṇam ||37||
kṣamayā vāḍavāḥ sarve devaiḥ pūjāmavāpnuyuḥ |
putrāḥ pṛcchāmi yuṣmābhistasyāniṣṭaṃ nu cintitam ||38||
iti  praṣṭāstadā putrāḥ ṛṣiṃ tatra nyavedayan |
rājānaṃ bhinnamaryādaṃ māsāntare tu sarparāṭ ||39||
kuhako’smannodito vai daṃkṣyatītyeva noditam |
ṛṣirvajramayaṃ śrutvā rājanāśanamulbaṇam ||1.57.40||
tepe’tīva svahṛdaye kṣaṇaṃ tu maunamāsthitaḥ |
āha svayaṃprakāśaṃ vai tvanāhāryaṃ tvayā hṛtam ||41||
svalpe drohe mahān daṇḍo na vai nyāyyaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā |
rājñi śāstari caurādyā na prajāḥ pīḍayantyapi ||4||
rājaśūnye prajāḥ svaṃ svaṃ ghnanti luṇṭanti dasyavaḥ |
apakvabuddhinā tāta tvayā śaptaṃ tu dāruṇam ||43||
ajñātena kṛtaṃ doṣaṃ bhagavān kṣantumarhati |
aparādhisahasreṣu satsvapi naiva śocati ||44||
kliṣyati no pratikāraṃ karoti bhaktimān janaḥ |
tiraskṛtāstāḍitāścākruṣṭāśca kutsitīkṛtāḥ ||45||
gālīdattāḥ praśaptāśca viprakṛtāśca pātitāḥ |
āpatsvapi na duṣṭānāṃ pratikurvanti sādhavaḥ ||46||
tasmāt svayaṃprakāśa tvaṃ yāhi śīghraṃ nivedaya |
māsābhyantara eva tvāṃ kuhako daṃkṣyatīti vai ||47||
iti tu preritaḥ śiṣyo jagāma barhiṣāṃgadam |
rājarṣiḥ khedamāpanno duṣṭatāṃ svāṃ vyacintayat ||48||
aho’nāryo’pi no kuryāt kṛtaṃ tādṛṅmayā hyagham |
brāhmaṇe pūjanīye me mahatpāpaṃ samarjitam ||49||
