sampattiryauvanaṃ garvo sattā caivāvivekitā|||
vipatteḥ kāraṇānyāhurmayyevānvarthatāmaguḥ ||1.57.50||
aho me ko bhavelloko brahmadveṣṭurvijṛmbhṛtaḥ ||
asya pāpasya pratyarthovaśyaṃ me bhavatu kṣayaḥ ||51||
punarevaṃ na vai kuryāṃ tathā śāstu dharāmaraḥ |
athavā kṣemakuśale rājñāṃ viprābhisatkṛte ||52||
tathāpi me mahān daṇḍo bhagavān dātumarhati |
evaṃ cintayatastasya brahmadaṇḍārthasaṃbhṛtā ||53||
śiṣyavāṇī kuhakādvai mṛtyuśaṃsinyupasthitā |
śrutvā vinayasampanno’naśanavratamāsthitaḥ ||54||
brāhmaṇaṃ tu namaskṛtya svātmānaṃ brahmaṇi nyadhāt |
khaṭvāṃgadapurātprācyāṃ raivatādhityakābhuvi ||55||
bhaveśasaraso madhye dvīpe jalamaye tadā |
vrataṃ cānaśanaṃ kṛtvā niṣasāda udaṅmukhaḥ ||56||
jñātvā samādhiyogena ṛṣayo manavastathā |
pitaro devagandharvāḥ surā yakṣāśca mānavāḥ ||57
brāhmaṇāḥ sādhavaḥ sādhvyo tīrthāni parvatāstathā|
graharkṣatārakā divyā auṣadhyaḥ kalpapādapāḥ ||58||
kāmadughāḥ surabhyaśca mātaro lokapālakāḥ |
āyayustānsamabhyarcya vavande daṇḍavanmuhuḥ ||59||
teṣu sukhopaviṣṭeṣu rājā mānasamarthitam |
ante kartavyamālakṣya nyavedayaccikīrṣitam ||1.57.60||
aho dayābhṛtāṃ muktidātṝṇāṃ puṇyaśālinām |
darśanaṃ tvaghanāśāya paralokaprasattaye ||61||
dvijaśāpo’nugraho me yanmiṣaṃ bhavadāgamaḥ |
nirvedamūlaṃ saṃjāto muktaye prerako’pi ca ||62||
miṣṭaṃ vā kaṭu viproktaṃ sarvathā śreyase bhavet |
tad yūyaṃ me dṛṣṭipathaṃ yātāḥ santo mṛtikṣaṇe ||63||
stheyaṃ kṛpālubhistāvad geyaṃ harerdaśastathā |
kuhako daśatu sveṣṭaṃ na me cintādya vartate ||64||
satāṃ maṇḍalamadhye me prāṇo yātu sukhaṃjuṣaḥ |
yatra yāmi tatra brahmajuṣāṃ sevāṃ lasāmyaham ||65||
iti kṛtvā ca natvā ca bhaveśvarasarovare |
madhyadvīpe nirāhāro niṣasāda mahīpatiḥ ||66||
tadā devaiśca munibhirapsarobhirmuhurmuhuḥ ||
praśasya vṛṣṭiḥ puṣpāṇāṃ kṛtā jayadhvaniśritā ||67||
tāvattatrāgato vyāsaḥ śvetavyāsamuniḥ svayam |
śvetarūpadharaḥ kalpe prathame yo hyajāyata ||68||
tejasā sūryasaṃkāśo vidyayā jñānabhāsuraḥ |
yogena brahmasadṛśa aiśvaryeṇa hariḥ svayam ||69||
āgatāya namaścakrurutthāya tatra ye’bhavan |
taṃ copaveśayāmāsuḥ samarhe tu mahāsane ||1.57.70||
āsīnaṃ taṃ sa nṛpatiḥ praṇanāma kṛtāṃjaliḥ |
paripapraccha vinayāt śreyaskaramadaḥ śubham ||71||
vayaṃ vai kṣatradāyādāḥ karmaṇā hyadhamāḥ punaḥ |
bhavādṛśaiḥ samāgatya lokānāmuparikṛtāḥ ||72||
tirthībhavanti saudhāni yasyābhidhānakīrtanāt |
darśanaspṛśisānnidhyasevāmardanaprahvaṇaiḥ||73||
sevitāḥ sādhavaḥ samyak sevakānprapunanti hi |
yeṣāṃ pādarajaḥprāptyā śuddhyanti gṛhamedhinaḥ ||74||
gṛhāṇyapi viśuddhayanti kiṃ punastatsamāgamāt |
bhavato darśanaṃ mahyaṃ dayāmṛte kathaṃ bhavet ||75||
tasmānmokṣo mama dhruvaṃ bhavitā śāśvatīsamāḥ |
atha me kiṃ vidheyaṃ vai mriyamāṇasya sarvathā ||76||
pṛcchāmi śravaṇaṃ jāpo bhajanaṃ vā yathocitam |
anyadvā donahomādi śreyaskaraṃ pradarśyatām ||77||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne barhiṣāṃgadotpattipatnīvratāśramagamanasanmānālābhaprayojyamaharṣigalamṛtasarpanikṣepatadṛṣiputrakṛtamāsābhyantarakuhakasarpadaṃśajamṛtyuśāpatajjñānottaraprāyopaveśanavratarṣisamāgamaśvetavyāsāgamanasvaśreyaskarajijñāsādipraśnanirūpaṇanāmā saptapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||57||

<1.58>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tatastatra kiṃ kiṃ jātaṃ nibodha me |
śvetavyāsamuniścādyaḥ provāca hāṭakāṃgadam || 1 ||
rājaṃstavāśramastādṛk śreyo’rthaḥ svalpa āpyate |
ātmattattvasya lābho na nidrāvyavāyakarmabhiḥ || 2 ||
vayo vyatyeti kāmena rātryo niryānti nidrayā |
dinānyudarapūrtyarthaṃ vyavasāyaviḍambanaiḥ || 3 ||
draṣṭā paśyatyavirataṃ līyamānaṃ kṣaṇa jagat |
gṛhāpatyakalatrādi mṛtaṃ paśyanna paśyati || 4 ||
hyaḥ samupārjitaṃ cādya śvo vā nāśaṃ prayātyapi |
loko naiva vijānāti svasya nāśamupasthitam ||5||
sarpeṇārdhaṃ mukhe grasto maṇḍuko nikaṭāgatām |
yatate makṣikāmattuṃ jīvitāśā duratyayā || 6 ||
kaścideva kṛpāleśād vijānātyātmamokṣaṇam |
kaścideva kṛpāpātraṃ yatate śreyase punaḥ || 7 ||
kaścit tatrāpi sukṛtī mokṣārthameva tiṣṭhati |
rājan samyagvyavasitaṃ tvayā vai mokṣakāṃkṣiṇā || 8 ||
śrotavyaḥ kīrtitavyaśca smartavyaḥ śrīhariḥ prabhuḥ |
yogasādhanasampatteḥ sāṃkhyavijñānasaṃdhṛte || 9 ||
śāstrāṇāṃ ca tathābhyasterlābho mokṣaviniścayaḥ |
lābho mānavasaṃbhūteryadante śrīharismṛtiḥ ||1.58.10||
sādhavaḥ prāyaśo rājan ramante’jaguṇārṇave |
nirguṇā api kurvanti kathākīrtyādikaṃ hareḥ ||11||
kīrtanaṃ tu caritrāṇāṃ mūrteśca smaraṇaṃ tathā |
samāgamastadbhaktānāṃ paraṃ śreyo dadāti hi ||12||
śravaṇaṃ tatkathānāṃ tadvibhūtīnāṃ ca vijñatā |
upāsā hṛtsthitestasya paraṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti hi ||13||
śrīharestu kṛpāyogācchrīhareḥ kiraṇodbhavaḥ |
śvetavyāsamuniścādyo nirguṇo’haṃ haro harim ||14||
dhyāyāmi ca smarāmi ca kīrtayāmi kathā hareḥ |
kathāstāstu mayā lakṣmīnārāyaṇamukhācchrutāḥ ||15||
tābhiścāhaṃ sthitiṃ prāpto nirguṇāṃ muktirūpiṇīm |
tathāpyetāḥ śrāvayāmi janān paramamuktaye ||16||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitaiṣā tu brahmarūpiṇī |
mahābhāgavatī vāṇī brahmarūpān karoti hi ||17||
yatra sthale śravaścāsyā māsapārāyaṇena vai |
sārasyāpi sthalaṃ tadvai divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhakaṃ bhavet ||18||
yeṣāṃ śravaṇagā hyeṣā saṃhitātmanyadhiṣṭhitā |
te vai muktāḥ sadā bodhyā dehadhṛgo’pi mānavāḥ ||19||
eṣāṃ tu saṃhitāṃ rājan ṣaṭvāṃgadaḥ pitā tava |
śrutavān kuṃkumavāpyāṃ gatavānabhayaṃ harim ||1.58.20||
brahmaṇā saṃśruteyaṃ tu saṃhitā ṛṣibhiḥ samam |
tretāyāṃ satyaloke ca devaiśca pitṛbhiḥ samam ||21||
vaikuṇṭhe pāṭhamasyāśca lakṣmīrdevī karoti hi |
etatpārāyaṇaṃ sarvavedebhyo’pyuttamaṃ matam ||22||
sarvataḥ prāgidaṃ śāstraṃ nārāyaṇamukhodgamam |
parabrahmāvatārāstadvibhūtikoṭayastathā ||23||
pravarṇitā yathārthā vai nārāyaṇamukhācchrutāḥ |
sarveṣāmādimaṃ śāstraṃ saṃhiteyaṃ sunirmitā ||24||
ādyavyāsena vai śveteneyaṃ saṃviśadīkṛtā |
imāmādhāramādāya śāstrapurāṇasaṃhitāḥ ||25||
granthiṣyantyanyavyāsādyāḥ purāṇetikathānakān |
tadidaṃ paramaṃ śrāvyaṃ nārāyaṇapadārjakam ||26||
ekāgreṇaiva manasā cintyastasyārtha uttamaḥ |
yena mokṣo bhavetsadyo brahmalokagamātmakaḥ ||27||
viṣayebhya indriyāṇāṃ vigamaṃ hi samācaret |
vṛttīnāṃ cāntare tattve layamanvahamācaret ||28||
āntarāṇāṃ tu vṛttīnāṃ svasmin sthairyaṃ samācaret |
svasya yogaṃ tu hariṇā samaṃ sudṛḍhamabhyaset ||29||
ityevaṃ brahmaśīlasya drāgvimuktiḥ kare sthitā |
svastikāsanamāsīnaḥ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ ||1.58.30||
indriyavṛttīrāhṛtya sthūlaṃ prāgvai pradhārayet |
mūrtaṃ vai śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmakam ||31||
iṣaddhāsyāmṛtajharaṃ prasannaṃ premanirjharam |
ramyamākarṣakaṃ saumyaṃ saprabhaṃ dhavalaṃ mukham ||32||
tayoḥ pṛthakpṛthagdhāryaṃ bhaktena tu mumukṣuṇā |
harernetradvayaṃ cābjarājīvapatrikāyatam ||33||
premarasapravāhādāhlayanniva sudarśakam |
viśālaṃ prānta dhavalaṃ smaramūrtiviḍambanam ||34||
kamanīyaṃ tayordhyeyaṃ pṛthakpṛthaṅamumukṣuṇā |
bhṛkuṭīyugalaṃ dhyeyaṃ tiryakasnigdhaṃ kramātkṛśam ||35|| 
sūkṣmaromāvalīprāntapicchamākarṇamāyatam |
madhye tu kāmacandrāḍhyaṃ sumūrtamiva sūjjvalam ||36||
athālakāḥ kṛśāḥ snigdhā vakrāścakacakāyakāḥ |
projjvalā madhyasannyastabrahmamārgāvalambanāḥ ||37||
tayordvayoḥ pṛthag dhyeyāḥ svarṇamukuṭamaṇḍitāḥ |
gumphitaṃ dhammilaṃ yadvā cūḍāmaṇiṃ śikhāmaṇim ||38||
tantvīmuktādāmamṛṣṭe kapole dhārayed dvayoḥ |
ūrdhvaṃ vā candrakaṃ tatra dhārayenmana ātmanaḥ ||39|| 
udgamānudgamaśmaśrupakvabimbaphaloṣṭhakau |
ākiṃcinmilitau bhugnau darśitacumbanakṣaṇau ||1.58.40||
hṛdyau dhanuṣkasadrekhāvyañjitāvamṛtaṃdharau ||
pṛthak tau dhārayedbhaktyā śanaistatraikatānayet ||41||
cibuke’ñcitasadratnasvarṇabinducamatkṛte |
tayorvai dhārayetkarṇau svarṇaśaṣkulikāvṛtau ||42||
karṇapūrāvataṃsasraksubuṭṭimalasadvarau |
evaṃ lakṣmyānanaṃ kāmyaṃ ramyaṃ nārāyaṇānanam ||43|| 
prollasanmiṣṭapāṇḍurāmṛtatejaḥsuvartulam |
dhyāne cākṛṣyātmavṛttau dhyeyaṃ sthāpyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||44||
tatra cittasyātmanaśca līnībhāvaḥ samādhikṛt ||
evamātmani cātmānaṃ parabrahmaṇi yojayet ||45||
kṛtaṃ tu yojanaṃ yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ nijam ||
ityeva kaṇṭhahṛdayabhujodarakaṭīṃganam ||46||
sakthijānunalapiṇḍīgulphaprapadapārṣṇikān |
avayavānmahālakṣmyā mahānārāyaṇasya ca |||
pratyekaṃ dhārayed dhyāyetsamādadhyācca sarvadā ||47||
mokṣastena bhavet sadyo’punarāvartanātmakaḥ |
atha bandhakaraṃ tatrāvaraṇaṃ vastumātrakam ||48||
brahmāṃḍasthaṃ virodhi syāt tatrāpīkṣeta taṃ tadā ||
pātāle tasya caraṇau pārṣṇidvayaṃ rasātale ||49||
mahātale tu tadgulphau jaṃghe tasya talātale |
sutale jānunī tasyorudvayaṃ vitale tathā ||1.58.50||
atale mehanaṃ tasya sakthimūlaṃ mahītale ||
nabhastale nābhikūpaṃ svarge taddhṛdayaṃ tathā ||51||
mahari tasya kaṇṭhaṃ vai jane tasyāsyamīkṣayet ||
lalāṭaṃ tasya tapasi satye śīrṣāṇamīkṣayet ||52||
indrādiṣu ca tadbāhūn dikṣu karṇau samīkṣayet |
śabde tasya śravaṇaṃ cāśvineyayośca nāsikām ||53||
gandhe tasya prāṇamiddhānale tasyānanaṃ tathā |
divi tasyākṣiṇī paśyet sūrye tannetramīkṣayet ||54||
divārātrau pakṣmaṇī tadbhruvaṃ brahmāsane tathā |
apsu paśyeddharestālūṃ rase jihvāṃ samīkṣayet ||55||
chāndassu tacchiro daṃṣṭrā yame snehe dvijāṃstathā ||
māyāyāṃ śrīharerhāsaṃ sarge kaṭākṣamokṣaṇam ||56||
taduttarauṣṭhaṃ vrīḍāyāṃ lobhe cauṣṭhamadhaḥsthitam ||
dharme stanamadharme tu pṛṣṭhaṃ hareḥ samīkṣayet ||57
meḍhraṃ vedhasi tasyaiva mitrayorvṛṣaṇau hareḥ |
samudreṣu hareḥ kukṣīn giriṣvasthicayām̐stathā ||58||
nadīṣu tasya nāḍīṃśca vṛkṣeṣu tattanūdbhavān |
pavane śvasanaṃ tasya vayasi śrīharergatim ||59||
kriyāṃ guṇapravāhe ca keśānmegheṣu tasya vai |
sandhyāsu tasya vastrāṇi pradhāne tasya sūkṣmatām ||1.58.60||
candre harermanaḥ paśyedvijñāne mahanīyatām |
rudre tadantaḥkaraṇam aśvādiṣu nakhāni vai ||61||
kaṭiṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ paśuṣveva taccāturyaṃ tu pakṣiṣu 
svāyaṃbhuve harerbuddhiṃ parṇakuṭiṃ nareṣu ca ||62||
gandharveṣu smṛtiṃ tasyāsurasainyeṣu sadbalam |
brāhmaṇeṣu mukhaṃ tasya kṣatriyeṣu bhujadvayam ||63||
vaiśyeṣūrudvayaṃ tadvaccaraṇe śūdramīkṣayet ||
kāme tasya tu saṃkalpaṃ strīṣu divyaharestanum ||64||
nareṣu divyavīryaṃ tasyānandaṃ brahmabhāvanam |
sthūle sūkṣmaṃ mahatyalpaṃ vairāje kṛṣṇamīkṣayet ||65||
evaṃ sarvatra ca śrīmannārāyaṇamitīkṣayet ||
śravaṇaṃ mananaṃ dhyānaṃ tena tatra samāpayet ||66||
tadānandaṃ tasya saukhyaṃ tasya miṣṭarasaṃ dhruvam ||
sarvadaiva bhajato’nyat sarvaṃ tanmayatāṃ nayet ||67||
iti mukteḥ kṛte rājan vidheyaṃ te pradarśitam ||
tena mārgeṇa sākṣādvai hariḥ sannihito bhavet ||68||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śvetavyāsakṛtopadeśasaṃhitāpārāyaṇanirdeśabhagavanmūrtidhāraṇāvibhūtyādiharitādātmyadhāraṇādikathananāmāṣṭapaṃcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||58||

<1.59>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
athāpi vāsanāleśād bahujanmabhramestathā |
mano yadi punaścāyātsthairyaṃ naiva samāśrayet || 1 ||
tadā tu mana evedaṃ brahma ityapi dhārayet |
tasmin yadudbhavecchuklaṃ mantavyaṃ kṛṣṇameva vā || 2 ||
tadapi brahma eveti nānyo vai viṣayo hi saḥ ||
ityevaṃ kalpayet prājño mumurṣurnānyamarthayet || 3 ||
athāpi tatra bhāsaḥ syādvividhānāṃ tu dehinām ||
paśukalatraputrādidravyabhavanasampadām ||4||
sarvaṃ vai brahma ityevaṃ kalpayennānyamarthayet |
evaṃ tadbrahmabhāvena brahmarūpāṇi tāni vai ||5||
bhavantyeva tatastāni naiva bandhakarāṇi hi |
athāpi tanmano brahmarūpaṃ kṛtvā svayaṃ janaḥ || 6 ||
sarvaṃ brahmamayaṃ paśyennānyat kiṃcidvilokayet |
nendriyairnāntarairnaiva vāsanākiraṇena vā || 7 ||
svātmariktaṃ vipaśyeddhi kiṃcidanyadatanmayam ||
tādṛśaṃ svaṃ manaścaiva mantavyaṃ brahmarūpakam || 8 ||
kṛtvā tataḥ paraṃbrahma dhyāyecchāntarayeṇa vai ||
tad yathā svaṃ brahma kṛtvā paraṃ brahma sumūrtakam || 9 ||
cintayet saumyarūpaṃ taṃ sūkṣmaṃ prādeśamātrakam ||
caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ prabhum ||1.59.10||
suprasannamukhāṃbhojaṃ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇam |
kesarapiśaṃgadhautraṃ ratnanaddhasubhūṣaṇam ||11||
mahāratnāñcitaprāntakalgikirīṭakuṇḍalam
śrīvatsaṃ vakṣasi dadhadvanamālāsukaustubham ||12||
raśanāvṛttakaṭyāḍhyaṃ svarṇanūpurapatkajam |
komalasvarṇapattrāṇaṃ varaprāvārasaṃvṛtam ||13||
suvarṇaśṛṃkhalāyuktāṅgulīyakaṃkaṇānvitam |
snigdhābhugnanīlakeśaṃ mandahāsāmṛtānanam ||14||
premarasodgamannetraṃ bhrūcāṃcalyakṛpāparam ||
ityevaṃ divyatejaskaṃ surūpaṃ cintayennije ||15||
tathā nakhaśikhāpūrṇamekaikamaṃgamīkṣayet |
yāvannasthiratāṃ yāyāt samabhyasyettu tāvatā ||16||
sukhasthirāsanasaṃstho jihāsurlokamulbaṇam |
prāṇānyacchenmano yacched buddhiṃ yacchennijātmani ||17||
ātmānaṃ brahmaṇi yacched brahmātmānaṃ parātmani |
evaṃ kramātparaṃ ruddhaḥ śāntastadrūpatāṃ gataḥ ||18||
virameta śanaiḥ kṛtyānna guṇā bandhanapradāḥ |
kuto’nyatkālamāyādi yatpadaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tu tat ||19||
nābhiṃ saṃkucya ca gudaṃ kramāccakrāṇi laṃghayet |
suṣumṇayā bhruvormūle guruṃ dhyātvordhvamāgataḥ ||1.59.20||
mūrdhnaśchidraṃ tato bhittvā muktaiḥ saha parivrajet |
śuklaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ gatvā sūryaṃ cāndraṃ ca tārakāḥ ||21||
paitryaṃ sthānaṃ samullaṃghya ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍalāni ca ||
satyaṃ lokaṃ samulaṃghyāṣṭaiśvarāvaraṇāni ca ||22||
samullaṃghya tato gacchedvirāṭnārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||
hiraṇyagarbhamullaṃghya mahāviṣṇupadaṃ tataḥ ||23||
taccāpi saṃparityajya prādhāne prākṛte pade |
samapohya brahmalokaṃ śāśvataṃ dhāma cāpnuyāt ||24||
na mṛtyurna jarā tatra na kālo na ca śocanam |

<1.61>

sūryo’pyaicchattadā patnīṃ putrasantatihāyinīm ||24||
atha sarvaguṇopetā prāptā saṃjñābhidhā priyā ||
viśvakarmasutā divyā raviṇā sā vivāhitā ||25||
sūryastu tejasā tīvraḥ saṃjñā mṛdvī svatejasā ||
sūryatejo’sahamānā raveḥ sevāṃ karotyapi ||26||
yadā sūryastu saṃjñāyā mukhaṃ paśyati kāmataḥ ||
tadā saṃjñā sūryatejaḥpradhṛṣyā bhavati drutam ||27||
sūryasya tejasā saṃjñā netre nimilate sadā |
premṇā paśyantyapi sūryaṃ tejasābhibhavāttadā ||28||
nahi vivṛttanetreṇa draṣṭuṃ śaktā bhavatyasau |
sūryaḥ svayaṃ svabhāvāddhi dehe’pyuṣṇatamaḥ paraḥ ||29||
saṃjñā sūryasya tattejo hyugraṃ soḍhuṃ śaśāka na |
yadā yadā tu sūryastāṃ samāśliṣyati vai priyām ||1.61.30||
tadā tu sūryaṃ santaptaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca vivaśā hi sā ||
patiṃ dṛṣṭvā muhuḥ saṃjñā svākṣisaṃyamanaṃ vyadhāt ||31||
sūryastu premasamaye priyāṃ saṃruddhalocanām ||
muhurdṛṣṭvā hyadhīraḥ san roṣādvacanamabravīt ||32||
mama yoge sadā bhīru kuruṣe svākṣisaṃyamam |
tasmānmadvīryataste’pi putro bhavatu saṃyamaḥ ||33||
nāmnā yamastu vikhyāto yamarājeti vai mahān |
jīvānāṃ karmapākasya daṇḍadātā bhaviṣyati ||34||
mama krodhavaśāt so’pi krūradharmā bhaviṣyati |
tava netrasaṃyamanāt sopi tādṛgbhaviṣyati ||35||
yadā tu karmapākaṃ vai daṇḍaṃ dāsyati karmaṇe |
tadā hyākrośato jīvānnaiva drakṣyati netrataḥ ||36||
netre sammīlya daṇḍaṃ vai yathākarma pradāsyati |
yādṛg vai saṃgame pitrorbhāvastādṛk tu bālake ||37||
ityevaṃ vadamāne tu ravau saṃjñā yathā tathā ||
priyacikīrṣayā patyuścaṃcalāpyabhavattadā ||38||
hāvaṃ bhāvaṃ darśayantī sneharatiṃ karoti vai ||
kāmabhogaṃ ratiṃ rītyā netre conmīlya bhāvataḥ ||39||
śaṃ nirvartayate yāvat sūryādgarbhaṃ samādadhau ||
sūryaḥ prāha tadā saṃjñāṃ priye tvaṃ cañcalā muhuḥ ||1.61.40||
vilolitasucāñcalyapūrṇadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ punaḥ ||
vilokayasi ramaṇād raṃjayasi ca māṃ muhuḥ ||41||
tato’patyaṃ dvitīyaṃ te caṃcalaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati |
sāpi kanyā tvayā tulyā caṃcalā vai bhaviṣyati ||42||
ityevaṃ yamakaṃ garbhe dadhāra ravikāmyayā |
atha prāpte tu samaye suṣuve yamakaṃ tu sā ||43||
patipradattavacanāttasyā jajñe yamo yamī ||
jātamātaṃ tu ṣoḍaśahāyanaṃ samabhūd dvayam ||44||
sūryagṛhe tu ramate yamakaṃ tad yamo yamī ||
putro dvitīyaḥ saṃjñāyāḥ śrāddhadevo’bhavanmanuḥ ||45||
yamastu yamarājo’bhūt saṃyaminyāṃ phalapradaḥ ||
yamī tu yamunā bhaktā nadī kṛṣṇecchayābhavat ||46||
golokātkṛṣṇacandreṇa preritātra samāgatā ||
sūryaputrī svayaṃ bhūtvā vṛndāvane gamiṣyati ||47||
kalindasya sutā paścāt kālindī sā bhaviṣyati |
yamunā sā mahādevī divyā mokṣapradāyinī ||48||
ākalpāntaṃ jalarūpā vṛndāvanavihāriṇī ||
kṛṣṇakelihradaramyā gopagopīkṛtāplavā ||49||
devadevīmahāpūjyā gokulāgre gamiṣyati ||
evaṃ putradvayaṃ putraṃ saṃjñā saṃsuṣuve raveḥ | ||1.61.50||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne sūryotpāditasvapatnīsaṃjñāgarbhotpannaśrāddhadevayamayamīprāvirbhāvakathananāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 61 ||

<1.62>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ paścāt saṃjñāyā yā kathā hyabhūt |
nityaṃ sūryaprasaṃge’syā jvalanaṃ duḥsahaṃ hyabhūt || 1 ||
evaṃ saṃjñā ravestejomahaduḥkhena bhāminī ||
asahantīva sā citte cintayāmāsa vai sadā || 2 ||
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi kva yāmi sukhadaṃ sthalam ||
yadi yāmi vinā hyājñāṃ sūryo me kopavānbhavet || 3 ||
tasmādājñāṃ gṛhītvaiva svapiturgṛhamemyaham ||
iti sañcintya bahudhā sūryaṃ prāha muhustadā || 4 ||
deva me jāyate nityaṃ vicārastu piturgraham ||
gantuṃ mīlayituṃ sarvān svasṝrbhātṝnsakhījanān || 5 ||
ājñāpayatu māṃ nātha yāmi devāya rocate ||
sūryaḥ prāha na vai devi kālo’yaṃ gamanāya na || 6 ||
putrapālanakālo’yaṃ gṛhasaṃbhālanāya ca |
patyuḥ sevātilābhāya samayo’yaṃ tava priye || 7 ||
tatra gatvā nu te lābhaḥ ko vā bhāvī mama priye ||
māṃ vihāya viyogasthaṃ kathaṃ sthāsyasi tatra vai || 8 ||
anāhūtā piturge he putrī gacchati vegataḥ ||
satī śaṃkarapatnīva durdaśāmāpnuyāddhi sā || 9 ||
tasmānmā gaccha rambhoru gantavyaṃ tvanyadā punaḥ ||
kanyā vivāhapūrvaṃ vai śobhante tu piturgṛhe ||1.62.10||
kṛtodvāhāstu tāḥ paścācchobhante svapatigṛhe |
khānapānavilepābhyaṃjanaprābhūṣaṇādibhiḥ | 11||
vastravāhanayānodyānopavanavihārakaiḥ|
vividhaiḥ smaraṇottejisādhanaistu navairnavaiḥ ||12||
ramayanti patiṃ premṇā tṛpyanti patisaukhyataḥ ||
nirdhano vā pitā yāsāṃ vyayāśaktaśca sarvathā ||13||
putryastadgṛhamāgatya duḥkhe taṃ yojayanti hi ||
vastrairdhanairābharaṇaiścānyairbhogyaistu vastubhiḥ ||14||
aśakto raṃjane putryā mā duḥkhe pātayantu tam |
dine deha prayāsena śramyaṃ kāryaṃ vidhāya ca ||15||
dhanaṃ svodarapūrtyātma nītvā sāyaṃ gṛhaṃ gataḥ ||
evaṃ tu pratidivasaṃ svodyogārjyālpanāṇakam ||16||
nītvā krīṇātyannavastraṃ mā taṃ duḥkhe nipātaya ||
ityevaṃ bahu sandiṣṭā hyanunītā muhurmuhuḥ ||17||
saṃjñā tejo’sahaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhartre naiva vadatyapi ||
paścāttu mohamāpannā vicārya ca muhuḥ svayam ||18||
patiryathā na jñāyeta dvitīyaṃ rūpamādadhe |
seyaṃ tanudvitīyā sā chāyā svasyaiva daihikī ||19||
hyabhūttatra tu saṃkalpya cetanaṃ samanodayat ||
tejasvinī vahnisamā sūryatejaḥsahā tathā ||1.62.20||
pārthivāṃśasamakrāntā chāyābhūt strīsvarūpiṇī |
tathā sā cetanavatī nārīrūpā tu sundarī ||21||
saṃjñāsadṛśarūpā ca sarvaṃ saṃjñāmayaṃ hyabhūt ||
piturgṛhaṃ tato gantuṃ kṛtabuddhiryaśasvinī ||22||
chāyāmāhūya satkṛtya datvā gṛhadhanādikam ||
tāṃ provāca tvayā stheyamatra bhānoryathā mayā ||23||
tathā samyagapatyeṣu vartitavyaṃ yathā ravau |
na duṣṭamapi vācyaṃ te yathā bahumataṃ mama ||24
saṃjñāhamasmi saiveti vācyamevaṃ tvayānaghe |
yadi pṛcchetpatiḥ krodhātpremato vānyakāraṇāt ||25||
tvaṃ tu sūryasya tāpaṃ vai sahiṣyase yathā tathā |
śītalaṃ te śarīraṃ vai bhaviṣyati tathā tathā ||26||
tāpasahanayogye vai śāntide jvaranāśake |
sukhade te śarīre vai tāpaḥ śamiṣyati drutam ||27||
uṣṇasya layakaraṇāt sūryo’pi śāntimeṣyati |
tasmāttvayā sadā sevyaḥ sūryo mayeva bhāvataḥ ||28||
bhartsane tāḍane vātha gālīdāne sumardane |
tvayā nodāsitavyaṃ na prakāśyaṃ mama gopanam ||29||
chāyā provāca saṃjñāṃ tu sahiṣye sarvamādarāt |
ākeśagrahaṇāccāhamāśāpācca vacastathā ||1.62.30||
kariṣye pālayiṣyāmi yāvatkeśāpakarṣaṇāt ||
yadā vā maraṇaṃ yāvad duḥkhaṃ paśyāmi tāvatā ||31||
na tathāpi kathayiṣye tava vā mama vartanam |
gaccha devi bhagini tvaṃ piturgṛhaṃ sukhā bhava ||3||
kadāciccittavaiklavye smartavyāhaṃ tvayā svasaḥ |
ityevaṃ samayaṃ kṛtvā saṃjñā yayau piturgṛham ||33||
dadarśa tatra tvaṣṭāraṃ tapasaidhitavigraham |
namaskṛtya ca pitarau niṣasāda tadantike ||34||
bahumānācca tenāpi pūjitā viśvakarmaṇā |
piturgṛhe sukhaṃ tasthai bahukālamaninditā ||35||
patyurgṛhaṃ prati gantuṃ yadā necchati putrikā |
tataḥ prāha sa dharmajñaḥ pitā putrīṃ ciroṣitām ||36||
tvāṃ tu me paśyato vatse dināni su bahūnyapi ||
muhūrtena samāni syurbālaṃ kasya na rocate ||37
putro vā yadi vā putryaḥ saguṇā nirguṇāśca vā |
sucittā vā vicittā vā yathā tathā ca vā punaḥ ||38||
tathāpi pitroḥ snigdhāḥ syurāhlādakārakāḥ sadā ||
tvaṃ putri yauvanavatī raviṇā ca vivāhitā ||39||
ciraṃ tvatra nivāsena tava dharmo vilupyati |
bāndhaveṣu ciraṃ vāso nārīṇāṃ na yaśaskaraḥ ||1.62.40||
icchanti bāndhavā dharm patnyāḥ patigṛhe sthitim |
sā tvaṃ trailokyanāthena bhartrā sūryeṇa saṃgatā ||41||
piturgehe ciraṃ kālaṃ vastuṃ nārhasi putrike |
patyurgṛhe nivāsaṃ vai kartumarhasi putrike ||42||
ato bhartṛgṛhaṃ gaccha dṛṣṭo’haṃ pūjitā ca me |
punarāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ darśanāya śubhe kṣaṇe ||43
yadi te manasi kiñcid duḥkhaṃ jāmātṛtaḥ kṛtam ||
bhavejjñāpayitavyaṃ me satvaraṃ putrike’tra vai ||44||
no ced duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ gaccha sevayāṃśukaraṃ prabhum ||
tena tvamatra cāmutra dharmyāṃ siddhiṃ gamiṣyasi ||45||
ityuktāpi svakaṃ duḥkhaṃ lajjamānā satī tadā |
novāca pitaraṃ kiṃcid vicāryāpi muhurmuhuḥ ||46||
tathetyuktvā ca natvā ca pūjayitvā gurūm̐stathā ||
bhrātṝnsvasṝśca saṃśliṣya sā jagāmottarān kurūn ||47||
sūryatāpakṛtodvegā tejasastasya bibhyatī ||
na gatā sā sūryagṛhaṃ gatāraṇyaṃ tapaḥpriyā ||48||
tatrānyeṣāmaviditā vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī |
tapaścacāra paramaṃ ghāsagrāsādijīvanā ||49||
saṃjñāmityeva manvāno chāyāyāṃ tu divākaraḥ |
janayāmāsa tanayau kanyāṃ caikāṃ manoramām ||1.62.50||
nāmnā tu sāvarṇimanuṃ tāpīṃ śanaiścaraṃ tathā ||
sāvarṇistu manurbhāvī śanaiścaro graho bhavet ||51||
tapatī tu nadī tāpī gaurjare bhāvinī priye ||
saṃjñāmityeva niścitya chāyāyāṃ ca divākaraḥ ||52||
ratyā saṃyujyamāno vai reme subahuvatsarān |
nāvidatseyamanyeti tadā daivavaśāttu sā ||53||
chāyā divāniśaṃ samyak svasyāpatyasya vai muhuḥ ||
cakārābhyadhikaṃ snehaṃ bhojanācchādanādiṣu ||54||
saṃjñāyā na tathā putrīputrayoścāpyavartata |
manustatkṣāntavānasyā yamastasyā na cākṣamat ||55||
prāgabhūdbahumānaḥ sa sapatnyā duḥkhito’dya ca ||
sapatnyāścāvamānāya krodhaṃ sa tu cakāra vai ||56||
tato roṣācca bālyācca bhāvino’rthasya vai balāt ||
tāḍanāya tu tāṃ chāyāṃ pādastena samudyataḥ ||57||
tasyāḥ punaḥ kṣāntamanā na tu dehe nyapātayat ||
tataḥ śaśāpa taṃ krodhāt sapatnī jananī yamam ||58||
kiñcitprasphuramāṇauṣṭhī vicalatpāṇipallavā ||
patnyāṃ pituryadi mayi pādamudyacchase balāt ||59||
bhuvi tasmādayaṃ pādastavādyaiva patatviti ||
ityākarṇya yamaḥ śāpaṃ mātaryativiśaṃkitaḥ ||1.62.60||
abhyetya pitaraṃ prāha praṇipātapuraḥsaram |
tātaitanmahadāścaryamadṛṣṭamiti ca kvacit ||61||
krodhaṃ karoti nityaṃ me subahu bhartsayatyapi |
mātā vātsalyamutsṛjya śāpaṃ putre prayacchati ||6||
nirguṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā nirdayī bhavet ||
yathā mātā tu māṃ cakhyau neyaṃ mātā tathā mama ||63||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayuga santāne saṃjñāyāḥ svacchāyārūpanārīṃ sūryāya samarpya svapitṛgṛhagamanaṃ chāyāyā yamaṃ prati snehaśūnyavartanaṃ cetivarṇananāmā dviṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||62||

<1.63>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yamasyaitadvacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān lokabhāskaraḥ ||
hārdaṃ gambhīramevaitajjñātvā provāca vai yamam || 1 ||
asaṃśayaṃ mahatputra bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam |
yena tvāmāviśatkrodho mātaraṃ prati tattathā || 2 ||
putraṃ pratyapi mātuśca krodhaḥ samāviśannanu |
putra tvamasi dharmajñaḥ satyavādī ca mānadaḥ || 3 ||
na śakyametanmithyā tu kartuṃ māturvacastava ||
kṛmayo māṃsamādāya yāsyanti tu mahīṃ tava || 4 ||
tataḥ pādaṃ mahāprājña punaḥ saṃprāpsyase sukham |
kṛtamevaṃ vacaḥ satyaṃ mātustava bhaviṣyati ||5||
śāpasya parihāreṇa tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi ||
ādityastvabravīcchāyāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai || 6 ||
nyūnādhiko nu tulyeṣu sneho vai kriyate tvayā ||
kathamevaṃ dvitīyāṃ tu vinā syātpakṣapātitā || 7 ||
kā tvaṃ saiva dvitīyā vā vada yāthārthyameva me |
sā cāha tanayā tvaṣṭurahaṃ saṃjñā vibhāvaso || 8 ||
patnī tava tvayāpatyānyetāni janitāni me ||
itthaṃ vivasvatastāṃ tu bahuśaḥ pṛcchato yadā || 9 ||
nācakṣe tu tadā kruddho ravistāṃ śaptumudyataḥ ||
tataḥ sā kathayāmāsa yathāvṛttaṃ vivasvate ||1.63.10||
viditārthaśca bhagavān sūryaḥ śaśāpa tāṃ tadā |
sarvadā tvaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇā chāyā vṛkṣādijā bhava ||11||
andhakārasvarūpā tvaṃ madviyogavatī sadā ||
rodhakavastvāvaraṇā jaḍarūpā sadā bhava ||12||
gaccha gehātsadā dūraṃ mā māṃ darśaya te mukham ||
madraśmirodhakavastvadhastāttvaṃ tu sadā vasa ||13||
nirvivāsyeti vai chāyāṃ jagāma tvaṣṭurālayam ||
tatra saṃpūjayāmāsa tvaṣṭā sūryamupāgatam ||14||
bhāsvan kiṃ rahitaḥ śaktyā mama gehamupāgataḥ ||
papracchātha ca tasmai sa kathayāmāsa tattvataḥ ||15||
prāha tvaṣṭāgatā sātra bhavataḥ preṣitā rave ||
mama gṛhātpunaryātā tava gehaṃ divākara ||16||
divākaraḥ samādhau tām vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm |
tapaścarantīmācaṣṭe cottareṣu kuruṣvatha ||17||
tāṃ śaptukāmo bhagavānnāśāya kupito raviḥ ||
tvaṣṭā tu taṃ yathānyāyaṃ sāntvayāmāsa vai śanaiḥ ||18||
deva te sāsahamānā tejasā hyatipīḍitā |
vahnyābhanijarūpasya chāyārūpaṃ vimucya ca ||19||
ghorāraṇye tu sā gatvā tapaścarati duścaram ||
ghṛṣṇyauṣṇyād dagdhadehā sā tapaścarati duḥsaham ||1.63.20||
yena tvāṃ tejasāsahyaṃ śarīreṇāpyasaṃskṛtam ||
bahuśṛṃgoccadhāraṃ ca khararūkṣocanīcinam ||21||
vajrādapi sukaṭhinaṃ draṣṭuṃ soḍhuṃ śaśāka na |
tavedamativairūpyaṃ naiva bhāti na śobhate ||22||
asahā tasya sā saṃjñā vane carati śādvale|
tasmādrūpaṃ vraja mandaṃ tādṛṅnirvartaye tvaham ||23||
rūpaṃ vivasvatastvāsīdavyavasthaṃ kharāghaṭam |
ekataḥ prajvālayati cānyato’nuṣṇaśītalam ||24||
vivasvānatha tacchrutvā vrīḍito’bhūnmuhustadā ||
anujñātastatastvaṣṭā rūpasamīkarāya vai ||25||
bhramimāropya sūryaṃ tu śātayāmāsa śāṇataḥ |
śṛṃgadeśāstadā tasya dvādaśa śātitāḥ pṛthak ||26||
samīkṛtastadā saumyaḥ surūpobhūcca bhāskaraḥ ||
sahyatejāḥ sparśayogyaḥ sahavāsyo’bhavadraviḥ ||27||
dvādaśebhyastu khaṇḍebhyastvaṣṭāyudhāni nirmame ||
cakraṃ sudarśanaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇave tatsamārpayat ||28||
triśūlaṃ sumahat kṛtvā śaṃbhave tatsamārpayat ||
śaktiṃ kṛtvā mahālambāṃ kārtikāya samārpayat ||29||
vajraṃ kṛtvāṣṭadhāraṃ tatsurendrāya samārpayat ||
daṇḍaṃ kṛtvā mahāghoraṃ yamāya sa samārpayat ||1.63.30||
maṇiṃ kṛtvā mahāmūlyaṃ kuberāya samārpayat |
pāśaṃ kṛtvā tu vaidyutaṃ varuṇāya samārpayat ||31||
khaḍgaṃ kṛtvā mahaddhoraṃ devyai kālyai samārpayat |
kṛpāṇaṃ tu mahāghoraṃ kṛtvāgnaye samārpayat ||32||
phalaṃ kṛtvā mahābāṇe narāya tatsamārpayat |
ulkāṃ kṛtvā mahādivyāṃ vāyave tāṃ samārpayat ||33||
kṛkaśāṃ dantrikāṃ kṛtvā nirṛtāya samārpayat |
tadanye svalpakhaṇḍāstu hīrakā maṇayo’bhavan ||34||
atha susaṃskṛtaḥ sūryo devarūpaṃ dadhāra ca |
dadarśa yogamāsthāya svāṃ bhāryāṃ vaḍavāṃ raviḥ ||35||
gatastatra sthale rūpaṃ pracchādya cāspṛśattataḥ ||
aśvarūpeṇa mārtaṇḍaḥ tāṃ cucumba muhurmuhuḥ ||36||
pṛṣṭhe gacchannathordhvaṃ tāṃ samārohati kāmataḥ |
maithunāya viceṣṭantaṃ parapuṃsaṃ viśaṃkya sā ||37||
vivṛtya tatsamīpe tu mukhaṃ kṛtvā sthitābhavat ||
aśvarūpo’pi sūryastu kāmavegena cākulaḥ ||38||
kaṃdharāyāṃ samutplutya ghrāṇe liṃgaṃ niveśya ca |
vīryaṃ sarvamasiñcadvai nāsikāyāṃ dvidhā tadā ||39||
sā taṃ niradhamacchukraṃ nāsikāśvāsavāyunā ||
devau tasmātsamutpannāvaśvinau bhiṣajāṃvarau ||1.63.40||
nāsatyaścaiva dasraśca smṛtau dvāvaśvināviti ||
atyadbhutaśarīrau tau devavedyau babhūvatuḥ ||41||
avaśeṣeṇa vīryeṇa nāsikātastadaiva hi ||
tṛtīyo’bhūd revatākhyaḥ putro nīlasurūpakaḥ ||42||
sa vai tasmāt tapaḥ kartuṃ paścimāyāṃ gato diśi ||
raivatācalamāsādya tatra vāsaṃ cakāra ha ||43||
raivatasya gireḥ so’yamātivāhikadaivataḥ ||
bhūtvā vasati tatraiva kalpāntaṃ tapa ādadhan ||44||
atha sūryaḥ svakaṃ rūpaṃ bhāskaraṃ samadarśayat ||
tadā saṃjñāpi viśvastā patipādau prapūjya ca ||45||
kṣamāpya svāparādhaṃ vai jagāma ravimaṇḍale |
sarvadā sā mahādivyā devī sūryasarūpiṇī ||46||
samāste ramate sārdhaṃ sūryeṇa divi modate ||
ityevaṃ sūryabālānāṃ navānāṃ divyajanmatā ||47||
śrāddhadevo yamo yamī sāvarṇiśca śanaiścaraḥ ||
tapatī cāśvinībālau revataśca nava smṛtāḥ ||48||
tatra yamāya sūryeṇa brahmaṇā ca samarpitam ||
lokapālatvamevaitya dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ ||49||
yamapūrīti sā proktā kṛtānāṃ tu vikarmaṇām ||
phalabhogāya duḥkhātmaniṣkṛtistatra kāryate ||1.63.50||
prāyaścittenātra loke pāṃkto bhavati mātrataḥ |
yamapūryāṃ phalabhogācchuddho bhavati cātmataḥ ||51||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne saṃjñāyā vaḍavārūpeṇa tapaścaryā sūryo’śvo bhūtvā tayā saṃśliṣṭo’śvinīkumārau revataṃ cotpādayāmāsa viśvakarmaṇā śāṇollīḍhasūryasya khaṇḍairdivyacakraśūlādiśastrotpādanamityādivarṇananāmā triṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||63||

<1.64>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yāmyanairṛtayormadhye puraṃ vaivasvatasya tu |
sarvaṃ vajramayaṃ divyamabhedyaṃ yat surāsuraiḥ || 1 ||
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ saptaprākāratoraṇam |
svayaṃ tiṣṭhati tasyāntaryamo dūtaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 2 ||
yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ hi pramāṇena tu dṛśyate |
sarvaṃ ratnamayaṃ divyaṃ vidyunmālārkavarttulam || 3 ||
pañcaviṃśapramāṇena yojanāni samucchritam |
vṛtaṃ stambhasahasraistu vaidūryamaṇimaṇḍitam || 4 ||
muktājālaṃ gavākṣantu patākāśatabhūṣitam |
ghaṇṭāśataninādāḍhyaṃ toraṇānāṃ śatairvṛtam || 5 ||
tatrastho bhagavān dharmaḥ āsane niyate śubhe |
daśayojanavistīrṇe nīlajīmūtasannibhe || 6 ||
dharmajño dharmaśīlaśca dharmanyāyahito yamaḥ |
bhayadaḥ pāpayuktānāṃ dharmiṇāṃ tu sukhapradaḥ || 7 ||
puramadhye praveśe tu citraguptasya vai gṛham |
pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyānāṃ yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ || 8 ||
daśocchritaṃ mahādivyaṃ lohaprākāraveṣṭitam |
pratolīśatasañcāraṃ patākāśataśobhitam || 9 ||
dīpikāśatasaṃkīrṇaṃ gītadhvanisamākulam |
citritaṃ citrakuśalaiścitraguptasya vai gṛham ||1.64.10||
maṇimuktāmaye divye āsane paramādbhute |
susthito gaṇapatyāyurmānuṣeṣvitareṣu ca ||11||
na muhyati kathaṃcitsaḥ sukṛte duṣkṛte’pi ca |
janmanopārjitaṃ yāvat sadasadveti tasya tat ||12||
dehendriyamanobhiśca kṛtaṃ karma likhatyasau |
citraguptagṛhātprācyāṃ jvarasyāsti mahāgṛham ||13||
dakṣiṇe cāpi śūlasya lūtāvisphoṭakasya ca |
paścime kālapāśasya ajīrṇasyārucestathā ||14||
madhyapīṭhottare jñeyā nānāvidhā visūcikā |
aiśānyāṃ tu śirorogo vahridiśi tu mūrchanā ||15||
nairṛtyāmatisāraśca vāyavyāṃ dāhapīḍanam |
ebhiḥ parivṛto nityaṃ citraguptaḥ sa vartate ||16||
yatkarma kriyate yaiśca tatsarvaṃ tu likhatyasau |
dharmarājagṛhadvāri dūtāstiṣṭhanti koṭiśaḥ ||17||
yamalokasya cādhvā vai antaro mānuṣasya ca |
duḥkhena pāpino yānti yamamārgaṃ sudurgamam ||18||
yamaścaturbhujo bhūtvā śaṃkhacakragadābjabhṛt |
āhūya pāpinaḥ sarvān dūtairdaṇḍaṃ dadāti vai ||19||
pralayāmbudanirghoṣo hyaṃjanādrisamaprabhaḥ |
mahiṣastho durārādhyaḥ sūryatejaḥsamadyutiḥ ||1.64.20||
yojanatrayavistṛtadeho | krūro’tibhītidaḥ |
doṣṇā daṇḍadharo bhīmaḥ pāśapāṇirdurākṛtiḥ ||21||
raktanetro’tibhayado darśanaṃ yāti pāpinām |
aṃguṣṭhamātraḥpuruṣo hāhākurvan kalevarāt ||22||
yadeva nīyate dūtairyāmyairyamapurīṃ tadā |
darśayanti bhayaṃ tīvraṃ dūtāḥ saṃtarjayanti hi ||23||
śīghraṃ pracala duṣṭātman yāsyasi tvaṃ yamālayam |
kumbhīpākādinarakān tvāṃ neṣyāmo drutaṃ kuru ||24||
mārge prayāti vai preto . hyasipatravanānvite |
kaṇṭakaśarkarātaptavālukāviṣakardame ||25||
ahanyahani sa preto yojanānāṃ śatadvayam |
catvāriṃśattathā sapta ahorātreṇa gacchati ||26||
trayodaśe’hni sa preto nīyate yamakiṃkaraiḥ |
tasminmārge vrajatyeko gṛhīta iva markaṭaḥ ||27||
saptadaśadinānyeko vāyumārgeṇa gacchati |
aṣṭādaśetvahorātre pūrvaṃ yāmyapuraṃ vrajet ||28||
yāmyaṃ tu prathamaṃ proktaṃ sauripuraṃ dvitīyakam |
surendrapuraṃ tṛtīyaṃ gandharvanagaraṃ tataḥ ||29||
śailapuraṃ pañcamaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhaṃ krūrapuraṃ tathā |
saptamaṃ krauṃcanagaraṃ citrapuraṃ tathāṣṭamam ||1.64.30||
bahvāpannagaraṃ paścād daśamaṃ duḥkhadaṃ puram |
daśaikamākrandapuraṃ sutaptanagaraṃ tataḥ ||31||
trayodaśaṃ raudrapuraṃ payovṛṣṭaṃ caturdaśam |
pañcadaśaṃ śītapuraṃ bahubhayaṃ tu ṣoḍaśam ||32||
saptadaśaṃ dharmapuraṃ yāmyaṃ cāṣṭādaśaṃ puram |
purāṇyetāni santyeva mārge viśrāntilabdhaye ||33||
pāpī mṛto bhavetpretaḥ pretadehaṃ tu vindati |
pretadehastu navabhirahorātraiḥ subaddhyate ||34||
dehaniṣpattilābhāya piṇḍā deyāḥ pṛthak pṛthaka |
prathame’hani yaḥ piṇḍastena mūrddhā prajāyate ||35||
grīvāskandhau dvitīye tu tṛtīye hṛdayaṃ bhavet |
caturthe’hni bhavet pārṣṇirnābhirvai paṃcame tathā ||36||
ṣaṣṭhe kaṭiḥ saptame tu guhyaṃ pūrṇaṃ prajāyate |
dine’ṣṭame sakthinī ca jānvaṃghrī navame tathā ||37||
navabhirdehamāsādya daśame’hni bhavet kṣudhā |
deharūpaḥ kṣudhitaśca gṛhāgropari tiṣṭhati ||38||
daśame’hani taṃ piṇḍaṃ dadyātkṣudhānivartakaḥ |
ekādaśadvādaśāhe preto bhuṃkte dinadvayam ||39||
trayodaśe’hni vai preto nīyate tu mahāpathe |
saptadaśadinaṃ yāvat vāyumārgeṇa gacchati ||1.64.40||
aṣṭādaśe tvahorātre pūrvaṃ yāmyapuraṃ vrajet |
tatra mahānpretagaṇaḥ puṣpabhadrānadītaṭe ||41||
mahānyagrodhachāyāyāṃ preto viśrāmamṛcchati |
krandati karuṇairvākyaistṛṣārtaḥ śramapīḍitaḥ ||42||
śambalastatpurādhyakṣaḥ pretāya saṃprayacchati |
yadi dattaṃ sutaiḥ putraiḥ snehādvā kṛpayāthavā ||43||
māsikaṃ piṇḍamattvā ca yāti sauripuraṃ tataḥ |
tatra nāmnā tu rājā vai jaṃgamaḥ kālarūpadhṛk ||44||
tripākṣikaṃ tu piṇḍaṃ vai dadātyasmai subhuktaye |
jalaṃ cānnaṃ tatra bhuktvā tatpuraṃ so’tigacchati ||45||
māsadvayābhyantare vai surendrapuramṛcchati |
surendro bhīṣaṇastantādhiṣṭhātāsmai dadāti hi ||46||
māsadvayāntare dattaṃ piṇḍaṃ vā yadi bhojanam |
vyatikramya puraṃ tacca tṛtīye māsi cāparam ||47||
gandharvapuramāsādyāśnāti piṇḍaṃ trimāsagam |
tataḥ śailapuraṃ māsi caturthe preta eti ca ||48||
patanti tatra pāṣāṇāḥ pretasyopari pṛṣṭhataḥ |
caturthamāsikaṃ śrāddhaṃ bhuktvā krūrapuraṃ gataḥ ||49
pañcame māsi tatrasthaḥ piṇḍaṃ pañcamamāsikam |
bhuktvā yāti krauṃcapuraṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ krauṃcādhivāsitam ||1.64.50|| 
sārdhapaṃcamamāsārjyamūnaṣāṇmāsikaṃ tathā |
śrāddhe dattaṃ tu piṇḍādi bhuktvā viśramya yāti ca ||51||
citrapuraṃ saptamaṃ tatpurarājastu citrakaḥ |
yamānujo hyadhiṣṭhātā piṇḍaṃ ṣāṇmāsikaṃ jalam ||52||
bhojayatyatha bhuktvā sa mārge gacchati cāgrataḥ |
āyānti sammukhāstatra kaivartāstu sahasraśaḥ ||53||
vayaṃ tvāṃ tārayiṣyāmo mahāvaitaraṇīṃ nadīm |
śatayojanavistīrṇāṃ pūyaśoṇitapūritām ||54||
āmiṣādapatatryahijhaṣakṛkacasaṃvṛtām |
yena tatra pradattā gauḥ pretaṃ tārayati drutam ||55||
na pradattā yadi dhenurvaitaraṇyāṃ sa majjati |
svasthāvasthe śarīre tu vaitariṇyā vrataṃ caret ||56||
deyā ca viduṣe dhenustāṃ nadīṃ tartumicchatā |
ṣāṇmāsikaṃ kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatra bhuktvā prasarpati ||57||
saptame māsi saṃprāpte yāti bahvāpadaṃ puram |
tatra bhuktvā pradattaṃ yat sāptamāsikasaṃbhavam |58||
tatpuraṃ sa vyatikramya puraṃ duḥkhadamṛcchati |
mahadduḥkhamanubhūya krośatyatra pratāpitaḥ ||59||
māsyaṣṭame pradattaṃ yat tatra bhuktvā sa gacchati |
navamaṃ māsikaṃ bhuṃkte nānākrandapure sthitaḥ ||1.64.60||
tatrāyaṃ śūnyahṛdayaḥ samākrandati duḥkhitaḥ |
vihāya tatpuraṃ preto yāti taptapura prati ||61||
sutaptanagaraṃ prāpya daśame māsi so’śnute |
bhojanaiḥ piṇḍadānaistu dattaistatra phalaṃ bhavet ||62||
māsi caikādaśe pūrṇe raudraṃ puraṃ sa gacchati |
daśaimāsikaṃ bhuktvā payovṛṣṭaṃ pragacchati ||63||
meghāstatra pravarṣanti pretānāṃ duḥkhakārakāḥ |
nyūnābdikaṃ ca yacchrāddhaṃ tatra bhuṃkte paretakaḥ ||64||
sampūrṇe ca tato varṣe yāti śītapuraṃ tataḥ |
mahāśītārditaḥ preta ākrandati muhurjaḍaḥ ||65||
śītapuraṃ cātikramya bahubhītipuraṃ vrajet |
tatra kṣuttṛṭbhayād dagdho yāti dharmapuraṃ tataḥ ||66||
yatroṣmaṇā prabāṣpeṇa bharjito bhavate mṛtaḥ |
khādanti yamadūtāstaṃ mārgaśramāpanuttaye ||67||
bahubhītipuraṃ dharmapuraṃ ca dharmakheṭakau |
dharmarājapurasyaitau śākhāgrāmau samīpagau ||68||
atha pretaṃ nayantīme yāmyaṃ dharmapuraṃ param |
caturaśītilakṣaiśca mūrtāmūrtairadhiṣṭhitam ||69||
yamadūtairmahākrūrairāgatānāṃ prapīḍakaiḥ ||
pretamatra nyāyasaudhe dūtāḥ kurvantyupasthitam ||1.64.70||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne yamapurapariṇāhacitraguptasaudhamārgīyāṣṭādaśapuragamanavat pretadaśāpradarśananāmā catuḥṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||64||

<1.65>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi yāmyapure śrāvaṇā dvādaśo’nugāḥ |
brahmaputrāḥ pratīhārāḥ manuṣyāṇāṃ tu ceṣṭitam || 1 ||
śubhāśubhaṃ tu yatkarma vicāryyaiva punaḥ punaḥ |
śrāvayanti tadānīṃ vai citragupte yame tathā || 2 ||
naraistuṣṭaiśca ruṣṭaiśca yadyatkarma kṛtaṃ bhavet |
sarvamāvedayanti sma yathārthaṃ yādṛśaṃ ca yat || 3 ||
dūrāchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrād darśanagocaram |
svarbhūḥpātālavāsānāṃ ceṣṭājñānaṃ ca dūrataḥ || 4 ||
evaṃ teṣāṃ śaktirasti martyādau guptabodhinī |
te vai pretasya yāvaddhi karma gāyanti tatra ca || 5 ||
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
śrāvaṇāḥ kasya putrāste kathaṃ yamapure sthitāḥ |
trilokasthaiḥ kṛtaṃ karma kathaṃ jānanti te prabho || 6 ||
kathaṃ śṛṇvanti te sarve kasmājjñānaṃ samāgatam |
kadā te ca samutpannā brūhi me kānta sarvathā || 7 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ādau jagatsamutpannaṃ brahmayā nirmitaṃ hi tat |
mayā tu pālitaṃ tadvai rudraḥ saṃhārakṛt tataḥ || 8 ||
dharmarājo mayā sṛṣṭaścitraguptena saṃyutaḥ |
svasvakāryaṃ nirvahanti trayo devāḥ svatantrataḥ || 9 ||
sarve’pyādye satyayuge svatantrā hyabhavan janāḥ |
sarve tridevasadṛśā na teṣu kasya śāsanam ||1.65.10||
tretāyāmapi tadvacca svatantrāḥ karma cakrire |
śāstṝṇāṃ tadaviditaṃ śāstṛtvaṃ kutra sārthakam ||11||
tadā devāstrayastatra militāścintanāya vai |
prāṇināṃ tu svatantrāṇāṃ karmajñānaṃ na no yadi ||12||
na jānīmaḥ kathaṃ śāsayitavyāḥ prāṇinastadā |
vicāryetthaṃ vimamṛśuḥ sraṣṭavyāstādṛśāḥ sutāḥ ||13||
tadā brahmā śivaviṣṇvormatamādāya mantrayuk|
gṛhītvā dvādaśakuśān jalaṃ saṃprokṣya tatra ca ||14||
dadau dharmāya sajalakuśān dvādaśa cetanān |
yamo haste gṛhītvā tān saṃkalpayati putrakān ||15||
tejorāśīn viśālākṣān dūraśravaṇadarśanān |
ātmadraṣṭṝrnigitajñān parasaṃkalpabodhakān ||16||
adṛśyān dṛśyarūpām̐śca so’sṛjad dvādaśātmajān |
yamaputrā ime loke sarvatra karṇanetragāḥ ||17||
yo yaṃ vadati loke’smin yat karoti śubhāśubham |
prāpayanti ca te śīghraṃ yamasya karṇagocare ||18||
dūrācchravaṇavijñānaṃ dūrāddarśanagocaram |
sarvaṃ śṛṇvanti te sarve tenaiva śrāvaṇā matāḥ ||19||
vicaranti vāyurūpāḥ sthitvā cākāśavarmani |
jantūnāṃ ceṣṭitaṃ jñātvā yamāya pravadanti te ||1.65.20||
mṛtyoruttarakāle te yathākarma yathākṛtam |
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca yadvā mokṣaṃ yathā kṛtam ||21||
tathā sarvaṃ prāṇināṃ tu citraguptāya satvaram |
nivedayanti paścādvai yamāyāvedayanti ca ||22||
śrāvaṇāste bahurūpāṇyapi dhārayituṃ kṣamāḥ |
caturdaśabhuvaneṣu naikarūpaiścaranti te ||23||
dharmacarā janā ye te yānti vimānasaṃsthitāḥ |
arthadāste’jñapyapsarobhiryānti vimānasaṃsthitāḥ ||24||
kāmadānapradātāro yāntyaśvayuktasadrathaiḥ |
haṃsahastivimānaiśca mokṣabhājaḥ prayānti vai ||25||
adhārmikāstu padbhyāṃ vai yānti mārgaṃ suduḥsaham |
pāṣāṇaiḥ kaṇṭakaiḥ kliṣṭaṃ hyasipatravanātmakam ||26||
taptavālukayā vyāptaṃ pāśabaddhāḥ prayānti vai |
teṣāṃ sukhapravāsārthaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ yathābalam ||27||
chatropānahavastrāṇi mudrikā ca kamaṇḍaluḥ ||
āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ caiva vāhanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ jalam ||28||
annamājyamupavītaṃ gomahiṣyādikaṃ dhanam |
dātavyaṃ pretamuddiśya mārgaṃ sukhakaraṃ bhavet ||29||
mṛtoddeśena yatkiṃcid dīyate svagṛhe priye |
jalātmā sākṣikastaddhi varuṇo vetti sarvathā ||1.65.30||
gṛhṇāti varuṇo dānaṃ mama haste prayacchati |
ahaṃ nārāyaṇastato’rpayāmi bhāskare ravau ||31||
bhāskarāt sa ca vai pretaḥ saṃgṛhyāśnāti cetyataḥ |
deyaṃ pretasukhārthaṃ vai dānaṃ bahuvidhaṃ priye ||32||
yastu dharmaḥ kṛto naiva dānaṃ paścānna dīyate |
puṇyaṃ tu nārjitaṃ svaiśca narakān yāti dāruṇān ||33||
caturaśītilakṣāste narakāḥ santi duḥkhadāḥ |
teṣāṃ madhye mukhyatamā dhaureyāstvekaviṃśatiḥ ||34||
tāmisraścāndhatāmisro mahārauravarauravau |
kuṃbhīpākaḥ kālasūtramasipatravanaṃ tathā ||35||
sūkarāsyamandhakūpaḥ kṛmibhojanamityapi |
saṃdaṃśastaptasūrmiśca vajrakaṃṭakaśālmalī ||36||
pūyodo vaitaraṇī ca prāṇarodho viśaṃsanam |
ayaḥpānamavīciśca śvādanaṃ lālabhakṣaṇam ||37||
ityete mukhyarūpā vai yamapūryāṃ matāstathā |
tebhyo’dhastātpare sapta santyanye nāmataḥ śṛṇu ||38||
kṣārakardama eko’nyo rakṣogaṇaprabhojanaḥ |
śūlaproto dandaśūko’vaṭanirodhanastathā ||39||
paryāvartanakaścaiva sūcīmukhamiti pṛthak |
athānye narakagrāmāstatra santi nibodha tān ||1.65.40||
talapāto mahājvālaḥ śabalaśca vikartanaḥ |
adhaḥśirā rudhirāndhaścakṣuḥśūlaḥprapācanam ||41||
śailapāto lohaśaṃkupratodanigaḍāstathā |
lohayantraśca kākolo mṛtajīvanavaiśasau ||42||
narakāṇīti cānyāni bhedaprabhedatastathā |
bhavanti pāpakartṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtyarthaṃ kṛtāni vai ||43||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvādaśaśravaṇākhyadūtānāmaṣṭāviṃśatyādinarakāṇāmuddeśanāmā pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 65 ||

<1.66>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yeṣāṃ tu narake ghore gatānyabdaśatāni vai |
santatirnaiva vidyeta dūtatvaṃ te prayānti hi || 1 ||
yamena preṣitāste vai mānuṣādermṛtasya ca |
dine dine pragṛhṇanti dīpamannaṃ ghaṭādikam || 2 ||
pretasyaiva prayacchanti hyannakāmasya sattṛṣaḥ |
tṛptiṃ prayānti te sarve pratyahaṃ caiva vatsaram || 3 ||
citraguptapuraṃ pūrvaṃ yojanānāṃ tu viṃśatiḥ |
kāyasthāstatra paśyanti pāpapuṇye ca sarvathā || 4 ||
yojanānāṃ caturviṃśatistu vaivasvataṃ puram |
tatra gatvā preṣyadūtāḥ pratīhāraṃ vadanti vai || 5 ||
dharmadhvaja pratīhāre brūte tasya śubhāśubham |
yamarājasya dūtāstu bhīṣaṇā yamakiṃkarāḥ || 6 ||
pāśadaṇḍadharā ghorāḥ sahasrāṇi ca ṣoḍaśa |
ekaikasya purasyāgre sahasraikaṃ ca tiṣṭhati || 7 ||
dharmarājaḥ svayaṃ nyāyaṃ dadātyasmai tu pāpine |
tatra tatra ca narakān prabhuṃkte tadyathā śṛṇu || 8 ||
prasahya paravittastryapatyapatyādihārakāḥ |
patanti tatra tāmisre bhṛśaṃ kṣuttṛṭprabādhitāḥ || 9 ||
vaṃcayitvā paravittāpatyanāryādibhoginaḥ |
patanti tvandhatāmitre naṣṭadṛṅmatayastu te ||1.66.10||
patanti hiṃsakā mahāraurave tatra dehinaḥ |
kravyādā ruravo bhūtvā ghātayanti svaghātakam ||11||
bhūtadrohaiḥ kuṭumbasya poṣakā yānti raurave |
bhūtāni ruravaḥ sarpā bhūtvā hiṃsanti hiṃsakān ||12||
paśvādirandhakā duṣṭāḥ kuṃbhīpāke patanti vai|
dūtāstām̐staptataileṣu randhayanti muhurmuhuḥ ||13||
gurupitṛbrahmasādhusādhvyādiprāṇināṃ druhaḥ |
yānti vai kālasūtrākhye’yutayojanamaṇḍale ||14||
vahnitapte tāmrakhale loṭhayanti dahanti te |
svadharmahantā pākhaṇḍī vane yātyasipatrake ||15||
ubhatodhārakhaḍgaiḥ saṃchidyate mṛdyate muhuḥ |
anyāyadaṇḍadā yānti sūkarāsyākhyayantrake ||16||
niṣpīḍyamānāvayavāścūrṇībhavanti tatra vai|
īśakalpitavṛttīnāṃ yūkāmaśakapakṣiṇām ||17||
jantūnāṃ nāśakartāro hyandhakūpe patanti vai|
tatra dūtā janturūpā drugdhā druhyanti tānpunaḥ ||18||
asaṃvibhajya bhoktāraḥ patanti kṛmibhojane |
bhakṣyante kṛmibhiste ca śatasāhasrayojane ||19|| 
steyādbalātparasvarṇaratnabhvādyapahārakāḥ
saṃdaṃśe yāntyayodaṃśairniṣkṛntanti ca tān yamāḥ ||1.66.20||
agamyām̐stu narānnārīrbalātkāreṇa kāmukān |
taptasūrmyāṃ taptaloṣṭhaputalyāliṃgayanti te ||21||
paśvādinaramādāsu prasahya kāmukān janān |
vajrakaṃṭakaśālmalyāmāropya kartayanti vai ||22||
paśvācārā naṣṭaśaucāḥ śleṣmaviṇmūtrapūyake |
pūyodākhye patantyete hyaśnanti tanmalaṃ tathā ||23||
rakṣakā bhakṣakā bhūtvā rakṣyān bhindanti bhītidāḥ|
viṇmūtrapūyaraktātmavaitaraṇyāṃ vahanti te ||24||
mṛgayāsaktapaśvādighātinaḥ prāṇarodhane |
pātayitveṣubhistatra vidhyanti yamapūruṣāḥ ||25||
viśaṃsane paśu pakṣimanuṣyādividārakān |
vidārayanti khādantyasṛk pibanti ca te punaḥ ||26|| 
asaṃkhyajantunāśotthamadirāpānakṛjjanān |
taptāyorasapānaṃ vai kārayanti balād yamāḥ ||27||
kūṭasākṣyaprakartṝṃścāvīcau yāmyāḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
gavyūtidviśatocchrāyagirestu pātayanti vai ||28||
viṣadānagnidānduṣṭān śvādane’danti kukkurāḥ |
retaḥprapāyakān lālāḥ pāyayanti yamānugāḥ ||29||
pūjyapūjāvyaticārakartā tu kṣārakardame |
patatyavākśirāstatra tatphalaṃ ca samaśnute ||1.66.30||
paśupakṣinaranārīkhādakānāṃ yamānugāḥ |
khādantyasṛk prāpibanti rakṣogaṇaprabhojane ||31||
prāṇināṃ kaṇṭakasūcīśūlaistu vedhakānmuhuḥ |
śūlaprote pravidhyanti tīkṣṇāgrairyamasevakāḥ ||32||
prāṇyudvegaprakartṝṃśca daṃdaśūke śatānanāḥ |
dandaśūkāstroṭayanti grasante ca muhurmuhuḥ ||33||
guhāvivarakusūlabilādau prāṇirundhakān |
yāmyā rundhanti dhūmādyairvahninā sagareṇa ca ||34||
māṃsādikhādakān dūtāḥ khādanti kṣudhitāḥ punaḥ |
karasparśeṇa jāyante pūrṇāḥ khādanti tānpunaḥ ||35||
āḍhyābhimāninaṃ tiryakprekṣakaṃ pāpakāriṇam |
sūcīmukhe pātayitvā sūtraiḥ parivayanti ca ||36||
dīnadurbalasatpātramīkṣate kruddhacakṣuṣā |
tannetre vajratuṇḍairutpāṭayanti patattriṇaḥ ||37||
anyeṣāṃ tu vṛkṣaphalacauryakartārameva tu |
tāle uttolya bhūbhāge pātayanti yamānugāḥ ||38||
araṇyakṣetradagdhāraṃ mahājvāle nipātya vai |
vahnau taṃ bharjayantyeva yamadūtā muhurmuhuḥ ||39||
aśuddhaṃ bhojayitāraṃ śamale pātayanti hi ||
tatrāśuddhaṃ ca durgandhaṃ bhojayanti yamānugāḥ ||1.66.40||
kaṃcukapuṭakaṃ ye cotkṛtya dravyaṃ haranti tān |
vikartane kṣipantyugrāḥ kṛntanti prapibantyasṛk ||41||
bhittyādau vivaraṃ kṛtvā corayanti ca ye dhanam |
tānadhaḥśirasā vyomni tolayanti talāgninā ||42||
dugdhadānannatoyābhyāṃ sevante na paśūnnarāḥ |
rudhirāndhe pātayanti rudhiraṃ tat pibanti te ||43||
dṛśyānarhe duṣṭacakṣuḥprayoktāraṃ yamānugāḥ |
śūlaṃ netre praviśyaiva daṇḍaṃ dadati tatra vai ||44||
agninā randhitā jīvāḥ pācayanti ca taṃ tu te |
pāṣāṇairbhūtahantṝnvai pātayanti śilopari ||45||
nirāgaso bandhayitā badhyate nigaḍairyamaiḥ |
jñātvā jantucūrṇayitā cūrṇyate lohayantrakaiḥ ||46||
jīvānduḥkhapradātā tu kākole paripīḍyate |
ājīvanaṃ duḥkhadātā mithyābhiśaṃsakaśca yaḥ ||47||
mārayitvā khādayitvā jīvayitvā yamānugāḥ |
kṛntanti saṃchedayanti khādayanti hyamuṃ yamāḥ ||48||
patnyai duḥkhapradātā yaḥ svāmine duḥkhadā ca yā |
āśritānāṃ duḥkhadā ye te patanti tu raurave ||49||
ityevaṃ rakṣakā yatra bhakṣakā luñcajīvinaḥ ||
sarve te nārakāḥ pāṭyā jāyante yamakiṃkaraiḥ ||1.66.50||
ityevaṃ nirayāḥ santi prāṇināṃ niṣkṛtātmakāḥ |
yatra śuddhyanti pāpiṣṭhāstato gacchanti janmane ||51||
yasya yādṛk janma karma vidyate prāk tu saṃcitam |
tasya tathaiva mārgeṇa yamaḥ prāpayate janim ||52||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne catvāriṃśannarakagāmināṃ pāpaphalavarṇananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||

<1.67>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
narakāṇāṃ mahākaṣṭamanubhūya tu nārakāḥ |
svakarmaśeṣabhāgena prāpnuvanti ca vai tanum || 1 ||
daivikīṃ paitṛkīṃ yoniṃ mānuṣīṃ vātha nārakīm |
prāpya dharmasya vacanānmuktirbhavati vā tataḥ || 2 ||
yathā yathā kṛtaṃ karma tāṃ tāṃ yoniṃ vrajennaraḥ |
tattathaiva hi bhuñjāno vicaretsarvayoniṣu || 3 ||
yena karmavipākena yathā nirayabhāgbhavet |
yathā taduttara janma tattanme śṛṇu padmaje || 4 ||
yātanānte vimuktāste hyanekāṃ jīvasantatim |
gatvā mānuṣayonau tu pāpacihnā bhavanti te || 5 ||
tatrānṛtapravāhī tu galatkaṇṭho’rdhajihvakaḥ |
yadvā mūko bhavedeva devādīnāṃ vinindakaḥ || 6 ||
jīvahā tu kṣayī kuṣṭhī śyāvadantastu madyapaḥ |
svarṇahārī kunakhī duścarmā strībhogakṛd balāt || 7 ||
mātsaryādapi jātyandho janmāndho’nyākṣisaṃharan |
phalahartā vānaraḥ syāt kākaścauryānnabhojanāt || 8 ||
anyavaṃśaṃ vinindanvai vaṃśahīno’napatyakaḥ |
dravyahartā bhaved godhā garadaḥ sarpajanmavān || 9 ||
prasahya tu balātkārī jāyate’tra piśācakaḥ |
cātako jalahartā syād dhānyahartā tu mūṣakaḥ ||1.67.10||
jalaprasravaṇabhettā jale matsyo bhavediti |
vañcanākarmakṛtprāṇī hyulūko jāyate muhuḥ ||11||
anyādācchidya bhuṃjānaḥ sārameyo’bhijāyate |
pratiśrutyādadanprāṇī jambūko jāyate vane ||12||
cauryaṃ kṛtvā sadā bhuṃjan viḍvarāhaḥ prajāyate |
pūjyānāṃ tvavamānādvai labhate kācchapī tanum ||13||
sarveṣāṃ tu tiraskartā cāṇḍālo jāyate’tra vai |
syādanyasya ṛṇagrāhī vṛṣo’śvo gardabhaśca vā ||14||
rativighnakaraḥ ṣaṇḍho mārjāraḥ paramāṃsabhuk |
pārakyasya prahartā vai tittiro jāyate vane ||15||
prasahya vaśakartāro nārījanma hyavāpnuyuḥ |
prasahya ratikartāro bhagaliṃgādirogiṇaḥ ||16||
gṛhāvāsādihartāro jāyante’raṇyajantavaḥ |
paśūnāṃ ghātakāścātra jāyante ghātyajantavaḥ ||17||
svāmidravyāpahartāro draridrāḥ saṃbhavantyapi |
vidvannindāprakartāro mūrkhā bhavanti bāliśāḥ ||18||
viśvāsayitvā jantūnāṃ bandhakā ghātakā janāḥ |
pañjarīyapaśupakṣijanmānaḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||19||
manuṣyāṇāṃ tiraskartā vicitto jāyate’tra vai |
śāṭhyakāpaṭyanairghṛṇyapoṣṭā kitavatāṃ vrajet ||1.67.20||
manuṣyahā jāyate’tra pāśadhṛk pāradhiśca vai |
paśuhā ghātakī bhūtvā śatajanmā hyajo bhavet ||21||
matsyādo matsyajanmā syāt sarvādo jhaṣa eva ca |
anyānnavastragehāderhartā vṛkṣomarusthale ||22||
gandhacandanasaṃhartā nāsāhīnaḥ prajāyate |
gurupitṛpūjyanindāśrotā syād badhiro’tra vai ||23||
pādahartā bhavet paṅgurhastaghno vṛkṇa eva ca |
nārīṇāṃ duḥkhakṛtkuṃbhakārasya gardabho bhavet ||24||
patyurduḥkhakarī nārī gardabhī saṃbhavettathā |
karmacāridravyachettā daridro vānaro bhavet ||25||
jantujāṃ nāśako bhittijantvadā godhakī bhavet |
malino makṣikājanma krodhī sarpatvamāpnuyāt ||26||
dveṣī grāmyaśunaḥ pipīlikānāṃ janma cāpnuyāt |
anyāyakāmī vṛṣaṇocchettā syāt ṣaṇḍhagovṛṣaḥ ||27||
dharmānnadravyavasvādehartā syādārtikukkuraḥ |
pārakyānnādibhoktāraḥ kukkuṭīṃ yonimāpnuyuḥ ||28||
kāryahantā tu ghūkaḥ syāt kāryaroddhā śṛgālakaḥ |
pariveṣitapātrāṇāṃ hartā syādvṛkṣavāgulī ||29||
nārīhartā rākṣasaḥ syāt māntrikaḥ syāt piśācakaḥ |
vāsanikastu bhūtaḥ syāt krūradṛṣṭistu śākinī ||1.67.30||
samātsaryā ḍākinī syāt piśācinyabhicārikā |
garbhahantrī gaṇikā syāt kulaṭā patyakāmanā ||31||
parāpatyāsahāpyatrāpatyahīnā bhavatyapi |
ṛtudānāgrāhikā tu ṣaṇḍhā bhavati sarvathā ||32||
parocchedakarī svīyocchedakartrī bhavetpunaḥ |
suptanāśaprakartāro hanyante ghātakīgṛhe ||33||
parasasya praloptāro bhavantyakṣetravṛttayaḥ |
parakarmaviloptāro jāyante’karmayoniṣu ||34
tailahārī tailapāyī pūtivaktrastu sūcakaḥ |
dhānyahāryatiriktāṃgaḥ piśunaḥ pūtināsikaḥ ||35||
brahmahā śvāḥ svaroṣṭaḥ syānmūkaścānte bhavatyapi |
dravyacauraḥ kṛmiḥ kīṭastṛṇādo gurunāśakaḥ ||36||
kṣayarogī śyāvadantaḥ kunakhī svaṇacauryakṛt |
pakvahartā tvanāhārī mūko rāgāpahārakaḥ ||37||
tulakūṭapramākartā vaṭavāgulikā bhavet |
vikreyakūṭasāṃkaryakartā śvāsārtiko bhavet ||38||
anyeṣāṃ prāṇaroddhā vai kṣayarogārtiko bhavet |
krayavikrayakauṭilyakartārṣarogavānbhavet|
ucchiṣṭajalapātā syānmūtrakṛcchrādirogavān |
anyavṛttiharo loke bhikṣukaḥ satiraskṛtaḥ ||1.67.40||
anyonyātyasaho duṣṭaścāṇḍālo vāghgharirbhavet |
chalachadmaprakartā syād dhīvaraḥ śabaro’pi ca ||41||
vastravikrayakāpaṭyatantuvāyo bhavatyapi |
rathyācatuṣkamālinyakartā malaharo’ntyajaḥ ||42||
snānaśuddhiniṣeddhā syād rajako vastraśodhakaḥ |
anyāniṣṭecchukacauro mārjāro jāyate rudan ||43||
kūṭauṣadhapradātā syānnakūlo nirjane vane |
kūṭavastuprakartā syāt kūṭastrīputrako’tra vai ||44||
svarṇarūpyādisāṃkarye kāpaṭyena karoti yaḥ |
varṇasaṃkarajanmā syād galatkuṣṭho bhavettathā ||45||
kaumāryaduṣakāśca syurājīvanaṃ vidhūrakāḥ |
svāminyasatpravaktā syānnāpitaḥ kṣurakarmakṛt ||46||
āyudhānāṃ tu nirmātā jalaukā saṃprajāyate |
paśupakṣigavājādimāṃsādāḥ gṛdhraviḍbhujaḥ ||47||
siṃhā vyāghrā vṛkā dīpā jāyante māṃsabhojinaḥ |
kanyāvikrayakartāro jāyante yonikīṭakāḥ |
rasasāṃkaryakartāro jāyante malakīṭakāḥ ||48||
nirādhārapradogdhāro bhavanti māstikīyūkāḥ |
paṃktibhettodaraṃbharo jāyate cāntrarogavān ||49||
dampatīkleśakartāro bhāṃḍā bhavanti nartakāḥ |
kāmāsaktaviyoktāro vṛndalāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||1.67.50||
kāmasukhaprabhaṃktāro’raṇye śūnyaraṃtimṛgāḥ |
maṇḍukāścaiva jāyante ratimātsaryavannarāḥ ||51||
sādhusādhvīdrohakartā syānmūko badhiro janeḥ ||
poṣyāpoṣaṇakartṝṇāṃ malamūṣakatā bhavet ||52||
dugdhadaprāṇihantṝṇāṃ janma nirjalabhūphaṇam |
vāgbāṇamarmabhettṝṇāṃ kaṃkiṭakṛkalāsajam ||53||
piṣṭacauryaprakartṝṇāṃ janma bhallukarūkṣajam |
mahaccauryaprakartṝṇāṃ janma tvandhasarīsṛpe ||54||
devatīrthagurudrohī dharmāṇāṃ nindakastathā |
kuṭumbakleśakartā syādaraṇye kākadīpakaḥ ||55||
madirāmāṃsasaṃjīvī siṃho’raṇye nṛpo bhavet |
jālatarkaṭapāśāśī bahuśrṛṃgo mṛgo bhavet ||56||
snānālasastu khaḍgākhyamṛgo genḍo bhavediti |
bhallukaḥ syāt piṣṭahartā vāgulī guptabhojinī ||57||
citrapicchā chalakartrī śilakī syāt svatantriṇī |
guptapibā gṛhagodhā gavayo guptabhojanaḥ ||58||
yathā vā vāsanāyogājjāyante citradehinaḥ |
caturaśītikhanyantāścitrakarmakarā muhuḥ ||59||
jāyante tāmasāḥ kīṭā vṛkṣādyā vā tṛṇaukasaḥ |
vṛddhāpamānakartāro jāyante māhiṣā vṛṣāḥ ||1.67.60||
dāmpatyabhaṃgakartāro vidhurā janmajanmasu |
malendriyātilubdhāstu kīṭā malagatāḥ sadā ||61||
guptaghātāstu jhallādāḥ pāśinaḥ śvapacādayaḥ |
indriyahā bhavedindriyeṇa hīnaḥ kṣatiśritaḥ ||62||
ātatāyijanā yānti bhugnadehān sadārtidān |
tāmasāḥ saṃprajāyante yavanā daityarākṣasāḥ ||63||
patyurhantryaḥ prajāyante vidhavā janmajanmasu |
śvaśrūduḥkhapradā nārī gardabhī jāyate kṛśā ||64||
vadhūdveṣṭrī bhavenmārjārikā kuṣṭhādirogiṇī |
sāpatnyadveṣakartrī syācchunī kharjanarogiṇī ||65||
pakṣapātakarī yāyād daridre pāśavīṃ daśām |
kāryahantrī bhaved ghūkī kleṣadā kābarī bhavet ||66||
anaivedyarasāsvādā bhaved gṛdhrā ca garjukī |
śyenā bakī bhavet sā yā gṛhe kāpaṭyavartinī ||67||
dhūrtā kākī bhavet kṛṣṇā śṛgālī nāpitī tathā |
jāṃgulikī bhaved dviṣṭā santāne dveṣacāriṇī ||68||
ṣaṇḍhā syāt liṃgapātātmābhicārādiprayogiṇī |
mantrābhicārakartrī syād bhūtī piśācikā tathā ||69||
bālahā garbhahā bījahantrī tu rākṣasī bhavet |
antardāhakarī duḥkhapradā syād yavanī khasī ||1.67.70||
ityevaṃ bahujanmāno bhavanti nārakā janāḥ |
punaḥ karma punarjanma lakṣayoniṣu jāyate ||71||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārakāṇāṃ punarjanmacihnaparicayādikathananāmā saptaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||67||

<1.68>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi janaṃ śārīracihnakam |
kīdṛgrūpo janaḥ kīdṛkkarmā kīdṛgguṇo bhavet || 1||
saṃkṣepāttatpravakṣyāmi lokavijñāna hetave |
śarīrāṇi samānyeva naranārīdivaukasām || 2 ||
ākṛterbhedabhāvo vai paricāyaka eva ha |
cihnānāṃ bhedabhāvastu karmaṇāṃ paricāyakaḥ || 3 ||
dhanahīnasya tu pādau śūrpākārau śirālakau |
vakrau rukṣau ca saṃśuṣkau pāṇḍunakhaudarāṃgulī || 4 ||
vaṃśasya nāśakau pādāvutkamaṭhau kaṣāyakau |
brahmaghnasya bhavetāṃ tu caraṇau śaṃkusannidhau ||5||
nirdhanasya romakūpe ekaika eva romakaḥ |
nṛpasya śrotriyasyāpi dvau dvau śrīdhīmatāṃ tathā || 6 ||
tryādyairniḥsvā duḥkhabhājo ninditāśca bhavanti hi |
yasya keśāḥ kuṃcitāḥ syuḥ sa pravāse mriyeta vai || 7 ||
yasya jānū tu nirmāṃsau saubhāgyaḥ sa bhavejjanaḥ |
nimnālpajānumān bodhyaḥ sarvadā strīrato janaḥ ||8||
daridro viṣamajānuḥ puṣṭajānurnṛpo bhavet |
mahajjaānurdīrghajīvī vakrajānustu kāmukaḥ || 9 ||
yasya pādau mṛdutalau kamalodarasannibhau |
śliṣṭāṃgulī tāmranakhau supārṣṇī va śirojjhitau ||1.68.10||
uṣṇau kūrmonnatau gūḍhagulphau sa nṛpatirbhavet |
yo naro hyalpaliṃgaḥ syādapatyarahitastu saḥ ||11||
yastu bhavet sthūlaliṃgaḥ sāpatyo’pi dhanojjhitaḥ |
meḍhraṃ vāmanataṃ yasya tasya putrārthahīnatā ||12||
liṃgamadhonataṃ yasya dāridryaṃ tasya sarvadā |
dakṣavakraṃ yasya meḍhraṃ putravānsa matau janaḥ ||13||
sthūlagranthiyute liṃge śirāle bahuputrakaḥ |
koṣagūḍhe prajanane nṛpaḥ syādbahuputrakaḥ ||14||
dīrghakāṣo bhugnakoṣo dhanahīnaḥ sadā bhavet |
durbalatvekavṛṣaṇo viṣamavṛṣaṇaścalaḥ ||15||
samābhyāṃ nṛpatiḥ proktaḥ pralambena śatābdavān |
bhavet siṃhakaṭī rājā niḥsvaḥ kapikaṭirnaraḥ ||16||
sarpodarā daridrāḥ syurdhaninaḥ sthūlapārśvakāḥ |
samakakṣāśca bhogāḍhyā nimnakakṣā dhanojjhitāḥ ||17||
nṛpāśconnatakakṣāḥ syurjihmā viṣamakakṣakāḥ |
aśīghramaithunyalpāyurdīrghāyuḥ śīghramaithunī ||18||
sukhī syādvistīrṇanābhirduḥkhyatinimnanābhikaḥ |
valimadhyagato nābhiḥ śūlapīḍāṃ karoti vai ||19||
medhāvī dakṣiṇāvarto vāmāvarto vaśī naraḥ |
pārśvāyatā cirāyuḥ syādupariṣṭhāddhaneśvaraḥ ||1.68.20||
ekavaliḥ śatāyuḥ syāt śrībhogī dvivalirnaraḥ |
trivaliḥ kṣmeśa ācārya ṛjubhirvalibhiḥ sukhī ||21||
dakṣiṇāvartaromā syācchāsakaḥ sumahān janaḥ |
vāmāvartānyathāvartaromā preṣyaśca duḥkhitaḥ ||22||
anuddhataiścucukaiśca bhavanti subhagā janāḥ |
uddhatairviṣamairdīrghaiḥ pītāgrairnirdhanā narāḥ ||23||
samonnataṃ ca hṛdayamakampaṃ māṃsalaṃ pṛthu |
nṛpāṇāmadhamānāṃ ca khararomaśirālakam ||24||
samavakṣāstu dhanavān pīnavakṣāḥ ramāpatiḥ |
nirdhano viṣamavakṣāḥ śastreṇa mṛtyumāpnuyāt ||25||
viṣamajatruko niḥsvaḥ pīnajatrurdhanādhipaḥ |
nirdhanaścipiṭakaṇṭhaḥ śirāśuṣkagalaḥ sukhī ||26||
śūraḥ syānmahiṣagrīvaḥ śāstrānto mṛgakaṇṭhakaḥ |
kambugrīvaśca nṛpatirlambakaṇṭho’tibhakṣakaḥ ||27||
kakṣāśvatthadalā śreṣṭhā sugandhirmagaromikā ||
anyathā tvarthahīnānāṃ dāridryasya ca kāraṇam ||28||
samāṃsau vipulau śliṣṭau bhugnālpau pīvarau tathā |
vṛttāvājānulambau ca bhujau daivau ca rājakau ||29||
niḥsvānāṃ romaśau hrasvau śreṣṭhau karikaraprabhau |
hastāṃgulaya eva syuḥ svarṇavarṇā dhaneśituḥ ||1.68.30||
tāśca medhāvināṃ sūkṣmā bhṛtyānāṃ cipiṭāḥ smṛtāḥ |
susthūlāṃgulayo niḥsvāḥ kapitulyakarāstathā ||31||
pitṛdravyavināśī syānnimnakaratalo janaḥ |
maṇibandho nigūḍhaḥ syād rājyado dhanado vṛtaḥ ||3||
karaiḥ karatalaiścaiva lākṣābhai raktakomalaiḥ |
guravaḥ syuḥ pītarukṣairnidhanā eva sarvadā ||33||
tuṣatulyanakhāḥ klībā niḥsvāḥ sphuṭitavakrakaiḥ |
kunakhaiśca vivarṇaiśca paratarkakarā matāḥ ||34||
tāmraiśca vartulairdevā madhyonnatanakhairmatāḥ |
sayavāṃguṣṭhako rājā putrī parvaprapūrṇakaḥ ||35||
yugamīnāṃkitakaro bhavetsatraprado naraḥ |
vajracihnaṃ tu dhanināṃ viduṣo matsyapucchakam ||36||
śaṃkhātapatraśibikāgajapadmāni bhūbhrati |
kuṃbhāṃkuśapatākāśca mṛṇālaśca nidhīśvare ||37||
dāmarekhā gavāḍhye vai svastikaśca nṛpeśvare |
cakrāsitomaradhanurdantarekhā nṛpeśvare ||38||
ulūkhalasamā rekhā yājñikasya kare matā |
cakrāṇi bahūni caiva vedīrekhāgnihotriṇi ||39||
vāpīdaivīnadīrekhāstrikoṇo dhārmike kare |
aṃguṣṭhamūlagā rekhāḥ sukhakṛtsutabodhikāḥ ||1.68.40||
kaniṣṭhāmūlataḥ pradeśinīmūlagatā ca yā |
śatāyurbādhikā rekhā chinnā cet taruto bhayam ||41||
niḥsvāśca bahurekhāḥ syurnidhanāścibukaiḥ kṛśaiḥ |
māṃsalaiḥ raktavarṇaiśca hyadharairdhanavānbhavet ||42||
bimbopamaiśca sphuṭitai rūkṣairviṣamakhaṇḍitaiḥ |
oṣṭhairdhanarahitāḥ syurdantāḥ snigdhā ghanā śubhāḥ ||43||
tīkṣṇā dantāḥ samāḥ śreṣṭhā jihvā raktā samā śubhā |
ślakṣṇā dīrghā tu vijñeyā tāluḥ śveto dhanakṣayaḥ ||44||
kṛṣṇā tu paruṣā jihvā raktāgrā rogiṇī matā |
vaktraṃ saumyaṃ samaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ saṃvṛtaṃ nṛpateḥ smṛtam ||45||
viparītaṃ tu duḥkhānāṃ durbhagāṇāmalokakam |
āḍhyānāṃ vartulaṃ vaktraṃ nirdravyāṇāṃ tu dīrghakam ||46||
bhīruvaktraḥ pāpakārī dhūrtānāṃ caturasrakam |
nimnaṃ vaktraṃ tvaputrāṇāṃ kṛpaṇānāṃ ca hrasvakam ||47||
sampūrṇaṃ bhogināṃ kāntaṃ śmaśrusnigdhaṃ śubhaṃ mṛdu |
saṃhataṃ cāsphuṭitāgraṃ raktaśmaśru ca caurakam ||48||
śaṃkukarṇāstu rājāno romakarṇā gatāyuṣaḥ |
bṛhatkarṇā dhaninṛpāḥ kṛpaṇā hrasvakarṇakāḥ ||49||
bhogī vai nimnagaṇḍaḥ syānmantrī sampūrṇagaṇḍakaḥ |
śukanāsaḥ sukhī proktaḥ śukanāso’tijīvanaḥ ||1.68.50||
chinnāgrakūpanāsastu bahunārīvyavāyakaḥ ||
dīrghanāsaḥ saubhagaḥ syāccauraḥ kuñcitanāsikaḥ ||51||
cipiṭanāsaḥ krūraḥ syāttathā bhāgyavihīnakaḥ |
svalpachidrā supuṭā cāvakrā sā nṛpatermatā ||5||
krūre dakṣiṇavakrā syād vāmavakrā hyaniṣṭadā |
vakrāntaiḥ padmapatrābhairlocanaiḥ sukhabhāginaḥ ||53||
mārjāralocanaiḥ pāpmā durātmā madhupiṃgalaiḥ ||
krūrāḥ kekaranetrāśca haritākṣāḥ sakalmaṣāḥ ||54||
jihmaiśca locanaiḥ śūrāḥ senānyo gajalocanāḥ |
gaṃbhīrākṣā īśvarāḥ syurmantriṇaḥ sthūlacakṣuṣaḥ ||55||
nīlotpalākṣā vidvāṃsaḥ saubhagāḥ śyāmacakṣuṣaḥ ||
syurutpāṭanakartāraḥ kṛṣṇatārakacakṣuṣaḥ ||56||
maṇḍalākṣāśca pāpāḥ syurniḥsvā syurdīnalocanāḥ ||
dhanī dīrghasaṃsaktabhrūrdaridrā viṣamabhruvaḥ ||57||
viśālonnatabālendūnnatabhruvaḥ sukhāḍhyakāḥ |
niḥsvo bhavati khaṇḍabhūrdārakabhrūśca nirdhanaḥ ||58
nirdhanā vipulaiḥ śaṃkhairlalāṭairviṣamaistathā |
ardhendusamabhālaistu dhanavanto matā janāḥ ||59||
śuktiviśālairācāryāḥ śirālaiḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ |
unnatābhiḥ śirābhiśca svastikābhirnareśvarāḥ ||1.68.60||
nimnairbhālairvadhārhāśca krūrakarmāratāstathā |
saṃvṛtaiśca lalāṭaiśca kṛpaṇā unnatairnṛpāḥ ||61||
akampaṃ hasitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nimīlitamaghāvaham |
asakṛddhasitaṃ duṣṭaṃ sadarpaṃ ghātakaṃ bhavet ||62||
lalāṭopasṛtāstisro rekhāḥ syuḥ śatavarṣiṇām |
nṛpaḥ sa syāccatasṛbhiḥ paṃcanavatirjīvati ||63|| 
arekhenāyurnavatirvicchinnābhistadardhakam |
keśāntopagatābhiśca hyaśītyāyurnaro bhavet ||64||
paṃcabhiḥ saptabhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paṃcāśat bahubhistathā |
catvāriṃśacca raktābhistriṃśad bhrūlagnagāmibhiḥ ||65||
viṃśatirvāmavakrābhirāyuḥ kṣudrābhiralpakam |
chatrākāraiḥ śirobhistu nṛpo bāṇasamo dhanī ||66||
ghaṭamūrdhā pāparuciḥ piturmṛtyuścipīṭakaḥ |
kṛṣṇākuṃcitasnigdhāgrābhinnāntakeśavān nṛpaḥ ||67||
rājñyāḥ pādau mṛdutalau matsyāṃkuśadhvajāṃcitau |
vajrābjahalacihnau ca nigūḍhagulphakau matau ||68||
aśvatthapatrasadṛśaṃ vipulaṃ guhyamuttamam |
gūḍhaḥ śukaśva śubhado māṃsalaṃ vartulaṃ mukham ||69||
nābhiḥ pradakṣiṇāvartā madhyaṃ trivaliśobhitam |
āraktāvadharau śreṣṭhau māṃsalaṃ vartulaṃ mukham ||1.68.70||
snigdhanīlāśca mṛdavo mūrdhajāḥ kuṃcitāḥ śubhāḥ |
strīṇāṃ pādatale yadvā pāṇidvayatale imāḥ ||71||
vājikuṃjaraśrīvṛkṣayūpeṣuyavatomarāḥ |
dhvajacāmaramālāśca śailakuṇḍalavedikāḥ ||72||
śaṃkhātapatrakamalamatsyasvastikasadrathāḥ |
aṃkuśādyāśca rekhāḥ syurdevyastā rājavallabhāḥ ||73||
haryaṃśāḥ svastikadhanustriśūladhvajamatsyakāḥ |
rekhā yā maṇibandhotthā gatā madhyāṃgulīkare ||74||
ūrdhvarekhā tu sā proktā haste pāde’thavā bhavet |
strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ tathā sā syād rājyāya ca sukhāya ca ||75||
naracihnavatī nārī naraśca strīsvarūpakaḥ |
na maṃgalakṛtau syātāṃ vaiparītyakarāvubhau ||76||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārīdaivīśārīracihnapradarśananāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||68||

<1.69>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi tava cihnāni me priye 
paśya nābhiṃ dakṣiṇāvartāṃ te gāmbhīryaśālinīm || 1 ||
aromāṃ trivalīṃ paśya hṛtstanau romavarjitau |
madhyāṃśaṃ sarvaśaktyāḍhyaṃ paśyāntardṛḍhakuṇḍalam || 2 ||
nābhyadhaḥ paśya rekhāṃ tu svarṇabāṇasya piṃgalām |
vāmasakthni tathā paśya pādukācihnamagrataḥ || 3 ||
vakṣasi stanayormadhye pādarekhāṃ vilokaya |
lalāṭe mukuṭākārāṃ gaṇḍe binduṃ ca lokaya || 4 ||
urasī paśya viṣṇuṃ māṃ rekhārūpacaturbhujam |
vāme bhuje gadācihnaṃ cāvalokaya me priye || 5 ||
hṛdaye vaijayantyāstu rekhāṃ paśya prapauraṭīm |
gajaṃ karatale dakṣe sapadmaṃ paśya cānaghe || 6 ||
dakṣiṇe tu pade paśya śaṃkhacihnaṃ sumaṃgalam |
aṃgulyā mūlake paśya rekhāṃ vimānasadṛśīm || 7 ||
kaniṣṭhāyāḥ paśya mūlādhastvaṃ naukāṃ surekhayā |
tathā śaṃkhagadārekhāḥ paśya makaralekhanam || 8 ||
tathā madhye suśikhararekhāṃ nibhālaya priye |
paśya pārṣṇau matsyarekhāṃ madhye tāmbūlavallikām || 9 ||
paśya vāmāṃguṣṭhamūle yavacihnaṃ surekhayā |
tadadhastu mahāntaṃ vai prāsādaṃ paśya rekhayā ||1.69.10||
chatraṃ paśya tadadhastu yutaṃ taccordhvarekhayā |
kamalarekhāṃ phaṇake dhvajarekhāṃ prapaśya ca ||11||
aṃkuśacihnaṃ kumudaṃ paśya śrīphalamityapi |
sthalīyapadmarekhāṃ ca ghaṭarekhāṃ nibhālaya ||12||
dvitīyāyāścandrarekhāṃ daśacakrāṇi paśya ca |
svarṇarekhāṃ phaṇopari bhāle tāntikalekhanām ||13||
cibuke bindukaṃ paśya stane vāme tu cakrakam |
dakṣe stane hastarekhāṃ kaṇṭhe hāraṃ supiṃgalam ||14||
jaghane tu suvarṇāṃ vai dhanūrekhāṃ prapaśya ca |
svastikaṃ dakṣiṇe hastatale matsyaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā ||15||
dhanurvaṃśīmatsyarekhāḥ paśya kalaśarekhikām |
aṃkuśaṃ maṇḍalaṃ cakraṃ paśya dakṣe kare tale ||16||
paśya prākārarekhāṃ ca tatra toraṇamityapi |
paśya lāṃgalacihnaṃ ca tatraiva phaṇake priye ||17||
gūḍha śukaṃ paśya lakṣmi āraktāvadharau tathā |
haste dakṣe cordhvarekhāṃ paśya vāme tathaiva ca ||18||
pādatalayostūrdhvarekhāḥ prapaśya mama priye |
pāde tu vājinaṃ caiva kuṃjaraṃ śrīmahādrumam ||19||
yūpaṃ bāṇaṃ yavaṃ caiva tomaraṃ paśya rekhayā |
haste ca mālikārekhāṃ paśya dīpaṃ ca cāmaram ||1.69.20||
paśya śailaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ ca vedikāṃ paśya rekhayā |
mukhanetrabhrūlalāṭauṣṭhanāsikākapolakān ||21||
paśya vibhrājamānām̐ste gaurān svarṇamanoharān |
tattaccihnaistathā devyo bhavanti bhagavatpriyāḥ ||22||
bhaktimatyaśca me nāryo lakṣmīrūpā bhavanti vai |
mamopāsanasāmarthyāt karomi kamalālayāḥ ||23||
brahmalokanivāsinyo golokabhūkṛtālayāḥ |
vaikuṇṭhavāsamāpannāḥ śvetadvīpagatāśca yāḥ ||24||
amṛtadhāmasthāyinyo vahnimaṇḍalamadhyagā |
sūryalokanivāsinyaḥ candramaṇḍalasaṃsthitāḥ ||25||
satyalokanivāsinya īśvarasṛṣṭisaṃbhavāḥ |
pitṛsargagatā yāśca ṛṣipatnyastathā ca yāḥ ||26||
devyaścātha manuṣyāṇyo’devyo nāgādisaṃpriyāḥ |
sarvāstu māṃ parābhaktyā samāsādyābhavan śriyaḥ ||27||
tāścāhaṃ naikalokeṣu nārāyaṇasvarūpakaḥ |
ramayāmi mahālakṣmi yathā tvāmatra dhāmani ||28||
mana bhaktyā tu sarvāstā lakṣmyo jāyanta eva hi |
yāśca māṃ na bhajantyanyāḥ tāstu pāpena karmaṇā ||29||
gacchanti vividhākārakhaniṣvatra paratra ca |
yamaloke mahāduḥkhānyanubhūyāpi janmani ||1.69.30||
jāyante nahi śubhadā duḥkhāya saṃbhavanti tāḥ |
yamapuryāstu yā nāryo yātanā anubhūya ca ||31||
pāpaleśājjanmavatyo duḥkhadā eva kīrtitāḥ |
śṛṇu tā api saṃkṣepātprasaṃgātpravadāmi te ||32||
kaniṣṭhikānāmikā vā yasyā na spṛśate mahīm |
aṃguṣṭhaṃ vā gatātītya tarjanī kulaṭā ca sā ||33||
romaśe cātimāṃse ca jaṃghe cātiśirālake |
vāmāvartaṃ nimnamalpaṃ guhyaṃ yasyā hi duḥkhadā ||34||
grīvayā hrasvayā niḥsvā dīrghayā ca kulakṣayaḥ |
pṛthulayā pracaṇḍā ca bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||35||
kekare piṃgale netre śyāme lole tu cāsatī |
smite kūpe gaṇḍayośca sā dhruvaṃ vyabhicāriṇī ||36||
pralambinī lalāṭe tu devaraṃ hanti cāṃganā |
udare śvaśuraṃ hanti patiṃ hanti sphicordvayoḥ ||37||
yā tu romottarauṣṭhī syānna śubhā bhartureva ha|
stanau saromāvaśubhau karṇau ca viṣamau tathā ||38||
karālā viṣamā dantāḥ kleśāya tu bhavanti tāḥ |
cauryāya kṛṣṇamāṃsābhā dīrghā bhartuśca mṛtyave ||39||
kravyādarūpairhastaiśca vṛkakākādisannibhaiḥ |
śirālairviṣamaiḥ śuṣkairvittahīnā bhavanti tāḥ ||1.69.40||
samunnatottarauṣṭhī yā kalahaiḥ rūkṣabhāṣiṇī |
lambakarṇasvarā śmaśrumatī pāde tu kālikā ||41||
netre raktā bhuvi tīvrā svalpabhālā tu ghātinī |
bahurekhā bahuromā bahubhāṣāticañcalā ||42||
bahusaṃgā bahunidrā bahvālasyā bahuvyayā |
sarvathā nirdhanatvaṃ ca dāridryaṃ mantrayatyasau ||43||
tasmāt satkarma kartavyaṃ nāsatkarma kadācana |
susatkarmakṛtātpuṇyāccharīraṃ śubhalakṣaṇam ||44||
prāpyate dhanadhānyārthyagṛhodyānādi cottamam |
kālaḥ pratīkṣate naiva kimanena kṛtaṃ na vā ||45||
mriyate jāyate jantuḥ puṣyate ca punaḥ punaḥ |
maraṇaṃ jananaṃ puṣṭiryā tu mokṣāya nirmitā ||46||
sā vai svenaiva kartavyā yadvā putrakuṭumbibhiḥ |
śubhaṃ jantorbhaved yena tathācaryyaṃ divāniśam ||47||
pṛthvī vāsāya salilaṃ tṛptaye śāntaye marut |
dehaḥ śramāya cānnāya śreyaḥ kasmānna sādhayet ||48||
sarvatrātiśayaścāsti vicāryaiva punaḥ punaḥ |
yathāpekṣe cātiśayo nāstītyapi vicārya ca ||49||
yadṛcchayopapannena nirvāhya svakalevaram |
nātisaṃsaktamanasā lokayātrāṃ tu nirvahan ||1.69.50||
nārāyaṇaṃ bhajennityaṃ yathā tvaṃ kamalekṣaṇe |
tasya nāsti sukhaṃ śreyo mokṣaśca dūramaṇvapi ||51||
sādhusādhvīsvarūpaṃ māṃ bhajet sarvasamarpaṇāt |
dīnātithinirādhārarūpaṃ māṃ sevayenmudā ||52||
vidyārthibālabālāsuvṛddhagurvādirūpataḥ |
vicarāmi kvacid devi tadrūpaṃ māṃ prasevayet ||53||
tatrastho’haṃ paraṃ śreyaḥ kariṣyāmi yathā svayam |
bhaktasya tu sadā śreyaḥ kartuṃ dīkṣāṃ vahāmyaham ||54||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lakṣmīcihnāni pramadāntaracihnāni cetyādikathananāmā ekonasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||69||

<1.70>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi vinā muktiṃ paralokagatiḥ sadā |
kaṣṭā kaṣṭapradā syādvai hyātma svārjitajīvanaḥ || 1 ||
mṛtasya yadi kārye’pi yogyapiṇḍādi nārpayet |
agre gatervilopaḥ syād duḥkhabāhulyamāpatet || 2 ||
tasmātkarmagatiṃ yāsyan mariṣyam̐śca svayaṃ tadā |
jīvanneva svasaukhyārthaṃ kuryātpuṇyamatandritaḥ || 3 ||
naro vā yadi vā nārī śarīrendriyayogataḥ |
sukhaṃ dharmaṃ duḥkhamadharmaṃ kurvanti svabhāvataḥ || 4 ||
sukhārthaṃ dharmamākuryādadharmaṃ tu duḥkhāya vai |
svena naiva kṛtaṃ kiñcit pāścātyaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati || 5 ||
tathāpi snehilo loko janaścāpi tathā vidhaḥ |
snehādhīnaḥ karotyeva pāścātye’pi janaḥ kvacit || 6 ||
yadā jantuḥ śarīrādvai paralokāya yāti vai |
tadā prāṇairvihīnaṃ taccharīraṃ śavasaṃjñitam || 7 ||
aspṛśyaṃ jāyate tūrṇaṃ kṛmiviṭbhasmasaṃjñitam |
mṛtasyotkrāntisamayāt ṣaṭpiṇḍān kramato’rpayet || 8 ||
mṛtasthāne śavo nāma piṇḍastatra pradīyate |
tena bhūmirbhavet tuṣṭā tadadhiṣṭhātṛdevatā || 9 ||
dvāradeśe bhavetpānthastena nāmnā pradīyate |
tena dattena tuṣyanti gṛhavāstvadhidevatāḥ ||1.70.10||
catvare khecaro nāma tannāmnā tu pradīyate |
tena tatropaghātāya bhūtakoṭiḥ palāyate ||11||
viśrāme bhūtasaṃjño’yaṃ tamuddiśya pradīyate |
piśācā rākṣasā yakṣā ye cānye tatra vāsinaḥ ||12||
tasya hotavyadehasya naivāyogyatvakārakāḥ |
citāyāṃ sādhako nāma pretastasmai pradīyate ||13||
ityevaṃ pañcapiṇḍairhi śavasyāhutiyogyatā |
dehadoṣavināśaśca tatognirjvālayeccitām ||14||
saṃmṛjya copalipyātha ulikhyoddhṛtya vedikām |
abhyukṣīya samādhāya vahniṃ tatra vidhānataḥ ||15||
puṣpākṣataiḥ susampūjya devaṃ kravyādasaṃjñakam |
svargaṃ mṛtaṃ nayetyuktvā śarīrāhutimācaret ||16||
ardhadehe tathā dagdhe dadyādājyāhutiṃ tataḥ |
yamāya cāntakāyeti mṛtyave brahmaṇe tathā ||17||
jātavedomukhe deyā hyekā pretamukhe tathā |
ūrdhvaṃ tu jvālayed vahniṃ pūrvabhāge citāṃ punaḥ ||18||
asau svargāya lokāya svāhā jvalati pāvakaḥ |
evamājyāhutiṃ datvā tilamiśrāṃ samantrakām ||19||
tato dāhaḥ prakartavyaḥ putreṇa kila niścitam |
roditavyaṃ tato gāḍhaṃ evaṃ tasya sukhaṃ bhavet ||1.70.20||
dāhasyānantaraṃ tatra kṛtvā saṃcayanakriyām |
pretapiṇḍaṃ pradadyācca dāhārtiśamanaṃ kila ||21||
tataḥ sacailakaṃ snānaṃ putraiḥ kṛtvā tilodakam |
śilāyāṃ nāmagotreṇa dadyācca karatāḍanīm ||22||
viṣṇurviṣṇuriti brūyāt tatastasya gṛhaṃ janāḥ |
dvārasya dakṣiṇe gatvā gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān ||23||
nidhāya varuṇaṃ devamantardhāya svaveśmani |
bhakṣayennimbapatrāṇi ghṛtaṃ prāśyaṃ gṛhaṃ vrajet ||24||
aśrupātaṃ na kurvīta datvā cātha jalāṃjalim |
śleṣmāśru bāndhavairbhuktaṃ preto bhuṃkte yato’vaśaḥ ||25||
dugdhaṃ ca mṛnmaye pātre toyaṃ dadyād dinatrayam |
śmaśānaṃ catvaraṃ gehaṃ paśyan yāmyaiḥ sanīyate ||26||
gartapiṇḍān daśāhāni pradadyācca dine dine |
jalāṃjalayo dātavyāḥ pretamuddiśya nityadā ||27||
putro bhāryā ca vā śiṣyo bhrātā kriyāṃ karotu vai |
pratyahaṃ tu pradattasya piṇḍasyārdhe tu dehadam ||28||
tṛtīyaṃ yamadūtānāṃ caturthenopajīvati |
ahorātraistu navabhiḥ preto niṣpattimāpnuyāt ||29||
jantorniṣpannadehasya daśame tu kṣudhā bhavet |
dehabhūtaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo gṛhopari sa tiṣṭhati ||1.70.30||
tatra sthitvā yamamārge gacchantyatha yamālaye |
duḥkhānyanubhavan paścājjanma prāpsyan praśocati ||31||
aho kiṃcinmayā naiva svāsthye mokṣapradaṃ kṛtam |
na harernāmajapanaṃ na kathāśravaṇaṃ kṛtam ||32||
na mayā kīrtanaṃ gītaṃ smaraṇaṃ na hareḥ kṛtam |
ne kṛtaṃ tvarcanaṃ tasya satāṃ pādābhimardanam ||33||
na stotraṃ na namaskāraḥ śarīreṇa kṛtaṃ nahi |
śarīra tanmadīyaṃ na yanmayā poṣitaṃ bahu ||34||
rakṣitaṃ lālitaṃ samyak sevitaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ |
vṛthaiva tatparityaktaṃ tena kāryaṃ na sādhitam ||35||
indriyaiḥ saha sammīlya deho vyarthaṃ prayāpitaḥ |
samayo mokṣalābhārthaṃ na mayā sārthakīkṛtaḥ ||36||
anukūlābhavannārī patiścāpyabhavat priyaḥ |
putra dāsāścānukulāstathāpyātmā pravañcitaḥ ||37||
dhanaṃ cāsīdvipulaṃ me dānārthaṃ vastujātayaḥ |
kevalena pralobhena mayā mokṣo na cārjitaḥ ||38||
sādhusādhvījanānāṃ tu sevā naiva kṛtā mayā |
duṣkṛtasya phalaṃ bhuṃje kimidānīṃ bhavennanu ||39||
mahatā puṇyayogena mānuṣaṃ janma labhyate |
tanmayā sārthakaṃ naiva kṛtamanyatkṛtaṃ bahu ||1.70.40||
krīḍayā yāpitaṃ bālyaṃ yauvanaṃ kṣapitaṃ ratau |
vārdhakyaṃ cintayā kṣiptaṃ mṛtau kiṃ syādaśaktinā ||41||
śarīraṃ tatkalpavṛkṣakāmadhenumaṇiprabham |
kṣapitaṃ cānyakāryeṣu nātmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ||4||
kiṃkaraiḥ pīḍyate’tyarthaṃ parādhīnaḥ karomi kim |
dānaṃ naiva pradattaṃ vai tapastaptaṃ na vai mayā ||43||
vrataṃ vā pālitaṃ naiva hutaṃ sādhumukhe nahi |
tīrthaṃ naiva kṛtaṃ kiñcid vāpyādi naiva kāritam ||44||
gocaraṃ na kṛtaṃ kvāpi sāhāyyaṃ kaḥ kariṣyati |
kṛtaḥ paropakāro na na kṛtaṃ pāralaukikam ||45||
niyamā nādṛtāḥ samyak idānīṃ kiṃ bhavennanu |
guroḥ pitrostathā sevā naiva kvāpi mayā kṛtā ||46||
nārīdeho mahākaṣṭaḥ parādhīnaḥ sadāśuciḥ |
bhaktyā vā sevayā naiva mayā vai sārthakīkṛtaḥ ||47||
naradeho mahābhāro naikatṛṣṇāvaho’śubhaḥ |
bhajanena ca puṇyena na mayā sārthakīkṛtaḥ ||48||
evaṃ sa yātanāpreto brūte śocati roditi |
pīḍyate tāḍyate dūtaiḥ krandantyapi muhurmuhuḥ ||49||
jāyādhanadharādhāmasukhaṃ smarati duḥkhitaḥ |
bhṛtyamitrasutāputrakuṭumbaṃ saṃpraśocati ||1.70.50||
mārge gantuṃ samartho na dūtairākṛṣyate hyadhaḥ |
karuṇaṃ vilapatyeva re priye he sutādayaḥ ||51||
mocayantu samāgatya māmetadduḥsahārdanāt |
putraḥ pautro bāndhavo vā puṇyaṃ karotu matkṛte ||52||
dhenudānaṃ madarthaṃ vai karotu mama putraka ||
vaitaraṇīṃ tariṣyāmyanyathā me tatra majjanam ||53||
mayā pātheyamalpaṃ tu na nītaṃ puṇyanāmakam |
na taptaṃ na hutaṃ japtaṃ na dattaṃ kuta āvrajet ||54||
uṣṇenārdreṇa śītena mārgeṇa gamyate yadā |
mūrchitastrāsitastatra hṛdi śocati kevalam ||55||
yadi me bāndhavaḥ ko’pi vastrāderdānamarpayet |
tadaitaduḥkhanāśaḥ syānnānyathā bhoga eva ha ||56||
kiṃkarāstu vadantyenaṃ kva te puṇyaṃ hi tādṛśam |
tadā hā daiva samprocya dhairyamālabhate kṣaṇam ||57||
yadi vai mānuṣaṃ dehaṃ prāpnuyāṃ punareva cet |
avaśyaṃ muktidaṃ mārgamāśrayiṣye śapāmyaham ||58||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtaśavasya kriyāpiṇḍadānaśokapretaśokādipradarśananāmā saptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 70 ||

<1.71>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yamapuryāstu duḥkhāni samanubhūya nārakāḥ |
viniḥsṛtāśca narakādvicaranti yathā śṛṇu || 1 ||
te tu pretā yadi janma kimapyāptumaniścitāḥ |
kuṭumbaṃ svaṃ samanviṣya patnyāṃ putre kuṭumbini || 2 ||
bāndhave vā kṛtasthānā nivasanti gṛhe jane |
vicarantyaśarīrāste kṣutpipāsārditā bhṛśam || 3 ||
kvacitkadācidbalato rundhanti mohayanti tān |
duḥkhayanti mūrchayanti pīḍayanti muhurmuhuḥ || 4 ||
kathaṃ tvayā madarthaṃ vai mokṣaṇārthaṃ kṛtaṃ nahi |
tasmād vayaṃ pretabhūtāḥ pīḍayiṣyāma ulbaṇam ||5||
itiroṣeṇa saṃrabdhā pīḍayanti punaḥ punaḥ |
pitṛdvārāṇi rundhanti tanmārgarundhakāstathā || 6 ||
pitṛbhāgām̐śca gṛhṇanti pathikām̐staskarā iva |
svaveśmani malamūlotsargādyaśuddhabhūtale || 7 ||
uṣitvā ca nirīkṣante yaṃ janaṃ syāt sa rogavān |
pīḍayanti jvararūpaistadbhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayanti ca || 8 ||
pibanti cāpi tadraktaṃ sūkṣmaṃ svalpaṃ kvacitkvacit |
cintayanti sadāniṣṭamucchiṣṭādisthalasthitāḥ || 9 ||
pibanti tatra pānīyaṃ bhojanocchiṣṭayojitam |
kuṭumbasyātmajādīnāṃ cintayanti chalaṃ sadā ||1.71.10||
evamaniṣṭamatayaḥ svakān pīḍāṃ prakurvate |
svakulaṃ pīḍayet pretaḥ paraṃ chidreṇa pīḍayet ||11||
jīvan sa snehavānāsīnmṛto duṣṭatvameti hi |
chidraṃ mālinyamāsādya muhuḥ pīḍāṃ karoti saḥ ||12||
sarvakriyāparimṛṣṭaṃ devapūjāvihīnakam |
aśuddhabhojyabhoktāraṃ janaṃ pretaḥ prapīḍayet ||13||
ekasya putranāśaḥ syātputraṃ na labhate’paraḥ |
ekaḥ santatihīnaḥ syātpretadoṣo’sti tatra vai ||14||
santatirgarbhato naśyet samutpanno vinaśyati |
paśudravyavināśaśca virodho bāndhavaiḥ samam ||15||
prakṛtiśca vivarteta suteṣu kalahastathā |
akasmād vyasanaprāptiḥ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||16||
unmattatā hyanidrā ca bhojanāpācano jvaraḥ |
udgārā udaraśūlaṃ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||17||
cauryarucirgṛhakalirdhanadhānyadaridratā |
sampattestu śanairhāsaḥ pīḍeyaṃ pretasaṃbhavā ||18||
bahutpannamapi dravyaṃ viniḥsarati hastataḥ |
subhikṣe kṛṣināśaḥ syād udyoge viparītatā ||19||
hīnakarmābhiyānaṃ syāt caurāgnirājabhirbhayam |
mahārogopapattiśca svadehapīḍanaṃ tathā ||1.71.20||
pūrvaṃ tu sevikā patnī paścācchūnīva jāyate |
gṛhanāśamatirnityaṃ pīḍā sā pretasaṃbhavā ||21||
bhāvanā smṛtihīnā ca kāryaṃ mānasavarjitam |
kalaho’nudinaṃ sveṣu sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||22||
strīṇāṃ garbhavināśaḥ syānna puṣpaṃ dṛśyate tathā |
puṣpaṃ pradṛśyate’thāpi phalaṃ naiva pradṛśyate ||23||
jīvitānāṃ kramānnāśo gṛhe dantakaliḥ sadā |
bhojane kopasamudvegādinā tṛptiśūnyatā ||24||
kalaho ghātakāścaiva putrāḥ śatrorivātmajāḥ |
na prītirna ca vai saukhyaṃ sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||25||
pitrorvākyaṃ na kuruto svapatnīṃ na ca sevate |
patnī patidṛśiṃ nāyāt sā pīḍā pretasaṃbhavā ||26||
akasmānmṛtikartāraḥ pretā bhavanti pīḍakāḥ |
vikarmaṇā bhavet preto vidhihīnakriyastathā ||27||
tatkāle duṣṭasaṃsargād vṛṣotsargādṛte tathā |
duṣṭamṛtyuvaśādvāpi hyadagdhavapuṣastathā ||28||
dāhakriyādilopācca khaṭvādimṛtidoṣataḥ |
kṣuttṛṭdāhamṛterdoṣāt pretatvaṃ jāyate priye ||29||
vāsanāvaśataḥ kvāpi vāṇīceṣṭāvivarjitam |
pretatvaṃ susthira bhāvi pretamuktiṃ samācaret ||1.71.30||
na yo vai manute pretān mṛtaḥ pretatvamāpnuyāt |
pretadoṣaḥ kule yasya sukhaṃ tatra na vidyate ||31||
matiḥ prītiḥ ratirbuddhirlakṣmīḥ pañcavināśanam |
tṛtīye paṃcame puṃsi vaṃśacchedo’bhijāyate ||32||
daridro nirdhanaścaiva pāpakarmā bhave bhave |
pretā evaṃ duḥkhayanti svāneva krūrabhāvataḥ ||33||
kṣutpipāsārditāḥ pretāḥ praviśeyuḥ svaveśmani |
praviṣṭā vāyudehena śayānān svasvavaṃśajān ||34||
svapne putrakalatrādīn darśayanti svarūpakam |
gajo hayo vṛṣo bhūtvā dṛśyante vikṛtānanāḥ ||35||
mārjāro vanitā sarpo dṛśyantevai kṣaṇaṃ muhuḥ |
śayanaṃ viparītaṃ vā svātmānaṃ vā viparyayam ||36||
utthitaḥ saṃvīkṣate vai yaḥ sa pretena pīḍyate |
nigaḍairbadhyate svapne pretakṛt tanna saṃśayaḥ ||37||
annaṃ tu yācate svapne vadhyate bahuśastrakaiḥ |
svayaṃ vā hanti manujaṃ tatsarvaṃ pretadarśitam ||38||
bhuṃjānasya tu pakvānnaṃ gṛhītvā vai palāyate |
svasya vānyasya salilaṃ tṛṣārtastu pibed balāt ||39||
vṛṣabhārohaṇaṃ svapne vṛṣabhaiḥ saha vāṭanam |
utplutya vyomagamanaṃ tīrthe vā kṣudhayā gatim ||1.71.40||
svakalatraṃ svabandhūm̐śca svasutaṃ svapatiṃ gurum ||
vidyamānaṃ mṛtaṃ paśyet tatsarvaṃ pretadarśitam ||41||
yastvapo yācate svapne kṣuttṛṣābhyāṃ pariplutaḥ |
tasya pretasya muktyarthaṃ tīrthe piṇḍānpradāpayet ||42||
nirgacchato gṛhād rātrau svapne putrām̐stathā paśūn |
pitṛbhrātṛkalatrāṇi pretadoṣeṇa paśyati ||43||
tacchāntyarthaṃ gṛhe tīrthe śrīvṛkṣe tarpaṇaṃ caret |
kṛṣṇadhānyāni saṃpūjya pradadyād vedapārage ||44||
sarvavighnāni santyajya muktyupāyaṃ karoti yaḥ |
tasya karmaphalaṃ sādhu pretatṛptiśca śāśvatī ||45||
ātmaiva śreyasā yujyat pretastṛptiṃ vrajecciram |
te tṛptāḥ śubhamicchanti svātmabandhuṣu sarvadā ||46||
anyathā tu durātmānaḥ kleśayanti svavaṃśajān |
darśanādbhāṣaṇād yastu ceṣṭanātpīḍanādapi ||47||
sadgatiṃ na prāpayati pretaśāpaiḥ prapīḍyate |
aputrako’paśuścaiva daridro vyādhitastathā ||48||
vṛttihīnaśca dīnaśca bhavejjanmani janmani |
tasmānmuktiḥ prakartavyā pretānāṃ tarpaṇaiḥ sadā ||49||
te tṛptā vārayanti – svān jāyamānānupadravān |
paścātte muktimāyānti kāle prāpte tu putrataḥ ||1.71.50 ||
sadābandhuṣu yacchanti ṛddhiṃ vṛddhiṃ ca sampadaḥ |
pitṝnuddiśya yaḥ kuryānnārāyaṇabaliṃ śubham ||51||
kṛtena tena vighnāni vinaśyanti na pīḍyate |
bhūtapretapiśācādipīḍābhyo mucyate dhruvam ||52||
nārāyaṇabaliṃ kṛtvā vṛṣotsargādikaṃ kriyāt |
sarvopadravarāhityaṃ sarvasaukhyamavāpnuyāt ||53||
pitṛmātṛsamaṃ loke nāstyanyad daivataṃ param |
prabhuḥ śarīrajanmakṛt pratyakṣadaivataṃ pitā ||54||
hitānāmupadeṣṭā ca guruḥ pratyakṣadaivatam |
tasmāt pitāgururmātā vṛddhāḥ pūjyāḥ patistathā ||55||
śarīraṃ sampado dārāḥ sutā lokāḥ sanātanāḥ |
yasya prasādātprāpyante ko’nyaḥ pūjyatamastataḥ ||56||
puṃnāmno narakād yasmāt pitaraṃ trāyate tu yaḥ |
tasmāt putra iti proktastasmāt pitaraṃ tārayet ||57||
apamṛtyumṛtau syātāṃ pitā mātā ca kasyacit |
dharmaṃ tīrthaṃ vivāhādi śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ kriyāt ||58||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pretānāmaśuddhabhūvāsapretakṛtavividhapīḍāpretakṛtasvapnacihnatannivṛttyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||71||

<1.72>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi pretān tvakālamṛtyujān |
pākhaṇḍakān lobhamṛtān cāsaṃskāramṛtām̐stathā || 1 ||
cāṇḍālādudakātsarpāt śāpād drumācca vaidyutāt |
daṃṣṭriśṛṃgipaśubhyaśca mṛtāḥ pretā bhavanti te || 2 ||
udbandhanamṛtā ye ca viṣaśastrādisaṃhatā |
ātmaghātina evābhicārakarmādisaṃhatāḥ || 3 ||
mahakaṣṭairmṛtā rogairdasyubhirmāritāśca ye |
visūcyagnihatā ye ca bhūkhaṇḍādimṛtāśca ye || 4 ||
asaṃskṛtāḥ pramṛtā ye malinā malamṛtyavaḥ |
piṇḍaluptā vṛṣotsargakriyāhīnā mṛtāśca ye || 5 |||
parvatād bhittipātādvā vyomnyevaṃ gamanānmṛtāḥ |
rajasvalāsthitau vātha maithune śaucage mṛtāḥ || 6 ||
antarikṣe hyantarāle sīmni nirjanake mṛtāḥ |
duṣṭaśalyādinā naṣṭāḥ sūtakādau mṛtāśca ye || 7 ||
tṛṣāyāṃ ye jalānāptāḥ kumṛtyuvaśagāśca ye |
te vai pretāḥ prajāyante tvaṭanti kṣitimaṇḍale || 8 ||
gaupaśugrāsaloptāro jalārāmavināśakāḥ |
devavṛttivineṣṭāro dīnavṛttivibhedakāḥ || 9 ||
dānakarmaviloptāraḥ puṇyakārya prabhañjakāḥ |
bahūnāṃ duḥkhakartāraḥ pretā bhavanti pāpataḥ ||1.72.10||
paradroharatāḥ pāpāḥ pāpamṛtyuvaśaṃgatāḥ |
kṣutpipāsārditā nityaṃ pretatvamupayānti te ||11||
na mātā na pitā pretajanmādau kāraṇaṃ matam ||
pretatvaṃ karmato yāmyasaṃkalpācca bhavatyataḥ ||12||
tatra vai vikṛtākārā lamboṣṭhā vikṛtānanāḥ |
bṛhaccharīradaśanā vakrāsyāścāpi kecana ||13||
sarpāsyāśca biḍālāsyā vividhāsyā bhavanti te |
nāmāpi yādṛśaṃ karma kṛtvā bhavanti nārakāḥ ||14||
tādṛgguṇaṃ bhavatyeva pretasya tu tadā tadā |
yādṛkpāpaṃ vidhāyaiva pretatāṃ yāti mānavaḥ ||15||
tathā tathā kṣudhā tasya pipāsāpi muhurbhavet |
bhojanaṃ vā jalaṃ vāpi śuddhaṃ naivāpyate kvacit ||16||
śuddhe tu bhojane kvāpi jale vā nāstyadhikṛtiḥ |
śuddha tvannaṃ vasubhiśca śuddhaṃ jalaṃ tu vāruṇaiḥ ||17|||
