sarvadā rakṣitaṃ tatra pretānāṃ bhāga eva na |
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣaiśca recakaiḥ samalaiḥ saha ||18||
paryuṣitaistathocchiṣṭaiḥ pretānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhavet |
śaucahīnaṃ malinaṃ yat pretā bhuṃjanti tatsadā ||19||
yasya gṛhe na vai śuddhirna vā devārpaṇaṃ bhavet |
madyamāṃsamaye duṣṭe pretā bhuṃjanti tadgahe ||1.72.20||
lobhakrodhamadālasyanidrāśokabhayāni ca |
māyākalahakāpaṭyaṃ mālinyaṃ snānahīnatā ||21||
dhātvādimalaśuddhirna rajovīryāktamambaram |
lālāliṭṭamayī bhittirnālikā mūtrasaṃbhṛtā ||22||
yatra yatra gṛhe santi pretā bhuṃjanti tatra vai |
nityaṃ liṃgabhagābhyāṃ ca kṣarat tatpretabhojanam ||23||
mṛtyurnityaṃ varaṃ jantoḥ pretatvaṃ mā bhavet kvacit |
patitānnena bhuktena jaṭharasthena yo mṛtaḥ ||24||
pāpamṛtyuvaśād yo vai sa preto jāyate naraḥ |
devadravyaṃ parasvādi haretpretaḥ sa jāyate ||25||
gurudravyaṃ paranyāsaṃ haret pretaḥ sa jāyate |
viśvāsaghātaḥ kūṭaśca kanyā vikrayakṛjjanaḥ ||26||
bhrātṛdhṛk janahā goghnaḥ paśughnaḥ pāradārikaḥ |
hemahartā bhuvo hartānṛtaḥ pretaḥ sa jāyate ||27||
mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ bhāryāṃ snuṣāṃ duhitaraṃ sutam |
pitaraṃ yo vā tyajati sa preto jāyate naraḥ ||28||
śiṣṭācāravihīnā ye pitrorbhaktivihīnakāḥ |
madyamāṃsaratā ye ca paśughātādikarmiṇaḥ ||29||
paradrohaprakartāro mahātrāsapradāśca ye |
ye chidrānveṣiṇo nityaṃ parakalpāntakārakāḥ ||1.72.30||
bahuvyavāyasaṃsaktā hārdamāṃsādibhakṣakāḥ |
krūrā vyasanino duṣṭā niṣiddhācaraṇe ratāḥ ||31||
cānye ye tādṛśāsteṣāṃ jāyate hyāyuṣaḥ kṣayaḥ |
svalpāyuṣaṃ kuśarīraṃ hitvā pretā bhavanti te ||3||
tādṛśena śarīreṇa śreyaḥ svasya prasādhayet |
puṇyena karmaṇā svargaṃ sādhayenmokṣameva vā ||33||
prāktanaiḥ karmapākaistu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu vindati |
tadatra janmani saukhyapradaṃ dharmaṃ samācaret ||34||
naro vā yadi vā nārī svārthaṃ kṛtvāpi bhūtale |
parārthaṃ sādhayennityaṃ śreyo mokṣakaraṃ param ||35||
anyattu vismaret kāmaṃ mokṣaṃ tu naiva vismaret |
anyattu vismaretkāryaṃ dharmaṃ tu naiva vismaret ||36||
anyattu vismared bhogyaṃ ātmasaukhyaṃ na vismaret |
kṛtrimaṃ vismared yogaṃ hariṃ hṛtsthaṃ na vismaret ||37||
prabhuṃ vihāya sukhadaṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhajate tu yaḥ |
duḥkhaṃ syāttu phalaṃ tasya nānyat śreyaḥ sa vindati ||38||
nārakāstrividhāstasmāt vijñeyāḥ kamalekṣaṇe |
eke yamapurasthāścāpare tu pretarūpiṇaḥ ||39||
anye tu nārakāḥ sarve gṛhe gṛhe’tiduḥkhinaḥ |
yeṣāṃ gṛhe na vai saukhyaṃ bhojyabhojanavaibhavāt ||1.72.40||
nārīputradhanadhānyāt te’tra pratyakṣanārakāḥ |
yeṣāṃ kuṭumbaṃ bahulaṃ poṣaṇe tu daridratā ||41||
vastrānnāni na pūryante te’tra pratyakṣanārakāḥ |
ekādhikastrīpatiryaḥ sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ||42||
vyabhicāro gṛhe yasya tadvai pratyakṣanārakam |
paradāragaṇikādirataḥ pratyakṣanārakaḥ ||43||
śvavat svanāryā gaṇitaḥ so’tra pratyakṣanārakī |
patnī śunīva yā yatra sāpi pratyakṣanārakā ||44||
yeṣāṃ hūm̐ tūm̐ kṛto dveṣaḥ kleśo gṛhajaneṣu vai |
na nidrā na sukhaṃ prema te vai pratyakṣanārakāḥ ||45||
svajanaścauryakṛt yatra svajano yatra ghātakī |
svajano vaṃcako yatra tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ||46||
ājñākarā na putrādyāḥ premadā vanitā nahi |
kuṭumba mānadaṃ nāsti tadvai pratyakṣanārakam ||47||
bhojanaṃ sarvadā rūkṣaṃ gālīdānādipūrvakam |
darśanaṃ dveṣanetreṇa so’tra pratyakṣanārakī ||48||
sphāṭitāni tu vastrāṇi gṛhaṃ rathyā ca catvaram |
satkāre tu tiraskāraḥ sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ||49||
parādhīnā daśā nityaṃ sevakāḥ kṣepakāstathā |
svajanaḥ śvajanavacca sa tu pratyakṣanārakī ||1.72.50||
ādhivyādhisamupādhikleśagṛhaṃ tu yadgṛham |
chidraraudradhūrtaśāṭhyāśrayaṃ pratyakṣanārakam ||51||
patnī kāmapradā naiva sarvathā pratipakṣiṇī |
patiḥ ratiprado naiva tāḍakaḥ so’tra nārakaḥ ||52||
janmakṣatā janmarogā janmaduḥkhāḥ pratāpinaḥ |
kleśāḍhyā janmata eva te vai pratyakṣanārakāḥ ||53||
narakaṃ tu śarīraṃ vai tatra vāsāttu nārakī |
narakaḥ khalu saṃsārastatra vāsāttu nārakī ||54||
bhaktyā śreyaḥprakartā tu narakānmucyate khalu |
yāvannaiva pramucyante tāvat sarve tu nārakāḥ ||55||
narakasya malānāṃ ca lālānāṃ dhātuyoginām |
dvārāṇyālambya ramate so’tra sākṣāddhi nārakī ||56||
narakebhyaḥ samutpanno narake sajjate punaḥ |
puṣṭau narakarūpo’yaṃ ko’nyastasmāddhi nārakī ||57||
avamānaṃ mahāduḥkhaṃ bandhanaṃ tu tato’dhikam |
parādhīnaṃ mahātrāsastadvānatraiva nārakī ||58||
tṛṣṇākhyaṃ narakaṃ yasya lagnaṃ sa nārakī mataḥ |
evaṃ tṛtīyanarakaṃ sarvasyātra gṛhe gṛhe ||59||
aviśuddhiḥ kṣayaścaivātiśayaśca tridoṣakam |
yasya yasyābhavat śliṣṭaṃ sa vai nārakavad bhavet ||1.72.60||
ete pretāstu jīvanto mṛtāḥ pretā yamālaye |
adṛśyā vāyurūpāśca pretāstrayaḥ paretakāḥ ||61||
sarve vai duḥkhabhoktāraḥ sarve ca duḥkhadāstathā |
sarve bhaktivihīnāśca ko bhedo’tra paretake ||62||
yāmyāścaiva ca vāyavyā mānavīyāśca te trayaḥ |
yadi śreyo na kurvanti tarhi pretāḥ samāstrayaḥ ||63||
tasmānmānuṣadehena kartavyaṃ mokṣakārakam ||
tena muktiṃ pragantāraḥ pretatvaṃ naiva yānti hi ||64||
nārī tu ḍākinī yasya patirvā bhūtabhītidaḥ |
putrā rākṣasahantāraḥ pretastasmātpalāyate ||65||
yonistu kaṇḍanī yasyāḥ kledinī mūtravīryakaiḥ |
kardamābhaṃ śarīraṃ ca tasyā bhoktā tu nārakī ||66||
śvapacā grāmabāhyasthā aśuddhā doṣapeṭakāḥ |
doghe doṣastu ko deyaḥ pretastatra karoti kim ||67
pretaṃ preto yathā naiva trāsayenna ca pīḍayet |
tathā pretasamaṃ duṣṭaṃ pīḍayitvā labheta kim ||68||
tādṛśaṃ tu kuṭumbaṃ vai tyaktvā pretāḥ prayānti vai |
tīrthe’raṇye’thavānyatra vasanti nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||69||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne keṣāṃ pretatvaṃ pretānāṃ vāso bhojanādi pretāstrividhetyādivarṇananāmā dvāsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||72||

<1.73>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sarveṣāṃ sarvayonyādau sukhaṃ nyūnādhikaṃ kṛtam |
manuṣyayonau dharmātmā sukhī bhavati sarvathā || 1 ||
puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ vidhijaṃ ca niṣedhajam |
āgarbhāt pañcavarṣāṇi na vai pāpena lipyate || 2 ||
pañcavarṣottaraṃ dehī tvardhapāpena lipyate |
dvādaśābdaparo dehī sarvapāpaiḥ pralipyate || 3 ||
yathāvasthaṃ yathāpāpapralepastatpramāpataḥ |
mṛtasya sūtakaṃ cātrādhikaṃ nyūnaṃ ca gamyate || 4 ||
yāvanmāse garbhapātastāvaddināni sūtakam |
tasya kiñcidapi karma kartavyaṃ naiva vidyate ||5||
janmata ācūḍānmṛtyau bālaṃ garte viniḥkṣipet |
dugdhaṃ deyaṃ yathāśakti bālānāṃ tuṣṭi hetave || 6 ||
ācūḍātpañcavarṣe tu mṛtau dehaṃ dahettataḥ |
kṣīra bhojyaṃ pradātavyaṃ bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ yataḥ || 7 ||
pūrṇapaṃcamavarṣasya mṛtau karmāṇi sarvathā |
aurdhvadaihikāni yathāvidhi kāryāṇi sarvathā || 8 ||
kumārāṇāṃ ca bālānāṃ bhojanaṃ vastraveṣṭanam |
mahādānavihīnaṃ tu kumāre kṛtyamācaret || 9 ||
bāle vā taruṇe vṛddhe ghaṭo bhavati dehinām |
garne nikṣepaṇaṃ bālamāvarṣadvayameva ha ||1.73.10||
tataḥ paraṃ vā sarvasya dehadāho vidhīyate |
śiśurādantajananād bālaḥ syād yāvadāśikham ||11||
tataḥ paraṃ kumāraśca syādāmauñcīprabandhanam |
pañcavarṣādhike mṛtyau vṛṣotsargavidhiṃ vinā ||12||
tathā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā hyekādaśe’hani |
śrāddhāni ṣoḍaśa kuryādudakubhaṃ ca dāpayet ||13||
dīpānnajalavastrādisvarṇadānādi bhojanam |
kāraṇīyaṃ yathāyogyaṃ pretatvavinivṛttaye ||14||
putramukhaṃ pitā dṛṣṭvā pituḥ ṛṇātpramucyate |
ata aurasaputrastu kuryācchāddhaṃ tu pārvaṇam ||15||
pautraṃ dṛṣṭvā ṛṇatrayānmucyate svargamāpnuyāt |
anaurasāḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ putrā navavidhā matāḥ ||16||
ekoddiṣṭaṃ navabhistaiḥ kartavyaṃ śrāddhameva hi |
aurasena prakartavyaṃ sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ pituḥ ||17||
saṃvatsare tu sampūrṇe kuryāt piṇḍapraveśanam |
varṣānte ca kṛte piṇḍamelane yāti sadgatim ||18||
evaṃ kṛte tata eva pretaḥ pitṛgaṇo bhavet |
bhikṣurbhikṣāṃ na gṛhṇīyād yāvanna syātsapiṇḍanam ||19||
svagotreṣvaśucistāvad yāvat piṇḍaṃ na melayet |
ānantyātkuladharmāṇāṃ puṃsāṃ caivāyuṣaḥ kṣayāt ||1.73.20||
asthiratvāccharīrasya dvādaśāhe sapiṇḍayet |
tripakṣe vā ṣaṇmāse vā vatsare yā sapiṇḍayet ||21||
putrābhāve priyā kuryāt patnyabhāve sahodaraḥ |
bhrātā vā bhrātṛputro vā sapiṇḍaḥ śiṣya eva vā ||22||
sapiṇḍanakriyāṃ kṛtvā kuryādabhyudayaṃ tataḥ |
sarveṣāṃ putrahīnānāṃ putrī kuryāt sapiṇḍanam ||23||
ṛtvijaḥ kārayedvāpi purohitamathāpi vā|
kṛtacūḍaiḥ sutaiścāpi pitṛśrāddhaṃ ca kārayet ||24||
tena vai pitarastṛptāḥ pretatṛptistathā bhavet |
pretasya sukhalābhāya sarvaṃ putreṇa kāryate ||25||
tārayennarakātputro yadi mokṣo na vidyate |
aputrasya gatirnāsti svargaṃ naiva ca naiva ca ||26||
dāhaḥ putreṇa kartavyo hyagnidātā ca pautrakaḥ |
tilairdarbhaiśca bhūmyāṃ vaikuṇṭhe tatra matirbhavet ||27||
pañcaratnāni vaktre ca tena jīvaḥ prarohati |
pralepyā gomayairbhūmistilāndarbhāṃśca nikṣipet ||28||
tasyāmevāturo nyastaḥ sarvaṃ dahati duṣkṛtam |
darbhatūlī nayetsvargamāturaṃ tu na saṃśayaḥ ||29||
sarvatra vasudhā puṇyā liptā nirlaṃpajā hyapi |
yātudhānāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasāḥ krūrakarmagāḥ ||1.73.3 0 ||
alipte hyāturaṃ muktaṃ viśantyete viyonayaḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca śrīrhutāśana eva ca ||3 1 ||
maṇḍale copatiṣṭhanti tasmātkurvīta maṇḍalam |
anyathā mriyate yaḥ saṃkrīḍate vāyunā sa tu ||32||
mama dehasamutpannāstilāḥ lakṣmi pavitrakāḥ |
asurā dānavā daityā vidravanti tilaiḥ sthitaiḥ ||33||
darbhā romasamutpannāstilāḥ svedādato nyaset |
darbhamūle sthito brahmā darbhamadhye tu keśavaḥ ||34||
darbhāgre śaṃkaraścāste trayo devāḥ kuśe sthitāḥ |
viṣṇurekādaśī gaṃgā tulasī vipradhenavaḥ ||35||
asāre durgasaṃsāre ṣaṭpadī muktidāyinī |
nivārayanti caitāni durgatiṃ prāptamāturam ||36||
viṣṇudehasamutpanno yato vai lavaṇo rasaḥ |
prāṇayāne tu lavaṇaṃ deyaṃ vai svargamārgadam ||37||
dāna vai tatra dātavyaṃ tena puṇyena rakṣyate |
tilām̐śca gāṃ kṣitiṃ hema kārpāsaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā |||38||
saptadhānyaṃ tathā lohaṃ hyekaikaṃ pāvayettu tama |
hemadānātsukhaṃ svargyaṃ bhūmidānānnṛpo bhavet ||39||
saptadhānyaistu dhānyāptistṛptāśca yamakiṃkarāḥ |
lohadānena yāmyāstu nāgacchanti mṛtagṛhe ||1.73.40||
kuṭhāro muśalaṃ daṇḍaḥ khaḍgaśca cchurikā tathā |
pāśaḥ kaśā mudgaraṃ ca yamahastāyudhāni vai ||41 ||
kuriṇāḥ sārvasūtrāpāḥ śūṇḍā markāstvanurvarāḥ |
śabalāḥ śyāmadūtāśca prīṇitā lohadānataḥ |||42||
uddharettu lohadānaṃ hyātmānaṃ pāpasaṃcayāt |
vaitaraṇīṃ tārayedvā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ nayeddhi gauḥ |||43||
gavāṃ sevāṃ mahādevo goloko’pyakaronmuhuḥ |
śrauharistu gavāṃ sevāṃ sarvadā prakaroti vai ||44||
gāvaḥ sarvavidhā lakṣmīḥ goṣu nityaṃ vasāmyaham |
hemadānātsūryalokaṃ candrasyāgneśca vaibhavam ||45||
dattaṃ tu lavaṇaṃ svargadvāramudghāṭayettathā |
tiladānaṃ tu martyasya mahāpātakanāśanam ||46 ||
tadanyāni ca dānāni vastūpakaraṇāni ca |
dātavyāni paretasya sukhamokṣaprapattaye ||47||
bhūmisthaṃ pitaraṃ dṛṣṭvā hyardhonmīlitalocanam |
svasthānāccalite śvāse dānamāturamucyate ||48||
tasmin kāle suto yastu sarvadānāni dāpayet |
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate ||49||
vāsudeva parabrahma svāmin śrīrāma gopate |
ityevaṃ bhajanaṃ kāryaṃ prāṇaprayāṇasaṃgatau ||1.73.50||
śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama śrīkṛṣṇa tvaṃ gatirmama |
oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāyeti vā japet ||5 1||
dadyādāturasanyāsaṃ mantraṃ śrīharirityapi |
śrīkṛṣṇa ityapi mantraṃ lakṣmīnārāyaṇetyapi ||||52||
śrīmannārāyaṇetyeva svāminnārāyaṇetyapi |
rāmakṛṣṇa harikṛṣṇa rādhākṛṣṇa omityapi |||53||
nṛsiṃha dattātreya śrīśaṃbho viṣṇo japetyapi |
jaya govinda gopāla jaya mādhava ityapi ||54||
viṣṇurmātā pitā viṣṇurviṣṇuḥ svajanabāndhavāḥ |
jalaṃ viṣṇuḥ sthalaṃ viṣṇurviṣṇurbhūrvaiṣṇavaḥ kuśaḥ ||55||
viṣṇurviprastilā gāvo hema dhānyaṃ tu vaiṣṇavam |
viṣṇurdātā gṛhītā ca netā prāpayitāpi saḥ |||56|||
tameva pūjayennityamantakāle tu kīrtayet |
na tasyāsadgatiḥ kvāpi pretabhāvo’pi naiva ca ||57||
yena santastvantakāle dṛṣṭā natāśca sevitāḥ |
prasāditāḥ sa vai mokṣaṃ yāti drāk nātra saṃśayaḥ |||58|||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtasya yathāyogyasūtakasapiṇḍīkaraṇāditilādidānāturamantrapradānādipradarśananāmā trisaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||73||

<1.74>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
antakāle gavāṃ dānaṃ svargavāsaphalaṃ khalu |
aśvārūḍhāśca te yānti dadate ye hyupānahau || 1 ||
pretastu chatradānena chāyayā vicaretsukham |
evaṃ tathānnadānena kṣudhāhīnaścaretsukham || 2 ||
tadvadvai dīpadānena prakāśe yāti saukhyataḥ |
prāṅmukhodaṅmukho dīpo devāgāre kṛto bhavet || 3 ||
āsanaṃ bhājanaṃ dadyāt paralokahitāvaham |
kamaṇḍalujalaṃ dadyāt tṛṣitaḥ pibatīti vāḥ || 4 ||
ekādaśāhe dātavyaṃ kusumaṃ cāṃgulīyakam |
bhājanaṃ cānnadānaṃ ca preto yātyuttamāṃ gatim || 5 ||
kuṃbhadānaṃ vastradānaṃ gajāśvarathadānakam |
mahiṣīdānamityevaṃ dātavyaṃ mṛtanāmataḥ || 6 ||
śayyādānaṃ savastraṃ cānyāni vai śaktitastathā |
kāryāṇi pretasaṃtṛptisukhaśāntyupalabdhaye || 7 ||
śarīrād vāyumiśraḥ sa ātmā yadā prayāti hi |
kaṭyūrdhvaromacchidrebhya indriyagolakāttathā || 8 ||
prāṇaḥ puṇyakṛto yātyanyasyādhobhāgataḥ saret |
daśendriyacaturantaḥkaraṇapaṃcamātrakam || 9 ||
sūkṣmaṃ dehaṃ puṇyapāpe gṛhītvā yāti yatra ca |
tatra karmānusāreṇa navaṃ dehaṃ gṛhaṃ matam || 1.74.1 0||
ekaviṃśatilakṣāṇi jarāyujāni tāvatā |
svedajā udbhijjāścaiva aṇḍajāścāpi tāvatā || 11 ||
ityevaṃ caturaśītilakṣāṇi yonayo matāḥ |
tatra tatra gataḥ preto punarduḥkhī punastathā || 12||
punargarbhe nivasati janirmṛtiḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
hariṃ cābhajamānasya garbhe vāsaḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 1 3||
strīṣu puruṣabījena garbhā jāyanta ityataḥ |
ṛtukāle tu nārīṇāṃ tyajed rātricatuṣṭayam || 14||
saptarātrimadhyagato garbhastu malino bhavet |
pūrvasaptakamutsṛjya tato yugmeṣu saṃviśet || 15||
ṣoḍaśartuniśāḥ strīṇāṃ garbhadhāraṇakārikāḥ |
caturdaśyāstu yā rātrirgarbhastiṣṭhati tatra cet || 16||
guṇabhāgyanidhistatra putro jāyeta dhārmikaḥ |
yugmāsu putrā jāyante striyāstvekāsu rātriṣu || 17||
pañcame’hani nārīṇāṃ gaulmamādhuryabhojanam |
kaṭukāraṃ ca tīkṣṇaṃ ca sājyaṃ yuvatībhojanam || 18||
nāryā tvevātapo varjyaḥ śītalaṃ kevalaṃ caret |
tāmbūlagandhaśrīkhaṇḍaiḥ samaṃ saṃgaḥ śubhe’hani || 19||
niṣekasamaye śukraśoṇitamiśraṇe yathā |
naranārīpracitte tu bhāvanā tadyutaḥ sutaḥ ||1.74.20 ||
caitanyaṃ bījarūpe tu śukre nityaṃ vyavasthitam |
kāma cittaṃ ca śukraṃ ca yadā hyekatvamāpnuyuḥ ||21||
tadā dravamavāpnoti yoṣāgarbhāśaye naraḥ |
raktādhikye bhavennārī śukrādhikye bhavennaraḥ ||22||
śukraśoṇitayoḥ sāmye garbhaḥ ṣaṇḍhatvamāpnuyāt |
ahorātreṇa kalalaṃ budbudṃ pañcabhirdinaiḥ ||23||
daśame’hani karkandhurviṃśāhe ghanamāṃsatā |
tathā māse tu sampūrṇe pañcatattvāni dhārayet ||24||
māsadvaye tvacāmedau majjāsthīni tribhistathā |
caturthe tu gulphakeśāḥ pañcame karṇanāsike |||25||
saptame kaṇṭhaguhyādi hyaṣṭame’ṅgaprapūrṇatā |
navame bahirjigamiṣā daśame tu prasūyate ||26||
pṛthivyāstvagasthināḍīromamāṃsetipañcakam |
apāṃ lālāmūtraśukramajāraktetipaṃcakam |||27||
vahneḥ kāntikṣudhānidrātṛṣṇālasyetipañcakam |
vāyoḥśvāsagatirodhākuṃcaprasārapañcakam |||28|||
rāgadveṣabhayalajjāmohā vā pañca vāyujāḥ |
vyomno ghoṣāśrayacchidragāmbhīryaśravaṇā guṇāḥ ||29||
iḍā piṃgalā suṣumṇā gāndhārī gajajihvikā |
pūṣā yaśā hyalambuṣā kuhūḥ śaṃkhinī nāḍikāḥ ||1.74.30||
prāṇo’pānaḥ samānaścodāno vyānaśca vāyavaḥ |
nāgaḥ kūrmaḥ kṛkalaśca devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ ||3 1||
hṛdi prāṇo gude’pānaḥ samāno nābhimaṇḍale |
udānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe syād vyānaḥ sarvaśarīragaḥ ||32||
nāgasya jṛṃbhaṇaṃ kūrmavāyo saṃkocanaṃ matam |
śūlaṃ kṛkalajaṃ devadattasyodgāraprabhṛti ||33||
dhanaṃjayo vikāsāya mṛte’pi tridivāsthitiḥ |
karṇākṣināsikānanagudaguhyāni vai nava ||34||
nābhirdaśamī brahmarandhramekādaśakaṃ smṛtam |
strīguhye garbhagarto dvādaśaṃ stanau caturdaśa ||35||
romakoṭistathā tisro hyardhakoṭisamanvitā |
dvātriṃśaddaśanāḥ proktā nakhā viṃśatireva ca |||36||
trilakṣakeśā mūrdhanyā mukhasthāśceti vai sthitiḥ |
trayastu mātṛto romalohitamāṃsasaṃjñakāḥ ||37||
pitṛtaśca snāyvasthimajjānaśca koṣaṣaḍvidham |
māṃsaṃ palasahasraikaṃ raktaṃ palaśataṃ tathā ||38||
palāni daśa medaśca majjā palaṃ daśa dvayam |
raktaṃ palatrayaṃ proktaṃ śukraṃ dvikuḍavaṃ tathā ||39||
śoṇitaṃ kuḍavaṃ śleṣmā ṣaṭ viṇmūtraṃ tathārdhakam |
mano buddhirahaṃ cittametatkaraṇamāntaram ||1.74.40||
tatsarvaṃ dehasaṃbhūto garbhaḥ prasūtivāyunā |
niṣkāsito bahiryāti mūrchito janma caiti hi ||41||
brahmāṇḍasyākṛtiḥ sarvā śarīre samavasthitā |
satyalokaṃ śirorandhraṃ tapolokaṃ lalāṭakam ||42||
janalokaṃ mukhaṃ proktaṃ mahaḥ kaṇṭhamudāhṛtam |
hṛdyaṃ tu svaraṃ vidyādbhuvarlokamudaryakam |||42||
bhūlokaṃ nābhyadhobhāgo hyatalaṃ kaṭisaṃsthitiḥ |
vitalaṃ guhyamākhyātaṃ sutalaṃ sakthimūlayoḥ ||44||
ūrū talātalaṃ mahātalaṃ jānudvayaṃ tathā |
rasātalaṃ mate jaṃghe pādau pātālamucyate ||45||
kṣārodastvatra tu mūtre dugdhe kṣīrodasāgaraḥ |
surodadhiḥ śleṣmasaṃstho majjāyāṃ ghṛtasāgaraḥ ||46||
rasodadhirmiṣṭarase śoṇite dadhisāgaraḥ |
svādūdakaḥ kukṣibhāge garbhodaḥ śukrasaṃsthitaḥ ||47||
netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca oṣṭhe tu maṃgalaḥ smṛtaḥ |
budhastu hṛdye bodhyo gururjñāne vyavasthitaḥ ||48||
śukre śukraḥ śanirnābhau mukhe rāhurvyavasthitaḥ |
keturguhye sthitaśceti piṇḍaṃ brahmāṇḍamīritam ||49||
āyurvidyā ca vittaṃ ca yaśo nidhanameva ca |
pañcaivaitāni sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ ||1.74.50||
adhomukhaṃ cordhvapādaṃ garbhādāyāti vai bahiḥ |
rakṣyamāṇo janmakartryā rakṣam̐ścānyānnijāśritān ||51 ||
putraiḥ saṃrakṣitaḥ paścānmṛtaḥ punaḥ sa eva hi |
bhaktyā hariṃ bhajennityamatandritamanukṣaṇam ||52||
tadā muktirbhavedeva svargaṃ sarvasukhāspadam |
yanna duḥkhena sambhinnaṃ na ca grastamanantaram ||53 ||
abhilāṣopanītaṃ ca tatsukhaṃ svaḥpadāspadam |
so’śnute sarvakāmāṃśca saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā ||54||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dānaphalaniṣekasamayagarbhanirmāṇaśārīrakoṣabrahmāṇḍaikyatādikathananāmā catuḥsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||74||

<1.75>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ṣaḍaśītisahasrāṇi yojanānāṃ pramāṇataḥ |
mārgo yamapurasyeti sarvaiḥ pātheyamiṣyate || 1 ||
yamagrāme’pi bhojyaṃ tairiṣyate vaṃśajaiḥ kṛtam |
vṛkṣāstu ropitā yena taḍāgādijalāśayāḥ || 2 ||
kṛtā yena hi mārge tatsukhaṃ yānti yamādhvani |
hime tuṣāraśītābhyāṃ pīḍyate na yamālaye || 3 ||
tapyamānaḥ sukhaṃ yāti hīndhanāni dadāti yaḥ |
yajñotsavādikartāro bhavanti tatra modinaḥ || 4 ||
tṛptā vibhūṣitāścaiva gandhapuṣpasamanvitāḥ |
bhūmidāne sukhaṃ yānti sarvakāmaiśca pūritāḥ || 5 ||
suvarṇabhūmimuktādivastrābharaṇagodhanam |
tena sarvamidaṃ dattaṃ yena dattā vasundharā || 6 ||
vyaṃjanāni vicitrāṇi bhakṣyabhojyāni yāni ca |
dīyante vidhinā putraiḥ pitre tadupatiṣṭhati || 7 ||
apakve mṛnmaye pātre dugdhaṃ dadyād dinatrayam |
ākāśasthaḥ pibed dugdhaṃ preto vāyuvapurdharaḥ || 8 ||
caturthe saṃcayaṃ kṛtvā gaṃgāsparśo vidhīyate |
prātaḥ prathamayāme tu dadyādādyajalāṃjalim || 9 ||
adharottaravastrābhyāṃ vastragranthiṃ ca dāpayet |
ekavastraḥ pradadyāttu sadarbhe ca tilāṃjalim || 1.75.10 ||
dinatrayaṃ vasettoye agnau cāpi dinatrayam |
ākāśe ca vaset trīṇi dinamekaṃ ca vāsave || 11 ||
vāyurūpo bhramatyeva vāyuḥ kuṭyāṃ sa gacchati |
ekādaśāhe yat śrāddhaṃ tatsāmānyamudāhṛtam || 1 2||
kṛtvā caikādaśāhantu punaḥ snātvā śucirbhavet |
prathame’hani yaḥ kuryāt sa daśāhaṃ samāpayet || 1 3 ||
ekādaśāhe pretasya dadyāt piṇḍaṃ samantrakam |
siddhānnaṃ tasya dātavyaṃ śarkarāpūpakādayaḥ || 14||
śayyādānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ paścāt ko’nupradāsyati |
tāvadbandhuḥ pitā tāvad yāvajjīvati mānavaḥ || 15 ||
mṛtamenaṃ śavaṃ jñātvā kṣaṇāt sneho nivartate |
ātmā vai hyātmano bandhurātmā caivātmano ripuḥ || 16 ||
ato jīvan hi sarvasvaṃ svahastenaiva dāpayet |
tasmāt kāṣṭhamayīṃ khaṭvāṃ hemādipaṭṭikābhṛtām || 17||
sagendukāṃ sopadhānāṃ sādarśaguptadorakām |
gandhavastrādisatpuṣpāṃ sadvyajanasadantikām || 18 ||
sapracchādanapaṭikāṃ haimalakṣmīhariśritām |
ghṛtakuṃbhaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ karpūrāgurucandanam || 1 9||
kuṃkumaṃ dīpakaṃ chatraṃ cāmarāsanabhājanam |
upānahau saptadhānyaṃ bhṛṃgārakaṃ vitānakam || 1.75.20 ||
evaṃ śayyādidānena svarlokaḥ sukhado bhavet |
upayuktaṃ ca tasyāsīd yatkiñciddhi gṛhe tathā || 2 1 ||
gātre cāpi ca yallagnaṃ vastrabhājanabhūṣaṇam |
dātavyamupatiṣṭhettadaindre saurye’pi dhāmani || 22||
navakaṃ ṣoḍaśaśrāddhaṃ śayyāṃ saṃvatsarakriyām |
bharturyā kurute nārī tasyāḥ śreyo bhavediha || 23 ||
pramadāyā mṛtau deyaṃ vastu strībhūṣaṇādikam |
ācāryāya pradātavyaṃ śayyāratnāmbarādikam || 24||
bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ |
ekasmai tu pradātavyamācāryāya tu kevalam || 25||
yatpuṇyaṃ ca vyatīpāte kārtikyāmayane tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ ca yatpuṇyaṃ candrasūryagrahe tathā || 26||
prayāge naimiṣe yacca kurukṣetre tathārbude |
gaṃgāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca sindhusāgarasaṃgame || 17||
śayyādānāḍhikāryeṇa tattatphalamavāpnuyāt |
yatrāsau jāyate janturbhuṃkte tatraiva tatphalam || 28 ||
karmakṣaye kṣitau jāto mānuṣaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ |
mahādhanī ca dharmajñaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 29||
arho’sau havyakavyeṣu pitṛbhiḥ saha modate |
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya tvapsarobhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 1.75.30 ||
devaiḥ susatkṛto yāti vaikuṇṭhaṃ maraṇottaram |
śrāddhe tṛptaḥ pitā dadyātputrān santativardhakān || 31 ||
tathā tṛpto godhanaṃ tu sandadāti pitāmahaḥ |
tathā tṛpto hemadaḥ syād yastasya prapitāmahaḥ || 32||
dadyādvipulamannādyaṃ vṛddhastu prapitāmahaḥ |
nārāyaṇabaliṃ kuryād yasya vaṃśo na vidyate || 33 ||
vimuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo muktaḥ sa narakād dhruvam |
dhaniṣṭhāṃ tu samārabhya revatyantaṃ tu pañcakam || 34||
paṃcake tu mṛtasyātra dāho naiva vidhīyate |
śavasya tu samīpe ca kṣipyante puttalāstataḥ || 35||
darbhamayāśca catvāra_ ṛkṣamantrābhipūjitāḥ |
tato dāhaśca kartavyastaiśca puttalakaiḥ saha || 3 6||
pañcakeṣu mṛto yo’sau na gatiṃ labhate naraḥ |
dīyate na jalaṃ tatra sarvadā hyaśubhaṃ bhavet || 37|||
lokayātrā na kartavyā duḥkhārtaḥ svajano yadi |
paṃcakānantaraṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ vidhipūrvakam || 38 ||
putrāṇāṃ gotriṇāṃ tasya santāpastvanyathā bhavet |
gṛhe hānirbhavet tasya paṃcake tu mṛtasya vai || 3 9||
sūtakānte tataḥ putraḥ kuryācchāntikṛduttamam |
tilān gām̐śca hiraṇyaṃ ca tasyoddeśe ghṛtaṃ diśet ||1.75.40 ||
bhojanopānahau chatraṃ hemamudrā ca vāsasī |
dakṣiṇā dīyate cāpi pretapātakanāśinī ||4 1 ||
aṣṭādaśaiva vastūni pretaśrāddhe vivarjayet |
āśiṣo dviguṇā darbhāḥ svastyastu praṇavastathā ||42|||
agnīkaraṇamucchiṣṭaṃ śrāddhaṃ tu vaiśvadaivikam |
vikīraśca svadhākāraḥ pitṛśabdo’pravācanam |||43 ||
āvāhanamulmukaṃ cāsīmāntaṃ ca pradakṣiṇā |
visarjanaṃ tilahomaḥ pūrṇāhutirdaśāṣṭa tān ||44||
tāmbūlaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca bhojanaṃ ṛtusevanam |
grāmamadhye sthite prete varjayet piṇḍapātanam ||45 ||
kṛtvā niraśanaṃ yo vai mṛtyumāpnoti ko’pi cet |
mānuṣīṃ tanumutsṛjya prāpnoti haritulyatāma ||46||
tasmādanaśanaṃ nṝṇāṃ vaikuṇṭhapadadāyakam |
svasthāvasthena dehena mokṣasyaiva prasādhakam ||47||
anaśanavratakartā ṛṣīṇāṃ maṇḍale vaset |
yadvā vairājadeveṣu īśeṣu vātha mokṣaṇe ||48 ||
tuṣṭā brahmādayastasya yāmyāḥ santi na yātanāḥ |
asthīni mānuṣe dehe ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatrayam ||49|||
udakuṃbhena puṣṭāni jalakuṃbhaḥ pradīyate |
sulipte bhūmibhāge ca pakvānnamapi dīyate ||1.75.50 ||
ityevamapi kartavyaṃ brahmabhāvanayā sadā |
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ tasya muktiṃ karoti saṃsmṛtaḥ ||5 1 ||
mṛtyupūrvaṃ mṛtau śavayātrāyā śavadāhane |
śrāddhe sarvatra vācyaṃ śrīharirnārāyaṇo muhuḥ ||52|||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prakīrṇakadānaśayyādānādipaṃcakamṛtordhvakāryānaśanakṛnmṛtyūttaragatyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||75 ||

<1.76>
śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca
evaṃ suśikha bhajanāddharernāmānukīrtanāt |
hāṭakāṃgadarājāpi kathārasasukho’bhavat || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu priye prasaṃgādvai mayā tu bahu varṇitam |
lokasyaiva hitārthe tat kathaye’pyadhikaṃ hitam || 2 ||
jīvanneva janaḥ kuryānmokṣamārgāvalambanam |
mokṣadāni mayā cātra klṛptāni subahūnyapi || 3 ||
jñānānmuktiḥ karmanāśānmuktirvairāgyavegataḥ |
tīrthānmuktiḥ satāṃ saṃgāddharmānmuktirgurūśrayāt || 4 ||
niṣkāmakarmato muktirmuktiḥ saṃnyāsamārgataḥ |
sādhvīdharmāśrayānmuktirmuktistyāgācca sevayā |
svasyākartṛtvavijñānānmuktiḥ saṃkīrtanādapi || 5 ||
pitrostu sevayā muktirmuktiḥ patiniṣevayā |
sarvabrahmātmavijñānānmuktiḥ sarvasamarpaṇāt || 6 ||
paropakārakaraṇānmuktiḥ parasukhārpaṇāt |
anyārthitapradānācca muktirātmasutoṣaṇāt || 7 ||
vāsanākṣayato muktirmuktirvimalabodhataḥ |
sarvakārye kṛte’pyātmā nirlepo mukta eva saḥ || 8 ||
ahaṃmamatvarahitaḥ śītoṣṇarahitastathā |
abrahmasattvarahito mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||
visṛjya saccidānandaṃ bhānaṃ mṛṣājaḍārtikam |
manute svaṃ sa vai baddho na manute sa muktakaḥ || 1.76.1 0||
bhagavadyogatīrthāni puryaśca harinirmitāḥ |
nadyaśca parvatāḥ puṇyāraṇyāni mandirāṇi ca || 11 ||
śālagrāmaśilā devaśilā bāṇaśca mūrtayaḥ |
tulasīcandanaplakṣadhātrībimbavaṭadrumāḥ || 12||
ropaṇātpālanātsekānnamaḥsparśanakīrtanāt |
nirmāṇoddhārakaraṇātpāpakṣapā hi muktidāḥ || 13||
jñānahrade satyajale rāgadveṣamalāpahe |
yaḥ snāto mānase tīrthe muktiṃ yāyānna saṃśayaḥ || 14||
devaḥ sarvatra vasati yadi bhāvo’sti nirmalaḥ |
devaḥ kvāpi na vasati nāstikyaṃ yadi rājate || 15||
prātaḥ prātaḥ prapaśyanti gaṃgādyāṃ matsyaghātakāḥ |
sūryaṃ sarve’pi paśyanti bhāvahīno na muktibhāk || 16 ||
pitṛmātṛsādhusādhvīgurugodevadharmaṇām |
kṛte prāṇām̐styajan vyaktirniścayaṃ mokṣamāpnuyāt || 17||
jīvanaṃ dānabhogābhyāṃ maraṇaṃ raṇatīrthayoḥ |
avaśyaṃ muktidaṃ syāttad yadvi devārpaṇānvitam || 18||
puṇyakṣetre puṇyatīrthe puṇyajanasamāśraye |
puṇyasthitau puṇyatithau maraṇaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 19||
kanyādātā bhuvo dātā dātā cāpyabhayasya yaḥ |
devaprāsādanirmātā sadmadātā ca muktibhāk || 1.76.20 ||
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāmārāmodyānadharmiṇām |
jīrṇoddhāraṃ prakurvāṇo muktibhāg saṃśayo nahi ||2 1 ||
sarvopakaraṇopetaṃ gṛha dhenuṃ savatsakām |
kanyāṃ sarvaguṇāḍhyāṃ vai dadan muktimavāpnuyāt ||22||
sādhvī pativratā nārī patiṃ vilokya vai mṛtam |
svāṃguṣṭhādagnimutpādya patyā saha prayāti cet |||23||
tisraḥ koṭyo’rdhakoṭiśca samāḥ svarge mahīyate ||
yadi bhaktimatī nārī patiṃ nayati dhāmani ||24||
mahāpāpasamācāro bhartā ced duṣkṛto bhavet |
tasyāpyanuvratā nārī nāśayet sarvakilbiṣam || 25||
nityamannapradātā yaḥ sadā jñānapradāyakaḥ |
nityātmasukhadātā yaḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||26||
vidyādānapradātā yaḥ kanyādānakaraśca yaḥ |
jīvanavṛttidātā yaḥ sa vai mokṣamavāpnuyāt ||27||
sukṛtaiḥ svargamāpnoti svargaṃ mokṣasthalaṃ matam |
tyaktvā phalgukriyāṃ tasmātsatataṃ mokṣabhāgbhavet || 28||
dānaṃ deyaṃ daridrāya kanyā nirvaṃśakāya ca |
anāthakāya sadvṛttiḥ sādhave sveṣṭavastukam |||29||
bhāvanā gurave deyā vidyā pātrāya mokṣiṇe |
jñānaṃ sāttvikaśiṣyāya bhaktirdeyāntarātmane |||1.76.3 0 ||
mohajālaṃ tu māyāyai sarvasvaṃ paramātmane |
muktiśca svātmane deyā svātmā deyaḥ parātmane ||2 1 ||
evaṃ mokṣaṃ prapadyeta dātā dānaphalaṃ labhet |
tasmātsarvaṃ pradātavyaṃ koṭiyajñaphalādhikam || 32||
sarvadānapradātā yaḥ svasminnarakṣakaśca saḥ |
arthānmukta iti bhāvyo nityamuktaḥ sa sammataḥ |||33||
nāryā kāryaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi dānaṃ kīdṛgvidhaṃ matam |
mātre’rpaṇīyaṃ kanyātvaṃ kaumāryaṃ lagnavahnaye |||34|||
dehastu pataye deyaḥ putrāyāhaṃmamatvakam |
saundaryaṃ tu jarāyai ca vāsanārpyā tu mṛtyave ||35||
apatyasneho vadhvai ca nanāmikyai tu bandhanam |
bhāvanā brahmaṇe deyā bhaktirdeyāntarātmane ||36||
muktiśca svātmane deyā svātmā deyaḥ parātmane |
iti sarvasvadānaṃ vai kartavyaṃ mokṣakāṃkṣibhiḥ |||37||
vinā vinimayaṃ naiva vastvamūlyamavāpyate |
sarvasvadānamūlyenāmūlyamokṣamavāpnuyāt |||38||
ātmā tu nityaśuddho’sti śuddhistasya na śiṣyate |
śarīreṇāpyaśuddhena śuddhasyāśuddhatā katham ||39||
pātraṃ naivāstyaśuddhaṃ vai lagnaṃ dravyaṃ tvaśuddhidam |
lagnadravyādyapasārātpātraṃ tu śuddhameva ha ||1.76.40||
hasto nāstyaśuddho vai tu malaṃ cāśuddhirucyate |
malāpasaraṇāddhastaḥ śuddha eveti manyate ||41||
yadi pātraṃ ca hastaścāśuddhau bhavataḥ saṃgataḥ |
tadā nāśyaṃ bhavetpātraṃ hastaśchedyo bhavettathā |||42||
kintu naivaṃ prakurvanti malaṃ niṣkāsayanti vai |
evamātmā sadā śuddhaḥ svarṇāgnivyomavanmataḥ |||43||
rāgadveṣamalāstasmādapaneyā dhiyāgninā |
bhaktyārādhanayā premṇā prītyā snehena bhāvataḥ ||44||
malā dhyeyā vināśyāśca nirmalo brahma eva saḥ |
brahmarūpaḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā parabrahma bhajetsadā ||45||
nārāyaṇabalaṃ prāpya nārāyaṇamavāpnuyāt |
nārāyaṇabalistasya kartavyo nāvaśiṣyate ||46||
nārāyaṇabalaṃ yasya nāsti tasyaiva muktaye |
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastadrītiṃ kathayāmi te ||47||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne muktervividhasādhanāni niṣkāmatayā kṛtāni niṣkāmatayā pradattavastūni ca muktidāni deyadānāni nijātmaśuddhyādīni ceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||76||

<1.77>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tava snehāt priye jñānaṃ proktaṃ bhavanibarhaṇam |
nārāyaṇabaliṃ brūve lokopakṛtihetave || 1 ||
akasmātādinaṣṭānāmuddhārārthamayaṃ vidhiḥ |
śubhe tīrthe śubhe kṣetre pavitre devamandire || 2 ||
vāritaṭe puṇyavṛkṣatale nārāyaṇabalim |
kuryādviṣṇuṃ samuddiśya mantraiḥ paurāṇavaidikaiḥ || 3 ||
dakṣiṇābhimukho bhūtvā pretaṃ viṣṇumiti smaret |
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa pretamokṣakaro bhava || 4 ||
pūrṇaṃ tu tarpaṇaṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhānyekādaśāpi ca |
toyavrīhiyavān dadyād godhūmām̐śca priyaṃgavān || 5 ||
haviṣyānnaṃ śubhāṃ mudrāṃ chatroṣṇīṣau ca celakam |
kṣīraṃ kṣaudraṃ ca dhānyāni vastre copānahau tathā || 6 ||
bhūmau sthiteṣu piṇḍeṣu gandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ |
dātavyamatha śaṃkhe vā pātre tāmre ca tarpaṇam || 7 ||
prathamaṃ vātadhāreṇa jānubhyāmavanīṃ gataḥ |
jalārthaṃ cārpayed devamekoddiṣṭaṃ pṛthakapṛthak || 8 ||
āpo devī madhumatī tvādipiṇḍe prakalpitā |
upayāmagṛhīto’si dvitīye tu nivedayet || 9 ||
ye devāsaḥ caturthe tu samudraṃ gaccha pañcame || 1.77.10 ||
agnirjyoti stathāṣaṣṭe’hihyayagarbhaḥ saptame |
yamāya tvaṣṭame jñeyaṃ yajjāgrannavame’ tathā || 11 ||
daśame’yāḥ phalinīti piṇḍe caikādaśe tataḥ |
bhadraṃ karṇebhirityādyaiḥ kuryāt piṇḍavisarjanam || 12||
kṛtvaikādaśadaivatyaṃ śrāddhaṃ kuryātpare’hani |
viprānāvāhayedarghyaṃ dadyāddevān vidhāpayet || 13 ||
viṣṇuṃ sarvamayaṃ rudraṃ tāmrajaṃ lohajaṃ yamam |
brahmāṇaṃ rājataṃ pretaṃ sīsakaṃ darbhakaṃ ca vā || 14||
tato’yamāya tvetyādimantreṇa sāmavedinam |
agne āyāhimantreṇa govindaṃ paścime nyaset || 15||
agnimīletimantreṇa pūrvāśāyāṃ prajāpatim |
iṣe tventyādimantreṇa dakṣiṇe sthāpayed yamam || 16||
madhye tu maṇḍale tatra sthāpyo darbhamayo naraḥ |
brahmā viṣṇustathā rudro yamaḥ pretaśca paṃcamaḥ || 17||
pṛthak kuṃbheṣu saṃsthāpyāḥ pañcaratnayuteṣu hi |
vastrayajñopavītāni mudrāścaiva pṛthakpṛthak || 18||
japaṃ kuryātpṛthak tatra brahmādidevatāsu vai |
paṃca śrāddhāni kurvīta devatānāṃ yathāvidhi || 19||
jaladhārāṃ tataḥ kuryāt piṇḍe piṇḍe pṛthakpṛthak |
śaṃkhe vā tāmrapātre vā hyalābhe mṛṇmaye’pi vā |||1.77.20||
tilodakaṃ samādāya sarvauṣadhisamanvitam |
āsanaṃ mudrikāṃ chatramupānahau kamaṇḍalum ||2 1||
pātraṃ bhojyārhadhānyaṃ ca vastrāṇyaṣṭavidhaṃ padam |
tāmrapātraṃ tilapūrṇaṃ sahiraṇyaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||22||
dadyāttu vidhinā tatra mukhyāya brāhmaṇāya vai |
ṛgvedine tu viprāya dadyāt sasasyamedinīm ||23 ||
yajurvedibrāhmaṇāya dadyād gāṃ tu payasvinīm |
sāmavedibrāhmaṇāya dadyāt sadvastradhautrakam ||24||
dadyād yamaṃ samuddiśya tilān lohaṃ ca dakṣiṇām |
atha puttalakaḥ kāryaḥ sarvauṣadhisamanvitaḥ ||25||
palāśasya ca vṛntānāṃ bhāgaṃ kṛtvā ca tatra vai |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ samāstīrya kuśaiśca puruṣākṛtim ||26 ||
śatatrayaṣaṣṭiyutairvṛntaiḥ prokto’sthisaṃcayaḥ |
vinyasya tāni badhnīyāt kuśairaṅge pṛthak pṛthak ||27||
catvāriṃśacchirobhāge grīvāyāṃ ca daśa nyaset |
viṃśatiścorasi kṣepyaṃ viṃśatirjaṭhare tathā ||28||
bāhudvaye śataṃ dadyāt kaṭyāṃ dadyācca viṃśatim |
ūrudvaye śataṃ cāpi triṃśacca jaṃghayordvayoḥ |||29|||
dadyāccatuṣṭayaṃ śiśne ṣaḍ dadyād vṛṣaṇadvaye |
daśa pādāṃgulībhāge evamasthīni klṛptayet ||3 0||
śiraḥsthāne nārikelaṃ dadyāttāraṃ ca tāluke |
āsye dadyātpaṃcaratna jivhāyāṃ kadalīphalam ||1.77.3 1||
antreṣu vālukāṃ dadyād vāhlīkaṃ ghrāṇa eva ca |
vasāyāṃ mṛttikāṃ dadyād gomūtraṃ mūtrake tathā ||32||
gandhakaṃ dhātave dadyād haritālaṃ manaḥśilām |
yavapiṣṭaṃ tathā māṃse madhu śoṇita eva ca || 33 ||
keśeṣu ca jaṭājūṭaṃ tvacāyāṃ ca mṛgatvacam |
pāradaṃ retasaḥ sthāne purīṣe pittalaṃ tathā |||34||
manaḥśilāṃ tathā gātre tilakalkaṃ ca sandhiṣu |
karṇayostāḍapatraṃ ca stanayoścaiva guṃjakau ||35|||
nāsāyāṃ śatapatraṃ ca kamalaṃ nābhimaṇḍale |
vṛntākaṃ vṛṣaṇe dadyāt liṃge tu gṛṃjanaṃ śubham ||36||
ghṛtaṃ nābhyāṃ pradadyādvai kaupīne tu trapu smṛtam |
mauktikaṃ stanayormūrdhni kuṃkumena vilepanam ||37||
karpūrāgurudhūpaiśca śubhairmālyaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
paridhāne paṭṭasūtraṃ hṛdaye rukmakaṃ nyaset ||38||
ṛddhivṛddhibhujau dvau ca netrayośca kapardikām |
sindūraṃ netrakoṇeṣu tāmbūlādyupahārakaiḥ || 39 ||
sarvauṣadhiyutāṃ pretapūjāṃ kṛtvā yathoditām |
sāgnikaiścāpi vidhinā yajñapātrāṇi cārpayet ||1.77.40||
śanno devī punantu me imaṃ me varuṇe’ti ca |
pretasya pāvanaṃ kṛtvā śālagrāmaśilodakaiḥ ||41 ||
viṣṇumuddiśya godānaṃ mahādānaṃ tilāni ca |
vaitaraṇīṃ pradadyācca sarvābharaṇabhūṣitām ||42 ||
prakuryād vaiṣṇavaṃ śrāddhaṃ pretamuktyarthamātmanā |
pretamokṣaṃ tataḥ kuryāddhariṃ tatra prakalpayet ||43 ||
tvaṃ viṣṇuriti saṃsmṛtya pretamagnau dahettathā |
tridinaṃ sūtake rakṣya daśāhaṃ gatapiṇḍakāḥ ||44||
sarvaṃ vai varṣaparyantaṃ kartavyaṃ pretamuktaye |
svarṇabhūgopradānaṃ ca kartavyaṃ mokṣalabdhaye |||45 ||
saṃkrāntau kṛtadānaṃ tu dyupradaṃ saptakalpakam |
harau sarvasvadānaṃ tu syādanantaṃ pramokṣadam ||46 ||
vaitaraṇī bhaved dvedhā ekā vai yāmyamārgagā |
śatayojanavistīrṇā godānātsā tu tīryate ||47||
aparā vāsanā sākṣād vaitaraṇī hṛdi sthitā |
anantayojanadīrghā jñānabhaktyā hi tīryate ||48|||
prathamā tatra durgandhā dvitīyā bhāvagandhinī |
ādyā rakta pūyatoyā rāgadveṣajalāparā ||49 |
māṃsakardamayuktādyā dhātukardamakāparā |
vajratuṇḍaiḥ śiśumārairmakarairvajrakartanaiḥ |||1.77.50 |
kṛkacaiḥ kharjakairjīvairyuktādyā viṣayaiḥ parā |
patanti tatra martyāstu krandamānā hi pāpinaḥ ||51|
payasvinyāśca godānaṃ tārayet pūyaśoṇitam |
amṛtakṛddharerdānaṃ tārayed vāsanānadīm ||52 ||
prāṇāḥ prāghūṇikā bodhyā na yāsyantyātmanā saha |
atraiva layameṣyanti prāṇadaṃ ta hariṃ bhaja ||53 ||
saprāṇaṃ maraṇaṃ nidrā hyaprāṇaṃ maraṇaṃ mṛtiḥ |
dvayornāstyeva viśvāso jīvasya jīvanāya hi ||54|
mokṣārthamadya kurvīta yāvanna maraṇaṃ bhavet |
maraṇaṃ mokṣaparyāyaṃ prāpyaṃ nānyābhidhānakam ||55||
kaḥ patiḥ kasya vā nārī kaḥ putraḥ kasya vā pitā |
ṛṇānubandhasaṃsargāḥ santi vaitaraṇīpradāḥ ||56 ||
mamedamiti sammatvā ghorayatnaṃ karoti yat |
tatsarvaṃ tu yatnakṛtaḥ tyaktvā tiṣṭhati dūrataḥ ||57||
valgantaṃ naiva valganti mānayantaṃ na manvate |
snihyantaṃ naiva snihyanti tathāpyajño na paśyati ||58||
guṇavantaṃ tu śuṣkārthā janāḥ śaṃsanti vāha vāha |
rūkṣāḥ svārthaṃ prasādhyaiva yānti dūraṃ na tān saret ||59||
ādau sārthastathā madhye yo’nte’pi sārthatāṃ bhajet |
anyat tyaktvā sadā sārthaṃ sakhāyaṃ saṃbhajeta tam ||1.77.60||
yena kartavyamanyadvai nāvaśiṣyeta kiṃcana |
kartavyaṃ tatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sakhā mitraṃ vimokṣyate ||6 1 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nārāyaṇabalikriyānirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||77||

<1.78>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
gatayo vividhāḥ karmaprāpyāstu saṃśrutā mayā |
pretānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ dānaṃ prabhuṇā śrāvitaṃ tathā || 1 ||
prasaṃgādyamarājñastu yamaloko’pi bodhitaḥ |
dhanvantareḥ kathā cāpi śrotumicchāmi mādhava || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
pūrve satye tathā tretāyuge saṃkalpasiddhijam |
sarvamāsīd yatheṣṭaṃ vai yadecchātyupatiṣṭhate || 3 ||
nāsīdapūrṇatā kācitkasyacidvastuno’pi ca |
sadā tṛptiḥ sadā toṣaḥ sadaivaḥ kāmanāphalam || 4 ||
pañcabhūtāni ca tadā parivartanta icchayā |
jano yadicchati bhūtāt tattasmāllabhate drutam || 9 ||
sarvalokā hṛṣṭapuṣṭā nīrogāḥ svātmatṛptayaḥ |
āsanprāpte dvāpare tu jātaṃ tatparivartanam || 7 ||
śaktistu kalpavṛkṣāṇāṃ kiñcinnaṣṭābhavattadā |
cintāmaṇīnāṃ sāmarthyaṃ kiṃcinnāśonmukhaṃ gatam || 7 ||
aiśvaryaṃ kāmadhenūnāṃ layamāpat kvacitkvacit |
tadā kṣetravane svatvaṃ janā hyasthāpayan svakam || 8 ||
bhojyādilabdhikā cintā janānāmabhavad hṛdi |
svatvaparatvabhedena cintāśokaspṛhādhayaḥ || 9 ||
adharmavaṃśāḥ svāvāsaṃ cakrurjanahṛdi drutam |
janāścintādyākulāstu śuṣkāyante śarīrataḥ || 1.78.10 ||
teṣāṃ vyathāṃ nirbalatvaṃ dūrīkartuṃ tadā khalu |
hyapekṣā samabhūttatrauṣadhānāṃ baladāyinām || 11 ||
bhojyauṣadhikaṇādīnāṃ bhājānāṃ phalamūlinām |
janānāṃ bhojyasampattyai kṛṣisiddhyai tadā khalu || 1 2||
apekṣā samabhūdudbhijjātīnāṃ lokavṛttaye |
kā cauṣadhirbhakṣyaphalakaṇapatrātmiketi vai || 13 ||
kā ca kathaṃ susampoṣyā hyupayojyā kathaṃ bhuji |
ityevamudbhidvijñānī kaścinnāsīttadā hyajaḥ || 14||
jñātṛguruṃ prasasmāra punarnārāyaṇaṃ punaḥ |
āgato bhagavām̐statra sarvajñānamayo vibhuḥ || 15 ||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaḥ sauvarṇakuṇḍalaḥ |
suvarṇamukuṭaḥ svarṇamālākaustubharājitaḥ || 16 ||
mandahāsyaṃ sravam̐stejaḥ saṃvyāptamukhamaṇḍalaḥ |
pītāmbaradharaḥ āyurvedasaṃstutasadyaśāḥ || 17||
sarvarasaprapūrṇo hi yāvaddugdhābdhipūjitaḥ |
yāvacchākarasairvandyaḥ sarvagundrābhisannataḥ || 18 ||
divyauṣadhilatāvṛkṣatṛṇakandādisaṃstutaḥ |
śubhramukho haridvarṇo raktapādakarāmbujaḥ || 19 ||
yuñjan śubhāśiṣā viśvasṛjaṃ prāha dayāmayaḥ |
brahman kathaṃ tvayā saṃsmārito’haṃ dvāpure yuge || 1.78.20 ||
brahmovāca tadā devaṃ sarvagaṃ bhiṣajāṃ varam |
namaskaromi deveśa vande yugalapatkajam |||2 1||
namo hyaṇusvarūpāya dvyaṇukāya namo namaḥ ||
tryaṇukāya namaścaturaṇukāya namonamaḥ |||22||
namaḥ pañcāṇurūpāya rajorūpāya te namaḥ |
namo dhūlīsvarūpāya namaste kaṃkarātmane ||23||
namo grāvasvarūpāya namaste piṇḍanāmine |
namaḥ piṇḍāḍhyabījāya namo’vyaktāṃkurātmane |||24||
namaḥ patrasvarūpāya namaḥ kāṇḍādirūpiṇe |
namaḥ śākhapraśākhāya namaḥ stambādihetave |||5||
namo nālāya puṣpāya namo rasaphalātmane |
namaḥ kaṇasvarūpāya namaḥ piṣṭarasātmane ||26||
namo’pākajarūpāya pakvarūpāya te namaḥ |
namo bhakṣyabhojyalehyacośyarūpāya te namaḥ || 27||
namo miśrasvarūpāya nama oṣadhirūpiṇe |
namaḥ kvāthādirūpāya namaścūrṇādirūpiṇe ||28||
namo recakamātrāya namo bhasmādivedine |
nama āyuḥpradātre te nama oṣadhiśaktaye ||29||
namaste parameśāna kṣemakuśalakīrtaye |
bhoktre bhogyapradānāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ || 1.78.30 ||
devadeva śarīrāṇāṃ dhātā tvaṃ poṣako’vitā |
yuge’smin kalpanāsiddhirlayaṃ prayāti dehinām || 31 ||
saṃkalpitaṃ na cāyāti nopatiṣṭhati nekṣyate |
tasmādvṛttikaraṃ dhānyaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalādikam |||32|||
kaṇaṃ mūlaṃ tathā stambaṃ tṛṇaṃ sasyaṃ payobhṛtam |
ṣaḍrasaṃ madhuraṃ snigdhaṃ pathyaṃ vai sarvadehinām ||3 3 ||
mṛgayitvā saṃviśuddhya miśrayitvā mahauṣadhīn |
bhojyaṃ cāpyauṣadhaṃ lokān prabodhayitumarhasi ||34||
na kaścit tvāmṛte cāsya prodbhidvargasya bodhakaḥ |
vijñātāpi bhavennaiva yaḥ sarvaśaḥ sa sarvavit ||35||
kāryakāraṇavijñātā yasya jñānamayaṃ tapaḥ |
tasmād rasāyanaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhojyaṃ peyameva vā ||36||
yallehyaṃ mṛdyamāghreyamāsevyaṃ śāntidaṃ bhavet |
āsvādanīyamābandhyaṃ tatsarvaṃ kartumarhasi ||37||
yattapyaṃ yacca vai kvathyaṃ yadbhṛjyaṃ cūrṇyameva yat |
yanmiśryaṃ yatsārarūpaṃ tatsarvaṃ kartumarhasi ||38||
ityevamarthito viṣṇurmerostu śikhare svakām |
kuṭīṃ cakre nivāsaṃ ca tasyāmevākarotprabhuḥ ||39||
devarṣimunipitṛbhyo mānavādibhya eva ca |
dattāstu mārgaṇaṃ kṛtvā kṛṣyoṣadhaya ityatha ||1.78.40 ||
karṣukāstāḥ sasyarūpā vardhayāmāsurutsukāḥ |
tābhyo vividhadeśeṣu vividhānnāni jajñire ||41 ||
tāḥ kṛṣivṛttayo jātā udyānāni ca bhūriśaḥ |
athāpi prāṇināṃ tābhirvanauṣadhibhirapyayam |||42||
balalābhāya bhagavān āyurvedaṃ lilekha vai |
tādṛśāḥ saṃprayogāśca vyāptā dhanvantarikṛtāḥ |||43||
rasāyanādiśālāśca kṛtā merau bahuprathāḥ |
yatrauṣadhaṃ trikālīyaṃ jñātavyaṃ nāvaśiṣyate ||44||
kartavyaṃ miśraṇaṃ yatrauṣadhīnāṃ nāvaśiṣyate |
iti tu prathame caturyuge tvevābhavaddhariḥ ||45|||
svayaṃ dhanvantarirdivyaḥ prabhurbrahmāṇḍarakṣakaḥ |
athāpi kalimāpannā lokāstu bahuduḥkhitāḥ ||46||
tadā vai bhagavān sākṣādavatarītumicchati |
sa vai dvitīyarūpeṇa dhanvantarirbabhūva ha ||47||
vaṃśaparamparājanmā kāśyāṃ so’bhūd bhiṣagvaraḥ |
śṛṇu tāṃ ca kathāṃ lakṣmi kasmin vaṃśe babhūva saḥ ||48||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ādyasatyugīyadhanvantariprādurbhāvakathanādināmāṣṭasaptatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||78||

<1.79>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro’triṛṣirlokaviśrutaḥ |
kāṣṭhavadūrdhvabāhuḥ sam̐stapaścacāra duścaram || 1 ||
trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni vigatāni vai |
tasyānimiṣanetrābhyāṃ tapastejomayaṃ jalam || 2 ||
susrāva dyotayandaśa diśaḥ kāntyā sudugdhayā |
taṃ tu jalātmakaṃ garbhaṃ diśo vidhyājñayā daśa || 2 ||
daghustathāpyaśaktāstaddhāraṇe’to jalaṃ hi tat |
ghanībhūtaṃ śuklavarṇaṃ śītahimasugolakam || 4 ||
patitaṃ vai pṛthivyāṃ tat samādāya tu padmajaḥ |
rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 5 ||
tuṣṭuvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrāḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ |
bhṛguraṃgirā marīcirvaśiṣṭhāśceti mānasāḥ || 6 ||
ṛgbhiryajubhirbahubhiratharvāṃgirasairapi |
evaṃ vivardhamānasya tejaḥ somasya bṛṃhitam || 7 ||
ārdrīkurvacca lokām̐strīnsarvatra puṣṭimādadhat |
śuklaṃ śītaṃ ca tejastatpṛthivīmanvapadyata || 8 ||
oṣadhyastāḥ samudbhūtāstejasā poṣaṇaṃ gatāḥ |
brahmaṇāpi ratho vājisahasasahitaḥ śubhaḥ || 9 ||
somāyārpita eveti tena proccarite divi |
evaṃ poṣṭābhavad devo jagataḥ sarvadehinām || 1.79.10 ||
tapastepe punaścandraḥ padmānāṃ daśatīrdaśa |
hiraṇyavarṇā lakṣmyastu dhārayantyātmanā jagat || 1 1||
vibhustāsāṃ dharaḥ somo babhāra tāḥ svatejasā |
tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ ||12||
bījauṣadhiṣu sarvāsu cāpsu vipreṣu rātriṣu |
sa tatprāpya mahadrājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ prabhuḥ || 13||
yajñaṃ cakre rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam |
hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvamāptavān || 14||
sadasyastatra bhagavān harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ ||15||
dakṣiṇāyāṃ trilokānvai somo’rpayantu sarvathā |
taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva vapuḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ || 16||
kīrtirdyutiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire |
prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ sarvadevarṣipūjitaḥ || 17||
atirājātirājendraḥ prāpyaiśvaryaṃ tu garvitaḥ |
patnīṃ bṛhaspatestārānāmnīṃ jahāra kāmataḥ || 18||
sa yācyamāno devaiśca devarṣibhiśca vai punaḥ |
naiva vyasarjayattārāṃ bṛhaspataya ityata || 19||
śukro bṛhaspaterdveṣādagrahītsāsuroḍupam |
haro gurusutaṃ snehātsarvabhūtagaṇāvṛtaḥ ||1.79.20 ||
sarvadevaguṇopeto mahendro gurumanvayāt |
jagrāha tena rudro’pi svīyamājagavaṃ dhanuḥ |||1 ||
surāsuravināśo’bhūtsarveṣāṃ kadanaṃ mahat |
saṃjātaṃ ca tadā daivāstuṣitānāmakāśca vai |||2||
brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ jagmurādidevaṃ pitāmaham |
tato nivāryośanasaṃ rudraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ ca śaṃkaram |||23||
dadau bṛhaspataye tu tārāṃ svayaṃ pitāmahaḥ |
antarvatnīṃ ca tāṃ tārāṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha bṛhaspatiḥ |||24||
tāre candramaso garbhaṃ samutsṛjya tvimaṃ bahiḥ |
tārā nāvasṛjattaṃ tu kumāraṃ dasyuhantamam |||25||
tadā bṛhaspatirgarbhākarṣaṇaṃ tvakarotsvayam |
jātamātraḥ sacetāḥ sa devebhyo’pyatibhāsvaraḥ ||26|||
abhāt sa rūpavān sarvadevādhidevasadṛśaḥ |
taṃ vilokya bṛhaspatirlulobha putrake nave |||27||
mamāyamiti jagrāha putraḥ prāha na te’smyaham |
ahaṃ candramasaḥ putro mā māṃ spṛśa bṛhaspate |||28||
tadānīṃ brahmaṇā putraḥ somāyaiva samarpitaḥ |
budha ityakaronnāma tasya putrasya candramāḥ ||29||
budhasyelākhyapatnyāṃ tu putraḥ pururavā hyabhūt |
tasya rūpaguṇaudāryaśīlaujaskaparākramān ||1.79.30||
nāradenendrabhavane gīyamānānmahāguṇān |
śrutvaurvaśī manaścakre purūravasamīkṣitum |||3 1||
mitrāvaruṇau tatrāstāṃ gāyakau tu tayā saha |
ūrvaśyā tu manastatra mānuṣe saṃgataṃ param ||32||
jñātvā tu mitrāvaruṇau prāhaturūrvaśīṃ priyām |
devau vihāya mānuṣye svairiṇyāścalate manaḥ ||33||
tasmātsvargādadho gaccha nareṇa saṃgatā bhava |
evaṃ śāpāttu drāgeva svargādūrvaśyadhogatā |||34|||
bhūmau tu mārgayāmāsa purūravasameva sā |
kokilālāpamadhuravīṇayopavane jagau ||35||
tādṛśīmūrvaśīṃ tatra rājā purūravastadā |
uvāca sundarīṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāryā mama bhaveti ca |||36|||
sāpi tatra sakāmāsīt tatastaṃ pratyabhāṣata |
bhavatvevaṃ mahārāja samayaṃ yadi me bhavān ||37||
karotu cennivasāmi karomītyabravīnnṛpaḥ |
ūrvaśī prāha meṣau dvau putrabhūtau matau mama ||38||
yāvad rakṣiṣyasi rājam̐stāvadvatsyāmi te gṛhe |
na nagno dṛśyase rājan kāmādanyatra vai kṣaṇe |||39||
nocchiṣṭaṃ me yāvad dadyāstāvadvatsyāmi te’ntike |
atsyāmi ghṛtamātraṃ vai ramiṣye ca tvayā saha ||1.79.40||
evamastviti rājoktvā jagṛhe tatkaraṃ varam |
vimāne tāṃ samāropyālakāyāṃ tu himālaye ||41||
vane caitrarathe pṛthvyāṃ saritsu ca sarassu ca |
antarīkṣe ca merau ca mānase’pi sarovare |||42||
kamalānāṃ vane kundavane ca raivatācale |
sarasvatītaṭe tadvad reme vardhitarāgataḥ ||43||
ekaṣaṣṭiṃ sa varṣāṇi ramamāṇāṃ hyaraṃjayat |
sāpi svargaṃ tu vismṛtya tasminneva spṛhāvatī ||44||
nāmanyata devalokaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ ca taṃ vinā |
atha viśvāvasunāmā gandharvastāṃ vinākulaḥ |||45||
tāmānetuṃ svargalokādbhūrlokamagamat kṣaṇāt |
ūrvaśyā saha rājñastu kṛtaṃ vāksamayaṃ tataḥ ||46||
viditvā saha gandharvaiḥ saṃyutaśca niśāntare |
ūrvaśyāḥ śayanābhyāśājjahāroraṇakaṃ javāt ||47||
ūrvaśyāhoraṇaḥ kena gṛhyate tyajyatāmayam |
purūravāstadā śrutvā vastrahīno vicārya vai ||48||
māṃ na nagnaṃ nirīkṣeta devīti na yayau tadā |
jahārānyaṃ tu tanmeṣaṃ vilalāporvaśī tadā ||49||
anāthāyā mama bālau gṛhyete taskarairaho |
nāsti me rakṣakaḥ kaścit kaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ naram ||1.79.50||
amarṣavaśamāpannaṃ śrutvā tadvacanaṃ nṛpaḥ |
khaḍgamādāya nirvastro nagno’dhāvattamomaye ||51||
ko duṣṭo harate meṣaṃ kuto yāsi sthiro bhava |
santiṣṭha matpriyāmeṣāvādāya naiva jīvasi |||52||
tāvadvidyullatā dīptā gandhavairjanitā bhṛśam |
tatprakāśaistadā devī rājānaṃ vigatāmbaram |||53||
dṛṣṭvā samāptasamayā tadgṛhātsā viniryayau |
tyaktvā meṣau ca gandharvaścitraratho’pi niryayau ||54||
rājā meṣau samādāyāgamatsvaśayanāntikam |
ūrvaśīṃ tatra nālokya babhrāmonmattavadbhuvi ||55||
mārgayannūrvaśīṃ bhūmau kurukṣetramavāpa ha |
ramye sarovare tatra kamalaiḥ sarvatovṛte ||56||
caturbhirapsaraḥstrībhiḥ krīḍamānāṃ vilokya saḥ |
he jāye kvāgatā cātra snānārthaṃ māṃ vihāya vai ||27||
āgaccha madgṛhaṃ tvehi ramasvāti mayā saha |
tvāṃ vinā naiva jīveyaṃ priye kasmādihāgatā |||28||
ityevaṃ lapamānaṃ taṃ provācorvaśikā ṛtam |
rājarājālametena cāgraheṇa tava priya ||99||
tvattogarbhiṇyahaṃ varte ratiṃ naiva karomyaham |
varṣapūrvaṃ bhavānatra cāyātu putralabdhaye ||1.79.60||
putrajanmottaramekāṃ rātriṃ vatsyāmi vai tvayā |
ityukto nṛpatiḥ prāyāt rājadhānīṃ sacintanaḥ ||6 1 ||
ūrvaśī varṇayāmāsa patiṃ kṣmeśaṃ susadguṇam |
uṣitāsmi sahānena rājñā kāmavaśā ciram ||62||
śrutvā tadūrvaśīsakhyaḥ sādhu sādhviti cābruvan |
prāhuḥ sarvā vayamapi raṃsyāmo’nena bhūbhṛtā |||63||
athābde tatra rājāpi yayau taṭākasannidhau |
ūrvaśīṃ putrayuktāṃ vai dṛṣṭvātiharṣamāpa saḥ |||64||
āyuṣākhyaṃ suputraṃ sā dadau tasmai yathā punaḥ |
sakāmā tena sākaṃ tāṃ rātrimekāṃ nināya vai |||62||
pañcaputrapradaṃ garbhaṃ dadhārovāca taṃ punaḥ |
gandharvebhyo varān rājan gṛhāṇa manasi sthitān ||66||
tāvattatrāpi gandharvā dṛṣṭā rājñātha cāha tān |
ahaṃ sampūrṇakośaśca vijitārātimaṇḍalaḥ ||67||
ūrvaśyā saha vāsena kālaṃ netuṃ sadā vṛṇe |
gandharvāstatsamākarṇya svargārohaṇakāriṇīm ||68||
agnisthālīṃ striyaṃ rājñe daduḥ procurnṛpaṃ tadā |
agniṃ tredhā vibhajya tvaṃ yajñaṃ kurvanayā saha ||69||
tena tvamūrvaśīlokaṃ prāpsyasī nātra saṃśayaḥ |
agnisthālīṃ gṛhītvātha rājā tasmin vane’nayā ||1.79.70||
agnisthālyā striyā sākaṃ reme tṛptamanā alam |
atha stryagre tu yat pātraṃ sthālīrūpaṃ tadābhavat ||71 ||
rājā cikṣepa tatpātraṃ vane vyarthaṃ viditya hi |
tāvat sā strīragnivarṇā tūrṇamadṛśyatāṃ gatā |||75||
pātraṃ cāpi tadādṛśyaṃ jātaṃ tadavamānataḥ |
rājā nirāśatāṃ prāptaścāyayau nijamandiram |||73||
kintu kāmapravegena cintayāmāsa tanmuhuḥ |
aho nārī gatā pātraṃ gataṃ kṣiptaṃ vane mayā ||74||
ūrvaśīlokasaṃprāptyai gandharveṇārpitaṃ hi me |
tadāhariṣye tatpātraṃ vicāryetthaṃ vanaṃ yayau ||751||
gatvā hyārādhanāṃ cakre’gnisthālīpātrayormuhuḥ |
tāvattatrāgnisthālī sā vṛkṣarūpeṇa codgatā ||76||
agninārī śamīrūpā pātraṃ sthālī tu pippalaḥ |
śamīṃ ca pippalaṃ rājā gṛhītvā gṛhamāyayau ||77||
tayorviśvāsamāpannaścorvaśīlabdhidāvimau |
yadvā nārī tathā sthālī punaḥ syātāmimāviti ||78||
gṛhe rājā saṃpratarkya nirmamanthobhayaṃ saha |
adho’raṇīṃ śamīṃ cakre pippalaṃ cottarāraṇīm ||79||
gāyavyakṣarasaṃkhyākāṃgulamānāraṇīdvayāt |
nirmathanāt samutpannaṃ tatrāgnitrayameva tat ||1.79.80||
juhāvāgnitrayaṃ rājā yajñe corvaśikāptaye |
yajñeṣvagniḥ prasanno’bhūdvimānaṃ cānayat divaḥ ||8 1 ||
tenaiva divyayānena yajñapuṇyapratāpataḥ |
ūrvaśīlokamāsādya reme rājā tayā saha |||82||
athendrasya sabhāyāṃ tu nṛtyaṃ surāṃganākṛtam |
rājā vyalokayat tatrorvaśīnṛtyaṃ muhuḥ kṛtam ||8 3 ||
nṛtyābhinayasāmarthyagarvayuktorvaśī tadā |
purūravasaṃ sānnidhye jahāsātīva modataḥ ||84||
rājā prasannatāṃ prāpto jahāsāpi nijāṃ puraḥ |
nāṭyācāryastumburustau vilokya krodhamāpa vai ||85||
asaṃkhyadevasadasi nṛtye vai hasanaṃ vṛthā |
tasmāttu yuvayostāvadviyogo bhavatu drutam ||86||
evaṃ śaptau tadendraṃ tau jagmatuḥ śaraṇ tataḥ |
indraḥ prāha dayāṃ kṛtvā pṛthvyāṃ vai gandhamādane ||87||
parvate tu yuvāṃ gatvā tīrthe sādhyāmṛtābhidhe |
susnān kurutaṃ tena śāpamokṣo bhaviṣyati ||88||
sadā yogaśca yuvayoḥ susampanno bhaviṣyati |
ityevaṃ kṛtavannau tau tato diviṃ vimānagau ||89||
remāte pañcaputrāśca tayorāsan mahābalāḥ |
eko jyeṣṭhatamastvāyurmilitvā ṣaṭ suputrakāḥ || 1.79.90 ||
gandharvaloke viditāḥ āyuḥ dhīmān amāvasuḥ |
viśvāyuśca śatāyuśca gatāyuścorvaśīsutāḥ ||9 1||
rājy cakruḥ prayāge te pratiṣṭhāne subhūtale |
tadvśe’bhūddhanvantarirbhagavāṃstaṃ vadāmyatha ||92||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne atreḥ somastasya bṛhaspatipatnītārāyāṃ budhotpattistasya purūravāstasyorvaśyapsarāyāṃ ṣaṭ putrā ityādipradarśananāmā ekonāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||79||

<1.80>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yaḥ purūravasaḥ putra āyustasyābhavan sutāḥ |
pañcādyastatra nahuṣaḥ kṣatravṛddho dvitīyakaḥ || 1 ||
rajastatra tṛtīyastu caturtho raṃbhanāmakaḥ |
pañcamastvanenā vai pitṛtulyaparākramāḥ || 2 ||
kṣatravṛddhasya caiko vai sutahotro’bhavat sutaḥ |
sutahotrasya dāyādāstrayaḥ paramadhārmikāḥ || 3 ||
kāśyaḥ kuśo gṛtsamado gṛtsamadasya vai sutaḥ |
śunakastasya sutaḥ śaunakākhyastasya vai sutāḥ || 4 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścaivābhavan śubhāḥ |
kuśātmajo hyārṣṭiṣeṇaścarantastasya cātmajaḥ || 5 ||
śaunakāścārṣṭiṣeṇāśca kṣatropetā dvijātayaḥ |
kāśyasya kāśistatputro rāṣṭro dīrghatapāstataḥ || 6 ||
dīrghatapaso bhagavān dhanvantariḥ sutaḥ prabhuḥ |
so’yaṃ kāśīpurīrājo hyāyurvedapravartakaḥ || 7 ||
yasya nāma smarejjantustasya rogo vinaśyati |
dvitīyo’yaṃ dhanvantariḥ parameśvara eva ha || 8 ||
prāk tu jātaḥ samudre tu mathyamāne’mṛtārthadhṛk |
sa provāca tadā nārāyaṇaṃ putro’smi te prabho || 9 ||
vidhatsva bhāgaṃ sthānaṃ ca mama loke’tra me pitaḥ |
śrīhariḥ prāha taṃ putraṃ dhanvantariṃ samudrajam || 1.80.10 ||
kṛto yajñavibhāgastu yajñiyairhi suraistathā |
vedeṣu vidhiyuktaṃ ca vidhihotraṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 11 ||
na śakyastu tvayā homaḥ kartuṃ tattulya eva ha |
arvāk suto’si he deva nāmamantro’si vai prabho || 1 2||
tasmādidānīṃ te bhāgo naiva yajñe bhaviṣyati |
kintu dvitīye tvaṃ tatra janmani khyātimeṣyasi || 1 3|||
aṇimādiyutā siddhirgarbhasthasya bhaviṣyati |
tenaiva ca śarīreṇa devatvaṃ prāpsyasi dhruvam || 14||
carumantrairghṛtairgandhairyakṣyanti tvāṃ dvijātayaḥ |
atha ca tvaṃ punaścaiva āyurvedaṃ vidhāsyasi || 11||
avaśyaṃbhāvi hyartho’yaṃ prathamastvaṃ tu mānasaḥ |
samudrajo dvitīyo vai kāśīrājastṛtīyakaḥ || 16||
ityevaṃ trividhaṃ dhanvantareḥ prākaṭyamasti vai |
dvāpare tatra samprāpte putrārthaṃ tapa ācaran || 17||
dīrghatapā vyapaśyadvai bhagavantaṃ hariṃ puraḥ |
prasannāsyaṃ praśāntaṃ ca kiṃciddātuṃ samāgatam || 18||
jagād bhagavān dīrghatapasaṃ vṛṇu cepsitam |
dārghatapāstadovāca prāṃjalirvinayānvitaḥ || 19||
bhagavān yadi tuṣṭastvaṃ putro me dhṛtimān bhava |
tatheti samanujñāya prabhurantaradhīyata |||1.80.2 0 ||
tasya dehāt samutpanno lakṣmi dhanvantarirhariḥ |
kāśīrājo mahārājaḥ sarvarogapraṇāśakaḥ ||21 ||
dhanuścihnakaro devo bhagavān lokarakṣakaḥ |
poṣakaḥ sarvavastūnāṃ jñānado mokṣadastathā || 22||
āyurvedaṃ sa vai devaścakāra sabhiṣakkriyam |
tamaṣṭadhā punarvyasya śiṣyebhyaḥ pratyapādayat ||23||
dhanvantarisutaścāsīt ketumān sumahāyaśāḥ |
ketumato bhīmaratho divodāsāparābhidhaḥ ||24||
divodāso mahānāsīd bhakto viṣṇusamo balī |
prajāyāṃ vardhitā tena harerbhaktistu sarvathā || 25||
sthito’pi bhagavān śaṃbhurmandaraṃ cārukandaram |
kāśīṃ vinā sukhaṃ nāpa divodāsanṛpoṣitām |||26||
bhagavān śaṃkaro devo vaiṣṇavo’styeva sarvathā |
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃbrahma bhajatyeva samādhinā || 27||
divodāso’pi tu tadvatparamo vaiṣṇavo mataḥ |
niṣkāsayitvā taṃ bhaktaṃ vāsamaicchattu śaṃkaraḥ || 28||
śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca
suśikhaivaṃ śaṃkarasya kathāyogaṃ praśāntidam |
divodāsasya bhaktasya cāpi śrutvā drutaṃ tadā ||29|||
lakṣmīḥ papraccha cākarṇya divodāsaṃ trilocanaḥ |
kāśīṃ saṃtyājayāmāsa kathaṃ tatrāgamat nagāt || 1.80.3 0||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ tena devena divodāso yadatyagāt |
kāśīṃ tu rājadhānīṃ svāṃ śrotumicchāmi mādhava || 31 ||
hāṭakāṃgad ityevaṃ lakṣmīḥ pṛṣṭvā patiṃ prabhum |
ekāgramānasābhūt tāṃ nārāyaṇa uvāca ha ||32 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dhanvantaryavatāratrayakathananāmāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||

<1.81>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pavitrāṃ tāṃ kathāṃ bhaktacamatkarām |
divodāso mama bhaktastato’pi bhūtarāṭ svayam || 1 ||
paramo mama bhakto vai tiṣṭhatī mandare girau |
mandareṇa tapastaptaṃ ghoraṃ paramadāruṇam || 2 ||
tapasātiprasanno vai mahādevo jagatpatiḥ |
mandaraṃ prāha bhūbhṛt te hṛdye kiṃ nu vidyate || 3 ||
prasanno’smi mahādevo vṛṇu sveṣṭaṃ vadāmyaham |
mandaraḥ prāha deveśa tava vāsaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 4 ||
tava vāsena me kāyaḥ pavitraḥ saṃbhaviṣyati |
tīrthamaurdhanyamāpanno mānyatāṃ saṃvrajiṣyati || 5 ||
sarve devarṣimunayo bhavaddarśanamāgatāḥ |
svapādajaladānena pāvayiṣyanti māṃ sadā || 6 ||
ityabhyarthanamāsādya śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ |
uvāsa mandaragirau tadā sarve divaukasaḥ || 7 ||
ṛṣayo munayaścātha yakṣarākṣasapārṣadāḥ |
sarve’pi mandaravāsaṃ cakruḥ śaṃbhusamāśrayāḥ || 8 ||
kāśyāṃ pūrve ca ye hyāsan skandaviṣṇugaṇādhipāḥ |
sūryo devyastathā cānye tyaktvā kāśīṃ giriṃ gatāḥ || 9 ||
gateṣu devasaṃgheṣu divodāsaḥ pratāpavān |
cakāra rājyaṃ nirdvandvaṃ prabhorbhaktibharaṃ śubham || 1.81.10 ||
rājadhānī kṛtā rājñā vārāṇasī suniścalā |
vardhayāmāsa bhaktyā tāṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan || 1 1||
kāśīvāsāstu ye devāḥ svargiṇaḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ |
saṃyamena tu hīnām̐stān divodāso vyavāsayat ||12||
dharmahīnairvratahīnaiḥ saṃyamena tu varjitaiḥ |
mama kāśyāṃ na vai stheyaṃ devairanyairapi dhruvam || 1 3||
bhagavadbhaktihīnaiśca viśeṣeṇa na vai kṣaṇam |
sthātavyaṃ ceti rājā vai devādīn nirakāsayan ||14||
sūryavat sa pratapitā durhṛdāṃ hṛdi netrayoḥ |
candravat suhṛdāmāsīt hṛdi manasi netrayoḥ || 15||
śatrugaṇāḥ palāyante dṛṣṭvā taṃ tu dhanurdharam |
dharmādharmavivektā sa dharmarāja ivāparaḥ || 16||
indra iva balī caiva pāśīva vairipāśakṛt |
kuberaiva dhanavān prāṇa iva prajāgrahaḥ || 17||
rājarājaḥ sa evāsīd rudra iva ripuñjayaḥ |
viśvadevasamo rūpe hyasādhyo vasunādhikaḥ || 18||
dasrato rūpamāpanno marutāmapi rodakaḥ |
sarvavidyādharo gītikuśalo lokatoṣaṇaḥ || 19||
yakṣarākṣasanāgāśca dānavāstaṃ siṣevire |
guhyakā guptadāsāstu yasya karmakarāḥ saṭā ||1.81.20 ||
pavano yasya cāśvānvai parāṃ gatimaśikṣayan |
dāninastu gajā yasya dānamanyānaśikṣayan ||21||
sabhāyāṃ yasya boddhāro yoddhāraśca raṇājire |
śāstrairyasya vijetā na na śastraiḥ kenacit kvacit ||22||
rājye yasya na vai dveṣyāḥ prajāḥ sukhamayāśayāḥ |
kalāvāneka evāsījjanāḥ sarve kalālayāḥ ||23||
na ko’pyāsīd gotrabhit tadrājye sva eva gotrabhit |
nāsīt kopi kṣayī tasya rājye svarge kṣayī śaśī ||24||
na tadrājye’vagraho’bhūd grahāstu nava vai diti |
hiraṇyagarbho divyeko hyasya sarve hiraṇmayāḥ ||25||
svarge saptāśva eko’styasya janā bahuvājinaḥ |
svargāpsarogaṇaśreṣṭhā viṣaye’syāpsarāḥ sadā ||26|||
ekaiva padmā vaikuṃṭhe’sya vai padmākarāḥ śatam |
iti duḥkhāni naivāsya nāsannupadravāḥ kvacit ||27||
vasudhā vasudā sarvā dhanahāstu gṛhe gṛhe |
evaṃ sukhayato rājyaprajā rājño’yutāṣṭakam |||28||
śaradāṃ tu gataprāyaṃ tadā śaṃbhurmano dadhe |
vārāṇasyāṃ nivāsāya pratīkāraṃ cikīrṣati ||29||
devā bṛhaspatiṃ prāpya tena cakruśca mantraṇām |
vayaṃ bhavadyutāḥ syāmo vipatkartāra eva ha ||1.81.30||
yadyapi bhūbhṛtā tena devā yajñaiḥ sumānitāḥ |
tathāpi mānavā naiva mitrāṇi vastuto matāḥ ||3 1||
yadyapi tena cāsmākaṃ nāpakṛtyaṃ vidhīyate |
tathāpi dyusadāṃ rītiḥ parotkarṣāsahiṣṇutā ||32||
divodāsagṛhe rājye nālpo’pyadharmasaṃgrahaḥ |
nāsya parābhavo rājñaḥ kartuṃ kenāpi śakyate |||33||
ekapatnīvratāḥ sarve narāstasya ca maṇḍale |
pātivratyaparā nāryo vidyante cāsya maṇḍale ||34||
tadrājye’vidyavipro na nāvīro bāhujastathā |
nānudyogo’pi vaiśyo’sti nāsevākṛt tu śūdrakaḥ ||35||
nāsya rājye brahmacāryabrahmavrataparāyaṇaḥ |
nāpyasatkārakṛdasya gārhasthyamapi maṇḍale ||36||
nāpyavanyavṛttikarā vānaprasthāśca niḥspṛhāḥ |
na cāsaṃgavihīnāstu sanyāsapathagāminaḥ |||37||
evamanye’pi tadrājye nāvartmagatikā vṛthā |
nānapatyo na cābhakto nādravyaḥ ko’pi tadbhuvi ||38||
nāvṛddhasevī nākāṇḍamṛtirnādrohaketaraḥ |
na cāṭā naiva vācāṭā na śaṭhā vaṃcakā nahi ||39||
na pākhaṇḍā na vai bhaṇḍā na raṇḍā na ca śauṇḍikāḥ |
tasya rājye tu sarvatra śrutiśāstrādisevanam ||1.81.40||
sarvatra śubhakṛdvāṇī madyamāṃsādihīnatā |
na dyūtadyotakāstatra ṛṇino na na taskarāḥ ||41||
pitṛdevādipūjāpi na vicchinnā kadācana |
na tadrājye vratalopo nātīrthasevanaṃ tathā ||42||
patipatnyoḥ sadā snehaḥ kuṭumbaṃ kleśakṛnnahi |
vandyante vandakairvandyāḥ pūjyante pūjakaiḥ parāḥ ||43||
ādriyante tu vidvāṃsaḥ prajābhistatra sarvadā |
vidvadbhiśca tapaḥśreṣṭhāstāpasaiśca jitānnarāḥ ||44||
jitāntarairjñānadhanā jñānibhirbrahmavijjanāḥ |
brahmavidbhiḥ sarvatattvamīkṣyate brahmarūpakam ||45||
viprasādhuprasādhvīnāṃ mukhe devānnamarpyate |
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ jalānyāpūravanti ca ||46||
meghā mehanta aiśānyā sasyavastrā mahī sadā |
hṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ prajāstasya śucayo’pyubhaye sadā ||47||
mārgayanto’pi chidraṃ tadrājye devā manāgapi |
nāpnuvannatha devām̐stān bṛhaspatiruvāca vai ||48||
parābhavo vinā chidraṃ naiva bhāvīti sarvathā |
upāyaṃ bhedamādāyāchidro’pi paribhūyate ||49||
asmatpakṣā api tatra bhavanti sukhasampadaḥ |
tathāpi bhedakārye tu sāhāyyāḥ syuratanmatāḥ ||1.81.50 ||
iti nirṇayamāsādya tadāsyāntarbahiścarān |
vijñāpya dyusadaḥ sarve cāgnidevaṃ vavandire ||51 ||
indro’pyagniṃ tadā prāha tvaṃ kāśyāṃ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ |
mūrtirūpo bhavām̐statra rājate viṣayāt tataḥ ||52||
tāmupāsaṃhara kṣipramevaṃ syādvijayastu naḥ |
mūrtiśūnye yājakāstu havyakavyādivarjitāḥ ||53||
viraṃkṣyante nṛpe tatra prajā apyarthaśūnyatām |
rājaśabdasya cālokya rūḍhiśaktivihīnatām ||54||
prajāstatra viraktāḥ syuḥ kṣīṇaṃ kośabalaṃ bhavet |
rājāpi kṣīṇavṛttiḥ syāt trivargaḥ kṣīyate svayam ||55||
divodāsastathā kṣīṇo naśyatyathavā yāsyati |
tena cāsmākamevātra kāśyāṃ vāso hyakaṇṭakaḥ |||56||
atiśayākhyadoṣādyasaṃbhinna eva saṃbhavet |
ityagnirindrakathitamupāgamya hṛdi smaran ||57||
mahādevaṃ svakāṃ mūrtimājahāra sthalāt tataḥ |
āhavanīyāṃ ca gārhapatyāṃ dākṣiṇakāṃ trikam ||288|||
jāṭharāgniṃ cāpi tatratyaprajānāṃ jahāra saḥ |
rājā prajā na vindanti prātarmadhyāhnakarmasu |||59||
kamapyagniṃ tadā sarve karmaṭhāḥ pācakāstathā |
cintayāmāsurugraṃ vai kiṃ syātkṛtyaṃ vināgninā ||1.81.60 ||
rājā mādhyāhnikaṃ kṛtvā praviveśa mahānasam |
vaiśvadevāya bhojyāya yāvadāgatya tiṣṭhati ||6 1||
āndhasikā vepamānāḥ kṣudhārtaṃ taṃ vyajijñapan |
yadi viśrāvayed rājan bhavānabhayadakṣiṇām ||62|||
tadā vijñāpayiṣyāmaḥ kimabhūditi tatvataḥ |
rājñā tathā kṛtādeśāḥ pācakā hyūcire śanaiḥ ||63||
na jānīmo vayaṃ nātha kathamagnirapāsarat |
purāt kṛśānau vigate kathaṃ pātrādi saṃbhavet ||64||
sūryapākena yatpakvaṃ tat kiṃcidānayāmahe |
tāvadrājā vivedaitaddevānāṃ kṛtyameva ha ||65||
tapobalādavetyaitadvicāryāpyavadattadā |
agnau gate na me hānirdevānāṃ hānireva vai ||66||
mayā tebhyo na rājyaṃ vai labdhaṃ labdhaṃ pitāmahāt |
svātmabalād racayiṣye vāyumagniṃ jalaṃ bhuvam ||67||
prakāśaṃ ceti tatsarvaṃ yadyadvāpekṣyate’tra tat |
sarvaṃ kariṣye caitanyājjaḍe me na prayojanam ||68||
iti cintayatastasyāyayurjānapadā janāḥ |
tameva virāvaṃ kartuṃ dvāḥsthenāntaḥ praveśitāḥ ||69||
datvopadāṃ yathārhaṃ te niṣedurmānadāsane |
jagadurduḥkhamatyarthaṃ vahniyātrākṛtaṃ tadā ||1.81.70 ||
prāha rājā tadāśrutya sarvasya sukhamāvahan |
cikīrṣurahamevāsaṃ paurāḥ kāryamidaṃ purā ||71||
paraṃ hyupekṣitaprāyaṃ droho na syāditīcchayā |
gato’nalo’bhavadbhadraṃ prāṇo’pi yātvito drutam ||72||
śaśī sūryo varuṇaśca bhūrākāśo’pi yāntvitaḥ |
bhagavadyogaprābalyādahamagnirbhavāmyaham |||73||
caturdhā vahnirūpeṇa gṛhṇāmi pācayāmi yat |
ahaṃ prāṇa svayaṃ bhūtvā jīvayiṣyāmi dehinaḥ ||74||
mahāvāyuḥ svayaṃ bhūtvā dhārayiṣyāmi golakān |
śaśī cāhaṃ svayaṃ bhūtvāpyāyayiṣyeṃ’kuraṃ jagat ||75 ||
tāpayiṣye svayaṃ sūryo bhūtvemāṃ medinīṃ sadā |
megho bhūtvā svayaṃ vṛṣṭiṃ kariṣye varuṇo’pyaham ||76||
sthāsyehaṃ jalarūpeṇa bhūrūpo’pi bhavāmi ca |
dhārayiṣye jagatsarvaṃ vyomarūpo bhavāmi ca ||77||
ityuktvā sāntayitvā svaprajā rājā hyabhūt tathā |
bahurūpaśca saṃbhūya tattatkāryāṇyavartayat ||78||
bhagavallabdhayogena hyekopyanekaśo’bhavat |
tadā divaukasāṃ rājā śalyarūpo babhūva ha ||79||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya mandaragirau varadānakṛtāvāsaḥ kāśīto devā api tatra gatāḥ divodāsarājye guṇavarṇanaṃ kāśīto divodāsasya niṣkāsanopāyaracanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ekāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||8 1||

<1.82>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevo mandarācalamandire |
sukhaṃ nāpa kāśyayogātsarvathopaskarānvite || 1 ||
sukhadomandarastasya sukhamāndyakaro’bhavat |
lepārthaṃ candanaṃ tasya pāṃsulendhanamābhavat || 2 ||
kaṃkaṇāni mṛṇālāni kaṃkarāṇyabhavam̐stadā |
bhāla candro’bhavattasya virahānalacandrakaḥ || 3 ||
kāśīviyogamūrdhanyatāpaśāntikṛte’munā |
jaṭāghaṭṭadhṛtā gaṃgā na tyaktā rakṣitā balāt || 4 ||
devaiścāpi na vidito virahāgnivadīśvaraḥ |
dhyānamagno yathāpūrvamāste mandarabhūbhṛti || 5 ||
hyeṣaiva līlā devasya svamūrtyā tapyate prabhuḥ |
aṣṭamūrtiḥ svayaṃ yo vai tāpayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 6 ||
viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ kaṇṭhagataṃ no tāpayatyamum |
kāśīvirahatāpastaṃ tāpayatyativardhitaḥ || 7 ||
api śītalacandrakāntajā nanu mālā vidhṛtā tu vakṣasi |
virahānnavakāśikākṛtād ravikāntabhramamāvahatyasau || 8 ||
yadapāṃgavimokṣaṇodbhavādanalālūlokasukhāvaho’pyayam |
nanu mānasabhūśca bhasmasādabhavatso’pyanalena tapyate || 9 ||
śrutimārgamabhidruto’pi yo nijabhaktāntarasaukhyasaṃpradaḥ |
sa hi śāntarayo viyogajānalatapto bhavatīti vaiśasam || 1.82.10 ||
api kāśisugaṃgajānkaṇānabhisaṃgṛhya samāgato’nilaḥ |
spṛśate yadi māṃ viyoginaṃ parisaukhyaṃ mama jāyate tadā || 11 ||
api kāśisurathyagaṃ rajo yadi cāyātyanilena vāhinā |
tadapi prabhu syādviyogajaṃ hyasukhaṃ vārayituṃ balādalam || 1 2||
ityevaṃ śokasaṃmagnaṃ śaṃkaraṃ vīkṣya pārvatī |
patidevaṃ namaskṛtya prāha cāntarakhedahṛt || 1 3||
kathaṃ deva mahādeva jagatāṃ nātha ceśvara |
hṛdi santapyase lokasantāpahara śaṃkara || 14||
vāmā vāmasvarūpā te saṃsthitāsmi tavārcane |
tāpahārāya me nātha kathamuttapyase tvayā || 15||
bhūvāragnyanilākāśacandrasūryātmamūrtika |
sākṣānumopamāśabdārthāpattyaitihyamānavan || 16||
anupalaṃbhāsaṃbhavaceṣṭāyogajabhānavan |
kathaṃ kāśiviyogaste sarvayogin pradharṣati || 17||
sarvāntarātman sarvajña kāśavadbrahmarūpadhṛk |
triśūlāgre’sti te kāśī kastāpastatkṛtastvayi || 18||
tathāpi devayogātsā divyā mokṣakarī ca pūḥ |
na kāladeśavastukṛtparicchedo’tra vartate || 19||
na vivṛttiḥ pariṇāmo na dhvaṃso na mṛṣātmatā |
na layo na tirobhāvastvadyogāt kāśikāśavat ||1.82.20 ||
divyā divyagaṇopetā divyatīrthā ca pāvanī |
divyamokṣapradā kāśī gantavyā nātha sarvathā ||21||
naiva kāśīsamaṃ saukhyaṃ naiva kāśīsamā sthitiḥ |
naiva kāśīsamā śāntiḥ kāśī sarvārthadāyinī ||22||
kaṃ sukhamāpyate kā sā śaṃ sukhamīyate’taḥ śī |
kāśī sukhamayī tasmāt sarvasevyā bhavatyapi ||23 ||
kasya vai brahmaṇo vāsādasya viṣṇoḥ samāśrayāt |
śasya śaṃbhornivāsācca kāśī tridevamūrtikā ||2||
kā tu sarasvatī proktā ā tu lakṣmīḥ ramā svayam |
śī tu devī pārvatī vai kāśī devītrayātmikā |||25||
na mandaro na himavān nodyānāni vanāni ca |
vaihāyasāni bhūgāni sukhayanti tu kāśivat ||26||
na karmadevo nādharmo na yāmyo nāpi nākajaḥ |
kāśīvāsijanaṃ daṇḍayituṃ śakto bhavediha |||27||
vāsanānāṃ kṣayo yatra maraṇānna punarbhavaḥ |
nivāsātkarmalepo na kadā dṛkṣye nu tāṃ vibho ||28|||
purāṇi santyanekāni nagarāṇyapi vai tathā |
pade pade smṛddhimanti na kāśīsadṛśāni vai ||29|||
satyasthā bhūmayaḥ sarvāḥ kāśītulyā bhavanti na |
yathā tvāṃ ca tathā māṃ ca bādhate kāśitāpanā ||1.82.30 ||
kāśī tāpaharā yādṛṅ na tādṛṅ mama janmabhūḥ |
tapoyajñeṣṭapūrtyarhādānadharmavratādibhiḥ ||3 1 ||
na tathā prāpyate muktiḥ kāśyāṃ tu dehapātanāt |
na yogasāṃkhyavedāntakarmakāṇḍātmavittibhiḥ ||32||
yathā kāśyāṃ dehapātānmuktirbhavati śāśvatī |
na vedādhyayanād brahmavratādapi gatistathā ||33||
na satye cendraloke vā munīnāṃ nilaye’pi na |
nātalādau tathā kvāpi sukhaṃ kāśyāṃ tu yādṛśam || 34||
manasā saṃsmṛtya kāśīṃ yogābhyāsaphalaṃ labhet |
mānavātkhalu tiryaktvaṃ kāśyāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ sadā ||35|||
maraṇādeva muktiḥ syājjñānajanmani kiṃ phalam |
tasmād yāyāṃ yathā kāśyānandāraṇyaṃ tathā kuru || 36||
śaṃbhuruvāca deveśi jānāsi mama yadvratam |
abhuktapūrvamanyena vastūpāśnāmi netarat ||37||
brahmaṇā nodito divodāso dharmeṇa tāṃ purīm |
śāsti tatra kathaṃ gamyamanyaśāstari saṃsthite ||38||
divodāsaḥ purīṃ kāśīṃ tyaktvā yāyād yathā tathā |
kartavyameva sammīlya tato vāsaḥ sukhāvahaḥ ||39||
adharmiṇastu vighnāni bhaveyurna tu dharmiṇaḥ |
dharmasthitasya yo vighnamācaret sa vipadyate ||1.82.40 ||
vinā chidraṃ kathaṃ dharmayukto hyutsādyate sthalāt |
na jarā na mahākālo na mṛtyurvyādhayo’śamāḥ ||4 1 ||
na vighnā naiva rogāśca na grahā na piśācakāḥ |
netayo nāpi bhūtāni bādhante dharmasaṃgraham |||42||
tasmātkaṃ preṣayāmīśe yastaṃ vidrāvayet tataḥ |
evaṃ cintayataḥ śaṃbhoryoginīmaṇḍalaṃ puraḥ ||43 ||
upasthitaṃ tu taccakraṃ prāha vākyamidaṃ haraḥ |
satvaraṃ yāta yoginyo yatra rājātidhārmikaḥ ||44||
divodāsa iti khyātaḥ kāśyāṃ dharmeṇa śāstyayam |
yathā kāśīṃ tyajecchīghraṃ tathā kuruta māyayā ||45 ||
ahaṃ tato navīkṛtya purīṃ vārāṇasīṃ śubhām |
sannivatsyāmi tatraiva śīghraṃ sarvaṃ vidhīyatām ||46 ||
ityājñāṃ śirasā tāśca gṛhītvā yayurutsukāḥ |
pravadantyo dhanyatamā vayaṃ devaprasāditāḥ ||47||
preṣitāścāpi kāryārthaṃ śrīmadānandakānanam |
uḍḍīya mandaradroṇyā vyomni kāśyupari sthirāḥ ||48 ||
dadṛśurdivyasaudhāḍhyaṃ puraṃ svargamivāparam |
patākābhistu mārgasthānpānthānāhvayatīva tat ||49 ||
śvetamaṇimahājālairnīlaṃ vyomāpi nirmalam |
sarvaṃ dhavalayattejaḥpravāhaiḥ svargagāmibhiḥ ||1.82.50 ||
atha vyomnyeva sarvābhiḥ svarūpāṇāṃ vivartanam |
vividhaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tāśca vibhinnajñānavartanāḥ |||5 1 ||
vibhinnaveṣā hyabhavan kāśyāṃ sthale sthale striyaḥ |
avateruśca yoginyaḥ sundaryaḥ kāryasiddhaye ||52 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mandarācalaguhāyāṃ śaṃbhoḥ kāśīvirahajatāpottaraṃdivodāsasya vighnārthaṃ yoginīcakrapreṣaṇamityādikathananāmā dvyaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ |||82||

<1.83>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
paśya lakṣmi kiyadveṣā nāryo svārthārthamudyatāḥ |
bahurūpāṇi kurvanti yāvatsvārthau na siddhyati || 1 ||
yoginītvaṃ parityajya devītvaṃ cāvaguhya ca |
kācit saṃnyāsinī kācit tapasvinī tu mānavī || 2 ||
kācit babhūva sairandhrī kācittu bhikṣukī tathā |
kācittu mālinī kācit nāpitī sūtikābhavat || 3 ||
kācidbhiṣagvarārohā kācit tulāsuvikrayā |
kācicchākavikrayiṇī kācit sarpādirakṣikā || 4 ||
kācittu nartakī jātā kācid dhātrī ca kiṃkarī |
aparā gāyikā jātānyā vāditrapravādinī || 5 ||
kācit tālakarī cānyā jātā kārmaṇamantradā |
kācinmālāgumphanajñā kācittailādivikrayā || 6 ||
parā dyūtavidhānajñā itarā gopavallabhā |
kācinnaṭī ca kācittu rathyācatvaramārjikā || 7 ||
anyā madhvādivyāpārā rathyācīvaramārgaṇā |
apatyadāparā jātā śvapacī carmakāriṇī || 8 ||
sādhvī ca karṣukī dugdharasavyāpārahāriṇī |
tīrthavāsinī cānyā ca muṇḍinī grāmaṭhāparā || 9 ||
kācid rekhācihnadraṣṭrī kācillekhanacitrikā |
vaśīkaraṇamantrajñā kācij jvarapramārjikā || 1.83.1 0||
kācidaṃjanakuśalā guṭikāsiddhibodhikā |
dhātvādimiśrikā kācid vāstrapattrāṇakāriṇī || 1 1||
puṃmohinī bahurūpā vāgagnistaṃbhabodhikā |
adṛśyatvakhecaratvānyākāratvādimantradā || 12||
uccāṭanākarṣaṇajñā yuvacittavimohinī |
cintitārthapradā jyotirvijñānyā paśurakṣikā || 12||
dantadhāvanadātrī ca gośakṛtsaṃgrahāṭinī |
mṛttikāyāśca vikretrī kācittu nāgarī tathā || 14||
karmacāriṇi dāsī ca bhūtvā bhūtvā pratigṛham |
prāviśam̐stāśca yoginyo’harniśaṃ vicaranti ca || 15||
vighnārthaṃ chidramalpaṃ vā mārgayantyo’pi nālabhan |
tatastā etya gaṃgāyāstīre sametya niṣphalāḥ || 16||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ divodāse prajāsu ca |
chidraṃ no labhyate kiṃcitkathaṃ dūraṃ prakurmahe || 17|||
kāryasiddhiṃ vinā naiva gantavyaṃ svāminaṃ prati |
saṃmantryeti tatra tasthurna gatā mandarācalam || 18||
prabhoḥ kāryamaniṣpādya preṣyaḥ ko nikaṭe bhavet |
prabhuṃ vināpi kāśyāṃ vai jīviṣyāmo’tra sarvadā || 19||
prabhū ruṣṭo hared vṛttyaṃ kāśī tvarthacatuṣṭayam |
tasmātkāśyāṃ pravastavyaṃ gantavyaṃ nahi mandaram ||1.83.20||
ityārabhya ca yoginyaḥ kāśyāṃ tiṣṭhanti sarvadā |
caritvā dikṣu vidikṣu tiṣṭhantyāgatya tatra vai ||21||
nārāyaṇaṃ prabhajantyo divodāsaṃ namanti ca |
ātmanaḥ paramaṃ lābhaṃ manyante sma ca tāḥ sadā || 22|
kāśīsevākṛtātpuṇyādīśo’pyasmān sameṣyati |
kāśīṃ vinā sa tatrāpi duḥkhito’trāgato bhavet |||23||
iti niścitya yoginyaḥ śaṃbhorānandakānane |
atiṣṭhan saṃsmarantyastaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram |||24||
tāsāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi śṛṇvatra kamalālaye |
gajāsyā siṃhavaktrā ca gṛdhrāsyā kākatuṇḍikā ||25||
uṣṭrāsyāśvakharagrīvā vārāhasyā śivānanā |
ulūkākṣī ghoraravā māyūrī śarabhānanā ||26||
koṭarākṣī cāṣṭavaktrā kubjā ca vikaṭānanā |
śuṣkodarī lalajjihvā śvadaṃṣṭrā vānarānanā |||27||
ṛkṣākṣī kekarākṣī ca bṛhattuṇḍā surāpriyā |
kapālahastā raktākṣī śukī śyenī kapotikā ||28||
pāśahastā daṇḍahastā pracaṇḍā caṇḍavikramā |
śiśughnī pāśahantrī ca kālī rudhirapāyinī ||29||
vasāpānā garbhabhakṣā śavahastāntramālikā |
ṛkṣakeśī mahākukṣirnāgāsyā pretapṛṣṭhakā ||1.83.30||
dandaśūkadharā krauṃcī mṛgaśṛṃgā vṛṣānanā |
phāṭitāsyā dhūmaśvāsā vyomapādordhvadṛṣṭikā ||3 1||
tāpinī śoṣiṇī schaghoṇoṣṭhā koṭarī tathā |
vidyullolā balākāsyā mārjārī kaṭapūtanā ||32||
aṭṭahāsyā ca kāmākṣī mṛgākṣī ceti tā matāḥ |
catuḥṣaṣṭistu yoginyaḥ pūjitā navarātrake ||33||
duṣṭabādhāṃ nāśayanti garbhabālādirakṣikāḥ |
na ḍākinyo na śākinyo na kūṣmāṇḍā na rākṣasāḥ ||34||
tasya pīḍāṃ prakurvanti nāmānyetāni yaḥ paṭhet |
raṇe rājakule vāpi vivāde jayadānyapi ||35||
balipūjopahāraiśca dhūpadīpasamarpaṇaiḥ |
kṣipraṃ prasannā yoginyo prayaccheyurmanorathān ||36|||
kṛṣṇacaturdaśīrātrāvupavāsī narottamaḥ |
praṇavādicaturthyantanāmabhirhavanaṃ caret ||37||
pratyekaṃ havanaṃ cāsāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ matam |
sasarpiṣā guggulunā laghubadaramānataḥ ||38||
ekāgramanasā śuddhaḥ sveṣṭaṃ vicintya sarvathā |
yāṃ yāṃ siddhimabhīpsetāṃ tāṃ suprāpnoti mānavaḥ ||39||
atheśo yoginīcakre’nāgate ciramityapi |
sūryaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa jñātuṃ kāśīpravartanam ||1.83.40 ||
prāha śaṃbhustu sūryaṃ vai divodāsasya vai rave |
dharmakṣatyā nivāsaḥ syāttathā kuru divākara ||41 ||
dharmamārgasthitasyātra bhaktasya yo’vamānanam |
karoti tasya sarvasvanāśo bhavati bhāskara |||42||
yāvaddharme sthirā buddhiryāvadbhaktiśca mādhave |
tāvadvighnodayo nāsti tathāpi kuru ceṣṭitam ||43||
raviḥ śaṃbhorvacasā cāgamatkāśyāṃ manuṣyavat |
antarbahiścarankāśyāṃ divodāse prajāsu ca ||44||
dharmabhaktipravāhe tu manāk kṣatiṃ na caikṣata |
vatsaraṃ vicaransūryo’tithirbhūtvārthayacca tam ||49||
sarvaṃ saṃprāptavān paścād bahurūpāṇyadhārayat |
yācako bahudo dīno gaṇako mantrado’pyabhūt ||46||
kadācinnāstiko dhūrto jaṭilaśca digambaraḥ |
jāṃgaliko viṣavaidyaḥ pākhaṇḍī brahmavādyapi ||47||
vratakṛdaindrajālajñaḥ kathākāraḥ kapāladhṛk |
dvijo jñānī dhātuvettā khagolajñaḥ sumantravit ||48||
sādhuḥ sanyāsadharmā vai sanyāsinīsvarūpadhṛk |
vipraḥ kṣatriyavaiśyau ca śūdro brahmacaro gṛhī ||49||
vanasthaḥ saṃkararūpo’thāpi cāṇḍālarūpadhṛk |
ityevaṃ vicaran kāśyāṃ kvāpi chidraṃ na cāpa saḥ ||1.83.50||
tadāhyakṛtakāryo’sau gantuṃ tu mandara punaḥ |
neyeṣāvamānabhayād divodāsabalāttathā ||51||
kāśyāmeva kṛtāvāso bhaktilagnahṛdantaraḥ |
anivedanajanyainonāśo bhaktyā bhaviṣyati ||52||
dharmo hi rakṣito yena sarvaṃ tena tu rakṣitam |
ayameva hi saddharmaḥ kāśīsevanasaṃbhavaḥ ||53||
putramitrakalatrāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca dhanāni ca |
pratijanmeha labhyante kāśyekā naiva labhyate ||54||
divodāsasamo bhakto naivānyatra kvacinmilet |
tasmādatraiva vastavyaṃ niścityaivaṃ divākaraḥ |||55||
bhūtvā dvādaśarūpo’sau kāśīpuryāṃ vyavasthitaḥ |
lokārka uttarārkaśca sāmbādityaḥ khakholakaḥ ||56||
drupadādityo mayūkhādityastathāruṇāhvayaḥ |
vṛddhārkaḥ keśavārkaśca vimalārko yamāhvayaḥ ||57||
gaṃgādityau dvādaśetirūpaiḥ kāśyāṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||
bhajate śrīhariṃ nityaṃ divodāsasamāgame ||58||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divodāsachidrānveṣaṇāya catuḥṣaṣṭiyoginīnāṃ rūpāntaradhṛtiḥ kāśyāmeva vāso raveścāpi tathaiva tatkāryārthamāgamanaṃ kāśyāmeva dvādaśarūpairvāsaścetyādipradarśananāmā tryaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||83||

<1.84>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
lakṣmi devo mahādevo yaṃ yaṃ preṣayati prabhum |
sa saḥ punarna cāyāti cintāmagno haro’bhavat || 1 ||
nādyāpyāyānti yoginyo nādyāpyāyāti bhāskaraḥ |
kāśyāṃ vāso na vai syāccet kālo yāsyati kena me || 2 ||
adhākṣiṣamahaṃ kāmaṃ kāmo māṃ dunuyāttarām |
kāśīpravṛttimanveṣṭuṃ kaṃ vā prahiṇuyāmitaḥ || 2 ||
iti cintya vidhātāraṃ bahumānapuraḥsaram |
śivaḥ provāca yoginyaḥ sūryaśca preṣitā mayā || 4 ||
nādyāpi te nivartante kāśyā vijñāya vartanam |
nābādhiṣṭa tathā kṣveḍaṃ māṃ kāśīviraho yathā || 5 ||
vidhe vidhehi me kāryaṃ yāhi kāśīṃ yatasva ca |
adyaiva ca mayā satyā gantavyaṃ kintu dhārmikam || 6 ||
divodāsaṃ tu rājānamullaṃghayituṃ notsahe |
nānyarājye pravastavyaṃ nocchiṣṭaṃ bhojyameva ca || 7 ||
svastimān gaccha panthāste śubhodarko bhavatvalam |
ādāyājñāṃ vidhirdrāgvai kāśīmāyād vihāyasā || 8 ||
haṃsastho’paśyadānandavāṭikāṃ kāśikāṃ śubhām |
gaṃgā vṛkṣā janāḥ saudhā yatrānandamayāḥ sadā || 9 ||
kāśibhūrālocitā yairindriyaistāni santi vai |
varāṇi tṛṇadhānyāni kāśyāṃ yāni patanti hi || 1.84.1 0||
adya me saphalaṃ cāyuraho me bhāgyagauravam |
adya me phalito vṛkṣo deho yatkāśidarśanam || 11 ||
mayā sṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā sarvā bahudākṣyapuraḥsarā |
paramanyādṛśī kāśī devena nirmitā svayam || 1 2||
iti hṛṣṭamanā vedhā vṛddhabrāhmaṇaveṣadhṛk |
avatīrya kṣitau haṃsād divodāsaṃ dadarśa ha || 1 3||
rājñā saṃmānito vṛddhabrāhmaṇaḥ satkṛtastathā |
upaviśyāsane ramye cāśīrvādān dadau nṛpam || 14||
kośavṛddhiḥ satyadravye’saukhyavṛddhiḥ samāntare |
gativṛddhiḥ satyamārge kāśavṛddhistavāntare || 15||
rājā prāha kathaṃ dvyarthaṃ bhāṣase vṛddhabhūsura |
dharmabhaktyoryatra vṛddhistatra vṛddhiḥ satī sadā || 16 ||
adravye ca amārge ca sati vṛddhirbhayapradā |
adravye satyaṇḍavṛddhiramārge sati dhāvanam || 17||
varṣāntare hyasaukhyaṃ tu dhārmikasya na saṃbhavet |
adhārmikasyāntare tu asaukhyaṃ sadṛśaṃ bhavet || 18||
stutau prakāśavṛddhiḥ syādantare nānyathāvile |
kimicchasi vṛddhavipra dravyahīnaḥ kumārgagaḥ || 19||
hṛdi me kiṃ daṃbhavṛddhirvarṣapūrvaṃ ca duḥkhabhāk |
bhavāmyahaṃ divodāsaḥ itīcchasi kimīcchasi |||1.84.20||
kāśyāḥ palāyanaṃ me syāditīcchasi kimicchasi |
kūṭavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ kūṭaveṣadhṛk ||21||
kūṭadharmo bhavettatra kūṭāśīrvādavān bhava |
brahmā prāhātra kūṭaṃ ca kāpaṭyaṃ śṛṃgagauravam ||22|||
śreṣavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ śreṣṭhaveṣadhṛk |
śreṣṭhadharmo bhavettatra śreṣṭhāśīrvādavānaham ||23||
kāpaṭyaṃ yadi śāṭhyaṃ vai tadā tādṛṅ na cānyathā |
śāṭhyavāg brāhmaṇo yatra bhūsuraḥ śāṭhyaveṣadhṛk |||24||
śāṭhyadharmo bhavettatra śāṭhyāśīrvādavān bhavet |
rājā prāha tadā vipraṃ brahmāṇaṃ kūṭadharmakam |||25||
yadyevaṃ dharmamūrtistvaṃ kathaṃ śāṭhye pravartase |
śāṭhye parājayo bhāvyaḥ śāṭhyapādaḥ patatyadhaḥ ||26||
ehi vipra svāgataṃ te karomyaśāṭhyadharmataḥ |
pādyaṃ bhojyaṃ phalaṃ gāṃgajalaṃ peyaṃ prasādhanam ||27||
sarvaṃ gṛhāṇa viprendra vṛṇu yad hṛdi vartate |
brahmovāca gṛhītaṃ tat bhaktyā pravardhase nṛpa ||28||
vidyayā satyabodhinyā jayase dharmaṇā nṛpa |
rājāno bahavo dṛṣṭā yajvāno bhūridakṣiṇāḥ ||29||
śrotriyā nītinipuṇāḥ sattvaśīlā jitendriyāḥ |
kṣamādayāsugāṃbhīryadākṣiṇyasaumyabhūmayaḥ || 1.84.30||
paraṃ tebhyastvayi rājan guṇā dvitrā viśeṣataḥ |
prajā eva kuṭumbaṃ te brāhmaṇā eva daivatam ||3 1||
bhaktidharmau sahāyau te tapasvināṃ sahāyakaḥ |
ete nānyeṣu dṛśyante dhanyo mānyo’si vai satām ||32||
sadguṇaiḥ pūjanīyo’si bhaktyā dharmeṇa vardhase |
devā drohaṃ ca te kartumapi bibhyati dhārmika |||33||
ahaṃ tu brāhmaṇo rājan yajñān kartumihāgataḥ |
tvādṛśaṃ bhaktamāsādya mama vāso’tra bhūyatām ||34||
anyattu mantritaṃ dūraṃ tatsadā dūramastu vai |
atra tīrthatrayaṃ rājan tvaṃ gaṃgā bhūḥ parātparam ||35 ||
yatra kṛtānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ saṃvarte’pi na saṃkṣayaḥ |
saṃcitaṃ yaddhanaṃ yatnād viniyujyeta tanmakhe ||36||
iti joṣaṃ sthitaṃ vipraṃ divodāsa uvāca ha |
hariṃ yiyakṣamāṇasya tava dāso’smi sarvathā ||37||
kośād gṛhāṇa me yajñasaṃbhārān samapekṣitān |
svāmyamātyasuhṛtkośarāṣṭradurgasusainyakam ||38||
viniyuṃkṣvāvaśyakaṃ tatsvārthaṃ tanna manāgapi |
putraiḥ kalatrairdehena rājā prajāstu raṃjayet ||39||
prajāsantāpajo vahnirvajrādapi bhayaṃkaraḥ |
dvitrān vināśayed vajraṃ tāpo rājyaṃ kulaṃ tanum ||1.84.40||
viprapādarajobhistu karomyavabhṛthaṃ sadā |
viprānane prahutaṃ tanmanye yajñādviśiṣṭakam ||41||
ekaivādyāpi jāgarti samīhā brāhmaṇakṛte |
svadeho’pi tadarthaṃ vai cārpaṇāt saphalo bhavet ||42||
adya me saphalaṃ jayema kuru yajñān sudakṣiṇān|
yaja devān kṛtaṃ viddhi sāhāyyaṃ sarvavastubhiḥ |||43||
śrutvā rājño vaco viprabrahmā saṃbhāramāharat |
iyāja daśabhirgaṃgātīre’śvamedhayajñakaiḥ ||44||
yatra sthale ca tattīrthaṃ pūrvāṃ rudrasaro’bhidhām |
tyaktvā daśāśvamedhākhyāmāpede viśrutaṃ tathā ||45||
divodāsasya bhaktasya chidraṃ nāvāpa kiṃcana |
kiṃ vadenmandaraṃ gatvā śaṃbhoragre tu viśvasṛk ||46||
ato daśāśvamedheśaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ tathā |
svakāṃ mūrtiṃ ca saṃsthāpya vidhistatraiva cāvasat ||47||
divodāsasya satsaṃgād harerbhakto’bhavat sadā |
satyaloke ca vairāje vaiṣṇave śāṃbhave pade ||48||
mokṣākhyaṃ yadbhavetsaukhyaṃ tadvai kāśiniṣevaṇāt |
jyeṣṭhaśuklapratipadi snātvā mucyeta bandhanāt ||49||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam |
saṃdhyā devārcanaṃ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tatrākṣayaṃ bhavet ||1.84.50 ||
snātvā daśaharāyāṃ ca liṃgaṃ sampūjya cāpnuyāt |
puṇyaṃ daśāśvamedhīyaṃ na punargarbhamāviśet ||51 ||
brahmā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa sthito yāvacchivāgamaḥ |
brahmaṇe tu divodāso brahmaśālāmakārayat ||52||
ahalyayā kṛtā tatra brahmapurī suśobhitā |
ityeṣā bhūḥ sadā brāhmī brahmalokapradāyinī ||53 ||
divodāso mahābhaktaḥ kīdṛśo me’bhavat priye |
yasya brahmādayo devāḥ pratikartuṃ na cāśakan ||54||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne mandarācalataḥ śaṃbhupreṣitabrahmāpi viprarūpeṇa kūṭaślokadvārāśīrvādān dadau tatsaṃvādottaraṃ daśāśvamedhayajñān kṛtvā kāśyāmevovāsetyādikathananāmā caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||84||

<1.85>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahādevi mandare nivasan haraḥ |
śuśoca bahudhā tatra gatā nāyānti vai punaḥ || 1 ||
kiṃ vai kāśyāṃ sthitāste vākṛtakāryā hataujasaḥ |
nāyānti yoginīsūryavedhasaḥ prahiṇomi kān || 2 ||
cintayanniti deveśo gaṇānāhūya bhūriśaḥ |
preṣayāmāsa bho yāta kāśīṃ vivasituṃ drutam || 3 ||
śaṃkukarṇaṃ mahākālaṃ ghaṇṭākarṇaṃ mahodaram |
nandiṣeṇaṃ somanandikālapiṃgalakukkuṭān || 4 ||
kuṇḍodaraṃ mayūrākṣaṃ bāṇagokarṇatārakān |
tilaparṇaṃ sthūlakarṇaṃ dṛmicaṇḍaṃ prabhāmayam || 5 ||
sukeśaṃ vindatiṃ chāgaṃ kapardipiṃgalākṣakau |
vīrabhadraṃ kirātaṃ ca caturmukhaṃ nikuṃbhakam || 6 ||
paṃcākṣaṃ bhārabhūtaṃ ca kṣemakaṃ lāṃgaliṃ tathā |
tryakṣaṃ virādhaṃ sumukhamāṣāḍhiṃ skandameva ca || 7 ||
mahāśākhaṃ viśākhaṃ ca śākhaṃ nandinameva ca |
bhṛṃgiṇaṃ naigameyaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || 8 ||
ete gaṇā mahābhāgāḥ svāmibhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ |
kṛtvā māyāṃ bahuvidhāṃ bahurūpā vicakṣaṇāḥ || 9 ||
animeṣakṣaṇāstasthuḥ kṣoṇīśacchidrakāṃkṣiṇaḥ |
dharme satye dayāyāṃ ca daṇḍe prajāprapālane || 1.85.1 0||
rakṣaṇe dānadharme ca rājyadharme śrutau smṛtau |
varṇāśramavipaddharmadeśakālādidharmasu || 11 ||
pañcayajñajapabhaktisevāsatkāravṛttiṣu |
kvāpi kutrāpyalabdhvā vai kṣatiṃ truṭiṃ sacchidratām || 1 2||
rājānaṃ cāparābhavyaṃ divodāsaṃ prapūjya ca |
sarve gaṇā asiddhasvasvāmikāryāḥ sulajjitāḥ || 13 ||
svasvanāmnā mahādevaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya nirantaram |
kāśyāmeva nivāsān svān cakrire vigatajvarāḥ || 14||
na nivṛttā mandaraṃ te kāśīmāhātmyabodhanāt |
vārāṇasī na vai tyājyā svargādapi garīyasī || 15||
ānandodyānasaṃlabdhasukhatulyaṃ na cetarat |
atra kailāsa evāsti vaikuṇṭho’pyatra vidyate || 16||
kārśīṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ kāryā śuṣkā mandarasaṃsthitiḥ |
vārāṇasīti kāśīti ānandodyāna ityapi || 17||
mukhena yena saṃproktaṃ nāsti tasya yamādbhayam |
pañcakrośyā parimitā tanustridevasaṃbhavā || 18||
anākalitapuṇyānāṃ parikṣīṇadhanāyuṣām |
