yonidvāre skhalitaṃ tad bahireva pravāhitam ||18||
ayonijasya putrasyotpattaye’bhūddharīcchayā ||
atha pravāharūpeṇa jvālārūpeṇa retasā ||19||
uṣṇatejaḥsamudbhūtoṣmasvarūpeṇa cāmbare |
antarikṣe bhūtale ca prāṇino mūrchanāṃ yayuḥ ||1.97.20||
tacchāntyarthaṃ svayaṃ brahmā viṣṇuścānye divaukasaḥ ||
sasmarurmanasā cāgniṃ so’pyājagāma satvaram ||21||
devānāmanumatyā ca viveśa suratasthalam |
tadaṃgaṇamanuprāpya bhikṣāṃ dehīti tūcivān ||22||
pāṇipātrasya me hyamba bhikṣāṃ dehi vrajāmyaham ||
bhikṣāṃ tasmai dadau cāmbā dugdharūpāmupasthitām ||23||
paramānnaṃ dugdhapākaṃ pradattaṃ cāṃjalau yadā ||
tadā ca prāsarad retaḥ śaṃbhorvyomādhvanaścyavat ||24||
vahnyaṃjalau prapatitaṃ miṣṭaṃ sugandhi sadrasam |
nigīrṇaṃ miśritaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vahninā svayam ||25||
rasāsvāde mohito’gniranyadreto’pi yattvabhūt ||
vyomno’ntarikṣādbhūmeśca śayyāyāścālabheddhi tat ||26||
tat sarvaṃ bhikṣayā sārdhaṃ rasalobhācca mohataḥ ||
svayameva gṛhītvā tanmiśrayitvā muhurmuhuḥ ||27||
jagrāsāsvādayandugdhapākaṃ vīryaṃ ca bhāvataḥ ||
na kiṃcidavaśiṣṭaṃ hi putrārthaṃ pārvatīśaye ||28||
tadā cintāparā gaurī rasāsvāde pralobhinam |
vahniṃ śaśāpa bho vahne rasāsvādapradūṣaṇāt ||29||
bījaṃ putrātmakamapi śayyāsthaṃ bhakṣitaṃ tvayā ||
tasmād bhikṣo mama śāpātsarvabhakṣo bhavāśu vai ||1.97.30||
śāpaḥ prāpto mahadduḥkhamabhavadvahnimānase ||
reto na jīrṇaṃ prabalaṃ tejo’pyuṣṇataraṃ yataḥ ||31||
pratyuta vahniṃ tadretaḥ prājvālayadatīva ca ||
vahnirjājvalyamāno vai gatvā gaṃgāmahāhrade ||3||
vamati sma ca tatsarvaṃ vahniḥ svastho’bhavattadā ||
kintu vīryoṣmaṇā gaṃgā taptā dagdhābhavattadā ||33||
jalānyucchalitānyāsan tattāpaṃ naiva sehire |
gaṃgayā projjhito dhātuḥ śarastambe papāta ha ||34||
tatra samajvaladdhāturvahnibhrāntikarastadā ||
saptarṣipramadāstatra gaṃgāyāṃ snātumāgatāḥ ||35||
dṛṣṭvā prajvalitaṃ tatra snātāśca śītapīḍitāḥ ||
kṛttikāstaptusaṃkalpā hyarundhatyā nivāritāḥ ||36||
api tatrāgaman ṣaḍ vai ṛṣipatnyaśca tatsthale ||
yāvat tepuśca tāḥ sarvā retasaḥ paramāṇavaḥ ||37||
viviśū romakūpeṣu tāsāṃ tatraiva satvaram ||
sagarbhāstāśca saṃjātāḥ ṣaḍgarbhairjajvalurbhṛśam ||38||
śuśucuśca kutastādvai garbhavatyo bhavāma ha ||
dāhayatyakhilaṃ dehaṃ kimidaṃ tvanalādabhūt ||39||
tyajāmaścainamevātra nālakhaṇḍauṣadhigrasāt ||
pītvā rasaṃ ca tadretaḥ utsasṛjurbhuvastale ||1.97.40||
aikapadyena tadretaḥ ṣaṇmukhaṃ hāṭakaprabham ||
apatyaṃ drāgabhavadvai surūpaṃ sukumārakam ||41||
gaṃgāyāḥ puline jātaḥ kārtikeyaḥ pratāpavān ||
jāto yadā hi gaṃgāyāṃ ṣaṇmukhaḥ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ||42||
tadānīmeva girijā jātā snutapayodharā |
śivaṃ nirīkṣya tanvaṃgī he śaṃbho prasravaḥ stanāt ||43||
saṃjāto me mahādeva kimarthastannirīkṣyatām |
samādhinā mahādevo jñātvābravīt suto’bhavat ||44||
nāradena tadāgatya kathitaṃ janma tasya tat ||
śivāya ca śivāyai ca putro jāto’tisundaraḥ ||45||
tadākarṇya vaco viprāḥ ṛṣayaḥ pramathāstathā ||
kailāsaṃ bhūṣayāmāsurvitānadhvajatoraṇaiḥ ||46||
patākākadalīstaṃbhaiḥ svastimaṃgalamaṇḍanaiḥ ||
tadā surarṣayaḥ siddhāścāraṇā apsarogaṇāḥ ||47||
yakṣāḥ sarpā mānavāśca jagmurgaṃgātaṭaṃ śubham ||
draṣṭuṃ gāṃgeyamāruhya vṛṣabhaṃ śaṃkarastathā ||48||
pārvatyā saha sagaṇo gaṃgātaṭamupāyayau ||
tathā śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca nedustūryāṇyanekaśaḥ ||49||
kecinnṛtyanti gāyanti stuvanti tadguṇārṇavam ||
yāvatsamīkṣayāmāsurgāṃgeyaṃ śaṃkaropamam ||1.97.50||
dadṛśustejasā vyāptaṃ bālaṃ sūryasamaprabham ||
sumukhaṃ suśriyaṃ ramyaṃ sunāsaṃ sasmitekṣaṇam ||51||
prasannaṃ cārudaśanaṃ sarvāvayavasundaram ||
snigdhālakaṃ kumāraṃ taṃ devā vavandire tadā ||52||
pramathāśca gaṇāḥ sarve vīrabhadrādayastathā |
brahmā viṣṇurmahendraśca parivārya kumārakam ||53||
upasaṃsthāstathā cānye vāmadakṣiṇabhāgataḥ |
avatīrya vṛṣācchaṃbhuḥ pārvatyā saha suvrataḥ ||54||
putraṃ dadarśa cātmānaṃ snehapluto babhūva ha ||
upaguhya guhaṃ tatra pārvatī premasaṃplutā ||55||
prasnutaṃ pāyayāmāsa stanyaṃ cāṃke nidhāya vai |
cucumba pārvatī putramaślikṣat śaṃkaraḥ pitā ||56||
yojito hyāśiṣā sarvaiḥ śarkarā dāpitā tadā |
dānāni vividhānyeva dāpitāni hareṇa vai ||57||
dampatī tau tadā tatra caikapadyena rejatuḥ ||
kumārastu tadā reme dhṛtvā kaṃṭhasthavāsukim ||58||
atha tatragatā gaṃgā kṛttikāścāgnidevatā |
dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ mahārūpaṃ sabalaṃ sūryavarcasam ||59||
mamāyaṃ na ca te bālo vivadante sma cāgrahāt ||
bālaḥ prāha tadā sākṣānmadālokāt tu yatstanāt ||1.97.60||
dugdhaṃ parisnutaṃ snehāt tasyāścāhaṃ suputrakaḥ ||
ityuccārya nanāma svapitarau prāk tato’parān ||61||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyai śrīkṛṣṇapradattaputradvayarūpadarśanaṃ śaṃkarapārvatīvahnigaṃgāśarastambakṛttikādvārā kārtikeyajanma ceti pradarśananāmā saptanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||97||

<1.98>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śivaḥ prāha tadā devān kumāro’yaṃ pratāpavān |
jātamātro yuvā divyo devānāṃ kāryakṛnmataḥ || 1 ||
tad bhavadbhiḥ sanniyojyo yatheṣṭaṃ balavān kṛtī ||
devāḥ prāhustadā śaṃbhuṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhahetave || 2 ||
tārakādbhayamastyeva sarveṣāṃ jagatāṃ vibho ||
tasmāt senāpatitve’bhiṣecanīyaḥ sutastvayam || 3 ||
ityevaṃ sammatau tatra śaṃkaraḥ sumuhūrtake ||
saināpatyapradānāya lilekhotsavapatrikāḥ || 4 ||
gaṇā maṃgalapatrāṇi yayurnītvā caturdaśa ||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu ṛṣipitṛdyuvāsinām ||5||
yakṣarākṣasagandharvabhūtapretapalāśinām ||
mānavāsurasarpāṇāṃ kinnaroragabhūbhujām || 6 ||
pratigṛhaṃ pradadustāḥ patrikāśca śivājñayā ||
āyayuḥ ṛṣayaḥ satyalokāttu brahmaṇā saha || 7 ||
pitaraśca tapolokādagniṣvāttādayastathā |
barhiṣadā ājyapāśca somapā vatsarādayaḥ || 8 ||
pāvanā vahnayaḥ sarve yamapretā digīśvarāḥ |
samīyuśca sthale tatra manavo marutastathā || 9 ||
indraḥ kubero varuṇo yamo yamagaṇāstathā |
bālakhilyāstathā sarve saptarṣayaśca nairṛtāḥ ||1.98.10||
adharmadharmasantānāḥ sumedhāḥ stanayitnavaḥ |
vasantādyā ṛtavaśca kāmo bāṇādinānvitaḥ ||11||
viṣṇurlakṣmīpatirlakṣmyā pārṣadaiḥ saha cāgamat ||
devyaḥ sādhvyaścaturdaśalokagārhasthyaśobhanāḥ ||12||
vilāsinyaśca nartakyaḥ sevikāśca pativratāḥ ||
samājagmuśca bhūdevā nadā nadyaśca parvatāḥ ||13||
araṇyāni ca tīrthāni puryoṃ dhāmāni mūrtayaḥ ||
bhūtāni prāṇinastatra sūtamāgadhabandinaḥ ||14||
mānavā nāgasarpāśca vṛkṣā vallyaśca pakṣiṇaḥ ||
gaganasthā jalacaryāḥ sthalasthāḥ sthāsnujaṃgamāḥ ||15||
divyadehāḥ samājagmuḥ saināpatyamahotsave |
gāyakā nartakā narmakāriṇo nāṭakaṃvidaḥ ||16||
vādakāḥ sevakāścānye ye devādevajātayaḥ |
sarve tatra samāhūtā āgatāḥ protsavārthinaḥ ||17||
saināpatyasthānayogyaṃ bālakaṃ draṣṭumutsukāḥ |
vidhiṃ draṣṭuṃ samājagmuḥ prāyo draṣṭuṃ svarakṣakam ||18||
samājaṃ ca tathā draṣṭuṃ prāyaḥ sarve samāgatāḥ ||
śaṃkareṇa tadā svasya kailāsaḥ supariṣkṛtaḥ ||19||
maṇḍapo hi mahān svarṇaratnavastrādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ||
kadalīstaṃbhakalaśatoraṇollecaśobhitaḥ || 1.98.20||
paṭamaṇḍapalakṣāṇi koṭiśaḥ parṇaśālikāḥ ||
sabhāsthānāni ramyāṇi vihārodyānagopurāḥ ||21||
bhakṣyabhojyānyanantāni lehyacoṣyāṇi koṭiśaḥ |
peyāni svādumiṣṭāni saugandhīnyapi lakṣaśaḥ ||22||
dṛśyāni ca manoraṃjanakānyagaṇitāni vai |
amṛtāni vividhāni svāduphalānyanekaśaḥ ||23||
pakvānnāni sudivyāni sitāsudhājyavanti vai ||
atitṛptipradānyevaṃ tāmbūlādīni cābhavan ||24||
sthānopaveśanabṛsyo ratnasiṃhāsanāni ca |
javanikāsusaudhāni vimānāni hyanekaśaḥ ||25||
vāhanāni jalavyomabhūgāmīni ca koṭiśaḥ |
bhājanāni ca bhogyāni darpaṇāḥ keśadanturāḥ ||26||
puṣpāṇi tailasaugandhyacandanāni ca bhūriśaḥ ||
kuṃkumāni ca dhūpāśca dīpā vādyāni bhūriśaḥ ||27||
sthale sthale pṛtanādhipatyasūcakasudhvajāḥ ||
prasphuranti smāntarīkṣe gīyante jayagītikāḥ ||28||
muhūrte’bhijiti prāpte svastivācanapūrvakam |
vedaghoṣān pracakrurvai bhūdevāḥ ṛṣayastathā ||29||
yajñopavītaṃ rakṣāyāḥ sūtraṃ jayamaṇiṃ tadā ||
dhārayāmāsa taṃ skandaṃ bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ ||1.98.30||
tilakaṃ sākṣataścandraḥ kauṃkumaśca kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ ||
guruṇā gāṃgatoyaiśca prokṣaṇaṃ ca kṛtaṃ śubham ||31||
mantrā balapradāstatra yojitā dakṣakarṇake |
darbhaḥ karṇopari nyasto maṃgalaṃ mastake tathā ||32||
dravyaṃ tu prokṣitaṃ mūrdhni mukuṭo brahmaṇārpitaḥ ||
karṇayoḥ kuṇḍale datte kubereṇa tadā śubhe ||33||
samudreṇa tadā ratnahārāstasya gale’rpitāḥ ||
himālayena svarṇānāṃ bhūṣaṇānyarpitāni vai ||34||
dikpālaistattatpradeśodbhavadvastu samarpitam ||
varuṇenārpitaṃ chatraṃ śvetaṃ candrasamaṃ tadā ||35||
gaṃgayā ramayā tatra cāmare karayordhṛte |
indreṇa kavacaṃ dattaṃ saināpatyasya rakṣakam ||36||
saināpatyasya veṣaśca datto vai viṣṇunā svayam |
ādityena ratho datto raṇākṣatadṛḍhāṃgakaḥ ||37||
khaḍgaṃ carma pradatte vai dṛḍhe tu viśvakarmaṇā ||
śaṃbhunā tu dhanurdattamiṣudhyakṣayyasāyakau ||38||
cakraṃ tu hariṇā dattaṃ gadādaṇḍau yamena vai 
vajraṃ tadāgninā dattaṃ śaktiśca vāyunārpitā ||39||
mayūrāśvagajā dattāḥ parvatairvyomagāminaḥ ||
astraśastrāyudhahetipāśarṣṭitomarādayaḥ ||1.98.40||
pradattā vividhairdevaiḥ tadutsavasamāgataiḥ |
devībhirvividhāstasmai pradattāḥ śaktayo’kṣayāḥ ||41||
pārvatyāśīrvaco dattaṃ sarvadā vijayī bhava |
senābhogyaḥ parikaro munibhiścārpitastadā ||42||
nyūnaṃ sarvaṃ pūritaṃ ca tadā dakṣādirājakaiḥ ||
tato vijayaghoṣo’bhūtkārtikasya mahātmanaḥ ||43||
avādyanta ca vādyāni babhūvurjayaghoṣaṇāḥ ||
āsannugrāḥ surapakṣāḥ senāpatikṛtāvanāḥ ||44||
maṃgalāni vividhāni jātāni surayoṣitām |
samājastatra lokebhyaścaturdaśabhya āgataḥ ||45||
bhojyairmiṣṭairmiṣṭapānaiḥ suvāsyaiśca sutarpitaḥ |
puruṣāḥ pramadāścaiva vardhayanti sma śāṃkaram ||46||
senāpatiṃ mahāśaktaṃ durdharṣaṃ sarvato’dhikam ||
sainyānyapi suklṛptāni lokapālaistadā tataḥ ||47||
tadanyebhyastu saṃdatvā pātheyānyupadāstathā ||
śaṃbhunā preṣitāḥ sarve svasvadhāmāni te yayuḥ ||48||
atha sammilitā devāḥ brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ ||
mantrayāṃcakruradyaiva divāniśi mahāsuraḥ ||49||
diviṣadāṃ tārakākhyastrāsayate mahābalaḥ ||
ayaṃ skando mahāsatvo haniṣyati tu tārakam ||1.98.50||
dināni saptajātāni janmato’sya tathāpi vai ||
mahāsenāpatirjāto devadattabalairbalī ||51||
tasmādadyaiva yāsyāmastārakaṃ hantumudyatāḥ ||
matvā tatheti sahasā nirjagmustārakāsuram ||52||
tadā bheryo mṛdaṃgāśca paṭahānakagomukhāḥ |
avādyanta ca vādyāni tūryāṇi vividhāni ca ||53||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kārtikeyasya senāpatitvadhikāratadaṃgāyudhādivarṇananāmāṣṭanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ||98||

<1.99>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā loke bhayābhaye babhūvatuḥ ||
devānāmudyamaṃ jñātvā prabalastārakāsuraḥ || 1 ||
asurasainyakṛtkoṭyā yayau yoddhuṃ surānprati |
asurā rākṣasā daityā dānavāstatra saṃgatāḥ || 2 ||
ākrośanto mahādarpā niryayuryuddhavāṃchayā |
tāḍakasya mahatsainyaṃ tvāgataṃ devasannidhau || 3 ||
tadā devānnabhovāṇī prāha prasannatānvitā |
skandaṃ vijayinaṃ cāgre kṛtvā yāntu jayo bhavet || 4 ||
vijayārthaṃ tu pārvatyā putraḥ sa prakaṭīkṛtaḥ |
yeṣāṃ skandogrago yuddhe teṣāṃ vai vijayo dhruvaḥ || 5 ||
śrutvā devā jahṛṣurvai yoddhukāmāśca nirbhayāḥ |
brahmaṇā tatra tāvadvai noditaikā kumārikā || 6 ||
mṛtyoḥ putrī samāyātā mṛtyusenābhidhā tadā ||
varaṇārthaṃ kumārasya tapaḥ paramamāśritā || 7 ||
śatrūṇāṃ mārayitrī sā sundarī varamālayā|
kumāra kārtikaṃ tatra varayāmāsa mārtyavī || 8 ||
tayā yuktastadā skandaḥ senāpatiriyāya vai|
raṇāṃgaṇe tadā ghorā raktottejakagomukhāḥ || 9 ||
mahādundubhayo nedurḍiṇḍimānyadbhutāni ca |
raṇakarkaśatūryāṇi mṛdaṃgapaṭahānakāḥ ||1.99.10||
kharaśrṛṃgāṇi śaṃkhāśca bheryo’vādyanta utkaṭāḥ ||
aikapadyena cottasthuryoddhukāmāḥ surāsurāḥ ||11||
kumāraṃ gajamāropya devendro hyagrago’bhavat |
surasainyena mahatā lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ||12||
yamo’pi svagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ marudbhiśca samīraṇaḥ ||
yādobhirvaruṇastatra kubero guhyakairvṛtaḥ ||13||
śaṃkaraḥ pramathaiḥ sārdhaṃ nairṛto vyādhibhiḥ saha ||
antarvedyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve gāṅgayāmunamadhyagāḥ ||14||
pātālāśca samāyātāstārakasyopajīvinaḥ |
daityāśca dānavāścaiva rākṣasā asurāśca ye ||15||
gajā uṣṭrā eḍakāśca hayā aśvatarāḥ khagāḥ ||
syandanāni vicitrāṇi vimānāni ca bhūriśaḥ ||16||
padātayo bahavaścāśobhanta sāyudhāstadā |
khaḍgatomaranārācaiḥ pāśamudgarapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||17||
bāṇaparighacakraiśca śaktiśūlaparaśvadhaiḥ ||
taiḥ suyukte tadā sainye daityānāṃ ca divaukasām ||18||
śuśubhāte mahākālavakradṛṣṭyā nirīkṣite ||
yuddhāraṃbhadhvajau dṛṣṭvā mumucuḥ sāyakām̐stadā ||19||
bāṇānvavarṣurātīkṣṇān kṣuradhārānsamantataḥ |
śikhānardhacandrām̐śca tridhārānpaṃcadhārakān ||1.99.20||
bāṇairācchāditaṃ vyomāvidhyanta viśikhairbhaṭāḥ |
praphullakiṃśukā yadvad rājante kartitā bhaṭāḥ ||21||
sainye parasparaṃ bāṇaiśchanne garjanti tadbhaṭāḥ |
bhūmau ca patitāḥ kecitkecinmuṇḍā luṭhanti vai ||22||
keṣāṃcidbāhavachinnāḥ kaṃdharāśca vidāritāḥ |
hṛdayāni vinirbhinnānyanyeṣāṃ cūrṇitā kaṭiḥ ||23||
pāśairbhallairaṃkuśaiśca kuntaiśca ṛṣibhistathā |
bhaṭāśca bahavastatra bhūśayyā hyabhavankṣaṇāt ||24||
sadaṃśauṣṭhaśirāṃsyācchādayadvai raṇamaṇḍalam |
nṛtyamānakabandhāni dhāvantvanyajighṛkṣayā ||25||
bhaumaścaivāntarikṣaśca saṃgrāmo dāruṇo’bhavat ||
nāste paricayastatra śastrapātanakarmaṇi ||26||
jalpantaṃ śatrumādāya cūrṇayanti gadādibhiḥ ||
nadyaḥ pravartitā raktapravāhinyaḥ śavastarāḥ ||27||
rakte raṇāṃgaṇe raktaśchinnā bhinnā bhaṭāstadā ||
dvandvayuddhaṃ ca kurvanto jayāya bahavo hatāḥ ||28||
kujaṃbho vāyunā sārdhaṃ jaṃbhaḥ sārdhaṃ yamena vai ||
varuṇena balaścātha kubereṇa saha tripāt ||29||
agninā saha saṃhrādo naiṛtena mahāhanuḥ ||
īśena saha meghābha indreṇa saha tārakaḥ ||1.99.30||
yakṣāḥ piśācī uragāḥ pataṃgāḥ pitarastathā ||
vyādhayaḥ sannipātāśca jvara bhūtāśca guhyakāḥ ||31||
yuyudhuḥ pramathā astraśastraiśca bahubhistadā ||
evaṃ yuddhe sutumule devadānavasaṃkule ||32||
tārakeṇaiva devendraḥ śaktyā paramayā hataḥ ||
sadyaḥ papāta nāgādvai pṛthivyāṃ mūrchito’bhavat ||33||
svastho drāgeva saṃbhūtvā vajramādāya vegataḥ ||
vivyādha tārakaṃ vakṣasthale daityo’patad bhuvi ||34||
mūrchitaśchinnahṛdayo bhinnapṛṣṭhāsthidaṇḍakaḥ ||
śukreṇa sandhinīvallībalena sandhitaḥ punaḥ ||35||
utthitaśca jaghānendraṃ brahmāstraṃ prāṇanāśakam ||
viṣṇurnārāyaṇastadvai jagrāsa jihvayā drutam ||36||
indrastato mahāroṣānmahākālāstramādadhe |
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tvindraṃ mā mā māraya taṃ hare ||37||
tasya hantā kumāro’yaṃ samudbhūtaḥ śivātmajaḥ |
tasmādbhavadbhiḥ sthātavyaṃ bālena yudhyatā saha ||38||
senānītāḍakau cograu yuddhayamānau mahābalau |
śuśubhāte’tisaṃrabdhau prahārairjarjarīkṛtau ||39||
mahām̐statra gaṇo vīro vīrabhadro ruṣānvitaḥ ||
gaṇaiḥ subahubhiryuktastārakaṃ hantumudyataḥ ||1.99.40||
triśūlairṛṣṭibhiḥ prāsaiḥ khaḍgaiḥ parighapaṭṭiśaiḥ ||
jaghnatuḥ samare’nyonyaṃ surāsuravimardane ||41||
tārako vīrabhadreṇa triśūlena hato bhṛśam |
papāta sahasā tatra kṣaṇaṃ mūrchāmavāpa ca ||42||
utthāya ca muhūrtādvai śaktyā tu tārako balī ||
śivasyānucaraṃ śūlaṃ vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna ha ||43||
triśūlena tu ghoreṇa vīrabhadro’pi tārakam ||
jaghāna hṛdaye vegāttārakaḥ pothito bhuvi ||44||
hariḥ prāha tadā vīrabhadraṃ tu tārako’suraḥ ||
kārtikeyasya vadhyo’sti mā kuru tvaṃ pariśramam ||45||
na rocate’sya tadvākyaṃ tārakasya vadhaṃ prati |
vīrabhadro ruṣāviṣṭo jagarja jaladopamaḥ ||46||
atārakāṃ mahīṃ cādya kariṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ ||
tāvatkapardino’neke jaṭājūṭavibhūṣitāḥ ||47||
vṛṣārūḍhā daśahastāḥ śūrāḥ krūrāstrilocanāḥ |
pañcāsyā nīlakaṇṭhāśca gaṇā vai candraśekharāḥ ||48||
yuyudhuste mahādaityaistārakāsurajīvibhiḥ ||
devadānavadaityānāṃ sannipāto mahānabhūt ||49||
aśvavārāśca vājisthān gajino gajinastathā |
jaghnū rathasthān rathino vyomagā vyomagāminaḥ ||1.99.50||
vīrabhadrastārakaṃ saṃgṛhya vai pādayostadā |
bhrāmayitvāntarīkṣe’tha pothayāmāsa bhūtale ||51||
kṣayaṃ praṇītā bahavo’pare yātā rasātalam |
palāyamānā bahavo bhītāḥ prāṃjalayo’pare ||52||
śaraṇyāśca raṇādbhagnā mṛtāḥ kecidbhuvastale ||
nipetuḥ śikharāṇīva vīrabhadrādināśitāḥ ||53||
evaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ svakaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai tāḍakāsuraḥ ||
bhujānāmayutaṃ kṛtvā hantuṃ devagaṇān yayau ||54||
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā skandaṃ nānyo hantāsti kartika ||
tasmāt tvayaiva netavyastārako yamasādanam ||55||
tārakeṇa purā vīra tapastaptaṃ bhayāvaham |
tapasā tena cogreṇa hyajeyatvamavāptavān ||56||
jitā indrādilokeśāstrailokyaṃ ca jitaṃ tathā |
tasmāt tvayā nihantavyaḥ śāntiḥ syācca tadā parā ||57||
ityāśrutya tadā skaṃdaḥ śaktimādāya pāragām |
adhāvattārakaṃ tāvattārakaḥ śaktimādade ||58||
provāca daityo garviṣṭho devānavigaṇayya tu ||
indraḥ palāyito’thāpi yūyaṃ devā gatatrapāḥ ||59||
kumāraṃ yatpuraskṛtya raṇāgre’tra vyavasthitāḥ ||
maruto ghātitā garbhe dharṣitā gautamapriyā ||1.99.60||
viśvarūpo hato vipro vṛtro yena niṣūditaḥ ||
kārayituṃ kumārasya ghātaṃ kva pragato hariḥ ||61||
dakṣayajñe tvanekeṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ nāśako hyayam |
na bālo vai vīrabhadraḥ sannidhau mama tiṣṭhatu ||6||
vīraṃ cendraṃ kumāraṃ ca nayāmi yamasādanam ||
uktvaivaṃ tu tadā śaktitrayaṃ jagrāha tārakaḥ ||63||
tāvadindro bahudhāraṃ vajraṃ cikṣepa tārake |
patito’pi samutthāya śaktyendraṃ prāharadruṣā ||64||
patitaṃ cendramālokya gatvā padā nipīḍya ca |
vajraṃ tasyāharatpaścādyāvadindraṃ jighāṃsati ||65||
tāvat triśūlamudyamya vīrabhadreṇa tāḍitaḥ ||
patitaścāsuro bhūmau drāgeva punarutthitaḥ ||66||
prajaghāna triśūlena vīravakṣasi vegataḥ ||
vīrabhadrastataḥ kruddhastriśūlena jighāṃsati ||67||
kumāreṇa niṣiddho yat mama nāśyo hyayaṃ tviti ||
atho jayetyabhiprokto devairākāśasaṃsthitaiḥ ||68||
jagarja ca mahātejāḥ kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ ||
mūrdhni kaṇṭhe codare’pi jānvoścaiva kaṭibhramau ||69||
vakṣasi pṛṣṭha urasi tvanyonyaṃ pravijaghnatuḥ |
na vavau ca tadā vāyurniṣprabho’bhūddivākaraḥ ||1.99.70||
cacāla vasudhā sarvā saśailabahukānanā ||
himālayādayaḥ sarve parvatāśca cakampire ||71||
kumāraḥ prāha pāpiṣṭha devānāṃ duḥkhadāyaka |
ghātayāmi mahāśaktyā smara sveṣṭaṃ sthiro bhava ||72||
iti kṣiptā mahāśaktistīkṣṇāgrāṣṭapradhārikā |
tārake vakṣasi śīrṇe pāraṃ pṛṣṭhe jagāma sā ||73||
tārakaṃ viddhamādāya pṛthvyāmardhā viveśa sā |
viśīrṇastārakaścāyaṃ punaḥ skandena māritaḥ ||74||
dadṛśustaṃ suragaṇāḥ ṛṣayo guhyakāḥ khagāḥ |
kinnarāścāraṇāścāpi siddhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||75||
parameṇa praharṣeṇa tuṣṭuvustaṃ kumārakam ||
vidyādharyaśca nanṛturgāyakāśca jagustathā ||76||
devā nirāmayā jātāḥ santuṣṭāśca śivādayaḥ ||
girijā harṣamāpannā svāṃkamāropya cātmajam ||77||
pariṣvajya śubhāśīrbhiryuyoja jayinaṃ sutam |
pariśramaṃ kṣataṃ dehe sphāṭitaṃ vā praphullitam ||78||
pārvatī svakarasparśānnīrujaṃ tvakarotkṣaṇāt |
devāḥ kalyāṇarūpāya namaścakrustadā mudā ||79||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mṛtyuputryā senayā vṛṇītena kārtikeyena yuddhe tārakāsuro hata ityabhivarṇananāmā navanavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ || 99 ||

<1.100>
śrīśvetavyāsa uvāca
evaṃ suśikha sannaṣṭaṃ tārakaṃ lokahārakam ||
naṣṭaṃ śrutvā svayaṃ lakṣmīrnārāyaṇamuvāca ha || 1 ||
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇa mahāviṣṇo daityaḥ sa tārakāsuraḥ ||
ka āsīcca kathaṃ kasmādvaraṃ prāpto’tra me vada || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu caikahṛdā devi vajrāṃgasutatārakam |
mānaso brahmaṇaḥ putro dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ |
tena kanyā ditirdattā kaśyapāya mahātmane || 3 ||
tasyā garbhe marutdevā mahendreṇa vikartitāḥ |
ekonapañcāśajjātā devāste maruto matāḥ |
kintu ditisturāṣāho vināśāya tapo’karot || 4 ||
daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tena vajrāṃgadaḥ sutaḥ |
samutpanno janmataḥ sa vajrasāramayāṃgakaḥ || 5 ||
jātamātro mahāyoddhā śastraśāstraprapāragaḥ ||
uvāca mātaraṃ bhaktyā mātaḥ kiṃ karavāṇyaham || 6 ||
mātā prāha surendreṇa sutā me bahavo hatāḥ |
teṣāmapacitiṃ cikīrṣāmi śakravadhādaham || 7 ||
bāḍhamityevamuktvā sa jagāma tridivaṃ tadā |
pādenākṛṣya caivendraṃ māturantikamānayat || 8 ||
brahmā tāvatkaśyapaśca procaturmuñca vajriṇam |
avamānaṃ mṛtyurasya tvayā māturvacaḥ kṛtam || 9 ||
tathā piturvacaḥ kāryaṃ muñcāmuṃ tu sureśvaram ||
natvā sa pitroścaraṇe taṃ mumoca śatakratum ||1.100.10||
vajrāṃgadastato yāto vane kartuṃ tapo mahat ||
brahmaṇā ca tadānīṃ tu varāṃgī kanyakārpitā ||11||
tāṃ patnīṃ tu samādāya vajrāṃgo hyagamadvanam |
ūrdhvabāhuḥ sa daityendro’tiṣṭhadabdasahasrakam ||12|
tāvannadhomukhaḥ kālaṃ tāvatpaṃcāgnisādhakaḥ |
tataḥ so’ntarjale cakre tapo varṣasahasrakam ||13||
tatpatnī sarasastīre tapastepe pativratā |
indro vibhīṣaṇāścakre bhūtvā vai markaṭaḥ svayam ||14||
jalakuṃbhaṃ babhaṃjāsyā meṣarūpo bhayaṃ dadau |
sarparūpastato bhūtvā babandha caraṇāvubhau ||15||
gomāyūśca tato bhūtvā rauti sannidhimāgataḥ ||
agnirūpastato bhūtvā tasyā dadāha vastrakam ||16||
vāyurbhūtvā cakarṣaināṃ siṃho bhūtvā hyabhīṣayat |
tāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu vyatītaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ ||17||
āyayāvatha vajrāṃgo dharmavṛttiṃ tato’vṛṇot |
evamastviti datvā tadvaraṃ brahmā tirodadhe ||18||
śokārtāṃ svāṃ striyaṃ rājā vajrāṃgo’paśyadāha ca |
kiṃ te kāryaṃ dadāmīha mā śokaṃ kuru bhāmini ||19||
patnī prāha kṛpā cenme putraṃ duḥkhasya tārakam |
dehi cendraḥ sadā māṃ tu trāsaṃ dadāti cetyataḥ ||1.100.20||
vajrāṃgastu virakto’pi hyanukampyā priyeti yat ||
matvā tatheti jāyāyai punastapaścakāra ha ||21||
yāvadabdasahastraṃ vai nirāhāraṃ tapo’karot ||
brahmā prāha punastasmai kathaṃ vidhīyate tapaḥ ||22||
prāha daityo dehi putraṃ gīrvāṇadarpanāśakam ||
brahmovāca tava patnyāṃ putro vai duḥkhatārakaḥ ||23||
devasīmantinīnāṃ yo dhammilakavimokṣakaḥ ||
bhaviṣyatīti tatsthānāt daṃpatī tau prajagmatuḥ ||24||
svāśramaṃ cātha sā garbhaṃ ditirdadhāra tārakam |
pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu dadhārodara eva vai ||25||
tato jāte suputre tu pracacāla vasundharāḥ ||
celurdharādharāḥ sarve vavurvātāḥ prabhīṣaṇāḥ ||26||
sūryādyāśca jahuḥ kāntiṃ nīhārācchāditā diśāḥ ||
viṣaṇṇamanaso devā dānavāstu mahotsavāḥ ||27||
jātamātrastu daityendro hyabhiṣikto’surādibhiḥ ||
mahārājye’tha sarvānsa prāha surajigīṣayā ||28||
surāstu śatravo’smākaṃ jayyāste tapaso balāt |
tapaḥ kartuṃ tu gacchāmi pāriyātragirerdarīm ||29||
tatra gataḥ śivaṃ dhyātvā śivamantraṃ jajāpa saḥ ||
nirāhāraḥ pañcatapāstathāvarṣāyutaṃ gatam ||1.100.30||
tataḥ svadehādutkṛtya karṣaṃ karṣaṃ dine dine |
māṃsasyāgnau juhāvaiva tato nirmāṃsatāṃ gataḥ ||31||
dehaścāgnimayo jātastena bhūtāni jajvaluḥ ||
brahmā tasmai varaṃ dātuṃ suprasanno jagāma ha ||32||
brahmovācottiṣṭha putra varaṃ vṛṇīṣva cepsitam |
tārakaḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā varaṃ vavre tadepsitam ||33||
jātivaireṇa devāstu sarvadā trāsayanti naḥ |
ato daityasamuddhartā bhaveyamiti me matiḥ ||34||
avadhya sarvabhūtānāmastrāṇāṃ ca mahaujasām |
syāmahaṃ cāmaraścaiṣa varo deyo madīpsitaḥ ||35||
brahmā prāha ca taṃ mṛtyumṛte dehī na jāyate ||
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyustasmādanyad vṛṇu priyam ||36||
mohito’pi sa daityendraḥ śiśorāsaptavāsarāt ||
vavre mṛtyuṃ tathetyāha brahmā śaṃkaravākyataḥ ||37
daityo jagāma rājye sve mahārṇavataṭottare||
sarvasmṛddhipariṣvakto modate sa sabhājitaḥ ||38||
sarvāstrajñaśca śastrajño yuddharītiviśāradaḥ ||
sarvāndaityāndānavām̐ścāsurānnītvā svarāyayau ||39||
dikpālān lokapālām̐śca jitvā devāngrahām̐stathā ||
trilokyāśca svayaṃ rājyaṃ cakre devān vyavāsayat ||1.100.40||
svayamindro nimirvahniḥ kālanemiryamo’pi ca ||
jambhaśca niṛtisthāne mahiṣo varuṇastathā ||41||
meṣo vātādhikāraśca kujaṃbho dhanado’bhavat |
anyeṣāṃ cādhikārām̐śca daityebhyastārako dadau ||42||
evaṃ viprakṛtā devā mahendrasahitāstadā ||
yayuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaṃ dhāma tuṣṭuvuḥ parameṣṭhinam ||43||
namo jagatprasūtyai te hetave pālakāya ca |
saṃhartre ca namastubhyaṃ tārakād rakṣaṇaṃ kuru ||44||
brahmā prāha tadā sarvān jāne yuṣmān vivāsitān ||
tasya hantā ca nādyāpi sa jāto bhuvane pumān ||45||
sa ca vavre vadhaṃ daityaḥ śiśutaḥ saptavāsarāt |
sa vai saptadino bālaḥ skandākhyaḥ śaṃkarodbhavaḥ ||46||
kālarātrirmama tanuḥ dakṣaputrī satī ca yā |
tanuṃ tyaktvā punaḥ sā ca pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati ||47||
vivāhaḥ śaṃbhunā tasyā bhaviṣyati yadā tadā |
skandākhyaḥ khalu putro yo bhaviṣyati mahābalaḥ ||48||
saptadino haniṣyati senānīstārakāsuram |
prāpte tu samaye sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati harīcchayā ||49||
ityanenāgate kāle senānyā ca raṇāṃgaṇe ||
hato vai tārako daityaḥ śāntimāpustadā surāḥ ||1.100.50||
atha senānyanujasya gaṇeśasya ca tāṃ kathām ||
śṛṇu vacmi tato lakṣmi śrīkṛṣṇasmārikāṃ śubhām ||51||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne tārakāsurasya brahmaṇo varadānajanmādikathananāmā śatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||100||

<1.101>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato vasantasamaye śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ ||
kokilākūjitaṃ śrutvā ghrātvā saugandhikaṃ dravam || 1 ||
dṛṣṭvā śrāṃgārikaiḥ puṣṭaṃ yauvanaṃ ratisaṃbhṛtam |
patnīṃ svāṃke nidhāyeśo ramate sma ciraṃ ciram || 2 ||
śatavarṣasamaḥ kālo yayau ratikriyāparaḥ ||
viṣṇurvaraṃ pradattaṃ prāk smṛtvā tatrāgamatsvayam || 3 ||
pārvatyā cāgrapūjyo vai vṛtaḥ putro madātmakaḥ ||
ayonijaḥ sa evāhaṃ bhaveyaṃ miṣataḥ svayam || 4 ||
iti vicintya kṛṣṇaḥ sa vipro babhūva tatkṣaṇam ||
retaḥpātanakāle ca sa viṣṇurnijamāyayā ||5||
vidhāya viprarūpaṃ tadājagāma ratigṛham ||
jaṭāvantaṃ vinā tailaṃ kucailaṃ bhikṣukaṃ tathā || 6 ||
atīva śukladaśanaṃ tṛṣṇāvyāptahṛdantaram |
atīva kṛśagātraṃ ca bibhrattilakamujjvalam || 7 ||
bahugharghasvaraṃ dīnaṃ dainyāt kutsitamūrtikam |
karadaṇḍāvalambaṃ ca vārdhakyādatidurbalam || 8 ||
etādṛśena rūpeṇa ratikāle’nnayācakaḥ ||
bhūtvā sthito vadan svasti yajamānasya cāstviti || 9 ||
punarāha mahādeva kiṃ karoṣi śaraṇyada ||
paśya vṛddhaṃ jarāgrastaṃ kṣuttaṣādyatipīḍitam ||1.101.10||
saptarātrivrate’tīte pāraṇākāṃkṣitaṃ ca mām |
vitraṃ saṃbhojayitvātra rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||11||
māṃtaruttiṣṭha me’nnaṃ tvaṃ prayacchādya śivaṃ jalam |
anantaratnayukputri rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam ||12||
mātarmātarjaganmātarehi dehi subhojanam ||
sīdāmi kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ kasmāt sthitāyāmātmamātari ||13||
iti dīnaṃ svaraṃ śrutvā śivasyottiṣṭhato drutam ||
papāta vīryaṃ śayyāyāṃ yonimukhād bahirgatam ||14||
pārvatī tatra śayyāyāṃ nāvait patitavīryakam ||
svapityeva muhuḥ pārśve parāvartayati sma sā ||15||
dhātuḥ sarvopi pārvatyāḥ pṛṣṭhe pārśve tanau tadā ||
lagnaḥ śuṣko’bhavaddivyo rājato varṇataḥ khalu ||16||
na jānati śarīre me kiṃ lagnaṃ vai pariśramāt ||
svāpnanidrābhibhūtā sā svapityeva pariśramāt ||17||
śaṃkarastu bahidvāramājagāma dadarśa tam ||
yācantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dīnaṃ jarayā paripīḍitam ||18||
vṛddhaṃ jarjaramātraṃ ca bibhrataṃ daṇḍamānatam |
tapasvinamaśāntaṃ ca kurvantaṃ namanaṃ muhuḥ ||19||
śaṃkaraḥ prāha viprarṣe kimicchasi kuto bhavān ||
āgato’sti svāgataṃ te mama bhāgyādupasthitaḥ ||1.101.20||
adya me saphalaṃ janma brāhmaṇo madgṛhe’tithiḥ |
atithiḥ śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ pūjitaḥ pūjitaṃ jagat ||21||
devāstiṣṭhantyatithiṣu brāhmaṇāḥ puṇyadāḥ sadā |
atitheḥ pādapātreṣu vasanti tīrthajātayaḥ ||22||
atitheḥ pādasalilāt puruṣārthacatuṣṭayam |
prāpyate gṛhasaṃsthānairlabhyante smṛddhayo’kṣayāḥ ||23||
snātāni sarvatīrthāni yajñā nirvartitāstathā |
mahādānāni dattāni yenātithiḥ susatkṛtaḥ ||24||
vedaśāstrādivarṇyāni satkarmāṇi ca yāni vai ||
tāni cātithisevāyāḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||25||
asatkṛto’tithiryasya gṛhādvai vinivartate ||
pāpāni gṛhiṇe datvā puṇyamādāya gacchati ||26||
atitherasamarhāyāṃ viyanti pitṛdevatāḥ ||
sādhoḥ sādhvyā asatkāre gṛhī devairasatkṛtaḥ ||27||
sarvasampadvihīnaḥ syātpāpaṃ bhuṃkte darībharam ||
vipraḥ prāha śubhaṃ bhūyād brahmam̐ste’tithibhāvataḥ ||28||
jānāsi cedatithirme vedoktaṃ kuru pūjanam ||
manogataṃ ca dātavyaṃ nirāhārāya cārtiṇe ||29||
nānāvidhaṃ tu miṣṭānnaṃ dīyatāṃ me sutṛptikṛt |
tṛptaścāhaṃ bhavatputro bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||1.101.30||
sarvāgryārcyo bhaviṣyāmi bhaviṣyati bhavān pitā |
tātāḥ pañcavidhāḥ proktā mātarastvaṣṭadhā matāḥ ||31||
putrāḥ pañcavidhāḥ sādho tanmadhye’haṃ bhavāmi vai |
vidyādātānnadātā ca bhayatrātā ca janmadaḥ ||32||
kanyādātā brahmaṇoktā narāṇāṃ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ ||
guroḥ patnī garbhadhātrī stanyadātrī pituḥ svasā ||33||
svasā mātuḥ sapatnī ca putrabhāryānnadāyikā |
etā aṣṭavidhā mātā pūjanīyā suputrakaiḥ ||34||
bhṛtyaḥ śiṣyaśca poṣyaśca vīryajaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ||
pañca putrāḥ sadā bodhyā vīryajo’tra viśeṣakaḥ ||35||
kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ suparītāṃgaṃ putraṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam |
piṣṭakaṃ paramānnaṃ ca supakvāni phalāni ca ||36||
ikṣurasaṃ śarkarāṃ ca kṣīraṃ śālyannamityapi |
laḍḍūkām̐ścūrṇagodhūmān vyañjanāni tilāni ca ||37||
preyāṃsi peyakhādyāni picchalaṃ madhuraṃ dadhi |
mama priyāṇi vastūni sudhayā tulyakāni ca ||38||
tāmbūlaṃ ca varamelāpūgīkarpūramiśritam |
rasamiṣṭasugandhāḍhyaṃ dravyāṇyetāni dāpaya ||39||
svāmī tvaṃ trijagatkartā pradātā sarvasampadām ||
mahālakṣmīsvarūpā te patnī caiśvaryadāyinī ||1.101.40||
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ ramyamamūlyaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇam |
vahriśuddhāṃśukaṃ cāru pradāsyasi sudurlabham ||41||
sudurlabhaṃ harermantraṃ harau bhaktiṃ sudurlabhām ||
sarvasiddhipradaṃ nāma kimadeyaṃ sutāya te ||42||
icchayā kurute karma tato bhogo bhavatyapi |
sukhaduḥkhe sadā lagne dehināṃ viramedataḥ ||43||
karma nirmūlayantyeva santo hi satataṃ mudā |
harismaraṇaśīlānāṃ nāyuryāti satāṃ vṛthā ||44||
na teṣāmīśvaraḥ kālo nānye vā tanniyāmakāḥ ||
ciraṃ jīvanti te bhaktāḥ svacchandaṃ sarvagāminaḥ ||45||
jātismarā harerbhaktā jānanti janmanāṃ śatam |
kathayanti kathāṃ janma labhante svecchayā ca te ||46||
paraṃ punanti te pūtāstīrthāni svīyalīlayā ||
puṇyakṣetre’tra sevārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca bhramanti te ||47||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ padasparśāt sadyaḥ pūtā vasundharā ||
gurorāsyād viṣṇumantro yasya karṇe viśatyapi ||48||
taṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tīrthapūtaṃ kathayatyeva mādhavaḥ |
puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ pūrvamuddharanti śataṃ param ||49||
līlayā parayā bhaktyā sodarān pitaraṃ tathā |
mātāmahānāṃ puruṣāndaśa pūrvāndaśāparān ||1.101.50||
mātuḥ prasūmuddharanti dāruṇāt yamatāḍanāt ||
bhaktadarśanamāśleṣaṃ mānavāḥ prāpnuvanti ye ||51||
te yātāḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu dīkṣitāḥ ||
na liptāḥ pātakairbhaktāḥ santataṃ harimānasāḥ ||52||
trikoṭijanmanāmante prāpnoti janma mānavam ||
prāpnoti bhaktasaṃgaṃ sa mānuṣe koṭijanmataḥ ||53||
bhaktasaṃgād bhaved bhakteraṃkuro jīvito hara ||
aṃkuraścāvināśī ca vardhate pratijanmani ||54||
tattarorvardhamānasya harerdāsyaṃ bhavet phalam ||
pariṇāme bhaktipāke pārṣadaśca bhaveddhareḥ ||55||
tasmādbhaktiṃ harau dehi yathā te śrīharau sadā ||
gaṇeśarūpaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ kalpe kalpe tavātmajaḥ ||56||
bhaviṣyati śubhaṃ te’stu dehi bhikṣāṃ mama priyām ||
āgatosmi nivāsāya yadi te’pi mataṃ bhavet ||57||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pārvatyāḥ sahavāse śaṃkaramāhvayan śrīkṛṣṇo brāhmaṇarūpeṇa bhikṣārthamāgatastayoḥ sadbhaktamāhātmyasaṃvādaśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ekādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||101||

<1.102>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato yadvai sampannaṃ kathayāmyaham |
ityabhyarthya svapitaraṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram || 1 ||
tūṣṇīmāsa yadā vipraḥ śaṃbhurāśvāsya taṃ dvijam ||
gṛhāntare gataḥ śaṃbhuḥ pārvatīṃ nidritāṃ priyām || 2 ||
śīghraṃ prabodhayāmāsa bhikṣārthaṃ ca dvijātaye ||
sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa yadyadicchati vāḍavaḥ || 3 ||
pārvatī karapādādi śodhayitvā jalena ca |
viprepsitāni vastūnyāhārayāmāsa cāṃgaṇe || 4 ||
saṃkalpena tu siddhāni yānyapyanyāni vāñcchati |
tatsarvaṃ tatra vṛddhāya brāhmaṇāya samarpayat || 5 ||
na vai nyūnamabhūt kiṃcit tutoṣāti sa vāḍavaḥ ||
vastūnyādāya vipraḥ saḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||6||
putro bhavitumicchan vai tatraivādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||
pārvatyāstu śarīre yo dhāturlagno’sti śāṃkaraḥ || 7 ||
tatra dhātau praviṣṭo’yaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||
pārvatyapi tadā svāṃgeṣvabhilagnaṃ sacetanam || 8 ||
dhātuṃ dṛṣṭvā śārīraṃ tan malaṃ dhūlyādisaṃbhavam |
matvā śuddhiṃ tadā naiva cakāra parameśvarī || 9 ||
śarīraṃ bahudhūlyādimalāḍhyaṃ pravilokya ca ||
snānaṃ viśālaṃ sodgandhaṃ kariṣye’dya dine śanaiḥ ||1.102.10||
nirmalaṃ vai śarīraṃ ca nadyāmeva bhaviṣyati |
evaṃ vicāraṃ dadhatī sthitā prātaḥ śubhāsane ||11||
snānayogyavicitrāṇi gandhadravyāṇyakārayat ||
dāsībhirgṛhakāryāṇi maṃgalādīnyakārayet ||12||
atha śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ devanadyāṃ snānāya nirgataḥ ||
gaṇaiḥ saha sa vai yāto’nye gaṇāstamanudrutāḥ ||13||
kelāse pārvatīkṣetre gopure nāsti rakṣakaḥ ||
sarve gaṇāstadā yātā jñātvā snānotsavaṃ param ||14||
śaṃbhumarghyaiścandanaiśca tailaiḥ sugandhibhistathā |
saurabhaistilapiṣṭaiśca kaisareḥ karpuraistathā ||15||
upamṛdya mahādevaṃ snāpayanti sma dhārayā ||
gaṇānāmapi sarveṣāṃ vihārasnānatāraṇaiḥ ||16||
jalakelyādibhistatra sumahānutsavo’bhavat |
snānānte tu gaṇaiḥ śaṃbhoḥ saṃskṛtā tu śirojaṭā ||17||
bhasmapuṣpasugandhyādidravaiḥ saṃprokṣitābhavat |
lalāṭe bālacandrasya rekhayā saha candanam ||18||
lekhayā kṛtarekhaṃ tu carcitaṃ puṇḍrakaṃ yathā ||
karṇapūrau ca rudrākṣaiḥ kṛtau kaṇṭhe ca vāsukiḥ ||19||
hāro rudrākṣasampanno muṇḍamālāpi pauraṭī ||
karṇayordhatttūrapuṣpe rudrākṣadvayavuṭṭike ||1.102.20||
bhujayoḥ sarparājau ca prakoṣṭhe bhujagadvayam ||
kauśyastu mudrikā ratnaśrṛṃkhaleṃ’gulihastayoḥ ||21||
yajñopavītaṃ śubhagaṃ hasticarmasukaṃcukam ||
siṃhacarmakṛtadhautraṃ kaṭyāṃ ca muñjamekhalā ||22||
triśūlaṃ hastasannyastaṃ kaupīnaṃ mṛgacarmaṇaḥ ||
satkāṣṭhapāduke ramye śarīre bhasma saṃdhṛtam ||23||
atha netre dhyānayukte parāvṛtyārdhamelite ||
vyāghracarmaṇā prātarvai sandhyārthaṃ saṃsthito haraḥ ||24||
apāṃ kamaṇḍaluḥ pārśve pañcapātrāṇi cāgrataḥ ||
kuśapuṣpākṣatadhūpadīpacandanakuṃkumam ||25||
nyastaṃ gaṇaiḥ svayaṃ devo dhyānamagno babhūva ha ||
samādhiṃ svātmani prāpto nispṛhaḥ sarvathā sadā ||26||
yadā tiṣṭhati dhyāne vā samādhau śaṃkarastadā ||
nāsti kālasya niyamo nispṛhasya tṛṇaṃ jagat ||27||
samādhau saṃsthito devo gaṇāstatra tvitastataḥ |
nṛtyanti ca pragāyanti ramante ca vanādiṣu ||28||
vṛkṣeṣvārohāvarohau kurvanti ca svapanti ca |
phalamūlānyāharanti gṛhṇanti mādakāni ca ||29||
puṣpapatrāṇi cinvanti nayanti harasannidhau ||
nivedya dhyānamagnāya śaṃbhave’tha ca te gaṇāḥ ||1.102.30||
phalakandādi khādanti rasānāsvādayanti ca ||
evamutsavakartṛṇāṃ saṃgavastatra vai gataḥ ||31||
gaṇāḥ śaṃbhuṃ vihāyaiva na cāyānti haragṛham ||
pratīkṣate pārvatī tu nāyādeko’pi sevakaḥ ||32||
tataḥ snātuṃ samīhānā tailasaurabhavāribhiḥ ||
sugandhitadravairdevī sakeśaṃ snānamicchati ||33||
dvāre kaścinmayā sthāpyo dvārapālo nirodhakaḥ ||
snāne kaścinna cāgacched rahasīti vicārya vai ||34||
svasyā dhūlyādikaṃ lagnaṃ śaṃbhudhātumayaṃ malam |
svedamiśraṃ dravaṃ matvā viśliṣya kṛtapeśikam ||35||
puttalaṃ sundaraṃ tasya sarvāvayavaśobhitam ||
satyaḥ putro yathā vā syāt tādṛśaṃ viracayya ca ||36||
yāvatkareṇa dehaṃ taṃ snigdhacikkaṇatāptaye ||
parimārjayate mohāttāvat tāvattu tat svayam ||37||
caitanye sadrūpe bhāve vivṛtiṃ prāpya śobhate |
śiraḥ karatalenaiva yāvanmārjayate śivā ||38||
tāvattu mastakaṃ tasya sakeśaṃ sūjjvalaṃ hyabhūt ||
lalāṭe mukhanetrādau yāvaddhastau suyojitau ||39||
tāvannetre surūpe sugrāhake’bhavatāṃ tadā |
kapolau prollasadgolau lalāṭaṃ cārucandrakam ||1.102.40||
oṣṭhau raktau mukhaṃ mandahāsyakṛt kalidantavat ||
sunāsaṃ ca surūpaṃ ca nirvṛttaṃ tatkṣaṇācchubham ||41||
tāvattu pārvatī devī sahāsyā svasakhīstadā ||
āhvayate prapaśyantu bālo’yaṃ nirmito mayā ||42||
hasan bālo’pi mandaṃ svanetre tudghāṭya paśyati |
mātaraṃ tatsakhīśceti sarvānandakaro’bhavat ||43||
tato mātrā kṛtaṃ svasti putrasya karayostathā |
pṛṣṭhe vakṣasi kaṭyāṃ ca sakthnostathaiva jānunoḥ ||44||
jaṃghayoḥ pādayoścāṃguliṣu prokṣyadravaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||
svahastau bhrāmitau tasyāṃgāni pramārjitāni ca ||45||
yatra yatra pradeśe ca spṛṣṭe hastatale śubhe |
pārvatyāstatra tatrāyaṃ bālo bhavati cetanaḥ ||46||
surūpaḥ suṣṭhvavayavaḥ puṣṭaśca mātṛjo yathā |
krīḍayā puttalaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ putro jātaḥ sa cetanaḥ ||47||
ityāścaryaṃ mahatprāpya pūjanaṃ prāṇarakṣaṇam ||
sarvāvayavapūrṇatvaṃ kṛtaṃ devyā viśeṣataḥ ||48||
saṃsmṛtya pārvatī kṛṣṇapradattaṃ varadānakam ||
ayonijo’grapūjyaste putraścānyo bhavediti ||49||
tadidaṃ varadānaṃ vai kṛṣṇarūpaṃ suputrakam |
matvā niścayatastasya mahāpūjanamācarat ||1.102.50||
sugandhaiḥ snāpito dravyairarcito bhojitastathā |
śrṛṃgāravastubhiḥ samyaka śobhito bodhitastayā ||51||
mama putreti cāhūya cumbanaṃ sā vyadhānmuhuḥ |
stanyapānaṃ nidhāyāṃke’kārayatprāha pārvatī ||52||
mama rakṣākaraḥ putraḥ kṛṣṇo’yaṃ bhagavān svayam |
prādurbhūto mama kalpavādapaḥ phalito’dhunā ||53||
aho sakhyaḥ kumāraṃ me vardhayantu śubhāśiṣā ||
sakhya āyāntu putraṃ me balaṃ dadatu rakṣakam ||54||
aho ālyaḥ kumāraṃ me śirastrāṇaṃ sukaṃcukam |
yajñopavītakaṃ ramyaṃ hāraṃ kāṃcanajaṃ tathā ||55||
ratnahīrakabhūṣāśca dhārayantu yathāsthalam |
dhautraṃ pītāmbaraṃ kaṭisūtraṃ ca kaṭibandhanam ||56||
samarpayantu tadyogyaṃ dadatvanyadapekṣitam ||
kurvantu jayatilakaṃ candrakaṃ sākṣataṃ tathā ||57||
evaṃ śrṛṃgāritaścāpi vardhitaśca sakhījanaiḥ ||
satyā ca bodhito me tvaṃ rakṣako bhava gopure ||58||
dattānyasmai mahaddhāryaṃ triśūlaṃ carma khaḍgakam |
śaktiḥ pāśaḥ kuṭhāraśca rakṣāyā māliketi ca ||59||
evaṃ susajjya putraṃ taṃ śaṃbhoranyūnasadbalam ||
svasnānodyānamārgasya gopure’sthāpayat satī ||1.102.60||
tayājñapto vayaṃ snāmo devanadyā hṛde śubhe ||
udyāne saṃsthite tatra jalāgādhe ramāmahe ||61||
mama putro gaṇeśastvaṃ mā praveśaya kaṃcana |
yāvadvayaṃ nivṛttāḥ sma snānādatra gṛhāṃgaṇe ||6||
tāvatkaścijjano nāyād gopurāntaramityayam ||
ādeśo me tvayā rakṣyo mā pumān viśatu sthalīm ||63||
yadi prasahya cāgacched balāttaṃ vinivārya vai |
rakṣaṇaṃ tava mātustu pārvatyā me karotviti ||64||
yāvatsnānāni jāyante tāvanna praviśennara |
evamuktvā dṛḍhayitvārpayitvā cāyudhāni sā ||65||
mantrāṇyapi tadā datvātiṣṭhipadgaṇanāyakam ||
so’yaṃ gopuramavati yathādeśamatandritaḥ ||66||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kṛṣṇātmakaviprasya bhikṣāprāptyuttaramadṛśyatā pārvatyāḥ śārīradhātumalād gaṇeśotpattiḥ saprāṇagaṇeśasya pārvatyāḥ snānakāle gopurarakṣārthaṃ niyuktiścetyādivarṇananāmā dvyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 102 ||

<1.103>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu priye sahālībhiḥ pārvatī harasundarī ||
devyaḥ sarvāśca dāsyaśca militvā dyunadīṃ saha || 1 ||
gatāḥ snānārthamityatra niḥśaṃkaṃ snānti vāriṣu |
sugandhisāratailāni sammṛdyātyamṛtāni ca || 2 ||
dadhīni madhubhiścāpi rasyānyapi kaṭūni ca |
sakhyaḥ snānaṃ kārayanti pārvatīṃ jagataḥ prasūm || 3 ||
ramayanti jale tāṃ vai prāṃjalakṣepaṇādibhiḥ ||
sugandhi salilaṃ jātaṃ sugandhadravamiśritam ||4||
snāne sakhīvihāre’tra tṛptirnāsāṃ prajāyate ||
snānti caiva punaḥ snānti patanti salile muhuḥ || 5 ||
vinirgatya punaḥ snānti snānāntaṃ naiva yānti hi ||
saṃgavo vigataḥ kālaḥ śaṃbhurdhyānād bahistadā || 6 ||
āgataḥ svāsanaṃ tyaktvā caikākī svāśramaṃ gataḥ ||
gaṇāṃścānye na jānanti snānalagnāstadābhavan || 7 ||
śaṃbhuḥ svābhāviko dhyānī śanaiḥ śanaiḥ prayāti hi ||
svāśramasya mahaddvāraṃ yāvat praviśatīśvaraḥ || 8 ||
tāvatpārvatyātmajena niruddho yāhi mā tviti ||
kastvaṃ kasmātsamāyātaḥ karamādviśasi gopuram || 9 ||
tiṣṭha vivṛtya taṃ mārgaṃ yāhi yenāgato’tra vai ||
nātra sthātuṃ pradeyo vai mayā kau’pi jano naraḥ ||1.103.10||
ājñā nāstyeva me mātustasmādvigaccha gopurāt |
tathāpi śaṃkarastasya naiva śrutvā prayāti hi ||11||
tāvat krodhasamāviṣṭo gaṇeśo mātṛsevakaḥ |
prodghuṣya ca samutplutya pradudrāva haraṃ prati ||12||
gatvā tanmārgamārudhya mā gacchoktvā hyupasthitaḥ |
parāgaccha parāgaccha ko’si kva gacchasi drutam ||13||
atrodyāne praveśāya manmātrājñā na vartate 
snānaṃ kurvanti sakhyaśca manmātrā saha vāribhiḥ ||14||
mā yāhi naiva gantavyaṃ vigaccheto bahiḥ pivan |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tamajñātvā ko’si roddhā mama gṛham ||15||
mamodyānaṃ tu gacchāmi kastvaṃ roddhā mamāpi ca ||
gaccha yāhi tvitaḥ sthānāt kayā tvaṃ yojito’tra vai ||16||
bahirgaccha mama dvārādgopurānmama rakṣitāt |
ityākruśya hareṇa svamavijñāya tu bālakam ||17||
haste dhṛtvā gopurāt sa bahirniṣkāsito balāt |
tāvadgaṇeśastaddhastāddhastaṃ svaṃ praviyujya ca ||18||
śaṃbhuṃ hastadvaye dhṛtvā cākruśya nītavān bahiḥ |
prāha śaṃbhuṃ yāhi dūraṃ mā mukhaṃ me pradarśaya ||19||
śaṃbhunāpi tadā jñātaṃ matto’pi balavānayam |
na vai śārīrayuddhena jetuṃ śakyo bhavedayam ||1.103.20||
aho madīyaḥ kailāso gṛhodyānaśca rakṣasā ||
svāyattīkṛta evaitya kenāpi dhruvamarthataḥ ||21||
kva syād devī mama patnī kimabhūd viparītakam |
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayā cādya hyayaṃ tu balavāniti ||22||
yadi gatvā gaṇān vakṣye tadā me balahīnatā ||
hāsyāspadatvamāpnuyāṃ yuddhe cāpi parājayam ||23||
svasya mānaṃ dhanaṃ mantraṃ cāvamānaṃ ca maithunam |
dānaṃ dharmaṃ gṛhakleśaṃ kāryaṃ naiva prakāśayet ||24||
tataḥ kimiti vai kāryaṃ bālo’yaṃ balavāniti |
pārvatī ced vijānīyād yuddhe śaṃbhuḥ parājitaḥ ||25||
tadagre ca mayā bhāvyaṃ natakaṃdharavartinā |
vaktyayaṃ pārvatīputraḥ kimevaṃ saṃbhavediti ||26||
sarvasmājjayamicchedvai putrācchiṣyātparājayam ||
ataḥ sāmnā bodhayitvā gacchāmi mama mandiram ||27||
vicāryetthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā yāvadvadati śaṃkaraḥ |
gaṇeśo’pi tadā dvāraṃ niruddhya pratitiṣṭhati ||28||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mamaiṣo vai kailāso vartate gṛham ||
patnī bhāryā mama devī pārvatī vartateṃ’gaja ||29||
māhaṃ tvayā niroddhavyo gantuṃ dehi mama gṛham ||
śrutvaitatsa gaṇeśastu prāha taṃ roṣataḥ khalu ||1.103.30||
mā vocaḥ śaṭha patnīti bhāryeti cāṃgajeti ca ||
mārayiṣyāmi ca tvāṃ vai no ced gacchasi dūrataḥ ||31||
sthūlo mahānaraṇyastho gaccha dūraṃ na te gamaḥ |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca taṃ jñātvā mātṛbhaktaṃ samudyatam ||32||
aho bāla na te mātā na pitā te’sti kaścan |
mātā piteti nāmnā vai svārthamātranibandhanā ||33||
kathaṃ prāṇān priyām̐styaktumīhase mātṛnāmataḥ ||
haniṣye tvāṃ triśūlena no cenmuñcasi mārgakam 34
ityuktvā taṃ haraścāpāsārayat svakareṇa vai |
gaṇeśo’pi haraṃ cāpāsārayat svakareṇa hi ||35||
gopurānnirgatau bāhye deśe yuyudhatuśca tau ||
keśākeśi muṣṭāmuṣṭi daṇḍādaṇḍi nijaghnatuḥ ||36||
bahubalena pāśena bāhubhirjānubhistathā |
kaphoṇikābhiranyonyaṃ tāḍayāmāsaturmuhuḥ ||37
tayostu tāḍanaṃ tatra tvākaṇṭhāgraṃ yadā hyabhūt ||
gaṇeśastu tadā śaṃbhumūrdhvamuttolya vegataḥ ||38||
bhuvi prakṣipya tadvakṣaḥ prapīḍyopari saṃsthitaḥ ||
yuvā kruddho gaṇeśastaṃ mūḍhamāramamārayat ||39||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha aho hā hā mṛto’smi muñca māṃ yadi |
tadā te laḍḍukāndatvā pūjayiṣyāmi cāgrataḥ ||1.103.40||
gaṇeśastu tadā tyaktvā śaṃbhuṃ pārśve sthito’bhavat |
śaṃbhurjaṭāṃ samāṃ kṛtvā dhulīrdehādamārjayat ||41||
svastho bhūtvā ca yāvadvai gopurāntarvivikṣati ||
triśūlaṃ tu gaṇastāvat samādāya ruṇaddhitam ||42||
śaṃbhuścāpi mahākruddhaḥ prāha bālamaninditam ||
kathaṃ prāṇān vihātuṃ tvaṃ mayā virodhamicchasi ||43||
gacchāntaḥ pṛccha jananīṃ śaṃkaraḥ ko bhavettava ||
yadi sā kathayenmāṃ svapatiṃ dehi praveśanam 44||
gaṇeśaḥ prāha dhūrtastvaṃ vadhyo bhavasi śastrataḥ |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha varākastvaṃ vadhyo bhavasi śūlataḥ ||45||
gaṇaḥ prāha svamātrārthaṃ yadi prāṇāḥ paretakāḥ ||
tadāpi me śubhaṃ bhūyāt svargaṃ vindāmi sevayā ||46||
mātrarthaṃ janakārthaṃ ca patnyarthaṃ ca satāṃ kṛte ||
prāṇādyarpayitā yāti svargaṃ vā mokṣamityapi ||47||
yadi prāṇā mama yānti mātrarthaṃ saphalaṃ januḥ |
hato yadyajñātapitrā tathāpi saphalaṃ januḥ 48||
evamuktvā namaḥ kṛtvā jagrāha ca triśūlakam |
śaṃbhūrapi varaṃ putrahastānmṛtyumupasthitam ||49||
yāvadajñātacaryau svastāvat snehaḥ kuto mataḥ ||
mṛtyurbuddhimatāpohyo yāvadbuddhibalodayam ||1.103.50||
vicāryetthaṃ hariṃ smṛtvā jagrāha svatriśūlakam ||
parasparaṃ prajaghnaturdayāṃ kṛtvā tu pṛṣṭhataḥ ||51||
gaṇeśena tadā śaṃbhostriśūlaṃ parigṛhya ca |
dvivṛttaṃ valayaṃ kṛtvā kṣepitaṃ bhūtale drutam ||52||
dṛṣṭvā bālabalaṃ śaṃbhuḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ sumohitaḥ |
punaḥ paraśumādāya jaghāna gaṇakaṃdhare ||53||
gaṇastaṃ paraśuṃ svasya kuṭhāreṇa babhaṃja vai ||
dvedhā jātaṃ tu paraśuṃ tyaktvā śaktimupādade ||54||
gaṇeśo’pi tvaritaḥ san utplutya vyomavartmani |
śaktiṃ vidhṛtya ca balācchaṃbhuṃ tayā jaghāna saḥ ||55||
mūrchito roṣamāpanno niṣasāda haro bhuvi ||
punarutthāya yāvadvai khaḍgaṃ gṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ ||56||
gajastāvat triśūlena khaḍgaṃ dvedhā babhaṃja ha ||
śaṃkaraścātikhinnaḥ san mahākālasurūpadhṛk ||57||
gaṇasyaiva triśūlaṃ tvāskandya prāmārayad gale ||
chinnaḥ kaṇṭho gaṇeśasya patitaṃ mastakaṃ bhuvi ||58||
kṛṣṇe tallīnatāṃ prāptaṃ kabandho vartate’tra tu |
śaṃbhuḥ saroṣatāmrākṣaḥ snātvā svāṃ pārvatīṃ prati ||59||
tatra sthāne gato yāvad dṛśyate kālarūpadhṛk |
pārvatī bhayamāpannā drāgeva pādayorgatā ||1.103.60||
kṣamāpaya mahādeva kiṃ krodho deharaktatā |
kiṃ kṛtaṃ bhavatā svāmin kathaṃ raktapluto bhavān ||61||
kva yuddhaṃ kena sākaṃ vā jātaṃ cāniṣṭamāgatam |
śaṃbhustadā priyāśliṣṭaḥ śānto bhūtvābravīdidam ||62||
ko’yaṃ gopurasaṃroddhā tvayā rakṣita ujjaḍaḥ |
kiṃ kiṃ deva kṛtaṃ kiṃ vā kiṃ jātaṃ vada me bhramaḥ ||63||
tava putro gaṇeśaḥ sa bahunā tapasārthitaḥ ||
mayā snānaprakālasyetarapraveśarodhakaḥ ||64
niṣāditaḥ kimaniṣṭaṃ jātaṃ prāṇada me vada |
iti kṛtvā gale lagnāṃ śaṃbhuḥ prāha mṛto hyayam ||65||
mayā triśūlaghātena nāśitaḥ kādviyojitaḥ |
pārvatī tu samāśrutya roditī kurarīva sā ||66||
aho putrajaneḥ saukhyaṃ nidhane duḥkhamityapi ||
patiṃ tyaktvā satvaraṃ so dudrāva gopuraṃ prati ||67||
patitaṃ tatkabandhaṃ tu svāṃke sthāpyaruroda ha ||
svātmābhimānajaṃ duḥkhaṃ sati jñāne nivartate ||68||
putraṃ śocāmi kiṃ vā me patiṃ śocāmi nāśakam |
gṛhe hantā ca ghātyaśca kaṃ śocāmi gṛhiṇyaham ||69||
re putra tvaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo ha janimṛtireva ha |
na vai te maraṇaṃ yogyaṃ hyevaṃ cecca mriye’pyaham ||1.103.70||
yadi tvāṃ na jīvayate śaṃkaraste vināśakaḥ ||
anāhāravrataṃ kṛtvā yātrāpāraṃ karomyaham ||71||
ityuktvā hyaśanaṃ tyaktvā vilalāpa muhurmuhuḥ ||
saṃgṛhya gopurasthāne kabandhaṃ tatra saṃsthitā ||72||
aho ho lokamātā sā hyaśokāpi śucānvitā |
loko’yaṃ dehasambaddho jñānināmapi śokakṛt ||73||
kṣaṇaṃ bhavati saṃmohādbhrāmakaḥ kā vicitratā |
śrutvā vilāpaṃ pārvatyāḥ sakhyastatra samāgatāḥ ||74||
śaṃbhuśca kārtikeyaśca brahmaviṣṇusurādayaḥ |
gaṇāśca prāyayuḥ sarve vilopaṃ cakrire tadā ||75||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu śoko’yaṃ prasṛto drutam ||
ājagmustatkṣaṇe tatra caturdaśabilasthitāḥ ||76||
śokārtāṃ pārvatīṃ devyo bodhayanti narāstathā |
śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ vicāraṃ saṃcakre tajjīvanāya ca ||77||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśaśaṃkarayoryuddhe gaṇeśamastakacchedatajjanyaśokaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 103 ||

<1.104>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
etasminnantare tatra vāg babhūvāśarīriṇī |
mā śokaṃ kuru deveśi sutaste kṛṣṇa īśvaraḥ || 1 ||
yattejo yoginaḥ śaśvad dhyāyanti satataṃ mudā |
dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavā devā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ || 2 ||
yasya pūjyasya sarvāgre kalpe kalpe ca pūjanam |
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvavighno vinaśyati || 3 ||
nāsīt sa bhikṣuko vipraḥ sa āsīdvai janārdanaḥ ||
kiṃ vā vilāpaṃ kuruṣe na nāśastava śāṃkareḥ || 4 ||
eṣāṃ sarasvatīṃ śrutvā dhairya cālambya yatnataḥ ||
tathāpi virahāt sābhūd vilapya kṣaṇamūrchitā || 5 ||
vismitāste surāḥ sarve putradehoparipragām ||
mṛtāmiva prapaśyanti citraputtalikāṃ yathā || 6 ||
devyaścaiva surāścaiva sarve’pi duḥkhamūrchitāḥ ||
tānsarvāṃstu tadavasthān dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ | 7 ||
sadvākyairbodhayāmāsa śītādbhirvyajanaistathā ||
sukhayitvākarot tatra prastāva śāṃkarikṛte || 8 ||
kiṃ kāryamasya bālasya mastakasya suyojane |
prāṇa ātmā tu pārvatyāḥ śaktyā nihita eva vai || 9 ||
sa cātra punarāgacchetpārvatyāstu prabhāvataḥ ||
mastakaṃ tu gaṇeśasya kṛṣṇe vilīnatāṃ gatam ||1.104.10||
tasmād dvitīyamāptavyaṃ mastakaṃ tu śivādibhiḥ ||
gaṇeśo jīvito bhūyādasmābhiḥ pūjito bhavet ||11||
brahmā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ bhavān sarvajña ucyate ||
karmaṇāṃ gativettā tvaṃ ṛṇānubandhabhānavān ||12||
kasya kena samaṃ karma bhogyaṃ vetti na cāparaḥ ||
vṛkṣaśākhā paricchinnā bhuvi nyastāpi rohati ||13||
tatra bījaṃ vinā jīvaḥ karmabalāt suyujyate |
kecid bījācca kecidvai dehāt kīṭādayo’pare ||14||
pārthivakardamādanye stambāt kāṇḍācca māṃsataḥ ||
annādanye dehayogāddhātuyogāt tathāpare ||15||
jāyante jantavasteṣāṃ svasvakarmānusārataḥ ||
tasmāt tvameva vijñātā mastakaṃ kīdṛśaṃ bhavet ||16||
yasmānena śarīreṇa mastakasyaṛṇaṃ bhavet |
tasyaiva mastakaṃ tvatra kabandhe yojyameva vai ||17||
brahmā prāha tadā sarvān yamo gacched vanāntare|
prathamaṃ yo milet prāṇī tadā tasyaiva mastakam ||18||
gṛhītvā ca samāgatya gaṇaskandhe niyojayet ||
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā tatra mama śṛṇvantu devatāḥ ||19||
uttarasyāṃ diśi puṣpabhadrāyāḥ saritastaṭe |
asya ṛṇānubandhyeko hastī vartata ityamum ||1.104.20||
hastinaṃ prati gatvāhaṃ mastakaṃ tasya śobhanam || 
kabandhaitatpariṇāhamānagrīvasumaṇḍalam ||21||
chitvā sudarśanenaiva nayāmi tatra yāmi ca ||
ityāśvāsya ca tānsarvānāruhya garuḍaṃ hariḥ ||22||
jagāma puṣpabhadrāyāstaṭe yatra sa ībharāṭ |
sughaṭṭavṛkṣavallyādisaṃvṛte tatra kānane ||23||
gajendraṃ divyavapuṣaṃ śvetaṃ svahastinīyutam |
tathodakaśirasaṃ ramyaṃ sukhinaṃ surataśramāt ||24||
paritaḥ śāvakān kṛtvā paramānandamānasam ||
dadarśa bhagavām̐staṃ vai prāha cainaṃ gajādhipam ||25||
sukhito’si kuṭumbena dārāpatyajanādibhiḥ ||
athottaraṃ mahatsaukhyaṃ labhyaṃ dānādikarmabhiḥ ||26||
gajaḥ prāha bhavān ko’sti me’tithiḥ prasamāgataḥ ||
kadalīvanajātāni svarṇāni kadalāni vai ||27||
dāsye bhuṃkṣva paraṃ śreyaḥ kurvasmākaṃ vanaṃjuṣām ||
paśūnāṃ nedṛśo lābho kadāpi bhavati prabho ||28||
pūrvajātismarāt tvāṃ vai manye kṛṣṇaḥ samāgataḥ |
matpūrvakarmaṇaḥ pāśād bandhanaṃ pāśavaṃ mayā ||29||
jñātaṃ ca jñāsyate yadvai bhāvi tadapi me kuru ||
bhagavānapi taddattaṃ jagrāha yāvadarhaṇam ||1.104.30||
tvarā me’sti mama prārthyaṃ dehi śreyo bhaviṣyati |
gajaḥ prāha prabhuḥ sākṣānmadarthaṃ tu samāgataḥ ||31||
tasmātputraiḥ striyā cānyairmā śokastu vidhīyatām ||
nātha gṛhāṇa yanneyaṃ śīghraṃ kuru prasannatām ||32||
tava yogānmama muktiḥ kuṭumbasyāpi vai dhruvā ||
iti procya praṇamyātha samīpe samupasthitā ||33||
hariḥ sudarśanenaiva cicchede tacchiro mudā ||
garuḍe sthāpayāmāsa rudhirāktaṃ manoharam ||34||
vicchinnāṃgaṃ patiṃ dṛṣṭvā ruroda hastinī priyā |
ruruduḥ śāvakāratasya vilapya ca śucāturāḥ ||35||
sā tuṣṭāva ramākāntaṃ śāntaṃ sasmitamāsthitam ||
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmadharaṃ pītāmbaraṃ harim ||36||
garuḍasthaṃ jagannāthaṃ bhrāmayantaṃ sudarśanam ||
saṃsārasukhadātāraṃ taddhartāraṃ namāmyaham ||37||
anāthinyai punarnāthapradātāraṃ namāmyaham |
bhaktāyāḥ sukhakartāraṃ namāmi patijīvanam ||38||
prabhustatstavanāttuṣṭastasyai prāha praharṣitaḥ |
tava kāryaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā jīvayitvā patiṃ tava ||39||
tato gamiṣye bhadraṃ te kṣaṇaṃ śokaṃ parityaja ||
ityuktvā ca mahāraṇyaṃ jagāma tatra yūthapaḥ ||1.104.40||
prāptaḥ kālavaśācchubhro mṛto’bhūtkaścidībharāṭ |
akhaṇḍitaśarīrasya tasyaiva mṛtamastakam ||41||
pṛthakkṛtya yuyuje’trāgatya kabandhamaṇḍale|
yadyapi bhagavān kṛṣṇaḥ sarvasāmarthyavān vibhuḥ ||42||
gaṇeśasya mastakaṃ vai yoktuṃ tadeva cārhati ||
navaṃ vā mastakaṃ tatra cāṃkurayitumarhati ||43||
hastino’pi mastakaṃ tad dvitīyaṃ kartumarhati ||
tathāpi yatkṛtaṃ cātra svecchāyā ṛṇabandhanāt ||44||
evaṃ taṃ jīvayāmāsa hastinaṃ caraṇāṃbujam ||
sarvāṃge yojayāmāsa parivāraṃ pavitrayan ||45||
tvaṃ jīvākalpaparyantaṃ parivāraiḥ samaṃ gaja |
ityuktvā ca garuḍena kailāsaṃ hyājagāma vai ||46||
kabandhaṃ tu gaṇeśasya nītvā svasyaiva vakṣasi |
ruciraṃ tacchiraḥ samyag yojayāmāsa bālake ||47||
jīvayāmāsa taṃ śīghra huṃkāroccāraṇena ca ||
sarve prasannāḥ saṃjātāḥ kaṇṭhe tu sandhinīṃ dadhau ||48||
gaṇeśaḥ putrarūpo’sau praṇanāmāgatānmuhuḥ |
sarvaiḥ sabhājito devairāśīrbhiścirajīvitā ||49||
pradattātha tato viṣṇuruvāca pārvatīṃ satīm ||
brahmādikīṭaparyantaṃ phalaṃ bhuṃkte svakarmaṇaḥ ||1.104.50||
śubhāśubhaṃ kṛtaṃ yadyat pratiyonau prapadyate |
indraḥ svakarmaṇā kīṭayonau janma vrajet sati ||51||
kīṭaścāpi bhavedindraḥ pūrvakarmaphalena vai ||
siṃho’pi makṣikāṃ hantumakṣamaḥ prāktanaṃ vinā ||52||
maśako hastinaṃ hantuṃ kṣamaḥ prāktanakarmaṇā ||
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokamānandaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||53||
sukarmaṇaḥ sukhaṃ harṣamitare pāpakarmaṇaḥ ||
ihaiva karmaṇāṃ bhogaḥ paratra ca śubhāśubhaiḥ ||54||
golokanāthaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ paripūrṇatamaḥ svayam ||
tava putraḥ samutpannaḥ śrutvā tuṣṭā ca pārvatī ||55||
stanaṃ dadau ca śiśave taṃ praṇamya gadādharam ||
tuṣṭāva prāṃjalirbhaktyā viṣṇuṃ taṃ kamalāpatim ||56||
āśiṣaṃ yuyuje viṣṇuḥ śiśuṃ ca śiśumātaram |
dadau kaṇṭhe bālakasya kaustubhaṃ ca svabhūṣaṇam ||57||
brahmā dadau mukuṭaṃ ca dharmo vai ratnabhūṣaṇam |
siddhāsanaṃ dadau dharmastasmai vedhāḥ kamaṇḍalum ||58||
śaṃkaro yogapaṭṭaṃ ca tattvajñānaṃ sudurlabham ||
ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ śakraḥ sūryaśca maṇikuṇḍale ||59||
māṇikyamālāṃ candraśca kuberaśca kirīṭakam ||
vahniśuddhaṃ ca vasanaṃ dadau tasmai hutāśanaḥ ||1.104.60||
ratnachatraṃ ca varuṇo vāyū ratnāṃgulīyakam ||
kṣīrododbhavasadratnaracitaṃ valayaṃ varam ||61||
mañjīraṃ cāpi keyūraṃ dadau lakṣmīrharipriyā ||
kaṇṭhabhūṣāṃ ca sāvitrī bhāratī hāramujjvalam ||62||
krameṇa sarve devāśca devyaśca yautakaṃ daduḥ |
munayaḥ parvatāṃcaiva ratnāni vividhāni ca ||63||
vasundharā dadau tasmai vāhanāya ca mūṣakam |
krameṇa devā devyaśca munayaḥ parvatādayaḥ ||64||
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā manavo mānavāstathā |
nānāvidhāni dravyāṇi svādūni madhurāṇi ca ||65||
pūjāṃ cakruśca te sarve kramādvai bhaktipūrvakam |
pārvatī jagatāṃ mātā smerānanasaroruhā ||66||
ratnasiṃhāsane putraṃ vāsayāmāsa jīvitam |
kartuṃ pūjāṃ tatastasya viśeṣeṇopacakrame ||67||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vyomavāṇyā śrīkṛṣṇo’yaṃ gaṇeśa iti vijñāpite śrīhariṇā hastimastakasandhānaṃ kṛtaṃ brahmādibhirupadādānaṃ kṛtamityādinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||104||

<1.105>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sarvatīrthodakaiḥ ratnakalaśāvarjitaiḥ stutaiḥ |
snāpayāmāsa vedoktamantreṇa munibhistadā || 1||
agniśuddhe ca vasane dadau tasmai satī mudā ||
godāvaryudakaiḥ pādyamarghyaṃ gaṃgodakena ca || 2 ||
dūrvābhirakṣataiḥ puṣpaiścandanena samanvitam |
puṣkarodakamānīya dadāvācamanīyakam||3||
madhuparkaṃ ratnapātraiḥ supeyaṃ śarkarānvitam |
snānīyaṃ viṣṇutailaṃ ca svarvaidyābhyāṃ vinirmitam || 4 ||
amūlyaratnaracitaṃ cārubhūṣākadambakam |
pārijātaprasūnānāmanyeṣāṃ śatakāni ca ||5||
mālatīcampakādīnāṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca |
pūjārhāṇi ca patrāṇi tulasīsahitāni ca || 6 ||
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumāni ca sādaram ||
ratnapradīpanikaraṃ dhūpaṃ ca parito dadau || 7 ||
naivedyaṃ tatpriyaṃ caiva tilalaḍḍukaparvatān |
yavagodhūmacūrṇānāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ ca parvatān || 8 ||
pakvānnānāṃ parvatām̐śca susvādusumanoharān |
parvatān svastikānāṃ ca susvāduśarkarānvitān || 9 ||
guḍāktānāṃ ca lājānāṃ pṛthukānāṃ ca parvatān |
śālyannānāṃ piṣṭakānāṃ parvatān vyañjanaiḥ saha ||1.105.10||
payobhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca lakṣāṇi pradadau mudā ||
lakṣāṇi dadhipūrṇānāṃ kalaśānāṃ ca pūjane ||11||
madhubhṛtkalaśānāṃ ca trilakṣāṇi ca pārvatī ||
sarpiḥsuvarṇakuṃbhānāṃ paṃcalakṣāṇi sādaram ||12||
dāḍimānāṃ śrīphalānāmasaṃkhyāni phalāni ca |
kharjurāṇāṃ kapitthānāṃ jambūnāṃ vividhāni ca ||13||
āmrāṇāṃ panasānāṃ ca kadalīnāṃ phalāni ca |
anyāni paripakvāni kāladeśodbhavāni ca ||14||
dadau tāni mahādevī svādūni madhurāṇi ca ||
svacchaṃ sunirmalaṃ caiva karpūrādisuvāsitam ||15||
gaṃgājalaṃ ca pānārthaṃ punarācamanīyakam |
tāmbūlaṃ ca varaṃ ramyaṃ karpūrādisuvāsitam ||16||
suvarṇapātraśatakaṃ bhakṣyapūrṇaṃ ca sā dadau |
śailarājapriyāmātyāḥ pupūjuḥ śailajātmajam ||17||
viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ pupūjainaṃ hyupahārairanuttamaiḥ ||
sarvāgre tava pūjā ca mayā dattā surottama ||18||
sarvapūjyaśca yogīndro bhava vatsetyuvāca tam ||
vanamālāṃ dadau tasmai brahmajñānaṃ ca muktidam ||19||
sarvasiddhiṃ pradāyaiva cakārātmasamaṃ hariḥ ||
dadau dravyāṇi cārūṇi copacārām̐śca ṣoḍaśa ||1.105.20||
nāmabhiḥ stavanaṃ cakre munibhiśca samaṃ suraiḥ ||
vighneśaśca gaṇeśaśca herambaśca gajānanaḥ ||21||
lambodaraścaikadantaḥ śūrpakarṇo vināyakaḥ |
etānyaṣṭau ca nāmāni sarvasiddhipradāni ca ||22||
yadyatkāryaṃ bhavet kiṃcinmahadvā tatra sarvadā ||
pūjanaṃ tu gaṇeśasya kāryaṃ prathamameva vai ||23||
tato’nyeṣāṃ tu devānāṃ mamāpi pūjanaṃ bhavet ||
gaṇeśapūjanādīni vihāya kopi sādhakaḥ ||24||
yadyanyatkurute kāryaṃ na syāt siddhaṃ dhruvaṃ hi tat |
ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ pitṛdevamanvantarādibhiḥ ||25||
dikpālairlokapālaiśca yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ |
bhuvarantarīkṣasadbhirmānavairatalādijaiḥ ||26||
caturdaśastarāvāsaiḥ sarvaireva sadā kṛtau ||
gaṇeśaḥ prathamaḥ pūjya iti brahmānuśāsanam ||27||
ityagrapūjyatā dattā sabhāyāṃ tatra vedhasā ||
śrīkṛṣṇena svayaṃ tatra prathamaṃ pūjitaśca saḥ ||28||
atha pūjottaraṃ tasyāśīrvādā devasatkṛtāḥ |
viṣṇuḥ prāha śivatulyajñānī cirāyurīśvaraḥ ||29||
parākrame ca me tulyaḥ sarvasiddhīśvaro bhava |
brahmovāca yaśaḥkīrtikhyātibhistvatigo bhava ||1.105.30||
sarveṣāmagrataḥ pūjā jāyatāṃ te’tidurlabhā |
dharmaḥ prāha mayā tulyo dharmiṣṭho bhava bhaktimān ||31||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā tulyo dātā bhakto harerbhava |
vidyābuddhisupuṇyāḍhyaḥ śānto dāntaḥ sadā bhava ||32||
lakṣmīḥ prāha mamāvāso gehe dehe bhavettava ||
pativratā mayā tulyā kāntā tava bhavatviti ||33||
vāṇī prāha mayā tulyā kavitā dhāraṇā smṛtiḥ |
vivecanā sumedhā sacchaktirbhavatu te sadā ||34||
sāvitryuvāca vatsa tvaṃ vedajñānī japī bhava |
śailaḥ prāha harau kṛṣṇe bhaktirbhavatu te sadā ||35||
śrīkṛṣṇatulyo guṇavān bhava kṛṣṇaparāyaṇaḥ ||
menovācābdhitulyastvaṃ gāṃbhīrye’naṃgarūpavān ||36||
śrīyuktaḥ śrīsvāmitulyo dharme dharmasamo bhava |
pṛthvī prāha mayā tulyaḥ kṣamayā sarvaratnavān ||37||
śaraṇyo vighnanighnaśca pāraṇyo bhava śobhanaḥ |
umovāca mahāyoge tātatulyo’rthasiddhidaḥ ||38||
mṛtyuñjayaśca bhagavān bhavatvativiśāradaḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sarve yuyujurāśiṣaḥ ||39||
brāhmaṇā bandinaścaiva yuyujuḥ sarvamaṃgalam |
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau tatra koṭiratnāni pārvatī ||1.105.40||
aśvānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca |
bandibhyaḥ pradadau tatra dānāni vividhāni ca ||41||
brāhmaṇān bhojayāmāsa sādhūn sādhvīśca bālakān |
vedām̐śca pāṭhayāmāsa kārayāmāsa maṃgalam ||42||
oṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ klīṃ gaṇeśāya brahmarūpāya cārave |
sarvasiddhipradeśāya vighneśāya namo namaḥ ||43||
itimantreṇa saṃpūjya datvā dravyāṇi bhaktitaḥ |
sarve pramuditāstatra brahmaviṣṇuharādayaḥ ||44||
dvātriṃśadakṣaro mālāmantro’yaṃ sarvakāmadaḥ |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ phaladaḥ sarvasiddhidaḥ ||45||
pañcalakṣajapenaiva mantrasiddhirhi mantriṇaḥ ||
vighnāni ca palāyante tannāmasmaraṇena vai ||46||
yātrākāle paṭhitvā yo yāti tadbhaktipūrvakam ||
tasya sarvābhīṣṭasiddhirbhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||47||
rātrau dṛṣṭaṃ tu duḥsvapnaṃ susvapnamupajāyate |
kadāpi na bhavetpāṭhādgrahapīḍāpi dāruṇā ||48||
śatrunāśo buddhivṛddhirlakṣmīvṛddhiḥ sadā bhavet |
ādhayo vyādhayaścaiva śokāścaiva bhayāvahāḥ ||49||
nāśaṃ yānti na cāyānti gaṇeśasyārcanātstavāt |
vināyakasya kavacaṃ sarvāpadvinivārakam ||1.105.50||
kathayāmi mahālakṣmi sarvalokeṣu śāntikṛt ||
uktaṃ kauthumaśākhāyāṃ sāmavede manoharam ||51||
kavacaṃ bibhratāṃ mṛtyurna bhiyā yāti sannidhim |
nāyurvyayo nāśubhaṃ ca brahmāṇḍe na parājayaḥ ||52||
daśalakṣajapenaiva siddhaṃ tu kavacaṃ bhavet |
saṃsāramohakasyāsya kavacasya prajāpatiḥ ||53||
ṛṣiśchando bṛhatī ca devo lambodaraḥ svayam ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||54||
oṃ gaṃ huṃ śrīgaṇeśāya svāhā me pātu mastakam ||
dvātriṃśadakṣaro mantro lalāṭaṃ me sadāvatu ||55||
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ gamiti vai satataṃ pātu locane |
tālukaṃ pātu vighneśaḥ satataṃ ca dharātale ||56||
oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ klīmiti paraṃ santataṃ pātu nāsike |
oṃ gauṃ gaṃ śūrpakarṇāya svāhā pātvadharau mama ||57||
dantām̐śca tāluke jihvāṃ pātu me ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ ||
oṃ laṃ śrīṃ lambodarāyeti svāhā gaṇḍau sadāvatu ||58||
oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ vighnanāśāya svāhā karṇau sadāvatu ||
oṃ śrīṃ gaṃ gajānanāyeti svāhā skandhaṃ sadāvatu ||59||
oṃ hrīṃ vināyakāyeti svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ sadāvatu ||
oṃ klīṃ hrīmiti kāṅkalaṃ pātu vakṣaḥsthalaṃ param ||1.105.60||
karau pādau sadā pātu sarvāṃgaṃ vighnanāśakṛt ||
prācyāṃ lambodaraḥ pātu cāgneyyāṃ vighnāyakaḥ ||61||
dakṣiṇe pātu vighneśo nairṛtyāṃ tu gajānanaḥ ||
paścime pārvatīputro vāyavyāṃ śaṃkarātmajaḥ ||62||
kṛṣṇasyāṃśaścottare ca paripūrṇatamasya ca ||
aiśānyāmekadantaśca herambaḥ pātu cordhvataḥ ||63||
adho gaṇādhipaḥ pātu sarvapūjyaśca sarvataḥ ||
svapne jāgaraṇe caiva pātu māṃ yogināṃ guruḥ ||64||
ityetatkavacaṃ kṛṣṇo goloke’dātsvayaṃ tu me ||
mayā nārāyaṇenātra yamādisurasannidhau ||65||
śanaiścarāyārpitaṃ tat sarvasaṃkaṭatārakam ||
tadevedaṃ mahālakṣmi sarvebhyaḥ śrāvitaṃ mayā ||66||
gurumabhyarcya vidhivat kavacaṃ dhārayettu yaḥ ||
kaṇṭhe vā dakṣiṇe bāhau so’pi viṣṇusamo bhavet ||67||
sarvatra vijayī pūjyo bhavedgrahaṇamātrataḥ ||
bhūtapretapiśācāśca kūṣmāṇḍā brahmarākṣasāḥ ||68||
ḍākinīyoginīyakṣavetālā bhairavādayaḥ ||
bālagrahā grahāścaiva kṣetrapālādayastathā ||69||
varmaṇaḥ śabdamātreṇa palāyante tu bhīravaḥ ||
ṛjave gurubhaktāya svaśiṣyāya prakāśayet ||1.105.70||
atha gaṇeśadevasyāṣṭakaṃ vakṣye sukhapradam ||
yatpāṭhakaṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo gaṇeśo’vati sarvadā ||71||
oṃ namo’ntaḥsusattvāya śivasattvāya te namaḥ ||
oṃ namaḥ kṛṣṇarūpāya śailajāṃgāya te namaḥ ||72||
oṃ namo vṛddhaviprāya sattvasaṃsthāya te namaḥ |
oṃ namaḥ piṇḍarūpāya nyastacittāya te namaḥ ||73||
oṃ namaḥ siddhyadhiṣṭhāya sarvavidyāya te namaḥ |
oṃ namo gopuratrātre mātrājñāpāya te namaḥ ||74||
oṃ namo’stvalakṣyapitre pitṛśastyāya te namaḥ |
oṃ namaḥ skandharūpāya karyānanāya te namaḥ ||75||
oṃ namaḥ śivaputrāya sarvapūjyāya te namaḥ |
oṃ namaścāgrajārcāya laḍḍukādyāya te namaḥ ||76||
oṃ namo vighnanāśāya mūṣakāsanine namaḥ|
oṃ namo hetilābhāya cirajīvāya te namaḥ ||77||
oṃ namo divyavarṣmaṇe bhavyavarmaṇe te namaḥ |
oṃ namaḥ kavacāpyāya vaco’vyayāya te namaḥ ||78||
oṃ namo maṃgalāḍhyāya bhaktidārḍhyāya te namaḥ|
oṃ namaḥ śrīgaṇeśāya śrīkṛṣṇāya namo namaḥ ||79||
iti stutvā naro bhaktyāmaro bhavati mokṣagaḥ |
gaṇeśavṛttamityuktaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||1.105.80||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśasya viśeṣāgrapūjāśīrvādamantrakavacastotrādipradarśananāmā paṃcādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||105||

<1.106>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
gaṇeśasya śironāśaḥ kathaṃ vai kena karmaṇā |
gajamastakasandhānaṃ kathaṃ vai kena karmaṇā 1 || 1||
paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmānparamātmā parātparaḥ ||
golokanāthaḥ svāṃśena pārvatīputratāmagāt || 2 ||
āścaryaṃ śrīharestasya mastakacchedanādikam |
vighneśasya kathaṃ vighnaṃ saṃbhavetparamātmanaḥ || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sāvadhānā śṛṇu lakṣmi samaitihyaṃ purātanam |
ekadā śaṃkaraḥ sūryaṃ jaghāna paramaṣṭadhā || 4 ||
sumālimālihantāraṃ śūlena ca tadā raviḥ ||
jahau svacetanāṃ sadyo rathācca nipapāta ha ||5||
dadarśa kaśyapaḥ putraṃ mṛtavattūrdhvalocanam |
kṛtvā vakṣasi taṃ śokādvilalāpa bhaśaṃ muhuḥ || 6 ||
andhībhūtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ babhūva bhayakātaram |
niṣprabhaṃ tanayaṃ dṛṣṭvā cāśapat kaśyapaḥ śivam || 7 ||
matputrasya yathā tejaśchinnaṃ śūlena vakṣasi |
tvatputrasya śiraśchinnaṃ bhaviṣyati sataijasam || 8 ||
śivaśca galitakrodho jīvayāmāsa taṃ ravim |
vakṣaḥ sandhānayāmāsa pūrayāmāsa tejasā || 9 ||
sūryastu cetanāṃ prāpya samuttasthau pituḥ puraḥ |
sūryo yayau nijāvāse brahmaṇā kṛtamaṃgalaḥ ||1 0||
mālī sumālī daityau tu vyādhigrasto babhūvatuḥ |
śvitrau galitasarvāṃgau śaktiśūnyau hataprabhau ||1 1||
sūryakopena malinau brahmovāca tadā tu tau |
oṃ hrīṃ namo bhagavate sūryāya paramātmane svāhā || 12||
ityanena tu mantreṇa sāvadhānaṃ divākaram |
bhaktyā saṃpūjya saṃdattvā tūpacārām̐śca ṣoḍaśa || 13|||
evaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvad dhruvaṃ muktau bhaviṣyathaḥ |
atha sūryasya kavacaṃ bibhrato vyādhayo nahi || 14||
prajāpatiḥ ṛṣiśchando gāyatrī devatā raviḥ |
vyādhipraṇāśe saundarye viniyogaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 15||
oṃ klīṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ śrīsūryāya svāhā me pātu mastakam |
aṣṭādaśākṣaro mantraḥ kapālaṃ me sadāvatu || 16||
vakṣaḥ pātu raviḥ śaśvannābhiṃ sūryaḥ sadāvatu |
kaṃkālaṃ me sadā pātu sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || 17||
karau pātu sadā bradhnaḥ pātu pādau prabhākaraḥ |
vibhākaro me sarvāṃgaṃ pātu santatamīśvaraḥ || 18||
ityetatkavacaṃ dhṛtvā nīrujau tu bhaviṣyathaḥ |
stavanaṃ sāmavedoktaṃ sauryaṃ vyādhivināśakam || 19||
sarvapāpaharaṃ sāraṃ dhanārogyakaraṃ param |
tatastau rākṣasau gatvā puṣkaraṃ tīrthamuttamam |||20 ||
dhṛtvā varma raviṃ stotramantreṇārādhya bhāvataḥ |
tataḥ sūryād varaṃ prāpya nijarūpau babhūvatuḥ ||21||
gaṇeśamastakacchedavighnaṃ śāpoṃ’śumālinaḥ |
jātastu śaṃkarāyeti kāraṇaṃ kathitaṃ tava ||22|
atha hastikathāṃ vacmi śiraḥsambandhabodhinīm |
sthiteṣvanyeṣu bahuṣu jantuṣvapi gajasya yat ||23||
mastakaṃ yojitaṃ tasya kāraṇaṃ śṛṇu padmaje |
ekadā devarājo vai puṣpabhadrānadīṃ yayau ||24||
tattīre’tirahaḥsthāne puṣpodyāne sugandhini |
dadarśa kāmukīṃ raṃbhāṃ candralokātsamāgatām ||25|| 
hāvabhāvānaṃgaceṣṭāsvedakaṭākṣacaṃcalām ||
āhvayantīmiva rantuṃ provācendro gaje sthitaḥ ||26||
raṃbhoru vāmanāśliṣya na gantumiṣyate mayā ||
raṃbhovāca na cāhaṃ te santoṣajananī matā ||27||
kṛtakāryajanānāṃ tu dhūrtānāṃ kā nu mitratā ||
nārī svāduttamaṃ yāti madhu tyaktveva makṣikā ||28||
kāmukī kākavallolā phalaṃ bhuktvā prayāti vai ||
yuvānaṃ rasikaṃ śāntaṃ suveṣaṃ sundaraṃ priyam ||29||
guṇinaṃ dhaninaṃ svacchaṃ kāntamicchati kāminī |
duḥśīlaṃ rogiṇaṃ vṛddhaṃ ratiśaktivihīnakam ||1.106.30||
adātāramavijñaṃ ca naiva vāñcchanti yoṣitaḥ ||
tavājñākāriṇīṃ dāsīṃ gṛhāṇātra yathāsukham ||31||
ityuktvāgatya devendraṃ kaṇṭhe lagnā babhūva sā ||
puṣpabhadrātaṭe tatra tayoḥ ratisamāgame ||32||
etasminnantare tena vartmanā śaṃkarālayam |
vaikuṇṭhād yāti durvāsā dṛṣṭaścendreṇa mānitaḥ ||33||
pārijātaprasūnaṃ tu durvāsā haraye dadau |
puṣpaṃ yasya gṛhe caitallakṣmīstaṃ na jahāti vai ||34||
tasmādrakṣa sadaivaitadamlānaṃ smṛddhivardhanam |
sarvavighnaharaṃ nārāyaṇaprasādalabdhikam ||35||
mālayā sahitaṃ mūrdhni yasya tasya jayaḥ sadā |
puraḥ pūjā ca sarveṣāṃ devānāmagraṇīrbhavet ||36||
tacchāyeva mahālakṣmīrna jahāti kadāpi tam |
jñānena tejasā buddhyā vikrameṇa balena ca ||37||
sarvadevādhikaḥ śrīmān viṣṇutulyaparākramaḥ ||
bhaktyā mūrdhni na gṛhṇāti yo’haṃkāreṇa mānavaḥ ||38||
naivedyaṃ ca hareratra sa naṣṭaśrīḥ svajātibhiḥ |
durvāsāstu tataḥ sthānādagacchacchāṃkaraṃ girim ||39||
indro raṃbhāntike vegī tat tāṃ cikṣepa hastini ||
kuṃbhayoḥ patitāṃ puṣpamālāṃ hastī nije pade ||1.106.40||
śuṇḍhenāptvā mamardāpi taddṛṣṭvā śrīrvinirgatā |
tathā raṃbhā divaṃ yātā gajo’raṇyaṃ viveśa ca ||41||
pāvanaṃ mastakaṃ tasya mālāpuṣpaprasaṃgataḥ |
chitvā nītvā haristadvai yojayāmāsa bālake ||42||
evaṃ śvetagajasyāsya gaṇeśasthaṃ śiraḥ sadā ||
lakṣmi prapūjyatāṃ yātaṃ tvairāvatasya kaṃ hi tat ||43||
atha kaśyapaśāpena preritastu śaniścaraḥ ||
saṃjñāsūryātmajo vakradṛṣṭimān duḥkhadāyakaḥ ||44||
tatra vyomapathāyāto dadarśa gaṇanāyakam ||
gopure sa yadā devyā rakṣārthaṃ sthāpitastadā ||45||
śaṃkareṇa saha tasya gaṇeśasyābhavadraṇaḥ ||
savyalocanakoṇena sandadarśa śiśormukham ||46||
śanestu dṛṣṭimātreṇa cicchide mastakaṃ haraḥ |
ityevaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra śanerdṛṣṭiḥ raveḥ śapiḥ ||47||
gajakuṃbhaḥ pārijātamālā lakṣmīranantakā |
trayaṃ tvekasya bhāgye na devānāmapi durlabham ||48||
sarve svakarmaṇā sādhvi bhuṃjate vividhaṃ phalam ||
koṭikalpairapyaluptaṃ karma kartāramīyate ||49||
karmaṇā brahmarudrādyā mānavāḥ paśupakṣiṇaḥ ||
rājā bhṛtyāśca vaikuṇṭhavāsino’pi svakarmabhiḥ ||1.106.50|| 
vyādhiviṣayasaundaryadhanadāridryaśālinaḥ|
sudārāputrasukhavān bandhukuṭumbakaṇṭakaḥ ||51||
adārāputraduḥkhāḍhyā jāyante karmabhirjanāḥ|
vibhinnakarmaṇāṃ teṣāṃ mūrtiḥ śaniścaraḥ svayam ||52||
tattatkarmānusāreṇa vakradṛṣṭyā sa paśyati |
śaniścaro’pi duḥkhena jīvatītyapi karmaṇā ||53||
śaniścarāya kanyāṃ svāṃ dadau citrarathastataḥ ||
ṛtusnātā suveṣaṃ svaṃ vidhāya manmathārditā ||54||
śaniṃ smarati dānārthaṃ śanirnaiva smaratyapi |
ṛtunāśād ratyalābhāt kopataḥ sā śaśāpa tam ||55||
na dṛṣṭāhaṃ tvayā yena na kṛtaṃ ṛturakṣaṇam ||
tasmāt sadaiva te dṛṣṭiḥ sukhadā naiva jāyatām ||56||
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ bhavedvastu tatsarvaṃ vai vinaśyatu ||
itiśāpācchanirvakradṛṣṭyā paśyati yad yadā ||57||
tadvai naśyati sarvaṃ drāk tattatkarmānuyogataḥ |
śaniḥ prakṛtinamrāsyo vinā karma na paśyati ||58||
karmaṇā prerito vai saḥ kartāramabhipaśyati |
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||59||
gajāsyayojanāyāśca kāraṇaṃ gahanaṃ mahat |
yajjñātvā sukhaduḥkhādau śubhāśubhe na muhyati ||1.106.60||
aṃśenātmāntarasthasya kṛṣṇasyātmāntarakṛtāt ||
karmaṇo naiva lepyatvaṃ bhuṃkte tvātmāntaraḥ kṛtam ||61||
avatārāḥ sadā sarve nirlepāḥ santi padmaje ||
yatrātmanyavatīrṇāste sa ātmā karmabhogabhāk ||62||
sakhāyau sayujau dvau ca suparṇau karmadrusthitau ||
tayoḥ karmakṛdaśnātyakarmakṛto na tatspṛśiḥ ||63||
tasmāt kṛṣṇasya naivāsti kaṇṭhacchedakṛtivyathā |
sā tu tatrānyabhoktuḥ syādātmāntaraṃ hi tanmatam ||64||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśopari śanidṛṣṭiḥ śivasya sūryaśāpaḥ indrasya śvetakarikṛtaṃ durvāsaḥpradattaprasādipuṣpamālāmardanaṃ tanmālāpuṣpasparśajanyakuṃbhamastakapāvanatāprayojya gaṇeśamastakayojanāpūjyatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||106||

<1.107>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
gaṇeśasya śrutā nātha kathā citraparākramā |
bhādre kṛṣṇe caturthyāṃ tu candrodayādyayāmake || 1 ||
gaṇeśastu samutpannastadā tasya vrataṃ matam ||
sāṃgadevo niraṃgo vā pūjyaḥ kiṃ tattu me vada || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
patnīputravāhanaiśca sahito’rcyo gaṇeśvaraḥ |
mātṛpitṛsamaścāpi sadā pūjyo gaṇeśvaraḥ || 3 ||
skando gaṇapatiścaitau mātāpitroḥ sukhau sutau ||
tayorvivāhakāryārthaṃ śivāśaṃbhū samūcatuḥ || 4 ||
vivāhaśca kathaṃ kāryaḥ putrayorubhayoḥ śubhaḥ ||
ṣaṇmukhaḥ senayāptaśca gaṇeśo me priyojjhitaḥ ||5||
gaṇeśasya vivāhārthaṃ yatnaḥ kāryaḥ śubho mataḥ |
kārtikeyasya vāñcchāsti vivāhāya punastathā || 6 ||
hārdaṃ kanyāpradānāya viśvarūpaprajāpateḥ ||
dvābhyāṃ kanyādvayaṃ deyaṃ vartate’tastathā bhavet || 7 ||
kintu deyaṃ gaṇeśāya kanyāratnadvayaṃ varam |
kadācittau samāhūya kathayāmāsatustadā || 8 ||
śṛṇutaṃ susutau prītyā kathayāvo yathārthakam ||
ekaḥ sadāro jyeṣṭho’si gaṇeśo dāravarjitaḥ || 9 ||
yuvayorvai vivāhasya sukhado niyamaḥ kṛtaḥ |
samau dvāvapi satputrau viśeṣo nātra labhyate ||1.107.10||
tasmātpaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ śaṃdaḥ putrayorubhayorapi |
yaścaiva pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ krāntvā pūrvamupāvrajet ||11||
tasyaiva prathamaṃ kāryo vivāhaḥ śubhalakṣaṇaḥ ||
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ pitroḥ kārtikeyo mahābalaḥ ||12||
jagāma mandirāttūrṇaṃ śikhivāhanasaṃsthitaḥ ||
pṛthivyāstu bahuvegāt parikramaṇahetave ||13||
gaṇanāthastu tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ suvicārya vai ||
vāhanaṃ mama tu pṛthvyāṃ gatimannaiva dhāvati ||14||
vyomamārgeṇa gantā kva kvāhaṃ pṛthivīmārgagaḥ ||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ svayaṃ sthūlaśarīrakaḥ ||15||
krośamātraṃ gate cāgre śramādgantuṃ na śakyate |
kiṃ punaḥ pṛthivīṃ krāntvā vijayāśā viḍambyate ||16||
ityevaṃ suvicāryaiva gṛhaṃ snātvā praviśya ca ||
praṇamya pitarau devo gaṇeśaḥ samuvāca tau ||17||
mātā pṛthvī pitā svargaṃ gaustu brahmāṇḍamucyate |
mātā me pārvatī devī pitā me śaṃkaraḥ prabhuḥ ||18||
gaustayorvāhanaṃ cāsti vṛṣabho’yaṃ sudharmarāṭ |
gaustu pṛthvīsvarūpā me mātāpīlāsvarūpiṇī ||19||
pitā me śaṃkarastasya śarīraṃ vasudhā matā ||
pūjā trayāṇāṃ kartavyā mayā yātrāsusiddhaye ||1.107.20||
āsane sthāpite cātra pūjārthaṃ bhavatostathā ||
atiṣṭhataṃ gurū cātra pūrayataṃ manogatam ||21||
itiśrutvā vacastasya tatpūjāgrahaṇāya tau ||
asthātāmāsane tau ca pupūja gaṇanāyakaḥ ||22||
pradakṣiṇaṃ tayoḥ saptavāraṃ putreṇa satkṛtam ||
praṇāmāścāpi vihitāḥ sapta evārpitaṃ tataḥ ||23||
gaṇeśaḥ prāha mātarme śīghraṃ vivāhanaṃ kuru ||
mātā prāha drutaṃ putra pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāṃ kuru ||24||
kumārātpūrvamāyāhi vivāhaḥ prathamo bhavet ||
gaṇeśaḥ prāha re mātaḥ śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama ||25||
mayā tu pṛthivī krāntā saptavāraṃ punaḥ punaḥ ||
mātā prāha kadā putra tvayā krāntā vasundharā ||26||
gaṇeśaḥ prāha bhavatoḥ kṛtaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ mayā |
tena vai sā samudrāntā mayā pradakṣiṇīkṛtā ||27||
mātā dharā pitā dyauśca dvayordharmasvarūpatā|
vṛṣabho vāhanaṃ dharmastasya vāmādharka tu gauḥ ||28||
ityuktvā vṛṣabhaṃ tātaṃ mātaraṃ ca pradakṣiṇām |
cakre tena tadā jātaṃ pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ ||29||
pitarāvūcatuḥ hṛṣṭau bāḍhaṃ putra tvayā kṛtam |
prāptaṃ tena samagrāyāḥ pṛthvyāḥ pradakṣiṇāphalam ||1.107.30||
śraddhayāvāpyate dharmaḥ śraddhayāvāpyate hariḥ |
śraddhayāvāpyate siddhiḥ śraddhayāvāpyate phalam ||31||
mātā pitā gṛhe tīrthaṃ gaṃgā tu gṛhiṇī sadā |
yadi śraddhā na tatrāsti vyarthaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet ||32||
pitrostu pūjanaṃ kṛtvā prakrāntiṃ ca karoti yaḥ ||
tasya vai pṛthivīkrāntijanyaṃ sampadyate phalam ||33||
apahāya gṛhe yo vai pitarau tīrthamāvrajet |
na tīrthaphalabhāgī syādasevādoṣabhāg bhavet ||34||
putrasyātra mahattīrthaṃ pitroścaraṇapaṃkajam |
idaṃ sannihitaṃ tīrthaṃ sulabhaṃ dharmasādhanam ||35||
patnyāstīrthaṃ patiḥ proktaḥ putrasya pitarau tathā ||
patyuḥ pativratā patnī tīrthāni tārakāṇi vai ||36||
yadi satyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭaṃ sadā pṛthvīpradakṣiṇam |
jātaṃ prāha gaṇeśo me na cecchāstramasatyakam ||37||
pitṛbhaktirasatyā syāt sarvā sā niṣphalā bhavet |
mātṛbhaktirgavāṃ bhaktiḥ sarvathā niṣphalā bhavet ||38||
tasmāt pradakṣiṇaṃ pṛthvyāḥ sarvathātra mayā kṛtam |
śīghraṃ ca bhavitavyo me vivāhaḥ kriyatāṃ śubhaḥ ||39||
iti śrutvā vacastasya prasannau pitarau ca tam ||
prāhatuḥ putra śāstrajña buddhiste śāstragāminī ||1.107.40||
kairapi śāstramaryādānyathākartuṃ na śakyate |
upasthite tvagamye vai kārye śraddhā tu śāstrajā ||41||
yujyate ca tathā duḥkhe yasya buddhirviśiṣyate ||
tasya duḥkhaṃ vinaśyettu buddhiprajñāprabhāvataḥ ||42||
buddhiryasya balaṃ tasya nirbuddhestu kuto balam |
kūpe siṃho madonmatto gomāyunā nipātitaḥ ||43||
samyak kṛtaṃ tvayā putra pṛthvīpradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtam |
gomātṛpitṛkramaṇāt kṛtaṃ dharmasya pālanam ||44||
kārtikastu na cāyāti parādhāvati vegataḥ |
mārge tvagre mūṣakasthaṃ yāntaṃ paśyati cānujam ||45||
yato gaṇeśaḥ pitrostu yadākarotpradakṣiṇām |
tasya puṇyasya lābhena gaṇeśasyānyarūpakam ||46||
bhūtvā dhāvati cāgre vai kārtikeyasya vegataḥ ||
kārtikeyastu taddṛṣṭvā śuśoca paramaṃ tadā ||47||
aho’yamunduruḥ svalpastatra sthūlo gaṇeśakaḥ |
kīdṛśena ca vegena tvagre prāgre pradhāvati ||48||
mayā mayūrabarhāṇi kaśayā vāyunā tathā ||
pātitāni hi sarvāṇi vegārthaṃ tāḍito muhuḥ ||49||
mayūro’pi tathā yāvadbalenoḍḍīyate’dhunā ||
tathāpi na gaṇeśaṃ vai saṃprāpnomi krameta kaḥ ||1.107.50||
ullaṃghanaṃ prāggamanaṃ svapne’pi naiva dṛśyate |
tasmānnāyaṃ vivāho’nyo mayā kāryaḥ śape tviti ||51||
iti kṛtvā parāvṛtyāgacchad yatra gṛhaṃ svakam |
śānto bhūtvā praviśya senayā śramamapānudat ||52||
gaṇeśasya vivāhārthaṃ pitarāvudyatau tadā ||
kārtikeyasya mārgaṃ ca pratīkṣantau pratiṣṭhataḥ ||53||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gaṇeśakārtikeyavivāhe gaṇeśena pṛthivīpradakṣiṇāphalārthaṃ mātāpitṛgopradakṣiṇā kṛtetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 107 ||

<1.108>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi jaganmātā pārvatī bahuharṣitā |
snuṣādvayaṃ bhaviṣyanme cakre tat bahumaṃgalam || 1||
etasminnantare tatra viśvarūpaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
dve putryau svasya dānārhe nītvaiva vidhinoditaḥ || 2 ||
ekā varāya dātavyo gaṇeśāya guṇābdhaye |
anyā skandāya dātavyā yadvā kanyāmataṃ matam || 3 ||
dṛṣṭvā skandaṃ vadhūyuktaṃ vavrāte na dvayaṃ tu tam |
gaṇeśaṃ kanyake dṛṣṭvā vavrāte rūpasadguṇam || 4 ||
siddhirbuddhirubhe patnyau gaṇeśasya babhūvatuḥ ||
mahotsavo vivāhasya tadā jāto’tiharṣakṛt || 5 || 
devagāndharvavidyādhrakinnarāguhyakādayaḥ |
santuṣṭāśca trilokasthāstadvivāhe samāgaman || 6 ||
sahadharmaṃ caretāmityādipurohitasya vāk |
saphalā tatra saṃjātā gaṇeśasya vivāhane || 7 ||
gaṇeśastu sadā saukhyaṃ tābhyāṃ vai prāptavān param |
loke sāpatnaśatrutvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ khalu jāyate || 8 ||
yasya bhāgyaṃ bhaved bhagnaṃ loke’sya strīdvayaṃ bhavet |
dvibhāryastu naraścārdhaṃ mṛto’styeva viniścayaḥ || 9 ||
na vai taṃ śatravo ghnanti dvibhāryastu mṛto yataḥ |
ekā svapiti yāvadvai dvitīyā dveṣṭi vai krudhā ||1.108.10||
anyā sevāṃ karotyatra prathamā cerṣyati krudhā ||
kṣaṇe kṣaṇe dvibhāryasya krodhāgāraṃ gṛhaṃ matam ||11||
ekayā putrasampattyā dvitīyāṃ tu ghṛṇāyate |
dvitīyā dhanasampattyā prathamā vai tṛṇāyate || 12||
ekayā rūpasampattyā dvitīyā notsavāyate |
dvitīyā snehasampattyā prathamāṃ kutsitāyate || 13||
śayane bhojane yāne vilāse vastradhāraṇe |
hāve bhāve tathā māne cotsave narakaṃ dvayam || 14||
tatrāpi kākajātīye śvajātīye yayā striyau |
tadā sākṣāttu vai kuṃbhīpākākhyaṃ narakaṃ hi te || 15||
yadi bhārye kuṭumbinyau suniṣekabhave tadā |
kleśo naiva bhavet tatra svargavācyaṃ gṛhaṃ matam || 16||
parasparaṃ sahāyinyau sukhaduḥkhasamakriye |
parasparapradāyinyau naikāṃ vihāya tiṣṭhataḥ || 17||
nānyonyāntarabhedinyau dyekakriyaikamānase |
parasparopakāriṇyau samaśīlavratārthike || 18||
apatyeṣvekabhāvinyau tathopakaraṇaikate |
svargasukhaṃ patistatra bhuṃkte tābhyāṃ pramoditaḥ || 19||
siddhirbuddhiśca tādṛśyau patnyau śaṃde babhūvatuḥ |
kiyatā caiva kālena gaṇeśasya mahātmanaḥ ||1.108.20||
siddhergaṇeśapatnyāstu kṣemanāmābhavatsutaḥ |
buddherlābhābhidhaḥ putraḥ samajāyata śobhanaḥ ||21||
atha śrīnāradaścāyāt skandasya gṛhamadbhutam |
prāha vacmi matsarānna nāsatyaṃ na chalena ca ||22||
pitṛbhyāṃ te kṛtaṃ yādṛk tādṛk nānyaḥ kariṣyati |
niṣkāsya tvāṃ prādakṣiṇye miṣamutpādya tadvidham ||23||
gaṇeśasya varo’kāri vivāhaḥ strīdvayena yat |
palayordvayorgaṇeśo’sau lebhe putradvayaṃ śubham ||24||
mātāpitrormatenaiva sukhaṃ bhuṃkte nirantaram |
bhavatā pṛthivī krāntā tayorvai chalakarmaṇā ||25||
yadi mātā ca vā tātaśchaladharmeṇa putrakam |
vañcayatyanyalokasya kā vārtā chaladharmaṇi ||26||
asamyagvai kṛtaṃ tābhyāṃ tvatpitṛbhyāṃ hi karma tat |
vicāryatāṃ tvayāpīha maccitte na śubhaṃ matam ||27||
dadyād yadi garaṃ mātā vikrīṇīyād pitā yadi |
rājā harati sarvasvaṃ ko’nyo rakṣākaro bhavet |||28||
yenaivedaṃ kṛtaṃ karma svaputre pakṣapātajam |
kaḥ śāntimān sudhīḥ putrastādṛktātagṛhe vaset ||29||
iti nītirmayā proktā yathecchasi tathā kuru |
ityuktvā nāradastasmād yayau satyapuraṃ tataḥ ||1.108.30 ||
skandaḥ śokaṃ samudvegaṃ samāpanno gṛhāttataḥ |
vinirgatya ca pitarau praṇamya krodhapūritaḥ ||3 1||
jagāma parvataṃ kraucaṃ pitṛbhyāṃ vārito’pi san |
yadyevaṃ kapaṭaṃ prītinapahāya kṛtaṃ mayi ||32||
gaṇeśasya sulagnasya kāryaṃ sāralyataḥ kṛtam |
ahantu ghorapanthārthaṃ gṛhānniṣkāsitastataḥ ||33||
mayā nātra gṛhe yāvajjīvaṃ sthātavyameva hi |
mayūraṃ svaṃ samāruhya senāṃ tyaktvā piturgṛhe ||34||
yayau krauṃce mahāśaile nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ |
paramo vaiṣṇavo bhūtvā bhajatyaniśamacyutam ||35||
svāmitvaṃ sa samāpannaḥ sādhutāmagrahīttataḥ |
brahmavrate sadā tiṣṭhan vartate sādhuśīlavāt ||36||
kārtikasvāmināmāsau pūjyate krauṃcaparvate |
kārtikyāṃ tu sadā devā ṛṣayaśca satīrthakāḥ ||37||
darśanārthaṃ kumārasya gacchanti ca munīśvarāḥ |
athomā duḥkhamāpannā skandasya virahe sati ||38||
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ dīnā tatra gaccha mayā saha |
tatsukhārthaṃ svayaṃ śaṃbhurgataḥ svāṃśena parvate ||39||
mallikārjunanāmā sa śaṃbhuḥ satyā sahāvasat |
kārtikastadravrataṃ jñātvā virajyānyatra gacchati ||1.108.40||
tāvad devādibhistatra prārthito hyavasat khalu |
yojanatrayamutsṛjya sthitaḥ skandaḥ suśīladhṛk ||41||
putrasnehāturau tau vai śivau parvaṇi parvaṇi |
darśanārthaṃ kumārasya snehilau cāpi gacchataḥ ||42||
amāvāsyādine tatra svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ prayāti hi |
pūrṇimāyāṃ svayaṃ yāti pārvatī senayā yutā ||43||
ityevaṃ śrīgaṇeśasya siddhirbuddhiśca vai priye |
kṣemo lābhaśca putrau dvau saha taiḥ pūjanaṃ kriyāt ||44||
etadākhyānamanaghaṃ yaśasyaṃ sukhavardhanam |
āyuṣyaṃ svargyamatulaṃ śivabhaktivivardhanam ||45||
kathitaṃ te mahālakṣmi mātṛsevāvivardhanam |
apavargapradaṃ proktaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||46||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne viśvarūpaprajāpatinā siddhibuddhināmakakanyādvayaṃ śrīgaṇeśāya vivāhavidhinārpitaṃ tataḥ kṣemo lābhaśceti putrotpattiḥ kārtikeyasya krauṃcādriṃ prati sadā gamanamityādikathananāmāṣṭādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 108||

<1.109>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
bhagavan devadeveśa śrāvitaṃ paramādbhutam |
kathānakaṃ gaṇeśasya kārtikeyasya vai tathā || 1 ||
atra me bhagavan kācijjijñāsā bhavatīti te |
pṛcchāmi devadeveśa śrutvā śamaya tāṃ prabho || 2 ||
kārtikeyastu pitarau tyaktvāgāddūrameva yat |
tadyogyaṃ na bhavelloke śāstre’pi saṃbhavennahi || 3 ||
mātuḥ piturguroḥ sevā kāryeti mokṣadā śubhā |
sevāṃ tyaktvā gato dūre duritaṃ tatkṛtaṃ bhavet || 4 ||
duritasya tu pāpasya prāyaścittaṃ tathā kṣayaḥ |
phalaṃ syāditi kasmāttatkārtikeye babhūva na || 5 ||
mātuḥsevā muktikaro mātā bahuvidhā matā |
stanadātrī garbhadhātrī bhakṣyadātrī gurupriyā || 6 ||
abhīṣṭadevapatnī ca pituḥ patnī ca kanyakāḥ |
sagarbhā bhaginī cāpi putrapatnī priyāprasūḥ || 7 ||
māturmātā piturmātā sodarasya priyā tathā |
mātuḥ pituśca bhaginī mātulānī tathaiva ca || 8 ||
janānāṃ vedavihitā mātaraḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ |
tā vai pūjyā namaskāryāḥ sevyāḥ stutyāḥ suputrakaiḥ || 9 ||
tāsāṃ tvāśīrvaco’pyatra putraṃ rakṣati kilbiṣāt |
tāsāṃ sevā kṛtā yena sa yāti brahma śāśvatam || 1.109.10 ||
tāsāṃ tu sevayā putro bhāgyavān bhavati dhruvam |
tāsāṃ hṛdayaduḥkhena bhāgyaṃ dahyati vai śubham || 11 ||
puṇyaṃ naśyati sallakṣmīstaṃ tyaktvānyatra yāti ca |
tatkathaṃ kārtikeyena tyaktā mā jagadīśvarī || 1 2||
senā pativratā patnī kathaṃ tyaktā priyā nijā |
pativratāyāstyajane narakaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 13 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi mayā sarvaṃ puraiva vihitaṃ tathā |
mayājaśaṃbhupitrarṣidevāśryaṇḍaṃ vinirmitam || 14||
ādye satyayuge sarve brāhmaṇā brahmatejasaḥ |
paramātmasamā hyāsan sakalpasmṛddhayo’bhavan || 15 ||
tretāyāṃ nyūnasāmarthyā hyabhavankālabhedataḥ |
dvāpare tu viśeṣeṇa sāmarthyahīnatāṃ gatāḥ || 16 ||
sāmarthyaṃ tu tapomūlaṃ tapohānau vinaśyati |
prajāyāṃ tapaso hāsātsāmarthyahīnatābhavat || 17||
