yathā yathā ca sāmarthyaṃ hīyate tu tathā tathā |
adharmavaṃśasāmarthyaṃ vardhate tu śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 18||
adharmeṇa prajāstatrāsatyalobhamadānvitāḥ |
parasparaṃ duḥkhadātryo’bhavankālasya vegataḥ || 19||
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ brahmaṇā tāvannārāyaṇapareśvaraḥ |
smṛtastatra prajārakṣopāyārthaṃ śrīharistadā ||1.109.20||
brahmadhāmasthitaḥ sākṣāllokarakṣaṇahetave |
sakalpaṃ vedhaso jñātvā drāgeva cāyayau hariḥ |||21||
brahmā prāha tadā devaṃ natvā stutvā punaḥ punaḥ |
mahārāja kṛpāsindho hyadhamoddhārakāraka |||2||
yugabhedātprajāḥ samyaṅ na vartante tapaḥpriyāḥ |
tapo’bhāvānna vai puṇyaṃ sāmarthyaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||23 ||
tadabhāvācca duḥkhāḍhyā mānavā daivavarjitāḥ |
kathaṃ mayā rakṣaṇīyāḥ prabho bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ |||24||
śuṣkeṇa sākaṃ sarasaṃ dahyatyapi nirāgasam |
tadrakṣaṇāya bhagavan kamupāyaṃ karomi vai ||25||
bhaktānāṃ tapaso yogād bhajanātparameśvara |
sarve jīvāḥ prasukhino bhavantyeva hi niścitam ||26||
kālayogācca bhaktā vai tapaḥsādhanavarjitāḥ |
bhavanti cettadā jīvā rakṣyante kena karmaṇā ||27||
tasmātprajānāṃ saukhyārthamupāyaṃ parikalpaya |
yugeṣu yena sarveṣu bhaktāḥ syuḥ sukhinaḥ sadā ||28||
iti vedhaḥkṛtāṃ jīvarakṣāgarbhitarādhanām |
śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ śrīmān paraṃbrahma svayaṃ hariḥ ||29||
brahmāṇaṃ prāha deveśa mā cintā vaha padmaja |
tava brahmāṃḍajīvānāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ tu rakṣaṇam || 1.109.30 ||
ahameva kariṣye’tra nānyastādṛgbhavedataḥ |
mayaiva tatsamācintya yāvadbrahmāṇḍasaṃsthitiḥ ||3 1||
tāvattu rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ mama bhaktā yataḥ priyāḥ |
yadyanyaṃ rakṣakaṃ tatra yojayāmi tadā tu saḥ || 32 ||
kālavegena galito duḥkhaṃ pratyuta cāpnuyāt |
tasmādahaṃ svayaṃ sākṣātparabrahma parātparaḥ |||33 ||
akṣaraṃ brahma nītvaiva sākaṃ prajāvanāya vai |
nivasāmyatra loke tachreyaḥ syājjagatāṃ param ||34||
dharmadevānmama janma mūrtyāṃ saṃkalpamātrataḥ |
svīkṛtyātra bhaviṣyāmi naranārāyaṇātmakaḥ |||35||
yāvajjīvaṃ brahmacārī brahmatapasi saṃsthitaḥ |
tapasaiva prajā rakṣan kariṣye’vanamādarāt ||36||
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahmākṣaraṃ brahma naraḥ smṛtaḥ |
ubhau brahmavratāḍhyau vai tapasi kṛtamānasau ||37||
vartiṣyāmaha ityetatsādhanaṃ rakṣaṇaṃ param |
brahācaryavrataṃ me’sti priyaṃ priyatamaṃ sadā || 38||
tadvrataṃ sarvadā brahmaloke saṃpālayāmi vai |
tatraiva divye badarikāśrame pālayāmi ca ||39||
īśvarāṇāṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ sadā tapasi saṃsthitaḥ |
atrāpyāgatya himavacchikhare yogamāsthitaḥ ||1.109.40 ||
sarvendriyapratirodhātmake tapasi saṃsthitaḥ |
tapaḥpuṇyapradānena rakṣiṣyāmi janānmama ||41||
cintāṃ mā kuru padmastha tapasā rakṣyate jagat |
bhavanti vividhānyeva tapāṃsi rakṣaṇāya vai |||42||
ghrāṇenānyanna ghrātavyamityetattapa ucyate |
tato’pi ca tvacā cānyanna spraṣṭavyaṃ viśiṣyate ||45 ||
tato’pi cakṣuṣā cānyanna draṣṭavyaṃ viśiṣyate |
tato’pyanyanna śrotavyaṃ śrotreṇeti viśiṣyate ||44||
tato rasanayā cānyanna rasyaṃ vai viśiṣyate |
tato vācā na vaktavyaṃ tapo vai śreṣṭhamucyate ||45||
ūrdhvahastaścaikapādo nirāhārastapaḥsthitaḥ |
maunādapyadhikaḥ proktastāpasaḥ kaṣṭamāsthitaḥ ||46||
tato’pi nirjalaḥ śreṣṭhastato’pyakalpitakriyaḥ |
śreṣṭhastato’pi sarvasmānniṣkāmaścordhvavīryavān ||47||
ūrdhvaretā brahmacārī ratyabhāvādviśiṣyate |
sarvendriyebhyo liṃgasya nirodho balavattapaḥ ||48||
rasanāyā nirodhaśca manonirodha ityapi |
dhātornirodhastvagrodho rodhāścatvāra īritāḥ ||49||
brahmacarye nirodhāste catvāraḥ saṃbhavanti vai |
tasmātkaṣṭataro rodho nānyo’sti balavān khalu ||1.109.50 ||
yena brahmavrataṃ sāṃgopāṃgaṃ saṃpālitaṃ tu saḥ |
mūrtimān vai parabrahma harirnāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ||51 ||
brahmacaryavratasthasyānyatkartavyaṃ na śiṣyate |
kāntākanakasūtreṇa veṣṭitaṃ sakalaṃ jagat ||52||
tāsu teṣu virakto yo dvibhujaḥ parameśvaraḥ |
brahmacaryabalāt so’tra tārayatyakhilaṃ jagat ||53||
ahamanne nivasāmi śuddhasattvamayaḥ prabhuḥ |
jāṭhare’haṃ nivasāmi parātṛptipradaḥ prabhuḥ ||94||
dhātuṣvahaṃ nivasāmi rajovīryātmakaḥ prabhuḥ |
tasyāvanaṃ kṛtaṃ yena mama tenāvanaṃ kṛtam ||55||
kāmabhogasya saṃkalpaḥ kartavyo naiva sarvathā |
kāmabhogāya vārtāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ kāryameva na ||5 6 ||
kāmabhogasya vacanaṃ noccāryaṃ sarvathā yataḥ |
kāmabhogasya saṃsparśo vidheyo naiva sarvathā ||5 7||
kāmabhogakṛte kāmidarśanaṃ kāryameva na |
kāmabhogakṛte guptasaṃketaḥ kārya eva na ||5 8 ||
kāmabhogādhyavasāyo naiva kāryaḥ kathaṃcana |
rajovīryaprapātaśca naiva kāryaḥ kadācana ||59||
ityevaṃ brahmacaryaṃ vai sarveṣāṃ duṣkaraṃ matam |
mithunībhūtajīvānāṃ duṣkaraṃ cātapasvinām ||1.109.60 ||
tādṛśaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tu naranārāyaṇamṛte |
nānyatrāstīti tadrūpaṃ dhṛtvā dhāsye paraṃ tapaḥ ||6 1 ||
tadvratena prajāṃ sarvāṃ rakṣiṣyāmi tanuṃ mama |
pāpāduddhārayiṣye tāṃ sukhayiṣye samantataḥ ||62||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne svaprajārakṣaṇāya brahmacaryatapaḥkaraṇāya nārāyaṇena brahmaṇe naranārāyaṇāvatārāvaśyakatetikathitamiti pradarśananāmā navādhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 109 ||

<1.110>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ityevaṃ tu mayā lakṣmi pratijñātaṃ tu vedhase |
tataścāhaṃ tataḥsthānād drāgevādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ || 1 ||
mamākṣare pare dhāmni brahmacārivrate sthitaḥ |
varte yadvatsarvathaiva varte badrīvane tathā || 2 ||
divyaṃ cākṣaradhāmnastu prāntabhāge tadāśrame |
tathaiva ca prasaṃkalpya dharmadeve praviṣṭavān || 3 ||
akṣarabrahmaṇā sākaṃ dharmānmūrtau praviṣṭavān |
mūrtyā mama jananyā ca tadā saṃkalpamātrataḥ || 4 ||
bālau pravirbhāvitau tau naranārāyaṇātmakau |
jātamātro ṣoḍaśābdau surūpau kāmamohanau || 5 ||
supuṣṭahṛṣṭasarvāṃgau mālā pustikarābjakau |
koṭikoṭyarkasaṃkāśau projjvalau parameśvarau || 6 ||
sūkṣmasvarṇatantutulyajaṭāśobhitamastakau |
kaupīnācchādanau vṛkṣaśālākanthākamaṇḍalū || 7 ||
sopavītau brahmacaryavratapūrṇau tapasvinau |
anyatra puruṣe nārībhāgau tu bhavato yathā || 8 ||
pūruṣasya vāmabhāgo nyūnaśaktyāśrayo bhavet |
mayi nārāyaṇe vāme nyūnaśaktirna vai manāk || 9 ||
vāmadakṣiṇayoḥ sarvāḥ samānā eva śaktayaḥ |
nyūnaśaktyātmako nārībhāgo mayi na vidyate || 1.110.1 0||
vidyete vakṣasi cihne stanayostu mamaiva te |
stanacihnasya virahe mūrtau me nyūnatā bhavet || 11 ||
sarvāṃgapūrṇatā na syāt tataścihne tu rakṣite |
nare’tha mama rūpe vai vidyete na stanau yataḥ || 1 2|
tasminnare mayā nārībhāvaleśasya hīnatā |
darśitā na tu sāmarthyanyūnādhikyamubhāṃgayoḥ || 1 3|||
nistanastu naro bodhyaḥ sastano’haṃ narāyaṇaḥ |
mayā lakṣmīḥ sadā rakṣyā stano vai rakṣitau tataḥ || 14||
nararūpe tu lakṣmyāste susattve na prayojanam |
brahmacaryasvarūpe me patnyā nāsti prayojanam || 15||
ityato nararūpaṃ me brahmacaryaṃ paraṃ matam |
tādṛgrūpau samutpannāvājānubhujapaṃkajau || 16 ||
dṛṣṭvā tu pitarau samyakprasannau ca pracakratuḥ |
saṃskārau jātasaṃśuddhathai samājñaptau tapaḥkṛte || 17||
tadā hyāvāṃ naranārāyaṇau tau ca vavandatuḥ |
sevārthaṃ na tapo’rtha vai sevā pitrostu durlabhā || 18||
sevāyāṃ tu sadā samyagvartanīyaṃ suputrakaiḥ |
loke sṛṣṭau sadā mātā putraṃ garbhe surakṣati || 1 9||
tannimittaṃ sadā kaṣṭaṃ sahate jananī mahat |
prasave cāpi kaṣṭaṃ ca pālane kaṣṭamityapi || 1.110.20||
rātryahaṃ cānusandhānaṃ kṣālanaṃ malamūtrayoḥ |
prāṇavad rakṣaṇaṃ śaśvatstanyapānena poṣaṇam ||21|||
aṃke kaṭyāṃ ca vahanaṃ svamabhuktvā prapoṣaṇam |
lālanaṃ raṃjanaṃ sevā mātrā tu kriyate sadā || 22||
tasyā jananyā ājanma āmṛti sevayāpi vai |
na putro nirṛṇo vai syādasevakasya kiṃ bhavet ||23 ||
sevāhīnasya putrasya mātṝṇaṃ na nivartate |
tasmātsevā prakartavyā cetyāvābhyāṃ prarocate ||24||
mātṛsevāvihīnastu putro na putra ucyate |
sa tvaputra iti prokto mātṛbhārakaro hi saḥ ||25 ||
tasmātsevāṃ kariṣyāvo hyubhau pitrostu sarvadā |
asevakasya putrasya narake niyatā gatiḥ || 26 ||
kālapāśena baddhaḥ syātpretaścāpi bhavettathā |
ṛṇadānāya vividhāṃ yoniṃ gacchecca yātanām ||27||
ṛṇāni trīṇyapākṛtya mano mokṣe niveśayet |
saṛṇasya gatirnāsti na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaḥ ||28|||
pitṝṇaṃ putramutpādya devarṇaṃ yāgakarmaṇā |
ṛṣyṛṇa vidyayāpohya manastapasi yojayet ||29||
tasmātsevāṃ kariṣyāvo’nyathādhogatimāpnuvaḥ |
vṛddhau tu pitarau putraiḥ pālanīyau samantataḥ ||1.110.3 0||
anujāḥ pālanīyāśca rakṣyāḥ svasāra ityapi |
vivāhanīyāḥ satataṃ dattvā sāhāyyamarthajam || 3 1||
kuṭumbapoṣaṇaṃ kāryamudyamaśca dhanārjane |
sukhaduḥkhe same cohye sambandhibhirgṛhasthitaiḥ ||32||
pitrorāsvargavāsaṃ vai sevanīyau tu tau matau |
putro yuvā bhaviṣyanvai rakṣiṣyati ca nau tadā ||33||
sukhinau vai bhaviṣyāva iti pitroḥ prakalpanam |
bhaṃktvā yāyādvane putrau na putraḥ sa tu rākṣasaḥ ||34||
vane phalaṃ na vai tasya bhavetpratyuta pātakam |
pitrorāśīrvacoyuktān puṇyasaṃghānna yo’rjayet |||35|||
sa svargaṃ vātha sāmrājye sthito’pi nārakī mataḥ |
tasmāttu yuvayoḥ sevāṃ kariṣyāvastu sarvathā |||26||
mātṛsevā kṛtā yena tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
dānaṃ yajñastapo homo vedādhyayanameva ca ||37||
devatāḥ pūjitāstena dhyānaṃ sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā |
tapastaptaṃ ca vividhaṃ brahmavidyāpi cārjitā ||38||
sāmrājyaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tena svargaṃ hastagataṃ kṛtam |
pāramaiṣṭhyapadaṃ labdhaṃ yena mātā prasevitā ||39||
pitarastarpitāstena ṛṣayaḥ pūjitāstathā |
atithayo’rcitāstena yena mātā susevitā ||1.110.40 ||
gamitāni ca tīrthāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni vai |
vihitānīṣṭapūrtāni yena mātā prasevitā ||41||
nāsti sevāsamaṃ puṇyaṃ sāṃkhyayogādicarvaṇe |
nāsti mātṛsamā devī nāpi pitṛsamo hariḥ ||42||
mriyamāṇo’pi bālo vai pitṛbhyāṃ ca nirīkṣitaḥ |
tathāpi svargamāpnuyāt kastau devau parityajet ||43||
indraḥ sūryaḥ śaśī viṣṇurgaṇeśaḥ śaṃkaro’bjajaḥ |
varuṇo’gnistathā cānye devāstu janake sthitāḥ || 44||
janakasya sutaḥ samyaksevayā labhate’nvaham |
devapūjāphalātkoṭiguṇaṃ satphalamakṣayam ||45||
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī sandhyā sāvitrī ca satī tathā |
gāyatrī rohiṇī saṃjñā vāruṇī vaiṣṇavī tathā ||46||
sarvāśca pūjitāstena yena mātā susevitā |
tāsāṃ pūjākṛtapuṇyāt koṭipuṇyaṃ prasūsthitam ||47||
sarvāstā jananīmūrtau tiṣṭhantyeva na vai pṛthak |
tasmānmātuśca sevāṃ vai pituścāpi prasevanam ||48||
kariṣyāvo’tra pitrostu pādayorvāsamāsthitau |
pitroḥ sevāmahimānaṃ vijānantau narācyutau ||49||
mahāpāpābhibhūtasya pitṛsevāratasya tu |
putrasya nayane dūtā yamasya prabhavo na vai ||1.110.50||
mṛtikāle yadi pitrornetrābhyāṃ netramelanam |
kriyate tu suputreṇa tadāpi sadgatirbhavet ||51 ||
mṛtyukāle suputreṇa mukhe vṛndādalaṃ jalam |
dīyate’pi ca tanmātrāt pitrostu sugatirbhavet |||52||
yasya gehe bhavetputraḥ pratuṣyanti pitāmahāḥ |
putrahīnaṃ kuṭumbantu śapantyeva pitāmahāḥ |||53||
vaṃśe śrāddhaprakartāramadṛṣṭvā prapitāmahāḥ |
muñcantyuṣṇapraṇiḥśvāsān bhāvinīraśanārditāḥ ||54||
svasāraścāpi niḥśvāsān muñcantyabhrātrya ityataḥ |
nāsmabhyaḥ kaṃcukīdātā bhrātāpi vidyate iti ||55||
lokā vadantyanapatyānanaṃ dṛśyaṃ na maṃgalam |
kanyāṃ vadanti nabhrātrīṃ nirvaṃśyo’yaṃ jano vadet ||56||
putraśūnyaṃ gṛhaṃ saudho vimānaṃ ca śmaśānavat |
putraśūnyāḥ khānapānābharaṇādivibhūtayaḥ ||57||
kṛṣṇāhiviṣavadbodhyā nānandāya bhavanti tāḥ |
devāśca ṛṣayaḥ sarpā nāgāścāṇḍajajātayaḥ ||58||
sarve’pīcchanti satputrān janmāputraṃ nirarthakam |
tasmādbhāvyaṃ suputreṇa susevakena sarvathā |||59||
ato hyāvāṃ kariṣyāvaḥ sevāṃ pitrostu sarvadā |
tatraḥ śreyaḥ paraṃ bhāvyaṃ sevā muktipradāyinī ||1.110.60 ||
iti pitrormahimānamuktvā naranarāyaṇau |
tūṣṇīṃ babhūvatustatra sevādharmaratau yadā ||61||
pitṛbhaktimayau mātṛsevākṛtaviniścayau |
tutuṣaturmūrtidharmau śubhāśīrvādayojinau |||62||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne naranārāyaṇābhyāṃ janmottaraṃ pitroḥ sevādharmapraśaṃsananāmā daśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 110 ||

<1.111>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dharmadevaḥ sevāviniścayau |
putrau prāha paraṃ dharm paro yasmānna vidyate || 1 ||
sarvadharmasamāveśo yatra dharme pratiṣṭhitaḥ |
taṃ dharm prathamaṃ dhāmni hariṇā saṃpradarśitam || 2 ||
sarvaśreyaskaraṃ dharmamṛṇābādhyaṃ pramokṣadam |
śrutaṃ nārāyaṇamukhānmuktidaṃ sādhanottaram || 3 ||
dharmaḥ prāha śṛṇutaṃ vai putrau paramaśobhanau |
dharmavantau pitṛbhaktau yaduktaṃ tatsuśobhate || 4 ||
lakṣaṇaṃ tatsuputrasya mātāpitroḥ susevanam |
tattato’pyadhikaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇutaṃ hariṇoditam || 5 ||
brahmacaryasamo dharmo nāsti nāstyeva naiva hi |
anye sarve tu dharmāṇaḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 6 ||
brahmacaryaṃ brahmadharmo brahma vai sa svayaṃ matam |
brahmarūpaṃ brahmamūrtirbrahmātmā brahmarūpadaḥ || 7 ||
tuṣṭe brahmaṇi sarveśe sarvaṃ tuṣṭaṃ sadā bhavet |
sevā ṛṇāni dānāni tadagre svalpamātrakam || 8 ||

tasmād yajño brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā || 9 ||
iṣṭāpūrtena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
tasmādiṣṭaṃ brahmacarye sampratiṣṭhati sarvadā || 1.111.10 ||
yadidaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmacaryamiti smṛtam |
paraṃ tatsarvadharmebhyastena mokṣaḥ pralabhyate || 11 ||
brahmacarye sthito dharmo brahmacarye sthitaṃ tapaḥ |
brahmacarye sthitā ye te brahmadhāmni sthitā matāḥ || 1 2||
yogena jāyate siddhiḥ siddhyā kīrtiḥ pravartate |
kīrtiḥ siddhiśca tapasā tapo brahmaṇi caryayā || 13||
indriyanigraho’sādhyo brahmacaryeṇa sādhyate |
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā brahmaloko hyavāpyate || 14||

kiṃ punardevalokādyā brahmādhānaṃ hi tattataḥ || 15||
sattrāyaṇena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
sattrāyaṇaṃ brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā || 16||
maunavratena labhyaṃ yadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
maunaṃ tato brahmacarye saṃpratiṣṭhati sarvathā || 17||
anāśakāyanenāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
anāśakāyanaṃ brahmacarye tiṣṭhati sarvathā || 18||
araṇyayanasaṃprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate|
araṇyāyanamapyatra brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 19 ||
tyāgāyanena saṃprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
dṛṣṭānuśravike tyāgo brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 1.111.20||
ahiṃsayā ca yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
ahiṃsā sārvabhaumā sā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 21 ||
satyavratena yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
satyaṃ tasmād brahmacarye trividhaṃ pratitiṣṭhati || 22||
asteyena ca yatprāpyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
asteyaṃ sarvathā dvedhā brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 23 ||
aparigrahalabhyaṃ yadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
aparigraha evāpi brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 24||
śaucena prāpyate yadvai brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
śaucaṃ dvedhā brahmayogād brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 25||
santoṣāllabhyate yattadbrahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
santoṣaḥ sarvathātmīyo brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 26||
tapaścaryā vividhā yā brahmacaryeṇa pūryate |
tatastapomahākāṇḍo brahmacarye samāpyate || 27||
svādhyāyena ca yallabhyaṃ brahmacaryeṇa labhyate |
svādhyāyaḥ sarvatovyāpto brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 28 ||
īśvarasya praṇidhānaṃ brahmacarye pravartate |
tata īśapraṇidhānaṃ brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 29||

tasmādāsanakūṭastu brahmacarye pratiṣṭhati || 1.111.30 ||

samādhiryatra kartavyo brahmacaryeṇa siddhyati |
tasmāddvedhā caturdhā sa brahmacarye pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 35||
damaśāntititikṣehoparamādibhirāpyate |
yacca tadvai brahmacaryāllabhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3 6||
vivekācca vibho kāccābhyāsātsatkriyayā tathā |

brahmavimarśasadbindunādadhvānagiro’pi ca |
pravartante brahmaṇastadbrahmacaryaphalaṃ matam ||41||

ūhaḥ śabdo’dhyayanaṃ ca duḥkhaghātāstrayastathā |

dūraśravaṇadarśanādānagamanādṛśyatāḥ |
siddhayaśca tathā sarvā labhyante brahmacaryataḥ ||45||
netyā dhotyā ca bastyā ca kuṃjarakriyayā tathā |

pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇāt śrāddhād yadāpyate tadāpyate |

putrotpattyā vidyayāgnihotreṇārādhyate tu yat||

pratīkopāsanālabhya yanmataṃ dhāma tatkhalu ||49 ||

mātṛpitṛkuṭumbānāṃ lokānāṃ sevayā ca yat ||1.111.50 ||

goviprāṇāṃ surāṇāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ mahatāṃ tathā ||5 1 ||

brahmacaryatapoyogāduddhārayati yatsvakau || 1.111.100 ||
mātāpitarau sā sevā nānyatulyālpikā matā |
yatkṛtena sadā mātuḥ pituḥ prasannatā bhavet || 101 ||
tatkṛtaṃ sarvadā sevā nānyā sevā viśiṣyate |
kārtikena kṛtā sevā brahmavratatapomayī || 102||
iṣṭaṃ tapastu pārvatyāstathā śaṃbhorapi dhruvam |
loke yogyaṃ ca śāstre’pi tapaḥ kāryamiti prathā || 103 ||
brahmavrataṃ tapo lakṣmi mokṣadaṃ duritaṃ na tat |
mātā śivā prasannāsīt pitā śaṃbhuḥ prasādavān || 1 04||
senāpatitvamāpyaiva tārakāsuranāśanam |
kṛtaṃ pitrorvacana tat tvājñāsevātmakaṃ param || 105 ||
mayaiva vihitā ceyaṃ skandasthitiranuttamā |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 106 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmacaryamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakakārtikeyāduritatādipradarśananāmā ekādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 111 ||

<1.112>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇa harekṛṣṇa prāṇanātha mahāprabho |
bhavatoktaṃ mahādevo vaiṣṇavāgryo’sti sarvathā || 1 ||
kathaṃ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ proktastatkathāṃ śrotumutsahe |
kva kadā vaiṣṇavo jātaḥ śrāvayādya mama priya || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu devi kathāṃ divyāṃ mahāvaiṣṇavakāriṇīm |
mokṣadāṃ viṣṇusambaddhāṃ kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 3 ||
santi pṛthvyāṃ parvatāśca devādivāsadāyinaḥ |
teṣāṃ priyatamaḥ śaityaprado mokṣapradastathā || 4 ||
himālayaḥ sadā śāntastatra badarikāśramam |
puruṣau tatra vartete naranārāyaṇāvubhau || 5 ||
tatraikaḥ śvetapuruṣaścānyaḥ kṛṣṇastu rūpataḥ |
anujaḥ piṃgalaḥ proktaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 6 ||
dvibāhuśca caturbāhurnaro nārāyaṇaḥ kramāt |
tatra devā vasantīha ṛṣīṇāṃ cāśramāḥ śubhāḥ || 7 ||
gaṃgā yatrālakanandā divyā vahati sarvadā |
ekasminvatsare tatra maheśastaptavām̐stapaḥ || 8 ||
tadā nārāyaṇo devo bhaktanāmabhayaṃkaraḥ |
suprasanno’bravīcchaṃbhuṃ varaṃ varaya śaṃkara || 9 ||
yaṃ yamipsasi deva tvaṃ taṃ taṃ kāmaṃ dadāmyaham |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā nārāyaṇaṃ tu karuṇākaram || 1.112.10 ||
ahaṃ gṛhṇāmi bho deva yadi dātuṃ tvamicchasi |
dvau varau mama dīyetāṃ suprasanno janārdana || 1 1||
tava bhaktiḥ sadaivāstu bhaktarājo bhavāmyaham |
sarvaloke prasiddhaḥ syāṃ śivo bhakto mahāniti || 12||
viṣṇubhakta itikhyātirlokeṣu bhuvaneṣvapi |
jāyatāṃ sarvadā viṣṇu nārāyaṇa jagatprabho || 13 ||
atha ye māṃ bhajiṣyanti grahīṣyantyāśrayaṃ mama |
tasya tava prasādena muktidātā bhavāmyaham || 14||
yasyāhaṃ varadātā syāṃ tasya muktirbhaved dhruvā |
viṣṇubhakto muktidātā syāṃ me dehi varadvayam || 15||
iti śrutvā svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prāha śaṃbhuṃ guṇākaram |
bhava śaṃbho mama bhakto dātā mukteśca saṃbhava || 16||
evaṃ varau tadā labdhvā śaṃkaraḥ prāha taṃ harim |
dehi dīkṣāṃ ca me nātha vaiṣṇavaśca bhavāmyaham || 17||
nāvaiṣṇavo bhavedbhakto muktido nāpyavaiṣṇavaḥ |
bhuktirmuktiśca te yogādvaiṣṇavatve sati dhruvā || 18||
vaiṣṇavena tato bhāvyaṃ dehi dīkṣāṃ kṛpāṃ kuru |
viṣṇurnārāyaṇo devaḥ śrutvā prāha tu śaṃkaram || 1 9||
sādhu saṃkalpitaṃ śaṃbho sarvalokahitārthi yat |
gṛhāṇa śaṃbho prathamaṃ mantraratnaṃ śubhāvaham ||1.112.20 ||
brahmāhaṃ brahmabhaktosmi japasvainaṃ nirantaram |
mantraratnamidaṃ nāma prapāti śaraṇāgatam ||21 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ sarvaphalapradaḥ |
śrīmannārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ ||22||
svāminārāyaṇaśceti mantro mokṣapradaḥ smṛtaḥ |
naranārāyaṇaśceti mantro brahmagatipradaḥ ||23||
harinārāyaṇaśceti mantro duḥkhavināśakaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaśceti mantro vibhūtidāyakaḥ ||24||
mantro vāsudevanārāyaṇastvaiśvaryadāyakaḥ |
rāmanārāyaṇaśceti mantraḥ pāpavināśakaḥ ||25||
oṃ śrīnārāyaṇo mantro bhuktimuktipradāyakaḥ |
mantraḥ prapattidastveṣaḥ śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ mama ||26|||
ityevaṃ mantradaśakaṃ deyaṃ bhaktebhya uttamam |
oṃ namo bhagavata vāsudevāyeti mantrarāṭ ||27||
mantrarājaṃ mantraratnaṃ daśamantrām̐śca śaṃkara |
etān dvādaśamantrām̐stvaṃ dehi śiṣyajanāya vai ||28||
mantroccāraṇamātreṇa cātituṣṭo’smi nityadā |
mantrādhikāriṇaḥ sarve ye me bhaktā mumukṣavaḥ ||29||
jñānino yoginaścānye jaḍā nāryastathāśritāḥ |
bhaktiśraddhānvitāḥ sarve mānavā hyadhikāriṇaḥ |||1.112.30 ||
brahmāṇḍe ye’tra tiṣṭhanti surādyāścādhikāriṇaḥ |
tebhyo’nyatamamantro vai dātavyaḥ śreyase bhavet ||3 1||
śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ gṛhāṇa bhujayostathā |
taptamudrāṃkanaṃ caitaccandanāṃkanameva vā ||32||
gṛhāṇa śaṃbho bāhvostadviṣṇurūpatvadāyakam |
pañcaviṃśatyakṣarāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ ca gṛhāṇa vai || 33 ||
oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi |
tanno brahma pracodayāditi japyānvahaṃ tvayā ||24|||
dhyāyasva māṃ surūpaṃ ca dvibhujaṃ vā caturbhujam |
dvibhujaṃ brahmaṇo rūpaṃ brahmadhāmani saṃsthitam ||35||
sarvāvatārasaṃdhartṛ parabrahmātmakaṃ śubham |
cakrahastaṃ tathābhayapradahastaṃ dvihastakam |||36||
hārakuṇḍalamālākaṭakamukuṭabhūṣaṇam |
pītāmbaraṃ ṣoḍaśābdaṃ prasannaṃ parameśvaram ||37||
caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhacakragadāpadmakarānvitam |
vāmāṃkasthaśriyā sārdhaṃ rūpaṃ dhyāyasva hṛdgamam ||38||
atha māṃ ṣoḍaśadivyopacāraiḥ pūjayasya ca |
āvāhanaṃ svāsanaṃ ca pādyamarghyaṃ tataḥ param ||39||
ācamanaṃ tathā snānaṃ madhuparkaṃ tathāmbaram |
candanaṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ nivedanam ||1.112.40||
yajñasūtraṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dehi me bhaktibhāvataḥ |
sugandhyarkaṃ karpūraṃ ca sugandhaṃ dehi me’nagham ||41 ||
kuru pradakṣiṇāṃ daṇḍavacca namaskriyāḥ kuru |
stutiṃ puṣpāñjaliṃ dehi kṣamāṃ yācasva mat tathā ||42||
visarjaya bahiṣṭo māṃ sve hṛdi sthāpayātmani |
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ caiva smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam ||43||
arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam |
dhyānaṃ samādhiraikyaṃ ca kuru bhajasva sādhanaiḥ || 44||
ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ ca tilakaṃ lalāṭe kuru śaṃkara |
bāhvośca hṛdaye cāpyūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tilakaṃ kuru ||45||
candanena sugandhena satkesarayutena ca |
tanmadhye candrakaṃ tena kuṃkumenāthavā kuru ||46||
kaṇṭhe gṛhāṇa tulasīgraiveyaṃ dvisaraṃ śubham |
kaṇṭhī sā tu sadā dhāryā na tu tyājyā kadācana ||47||
tulasīmālikāṃ cāṣṭottaraśatārthapūritām |
gṛhāṇa japakāryāya maṇyādinirmitāṃ ca vā ||48 ||
īśvarāntaṃ ca te nāma prakaromi maheśvaram |
pālakena ramayā ca kṛtastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ ||49||
pareṇa ca mayā lakṣmyā kṛtastvaṃ parameśvaraḥ |
paṃ viṣṇuṃ raṃ ramāṃ maśca mimīte bhajate tu yaḥ ||1.112.50 ||
aiśvaryāśraya ityuktastvaṃ śaṃbhuḥ parameśvaraḥ |
īśvarāntāni nāmāni tava śaṃbho bhavantu vai ||51 ||
evaṃ lakṣmi mayā dīkṣā dattā śrīśaṃkarāya vai |
tadārabhya sadā śaṃbhurbhajate māmananyabhāg ||52||
dīkṣāmādāya śaṃbhu sa gato vai gandhamādane |
svīyāvāse tu kailāse bhajate māmaharniśam ||53||
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ kandaṃ toyaṃ grāhyaṃ ca yadbhavet |
tatsarvaṃ māmanivedya naiva gṛhṇāti śaṃkaraḥ ||54||
karoti tilakaṃ sthāne māṃ ca japati mālayā |
tiṣṭhati dhyānamagno’sau mama mūrtāvanīhayā ||55||
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ bhaktiṃ śaṃkaraṃ prāha pārvatī |
kasya dhyānaṃ ca mālābhirjapaśca tilakādikam ||56 ||
kriyate lokanāthena parameśvararūpiṇā |
bhavāneva parabrahma parātparataraḥ svayam ||57||
ityevaṃ pūrṇarūpasya kasya dhyānaṃ japaśca vai |
iti śrutvā mahādevaḥ pārvatīṃ prāha tāttvikam ||58||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne badarikāśrame nārāyaṇena śaṃkarāya vaiṣṇavīdīkṣāpradānaṃ tadaṃgakalāpādipradarśana ceti nirūpaṇanāmā dvādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 12||

<1.113>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
pārvatyā vacanaṃ śrutvā vaiṣṇavaśca maheśvaraḥ |
saṃpravaktuṃ samārebhe tajjijñāsānivṛttaye || 1 ||
śṛṇu sati pravakṣyāmi viṣṇuṃ bhaje’hamaṃjasā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo viṣṇuḥ parabrahma pareśvaraḥ || 2 ||
bhajanīyaḥ pūjanīyo japanīyaśca sarvadā |
mayā dīkṣā tadīyā vai grahītā badarīvane || 3 ||
taṃ vai pareśvaraṃ nityaṃ dhyāye bhajāmi bhāvataḥ |
pārvatī prāha deveśa vistarāt tadyathātatham || 4 ||
māmapi śrāvaya sarvaṃ yadi grāhyaṃ mayā bhavet |
yenāhamapi govindamāśritya śreya āpnuyām || 5 ||
kathaṃ nādyāpi me nātha kathitaṃ nahi tatkvacit |
etāvatkālaparyantaṃ śrīharerbhajanaṃ vinā || 6 ||
divasāḥ sarvathā vyarthā gamitā me hariṃ vinā |
yadyahaṃ te devadeva satpātra sammatāsmi vai || 7 ||
tadā māmapi bhaktāṃ śrīhareḥ saṃdīkṣaya prabho |
gururbahmā gururviṣṇurgurudevo janārdanaḥ || 8 ||
guruḥ svasyāḥ patiḥ proktaḥ patyau sarvaṃ samāsthitam |
patyuḥ sevā parā sevā patyurbhaktiḥ parā matā || 9 ||
patidharmaḥ paro dharmastaṃ dharmaṃ dehi śaṃkara |
patistu vaiṣṇavo yasyāḥ patnī yadi na vaiṣṇavī || 1.113.10 ||
avaiṣṇavyā kṛtā sevā bhaktiḥ sarvāpi niṣphalā |
avaiṣṇavyā kṛtaṃ bhojyamaśuddhaṃ pāvanaṃ nahi || 11 ||
avaiṣṇavyāḥ karajalaṃ hyapeyaṃ pāvanaṃ nahi |
avaiṣṇavyā gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ śmaśānamiti gīyate || 1 bhe ||
avaiṣṇavyā gṛhāllakṣmīrniḥsarati sarvathā |
tasmādahaṃ svāmidharmaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pāvanaṃ param || 13 ||
saṃgrahītuṃ samicchāmi vistarādbrūhi tattvataḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ pārvatīgāthāṃ prāha śaṃbhurmaheśvarīm || 14 ||
nādyāpi pātratā te’bhūt tasmānna kathitaṃ mayā |
bahūnāṃ janmanāṃ puṇyaiḥ pātratā prāpyate khalu || 12 ||
etajjanmani pātratvaṃ puṣṭiṃ yāti kathāśravāt |
satāṃ tu sevayā cātmā divo bhavati nityaśaḥ || 16 ||
pātivratyena patyuśca sevayātmā balaṃ vrajet |
balavānbhāgyavānsādhusevako yo bhavejjanaḥ || 17 ||
tasyaiva nirmalā vṛttirbhavatyāntarabāhyajā |
nairmalyaṃ tu bhavedbījaṃ śraddhāyāḥ sarvathā priye || 18 ||
tato bhavati jijñāsā tayā cāpyadhikāritā |
tathā sati guroryoge sarvaṃ phalati yatkṛtam || 1 9||
tavedānīṃ tu tatsarvaṃ samutpannaṃ ca yojitam |
hyupasthitaṃ ca saṃjātaṃ tasmāt tvaṃ pātramuttamam || 1.113.20 ||
jātāsyadya mahādevi prasannaśca bhavāmyaham |
aho mama priyā patnī vaiṣṇavīṃ sthitimicchasi || 2 1 ||
asmāt kinnu mahadbhāgyaṃ paraṃ mama kṛte bhavet |
atyatīva prasanno’smi śrutvā te hṛdayaṃ priye || 22||
sarvaṃ te’haṃ pradāsye vai yatastvaṃ vaiṣṇavī bhava |
devi cādyāpi paryantaṃ bhojyaṃ peyaṃ yadarpitam || 2 3 ||
viṣṇave tatsamarpayya paścād bhuktaṃ mayā hi tat |
kiṃ vacmi devadeveśi hyadyānandamayo mahān || 24||
sūryodayaḥ suvarṇasya mama jāto’sti sarvathā |
patisevāphalaṃ sarvaṃ sakhi te bhavatu priye ||25|||
gṛhaṃ sarvaṃ mama bhūyādvaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgyavānaham |
adya devi dehaśuddhyai kārtike śuklapakṣake || 26 ||
daśamyāṃ tu nirāhāramupavāsaṃ kuru priye |
dehaśuddhyarthamevātra paṃcagavyaṃ gṛhāṇa ca || 27||
maṇḍapaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapūjākṛte racaya śobhanam |
kadalīstaṃbhasannaddhamaśokadalatoraṇam || 28 ||
saptadhānyakṛtaṃ tatra sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam |
racaya tvaṃ mahābhāge tatra sthāpaya sadghaṭam || 29 ||
aṣṭadikṣu ghaṭānpārśve sthāpayāṣṭau navām̐stataḥ |
kaṇṭhe veṣṭaya vastrāṇi mukhe paṃcārdrapallavān || 1.113.3 0 ||
nārīkelaphalānyaṣṭa kṛṣṇaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca tatra vai |
madhye ghaṭe svarṇapātre pratiṣṭhāpaya bhāvataḥ || 31 ||
gaṇeśapūjanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇapūjanaṃ tataḥ |
lakṣmyāśca pūjanaṃ nārāyaṇena saha kārayā || 32||
nivedaya varāṇyeva hyupacārāṇi ṣoḍaśa |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāḥ prātaḥ snānaṃ tathā kuru || 33 ||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pratipūjaya |
tatra samāgataṃ dīkṣāvidhijñātārameva ca || 34||
ācāryaṃ māṃ śraya pūrvaṃ haryāśrayaṇasiddhaye |
ācinoti ca śāstrārthānācāre sthāpayatyapi || 25||
svayaṃ tvācarate yasmāt brahmādhyāpayati dhruvam |
mantraṃ jānāti viṣṇośca bhaktiṃ karoti sarvathā || 36||
śrīmannārāyaṇasampradāyavidyāṃ tu vetti yaḥ |
tārayati svakaṃ śiṣyamācāryaḥ sa mato guruḥ || 37||
tadvākyeṣu suviśvāsaḥ śiṣyo bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ |
gṛhṇīyānmantraratnaṃ tadekādaśyāṃ tu kārtike ||38||
gṛhāṇa devi dīkṣāṃgaṃ śaṃkhacakrasumudraṇam |
paṃcāmṛtaiḥ prasaṃsnāpya śaṃkhaṃ cakraṃ prapūjya ca ||39||
agniṃ saṃsthāpya vidhinā juhayājyaṃ vidhānataḥ |
ghṛtapāyasayorhomamaṣṭottaraśataṃ kuru ||1.113.40 ||
śaṃkhacakre pratapte ca kuru hyagnau tato guruḥ |
ahaṃ śaṃbhurgurustvāṃ vai cakreṇa jalajena ca ||41||
aṃkayāmi dvayorbāhvoḥ punaḥ prapūjya taddvayam |
kalaśasthajalenātrābhiṣekaṃ kuru mastake |||42||
nūtanāṃ śāṭikāṃ dhṛtvā jalenācamanaṃ kuru |
lalāṭe tilakaṃ cordhvapuṃḍraṃ sacandrakaṃ kuru ||43||
candanena kuṃkumena tato mantraṃ gṛhāṇa me |
brahmāhaṃ brahmabhaktāsmi trivāraṃ tad gṛhāṇa me ||44||
tato māṃ prapūjayādritanaye māṃ namaskuru |
gṛhāṇa tulasīkaṇṭhīṃ kaṇṭhe dhāraya cādrije ||45||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśceti mantraṃ gṛhāṇa cādrije |
maheśvarīti te nāma parameśvarī cetyapi ||46||
bodhyaṃ tataḥ kuru dhyānaṃ śrīhariṃ dvibhujaṃ tathā |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ divyaṃ dhyāne gṛhāṇa sarvadā ||47||
parasmād brahmaṇo nārāyaṇād devo’sti no paraḥ |
tasyaiva cāparo mantraḥ śrīhariṃ śaraṇaṃ mama ||48||
gṛhāṇainaṃ śive’dya tvaṃ jātā pūjyā suvaiṣṇavī |
kuru bhaktiṃ harernityaṃ gurorme sevanaṃ kuru ||49||
śiṣyapraśiṣyaśākhāśca mantradānena vardhaya |
lakṣmyāvāsastvayi prāpto mayi nārāyaṇasya ca ||1.113.50||
āvāṃ bhaktiṃ kariṣyāvo nārāyaṇasya sarvadā |
sevāṃ tasya kariṣyāvo yena muktirdhruvā bhavet ||51||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kailāse śaṃbhunā pārvatyai śrīvaiṣṇavīdīkṣādattetyaṃgabhūtakāṇḍanirūpaṇanāmā trayodaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 11 3|||

<1.114>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato devyā vaiṣṇavyā prārthitaṃ punaḥ |
śaṃbhoragre kathayāmi śravaṇārhaṃ paraṃ yataḥ || 1 ||
pārvatyuvāca deveśa mahādeva sureśvara|
viṣṇubhaktiṃ mamācakṣva muktidāṃ vistarātpunaḥ || 2
nārāyaṇasvarūpāṇi mantrapūjāvidhīṃstathā |
tadvibhūtiguṇādīṃśca taddhāmagatisādhanam || 3
dhāmnastasya svarūpaṃ ca cihnamāhātmyamityapi |
vistareṇa mayi prītyā brūhi sarvamaśeṣataḥ || 4 |
iti pṛṣṭo mahādevyā śaṃbhuvaiṣṇavasattamaḥ |
uvāca paramapremṇā natvā nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 5 |
sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi sarvajīvahitaiṣiṇi |
bhaktavarye śīlarūpaguṇopete maheśvari || 6 |
parituṣṭo’smi te praśnād dhanyāsi vaiṣṇavi priye |
kṛtapuṇyāsi bhaktāsi prabhornārāyaṇasya ca || 7 |
vakṣyāmyahaṃ ca te devi bhagavadbhaktimuttamām |
nārāyaṇasvarūpaṃ ca mantrapūjāvidhiṃ tathā || 8 |

nāryo narādiveṣasthā nararūpasvadarśikāḥ ||54||

acihnāste vicihnā vai yāsyanti narakānmuhuḥ ||55||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne ūrdhvapuṃḍrādimāhātmyanirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 115||

<1.116>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tataḥ śaṃbhurmantramāhātmyamuttamam |
pārvatīṃ prāha sarvārthaṃ sabījaṃ ca savistaram || 1 ||
avaiṣṇavopadiṣṭena mantreṇa naiva siddhyati |
mokṣo vā kāryamevāpi tasmādvaiṣṇavamāśrayet || 2 ||
vaiṣṇavācāryadatto vai mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ |
guruṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ kuryānnāvaiṣṇavaṃ kadācana || 3 ||
vaiṣṇavasya guroryogācchuddhā bhavanti mānavāḥ |
baiṣṇavastu guruḥ prokto nārāyaṇasvarūpakaḥ || 4 ||
nārāyaṇasamo devo gururvai tārayejjanān |
gururnārāyaṇaḥ sākṣānmantrado mokṣadastathā || 5
na vai nārāyaṇānnyūno nārāyaṇasukhapradaḥ |
nārāyaṇasamo dehe nārāyaṇasamo guṇe || 6 ||
nārāyaṇasamo mokṣe nārāyaṇa ivārthadaḥ |
tasmādvaiṣṇavamūrdhanyādgurorgrāhyaḥ sumantrakaḥ || 7 ||
sahasraśākhādhyāyī ca sarvayajñādhikāravān |
viprādijanmavām̐ścāpi na guruḥ syādavaiṣṇavaḥ || 8 ||
gurumāśritya mantrārthaḥ samyag jñātavya eva ca |
śaṃkhacakrādicihnāktaḥ kṛtordhvapuṃḍracaṃdrakaḥ || 9 ||
kaṇṭhasthatulasīmālo mantrārthaṃ cintayed budhaḥ |
nyāsaścāṣṭākṣaro mantro brahmāhaṃ vrahmabhakto’smi || 1.116.10||
anye’pi vaiṣṇavā mantrā lakṣmīnārāyaṇā dayaḥ |
nyāso mantro mantrarūpaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ paraṃ matam || 1 1||
tadanye vaiṣṇavā mantrāstārakāḥ santi dehinām |
nyāsārthe tu parijñāte jñātavyārtho na śiṣyate || 12||
tasmācchṛṇu mahādevi mantraratnārthameva ca |
brahmāhaṃ brahmabhakto’smi tatra catuṣpadāni vai || 13||
brahatvād bṛṃhaṇatvācca vyāpakaṃ brahma cocyate |
tadvai brahma bhaved dvedhā sākāraṃ ca nirākṛti || 14||
sākāraṃ mūrtimatsevādharmavaddhāmni saṃsthitam |
sevaka cākṣaraṃ brahmā vartate pārṣadā yathā || 15||
kadācinmama muktākhyaṃ kadācicchrīsvarūpakam |
nararūpaṃ kadācittu kadācit siṃhamāsanam || 16||
tasya dharmo’nanyasevā pātivratyena sevanam |
sevādharmo brahmadharmo tadvad brahmasumūrtikam || 17||
dvitīyaṃ tu nirākāraṃ brahmalokaḥ sa ucyate |
akṣaraṃ dhāma cetyuktaṃ śrīharervyomadhāma tat || 18||
atitejomayaṃ śāntaṃ ramyamāhlādasaukhyadam |
tejomayaḥ pradeśaḥ sa vyāpakaṃ dhāma cocyate || 19||
parabrahmanivāsāya muktānāṃ vāsahetave |
sarvadā śāśvataṃ rūpaṃ vartate divyabhūstaraḥ ||1.116.20||
saccidānandatattvaṃ tat cidākāśākhyameva vai |
tatra divyo hariḥ sākṣātpuruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ ||21||
vasatyeva pare dhāmbi cākṣarākhye sukhāśraye |
tasya dhāmno bhavatyeva dharmo nirlepitātmakaḥ || 22||
māyātattveṣu sarveṣu vyāpakaṃ cāpyalepi tat |
māyādharmairna lepo’sti tasmādalepi kīrtyate |||23|||
ityevaṃ dvividhau dharmau sevā nirlepatā tathā |
sevakaścāpi nirlepo brahmaśabdārtha ucyate|||
ahaṃśabdaḥ śarīryarthamātmānaṃ bodhayatyapi |
viśeṣadehamāpannaścetanaścāhamucyate ||25||
mumukṣustādṛśo hyātmā dehabhinnastadāśritaḥ |
ahaṃpadena boddhavyo nāmarūpopalakṣitaḥ ||26||
puṃstrīśārīraātmāhaṃ nirlepaḥ sevakastava |
iti brahmāhamityasya tātparyortho’vadhāryatām ||27||
brahmabhaktapade vrahma parabrahmapada pareśvaraḥ |
paramātmākṣaraparaḥ puruṣottama ucyate |||28||
tasya vai vividhā bhaktiḥ pātivratyasamāhvayā |
tadāśrayaḥ sadā bhaktaḥ prapannaḥ śaraṇāgataḥ ||29||
bhaktiḥ prapattiḥ śaraṇāgatiḥ ṣaḍrūpadhāriṇī |
viśvāso varaṇaṃ nyāsaḥ kārpaṇyaṃ ca sthirā matiḥ ||1.116.3 0||
anuvṛttiśca bodhyā sā ṣaḍvidhā śaraṇāgatiḥ |
patnī dehaḥ patiścātmā tayoraikyena vartanam ||3 1||
pātivratyaṃ bhaveddharmaḥ sā bhaktiḥ patisevanam |
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ tasya smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam ||32||
arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam |
iti bhaktiḥ premapūrvā sevā vai svāmisevanam |||3 3||
nipatya pādayostasya yatkarotu kuruṣva me |
ityarpaṇaṃ sarvathā sā prapattiḥ prāṇanārpaṇam ||34||
vyāpyādhīnāsamarthādidharmī yo’haṃpadāśrayaḥ |
so’haṃ patyuḥ svāminaśca prāṇapriyasya sevanam || 35||
kāromītyeva traikālābādhyasevāśrayo’bhavam |
samaṣṭyarthastu brahmāhaṃ brahmabhakto’smi mantrajaḥ || 36 ||
vyāpyādhīnāsamarthādidharmyahaṃ sevako hareḥ |
nirlepaḥ san pātivratyaśravaṇādikabhaktimān || 37||
śāśvatikapadāvāso’bhavamityartha īritaḥ |
enaṃ vai mantraratnārthaṃ vāraṃ vāraṃ vicārya ca ||38||
brahmānande sumagnena bhāvyaṃ bhakte na sarvathā |
nārāyaṇaṃ vinā naiva sukhado mokṣado’paraḥ || 3 9||
tasmāt tatraiva sarvasvaṃ sthāpyaṃ cārpyaṃ samantataḥ |
mantrādau brahmaṇo nāma niyojyaṃ omiti dhruvam ||1.116.40 ||
akārokāramavarṇā vedāstrayastu vai khalu |
akāreṇa svayaṃ viṣṇurukāreṇocyate’bdhijā ||41 ||
makāreṇa tayorbhakta omititraya eva te |
akāro vāsudevaḥ syādukāraḥ śrīprabodhakṛt ||42||
makāreṇa tayordāsa omityeva trayo matāḥ |
akārastu parabrahma ukāro brahma kathyate ||43 ||
makāreṇa tayorbhaktaḥ sevādāsa iti smṛtaḥ |
bhāskarasya prabhevāsti nityaṃ tato’napāyinī ||44||
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇatanuḥ patnī viṣṇormanoramā |
jagatāmīśvarī nityā mātā jagadvidhāriṇī ||45||
jñāno jñānaguṇo jñānāśrayaḥ sūkṣmo hṛdisthitaḥ |
cetanānandasandohāśraya ātmā hyahaṃ mataḥ ||46||
śeṣabhūto dāsabhūto bhaktaḥ śrīmaddharermataḥ |
svasvatvaṃ tu harau nyasya tadāyattātmajīvanaḥ ||47||
nārāyaṇasya sāmarthyānnālabhyaṃ cātmano bhavet |
narāṇāṃ tu samūho vai nārā ātmāna eva te ||48 ||
tatrāyanaṃ bhavedasya tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ |
sarvacidacitattveṣu vyāpakaḥ śrīharistu saḥ ||49 ||
narājjātaṃ jalaṃ nāraṃ tatrāyanānnarāyaṇaḥ |
narāṇāṃ tragatāṃ yatra pralaye’yanamucyate ||1.116.5 0 ||
tasmānnārāyaṇo devaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ |
yatra sarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaśca sarvaṃ narāyaṇaḥ |||51|||
anantacakṣuścaraṇo’nantaśīrṣāmṛtādhipaḥ |
hiraṇyagarbho viṣṇurvai bhūtabhavyabhavatprabhuḥ ||52||
brahmasṛṣṭāvīśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭāvapi sthitaḥ |
tripālloke hyekapāda vyāpya tiṣṭhati yo hariḥ |||53||
parabrahmākṣaraṃbrahma vāsudevo hiraṇmayaḥ |
vairājo viṣṇurīśeśo yajño vai savitā śivaḥ ||54||
sa ca vai sarvataspṛtvā bhūmimāvṛtya tiṣṭhati |
dityadityau tato jāte ye ke cobhayatodataḥ |||55|||
grāmyāraṇyāstato jātāḥ sādhyāśca ṛṣayaśca ye |
yajñasūtrāstathāsūtrāstata evāgnayastathā ||56||
kṛtāḥ paridhayastenānakhacūḍāmayaṃ jagat |
diśāṃpālāstathā lokālokapālāstato’pi hi ||57||
jāyante ca tastasmim̐stasya bhakto bhavāmyaham |
ityarthaṃṃ parivijñāya siddhiṃ vindati sevakaḥ ||58||
bhaktabhūtaṃ dāsabhūtaṃ dehabhūtaṃ sadā jagat |
bhajanīyaṃ sevanīyaṃ dehinaṃ taṃ samāśrayet ||59||
athānyamantrasatyārtharahasyaṃ śṛṇu sundari |
lakṣmaṃ mohakaraṃ cihnaṃ pārāvārakṛpā tu sā ||1.116.60 ||
tayā yuktā mahāśaktiḥ sā vai lakṣmīrudāhṛtā |
nārāyaṇastayā yukto lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||6 1 ||
śrīḥ proktā divya sampattiḥ sā yasyāstīti sa prabhuḥ |
śrīmannārāyaṇaḥ proktastatkṛpā sampadāmpradā ||62||
avyāhataṃ svamaiśvaryaṃ ṣaḍvidhaṃ cāṣṭadhāpi ca |
sarvajñātā nityatṛptiḥ saphalecchāhanākṛtiḥ ||6 3||
nityānando niyāmakateti ṣaṭ santi tatra vai |
āhatapāpmatāśokatāvijighatsatā tathā ||64||
tathāpipāsatā caiva vijaratvaṃ vimṛtyutā |
satyasaṃkalpatā satyakāmatetiguṇāṣṭakam ||65||
yatrāsti sa svayaṃ svāmī nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ prabhuḥ |
naṃ brahmacaryaṃ rāti yo naro nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ ||66||
harati bhaktaduḥkhāni harinārāyaṇaḥ sa hi |
māyāṃ nikṛṣya nayate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi ||67||
vasati dīvyati cāntaryāmī yaśca prakāśakaḥ |
vāsudevaḥ sa vai nārāyaṇaḥ śreyaskaraḥ prabhuḥ ||68||
ramante yogino yatra rāmanārāyaṇaḥ sa hi |
omityuktaḥ parabrahma śrīrityuktā haripriyā ||69||
tābhyāṃ yukto narasaṃghastatrāntaryāmitā hareḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ ca tathā vīryaṃ yaśo lakṣmīśca vijñatā ||1.116.70 ||
vairāgyaṃ ceti ṣaṣṇāṃ vai bhagasaṃjñā prakīrtitā |
tadvate vāsudevāya nama utkṛṣṭavān bhava ||7 1 ||
jñānaśaktibalaiśvaryavīryatejāṃsi yatra ca |
santyayaṃ bhagavān śrīmān parabrahmaparātparaḥ |72|||
ātmāyanāya jānāmi dhyāyāmyantaḥsthitaṃ harim|
vyāpakaḥ sa prabhustvasmānmokṣakārye pravartayet ||73 ||
gāyatrīmantramityarthaṃ jñātvā yo bhajate harim |
tasya muktiḥ sadā devi hastamadhye kṛtāspadā ||
śrīhariḥ śaraṇaṃ me’sti prapattirarthasaṃbhṛtā ||74||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiṣṇavagurupradattavividhaśaraṇāgatimantrāṇāmarthapradarśananāmā ṣoḍaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 16||

<1.117>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
pārvatī prāha deveśaṃ vaiṣṇavāgryaṃ maheśvaram |
nātha brūhi yathā nārāyaṇarūpasya gauravam || 1 ||
muktidaṃ cāmṛtaṃ pītvā na vai tṛpyati mānasam |
kathametāvatā dīrghakālenāpi na bodhitam || 2 ||
etatta parama śrāvyaṃ parabrahmāmṛtāmṛtam |
śravaṇīyaṃ mayā nityaṃ nūtanaṃ tu śrave śrave || 3 ||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ pārvatīṃ parameśvarīm |
śṛṇu devi mamāpyeṣā nārāyaṇamayī kathā || 8 ||
nūtanā surasā bhāti tadāhlādo vivardhate |
yathāsmaryaṃ kathayāmi hyavāṅgocaramastyapi || 5 ||
parabrahma svayaṃ sākṣāddivyo nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ |
rājate sarvadā dhāmni svayaṃ rājādhirājakaḥ || 6 ||
anantaśīrṣā puruṣaścānantākṣo’pyasaṃkhyapāt |
sa sṛṣṭiṃ sarvataspṛtvāpyatiṣṭhatkeśamātrake || 7 ||
sa vai sarvatra saṃbhāti mokṣeśāno’tiṛddhimān |
nānyo’to’sti paraḥ kaścinna samo nāpi dāyabhāg || 8 ||
pratallokacaturthāṃśe sarvā jīveśasṛṣṭayaḥ |
vyaṃśastu brahmaloko’tra brāhmaṇā vyomni vai pare || 9 ||
nāsti tatra vijighatsā no pipāsā pravartate |
kṣutpipāsāśrayā māyā tadadhastādvikāsate || 1.117.10 ||
tasya dhāmni ca dhāmāni paramāṇi bhavanti vai |
muktānāṃ ceśvarāṇāṃ cāvatārāṇāṃ manāṃsi saḥ || 1 1||
svasmin vai dhārayan divyo deva eko virājate |
evaṃ bṛhatsvarūpo’yaṃ brahmaṇā saharājate || 12||
anantakoṭimuktaiśca pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ |
īśvarībhistathā śrībhiḥ śaktibhiścātisevitaḥ || 13|| 
niḥsīmadivyabhogāḍhyadivyamaṃgalarūpavān |
yuvācyutamahāsattvaḥ sukumārāṃgakomalaḥ || 14|| 
jagajjananīśrīpūrṇajyotsnāmūrtikayauvanaḥ |
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyākṣayapremaprapūritaḥ || 19||
śriyaḥ saṃkalpasiddhyarthaṃ vaikuṇṭhakṛtamaṇḍalaḥ |
rādhāyai sukhadānārthaṃ goloke śyāmalaḥ sthitaḥ || 16||
muktasaukhyapradaṃ dhāmākṣaraṃ brahma sadā matam |
bhogārthaṃ parame vyomni vaikuṇṭhaṃ dhenulokakam || 17||
līlārthaṃ bhaktavāsārthaṃ trisṛṣṭamakhilaṃ jagat |
sukhabhogapralīlākhyā bhūmikāstā vibhūtayaḥ || 18||
tisro bhavanti tasyaiva vibhūtitrayameva tat |
līlākhyā sakalā sṛṣṭirbhogārthaṃ dhāma taddvayam || 19||
muktasaukhyapradānārthaṃ paramaṃ dhāma cāsthitam |
yadā līlāṃ mahāsṛṣṭiṃ saṃharate janārdanaḥ ||1.117.20 ||
tadā bhogavibhūtau vai nityā sthitistu vidyate |
tato’pyanyā mahānandā parā mūrtimayī sthitiḥ ||2 1||
līlā bhogastathā saukhyaṃ trayaṃ tasyaiva śaktayaḥ |
tripāt tatparamaṃ dhāma nityaṃ śāśvatamaiśvaram |||22||
tasyaiva prāntabhāgeṣu dhāmānyanyāni nityadā |
tāni sarvatra bhaktānāṃ sevābhogārthamātanot |||22|||
amṛtaṃ dhāma badarīdhāmāvyākṛtamityapi |
lakṣmīdhāma śvetadhāma sevābhogārthamātanot |||24||
taporthaṃ cāpi vyatanollokarakṣaṇahetave |
tripāttattu śāśvataṃ vai pādamekamaśāśvatam ||25||
acyutaṃ brahmarūpāḍhyaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ ca gavāṃsthalam |
amṛtaṃ śrīpuraṃ ceti rādhikāyāḥ śriyastathā ||26||
anyāsāṃ prabhupatnīnāṃ krīḍārthāni kṛtāni vai |
bhagavānśrīharistatra nityaṃ yauvanamāśritaḥ ||27||
nityaiṣā ca jaganmātā lakṣmīśca rādhikā tathā |
yathā sarvagato viṣṇustathā lakṣmīśca rādhikā |||28|||
īśāno bhūtabhavyasya tatheśānī maheśvarī |
śrīśca lakṣmīśca rādhā ca viṣṇoścaivānapāyinī |||29|||
sarvatohastacaraṇā sarvato’kṣiśiromukhā |
nārāyaṇī ca kṛṣṇā ca viṣṇupatnī jaganmayī ||1.117.3 0||
mahāmāyā jagatkartrī sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāriṇī |
yadapāṃgasthitaṃ sarvaṃ jaḍacetanamiśraṇam |||3 1 ||
meṣonmeṣakṛtaṃ yasyā layodbhavamayaṃ jagat |
nityājā vāmabhāgā mā mahālakṣmīḥ pareśvarī ||32||
avyaktā vyaktarūpā sā samavyāpyā vyavasthitā |
pṛthvyāṃ rasā sudhā svarge puṇyā sā pitṛmandire ||3 2 ||
jale miṣṭānale pākā lakṣmīśca dhanarūpiṇī |
saundaryaṃ kāntisaubhāgye rūpaṃ lāvaṇyamityapi ||34||
nārīṇāmakhilaṃ sarvaṃ tasyā evāsti saṃgatam |
tayā brahmapadaṃ śaivaṃ māhendraṃ yāmyamityapi ||35||
sauryaṃ kauberamāgneyaṃ cāndraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ samṛddhimat |
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīrlakṣmīḥ śrīḥ rādhikā priyā ||26||
kamalā śāradā padmā vidyā mā paramā ramā |
abdhiputrī satī śyāmā mahādevī ca vaiṣṇavī || 357||
nārāyaṇī mahāvidyā viṣṇupatnī maheśvarī |
gaurī sarasvatī śāntiḥ prabhā svāhā svadhā ratiḥ ||38||
sāvitrī kaṃbharādevī pārvatīti dviṣoḍaśa |
nāmānyasyāḥ pratiprātaḥ pāṭhyāni bhūtilabdhaye || 39||
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ hiraṇyarajatātmikām |
cāndrīṃ svarṇamayīṃ lakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇo ma āvaha ||1.117.40 ||
dhanāṃ dhānyāṃ gosvarūpāṃ vāhanīṃ puruṣātmikām |
nārāyaṇo ma āvaha lakṣmīmanapagāminīm ||41||
tṛptiṃ tejasvinīṃ svarṇaprākārāṃ bhāsvarāṃ śriyam |
daivīṃ varcasvinīṃ vārkṣīṃ kīrtiṃ kṛṣṇo ma āvaha ||42||
sugandhāḍhyāmanādhṛṣyāṃ nityapuṣṭāṃ karīṣiṇīm |
sarveśvarīṃ mahālakṣmīṃ nārāyaṇo ma āvaha ||43 ||
ākūticitisaṃkalpasiddhiṃ harirma āvaha |
hiraṇyadāsadāsīdāṃ tāmihopahvaye śriyam || 44||
yairevaṃ prastutā lakṣmīsteṣāmanapagāminī |
harervakṣasi nityāptā sa hariḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||45 ||
sarveśvaraḥ sarvasvāmī nārāyaṇo guṇākaraḥ |
sarvajñaḥ sarvaśaktyāḍhyaḥ pūrṇakāmaḥ suhṛtsukhī ||46 ||
karuṇāsāgaraḥ śrīmān śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ |
svargāpavargavibhavastasya dāsyaṃ karomyaham ||47||
sarvadā sarvathā sarvāvasthāsu taṃ bhajāmyaham |
dāsyaṃ tasya karomyeva dāsabhūtamidaṃ hareḥ ||48||
śrīmān nārāyaṇaḥ svāmī sevyaḥ prāpyaḥ paro’kṣarāt |
sa eva jananī bhrātā pitā putraśca bāndhavaḥ ||49||
śaraṇaṃ cāśrayo vāso gatirnidhanameva saḥ |
sarvadivyaguṇairyukto māyāguṇādivarjitaḥ ||1.117.50 ||
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃbrahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ parojyotirātmā nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||51||
nārāyaṇaparo dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
yacca kiṃcijjagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrūyate’pi vā ||52||
antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ |
hṛdye jīvamadhye sa paramātmā vyavasthitaḥ |||53||
sa vai tatra pare dhāmni śrīyuṅnārāyaṇaḥ sthitaḥ |
tasya śaktyā śriyā mūlaprakṛtyā racitaṃ mahat ||54||
tato virāḍabhūdbhūmirgrāmyāraṇyāśca jīvinaḥ |
yadāsyabāhūrupādā varṇā vai saṃbhavanti hi ||55||
praviprakṣatraviḍḍāsā hyajāyanta makho hi saḥ |
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca hotā ca bhāgabhuk samidhaśca saḥ ||56||
yajñaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devā ayajanta ca tāḥ kriyāḥ |
prāgevāsan pare dharmā ārādhanādibhaktayaḥ ||57||
pūrve muktāḥ pare dhāmni mahimānaṃ sacanta vai |
taddāsabhaktikartāro yānti nārāyaṇaṃ padam ||58||
te vai divyā sadā siddhā muktā vasanti dhāmani |
māyāpāre pare loke brahmasādharmyamāsthitāḥ ||59||
na vai māyāmahākālapāpakarmayamādibhīḥ |
yadgatvā na parāvṛttistaddharerdhāma cākṣaram ||1.117.60 ||
māyā jaganmayī nityā triguṇā prakṛtirhi sā |
avidyā yoganidrā ca pradhānāvyaktaśāśvatī ||6 1 ||
dhāmacchāyāsvarūpā sā jñānaghanasvarūpiṇī |
lūtātantusamaṃ cāṇḍamanityaṃ prakaroti hi |
tayāvṛtaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sā brahmatejasāvṛtā |||62||
māyābrahmasambandhaśca sīmā dhāmnaḥ samucyate |
sarvavyāpi tvasīmaṃ tat tūpacārāt sasīmakam ||62||
māyāntare gataṃ sarvaṃ saṃkocaṃ ca vikāsanam |
tiraḥprāvirbhavatyeva bhaktā gacchanti tadbahiḥ ||64||
tadā sīmni brahmahade tejaānandacetane |
snātvā yānti brahmatanuṃ parajyotiḥpratāpataḥ ||65||
niṣpadyante tadātmānaḥ svena rūpeṇa mūrtayaḥ |
naro vā yadi vā nārī bhaktyā yānti yadākṣaram ||66 ||
sīmni brahmahade snānti tanurbrāhmī svayaṃ bhavet |
nānyadravyavibhūtervā yogo dehe’sti kaścana ||67||
ātmā sudṛk harirūpānurūpo dṛśyate svayam |
na yogo na vibhāgo vā na yogidravyasākṛtiḥ ||68||
ekātmatattvamūrtyātmā sumūrtaḥ sa hariryathā |
mahāmāyā tu virajā sā tu vaikuṇṭhagāminām ||69||
vaikuṃṭhamāyayormadhye nārāyaṇadravātmikā |
dṛśyate tatra saṃsnātvā śrīryathā pārṣadā yathā ||1.117.70||
niṣpadyante dāsadāsyastathā nityā vikuṃṭhake |
yantu jyotiḥparaṃ vyomākṣaraṃ brahma sanātanam ||71 ||
saccidānandatattvaṃ taddivyaṃ vai brahmasaṃjñitam |
koṭisūryāgniromaikamajaraṃ layavarjitam ||72|| 
svapnādiśūnyamānandavārdhiśītalaśāntikṛt
yadakṣaraṃ vedaguptaṃ niṣedurmuktakoṭayaḥ ||73||
tanna viduḥ ṛcastasya vidastatra samāsate |
tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatprapaśyanti sūrayaḥ ||74||
vairājā api yallokaṃ na vai paśyanti yatpadam |
yatra gāvo bhūriśṛṃgā āyatāḥ sukhadāḥ sadā ||75||
tadvai dhāma paraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇasya gosukhāvaham |
ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastādyānti tadvidaḥ ||76||
tatra pūrve hyanādinaḥ sādhyā muktā vasanti hi |
viśve viśvādgatā devā muktāḥ sacanta tatsukham ||77|| 
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne parabrahmākṣaradhāmavibhūtilīlābrāhmītanunārāyaṇanārāyaṇīgauravaprabhṛtivarṇanaṃnāmā saptadaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 117||

<1.118>
śrīnārāyāṇa uvāca
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tato devīṃ brahmadhāmavibhūtikāḥ |
kathayiṣye samāsena śṛṇu parvataputrike || 1 ||
akṣaraṃ dhāma paramaṃ brahmavyoma paraṃ sadā |

pṛthvī sṛṣṭisuyuktā ca divyakācamayī bhavet || 3 ||
parasparaṃ ca tadyogādyādṛśaṃ tejaudbhavet |
tādṛśaṃ tu ghanaṃ tejo mahat satye tu vedhasaḥ || 4 ||
tādṛgvedhastarātsatyāt koṭiguṇaṃ tu taijasam |
vairājaikakaṇṭhamaṇau vartate’tha tato’pi vai || 5 ||
koṭiguṇaṃ mahattejo mahāviṣṇoḥ śiromaṇau |
tataḥ koṭiguṇaṃ tejo vāsudevasya vai maṇau || 6 ||

badaryāmamṛte śvete śrīpure ca vikuṇṭhake || 7 ||

kuryāccettattvakṣarākhyadhāmnaḥ pūgīphalasthale || 8 ||
līnatāṃ tu samīyādvai pūrṇaṃ tatkīdṛśaṃ bhavet |
tādṛśākṣaradhāmnaśca muktānāṃ tejasāṃ tathā || 9 ||

ahantu nahi sākṣādvai draṣṭā kintu samādhinā || 1 1||

rūpānurūpāvayavo mandahāsyalasanmukhaḥ |
koṭikoṭyarkacandrāgnilīnamāṇikyakuṇḍalaḥ || 17||
asaṃkhyamaṇiratnādinaddhakirīṭakalgikaḥ |
divyahīrakasadratnāmūlyahāṭakahāradhṛk || 18||
yāvattejaḥkhanivrātikaustubhaujjvalakaṇṭhakaḥ |
naikatejaḥprasaratsatkiraṇodbhavamaṇḍakaḥ || 19||
divyaprakāśasaṃrājanmadhyabhālasubhāsvaraḥ |
meghaghaṭṭasadānīlaklṛptakesarakuntalaḥ ||1.118.20||
naikakāmakṛtavakradhanuḥprāntabhruvānvita |
svarṇasūkṣmanimeṣāḍhyapuṭaromālinetrakaḥ ||21||
divyaśvetasphaṭikāgryasatkoṇanetragolakaḥ |
raktasūkṣmasukiñjalkabhāsavatpārśvanāyanaḥ |||22||
madhyadivyaghaṭṭarūpasphurattejasvikṛṣṇikaḥ |

merumūlasamasthūlāraṃbhadyudharakandharaḥ ||1.118.3 0 ||

saptasopānakaṃ cāste kammānikābhitolitam |
makhamallamahāgaddīpārśvatakkīyarājitam |||45|||

tatra divyamahāstaṃbhā hyakṣarāḥ kadalīkṛtāḥ ||59||
haridvarṇā haritpatrā haritkadalamaṃgalāḥ |
śatastaṃbhāḥ svarṇavarṇā vastraveṣṭitaśobhanāḥ ||1.118.60||
teṣāṃ kammānikāḥ śilpakalāvyāptivicitritāḥ |

menāśukaśvetapārāvatacakrakacātakāḥ |

divyasusvaramādhuryakṛtagītikamaṃgalāḥ |
tatratyasaṃskṛtavāṇyā gāyanti guṇakīrtanam ||63||
naikakoṭimahāmuktamaṇḍalāni tu maṇḍape |
pratiṣṭhanti sthale bhūmau madhye copari cāntare ||64||
sṛṣṭisṛṣṭyantare yāni rūpāṇi saṃdhṛtāni vai |
hariṇā tāni sarvāṇi maṇḍape sthāpitāni hi ||65||
śobhante vividhākārā vividhaiśvaryacihnakāḥ |
tattajjanmāvatārādicaritrodbodhahetayaḥ ||66||
vṛttāntabodhakākārā bhagavanto vibhūtayaḥ |

tatratyā muktamūrdhanyāḥ sūryacandrādidarpaṇāḥ |
bhūtvā bhūtvā teṣu teṣu staṃbheṣu saṃvasanti vai ||68||
ullecastatpramāṇāḍhyo yatra muktātmatārakāḥ |
lagnāḥ samyakprakāśante śītakāntipravartakāḥ ||69||
muktāśca toraṇāstatra maṇihīrakarūpakāḥ |
kācakāntikarā naikadivyadīpakacandrakāḥ ||1.118.70 ||
ūrdhvamadhastathā pārśve dikṣu sarvavidikṣu ca |
maṇḍapāt kiraṇā yānti projjvalā vyomamārgagāḥ ||7 1 ||
tādṛśo maṇḍapastādṛk siṃhāsanamathāpi vā |
nānyadhāmasu vidyete kā varṇyā taccamatkṛtiḥ |||72||
śobhā divyāpi nānyatra na varṇyā jāyate mayā |
maṇḍapopariprāsādaḥ śrīharestaṃ śṛṇu priye ||73||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyā prathame kṛtayugasantāne’kṣaradhāmasthaparabrahmatatsiṃhāsanatanmaṇḍapavarṇananāmāṣṭādaśādhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 18||

<1.119>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śaṃbhuḥ prāha punardevīṃ śrīharermaṇḍapopari |
prāsādaṃ śṛṇu kalyāṇi na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 1 ||
lakṣayojanavistāraḥ sahasrayojanocchrayaḥ |
sahasrastaṃbhapaṃktyekā sahasrapaṃktayastathā || 2 ||

catuṣkoṇeṣu catvāri śikharāṇi lasanti vai |

trīṇi dakṣe ca vāme’pi trīṇi madhye mahattamam |

mahāsaudhe svakaṃ ramyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tu madhyage |
tatpārśve dharmadevasya bhakteśca vasatirdhruvā |||2||

saptakuṭumbakauṭumbitattadvāsā bhavanti vai |

guṇātītaśca gopālo brahma muktaḥ śukaḥ śata |
suvrato niṣkulo bhūmā vidhātā vāsudevakaḥ || 32||

tatra ceśvaralokebhyo gatā mukta vasanti vai ||1.119.70||

kāpilaṃ dhāma hāreyaṃ vāsudevagṛhaṃ tathā |
pārthavaṃ ca padaṃ dattātreyadhāma ca hāṃsakam ||74||
nṛharerdhāma ca yadvadāryamaṃ vāmaneyakam |
paraśurāmalokaśca yājñaṃ sāketamityapi ||75||
kaumāraṃ dhāma ca hāyagrīva nāradadhāma ca |
rājarājeyadhāmāni vyāsāśrayāṇi yānyapi ||76||
bauddhaṃ dhāma tathānyānyasaṃkhyadhāmāni santi vai |
anantā hyavatārāścānantā brahmāṇḍakoṭayaḥ ||77||
anantasṛṣṭayastatrāvatārāṇāṃ na saṃkhyanam |
atastattaddhāmnāṃ vai saṃkhyā naiva ca naiva ca ||78||
paṃcamāvaraṇasyāpi saṃkhyā naiva ca naiva ca |
tatrāraṇyāni nadyaśca pārvatā muktakoṭayaḥ ||79||
udyānāni vihārāṇi bhūmayo’kṣarasaṃjñikāḥ |
dhātavaḥ khanayaḥ khātā ucchrayāḥ śikharāṇi ca ||1.119.80||
vimānānyeva sarvāṇi tattatsevakajātayaḥ |
gāndharvā nartakāstatrākhyānakā vaṃśabodhakaḥ ||8 1||

kalākārāśca śrāṃgārā muktānīmuktamaṇḍalāḥ |||82||
asaṃkhyātā na saṃkhyātuṃ ko’pi nārāyaṇamṛte |
so’pi prāha mama dhāmno muktānāṃ nāsti saṃkhyanam ||83||
avatārāṇāṃ ca dhāmnāṃ naivāsti gaṇanaṃ tathā |
evaṃ divye’kṣare dhāmni vibhūtau tripadi prathe ||84||

mahāmāyākṛtā sṛṣṭirbhavantīśvarakoṭayaḥ ||85||

kathamahaṃ tadantena varṇanaṃ pārayāmi vai ||86||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato lakṣmi jagadbandhuḥ śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ |

raṃbhāvanāni śobhante śobhante phaliśākhinaḥ |
suratnāñcitagargaryo mastakasthāḥ suśobhanāḥ ||1.120.80 ||
jalāharaṇakāryārthā gopīnāṃ bhānti vāribhiḥ |
ghaṭāstāsāṃ kaṭitaṭe sthāpitā bhānti pauraṭāḥ ||8 1 ||
sindūrakuṃkumāktāśca gandhasugandhavāsitāḥ |
bhūṣitāḥ puṣpabhūṣābhiḥ yato gacchanti gopikāḥ ||82||
mārgānmārgāntaraṃ rathyārūpaṃ gacchanti kanyakāḥ |
svasvasaudheṣu ramyeṣu ratnasopānavartmasu ||83 ||
vahniśaucāṃśukadharāḥ svarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ |
śvetacāmaradarpaṇapuṣpatalpe svapanti tāḥ ||84||
tena mārgeṇa gopāśca gopyo yānti susundarān |
pārśvasthānsvīyasaudhānvai puṣpamālyasutoraṇān ||85||
ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyuktaprākārapariveṣṭitān |
paritaḥ parikhāyuktān dvārapālaiśca rakṣitān ||86||
ityevaṃ rājamārgaḥ saḥ pārśvadvayasuśobhitaḥ |
prākāradvāramāviśya yāti śrīkṛṣṇamandiram ||87||
prākārāntarvasatayo bhavanti koṭiśastathā |
prākāro vartulākāraḥ koṭiyojanavistṛtaḥ ||88 ||
goloko’yaṃ mahādivyo mahāgolokasaṃjñakaḥ |
nijagoloka ityevaṃ rādhāgoloka ityapi ||8 9 ||
nāmnā paricayastasya kurvanti gopagopikāḥ |
atha te mukhyagolokaṃ kathayāmi śive śṛṇu || 1.120.90 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne goloke virajāśataśṛṃgarāsamaṇḍapavṛndāvanākṣayavaṭabhāṇḍīravaṭarājamārgavṛndārakādivarṇananāmāviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 120 ||

<1.121>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato lakṣmi mahādevaḥ pārvatī prāha śobhanam |
saprākāraṃ tu golokaṃ mandirādisthalānvitam || 1 ||
tasya prākāravistāraḥ koṭiyojanamucyate |
caturdvārānvitaścaivākāśavimānasaṃśritaḥ || 2 ||
gopasamūharakṣāḍhyo dvārapālasamanvitaḥ |
prāsādā ratnakhacitā bahubhogyārthasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 3 ||
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvapaṃcāśatkoṭigopikāḥ |
santi vasanti tatratyaprāsādeṣu ca tāḥ priyāḥ || 4 ||
tatrāśramāśca bhaktānāṃ gopānāṃ śatakoṭayaḥ |
vṛkṣavallībhogyajātaprapūritasukhapradāḥ || 5 ||
tato’pyadhikavistārā ratnamaṇicamatkṛtāḥ |
āśramāḥ pārṣadānāṃ ca bhavanti daśakoṭayaḥ || 6 ||
sarvasiddhiprapūrṇāśca na nyūnaṃ vidyate’pyaṇu |
dvādaśahāyanāḥ kanyāḥ kumārāḥ ṣoḍaśābdikāḥ || 7 ||
tato’pi pārṣadavarāḥ śrīkṛṣṇarūpadhāriṇaḥ |
prāsādakṛtavāsāste vartante koṭiśo’pare || 8 ||
naiteṣāṃ śrīkṛṣṇavāsānnivāse nyūnatālpikā |
prāsādādā rādhikāśuddhabhaktagopījanairyutāḥ || 9 ||
ratnamaṇisvarṇakṛtā dvātriṃśatkoṭayo’pare |
rādhābhaktapragopīṇāṃ kiṃkarīṇāṃ tathā gṛhāḥ || 1.121.10 ||
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi santi vai daśakoṭayaḥ |
divyāḥ svarṇamayā ratnamaṇihīrakanirmitāḥ || 11 ||
golokāntargatāḥ sarve prāsādāḥ santi kāmadāḥ |
śatajanmatapaḥpūtā haribhaktiratāśca ye || 12||
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvā rādhākṛṣṇetijāpakāḥ |
yānti golokadhāmaite prākāre pravasanti ca || 1 3||
teṣāṃ nivāsāḥ sadratnamaṇimāṇikyanirmitāḥ |
puṣpaśayyāpuṣpamālāśvetacāmaraśobhitāḥ || 14||
ratnadarpaṇaśobhāḍhyā harinmaṇipraśobhitāḥ |
amūlyaratnakalaśavrātaprānvitaśekharāḥ || 15||
amoghavīryasaṃbhṛtadivyapuṣṭaśararikāḥ |
gopagopīgaṇā bhaktāḥ sūkṣmavastravibhūṣaṇāḥ || 16||
vividhāmṛtabhogāśca vasanti koṭikoṭayaḥ |
tato madhye mahodyāne rāseśvaryāḥ paro mahān || 17||
āśramo vartate vyasto rādhāyāḥ smṛtisaṃbhṛtaḥ |
devādhidevyā gopīnāṃ varāyāścārunirmitaḥ || 18||
prāṇādhikāyāḥ kṛṣṇasya ramyadravyamanoharaḥ |
sucāruvartulākāraḥ ṣaḍgavyūtipramāṇakaḥ || 19||
śatamandirasaṃyukto jvalito ratnatejasā |
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ cayairviracito varaḥ ||1.121.20||
durlaṃghyābhirgabhīrābhiḥ parikhābhiḥ suśobhitaḥ |
kalpavṛkṣaiḥ parivṛtāḥ puṣpodyānaśatāntaraḥ |||2 1 ||
sumūlyaratnakhacitaprākāreṇa suveṣṭitaḥ |
sadratnavedikāgarbhasaptadvāraiḥ suśobhitaḥ ||22||
vartulaḥ sumahām̐statra tūdyāno vartate’bhitaḥ |
sarvatastatra tatrāpi vṛkṣavallīsamanvitaḥ ||23 ||
āntarodyānamadhye’tra prākāro vartate’paraḥ |
sarvatastatra tatrāpi ṣoḍaśadvārasaṃyutaḥ || 24||
sahasradhanurūrdhvotthaḥ kalaśaśṛṃgamaṇḍitaḥ |
tejasā prajvalan ramyo vimānaśatamaṇḍitaḥ ||25||
prākāraṃ paritastaṃ ca kṛṣṇaprāsādasadṛśāḥ |
gopānāṃ gopikānāṃ ca śatasaudhamitāśramāḥ ||26||
prākārāntargatastatrodyāno divyaphalānvitaḥ |
divyapuṣpānvitaścaiva divyavārisukuṇḍakaḥ ||27||
divyaṃ sarovaraṃ ramyaṃ vartate tatra dakṣiṇe |
tattīre nṛpasaudho’sti yatra nṛtyanti nartakāḥ || 20||
sutānaṃ cārusaṃgītaṃ rādhākṛṣṇaguṇānvitam |
gāyanti gītapīyūṣaṃ vādakā gāyakāstathā ||29||
nānāveṣadharāstatra gopikāśca manoharāḥ |
sthāne sthāne pradṛśyante kṛṣṇaprasādalālasāḥ ||1.121.3 0||
kāścinmṛdaṃgahastāśca kāścidvīṇākarāstathā |
kāściccāmarahastāśca karatālakarāḥ parāḥ ||3 1 ||
kāścid vāditrahastāśca kāścinnūpuraśobhitāḥ |
kiṃkiṇībhūṣaṇaiḥ kāścicchabdayanti tu maṇḍapam ||32||
kāścitkuṃbhān gṛhītvā tu karayormastake tathā |
puṃveśanāyikāstatra nṛtyanti bahuvedhataḥ ||33||
kuṣṇaveśadharāḥ kāścid rādhāveśadharāḥ parāḥ |
kāściddūraṃ sthitāḥ kāścit kṛṣṇāliṃganatatparāḥ ||34||
krīḍāsaktāśca gopyastāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ bhajanta ityapi |
tatpārśve sarasastīre saudhāḥ santi varā varāḥ ||35||
rādhāsakhīnāṃ te gehā vartante bhavyadarśanāḥ |
trayastriṃśadvayasyāstā rādhāyāḥ pūrayauvanāḥ ||36||
rūpeṇaiva guṇenaiva veṣeṇa yauvanena ca |
saubhāgyenaiva vayasā sadṛśyo rādhayā ca tāḥ ||37||
nāmāni śṛṇu girije trayastriṃśattu mukhyataḥ |
candrakalā suśīlā ca yamunā mādhavī ratiḥ ||38||
kadambamālā sukuntī jāhnavī ca svayaṃprabhā |
padmamukhī ca sāvitrī gāyatrī sumukhī sudhā ||39||
padmālayā pārijātā sugaurī sarvamaṃgalā |
kālikā kamalā durgā bhāratī ca sarasvatī ||1.121.40 ||
gaṃgāmbikā madhumatī campāparṇā ca sundarī |
kṛṣṇapriyā brahmasatī nandinī nandanā tathā ||41||
etāsāṃ tāni saudhāni kṛṣṇasaudhasamāni hi |
ratnadhātubhogyavastusvarṇakalaśavanti vai ||42||
yatra yatra kanyakāśca gopyaḥ sakhyaśca gopakāḥ |
kṛṣṇārthakṛtasarvasvāstatra tatra gṛhe gṛhe ||42 ||
naikarūpadharaḥ kṛṣṇo vartate ramate tayā |
tayā tayā ca preyasyā tena tena ca sarvathā ||44||
rādhākṛṣṇasya saudhasya ye prākāre tu ṣoḍaśa |
gopurāḥ santi tatrādirgopuro maṇiratnajaḥ ||45||
vedikāyugmasaṃyukto vajraratnakapāṭakaḥ |
vartate dvārapastatra vīrabhānuḥ suyauvanaḥ ||46 ||
ratnasiṃhāsanasthaśca ratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
pītāmbaradharo ratnamukuṭojjvalamastakaḥ ||47||
yasyājñāyāṃ sārdhadvayalakṣagopā bhavanti hi |
dvitīye gopure tatra tato’pyadhikasundare ||48||
dvārapālaścandrabhānuḥ kiśoraḥ śyāmalo’sti hi |
svarṇavetradharo ratnasiṃhāsanasamasthitaḥ ||49 ||
yasyājñāyāṃ paṃcalakṣagopā vartanta īśvarāḥ |
tṛtīye gopure tatra tato’timaṇitaijase ||1.121.50||
dvārapālaḥ sūryabhānuḥ kiśoro muralīdharaḥ |
ratnadaṇḍakaraḥ svarṇamaṇikuṇḍalarājitaḥ ||51 ||
yasyājñāyāṃ navalakṣagopāḥ śyāmalasundarāḥ |
caturthe gopure tebhyo vilakṣaṇavibhūṣite ||52||
vasubhānurdvārapālaḥ kiśoro’sti vrajeśvaraḥ |
maṇidaṇḍadharo ratnasiṃhāsanakṛtāsanaḥ ||53 ||
pakvabimbādharauṣṭhaśca sarvabhūṣāvibhūṣitaḥ |
yasyājñāyāṃ navalakṣagopāḥ santi manoharāḥ ||54||
paṃcame gopure vajrabhitticitrapracitrake |
dvārapālo devabhānuścārusiṃhāsanasthitaḥ ||55||
mayūrapicchacūḍaśca ratnamālāsukuṇḍalaḥ |
yasyājñāyāṃ daśalakṣagopāḥ santi vyavasthitāḥ ||56||
ṣaṣṭhe tu gopure vajrabhittikapāṭaśobhite |
dvārapālaḥ śukrabhānuḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||57||
yasyājñāyāṃ daśalakṣagopāḥ santi vyavasthitāḥ |
saptame gopure ṣaḍbhyaścātiśobhe vilakṣaṇe ||58||
dvārapo ratnabhānuḥ śrīhareḥ priyatamo yuvā |
puṣpacandanabhūṣāḍhyo siṃhāsanasthavetradhṛk ||59||
yasyājñāyāṃ tu vartante gopā dvādaśalakṣakāḥ |
aṣṭame gopure tebhyaḥ saptabhyo’pi vilakṣaṇe ||1.121.6 0||
dvārapālaḥ supārśvo’sti ratnadaṇḍasubhūṣaṇaḥ |
ratnakuṇḍalaśobhāḍhyo bandhujīvādharauṣṭhakaḥ ||61 ||
yasyājñāyāṃ sadā santi gopā dvādaśalakṣakāḥ |
navame gopure vajraratnāḍhye citramālake ||62|||
dauvārikaḥ subalo’sti lalitākṛtibhūṣaṇaḥ |
yasyājñāyāṃ tathā santi gopā dvādaśalakṣakāḥ ||63||
daśame gopure ramye’nirvācyavarṇane pare |
dvārapastu sudāmāsti kṛṣṇatulyamanoharaḥ ||64||
daṇḍahasto yadājñāyāṃ gopā viṃśatilakṣakāḥ |
ekādaśe gopure sucitraramye tathādbhute ||65||
dvārapālaḥ śrīdāmāsti ratnasiṃhāsanasthitaḥ |
pītavastradharo’mūlyabhūṣācandanaśobhitaḥ ||66 ||
kuṇḍalakaṭakapuṣpamālāmukuṭasūjjvalaḥ |
yasyājñāyāṃ koṭigopāstena rājendrasadṛśaḥ ||67||
dvādaśe gopure’mūlyaratnavedicatuṣṭaye |
vicitracitrasadvajrabhitticitramanohare ||68||
dvārapāstatra gopyo vai santyābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
navayauvanasampannāḥ kabarībhārabhūṣitāḥ ||69||
pītaraktādyambarāstāḥ sugandhipuṣpadhammilāḥ |
ratnasvarṇamaṇibhūṣābhūṣitāḥ svarṇakaṃkaṇāḥ ||1.121.70 ||
keyūranūpurakuṇḍalyāgryaśobhitavigrahāḥ |
pīnaśroṇībharānamrā nitambabhāramantharāḥ || 71 ||
śatagopyo hareḥ preṣṭhāḥ śreṣṭhāstiṣṭhanti gopure |
tāsāṃ tu sevikāḥ koṭigopyaḥ santi haripriyāḥ ||72||
trayodaśe caturdaśe paṃcadaśe ca gopure |
gopyastu dvārapāḥ santi prodbhinnanavayauvanāḥ |||73 ||
śreṣṭhā manoharā ramyā varā dhanyāḥ suśobhanāḥ |
rādhāpriyāḥ subhūṣāḍhyāḥ kṛṣṇasaubhāgyamaṃgalāḥ ||74||
koṭyabjagopikāstāsāmājñākaryo bhavanti hi |
ṣoḍaśe gopure mukhyāstrayastriṃśattu gopikāḥ ||75||
santi tu dvārapāstāsāṃ rūpaṃ vaktuṃ na śakyate |
na pārvatī na vai lakṣmīrnorvaśī rādhikā kimu ||76 ||
tādṛśyastā ratnabhūṣābhūṣitā dṛḍhayauvanāḥ |
ratnakaṃkaṇakeyūrasvarṇanūpurabhūṣitāḥ ||77||
sakiṃkiṇīraśanābhirmadhyadeśe subhūṣitāḥ |
ratnakuṇḍalatejobhirgaṇḍasthalasamujjvalāḥ ||78 ||
praphullamālatīmālāmaṇihārādiśobhitāḥ |
śaratpārvaṇacandrārhamukhamaṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ ||79||
pārijātaprasūnādimālāhāralasatstanāḥ |
pakvabimbādharauṣṭhyaśca smerānanasaroruhāḥ ||1.121.8 0 ||
pakvadāḍimabījāgryakundadantasupaṃktayaḥ |
svarṇacampakasadvarṇāstanūdaryaḥ kaṭikṛśāḥ ||8 1 ||
gajamauktikasaṃsaktasvarṇavālikanāsikāḥ |
śukacañcunimnanāsāḥ kaṭhinastanabandhanāḥ ||82||
pīnaśroṇībharāḥ kṛṣṇacaraṇāsaktamānasāḥ |
svarṇatārāñcitadīrghapaṭakapāṭatoraṇe |||83 ||
gopure vedikāyukte tāstiṣṭhanti haripriyāḥ |
gopurāntaḥsthalaṃ sarvaṃ maṇiratnādibhūṣitam ||84||
haritsindūramaṇibhirbhittidvayavirājitam |
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālābhiśca suvāsitam ||85||
tadantastatra puṣpāṇāmudyāno vartate mahān |
tatra rādhāmahāsaudhaḥ kṛṣṇamandirameva saḥ ||86 ||
mandirāṇāṃ ca madhyasthaḥ śataśālo manoharaḥ |
vimānaiḥ saptakaiḥ kāmyaiḥ śālāsu gamyate tu saḥ ||87||
kevalaiḥ ratnasāraiśca racito divya eva saḥ |
nānāratnamaṇistambhairvajrayuktaiśca bhūṣitaḥ ||88||
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ mālājālaiśca rājitaḥ |
muktāmāṇikyahīrakakṛtabhittimanoharaḥ ||89||
śvetacāmaradarpaṇavyajanaiḥ kalaśairyutaḥ |
paṭṭasūtragranthiyuktaśrīkhaṇḍapallavānvitaḥ ||1.121.90||
maṇistaṃbhasamūhaiśca ramyaprāṃgaṇabhūṣitaḥ ||
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravasaṃyutaḥ ||9 1 ||
śuṣkadhānyaśuklapuṣpapravālaphalataṇḍulaiḥ |
parṇadurvākṣatalājākuṃbhahāravirājitaḥ ||92||
vividhagandhasaṃsaktapavanaiḥ surabhīkṛtaḥ |
adṛṣṭāśrutamagryaṃ yad brahmāṇḍe durlabhaṃ ca yat ||93||
tattadvastuśobhitaśca prāsādo rādhikākṛte |
ratnamaṃcāḥ sulalitāḥ sūkṣmavastraparicchadāḥ ||94||
koṭiśo ratnakubhāśca ratnapātrāṇi santi vai |
amūlyacāruvividhatattadvastuvibhūṣitaḥ ||95||
nānāprakāravādyānāṃ miṣṭanādairnināditaḥ |
svarayantraiśca vīṇābhirgopīsaṃgitasuśrutaḥ ||96||
mohano vādyaśabdaiśca gāyikāgītibhistathā |
gopānāṃ kṛṣṇatulyānāṃ samūhaiḥ parivāritaḥ ||97||
rādhāsakhīnāṃ gopīnāṃ bahuvṛndairvirājitaḥ |
rādhākṛṣṇaguṇodrekapadasaṃgītasuśrutaḥ ||98||
śrūyate madhuraṃ gītaṃ dṛśyate nṛtyamuttamam |
āpyate paramānandaḥ kṛṣṇalīlāraso’drije ||99||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne golokaprākāraprāsādodyānāntaḥpuraprākāraprāsādodyānaṣoḍaśagopuradvārapālādivarṇananāmaikaviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 121 ||

<1.122>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu priye tataḥ śaṃbhuḥ prāha svasya priyāṃ satīm |
rādhikākṛṣṇaprāsāde ratnasiṃhāsanaṃ varam || 1 ||
dhanuḥ śatapramāṇaṃ ca parito vartulākṛti |
uccāvacaiḥ svarṇaghaṭaiḥ śobhitaṃ śikharādiṣu || 2 ||
divyabhaktāputtalikāpremadāsīprabhūṣitam |
koṭyarkadyutisaṃvyāptaṃ tadūrdhvaṃ saptatālavat || 3 ||
adbhutaṃ sarvatejasvipadārthādhikasundaram |
tejastejo’mbaraṃ tejorāśistejaḥkhanipratham || 4 ||
divyaṃ siṃhāsanaṃ tadvai yatheṣṭaṃ vyomni gacchati |
siṃhapādaṃ vallicitrāṇyanantagopagopikāḥ || 5 ||
gāvo vatsā vatsataryastathā bhaktā priyāstathā |
siṃhāsane ca sopāne staṃbhe dvāri ca toraṇe || 6 ||
vādakā nartakāścaiva gāyakāḥ pārśvabhāgake |
puttalikāsvarūpāste klṛptāḥ sarve vibhānti vai || 7 ||
mayūrāḥ sārasā haṃsāścātakāḥ śukamenakāḥ |
śubhāḥ puttalikāścaitā yathāsthānaṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 8 ||
divye siṃhāsane tejorāśau kṛṣṇo virājate |
varo vareṇyo varado varadānāṃ ca kāraṇam || 9 ||
sarvamaṃgaladaḥ sākṣānmaṃgalānāṃ sumaṃgalam |
nirlepaśca nirīhaśca ḍhivyaiśvaryaguṇāśrayaḥ || 1.122.10 ||
sanātanaśca sākāraḥ kalāvibhūtidhārakaḥ |
sarvādhāraḥ sarvarūpaḥ sarvabījo hyatīndriyaḥ || 11 ||
jaḍacetanadehaśca svatantradivyamūrtikaḥ |
sarvasākṣī sarvadarśī saccidānanda īśvaraḥ || 12 ||
sarveśo’nādinidhano vidhātā janakaḥ pitā |
ekaikaromavivare brahmāṇḍamekamekakam || 1 3||
yasyaiva mahato viṣṇoḥ sa kṛṣṇaḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśajaḥ |
yaṃ vai dhyāyanti yogajñāḥ sevante dāsatāṃ gatāḥ || 14||
kiśoraḥ sundarataraḥ kāntānāṃ kamanīyakaḥ |
navīnajaladaśyāmaḥ pītāmbaradharo varaḥ || 15||
dvibhujo muralīhastaḥ sasmitaḥ sumanoharaḥ |
mayūrapicchacūḍaśca mālatīmālamaṇḍitaḥ || 16||
candanāgurukastūrīkuṃkumadravacarcitaḥ |
amūlyaratnasārāṇāṃ sārabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 17||
amūlyaratnaracitakirīṭamukuṭojjvalaḥ |

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

kvacit vividhāḥ sarito dugdhamiṣṭajalāvahāḥ |
kvacicchṛṅgāṇi cādrīṇāṃ kvacitsthalyo vanaukasām ||41 ||
kvaciddevāṃganāramyavihārārthakṛtagṛhāḥ |
anantāḥ sṛṣṭayastatra vane santi vanaukasām ||42||
nārāyaṇaprasaṃgena kalpe kalpāntare ca ye|
prāṇino muktimāpannāḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ |||43 ||
muktāste kosale tatra vane vasanti śāśvatāḥ |
nārāyāṇecchayā teṣāṃ kāmarūpatvamasti vai ||44||
kvacid yāne vimāne vā cāntarīkṣe prayānti hi ||
kvacid devāḥ kvacinmuktāḥ kvacit tattatsujātayaḥ ||45||
bhavantyeva vasantyeva phalapānāditṛptikāḥ |
divyā bhogapānarasāḥ phalāni vividhāni ca || 46 ||
kausalyākhyavanasthānāṃ kṛte viṣṇuvinirmitāḥ |
vane tatra sukuṃjāstu vṛkṣāṇāṃ santi bhūriśaḥ ||47||
vaṭānāṃ gundrakāṇāṃ cāmalakīnāṃ tathā śubhāḥ |
kiṃśukodumbarāṇāṃ ca pippalānāṃ ghaṭāsu ca ||48||
śobhanāḥ svarṇasaṃkāśāḥ piśaṃgāḥ vallayastathā |
vṛkṣeṣu lagnāḥ śobhante kuṃjārthaṃ kṛdvitānakāḥ ||49||
maṇḍapāḥ santi sadratnamaṇihīrakabhūmayaḥ |
divyasopānasanmārgārohaṇārthavimānikāḥ ||1.123.50 ||
sahasrabhūmayaste vai gagane gatasudhvajāḥ |
sūryakalaśasampannā vividhodyānasaṃvṛtāḥ ||51 ||
śītoṣṇajalakuṇḍāḍhyā vahnimaṇḍalamaṇḍitāḥ |
naisargikavasturamyā bhavanti kācadīpakāḥ |||52|||
gāvastatra kāmadughā viharanti caranti ca |
tathā vasatayo divyā vaikuṇṭhavanavāsinām ||53||
lakṣmyo ramāsamā rāmāḥ ṣoḍaśābdasuyauvanāḥ |
surūpāḥ sasvāmikāśca svakuṭumbasamanvitāḥ ||54||
acyutagotrakāḥ sarvā vasanti bhaktimānasāḥ |
krīḍāvihāraramyāsyavusībaṃkaṭamaṃcikāḥ ||55 ||
śayanārhavihārārharamaṇārhā bhavanti vai |
saprākārāśca sodhānāḥ savārivahnisādhanāḥ ||56||
vyajanaiścāmarairyuktā naikadarpaṇabhūṣitāḥ |
bhojanācchādanālāpanṛtyavādanamaṇḍitāḥ |||57||
saudhāśca maṇḍapāḥ santi ratnapradīpasuprabhāḥ |
dhūpāḥ sugandhinastatra kuṭīreṣu bhavanti vai ||58||
śṛgāradravapavanāḥ śītalā vānti saukhyadāḥ |
ramaṇārthaṃ ramaṇīnāṃ cetanaṃ kausalaṃ vanam |||59||
pañcāśatkoṭayastatra kuṃjakuṭīramaṇḍapāḥ |
snātvā sarayvāṃ bhūtvā ca muktadeho vrajettataḥ ||1.123.60 ||
kausalaṃ tadvanaṃ ramyaṃ yadi sthātuṃ samīhate |
tatraiva vāsamādāya ramate muktavaddhi saḥ ||61 ||
ito’pyagre mahārakṣāsthānaprākāra aiśvaraḥ |
mahāprākāravaryaḥ sa bhavatyarbudayojanaḥ ||62||
vartulākāra evaiṣo lakṣayojanamūrdhvagaḥ |
taducchraye mahādivyāḥ santi prāsādakoṭayaḥ |||63 ||
sarve vihāyasā yānti vimānaireva pauraṭaiḥ |
śataikayojanocchrāyā vyāse sāhasrayojanāḥ ||64||
santi vimānatulyāste prāsādā vyomagāminaḥ |
sarve vaikuṇṭhasadṛśā narā nāryaśca kāmagāḥ || 65||
yuvatyaśca yuvānaśca dvādaśaṣoḍaśābdajāḥ |
kabarīkeśaśobhāḍhyāḥ puṣpamālādharāstathā ||66||
kaṭakāṃgadakeyūraśṛṃkhalāmukuṭānvitāḥ |
ūrmikākaustubhamaṇisvarṇabhūṣāvibhūṣitāḥ ||67||
kāmanotkaṭabhrūbhāgāḥ premapravāhasaṃvahāḥ |
puṣṭāḥ śvetāruṇarūpāḥ svarṇavastrāntagātrakāḥ || 68 ||
svarṇarūpāḥ sadā ramyāḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhāḥ |
śaraccandrasamaśaityāḥ sukhānāmākarā iva ||6 9 ||
bhavantyeva tu paṃcāśatkoṭibhaktāṇya eva tāḥ |
bhaktāśca śāśvatāste’pi paṃcāśatkoṭayastathā ||1.123.70 ||
nivasanti tathānye’pi prākāre tatra vartule |
tasya dvārāṇi catvāri caturdikṣu bhavanti vai || 71 ||
bhagavatpārṣadaistatra kṛtā vai dvārapālatā |
ralabhūṣābhūṣitaiśca sadratnamukuṭojjvalaiḥ ||72||
divyahetidharaiḥ sarvaiḥ kirīṭakaṭakānvitaiḥ |
divyaiḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣaiścāvitaṃ dvāracatuṣṭayam ||73 ||
evaṃ durgottamavyāptā vartulākṛtikaiva ca |
tadante vartate divyā sāketākhyā subhūmikā ||74||
nityā sāketadhāmākhyā naikavasatisaṃśritā |
udyānā bahavastatra vāṭikāścāpyanantakāḥ ||75 ||
brahmarasamahānadyaḥ śailaśrṛṃgāṇi bhūriśaḥ |
sukṣetrāṇyapyasaṃkhyāni vanānyupavanāni ca ||76 ||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ vihārārthaṃ vinodārthaṃ vadhūmatām |
dārāṇāṃ ca nivāsārthaṃ tatra vasatayaḥ kṛtāḥ ||77||
grāmāstatra sadurgāśca prārbudārbudakoṭayaḥ |
nagarāṇi vicitrāṇi koṭilakṣāṇi santi vai ||78 ||
sāketanagaragrāmāḥ sadratnamaṇibhūmayaḥ |
maṇīnāṃ maṇḍapāstatra ratnahīrakasadgṛhāḥ ||79 ||
muktāmāṇikyasaudhāśca sphāṭikasṛtibhittayaḥ |
divyā gāvaśca vatsāśca vatsataryaḥ śubhāḥ śubhāḥ ||1.123.80 ||
saudhāśca ghummaṭāścaiva bhūrīṇi śikharāṇi ca |
candraśālā hyasaṃkhyātāstathā viśrāntibhūmikāḥ ||8 1 ||
deśamārgā rājamārgā vimānarathavāhanāḥ |
garuḍā yānahaṃsāśca vṛṣahastipraghoṭakāḥ ||82||
smṛddhayo vividhāḥ sarvāḥ pramadāḥ pramadottamāḥ |
dvādaśahāyanāḥ sarvāḥ kiṃcidudbhinnayauvanāḥ ||83 ||
arbudārbudabhaktānyo vaiṣṇavyaśca vasanti tāḥ |
kāmottejakasaddravyaiḥ rājitā ratiśāradāḥ ||84||
ratnālaṃkārabhūṣāḍhyā ratnamālāvirājitāḥ |
rannakaṃkaṇakeyūraratnabhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ||85||
ratnasatkuṇḍalādyaiśca gaṇḍasthalasamujjvalāḥ |
ratnakhacitasvarṇāṅgulīyadhṛtāṅguliprabhāḥ ||86||
muktāmauktikasadrājatpauraṭābhūṣaṇānvitāḥ |
raktacacatkuṃkumādikṛtabhālasucandrakāḥ ||87||
lalantikāvālikātantikātroṭivirājitāḥ |
prakoṣṭhakāṭakīśobhā baṃgiḍīśrṛṃkhalānvitāḥ ||88 ||
raśanārājatkaṭayaḥ sakiṃkiṇīnupūrakāḥ |
śratpārvaṇacandrāsyāḥ padmapatrasulocanāḥ ||89||
kabarīkeśaveśāktasugandhipuṣpamālikāḥ |
manojamantharagativakrabhrūlatikānvitāḥ || 1.123.90 ||
kaṭhinasvalpasustanyo nārāyaṇasamarpitāḥ |
pītacandanasvarṇābhāḥ pītāmbarapravāraṇāḥ || 91 ||
sudatyaḥ susvarā saumyāḥ premapātrāṇi vai hareḥ |
nāryo ramāsajātīyāḥ ramātulyasumastakāḥ ||9 2 ||
sarvālikāḥ satilakāḥ sataptamudracihnitāḥ |
narāścaturbhujāḥ sarve śaṃkhacakragadābjakāḥ || 93 ||
kaustubhamālabhūṣādiśobhitāḥ śvetapāṇḍurāḥ |
śāśvatāḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣavayaskāḥ pūrayauvanāḥ || 9 4||
siddhayo yatra tiṣṭhanti kalpavṛkṣā gṛhe gṛhe |
saṃkalpamaṇayastatra sākete pratimuktakam || 95 ||
divyāśca smṛddhayaḥ sarvā bhojyapānavilepanāḥ |
snānadānavihārādinṛtyaramaṇavādanāḥ || 96 ||
samājotsavapariṣatpūjāsatkārasatkriyāḥ |
sarvā bhavanti divyāścāmṛtakuṇḍapravāhaṇāḥ || 9 7||
phalapuṣpottamarasasugandhidravaparvatāḥ |
na nyūnaṃ vidyate kiṃcitsākete dhāmni vāsinām || 9 8||
mahālakṣmyājñayā sarvaṃ sāketaṃ bhaktavāsitam |
divyadṛṣṭyā darśanārhaṃ māyānetreṇa nekṣyate ||99||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne mahāvaikuṇṭhe divyasarayūkausalavanatatratyavasatitadantardurgavartulavasatitatsāketabhūmikāramārāmāvaiṣṇavādinivāsaprabhṛtivarṇananāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāya || 123||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śaṃbhustato mahādevīṃ prāha tatparavarṇanam |

teṣāṃ vaśāstu vaikuṇṭhe koṭyarbudāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ |

smṛddhīnāṃ bhogyabhāvānāṃ bhojyapeyavilāsinām |
