dhūlīnirdhūnanaṃ rajjubandhapramokṣaṇaṃ tathā ||77 ||
pādayoścumbanaṃ caiva mārjanaṃ cakrire muhuḥ |
aho keneva duṣṭena nāthānāmardanaṃ kṛtam ||78 ||
kasya hastau ca pādau ca bhagnau bhāgyaṃ ca visphuṭam |
vā kasyānnamitaḥ sthānāt samāptimagamat khalu ||79 ||
kasya jalaṃ tūdvinaṣṭamudiyāya ravirghṛṇī |
kasya vā puṇyarekhādya trūṭitā dharaṇīṃ gatā ||1.133.8 0||
etādṛśānāṃ sādhūnāmavamānaṃ tu kaiḥ kṛtam |
teṣāṃ naivātra vāso’sti bhavennaiva vidantu te ||8 1 ||
yāvannārāyaṇonaiva jānāti tāvadeva hi |
avamānayitustvatra sthitiḥ paścāttu nāsti hi ||8 2 ||
ityevaṃ lapamānāstā dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā rudanti ca |
tāvallalitayā gatvā nārāyaṇāya veditam |||83 ||
yāvacchṛṇoti deveśo drāk padbhyāṃ dhāvitaḥ svakāt |
siṃhāsanāt samutthāyāprāvṛtābhyāṃ ciraveda ca ||84||
yāvadāyāti vai tatra gopure śrīhariḥ svayam |
tāvattu lakṣaśaḥ patnyaḥ koṭiśo vaiṣṇavā api ||85 ||
samājagmuḥ sthale tatra praṇemuḥ sanakādikān |
śrīharistān catuḥsādhūn praṇanāma sadaṇḍavat ||86 ||
kiṃ kṛtaṃ kena cetyevamapṛcchadavamānakam |
bhavādṛśānāṃ sādhūnāṃ kṛtaṃ yenāvamānanam ||87||
na sa me gopure caiva vaikuṇṭhe vāsamarhati |
mama pādau ca hastau sādhvaparādhakarau yadi ||88||
chindyāṃ tau yadi netraṃ vā jihvāṃ vā kartayāmi tām |
lakṣmīṃ svakāṃ jahāmyeva sādhvaparādhakāriṇīm ||89||
lokavāyusparśahīnāḥ kilbiṣāspṛṣṭamānasāḥ |
bālā api viharanti kalyāṇāya gṛhārthinām ||1.133.90 ||
bālā api na vai bālā mokṣādeḥ pitaro matāḥ |
pāvanāḥ pāpināṃ lokapāvakā vicaranti hi ||9 1||
kṣamāpayantvaparādhān kṛpāṃ kṛtvā mamopari |
antaḥsaudhaṃ samāyāntu gṛhṇantu dāsasevanam ||92||
ityabhyarthya ca teṣāṃ vai pādapāṃsūn śirasyadhāt |
nītvā nārāyaṇastām̐śca yāvadāyācca gopure |||93||
pārṣadau jayavijayau tāvattejovihīnakau |
mlānamukhau sakampau ca dṛṣṭau nārāyaṇena vai ||94||
tāvattaiḥ śiśubhiḥ proktaṃ harerdhāmnyatra nirguṇe |
pavitre sarvathā śānte sukhade mokṣabhūmike ||95||
nirvikāre mahāsaumye divye hariniketane |
nedṛśau dvārapau yogyau duḥkhadau maukṣanāśakau ||96||
savikārau tathā kruddhāvaślīlavācau stabdhakau |
śiṣṭācārarahitau cāsuravatkṛtyakāriṇau ||97||
yato yogyāvāsuriṃ vai yonimeva prasevitum |
na tu yogyau śuddhasattvavaikuṇṭhaṃ dhāma sevitum ||98||
śrīhareḥ pādayoretau krūrau yogyau na vai matau |
yatpāpāmāsurīṃ yoniṃ yuvāṃ yātaṃ padacyutau ||99||
yāvadvai patataḥ sthānāt śāpayogāttadā punaḥ |
prārthayāmāsaturviprānkṣamārthaṃ cāśrunetrakau || 1.133.100 ||
nārāyaṇecchayā prahvībhāvaṃ yātā dayālavaḥ |
munayaḥ śiśavaścāhustānātrijanma tattathā || 10 1||
tataścāsurabhāvaṃ tu vihāyaitatsamāpsyathaḥ |
punardauvārikatvaṃ vai gamiṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 1 02||
evaṃ śaptau svabhavanātpatitau viṣṇulokataḥ |
diteḥ putrau tu tau jātau mahādaityau mahābalau || 1 03||
vaikuṃṭhe ca tayoḥ sthāne ajaṃ ajayameva ca |
niyuyoja harirdvārapālau yāvattadāgamaḥ || 1 04||
lakṣakoṭidāsadāsīramārāmājayādibhiḥ |
ātithyaṃ pūjanaṃ cāpi bhojanaṃ pādavāhanam || 1 05||
vividhaṃ sevanaṃ pānaṃ mardanaṃ śayanādikam |
sampāditaṃ caturṇāṃ tu sanakādikaśaṃjuṣām || 106||
kṛtvaiva darśanaṃ samyak datvā ca darśanaṃ svakam |
puṇyaṃ nītvā ca datvā cāgatā lokaṃ tu satyakam || 107||
vedhasā saha cāyātāste vai svapitṛmandiram |
tato gatāḥ kaśyapaṃ vai draṣṭuṃ merau tataśca te || 108||
putrayorharisamayorāśīrvādānvidhāya ca |
jagmurdhāma harerdivyaṃ śvetadvīpaṃ sadāsanam || 1 09||
atha jayaśca vijayo hyāsuraṃ bhāvamāsthitau |
hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣo’nujo’bhavat || 1.133.110 ||
varṣaśataṃ garbhasaṃsthau na ca janma hyavāpatuḥ |
yadi janma bhavettarhi duḥkhaṃ prāpsyāvahe yataḥ || 11 1||
janma naiva parigrāhyamiti matvā na nirgatau |
nāradena tadāgatya tatra tau tu prabodhitau || 1 12||
janmanāṃ grahaṇenaiva trijanmānte punaḥ svakam |
prāpsyatho vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma pārṣadau ca bhaviṣyathaḥ || 1 13||
ityādiśya tato mantramādideśa punastathā |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇetyevamāśrāvyājñāpayattadā || 1 14||
dveṣabhāvena vai lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ bhajiṣyathaḥ |
dvitīye janmani sītārāmaṃ caiva bhajiṣyathaḥ || 1 15||
tṛtīye janmani kṛṣṇaṃ naraṃ cāpi bhajiṣyathaḥ |
tato muktiṃ pragantārau bhaviṣyatho na saṃśayaḥ || 1 16||
iti coktvā gato devo nāradaḥ svaṃ trilokanam |
aṭanārthaṃ pārṣadau tvāsurau janma hyavāpatuḥ || 1 17||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne diteḥ putrārthaṃ tapo vedhasa āśīrvādo vaikuṇṭhagamanaṃ tatra viṣṇuṃ samprārthyavedhasā nārāyaṇasamaputraprāptivaradānakathanaṃ tato haripreraṇayā sanakādīnāṃ vaikuṇṭhagamane jayavijayābhyāṃ tiraskṛte janmatrayāsurabhāvaprātiśāpena hiraṇyakaśipuhiraṇyākṣajanmādivṛttāntakathananāmā trayastriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 133||

<1.134>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
kaśyapasya ca tau putrau jātamātrau mahābalau |
hiraṇyasamavarṇābhau mahāvīryabaloddhatau || 1 ||
hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣo’nujaḥ sa ca |
apramāṇaśarīro’bhūt bhrūstasya parvatīsamā || 2 ||
sa vai mahājale yāti yāti pavanamaṇḍale |
gamane cāntarīkṣe ca divi yāti punaḥpunaḥ || 3 ||
grahavad bhramati vyomni pātāle yāti śeṣavat |
prayāti pakṣivat merau cākāśe vainateyavat || 4 ||
aṣṭāvaraṇapāraṃ vai yāti kṛṣṇavimānavat |
mahākāyo hiraṇyākṣo no gaṇayati kaṃcana || 5 ||
yathecchati tathā dehe vardhayati kṣitiśravat |
yadā yadā vihārārthe yāti lokāntare tadā || 6 ||
cintāṃ karoti saḥ svīyajanmagṛhasya tatra vai |
yadi kaściddharenme vai gṛhaṃ svarṇamayaṃ tadā || 7 ||
nirādhāro bhaviṣyāmi vicāryāvartate punaḥ |
hiraṇyākṣeṇa saudhaḥ svaḥ kārito viśvakarmaṇā || 8 ||
merornitambabhūmau 3 cāntarīkṣe samastare |
pṛthvyā ūrdhva sahasraṃ vai yojanānāṃ samāntare || 9 ||
yojanadaśasāhasraṃ pariṇāho gṛhasya vai |
ucchrāyaśca sahasraṃ vai yojanānāṃ kṛtastathā || 1.134.10 ||
yāvadindrasya sūryasya somasya varuṇasya ca |
bṛhaspatervedhasaśca smṛddhayo’syābhavam̐śca tāḥ || 11 ||
nūtana manaso bhāvyaṃ saumyaṃ vā sundaraṃ hi yat |
dṛṣṭipathaṃ cāsya yāyādbhavet tanmahatāmapi || 12|||
prasahya tatsamānīya gṛhe bhuṃkte hyakaṇṭakaḥ |
evaṃ smṛddha gṛhaṃ tasya merāvāsītsvaranyadut || 13|||
evaṃ smṛddhaṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā yāti vihārabhūmiṣu |
tadā cintāṃ karotyeva drogdhurvai parato bhayam || 14||
ataḥ sa ekadā samyagavvṛdhe meruvanmahān |
uddhāṭya bāhusāhasre cotpāṭya ca mahīmimām || 15||
sāntardvīpāṃ saśailāṃ ca meroḥ saudhaṃ viyujya ca |
merordūramubhau nītvā praviveśa mahājalam || 16 ||
hāhākāro mahānāsītpṛthvīnāśe trayodaśa |
lokāścātrāvaśiṣyante’nyeṣāṃ nāśo’pi vai bhavet || 17||
prāṇisamāśritā sarvā pṛthvī nītā saparvatā |
savanakānanā sarvā mahādaityena saṃdhṛtā || 18||
karāmalakavannītā prāpitādho mahājalam |
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve cukruśurbhayapīḍitāḥ || 19||
śaraṇaṃ prayayurdevaṃ nārāyaṇahariprabhum |
dugdhābdhitīramāsādya tuṣṭuvurbahuvistaram |||1.134.20 ||
rakṣa trāhi hare pāhi procya petuḥ padorbhuvi |
rakṣa trāhi hare pāhi procya petu padārhikaiḥ ||21 ||
śrutvā nārāyaṇo devaḥ samāgacchatpatattriṇā |
sarvān viśvāsayāmāsa jñātavānadbhutaṃ mahat ||22||
śaṃkhacakragadādhārī viśvarūpī janārdanaḥ |
vārāharūpamāsthāya saṃsthito devasaṃyutaḥ |
anādimadhyāntavapurmahādaṃṣṭro mahābhujaḥ || 2 3 ||
hāhākāraṃ mahāśabdaṃ kurvanromāṇi dhūnayan |
viśvataḥ pāṇipāccakṣuḥsarvayajñamayo hariḥ |
kṛṣṇavarṇo meghanīlo babhūva merusannibhaḥ || 24 ||
mukhāṃ vārāharūpaṃ vai deho nārāyaṇātmakaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragadākhaḍgaśakticarmādidhṛkprabhuḥ |
jagāma tarasā vyomnādho’dho’dho yanmahājalam || 25 ||
tasya gatau gato bhrāntaścakrito’bhūnmahānilaḥ |
tadādhārā gṛhāścāpi kṛṣyante smāsya pṛṣṭhataḥ || 26 ||
mahājalaṃ yadā devaḥ praviṣṭaśca tadāsuraḥ |
bhayena tarasā vyāpto’pyabhūd yuddhāya tatparaḥ || 27 ||
pṛthvīṃ kukṣau tadāsthāpya hiraṇyākṣo mahāsuraḥ |
meruvajjagṛhe dehaṃ gadāṃ śaityācalopamām || 28 ||
bhrāmayitvā mahādaityo yuyodha jagadīśvaram |
gadāyuddhaṃ śatavarṣaṃ bahujātaṃ vināśakam || 29 ||
tadā vārāharūpo’sau harirmerusamo’bhavat |
daṃṣṭro ca vardhitā dīrghā vajrātivajraniṣṭhurā || 1.134.30 ||
pañcahimālayasthūlā daśahimādridīrghikā |
daṃṣṭrāgraṃ tu mahātīkṣṇaṃ śatagavyūtimānavat || 31 ||
balaṃ vairājadehasya prāvirbhāvya tadā hariḥ |
daṃṣṭrayā taṃ mahādaityaṃ paphāḍa parameśvaraḥ || 32 ||
maraṇe’kāri daityena mahārāvo bhayānakaḥ |
trāsakṛdbāhyasṛṣṭīnāṃ vairājeśvaravāsinām || 33 ||
devānāmāhlādakṛcca daityādīnāṃ bhayaṃkaraḥ |
avyāpnotsarvasṛṣṭyādāvutsavo’bhūt sthale sthale || 24 ||
saṃcūrṇitamahāgātro mamāra ditijo’dhamaḥ |
patitāṃ dharaṇīṃ dṛṣṭvā svarṇasaudhaṃ ca tatra vai || 35 ||
daṃṣṭrayoddhṛtya deveśo hyājagāma bhuvastalam |
merau yathābhavallagnā tathā pṛthvīṃ suyujya ca || 36 ||
tathaiva dṛśyarūpo’sau jagāma vai svakaṃ gṛham |
tatra kṣīranidhestīre kroḍarūpaṃ mahāharim || 37 ||
dṛṣṭvā vai devatā bhaktinamrāstuṣṭuvurādarāt |
namo mahāvarāhāya suyajñamūrtaye namaḥ || 38 ||
namo merusvarūpāya daityaghnāya namonamaḥ |
namo mahāsudaṃṣṭrāya dharaṇīdhāriṇe namaḥ || 39 ||
samagravedavedāṃgamūrtaye te namonamaḥ |
namaḥ sahasrahastāya namo viśvasvarūpiṇe ||1.134.40 ||
sargasthitisvarūpāya namaḥ kālasvarūpiṇe |
nūtnarūpadhṛte te ca sarvatrātre namonamaḥ ||41 ||
śrībhūlīlāramālakṣmīkaṃbharāpataye namaḥ |
namaḥ śāntasvarūpāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ ||42||
iti stutvā tayā devairmunibhiḥ ṛṣibhirbhuvā |
vārāhasya hareḥ pūjā kṛtāsrakcandanādibhiḥ ||43||
samarcyamānastairdevaisteṣāmiṣṭaṃ varaṃ dadau |
yadā yadā ca devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ matkalātmanām ||44||
āpadāyāttadā rakṣāṃ kariṣye smārito yadā |
ityabhidhāya gandharvairapsarobhirmaharṣibhiḥ ||45||
gīyamānasstūmānastatraivāntaradhīyata |
evaṃ kroḍāvatārāśca kalpe kalpe tadantare || 46 ||
bhavanti me jalayoge mahākārye hyupasthite |
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ vārāhaṃ vaibhavādikam ||47||
hiraṇyākṣādbalino’pi hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe |
nārasiṃhaṃ dhṛtaṃ rūpaṃ vakṣye lakṣmi śṛṇu priye ||48||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne svavaimānikaprāsādena saha pṛthvīṃ nītavato hiraṇyākṣasya vārāharūpeṇa mahājale kṛtasaṃhārādivarṇananāmā catustriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 134 ||

<1.135>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu devi mahālakṣmi hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svakam |
bhrātaraṃ nihataṃ śrutvā paryatapyadruṣā jvalan || 1 ||
uvāca daśanairoṣṭhaṃ daśan cāsphoṭayannurū |
netre ca cūrṇayan rakte krodhāgnijvālite’ śvasan || 2 ||
garjayan vivaraṃ bhaumaṃ nirīkṣan dhūmramambaram |
vikarālo mahākrūraḥ kampayam̐śca padā mahīm || 3 ||
duṣprekṣyabhūnetrakuṭiḥ svedabindulalāṭakaḥ |
prāleyameghavadvyagro hyudgacchadroṣavāridhiḥ || 4 ||
khaṅga dīrghaṃ kare dhṛtvā samutthāya tadāsanāt |
ākrauśanmeghavacchīghraṃ khaṅgamuttolya cāmbare || 5 ||
sambodhayandaityasabhāṃ pṛthvīṃ nirvīryaśobhanām |
manyate yadi vai kaścit sa ghāsagrāsamatti vai || 6 ||
nirvīryā nahi daiteyā na bhūrnivīryadhāriṇī |
nirvīryāstu śvasanto’pi mṛtā eva vinā mṛtim || 7 ||
na gaṇaye mahāviṣṇuṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ pitāmaham|
tarhi ko nāma viṣṇurvai paśurūpeṇa sañcaran || 8 ||
yadi viṣṇuḥ svamanasi jānāti balagarvitaḥ |
daityamūrdhanyahantāha tadātti ghāsameva saḥ || 9 ||
na daityā vai mṛtāḥ sarve yena viṣṇuḥ sukhī bhavet |
sati daitye sukhī syāt ceddaityo’tti ghāsameva saḥ || 1.135.1 0||
sati viṣṇau na vai daityaḥ sati daitye na mādhavaḥ |
viṣṇurjīvenmriyeddaityo daityo jīvenmriyeddhariḥ || 11 ||
na dvayorjīvatoḥ pṛthvyā rājyaṃ tu syādakaṇṭakam |
balena yadi vā smṛddhyā vāhanena ca hetibhiḥ || 12||
sainyena vidyayāstraiśca mantreṇa nyūnatāsti cet |
kariṣye sutapo ghoraṃ yena viṣṇurabhūddhariḥ || 13 ||
ahaṃ tato’pyadhikaṃ vai kariṣye tapa ulbaṇam |
tādṛśānkoṭiviṣṇūn vai grasiṣye kavalena yat || 14||
mahākālamapigrāsaṃ kariṣye ko’yameḍakaḥ |
meṣo’sti mama sāmye’yaṃ viṣṇurvaiṣṇavapūjitaḥ || 15||
dūraṃ daityakulādyāti cāntaryāti jalālayam |
tasmāddaityā bhavantyeva susajjāḥ śastrapāṇayaḥ || 1 6||
apacitiṃ kariṣyāmo mama bhrāturmahātmanaḥ |
maddhetibhinnadehasya bhūriṇā rudhireṇa vai || 17||
raktapriyaṃ tarpayiṣye bhrātaraṃ me gatavyathaḥ |
bho namuce śatabāho dvimūrdhastryakṣa śambara || 18||
bho śatāre sahasrāre bho puloman samilvala |
bho pramedya mahādhūmra bho devāre gajāsura || 19 ||
re bho śakuna kākākṣe śṛṇutānantaraṃ mama |
yūyaṃ yāta bhuvaṃ sarve viprakṣatrādirūpataḥ ||1.135.20 ||
sūdayadhvaṃ tapoyajñakāriṇo brāhmaṇānmuhuḥ |
viṣṇorbalaṃ brāhmaṇairvai yajñaiḥ saṃvardhitaṃ sadā ||2 1 ||
yajñairdevāḥ sadā puṣṭiṃ yānti svarganivāsinaḥ |
pitaraścāpi yajñena tṛptā bhavanti sarvadā ||22||
munayaḥ ṛṣayaścāpi viṣṇurvaikuṇṭhavāsinaḥ |
sarve’pi yajñabhāgairvai puṣṭiṃ yānti muhurmuhuḥ ||23 ||
yajñenendraḥ pravarṣati meghāśca vṛṣṭisanmukhāḥ |
brāhmaṇā dakṣiṇāpūrṇā yajño mūlaṃ hi jīvane ||24||
brāhmaṇānāṃ vināśena yajñā naṣṭā bhavanti vai |
yajñanāśe kuto vṛṣṭirdevānāṃ jīvanaṃ kutaḥ || 25||
viprayajñasurāṇāṃ ca vināśe sukhino vayam |
evaṃ tapaḥprabhāveṇa samedhitā maharṣayaḥ ||26 ||
tasmānnārīḥ saha nītvā kurvantu tapasāṃ kṣayam |
rūpāntarāṇi kāryāṇi sādhyante hyanurūpakaiḥ || 27||
tasmād bhavantu brāhmaṇyo daityapatnyaḥ sthale sthale |
daityā bhavantu viprāśca munīnāṃ sevakāstathā || 28|||
ūṭajāni mahāraṇye racayitvā vasantu vai |
mṛṣāgnihotrakartāro mṛṣāyajñapradarśakāḥ || 29 ||
mṛṣādharmapradeṣṭāro bhavantu vanavāsinaḥ |
mṛṣā brāhmaṇadharmeṇa teṣvāviśya ca chadmanā || 1.135.3 0 ||
mārayantu bhakṣayantu nāśayantu yathākṣaṇam |
yatra yatra dvijā yajñā gāvo dharmāśca satkriyāḥ || 31 ||
tatra tatra yāta yūyaṃ sandīpayata vṛścata |
pratijñāṃ prakurutātra sadasyuddhṛtahetayaḥ || 32 ||
sarvaidaityairmilitvaiva hyekībhūya ca sarvadā |
brāhmaṇānāṃ kratūnāṃ ca nāśaḥ kāryaḥ sadaiva hi || 32 ||
atra ye saṃgatā na syuste jñeyāḥ suravardhakāḥ |
hantavyāste daityayūthairanyathā mātṛghātakāḥ || 34||
ityāśrutya hiraṇyādyakaśiporvijayo’stu vai |
uccāryaivaṃ ca daityāste saśastroddhṛtapāṇayaḥ || 32||
cakruḥ pratijñāṃ tadvākyād yātā deśāntaraṃ bhavi |
viprāṇāṃ kadanaṃ cakruḥ pradehuḥ pattanāni ca || 36||
bibhidurnagarāṇyanye prādahan śaraṇārthinaḥ |
babhañjuryajñavistārānkadanaṃ cakrire mahat || 37||
tadā devāśca viprāśca pṛthvyāṃ ceruralakṣitāḥ |
tadā lakṣmi mahādaityo hiraṇyakaśipuḥ svakān || 38 ||
upadiśyaiva caikākī jagāma mandarācalam |
bhogānsarvānparityajyaikākī ca nirjane vane || 39||
tapastepe mahāghoraṃ divyavarṣasahasrakam |
vāyubhakṣo nirāhāraḥ pādāṃguṣṭhopari sthitaḥ ||1.135.40 ||
rudropari mahādaityo rudrāya nama īrayan |
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu mūrdhnastasya mahātmanaḥ ||41 ||
dhūmaḥ samudbhavan ghoro vyomnyutthito vyavardhayat |
ābrahmabhavanaṃ vyāpto mahātejo’titāpanaḥ ||42||
yathāgnervā ravervāpi jvālāmālānvito bhavet |
dāvānalo’thavā kiṃ vā vāḍavānala eva vā ||43 ||
tathānalo dhūmravarṇo hyutthito vyomapāragaḥ |
tenāgninā samantādvai jajvaluśca diśo daśa ||44||
tena taptāḥ svargadevā brahmalokaṃ yayustadā |
brahmaṇe jñāpayāmāsustapo daityasya duḥsaham || 45||
tadutthavahniśamanaṃ vidhehi tvaritaṃ prabho |
anyathā sa mahādaityo vairājapadamicchati ||46||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāstu tṛṇayante tadagrataḥ |
itisaṃkalpabalinā tapasā jetumicchati ||47||
vināśayitvā devādīn vidhāsye sunavāṃ sṛjim |
daityarūpāṃ svānukūlāṃ daityamayīṃ svatejasā ||48||
mahākālaṃ vaśīkṛtya cāpunarmārakāṃ sṛje |
kiṃ kālakavalāpannānvṛthā viṣṇupadādibhiḥ ||49||
itinirbandhamāsthāya karoti duścaraṃ tapaḥ |
tadvidhatsva yathānyāyaṃ trāhi śīghraṃ surādikān ||1.135.50 ||
devānnītvā saha brahmā rudraṃ prati gatastataḥ |
śrāvayāmāsa rudrāya nītvā ca saha śaṃkaram |||51 ||
jagmuḥ sarve mandarasya droṇyāṃ yatra sa daityarāṭ |
ākāśātparito dṛṣṭaṃ sthalaṃ kvāste mahāsuraḥ ||52||
na spaṣṭo dṛśyate kvāpi bahudhā mārgito’pi saḥ |
tathāpi nirjane śuṣke’raṇye valmikamastakāt ||53 ||
jvālāmālāsamucchrāyo ghaṭṭadhūmrordhvamiśritaḥ |
sarvairdṛṣṭastarkitaśca daityarājo’tra saṃbhavet ||54|||
yāvat tvavatarantīme jvālāmālipradeśake |
tatra dṛṣṭo mahānbhūmerucchrāyo mṛnmayotthitaḥ |||55|||
pipīlikābhirācīrṇo vṛkṣāgryatṛṇakīcakaiḥ |
vyāptaḥ śuṣkairmahāstambaiḥ suśṛṃgairiva parvataḥ |||56||
vividhaiḥ svalpaśṛṃgāḍhyairvalmīkaiḥ parigopitaḥ |
pracchannaḥ śuṣkamāṃsāsragasthilambitajīvanaḥ ||57||
tatra samādhinā dṛṣṭo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā |
brahmāpyāścaryamagno’bhūdanye tu kampitāstadā ||58 ||
aho tapaḥparākāṣṭhetyūcurvigalitāntarāḥ |
prāha vedhāḥ prahasan vai prapautraṃ kāśyapaṃ tadā ||59||
uttiṣṭha putra prottiṣṭha tapaḥsiddhirabhūt tava |
ayaṃ rudro mahādevo varadānāya cāgataḥ ||1.135.60 ||
kaśyapastava janakastasyāpi janakastathā |
maricirapyāgato’sti tasya bhrātara uttamāḥ |||61||
samāyātāstava kṛte prasannāstapasā tava |
varapradā ime prāptā vṛṇu tvaṃ yadabhīpsitam ||62||
paśyāmaste cātmabalaṃ tapaaugryaṃ tato’pi ca |
na kṛtaṃ na kariṣyantīdṛśaṃ cānye madantare ||63||
nirjalaṃ cāsthisaṃghāte prāṇān varṣāṇi vai śatam |
ko’nyastu dhārayedevaṃ yathepsitaṃ varaṃ vṛṇu ||64||
puna punarbodhyamāno bahirnāyātsa vai yadā |
deho’sya pṛthvyā saṃlīnaścātmā līnastu śaṃkare ||65||
kaḥ śṛṇoti ko jāgarti śavakalpasamādhigaḥ |
śuṣkakāṣṭhakaṭhorāsthisaṃdhayaḥ kāṣṭhatāṃ gatāḥ |||66|||
pāṣāṇakalpo daityendro yadā na kampate manāk |
tadā tu brahmaṇā svasya kamaṇḍalujalaṃ śubham ||67||
kare nidhāya mantraiśca sajīvanavidhāyakaiḥ |
abhimantrya prokṣitastadvalmīke tāvadeva saḥ ||68||
yuvā sūryasamo rūpe supuṣṭo divi devavat||
vajratulyaśarīrāṃgaḥ svarṇavarṇaḥ samutthitaḥ ||69||
vidhūya śarīrād vṛkṣastambapipīlikāmṛdaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā devān brahmarudrakaśyapādīn nanāma ca ||1.135.70||
praharṣitaścakāraiṣāmātithyamaśrucakṣuṣā |
rudraḥ prāha tadā daityaṃ kiṃ te manasi rocate ||71||
yadarthaṃ tapa ātiṣṭho vṛṇu varāndadāmyaham |
śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca varadaṃ natvā gadgadayā girā ||72||
namaḥ sarvādhibhūtāya sarvāntaryāmiṇe namaḥ |
tapaḥphalapradātre te brahmaṇe śaṃbhave namaḥ ||73||
namo’stu janakāyātrabhavate kaśyapāya ca |
namo marīcaye tadvat sarvarṣibhyo namonamaḥ ||74||
sarve śubhapradātāro bhavantu mama sarvadā |
yadi deyā varā mahyaṃ pātraṃ cāhaṃ mato’smi vaḥ ||79||
surāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām |
paśupakṣimṛgāṇāṃ ca siddhānāṃ ca mahātmanām ||76||
yakṣavidyādharāṇāṃ codbhijjānāṃ kinnarātmanām |
kiṃpuṃsāṃ sarvarogāṇāṃ mantryāyudhāstrayantriṇām ||77||
sarveṣāṃ dattaśāpānāmavadhyatvaṃ ca me bhavet |
nāntarbahirna divase na rātrau cijjaḍairna ca ||78||
na pṛthvyāṃ nāmbare mṛtyurmama syādajasṛṣṭitaḥ |
yuddhe cāpratidvandvatvamekapatyaṃ ca dehinām ||79||
sarveṣāṃ lokapālānāmīśvaratvamakhaṇḍitam |
tapoyogaprabhāvāṇāmavināśo mamāstviti ||1.135.80 ||
ityete tu varāḥ sveṣṭā dīyantāṃ pitṛbhiśca me |
brahmājñayā tadā rudraḥ prāha śiṣyaṃ tapasvinam ||8 1||
śiṣya caite varāḥ janmavatāṃ tu durlabhāḥ sadā |
tathāpi vitarāmo’dya kaḥ sṛṣṭau śāśvato janaḥ ||82||
iti dattvā varān rudrabrahmādyāḥ ketanaṃ yayuḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipuścāpi nivavṛte tapaḥsthalāt ||83||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipuḥ sakrodho viprayajñādināśārthaṃ daityānuttejayanmandarācale tapo’rthaṃ jagāma rudrabrahmādibhiḥ samāgatya tasmai vedhasaḥ sṛṣṭyāmaratvaṃ vitaritamitivarṇananāmā paṃcatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 35||

<1.136>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ sā kathā lakṣmi tvayā caikamanīṣayā |
evaṃ varānsamāpanno hiraṇyakaśipuḥ ripuḥ || 1 ||
smṛtvā bhrātṛvināśaṃ vai dveṣaṃ karoti mādhave |
gatvā gatvā diśāḥ sarvā jitvā tathā ca sāgarān || 2 ||
dvīpām̐stathopasudvīpān pātālasahitāṃ bhuvam |
vedhaḥsthānaṃ parityajya sarvaṃ vaśīcakāra saḥ || 3 ||
manūnṛṣīnpitṛpatīnsurāsurāndivaspatīn |
siddhacāraṇagāndharvān vidyādhrānmānuṣām̐stathā || 4 ||
yakṣarakṣaḥpretabhūtapiśācoragakinnarān |
kiṃpuruṣām̐śca kūṣmāṇḍān vetālām̐śca vināyakān || 5 ||
sādhyāṃśca maruto viśvedevānsarisṛpām̐stathā |
nāgān salilakṛdvāsām̐strilokisthānadhīśvarān || 6 ||
jitvā vaśaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā viśvajitso’bhavannatha |
lokapālakṛtā devāḥ prāsādāḥ smṛddhayastathā || 7 ||
devodyānāni sarvāṇi sāmudraṃ ratnajātakam |
mahendrabhavanaṃ yāvat dikpālānāṃ gṛhāṇi ca || 8 ||
grahāṇāṃ ca rathāḥ sarve devā devyo navā navāḥ |
sarvaṃ vaśīkṛtaṃ tena daityāḥ sarvatra yojitāḥ || 9 ||
caturdaśabhuvanānāmagryā lakṣmīrnijīkṛtā |
mahanto divyasatsaudhāḥ prāsādāḥ paramālayāḥ || 1.136.1 0||
yatra vidrumasopānā divyasphāṭikabhittayaḥ |
mahāmārakatīsthalyo vaidūryastambharājayaḥ || 1 1||
divyāmbaravitānāni padmarāgāsanāni ca |
vimānāni mahārhāṇi candraśālāḥ sudīptayaḥ || 12||
dugdhaphenasamāḥ śayyā muktāmaṇiparicchidāḥ |
khānapānavilāsāśca vilāsinyo’bdaṣoḍaśāḥ || 13||
svarṇavarṇāḥ sugandhāḍhyāḥ mṛgākṣyo viditeṅgitāḥ |
sakiṃkiṇīkanakakṛnnūpuraśabditagṛhāḥ || 14||
sadratnakhacitādarśadṛṣṭānanasaroruhāḥ |
sudatyaḥ svalpamadhyāśca padmapatrāyatekṣaṇāḥ || 15||
susaṃkocavikāsādiśaktisvātantryasaṃbhṛta|
dṛḍhagranthyagramadhyāntahṛsvāvakāśayonayaḥ |
svarṇavarṇacamatkāracaṃcadgātrāḥ surastriyaḥ || 16 ||
vilasanti yatra daityaṃ ramayanti ca sarvadā |
prāsādāstena te sarve svādhikāre vaśīkṛtāḥ || 17||
sarvadevābhivanditapādapīṭho mahābalaḥ ||
rājate ca mahendrasya siṃhāsanavirājitaḥ |
aśeṣadhiṣṇyapairdivyopadābhiḥ paripūjitaḥ || 18||
viśvāvasutumburugāndharvāgryairatyabhistutaḥ |
siddharṣimunividyādhrāpsarobhiḥ kṛtasaṃstavaḥ || 19||
nārāyaṇo’para iva rājate bhuvanaikarāṭ |
yajñeṣu dānakāryeṣu vaiśvānaravidhānake ||1.136.20 ||
ityābhāgān svayaṃ bhuṃkte’rpitā ṛtvigbhirādarāt |
bhūstasyāsīd vasumatī medinyakṛṣṭapākadā ||2 1||
svargaṃ kāmapravarṣyabhūd vāyuḥ śāntikaro’vasat |
ratnānyarpayate cābdhiḥ saritaḥ salilāni ca ||22||
saptadvīpāḥ samudrāśca sevante vardhayanti tam |
śailā drumā vanodyānāḥ ṛtavo gaganaṃ tathā |||23 ||
svasvaparicchadaistasya sevāṃ kurvanti nityaśaḥ |
agnistasya pāvako’bhūd vāyurvai gṛhamārjakaḥ || 24||
pṛthvī śayyākarī cāsījjalaṃ vāriharaṃ hyabhūt |
medhāḥ śaityābhivyañjakavyajanārpayiṇo’bhavan || 25||
candro ratiśramanode śaityado’bhūtsadāsthitaḥ |
kuberastasya bhūṣādhṛk gāyikā ca sarasvatī || 26||
indraḥ pānapradātābhūd yamo hārādhipo’bhavat |
kṣīramiṣṭodakāḥ sarve sāgarāścodakumbhayaḥ || 27||
sūryastasya kirīṭasyābhavanmaṇyamaṇiḥ svayam |
pātālāni ca daityasya pādapīṭhāstadābhavan || 28||
apsarasaḥ sadā dāsyo devyaśca pādamardikāḥ |
nadyaḥ snānavidhāyinyo’raṇyāni phaladāni ca ||29 ||
kiṃ nyūnaṃ kṛtabhakteśca dāsasya padabhraṃśane |
tatrāpi tapasā prāptaprasādasya sadā priye || 1.136.30||
na me bhaktasya kiñcidvai nyūnaṃ bhogye bhavediha |
yadyadicchati tasmādapyadhikādhikamuddade || 31 ||
aiśvaryaṃ madasampattiryauvanaṃ cāvivekitā |
pratyekaṃ cāpyanarthāya kimu yatra catuṣṭayam ||32||
tasmāttu sarvadā bhāvyaṃ nirlepatvena sarvathā |
sa vai bhogaṃ ca mokṣaṃ ca vindate’nyaḥ patatyadhaḥ |||33||
yathā yathā prabhuṃkte ca mūḍho viṣayaparvatān |
tathā tathā bhavellubdho mohapāśaprajālitaḥ || 34||
yatheṣṭaṃ saḥ prabhuñjāno viṣayān sārvabhaumajān |
nātyatṛpyanmahāmūrkhaḥ pratyutotpathago’bhavat |||35|||
ugradaṇḍairlokapālānudvejayati tāmasaḥ |
rakṣati na prajā daityānuttejayati pakṣataḥ ||36||
daityapakṣavardhayitā surapakṣavināśakaḥ |
nināya kālamarbudamabdānāmevameva saḥ |||37||
tato duḥkhaṃ paraṃ prāptā udvignā lokapālinaḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva brāhmaṇā naṣṭarakṣaṇāḥ ||38||
devāśca pitaraścānye ye ye duḥkhadaśānvitāḥ |
te sarve kṣīradhestīre śaraṇaṃ yayuracyutam |||39||
namaḥ śaraṇyāya śāntasvarūpāya namonamaḥ |
duḥkhāvāsāya daityāṃśalakṣmīsthitāya te namaḥ ||1.136.40||
rakṣākartre yatisanyāsārthine haraye namaḥ |
parivarttanivāsāya parivartātmane namaḥ ||41||
bahukālaṃ svabhaktāya daityāya sārvabhaumakam |
dattavān sāmprataṃ daityabhinnebhyo dātumarhasi ||42||
surādivāñcchitaṃ cāpi kṛpayā dātumarhasi |
parāvarttaṃ kuru viṣṇotvasahyaḥ samayo gataḥ ||43||
iti prārthya surāḥ sarve kṣīrābdhyuttarabhūtale |
samādhau susthitāścānye japayajñe vyavasthitāḥ ||44||
nārāyaṇādvaraṃ labdhvā rakṣāyā vacanaṃ tathā |
tato yāsyāma iti me pratipattiṃ vidhāya ca ||45||
smaranti sma hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇamahāprabhum |
tāvadākāśaśabdākhyā vāguvācāśarīriṇī ||46||
bho bhoḥ surādayo mukhyā yuṣmatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati |
āyatiḥ subhagā yuṣmatkṛte cāyāti niścitam ||47||
sarveṣāṃ kālacakrasyodayasyāvanatestathā |
samayo bhavati paścānna bhavatyeva sarvathā ||48||
puṇyāpuṇyakṛtaṃ cakraṃ sarveṣāṃ kṛtibandhanam |
pravartate yathānyāyaṃ tadasyāsti pravardhitaḥ ||49||
api mahattaraṃ puṇyaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ khalu |
prakāśate ca yāvat tannāśo’pi duṣkaraḥ khalu ||1.136.50 ||
daurātmyaṃ pūjyahāniścādharmaḥ patnyavrataṃ tathā |
āyurnāśaṃ karotyeva puṇyanāśaṃ tu vegataḥ || 51 ||
so’yaṃ lakṣmīmadāndho vai samācarati tadbahu |
pūrṇe nāśaṃ kariṣyāmi cekṣantāṃ kālamāgatam |||52||
dvijadevagavāṃ sādhvīsādhudharmakṛtāṃ mama |
vidveṣo nāśakṛddhyāśu madbhaktasya viśeṣataḥ ||53 ||
tadasya divasāḥ prāyaḥ samāptā eva sarvathā |
tadupāyaṃ karomyeva yāta yūyaṃ svakaṃ sthalam ||54||
ityabhidhāya sā vāṇī virame’tha surādayaḥ |
taddiśaṃ śrīhariṃ smṛtvā natvā sadaṃḍavatpunaḥ ||55||
sarve yātāḥ svakaṃ sthānaṃ hataṃ daityaṃ ca menire |
hariḥ prahlādamālakṣya daityanāśamaciklṛpat ||56||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipukṛtasuramunyādidveṣatadvaibhavatadvināśārthadevādikṛtaviṣṇvārādhanādivarṇananāmā ṣaṭtriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 136 ||

<1.137>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ lakṣmīpatiḥ lakṣmi sulakṣmakṛt |
devānāṃ hitakāryāya sarvārpaṇaṃ karoti vai || 1 ||
sutā tūttānapādasya kalyāṇīnāmakanyakā |
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ patnī suṣuve caturaḥ sutān || 2 ||
prahlādaścāpi saṃhlāda āhlādo hlāda eva te |
prathamastatra madbhakto mahātejā babhūva ha || 3||
mahāpuruṣasevāyāṃ tyaktānyaḥ sarvathābhavat |
brahmaṇyaḥ śīlasampannaḥ satyavartanamānasaḥ || 4 ||
ātmeva sarvalokānāṃ hṛdayaṃgama eva saḥ |
mahatāṃ pādasevāyāṃ kiṃkara iva vartate || 5 ||
dīnaduḥkhaharaḥ saumyaḥ paryupāsitamādhavaḥ |
vidyābhaktiprabhuśaktismṛddha eva tu janmataḥ || 6 ||
gurugoviprabhaktaśca vyasanādivivarjitaḥ |
anityāśuciduḥkhāni jānan tattvāni daihike || 7 ||
nābhūdāsakta īrṣyādimāyākāryavivarjitaḥ |
na bālakrīḍanake’sti prasanno vai manāgapi || 8 ||
krīḍā tasya harermūrtau suhṛt tasya hariḥ svayam |
anurakto hṛṣīkeśe garbhavāse’pi yo harau || 9 ||
sarvāvasthāsu kāryeṣu manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ |
nānyaṃ jānāti vai viṣṇornārāyaṇāt sanātanāt || 1.137.10 ||
yasminmahāguṇāḥ sarve sāttvatānāṃ sadā matāḥ |
vāsudeve harau kṛṣṇe tasya naisargikī matiḥ || 1 1||
jagatprati suṣuptaḥ sa jāgarti śrīhariṃ prati |
svapan śvasan samuttiṣṭhan calan pārśvaṃ vivartayan || 12|

dhyāyati smarati pratikṣaṇaṃ cintayate prabhum || 14||
kvacidaśrūṇi vai premṇā vimuṃcati hariṃ smaran |
kvaciddhasati devaṃ sa divyaṃ paśyan hṛdi sthitam || 15||
kvacidudgāyati nāmānyatipremṇā hareḥ svayam |
kvacinnṛtyati premātmā harau dravati ca kvacit || 16||
kvacitspṛṣṭo divyamūrtyā vilīno jāḍyameti saḥ |
evaṃ brahmarasapluto nārāyaṇe suvartate || 17||
kṣudhā na tṛṣā tasya na bhūṣā nāṃgamārjanam |
na vastrādisamībhāvo nānyaccitte vasatyadaḥ || 18||
netre harirmukhe kṛṣṇo jihvāyāṃ harireva ca |
bāhye caivāntare kārye hariryasyāśrayo’bhavat || 19||
sa kāle copanītaḥ san gurorgehe’vasat sudhīḥ |
guruḥ purohitastasya kāvyaścāsurapūjitaḥ |||1.137.20 ||
kāvyasya tasya śukrasya sutau dvau śāstrapāragau |
ādyaḥ ṣaṇḍo’paro’markastau rājñārpitaputrakam |||2 1 ||
pāṭhayāmāsatuḥ pāṭhyānarthānāsurabhāvanān |
tathā ca sāmavedādīn grāhyaṃ gṛhṇāti nāparam |||2||
daivyo’daivyo mahāvidyā bahvyaḥ sarvāḥ prapāṭhitāḥ |
guruproktaṃ hi tatsarvaṃ śuśrāvānupapāṭha ca |||23 ||
yayā mokṣo bhavet tāṃ sa samyak gṛhṇāti bhāvataḥ |
asadgrahāśrayāṃ cānyāṃ vidyāṃ tyajati cāntarāt ||24||
adhītya sarvavedām̐śca śāstrāṇi vividhāni ca |
kasmim̐ścidatha kāle ca guruṇā saha daityajaḥ ||25||
pituḥ samīpamāgatya vavande pātayoḥ patan |
taṃ pariṣvajya bāhubhyāṃ tanayaṃ śubhamānasam ||26||
aṃkamāropya papraccha hiraṇyakaśipuḥ pitā |
prahlāda cirakāle tvaṃ gurorgehe niveśitaḥ ||27|||
śikṣitaṃ guruṇā śreṣṭhaṃ tanmamācakṣva sādhu yat |
prahrādastu namaskṛtya prahṛṣṭaḥ san jagāda tat |||28||
gṛhajāla mahāyāmyaṃ parityajyātmavit pumān |
ātmamālaṃ hṛcchayanaṃ pariṣvajyātmanā yajet |||29||
sarvavidyārthasaṃcārī yo’sti śrīparameśvaraḥ |
sa vai sarvagataḥ sādhurartho’nyo’rthastvapārthakaḥ ||1.137.3 0||
śrutvā putragiro viṣṇubhaktipravāhagarbhitāḥ |
daityastu prahasan prāha gurūn putrapraśāsane |||3 1||
bālabuddhiḥ svacchavastrasamā pārśvastharopiṇī |
viṣṇupakṣikṛto bhede buddhāvasya kathaṃ gataḥ |||32||
yathā na bhidyate cāsyāpakvā buddhistathārthataḥ |
śāsathainaṃ pūjyapādāḥ punarnaivaṃ vadedayam ||3 3||
tadā vai guravastaṃ svaṃ gṛhamānīya sāmabhiḥ |
samapṛcchanta kenāyaṃ viṣṇurartho’dhiśikṣitaḥ |||34||
nāyamartho daityapakṣasukhadastaṃ parityaja |
svato vā parataste’yamartho viṣṇumayaḥ kutaḥ ||35||
prahlādaḥ prāha sarvātmā nārāyāṇapareśvaraḥ |
sarvāntarātmā diśati bhaja nārāyaṇaṃ sadā |||36||
guruḥ prāha tvayā prokto nārāyaṇaḥ sa te pitā |
nānyo nārāyaṇaḥ kaścittaṃ bhajasva sukhī bhava ||37||
śiṣyaḥ prāha guro satyaṃ nārāyaṇasya bhaktitaḥ |
nārāyaṇasamā bhaktā bhavantyevaṃ na me pitā ||38||
narasamūhavāsena nārāyaṇo’pi me pitā |
kālagrāso na tu divyo nārāyaṇo’kṣarādhipaḥ ||39||
tayorasti mahān bhedaḥ pataṃgadyupataṃgayoḥ |
khadyotaṃ mama pitaraṃ mṛṣā vedmi na bhāskaram ||1.137.40||
ātmaprakāśakaṃ satyaṃ vedmi nārāyaṇaṃ guro |
tathāpi pitaraṃ manye pitarameva kevalam ||41||
nātyadhikaṃ nārāyaṇadveṣitvānmānanaṃ na me |
guruḥ prāha tathāpi tvaṃ pitṛśāsanamāvaha ||42||
pituḥ pūjāṃ paricaryāṃ sevāmājñāṃ sadāvaha |
śikṣita iti prahrādaḥ sāyaṃ gṛhamupāgataḥ |||43||
pitrā saṃpariṣvajyāṃke snehapūrvaṃ niṣāditaḥ |
sāmnā pṛṣṭaśca me putrādya tvayādhītamatra kim ||44||
vada śrutvā sukhī syāṃ te vidyāmasmatkulocitām |
prahlādaḥ prāha pitaraṃ natvādhītaṃ bravīmi tat ||45||
bhavānnārāyaṇo rājyānmṛṣā naiva yathārthataḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ satyo vaikuṇṭhavāsisevitaḥ ||46||
taṃ bhajāmi bhajatvenaṃ bhavānapi pitarmama |
śravaṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ viṣṇo smaraṇaṃ pādasevanam |
arcanaṃ vandanaṃ dāsyaṃ sakhyamātmanivedanam ||47||
navadhādhyāpanaṃ śreṣṭhamanyat sarvaṃ viḍambanam |
navadhādhyayanaṃ kāryaṃ kimanyena viḍambinā ||48 ||
śrutvaitatparamaṃ bhaktimayaṃ daityapatistadā |
saroṣo gurumāhetthaṃ kimetacchikṣitaṃ tvayā ||49||
mamātmajasya durbuddhe harisaṃstavabhṛdvacaḥ |
kimarthamuktavānasmatkulākāryaṃ surocitam ||1.137.50 ||
guruputra kimetadvai vipakṣagataśikṣaṇam |
pracchanno’si viṣṇupakṣapoṣakaśchadmaveśadhṛk ||5 1||
kapaṭināmasādhūnāmapi kālo na dūrataḥ |
guruputrasya putrasya saha daṇḍo bhaviṣyati ||52||
guruputrastadā prāha nedṛgadhyāpitaṃ mayā |
buddhinaisargikī tvasya mā kadarthīkarotu naḥ ||53|||
tathāpi prāha daityendro nādhītaṃ tu gurostvayā |
kasmādadhītametadvai vada bāla yathocitam ||54||
prahlādaḥ prāha daityendra kṛṣṇadattā matirmama |
kṛṣṇabhaktarajoleśābhiṣiktatanumantarā ||55||
sādhuprasaṃgasatsevāmṛte na tvīdṛśī matiḥ |
kṛpayā devadevasya śikṣito’smi hareḥ prabhoḥ |||56||
nānyo gururme vadati sa eva prerako hariḥ |
śrotā mantā tathā vaktā draṣṭā sarvatra vartate ||57||
harirevākṣayaḥ śāstā buddhidātāpi sa prabhuḥ |
tadā hiraṇyakaśipuḥ prāha putraṃ ruṣānvitaḥ ||58||
ahameveśvaro loke trailokyādhipatirmataḥ |
māmevārcaya govindaṃ tyaja śatruṃ tamacyutam ||59||
athavā śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ rudraṃ lokaguruṃ prabhum |
arcayasva surādhyakṣaṃ sarvaiśvaryapradaṃśivam ||1.137.60||
prahlādaḥ prāha devasya māyāmohamime gatāḥ |
rākṣasā api manyante vayameveśvarā iti ||61||
śaṃkaro’pi svayaṃ viṣṇubhakto’sti vaiṣṇavāgryagaḥ |
daityo’yaṃ kiṃ na jānāti kathamevaṃ bhramaṃgataḥ ||62||
pitarnaitadvijānāsi madagarvadhiyāvṛtam |
nārāyaṇaḥ parabrahma tattvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ ||63||
nārāyaṇaḥ paro dhyātā dhyānaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ param |
gatirviśvasya jagataḥ śāśvataḥ sa prabhuḥ paraḥ || 64||
dhātā vidhātā jagato vāsudevaḥ sanātanaḥ |
viśvameveha puruṣastadviśvamupajīvati ||65||
hiraṇmayaśarīraḥ sa puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ |
tenaiva sṛṣṭau brahmeśau vartete tasya śāsane ||66||
bhīṣāsmādvāti pavano bhīṣodeti divākaraḥ |
bhīṣāsmādagniścendraśca mṛtyurdhāvati paṃcamaḥ ||67||
āsīdeko harirdevo divyo nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ |
na brahmā na tatheśāno na ca candradivākarau ||68||
na vā dyāvāpṛthivyau ca nakṣatrāṇi divaukasaḥ |
viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ tasya sadā paśyanti sūrayaḥ ||69||
tyaktvā taṃ śrīhariṃ kasmātpūjaye pitaraṃ śivam |
yamarcayanti brahmeśaśakrādyā devatāgaṇāḥ |||1.137.70 ||
yaṃ dhyāyanti mahātmāno yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ |
yasya lakṣmyāḥ kaṭākṣārdhadṛṣṭyā hṛṣṭā divaukasaḥ ||7 1 ||
brahmendrarudravaruṇayamasomadhanādhipāḥ |
yannāmajapanādeva muktirbhavati śāśvatī ||72||
taṃ śrīpatiṃ devadevamanantaṃ puruṣottamam |
śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ nityānandasukhapradam ||73||
rakṣakaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ harim |
prāpsyāmi susukhenaiva tadviṣṇoḥ parama padam ||74||
citsthaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ prabhum |
viśvataḥ paramaṃ nityaṃ viśvaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ harim ||75||
nārāyaṇaṃ sadā jñeyaṃ viśvātmānaṃ parāyaṇam |
nārāyaṇaṃ paraṃjyotirūpaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam ||76||
yacca kiṃcijjagatsarvaṃ dṛśyate śrṛyate’pi vā |
antarbahiśca tatsarvaṃ vyāpya nārāyaṇaṃ sthitam ||77||
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ paraṃbrahma puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam |
nārāyaṇaṃ cordhvaśīlaṃ vande viśvasvarūpiṇam ||78||
evaṃ putravacaḥ śrutvā hiraṇyakaśipustadā |
krodhena mahatāviṣṭaḥ kaṣāyībhūtanetrakaḥ ||79||
bhaktaṃ svaputraṃ svotsaṃgāt paryatyajanmahītale |
parito vīkṣya daiteyānityāha krodhamūrchitaḥ ||1.137.80 ||
bhīṣaṇaiḥ śastrasaṃghātaiḥ prahlādaṃ tvapathasthitam |
mamājñayā ghātayantu śatrupūjanatatparam ||8 1 ||
vadhyatāmāśvayaṃ vadhyo hitvā svān suhṛdo’dhamaḥ |
pitṛvyahanturyaḥ pādau viṣṇordāsavadarcati ||82||
aṃgaṃ rugṇaṃ cācikitsāviṣayaṃ chedyameva tat |
paro’pi hitanivahaḥ sevyastiktauṣadhādivat ||83||
rakṣitā harireveti cocyate tena vai balāt|
adyaiva saphalaṃ janma paśyeya harirakṣaṇama ||84||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipoḥ prahlāde putre vidyādhīte bhagavadvidyābhivyaṃjanāddveṣaprayukta mṛtyvājñādikathananāmā saptatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 137 ||

<1.138>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato lakṣmi mama bhaktaṃ nairṛtāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ |
tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrāḥ karālāsyāstāmraśmaśrukumūrdhajāḥ || 1 ||
kurvanto bhairavānnādāna chindhi bhindhītivādinaḥ |
parivārya ca taṃ jaghnuḥ śūlatomaraśaktibhiḥ || 1 ||
prahlādasya vapustatra hareḥ saṃsmaraṇācchubhe |
vajrabhūtamabhūttatra hyāsan ghātāstu niṣphalāḥ || 3 ||
saṃprāpyājñaspṛśya taddehaṃ mahāsrāṇi tu rakṣasām |
bhagnāni ca kṣitau petuḥ padmaśuṣkadalādivat || 4 ||
svalpamapyasya tadgātraṃ bhettuṃ daityāḥ kṣamā nahi |
vismitāvāṅmukhāstasthurdaityarājāntike bhaṭāḥ || 5 ||
pare brahmaṇyanirdeśye bhagavatyakhilātmani |
yuktātmani mahābhakte kasyāstraṃ saphalaṃ bhavet || 6 ||
prayāse niṣphale jāte dṛṣṭvā putraṃ tamavraṇam |
vismayaṃ paramaṃ prāpto hiraṇyakaśipustadā || 7 ||
mahāduḥkhairhṛdi cāndho mūrchita iva roṣataḥ |
cakāra tadvadhopāyānabhicārāvapātanaiḥ || 8 ||
māyābhiḥ sannirodhaiścābhojanairgalabandhanaiḥ |
sarvatra śrīharistasya rakṣāṃ cakāra mātṛvat || 9 ||
evaṃ kṛte’pi nirvighne putre daityastu śaṃkitaḥ |
mriyeta vā na mriyeta mārayeta vā kiṃ kriyāt || 1.138.10 ||
śatrustathāpi hantavyo yāvadbuddhibalodayaḥ |
ādideśa tataḥ sarpān dandaśūkānmahāviṣān || 11 ||
vāsukitakṣakādīṃśca khādayantviti saṃbruvan |
evamādeśamāptāste nāgā viṣolbaṇāstadā || 12||
jvalitāsyā mahābhīmāstaṃ cakhadurmahābalam |
garuḍadhvajadāsaṃ taṃ vidaśya garalāyudhāḥ || 13 ||
nirviṣāśchinnadaśanā babhūvuranilāśanāḥ |
viṣṇupreritagaruḍacchinnamarmādigātrakāḥ || 14||
dudruvustatsthalāt tūrṇamapṛṣṭhadarśinaḥ punaḥ |
vamanto rudhiraṃ bhagnā mṛtāśca kiṃcanābhavat || 15||
mahāsarpānapi putre niṣphalām̐śca vilokya saḥ |
ādideśa mahākruddho diggajānanivāryakān || 16||
madoddhatā mahākruddhā dantinaḥ parivārya tam |
jaghnurdantaiḥ pṛthutamaistathāpi vajradehavān || 17||
mama kṛpāvaśo romṇi manāgapi na vai kṣataḥ |
pratyuta hastināṃ dantā mūlāt chinnā adho’patan || 18||
dantairvinā kṛtā nāgāḥ pradudruvaḥ suduḥkhināḥ |
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ tu camatkāraṃ virarāma tathāpi na || 19||
aho māyā hareḥ subhru pātayatyadhamādhamam |
mahānāgairathācchinnaṃ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā sa roṣataḥ || 1.138.20||
prajvālite mahāvahnau cikṣepa sutamātmanaḥ |
hāhākāro mahānāsīd grāme kheṭe ca rāṣṭrake ||21 ||
agnirdevo’pi bhaktantaṃ jalaśāyiharipriyam |
matvā naiva dadāhāste śānto vahniḥ śaśīva saḥ ||22||
mūḍhastathāpi no vetti rakṣakaścāsya vartate |
paścād viṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ dattavān pānabhojane |||23||
arcane vastrasaṃgrāhe prayuktamapi nāspṛśat |
viṣamapyamṛtaṃ jātaṃ nārāyaṇaprabhāvataḥ ||24||
athāpi cākṣataṃ putraṃ yathāpūrvaṃ prapaśya saḥ |
khaniṃ mahattarāṃ bhūmau khanayāmāsa tatra tam ||22||
prakṣipya ca mahāgrāvṇairmahīmāpūrayat samām |
nārāyaṇena prahlādo rājasaudhe sukarṣitaḥ ||26||
yatrāsuro mahāsiṃhāsane vairājate’tra tam |
jīvantaṃ devasadṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvāgataṃ bhayānvitaḥ ||27||
mamāyaṃ mārakaścāsti niścikāyāha daityarāṭ |
unnītvā rākṣasā enaṃ kṣipantu jaladhau drutam |||28||
kṛtaṃ tathaiva taiḥ sarvaistebhyaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhāgataḥ |
dṛṣṭvaivaṃ taṃ himādrau tu mahāgniṃ tato’kṣipan ||29||
naranārāyaṇastaṃ cārakṣayad himavāraṇāt |
aprāpayat tu daityasya saudhaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sa rākṣasaiḥ ||1.138.30 ||
mṛterupāyāḥ santyeva paraṃ nātra phalanti te |
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ mṛtyurnāstyasya me yathā ||3 1||
mayā varo mama kṛte prāptaḥ sa phalito’tra kim |
pitā putraḥ samau ślāghyau paraṃ vaiṣṇavatārtidā ||32|||
bhāvi datsyāt tena bhāvyaṃ mama svit mṛtyurastyayam |
tathāpi nirṇayaṃ kurve bhaktau kāṣṭhāsya kiṃbalā ||33||
vicāryetthaṃ sutaṃ prāha tvayā coktaṃ mayāgrataḥ |
vyāpitvātsarvabhūtānāṃ viṣṇurityabhidhā yataḥ ||34||
tasya sarvatra cāstitve pratyakṣaṃ darśayasva me |
yaśca sarvagato devaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ ||35||
tasyaiśvaryaśaktitejojñānavīryabalāni ca |
rūpasmṛddhivibhūtisadgaṇacāritryakāṇi ca |||36||
dṛṣṭvā samyak tato manye tava viṣṇuṃ surādhipam |
matto yadi sa jyeṣṭho’sti jitvā māṃ balavīryataḥ |||37||
īśvaratvaṃ labhatvatra nānyayā tu kadācana |
mama pratibalo nāsti loke deveṣu kaścana |||38 ||
rudrasya varadānena hyavadhyo durjayo’smyaham |
itipiturvacaḥ śrutvā prahlādaḥ prahasam̐stadā |||39 ||
hareḥ prabhāvaṃ daityasya kathayāmāsa sarvathā |
yo vai nārāyaṇaḥ śrīśaḥ paramātmā parātparaḥ ||1.138.40||
nṛṣu nāreṣu ayanānnārāyaṇaḥ sa ucyate |
vasanātsarvabhūteṣu vāsudevaḥ sa eva saḥ ||41||
sarvasya jagataḥ poṣṭā viṣṇurityapi veśanāt |
na cānena vinā kiṃcijjagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ||42||
sarvacidacitormadhye rūpamasyaiva vartate |
tripādvyāptiḥ pare dhāmni pādavyāptistu māyikī ||42 ||
so’yaṃ cakragadāpāṇirbhaktidṛśyo’sti sarvathā |
roṣamatsaramānādidurguṇairnahi dṛśyate ||44||
devatiryaṅmanuṣyeṣu sthāvareṣu ca jantuṣu |
vyāpya tiṣṭhati sarveṣu kṣudreṣu ca mahatsu ca ||45||
yāvadevaṃ kathayati prahlāde tāvadeva tu |
hiraṇyakaśiporvāmanetroṣṭhāṃsādayo’sphuran ||46||
kāko ruroda nṛpaterdhvajadaṇḍe muhurmuhuḥ |
dhvajabhaṃgo’bhavattāvadapatat skhalanāt svayam ||47||
cakampe hṛdyaṃ tasya jānato’śakunāni yat |
dhūmraketuḥ sakalgiśca vyomamārge hyadṛśyata ||48 ||
kṛṣṇājaśakaṭī dṛṣṭā yāmyāṃ diśaṃ prayāti yā |
raktaikavastrā svapatnīrdṛṣṭā svaśleṣitā kṣaṇam ||49||
dṛṣṭaṃ svamastakaṃ dehāt pṛthak svahastagaṃ kṣaṇam |
divā śukrastadā dṛṣṭaḥ svarge diśaḥ sadhūlikāḥ |||1.138.5 0 ||
dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭvaiva mṛtyurme bhavitaitadvirodhataḥ |
jñātavānatha taṃ kiṃcinmlānaśriyamadhomukham ||5 1 ||
śaṇḍāmarkau śukraputrau sāntvanāyeti hocatuḥ |
mā khedaṃ kuru rājendra jagajjetā tvameva hi ||5 2||
āvāṃ taṃ śikṣayiṣyāvo yathā syāt kuladharmagaḥ |
baddhvā varuṇapāśaistaṃ rakṣiṣyāvo nije gṛhe ||53 ||
vayasaḥ pakvabhāve tu buddhiḥ sujñā bhaviṣyati |
iti saṃgṛhya tadvācaṃ śokama ca parityaja vai ||54||
arpayāmāsa putraṃ tau rājadharmādyadhītaye |
gṛhadharmopadeśāya dharmārthakāmalabdhaye ||55||
guruputrāvapi yogyānuktāndharmān yathāyatham |
śikṣayāmāsatustān sa nopājagrāha cātmani ||56 ||
yayā dvandvāni jāyante na sā vidyā tu muktaye |
matvaivaṃ riktasamaye bālānāhvaya sadṛśān ||57||
upādideśa mokṣākhyān dharmānāsuratātigān |
svacchātmānaśca te bālā sumiṣṭāniva mokṣadāna ||58||
ātmānandapradān svacchān dharmān jagṛhurādarāt |
tānāha bhoḥ svacchabālā viṣṇuḥ sarvatra tiṣṭhati |||59||
svacchātmasu ca bāleṣu viśeṣeṇa ca tiṣṭhati |
bālairabhyarhitaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktyārpayati keśavaḥ ||1.138.60||
abhyarthiteṣu sarveṣu mokṣo’styabhyarthitāgryagaḥ |
sa evābhyarthanīyo’trādhruvamānuṣajanmanā ||61||
ātmāyaṃ bahuvāraṃ vai surāsurādiyoniṣu |
jāto jātaḥ samāyāti bhogavilāsavartmanā ||62|||
mokṣapathena nāyāti mokṣaḥ sarvatra durlabhaḥ |
sarvatrāptaṃ sukhamaindriyakaṃ svabhāvasāri tat ||63||
tatra prayāse svāyurvai vṛthaiva vigataṃ bhavet |
śrīharipādapādmaṃ tu kuśalakṣemakāraṇam ||64||
yāvaddeho na naśyeta svaṃ kṣemaṃ sādhayedbudhaḥ |
puṃsaścāyurabjavarṣaṃ koṭayabdaṃ lakṣavatsaram ||65||
sahasrābdaṃ śatābdaṃ vā viṃśatyabdamathāpi vā |
tatrārdhaṃ nidrayā nītaṃ daśāṃśaṃ bālakhelane ||66||
daśāṃśaṃ vidyayā nītaṃ daśāṃśaṃ vṛddhatāhṛtam |
daśāṃśaścāvaśiṣyeta viṣaye vā dhanārjane ||67||
tasya vyayo bhaveccedbho kadātmārthaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
mokṣārthaṃ na kṛtaṃ kiñcittadā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ nahi ||68||
mokṣārthaṃ cetkṛtaṃ kiṃcittadā sarva kṛtaṃ bhavet |
vicāryaivaṃ sadā bālāḥ kartavyaṃ mokṣasādhanam ||69||
sādhanīyaḥ svayaṃ svāmī hāre sarvāntarasthitaḥ |
strīsnehaḥ putrakṛtsnehaḥ suhṛtsnehaḥ kuṭumbinām ||1.138.70||
bhrātṛsvasṛduhitṝṇāṃ sneho nigaḍabandhanam |
aupasthyajaihvyaviṣayān bahumatvātra sajjate ||71||
duḥkhe kuṭumbapuṣṭau ca kliṣṭe ca viṣayārjane |
tāpatrayeṇārdito’pi yatnaṃ naiva jahāti vai ||72||
dravyacitto dravyahartāśāntakāmo vinaśyati |
jñātāpi naiva kaivalyaṃ vindate viśati mṛtim ||73||
kāmanānigaḍaprāptaḥ krīḍāmṛgo na mucyate |
tasmād bālā mṛṣā tyaktvā hariṃ bhajata bhāvataḥ ||74||
drāgeva hṛṣyati devo dadātyānandamātmajam |
sthūlasūkṣmaprabhūteṣvindriyaprāṇāntareṣu ca ||79||
vikṛtāvikṛtāvasthamāyāyāmapi mādhavaḥ |
eka eva hi cānviṣṭo vyatirikto’pi caiva saḥ || 76||
dṛśyātmā ca pradraṣṭātmā vyāpyavyāpaka eva saḥ |
ānandapūrṇacaraṇabāhūdaramukhādikaḥ ||77||
surāsurādisarvātmā hṛdi tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ |
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ hitaṃ kāryamiti vakti hṛdi prabhuḥ ||78||
mṛṣā mithyā hataṃ tyājyamiti vakti sa eva saḥ |
asatyarthe neti vakti satyerthe vakti o hi saḥ ||79||
āsuraṃ bhāvamutsṛjya yena tuṣyati mādhavaḥ |
tena sauhṛdabhāvena vartadhvaṃ bhajatācyutam ||1.138.80 ||
dharmādayo harireva yamāśca niyamā hariḥ |
sādhanāni harireva vidyāḥ sarvāḥ kalā hariḥ ||8 1 ||
yāvatkṛtyaphalaṃ viṣṇau sarvātmārpaṇamucyate |
harau harerdāsadāsībhakteṣu vimalā matiḥ |||82||
teṣāṃ pādarajaḥsnānaṃ sāraṃ mokṣapradaṃ mahat |
mahyaṃ nāradadevena garbhe’dhyāpitameva yat ||83||
haristatsādhavaḥ sevyāstadanyajjanmadaṃ yataḥ |
māyādamabhimānaṃ ve hareḥ santastu muktidāḥ ||84||
śrutvaitaddaityaputrāstaṃ papracchurnāradaḥ kadā |
ālambya samaye garbhe’karod bodhamasaṃbhavam ||85||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne hiraṇyakaśipukāritaprahlādamāraṇopāyanaiṣphalyagurukṛtopadeśaprahādakṛtadaityabālakopadeśanirūpaṇanāmnāṣṭatriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 38||

<1.139>
śrī nārāyaṇa uvāca
prahlādaḥ prāha tāndaityārbhakān jñānānurāgiṇaḥ |
mandarādrau me pitari tapati dhūmra utthite || 1 ||
valmīkavaṃśakāṣṭhādicchanne daityā nirāśakāḥ |
mṛtau daityapramūrdhanya iti matvā ca duḥkhitāḥ || 2 ||
tadā tānnirbalān jñātvā cakruryuddhamatiṃ surāḥ |
hatā daityāḥ surasainyairdudruvuḥ sarvatodiśam || 3 ||
strīputraduhitṛsvasṛpitṛkuṭumbajīvinaḥ |
dhanadhānyaparicchadān parityajya ca dudruvuḥ || 4 ||
devāḥ sarvabalopetāḥ vyalumpan daityasaṃgrahān |
rājaprāsādamācchidya kalyāṇīṃ mama mātaram || 5 ||
indro nītvā yadā yāti svargaṃ tāvacca nāradaḥ |
mārge eva militastaṃ prāha kva nayasi drutam || 6 ||
satīṃ netumayogyastvaṃ muñcaināṃ vai nirāgasam |
indraḥ prāha tadāsyāstu garbhe daityasya bālakaḥ || 7 ||
aprasahyo’sti tasmādvai yāvatprasava rakṣaya |
kṛtārthena parityājyā nānyanme’sti prayojanam || 8 ||
nāradaḥ prāha cendrāya garbho mahān sa vaiṣṇavaḥ |
devaviṣṇugavāṃ bhakto viprasāttvatasevakaḥ || 9 ||
yadbhayaṃ te’sti tannaiva śaṃkanīyaṃ parityaja |
nāradoktaṃ tadā hīndraḥ svīkṛtyaināṃ vihāya ca || 1.139.10 ||
namaskṛtya gataḥ svargaṃ nārado’pi mahānprabhuḥ |
mātaraṃ me saha nītvā jagāma svāśramaṃ prati || 11 ||
āśvāsanena sambodhya yāvattapasaste patiḥ |
āgacchet tāvadatraiva sukhaṃ vatse samuṣyatām || 1 2||
ityāśrayaṃ śubhaṃ labdhvā satyavātsīcca nirbhayā |
nityaṃ paramayā bhaktyā ṛṣiṃ paryacaranmudā || 13||
ṛṣiḥ sakaruṇastasyai prādāt jñānaṃ tu mokṣadam |
tatsarvaṃ tu mayā garbhagatenāsāditaṃ sthiram || 14||
tanmāturme layaṃ yātaṃ mamaiva dṛḍhatāṃ gatam |
dṛḍhasaṃskārakaṃ sarvaṃ smarāmi ca yathoditam || 15||
jñānaṃ rocayamānānāṃ bālānāṃ bhavatāṃ mudā |
śreyaskaraṃ paraṃ no’sti śraddhāgrāhyaṃ hi tadyataḥ || 16||
vacmi kiñcicca tajjñānaṃ sāramākṛṣya sarvataḥ |
ādarśasvacchahṛdaye drāglagnaṃ mokṣadaṃ bhavet || 17||
strībālānāṃ kṛte yena lābhaḥ sāralyato bhavet |
tadyathāvanmano datvā śrotavyaṃ sāramātmanaḥ || 18||
pūrvakarmānusāreṇa tejasvyātmātisūkṣmakaḥ |
piturdhātau viśatyeva vīrya garbhe niṣicyate || 1 9||
vīryaṃ tadbhautikaṃ vastu jīvaḥ saccitsukhātmakaḥ |
aṇuḥ prakāśo nityaśca jñātā jñānaghanātmakaḥ |||1.139.20 ||
jīvātmanānvitaṃ vīryaṃ rajoyuktaṃ bhavatyatha |
rajovīryātmabhiḥ sarvā sūṣṭirbhavati cetanā ||2 1 ||
vyātmako’yaṃ bhaved dehaḥ puruṣaḥ pramadāthavā |
napuṃsako vā jāyeta ṣaṭkośātmātridhāpi vai ||22||
pitṛtaḥ snāyvasthimajjā māṃsaromāsrajaḥ striyāḥ |
ṣaṭkośāste śarīrasthāḥ ṣaṭsvātmā saṃpratiṣṭhati ||23||
sthūle bālaśarīre vai pṛthvyaptejo’nilāmbaram |
bhūtapaṃcakamastyeva tatra viṣayapaṃcakam ||24||
sthūlaṃ gandharasarūpasparśaśabdātmakaṃ tathā |
ghrāṇajihvānayanatvakśrotragrāhyaṃ kramāddhi tat ||25||
vāgdhastapādapāyūpasthendriyāṇi parāṇi ca |
vāṇyādānaviharaṇamalamūtravisarjanam |
kāryaṃ kramāddhi bodhavyaṃ manaścittamahaṃmatiḥ ||26||
antaḥkaraṇamityuktaṃ tatparaṃ prakṛtirmatā |
sattvarajastamoyuktā samāvasthā hi kāraṇam |
viṣamāvasthikā saiva saṃsārastattvavigrahaḥ ||27||
māyāyāstu vikārā ye nāśavantastu te matāḥ |
ātmāstyamāyikaḥ śuddho nāśo nāsya kadācana ||28||
dehastu jāyate paścād vardhate bahubhojanaiḥ |
vipariṇamate caiva kṣīyate naśyate mṛṣā ||29||
ātmā ca tatra sarvatra vartate’sti hyataḥ sa san |
dehādi jaḍamityeva cātmā cetana eva hi ||1.139.30||
dehādi duḥkharūpaṃ vai hyātmānandamayaḥ sadā |
saccidānanda ityukto na daityo na ca dānavaḥ ||3 1||
na suro nāsuraścātmā na nārī na pumān hi saḥ |
napuṃsako na rāgī na na dveṣī śuddha eva saḥ ||32||
ajñastu bādhahīno vai kvacitsāttvikabhāvanaḥ |
kvacittu rājasobhāvaḥ kvacittāmasabhāvanaḥ ||3 3||
sattvaṃ sukhakaraṃ manye rajo rāgakaraṃ bhavet |
tamaḥ pīḍākaraṃ proktaṃ tasmāt sattvaguṇaṃ bhajet ||34||
sattvamapyātmano lābhakaraṃ hitadamiṣyate |
yadyahitaṃ mokṣadaṃ na tadā tadapi tyajyate |||35|||
svātmanyavasthite nārāyaṇe yā sāttvikī matiḥ |
sā vai sadā bhavellābhakarī mokṣapradāpi ca ||36|||
jāgratsvapnaṃ suṣuptiśca dehādau nātmani kvacit |
sthaulyaṃ saukṣmyaṃ kāraṇatvaṃ dehādau nātmani kvacit||||37||
pāpaṃ puṇyaṃ cobhayaṃ ca janmapuṣṭirmṛtistathā |
devadaityamānavatvaṃ dehādau nātmani kvacit ||38||
na gṛhaṃ gṛhamityuktaṃ śarīraṃ gṛhamucyate |
kṣaṇabhaṃgurakaṃ tacca tena mokṣaṃ prasādhayet ||39||
ātmā hyasaṃgaḥ sarvatra janasaṃgī bhavedyadi |
śuddhe saṃgaḥ kulajāterabhimānakaro bhavet ||1.139.40 ||
tena dveṣo bhavet tattadviparīte ṛtārthake |
ahaṃ daitya ityahaṃkāreṇa cātmā yadi vṛtaḥ ||41||
tadā dveṣo bhaveddeve nārāyaṇe tu sarvathā |
patanaṃ muktimārgācca dveṣānnārāyaṇe tathā ||42||
tasmād bālā vayaṃ śuddhā yāvanna buddhibhedakāḥ |
śabdāḥ pakṣānugā labdhāstāvanmokṣaṃ prasādhayet ||43||
caturviśatitattveṣu paṃcaviṃśaṃ tu mārgayet |
svayaṃ svaṃ mārgayitvaiva ṣaḍviṃśe taṃ samarpayet ||44||
tāvatparyantamevāyaṃ saṃsāro vāsanātmakaḥ |
ātmatadātmanoryāvat saṃviveko’tra no kṛtaḥ ||45||
śāntaṃ ghoraṃ ca mūḍhaṃ ca tattvajālaṃ vibudhya ca |
tatparaṃ svaṃ parijñāya parātparaṃ samāśrayet ||46||
na mātā na pitā putro bhaginī bāndhavāstathā |
paraloke sahāyāḥ syuḥ hariḥ sāhāyyado bhavet ||47||
sa ca sarvatra bhūteṣu vartamāno’pi dehinā |
vinā sādhanasampattyā nopalabhyata eva saḥ ||48||
prabhuprāpteḥ sādhanāni guroḥ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā |
premabhaktiḥ sadā sevā sarvalabdhārpaṇaṃ tathā ||49||
sādhusādhvīprasaṃgaśca viṣṇorārādhanaṃ param |
tatkathāśravaṇaṃ tasya kīrtanaṃ guṇavarṇanam ||1.139.50 ||
tanmūrterdhyānamatyarthaṃ darśanaṃ smaraṇādikam |
sarvabhūteṣu tadbhānaṃ bhaktānāṃ tatsamārhaṇam ||51||
sarvaṃ samarpyate tatra ratiḥ sarvāpi tatra ca |
kriyāḥ sarvāśca tanmayyastato’nyannāvabudhyate ||52||
dhyāne vā dhāraṇāyāṃ vā samādhau cāpi tanmayaḥ |
jāgrati vā tathā svapne suṣuptāvapi tanmayaḥ ||53|||
pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā sarvāvasthāsu tanmayaḥ |
hasanaṃ rodanaṃ gānaṃ nartanaṃ krandanaṃ svapiḥ ||54||
chikkanaṃ vartanaṃ pānaṃ bhojanaṃ ramaṇaṃ gatiḥ |
sadanaṃ mārgaṇaṃ yadvā darśanaṃ sparśanaṃ śrutiḥ ||55||
kṣuvanaṃ cintanaṃ nirṇāyanamadhyāsanaṃ tathā |
mananaṃ tanmayaṃ harṣotpulakāśrusagadgadam |||56||
bhavettadā hariścātra bhaktiyogena dṛśyate |
tasya kathāśravaṃ kṛtvā mananaṃ kāryameva yat|||57||
tasya mūrteścintanena kalmaṣaṃ kṣālitaṃ bhavet |
nirmalātmā tadvā svasminnanyatrāpi ca sarvathā ||58||
nārāyaṇaṃ prapaśyet saṃbhajadhvaṃ vai tatocyutam |
prājñenāpyaṃ dhruvaṃ tattvaṃ tyājyamadhruvameva yat ||59||
dhruveṇa cātmanā prāptavyo dhruvo harireva vai |
sa vai sarvatra saṃpoṣṭā sukhado mokṣadastathā ||1.139.60||
sukhaṃ sātiśayaṃ tyājyaṃ kṣayiṣṇu tyājyameva ca |
aviśuddhaṃ sadā tyājyaṃ grāhyaṃ taddoṣavarjitam ||61||
tattu nārāyaṇādeva nānyasmānmilati kvacit |
tasmānnārāyaṇo dhyeyaḥ svātmanyārādhya eva saḥ |||62||
dṛṣṭānuśravadoṣāptaṃ sarvaṃ māyāmayaṃ jagat |
tacchūnyaṃ sukhasaṃsthānaṃ nārāyaṇo bhavatyataḥ ||63||
tadbhaktyā śāśvatānandaḥ prāptavyo’smābhirarbhakāḥ |
aśāśvataṃ sukhaṃ yatra putradāragṛhādiṣu ||64||
dhane rājye tathāmātye gajāśveṣu janādiṣu |
prāsāde vā suhṛdvarge tucche śāśvatikeṣu yat ||65||
kṣaṇa dṛśyeta subhagaṃ saha dehena naśvaram |
anarthadaṃ kṣaṇādarthābhāsaṃ duḥkhātikṛttathā ||66||
ko vāstyatrātmanaḥ svārthaḥ śāśvatastannirūpyatām |
dehe daihikasaṃghāte vastunyapi ca yatpriyam ||67||
tattu virṣṇornivāsādyat hariḥ sarvapriyātmakaḥ |
yatra kvāpi gato jīvo daityo yakṣo’thavāsuraḥ ||68||
suro vā mānavo vāpi gandharvo vāpi rākṣasaḥ |
bhajannārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ svastimān syānna tadṛte ||69||
mukundaprīṇane naiva vratadānatapaḥkriyāḥ |
bahujñatāvayorūpejyāśaucātikulārthitāḥ ||1.139.70||
kāraṇaṃ nirmalā bhaktirbhāvanārdrātmani prabhā |
evaṃvidhāṃ parāṃ bhaktiṃ harau kurvantu bālakāḥ ||71||
mayā sadā kṛtā bhaktyā yayā paśyāmi keśavam |
ṛṣayaḥ pitaro devā munayo mānavāstathā ||72||
dānavā rākṣasā daityā yakṣāḥ kiṃpuruṣāśca ye |
kinnarāścaiva gāndharvāścāraṇāḥ siddhapūruṣāḥ ||73||
vidyādharāḥ piśācā vā bhūtapretāśca ye’pare |
sādhyā viśvāśca kūṣmāṇḍā vaināyakāśca bhairavāḥ ||74||
vetālāśca gaṇāścaiva yāmyā nāgāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ |
khagā mṛgā jalavāsā bhūvāsāḥ pavanāśrayāḥ ||75||
antarīkṣagatā ye ca grahāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamāḥ |
bālā vṛddhāḥ striyaḥ śūdrāḥ saṃkarāḥ pāpayonayaḥ ||76||
hitvā pāpaṃ gatā muktiṃ śrīmannārāyaṇāśrayāt |
tasmādasmābhirapyatra durlabhe narajanmani ||77||
bhajanīyo hariḥ sākṣāt tadanyattu viḍambanam |
ityādeśo mayā garbhagatenāptastu nāradāt ||78||
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa śrīpate kamalāpate |
pārvatīśeśa mukteśa prabheśeśa ca te namaḥ ||79||
evaṃ bhajam̐śca varte’haṃ yūyaṃ kuruta tattathā |
śrutvaivaṃ bālakāḥ sarve jagṛhustadyathātatham |
śālāyāṃ te jagṛhurna guruśikṣitamaṇvapi ||1.139.80||
tadācāryasutaḥ khinno bhayabhītaśca bhūbhṛte |
nivedayāmāsa sarvaṃ bālāstu kupathaṃgatāḥ |
śrutvā svaputrakartavyamatikrodhena kampitaḥ ||8 1||
putrasya nidhanaṃ kartuṃ pitā daityo mano dadhe |
prahlādaṃ ca samāhūya vācā paruṣayā kṣipan ||82||
pāpena cakṣuṣā paśyan tiraścīnena roṣataḥ |
prāha śāntaṃ kuloddhārayogyaṃ bhāgavataṃ sutam ||83||
re buddhyādhama me vidyābhedakānyakṛtāśraya |
manyase na svayaṃ śikṣāmanyām̐śca nayase’patham ||84||
abhīta iva lokānāṃ śāsituḥ śāsanaṃ mama |
na gaṇayasi duṣṭātman preṣayiṣye yamālayam ||85||
caturdaśānāṃ lokānāṃ rājño’nādṛtya me vacaḥ |
balaṃ kasya samāśritya stabdho bhavasi re’dhama ||86||
prahlādaḥ prāha tacchrutvā pitaste cāsti yadbalam |
balaṃ tasyāpi me cāsti yadbalāt balavajjagat ||87||
vrahmarudrādayaḥ sarve yatsahaujobalādibhiḥ |
rājādhirājā rājante tadbalaṃ cāvayoḥ sadā ||88||
dveṣabhāvaṃ parityajya pitastvaṃ dhatsva mānase |
prahvībhāvena taddhyānaṃ manute sa samarhaṇam ||89||
tāvatāpyuddharedātmā nānyathā tu kadācana |
digjetāro’pi mohasya krodhasya kṣudraveginaḥ ||1.139.90||
āpannā vaśameveti mā yāhi tadvaśaṃ pitaḥ |
naivamātmā pātitavyastrilokeśena bhūbhṛtā ||91||
bhaktyā tvārohayitavyo harerdhāma paraṃ padam |
kathaṃ pāpaṃ cārjayase sarvanāśakaraṃ pitaḥ ||92||
śrutvaitatsvasutoktaṃ sa hiraṇyakaśipustadā |
mumūrṣurasahamāno’viṣahyavedanānalam ||93||
prāha putraṃ tava mṛtyurvyaktaṃ cātra samāgataḥ |
asthāne katthase duṣṭa kvāsti te parameśvaraḥ ||94||
nānyo madanya īśo’sti cedasti tvāṃ sa rakṣayet |
sarvatrāsti yadi cāsau yadi sarvagato bhavet ||95||
stambhe darśaya taṃ viṣṇumanyathā vadhamarhasi |
ityuktvā khaḍgamādāya sahasā ditijeśvaraḥ ||96||
pracakrame sutaṃ hantuṃ tāvat stambho dvidhābhavat |
jāto bhayaṃkaraḥ śabdaḥ staṃbhādvyāpto digambaram ||97||
saṃvartanāśasaṃrāvaiḥ khamiva sphuṭitāntaram |
tena śabdena mahatā daityaśrotravighātinā ||98||
sarve nipātitā bhūmau daityāstu menire tadā |
jagattrayaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ vā pralayaścāgato’sti naḥ ||99||
tāvat staṃbhe mahātejā niṣkrānto vai mahāgiriḥ |
nṛsiṃhavapurāsthāya cakāra ghoraniḥsvanān || 1.139.100 ||
anekakoṭisūryāgnitejasā prajvalan ruṣā |
mukhe pañcānanaprakhyaḥ śarīre mānuṣākṛtiḥ || 10 1||
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaḥ sphurajjihvāgradairghyakaḥ |
jvālāvalitakeśāntastaptālātekṣaṇo vibhuḥ || 10 2||
divyamālāmbaradharo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
tasthau nṛkesarī tatra saṃhartuṃ daityadānavān || 1 03||
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭapūrvarūpaṃ vihvalāṃgo mahāsuraḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaḥ papātānye ca mūrchitāḥ || 1 04||
prahlādo’tha tadā dṛṣṭvā nārasiṃhopamaṃ harim |
jayaśabdena deveśaṃ namaścakre janārdanam || 1 05||
nārasiṃhe tadā bhakto bhuvanāni dadarśa ha |
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi yathāvaddarśitaṃ tu yat || 106 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne garbhasthaprahlādasya nāradopadeśagrahaṇasamayahiraṇyakaśipuvivādabālopadeśakhaḍgaghātanṛsiṃhaprādurbhāvanirūpaṇanāmā ekonacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 139||

<1.140>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
prahlādo’nye ca daiteyā niścikyurnaiva vastu yat |
kutaḥ kasmādayaṃ śabdo lokasphoṭanakṛnmahān || 1 ||
dṛśyate śabdamūlaṃ na nākṛtirnābhibhāvakam |
niśamyāpūrvanirhrādaṃ surabhinnā vitatrasuḥ || 2 ||
satyaṃ prakurvan prahlādābhihitaṃ brahmaṇoditam |
varaṃ cāyaṃ hariḥ kṛṣṇo nṛhariḥ samajāyata || 3 ||
mūrterdrāksumahattejño’vyāpnodābrahmalokagam |
śanaiḥ śanaiśca tattejo’ntaḥsabhāyāṃ vyalīyata || 4 ||
tāvatstaṃbhāntare sattvaṃ mahākrūraṃ vyaloki tat |
nāyaṃ mṛgo na manuṣaḥ kimetannṛmṛgendravat || 5 ||
yāvaddaityāśca daityeśo vyaktaṃ paśyati nṛharim |
bhayānakaṃ lalajjihvaṃ sphāralohitalocanam || 6 ||
sūryavaccākacakyāsyaṃ harīvajjṛmbhitānanam |
mahātejaḥsphuratsvarṇavidyudvallībhakesaram || 7 ||
karāladaṃṣṭraṃ bhrūkuṭīcaṇḍakopānalānvitam |
stabdhordhvakarṇaṃ vyāttānananāsaṃ ca kalāsaham || 8 ||
candrāṃśuvālaṃ mahākhaṅgātitīkṣṇanakhāyudham |
tāvattadvivṛdhe sattvaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābalam || 9 ||
divyaṃ yanmandarasamaṃ prāsādastu vyalīyata |
divye nārāyaṇe siṃhe nare’pūrvakṛtākṛtau || 1.140.1 0||
dadarśa tasya gātreṣu prahlādo bhuvanāni vai |
lokān samudrān sadvīpān suragandharvamānuṣān || 11 ||
aṇḍajāni sahastāni saṭāgre sa dadarśa vai |
dadarśa netrayostasya sūryacandrādikān gṛhān || 12||
karṇayoraśvinau devau diśaśca vidiśastathā |
lalāṭe brahmarudrau ca nabho vāyuṃ ca tannasi || 13||
indrāgnī tasya vaktrānte jihvāyāṃ ca sarasvatīm |
daṃṣṭrāsu siṃhaśārdūlaśarabhām̐śca mahoragān ||14||
kaṇṭhe dadarśa mervadriṃ skandhe himācalādikān |
devatiryaṅmanuṣyām̐śca bāhuṣvapi parātmanaḥ || 15||
nābhau cāsyāntarīkṣaṃ ca pādayoḥ pṛthivīṃ tathā |
romasvasyauṣadhīn sarvānpādapānnakhapaṃktiṣu || 16||
niḥśvāse’sya caturvedān sāṃgopāgāndadarśa saḥ |
ādityām̐śca vasūn rudrān viśvedevānmarudraṇān || 17||
apsarasaśca gandharvān vidyādhroragarākṣasān |
evamāpālalokānsopaskaraprajānvitān || 18||
dadarśāṃgeṣu prahlādastataḥ saumyaṃ dadarśa tam |
śrīvatsakaustubhoraskaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 19||
śaṃkhacakragadākhaḍgaśārṅgādihetibhiryutam |
sarvopaniṣadāmarthaṃ dṛṣṭvā nanāma daṃḍavat ||1.140.20 ||
harṣāśrujalasiktāṃgo dhyāyanpārśve hyupasthitaḥ |
tāvaddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ krodhānmṛtyuvaśe sthitaḥ |||2 1||
kiṃsvidayaṃ nu hantā me hanmi taṃ purato jaye |
yoddhuṃ khaḍgaṃ samudyamya nṛsiṃhaṃ tamathādravat ||22||
devāśca munayaḥ sarve prāṇino brahmasṛṣṭijāḥ |
ājagmuḥ śrīharestasya yuddhasya darśanāya ca |||23||
atha daityagaṇāḥ sarve sajjaśastrā mahābalāḥ |
jaghnurhariṃ mahāvegāḥ peturvahnau pataṃgavat ||24||
nṛhariṇā saṭodbhūtavahninā dānavā bhṛśam |
nirbhasmitāḥ kṣaṇātsarve sahasrāṇyāyudhāni ca ||25||
anye ca rākṣasā daityā dānavā hyasurāstathā |
ye cāpatan raṇaṃ kartuṃ tān dvedhāpātayaddhariḥ |||26||
kām̐ścid daṃṣṭrābhirugrābhiḥ kām̐ścinnakhaiḥ sutīkṣṇakaiḥ |
kām̐ścicchastrairmahāghorairnāśayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||97||
prahlādaṃ sānugaṃ hitvā bhasmite rakṣasāṃ bale |
nāśite daityasainye ca kālānalaśikhopamaḥ ||28||
hiraṇyakaśipuryāvadudyamyāsiṃ tu nṛhareḥ |
vadhāya kṛtayatno’bhūt tāvajjagrāha taṃ prabhuḥ ||29||
khaḍgamācchidya deveśo mocayāmāsa taṃ ripum |
gadāmādāya daityeśaścakāra maṇḍalāni ca ||1.140.3 0 ||
gadāpi pātitā yāvat carmakhaḍgāntaraṃ mahat |
gṛhītvābhyadravad daityastaṃ harirmaṇḍalena vai ||3 1 ||
nināya ca gṛhadvāre madhye cotplutya dharṣitam |
bahubalaṃ prakurvantaṃ kṣipantaṃ patkarādikān |||3.||
pātayāmāsa deveśastadā caikena pāṇinā |
gṛhītvā patitaṃ bhūmau muhuḥ sampadya cāsuram ||3 2||
pādaghātaiścārdhamṛtyu kṛtvotsaṃge nidhāya ca |
nakhairvidārayāmāsa tīkṣṇairvajranibhairghanaiḥ || 34||
viṣṇunindākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tathā vaiṣṇavavairajam |
nṛhareḥ sparśanādeva nirbhasmitamabhūttadā ||35||
vakṣo daityeśvarasyāsau vidadārāsthimaṇḍalam |
tadgātraṃ śatadhā bhittvā nakhaistīkṣṇairmahāhariḥ ||36||
ākṛṣyāntrāṇi dīrghāṇi gale saṃsaktavān prabhuḥ |
sa nirmalātmā daityendraḥ paśyan sākṣānmukhaṃ hareḥ || 37||
harihastāgatamṛtyuḥ kṛtārtho vijahāvasūn |
nākāśe na kṣitau mṛtyurnāntarbahirna sṛṣṭijaiḥ ||38||
na śuṣkairnārdratattvaiśca satyaṃ kartuṃ hariḥ svayam |
asṛṣṭeḥ rūpamāsthāya dhāmākāśaṃ vidhāya ca |||39||
nidhāyāṅke nakhaiḥ sāyaṃ madhye dvāri jaghāna tam |
harirjānāti yatkartuṃ nānyo jānāti tattathā ||1.140.40 ||
atha daityendraraktena kiṃśukībhūtanṛharim |
hantumudāyudhā daityāḥ samantāt śastrapāṇayaḥ ||41 ||
abhyadhāvam̐stadā tām̐ścāhan pārṣṇinakhadormukhaiḥ |
cakre ca garjanāṃ brahmāṇḍāvṛtīn pravibhidya yā ||42|||
aṭṭahāsānvitā vyāptā brahmaloke ca dhāmasu |
jaladāścāpatan vyomno grahāśca kampitāḥ sthalāt ||43||
cukṣubhurvārinidhayo digibhāśca vicukruśuḥ |
dyaurbhramitā vimānāni stabdhāni bhūśca kampitā ||44||
utpetuḥ bhūbhṛtaḥ śailāḥ khaṃ kakubho na rejire |
daityaśūnye ca bhaktāḍhye prāsāde nṛhariṃ tadā ||45||
praharṣapūritā devyo vavṛṣuḥ kusumāni vai |
devarṣimunayo divyavimānasthāstadā harim ||46 ||
paśyanti sma ca vāditrāndundubhiprabhṛtīm̐stadā |
vādayāmāsurāpremṇāpsaraso nanṛtustathā ||47||
gandharvā gāyanaṃ cakrurjaguḥ svasti surastriyaḥ |
brahmāṇḍavāsinastatrāgatyeḍire ca nṛharim ||48||
brahmā rudrendragirīśapitṛsiddhārṣicāraṇāḥ |
prajāpatayo manavo vidyādharamahoragāḥ ||49||
yakṣāḥ kinnaravetālāḥ gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ |
kimpuruṣāḥ sādhyadevā viśvedevāśca yājñikāḥ ||1.140.50 ||
bhūdevāḥ pārṣadā nandasunandakumudādayaḥ |
īḍire taṃ narasiṃhaṃ mahābhayakaradṛśam ||5 1 ||
namo’kṣarapararūpākṣarāntaryāmiṇe ca te |
namo muktābhivandyāya namo vyūhātmane ca te ||52||
namaḥ prakṛtirūpāya pradhānapuruṣāya te |
mahākālasvarūpāya bhūmarūpāya te namaḥ ||23||
apratarkyasvarūpāyānantarūpāya te namaḥ |
abhaktānāśakartre te bhaktarakṣaṇakāriṇe ||54||
varadānānurūpāya tathaiva daityaghātine |
sarvātmane karālāya vikarālāya te namaḥ ||55||
yajñabhāgapradātre te rakṣakāya namonamaḥ |
hṛdi bodhāya devānāṃ trātre tasmai namonamaḥ |||56||
tapomārgapravṛttāya ṛṣigamyāya te namaḥ |
śrāddhatṛptipradāyātra paratradāyine namaḥ ||57||
yogagatiprasārāya siddhismṛddhigṛhāya ca |
tapobalaprakṛṣṭāya dharmātmam̐ste namonamaḥ ||58||
stutistutyāya vidyāyāḥ śubhādhipataye namaḥ |
ratnapradātre nyāyāya nītidhātre namonamaḥ ||59||
manutvasaṃrakṣakāya prajāpatitvadāyine |
naṭanāṭyagāyakānāṃ krīḍāgītyātmane namaḥ ||1.140.60 ||
vāhakatvapradātre te saparyādipradāyine |
viṣṭikāryaniyoktre te jagadīśāya te namaḥ ||61||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ rakṣakāya bahurūpadharāya te |
nārāyaṇāya kṛṣṇāya śrīharaye namo namaḥ |||62||
nityaṃ śāntasvarūpāyedānīṃ bhayaṃkarāya te |
avismṛtasvarūpāyādbhutāya haraye namaḥ ||63||
ityākāśāt tuṣṭuvuste’ntikaṃ ke’pi na cāyayuḥ |
ugramṛtyormukhe gantuṃ śrīmṛte kaḥ patet śvasan ||64||
te prasādayituṃ bhītā jvalitaṃ viśvatomukham |
mātaraṃ jagatāṃ dhātrīṃ cintayāmāsurīśvarīm ||65||
hiraṇyavarṇāṃ hariṇīṃ sarvopadravanāśinīm |
viṣṇornityānavadyāṃgīṃ dhyātvā nārāyaṇīṃ śubhām ||66||
śrīsūktaṃ saṃjapanto vai namaścakruḥ pareśvarīm |
cintyamānā tu sā devī tatraivāvirabhūttadā ||67||
caturbhujā viśālākṣī sarvabhūṣādyalaṃkṛtā |
dukūlaśāṭikāyuktā kaustubhasraksumaṃgalā ||68||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devadevasya patnīṃ māṃ jagatāṃ tataḥ |
ūcuḥ prāṃjalayo devāḥ prasannaṃ śrīhariṃ kuru ||69||
ityuktā sahasā lakṣmīḥ priyaṃ dūrātpatiṃ harim |
praṇipatya namaskṛtya prasīdeti hyuvāca tam ||1.140.70||

nṛsiṃhaṃ hṛdye dhyātvāstauṣīddhariṃ samāhitaḥ |
namo devādhidevāya sattvavilīnamūrtaye ||8 1||
brahmādayo bibhyati yadrūpāt tadrūpiṇe namaḥ

nāhaṃ bibhaimi deveśa krūrānnṛsiṃharūpaṇāt |
bibhemi kāmaroṣādestato rakṣāṃ vidhehi me ||87||

tadvai me rakṣaṇaṃ nāsti tasmānmadrakṣaṇaṃ kuru ||88||

īhāḥ putrakalatrāderdhanaiśvaryadivaspateḥ |
kadāpi naiva pūryante tābhyo me rakṣaṇaṃ kuru ||1.140.90 ||
daityendrasya mayā dṛṣṭāḥ smṛddhayastā na rakṣikāḥ |
aiśvaryāṇi mayā dṛṣṭānyetānyavanti naiva hi ||91||

bhaktānāṃ tvaṃ rakṣaṇāya bahurūpī bhavasyatha ||92||
uddhārayasi viśvātman tathoddhāraṃ ca me kuru |
rājyaṃ tu bandhanaṃ proktaṃ pāpaṃ pāpataraṃ mahat ||93 ||
yat satāṃ sevane vighnaṃ mānasattādidūṣaṇaiḥ |
dīnatve tapa āsthāya vāṃcchanti kāmanāmayān ||94||
bhogānāsādya paścāt tvāṃ vismarantīti kilbiṣam |

mā yogaṃ me dehi nātha dehi tvaccaraṇāmbuje |
tava dāsasya dāsānāṃ madhye yogaṃ pradehi me ||96||
ime divāstava rūpaṃ saumyaṃ kāṃkṣanti darśane |
tasmāt saumyaṃ sukhadaṃ vai rūpaṃ darśaya mādhava ||97||
ityarthitaḥ sa bhagavān tejastadatibhīṣaṇam |
roṣānvitaṃ tu saṃhṛtya babhūva sukhadarśanaḥ ||98||
śaratkoṭīndusaṃkāśaḥ puṇḍarīkanibhekṣaṇaḥ |
sudhāmayasaṭāpuṃjavidyutkoṭinibhaprabhaḥ ||99||
sadratnāḍhyakaṭakakeyūrormikādibhūṣitaḥ |
śaṃkhacakragṛhītābhyāmudbāhubhyāṃ virājitaḥ || 1.140.100 ||
varadābhayahastābhyāmitarābhyāṃ suśobhitaḥ |
śrīvatsakaustubhorasko vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 101 ||
kuṇḍalahāraraśanāmaṇisvarṇavirājitaḥ |
savyāṃgasthaśriyā yukto’bhavattadā nṛkesarī || 102|||
lakṣmīnṛsiṃhaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ samaharṣayaḥ |
ānandāśrujalaiḥ siktvā namaścakrurnirantaram || 103||
arpayāmāsurātmeśa divyapuṣpādipūjanam |
ratnakuṃbhaiḥ sudhāpūrṇairabhiṣicya sanātanam || 104||
vastrairābharaṇairgandhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpairmanoramaiḥ |
divyairniveditairdīpairarcayitvā janārdanam || 1 05||
tuṣṭuvurdivyasatstotrairnamaścakrurmuhurmuhuḥ |
pādayoḥ patitānsarvāndatveṣṭāśīrvacāṃsi saḥ || 106||
prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ cakre rājānamavyayam |
varārthaṃ prerayāmāsa prasanno bhagavānpunaḥ || 107||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nṛsiṃhaspaṣṭadarśanatattejovyāpanahiraṇyakaśipuvidāraṇadevādikṛtastavanaprahlādakṛtastutisaumyadarśanalakṣmīkṛtastavanādinirūpaṇanāmā catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 140||

<1.141>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
atha lakṣmi nṛsiṃhaḥ sa bhaktaparīkṣaṇāya vai |
prāha varān grahītuṃ ca prasahya nijabhaktakam || 1 ||
gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ pṛthvyāstadāsamudraṃ sukhī bhava |
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sukhī bhava || 2 ||
saptapātālarājyaṃ vā svīkuru bhaktapuṃgava |
saptasvargamayaṃ rājyaṃ kuru dhruvapadaṃ tathā || 3 ||
gṛhāṇa nūtanaṃ rājyaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ cārpaye priya |
yadyatkāmayase bhakta tattaddadāmi te sukham || 4 ||
yānāni pramadā dāsyo dāsā gajāsturaṃgamāḥ |
divyāni ca vimānāni siddhayaścāṇimādikāḥ || 5 ||
vedhaḥ padaṃ śivapadaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ virāṭpadam |
nūtanameva dāsye’haṃ gṛhāṇa yadi rocate || 6 ||
brahmāṇḍānāṃ madagre vai nāsti vai gaṇanā manāk |
asaṃkhyāni ca vartante śāsane mama tāni vai || 7 ||
lokāśca lokapālāśca tathā brahmāṇḍapālakāḥ |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānā hyasaṃkhyāḥ santi madvaśe || 8 ||
tathā tvāmapi caiśaṃ vā vairājaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca vā |
dhāmārpaye svatantraṃ vai yayecchasi gṛhāṇa bhoḥ || 9 ||
ityevaṃ bhrāmyamāṇo’pi niḥspṛhaḥ prākṛte’rthake |
vinā hareḥ padaṃ naiva yayāce sa janārdanāt || 1.141.10||
yadyadditsasi govinda tavaivāstu na me spṛhā |
vināśyarthayitā nāsmi prākṛtaṃ naṣṭameva yat || 1 1||
avināśī śāśvato’yaṃ nāśāntaṃ kathamarthaye |
tatsarvaṃ kṛtrimaṃ rājyaṃ nāstyakṛtaḥ kṛtena vai || 12 ||
akṛtaśca sadā mokṣyaḥ kṛtena karmaṇā nahi |
ātmanā śaraṇāgatyā nityo mokṣo hi labhyate || 13||
prakṛtipuruṣasyātra pradhānapuruṣasya vā |
vairājānāṃ mahāviṣṇorviṣṇorvā vedhasastathā || 14||
rudrasya lokapālānāṃ devānāṃ phaṇināṃ tathā |
lokā rājyāni vibhavāḥ sthānāni smṛddhimanti ca || 15||
prākṛtānīti sarvāṇi rajastamomayāni vā |
sāttvikānyapi gauṇāni procyante nirayā hi yat || 16||
paraṃdhāmākṣaramṛte prākṛtā nirayā hi te |
nāsti me tatra kutrāpi spṛhā haripadaṃ vinā || 17||
tasmānnātha sadā dehi dhāmni tvaccaraṇāmbujam |
tava sevāṃ sadā dehi tathā tvadbhaktasevanam || 18||
satsu ratiṃ sadā dehi vāsaṃ prayaccha dhāmani |
tvayi premāspadaṃ dehi caikāṃ niṣṭhāṃ sadā tvayi || 19||
dehi cātmakṛtānandaṃ tvayyeva śāśvataṃ param |
nānyānandaṃ samīhe’tra paratrāśāśvataṃ kṣayam || 1.141.20||
tavecchāyā yadā yatra yasya yasmācca yatkṛte |
yena yaṃ vā yo’haṃ kuryāṃ tattvayyaiva tavārthataḥ ||21 ||
bhavatsambandhakaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇārpaṇaṃ sadāstu me |
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāstṛptāḥ kadāpi na |||22||
tvayi syācchāśvatītṛptistāṃ vṛṇe dehi nātha me |
tvayyārāmaṃ sadā yaccha tvadvinānyad vidāraya ||23|||
mokṣaṃ yaccha satāṃ sevāṃ prayaccha śaraṇaprada |
ityabhyarthya virarāma prahlādo jñānināṃ varaḥ ||24||
bhagavānāha taṃ bhakta yo necchati dadāmi te |
ya icchenna dadāmyasmai iti me vakravartanam ||25||
mayājñayā gṛhāṇedaṃ rājyaṃ tava piturhi yat |
tatra tvaṃ bandhanaṃ naiva manniyogātprayāsyasi ||26||
madarpaṇaṃ vinā naiva bhoktavyamapi vastu sat |
śarīre mānase vāpi māṃ sadā smara karmaṇi ||27||
bālo’si vṛddhavijño’si bhakto’si nityamuktavat |
tasmād gṛhāṇa rājyaṃ vai saptapātālasaṃbhavam ||18||
āśayā bhajate yo māṃ na vai bhajāmi taṃ janam |
anāśayā bhajan bhakto labhate’rghyaṃ mamāgrataḥ ||29||
ahaṃ svāmyaspṛhe bhakte dṛṣṭvā bhaktaṃ tu saspṛham |
dūraṃ yāmi nāntikaṃ vai niṣkāmaṃ yāmi sarvathā |||1.141.3 0||
ato manvantaraṃ rājyaṃ daityānāmanubhuṃkṣva tat |
kathāṃ śṛṇvam̐śca kathayan madīyāṃ mokṣadāyinīm ||31 ||
karmāṇi cārpayanmahyaṃ kuru rājyamakaṃṭakam |
sadā māmanusandhāya kuru naiṣkarmyameva hi ||3 2||
kṛtasya kuru bhogena kṣapaṇaṃ nūtanaṃ ca yat |
tattu samarpaṇenaivābhogyāyati vidhāpaya ||33 ||
kālena dehe vilaye māmupaiṣyasi sadyaśāḥ |
prahlādaḥ prāha deveśa varaṃ me pitṛśodhanam ||34||
dehi tavāparādhaṃ sa kṛtavān nindayā ghṛṇī |
tava bhakte mayi cāpyaparādhaṃ kṛtavān sa hi ||35||
tadasmātpāpmanaḥ sadyaḥ pūyeta tvatkṛpāśrayaḥ |
bhavediti vṛṇe nānyad vṛṇe nātha namo’stu te |||36||
hariḥ prāha tvayā vaṃśyāścaikaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā |
tāritā bhaktavaryeṇa kimatrāsti praśaṃsanam ||37||
yatra me sādhavaḥ santi praśāntāḥ samadarśinaḥ |
taddeśā mlecchakācārāstatratyā mānavā api ||38||
pūyante tvādṛśabhaktayogādatra na saṃśayaḥ |
kuru pituḥ pretakāryaṃ sa ca yāsyati vaidhase ||3 9||
satye loke punā rāme janmani rākṣaso bhavet |
rāvaṇākhyastṛtīye tu kārṣṇe janmani me’nagha ||1.141.40 ||
śiśupālo’suro bhāvī tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati |
prahlāda pārṣadau me yau jayaśca vijayaśca tau ||41 ||
sanakādyaparādhena bhrātarau dvau babhūvatuḥ |
hiraṇyakaśipurjyeṣṭho hiraṇyākṣastato’nujaḥ ||42||
tāveva rāvaṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ kuṃbhakarṇastayo’nujaḥ |
tāveva dantavaktraśca śiśupālo bhaviṣyataḥ ||43 ||
tato śāpād vimuktau tāveṣyataḥ pārṣadaṃ pakṣa |
bhaktayoretayoryogāt mama janmakathāmayam ||44||
gāsyanti caritaṃ lokāstena yāsyanti mokṣaṇam |
tava bhaktyā ca bhaktānāṃ dārḍhyaṃ bhaktau bhaviṣyati ||45||
evaṃ prasanno lakṣmīśastasmāyiṣṭānvarāndadau |
tato devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarveśo bhaktavatsalaḥ ||46||
prahlādaṃ sarvadaityānāṃ cakre rājānamavyayam |
āśvāsya bhaktaṃ prahlādaṃ cābhiṣicya surottamaiḥ ||47||
dattvā naiṣkarmyarūpāṃ ca bhaktimavyabhicāriṇīm |
harirdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ stūyamāno nṛkesarī ||48||
vikīrṇaḥ puṣpavarṣaistu siṃhāraṇye jagāma he |
tatra śarabharūpeṇa śaṃbhunā kṛtavān raṇam ||49||
parasparaṃ parityajya dehāvadṛśyatāṃ gato |
siṃhaḥ śilā nārasiṃhī śaṃbhustu śarabheśvaraḥ ||1.141.50||
vartiṣyete ca yāvadvai sṛṣṭiḥ sthāsyati tāvatā |
tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarve svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ prapedire ||51 ||
punaśca yajñabhāgām̐śca bubhujuḥ prītamānasāḥ |
prahlādastu tadā cakre rājyaṃ vaiṣṇavadharmataḥ ||52||
bahubhiryajñadānādyairarcayitvā hariṃ tataḥ |
yāsyatyante harerdhāma yogigamyaṃ sanātanam ||53||
ityetatprahlādacaritaṃ śroṣyanti ye harerjanāḥ |
te sarve pāpanirmuktā yāsyanti śrīhareḥ padam ||54||
etatte kathitaṃ lakṣmi nṛsiṃhavaibhavaṃ hareḥ |
tadvaṃśyā siṃhamūrdhanyāḥ raivatāraṇyavāsinaḥ ||55||
atha vāmanarūpaṃ te kathayiṣye śṛṇu priye |
raivatādrau divyagirau vāmano’yāt svayaṃ hariḥ ||56||
iti śrīlakṣmonārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nṛhariṇā prahlādāya varadānaṃ pitṛrājye’bhiṣecanaṃ
nṛsiṃhasyāraṇye’dṛśyatā ceti kathananāmā ekacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 141 ||

<1.142>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
vāmanaṃ śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ yannimittamabhūt priye |
tatsarvaṃ susphuṭaṃ te’haṃ kathayāmi yathātatham || 1 ||
saurāṣṭre paścime prānte raivatādrirmahāngiriḥ |
yatra devagaṇāvāsāḥ siddhā vasanti lakṣaśaḥ || 2 ||
yoginyaścāpi tīrthāni nivasanti nirantaram |
prahlādasyābhavat putro virocana itīrataḥ || 3 ||
tasya putro mahābāhurbalī rājābhavadbalī |
tena yajñāḥ kṛtāḥ śreṣṭhā bahavo bhinnabhūmiṣu || 4 ||
eko yajñaḥ kṛtastatra raivatādritalasthale |
yatrāgatya svayaṃ devo vāmano’bhyarthayadbalim || 5 ||
tatkathāṃ paramāṃ divyāṃ pāvanīṃ mokṣadāyinīm |
kathayāmi mahālakṣmi tṛptirnāsti kathāmṛte || 6 ||
yatra dāmodaraṃ tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇahradastathā |
kimanyairbahubhistīrthaistayoḥ snātvā pramucyate || 7 ||
siṃhāraṇyasyottare vai vyāghrāraṇyamaye sthale |
somanāthasya sānnidhye hyudayānto girirmahān || 8 ||
yaḥ kṛtasmara ityukto vāḍavānalabhasmitaḥ |
tasyaiva pārśvabhāge tu revatākhyo giriḥ smṛtaḥ |
śrīhareḥ kaustubhamaṇeḥ khaṇḍo’yaṃ sthūlatāṃ gataḥ || 9 ||
raivatākhyo manustatra tadadhyātmatayā sthitaḥ |
so’yaṃ vai raivatagirirdivyaḥ kṛṣṇahṛdi sthitaḥ |
mahato hastinaḥ kaṇṭhe svarṇaghaṃṭādvayaṃ yathā || 1.142.10 ||
pūrṇimāyāstathā sāyaṃ cālambete śaśī raviḥ |
svargaṃ yāvat taducchrāyo’ntarīkṣaṃ kaṭisaṃśritam || 11 ||
dattātreyādayaḥ siddhā vasanti śikhare’sya vai |
śikharāṇāṃ kukṣibhāge vasanti sarvadevatāḥ || 12||
parvatasya kaṭibhāge’rhannāthagautamādayaḥ |
vasanti bhagavanto vai munayaḥ sādhuyoginaḥ || 13||
parvatasyorubhāge tu gāndharvāḥ kinnarāstathā |
vidyādharāstathā saumyāḥ kiṃpuruṣā vasanti hi || 14||
parvatasya jānubhāge yoginyaḥ śaṃkarapriyāḥ |
devyaśca kṛttikāścaivābhīrāṇyaḥ sādhvikāstathā || 15||
jaṃghābhāge parvatasya kāmadhenukulāni vai |
devāśca devakariṇaḥ śvetāścatuḥsudantakāḥ || 16||
siṃhā vyāghrāstathā daivā narasiṃhakuṭumbinaḥ |
vasanti vyomagatayo divyāḥ sūryasamaprabhāḥ || 17||
pādasthāne raivatasya gopyaḥ kṛṣṇapriyāḥ śubhāḥ |
divyāstathāpi mānuṣarūpeṇa vicaranti hi || 18||
mucukundasya mahatī guhā pātālasaṃcarā |
rādhāyā mandiraṃ ramyaṃ svarṇarakṣānadīgatam || 1 9||
rukmāṃgadādirājñāṃ vai rājadhānī ca vartate |
patnīvratākhyaviprasya camatkārā bhavanti ca |||1.142.20|||
yatrāraṇyāni cūtānāṃ kṣīrikāṇāṃ vanāni ca |
karmadānāṃ ṭimburūṇāṃ jāmbūnāṃ pravaṇāni ca ||21 ||
sītāphalānāṃ sauvarṇakadalīnāṃ vanāni ca |
ikṣūṇāṃ śarkarākandamūlānāṃ prasthalāni ca ||22||
boriyākhyamahāsthalyāṃ devyaḥ snānti vasanti ca |
nārāyaṇahṛdasthalyāṃ yoginyo vicaranti ca || 23 ||
devyastu kāṣṭhavāhinyo’raṇye tīrthe bhramanti ca |
pārijātaprasūnānāṃ kundānāṃ kalpaśākhinām |
vanānyatra bhavantyeva sugandhaśatayojanam || 24||
paritaḥ pavano nītvā karoti surabhisthalīḥ |
agneruṣṇāḥ prakuṇḍāśca kvacicchaityajalāśayāḥ || 25 ||
saritaḥ svarṇarūpyābhā nirmalodakasaṃcarāḥ |
sarasā oṣadhimiśrarasavatyo vahanti ca || 26 ||
yajjalāni janāḥ pītvā devā devyo bhavanti ca |
pārthivā api nṛnāryo tajjalauṣadhibhogikāḥ || 27||
ṣoḍaśābdāḥ sadā hṛṣṭapuṣṭāḥ kāmātigojjvalāḥ |
candramukhyo vilasanti svargabhramaṇakārikāḥ || 28 ||
navaraṃgapanasādiphalānāṃ nālpatā kvacit |
kharjūrāṇāṃ śrīphalānāṃ nārīkelāmṛtātmanām || 29||
āmalakatriphalānāṃ saṃghātsaṃghā bhavanti vai |
guṃdrakāṇāmiṅgudīnāṃ śimbipatraphalatvacām || 1.142.30 ||
vṛkṣāṇāṃ vaṃśamālānāṃ bilvatindukaśākhinām |
udumbaravaṭasarjatilakānāṃ vanāni ca || 31 ||
tulasīnāṃ vanānyatra devadārupraśākhinām |
drākṣāṇāṃ nāgavallīnāṃ tiktānāṃ vallayastathā || 32 ||
mālatīmallikāśvetājīvantīsvarṇavallayaḥ |
phalapuṣpapatrasampadvilasantyo’tra bhānti vai || 33 ||
sthale sthalyāṃ niriāraṇā jalānāṃ pravahanti ca |
svarṇakārāstāmrakārāḥ kāyākalpakarāstathā || 34||
kṣuttṛṭvināśikāścāpi vallyo vṛkṣā bhavanti ca |
kuṇḍā divyāstatra santi snānenādṛśyatā bhavet || 35||
svarṇajalāstathā kuṇḍā lauhaṃ svarṇaṃ bhavejjalāt |
patratṛṇāni vai santi chinno dehaḥ susīvyate || 36 ||
raktaṃ ghaṭṭaṃ bhavatyeva saṃjīvanī ca vartate |
jalakuṇḍāstathā santi snātvā nārī naro bhavet || 37||
naro vā jāyate nārī tatastu parvate gatiḥ |
nānyathā iti sāmarthyaṃ raivatādrau samīkṣyate || 38 ||
kvacitkuṇḍe kṛtasnānāt pakṣau bhavata uḍḍane |
punaḥ snānānmānavatvaṃ yathāvasthaṃ bhavennanu || 3 9||
yaddroṇyāṃ yonidānena nāryo bhavanti devatāḥ |
narā liṃgapradānena jāyante siddhayonayaḥ ||1.142.40 ||
kvacidoṣadhayogena janaḥ siṃhavapurbhavet |
mārgayitvā hariṇādīn punaśca mānavo bhavet ||41||
kāmarūpajalāḥ kuṇḍāḥ svalpakāḥ santi parvate |
yathecchati tathārūpaṃ jāyate snāturatra vai |
tatratyāstu prajāḥ sarvā svargānnyūnaṃ na bhuṃjate ||42||
vanāni vividhānyeva kāmapūraṇakāni hi |
sarvadā phalavantyeva patrapuṣpādimanti ca |
meghāstatra sadā madhye śroṇyāṃ vasanti vṛṣṭidāḥ |||43 ||
vidyutaśca sadā rātrau śanaistejo dadatyamum |
tārāḥ sthirāḥ kvacittatra vasanti śramanodane ||44||
rājatyaḥ svarṇakhanyaśca vividhadhātumiśritāḥ |
khanyo hīrakamāṇikyasphāṭikaratnavidrumāḥ ||45||
rasāyanāni divyāni pātālamūlavanti ca |
vidyante’tra raivatādrau labhyante puṇyaśālibhiḥ ||46||
apsarasaḥ svargavatyo’trāgatya snānti yānti ca |
yātrālavo lakṣakoṭisuramānavasajjanāḥ |
narā nāryo mahāprādakṣiṇyamūrje bhramanti hi ||47||
gaṇāśca gaṇikāścaiva śuddhyanti tanudānataḥ |
parīsarovaraṃ tatra parīṇāṃ snānakāraṇāt |
indrasarovaraṃ tadvad devīnāṃ snānakāraṇāt ||48||
rohasarovaraṃ tatra devāplavanakāraṇāt |
dātṛsarovaraṃ droṇyāṃ dātṝṇāṃ snānakāraṇāt |
vīrasarovaraṃ droṇyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ snānakāraṇāt ||49||
satīsarovaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ satīnāṃ snānakāraṇāt |
bhaveśvarataḍāgaṃ ca sarvauṣadhirasāyanam |
bhavantyevaṃ tatra śaile divyāni ca sarāṃsi ca ||1.142.50 ||
paritastatra sarito niḥsarantyakṣayairjalaiḥ |
raivatādrau sthitāḥ sarve paśyanti medinīṃ diśam |
samudrānparvatāndeśān grāmān lokān pradeśakān ||51 ||
sadehena yadā vāñcchā svargaṃ gantuṃ bhavet tadā |
raivatādreḥ śikhare vai gatvā snānena siddhatām ||52||
prāpya yāyāt tato naiva pated yadi na vāsanā |
gaumukhyāṃ snānamātrācca kamaṇḍalujalāplavāt |
dattātreyajalabindupānāt siddhā bhavanti hi ||53||
grahāstacchikhare śrāntiṃ labdhvā yānti diśāntaram |
divojuṣāṃ vimānāni tatra viśramya yānti ca ||54||
brāhmaṃ caiśaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ ca mokṣīyaṃ caiśvaraṃ tathā |
yāmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca panthānaṃ tacchṛṃgād yānti vai janāḥ ||55||
bhīravajapanāmānaṃ sthalamāsādya mānavaḥ |
patatyaraṇye tasyaiva tatra svargaṃ bhavatyapi ||56||
na svargānnyūnatā tatra kiṃcinmātramapi dhruvam |
tatra tīrthāni devānāmanekāni bhavanti vai ||57||
raivatādriṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kartumāyānti devatāḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaḥ svargyāḥ pitaro yoginastathā ||58||
siddhā vidyādharāścaiva cāraṇā devayonayaḥ |
sādhurūpeṣu devāśca siddhāḥ krāmyanti taṃ pari ||59||
sādhvīrūpeṣu devyaśca parikrāmyanti taṃ girim |
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śrīrāmacandro dattātreyaśca nṛhariḥ ||1.142.60 ||
kapilo vāmano haṃsaḥ ṛṣabho nāradastathā |
parśurāmaśca vai vyāsaḥ kumāro buddha ityapi ||61 ||
sanandanādayaḥ sarve vyūhā brahmādayastathā |
kārtikyāṃ tu prabodhinyāṃ pūrṇimāyāṃ ca yāvatā ||62||
save devāśca tīrthāni pūryaḥ kṣetrāṇi dhāma ca |
parvatāḥ saritaḥ sarve sāgarā bhūmayastathā ||63||
āyānti ca vasantyatra raivatādrau sthale sthale |
patre patre vasantyete devāḥ kartuṃ pradakṣiṇam ||64||
raivatādrestadānīṃ vai kṛtaṃ yena pradakṣiṇam |
kṛtaṃ tena pṛthivyāṃ vai savidhānapradakṣiṇam ||65||
raivatādriparikrāmayitāro mānavāstadā |
manuṣyā nahi draṣṭavyā draṣṭavyā devakoṭayaḥ ||66||
teṣāṃ pādarajolābhe mucyante janmakoṭayaḥ |
bālāḥ kumārāḥ sthavirā narā nāryopi ye tadā ||67||
raivataṃ parikrāmanti pāvanāste hariśritāḥ |
sādhuḥ sādhvī ca sanyāsī sanyāsinī virāgiṇī ||68||
vaiṣṇavī śāṃkarī devī vaiṣṇavaḥ śāṃkaro’thavā |
gāṇapatyāśca vā mokṣamārgagāste tu devatāḥ ||69||
tebhyo vai bhojanaṃ dānaṃ vastraṃ vānyat svakaṃ bhavet||
taddātavyaṃ samastaṃ vai sevāyāṃ svargadaṃ bhavet ||1.142.70 ||
yasyāgre yadbhavedvastu taddeyaṃ tatra sarvathā |
santaḥ sādhvyastoṣaṇīyāḥ kāyavāṅmānasairapi ||71||
sarvasvārpaṇakartre vai nārāyaṇahariḥ svayam |
svīyaṃ sarvaṃ dadātyeva bhaktāya brahmarūpiṇe ||72|||
dāmodare’titīrthe ye mṛtā vai yatra tatra hi |
te vasanti harergehe na patanti bhave kvacit ||73||
svārpaṇaṃ prathamaṃ dānaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu dhanārpaṇam |
kṣetrādikaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca naijārpaṇaṃ caturthakam ||74||
etatsarvaṃ girestasya parikramaṇajaṃ phalam |
labhyate tatra pāpāni jvalanti nodbhavanti vai ||75||
yatkiṃcidvā paropakārākhyaṃ svārthaṃ parārthakam |
daihyaṃ caindriyikaṃ hārdaṃ kṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ ca mokṣakṛt ||76||
jayed brahmātmabhāvastu dehabhāvaḥ parājayet |
asaṃśayo vimucyeta saṃśayātmā vinaśyati ||77||
tanmamāpi mahālakṣmi sthānaṃ raivataparvakam |
atīva rocate tatra dāmodaro vasāmyaham ||78||
rukmadurge mandire’haṃ trivikramo vasāmi vai |
madhyenagaraṃ nṛsiṃharūpeṇāpi vasāmyaham ||79||
sthale vṛkṣe sume patre mūle rajasi parvate |
saritsu bhūtale vāpyāṃ taḍāge ca vane jale ||1.142.80||
tatratye kamale padme kumude sthalapadmake |
pāṣāṇe bhūvivare ca valmīke tarugulmake ||8 1||
yatra kvāpi raivatosti tatsarvatra vasāmyaham |
ahaṃ vai raivatagiriḥ raivato’haṃ na bhinnatā |||82||
mama bhūṣā mama tanuḥ raivataḥ pāvanaḥ paraḥ |
saurāṣṭravāsināṃ naiva yamāḥ paśyanti vai gṛham ||83||
ānartena tapaḥ kṛtvā golokāt kṣatriyeṇa vai |
kṛṣṇātprāpyātra ca maṇerbhāgo bai sthāpito’sti saḥ ||84||
saurāṣṭra itivikhyātastatratyānāṃ kutobhayam |
tadasminparvate divye gatānāṃ tu kuto bhayam ||85||
yatra vai dhātavo raktāḥ śvetā nīlāḥ sitāstathā |
pāṣāṇā kuṃjarākārāḥ santyanye svarṇarājatāḥ ||86||
caṇakākṛtayaścānyā bālukā gokṣurāyatāḥ |
divyāśca taravo vallyo gulmāḥ santānapādapāḥ ||87||

nahi paśyati pāpātmā muktaḥ pāpena paśyati ||88||
sevyate sa girirnityaṃ dhātvādikhanimārgaṇaiḥ |
varṇāścāśramiṇastatra bhramanti ca vasanti ca ||89||
pakṣiṇastatra bahavaḥ sārasā vyomavāsinaḥ |
kokilāścātakā menā haṃsā mayūrakāstathā ||1.142.90||
garuḍā gṛdhrajātīyāḥ kapotā dīrghadarśinaḥ |
cakravākāḥ kṛkavākuḥ tittirā divyajātayaḥ ||91||
sarve śubhākṣarabhāṣāḥ śivāḥ śivakarāḥ sadā | 1

tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa duṣṭaṃ naivācaranti te ||93||
kālena nidhanaṃ cāptāḥ paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ |
sarve vimānamārūḍhā gacchanti vaiṣṇavaṃ padam ||94||
vāyunā patitaṃ yacca patrapuṣpaphalādikam |
svarṇarakṣājale tatra sarvaṃ vai muktimeti yat ||95||
suvarṇākhyā hareḥ patnī premadraveṇa sarvadā |
dāmodarasya sevāyāṃ nadīrūpeṇa vartate ||96||
nadī suvarṇarakṣā sā svarṇavālukayā yutā |
cakāsti svarṇamayyeva svarṇāṃścānyān karoti ca ||97||
tatra snātuṃ nāgarājo bhitvā bhūmiṃ tu vāsukiḥ |
tena mārgeṇa mūlena vivareṇāgate hyabhūt ||98||
svargādāgatya cendro’pi yaṣṭvā yajñeṣu puṣkalam |
puṇyamādāya muktyarthaṃ gataḥ svargaṃ nirāmayam ||99||
kurvantyanaśanaṃ caikadivasīyamatho janāḥ |
te śrīhareḥ pratāpena cāpnuyurdhāma vai hareḥ || 1.142.100 ||
vāsudevo’niruddhaśca pradyumnaśca sukarṣaṇaḥ |
tathānye tvīśvarāḥ śatalakṣakoṭyo vasanti hi || 10 1||
prakrīḍanti priyāsteṣāṃ nityaṃ dāmodarāgrataḥ |
sucandravadanā gauryaḥ śyāmāśca dṛḍhamadhyamāḥ || 102||
nitambinyaḥ sukeśyaśca sunāsāyatalocanāḥ |
sugulphāḥ subhruvastatra sukukṣyaḥ supayodharāḥ || 1 03||
śobhanāsyāḥ sujaṃghāśca supādāṃghryudarāstathā |
raivatākhye girau tasmin ramante ca hasanti ca || 1 04||

dadyāt svarṇādidānāni putriṇī subhagā bhavet || 105||
