na vaidhavyaṃ bhavet tasyāḥ saubhāgyamatule bhavet |
snātvā phalāni deyāni kuṃkumaṃ ca sakajjalam ||62||
gaurīsūtraṃ pradātavyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ puṣpamityapi |
pītaṃ vastraṃ pradātavyaṃ kaṃcukaṃ yaṣṭikā tathā ||63||
phalāni vaṃśapātreṣu bhṛtvā miṣṭānnamityapi |
strīṇāṃ tu sādhvīnāṃ satīnāṃ ca sadakṣiṇam ||64||
prātaḥ snātvā pradātavyaṃ raivatīdarśanaṃ tataḥ |
pūjanaṃ ca ṣoḍaśopacāraiḥ kartavyameva ca ||65|||
stutiṃ putrārthamevāvaidhavyārthamapi ca kriyāt |
sadā kṛpāvati devi raivati me kṛpāṃ kuru || 66 ||
avaidhavyaṃ sadā me’stu putrapautravatī tathā |
dhanadhānyavatī ca syāṃ dehi me vāṃchitaṃ śubhe || 67 ||
iti stutvā namaskṛtya dāmodarasya darśanam |
kṛtvā kārtika śukle vai pañcadaśadināvadhim || 68 ||
gantavyaṃ svagṛhe nityaṃ bhojyaṃ dugdhānnamityapi |
miṣṭānnaṃ vyañjanaṃ cāpi ghṛtapakvādikaṃ tathā || 69 ||
sahavāsaśca patinā kāryo na tu niṣidhyate |
nopavāsastathā kāryo nānyā pūjāpyapekṣate || 1.148.70 ||
vratī kuṇḍasnapanaṃ raivatīstutidarśane |
uktaphalādidānaṃ ca dāmodarasya darśanam ||7 1 ||
pañcadaśadinaprātaḥkṛtaṃ saubhāgyavardhakam |
iti tubhyamavaidhavyakaraṃvrataṃ tu darśitam || 72 ||
athānyat tvaṃ mahālakṣmi kiṃ mattaḥ śrotumicchasi |
lakṣmīḥ prāha kṛpāsindho tīrthāni raivate girau ||73 ||
tatpārśve ca yadanyāni vasanti tāni me vada |
kiyatsāmarthyavantyeva śrotumicchāmi keśava ||74 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne putraprāptidaṃ payovratam avaidhavyavrataṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 148 ||

<1.149>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi raivatasthatīrthāni kathayāmyaham |
yātrāphalasuyuktāni bhuktimuktipradāni ca || 1 ||
vastrāpathasya tīrthāni yāni yena kṛtāni ca |
tānyapi te kathayiṣye svargamokṣapradāni ca || 2 ||
pūrve kṛtayuge kānyakubje bhojanṛpo’bhavat |
tasmai vanāt samabhyetya vanapālabravīdidam || 3 ||
āścaryaṃ bhramatā rājan mayā dṛṣṭaṃ vanedhunā |
mṛgayūthagatā nārī mayā dṛṣṭā mṛgānanā || 4 ||
tatastu bhojarājaḥ saḥ senādhyakṣamuvāca ha |
idānīmeva gantavyaṃ yatra sā yuvatī sthitā || 5 ||
sāśvāśca pattayo yāntu veṣṭayantu vanaṃ girim |
strīveṣadhāriṇī nārī vaśaṃ neyā mṛgī hi sā || 6 ||
giriṃ saṃveṣṭayāmāsa bhojaḥ sainyapadātibhiḥ |
plavamānā tu sainyena vidhṛtā hariṇānanā || 7 ||
nārīdehāṃ samāninye kānyakubje mṛgīṃ nṛpaḥ |
dṛṣṭvāścaryaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ jāyate nṛpamandire || 8 ||
rājā tāṃ snāpayāmāsa divyagandhānulepanaiḥ |
ekānte nirjane rājā babhāṣe samalaṃkṛtām || 9 ||
kā tvaṃ kasya sutā kena hetunā ca mṛgānanā |
iti pṛṣṭhāpi novāca na bhuṃkte na papau tathā || 1.149.10 ||
tadā bhojastu daivajñān mantrajñān bhiṣajastathā |
tāntrikān sunamaskṛtya babhāṣe paśyata dvijāḥ || 11 ||
nārīdehā kathaṃ nveṣā kathaṃ ca hariṇānanā |
manuṣyavāṇīvadanā kathameṣā bhaviṣyati || 12 ||
viprāḥ prāhuḥ kurukṣetre sārasvatākhyabhūsuraḥ |
jānāti sa ca vṛttāntaṃ yathātathaṃ sa vakṣyati || 13 ||
bhojo jagāma taṃ vipraṃ tapantaṃ tapa ityamum |
namaskṛtyopaviṣṭaṃ taṃ bhojaṃ prāha sa bhūsuraḥ || 1 4||
gacchāmo yatra sā nārī vakṣyati svayameva tat |
ityāgatā yatra nārī tataḥ sārasvato dvijaḥ || 19||
upalipya ca bhūbhāgaṃ svastikaṃ sanniveśya ca |
sajalaṃ kalaśaṃ nyasya cāgnikāryaṃ nidhāya ca || 16 ||
indraṃ devāṃśca dikpālān kalaśe sanniveśya ca |
hutvāgniṃ ca caruṃ kṛtvā grahapūjāmakārayat || 17||
abhiṣekaṃ svayaṃ cakre tāṃ nārīṃ cābhiṣecayat |
tāvatā divyadṛṣṭyā sā babhāṣe prāgbhavān bahūn || 18 ||
bhoja tvaṃ saptame pūrve janmani bhvāṃ mayā saha |
kaliṃgadeśanṛpatirahaṃ patnī ca baṅgajā || 19 ||
duṣṭātmā tvamanācāro dayādharmavivarjitaḥ |
gobhūvipraguruvedadevaśāstravināśakṛt ||1.149.2 0 ||
militvā ca prajābhistvaṃ hato lokavirodhakaḥ |
mṛtaṃ kānta gṛhītvāgnau praviṣṭāhaṃ mṛtā saha ||21 ||
mṛtaṃ kāntaṃ samādāya bhāryāgnau praviśed yadi |
mahīyete hyubhau svarge yāvadābhūtasamplavam ||22 ||
tatastu mālave deśe viprastvaṃ nāstiko’bhavaḥ |
ahaṃ tu brāhmaṇī bhaktimatī bhāryābhavaṃ tava || 23 ||
tvayārjitaṃ dhanaṃ svarṇaṃ tyaktvāptaṃ maraṇaṃ yadā |
sahāhaṃ na mṛtā lobhāt kintu kālāntare mṛtā ||24||
śvetasarpo’bhavastvaṃ vai viprakanyābhavaṃ tvaham |
pariṇītānyavipreṇa vipraṃ tvamadaśaśca tam || 25 ||
ahantu vidhavā jātā sarpastvaṃ mārito janaiḥ |
vaidhavyaṃ mama datvā tu dvijasarpāvubhau mṛtau || 26 ||
tvaṃ mṛtvā makaro jāto godāvaryāṃ tadāpyaham |
tīrthaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātā janaiḥ saha |||27||
yāvat snātuṃ praviṣṭāhamākṛṣṭā makareṇa vai |
lokaiḥ kuntādighātena makaro vinipātitaḥ ||28||
ahaṃ makaradaṃṣṭrābhistadānīṃ ca mṛtiṃ gatā |
tvaṃ tato lubdhako jāto’haṃ śabaryabhabadvane |||29 ||
agnerjalācca sarpācca gajāt siṃhāddhayādapi |
roṣādvisphoṭakānmṛtyuryeṣāṃ te narakaṃgamāḥ || 1.149.3 0||
ātmahā bhrūṇahā strīghno brahmaghnaḥ kūṭasākṣiṇaḥ |
kanyāvikrayakartā ca mithyāpavādadāyakaḥ || 31 ||
vikrīṇāti kratuṃ yastu madyaṃ pāti dvijastu yaḥ |
rājadrohī svarṇacauro brahmavṛttivilopakaḥ || 32||
goghnaśca nikṣepaharo grāmasīmaharastu yaḥ |
sarve te narakaṃ yānti yā ca strī pativañcakī || 33 ||
śabaryahaṃ mṛtā rogāt krauṃcī jātā vane tadā |
kvacit krauṃcena kāmena krīḍitumudyatābhavam || 34||
tāvadvyādhena sa krauṃco bāṇena vinipātitaḥ |
krauṃcena ca tadā śaptaḥ krūro bhava mahāvane ||35||
strīhīnaḥ śārdūlarūpo duḥkhī bhava punaḥ punaḥ |
tatastvaṃ śārdūlarūpo raivate ca girābabhūḥ || 36||
mṛtā daivavaśāt krauṃcī mṛgyabhūd raivate girau |
bhaveśvarātpaścime tu svarṇarakṣānadījalam || 37||
pātuṃ cāhaṃ samāyātā dṛṣṭā kesariṇā tadā |
utplutā tadbhayāccāhaṃ patitā cāparaṃ taṭam ||38||
tāvat siṃhaḥ samutplutya madagre patito balāt |
ahaṃ yāvatparāvṛtyotplavitumupacakrame || 39||
pārśvasthakīcakastambe jalasthe mama mastakam |
dvayoḥ kīcakayormadhye plavane pāśavat hyabhūt ||1.149.40||
śarīraṃ jalamadhye me mastakaṃ vaṃśamadhyagam |
siṃhena saṃdhṛtaṃ kaṇṭhāddaṃṣṭrābhiśca viyojitam ||41||
yāvat siṃho’pi me varṣma jalamadhyād vikarṣati |
tāvat saibalayogena padbhyāṃ sṛptvā jale’patat ||42||
agādhācca jalāt śaivālabāhulyātsamantataḥ |
na nirgantuṃ śaśākāsau mṛtimāpat sa kesarī ||43||
svarṇarakṣājale siṃho mṛto bhojo’bhavannṛpaḥ |
tasya tīrthaprabhāveṇa nṛpatvaṃ samajāyata ||44||
idaṃ hi saptamaṃ janma rājābhojeti viśrutam |
lambate me śiro vaṃśe śarīraṃ jalamadhyagam ||45||
svarṇarekhājale tatra viśīrṇaṃ mama tadvapuḥ
na tu vaktraṃ nipatitaṃ tvaṅmāṃsaṃ śirasi sthitam ||46||
tato’haṃ hariṇīgarbhe jātā mānuṣarūpiṇī |
jātaṃ vaktraṃ mṛgīṇāṃ me yasmānna patitaṃ jale ||47||
nāhaṃ hariṇakanyāsti kintūddālakasanmuneḥ |
kanyāsmi caikadā svarṇarakṣāyāṃ snātumāgataḥ ||48||
sa tadānīṃ ca tatraiva yoginyaḥ snātumāgatāḥ |
yoginībhistadā tatra muniḥ parīkṣito muhuḥ ||49||
kīdṛśo’yaṃ brahmacārī dṛḍho vādṛḍha ityamum |
gṛhītvā kaṇṭhapāśaiśca samāśliṣya muhurmuhuḥ ||1.149.50 ||
krīḍayanti bahurītyā ṛṣirna vikṛtiṃ gataḥ |
athaikā yoginī nāmnā kāmadāhābhidhā tadā ||51 ||
uddālakasya dehe’ntaḥpraviṣṭā yogasadbalāt |
tāvatkāmo’bhavadbhīto vidudrāva ṛṣestanoḥ ||||52||
anyathā dagdhatāṃ kuryād yoginī sāntarasthitā |
kāmadevasya vidrāvād yoginyā uṣṇatāvaśāt ||53||
yauvanodbhedavegācca sahakrīḍanakādikāt |
stambhito’pi tadā dhāturvegācca patito jale ||54||
pravāheṇa saha dhāturnārāyaṇahrade gataḥ |
tatraikā hariṇī vāri papau taddhātumiśritam ||55||
tadgarbhe mama vāso’bhūt pūrvakarmānusārataḥ |
ahamuddālakaṛṣeḥ putrī jātā mṛgānanā ||56||
yoginībhirvardhitāsmi yoginīnāṃ sutā yataḥ |
yoginyasmi mṛgīmukhā divyāpi mānuṣī tathā ||57|||
rājam̐stava tathā me’pi saptamaṃ janma vidyate |
jānātyayamṛṣiḥ sārasvato yogabalāddhi tat ||58
praviśyāgnau mṛtā pūrve tvayā sārdhaṃ tu saptame |
tvāṃ vinā me patirmā bhūnmaraṇe yācitaṃ mayā ||59||
tadāntarīkṣe rājendra vāguvācāśarīriṇī |
rājāsau duṣṭakarmāsti hiṃsraḥ krūro’tilubdhakaḥ ||1.149.6 0||
na vedaśāstrakuśalo dayādharmavivarjitaḥ |
kāmī mānī mahākrodhī satyācāravivarjitaḥ ||61||
na devaṃ na guruṃ viprānna jānāti durāśayaḥ |
na sādhūnna ca sādhvīṃśca pūjayatyatimānavān ||62||
asatyavādī duṣṭātmā yajñadharmavināśakaḥ |
palalāśī ca vai viṣṇornindako vṛttihārakaḥ ||63|||
veśyāgāmī snānadānadharmakarmavivarjitaḥ |
caṇḍālatāmayaṃ prāptastasya pāpaṃ kiyadguṇam ||64||
gaṇayituṃ na śakyeta tādṛśaḥ pāpavānayam |
yadyapi tvaṃ satī nārī dagdhā bhavasi tena vai ||65 ||
tatastvaṃ saptajanmāni sahayuktā bhaviṣyasi |
kintu cāsya mahāpāpaiḥ svargaṃ nāsya bhaviṣyati ||66 ||
ādau pāpaphalaṃ bhuktvā paścād rājyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
aṣṭamaṃ cāsya sajjanma devajanma bhaviṣyati ||67||
tadā tvaṃ mānuṣī bhūtvā paścātsvargaṃ gamiṣyasi |
ityuktvā sā virarāma sarvaṃ smarāmi yogataḥ ||68 ||
api me mastakasyāsti kharparaṃ vaṃśasaṃsthitam |
yadi vastrāpathe gatvā śiraḥ kaścid vimuñcati ||69 ||
svarṇarakṣājale rājan mānuṣaṃ syānmukhaṃ mama |
asmyahaṃ mānuṣavaktrā dṛśyate’nyairmṛgānanā ||1.149.70 ||
pāpacchāyāvṛtaṃ caitanmṛgākṛtimukhaṃ mama |
śrutvaitadbhojarājena pratīhārastu tatsthalam ||7 1 ||
preṣitastena dṛṣṭaṃ tat svarṇarekhājalopari |
vartate tanmṛgaśiro vaṃśaprotaṃ mahāvane ||72 ||
gṛhītvā pātitaṃ yāvat svarṇarekhājale tadā |
bhojarājagṛhe tasyā mukhaṃ candrasamaṃ śubham ||73 ||
mānuṣa cābhavad divyaṃ padmapatrasulocanam |
suśobhanaṃ dīrghakeśaṃ dīrghakarṇaṃ śubhadvijam ||74||
kambugrīvaṃ padmagandhaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam |
na devī na ca gāndharvī nāsurī na ca kinnarī ||75||
yādṛśī sā tadā jātā tīrthabhāvena sundarī |
pariṇītā tu sā tena bhojarājena sundarī ||76 ||
mṛgānaneti vikhyātā devī sā bhojasundarī |
kutāsau paṭṭamahiṣī bhojarājena dhīmatā ||77||
deśānāṃ pravaro deśo girīṇāṃ pravaro giriḥ |
kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ vanānāmuttamaṃ vanam ||78 ||
gaṃgāsarasvatīrevāḥ svarṇarekhājale sthitāḥ |
brahmā viṣṇuśca sūryaśca sarve rudrādayaḥ surāḥ ||79 ||
nāgā yakṣāśca gandharvā asmin kṣetre vyavasthitāḥ |
svarṇarakṣānadīvārṣu snātvā nārāyaṇe hrade ||1.149.8 0 ||
mṛgītīrthe tathā snātvā kuṇḍe dāmodarābhidhe |
tathā ca revatīkuṇḍe snātvā svarmokṣamāpnuyāt ||8 1 ||
gaṃgā sarasvatī puṇyā yamunā svarṇarūpiṇī |
nadyāmāgatya tiṣṭhanti dṛśyante svarṇapatrikāḥ |||82 ||
sarasvatī svarṇarūpā gaṃgā rajatapatrikāḥ |
yamunā tāmrapatrāṇi nadyapsu pracakāsati ||8 3 ||
evaṃ suvarṇarakṣākhyā svarṇarekhābhiranvitā |
sarit sā raivate bhūdhre vartate mokṣadāyinī ||84||
brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ |
svarṇarekhājale snātvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||85||
ye ca kīṭapataṃgādyāḥ svarṇarekhājale mṛtāḥ |
vṛkṣavallītarugulmāste’pi yānti parāṃ gatim ||86 ||
bhojaḥ sārasvataṃ vipraṃ stutvā vacanamabravīt |
brahmā viṣṇurharaḥ sūryaṃ indro’gnirmarutāṃ gaṇāḥ ||87||
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā tvayā santoṣitāḥ prabho |
tvayā saha mayā cāpi yātrārthaṃ raivate girau ||88||
kṛpā cet tarhi gantavyaṃ kṛtārthaśca bhavāmyaham |
kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca bhoktavyaṃ kiṃ deyaṃ kiṃ na dīyate ||89||
tīrthopavāsaḥ snānaṃ ca sandhyāsnānavidhikramaḥ |
pūjā nidrā japo rātrau sarvaṃ saṃkṣepato vada ||1.149.90 ||
iti sārasvataḥ pṛṣṭho bhūbhṛtā prāha tadvidhim |
dānādikaṃ phalaṃ sarvaṃ prāha vipro yathātatham ||9 1 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pūrvakṛtayuge bhojākhyarājñastatpatnyāśca mṛgānanāyāḥ saptajanmavṛttāntamukhena svarṇarakṣānadyā māhātmyavarṇananāmonapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 149||

<1.150>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato vipraḥ sārasvato mahāmuniḥ |
saurāṣṭre raivatagireryātrābalaṃ jagād tam || 1 ||
saurāṣṭradeśe gantavyaṃ girau raivatake yadā |
tadā gurubalaṃ vīkṣya kṛtvā sūryasya tarpaṇam ||2 ||
vāme pṛṣṭe ca kṛtvānyad dinaśuddhiṃ vilokya ca |
candralagnagrahān dṛṣṭvā baliṣṭhān janmarāśitaḥ || 3 ||
śakunaṃ ca śubhaṃ buddhvā prasthātavyaṃ janaiḥ khalu |
aśvinī revatī citrā dhaniṣṭhā samalaṃkṛtau || 4 ||
mṛgāśvicitrāpuṣyāśca mūlā hastā śubhāḥ sadā |
kanyāpradāne yātrāyāṃ pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmasu || 5 ||
śukracandrau tu janmasthau śubhadau ca dvitīyake |
śaśijñaśukrajīvāśca rāśau cātha tṛtīyake || 6 ||
bhaumamandaśaśāṃkārkā budhaḥ śreṣṭhaścaturthake |
śukrajīvau pañcamau ca candraketusamāhitau || 7 ||
mandārkau ca kujaḥ ṣaṣṭhe gurucandrau ca saptame |
jñaśukrāvaṣṭame śreṣṭhau navamastho guruḥ śubhaḥ || 8 ||
arkārkicandrā daśame ekādaśe’khilā grahāḥ |
budho’tha dvādaśe caiva bhārgavaḥ sukhado bhavet || 9 ||
siṃhena makaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kanyayā meṣa uttamaḥ |
tulayā saha mīnastu kuṃbhena saha karkaṭaḥ || 1.150.1 0|||
dhanuṣā vṛṣabhaḥ śreṣṭho mithunena ca vṛścikaḥ |
etat ṣaḍaṣṭakaṃ prītyai bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 1 1||
caraḥ saumyau guruḥ kṣipro mṛduḥ śukro ravirdhruvaḥ |
śaniśca dāruṇo jñeyo bhauma ugraḥ śaśī samaḥ || 12||
carakṣipraiḥ prayātavyaṃ praveṣṭavyaṃ mṛdudhruvaiḥ |
dāruṇograiśca yoddhavyaṃ kṣatriyairjayakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 13||
nṛpābhiṣeko’gnikāryaṃ somavāre praśasyate |
some tule pramāṇe ca kuryāccaiva gṛhādikam || 14||
saināpatyaṃ śauryayuddhaṃ śastrābhyāsaḥ kuje smṛtaḥ |
siddhikāryaṃ ca mantraśca yātrā caiva budhe smṛtā || 15||
paṭhanaṃ devapūjā ca vastrādyābharaṇaṃ gurau |
kanyādānaṃ gajārohaḥ śukre syāt samayaḥ striyāḥ || 16||
sthāpyaṃ gṛhapraveśaśca gajabandhaḥ śanau śubhaḥ |
saptamopacayādyasthaścandraḥ sarvatra śobhanaḥ || 17||
śuklapakṣe dvitīyastu pañcamo navamastathā |
sampūjyamāno lokaistu guruvad dṛśyate śaśī || 18||
janmasthaḥ kurute tuṣṭiṃ dvitīye nāsti nirvṛtiḥ |
tṛtīye rājasanmānaṃ caturthe kalahāgamaḥ || 19||
pañcamena mṛgāṃkena strīlābho vai tathā bhavet |
dhanadhānyāgamaḥ ṣaṣṭhe ratiḥ pūjā ca saptame ||1.150.20 ||
aṣṭame prāṇasandeho navame koṣasañcayaḥ |
daśame kāryaniṣpattirdhruvamekādaśe jayaḥ |||21|||
dvādaśena śaśāṃkena mṛtyureva na saṃśayaḥ |
aśuklā pratipat śreṣṭhā dvitīyā candrasūnunā ||22||
tṛtīyā bhūmiputreṇa caturthī ca śanaiścare |
gurau śubhā pañcamī syāt ṣaṣṭhī maṃgalaśukrayoḥ ||23||
saptamī somaputreṇa aṣṭamī kujabhāskarau |
navamī candravāreṇa daśamī tu gurau śubhā ||24||
ekādaśyāṃ guruḥ śuddho dvādaśyāṃ ca punarbudhaḥ |
trayodaśī śukrabhaumau śanau śreṣṭhā caturdaśī ||25||
paurṇamāsyapyamāvāsyā śreṣṭhā syācca bṛhaspatau |
mūle’rkaḥ śravaṇe candraḥ proṣṭhapadyuttare kujaḥ ||26||
kṛttikāsu budhaścaiva gurau cātha punarvasuḥ |
pūrvaphalgunī śukre ca svātiścaiva śanaiścare ||27||
ete cāmṛtayogāḥ syuḥ sarvakāryaprasādhakāḥ |
haste’rkaśca guruḥ puṣye anurādhā budhe śubhā || 28||
rohiṇī ca śanau śreṣṭhā saumaṃ somena vai śubham |
śukre ca revatī śreṣṭhā aśvinī maṃgale śubhā ||29||
eteṣu siddhiyogā vai sarvadoṣavināśakāḥ |
kāryasiddhipradāścaiva tatra kāryaṃ samārabhet ||1.150.3 0||
aśvinīmatrarevatyo mṛgamūlā punarvasuḥ |
puṣyā hastā tathā jyeṣṭhā prasthāne śreṣṭhamucyate || 31 ||
yoginyo’pi praboddhavyāḥ sanmukhe’tīva duḥkhadāḥ |
brahmāṇī saṃsthitā pūrvaṃ pratipannavamītithau || 32||
māheśvarī cottare ca dvitīyādaśamītithau |
pañcamyāṃ ca trayodaśyāṃ vārāhī dakṣiṇe sthitā |||33||
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva caturdaśyāmindrāṇī paścime sthitā |
saptamyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca cāmuṇḍā vāyugocare || 34||
aṣṭamyamāvāsyayoge mahālakṣmīśagocare |
ekādaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāmagnikoṇe tu vaiṣṇavī ||35||
dvādaśyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ tu kaumārī nairṛte tathā |
yoginīsammukhe naiva gamanādi prakārayet ||36||
caturthī cāśubhā ṣaṣṭhī aṣṭamī navamī tathā |
amāvāsyā pūrṇimā ca dvādaśī ca caturdaśī ||37||
dvādaśīṃ dahate bhānuḥ śaśī caikādaśīṃ dahet |
kujo dahecca daśamīṃ navamīṃ ca budho dahet ||38||
aṣṭamīṃ dahati jīvaḥ saptamīṃ bhārgavo dahet |
sūryaputro dahet ṣaṣṭhīṃ gamanādyāsu nāsti vai ||39||
pratipannavamīṣveva caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca |
budhavāre ca prasthānaṃ dūrataḥ parivarjayet ||1.150.40 ||
meṣe karkaṭake ṣaṣṭhī kanyāyāṃ mithune’ṣṭamī |
vṛṣe kuṃbhe caturthī ca dvādaśī makare tule ||41||
daśamī vṛścike siṃhe dhanurmīne caturdaśī |
etā dagdhā na gantavyaṃ kila jīvādimānavaiḥ |||42||
viśākhātrayamāditye pūrvāṣāḍhātraye śaśī |
dhaniṣṭhātṛtīyaṃ bhaume budhe vai revatītrayam ||43||
rohiṇyāditrayaṃ jīve śukre puṣyātrayaṃ tathā |
śanivāre varjayecca uttarāphalgunītrayam ||44||
eṣa autpātiko yogo mṛtyurogādikaṃ bhavet |
viṣkaṃbhe ghaṭikāḥ pañca śūle sapta prakīrtitāḥ ||45|||
ṣaṭ gaṇḍe cātigaṇḍe ca nava vyāghātavajrayoḥ |
vyatīpāte parīghe ca vaidhṛte ca dine dine ||46||
ete mṛtyuyutā hyeṣu sarvakarmāṇi varjayet |
viśākhā cottarā trīṇi maghārdrā bharaṇī tathā ||47||
āśleṣā kṛttikāḥ caitāḥ prasthāne maraṇapradāḥ |
tadetadvai vicāryaiva prasthānaṃ sukhadaṃ bhavet ||48||
pūrṇakuṃbhaṃ dvijaṃ veśyāṃ śukladhānyāni darpaṇam |
dadhyājyaṃ madhulājām̐śca puṣpaṃ dūrvākṣatān sitān ||49||
vṛṣaṃ gajendraṃ turagaṃ jvaladagniṃ suvarṇakam |
ūrṇa ca paripakvāni phalāni vividhāni ca ||1.150.50||
patiputravatīṃ nārīṃ pradīpaṃ maṇimuttamam |
muktāṃ prasūnamālāṃ ca sadyomāṃsaṃ ca candanam ||5 1||
puro dṛśyanta etāni vastūni maṃgalāni vai |
vipraḥ kanyā śavaṃ gauśca śaṃkho bherī vasundharā ||52|
veṇuḥ strīḥ pūrṇakuṃbhaśca yātrāyāṃ darśane śubhāḥ |
savye śivoṣṭrakharanakulakuṃbhaśavāḥ śubhāḥ |||23 ||
rājahaṃso mayūraśca khañjanaśca śukaḥ pikaḥ |
pārāvataḥ śaṃkhacillaścakravākaśca māṃgalā ||54||
kṛṣṇasāraśca surabhiḥ camarīḥ śvetacāmaram |
dhenurvatsaprayuktā ca patākā dakṣiṇe śubhāḥ ||55||
kārpāsauṣadhitailāni pakvāṅgārabhujaṅgamāḥ |
muktakeśī raktamālyaṃ nagnādyaśubhamīkṣitam ||56||
hikkāgneye śokakarī dakṣiṇe hānidā matā |
nairṛtye codvegakarī paścime miṣṭabhuktidā ||57||
vāyavye’rthapradā proktā uttare kalahaṃkarī |
īśāne mṛtyudā ceti jñeyaṃ śubhāśubhaṃ phalam ||58||
tīrthe sadaiva gantavyaṃ sarve māsāśca śobhanāḥ |
tithayaścottamāḥ sarvāḥ snānadānārcanādiṣu ||59||
vasante tīrthayātrāyāḥ prayāṇaṃ śreṣṭhamucyate |
nigṛhya niyamān bhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ ||1.150.60 ||
gajavājirathān tyaktvā pādābhyāṃ yānti ye janāḥ |
haṃsayuktavimānena yānti te kṛṣṇamandiram ||6 1 ||
ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca |
bhikṣāhāreṇa toyena phalāhāreṇa vā yadi |||62||
upavāsena kṛcchreṇa śākāhāreṇa vā janāḥ |
tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvanti teṣāṃ lokāstu śāśvatāḥ ||63||
yadvā yāti divaṃ devīgaṇaiḥ saṃvījito’rcitaḥ |
anupānatpado yātrākartā yātyarkamaṇḍalam ||64||
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ deśaṃ bhrātṛsvajanabāndhavān |
grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā kṛtvā cendriyasaṃyamam |||65||
gṛhītvā vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ raivataṃ yāti yo janaḥ |
bhuktirmuktirbhavettasya dāmodaraprabhāvataḥ ||66||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne prasthānayātrādau śubhāśubhagrahanakṣatravārayoginīśakunādipradarśananāmā pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 150||

<1.151>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tataḥ sārasvataḥ prāha rājānaṃ bhojapuṃgavam |
miṣṭānnaṃ bhojanaṃ ramyaṃ pānamuccāvacaṃ śubham || 1 ||
pūjārhāṇi ca pātrāṇi puṣpāṇyupaskarāṇi ca |
vastrāṇi dānayogyāni sugandhicandanāni ca || 2 ||
kamalāni vicitrāṇi svarṇarūpyādyalaṃkṛtīn |
skandhe nidhāya padbhyāṃ ca yātrāṃ karoti yo janaḥ || 3 ||
arpayitvā ca haryagre’kṣayapuṇyamavāpnuyāt |
gaṃgodakaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ kuṃkumāgurucandanam || 4 ||
guggulaṃ bilvapatrāṇi dhattūrakusumaṃ tathā |
pādacārī bhajan devaṃ skandhe svayaṃ nidhāya ca || 5 ||
bhavanāthaṃ tu yo gacched dṛṣṭvā nivedayettathā |
svarṇanadyāṃ tathā snātvā dāmodaraṃ samarcayet || 6 ||
sarvabandhavinirmuktaḥ sa vai kailāsamāpnuyāt |
gaṇo mukto bhavatyeva yāvadābhūtasamplavam || 7 ||
kalatramitraputrairvā bhrātṛbhiḥ sujanairjanaiḥ |
suhṛtsambandhibhiścānyairyāti devaṃ smaram̐stu yaḥ || 8 ||
sa tanmaṇḍalasahitaḥ svargaṃ yātyādivākaram |
devamūrtiṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā rathasthāṃ supratiṣṭhitām || 9 ||
candanāgurukarpūrairarcitāṃ kuṃkumena ca |
pūjayan vividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpādikaistathā || 1.151.10 ||
gītanṛtyaiḥ savāditrairhāsyairlāsyairanekadhā |
dharitrīṃ kāṃcanaṃ gāṃ ca jalānnavasanāni ca || 11 ||
tṛṇendhane priyāṃ vāṇīṃ yacchan yāti tu raivate |
dāmodare tathā bhaveśvare gatvārcayatyatha || 12||
svarṇavatyāṃ taḍāge vā kuṇḍe ca raivatīkṛte |
snāti japati govindaṃ dadātyannāni bhūriśaḥ || 1 3||
tatra yacchati dānāni sarvasvāni ca yo janaḥ |
devāṃganākaragrāhe gṛhīto nandane vane || 14||
gatvā bhuṃkte śubhān bhogān yāvadācandratārakam |
tīrthe vipravacaḥ kṛtvā snātvā sandhyārcanādike || 15||
darbhāṃstilān haviṣyānnaṃ prayuñjyācchraddhayā tataḥ |
agastaṃ bhṛṃgarājaṃ ca puṣpaṃ śatadalaṃ śubham || 16||
karpūrāguruśrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tulasīdalam |
tīrthe saṃkalpitaṃ martyaistadanantaṃ prajāyate || 17||
bilvapramāṇapiṇḍāni dadyādvai tīrthabhūmiṣu |
tāmbūlaphalanaivaidyatiladarbhodakaistathā || 18||
māsāntare śuklapakṣe kṣayāhe mātṛpaitṛke |
gajacchāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ dravye prāpte dvijottame || 19||
gṛhe śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṛṇāmṛṇamuktaye |
gṛhācchataguṇaṃ nadyāṃ yā nadī yāti sāgaram ||1.151.20 ||
tato’nantaguṇaṃ devamandire devasannidhau |
prabhāse puṣkare tīrthe gayāyāṃ piṇḍatārake ||21 ||
prayāge cātha gomatyāṃ bhāve dāmodare tathā |
narmadāyāṃ tapatyāṃ ca kuryācchrāddhaṃ trivikrame |||22||
svarṇarakṣāpagāyāśca nārāyaṇahrade tathā |
ojasvatyāṃ ca bhadrāyāṃ tathā śatrujitātaṭe ||23 ||
vāmanasthalakuṇḍāgre kuryācchrāddhaṃ naro yadi |
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ pitaro yānti sadgatim ||24||
santānamuttamaṃ labdhvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān |
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya śrāddhakṛdyāti mokṣaṇam |||25||
jātakarmādiyajñeṣu vivāhe gṛhakarmaṇi |
devapratiṣṭhāprārambhe kūpavāpyādikarmaṇi ||26||
tṛpyanti devatāḥ sarvā hṛṣyanti pitaro nṛṇām |
vṛddhiśrāddhe kṛte gehe jāyate sarvamaṃgalam |||27||
kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madyaṃ madādayaḥ |
māyāmātsaryapaiśunyamaviveko’vicāritā || 28||
ahaṃkāro yadṛcchā ca cāpalyaṃ laulyamityapi |
anyāyasādhanāyāsaḥ pramādo drohasāhase ||29||
ālasyaṃ dīrghasūtratvaṃ paradāropasevanam |
ete doṣāḥ sadā tyājyāstīrthagāminarādinā || 1.151.3 0||
sa syādvai maṇḍanaṃ bhūmedeśasya nagarasya ca |
śrīmān vidvān kulīnaḥ syāt sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 31 ||
snānaṃ sandhyā japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam |
śrāddhaṃ devasya pūjā ca tyaktadoṣasya jāyate || 32|||
utthāyotthāya snātavyaṃ pūjyau hariharau tathā |
satyaṃ vācyaṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 33|||
parāpavādabhīrutvaṃ paradāravivarjanam |
tairthikadoṣāgrāhitvaṃ sevanaṃ ca satāṃ mudā ||34||
pitṛmātṛgurūṇāṃ ca nāpriyaṃ manasā vahet |
auṣadhaṃ śākamarthibhyo dātavyaṃ gṛhamedhinā || 36 ||
ekādaśī pañcadaśī caturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca |
amāyāṃ ca vyatīpāte saṃkrānto grahaṇeṣu ca || 36 ||
vaidhṛtau pitṛmātṝṇāṃ kṣayāhe śubhavāsare |
yugamanvādidivase gṛhe kāryo mahotsavaḥ || 37||
tīrthe vā gamanaṃ kāryaṃ puṇyaṃ śataguṇaṃ bhavet |
indriyāṇāṃ jayaḥ kāryo madyadyūtavivarjanam || 38 ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ surapūjā dvijārcanam |
sādhusādhvīprapūjā ca kartavyākṣayapuṇyadā || 39 ||
ekāpi goḥ pradātavyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitā |
dogdhrī savastrā taruṇī savatsā sudvijāya ca ||1.151.40 ||
sādhave’nnasubhojyāni sādhvyai vastrādyalaṃkṛtiḥ |
deyānyannāni vastūni yathā syādvai prasannatā || 41 ||
saptajanmasu pāpiṣṭha iha janmani cādhamaḥ |
ekāṃ dadāti yo dhenuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||4 2 ||
yadāsau nīyate baddho yamamārgeṇa kiṃkaraiḥ |
tadā dhenuḥ samāgatya svaṃ putramiva rakṣati ||43 ||
vijitya huṃkṛtenaiva tān dūtān dūrataḥ kṛtān |
gaurdātāraṃ samādāya yāti vai harimandiram ||44||
vṛṣo dharma iti proktastīrthe dānaṃ vṛṣasya ca |
kartavyaṃ rakṣayed dharmo dātāraṃ nayate divam ||45 ||
grāsamātrāpi bhikṣā sattīrthe deyā gṛhasthitaiḥ |
kuṃbhapatrādisiddhānnachatropānatkamaṇḍalum || 46 ||
aṃgulīyakavāsāṃsi datvā yāti naro divi |
pānaṃ śrāntatṛṣārtāya kṣudhārtāyānnameva ca ||47 ||
nagnāya vastraṃ saṃdeyaṃ devyo nayanti taṃ divam |
bhojanaṃ satataṃ deyaṃ yathāśaktyā ghṛtaplutam || 48 ||
śutpīḍā mahatī loke tasyānnaṃ bheṣajaṃ matam |
tena sā śāntimāyāti cānnadānaṃ taduttamam ||49 ||
annaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ takra śākaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu |
patraṃ puṣpaṃ tathopānat kanthā yaṣṭiḥ kamaṇḍaluḥ || 1.151.5 0 ||
chatraṃ pātraṃ tathā vidyā pustakaṃ ca surārcanam |
kanyākuśopanītāni bījauṣadhigṛhāṇi ca || 51 ||
ratnaṃ kṣetraṃ yajñapātraṃ yogapaṭṭaṃ ca pāduke |
kṛṣṇājinaṃ buddhidānaṃ dharmadeśakathānakam ||52 ||
tīrthe gatvā bahu deyaṃ tena śreyo mahadbhavet |
sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā dātā yāti hareḥ padam || 53 ||
aśvamedhādibhiryajñairgayāyāṃ piṇḍadānataḥ |
yatphalaṃ syānnṛṇāṃ tatsyād dṛṣṭe dāmodare bhuvi ||54||
ekādaśyāṃ kṛtasnāno devapūjāparo bhavet |
paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya snātvā tīrthodakena ca ||55||
kuṃkumāguruśrīkhaṇḍakarpūrodakamiśritaiḥ |
pūjayitvā tataḥ puṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ ||56||
mālatīkusumaiḥ śubhrairbahubhistulasīdalaiḥ |
vastraṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhūpaṃ caiva pradhūpayet ||57||
dīpaṃ dadyād ghṛtenaiva tailenāpi ghṛtaṃ vinā |
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyāt phalaṃ tāmbūlamityapi |||58||
prāsādapūjāṃ kuryācca dhvajadānādinā tathā |
gāṃ savatsāṃ tato dadyāt saṃsārārṇavatāriṇīm |||59||
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ |
vedapāṭhapurāṇaiśca vyākhyādivyakathānakaiḥ ||1.151.60||
devāgre jāgaraṃ kuryād dīpadyotitabhūmiṣu |
saptadhānyamayān sapta parvatān dīpasaṃyutān ||61||
phalatāmbūlapakvānnapūjitān parikalpayet |
vidvadbhiḥ śrotriyaiḥ śāntairbrāhmaṇaiḥ sādhubhistathā ||62||
sādhvībhiśca gṛhasthaiśca śrotavyā vaiṣṇavī kathā |
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ rāgadveṣādivarjitaiḥ ||63||
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrāvudite sūryamaṇḍale |
pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ kṛtasnānaḥ kṛtvā madhyāhnamācaret ||64||
devān pitṝn manuṣyām̐śca tarpitvā vidhipūrvakam |
kṛtvā snānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca dānaṃ dadyāttu śaktitaḥ ||65||
devaṃ dāmodaraṃ puṣpadhūpādinā prapūjya ca |
raivatīkuṇḍasalile snānaṃ kuryāt tataḥ punaḥ ||66 ||
rādhāderīdarśanaṃ vai kuryācca svarṇadījale |
tata ārohaṇavāpyāṃ pragacchecca hanūmataḥ ||67||
darśanaṃ ca prakuryādvai jalaṃ pibet| tataḥ punaḥ |
parvatārohaṇaṃ kuryād yadvāgacchet puraṃ prati ||68||
trievikramaraṇacchoḍadarśanaṃ saṃvidhāya ca |
vividhāni ca dānāni bhojanādīni sarvathā ||69 ||
datvā kṛtvā pragacchecca svālayaṃ tīrthakārakaḥ |
iti te tīrthakaraṇaṃ kathitaṃ mokṣadaṃ param ||1.151.70||
śrutvaitad bhojarājo’pi jagāma raivatācalam |
dadarśa mukhyatīrthāni maṃgalāni vidhāya ca ||71 ||
bhavaṃ dāmodaraṃ svarṇarakṣāṃ mṛgānanāsthalīm |
ambāṃ dattātreyarūpaṃ nārāyaṇahradaṃ tathā ||72||
raivatācalamālokya gaṃgāṃ gomukhikāṃ tathā |
trivikramaraṇacchoḍamandiraṃ vāmanasthalīm ||73||
balermakhasthalīṃ bhadrāṃ tathā kuṃkumavāpikām |
ojasvatīṃ somanāthaṃ suvarṇadvārikāṃ tathā ||74||
tīrthānyevaṃ vividhāni kṛtvā datvā mahīṃ ca gāḥ |
suvarṇarajatādīni ratnābhūṣaṇakāni ca ||75||
vastrāṇyannāni viprebhyaḥ sādhusādhvībhya eva ca |
dīnāndhakṛpaṇādibhyo datvā deyāni bhūriśaḥ ||76||
ājagāma skakaṃ rājyaṃ kānyakubjaṃ narādhipaḥ |
svarājñyā saha yātrāyā mahotsavamakārayat ||77||
tāvad bhojasya dṛṣṭirvai divyābhūt puṇyayogataḥ |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ cātha kailāsaṃ hariṃ haraṃ sapārṣadam ||78||
dadarśa suvimānaṃ ca divya mokṣakaraṃ tataḥ |
pārṣadaiḥ sthāpitastatra sastrīko divyavigrahaḥ ||79||
yayau vaikuṇṭhamevāyaṃ mukto bhūtvā harerbalāt |
ityuktaste camatkāro raivatasya priye rame ||1.151.80||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne tīrthavidhidānādipradarśananāmaikapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 151 ||

<1.152>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tīrthe pālyām̐śca niyamān yamām̐śca vacmi padmaje |
niyamānāṃ yamānāṃ ca pālanaṃ phaladaṃ bhavet || 1 ||
kāmakrodhavijetā yo lobhamohādivarjitaḥ |
śraddhāluścāstikaḥ śuddhaḥ sa tīrthaphalabhāgbhavet || 2 ||
karapādodarajihvāmanaḥśiśnāni yasya hi |
saṃyatāni bhaveyurvai sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 3 ||
satyavāk suvrataḥ śāntaḥ sarveṣvātmopamadṛśiḥ |
tapovidyākṛtaśuddhiḥ satīrthaphalamaśnute || 4 ||
tīrthe hyupoṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ kṣauraṃ śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam |
bhojanīyāḥ sādhusādhvyo dānaṃ deyaṃ tu bhāvataḥ || 5 ||
nārīṇāṃ pativatnīnāṃ kṣauraṃ naiva vidhīyate |
parīkṣā bhojanīyānāṃ kartavyā naiva kenacit || 6 ||
tatratyadevatānāṃ ca kartavyaṃ mukhyamarcanam |
bhūṣāvāsodravyapātraphalanaivedyavastubhiḥ || 7 ||
aśaktastu namaḥ kuryāt tathā sammārjanādikam |
sādhucaraṇaśuśraṣāṃ sevāṃ prasannatāpradām || 8 ||
sādhavaḥ sevitā yena tanumānasavastubhiḥ |
mahāpūjāphalaṃ tasya sarvaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ bhavet || 9 ||
sādhavastoṣitā yena sarvasvārpaṇasādhanaiḥ |
sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya sādhurnārāyaṇo yataḥ || 1.152.1 0||
puṇyatīrtheṣu yatkāryaṃ kriyate sānusaṃgame |
sahasraguṇitaṃ cāpyanantaphalakaraṃ bhavet || 1 1||
kṛtaṃ tīrthe svalpamapi tīrthabalādvivardhate |
puṇyaṃ vivardhate nityaṃ pāpaṃ tu līyate sadā || 12||
tīrtha kṛtānāṃ jīvānāṃ pāpaleśo na vidyate |
tārayati janān yasmāt tasmāt tattīrthamucyate || 13||
yadyat karoti sat tīrthe sarvaṃ tatpuṇyadaṃ bhavet |
niyamena ca tīrthe vai sthātavyaṃ tanudhāribhiḥ || 14||
manaḥśuddhiṃ tathā sevāṃ satāṃ kuryāddhi tīrthakṛt |
lubdhasya piśunasyātha krūrasya dābhikasya ca || 15||
malinasya ca caurasya nāstikasya śaṭhasya ca |
nindakasya tathā drogdhurna syāt tīrthaphalaṃ kvacit || 16||
śārīramalasaṃtyāge mano na nirmalaṃ bhavet |
doṣadṛṣṭiparityāge manastu nirmalaṃ bhavet || 17||
rāgadveṣau malarūpau tattyāge nirmalo bhavet |
nārībhiśca narairvāpi tīrthe vīkṣyā tu divyatā || 18||
divyabhāvena svasyāntardivyatā vardhate’nvaham |
divyāntaḥkaraṇe dhāryo bhagavān tīrthamaṇḍale || 1 9||
sa vai saṃtārayed bhaktaṃ nirmalaṃ puṇyabhājanam |
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryamanāgrahaḥ || 1.152.20||
śaucaṃ tapaśca santoṣaḥ svādhyāyo bhajanaṃ hareḥ |
japaśca pūjanaṃ devadarśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ natiḥ |||21||
kartavyāni viśeṣeṇa pūrṇaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ bhavet |
krodhastīrthe na kartavyaḥ puṇyaprajvālako hi saḥ |||22|
tīrthe’nyasya na bhoktavyaṃ peyaṃ nānyasya vai kvacit |
pratigrahaśca na grāhyastapastejoharo hi saḥ |||23||
laḍḍukairmauktikaiḥ ramyaiḥ kasārairghṛtapūrakaiḥ |
saṃyāvapāyasāpūpaiḥ śaṣkulīkhājakādibhiḥ |||24||
parpikāpiṇḍakādyaiśca vyañjanairdvidalādibhiḥ |
dadhidugdhaiśca takraiśca śrīkhaṇḍadaugdhasadrasaiḥ ||25||
ghṛtaśarkarasupakvaiścānyairbhakṣyasulehyakaiḥ |
tarpaṇīyāḥ sādhuviprasādhvyaśca dīnabālakāḥ ||26|||
pitarastena tṛptāḥ syustasya puṇyamanantakam |
bhoktavyaṃ bhojanīyāśca tīrthasya phalamicchatā |||27||
vandhyaṃ tīrthaṃ na vai kuryāt yadi saukhyaṃ samīhate |
jaḍatīrthāt cetanaṃ tu tīrthaṃ tīrthottamaṃ matam ||28||
santaḥ sādhvyo yoginaśca yatayo brahmacāriṇaḥ |
te sarve cetanaṃ tīrthaṃ tallābhe sukṛtaṃ mahat ||29||
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa tīrthasevā vidhīyate |
taponiyamasatkāle phalaṃ tvanantakaṃ bhavet || 1.152.30 ||
alpāyāsān bahuphalān putralakṣmīpradāyakān |
cāturmāsyavrataśreṣṭhān kurvataḥ phalamakṣayam ||3 1||
gāṃ spṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ natvā sampūjya sādhudaivatān |
tapasvinaṃ yatiṃ śāntaṃ śrotriyaṃ brahmacāriṇam |||32||
mātāpitarau bhaginīṃ tatpatiṃ duhituḥ patim |
bhāgineyaṃ ca dauhitraṃ mitrasambandhibāndhavān |||33||
sādhvīḥ satīśca kanyāśca dīnāndhakṛpaṇān janān |
bālān vṛddhānāturām̐śca gāścātithīnanāthakān ||34||
bhikṣukān kṣudhitān śrāntān pathikān tīrthavāsinaḥ |
bhojayitvā pātakaiḥ saṃmucyante gṛhamedhinaḥ ||35||
rājā gajāśvanakulasatīvṛṣamahīdharāḥ |
ādarśakṣīravṛkṣānnapradāḥ sādhujanāstathā |||36||
jalasthalātmatīrthāni devamandiramūrtayaḥ |
dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punantyete cāturmāsyavratasthitāḥ ||37||
vedadharmakathāṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā muktiparānnarān |
smṛtvā lakṣmīṃ hariṃ śaṃbhuṃ śivāṃ gaṃgāṃ ca svarṇadīm ||38||
kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇordatvā dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ |
tāmbūlaṃ kusumaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyaṃ tulasīdalam ||39||
gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca vidhāya suramandire |
mahodayamavāpnoti phalaṃ svargyaṃ ca mokṣadam ||1.152.40||
indriyāṇāṃ ca manasa aikāgryaṃ tapa uttamam |
tadaikāgryaṃ vāsudeve kāryaṃ dhyānādinā janaiḥ ||41 ||
ṛṣayo munayaścāturmāsye jaihvaṃ rasaṃ drutam |
jitvā tapaḥ prakurvanti tīrthayātrāphalāptaye ||42||
phalāhāraḥ payaḥpānaṃ caikabhuktamathāpi vā |
śākatyāgo’thavā śākamātrāhārastilādanam ||43 ||
dadhiprāśo ghṛtatyāgaścaikānnabhojanaṃ tathā |
māṣamudgādimātrasya bhojanaṃ vratameva vā ||44||
bhūśayanaṃ jalasnānaṃ tailābhyaṃgādivarjanam |
bhajanaṃ pūjanaṃ mālājapaḥ śrīharikīrtanam ||45||
kathāyāḥ śravaṇaṃ nityamiṣṭadevasya darśanam |
sādhūnāṃ sevanaṃ tīrthe vrataṃ puṇyapradaṃ bahu ||46||
brāhmaṇaḥ sādhavaścārcyā bhojanīyāśca sadrasaiḥ |
ṣoḍaśopacāravaryairnityaṃ kṛṣṇārhaṇaṃ vratam ||47||
sādhūnāṃ pūjanaṃ nityaṃ yadvā homo vrataṃ param |
ghṛtaikṣavalavaṇādervarjanaṃ ca vrata matam ||48 ||
nityaṃ bhagavate’rpyaiva peyaṃ khādyaṃ ca tadvratam |
kṛtena karmaṇā yena sādhavo bhagavām̐stathā ||49 ||
prīyeran tadvrataṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ mokṣadaṃ yataḥ |
mātāpitrorguroḥ sevā vratānāṃ vratamuttamam ||1.152.5 0 ||
patyuḥ sevā vrataṃ patnyāḥ patnītoṣaṃ pativratam |
śiṣyavrataṃ guroḥ sevā śiṣyatoṣo gurorvratam ||5 1 ||
raivate kārtikavrataṃ kartavyaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ |
vaṭatāle hariharakṣetre ca kapilāśrame ||52 ||
vrataṃ māsopavāsākhyamathavā cāndrakālikam |
cāndrāyaṇaṃ vrataṃ kārya pūrṇimātastapaḥ śubham |||53 ||
āśvīnapūrṇimāyāṃ vai kavalā daśa pañca ca |
kārtikakṛṣṇapratipaddine grāsāścaturdaśa ||54||
ekaikasya tithikramāddhrāso vai kavalasya ca |
amāyāmupavāsaḥ syātpratipadyeka eva ca ||55||
grāsadvayaṃ dvitīyāyāmevamāpūrṇimāvadhi |
grāsavṛddhiryathātithivṛddhi kāryaṃ ca tadvratam ||56 ||
grāsaścaikena yatnena galādho yāti tādṛśaḥ |
na nyūno nādhiko vāpi vratārthe sammataḥ sadā ||57||
yadvānyat tīrthakartṝṇāṃ tapovratamudīryate |
udayāstāvadhi divā jalakṛcchraṃ jale sthitiḥ || 58 ||
daśamyāṃ gomūtraśakṛdghṛtadugdhadadhigrahaḥ |
ekādaśyāmupavāso harikṛcchravrataṃ hi tat ||5 9 ||
saptamītaḥ kramādgrāhyaṃ jalaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhighṛtam |
ekādaśyāmupavāsaḥ kṛcchraḥ paitāmahastu saḥ || 1.152.60 ||
ṣaṣṭhītastridinaṃ dugdhapānaṃ tryahamupoṣaṇam |
māhendrakṛcchra ityuktastīrthe kāryo viśeṣataḥ ||6 1 ||
tṛtīyātastryahaṃ bhojyaṃ nivārādi tatastryaham |
yavādikaṃ tryahamupoṣaṇaṃ kṛcchraḥ sa vaiṣṇavaḥ ||6 2||
pañcadinaṃ payaḥpānaṃ pañcāhaṃ dadhibhojanam |
ekādaśyāmupavāso bhāskarakṛcchra ucyate ||6 3 ||
pañcamītaḥ kramāt bhājīṃ yavān śākaṃ dadhi kṣīram |
ghṛtaṃ jalamekādaśyām ṛṣikṛcchraḥ sa ucyate ||64||
palāśabilvadarbhābjodumbaraparṇasuśṛtam |
payaḥ peyaṃ pratipadaḥ ṣaṣṭhyā kuryādupoṣaṇam || 65||
tadidaṃ vratamāgneyakṛcchrākhyaṃ samudīritam |
saptamītaḥ payobilvāṃbujamṛṇālabhakṣaṇam ||66 ||
ekādaśyāmupavāso lakṣmīkṛcchra udīritaḥ |
ekādaśadineṣveva parṇādaḥ parṇakṛcchrakṛt || 67||
tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahaṃ bhojyamayācitam |
tryahaṃ copavaset kṛcchraḥ prājāpatya udīritaḥ ||68 ||
dvādaśāhopavāsaistu pārākakṛcchra ucyate |
phalamātragrahaṇena phalakṛcchraḥ prakīrtyate ||69 ||
jalamātragrahaṇena jalakṛcchraḥ sa ucyate |
dalamātragrahaṇena dalakṛcchrastathocyate ||1.152.7 0 ||
puṣpamātragrahaṇena puṣpakṛcchraḥ prakīrtyate |
bījamātragrahaṇena bījakṛcchraḥ sa bhaṇyate ||7 1 ||
tilamātragrahaṇena caṇakagrahaṇena ca |
bharjitataṇḍulagrāhe tattatkṛcchraḥ sa ucyate ||72||
pakvakṛcchraścāmakṛcchraḥ saktukṛcchraudanavrate |
kārtike śuklapakṣe te kṛcchrāḥ kāryā vidhānataḥ ||73 ||
tattadbhagavato bhaktyā sahitā eva sarvathā |
bhuktimuktiphaladāste’nyathā tu svargadā matāḥ ||74||
kṛcchramadhye bhavenmūrchā gokṣīraṃ pāyayettadā |
jalaṃ mūlaṃ phalaṃ dugdhaṃ patraṃ puṣpaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhi ||75 ||
takraṃ tailaṃ śarkarādi munyannaṃ śākamabdhijam |
karpūraṃ tvaṅlavaṃgailātiktamarīcamauṣadham ||76 ||
mukhaśuddhikaradravyamārdrakaṃ kvāthamityapi |
caturviśatitattvānyavrataghnāni bhavanti hi || 77 ||
athavāyācitaṃ bhaikṣyamapakvāśanameva vā |
śākatyāgaḥ phalatyāgo rasatyāgo’nnasutyajiḥ ||78 ||
kṣāratyāgo daugdhavastutyāga aikṣavasutyajiḥ |
vratānyetāni sūktāni bhuktimuktikarāṇi vai ||7 9 ||
tīrthe kāryāṇi caitāni varṣāsu kārtike’thavā |
annadānaṃ jaladānaṃ vastradānaṃ sahāyakṛt ||1.152.8 0 ||
yānadānaṃ bhuvo dānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gavārpaṇam |
svarṇadānaṃ tiladānaṃ dīpadānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam ||8 1 ||
evaṃ svāpekṣitaṃ sarvaṃ dātavyaṃ punaricchatā |
ramādāmodarasyāpi pūjanaṃ vratamucyate ||8 2||
ketakījātyagastīnāṃ kusumairambujairapi |
kamalaistulasīpatrairlakṣeṇa pūjayeddharim ||8 3 ||
patre patre ca kusume’śvamedhaphalamāpnuyāt |
dhātrīphalarasāktāṃgo dhātrīphalasubhojanaḥ ||84 ||
dhātrīphalabhūṣitāṃgo dhātrīchāyāsamāśritaḥ |
dāmodaraṃ samabhyarcya vrajennārāyaṇaṃ padam ||85||
deyaṃ ākāśadīpaśca devālaye niśāmukhe |
pakvānnāni pradeyāni devāya dhanibhiḥ sadā ||86 ||
gṛhṇīyāt kārtike dīkṣāṃ mahābhāgavatīṃ janaḥ |
hareḥ padārpitāṃ mālāṃ tulasījāṃ gale dharet ||87||
sā vyaktirmucyate nūnaṃ janmasaṃsārabandhanāt |
ekenāpi vratenorje cāturmāsyaphalaṃ labhet ||88||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne pālanīyayamaniyamadānakṛcchravratādinirūpaṇanāmā dvipaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 152||

<1.153>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
vastrāpathasya vāyavye koṇe divyaṃ sarovaram |
tasya paścimadigbhāge vanaṃ gahanabhūruham || 1 ||
bilvavṛkṣamayaṃ tatra madhye liṃgaṃ tu mṛnmayam |
tatraiko lubdhakaḥ prāpto vasante jalakāṃkṣayā || 2 ||
pippalasya drumasyādhaḥ samāgatya vyavasthitaḥ |
mūle kṣaṇaṃ tu viśramya jalaṃ pātuṃ ca gacchati || 3 ||
tāvattena tadā dṛṣṭau puruṣau kṛṣṇapāṇḍurau |
pītāmbaracarmavastrau sukeśasujaṭādharau || 4 ||
kaustubhamuṇḍakadharau cakratriśūlahastakau |
vṛndārudrākṣamālau ca padmanetra trinetrakau || 5 ||
tilakacandrakabhālau padmāsatīprasevitau |
patattrivāsukiyuktau kambunīlābhasadvalau || 6 ||
divyau poṣāntakarūpau jīvanivṛttiyatnakau |
satvatamaḥparākrāntau vyomamārgāvalambinau || 7 ||
bilvavanaṃ prati yātau yāvat paśyati lubdhakaḥ |
tāvattāvaddṛśyabhāvaṃ liṃge ca prastare gatau || 8 ||
śveto liṃge’bhavalluptaḥ kṛṣṇastu prastare gataḥ |
lubdhakaśca tadāścaryayukto jagāma tatsthale || 9 ||
tāvalliṃgaṃ mṛnmayaṃ ca viṣṇumūrtiṃ śilāmayīm |
dṛṣṭvā tu lubdhakastatra jalapānaṃ vihāya ca ||1.153.10||
tatraiva susthito devau cintayam̐statra bhāvataḥ |
kṣudhitastṛṣitaḥ sāyamevameva vyavasthitaḥ ||11||
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ sāyaṃ vṛttamidaṃ yadā||
nirjane tatra tau devau saṃsmṛtya ca punaḥ punaḥ ||12||
lubdhako bilvapatrāṇi padmāni sarasastathā |
samādāyārpayatyetau liṅgaviṣṇū bhajan muhuḥ ||13||
paścājjalaṃ parigṛhya snāpitau puṣpapūjitau |
vanditau tāvatā rātryā madhye tau nīlapāṇḍurau ||14||
tasmādeva samudbhūtau puruṣau divyavigrahau |
prāhatustaṃ lubdhakaṃ tau yasmādatra vanāntare ||15||
tvayāgatyādya divase bilvapadme samarpite |
etatpūjāprabhāveṇa dagdhānyaṃhāṃsi te tathā ||16||
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ svargaṃ va sa devaśarīrakaḥ |
lubdhakastvaṃ bhava devaḥ śivarātriprapūjanāt ||17||
śivarātrervratayogāt śivarātri prajāgarāt |
pippalādhonivāsācca viṣṇubhakto bhaviṣyasi ||18||
evaṃ varaṃ pradatvaiva tirobhūtau harirharaḥ |
tāvat tatra vimānaṃ surukmavarṇaṃ śaśiprabham ||19||
avātaradvyomamārgād apsarobhiḥ suśobhitam |
sarvasmṛddhisamāyuktaṃ dāsadāsīnivāsitam ||1.153.20||
devyaḥ prāha tadā taṃ vai lubdhakaṃ puṇyaśālinam |
āgaccha kānta susvargaṃ vayaṃ klṛptāśca te’ṅganāḥ ||21||
bhavān devo’sti sampannaḥ śivaviṣṇuprapūjanāt |
māghe some caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ jāgare kṛte ||22||
tadetallabhyate sarvaṃ samāroha gṛhāṇa ca |
evaṃ divyāṃganāstaṃ ca lubdhakaṃ kāntameva ha ||23||
kṛtvāvimānamāropya jagmurdivaṃ hareḥ puram |
indro’pi taṃ samālokya tadātyantasuvismitaḥ ||24||
lubdhakaśca tadā pṛṣṭaḥ kena puṇyena labdhavān |
uktavān sa tadā śaivarātryāṃ tayostu darśanam ||25||
vrataṃ pūjāṃ yathāvṛttaṃ tatsarvaṃ devarūpavān |
tataḥ punaḥ samāyāte māgha kṛṣṇe caturdaśe ||26||
dine cendraḥ samāyāto lakṣmi devi dharātale |
asaṃkhyadevadevībhirbhavaṃ natvā ca mādhavam ||27||
pūjayāmāsa vidhinā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ cakāra saḥ |
kiṃ dānairbahubhirdattaiḥ kiṃ vrataiḥ kiṃ surārcanaiḥ ||28||
kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca brahmacaryeṇa kiṃ tathā |
gayāpiṇḍapradānena prayāgamaraṇena kim ||29||
someśvare sarasvatyāṃ somaparvaṇi kiṃ gataiḥ |
kurukṣetre gataiḥ kiṃ syād rāhugraste divākare ||1.153.30||
tulāsuvarṇadānena vedapāṭhena kiṃ bhavet |
sarvapāpakṣayo yena vṛṣotsargeṇa tena kim ||31||
godānaṃ kiṃ karotyeva tiladānaṃ karotu kim |
ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāntau kīdṛśaṃ phalam ||32||
māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ yādṛśaṃ jāgare kṛte |
akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti mahendraḥ prāptavān phalam ||33||
vāmanaṃ trivikramaṃ ca dāmodaraṃ bhaveśvaram |
yathāśāstraṃ pūjayitvā vrataṃ kṛtvā tathā hariḥ ||34||
nārāyaṇe hade snātvācamya gomukhato jalam |
ambāṃ nāthaṃ ca dattātreyaṃ namaskṛtya vāsavaḥ ||35||
uttarābhimukhaṃ gatvā viśrāntimāpa vai kṣaṇam |
tatra cendreśvaraṃ liṃga sthāpitaṃ devabhūbhṛtā ||36||
vāsavena pūjitaṃ tad devībhiḥ snāpitaṃ tathā |
sākṣādindrasya deveśo bhavo dṛṣṭipathaṃ gataḥ ||37||
viṣṇurdevastathā tatra vyadṛśyata caturbhujaḥ |
indreṇa sthāpito viṣṇuścaturbhujastathā sthale ||38||
pūjito bhojitaścaiva nīrājitaśca vanditaḥ |
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadendraṃ tvaṃ brahmā janmāntare bhava ||39||
anyabrahmāṇḍarājyaṃ vai kṛtvā vaikuṇṭhamāpnuhi |
itīndrastadvaraṃ prāpya pratiṣṭhāpya haraṃ harim ||1.153.40||
svargaṃ jagāma deveśaḥ prativarṣaṃ prayāti saḥ |
śivarātrivratavantaṃ vastrāpathanivāsinam ||41||
nārāyaṇahṛde snāntaṃ dāmodaraprasevinam |
bhaveśvarasya sadbhaktaṃ trivikramaprapūjakam ||42||
netuṃ varaṃ tathā kartuṃ samāyānti varāṃganāḥ |
varaṃ draṣṭumindravāsād varayanti parasparam ||43||
śaṃbhunārāyaṇasamo divyo me bhavatātpatiḥ |
mamāyaṃ na tavāstyeṣaḥ patirvai puruṣottamaḥ ||44||
vṛkṣāḥ kīṭāḥ pataṃgā vā paśavaḥ pakṣiṇastathā |
mriyante te viṣṇusamā bhūtvā svargaṃ prayānti hi ||45||
vastrāpathe tadā tāṃstān patiṃ kurvanti devikāḥ |
prāpya devaṃ śaṃbhusamaṃ viṣṇurūpaṃ patiṃ ca tāḥ ||46||
prahasanti ca gāyanti nṛtyanti kīrtayanti ca |
jayaṃ vadanti nayanti sukhaśayyāṃ ca taṃ suram ||47
nandane’pi vane devyaḥ pṛcchāṃ kurvanti taṃ suram |
vada kena prabhāveṇa devo divyo bhavānabhūt ||48||
tadā vakti sa devo vai vastrāpathaprabhāvataḥ |
devā bhavanti divyāstat tīrthaṃ muktiṃ dadātyapi ||49||
airāvataṃ samāruhya yadāyāto maheśvaraḥ |
ūrjayantagirermūrdhni gajarājaḥ sma tiṣṭhati ||1.153.50||
tadagre caraṇaṃ hastī dadau mūrdhni sa kāraṇāt |
tenākrānto girivarastoyaṃ susrāva nirmalam ||51||
gajapādodbhavaṃ vāri jātaṃ tadvai sadā sthiram |
iti kṛtaṃ surendreṇa tairthikānāṃ hitārthakam ||52||
atha cottaradigbhāge dhanadena pratiṣṭhitam |
dhanadeśvaramityākhyaṃ liṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ sukhapradam ||53||
triśūlinī tathā devī pārvatī tatra rājate |
bhavasya nirṛte koṇe gaṇo hairambasaṃjñitaḥ ||54||
yamena sthāpitaṃ yameśvaraṃ bāṇaṃ tu vartate |
citraguptasthāpitaṃ vai citragupteśvaraṃ tathā ||55||
prajāpatiścakāroccaiḥ kedāreśaṃ tu paścime |
parvate raivate śrṛṃge nimināthaśivastathā ||56||
bhavasya dakṣiṇe bhāge nṛsiṃhaḥ śrīharistathā |
sthāpitau śrīvāmanena pūjanīyau viśeṣataḥ ||57||
samprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma jñātvā haraṃ hariṃ tathā |
śivarātrirvāmanadvādaśī kāryāmumukṣubhiḥ ||58||
puṇyadā saukhyadā proktā bhuktimuktipradāyinī |
dvādaśābdaṃ vratametatkartavyaṃ vārṣikaṃ janaiḥ ||59||
jīvitaṃ caṃcalaṃ nṝṇāṃ kartavyaṃ prātimāsikam |
pratimāsaṃ śivarātrerdvādaśyāśca vrataṃ caret ||1.153.60||
vighnaśca jāyate madhye yadi vā daivayogataḥ |
na bhaved vratabhaṃgaśca samāptaṃ tatkṛtaṃ matam ||61||
kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca kṛtāhnikaḥ |
gṛhṇīyād vrataniyamaṃ snāyānnadyāṃ hrade śubhe ||6||
tailābhyaṃgo na kartavyo na kāryā rājasī kriyā |
tīrthasevā prakartavyā sādhusevā sukhāvahā ||63||
devasevā prakartavyā brahmacaryaparāyaṇaiḥ |
rātrau devāgrato gatvā kartavyāḥ sapta parvatāḥ ||64|| 
pakvānnaphalatāmbūlapuṣpadhūpādipūjitāḥ
ghṛtadīpaḥ prakartavyaḥ pāpanāśanahetave ||65||
divā vā niśi sandhyāyāṃ dīpaḥ kāryaḥ svaśaktitaḥ |
divyo dīpaḥ prakartavyaḥ phalaṃ tasya mahanmatam ||66||
kiṃcitprakāśamātreṇa devāstuṣyanti sarvathā |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ gītavāditrapūrvakam ||67||
śivarātricaritraṃ ca vāmanadvādaśīvratam |
śrotavyaṃ ca bhajanāni kartavyāni tu maṇḍalaiḥ ||68||
rātrau deyāni dānāni vrate jāgaraṇe tathā |
punaḥ snānaṃ prabhāte ca pūjyau hariharāvubhau ||69||
sādhavaḥ pūjanīyāśca bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ |
tapasvināṃ pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ ||1.153.70||
dvādaśāṣṭau catasraḥ ṣaḍ bhojanīyā viśeṣataḥ |
eko’pi brahmavettā vā brahmacārī tu pūjitaḥ ||71||
sahasrāṇāṃ samo bhaktyā gṛhe saṃpūjito bhavet |
akṣāralavaṇaiścānnairbhoktavyaṃ prākdine svayam ||72||
putramitrakalatrāṇāṃ dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā |
anena vidhinā kāryā dvādaśī śivarātrikā ||73||
vāmanastu svayaṃ tuṣyet śivastuṣyetmuhuḥ punaḥ |
vratānte gauḥ pradātavyā kṛṣṇā vatsayutā śubhā ||74||
savastrābharaṇā divyā ghaṇṭāśrṛṃgādiśobhitā |
gurave dakṣiṇā deyā brāhmaṇebhyaśca śaktitaḥ ||75||
tapasvibhyo vitīryānnaṃ deyaṃ kṣamāpayettathā |
evaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktastasya pāpaṃ na vidyate ||76||
puṇyātmā vimalo bhūtvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān |
santānamuttamaṃ labdhvā śāntiṃ labdhvaihikīṃ tathā ||77||
divyaṃ vimānamārūḍho divyastrīpariveṣṭitaḥ |
gītavāditranirghoṣairnīyate lokamaiśvaram ||78||
māsi bhādre śuklapakṣe dvādaśyāṃ śravaṇākhyabhe |
budhe madhyāhnasamaye vāmanastvaditerabhūt ||79||
ekādaśyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca phalāhāro vidhīyate |
ekādaśyāmupavāso dvādaśyāṃ naktameva vā ||1.153.80
pūjanārthaṃ tadā kuryāt vāmanārcāṃ tu pauraṭīm |
hrasvāṃ sajaṭāṃ chatradaṇḍakamaṇḍalūyutām ||81||
pītāmbarābharaṇāḍhyāṃ puṣpākṣatādibhistataḥ |
suṣoḍaśopacārairvai vāmanaṃ saṃprapūjayet ||82||
maṇḍale sarvatobhadre madhyāhne pūjayettu tam |
yathālabdhopacāraiśca bhaktyā pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ ||83||
aditiṃ kaśyapaṃ cendraṃ sakuṭumbaṃ prapūjayet |
ghṛtakhaṇḍādimiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ cārpayet śubham ||84||
vāmanasyāvatārasya caritrāṇi tu gāpayet |
trayodaśyāṃ tu miṣṭānnaistarpayet kṣudhitān bahūn ||85||
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ mahādevo mahāniśi |
viṣṇośca brahmaṇormadhye śrīhareḥ kiraṇātmakaḥ ||86||
śivaliṃgātmako jātaḥ koṭisūryasamaprabhaḥ |
adṛśya sa vai liṃge mahādevastṛtīyakaḥ ||87||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśānāṃ sṛṣṭikāle hyabhūdidam |
caturdaśyāṃ mahādevaṃ citravāsāṃsi dhārayet ||88||
satīṃ śāṭīṃ sucitrāṃ ca pauraṭābharaṇāni ca |
dhārayetpūjayet prītyā sakuṭumbaṃ maheśvaram ||89||
prapāṭhayedrudrasūktaṃ tvabhiṣekapuraḥsaram |
niśīthe pūjayet śaṃbhuṃ bhaṃgādugdhaphalacchadaiḥ ||1.153.90||
mallikākundapuṣpaiśca kanakaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ |
vastubhiḥ ṣoḍaśavidhairarcayeccānyavastubhiḥ ||91||
naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād deśakālānusārataḥ |
tadā caikātmapadyāni gāpayerddhārarudrayoḥ ||92||
dānāni vidhinānyeva dadyādraratnāni bhūriśaḥ |
dvitīye divase bhojyotsavaṃ kuryānmahattamam ||93||
evaṃ harerharasyāpi vrataṃ kuryāttu raivate |
kārtike māghamāse ca yātrāṃ kuryāttu mokṣadām ||94
kailāso viṣṇulokaśca mokṣaśca tasya niścitaḥ |
naro vā pramadā vāpi vratena mokṣamāpnuyāt ||95||
sakāmā pramadā tena ramā vā pārvatī bhavet |
akāmā pramadā tena muktiṃ yātyeva dhāmani ||96||
ūrje pradakṣiṇā kāryā savratā sarvamānavaiḥ |
māghe tu pūjanaṃ dānaṃ savrataṃ raivatācale ||97||
kartavyaṃ tena pṛthvyāśca prakramaṇaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
trayastriṃśatprakoṭīnāṃ devānāṃ pūjanaṃ bhavet ||98||
vandhyau māsau na netavyau ūrjamāghau mumukṣubhiḥ |
vandhyatve sarvavandhyatvaṃ bodhyaṃ mānavajanmanaḥ ||99||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne lubdhakasya hariharadarśanottaramindreśvaraviṣṇupratiṣṭhānaṃ gajapadaṃ dhaneśvaratriśūlinīyameśvaracitragupteśvaranṛsiṃhatīrthāni ca vāmanadvādaśīśivarātryorvratamahimā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tripaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||153||

<1.154>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi maṇivrāte raivate divyataijase |
mandarādriḥ samāyātaḥ svarṇapāṣāṇamiśraṇaḥ || 1 ||
divye tejomaye tatrāntargatvā sthūlabhāvataḥ |
militvā saṃsthitastena maṇestejo na dṛśyate || 2 ||
kumudādristathā tatrāyāto raivatake girau |
so’pyantarbhūya sthaulyena vartate raivatācale || 3 ||
śṛṇu divyāṃ kathāṃ tāṃ vai pūrvakṛtayugodbhavām |
purā kṛtayuge sarve sapakṣāḥ parvatāḥ kṛtāḥ || 4 ||
uḍḍayanto mahākāyā nipatanti yadṛcchayā |
merumandarakailāsā brahmaṇā vāritāḥ sthirāḥ |||9 ||
anye tu vāritāścāpi sthāyino na yadābhavan |
tadendreṇa svavajreṇa pakṣāsteṣāṃ nikṛntitāḥ || 6 ||
merordakṣiṇaśṛṃge tu kumudo nāma parvataḥ |
divyaṃ sapakṣaḥ sauvarṇo divyodyānasamṛddhimān || 7 ||
sarvā vaikuṇṭhasadṛśī sthalī smṛddhā suśobhanā |
tatropari purī divyā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇunā kṛtā || 8 ||
tanmadhye ca mahān viṣṇo prāsādo ramayā yutaḥ |
meroḥ śṛṃge mandarākhye purī śivasya śobhanā || 9 ||
sauvarṇā ca sabhā tatra bhavānī modate sadā |
brahmaṇaścāpi nagarī prāsādaśca supauraṭaḥ || 1.154.10||
ratnahīrakamaṇyāḍhyaḥ śṛṃge tasyāruṇācale |
vartate yatra te devāstrayaḥ kurvati mantraṇām || 1 1||
kumude vaiṣṇave sthāne sauvarṇā vallayo’bhavan |
puṣpāṇyapi piśaṃgāni sauvarṇāni ca saurabhaḥ || 1 2||
sugandho dīyate nityaṃ puryāṃ pauṣpaḥ suvāyunā |
vṛkṣāścāpi sugandhāḍhyapatramañjarikānvitāḥ || 13 ||
sugandhaṃ vāhayantyeva pratisaudhaṃ ca vāyavaḥ |
ekadā bhagavān rudraḥ kumude tu samāgataḥ || 14||
gṛhāgataṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇunā paripūjitaḥ |
lakṣmyā ca pūjitā gaurī harṣitā satkṛtā hyati || 15||
ekāsanopaviṣṭau tau mantrayantau parasparam |
tāvadvai kumudastatra mandaraścāpi parvataḥ || 16||
nararūpaṃ sudhṛtvā vai sevāyāṃ samupāgatau |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha hariṃ tatra balistu balavān yataḥ || 17||
tvayā neyastu sutalaṃ pṛthvītaḥ sarvathā hare |
vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya girau tu raivatācale || 18||
mayāpi tatra gantavyaṃ girau vai raivatācale |
baleḥ sutale vāsaṃ ca kārayitvā tu chadmanā || 19||
punaścātrāgamiṣyāmaḥ kṛtakāryau divaukasām |
saṃprāha mādhavastam om tāvattau parvatau mudā ||1.154.20 ||
kumudamandarau hariharau prārthayataḥ puraḥ |
āvāṃ saha gamiṣyāvastatra yatra harirharaḥ ||2 1||
tathāstviti varaṃ prāpya bhūbhṛtau tau tirogatau |
hariharau sapatnīkau jagmaturvedhasaṃ prati |||22||
aruṇācalaśikhare purī yatra prajāpateḥ |
baleḥ sutalavāsārthaṃ kṛtvā vai mantraṇāṃ tataḥ ||23||
tau pratyājagmatuḥ svasvapuryāṃ svasvagirau punaḥ |
prāpte tu samaye viṣṇurvāmanaḥ saṃbabhūva ha ||24||
jagāma ca baleryajñe śaṃkaro’pi jagāma ca |
saurāṣṭre raivate deśe tadā kumudamandarau || 25 ||
āyayatuḥ sapakṣau tāvuḍḍayitvāntarīkṣagau |
tāvanyān bahunakṣatragaṇānākṛṣya vegataḥ || 26||
ājagmatuḥ svarṇarekhānadīsthe raivatācale |
tadā tayostadanyāyaṃ jñātvā deveśvaraḥ svayam || 27||
gṛhītvā ca svakaṃ vajraṃ pakṣanāśanahetave |
vimānavaramāruhya jagāma yatra tau girī ||28||
yāvad vajraṃ prahiṇoti tāvat tau parvatau muhuḥ |
prāñjalī prāhaturdevau rakṣaṇāya harācyutau ||29||
drāgevendraḥ stambhitaśca savajrahastakastadā |
mā hantavyāvimāvadrī prāhatustaṃ harācyutau ||1.154.30 ||
indrastau prārthayāmāsa staṃbhanasya vimuktaye |
varayāmāsa kumudamandaroḍḍayanakṣayam ||3 1 ||
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā mahendrastaṃbhanaṃ tadā |
nivārya ca kumudādriṃ mandarādriṃ tu raivate ||32||
taijase’drau hariharau sthāpayāmāsatuḥ sadā |
ambāyā mandaraḥ so’yaṃ kumudastu samantataḥ |||3 3 ||
kamalākāratāṃ prāpto dvādaśapatrabhedataḥ |
tāvimau parvatau śailau dṛśyete taijase maṇau || 34||
raivate taijase tattve pārthivau tau niṣedatuḥ |
tatra dāmodaro viṣṇurbhavaḥ śaṃbhurniṣedatuḥ ||35||
brahmāruṇācalaṃ nītvā samājagāma tatra vai |
mandarāt pūrvadigbhāge’sthāpayat so’ruṇācalam || 36||
tatra brahmā svakaṃ vāsaṃ kṛtvovāsa kamaṇḍalum |
yatra vai mandare kuṇḍe babhāra sa jalāśayaḥ || 37||
jātaḥ kamaṇḍalukuṇḍastīrthamakṣayapuṇyadam |
aruṇādrau prathame tu śṛṃge brahmā hyuvāsa yat || 38||
sthala tad brahmakuṭyākhyaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ tu mokṣadam |
aruṇādrau dvitīye ca dattātreyo mahān prabhuḥ || 39 ||
dāruṇaṃ vai tapastepe tīrthaṃ mokṣakaraṃ ca tat |
evaṃ vedhohariharāstiṣṭhanti revatāśrite ||1.154.40 ||
mandare kumude caivāruṇādrau prakṣiṇi priye |
prāpte laye gamiṣyanti merau tai parvatāstrayaḥ ||41||
sapakṣā vai gamiṣyanti tāvat sthāsyanti tatra vai |
teṣu triṣu trayo devāstrayastriṃśacca koṭayaḥ ||42||
devā vasanti tatrāpi rahasyaṃ kathitaṃ priye |
raivatasya prakramaṇo kṛtaṃ merupradakṣiṇam ||43||
raivatasya pūjane ca kṛtaṃ meroḥ prapūjanam |
raivatasya darśane tu kṛtaṃ merośca darśanam ||44||
triṃśatkrośaṃ raivatādriṃ ye prayānti pradakṣiṇam |
kṛtaṃ merośca pṛthvyāśca pradakṣiṇaṃ tu tairiha ||45||
mandarāruṇayoryaistu kṛtaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tu taiḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtaṃ satyakailāsābhidhalokayoḥ ||46||
kumudasya dvādaśaparvatānāṃ tu pradakṣiṇam |
yena kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vaikuṇṭhasya pradakṣiṇam ||47||
yadā devāstrayaścātra nivāsāya samāgatāḥ |
naranarāyaṇau tatra boriyākhye vane gatau ||48||
brahmakamaṇḍalukuṇḍād gaṃgā guptā tu jāmbavī |
patatyadho boriyākhye bhūgate badrikāśrame ||49||
naranārāyaṇau sarvarṣibhiryuktau tu tāpasau |
janādṛśyau hi vartete dṛśyete puṇyaśālibhiḥ ||1.154.5 0||
dakṣiṇe mandarādgaṃgāmūle tau vasataḥ sadā |
uttare mandarāt tatra bhavantyāmravanāni vai ||5 1 ||
vaikuṇṭhātparamād vāryāvaraṇasthāt samāgataḥ |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaḥ sītāpatiścāmravanaiḥ saha ||52||
ātmā muktāḥ śāśvatā vai sarvadā phalaśālinaḥ |
sughaṭāpatraśākhābhiḥ sāketānāṃ niketanam ||5 3||
sughaṭṭaṃ ca vanaṃ tatra sītāvanamitīritam |
lakṣmaṇasya vanaṃ rāma vanaṃ kīśavanaṃ tathā ||14||
sītāpaṭī vanakṣmā ca divyā dhāmasamāsti sā |
yatra sūryo na vai bhāti na bhāti śaśitārakam ||55 ||
vidyuto yatra no bhānti hyagnirbhāti kutastadā |
tādṛśaṃ tanmahādivyajalaprasravaṇānvitam ||56||
svarṇarūpyagairikādidhātubhūkhanikānvitam |
sarvartusukhadaṃ divyaṃ viśālaṃ vanamasti yat ||57||
śāśvate tatra sākete vane prasravaṇātmikā |
sarayūrbhinnasalilanirjharaṇairvahatyapi |||58||
hanumān vartate tatra vane rakṣaṇakāraṇāt |
tīrthametat mahat proktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ param ||59||
pūrve ca raivate bhāge’ruṇācalasamīpataḥ |
indradyumnasarastatra samāgatya pratiṣṭhati ||1.154.60 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāṃśca naranārāyaṇaṃ tathā |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ sītārāmaṃ śrutvā samāgatān ||6 1 ||
puruṣottamapuryāstu jagannāthaḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ |
nīlākhyaṃ parvataṃ nītvā vaṭavṛkṣaṃ tathābdhijam ||62||
samāgato’tra vāsāya nyūṣuste prāgdiśi dhruvam |
ṭīmburuphalajātāni jāmbvāmalakakarmadāḥ ||53||
āmrāśca rāvaṇāścaiva badaryaścāmṛtāni ca |
sītāphalāni bahuśaḥ santi yatra vanāni vai ||64||
dugdhasamaṃ jalaṃ yatrāmṛtasvāduphalāni ca |
sukhaṃ svargasamaṃ yatra prāgbhāgeraivatācale ||656||
kṛṣṇā ca mṛttikā yatra svarṇarasasumiśritā |
vibhinnā dhātavaḥ santi viṃśatikrośabhūmayaḥ ||66 ||
tataḥ pūrve śubhaṃ kṣetramaśvapaṭṭasarovaram |
ciñcāṃgūdīvanaṃ ramyaṃ śubhā kuṃkumavāpikā ||67||
śatrūñjitānadī saumyā kaṃbharākṣetramucyate |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇaśca kaṃbharāgopālasaṃjñayā ||68||
pūjyate vandyate devairbhūsurairmānavaistathā |
patnīvratasya viprasya vaṃśastatrāpi tiṣṭhati ||69||
kuṃkumavāpikāyāścottare krośadvayāt param |
kṣetraṃ puṇyamaraṇyādiyutaṃ ramyaṃ ca vidyate ||1.154.70 ||
laṃkācatuṣṭakīkṣetraṃ yatra guptā sarasvatī |
prakāśā vartate cāpi sudivyasalilānvitā ||71 ||
himācalād yadā devī sarasvatī mahānadī |
vāḍavāgniṃ samādāya yātā paścimavāridhim ||72||
tadārbudācalāt siddhakṣetraṃ śrīnagaraṃ tathā |
gatvā virāṭanagaraṃ sāraṃgaṃ durgametya ca ||73 ||
unmattagaṃgāṃ bhogāṃ ca bhadrāṃ samprāpya vai tataḥ |
laṃkācatuṣṭakīkṣetraṃ prāptvā jayantamāgatā ||74||
bhadreśvaranṛsiṃhākhyaghaṭṭaṃ gatvā taduttaram |
skandapuraṃ tathā kālīvaṭaṃ ca nagaraṃ gatā ||79 ||
ājyāṃ prakāśamāsādya suvarṣādvārikāṃ gatā |
tato dakṣiṇadigbhāge barāṭākhye tu parvate ||76||
bilveśaṃ harṣadāṃ prāpya navanītādrimāgatā |
vāmanasthalamāsādya vastrāpathamumāgatā ||77||
raivatādriṃ parivīya parvataṃ ca kṛtasmaram |
prajvālya balikhātaṃ ca gatvā prācīsthapippalam ||78||
ekatarṣisthalaṃ prāpya somanāthaṃ samāgatā |
vyāghrāraṇye śubhaṃ guptaprayāgaṃ prāpya sā tataḥ ||79||
siṃhāraṇye divyabhūmau gatvāro’bdhau viveśa sā |
vāḍavāgniṃ samutsṛjya punaḥ sā raivatācale ||1.154.80||
sarvadā saṃsthitā devī pratisthānaṃ sarasvatīṃ |
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthitā devī janakalyāṇahetave ||8 1||
hanumannāmavikhyātāḥ kapayo raivatācale |
sītāmaḍhī ca hanumanmaḍhī santamaḍhī tathā ||82||
vyāghreśvarī mahādevī māhiṣākhye girau sthitā |
śrīrāmapādukātīrthaṃ bilveśaṃ hāṭakeśvaram ||83||
evamanyāni tīrthāni santi lakṣmi tu raivate |
tārakāṇi prāṇināṃ vai bhuktimuktipradāni ca ||84||
yathākathañcikchraddhādyaiḥ svārthenāpi prahelayā |
kṛtāni yena tīrthāni dṛṣṭapītāni vā tathā ||85||
snātāni tajjaladhūlīkardamāni dhṛtāni vā |
teṣāṃ pāpavināśena bhuktirmuktirbhaveddhruvam ||86||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathamaṃ kṛtayugasantāne taijasaraivatācale kumudamandarāruṇanīlādiparvatānāṃ badrikānaranārāyaṇalakṣmīnārāyaṇasītārāmajagannāthasarasvatīṃprabhatitīrthānāmāgamananirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 154||

<1.155>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi mahālakṣmīḥ paravaikuṇṭhavāsinī |
yathā nārāyaṇenaiva sahājagāma raivate || 1 ||
baliryadā hariṇā vai baddhastadātra raivate |
maṇḍape tu baleḥ patnī sasmāra parameśvarīm || 2 ||
mahālakṣmīṃ tadā stotrairbalerbandhanivṛttaye |
mahāvaikuṇṭhadhāmastho prahvībhāvena hṛdgatām || 3 ||
sandhyāvalī prāñjalistāṃ natvā hṛdi jagāda ca |
namo mātre mahālakṣmyai trāhi bhaktaṃ ca me patim || 4 ||
namaḥ prakṛtisaṃjñāyai mūlāyai te namonamaḥ |
saṃhartryai brahmamātre te kukṣisṛṣṭyai namonamaḥ || 5 ||
vāmanā vāpi dīrghāśca nārāyaṇāstu te mukhe |
mahākālādayaścāpi santi grāsāśca te namaḥ || 6 ||
saṃkarṣaṇāstathā rudrā yamāścaiva tavānane |
daṃṣṭraikacarvaṇāḥ sarve mahāmātre namonamaḥ || 7 ||
vāsudevastathā bhūmā nārāyaṇāśca pūruṣāḥ |
tvatpallatātāḍitāste mahāśaktyai namonamaḥ || 8 ||
tvatto lakṣmīḥ samutpannā mahāviṣṇustvadaṃkajaḥ |
brahmāṇḍāni ca te romṇi rakṣa lakṣmyai namonamaḥ || 9 ||
mahāgnayastu te gupte tvatsvede vāḍavānalāḥ |
bhagavantaśca te garbhe caṇḍalakṣmyai namo’vatu || 1.155.10||
jṛmbhe te pralayāḥ santi caṇḍe kālaḥ prakampate |
cūrṇāyante mahāṇḍāni pṛṣṭhamnīḍe namo’stu te || 1 1||
rakṣa rakṣa mahāmāye patiṃ me parameśvari |
caṇḍī taṇḍī mahāmuṇḍī ghamaṇḍī ḍiṇḍikādikāḥ |||12||
kālīkarālīprajvālīlihālīraktilādikāḥ |
śaktayaste raktaleśaḥ pāhi kāntaṃ drutaṃ kuru || 13 ||
pāhi śīghraṃ cānyathā tvāṃ galaṃ nikṛtya pūjaye |
yadyahaṃ vidhavā syāṃ cet pūrvaṃ tvaṃ vidhavā bhava || 14||
yadyahaṃ rājyaśūnyāṃ syāṃ tvaṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ vinā bhava |
yadyavamānito rājā syātpatiste’pyamānitaḥ || 15||
madyajñe ced bhavet vighnaṃ tava yajñe tathāstu vai |
vadatyevaṃ caṇḍavegā dravṛṇvantyapi sabhāsadaḥ || 16||
mā metyevaṃ tadā devā nivārayanti tāṃ striyam |
tāvat tatrāgatā patnī mahālakṣmīrmahāprabhoḥ || 17||
sāntvayitvā ca tāṃ rājñīṃ patitā kharvapādayoḥ |
mā maivaṃ deva cātyantaṃ mā bhaktasya hara prabho || 18||
vāmanaśca tadā prāha nainaṃ vai mārayāmyaham |
rājyabhraṣṭaṃ ca naivāhaṃ karomyenaṃ susevakam || 19||
sandhyāvalī sadevāstu susaubhāgyavatī priye |
daityo’yaṃ daityarājyaṃ vai karotu sutale priye ||1.155.20||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ yadyahaṃ tyakṣye nivatsye tadbalergṛhe |
tvayā saha mahālakṣmi rājñī sevāṃ karotu me ||2 1||
devarājyaṃ tu devebhyo daityarājyaṃ tu tadbalau |
dattvā nidhāya gantavyaṃ sandhyāvalyāḥ śubhaṃ bhavet|||22||
tadā tu daityavaryaiḥ sā mahālakṣmīḥ prapūjitā |
devaiśca pūjitā mātā sarvasaubhāgyarakṣikā ||23||
vāmanena samaṃ sāpi raivate’bhyarthitā ca taiḥ |
sadoṣitā mahālakṣmīḥ sarvasaubhāgyahetave ||24||
raivatātpaścime tatrocchrāye nitya vyavasthitā |
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīḥ prāṇarakṣaṇakāriṇī ||25||
vanditā pūjitā puṣpakuṃkumākṣatacandanaiḥ |
sindūraśrīphalavastraśāṭītailasugandhibhiḥ ||26||
tathā saubhāgyadravyaiśca bhojanairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
ābharaṇakaṭakormiśṛṃravalātroṭikādibhiḥ |||27||
peyairnānāvidhaiścaiva kaṃcukīśāṭikādibhiḥ |
maṃgalasūtrakarṇādibhūṣaṇādibhirādarāt ||28||
prasannā sā mahālakṣmīrdīpotsavadine sadā |
asaubhāgyamamāṃgalyamanarthaṃ ceti hasti sā ||29||
dadāti kuśalaṃ rājyaṃ kāntaṃ putraṃ dhanaṃ tathā |
pūjanārthaṃ mahālakṣmyā mūrtiḥ kāryā caturbhujā || 1.155.30||
pauraṭī susvarūpā ca ramyā ṣoḍaśahāyanā |
padmāmṛtaghaṭakarā pūjāpātrakarā tathā ||3 1||
abhayadānahastā ca dakṣayorvāmayoḥ kramāt |
ṣoḍaśopaparicāravastubhiḥ pūjayet tu tām ||32|||
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūlaṃ dattvā nīrājayet tataḥ |
bhojanāni vividhāni dātavyāni ca dakṣiṇāḥ ||33||
dānāni ratnahīrakamaṇisvarṇamayāni ca |
vastrāṇāṃ ca dukūlānāṃ kambalānāṃ gavāṃ tathā |||34||
tasyākṣayaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ mahālakṣmīpratāpataḥ |
ante vaikuṇṭhavāsaḥ syād bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ ||35||
kanyakā dvādaśavarṣapūrvā lakṣmīsvarūpikāḥ |
pūjanīyā yathālakṣmīrvastrānnadhanadāpanaiḥ ||36||
bhojanīyāstathā bhūṣālaṃkāradravyaśobhitāḥ |
vividhairmiṣṭapakvānnapāyasānnādisadrasaiḥ ||37||
bhojanīyāstathā sādhvyo viraktāḥ sāṃkhyayogagāḥ |
pūjanīyāśca dātavya vividhaṃ dānamiṣṭakṛt ||38||
sati vai vibhave tatra sāpatyasadhavāḥ striyaḥ |
vidhavāścāpi dīnāśca śaraṇyāśca nirāśritāḥ || 39||
bhojanīyāḥ pūjanīyā dāpanīyāśca dakṣiṇāḥ |
sammānanīyāḥ satataṃ yattṛptau śrīśca tṛpyati ||1.155.40 ||
mahālakṣmyāṃ prasannāyāṃ sarvā smṛddhirvivardhate |
nyūnaṃ kiñcidbhavennaiva yadyattvapekṣate milet ||41 ||
alakṣmīṃ drāvayatyeṣā gṛhāt sarvāṃ prapūjitā |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ te’tra samudramathane tu yā ||42||
jātā tāṃ kathayāmyadya prasaṃgātsukhadāyinīm |
durvāsasā pradattāṃ tu pārijātasumālikām ||43||
indraścikṣepa kariṇo mūrdhni gajena pattale |
kaccaritāṃ tu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā śaśāpa dyupatiṃ ṛṣiḥ ||44||
mālāvamānakartuste lakṣmīrnaṣṭā bhavatviti |
antardadhe kṣaṇāllakṣmīḥ petuḥ ratnāni vāridhau ||45||
taduddhārāya dugdhābdhirmathito devadānavaiḥ |
mandarādristadā pṛṣṭhe kūrmātmahariṇā dhṛtaḥ ||46||
manthanādudabhūt pramavai kālakūṭaṃ mahāviṣam |
tatsarvaṃ pītavānīśo mamanthuḥ punareva tam ||47||
tasmin pramathyamāne tu mayā devaiśca padmaje |
jyeṣṭhā devī samutpannā raktasragvāsasāvṛtā ||48||
alakṣmīḥ sā bhaginī te jyeṣṭhā dehe’pyasundarī |
kirātīsadṛśī rūpe dhīvarīsadṛśī mukhe ||49||
kṛkalāsasamā karṇe nālikābhā tathā nasi |
mahiṣīsadṛśī netre rākṣasīva tu mastake ||1.155.50||
khagrāsasadṛśī bhāle maṣītulyā tu gaṇḍayoḥ |
śūlāgrasadṛśī dante uṣṭrīnibhā tu coṣṭhayoḥ ||5 1 ||
hastinīsadṛśī kaṇṭhe gardabhīsadṛśī svare |
varburadrunibhā hastaṃ valmīkābhā stanadvaye |||52||
kusūlatulyāpyudare śilātulyā tu pṛṣṭhake |
tailiyantrasamā kaṭyāṃ kharjūradrunibhā pade ||53||
jalaukābhā cāṃgulīṣu kṛrmapṛṣṭhanibhā nakhe |
dardurībhā tu jihvāyāṃ svabhāve tu śunīsamā ||54||
daridrābhā prasāde ca hāsye kaṃgālasadṛśī |
carmakārīnibhā vastre caṇḍālābhā nivāsane ||55||
riktajalanikhātābhā jambhaṇe mroḍane khaniḥ |
bhāṇḍīnibhā sahavāse vivāhe kṣārabhūnibhā ||56 ||
saṃvāde raṇabhūsāmyā vaimanasye samṛddhibhā |
dṛṣṭvaināṃ tatrasustatra devadānavamānavāḥ ||57||
vicāraṃ cakrire keyaṃ sarvāmaṃgalabhūṣaṇā |
kālarātrirmahāmāriḥ kiṃvā pralayakṣut tviyam ||58||
haste mālāṃ śaṃkhalānāṃ gṛhītvā patimicchati |
gacchatītastatastāvatpatiṃ mṛgayituṃ yadā ||59||
dṛṣṭvā surāsurāḥ sarve dūraṃ dhāvanti necchukāḥ |
neyaṃ neto yāhi mā māmanyaṃ gacchetivādinaḥ ||1.155.60||
yadā kaiścit svīkṛtā na varamālā nirīhayā |
nirāśā prāha me vāso dīyatāṃ kvāpi yatra nu ||61||
utpannāhaṃ nirarthāhaṃ kiṃ kartavyaṃ mayeti ca |
tāmabruvam̐stadā devīṃ surāsuragaṇā drutam |||62||
yeṣāṃ gṛhāntare nityaṃ kalahaḥ saṃpravartate |
tatte sthānaṃ prayacchāmo vasa tatrāśubhānvitā ||63||
yasya gehe’bhicārārthaṃ kapālāsthiprapūjanam |
paruṣaṃ bhāṣaṇaṃ yatra mantratantrābhimāraṇam ||64||
anṛtaṃ sāhasaṃ dyūtaṃ pānaṃ ca mṛgayā madaḥ |
mātāpitrorasevā ca guroścaivāvamānanam ||65||
strībālānāṃ ca niḥśvāsāḥ kleśaḥ kuṭumbibāndhave |
vyabhicāraśca yatrāsti paṃktibhedo’sti yatra ca ||6 6 ||
teṣāṃ veśmani santiṣṭha duḥkhadāridryadāyinī |
gavādisvavaśaprāṇiniḥśvāsā yatra santi vai ||67||
āśritānāṃ pālanaṃ ca yatra nītyā na jāyate ||
śvaśrūśvaśurayoścaiva patipatnyośca putrayoḥ ||68||
putrapitrośca bhrātrośca mātṛputryoḥ parasparam |
svasroryatra vaimanasyaṃ tatra saṃtiṣṭha hānide ||69||
kuṭumbijanavargeṣu cauryeṇa vyayaśīlatā |
svasvasvattvapravṛttiśca gṛhe yatra kuṭumbini ||1.155.70 ||
svagṛhamapi pārakyaṃ svajano manute tu yat |
ālasyaṃ kāryakaraṇe cānyādhārā ca jīvikā ||71 ||
vṛddhānāṃ vacanaṃ yatra mānyaṃ bhavati naiva ca |
snānaṃ devasya pūjādi japo yatra na vidyate ||72||
utsavā mānuṣā daivā vārṣikā yatra santi na |
lobho’dharmavyayo yatra tatra tiṣṭha sukhī bhava ||73 ||
prāṇināṃ hiṃsanaṃ yatra satāṃ yatra ca nindanam |
dharmadrohaśca nāstikyaṃ vasa tatra kalipriye ||74||
yatra nātithisatkāro yatra śuddhirna vidyate |
mālinyaṃ vartate yatra tathā yatra nirudyamaḥ ||75||
yatra kṣaṇe kṣaṇe krodho yatra viṣayatṛṣṇikā |
yatra jaihvyaṃ tathaupasthyaṃ vyasanaṃ sīmavarjitam ||76||
dāsadāsīkarmacāripīḍanaṃ nyāyato bahiḥ |
paśupakṣigomahiṣīgajāśvādiprapīḍanam ||77||
gṛhajaneṣvaviśvāsastatra vāso vidhīyatām |
yatra śrāddhaṃ na bhavati na ca piṇḍapradānakam ||78||
svāhāsvadhāvaṣaṭkārakriyā yatra na vidyate |
bhūtayajño brahmayajño devayajño na yatra vai ||79||
dārāpatyagṛhasvāmyamātyabhṛtyeṣu cānṛtam |
lucābhakṣyaṃ bhavedyatra yatra drohaḥ parasya ca ||1.155.80 ||
rakṣyasyārakṣaṇaṃ yatra poṣyasyāpoṣaṇaṃ tathā |
daṇḍyasyādaṇḍanaṃ yatra tatra vāso vidhīyatām ||8 1 ||
devadvijagavāṃ vṛttihārakāṇāṃ gṛhe sadā |
anāthakṛpaṇāndhānāṃ duḥkhakṛto gṛhe vasa ||82||
sādhusādhvīyatiyogiviraktadrohakṛdgṛhe |
dānadharmaniṣedhasya kartṝṇāṃ ca gṛhe vasa ||83||
dehacauryamanaścauryahṛccauryasya gṛhe vasa |
anyāyopārjayituśca kṛṭatulādharasya ca ||84||
kṛṭasākṣyakṛto gehe sadā vāso vidhīyatām |
viduṣāmavamānayiturgṛhe vasa sarvadā ||85||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu yatrānyāyo’vivekitā |
pūjyapūjāvyatikramastatra vāso vidhīyatām ||86||
paṇye kapaṭasammiśre vyāpāre kapaṭānvite |
ācāre kapaṭādiṣṭe sadā vāso vidhīyatām ||87||
yatra rājā dharmapakṣī prajā sāhasabhakṣiṇī |
rāṣṭraṃ hṛdayabhakṣi syāt tatra vāsaḥ sadā tava ||88||
yatra kanyāvikrayasya jīryate hyudare dhanam |
nārīvikrayavṛttiśca tatra vāsaḥ sadā tava ||89||
śīlavrataṃ na yatrāsti hṛdayaṃ naiva nirmalam |
padakramo’pi kāpaṭyāt śāṭhye vāsaḥ sadā tava ||1.155.90||
rāgadveṣaprayukto vai divaso yasya gacchati |
adharmasya ca yatrāsti vaṃśastatra sadā vasa ||91 ||
kṛtaghnasya vañcakasya pāśakasyātatāyinaḥ |
agnidasya garadasya hanturanyāyatastathā ||92||
vidharmasthasya sadane dhruvavāso vidhīyatām |
paraguptaprakāśakagṛhe vāsaḥ duṣṭagṛhe tathā ||93||
annavastrabhuvāṃ dānākarturgṛhe sadā vasa |
piśūnasya bhedakasya kleśakṛto gṛhe vasa ||94||
rājye rāṣṭre tathāraṇye vāṭikāsu vaneṣu ca |
udyāne ca kṛṣikṣetre parvate ca sthale jale ||95||
vṛkṣe sasye tathā bīje ratne svarṇe rase raṇe |
saṃgrāme cotsave daive mānuṣe vā sthale jale || 96||
tīrthe bhojye vyavahāre kraye ca vikraye tathā |
vidyāyāṃ ca kalāyāṃ ca śilpe ṛtau ca varṣaṇe ||97||
yatrādhipaḥ śaṭho dhūrtaḥ kitavaścaura ulbaṇaḥ |
duṣṭo’nyāyī mahāpāpī tatra tatra sadā vasa ||98||
kiṃ bahunā tvaduktena yatra hiṃsānṛte tathā |
steyavyavāyagṛdhnāścāśuddhistṛṣṇā vinindanam ||99||
tatra vāsaḥ sadā te’stu lakṣmyā vāso na yatra ca |
ityuktvā tāṃ daduḥ devā uddālakāya carṣaye || 1.155.100 ||
visarjayāmāsa patyā sahālakṣmīṃ tataḥ punaḥ |
te sarve manthanaṃ cakruḥ kṣīrābdheḥ susamāhitāḥ || 101 ||
tataśca vāruṇī devī samutpannā śubhānanā |
ananto nāgarājo’tha tāṃ jagrāha sulocanām || 102||
tataśca gāruḍī devī samutpannā sulakṣaṇā |
vainateyasya bhāryābhūt sarvalakṣaṇaśobhitā || 1 03||
tato’psarogaṇā divyā gandharvāśca mahaujasaḥ |
jajñire rūpasampannā madhugāyanatatparāḥ || 1 04||
airāvatastato jajñe tathaivoccaiḥ śravāhayaḥ |
dhanvantariḥ pārijātaḥ surabhiḥ sarvakāmadhuk || 1 05||
etān sarvān sahasrākṣo jagrāha sarvamānitaḥ |
tataḥ prabhātasamaye dvādaśyāmudite ravau || 10 6||
utpannā śrīrmahālakṣmīrmathyamāne mahodadhau |
tataścandrastato jātā tulasī yā haripriyā || 107||
tulasyā saha mā lakṣmīrvarayāmāsa keśavam |
tataḥ provāca bhagavān sarvāścaiva mahāmunīn || 1 08||
ekādaśī mahāpuṇyā sarvopadravanāśinī |
tasmāttu sarvadā puṇyā dvādaśī mama vallabhā || 10 9||
adyaprabhṛti ye lokā ekādaśīmupoṣya ca |
dvādaśyāmudite bhānau śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ || 1.155.110 ||
ye pūjayanti māṃ bhaktyā tulasyā ca śriyā saha |
sarve te bandhanirmuktāḥ prāpnuvanti padaṃ mama || 11 1||
nārcayanti ca ye vai māṃ dvādaśyāṃ puruṣottamam |
tānpāpānviṣayairbaddhvā mama māyā duratyayā || 1 12||
kṣipatyajasraṃ saṃsāre nāstikānmatparāṅmukhān |
samudrātsā yadā lakṣmīrdvādaśyāṃ samajāyata || 112 ||
tadāprabhṛti ṛṣayo devā brahmapurogamāḥ |
siddhā ye mānuṣāścaiva yogino munisattamāḥ || 1 14||
viṣṇorājñāṃ puraskṛtya bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ |
ekādaśyāmupoṣyātha bhaktyā caiva janārdanam || 1 15||
dvādaśyāmarcayāmāsurlakṣmīnārāyaṇaṃ tu mām |
dvādaśīvāsaraste’sti mamāpi vāsaro hi saḥ || 1 16||
harivāsara ityukto lakṣmīvāsara ityapi |
dampatyostu sadaivaikyāt kimanyachrotumicchasi || 1 17||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne raivatācale mahālakṣmyāgamanaṃ tasyāḥ pūjanadānādi samudramathane’lakṣmyā utpattistatsvarūpaṃ tannivāsasthānāni tato lakṣmītulasīprādurbhāve dvādaśīmahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcapaṃcāśadadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 155||

<1.156>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi dvādaśyāśca vidhānakam |
viṣṇoḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ kartavyaṃ ca yathā prabho || 1 ||
tasyāḥ puṇyaprabhāvaṃ ca samācakṣva mama priya |
mama vrataprabhāvastu śrotavyaḥ sarvathā mayā || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi tava janmadinavratam |
tava vratasya saṃkalpāt santuṣṭaḥ syāmahaṃ sadā || 3 ||
ekādaśī mama patnī mamāṃgebhyo vyajāyata |
tathaiva tvaṃ mama patnī mama vāmāṃgasaṃbhavā || 4 ||
punaḥ samudrato jātā hyabdhijā kathyase tadā |
aruṇādrau ca padmākhyā bhṛgoḥ putrī tu bhārgavī || 5 ||
premṇo jātā kaṃbharā tvaṃ khanerjātā suvarṇikā |
vāraṃ vāraṃ prasūtāpi ramā vaikuṇṭhavāsinī || 6 ||
mama patnī sadā divyā yatrāhaṃ tvaṃ ca tatra vai |
gṛhe gṛhe sthitā tvaṃ tu māṃ vinā naiva tiṣṭhasi || 7 ||
yadā mayā pare dhāmni parabrahmasvarūpiṇā |
svasmād rūpaṃ dvitīyaṃ vai ramaṇārthaṃ samīhitam || 8 ||
tadā tvaṃ mama vāmāṃgasthitādṛśyā madicchayā |
matsvarūpādiṣadannyūnā sevikā samajāyathāḥ || 9 ||
rūpe guṇe tathaiśvarye sukhe bhoge vilāsane |
na nyūnā pramadābhāve puṃbhāvanyūnatā tu yā || 1.156.1 0||
saivāsti nyūnatā nāryā nānyā vai nyūnatā mama |
mamaikādaśasaṃkhyākendriyāṇāṃ śaktayastu yāḥ || 11 ||
tāḥ saṃbhūya ca bhavatī jātā vai dvādaśī mama |
patnīrūpā hyato bodhyā dvādaśīti tvameva sā || 12||
tava prāvirbhāvarūpaṃ dvādaśaṃ samajāyata |
tasmāt tvaṃ dvādaśī proktā mama patnī mamāṃganā || 13||
mamāṃgaṃ tvaṃ harervāsād rakṣaṇāt harivāsaraḥ |
dvādaśī tvaṃ mama patnī mama vāsararūpiṇī || 14||
mama rūpaṃ mama vāso ratistvayi sadā mama |
tatastvameva harivāsaro dvādaśī matā || 15||
ityetattu rahasyaṃ vai guptaṃ tubhyaṃ mayoditam |
tataḥ punaḥ samudrasya manthane dvādaśīdine || 16||
prātastvaṃ vai samutpannā tato’pi dvādaśī tava |
janmajayantī prakhyātā sarvatra samajāyata || 17||
yatra yatra ca samaye harernārāyaṇasya me |
prākaṭyaṃ cāpi te lakṣmyāḥ sa kāle balavān bhavet || 18||
harerbalāt samayo’pi balavān puṇyado bhavet |
mama janma tava janma yadā vai jāyate’tra hi || 1 9||
tatra tatra mahotsāhāḥ kartavyā dānabhojanaiḥ |
gītavāditranṛtyaiśca pūjākīrtanabhaktibhiḥ ||1.156.20 ||
ekādaśyāṃ sadāptāyāṃ samupoṣyeha mānavāḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktā yānti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||21||
ekādaśyā vratasyātra pūrṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tadā bhavet |
dvādaśyāmāvayoḥ pūjāṃ tataḥ kuryācca pāraṇām ||22||
saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ jñānato’jñānataḥ kṛtam |
kṣaṇādeva layaṃ yāti dvādaśyāṃ nau prapūjanāt |||23||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi vājapeyaśatāni ca |
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||24||
dvādaśī puṇyadā dravyapradā kāmaprapūriṇī |
mokṣadā sarvalokānāṃ yatrāhaṃ tvaṃ ca pūjitau ||25||
ekādaśī ca yā devī mamendriyamahadbalam |
vrataṃ tayārthitaṃ tadvai nirannameva sarvathā |||26||
tatrānnaṃ naiva bhoktavyaṃ cānne pāpaṃ pratiṣṭhati |
ekādaśīsamaṃ kiñcit pāpatrāṇaṃ na vidyate ||27||
ekādaśendriyaiḥ pāpaṃ yatkṛtaṃ bhavati priye |
ekādaśyupavāsena tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ vrajet ||28||
ekādaśyapi me patnī mama vāsara ucyate |
upavāsena tatrāhaṃ prasannaḥ syāṃ muhurmuhuḥ |||29||
dvādaśyāṃ mama naivedyaṃ kṛtvā kuryācca pāraṇām |
tenāhaṃ sarvadā tṛptaḥ prasanno’pi bhavāmi vai ||1.156.3 0||
mayi tṛpte jagattṛptaṃ sarvatṛptiphalaṃ bhavet |
raṭanti saṃhitāstvatra bhūyo bhūyo mama priye ||3 1 ||
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte harivāsare |
varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ ca strībālānāṃ sadā priye ||32||
ekādaśyāmupavāsaḥ kartavya eva sarvathā |
ekādaśyāṃ yadi śrāddhaṃ mātāpitrormṛte’hani ||33||
dvādaśyāṃ tatpradātavyaṃ nopavāsadine kvacit |
vaiṣṇavāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhaṃ nādantyekādaśīdine ||34||
daśamīmiśritāṃ tāṃ tu prayatnena vivarjayet |
aruṇodayavelāyāṃ dvādaśīmiśritā bhavet ||35||
tāṃ tyaktvā dvādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ prakuryādavicārayam |
trayodaśyāṃ tadā prātaḥ kṛtvā snānādi sattvaram || 36||
trayodaśīkalā cettu sūryodyāne pravartate |
tarhi tu dvādaśībhāge pūrvaṃ sūryodayācca vai || 37||
pāraṇaṃ khalu kartavyaṃ na tu trayodaśīpale |
dvādaśyāmupavāsaśca dvādaśyāmeva pāraṇam || 38||
niśā madhyagatā jāgaraṇayuktā tu tadvratam |
harivāsara ityuktaḥ sarvaśreṣṭho mama priyaḥ ||39||
vratametatparityajya yo hyanyadvratamācaret |
karasthaṃ sa mahārājyaṃ tyaktvā bhaikṣyaṃ tu yācate ||1.156.40 ||
kalāpyekādaśī yatra dvādaśyāmudite ravau |
sarvāmekādaśīṃ tyaktvā tatraivopavased vratī ||41 ||
trayodaśyāṃ kalāyāṃ ca sūryasyodayanaṃ bhavet |
pūrvadine tadā śuddhā dvādaśyeva vrataṃ matam ||42||
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād rātrāvanaṃgavarjitaḥ |
pṛthivīśayanaḥ prātardhātrīphalavilepanaḥ ||42||
snāyīta sandhyāṃ kurvīta pūjāṃ me vidadhīta ca |
upavāsī sāyamekādaśyāṃ saṃpūjayecca mām ||44||
gandhapuṣpairdhūpadauparvastrābharaṇabhojanaiḥ |
japaiḥ stotrairnamaskāraiḥ pūjayenniśi bhaktitaḥ |||45||
lakṣmīṃ ca pūjayed rātrau saubhāgyadravyavastubhiḥ |
keśān saṃsādhayet tatra puṣpamālāṃ tu dhārayet ||46||
grathnīyāt keśaveśaṃ ca kabarīṃ kārayet tataḥ |
sindūragandhitailādi dadyāt keśeṣu mastake ||47||
lalāṭe candanakuṃkumākṣatādīn suśṛṃkhalām |
tantrikāṃ pauraṭīṃ dadyāt candrakaṃ śobhanaṃ kriyāt ||48||
karṇabhūṣānāsikāsubhūṣaṇānyapi dhārayet |
kajjalaṃ netrayordadyādauṣṭhayoḥ rañjanaṃ kriyāt ||49||
gaṇḍayoḥ patrikāṃ dadyāt kapole sūkṣmatillikām |
kaṇṭhe svarṇavibhūṣām̐śca puṣpahārān sudhārayet ||1.156.50 ||
bhujayoḥ kaṭake dadyāt prakoṣṭhe ratnabaṃgiḍīḥ |
aṃguliṣūrmikā dadyāt kausuṃbhī kaṃcukīṃ dharet ||51||
śāṭikāṃ svarṇasūtrāntāṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kaustubham |
lalantikāṃ phullapatrīṃ svarṇapaṭṭīṃ gale dharet |||52||
kaṭyāṃ suvarṇaraśanāṃ kausuṃbhīṃ ghargharīṃ dharet |
pādayoḥ kiṃkiṇīnaddhajharjharān svarṇatroṭakān ||53||
rūpyacchaṭān pradadyāccalaktakaṃ pattale’rcayet |
aṃguliṣūrmikākarṭān dhārayet pādayostu vai ||54||
svarṇatārabhṛte makhammalīyamṛdupāduke |
gandhasārasugandhena vāsayed bahumānataḥ ||55||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇayoścārārtrikaṃ pañcavartibhiḥ |
kuryāt pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavat namaḥ stutikīrtanam ||56||
naivedyaṃ śarkarāghṛtaphalādyaṃ ca nivedayet |
pānīyaṃ mukhaśuddhiṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ cārpayet tataḥ |||57||
śayyāṃ sukhapradāṃ dadyāt komalagendukādikām |
śvetāṃ tūlapaṭīṃ citrāṃ rājāyanīṃ kabarhaṇam ||58||
śayyāyāṃ ca vikīryeta kausumāni dalāni vai |
vyajanenānilaṃ dadyātpādasaṃvāhanaṃ kriyāt ||59||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇayoścājñayāṅgamardanaṃ kriyāt |
svāpayitvā ca devau tau prātaḥ surabhivāribhiḥ ||1.156.60 ||
prabodhya snāpayedbhaktyā dantadhāvanapūrvakam |
vastreṇa mārjayed devau nūtnavastrāṇi dhārayet ||6 1||
tulasīmiśrasalilaistarpitvā pitṛdevatāḥ |
pūjayejjagatāmīśaṃ lakṣmyā saha janārdanam ||62||
komalaistulasīpatraiḥ kamalaiḥ sthalapadmakaiḥ |
sugandhyakṣatapuṣpaiḥ saubhāgyamaṃgalakārakaiḥ ||63||
jalaistathopakaraṇairvibhūṣābhiśca ratnakaiḥ |
dīpānnīrājayettatra śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tataḥ ||64||
śatapatrakṛtāṃ mālāṃ tābhyāṃ samyaṅ nivedayet |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tāmbūlaṃ ca samarpayet ||65||
śarkarāsahitaṃ divyaṃ pāyasānnaṃ sakesaram |
sasujātīphalayuktaṃ cailācūrṇasugandhitam ||66||
pūrikāṃ polikāṃ śākān pakvānnāni hyanekaśaḥ |
takraṃ dadhi payaḥ sūpaṃ kvathikāmodanaṃ tathā ||67||
parpaṭān piṇḍakān dadyādāranālānyanekaśaḥ |
phalāni salilānyalpāṃ mukhaśuddhiṃ ca dakṣiṇām ||68||
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ kṣamāpanamathāpi ca |
pūjottaraṃ vṛṇuyādvai varaṃ sveṣṭaṃ sukhapradam ||69||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sadārogyaṃ vastraṃ vāhanameva ca |
yānaṃ pātrāṇi bhūṣāśca kṣetraṃ sadvāṭikāṃ tathā ||1.156.70||
gomahiṣīvṛṣabhādīn patipatnīsukhaṃ tathā |
apatyaṃ dīrghajīvitvamavighnaṃ kāryamityapi ||71||
abhyudayaṃ mahāsattāṃ rājyaṃ gṛhaṃ ca rāṣṭrakam |
kuṭumbaṃ sukhasampattiṃ svargaṃ cānyad yadiṣṭakam ||72||
vṛṇīta devayoḥ sarvāṃ sukhasaubhāgyasampadam |
pīḍāmupadravaṃ duḥkhaṃ kleśaṃ cintāṃ vimocaya ||73||
vaidhavyamanapatyaṃ ca mā bhūnme vai kadācana |
putrapautraprapautrādikuṭumbaṃ sukhavad bhavet ||74||
ājyena juhuyād vahnau śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tathā |
bhaktyā puruṣasūktena śrīsūktena ca pāyasam ||75||
pratyṛcaṃ juhuyādbhaktyā viprān sādhūṃśca bhojayet |
svayaṃ cāśritavargaṃ vai bhojayitvādanaṃ kriyāt ||76||
saṃhitādiśravaṇena kṣapayecca dinaṃ śubham |
brahmacārī bhūmiśāyī nindādi varjayettathā ||77||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryādevaṃ dvādaśikāvratam |
kuryāt prasanno bhagavān sarvābhīṣṭaprado dhruvam ||78||
harivāsaravratakṛdgṛhe’ṣṭau vasavo diviṃ |
nārāyaṇasya lakṣmyāśca varadānādvasanti vai ||79||
āmo bhavaśca somaśca dharaścaiva nalo’nilaḥ |
pratyūṣaśca prabhāvaśca vasavo’ṣṭau vasanti hi ||1.156.8 0 ||
yatra tīrthe tava pūjā gṛhe yatra tavārcanam |
yatrāraṇye smṛtiste ca yatrābdhau te’bhidhākathā ||81||
yatra loke śravaste’sti tatra sarvatra saṃvasa |
yatra brāhmamuhūrte te me ca dhyānaṃ tu mānasam ||82||
nāmasmṛtiśca bhajanaṃ tatra sākaṃ mayā vasa |
yatra prātarbālavargaḥ prasannau vartate sukhī ||83||
na ca rauti nākrośati tatra sākaṃ mayā vasa |
prātaryatra ca dampatyorna kleśastatra saṃvasa ||84||
prātaryatra dehaśuddhiḥ snānaprakṣālanādibhiḥ |
śayyāśuddhirvastraśuddhirnairmalye tatra saṃvasa ||85||
jalena mārjanenāpi lepanena gṛhācchatā |
raṃgolyā svastikenāpi māṃgalyaṃ tatra saṃvasa ||86||
pradīpasya cullikāgneḥ prātaryatra prakāśanam |
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭaṃ pakvānnaṃ tatra saṃvasa ||87||
piṣṭānnaṃ saktukānnaṃ ca taṇḍulādi surandhitam |
prātargodhūmapolyādi yatra tatra sadā vasa ||88||
prātaḥ kūpataḍāgādijalaṃ gṛhagataṃ bhṛtam |
udakuṃbhau jale tatra sadā pūjājale vasa ||89||
snānaṃ prātaḥ sadā yatra dhyānaṃ devādipūjanam |
pūjyānāṃ pūjanaṃ mānaṃ vṛddhānāṃ tatra saṃvasa ||1.156.90||
yatrāṅganaṃ ca goṣṭhādi mārjitaṃ prātareva ca |
paryuṣitādiśuddhiśca tatra lakṣmi sadā vasa ||9 1 ||
yatra prātarbrāhmaṇasya darśanaṃ ca satāṃ tathā |
sādhvīnāṃ haribhaktānāṃ pitrośca tatra saṃvasa ||92||
viduṣāṃ ca gurūṇāṃ ca satīnāṃ puṇyaśālinām |
devānāṃ ca gavāṃ prātardarśanaṃ tatra saṃvasa ||93 ||
puṇyaṃ ca candrako bhāle kajjala netrayostathā |
puṣpaṃ sugandhadravyaṃ ca yatrāsti tanmukhe vasa ||94||
agnihotraṃ ca gāyatrī viṣṇupūjā śivārcanam |
devānāṃ pūjanaṃ prātarnaivedyaṃ tatra saṃvasa ||95||
kāṣṭhena dantaśuddhiśca śaucaṃ tu mṛjjalādibhiḥ |
snānaṃ saubhāgyabhūṣādi yatra tatra sadā vasa ||96||
bālānāṃ stanyapānādi vatsādīnāṃ ca sevanam |
paśūnāṃ tṛṇatoyādi sevā tatra sadā vasa ||97||
śukādipakṣiṇāṃ sārameyādīnāṃ ca rakṣaṇam |
saṃbhāvanānnatoyābhyāṃ yatra tatra sadā vasa ||98||
vṛṣabhāśvagajoṣṭrāṇāṃ vāhe trāso na yatra vai |
tathānyapaśusaṃtrāso yatra no tatra saṃvasa || 99||
gṛhodyānadrumavallīprabhṛtyudbhijjajātayaḥ |
jalaṃ khādyaṃ cāpnuvanti tatra tvaṃ sarvadā vasa || 1.156.100 ||
kīṭapipīlikādibhyo yatra piṣṭakaṇādikam |
prāpyate gṛhamedhibhyastadgṛhe tvaṃ sadā vasa || 101 ||
grāmasya paśavo yatra tāḍyante na vṛthā janaiḥ |
dayālūnāṃ gṛhe tatra vāmaste’stu mama priye || 10 2||
abhyāgatātithayo bhikṣukāḥ prāghūṇikāstathā |
yatra tṛpyantyannajalairvāṇyā ca tatra saṃvasa || 103 ||
svārthaṃ na bhojanaṃ yatra parārthaṃ devaśeṣitam |
paṃktibhedo na ca yatra na svārthastatra saṃvasa || 1 04||
śrāddhaṃ vratotsavā yatra dhārmikaṃ nṛtyagāyanam |
samājo jñātibhojyaṃ ca parārthaṃ tatra saṃvasa || 105 ||
sādhūnāṃ bhajanaṃ yatra santoṣo dānaśīlatā |
mahatāṃ cāpi sammānaṃ dīnānāṃ tatra saṃvasa || 106 ||
annavastrajalāvāsaiḥ santoṣo’nāthadehinām |
bahūnāṃ jīvikā nyāyyā yatrāsti tatra saṃvasa || 1 07||
sādhūnāṃ brahmacārāṇāmanāthānāṃ ca yadgṛhe |
sevayā bahusantoṣaḥ sarvasve tatra saṃvasa || 108 ||
yadgṛhe naiva kāpaṭyaṃ na kleśo na pratāraṇā |
na śāṭhyaṃ naiva ca krauryaṃ suśāntistatra saṃvasa || 109 ||
lobho roṣo mahodvego matsaro’dharmavṛttitā |
īrṣyāsūyā yatra daṃbho na santi tatra saṃvasa || 1.156.110 ||
tṛṣṇā nindā ca paiśūnyaṃ droho madaśca garvitā |
paradoṣaprakāśitvaṃ na santi tatra saṃvasa || 111 ||
anyāyānnaṃ bhikṣukānnaṃ parānnaṃ pāpināṃ tathā |
duṣṭānnaṃ pacyate naiva yatkukṣau tatra saṃvasa || 112||
vyāpāro nyāyato yatra nyāyyaśca vikrayaḥ krayaḥ |
kāpaṭyaṃ na tulāmāne’rjane dāne sadā vasa || 113 ||
jīrṇe ca nūtane yatra kāpaṭyaṃ miśraṇe nahi |
vāgdāne ca hṛdo dāne śāṭhyaṃ na tatra saṃvasa || 1 14||
paropakārapuṇyārthaṃ yajñārthaṃ rāṣṭrasvastaye |
dravyavyayo bhaved yatra parārthaṃ tatra saṃvasa || 115 ||
parādhīnapaśupakṣiprāṇināṃ hiṃsanaṃ tathā |
trāso yatra na vidyete tatra lakṣmi sukhaṃ vasa || 116 ||
bālānāṃ kanyakānāṃ ca sādhvīnāṃ ca satāṃ tathā |
dīnānāthadaridrāṇāmannasatre sadā vasa || 1 17||
vāpyāṃ kūpataḍāgādau nadyāṃ sarovare bhuvi |
khāte prasravaṇe’khāte prapāyāṃ ca sadā vasa || 118 ||

parvatānāmaraṇyānāṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ tatra saṃvasa || 119 ||
dānayajñāḥ kriyāyajñā yogayajñāśca yadgṛhe |
bhaktiyajñā jñānayajñā yatra tatra sadā vasa || 1.156.120 ||
bhūtayajñā brahmayajñā devayajñāśca yatra vai |

madyaṃ māṃsaṃ tathā cauryamanyāyastryādisevanam |

prajāyā rakṣaṇaṃ nītyā nītimatsu sadā vasa || 1 25||
