tasyāvighnaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ karma vaivāhikaṃ śubham || 174||
kanyā ca sukhasaubhāgyaśīlācāraguṇānvitā |
sādhvī syātputriṇī dhanyā sarvasmṛddhiyutā gṛhe || 175||
athāyaṃ śaṃkaro yogī viveśa girikandaram |
gaṇānniryāpayāmāsa nandyādīn prāha tāṃstadā || 176||
yadāhaṃ ca smarāmyatra smaraṇādaramānasāḥ |
samāgamiṣyatha tadā matpārśvaṃ me gaṇā drutam || 177||
kailāse te gaṇāḥ sarve nānāsthāneṣu saṃyayuḥ |
śaṃbhurvadhvā samaṃ reme vinā kāmaratiṃ tadā || 178||
kvacidgṛthitvā puṣpāṇāṃ mālāṃ satyai nyavedayat |
kvacicca darpaṇe satyā sahānanaṃ vyalokayat || 179||
kadācitkuṇḍale satyāḥ karṇayorapyadhārayat |
kadācitpattale cāsyā raktenāraṃjayaddharaḥ||1.172.180
keśaveśaṃ kadācitsveṃ’ke niṣādya hyakalpayat |
lalāṭe patrikāṃ śaṃbhuścandanenākarotkvacit || 18 1||
āhṛtya padmapuṣpāṇi ramyapuṣpāṇi śaṃkaraḥ |
sarvāṃgeṣu karoti sma puṣpābharaṇamādarāt || 182||
evaṃ bahuvidhairmārgaiḥ reme satīṃ vinodayan |
tayā vinā sma no yāti nāsthito na sma ceṣṭate || 18 3||
tayā vinā kṣaṇamapi śarma lebhe na śaṃkaraḥ |
agamaddhimavatprasthaṃ sasmāra svecchayā smaram || 184||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyai śaṃkaradarśanaṃ bhāryā bhaveti varadānaṃ śaṃbhoḥ kailāsagamanaṃ brahmaṇo dakṣagṛhaṃ prati preṣaṇaṃ kailāsaṃ pratyāgamanaṃ ca śaṃkarasya janavāhinyā dakṣagṛhaṃ prati gamanaṃ satī vivāhaḥ satyāṃ rūpe mohitabrahmaṇo retaḥpatanaṃ tena meghānāṃ vālakhilyānāmutpattiḥ janavā hinyāḥ kailāsaṃ pratyāgamanam janavāha vargavisarjanaṃ kailāsakandare satī śaṃkarayorviharaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 172 ||

<1.173>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi himādrau tu tayorviharatostadā |
kāmasmṛtyā kāmadevaḥ praviṣṭastatra sannidhau || 1 ||
tasminpraviṣṭe śaṃbhau ca satyāṃ ca kāmanā śubhā |
samabhavattadā śaṃbhorbhāvaṃ vijñāya sarvathā || 2 ||
vasantaḥ svasya kartavyaṃ samārebhe harāntike|
mandasugandhaśaityāḍhyo vavau ca malayo marut || 3 ||
vṛkṣāśca puṣpitāḥ sarve latāśca puṣpitāstadā |
virejire palāśāśca kiṃśukaiḥ raktakomalaiḥ || 4 ||
kamalāni vicitrāṇi saraḥsvapi virejire |
padmapuṣpāḍhyapavano vavau tatra harāntike || 5 ||
nāgakeśarapuṣpāṇi svarṇavarṇasugandhibhiḥ |
manojñānyabhavam̐statra śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ || 6 ||
sugandhagandhasaṃpṛktā nāgavallī ca mārutam |
satī śaṃkaranikaṭe prairayanmohakārakam || 7 ||
kokilāśca tadānīṃ susvaraṃ jagurmanoharam |
āmrāḥ praphullitāḥ patramaṃjarībhirbabhustadā || 8 ||
jalāni nirmalānyabhirejuśca phullakāśakāḥ |
jyotiścakrāṇi saṃrejurvāsantikaprabhādibhiḥ || 9 ||
kaumudyā saha raktāśca vibhāvaryo’bhavan priyāḥ |
śādvalāḥ supradeśāścābhavan kāmasukhapradāḥ || 1.173.1 0||
nadīṣu ca nikuṃjeṣu kandarīṣu sthalīṣu ca |
reme satyā samaṃ śaṃbhurvireje śaṃbhunā satī || 11 ||
ramayāmāsa deveśaṃ vividhābhistu kelibhiḥ |

kabarīkaraṇairaṃke svāpanaiścūmbanaistathā |
santoṣayati cālāpairhāsyavīkṣaṇamardanaiḥ || 12 ||

dhanadhānyasmṛddhimati yathāpekṣaṃ tathā kuru || 43 ||

saṃcaranti na gacchanti tata ūrdhvaṃ kadācana ||48 ||

pitaro’tithayaścaivamiti vedeṣu niścitam || 184||
anivedyamabhakṣyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ bhakṣyameva hi |
evamaśnāti yo bhaktyā pārṣadapravaro bhavet || 185||
amṛtaṃ sarvavastūnāmiṣṭasāraṃ sudurlabham |
viṣṇorniveditānnasya kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || 186 ||
hantyakālikamṛtyuṃ tadamṛtaṃ mūḍharaṃjanam |
naivedyaṃ ca harereva haritulyaṃ karotyaho || 187 ||
yadṛcchayā tannaivedyaṃ yo bhuṃkte sādhusaṃgataḥ |
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇāṃ prāpnoti tapasaḥ phalam || 188 ||
yo nivedya hariṃ bhuṃkte bhaktyā bhaktaśca nityaśaḥ |
sa paṃktipāvano bodhyaḥ sa harestejasā samaḥ || 189 ||
nāhaṃ vedavidhātryasmi kimahaṃ vaktumīśvarī |
suciraṃ tu tapastaptvā mayā labdhastvamīśvaraḥ || 1.173.190 ||
tvayā viṣṇoḥ prasādena vaṃcitāhaṃ kathaṃ prabho |
ityabhidhāya durgā tvaṃ rodanaṃ kṛtavatyasi || 191 ||
tato’haṃ tvāṃ parapremṇā kṛtvā vakṣasi sādaram |
kareṇa cakṣuṣornīraṃ saṃmṛjyābodhayaṃ muhuḥ || 192 ||
parituṣṭā tadā tvaṃ māṃ bhartāramuktavatyasi |
kalevaraṃ ca tyakṣyāmi naivedyena vinā hareḥ || 193 ||
bibharmi dehaṃ satataṃ tava saubhāgyavardhanam |
kathaṃ vahāmi saubhāgyarahitaṃ tu kalevaram || 1 94||
apūrvaṃ harinaivedyaṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam |
mahyaṃ dattaṃ na vai yasmātpaśya dehaṃ tyajāmyaham || 195 ||
ityuktvā tvaṃ mahādevi dehaṃ tyaktuṃ samudyatā |
tadā mayā stutā tvaṃ vai mahādevi sthirā bhava || 196 ||
mamāparādhamakhilaṃ kṣantumarhasi sundari |
māṃ bhṛtyaṃ tapasā krītaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru mamopari || 197 ||
icchaiva śrīhareḥ sākṣānnāhaṃ dātumapi kṣamaḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ śrīharericchāṃ durgā tuṣṭā babhūva sā || 198 ||
tato jagāma tūrṇaṃ svarṇadīṃ snānārthamityatha |
snātvā sampūjya bhaktyā ca kṛtvā pakvānnamityatha || 199 ||
naivedye me’rpitavatī tadā nārāyaṇo’pyaham |
gatvā sarvamahaṃ bhuktvā tasyai datvābhivāñchitam || 1.173.200 ||
ājagāma ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ lakṣmi prasādameva tam |
bhartre datvā ca śeṣaṃ yad durgā bhuktavatī ca tat || 201 ||
evaṃ śivāśivau bhaktau prāgbhavīyau hi vaiṣṇavau |
vartete sarvadā magnau yanmūrtau yoginau parau || 202||
na saṃvasāmi goloke vaikuṇṭhe tava vakṣasi |
sadā śivasya hṛdaye nibaddho bhaktipāśataḥ || 203 ||
svarasiddhaṃ sutānena pañcavaktreṇa śaṃkaraḥ |
śaśvadgāyati madgāthāṃ tenāhaṃ taddhṛdi sthitaḥ || 204 ||
mama bhaktiṃ ca dāsyaṃ ca muktiṃ ca sarvasampadaḥ |
mayyevāyaṃ sarvasiddhīḥ samarpayati śaṃkaraḥ || 2 05 ||
pañcavaktre mannāma yo hi gāyatyaharniśam |
madrūpaṃ dhyāyati śaśvanna bhaktaḥ śaṃkarātparaḥ || 206 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīśivayorhimācale vihāraḥ gṛhanirmāṇārthaṃ satī prārthanāgṛhayogyaparvatādināmāni himālaye kailāsapurīnirmāṇaṃ satīkṛtasaṃsārataraṇapraśraḥ śivoktaharinavadhābhaktiḥ śivakṛtapūrvakalpīyatapasā haridarśanaṃ haribhogyaṃ śivasyābhogyamitidhattūrabhasmādidhāraṇaṃ pārvatyoktaharinaivedyamahimetyādinirūpaṇanāmā trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 173 ||

<1.174>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi sutāsnehāt svayaṃ dakṣaprajāpatiḥ |
sutāsaṃbhāvanārthaṃ vai samāyācchaṃkaragṛham || 1 ||
samāyāntaṃ mahādevo dakṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā yathocitām |
dakṣāya pradadau pūjāṃ satkāraṃ ca yathocitam || 2 ||
dakṣastu mānavān śaṃbhurmānahīno munīśvaraḥ |
dvayostu mīlane dakṣa iyeṣādhikasatkṛtam || 3 ||
śaṃbhunā munitulyaṃ vai sammānaṃ tasya saṃkṛtam |
kintu cotthāyābhiyānaṃ tatra nācaritaṃ tadā || 4 ||
tatra heturmahānāsīcchṛṇu lakṣmi hitāvaham |
tapasā cātha dharmeṇa yogena śreṣṭhatāṃ gataḥ || 5 ||
svāpekṣayāpakṛṣṭasyāgame notthānamācaret |
śreṣṭhe samutthite’lpasya sarvapuṇyakṣayo bhavet || 6 ||
vicāryetthaṃ harastatra dakṣaṃ prati na cotthitaḥ |
kintu dakṣastamobhāvaṃ prāpya cukopa cāntare || 7 ||
bālo’yaṃ śaṃkara iti matvā novāca kiṃcana |
evameva prakupito gṛhaṃ jagāma maunataḥ || 8 ||
atha satīṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāṃ dakṣaḥ prāha sudurmanāḥ |
anye jāmātaraḥ śreṣṭhā bhartustava pinākinaḥ || 9 ||
sarve hyutthāya sammānaṃ kurvanti mama cādarāt |
śaṃbhurutthāya sammānaṃ na karoti sute mama || 1.174.10 ||
avyāvahārikaḥ śaṃbhurbāliśaḥ pratibhāti me |
astu śokaṃ na vai kurve bāle kā nāma dharṣaṇā || 11 ||
ityuktvā svīyaputryāḥ saḥ sammānaṃ vidadhe bahu |
satī satkāramādāya kailāse svagṛhaṃ gatā || 12 ||
proktavatī śaṃbhave tattadā vai śaṃbhunā priyā |
bodhitā spaṣṭarūpeṇa mā naśyed dakṣasukṛtam || 13 ||
satī jñātvā ca taddhārdaṃ kiṃcinnovāca tatra vai |
piturlābhāya śarveṇa kṛte tatsukhadaṃ matam || 1 4||
athāpi śaṃbhunā śaptaṃ dakṣo hyāṅgiraso dvijaḥ |
sammānaṃ cecchati matto’dhikaṃ cāghaṭitaṃ bahu || 15 ||
tasmātsa kṣatriyāṃ yoniṃ yātu prācaitasāṃ gṛhe |
prācetasaḥ kṣatriyaḥ sa bhavatu yatra neṣaṇā || 16 ||
sammānasyādhikā matsadṛśādbhavet kadācana |
iti śaṃbhoḥ kṣudraśāpo’bhavad dakṣaprajāpateḥ || 17 ||
nāradasyāpi śāpo’bhūt punarjanmagrahe yataḥ |
dakṣo dvitīyaṃ janmedaṃ prācetasāṃ gṛhe’labhat || 18 ||
tathāpi pūrvasaṃskāro vartate dakṣamānase |
prāgbhavīyajanako’haṃ satyā asmīti mānayan || 19 ||
vartate sarvathā mānī saṃskāro naiva naśyati |
janmāntare ca kaḥ kasya śvaśuro jananī pitā || 1.174.2 0 ||
śaṃbhunaiva gaṇayate bhave’tra śvaśuraṃ nijam |
lokapālaṃ gaṇayati kṣatriyaṃ bahumāninam || 21 ||
athāpi satyāḥ śaṃbhośca jātismarastu vartate |
dakṣaḥ pūrvaḥ evāyaṃ satāpitā punarbhavaḥ || 22 ||
tathāpi cātra kiṃ me’sti gataṃ pūrvabhave’khilam |
iti matvā na vai śaṃbhurmanute śvaśuraṃ nijam || 23 ||
athaikadā punastādṛk prasaṃgaḥ samabhūt priye |
śaṃbhuḥ svayaṃ svakailāse nagarāyāvicārayat || 24 ||
viśvakarmāṇamāhūya puro ramyaṃ susmṛddhimat |
svīyasurabhiśālāyāṃ kārayāmāsa sundaram || 25 ||
bhavanaṃ vistṛtaṃ samyak tatra siṃhāsanaṃ varam |
tatra chatraṃ mahādivyaṃ sarvathādbhutamuttamam || 26 ||
tadvāstukaraṇārthaṃ vai cakāra sumahotsavam |
śakrādīnājuhāvāśu samastān devatāgaṇān || 27 ||
siddhagandharvanāgādīnupadeṣṭṛm̐śca kṛtsnaśaḥ |
devānmunīnāgamām̐śca vidhiṃ śiṣyaiḥ ṛṣīnapi || 28 ||
devīḥ sarvā apsarobhirnānāvastubhiranvitāḥ |
devānāṃ ca tatharṣīṇāṃ siddhānāṃ phaṇināmapi || 29 ||
ānayanmaṃgalahastāḥ kanyāḥ ṣoḍaśa ṣoḍaśa |
vīṇāmṛdaṃgapramukhavādyānnānāvidhām̐stathā || 1.174.30 ||
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsa vādayitvā sugāyanaiḥ |
rājyābhiṣekayogyāni dravyāṇi sakalauṣadhaiḥ || 31 ||
pratyakṣatīrthapāthobhiḥ paṃcakubhām̐śca pūritān |
tathānyāḥ saṃvidhā divyā ānayat svagaṇaistadā || 32 ||
brahmaghoṣaṃ mahārāvaṃ cakrustatra tu bhūsurāḥ |
haro hariṃ sanmuhūrte nūtne sihāsane vare || 33 ||
upāveśya bahuprītyā bhūṣayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ |
ābaddhya ramyamukuṭaṃ kṛtakautukamaṃgalam || 34 ||
viṣṇuṃ tuṣṭāva taṃ śaṃbhuḥ svatantraṃ bhaktavatsalam |
anyaṃ sarvaṃ samājaṃ ca namaskṛtya haraḥ sthitaḥ || 35 ||
dakṣo’tra mānavānāyāt prajāpatibhiranvitaḥ |
śaṃbhunā satkṛtāḥ sarve dakṣo’pi saha satkṛtaḥ || 36 ||
bhojanācchādanapānamānayānavihārakaiḥ |
satkṛtāḥ sarvathā sarve dakṣaścaicchadviśeṣataḥ || 3 7||
sammānaṃ tu nijaṃ tatra śvāśuryasyābhiyogataḥ |
dakṣaḥ śaṃbhorgṛhamadhye jagāma svasutānanam || 38 ||
draṣṭuṃ praṣṭuṃ sukhaṃ śāntiṃ tadā śaṃbhustu notthitaḥ |
dakṣastadāntare’tīva mānī cukopa vai punaḥ || 3 9||
satīmāpṛcchya kuśalaṃ sukhaṃ cānāmayaṃ tathā |
dakṣo jagāma harmyaṃ svaṃ cānye’pi svagṛhān gatāḥ ||1.174.40 ||
pratyakṣaṃ tadidaṃ cābhūdavamānaṃ prajāpateḥ |
anāhūte’paricite hyanāgamanamuttamam ||4 1 ||
evaṃ manasi sandhārya tadāpi dakṣa ātmani |
avamānaṃ rarakṣaiva bahirnaivāprakāśayat ||42 ||
atha kālāntare naimiṣāraṇye ca tapodhanāḥ |
dīrghasatraṃ prakurvanto bhṛgvādyāstu maharṣayaḥ ||43||
āsannekatritāstatra samājagmurharādayaḥ |
āgatām̐ste ca dadṛśurmunayo dīrghasatriṇaḥ ||44||
uttasthuryugapatsarve saharṣāśca samutsukāḥ |
datvārghyapādyaṃ satkṛtya munayo vītakalmaṣāḥ ||45 ||
paśyanti sma haraṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ pulahādikān |
manavaścāgatāstatra tathā dakṣo’pi cāgataḥ ||46||
yadṛcchayā samāpannaḥ pūjitaśca maharṣibhiḥ |
stutibhiḥ praṇipātaiśca tathā sarvaiḥ surāsuraiḥ ||47||
abhipūjita evāsau niṣasāda sabhāntare |
rudreṇa na kṛtā tasyābhyutthānanatisatkriyāḥ ||48||
viśeṣataḥ svasya mānaṃ na jātaṃ rudrasatkṛtam |
cukopa rudraṃ tvaritaṃ tadā dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||49||
uvāca paruṣaṃ vākyaṃ rudramuddiśya tatra vai |
ete namanti sarve māṃ viprāḥ surāsurādikāḥ ||1.174.50 ||
abhyutthānādinā sarve mānayanti bhṛśaṃ ca mām |
kathaṃ durjanavaccāyaṃ naivottiṣṭhati bhūtapaḥ ||5 1 ||
śmaśānavāsī nistrapaḥ pretapiśācasaṃyutaḥ |
anuttamo mattasakhā karoti na natiṃ ca me ||52||
jātyā ca karmabhirhīnaḥ pākhaṇḍī durjanapriyaḥ |
pāpaśīlaścoddhataśca nindako’śucireva ca ||5 3 ||
tyājyo’yaṃ sarvadā sadbhirbahiṣkāryaśca sarvathā |
yadā yadā gṛhaṃ tasya gato’haṃ mūrkharāḍayam ||54||
naivottiṣṭhati sāmīpye me’vamānaṃ karoti vai |
tasmādayaṃ yajñabāhyo bhavatvadyadinātsadā ||55||
rudrasyānucarāṃ ye ca te’pi vedbahiṣkṛtāḥ |
pākhaṇḍavādasaṃyuktāḥ śiṣṭācāravivarjitāḥ | 56||
kapālinaḥ pānaratāḥ kālānanā bhavantviti |
nandī niśamya tadvākyaṃ dakṣaṃ prati ruṣānvitaḥ ||57||
śaśāpa dakṣaṃ tatpakṣān brāhmaṇām̐ścānyavarṇinaḥ |
vedavādaratā yūyaṃ nānyadastītivādinaḥ ||58||
kāmātmānaḥ svargaparāḥ krodhalobhasamanvitāḥ |
vaidikavidhinā viprā bhavantu śūdrayājakāḥ ||59||
daridriṇo bhavantvatra pratigraharatāstathā |
asatpathagatāḥ sarve bhavantu brahmarākṣasāḥ ||1.174.60 ||
śaṃbhuḥ śāntastadā prāha nandinaṃ svasya sevakam |
kopaṃ nārhasi vai kartuṃ brāhmaṇānprati sarvadā ||61 ||
ko’yaṃ kastvaṃ kva cāhaṃ vai kasmācchaptāstvayā dvijāḥ |
prapaṃcaracanāṃ tyaktvā prabuddho bhava sevaka ||62||
śātiṃ ca prāpitāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇusurādibhiḥ |
dakṣo gato gṛhaṃ svasya svāvamānaṃ smaran muhuḥ ||63 ||
tataḥ kāle mahān yajñaḥ samārabdhaśca tena vai |
dakṣeṇa dīkṣitenātivistārastatra carṣayaḥ ||64||
āhūtāśca vaśiṣṭhādyāstapasvinaḥ samāyayuḥ |
kaśyapo’trirvāmadevo hyagastyaśca bhṛgustathā ||65||
parāśaro dadhīcaśca vyāsaśca gautamaḥ sitaḥ |
gargaḥ pailo bharadvājo bhārgavaḥ kakupaḥ kṛtiḥ ||66||
tathānye ṛṣayo devā lokapālā diśādhipāḥ |
gandharvāḥ kinnarā vidyādharāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ ||67||
satyalokānsamānītaḥ sāvitrīsaṃyutastvajaḥ |
vaikuṇṭhācca tato viṣṇurlakṣmīramādisaṃyutaḥ ||68||
indrastatra samānītaścendrāṇyā saha svargataḥ |
tathā candro’pi rohiṇyā vāruṇyā varuṇastathā ||69||
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho māruto mṛgavāhanaḥ |
pāvako bastayānaśca nairṛtaḥ pretavāhanaḥ ||1.174.70||
dārāḥ putrāśca śiṣyāśca pārṣadā mantriṇastathā |
parivārāstathā vedāsteṣāṃ teṣāṃ samāgatāḥ ||71 ||
evamanye samāyātā dakṣayajñe kṛtādarāḥ |
satkṛtāstena dakṣeṇa sarve te bahuvastubhiḥ |||72||
bhavanāni mahārhāṇi suprabhāṇi mahānti ca |
tvaṣṭrā kṛtāni divyāni tebhyo dattāni tena vai ||73||
teṣu sarveṣu dhiṣṇyeṣu yathāyogyaṃ ca te sthitāḥ |
sammānitā arājam̐ste sakalā viṣṇunā mayā ||74||
athāsiknī satīmātā pūrvadakṣavivāhitā |
dakṣaṃ jātaṃ punarjñātvā tatrāgatyāvasat sadā ||75||
sā cāsiknī tatra śaṃbhuṃ yadarthamatapatsatī |
na dadarśa samāyātaṃ tadā prāha prajāpatim ||76||
dakṣaṃ natvāvadatprahvīkṛtāntaḥkaraṇā natā |
kathaṃ satī tathā śaṃbhurdṛśyete nātra tūtsave ||77||
dakṣaḥ prāha tadāsiknīṃ tayornāsti prayojanam |
satī tu sarvadā snigdhā pitrormānābhilāṣiṇī ||78 ||
śaṭhaḥ śarvo na vai snigdho me’vamānaprakārakaḥ |
atīva garvito jātaḥ satīṃ me prāpya kanyakām ||79 ||
kasyacinnāpyasau prāyo na kaścidasya vā priyaḥ |
kiṃvaṃśyastveṣa kiṃgotraḥ kiṃdeśīyaḥ kimātmakaḥ ||1.174.8 0 ||
kiṃvṛttiḥ kiṃsamācāro viṣādī vṛṣavāhanaḥ |
na prāyaśastapasvyeṣa kva tapaḥ kvāstradhāraṇam ||8 1 ||
na gṛhastheṣu gaṇyo’sau śmaśāne tiṣṭhate sadā |
nāyaṃ tu brahmacārī syād yataḥ satyā vivāhitaḥ ||8 2||
vānaprāsthyaṃ na caivāsminnaiśvaryamadamohite |
na jāne brāhmaṇo nāsti vedaścainaṃ na vetti yat ||8 3 ||
na jāne kṣatriyo nāsti prāyaḥ śastrāstrasaṃgrahāt |
kṣatāttrāṇaṃ nāsti cāsminsarveṣāṃ pralayapriye ||84||
nirdhano’raṇyaratimāna vaiśyo’pi naiva bhāti me |
kathaṃ śūdre samāveśo nāgayajñopavītinaḥ ||85 ||
evaṃ varṇāśramātītaḥ ko bhavenaiva budhyate |
sarvaḥ prakṛtyā jñāyeta sthāṇuḥ prakṛtivarjitaḥ ||86||
prāyaśaḥ puruṣo nāsau yato’rdhapramadāmayaḥ |
nāpi vai kevalānārī yato’sau śmaśrulānanaḥ ||87||
nāpi napuṃsako vāsti liṃgaṃ tvasya prapūjyate |
na cāpi bālarūpoyaṃ bahuvarṣodbhavo yataḥ ||88||
manvate taṃ marīcyādyā vṛddhaṃ nāyaṃ yuvā yataḥ |
vṛddho’pi kathamāstheyo jarāmṛtyuvivarjitaḥ ||8 9 ||
saṃhārayati sarvānvai tathāpyeṣa na pātakī |
puṇyaleśaḥ kathaṃ cātra brahmamastakanāśake || 1.174.90 ||
muṇḍahāradhare kvāsya śucitvaṃ vai digambare |
nāyaṃ ca dhanavānnaivāpatyavānna kuṭumbavān || 91 ||
nāsya mātā nāsya gotraṃ na vaṃśo nāpi dehavān |
śmaśāne vartate nityaṃ śvādo naivopalakṣyate ||92 ||
kiṃ bahūktena me devi jñāyate nāsya ceṣṭitam |
aho dhārṣṭyaṃ māṃ pratyeva jaṭilasyāvamānakṛt || 93 ||
yadāsanānnotthito’yaṃ dṛṣṭvā māṃ śvaśuraṃ gurum |
etādṛśā bhavantyeva mātāpitṛvivarjitāḥ || 94|||
nirguṇā akulīnāśca karmabhraṣṭā niraṃkuśāḥ |
yatheṣṭācaraṇāḥ svābhimānino yantṛvarjitāḥ || 95||
akiṃcanā api stabdhā bhavantīśvaramāninaḥ |
jāmātā jambukatulyaḥ śvaśure mṛgapāyate || 96||
asikni tava jāmātā mama mastakanāśakaḥ |
yato’vamantā me jātastasmānnākārito mayā || 97||
tasyāhaṃ garvasarvasvaṃ hariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ |
yathāvamānitaścāhamavamaṃsye tathaiva tam || 98 ||
tasmāttvayā na smartavyo mā yajñe phalabhāgbhavet |
iti dakṣeṇāgryapatnī bodhitā maunamāsthitā || 99 ||
viniḥśvāsaṃ tadā muktvā dīrghaṃ sutāṃ vināśapat |
notsave svasutāputrajāmātrādyāsyadarśanam || 1.174.100 ||
prajvalatūtsavastādṛk kusavaḥ sa tu kathyate |
yatrāsusamaputryādidarśanaṃ nopalabhyate || 101 ||
ityasiknyā manodagdho yajñāraṃbhastu bhasmitaḥ |
rājyamātuḥ śāpadagdho’vaśyaṃ dagdho bhaviṣyati || 102 ||
dakṣaścāgatya māṃ viṣṇuṃ yajñapūruṣamityapi |
mahākratūpadraṣṭāraṃ cakre’rpitasvamastakaḥ || 103 ||
prāha devānṛṣīn viprānprajāpām̐śca manūm̐stathā |

guḍānāṃ śarkarāṇāṃ ca phalānāṃ rāśayaḥ kṛtāḥ |
dukūlānāṃ ca ratnānāṃ bhogyānāṃ śikharāṇi ca || 192||

dhvanirmaṃgalagītānāṃ vyānaśe sarvatomukham || 193||

<1.175>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kalahasya gṛhaṃ rudragṛhaṃ gatam |
dvayorvai gṛhayoraikye kimaniṣṭaṃ na jāyate || 1 ||
nārado vyomamārgeṇa prāpya vai dhāma śāṃkaram |
kṣaṇaṃ tatra mahodyāne kailāse’vātaradbhuvi || 2 ||
viśaśrāma hariṃ dhyāyan satī tadantare bahiḥ |
tasminnevodyānavarye’viharat svasakhīyutā || 3 ||
tayā dṛṣṭāni vyomnyeva svargātpṛthvīṃ patanti vai |
vimānāni bhaginīnāṃ dāsadāsīyutāni ca || 4 ||
patibhiḥ kṛtaśṛṃgāraprabhṛtīnāṃ mahānti hi |
svasakhīṃ vijayāṃ prāhālokya satī tu rohiṇīm || 5 ||
re sakhīpravare paśya rohiṇī bhaginī mama |
candrayuktā vimānasthā kva yāti pṛccha satvaram || 6 ||
śīghraṃ tu vijayāpṛcchya jñātvā yajñotsavādikam |
dakṣagṛhe vartate’tastatra yātīti cāha tām || 7 ||
tāvadanyavimānāni prayānti vyomamārgataḥ |
tānyapyālokya bahudhā satī cetasyacintayat || 8 ||
dakṣaḥ pitā mama mātā hyasiknī vīriṇī tathā |
āhvānaṃ me na kurvanti vismṛtāḥ kiṃ satīṃ sutām || 9 ||
pṛccheyaṃ kāraṇaṃ tatra śaṃkaraṃ sarvamādarāt |
vicāryetthaṃ yayau tūrṇaṃ satī tu śaṃkarānvitam || 1.175.1 0||
satkṛtā śaṃkareṇātha satyuvāca prabhuṃ tadā |
piturmama mahān yajño bhavatīti mayā śrutam || 11 ||
tatrotsavo mahānasti samavetā maharṣayaḥ |
tatra kathaya gamanaṃ kasmāttava na rocate || 12||
āvābhyāṃ tatra gantavyaṃ bahūnāṃ darśanaṃ bhavet |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha sati dakṣo mama drohī viśeṣataḥ || 1 3||
pitustavādhvare prāptā mānino jñānavarjitāḥ |

anāhūtāstu ye yānti paragṛhaṃ tu te janāḥ |
prāpnuvantyavamānaṃ yanmaraṇādatiricyate || 15||
parālayaṃ gato’pīndro laghurbhavati vai yataḥ |

śatruśaraiḥ praviddho’pi na tathā vyathate janaḥ |
yathā svajanarūkṣoktairmarmabhedibhirardyate || 17||
mamopari tapastaptaṃ tasmānmayā vivāhitā |
na cet taptaṃ mādṛśastu kathaṃ pāśe’tra saṃpatet || 18||
vidyaiśvaryādibhirjāte garve khalāḥ satāṃ guṇān |
gaṇayantyeva nahite nādriyante mahājanān || 19||
śrutvaitatsahasā devī prāha svaprāṇarakṣakam |
kathaṃ dakṣeṇa nāhūtau jñātumicchāmi tattvataḥ ||1.175.20||
anujñāṃ dehi me nātha gantuṃ dakṣamakhe’dya vai |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha satīṃ sādhvi gantuṃ te prabalā ruciḥ ||21||
yadyastyāruhya vṛṣabhaṃ sajjaṃ bhūṣitameva ca |
mahārājñyupacārāṇi kṛtvā nītvā gaṇānbahūn |||22|
subhūṣitā gaccha yajñaṃ chatracāmaralakṣitā |
ityetadantare tatra nārado’pyāgato haram |||23||
dṛṣṭvā śivau praṇamyātha śaṃbhunā satkṛtādaraḥ |
tatpradattāsane ramye hyupāviśanmahāmuniḥ ||24||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha kathaṃ dattaṃ darśanaṃ bhavatā mune |
asti kiṃcidvicitraṃ cedbrūhi śīghraṃ ca mā ciram |||25||
ityājñāṃ prāpya devarṣiḥ vṛttaṃ tatprāha śaṃkaram |
adya nīlagireścāhaṃ haridvārasamīpataḥ ||26||
apūryamiva saṃvīkṣya pariprāptastavāntikam |
trailokye yacca puṃjātaṃ sakalatrasutādikam ||27||
sālaṃkāraṃ samānaṃ ca sānandamukhapaṃkajam |
dṛṣṭaṃ dakṣādhvare kintu bhavaddvandvaṃ na lokitam ||28||
prāyo viṣādajanakaṃ tatra yuṣmadadarśanam |
dakṣasya marmabhedīni vacanāni śrutāni vai |||29||
tāni vaktuṃ na śakyāni śrutvā tvadgarhaṇāgiraḥ |
mayā tu pihitau karṇau pratyuktāni dadhīcinā ||1.175.30||
dakṣaḥ śaptaḥ kratuṃ tyaktvā durvāsaḥ pramukhā dvijāḥ |
śaṃbhunindāṃ samākarṇya kiyantastu viniryayuḥ ||3 1||
prāvartata mahāyāgo dakṣapakṣātipātibhiḥ |
bhaginyastatra yāste tāḥ svasvāmiparicārikāḥ ||32||
dakṣato gauravaṃ prāptāstadvaktuṃ nāhamutsahe |
tatro’trārthe vidheyaṃ tadvidhīyetāṃ prayāmyaham ||33||
gate tu nārade devī prāṃjaliḥ prāha śaṃkaram |
vijayasvāndhakadhvaṃsin dehyanujñāṃ mama prabho ||34||
gatvā paśyāmi duṣṭatvaṃ kathamāvāṃ nirākṛtau |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha priyāṃ yajño gantavyārtho na bhāti me ||35||
kimapūrṇaṃ tavāstyatra mā parīkṣākṛte’pyagāḥ |
kuto māṃ hātumicchestyaṃ gamane śaṃ na dṛśyate ||36||
satī prāha mano me te pādayoḥ sthāsyati dhruvam |
kratuṃ draṣṭuṃ pituryāmi naikṣi yajño mayā kvacit ||37||
śaṃbhuḥ prāhādharekṣā cedāharāmi tataḥ kratum |
kratuṃ kriyāṃ tathā yajñapuruṣaṃ lokapālakān ||38||
anyānāśu vidhehi tvamṛṣīnārtvijya karmaṇi |
satī prāha niṣedhīrmā draṣṭavyaḥ pituradhvaraḥ ||39||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā devīṃ nārīhaṭhādhirohitām |
adya devi paścimāyāṃ dikśūlaṃ vāsaro’śubhaḥ ||1.175.40||
tithinakṣatrayogāśca viparītā bhavanti vai |
mā gā devi gatādya tvaṃ nahi drakṣyasi māṃ punaḥ ||41 ||
tadā satī babhāṣe yat yadi nāmnāsmyahaṃ satī |
tadā tanvantareṇāpi kariṣye tava dāsatām ||42||
tadā bhavaḥ punaḥ prāha ko vā vārayituṃ kṣamaḥ |
haṭhavyāptamanovṛttiṃ striyaṃ vā puruṣaṃ ca vā ||43||
mā yāhi devi māṃ hitvā gatā tvaṃ na miliṣyasi |
paraṃ na devi gantavyaṃ mahāmānadhanecchubhiḥ ||44||
anāhūtatayā kānte mātāpitṛgṛhānapi |
punarna darśanaṃ devi mama satyaṃ bravīmyaham ||45||
devyuvāca yadi raktā tava pādāmbujadvaye |
tathā tvameva me nātho bhaviṣyasi bhavāntare ||46||
ityuktvā niryayau devī haṭhāndhīkṛtamānasā |
na nanāma tadā śaṃbhuṃ na ca cakre pradakṣiṇam ||47||
ata eva hi sā devī gatā na punarāgatā |
devo’pi tāṃ satīṃ yāntīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu vivyathe hṛdi ||48 ||
gaṇānprāha saha devyā gacchantu sainyaśālinaḥ |
vimānaṃ śāṃkaracihnamāruhya yātu vaiṃ satī || 49 ||
devī vimānamāruhya yātā yajñasthalāṃgaṇam |
suchatracāmarādīni sadvastrābharaṇāni ca ||1.175.50 ||
mahārājñyupacārāṇi dattāni śaṃkareṇa vai |
gaṇāḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi raudrā jagmuḥ śivājñayā ||5 1 ||
hetisajjāḥ sayānāśca kutūhalotsavānvitāḥ |
nabho’ṅgaṇādvimānasthā sā tu vegādavātarat || 52 ||
āviśadyajñavāṭaṃ ca harṣastasyā vyavardhata |
śivapriyāyāḥ satkāro vāmadevādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ ||53 ||
kutūhalaṃ gaṇāścakruḥ śivayoryaśa ujjaguḥ |
pupluvuḥ kūrdanaṃ cakrurākāśe gaṇapuṃgavāḥ ||54||
jayāmbike jaya śaṃbho hyārāvaiḥ pūritaṃ jagat||
dākṣāyaṇī gatā tatra yajñasthale mahāprabhe ||65 ||
surāsuramunīndrādikutūhalasamanvite |
namaskṛtyāgnidevaṃ ca samājaṃ maṇḍapasthitam ||56 ||
jagāma jalapānāya svapiturbhavanaṃ tataḥ |
dadarśa suprabhaṃ cāru nānāścaryasamanvitam |||57||
mātṛsvasṛduhitṛtatsutāsutādisaṃśritam |
āgatāṃ ca satīṃ dṛṣṭvāsiknī ca vīriṇī tathā ||58 ||
cakruḥ samādaraṃ tasyā bhaginyaśca yathocitam |
daduḥ salilapānādi cāsanaṃ sukhaśāntidam ||59 ||
viśramya ca kṣaṇaṃ natvā mātaraṃ bhaginīstataḥ |
avaruhyāsanāt śīghramekaivāgacchadadhvaram ||1.175.6 0 ||
tatra svapitaraṃ natvā tathānyānvṛddhapuṃgavān |
kṛtamaṃgalanepathyāḥ prasūścānyāḥ kirīṭinīḥ || 61 ||
sabhartṛkāśca bhaginīrnavālaṃkṛtiśālinīḥ |
jyeṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhāḥ sāścaryāḥ sānandāśca kuṭumbinīḥ |||62||
satī cāho samāyātetyāścaryeṇa prapaśyatīḥ |
sarvā natvā vṛddhamātṛsamāśca haravallabhā ||63 ||
maṇḍapasthasamāje sā gatā dakṣāntikaṃ satī |
pitrā pṛṣṭā ca mātrā ca bhadraṃṃ jātaṃ tavāgame || 64||
ehi tiṣṭha priyaputri jāmātā svidanāmayaḥ |
te’pi svargyaṃ sukhaṃ nityaṃ nirābādhaṃ svidasti vai || 65||
satyuvāca yadi vṛddhau sukhinau cāsmi sukhyaham |
yuvayoścāpi jāmātā śivaḥ sukhī sadāsti vai ||66||
duḥkhamātraṃ prasaṃge’tra yadadarśanameva yat |
yena yajñaḥ paripūrṇo bhavet so’tra na vidyate ||67||
yadi bhadraṃ janetarme samāgamanato bhavet |
kathaṃ śaṃbhurahaṃ naivāhūtau cātra mahotsave ||68 ||
anye jāmātaraḥ putryaḥ samāhūtāḥ prasaṃgataḥ |
satīṃ śaṃbhuṃ parityajya kuto bhadraṃ śubhaṃ tava || 69 ||
abhadraṃ hyaśubhaṃ cātra paśyāmi ca kṣaṇāntare |
iti saṃbhāṣya mumocāśrubindūn piturantike ||1.175.7 0 ||
dakṣaḥ prāha ayi putri mahādhanye’timaṃgale |
tava doṣo manāṅnāsti mā śokaṃ kuru mānasam ||7 1 ||
jahyudvegaṃ sukhaṃ tiṣṭha mama doṣo’sti sarvathā |
yanmayābuddhinā kanyāratnaṃ śarve’pavarjitam ||72 ||
yadahaṃ tatsamājñāsyamīśo’panīśa āntare |
tadā kathamadāsyaṃ tvāṃ māyādhipataye śubhe ||73 ||
ahaṃ śivābhidhānena vañcito’śivakarmaṇi |
brahmaṇā bahudhā so’yaṃ praśaṃsito mamāgrataḥ ||74||
śaṃkaro’yamayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ śivaḥ sārthakanāmavān |
dehyasmai ca satīṃ kanyāṃ tadyogyā sarvathāsti sā ||75 ||
śrīkaṇṭho’sau maheśo’sau sarvajño vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ |
dhanvī sārthakanāmāsau dehyasmai te satīṃ sutām ||76||
iti viśvāsamādhāya dāpitā tvaṃ hi vedhasā |
na jñātaḥ sa virūpākṣa ukṣago viṣabhakṣakaḥ ||77||
pitṛkānanasaṃvāsaḥ śūladhṛkca kapāladhṛk |
dvijihvasaṃgasubhago jalādhāraḥ kapardavān ||78 ||
kalaṃkikṛtamauliśca dhūlīdhūsaracarcitaḥ |
kvacitkaupīnavasano nagno vātūlavat kvacit ||79 ||
kvacittu carmavasanaḥ kvacidbhikṣāṭanapriyaḥ |
virūpabhūtānucaraḥ sthāṇurugrastamoguṇaḥ ||1.175.8 0 ||
rudro raudraparīvāro mahākālavapurdharaḥ |
nṛkaroṭīparikaro jātigotravivarjitaḥ ||8 1 ||
brahmaṇā guṇavānukto jānāno’haṃ pratāritaḥ |
kimbahūktena tanaye samastanayaśālini ||8 2 ||
kva pāṃsulapaṭacchanno mahāśaṃkhavibhūṣaṇaḥ |
prabaddhasarpakeyūraḥ pradhūsarajaṭāsaṭaḥ ||8 3 ||
ḍamaḍḍamarukavyagrahastāgraḥ khaṇḍacandrabhṛt |
tāṇḍavāḍambararuciḥ sarvāmaṃgalaceṣṭitaḥ ||84||
evaṃvidho haraḥ kvāyamadhvaro maṃgalālayaḥ |
ata eva samāhūtau yuvāṃ na maṃgale’dhvare ||85 ||
dukūlānyanukūlāni ratnālaṃkaraṇāni ca |
hāraśreṣṭhā vibhūṣāśca prāgeva tvatkṛte mayā ||86 ||
rakṣitāstānpaśya putri sarvān śreṣṭhān gṛhāṇa ca |
śaṃkarārthamapi putri yadyannetuṃ samīhase ||87 ||
tatsarvaṃ saha netavyaṃ yajñapūrtyuttaraṃ sati |
yāvadetāstava sakhyaḥ svasāraścoṣitā makhe ||88 ||
tāvat tato’pyadhikaṃ tvaṃ vasātra tava rocate |
śrutvātidūnahṛdayā satī vaktuṃ pracakrame ||89 ||
bhāgānapaśyad devānāṃ haryādīnāṃ tadadhvare |
śaṃbhubhāgamanālokya kaṣṭaṃ vaktuṃ pracakrame || 1.175.90 ||
nākarṇitaṃ mayā kiṃcit prabrūvati pitastvayi |
padadvayīṃ samākarṇya tāṃ ca te kathayāmyaham || 91 ||
māyādhipatirevāyaṃ jānāno’pi pratāritaḥ |
etatsatyaṃ tvayākhyāyi māyādhipatireva saḥ || 92||
parabrahmaparamātmā śivarūpeṇa vartate |
māyānvitaśca māyāyā vyatiriktaḥ śivaḥ sa vai || 93 ||
tvaṃ ca pratāritaḥ pūrvamadhunāpi pratāritaḥ |
ajñātvā dattavān kanyāṃ dattvāsambaddhamucyate || 94||
tādṛśo manyate śaṃbhuḥ kuto māmadadāstadā |
na hetuste matistatra heturmatpuṇyagauravam || 95||
yena pūtamidaṃ viśvaṃ samagraṃ sacarācaram |
yajño yajñavidāṃ śreṣṭho yajñāṃgo yajñadakṣiṇaḥ || 96 ||
yajñakartā svayaṃ śaṃbhustaṃ vinā tu kathaṃ makhaḥ |
makhaḥ syānmama dehasya paśya dakṣa kṣaṇāntare || 97||
yasya smaraṇamātreṇa sarvaṃ pūtaṃ bhavatyaho |
taṃ tu śaṃbhuṃ vinā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ cākṛtameva tat || 98 ||
dravyamantrādikaṃ sarvaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca yanmatam |
śaṃbhunā hi vinā kṛtamapavitraṃ bhaviṣyati || 99||
kiṃ śivaṃ surasāmānyaṃ matvākārṣīranādaram |
bhraṣṭā buddhistava jātā vārdhakye iva sarvathā || 1.175.100 ||
viṣṇubrahmādayaḥ sarve yaṃ jānanti pareśvaram |
tva na jānāsi taṃ śaṃbhuṃ mā jānīhi tathottaram || 101 ||
ete kathaṃ samāyātā viṣṇubrahmādayo’dhvare |
jānanto’pi vinā śaṃbhuṃ lajjante na mukhadṛśaḥ || 102 ||
he viṣṇo tvaṃ mahādevaṃ tyaktvā yajñe’tra dṛśyase |
na lajjase sadā mitraṃ vismṛtyātra pravartase || 103 ||
re brahmam̐stvaṃ paṃcamukho’bhūrgarviṣṭho haraṃ prati |
kṛtaścaturmukhastena vismṛto’si tadadbhutam || 1 04||
yadi kruddho mahādevaścatvāryapi vineṣyati |
he sūrya candra cendrāde na svijjānatha śaṃkaram || 105 ||
vaśiṣṭhādyāśca munayo na vai jānatha śaṃkaram |
vajraṃ prajvālitaṃ yena kāmaḥ prajvālitastathā || 106 ||
dāruvane liṃgapāte yena prajvālitaṃ jagat |
prāgbhavīyām̐ścamatkārān kiṃsvid vismarathātra hi || 107 ||
sa yadi krodhamāpanno yuṣmākaṃ kiṃ bhaviṣyati |
sarve kāṃ mūrkhatāṃ prāptā vinā śaṃbhuṃ pratiṣṭhatha || 108 ||
iti tvekavidhā vāco’gadanmakhe maheśvarī |
kaupānvitā satī tatra hṛdyena vidūyatā || 109 ||
maunī bhūto’bhavacchrutvā samājo bhayavihvalaḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato dakṣaḥ kruddho’bravīt kṣayakaram || 1.175.110 ||
tava kiṃ bahunoktena na te kāryaṃ hi sāmpratam |
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā putri kasmāccātra samāgatā || 111 ||
sarvapūjyāvamānaṃ tvaṃ karoṣyāgatya cādhvare |
gaccha maunaṃ vasa vātra nāhūtāsi vilajjike || 112 ||
amaṃgalastu te bhartā bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ |
akulīno vedabāhyaḥ nāhūto’tra mayā tadā || 113 ||
devarṣisaṃsadi vedhaḥpreritena mayārpitā |
mandabhāgyena rudrāyāviditārthāya kiṃ bhavet || 11 4||
kopaṃ mā vraja rudrāṇi svasthā bhava śucismite |
yadyāgatāsi me yajñe dāyaṃ gṛhṇīṣva cātmanā || 115 ||
śrutvātha sā satī śaṃbhornindāmacintayat hṛdi |
dāyaṃ nītvāpi kiṃ me syātkathaṃ vai yāmi śaṃkaram || 116 ||
śaṃkareṇa yadi pṛṣṭā tatra vakṣye kimuttaram |
tasmādatraiva martavyaṃ prāpsye dehāntare haram || 117 ||
iti nirṇīya pitaraṃ niḥśvasantī hyuvāca ha |
kiṃ jīvitena me tāta śṛṇvantyā patigarhaṇām || 118 ||
yo nindati mahādevaṃ nindyamānaṃ śṛṇoti vā |
tāvubhau narakaṃ yātau yāvaccandradivākarau || 119 ||
yadi śakto nindakasya jihvāṃ chindyātprasahya vai |
yadyaśaktaḥ supidhāya karṇau gacchet sthalāntaram || 1.175.12 0 ||
śaṃbhunā tu niṣiddhāpi prasahyātra samāgatā |
phalaṃ tasyātra me prāptaṃ kva gantavyaṃ mayādhunā || 12 1 ||
asmaracchāṃkaraṃ vākyaṃ paścāttāpamavāpa sā |
sā saṃkruddhya munīndevān dakṣaṃ niḥśaṃkamāha yat || 1 22||
tāta tvaṃ nindakaḥ śaṃbhoḥ paścāttāpaṃ gamiṣyasi |
māyaṃ dhūmro tava yājño vṛṣṭiheturbhavediha || 123||
aśruheturbhavedevāgatānāṃ yajñabhoginām |
sphuṭaṃ bha vantaḥ śaṃbhostu pratīpā militāḥ khalu || 1 24||
pratīpānāṃ pratīpaṃ saṃkariṣye yajñamārjanam |
śaṃbhuṃ vinā na yajñaḥ syāt kariṣye’gnipratoṣaṇam || 125||
dakṣaḥ svīyaṃ juhotyagnau svīye’pi gaṇanā mama |
svaṃ svīyaṃ ca juhotyagnau kariṣye havanaṃ mama || 1 26||
kiṃ bahūktena vacasā dakṣo hare sadā kudhīḥ |
tadudbhavena dehena na me kiṃcitprayojanam || 127||
tajjanma dhik yanmahatāmavajñāpādakaṃ bhavet |
parityājyo viśeṣeṇa janmasamvandha eva vai || 128||
vaimanasye sadā śaṃbhurdākṣāyaṇīti vakti mām |
tasmāddakṣāṃgajaṃ caitatkuṇapaṃ garhitaṃ sadā || 129||
vyutsṛṣṭavyaṃ nūnamatra projjhitavyaṃ tu vahnaye |
yāvajjīvitanāthasya na śrotavyā vigarhaṇā || 1.175.130||
satyantimaṃ vacaḥ prāha naśyantu śivanindakāḥ |
ahaṃ tu krodhadīptāgnau mahādevasvarūpiṇi || 13 1||
juhomi dehasamidhaṃ prāṇarodhavidhānataḥ |
evamuktvā satī prāṇāyāmaṃ cakre śanaistadā || 1 32||
prāṇarodhaḥ kṛtaḥ satyā sudṛḍhastāvadeva vai |
sarveṣāṃ ca surādīnāṃ prāṇarodho’bhavattadā || 133|||
nāgnirjajvāla ca tathā yathājyāhutibhiḥ purā |
mantrāḥ kuṇṭhitasāmarthyāstatkṣaṇādeva cābhavan || 134||
mahājhanjhānilaḥ prāptaḥ parvatāndolanakṣamaḥ |
makhamaṇḍapabhūstena kṣaṇataḥ sthapuṭīkṛtā || 135||
akāṇḍataḍidāpāto jāto’bhūdbhūprakampanaḥ |
divaścolkāḥ prapatitāḥ piśācā nṛtyamādadhuḥ || 136||
āpatadgradhrairupari gagane maṇḍalāyitam |
tatra purastādaśivaṃ śivāḥ krūramarāriṣuḥ || 137||
meghā rudhiravarṣābhistatrāhuścātyamaṃgalam |
nirghātaniḥsvano bhūmerutthito hṛtprakampanaḥ || 138||
divyāyudhāni ca mitho yuddhyanti smātibhīṣaṇam |
havanīyaṃ mahādravyaṃ dūṣitaṃ kroṣṭṛbhiḥ śvabhiḥ || 1 39|||
satyāḥ prāṇanirodhāśca sarvarodhena tattadā |
śmaśānavāṭavajjātaṃ niṣkriyaṃ makhabhūtalam || 1.175.140 ||
yadyatrābhūcca vinyastaṃ tattatraiva vyavasthitam |
citranyastamivāsīśca prāṇarodhabalāttathā || 141||
sujaḍā iva saṃjātāstadā cakradharādayaḥ |
devī prāṇaṃ bahirnītvā śamayāmāsa bhīṣikām || 142||
camatkāro darśito’yaṃ devyā tathāpi dakṣarāṭ |
śaṃkarāhvānavacanaṃ novāca mānanaṣṭadhīḥ || 143||
maunībhūtā satī smṛtvā śaṃbhuṃ svapatimādarāt |
pṛthvyāṃ punaḥ sā sahasā niṣasāda praśāntadhīḥ || 144||
jalamācamya vidhivat saṃvṛtā vāsasā śuciḥ |
dṛṅnimīlya patiṃ smṛtvā yogarītimupādade || 145||
kṛtvā samāne hyanilau prāṇāpānau tathā punaḥ |
utthāpyodānasamānau nābhicakrātparaṃ gatā || 146||
hṛdisthāpyorasi nītvā nītvā kaṇṭhād bhruvoḥ satī |
madhyamānīya dyurandhraṃ sā jagāma tvarānvitā || 147||
agnimutpādayāmāsa brahmarandhrasthitā satī |
brahmarandhrāgninā deho jājvalyamāna eva vai || 148||
ākāśamutthito vyomnā cāgnikuṇḍe hyavātarat |
bhasmasādabhavat kuṇḍe satī samājagocarā || 149||
tatpaśyatāṃ ca khe bhūmau hāhākāro vyavartata |
hāhābhūcca jagatsarvaṃ bhītā viṣṇusurādayaḥ || 1.175.150||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satyā vyomnā svasṛvimānāvalokanam dakṣayajñe gamanāya śaṃbhorājñā kailāse nāradāgamanaṃ yajñāddadhīcinirgamaḥ yajñe satī gamanaṃ śaṃkarāsanādarśanaṃ satīdakṣavākyāni satīdehatyāgaityādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 175||

<1.176>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi kīdṛśaṃ trāsakṛddhi tat |
anātmyaṃ tu pitustasyā nānyastathā kariṣyati || 1 ||
bhasmībhūte satīdehe dṛśyaṃ sakaruṇaṃ tadā |
samabhūcca samāje’nyonyavāṇī karuṇāvahā || 2 ||
hanta priyā parā śaṃbhorahādasūnprakopitā |
dakṣeṇa paśyataitasya daurātmyaṃ tu prajāpateḥ || 3 ||
carācaraṃ prajā yasya tasyāpi hṛdayaṃ sadā |
kṣubdhaṃ ruṣṭaṃ kharaṃ śuṣkamaho saṃsārakaṣṭatā || 4 ||
śaṃkarasya priyābhīkṣṇaṃ mānayogyā satāṃ sadā |
dakṣeṇa vimanā sābhūt tatrāpi sumahotsave || 5 ||
tasmāddurmarṣahṛdayo brahmadhik ca duhitṛdhṛk |
mahatīmapakīrtiṃ saḥ prāpsyatyakhilasṛṣṭiṣu || 6 ||
yaḥ svāṃgajāṃ sutāṃ śabhudviṭ nyaṣedhatsamāgatām |
mahānarakabhogī sa putrīhā no’parādhataḥ || 7 ||
vadatyevaṃ jane dṛṣṭvā satyāścāsuviyojanam |
drāgeva pārṣadāḥ krūrā hyudatiṣṭhannudāyudhāḥ || 8 ||
ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi te sarve saṃvṛtya makhabhūmikām |
mā kaścid bahirnigacchedghātayantu makhasthale || 9 ||
hāhākārairvikrośanto dhigdhikdakṣetivādinaḥ |
mārayantu nāśayantu mardayantu makhāṃgaṇe || 1.176.10 ||
gaganaṃ ca tadā hāhākārairvyāptamabhūt priye |
devāḥ prāpan bhayaṃ sarve munayo’nye’pi ye sthitāḥ || 11 ||
akāṃḍayuddhaṃ saṃprāptaṃ pralayo vai bhaviṣyati |
dakṣayajñāgatānāṃ te hyakurvan hananaṃ bahu ||12||
śastrairaghnanparāṃgāni sutīkṣṇaiḥ prāṇanāśibhiḥ |

jvālakeśo dvādaśakoṭibhirjīmām̐stu saptabhiḥ |
dudrubho’ṣṭābhiḥ koṭibhiḥ kapālīśastu paṃcabhiḥ || 143 ||
ṣaḍbhiḥ saṃdārako yāyāt kokuṇḍaḥ koṭikoṭibhiḥ |
viṣṭaṃbho’ṣṭāṣṭabhiryāyāt koṭibhirgaṇasattamaḥ || 144||
sahasrakoṭibhiryāyāt śaṃnādaḥ pippalastathā |
āveśānastathāṣṭābhiraṣṭābhiścandratāpanaḥ || 145 ||
mahāveśaḥ sahasreṇa koṭinā gaṇapastathā |
kuṇḍī dvādaśakoṭibhistathā parvatako yayau || 146 ||
kālaśca kālakaścaiva mahākālastathā gaṇaḥ |
koṭīnāṃ śatakenaiva yajñanāśaṃ yayuḥ prati || 147||
agnikṛcchatakoṭyā ca koṭyāgnimukha ityapi |
ādityamūrdhā koṭyā ca tathā koṭyā ghanāvahaḥ || 148 ||
sannāhaḥ śatakoṭyā ca koṭyā ca kumudo gaṇaḥ |
amoghaḥ kokilaścaiva koṭikoṭyā gaṇādhipaḥ || 149||
kāṣṭhāgūḍhaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sukeśī vṛṣabhastathā |
sumantrako gaṇādhīśastathā yajñaṃ viniryayuḥ || 1.176.150 ||
kākapādodaraḥ santānakaśca ṣaṣṭikoṭibhiḥ |
mahābalaḥ puṃgavaśca navabhiḥ koṭibhistathā || 151 ||
madhupiṃgaḥ pūrṇabhadro navatikoṭibhiryayau |
virūpākṣastālaketuḥ ṣaḍāsyaḥ paṃcavaktrakaḥ || 152||
saṃvartakaḥ kulīśo daityānto lokāntakastathā |
bhṛṃgīriṭiḥ śṛṃgiriṭiraśanirbhālakastathā || 153 ||
catuḥṣaṣṭyā sahitāste pratyekamadhvaraṃ yayuḥ |
bhūtakoṭisahasrāṇi śvagaṇastisṛkoṭibhiḥ || 1 54||
nyapatadvyomamārgeṇa dakṣasyādhvarabhūmiṣu |
tayā bheryaśca śaṃkhāśca paṭahāścāpi gomukhāḥ || 155||
śṛṃgāṇi vividhānyeva nineduśca raṇotsave |
dakṣavāmākṣi bāhūruvispandaḥ samajāyata || 156||
bhūkampo’bhūcca madhyāhne dakṣo’paśyannakṣatrakam |
diśo malīmlucastvāsan nistejo’bhūddivākaraḥ || 157||
pariveṣaiḥ saptabhiśca parivṛto bhayapradaḥ |
nakṣatrāṇi patanti smākālikastanayitnavaḥ || 158||
nakṣatrāṇāmabhūdvakrā gatiścādhomukhī tadā |
gṛdhro dakṣaśiraḥ spṛṣṭvā yayau nītvā śiraḥpaṭam || 159||
vavāśire ca jambūkāḥ kharā vātā vavustadā |
ulkāvṛṣṭiḥ pāṃsuvṛṣṭiḥ śvetavṛścikavarṣaṇam || 1.176.160 ||
arbudārbudaśalabhā dṛśyante sma makhāṃbare |
nītaśca pavanairūrdhvaṃ dakṣasyādhvaramaṇḍapaḥ || 16 1||
vemuḥ raktaṃ yājñīyāste sakampā babhūvustadā |
asṛgvṛṣṭirdiśāṃ dāhastimirāvṛtikā diśaḥ || 162||
evaṃvidhānyariṣṭāni cādrākṣurdakṣayajñagāḥ |
bhuvi te mūrchitāḥ peturhā hatāḥ smeti cairayan || 163||
etasminnantare tatrākāśavāṇī jagāda tān |
dhik dakṣa dhik surādyā vo’nivāryaṃ duḥkhamāgatam || 164||
tāvattu śaṃbhusainyāni praviṣṭāni makhāṃgaṇam |
bhayāviṣṭastadā dakṣo hyagacchaccharaṇaṃ hareḥ || 165 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satī pārṣadānāṃ yuddhaṃ dakṣāya vyomavāṇī nāradasya punaḥ kailāsagamanaṃ śaṃbhujaṭāto vīrabhadrotpattiḥ avaśeṣagaṇānāṃ kailāsāgamanam kālikājvaragaṇabhūtasiṃhādisainyasarjanam yajñaṃ prati preṣaṇam nāradasya yajñaṃ pratyāgamaḥ dakṣāderapaśakunāni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 176 ||

<1.177>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
dakṣastadā bhayodvigno viṣṇuṃ sasmāra padmaje |
devadeva harekṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa jagadguro || 1 ||
mama rakṣā vidhātavyā makhasya ca janasya ca |
makhabhaṃgo mā bhavatu makhātmakastvamacyuta || 2 ||
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā tasya śrutā vai prārthanā tadā |
haṃsaṃ garuḍamāruhya svasthānātpunarāgatau || 3 ||
papāta pādayostayorbhayavyākulamānasaḥ |
utthāpya ca tato viṣṇurdakṣaṃ viklinnamānasam || 4 ||
prāha dakṣa śṛṇu tattvaṃ sarvathā hitakṛdvacaḥ |
avajñā hi kṛtā dakṣa tvayā tattvamajānatā || 5 ||
īśasyāvajñayā sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavati niṣphalam |
viphalaṃ kevalaṃ naiva vipattiśca pade pade || 6 ||
apūjyā yatra pūjyante pūjanīyo na pūjyate |
trīṇi tatra bhavantyeva dāridryaṃ maraṇaṃ bhayam || 7 ||
asatkṛtānmahādevāt mahadbhayamupasthitam |
śaṃkaro vaiṣṇavo devo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || 8 ||
nārāyaṇasya bhaktasya hyaparādhaḥ kṛtastvayā |
bhaktāparādhino rakṣāṃ kartuṃ svāmī na vai kṣamaḥ || 9 ||
śivasya śaraṇaṃ yāhi sa vai rakṣāṃ kariṣyati |
ahaṃ bhaktaparādhīnaḥ satīnāśena duḥkhyaham || 1.177.10 ||
krūrasya kṛtakāryasya phalaṃ prāpnuhi kiṃ bhavet |
dakṣastadvacanaṃ śrutvā vivarṇavadano’bhavat || 11 ||
prāha ca śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇa yajñāraṃbho bhavadbalāt |
kṛto’yaṃ karmaṇāṃ sākṣin vedadharmasya siddhaye || 1 2||
tasmād rakṣā vidhātavyā yajñasyāsya mama prabho
tvāṃ vinā rakṣituṃ yajñaṃ cāsmān śakto na vidyate || 13 ||
viṣṇuḥ prāhādhvararakṣā vidhātavyā mayā dhruvam |
khyāto mama paṇaḥ sarvo dharmasya paripālanam || 14||
maryādā vedadharmasya rakṣaṇīyā mayā sadā |
yajñe devatrayāṇāṃ ca tathānyeṣāṃ mahātmanām || 15||
surādīnāṃ ca bhāgo’sti vedo vakti na cānyathā |
tvayā vyatikramastasya mānenācarito’dhvare || 16||
vada dakṣa dharmapaṇaḥ kathaṃ tyājyo mayā bhavet |
kathaṃ satīśivau yajñe tvayā nākāritau purā || 17||
kathaṃ yajñasya maryādā hyullaṃghitā vijānatā |
kiṃ karma kimakarmeti na kiṃ paśyasi durmate || 18||
devenaikena śūnyo’yaṃ yajño naiva phalapradaḥ |
kevalaṃ jñānamāśritya mānamāśritya yājakāḥ || 19||
īśvaraṃ ca parityajya kevale karmaṇi sthitāḥ |
te nu karmamayaiḥ pāśairbadhyante bahujanmasu ||1.177.20|||
nirayeṣu prapacyante hīśvarasya vamānakāḥ |
ekatra tu śivākhyasya bhrātuḥ sainyamupasthitam ||21|||
aparatra ca dakṣādeḥ putrapautrādivāhinī |
sarve sambandhino devāḥ kuṭumbaṃ tvekameva ha ||22||
kutra sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ moktavyaṃ vada me’dhunā |
kuṭumbināṃ sevakānāṃ sarvathā ca mahātmanām |||23||
nāśa upasthitaste’tra śivāvamānadoṣataḥ |
nāśa āmantrito buddhyā gṛhanāśa upasthitaḥ ||24||
ayaṃ rudragaṇādhīśo vīrabhadro’rimardanaḥ |
sarvavināśanārthaṃ vai cāgato’sti na saṃśayaḥ |||25||
evaṃ bruvati govinde sainyamāpatitaṃ tadā |
parito’dhvarabhūmau tad vyapaśyan vai surādayaḥ ||26||
indrastadā hasan rudraṃ vīrabhadraṃ tathā gaṇam |
vajraṃ dhṛtvā kare yoddhuṃ sajjo’bhūt surasainyakaḥ ||27||
indraḥ svagajamārūḍho vastārūḍho’nalaḥ svayam |
yamo mahiṣamārūḍho nirṛtiḥ pretavāhanaḥ ||28||
varuṇo makarārūḍho mṛgārūḍho’nilastathā |
kuberaḥ puṣpakārūḍho yuyudhe śaṃkaraiḥ saha ||29||
tathānye surayoddhāro yakṣacāraṇaguhyakāḥ |
āruhya vāhanānyeva yuyudhire pratāpinaḥ ||1.177.3 0||
devānāṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca tadāsītsamaro mahān |
neduḥ śaṃkhāśca bheryaśca mahādundubhayastathā ||3 1||
ḍiṇḍimāḥ paṭahā neduḥ raṇaśṛṃgāṇi gomukhāḥ |
tīkṣṇatomaranārācaiḥ surā jaghnurgaṇān bahūn ||32||
indrādyairlokapālādyairgaṇāḥ śaṃbhorvinirjitāḥ |
bhṛgormantrajasainyaiśca nirjitāśca palāyitāḥ ||33||
uccāṭanaṃ kṛtaṃ teṣāṃ bhṛguṇā yajvanā tadā |
caṇḍikānāṃ ca sainyāni makhe tatrāpatanti ca ||34||
mahālayānāṃ sainyāni yuddhyanti ṛbhusaṃgare |
kālānāṃ bhairavāṇāṃ ca bhūtapretādidhanvinām ||35||

nipātitāni sarvāṇi ṛbhuśṛṃbhudharāṃbhubhiḥ || 36||

parājitān svakān dṛṣṭvā vīrabhadro’drisannibhaḥ |
bhūtapretapiśācām̐śca kṛtvā tāneva pṛṣṭhataḥ ||38||
mahāgaṇānpuraskṛtya samāpatadraṇāṃgaṇe |
mahātriśūlamādāya pātayāmāsa nirjarān |||39||
devānsādhyagaṇānyakṣām̐ścāraṇānguhyakānapi |
śūlaiśca tomaraiḥ śaktipravaraiste prajaghnire ||1.177.40 ||
keciddvedhā kṛtāḥ khaḍgairmudgaraiśca vipothitāḥ |
anyaiḥ śastraistathāstraiśca surā bhinnā mahāgaṇaiḥ ||41 ||
kālakavalamantraiśca svabhaṭā jīvitāḥ kṛtāḥ |
dakṣabhaṭā vinaśyanti ko’pi tajjīvako’sti na ||42||
sarve parājitā devāḥ palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ |
yuddhasthānaṃ parityajya gatāḥ sarve triviṣṭapam ||43||
kevalaṃ lokapālāste śakrādyāstasthurutsukāḥ |
vīrabhadro’bravītsarvāndakṣapakṣaprapātinaḥ ||44||
sarve yūyaṃ bāliśatvādavadānārthamāgatāḥ |
avadānaṃ prayacchāmi samāgacchata me’ntikam ||45||
he śakra he guro bhāno śaśin yama dhaneśvara |
vāyo varuṇa nirṛte śeṣa sūryādayaḥ surāḥ ||46||
samāgacchata sānnidhye prayacchāmyavadānakam |
evamuktvā tīkṣṇabāṇaiḥ śastrairastraiśca parvataiḥ ||47||
nirjaghāna surānsarvān dikpatīndrasureśvarān |
te ca palāyanaparā vidudruvurdiśo daśa ||48||
atha palāyitāndṛṣṭvā yajñanārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
nārāyaṇo naro bhūtvā dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ mahāsvanam ||49||
śrutvā taṃ śaṃkhanirhrādaṃ devāste punarāyayuḥ |
nandinā yuyudhe śakro vahnistatrāśmanā saha ||1.177.50|||
kuṣmāṇḍāgreṇa dhanarāṭ yuyudhe prāṇadānataḥ |

kṣetrapālā jajakṣustānkālī ca rudhiraṃ papau ||53||

kaiścidutpāṭitā yūpāḥ kecitkuṇḍānyapūrayan |
kaiścittu maṇḍapā dhvastā vedāśca khanitāḥ paraiḥ ||56||
kaiściddhavīṃṣi bhuktāni pītānyājyāni cāparaiḥ |
kaiściddhvastāni cānnāni pītāni pāyasāni ca ||57||
pakvānnāni prabhuktāni kṣīrāṇyāsvāditāni ca |
cūrṇitāni ca bhagnāni yajñapātrāṇi sarvathā ||58||
bhagnāśca śakaṭāḥ kaiścit srucaḥ sruvāśca moṭitāḥ |
paśavaḥ khāditāḥ kaiścit kuṇḍāgnayo vināśitāḥ ||59||
dukūlāni ca ratnāni kaiściddhṛtāni tatsthale |

tataścālātacakreṇa viśiraskastadā kṛtaḥ ||6 1 ||
nandī bhagasya netre dve samujjahāra yo bhagaḥ |
śapantaṃ dakṣaṃ netrābhyāmasūsucatpunaḥ punaḥ ||62||
caṇḍaścotpāṭayāmāsa pūṣṇo dantānpravegataḥ |
śapamāne hare pūrvaṃ yo’hasad darśayandataḥ ||63||

aditeroṣṭhapuṭakau cicchedaścānyabhadrakaḥ ||64||

iti kṛtvā dhṛtaṃ cakraṃ mumoca vīrabhadrake ||1.177.80||
hāhākāro mahānāsīt lagnaṃ bhadragale tadā |

kaṇṭhaṃ tyaktvā samāyātaṃ vipṇuhastagataṃ hyabhūt||
garuḍaśca tadā kruddhastvekaikaṃ pramathaṃ nakhaiḥ ||82||
dārayāmāsa lakṣām̐ste prāpuḥ śobhāṃ tu kaiṃśukīm |

athāṭṭahāsamakarot pūrayam̐śca jagattrayam |

troṭayāmāsa karṇādīnyaṃgapratyaṃgakāni ca |
veṇīdaṇḍām̐śca kāsāñcit tena chinnā tadā ruṣā ||95||
kāsāṃcicca karāśchinnāḥ kāsāṃcitkartitā bhujāḥ |
nāsikāśca tathāṃgulyaḥ chinnā kāsāṃcideva ha ||96||
jihvāḥ karṇāstathā chinnā nindoktā vā śrutā yayā |
candro dharmo bhṛguścaiva mārīcādyāḥ sutādhavāḥ ||97||
atyantamapamānasya bhājanaṃ tena kāritāḥ |
tāni kuṇḍāni te yūpāste staṃbhāḥ sa ca maṇḍapaḥ ||98||
tā vedyastāni pātrāṇi tāni havyānyanekadhā |
te ca vai yajñasaṃbhārāste te yajñapravartakāḥ ||99||
te rakṣapālāste mantrā vineśuḥ śivahelayā |
kṣaṇatulyena kālena āsan nāsan babhūvire || 1.177.100 ||
mahatāṃ helanāllakṣmi kṣīyate’rjitasukṛtam |
tannāśe sarvanāśaḥ syād yathā dakṣasya sampadām || 101 ||
tasmāddroho na kartavyo’lpīyasāmapi dehinām |
paraduḥkhaphalaṃ svasyāvaśyaṃ bhoktavyamāpatet || 102 ||
atha viṣṇuryayau vyomni vimānasthaṃ tu vedhasam |
prāha brahman śaṃkaraṃ vai nītvāyāhyatra satvaram || 103 ||
vidhihīnaṃ makhadhvasa paśyedāgatya śaṃkaraḥ |
adhvarasya ca dakṣasya nistāro’pi bhavettadā || 10 4||
śrutvaivaṃ satvaraṃ brahmā kailāsaṃ prajagāma ha |
uvācādhvaravṛttāntaṃ śaṃbhumādāya vai drutam || 1 05||
ājagāmādhvarasthānaṃ sarvaṃ dhvastaṃ vilokya ca |
trāsadaṃ dṛśyamālokya dayāleśānvito haraḥ || 106 ||
kṣaṇaṃ śarvastu saṃpaśyan dūyamānamanā hyabhūt |
vīrabhadro’pi natvaiva saṃsthito bahulajjitaḥ || 1 07||
brahmā prāha haraṃ tatra prasādya ca muhurmuhuḥ |
aparādhyapyayaṃ dakṣaḥ samprasādyaḥ surottama || 108 ||
yathāpūrvaṃ punaramūn sarvānkāraya śaṃkara |
yathā vidhiḥ pravarteta vaidikaḥ punareva saḥ || 109||
tathājñā dīyatāṃ śaṃbho karma siddhyati seśvaram |
anīśvarāsu sarvāsu kriyāsu vai maheśvara || 1.177.110 ||
evameva bhavantyeva vighnajātāḥ sahasraśaḥ |
devabhakto’pi dakṣo’yaṃ devaṃ tyaktvākarot kratum || 111 ||
loke vigarhaṇāṃ prāptā nidarśanāya so’bhavat |
īśaṃ tyaktvā ca kāryāṇi kariṣyanti janā yadi || 112||
tadantaṃ te na paśyanti lokā gāsyanti dakṣavat |
tato magaladaṃ devaṃ vihāyānyo janaḥ kvacit||| 113 ||
svārthaṃ cāpi padārthaṃ ca daivaṃ vādaivamityapi |
karma naiva kvacitkiṃcit śrutvaitatpravidhāsyati || 11 4||
brahmaṇoktaṃ vicāryaiva prahasya śaṃkaraḥ punaḥ |
vīramājñāpayāmāsa yathāpūrvaṃ prakalpaya || 115||
tadā gaṇān svasainyāni prairayanmārjanāya tat |
sthalaṃ bhūtairmārjitaṃ ca bhūmirvipraiḥ susaṃskṛtā || 116 ||
ujjīvitā mṛtā mantraiḥ saṃjīvanyāmṛtādibhiḥ |
ye sainyārthaṃ dvayoḥ pakṣe nūtnāścotpāditā bhaṭāḥ || 1 17||
śaṃbhunā bhṛguṇā svasvamantrairlīnīkṛtāśca te |
koṭyarbudāni sainyāni parārthalakṣakāṇi ca || 118 ||
asaṃkhyadevadevīnāṃ paśūnāṃ pṛtanāstathā |
sarvaṃ līnīkṛtaṃ tatra bhṛguṇā śaṃbhunā tathā || 119 ||
aṃganāśāśca nārīṇāṃ dravyanāśāḥ kratostathā |
dehanāśā makhasthānāṃ punarujjīvya sandhitāḥ || 1.177.120 ||
viṣṇunā brahmaṇā candramasā ca śaṃbhunā makhe |
kumāreṇāśvinījena dhanvantariyutena ca || 121 ||
sūryeṇa guruṇā yoginībhiḥ śrībhistathā tadā |
munibhiḥ ṛṣibhiścaiva svasvasāmarthyasaṃyutaiḥ || 122 ||
yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ cotpāditaṃ tu mānasam |
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ dāravaṃ caurṇamikṣujam || 123 ||
pāyasaṃ vallijaṃ sasyajanyaṃ kārpāsakaṃ tathā |
annajaṃ jalajaṃ codbhijjātaṃ hrasva mahacca yat || 124 ||
svalpaṃ pracūrakaṃ cāpi havyaṃ cānyacca yaddhyabhūt |
vinā dakṣasya vadanaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ samīkṛtam || 125 ||
śaṃkarādyājñayāgṛhya yajñīyameṣamastakam |
tena meṣamukhaṃ dakṣaṃ vīrabhadragaṇo vyadhāt || 126 ||
dakṣasya yajñaśīrṣṇaḥ syāt sadā hyajamukhaḥ śiraḥ |
mitranetreṇa saṃpaśyet yajñabhāgaṃ bhagaḥ suraḥ || 127 ||
bhagnadantaḥ suraḥ pūṣā bhavatu yajñapiṣṭabhuk |
bastaśmaśrurbhavedeva bhṛguḥ śivavirodhakṛt || 128 ||
devāḥ prakṛtisarvāṃgā bhavantveva sadā svayam |
bāhubhyāmaśvinau pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ kṛtavāhakaḥ || 129 ||
bhavantvadhvaryavaścānye yathāpūrvaṃ śivājñayā |
abhavam̐ste tathā sarve sarvaṃ svasthamabhūttadā || 1.177.130 ||
atha yajñakriyāstatra prāvartanta punaḥ suraiḥ |
pūrṇāhutiḥ pradattāvabhṛthasnānaṃ kṛtaṃ surān || 131 ||
viprānabhyāgatānputraduhitṛsvasṛbāndhavān |
bhāgineyāndeyapātravarānsatkṛtya sarvathā || 132 ||
dānāni dattavām̐stebhyo dakṣo bastamukho’rthinām |
tṛptiṃ cākārayat bhakṣyabhojyapānāmbarādibhiḥ || 133 ||
sarve svānsvānsvatvabhāgānnītvā yātā nijālayān |
viṣṇuryayau ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ brahmā satyaṃ jagāma ha || 1 34||
dikpālā lokapālāśca surā munyādayaśca ye |
gatāḥ sarve tṛptahṛdo dānamānārhaṇādibhiḥ || 1 35||
atha śaṃbhurvidhuro vai kva yāmīti vicārayan |
himālayasya śikharaṃ tapase saṃjagāma saḥ || 136 ||
vānaprasthakriyādharmaṃ jagrāha śaṃkarastadā |
anāśramavatā puṃsā yataḥ kālo manāgapi || 137||
vyarthaṃ kalayitavyo na vane śreyastapaḥśramaḥ |
tapaścacāra śarvaḥ sagaṇaḥ śṛṃge śivābhidhe || 1 38||
kailāsasya ca rakṣārthaṃ vīrabhadramayojayat |
dakṣo’pi pāpaśāntyarthaṃ kāśīṃ jagāma caikalaḥ || 1 39||
tapasārādhayacchaṃbhuṃ liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya satvaram |
prāvirbhūtvā svayaṃ śaṃbhurdakṣapāpaṃ hyamārjayat || 1.177.140 ||
prāha brūhi varaṃ dakṣa dāsyāmi manasepsitam |
prāha dakṣo haraṃ deyo varo mama yadi tvayā || 141||
tava bhaktiḥ sadā cāstu kṣantavyo me’parādhakaḥ |
dakṣeśvare tvayā stheyaṃ liṃge tu sarvadā prabho || 142||
dattamiti tathā cānyad gṛhāṇa dakṣa me’grataḥ |
parārdhadvitīyaprānte tato mokṣamavāpsyasi || 143||
iti haro dadau tasmai varadānaṃ pramokṣaṇam |
dakṣasya yajñabhaṃgaḥ sa na hareṇa kṛtaḥ khalu || 144||
paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati |
pareṣāṃ kadanaṃ karma na kāryaṃ tat kadācana || 145||
paraṃ dveṣṭi pareṣāṃ yadātmanastadbhaviṣyati |
iti sambodhitaṃ tasmād drohaṃ parasya nācaret || 146||
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī caiva caturthakaḥ |
caturvidhā bhajante’jaṃ caturtho’tra viśiṣyate || 147||
kevalaṃ karmaṇā yo vai saṃsāraṃ tartumicchati |
na ca pāramavāpnoti madhye vighnena lupyate || 148||
harerbhakto haraṃ nindet harabhakto hariṃ tathā |
tayoḥ śāpā bhaveyuste tattvaprāptirbhavennahi || 149||
hariharau sadā caikatattvaṃ brahmāpi tanmayaḥ |
haro brahmā ca viṣṇuśca jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ param || 1.177.150 ||
haransṛjam̐stathā rakṣandadhe saṃjñāḥ kriyocitāḥ |
advitīye pare tasmin brahmaṇyātmani kevale || 151||
ajñaḥ paśyati bhedena bhūtāni brahma ceśvaram |
ityetadbrahmarūpasya satyāśca śaṃkarasya ca || 152||
caritraṃ śṛṇuyād bhaktyā śrāvayedbhaktimān janān |
sarvasaukhyaṃ labhedatra paratra paramāṃ gatim || 153||
yaḥ paṭhetpāṭhayedvāpi satyākhyānamidaṃ śubham |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ sarvārthasampradāyakam || 154||
svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaputrapautraphalapradam |
sa ca bhuktvākhilān bhogānante mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 155||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhītadakṣaprārthanā vipṇunyāyavākyaṃ surādīnāṃ gaṇādīnāṃ ca yuddhaṃ yajñādidhvaṃsaḥ ṛtvijāmaṃgabhaṃgāni cakreṇa śivāviṣṭavīrabhadrānāśaḥ śaṃkarāgamanaṃ sarveṣāṃ punaḥ sajīvanaṃ yajñasamāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 177||

<1.178>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pareśo vā maheśo vā janārdanaḥ |
lokarītiśca prakṛtirbādhate tānapi kvacit || 1 ||
mānāvamāne devasya bādhete brahmaṇo yadi |
tarhi tatra ca dakṣādeḥ kā kathā kṣudradehinaḥ ||2 ||
satīdehe pradagdhe ca śaṃkaro mohamāptavān |
kalatraśoko balavān svātmārāmaṃ parātparam || 3 ||
bādhate jñāninaṃ cāpi yogīndrāṇāṃ gurorgurum |
satīdehasya yadbhasma cāsthipuṣpāṇi yāni ca || 4 ||
gṛhītvā śaṃkarastāni vilalāpāśrunetrakaḥ |
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha subhage sati prāṇeśvari priye || 5 ||
śaṃkaro’haṃ tava svāmī paśya māṃ nikaṭāgatam |
sarvātmānamatidīnaṃ śavatulyaṃ tvayā vinā || 6 ||
yaśca śaktiṃ na jānāti jñānahīnaśca nindati |
taṃ tyaktumucitaṃ vijñe kathaṃ māṃ tyajasi priye || 7 ||
sasmitaṃ sakaṭākṣaṃ ca vadāgatya sudhopamam |
madhurābhāsadṛṣṭyā ca māṃ dagdhaṃ siktamācara || 8 ||
prāṇādhike samuttiṣṭha rudantaṃ māṃ na paśyasi |
parityajya ca naḥ prāṇān gantuṃ nārhasi sundari || 9 ||
pativrate samuttiṣṭha kathaṃ māṃ nādya sevase |
ityuktvā ca satībhasma dehe śaṃbhuradhārayat || 1.178.10 ||
gaṃgātaṭe rurodoccaiḥ sati sādhvītyudīrya ca |
trinetranetranīraiśca saṃbabhūva saraḥ tanuḥ || 11 ||
tadvai netrasaro nāma tīrthaṃ jātaṃ tapaḥsthalam |
satyasthimālikāṃ kṛtvā dadhāra kaṇṭhabhūṣaṇam || 12||
nityaṃ tadbhasma bhaktyā ca cakāra gātralepanam |
sati prāṇeśvarītyuktvā punarmūrchāmavāpa saḥ || 1 3||
tadā devāḥ sapārṣado nārāyaṇaścaturbhujaḥ |
brahmā śeṣaśca dharmaśca surāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 14||
mūrchitaṃ ca samutthāya rudantaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tadā |
ucitaṃ bodhayāmāsurviṣṇuḥ prāha taduttaram || 1 5 ||
śaṃbho māyāguṇāḥ sarve hetavaḥ sukhaduḥkhayoḥ |
viṣṇumāyā balavatī guṇayuktaṃ prabādhate || 1 6||
duḥkhaṃ śoko bhayaṃ śaṃbho guṇātīte bhavennahi |
manvate sukhaduḥkhāni svapnānīva vipaścitaḥ || 1 7||
jñānaṃ labha mahādeva svastho bhava maheśvara |
cetanāṃ kuru bhadraṃ te satīṃ prāpsyasi niścitam || 18 ||
sudinaṃ durdinaṃ śaśvad bhavatyeva bhave bhave |
tābhyāṃ harṣaśca śokaśca jāyate prākṛte jane || 19 ||
śubhena cāśubhena karmaṇā sudinadurdine |
tatra karma śubhaṃ kāryaṃ sadā sattvasvabhāvajam || 1.178.20 ||
sattvaṃ saṃsargasādhyaṃ ca saṃgaḥ puṇyabalādbhavet |
puṇyaheturmano bodhyaṃ mānasehaṃ hariḥ sthitaḥ || 21 ||
mayā ca hariṇā sarvaṃ kāryate śocanaṃ tyaja |
atha caikaṃ parabrahma dvividhaṃ bhavatīcchayā || 22 ||
nityaṃ ca prākṛtaṃ caiva śarīraṃ dvividhaṃ hi tat |
nityaṃ vināśarahitaṃ naśvaraṃ prākṛtaṃ sadā || 23 ||
ahaṃ tvaṃ cāpi bhagavānnāvayornityavigrahaḥ |
āvayoraṃśabhūtā ye prākṛtā naṣṭavigrahāḥ || 24||
rudrādayastadaṃśāśca madaṃśā viṣṇurūpiṇaḥ |
mamāpyevaṃ dvidhā rūpaṃ dvibhujaṃ ca caturbhujam || 25||
caturbhujo’haṃ vaikuṇṭhe padmayā pārṣadaiḥ saha |
goloke dvibhujo’haṃ ca gopībhiḥ saha rādhayā || 26||
evaṃ sa bhagavānāste nityaḥ saḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
nityā ca prakṛtistasya hyuttamā pauruṣī matā || 27||
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīrmaheśvarī ca saiva ha |
sadā tau dvau ca saṃśliṣṭau sarveṣāṃ pitarau śiva || 28||
satīmicchasi cecchaṃbho prakṛteḥstavanaṃ kuru |
śokaṃ tyaja svīyamāyāṃ bhaja smara jagatprasūm || 29||
śokanāśo jāyatāṃ te śivaṃ syācca mamāśiṣā |
dūraṃ viplavahetuśca yātustrīvirahajvaraḥ || 1.178.30 ||
ityuktvā śroharirmaunamāsasādātha śaṃkaraḥ |
snātvā natvā ca śrīkṛṣṇaṃ baddhapuṭāṃjalistataḥ || 31 ||
stavanaṃ kartumārebhe brahmaśakteḥ sabhaktikaḥ |
brāhmi brahmasvarūpe tvaṃ māṃ prasīda sanātani ||32||
paramātmasvarūpe ca paramānandarūpiṇi |
oṃ prakṛtyai namo bhadre māṃ prasīda bhavārṇave ||33||
sarvamaṃgalarūpe ca prasīda sarvamaṃgale |
vijaye śivade devi māṃ prasīda jayaprade || 34||
vedavedāṃgarūpe ca vedamātaḥ prasīda me |
śokaghne jñānarūpe ca prasīda bhaktavatsale ||35|||
sarvasampatprade māye prasīda jagadambike |
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇakroḍe sraṣṭurvakṣasi bhāratī ||36 ||
mama kroḍe mahāmāyā vipṇumāye prasīda me |
kālarūpe kāryarūpe prasīda dīnavatsale || 37|||
kṛṣṇasya rādhike bhadre prasīda kṛṣṇapūjite |
samastakāminīrūpe kalāṃśena prasīda me ||38||
sarvasampatsvarūpe tvaṃ prasīda sampadāṃ prade |
yaśasvibhiḥ pūjite tvaṃ prasīda yaśasāṃ nidhe || 39 ||
carācarasvarūpe ca prasīda mama mā ciram |
mama yogaprade devi prasīda siddhayogini ||1.178.40 ||
sarvasiddhisvarūpe ca prasīda siddhidāyini |
adhunā rakṣa māmīśe pradagdhaṃ virahāgninā || 41 ||
svātmadarśanapuṇyena krīṇīhi parameśvari |
ityuktvā virataḥ śaṃbhurdadarśa gaganasthitām ||42||
taptakāṃcanavarṇābhāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām |
īṣaddhāsyaprasannāsyāṃ śatabhujāṃ ca tāṃ satīm ||43||
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ virahāsaktaḥ punastuṣṭāva satvaram |
duḥkhaṃ nivedayāmāsa prarudan virahodbhavam ||44||
darśayāmāsāsthimālāṃ svāṃgasthaṃ bhasma bhūṣaṇam |
kṛtvā bahuparīhāraṃ toṣayāmāsa sundarīm ||45||
babhūva parituṣṭā sā śaṃbhumuvāca bhāvataḥ |
sthiro bhava mahādeva prāṇādhika mama prabho ||46||
bhavānātmā ca yogīśaḥ svāmī janmani janmani |
ahaṃ śailendrakāminyāṃ labdhvā janma maheśvara ||47||
tava patnī bhaviṣyāmi muñca tvaṃ virahajvaram |
ityuktvā śivamāśvāsya cāntardhānaṃ cakāra sā ||48||
svanivāsānsurā jagmuḥ kailāsaṃ ca yayau haraḥ |
nanarta sagaṇastūrṇaṃ santyajya virahajvaram ||49||
etatpaṭhecchṛṇuyācca na viyogajvaro bhavet |
na bhavetkāminībhedastasya janmani janmani |||1.178.5 0 ||
ityevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ tūktvā menāyāṃ janmakāmukī |
jagāma himavaddeśe’dṛśyarūpā cacāra sā ||51||
kurvāṇā ca tapo divyaṃ śivasya vyacarat sakhī |
śivaṃ śivaṃ bhajamānā samayaṃ taṃ pratīkṣate ||52||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne satīdāhottaraṃ bhasmāsthīni samādāya śaṃkarasya
gaṃgātaṭe śokaḥ satīstotraṃ satīdarśanaṃ pārvatī janmavacanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 178 ||

<1.179>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi vidhuraḥ śaṃkaraḥ kvacit |
himālaye vicacāra śailapatnīṃ dadarśa saḥ || 1 ||
sādhusvarūpaḥ saumyaśca prasannatāṃ prakāśayan |
śaṃbhuruvāca mātarme bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 2 ||
menā pakvānnamādāya yāvaddadāti śaṃbhave |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tadā menāṃ bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 2 ||
iyaṃ pakvānnabhikṣā tu naikasyaiva kṛte bhavet |
tatrānyeṣāṃ vibhāgo’stita bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 4 ||
yatra nānyasya bhāgo’sti vṛṇe bhikṣāṃ tu tādṛśīm |
menā prāha tadā sādhuṃ sādho kimicchasi priyam || 5 ||
yathecchasi tathā dāsye sphuṭaṃ vada dadāmyaham |
menāṃ śaṃbhustadā prāha dadāmītyucyate yadi || 6 ||
prāpnomītyeva ca prāptā prāpsyāmyavasarāgame |
mātastadāgamiṣyāmi bhikṣāṃ dehyekalāya me || 7 ||
menā tvāścaryamālokya patitā pādayostadā |
uvāca dāsye’vaśyaṃ te yadi yogyā kṛte tava || 8 ||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha tathāstveva mātaḥ paśya tayā vinā |
vicarāmi mahāraṇye priyayā śivayā vinā || 9 ||
tava gehe satī dakṣaputrī janma grahīṣyati |
sā matkṛte bhavedbhikṣā śaṃkaro’haṃ samāgataḥ || 1.179.1 0||
menā śrutvā tvatyatīva prasannābhūd hṛdantare |
bhojitaḥ pūjitaḥ śaṃbhurjagāma ca yathecchayā || 1 1||
tata ārabhya menā sā sasmāra bhāviputrikām |
śaṃbhuṃ jāmātaraṃ caiva mumoda hṛdayāmbare || 12||
prāgbhavīyabhaktivaśāt śive bhaktirvyavardhata |
śivāṃ dhyātvā śivāmātā bhaviṣyati samudraje || 1 3||
lakṣmīruvāca
menakā sā śivāmātā kāsīttacchrīhare vada |
hariḥ prāha śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi samāsataḥ || 14||
vedhaḥputrasya dakṣasya kanyāḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
tāsāṃ vivāhamakarot sa varaiḥ kaśyapādibhiḥ || 15||
tāsāṃ madhye svadhānāmnī pitṛbhyo dattavān sutām |
tisro’bhavan sutāstasyāḥ subhagāḥ dharmasaṃbhṛtāḥ || 16 ||
jyeṣṭhā madhyā kaniṣṭhā ca menā dhanyā kalāvatī |
etāḥ pitṛmānasotthāstisraścāyonijā hi tāḥ || 17||
avyāhatagatikāstā yoginyaḥ kāmarūpagāḥ |
ekasmin samaye tisro bhaginyastīrthavāñcchayā || 18||
śvetadvīpaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ jagmurdarśanahetave |
divyaṃ vimānamāruhya gatāstāḥ kāmagaṃ śubham || 1 9||
vimānādavatīryaiva cakrurviṣṇoḥ stutiṃ natim |
tasthustadājñayā śvete susamājo mahānabhūt |||1.179.2 0 ||
samāje tatra pañcahāyanā brahmasutāstadā |
sanakādyāḥ samājagmuḥ stutvā natvā hariṃ tataḥ ||2 1 ||
samāje viṣṇuvacanāt tasthuste sanakādayaḥ |
samājaśca tadottasthau munisvāgatamācaran ||22||
devīsatīyoginīnāṃ samājo’pyutthitastadā |
tisro bhaginyaḥ paścātsthā nottasthurmohato yathā ||23||
tāstisro yoginīnāṃ madhyapṛṣṭhe saṃsthitā yataḥ |
pāścātyā naiva paśyanti paurvāste’pi ca tām̐stathā ||24||
naḥ tisra naiva paśyanti samājāgrasthitā yataḥ |
kimutthāya ca kartavyaṃ matvaivaṃ notthitā yataḥ ||25||
saiṣā māyālasyarūpā pramādātmakamohinī |
bhūtvā tadvaśagāstā vai na cakruryogyamarhaṇam ||26||
yadyapi jñāninaḥ santo na krodhavaśagā nanu |
kintu bhāviprabalena preritāḥ krodharaśminā ||27||
tāsāṃ tātkālikīṃ dṛṣṭvā śāntopi yogīśaḥ kṛtim |
sanatkumāro muktātmā śāpaṃ daṇḍakaraṃ dadau ||28||
yūyaṃ tisro bhaginyo vai pitṛkanyā api dhruvam |
śiṣṭācāravihīnāḥ sthābhyutthānanativarjitāḥ ||29||
kṣudramānavakṛtyāḍhyāḥ dūrā bhavatu vai divaḥ |
narastriyaḥ saṃbhavatu labhadhvaṃ svakṛteḥ phalam ||1.179.3 0||
tisra ākarṇya sādhvyastāḥ patitvā pādayormuneḥ |
prāhurmune dayāsindho prasanno bhava sarvathā ||3 1 ||
tvādṛśānāṃ satāṃ bhāvo hṛdaye’smākamasti vai |
pramādānna natirabhyutthānādisatkriyāḥ kṛtāḥ ||32|||
phalaṃ labdhaṃ kṛteḥ svasyāḥ kuruṣvānugrahaṃ mune |
tavaiva vacanād brahman labhema svargatiṃ punaḥ |||33 ||
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā ṛṣistatra provāca prītamānasaḥ |
śāpoddhāraṃ karomyeva mahatkāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ||34||
tvannimittaṃ ca sukhadaṃ yatrāśleṣo harerbhavet |
jyeṣṭhā menā hareraṃśabhūtasya himabhūbhṛtaḥ || 35||
patnī bhavatu te kanyā pārvatī saṃbhaviṣyati |
yāṃ śaṃbhave pradāyaiva prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ||36||
ante śivāśivāśīrbhirmuktiṃ kailāsamāpsyasi |
madhyā dhanyā siradhvajajanakasya priyāṃganā ||37||
bhavatu te sutā mahālakṣmīḥ sītā bhaviṣyati |
yāṃ rāmāya pradāyaiva prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ||38||
ante sītārāmasya kṛpayā vaikuṇṭhamāpsyasi |
kalāvatī kaniṣṭhā ca vṛṣabhānuviśo gṛhe ||39||
patnī bhavatu te kanyā rādhikā saṃbhaviṣyati |
yāṃ kṛṣṇāya pradatvā tvaṃ prāpsyasi sukhamuttamam ||1.179.40||
ante ca rādhākṛṣṇakṛpayā golokamāpsyasi |
sukarmiṇāṃ gate duḥkhe prabhaved durlabhaṃ sukham ||41||
yūyaṃ pitṛsutāḥ sarvāḥ sadā svargavilāsikāḥ |
etannimittamālambya mokṣagāḥ saṃbhaviṣyatha ||42||
paścātsanatkumārādyāḥ samājātsvālayaṃ gatāḥ |
menādikāstisra īyuḥ svapitṛbhavanaṃ tataḥ ||43||
athaikadā kurukṣetre snātvā hīndrādayaḥ surāḥ |
āṣāḍhe māsi mārgarkṣe candrakṣayatithirhi sā ||44||
dadurindrādayastasyāṃ piṇḍān pitṛbhya ādarāt |
tilānmadhu supakvānnaṃ miṣṭaṃ haviṣyamityapi ||45||
tataḥ prītāstu pitaro devānāha sutṛptitaḥ |
vṛṇuta kiṃ vitarāmo devāḥ prāhustadā pitṝn ||46||
sarve śṛṇuta no vākyaṃ pitaraḥ prītamānasāḥ |
kartavyaṃ tattathaivāśu devakāryepsavo yadi ||47||
yūyaṃ smaratha kanyānāṃ śvetadvīpe vṛtaṃ ca yat |
sanatkumāraśāpaṃ taṃ smaratāthocitaṃ matam ||48||
menā nāma sutā yā vo jyeṣṭhā maṃgalakāriṇī |
tāṃ vivāhya ca suprītyā himākhyena tu bhūbhṛtā ||49||
sarve bhavantu sukhino lābhavantaḥ pade pade |
yuṣmākamamarāṇāṃ ca duḥkhahānirbhaviṣyati ||1.179.50 ||
surāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā smṛtvā śāpaṃ purā bhavam |
omiti procuḥ pitaro dadurmenāṃ himādraye ||51|||
himādriḥ parvato divyo mahātejāḥ samṛddhimān |
dvirūpo vartate loke jaṃgamasthirabhedataḥ ||52||
pūrvāparau toyanidhī suvigāhya sthitaḥ sthiraḥ |
tuṣāravidhiratyugro devarṣisiddhasaṃśritaḥ ||53||
tapaḥ siddhipradaṃ śīghraṃ pāvanaśca mahātmanām |
sa eva divyarūpo hi ramyaḥ sarvāṃgasundaraḥ ||54||
viṣṇvaṃśaśca mahābhaktaḥ śailarājaḥ sumūrtimān |
sa eva svakulasthityai dharmavardhanahetave ||55||
svavivāhaṃ kartumanā pitṛdevahitecchukaḥ |
menāpāṇiṃ ca jagrāha vivāhavidhinā tadā |||56||
samutsavo mahānāsīt tadvivāhe sumaṃgale |
haryādayo’pi te devā ṛṣayo munayo’drayaḥ ||57||
ājagmustatra vaivāhe praśaśaṃsurhimācalam |
utsavaṃ kārayāmāsurdadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||58||
mahāmodānvitā devāḥ pitṝndivyānpraśasya ca |
saṃjagmuḥ svasvadhāmāni prāpya satkārapūjanam ||59||
menāṃ tu yuvatīṃ prāpya himavān gṛhadharmataḥ |
prītimānabhavattatra reme kāmād yathecchayā ||1.179.60||
atha dakṣasutā kāle satī tu himaparvate |
yadāsīcchaṃbhunā sārdhaṃ tadaiva tāṃ tu menakā ||61||
mama gehe kṛtāvāsā matsutā vai satī matā |
iti sutāsamāṃ jñātvā siṣeve mātṛvarcasā ||62||
evaṃ nityaṃ dhyāyamānā sevate menakā satīm |
satī ca dakṣayajñe svatanuṃ tyaktvāsmaratprasūm ||62||
tasyāmahaṃ sutā syāmityavadhārya satī hṛdā |
samayaṃ prāpya prītyā sā menakāputrikābhavat ||64||
pārvatī sā tapaḥ kṛtvā patiṃ prāpa śivaṃ punaḥ |
menāyāṃ kanyakāstisro jātā rūpaguṇānvitāḥ ||65||
rāgiṇī kuṭilā kālī tisraḥ kanyā yathākramam |
raktāṃgī raktanetrā ca raktāmbaravibhūṣitā ||66||
rāgiṇī nāma saṃjātā jyeṣṭhā menāsutā priye |
śubhāṃgī padmapatrākṣī nīlakuṃcitamūrdhajā ||67||
śvetamālyāmbaradharā kuṭilā nāma madhyamā |
nīlāṃjanacayaprakhyā nīlendīvaralocanā ||68||
rūpeṇānupamā kālī jaghanyā menakāsutā |
sunābha iti ca khyātaścaturthatanayo’bhavat ||69||
jātāstāḥ kanyakāstisraḥ ṣaḍabdāt purataḥ priye |
kartuṃ tapaḥ prayātāśca devāstā dadṛśuḥ śubhāḥ ||1.179.70|||
tato divākaraiḥ sarvairvasubhiśca tapasvinī |
rāgavatī nāma kanyā divaṃ nītā suraistadā ||71 ||
brahmaṇā sā kṛtā sandhyārāgavatī suvigrahā |
mahiṣāsuranāśāya sandhyāsamayarūpiṇī ||72 ||
pratīcchukī kṛttikābhāge sadā tiṣṭhate divam |
kuṭilā brahmalokaṃ tu nītā devaiḥ śaśiprabhā ||73 ||
brahmā prāha mahiṣasya vināśārthamiyaṃ sutā |
śārvaṃ dhārayituṃ tejo na vai śaktā hi dṛśyate ||74||
ataśceyaṃ brahmaloke satye kṛtālayā sadā |
āpomayī plāvayantī nadī tiṣṭhatu madgṛhe ||75 ||
iti gate kanyake dve jñātvā menā tapasvinīm |
tṛtīyāṃ putrikāṃ menāṃ tapaso’vārayadyataḥ ||76 ||
u mā tapaḥ kuru putrītyevamumābhidhābhavat |
ityetatkathitaṃ svalpaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi ||77||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne menāyai śaṃbhunā satījanmārthasūcanam menā dhanyā kalāvatī tisraḥ pitṛkanyāḥ śvetadvīpaṃ jagmuḥ tatra sanatkumāraśāpaḥ kramaśo himagireḥ sīradhvajajanakasya vṛṣabhānuvaiśyasya ca patnyo jātāḥ kramaśastatputryaḥ śivā sītā rādheti menāyāṃ sandhyārāgiṇī kuṭilābrahmanadī kālī ceti putrītrayaṃ sunābhaputraścetinirūpaṇanāmaikonāśītyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 179||

<1.180>
śrīlakṣmī uvāca
kālījanmakathāṃ divyāṃ vada me parameśvara |
kālī punaḥ kathaṃ gaurī jātetyapi kathāṃ vada || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi satī dehaṃ tyaktvāvyaktābhavattataḥ |
himālayapradeśeṣu guptādṛśyā vyavartata || 2 ||
devāḥ kailāsamāsādya susthāne praṇipadya ca |
sasmaruśca praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca tadā satīm || 3 ||
devyubhe omiti tvaṃ vai gāyatrī parameśvarī |
pūjitā brahmamunibhirūrjitā rājabhirnṛpaiḥ || 4 ||
tvaṃ bhūritiviḍbhi pṛthvī śūdraiḥ śiveti pūjitā |
kṣāntirmunīnāmakṣobhyā dayā niyamināmapi || 5 ||
tvaṃ mahopāyasandohā nītirnayavisarpiṇām |
paricitistvamarthānāṃ tvamīhā prāṇihṛcchrayā || 6 ||
tvaṃ muktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ matiḥ sarvadehinām |
itistvaṃ raktacittānāṃ prītistvaṃ hṛdi dehinām || 7 ||
tvaṃ kīrtiḥ satyabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ śāntirduṣṭakarmaṇām |
tvaṃ bhrāntiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ kratuyājinām || 8 ||
tvaṃ samudramahāvelā tvaṃ ca līlā vilāsinām |
saṃbhūtistvaṃ padārthānāṃ sthitistvaṃ lokapālinām || 9 ||
tvaṃ kālarātrirniḥśeṣabhuvanāvalivāsinī |
priyakaṇṭhagrahānandadāyinī tvaṃ vibhāvarī || 1.180.1 0||
rakṣikā tvamanāthānāṃ darśanaṃ dehi cāmbike |
anekairvividhairloke rūpairdevi tvamarcitā || 11 ||
sadā śivapriye durge tvāṃ namāmo maheśvari |
śrīśaktiṃ pāvanīṃ puṣṭiṃ mahadavyaktarūpiṇīm || 12||
vayaṃ namāmahe bhaktyā śuddhāṃ brahmaparāyaṇām |
antarvidyāsuvidyābhyāṃ suprītāṃ tvāṃ namāmahe || 1 3||
tvaṃ dīdhitiḥ sūryagatā kaumudī candrasaṃgatā |
āpyāyayasi brahmāditṛṇāntaṃ tvāṃ namāmahe || 14||
gāyatrī tvaṃ vedamātā tvaṃ sāvitrī sarasvatī |
tvaṃ vārtā sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ trayī dharmarūpiṇī || 15 ||
tvaṃ nidrā sarvabhūteṣu kṣudhā tṛptistvameva ha |
tvaṃ lakṣmīḥ puṇyakartṝṇāmalakṣmīḥ pāpināṃ tathā || 16 ||
tvaṃ śāntiḥ sarvajagatāṃ tvaṃ dhātrī prāṇapoṣiṇī |
gītistvaṃ sāmavedasya granthistvaṃ yajuṣāṃ hutiḥ || 17||
ṛgvedasya tathā mātrātharvaṇasya parā gatiḥ |
samastagīrvāṇaśaktirduḥkhanistārakāriṇī || 18||
śive rudrāṇi sannidre caṇḍe kātyāyani sati |
kauśiki caṇḍike kāli nārāyaṇi namo’stu te || 19 ||
tapaḥpriye sadādṛśye pārvati te namonamaḥ |
prasannā bhava deveśi darśanaṃ dehi suvrate ||1.180.2 0||
menāyāṃ labha putrītvaṃ mahādevi namo’stu te |
itthaṃ devaiḥ stutā devī durgā durgatināśinī ||21||
āvirbabhūva devānāṃ purato jagadambikā |
babhūvānandasandohaḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām ||22||
punardevāḥ praṇemuśca tuṣṭuvuśca viśeṣataḥ|
śive śarvāṇi kalyāṇi vijñaptiṃ śṛṇu cāmbike ||23||
dakṣasutā surakāryakṛte jātāpi śāṃkarī |
nahi jātaṃ prapūrṇaṃ tat devakāryaṃ maheśvari ||24||
pūrṇaṃ kuru mahādevi nirjarāṇāṃ manoratham |
sanatkumāravacanaṃ saphalaṃ syāttathā kṛte ||25||
bhūtvā tvaṃ menakāputrī rudrapatnī punarbhava |
sarve bhavantu sukhino duḥkhaṃ naśyatu kṛtsnaśaḥ ||26||
śrutvaitatprāha śarvāṇī prasannāhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
menāputrī bhaviṣyāmi svaṃ sukhaṃ labhatāṃ haraḥ ||27||
sarve gacchata dhāma svaṃ sadā smarāmi śaṃkaram |
mama hetormahāduḥkhī vartate sa kuveṣabhṛt || 28||
vidhāya mālāṃ suprītyā mamāsthnāṃ virahākulaḥ |
dehe mama citābhasma dhārayatyaniśaṃ prabhuḥ ||29||
ataścāvatariṣyāmi rudrasantoṣahetave |
bhaktāḥ śaṃbhupriyā bhūtvā tapaḥ kṛtvā suduḥsaham |||1.180.3 0 ||
surakāryaṃ kariṣyāmi satyaṃ svaṃ gacchata gṛham |
ityuktvāntardadhe devī jagāma himavadgṛham || 31 ||
surāstaddiśi natvaiva svasvadhāmani saṃyayuḥ |
himādrirmenakā cobhau tepāte paramaṃ tapaḥ || 3 2||
śivāmārādhayāmāsatuśca bhaktyāḍhyacetasā |
dānaṃ dadaturviprebhyaḥ sadā tattoṣahetave || 33||
caitramāsaṃ samārabhya saptaviṃśativāsarān |
śivāṃ sampūjayāmāsa putryarthinī tu menakā ||34||
aṣṭamyāmupavāsaṃ ca kṛtvādānnavamītithau |
modakairbalipiṣṭaiśca pāyasairgandhapuṣpakaiḥ ||35 ||
gaṃgāyāmauṣadhiprasthe kṛtvā mūrtiṃ mahīmayīm |
umāṃ saṃpūjayāmāsa nānāvastvarpaṇādibhiḥ || 36 ||
nirāhārā jalāhārā vāyvāhārā kvacitkvacit |
nināya menakā saptaviṃśativāsarān vrate || 37||
vratapūrṇe satī cāvirbabhūva parameśvarī |

praṇamāmi mahādevīṃ sarvakāmārthadāyinīm |
praṇamāmi sadā siddhāṃ paramātmasvarūpiṇīm ||4 1 ||
praṇamāmi sadānandāṃ vanitābuddhirūpiṇīm|

yoṣāṇāṃ satpriyakartrī brahmasukhapradāyinī |
bhaktecchāpūraṇī śaktirnārāyaṇi namo’stu te ||43||

prathamaṃ śataputrā me bhavantu jagadambike |
