suchatracāmarādarśapatratoraṇaśobhitam ||89||
divyapradīpatārādhivāsitaṃ śaśisūjjvalam |
kadalīpallavapuṣpaphalamālādyalaṃkṛtam ||1.190.90 ||
vāmapārśve gajau svarṇavarṇau sāmbālikau kṛtau |
caturdantau ṣaṣṭivarṣau madayuktau giriprabhau ||91||
tathāśvau dvau sūryavaṇau hyalaṃkṛtau tu kṛtrimau |
kṛtau cānye pratīhārāḥ svarṇavetradharā janāḥ |||92||
kṛtrimāśca hasantaśca lokapālāḥ śubhāḥ kṛtāḥ |
sarve devīyutā devāḥ kuṭumbasahitāḥ kṛtāḥ ||93||
upadevā guhyakāśca siddhacāraṇakinnarāḥ |
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaiva manavaścāpi kṛtrimāḥ ||94||
ayojitātmamātrāste dṛśyante cetanā iva |
viṣṇurlakṣmīyuto nārāyaṇaśca ramayā yutaḥ ||95||
vāṇyā yutastathā brahmā garuḍo haṃsa ityapi |
pārṣadāśca kuṭumbāni tattadīyāni sarvathā ||96||
vedāśca sanakādyāśca pāṭhakāḥ karapustakāḥ |
kṛtrimāśca kṛtāḥ sarve prītena viśvakarmaṇā ||97||
airāvatasthitaścendraḥ patnīputrādisaṃyutaḥ |
anye ca dhanadādyāśca dikpālā lokapālakāḥ ||98||
kṛtrimāśca kṛtāstatra viśvakarmeśvareṇa vai |
bahūktena ca kiṃ lakṣmi hyubhayoḥ pakṣayostu yaḥ ||99||
samājaścāgataścāthāgamiṣyati mahājanaḥ |
te sarve tāśca sarvāśca kṛtrimā viśvakarmaṇā || 1.190.100 ||
nirmitā akṛtanibhā āścaryārthaṃ dvayostayoḥ |
ityatra maṇḍape mañcā bṛsyaścopari paṭṭikāḥ || 10 1||
dugdhābhā sphaṭikābhāśca darpaṇābhāḥ kṛtāḥ śubhāḥ |
sthalyaścandranibhā ramyā haritāḥ śādvalātmikāḥ || 1 02||
kṛtrimāścitritāstatra muhyeyurbhrānticetanāḥ |
svayaṃbhuvo nivāsārthaṃ kṛtrimaḥ satyalokajaḥ || 1 03||
saudhaḥ sudharmā susabhā kṛtrimā cādbhutā kṛtā |
viṣṇornivāsanārthāya vaikuṇṭhaṃ bahusmṛddhimat || 1 04||
divyaṃ divyāścaryamayaṃ vireje viśvakarmakṛt |
indrapurī kṛtrimā ca kṛtā yadvat divi sthitā || 1 05||
tathānyadikprapālānāṃ puryo nivāsanāya hi |
lokapālamanūnāṃ ca puryaśca viśvakarmaṇā || 1 06||
kṛtrimāstatra racitāstattadvāsāya cāmbare |
sadanāni nivāsāya mahādivyādbhutāni ca || 1 07||
racitāni mahābuddhyā kṣaṇato viśvakarmaṇā |
saudhānāṃ paṃktayo rājaprākārāḥ kṛtrimāḥ kṛtāḥ || 1 08||
tathā divyaṃ ca kailāsaṃ racayāmāsa sūjjvalam |
sarvasmṛddhimayaṃ gehaṃ śaṃkarasya mahātmanaḥ || 1 09||
badarikāśramastatra śvetaśca kṣīrasāgaraḥ |
golokaścitritastatra kṛtrimaśca dravaiḥ kṛtaḥ || 1.190.11 0||
evaṃbhūtāḥ kṛtā viśvakarmaṇā racanāḥ śubhāḥ |
śarvaharyādayaḥ sarve prasannāḥ syuritīcchayā || 11 1||
sarvaṃ sajjaṃ śobhitaṃ ca kṛtaṃ ca kāritaṃ mudā |
putryā vivāhaśobhābhivṛddhaye himabhūbhṛtā || 11 2||
evaṃ susajya sarvārthaṃ lokarītiṃ vivardhya ca |
paryaikṣiṣṭa mudā śaṃbhvāgamanaṃ sa himācalaḥ || 11 3|||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne himālayena pakvānnaratnopakaraṇānāṃ rāśayo maṃgalāni ca kāritāni nimantritaparvatanadanadītīrthāraṇyadevadevyādyāgamanaṃ nagaramaṇḍapādiśobhā viśvakarmadvārā kāritā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 190||

<1.191>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu priye pravakṣyāmi śaṃbhuḥ kiṃ kiṃ cakāra ca |
kailāse saṃsthito devaḥ prāpya maṃgalapatrikām || 1 ||
mānaṃ vyadhād vācayitvā svīcakāra vidhānataḥ |
satkṛtya patrikāvāhaṃ yāpayāmāsa cādarāt || 2 ||
viṣṇuprabhṛtidevānnimantrayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ |
sarve āyāntu sotsāhā sastrīputrasutādayaḥ || 3 ||
nāgamiṣyanti ye tvatra madvivāhotsave tu te |
svakīyā naiva mantavyā ye ke’pi syurmahājanāḥ || 4 ||
nāradaṃ preṣayāmāsa caturdaśasu bhūmiṣu |
nimantrya mānataḥ sarvān tvāyayau śaṃkaraṃ muniḥ || 5 ||
atha prāghūṇikānāṃ ca sanmānāya tu śaṃbhunā |
racitaṃ nagaraṃ divyaṃ kailāsamaparaṃ navam || 6 ||
saudhāni yatra lakṣāṇi gṛhāśca koṭiśastathā |
udyānāni sahasrāṇi vāṭikāḥ śataśastathā || 7 ||
vāpyaśca dīrghikāścaiva vimānāni ca maṇḍapāḥ |
rasaśālāḥ sūdaśālā nṛtyaśālā vihārikāḥ || 8 ||
bhojyaśālā modaśālāḥ pradarśanyastathātulāḥ |
pānaśālāḥ snānaśālāḥ kuṇḍāḥ kathāsabhāgṛhāḥ || 9 ||
maṇḍapāḥ kāritā divyāḥ samastaṃ nihitaṃ divam |
na nyūnaṃ brahmalokādvā vaikuṇṭhādvāpi nākataḥ || 1.191.10 ||
janavāhāstvāyayuśca brahmāṇḍasthā nimantritāḥ |
sakuṭumbaparīvāradāsadāsīsuhṛjjanāḥ || 11 ||
prathamaṃ tu mahāviṣṇurlakṣmīyuktaḥ sapārṣadaḥ |
śṛṃgārān racayitvā cājagāma saparicchadaḥ || 1 re ||
svakuṭumbāni sarvāṇi cādāya viśvasṛṭ tathā |
taddāsadāsīvargaiścāyayau cālaṃkṛto’bhitaḥ || 13 ||
vairājā brahmamunayo vāsudevādayastathā |
avatārā hareścaiva rudrāśca koṭiśastathā || 14 ||
yamādayaśca pitaraḥ sauryāścāndrā gaṇāstathā |
lokapālāśca ṛṣayo dikpālā bhinnamūrtayaḥ || 15 ||
sālaṃkṛtāḥ saśṛṃgārāḥ sarvaparicchadairyutāḥ |
sastrīputrasutātvasṛtatkuṭumbādikānvitāḥ || 16 ||
āyayuḥ śivakailāsaṃ vivāhaḥ śivayoriti |
pitarau dyauḥ samastā ca yakṣāśca rākṣasā api || 1 7||
bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca gaṇāścārbudakoṭayaḥ |
kūṣmāṇḍā bhairavāścaiva vaitālā ścāgnayastathā || 18 ||
vidyutaśca mahākālo jarāmṛtyumahālayāḥ |
rātryo dhūmrāstathā devyaścaṇḍikādyāśca mātaraḥ || 19 ||
jvarāścāpi tathā rogāḥ ketavaśca grahāstathā |
upadravāstathāyātā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti || 1.191.20 ||
kiṃpuruṣā māgadhāśca sūtāścāpi ca bandinaḥ |
cāraṇāśca tathā bhūsthā divyamānuṣayonayaḥ || 21 ||
sthāvarā jaṃgamāścaivārṇavā nadyo nadādayaḥ |
asurā dānavā daityāḥ śaivā ye kadrujāstathā || 22 ||
nāgāḥ sarpāśca garuḍā ye cānye śaivapakṣagāḥ |
devā devyaścārbudābjaśevadhisaṃkhyakāstadā || 23 ||
sastrīputrakuṭumbāśca pṛthvyādyāḥ śivamūrtayaḥ |
sotsāhāḥ saparicchadāḥ sālaṃkārāḥ savāhanāḥ || 24||
durvāsādimahāyogijanā yoginya ityapi |
sādhvyo’vadhūtavaryāścāvadhūtānyastadāyayuḥ || 25 ||
ājagmurbrahmacāriṇyo durgā devyastathāyayuḥ |
śaktayaścāyayuḥ sarvā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti || 26 ||
āgatānāṃ svayaṃ śaṃbhuḥ satkārān bahudhā vyadhāt |
mahotsave sunṛtyāni cakre nartakikāgaṇaḥ || 27 ||
varayātrāṃ kārayituṃ kailāse mahīmānakāḥ |
nyūṣuḥ kāryaṃ svakaṃ matvā cakrire susahāyatām || 28 ||
cakrire giṣṭakāmarda śaṃbhovai sarvamātaraḥ |
cakrire ca yathāyogyaṃ śivabhūṣāvidhiṃ param || 29 ||
avādyanta suvādyāni śivabhūṣāvidhau tadā |
bhuṃjate ca mahīmānā nṛtyanti surayoṣitaḥ || 1.191.30 ||
śṛṃgārayanti yānāni janavāhāḥ pṛthakpṛthak |
saṃskārayanti gātrāṇi devyaḥ śrāṃgārikairdravaiḥ || 31 ||
mahotsāhāḥ pravartante maṇḍape maṇḍape tadā |
pūrvasṛṣṭau samutpannā gaṇeśāḥ kārtikāstathā || 32 ||
vairājadhāmato lakṣā āyayurmaṃgalārthakāḥ |
śāśvatasya pituḥ kārye sahāyā vāhinīkṛte || 33 ||
śivasya tu tadā veṣaḥ kīdṛśo’bhūcchṛṇu priye |
tasya svābhāviko veṣo bhūṣāvidhirabhūt tadā || 34||
svābhāvike jaṭāyūthe vidyutaḥ stanayitnavaḥ |
śītā bhūtvā sthitā hyāsan projjvalāḥ keśarāśayaḥ || 35 ||
gaṃgā svayaṃ vārirūpā brahmakiraṇamiśritā |
tejaḥparidhiṃ tvabhitaścakre dhāmamayaṃ tadā || 36 ||
golokātsvarṇamukuṭo divyo jaṭāsahāyakṛt |
śrīkṛṣṇenārpitaḥ kalgisahito mūrdhni rājate || 37||
pārījātakusumānāṃ hārālī tatra lambate |
dvitīyāyāḥ śaśī bhāle sakalastilakāyate | 38 ||
śāntamunnidramatibhaṃ cakṣurbhāle tṛtīyakam |
saprakāśaṃ tadā bhāle tripuṃḍraracanāyate || 39 ||
kāmarūpadharau sarpau vāsukī karṇayostadā |
kuṇḍale’bhavatāṃ śaṃbhoḥ ratnamaṇyaṃcite prabhe ||1.191.40 ||
kaṇṭhe tu vāsukiḥ kaṇṭhī pauraṭī dṛśyate śubhā |
bhujayorvāsukī svarṇakaṭake’bhavatāṃ tadā ||4 1 ||
rudrākṣāśca tadā śaṃbhoḥ prakoṣṭhaśṛṅkhalāmayāḥ |
pauraṭā maṇiyuktāśca babhūbuḥ kāmarūpagāḥ ||42 ||
mālāyāḥ sphaṭikāścāsyormikāḥ syustvagnijāḥ śubhāḥ |
citābhasmāsya netreṣu kajjalaṃ cābhavat tadā || 43 ||
tacca bhasma mukhe śaṃbhordravo jāto hi dugdhajaḥ |
dhavalaṃ lepanaṃ cūrṇaṃ bhasmābhavattu varṣmaṇi || 44 ||
valkalaṃ tu tadā jātaṃ svarṇakaṃcukamuttamam |
gajacarma tadā jātaṃ susamrāḍuttarīyakam ||85||
mekhalā ca tadā jātā raśanā divyapauraṭī |
saptaviṃśatirajjvāḍhyā naddhasadratnahīrakā || 46||
tadā himakaṇāḥ śaṃbhorabhavaṃścandanārhaṇāḥ |
kaṇṭhasthitaṃ viṣaṃ tasya tadā vai kaustubho’bhavat || 47 ||
vyāghracarmābhavat kaṭyāṃ dukūlaṃ pītavastrakam |
triśūlaṃ cābhavattasya svarṇakhaḍgo mahojjvalaḥ ||48 ||
pāvaṭikābhavattasya pauraṭī yaṣṭikā śubhā |
kāṣṭhasya pāduke svarṇamakhamallasukomale || 49 ||
susnigdhe’bhavāṃ pādarakṣike divyaśobhane |
bhaṃgābhavattadā cāsya tāmbūlaṃ susugandhavat || 1.191.50 ||
gṛṃjo’bhavattadā tasyottejikā gūṭikā parā |
kanakāśca tadā tasyābhavatkeyūranūpurāḥ || | 51 ||
muṇḍamālābhavanmahāmaṇimālā hyamūlyakā |
kapālaṃ ca tadā tvasyābhavacchreṣṭhasuśekharaḥ || 52 ||
vivṛtya vṛṣabhastatrābhavat śvetaṃ vimānakam |
sahasraśvetahastyaśvavṛṣavāhādisaṃyutam ||53 ||
gajādhirūḍho devendraśchatraṃ śuṣkapaṭaṃ vibhoḥ |
dhārayāmāsa vitataṃ sahendrāṇyā sahasradhṛk || 54||

sarasvatī dvitīyaṃ tadgajārūḍhā samādadhe |
ṛtavaḥ ṣaṭ kusumānāmaṃjalīndadhate hare || 56 ||

samudraścānulepasya pātramādāya saṃsthitaḥ ||57 ||
īdṛśaṃ sundaraṃ rūpaṃ kāmarūpaṃ dhṛtaṃ tadā |
sarvaṃ pariṇataṃ ceśe’pariṇāmaparātmani || 58 ||
īśecchayā krūra rūpā yogyarūpāstadābhavan |
varayogyavibhūṣāste’bhavan śrīśaṃkarecchayā || 59 ||
evaṃ yātrājane sajjīkṛte śaṃkarapakṣagāḥ |
sametya prāhurasmābhiḥ saha yānaṃ kuru prabho || 1.191.60 ||
viṣṇuḥ prāha tadā śaṃbhuṃ gṛhyoktavidhinādya vai |
svavivāhasya pārvatyāḥ karma kartumihārhasi || 61 ||
maṇḍapasthāpanaṃ nāndīmukhaṃ karma ca kāraya |
brahmā hyadhikṛtastatrābhyudayocitakarmaṇi ||62 ||
brahmaṇā noditāścakruḥ ṛṣayo vidhivat kriyām |
kaśyapo’trirgautamaśca kaṇvo brahaspatirguruḥ ||63 ||
vasiṣṭho bhāguriḥ śaktiragastyaścyavanastathā |
gargaḥ śilādo’kṛtaśramo’ruṇaśca parāśaraḥ ||64||
jamadagniḥ śilāpāko mārkaṇḍeyo’kṛtavṛṇaḥ |
bharadvājo dadhīciścopamanyuḥ kuśikastathā ||65||
pippalādaśca kautsaśca śvetavyāsaḥ saśiṣyakaḥ |
vedoktavidhikarmāṇo vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || 66||

rakṣāṃ cakruśca te śaṃbhoḥ kṛtvā kautukamaṃgalam || 67||
vedoktavidhinā cakruḥ ṛgyajuḥsāmasūktakaiḥ |
maṃgalāni vividhāni śaṃbhunā grahapūjanam ||68 ||
maḍalasthasurapūjāṃ cakruśca vighnaśāntaye |

kailāsācca bahiḥ sajjo bhūtvā gatvā sthito haraḥ ||1.191.7 0 ||
gānavādyasunṛtyāni jāyante ca tadotsavaḥ |
yayuścāpi gaṇāścānyo kailāsarakṣakān vinā ||7 1||
abhyagācchaṃkhakarṇaśca gaṇakoṭyā susmṛddhayā |

catuḥkoṭyā viśākhaḥ pārijāto navakoṭikaḥ |

śatakoṭyā yayuścātha sumantraḥ koṭikoṭibhiḥ ||79 ||
kākapādodaraḥ koṭiṣaṣṭyā santānakastathā |

nīlaśca pūrṇabhadraśca navatikoṭibhiryutau |
caturvaktraḥ saptakoṭyā karaṇo viṃśakoṭiyuk ||8 1||
yajvākṣaḥ śatamanyuśca meghamanyustathā paraḥ |
ahiromako navatikoṭibhiḥ sahitā yayuḥ ||82||
kāṣṭhāgūṣṭaścatuḥṣaṣṭyā sahito gaṇanāyakaḥ |

hārakeyūrakuṇḍalamukuṭādyairalaṃkṛtāḥ ||1.191.90||

koṭyaikādaśarudraiśca pṛṣṭhaṃ yātairanusṛtā |
ḍamarūṇāṃ mahāghoṣāstadā vyāptā jagattraye || 96||
dundubhiśaṃkhabheriṇāṃ ghoṣaiścāpūritaṃ jagat |
gaṇānāṃ pṛṣṭhato devāstataḥ siddhā maharṣayaḥ ||97||
tato’nvayurlokapālā madhye sagaruḍo hariḥ |
lakṣmīyuk pārṣadairyuktaḥ svabhūṣābhūṣitaiḥ śubhaiḥ ||98||
koṭyarbudairvaiṣṇavaiśca dāsairabjābjavargakaiḥ |
lakṣmībhiśca ramābhiśca kamalābhiryuto yayau ||99||
tato brahmā vedaśāstrasaṃhitāgamavittibhiḥ |
vairājairbrahmacaryasthaiḥ siddhaiśca sanakādibhiḥ || 1.191.100 ||
prajāpatibhiḥ putraiśca sāvitrīpramadādibhiḥ |
ṛṣibhirmunibhiścaiva sālaṃkṛto’nusaṃyayau || 101 ||
haṃsayānavimānaiśca vāhanaiḥ samalaṃkṛtaiḥ |
tataḥ sasainyastvindraśca airāvatakṛtāsanaḥ || 102 ||
naikadevagaṇairyukto reje sālaṃkṛtaḥ kṛtī |
tataśca ṛṣayo viprāḥ sādhyaśca sādhavastathā || 103 ||
tyāgino vānaprasthāśca vaiṣṇavāḥ saṃyayurmudā |
sarve nimantritā hṛṣṭā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti || 1 04||
yogino yatayaścaiva vītarāgāḥ śivāyanāḥ |
sannyāsinastadā jagmumurvivāhaḥ śivayoriti || 105 ||
gaṇyaśca gaṇikāścāpi koṭikoṭayaḥ śivāyanāḥ |
gaṇadāsyo gaṇapatnyo jagmurasaṃkhyakoṭikāḥ || 10 6||
bhūṣāveśādisaṃśobhāḥ sarvālaṃkṛtiśobhanāḥ |
sarvāḥ kailāsavāsāstā vivāhaḥ śivayoriti || 107||
tato yayuryoginīnāṃ maṇḍalānyarbudāni ca |
sanyāsinīnāṃ yūthāni koṭyabjāni yayurmudā || 1 08||
yadarthamāśramāḥ sarve varṇā yadarthamādṛtāḥ |
yadarthaṃ sampradāyāstadvivāhaḥ śivayoriti || 10 9||
ḍākinyaścāpi śākinyo vetālinyaśca mātaraḥ |
bhairavyo yātudhānyaśca kinnaryaśca yayustadā || 1.191.110 ||
tumbururnārado hāhā hūhūśca parvatādayaḥ |
gandharvāḥ kinnarā jagmurvādyānyādhmāya harṣitāḥ || 111 ||
koṭikanyāparivṛto varaḥ śṛṃgāraśobhitaḥ |
devībhirvardhito gītaiḥ śaṃkaraśca yayau tataḥ || 112 ||
śuddhasphaṭikasūjjvalavṛṣavimānamāruḍhaḥ |
parībhiḥ pūjito vyomnā brahmasarobhirādarāt || 113 ||
puṣpavṛṣṭyā jayanādairvardhitaḥ śaṃkaro yayau |
himaśailasutāpāṇigrahaṇārthaṃ haro yayau || 1 14||
nāradaḥ preṣitaścāgre himādrerbhavanaṃ prati |
varavāhinyāgamādisūcanārthaṃ drutaṃ yayau || 115 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkareṇa lagnapatrikā prāptā caturdaśalokasthānino
nimantritā āyayuḥ śivasya varayogyaṃveṣaḥ maṇḍapasthāpananāndīprabhṛtirmaṃgalakarmavarayātrākramavyavasthāprathamaṃ nāradaḥ preṣitaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 191 ||

<1.192>
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato gatvā nārado vismito’bhavat |
dṛṣṭvāścaryakarāṃ viśvakarmaṇā racitāṃ kṛtim || 1 ||
kṛtrimeṣu mohitaḥ sannāradaḥ prāha bhūbhṛtam |
varavāhinī prāgevāyātātra kimu vidyate || 2 ||
śailaḥ pratyāha devarṣe vismayaṃ tyaja kṛtrimam |
viśvakarmakṛtaṃ caitaddṛśyaṃ devādimaṇḍalam || 3 ||
bhojitaḥ pūjitaḥ prārthitaḥ śaṃbhorāgamāya ca |
nāradastvarito gatvā prāha śaṃbhuṃ surādikān || 4 ||
pratīkṣate himādriścāyātu vai varavāhinī |
tatra vimohanārthaṃ ca samāścaryārthamityapi || 5 ||
citramayī kṛtā māyā yatra trailokyamāhitam |
brahmaviṣṇumahendrādyāḥ sarve devāḥ sucitritāḥ || 6 ||
kṛtrimāścitrarūpeṇa na kiṃcidavaśeṣitam |
jaḍaṃ tu cetanaṃ yadvad dṛśyate sakriyaṃ hi tat || 7 ||
śrutvaitacca varādyā āturā hyāsan nirīkṣitum |
śivājñayā varayātrā vāhinī nirjagāma ha || 8 ||
ājagāmopahemādripuraṃ tu haravāhinī |
ākarṇyaitattu hemādriḥ preṣayāmāsa parvatān || 9 ||
viprām̐ścāpi svayaṃ cāpi yayau saṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
senayā sahitaḥ śailaḥ saṃbhāṣāṃ kartumīśvaram || 1.192.10 ||
śailendrāṇāṃ mahāsenāṃ śaivānāṃ ca tato’dhikām |
dṛṣṭvobhapakṣagāste tu vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 11 ||
virajeturmilitvaiva pūrvapaścimasāgarau |
haimo śailāśca viprādyāḥ praṇemurvaraśaṃkaram || 12||
vṛṣavimānasaṃsthaṃ suprasannāsyaṃ subhūṣitam |
divyāvayavasatkāntiprakāśitadigantaram || 13||

śivājñayā himaśailo yayau ca vidhivedikām || 16||

gamanaṃ cakrurīśādyā agragā girirāṭgṛham || 17||
tasminnavasare menā śivadarśanalālasā |
nāradaṃ pārśvataḥ kṛtvā candraśālāṃ samāgatā || 18||
śivo’pi svacamatkāraṃ darśayituṃ samicchati |
prāha vai vedhasaṃ viṣṇuṃ yātaṃ yūpaṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 1 9||
senāṃ kramayasārāṃ ca kṛtvā yāmaḥ sudarśanām |
menā vyavasthitāṃ ramyāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa ca || 1.192.20 ||
prathamaṃ ca giridvāraṃ gandharvāḥ sundarāḥ prabhāḥ |
divyālaṃkāravastrāḍhyāḥ subhagā vāhanairyutāḥ || 2 1 ||
vādayantaśca vādyāni hyapsarobhiḥ svarāyitāḥ |
patākājayapaṭṭaiśca yutāḥ praviviśustadā || 22||
atha vasupatiṃ dṛṣṭvā śivo’yamiti sābravīt |
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ sa hyete vai śivakiṃkarāḥ || 23 ||
atha dviguṇaśobhāḍhyayakṣasenādhipaṃ tu sā |
maṇigrīvābhidhaṃ dṛṣṭvā rudroyamiti sābravīt || 24||
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ sa hyete’pi śivasevakāḥ |
athadviguṇaśobhāḍhyasenāmadhyagato’nalaḥ || 25||
dṛṣṭo hyāyāta ityayaṃ śivāsvāmīti sābravīt |
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ śivanetrānalo hyayam || 26||
atha tato’pi dviguṇaśobhāvān yama āgataḥ |
taṃ svasenāyutaṃ dṛṣṭvā menā śivo’yamabravīt || 27|||
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ sūryaputrastvayaṃ yamaḥ |
athāyāntaṃ nirṛtiṃ svasenānvitaṃ vilokya sā || 28 ||
yamāddviguṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ puṇyajanamahāprabhum |
śivo’yamabravīnmenā nāradaḥ prāha neti saḥ || 29 ||
athāyāntaṃ varuṇaṃ dviguṇaśobhānvitaṃ ca sā |
senāmadhyagataṃ dṛṣṭvābravīdrudro’yameva kim || 1.192.30 ||
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ tāvadvāyuḥ samāgataḥ |
tato’pi dviguṇaśobhaṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ sainyamadhyagam || 31 ||

athāyāt taddviguṇādhiśobhānvito dhanādhipaḥ || 32 ||

nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ sa guhyakādhipatistvayam || 33 ||

tato dviguṇaśobhāḍhyaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā menakābravīt || 1 4||

dṛṣṭvā taṃ harṣitā menā prāhāyaṃ macchivāpatiḥ |
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ kintvindro’yaṃ surādhipaḥ || 3 6||
atha candraḥ samāyātastato dviguṇaśobhitaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā svasainyamadhyaṃ taṃ menābravīcchivo hyayam || 37||
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ kintu tadbhālacandrakaḥ |
atha sūryaḥ samāyātsvasainyamadhyagataḥ svarāṭ || 38 ||
tato dviguṇaśobhaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvāhāyaṃ śiveti sā |
nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ saḥ kintvayaṃ tattanū raviḥ || 3 9||
athāyayuśca bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayastejasādhikāḥ |

tato dviguṇaśobhaṃ ca dṛṣṭvāhāyaṃ śiveti sā |

atharṣimaṇḍalaistejorāśibhiḥ pūjito hyajaḥ |
tato’pi bahuśobhāḍhyaḥ samāyādvai pitāmahaḥ ||42 ||
dṛṣṭvā tato bahuśobhaṃ menā harṣavatī hyabhūt |
provāca śaṃkaro’yaṃ syāt nāradaḥ prāha naiva saḥ || 43 ||
kintu brahmā viśvasṛṣṭā menāścaryagatābhavat |
atha viṣṇurbahurūpo’tyatilakṣmīramāyutaḥ ||44 ||
sarvaśobhānvito meghaśyāmaḥ svarṇasamujjvalaḥ |
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyaḥ pītāmbaraścaturbhujaḥ ||45 ||
cakrādicihnavān vakṣaḥsthalarājatsukaustubhaḥ |
mukuṭakaṭakādyuktaḥ padmapatrābhalocanaḥ ||46 ||
lāvaṇyasaundaryanidhiraprameyaprabhojjvalaḥ |
anantadāsadāsīnāṃ sainye garuḍarājitaḥ ||47||
praviveśa tamāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvātiharṣavihalā |

nāradaḥ prāha nāyaṃ tvattsutāsvāmī hi menake |
śivabhrātā hyayaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivakāryādhikāryayam ||49 ||

kintu śivaḥ sadāśivo rājate īśasṛṣṭiṣu ||59||

ato’tirūpavān samṛddho vartata pārvatīpatiḥ ||1.192.60 ||

nārada prāha mene’yaṃ śivāpatipitāsti hi ||65||

mahāvairāgyamūrtiḥ sa varṇayituṃ na śakyate ||67||

varayātrāpravāhinyāṃ varaśobhā viśiṣyate |
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyasaundaryakāntisūjjvalam ||7 1 ||

eteṣāṃ yaḥ patiḥ so’tra patiḥ putryā bhaviṣyati || 73 ||
svabhāgyamadhikaṃ mene putryāścāpi tato’dhikam |

vigartārdhaparāyuṣye’sughaṭe śmaśrule’guṇe || 1 03|||
prāyo’sukhakare netrāraṃjane cāmanohare |

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tadā raṃge bhaṃgo’bhūnmenakākṛte |
śāṃkare darśane raudre śokābdhiḥ sulabho’bhavat || 1 ||
kapālayoḥ karau kṛtvā netre pramṛjya khedataḥ |
bhagnahṛdā bhāvahīnavacanānyavadanmuhuḥ || 2 ||
yaiśca yābhiśca śarvāya deyā putrīti bhāṣitam |
prastāvitaṃ jñāpitaṃ ca vāṅgīkāritamityatha || 3 ||
avagamitaṃ prayatitaṃ tattathāpyanumoditam |
tān sarvānatisaṃkṣubdhā tiraskaromi vai śaṭhān || 4 ||
nārada tvaṃ pariṇāme kleśado’si śaṭho’si ca |
tvayā svarṇasamā putrī kardame vinipātitā || 5 ||
phalaṃ caitanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ viparītamanarthakam |
prasahya preritā cāpi sarvathā vañcitā tvayā || 6 ||
phalaṃ tvasya tavāpi syācchapāmi tvāṃ punaḥpunaḥ |
sati yoge’pi lagnasya mā kanyāṃ labha durmukha || 7 ||
aho putri tapastaptvā tvīdṛśo vānaraḥ katham |
ārādhito’sahyaroṣo bhūtapretapiśācarāṭ || 8 ||
kiṃ kāryaṃ tvadya saṃjāte samāje cāgate gṛham |
tathāpyahaṃ sutāmātā samarthāsmi vyapohitum || 9 ||
yadi putrī prakathayennāyaṃ yogyo’sti me varaḥ |
mayā kṛte’pi yatne ca putrī na manute yadi || 1.193.10 ||
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ mama vyarthaṃ kiṃ karomi kuputrike |
kulādikaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ me vihitaṃ jīvanaṃ mama || 11 ||
kva gatāḥ ṛṣayasteṣāṃ śmaśrūṇi troṭayāmi vai |
kvāsti dhūrtārundhatī sā yayā sarvaṃ viṣīkṛtām || 1 2||
īdṛśāḥ svārthakapaṭāḥ nānyanāśaṃ pracakṣate |
tasmātkanyājanmadātrī svayaṃ gatvā vilokayet || 13 ||
varaṃ gṛhaṃ tathā smṛddhiṃ samācaraṇamityapi |
nānyaviśvāsamālambya kanyā deyā kvacijjanaiḥ || 14||
re putri padmapatrāsye grāvā vai rādhitastvayā |
krītaḥ kāco hema datvā kiṃ tvayā gavayo’rthitaḥ || 15 ||
tyaktvā tu candanaṃ putri hyarthitaḥ kledakardamaḥ |
adṛṣṭvā haṃsavayām̐śca kākaḥ sarvottamo mataḥ || 16 ||
hitvā dugdhābdhikāsvāda kṣārābdhisvāda arthitaḥ |
sūryaṃ hitvā ca khadyotastapaso’nte’rthitastvayā || 17||
hitvā bījāni satputri kiṃ kṛtaṃ tuṣabhakṣaṇam |
ājyamiṣṭānnamāmuktvā karīṣaṃ bhuktamāditaḥ || 18||
haricchāyāmanādṛtya śivāchāyāmadhiśritā |
muktvā brahmamayīṃ vidyāṃ bhāṇḍavidyārthitā tvayā || 19 ||
yajñabhūtimanālambya citābhasmāvalambitam |
are cintāmaṇiṃ tyaktvā kathaṃ vai kaṃkaro dhṛtaḥ || 1.193.20 ||
dugdhapākaṃ parityajya pīto nīmbarasaḥ katham |
aho putri kubuddhiste pañcavarṣasahasrakam || 21 ||
tapastaptaṃ tvayā cāsya śmaśānasthasya labdhaye |
nārībuddhirna vai buddhirnārībuddhiḥ parāśrayā || 22||
saguṇo vā nirguṇo vā yaḥ śliṣyati so’syā mahān |
tasmātkanyā na svabuddhyā saṃvivahetkadācana ||2 3 ||
vivāhayet pitā mātā kanyāṃ dṛṣṭvānuyugvaram |
tapo buddhiṃ ca caritaṃ rūpaṃ vṛttaṃ tavāstu dhik || 24||
nāradaṃ ca ṛṣīn pitāmahaṃ surām̐stathāstu dhik |
matkulaṃ me kriyādākṣyaṃ dhikkṛtaṃ ca yaśastvayā || 25 ||
kulaṃ dagdhaṃ tvayā vivāhayeyaṃ na mriye’tra vai |
saptarṣayo nāradaśca himādriśca pitāmahaḥ || 26 ||
ke’pi māyāntu nikaṭe darśayantu mukhāni na |
kimatra sādhitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pratyuta ghātitaṃ kulam || 27||
militvā kālakavale pātitā mama putrikā |
varamasmāttu vandhyātvaṃ varaṃ vā garbhagālanam ||28 ||
varaṃ vā janmato mṛtyurvaraṃ vā rākṣasādanam |
kumārītvaṃ cāpi varaṃ na śreṣṭhaṃ kuvarārpaṇam || 29 ||
gṛhaṃ samāgatā nagnabhūtapasya tu vāhinī |
daheyaṃ vā mriyeyātra gaccheyaṃ vā kriye’tra kim || 1.193.30 ||
na dātavyā na dātavyā varo yātu nijālayam |
janavāhāstu gacchantu prāghūṇikāḥ prayāntvapi || 21 ||
ahaṃ tu putrikāṃ nītvā gacchāmi mama paitṛkam |
yāntu sarve viśīryantāṃ riktaṃ kurvantu madgṛham || 32||
himālayo vanaṃ yātu na deyāsmai tu pārvatī |
iti vilapya putrīṃ svāṃ gatvāśliṣya muhurhṛdi || 23 ||
vakṣasyākṛṣya hastābhyāṃ dṛḍhīkṛtya sthitā gṛhe |
hāhākāro mahānāsīt tadā prāghūṇikeṣu vai || 34||
śrutvaitatprathamaṃ tatra jagāma tu pitāmahaḥ |
drāk dṛṣṭvā holikāśabdān brahmāṇaṃ prāha menakā || 35|||
gaccha duṣṭa mattabuddhe puṣpa prajvālitaṃ tvayā |
nirlajjo naskaṭo bhūtvā kanyānāśāya yatnitaḥ || 3 6||
kā āhvayati tvāmatra jaraṃ viśvāsaghātinam |
brahmā stabdho’bhavacchrutvā caṇḍīmātāpi caṇḍikā |||37|||
iti vicārya mauno’bhūt tāvatsaptarṣayo yayuḥ |
devāścāgraprapūjyāścāgatā menāpraśāntaye || 38 ||
ūcurmenāṃ rudrarūpaṃ śaṃbhornāstīti vāstavam |
līlayā saṃdhṛtaṃ caitat kṣaṇikaṃ nahi śāśvatam || 3 9||
paśyottiṣṭha haṭhaṃ tyaktvā dehi putrīṃ śivāya ca |
ayaṃ vai paramo lābhaḥ paraṃbrahma sadāśivaḥ ||1.193.40 ||
kṛṣṇaputraḥ kṛṣṇarūpaścāgatastava mandiram |
dānapātraṃ tava putryā tapasāṃ phalamarjitam ||41 ||
śrutvaitanmenakā prāha śaṭhāḥ sarve prapaṃcitāḥ |
rūpamasyā jīvanaṃ ca vyarthīkartuṃ samudyatāḥ ||42||
śastrādyairghātayiṣye’haṃ na dāsye ghorakarmaṇe |
dūraṃ gacchata sarve’smānnāgantavyaṃ mamāntike ||43||
varaḥ śaṭho bahurūpī varavāhāḥ śaṭhāstathā |
śaṭhaiḥ śaṭhāḥ sammilitāḥ prāṇahārāḥ parasya vai ||44||
śrutvā sarve mukhāṃgulyo’bhavan stabdhāḥ patanmukhāḥ |
himālayastadā prāyād bodhanāya sutākṛte ||45||
bahuśreṣṭhajanamadhye patiṃ novāca kiṃca sā |
śuśrāva śailarāḍuktaṃ mṛdu sāmayikaṃ vacaḥ ||46||
śṛṇu priye yathādṛṣṭastādṛgbhavedvaro yadi |
na deyā dayitā putrī noced deyā vicāraya ||47||
śrīkṛṣṇabrahmaviṣṇvarkacandrasūryendradevatāḥ |
ṛṣayaḥ pitaraḥ sādhyāḥ surāṇāṃ guravastathā ||48||
devyaśca koṭiśo mahālakṣmyādyāḥ sādhvya ādarāt |
lokapālā diśāṃpālā rājādhirājakeśvarāḥ ||49||
nāgaccheyurnimnaśaṃbhorvāhinyāṃ menakāgṛham |
vicārayeti vai patni yasya vāhe tvime gatāḥ ||1.193.50|||
sa kīdṛśo bhavecchreṣṭhaḥ saṃpaśya hṛdi sundari |
śivā jānāti taṃ śarvaṃ prāgbhavāt sahacāriṇī ||51||
tayoḥ prītiḥ śāśvatī cettatra kā vedanā tava |
susmṛddhāvapi cetpatnyā mano no ramyate vare ||52||
viṣavajjīvanaṃ tasyā guṇarūpāḍyake’pi kim |
mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tava putrī sukhyasti syāt sukhī sadā ||53||
yasyāsti deyā tasmai sā vikalā mā bhava priye |
keke samāgatā gehaṃ paśya mā ninda tān priye ||54||
enaṃ dvāragataṃ śaṃbhuṃ divyarūpadharaṃ priye |
paśya kṛṣṇasamaṃ rūpe uttiṣṭha kīrtivardhini ||55||
virarāmātha śailendrastaṃ menā prāha tatkṣaṇam |
mayā dṛṣṭo yathā rudrastādṛśo yadi cedbhavet ||56||
dhṛtvā kaṇṭhe subadhvā tāṃ kartāsmyadhaḥprapātanam |
tvaṃ tu putrīṃ ca māṃ nītvā dayāṃ tyaktvātha sāgare ||57||
nimajjya sukhī syāśca dāsye putrīṃ harāya na |
prasahya dāsyasi tasmai tyakṣyāmyadya kalevaram ||58||
atha sā pārvatī māturdṛṣṭvā duḥkhamapāragam |
kintvakāraṇamauḍhyotthaṃ vicāryāṃkasthitā śanaiḥ ||59||
netrāśrūṇi pramṛjyaiva snehaṃ kṛtvā rudīhi mā |
śāntiṃ labheta saṃprocya prāha miṣṭaṃ yathā bhavet ||1.193.60||
mātarvaraḥ surūpo’sti sarveśo’sti hareḥ paraḥ |
sarvāśca smṛddhayastasya sahasraguṇitāḥ parāt ||6 1||
yathā dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo mahāviṣṇurvilokitaḥ |
viṣṇuryathā tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ sūryaścandraḥ sureśvaraḥ ||62||
tathā tato’pyuttamo’sti rūpasainyasamṛddhibhiḥ |
mayā duṣṭo hi kailāso vaikuṇṭhādapi śiṣyate ||63||
yauvanaṃ ṣoḍaśavarṣaṃ rūpaṃ kṛṣṇādviśiṣyate |
atra tvayā tu yad dṛṣṭaṃ na taddṛṣṭaṃ mayā kvacit ||64||
na jāne darśitaṃ kasmāt rūpaṃ te vikṛtaṃ bahu |
nānārūpadharaścāyaṃ mahākālo’pi jāyate ||65||
saṃhṛtya viśvanetṝm̐śca dīvyati ramate śubhaḥ |
dharmāvalambanā bhūtvā mā vāgdharmaṃ jahāhi yat ||66 ||
atrāgatāstu ye devāḥ kiṃkarā hi śivasya te |
tava dvāri madarthaṃ sotsavāste kimataḥ param ||67|||
dehi māṃ tvaṃ śivāyāsmai jīvitaṃ saphalaṃ kuru |
manovāṅkarmabhirmātarmayā vṛto vṛto haraḥ ||68||
siṃhabhāgo vrajet siṃhaṃ na vṛṇe’nyamahaṃ varam |
mriyeya dāsyasi no cet yathecchasi tathā kuru ||69||
evaṃ śrutvā viparītaṃ putryuktaṃ sarvasannidhau |
menā dhabāk dhabāk putrīṃ muṣṭibhiḥ kūrparaistathā ||1.193.70||
tāḍayāmāsa tāṃ divyāṃ mahāroṣānvitā tadā |
ṛṣayastāṃ paricchidya ninyurdūraṃ tu pārvatīm ||7 1||
menā prasārya pādau ca hastau cāpi śiroruhān |
utpāṭya kṣmāṃ śiraḥ svasyā ghātayāmāsa mattavat ||72||
jalpayāmāsa bahudhā mārayiṣye sutāṃ svakām |
dāsye vā garalaṃ kūpe kṣepsye chetsye’tha khaṇḍaśaḥ ||73||
mariṣyāmyapi kanyāṃ na dāsye vikaṭarūpiṇe |
anayā duṣṭayā cāṭaḥ kīdṛśo mārgito varaḥ ||74||
mātuḥ pituḥ kule cogra upahāsaḥ prakāritaḥ |
na mātā na pitā tvasya nānujo nāgrajastathā ||75||
na kuṭumbaṃ na vai gotraṃ na gṛhaṃ rūpamārjavam |
na bhūṣā na ca vastrāṇi vāhanaṃ svasamo vṛṣaḥ ||76||
na dhanaṃ na vayo yogyaṃ na vidyā ca pavitratā |
kiṃ vilokya mayā putrī deyāsmai duḥkhidehine ||77||
brahmā siddhāśca sanakādikā devāḥ prajeśvarāḥ |
vyarthīkurvanti matputryā jīvanaṃ rudrakoṭare ||78||
svahastairhanyatāṃ putrī śāntirbhavakṛtā bhavet |
na deyā na ca vai deyā na dātavyā kadācana ||79||
śavavāhāya ghorāya daridrāya ca bhaṅgine |
śmaśānasthāya nagnāya malināya na cārpyate ||1.193.80 ||
sarve prapañcinaḥ putrīṃ mārayituṃ samudyatāḥ |
vṛṣabhāya mahīṣāya bahurūpadharāya ca ||8 1 ||
pāṣaṇḍine na vai deyā na deyā sarvakhaṇḍine |
viyāntu me gṛhadvārāt kiṃ hyanāthā vilokitā ||82||
iti prajalpya maunābhūt rurodoccaiśca vihvalā |
pārvatyapi mātṛvatsā tadāśrūṇi vyamuñcata ||83||
tadā brahmādayaḥ sarve cakitā vismayaṃ gatāḥ |
nirāśā abhavansarve tāvadviṣṇuḥ samāgataḥ ||84||
prāha mātastyaja śokaṃ kurmahe tava sammatam |
yādṛśaśca tvayā śaṃbhurdṛṣṭo vai tādṛśo bhavet ||85||
tadā putrī na vai deyā mamāsti sammatistathā |
mātaḥ śṛṇu kathaṃ tādṛgrūpaṃ śarveṇa darśitam ||86||
prathamaṃ yādṛśaṃ divyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasamamujjvalam |
susmṛddhaṃ rūpamatyarthānandasandohadāyakam ||87||
dṛṣṭaṃ tvayāsti cet tādṛk darśayecca tathā punaḥ |
tadā tvaṃ tvatpatiścaiva premabhaktiprapūritau ||88 ||
ātmanivedinau bhūtvākariṣyataṃ sutārpaṇam |
tatpradānaprabhāveṇa śuddhau bhūtvā bhuvaḥ sthalam ||89||
parityajya brahmadhāmāgamiṣyataṃ sumuktike |
tadā pṛthvī śailahīnā devasthānalayaṃkarā ||1.193.90||
oṣadhināśinī tadvat kailāsanāśinī bhavet |
tanmā bhūditi kṛtvaiva kāraṇaṃ tu vicārya ca ||9 1 ||
jāmātuḥ śaṃkarasyaiva droho yathā bhavettathā |
rūpaṃ tu śaṃbhunā dhāryaṃ sarvaṃ bhayaṃkaraṃ param ||92||
amanaskatayā putrīdāne mokṣo na vai phalam |
tadanyattu phalaṃ daśaputrodvāhakṛtaṃ bhavet ||93 ||
tatphalaṃ te bhavenmene na vai mokṣaphalaṃ bhavet |
tatsvāvaguṇadoṣasya grāhārthaṃ śaṃbhunā tathā ||94||
darśitaṃ vikaṭaṃ rūpaṃ nāsti tādṛk tu śāśvatam |
ehi paśya mahādevaṃ mahādevagaṇām̐stathā ||95||
sarve viṣṇusamākārāḥ susmṛddhāḥ santi sarvathā |
evaṃ prabodhitā menā kathaṃcitkomalābhavat ||96||
athāpi viṣṇunā nidarśanaiḥ saṃbodhitā punaḥ |
yūyaṃ ca ka parṇaḥstho vai pāṣāṇarūpadhāriṇaḥ|||97||
tathāpi kīdṛśāḥ saumyā devarūpadharāstviha |
kvacit samrāṭsvarūpāśca kvacitpakṣadharāstathā ||98||
evaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ matsyavārāhasiṃharūpadhṛk |
yathā dharmo vṛṣabho’pi yamo’pi bhavati kvacit ||99||
yathā nadyo jalarūpā nārīrūpā bhavanti ca |
yathā menā pakṣirūpā parvatātmāpi jāyate || 1.193.10 0||
idānīṃ tvaṃ pramadāsi tathā sarve bhavanti vai |
kāmarūpadharāḥ sarve bhavāmo devajātayaḥ || 101 ||
mohastatra na kartavyaḥ śoko’pi tyajyatāṃ tathā |
paśya śaṃkarasainyānāṃ rūpāṇi śaṃkarasya ca || 1 02||
kāryārthaṃ tādṛśaṃ rūpaṃ dhārayatyakhileśvaraḥ |
mayāpi śivamohārthaṃ mohinīrūpamāpyate || 10 3||
naropi pramadābhāvaṃ gṛhṇāmi kāryasiddhaye |
tathā viddhi ca mātastvaṃ haṭha tyaktvā ca śaṃ kuru || 1 04||
pārvatyā yattapastaptaṃ taddhi yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ tayā |
śaṃkarastoṣito varaṃ dadau yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ tathā || 1 05||
vāgdānaṃ ca kṛtaṃ putryāstadetad yogyamityapi |
śaṃkaraścāpi gṛhṇāti sutāṃ te yogyameva tat || 1 06||
śaṃkaro hyabhavadraudro yogyaṃ tenāpi tatkṛtam |
tvayā putryarthamātmā svastāpito yogyameva tat || 107||
mātā yadi svīyaputryāḥ kṛte yogyaṃ karoti na |
tadānye ke kariṣyanti haṭho yogyaḥ kṛtastvayā || 108 ||
athāpi devatāḥ sarve’dhikṣiptāśca tvayā hi yat |
tadapi yogyamevaitad vaivāhike tu karmaṇi || 10 9||
athāpi paśya deveśaṃ surūpaṃ śaṃkaraṃ punaḥ |
yadi smṛddhaḥ surūpaśca tvanmate’bhimato bhavet || 1.193.11 0||
tadā putrī tvayā deyā nānyathā tu kadācana |
yadi tvaṃ śaṃkarāyaiva naiva dātuṃ samicchasi || 11 1||
tadāhaṃ saṃgrahīṣye te putrīhastaṃ śucaṃ tyaja |
itibahuprakāreṇa bodhitā menakā tataḥ || 1 12||
svasthābhavat samutthāya draṣṭuṃ śaṃbhuṃ gatā bahiḥ |
uvāca ca hariṃ menā yadi ramyatanurharaḥ || 1 13||
sarvathā saparikaro mamābhiprāyato bhavet |
tadā sutā mayā deyā nānyathā koṭiyatnakaiḥ || 1 14||
etasminnantare viṣṇurnāradaṃ pairayad drutam |
anukūlayituṃ śaṃbhuṃ gatvā so’bodhayaddharam || 1 15||
sandeśaṃ prāpya dhṛtavān śaṃmabhū rūpamalaukikam |
viṣṇorapyadhikaṃ rūpo yauvane ṣoḍaśābdikam|| 116||
mṛdutve pārvatīsāmyaṃ tanutve sughaṭaṃ śubham |
puṣṭatve yogyasāpekṣaṃ taijase kṛṣṇato’dhikam || 1 17||
lāvaṇye cātha saundarye koṭimanmathato’dhikam |
bhūṣāsu vastraveṣe ca sarvebhyaścādhikaṃ param || 118 ||
parikareṣu sarveṣu sainyeṣvapi tato’dhikam |
sarvaṃ bhūtāvalīrūpaṃ tirodhāya navaṃ navam || 119 ||
golokasthaṃ yathārūpaṃ vaikuṇṭhasya yathāparam |
vairājasthaṃ yathā śreṣṭhaṃ sūryacandrendravaibhavam || 1.193.120 ||
tatsarvaṃ ca tato’pyati darśayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ |
tadānīṃ tatra vāhinyorubhayoḥ pakṣayorapi || 121 ||
nāsti kaścicca yenopamīyeta śaṃkaraṃ tadā |
santi kecinna vai yaiścopamīyeta ca tajjanam || 122 ||
tāvanmenā candraśālāmāyācca saha viṣṇunā |
dadarśa śivarūpaṃ tatparamānandasaṃbhṛtam || 122 ||
koṭisūrya pratīkāśaṃ mahatsaundaryabhājanam |
divyavastravibhūṣāḍhyaṃ hāsalāvaṇyavarṣi yat || 124 ||
devīnāṃ kṣobhakaṃ jātaṃ mohinyā api mohakṛt |
adhairyāḥ skhalitāstatra devyo māyāviḍambitāḥ || 125 ||
sūryeṇa chatritaṃ cāmaritaṃ candreṇa mastake |
bhūṣitaṃ ca kubereṇa dharmeṇa vāhitaṃ tadā || 1 26||
vyajitaṃ gaṃgayā yamyā nartitaṃ siddhibhistadā |
uttejitaṃ tathā devairjayetibhāṣitaṃ gaṇaiḥ || 127 ||
gāyitaṃ ca viśvāvasvapsarovrātaiḥ śivāgrataḥ |
gṛṇitaṃ ca paraṃbrahma munibhiḥ ṛṣibhistathā || 128 ||
nārāyaṇāyitaṃ sarvairgaṇaiśca sainikaistadā |
caturbhujāyitaṃ taiśca tathā samukuṭāyitam || 1 2 9 ||
bhūtapretapiśācādyaistirobhūtāyitaṃ tadā |
yāvadbhiḥ śaṃkarasainyairviṣṇujanāyita tadā || 1.193.130 ||
yāvatībhiśca nārībhirlakṣmīramāyitaṃ tadā |
vāhanaiścāpi sarvaiśca sadgaruḍāyitaṃ tadā || 131 ||
kimahaṃ varṇaye lakṣmi sarvaṃ madāyitaṃ tadā |
dṛṣṭvā tu menakā śokaṃ visasmārātiharṣitā || 132 ||
hariḥ prāha vinā bhānaṃ tvayā śokāyitaṃ vṛthā |
paśya śarvaṃ varaṃ mene kiṃ deyā vā na vā sutā || 133 ||
menā prāha prasannāsmi deyā deyā dhruvaṃ dhruvam |
athājagāma tvaritā śailadvāryabhiśaṃkaram || 1 34||

vivāhe ca tava lakṣmi evamevābhavatpurā |
vada cette samutsāhaḥ kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 244|||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne kuladevīpūjanaṃ pārvatyā yajñopavītaṃ śivapreṣitābharaṇādīni maṇḍapādāvāgamanaṃ madhuparkādi nāmagotrādipāṇigrahaṇavidhiḥ dānaṃ vahnipradakṣiṇaṃ brahṇaṇo’nyevālakhilyā utpannāḥ vedikācārolokācāraḥ vyaṃgyādi ratiprārthanayā kāmasajīvanatā bhojyasatkārādi pativratādharmāḥ dampatī prabhṛtīnāṃ kailāsābhigamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 194 ||

<1.195>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
himavadbhūbhṛtaḥ putrī kālīti varṇato’bhavat |
kāmarūpadharā sā ca vivāhasamaye tu vai || 1 ||
gauraṃ rūpaṃ dhṛtavatī punaḥ kālyeva sābhavat |
nityaṃ gaurī kathaṃ jātā kathāṃ tāṃ vada keśava || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi rūpaṃ gṛhasthakṛtpriyam |
kāṃcanasadṛśaṃ yadvā sthalapadmādisadṛśam || 3 ||
kaumudīsadṛśaṃ yadvā priyaṃ vidyutsamaṃ tvati |
kālyā ākṛtiḥ sarvāpi sughaṭāsīd yathāsthalā || 4 ||
pitṛkulasya varṇastu nīlo hyāsīnnisargajaḥ |
śaṃbhuḥ śivā svakailāse ramete smātibhāvataḥ || 5 ||
śaṃbhunā narmabhāvena kālītyabhihitā śivā |
hāsyaṃ cakāra bahudhā śivaḥ kālīti saṃvadan || 6 ||
yasya gṛhe nīlavarṇā patnī nīlā prajā bhavet |
apatyeṣu ca nīleṣu kulaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tato bhavet || 7 ||
yāvatpaśyāmi kālīti moho gacchati līnatām |
kuṭumbināṃ sambandhināṃ nārīṣu na prabhā bhavet || 8 ||
kālyā na gauravaṃ kiṃcitprabhavet gṛhavāsinaḥ |
kiṃ karomi yathābhāgyaṃ tathāptā nīlamohinī || 9 ||
yadi te na virodho’sti tvanyāṃ gaurīṃ nayāmyaham |
lagnaṃ karomi devānāṃ vārṣīṇāṃ kanyayā saha || 1.195.1 0||
vada devi mahākāli cātrārthe dehi mantraṇām |
ityuktā tu mahādevī drāk jātā bhagnamānasā || 1 1||
pratyuvāca mama varṇe ratirno bhavato’sti cet |
etāvantaṃ cirakālaṃ kathamatraiva rakṣitā || 12|
yadi nāhaṃ priyā te’smi kathaṃ nābhihitaṃ purā |
aratyā ca mayā sākaṃ divasā bhavato yadi || 1 3||
amanaskāśca niryānti kiṃ me nābhihitaṃ purā |
amanaskagṛhe sthātuṃ kiṃ me cātra prayojanam || 1 4||
aratyā vartamānaścet kathaṃ vai ramase mayā |
īśvarasya samarthasyāśakyaṃ na pramadārjanam || 15||
kathaṃ naitāvatānītā campakapuṣpasannibhā |
yadvātmārāmamuktasya na ratiḥ sukhasādhanam || 16||
jāne’ta eva bhavatā smaro’pi bhasmitaḥ purā |
manye mamāsi tapasi pañcasāhasravarṣaje || 17||
ata eva samāgatya niṣiddhaṃ bahudhā tadā |
vivāhaścāmanaskena prasahya ca kṛtastvayā || 18||
bhavatu vai tattu bhūtaṃ nānyathābhāvi vai bhavet |
sarvāvayavasaumyāpi bhartustoṣāya no bhavet || 1 9||
sānekaguṇayuktāpi vyarthaiva gṛhavāsinī |
mameyaṃ vyarthatā cādya prakāśiteti sukṛtam ||1.195.20||
kariṣye ca tathā yatno yathā syāṃ gauravarṇikā |
bhartuḥ sarvasvasaukhyasya sthānaṃ nārīti nirmitā ||2 1||
tatra yadi ne saṃtoṣaḥ kiṃ bhartṛtve rasastadā |
bharturbhāgārdha evāsti nārīsargo’tra sarjane ||22||
yadi sā na priyābhartustarhi kutropayoginī |
vivāhitayā kālyā cedbhartustoṣo bhavennahi ||23||
nānyatoṣo’pi bhavati na svayaṃ tuṣṭimāpnuyāt |
kiṃ phalaṃ cātra tatkālyāstasmād gaurī bhavāmyaham |||24||
tasmācchivasya toṣāya nāsti yo varṇa ujjvalaḥ |
taṃ tyakṣyāmi ca tapasā prāpsyāmi gauravarṇakam ||25||
yadvā tyaktvā punarvarṣma navaṃ prāpsyāmi janmataḥ |
gaurādgaurataraṃ yat syāt prathamāṃgulideśanam |||26||
ityuktvotthāya sahasā kālī jagāda gadgadam |
yayāce’numatiṃ śaṃbho tapojigamiṣāsti me ||27||
śrutvā stabdho’bhavacchaṃbhurhāsye hānirajāyata |
narmāpi nāśakṛnnaiva vācyaṃ kenāpi jānatā ||28|||
pārvatyā me viyogaḥ syāditi jñātvā naman satīm |
śaṃbhuḥ prāha priye narmavacasā kūpitā katham || 29||
tvāṃ vinā me ratiḥ kvāsti ratibhūścāsi me sati |
nityau nityaratau devau pārvatīparameśvarau || 1.195.30 ||
tayornityā ratiścāpi hyavinābhāvadharmataḥ |
nodvegaṃ vaha vākyena mā khedaṃ kuru bhāmini || 31 ||
āvayoḥ kāmabhāvastu nitya eva na kṛtrimaḥ |
pṛthagjanānāṃ rataye kṛtrimo janitastataḥ || 32 ||
sakāmo māṃ devatāsāmānyaṃ matvā balādapi |
parābhāvayituṃ prāpto mayā saḥ bhasmasātkṛtaḥ || 33 ||
naitāvatā svaṃ kālīti matvā saḥ bhasmito mayā |
ujjīvitastvadarthaṃ sa mahākālena vai mayā || 3 4||
ahaṃ cāsmi mahākālastvaṃ kālī viṣamau na vai |
dvayoryogyaṃ śāśvataṃ vai rūpaṃ kṛṣṇena kalpitam || 35 ||
mā khida tvaṃ mahādevi mā tapo’rthaṃ manaḥ kuru |
pañcavarṣasahasraṃ yattapastaptaṃ tvayā purā || 3 6 ||
tatra madarthaṃ te dārḍhyaṃ kiyacceti parīkṣitam |
vivāhitā mayā paścāt sadā tādātmyalabdhaye || 3 7||
mahākālasya vaṃśo’pi mahākālī hi saṃbhavet |
tatra tvayā na mantavyaṃ kālyā vaṃśo’sito bhavet || 38 ||
prathamā tvaṃ tu goloke dvitīyā tu sadāśive |
tṛtīyā tvaṃ satī dākṣī caturthī pārvatī ca me || 39 ||
yāsi sāsi pravarāsi mā kṛṣṇe khedamāvaha |
ahameko dvitīyā tvaṃ mayā kālī vivāhitā ||1.195.40 ||
sāvakāśo dvitīyāyā gauryā nāstīti narma tat |
narmaṇi naiva roṣo’tra kartavyo me priye sati ||41 ||
kaṭu hitaṃ ca madhuraṃ śrotuṃ kālītyathoditam |
nānyā vivāhitā pūrve paścānnaiva ca naiva ca ||42 ||
śrutvā ca pārvatī prāha cāṭu pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ mayā |
naitādṛśaṃ mahaccāṭu gṛhasaṃsāranāśakam ||4 3 ||
bharturyā tvapriyā patnī yadi prāṇānna vai tyajet |
sā bhartrā ninditā lokaiḥ sarvadaivātinindyate ||44||
avaśyaṃ te mayi kālyāmaprītirbhūyasī hṛdi |
anyathā narmavākye tannāgataṃ vai bhavet kvacit || 45||
sarvaiḥ kārṣṇyaṃ neṣyate ca neṣyate’pi tvayā tathā |
mayāpi dehakārṣṇyaṃ kṣālayitavyaṃ tapo’gnibhiḥ ||46 ||
kālīdehaṃ pṛthakkṛtvā haniṣyāmi mahāsurān |
gaurībhāgaṃ nijaṃ kṛtvā sevayiṣye haraṃ sadā ||47||
tavecchā tvāntarikyasti kālī krodhamayī bhavet |
gaurī tu sāttvikī sevākartrī meṃ’ṅke sadā vaseta ||48 ||
tathā kariṣye me nātha saṃkalpaste kṛto bhavet |
brahmāṇaṃ tapasārādhya kṣipraṃ gaurī bhavāmyaham ||49 ||
purā brahmāṇamārādhya satī bhūtvābhajaṃ haram |
tathā brahmāṇamārādhya gaurī syāṃ māṃ tato bhaja || 1.195.50 ||
ityuktvā ca patiṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya pativratā |
yatra vai pārvatīśṛṃge tapaḥ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ tayā || 51 ||
tatraiva ca tapaḥ kartuṃ gatā sā nīlalohitā |
dṛṣṭvā svapitarau natvā vṛttaṃ vijñāpya sā tataḥ || 52 ||
tāpasīveṣamādhāya snātvā saṃkalpya taddināt |
kṛtvā tu brahmaṇo mūrtimārcayat satphalādibhiḥ ||5 3 ||
tacchṛṃge phalamuddiśya gauratvaṃ cākarottapaḥ |
atha yāte bahutithe kāle vyāghra upāgataḥ ||54 ||
kṣudhitaḥ pārvatībhakṣaṇārthaṃ tiṣṭhati cāntikam |
samīpe yāvadāyāti jaḍo bhavati citravat ||55 ||
evaṃ bhakṣaṇalobhāya copāsanamivācarat |
devyānukūlatādṛṣṭiḥ kṛtā tasmin kṛpāmayī ||56 ||
siṃhasattve’nyaduṣṭograprāṇibhyo rakṣaṇaṃ mama |
bhavatīti kṛpādṛṣṭiṃ svabhāvācca kṛtā tayā || 57 ||
satkṛpāleśato vyāghrabubhukṣā līnatāṃ gatā |
nyavartatāṃgasastambho devīṃ ca bubudhe satīm || 58 ||
janmasiddhaṃ ca daurātmyaṃ naṣṭameva tato’bhavat |
bhūtvā tu devako duṣṭasattvānāṃ vārako’bhavat || 59 ||
devyāśca tapasā brahmā prasannastatra cāgataḥ |
devyā cārghyapradānena brahmā saṃpūjitastadā || 1.195.60 ||
provāca tāṃ tapohetumajānanniva viśvasṛṭ |
kiṃ tvayā tapasā sādhyaṃ sādhitastapasā haraḥ || 61 ||
athavā tāpasī līlā sādhvīnāṃ samayujyate |
citraṃ bhavati śaṃbhuṃ tvaṃ virahayya tapaḥsthitā || 62 ||
pārvatī prāha prathamaṃ kṛṣṇājjātā mahāsatī |
vairājī ca tadā brahman tvaṃ me putro’bhavaḥ purā || 63 ||
tato’bhavat sadāśivaḥ sadāśivāpyahaṃ tadā |
tadā tvaṃ me’bhavo jyeṣṭhastataste bhālato’bhavat || 64 ||
yadā rudrastadā cāhaṃ rudrāṇī śvaśuro bhavān |
himālayastava putrastatastvaṃ me pitāmahaḥ || 65 ||
itihetorgopyakaliḥ prākāśyo’tra pitāmaha |
śaṃbhustu śayane prāpte kālītyāha ca māṃ muhuḥ || 66||
tato mama śarīrasthakālimānaṃ vihāya vai |
gaurī bhavitumicchāmi tathā dehi tapaḥphalam || 67 ||
brahmā tathāstviti prāha devī kālī tadaiva ca |
kṛṣṇakośaṃ samutsṛjya gaurakośā hyajāyata || 68 ||
kṛṣṇakośātmikā kanyā kālīnāmnā ca kauśukī |
niśuṃbhaśuṃbhanāśāya yayau vindhyācalaṃ prati || 69 ||
gaurakośā navā gaurī divyā kanyā hyajāyata |
svarṇavarṇā campakābhā brahmāṇaṃ prāha viśvasṛk || 1.195.70 ||
ayaṃ rakṣākaraḥ siṃho divyo me sevayābhavat |
sa me vāhanarūpeṇa dīyatāṃ me gaṇeśvaraḥ || 71 ||
tathāstviti tadā brahmā dattavān siṃhameva tam |
saḥ kṛtaḥ somanandītināmnā devyā gaṇeśvaraḥ || 72 ||
brahmaṇābhyarthitā gaurī nivṛtya tapasā tataḥ |
praṇamya pitarau vṛkṣān yātā yatra maheśvaraḥ || 73 ||
praṇamyenotthitā yāvattāvat tāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
pragṛhya dorbhyāmāśliṣya svāṃke kṛtvā cucumba tām || 74||
mahotsavaḥ kṛtastasyāḥ kāyākalpanimittakaḥ |
bahvīḥ kathāstapobalamayī gaurī tadāvadat ||75 ||
tapasā kiṃ na cāpyeta sarvaṃ vai tapasi sthitam |
evaṃ lakṣmi prakartavyaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi || 76 ||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkaroktākālīti narmavacasā pārvatī saśokā tapaḥ kṛtvā gaurī jātā siṃhaśca bhakṣako bhūtvā somanandī jāta ityādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 195 ||

<1.196>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
brahmaviṣṇvorantarāle brahmaṇaḥ kiraṇaṃ ca yat||
samutpannastataḥ śarvaḥ so’bhavadvai sadāśivaḥ || 1 ||
kiraṇaṃ tadbrahmaliṃgaṃ śrutaṃ tava mukhānmayā |
nirākāraṃ hi tadbrahma bāṇarūpaṃ nirūpyate || 2 ||
tadeva śivaliṃgaṃ vā cānyadvā lokapūjitam |
iti me saṃśayaṃ chindhi yathāvṛttāntabodhanāt || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ sāścaryāṃ pāpanāśinam |
daivīṃ devacamatkāramayīṃ nānyasya bhāvinīm || 4 ||
yatastapaḥprakartāro bhavanti saṃyamairyutāḥ |
sastrīkā api munayo brahmadhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 5 ||
tathāpi kāmabhāvena kvacidbandhajavegataḥ |
vyavahāraṃ samāśritya brahmatvamanavāpya ca || 6 ||
ajñatvena ca devānāmanabhijñā bhavanti te |
purā dāruvane hyāsan ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 7 ||
na ca krodhena nirmuktāḥ kevalaṃ mūḍhabuddhayaḥ |
yadyapi munayaḥ sarve kāṣṭhaloṣṭhāsamadṛśaḥ || 8 ||
vedaṃ tvadhīyamānāśca kṛtāgnisadanakriyāḥ |
vartante sma ca śārīrabhāvena gṛhamedhinaḥ || 9 ||
pārvatyāstapasaḥ kāle śivo’pi cādvitīyakaḥ |
sarvasvaparityāgenāvartata tāpaso yathā || 1.196.10 ||
na carma na ca kaupīnaṃ nānyat kimapi sādhanam |
rakṣati smāvaraṇārthaṃ digambaro hyaṭatyapi || 11 ||
puṣpamālāṃ dadhan kaṇṭhe yuvā sarvāṃgasundaraḥ |
vane vane ṛṣyāśrame prāṭat bhikṣākapālabhṛt || 12||
dehi bhikṣāṃ tataścoktvā saṃbhramannāśramān yayau |
dvijarṣabhāśca divase samidhārthaṃ vanaṃ gatāḥ || 13 ||
āsannāśramavaryeṣu ṛṣipatnyaśca kevalāḥ |
taṃ vilokyāśramagataṃ yoṣito brahmavādinām || 14||
vihvalā vismitā jātāḥ kāścidbhayamupāgatāḥ |
kāścicca mohitāstatrājagmurdarśanalālasāḥ || 15 ||
procuḥ parasparaṃ nāryaḥ paśyāma ehi bhikṣukam |
darśanādarcanāttasya bhuktirmuktiśca labhyate || 16 ||
parasparamiti proktvādāya mūlaphalādikam |
āliliṃgustathā cānyā karaṃ dhṛtvā tathāparāḥ || 17 ||
parasparaṃ tu saṃsparśātsaṃmagnā ṛṣipatnikāḥ |
gṛhāṇa bhikṣāmūcustāstaṃ devaṃ muniyoṣitaḥ || 18||
sopi bhikṣākapālaṃ ca prasārya yoṣitaḥ prati |
dehi bhikṣāṃ śivaṃ te’stu dhanaputravatī bhava || 19 ||
bhikṣāṃ datvā tu tā nāryo jahasuścañcalā bahu |
papracchuśca tvayā ko’yaṃ nagnavratavidhirdhṛtaḥ || 1.196.2 0||
bhavān vai tāpaso hṛdyo brūhi sma yadi manyase |
śaṃkarastu hasan prāha rahasyaṃ vratamasti me || 21 ||
prakāśane phalaṃ na syāditi matvā na pṛcchata |
ityuktāstā brahmapatnyaḥ pratyūcurehi no gṛham || 22||
ityuccārya tadā taṃ vai jagṛhuḥ pāṇipallavaiḥ |
kāścit kaṇṭhe kāścitpṛṣṭhe kāścidudaramaṇḍale || 23 ||
kāścijānvośca kaṭyāṃ ca jaṭāsu pārśvayostathā |
kāścittu pādayoḥ kāścinnāsikāyāṃ ca karṇayoḥ || 24||
evaṃ samantato bhikṣukeśvaraṃ parivārya tāḥ |
raṃjayāmāsurākṛṣya svāṃ svāṃ prati dvijāṃganāḥ || 25|||
etasminnantare viprā ādāya samidho yayuḥ |
svagṛhāṇi ca tatraitatkautukaṃ tairvilokitam || 26 ||
viruddhaṃ tacca te dṛṣṭvā saroṣā hyabhavan kṣaṇāt |
ko’yaṃ kīdṛk pramatto’yaṃ yoṣitāṃ kṣobhakārakaḥ || 27||
ko’si kasmādāgato’si vastraṃ na dhriyate katham |
pṛṣṭho’pi nāvadat kiṃcit so’vadhūto digambaraḥ ||28 ||
pratyuta tadanāśrutya liṃge cāṃcalyamāvahan |
pramattayogivattatrādarśayat kāmanābalam || 29 ||
kṣobhaṃ vilokya bhūdevā jñātvā pramattameva tam |
dṛṣṭvā vikāravalliṃgaṃ jaghnurdarbhaśalākayā || 1.196.30 ||
tāḍayāmāsuratyarthaṃ kāṣṭhapāṣāṇapattalaiḥ |
samantrayā tayā darbhaśalākayā tu mūlataḥ || 31 ||
liṃgaṃ bhuvi prapatitaṃ vihāya vṛṣaṇau hatam |
śalākayā hatasyāsya khaṇḍāśca dvādaśābhavan || 32||
pātite tu tato liṃge gato’ntardhānamīśvaraḥ |
tadā śoko’bhavatteṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 33 ||
vartante vyākulāḥ sarve vidmo vayaṃ na śaṃkaram |
ko’yaṃ yogī kathamāyāt kimarthaṃ tāpasaḥ svayam || 34||
bruvanta evaṃ te sarve’manyanta pāpakaṃ kṛtam |
liṃgakhaṇḍāstadā sarve samutpatanti cāmbare || 35||
yatra yatra ca yaḥ khaṇḍo yāti tatrāgnivat tadā |
dadāha purataḥ prāptaṃ punarutplutya gacchati || 36 ||
yatra yatra ca yo yāti tatra dahati sarvathā |
pātāle ca gatāḥ khaṇḍāḥ svarge cāpi tathāgatāḥ || 37||
bhūmau sarvatra te yātā uḍḍayante patanti ca |
dāhayantyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ sthirā naivābhavan kvacita || 38 ||
lokāśca vyākulā jātāḥ ṛṣayaste’tiduḥkhitāḥ |
na śarma lebhire ke’pi surāsurarṣimānavāḥ || 39 ||
śāntyupāyavihīnāste brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ |
tatra gatvā ca te sarve natvā stutvā vidhiṃ tadā || 1.196.40 ||
pralaye tu nimittāste lajjayādhomukhāḥ sthitāḥ |
tatsarvamavadanvṛttaṃ brahmaṇe sṛṣṭikāriṇe || 41 ||
jñātvā tacchāṃkaraṃ kṛtyaṃ brahmā vacanamabravīt |
aho viprāḥ sadā kruddhā jānantyeva na tāttvikam ||42||
na dharmaṃ ca kriyāṃ kāṃcijjānanti mūḍhabuddhayaḥ |
brahmatattvaṃ vijānanti brāhmaṇāste prakīrtitāḥ ||43 ||
brahmaṇi naiva kāmo’sti vikṛtirna kutaśca ruṭ |
dehadharmā na vai dehādhyakṣe santi yathārthataḥ ||44||
ātmadharmā na vai dehe iti jānanti bhūsurāḥ |
hyetajjñānavihīnā ye dehāhaṃmamatānvitāḥ ||45||
krudhyanti dehamāśritya ghātayanti parām̐stataḥ |
druhyantyapi ca pārakyasvīyabhedasamāśritāḥ ||46||
tataḥ karmavaśāste vai bhuṃjate svarganārakān |
tanmanaḥ śodhayeddhīmān jñānayogātmabhāvanaiḥ ||47||
tasmin śuddhe hyantarātmā svayamevāvikāravān |
na kliśyati vapuḥkleśairvapurdharmaiḥ śubhāśubhaiḥ |||48|||
tathā sati ca nāveśaḥ kāmakrodhādimūlakaḥ |
tadbhāve ca nānarthaḥ samutpadyeta cedṛśaḥ || 49||
bhavantaḥ krodhakāmābhyāmabhibhūtāśrame sthitāḥ |
jñānināmāśrame krodhakāmābhibhavanaṃ vṛthā ||1.196.50 ||
vastuto nāsti nārīṇāṃ deho nārīti nāmabhāk |
nāpi narasya deho’pi nara ityapi nāmabhāk ||51||
ubhayostu sadā śārīrātmāsti naraśabdabhāk |
nṛbhogyaśarīraṃ yat tannārīti saṃprakīrtyate ||52||
śmaśrulo’śmaśrulako vā deho nārīti vocyate |
dehasyaivopabhogo’sti nānyadehasya kasyacit |||53||
paradehasukhaduḥkhe na bhujyete parātmanā |
svīyadehasukhaduḥkhe bhujyete hi nijātmanā ||54||
tasmāt keyaṃ kasya nārī ko’yaṃ kasyā narastathā |
kva ca nyastasamastecchā kva ca nārīmayo bhramaḥ |||55||
kva krodha īdṛśo ghoro yenātmānaṃ na jānatha |
sakrodho yajate yacca dadāti ca japatyapi ||56||
juhotyapi na vai tasya phalamāpnoti moghakṛt |
jñātāracca bhavanto vai kurvate garhitaṃ dvijāḥ ||57||
ajñātārastarhi kuryuḥ kiṃ tatrāścaryamūhyate |
śivaṃ viruddhya kuśalaṃ kasya jātaṃ ca vā bhavet ||58||
madhyāhnasamaye prāptamatithiṃ na parāmṛśet |
tasyaiva sukṛtaṃ nītvā datvā svīyaṃ ca duṣkṛtam ||59||
niryātyatisthitadvāsāt kiṃ punaryatra śaṃkaraḥ |
yāvalliṃgaṃ sthiraṃ na syānna vai syājjagatāṃ śubham ||1.196.60 ||
bhavadbhistu tathā kāryaṃ yathā svāsthyaṃ bhavediha |
śrutvaitat ṛṣayaḥ prāhurbrahman tattvaṃ samādiśa ||61 ||
brahmovāca samārādhya haraṃ sukhamavāpnumaḥ |
gacchāmaḥ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ kailāsa tu śivālayam ||62||
jagmuśca saṃhatāstatra dadṛśuḥ śaṃkaraṃ sthitam |
aliṃgaṃ ca tataḥ stotuṃ samārabdhāḥ surāstadā ||63 ||
aliṃgāya mahājvālānalarūpāya te namaḥ |
digambarāyāvikṛtaye parākṛtaye namaḥ || 64||
divyalīlāprarkatre te kṣamāśīlāya te namaḥ |
namaḥ śāntasvarūpāya ghoraliṃgāya te namaḥ ||65|||
no’parādhān kṣamasvātra mahādeva namo’stu te |
svaliṃgaṃ patitaṃ deva prabho samupasaṃhara ||66||
trailokyaṃ dahati vahnimayaṃ dvādaśarūpabhāk |
kṛpāṃ kuru mahādeva tava līlāmayaṃ jagat ||67||
evaṃ stutaḥ prasannaśca prāharṣīn śaṃkarastadā |
yasya drohaḥ kṛtastasya pūjanaṃ kuruta dvijāḥ ||68 ||
tadā bhaviṣyati śāntirligaṃ sthāne lagiṣyati |
saliṃgo’haṃ tathā syāṃ vai yena me prītiruttamā || 69||
yathābhilaṣitaṃ saukhyaṃ tataḥ prāpsyatha bhūsurāḥ |
devā ṛṣayo munayo brāhmaṇā hyasurāstathā || 1.196.70 ||
militvā mama liṃgasya pūjāṃ kurvantu ṣoḍaśaiḥ |
upacāraistataḥ śāntā bhaviṣyantyeva dvādaśa ||71 ||
śakalā mama liṃgasya nānyathā tu kadācana |
kurukṣetre tathānyatra yatra yatra patanti te ||72||
tatra tatra yonipīṭhe sthāpayantu dvijā nu tān||
prathamaṃ kurukṣetre ca yūyaṃ gacchantu saṃhatāḥ ||73 ||
tatra sarasi saṃsnātvā kurutaikasya pūjanam |
tasya śāntau bhaviṣyanti tadanye śāntavahnayaḥ ||74||
liṃgakhaṇḍā yatra yatra patitāstatra pūjanam |
prakurvantu mahābhāgā gacchantu mā ciraṃ yataḥ ||75||
ārādhya prāgbhavīyāṃ me patnīṃ satīṃ sthirāyanām |
yonirūpāṃ prasaṃkṛtvā sthāpayantu ca tatra tat ||76||
kubhamekaṃ ca saṃsthāpya kṛtvāṣṭadalamuttamam |
durvāyavāṃkuraistīrthodakairāpūrayantu tam ||77||
vedamantraistatastaṃ ca kuṃbhaṃ pramantrayantu ca |
pūjayitvā kalaśaṃ taṃ tajjalenābhiṣecanam ||78 ||
śatarudrīyamantraiśca prokṣaṇaṃ śāntimityapi |
kurvantu yonirūpāyāṃ bāṇaṃ śāntiṃ gamiṣyati ||79||
saṃsthāpyaivaṃ liṃgakhaṇḍaṃ liṅgāgre cāhvayantu mām |
sugandhaiścandanaiścaiva puṣpadhūpādibhistathā ||1.196.80 ||
naivedyādikapūjābhistoṣayantu pareśvaram |
praṇāmaiḥ saṃstavairnṛtyairgītaiścāpi pradakṣiṇaiḥ ||8 1 ||
tataḥ svastyayanaṃ kṛtvā jayeti vyāharantu ca |
sarvaśāntiṃ kuru deva prasanno bhava sarvathā ||8 2 ||
śānto bhava mahādeva rakṣāṃ kuru ca naḥ sadā |
evaṃ kurvantu bho viprā gacchantu mā ciraṃ yataḥ ||8 3 ||
ityuktāste dvijadevādayo natvā maheśvaram |
prāptāḥ prasannamanasaḥ kurukṣetre sarastaṭam ||84||
tatra tvārādhitā devī satī saṃsmṛtya bhūsuraiḥ |
drāgeva sā śaṃkarārthaṃ divyā hyupasthitā hyabhūt ||85 ||
brāhmaṇairvanditā yonirūpā divyābhavattadā |
tatra tu brāhmaṇairmantrairliṃgāgraṃ sthāpitaṃ tathā ||86||
sarvaṃ raktādi saṃkṣālya mardanādyaiḥ samīkṛtam |
ṣoḍaśopacārakaistad vedamantraiḥ surādibhiḥ ||87||
liṅgāgraṃ pūjitaṃ tatra bhaktyā yathopavastubhiḥ |
suprasanno mahādevo hyāvirāsa ca mūrtimān ||88 ||
svarṇavarṇo’titejasvī kiraṇaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |
prasannavadanaḥ śāntaḥ sarvānāha tato haraḥ ||89 ||
śāntaṃ ca brāhmaṇā yuṣmatkṛtaṃ drohākhyakarma tat |
śāntāśca sakalā yatra yatra santi ca te tathā || 1.196.90 ||
idaṃ tu pūjitaṃ satyā yonyāṃ saṃsthāpya yanmama |
liṃgāgraṃ tat hāṭakeśasaṃjñaṃ khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 91 ||
vasatu tacca pātāle hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñayā |
atra ca sṛṣṭikṛd brahmā liṃgaṃ śailamayaṃ tadā || 92||
ādyaṃ liṃgaṃ samāsthāpya svayaṃ pūjitavām̐stataḥ |
tasya sthāṇvīśvaranāmnā brahmaṇā khyātirāsthitā || 93 ||
tataḥ kālāntare tadvai khyātiṃ nāgeśvarābhidhām |
dārukāvanamāśritya sameṣyatīti jānatha || 94||
atha devā yatra khaṇḍāḥ patitā hyabhavam̐stadā |
tatra gatvā pupūjustān yonipīṭhān vidhāya ca || 95||
tatra tatra ca te khaṇḍāḥ pūjāṃ saṃgṛhya bhaktitaḥ |
svayamahṛśyatāṃ yātā yojitāśca yathākramam || 96||
liṃgāgraṃ cāpi pātālātsamutthāya samāgatam |
taccāpi ca yathāsthānaṃ saṃyogaṃ labdhavattadā ||97||
evaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ yātaṃ liṃgaṃ sacetanaṃ tataḥ |
śivasya vṛṣaṇau prāpya yathāsthānamavasthitam ||98 ||
saṃyojitaṃ yathāvattat śivenādbhutakarmaṇā |
brahmā vā śaṃkaro vātha viṣṇurvā śaknuyāttathā || 99||
nānyasyaitaddhi sāmarthyaṃ māraṇe yojane gatau |
pūjanārthaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ camatkāraḥ kṛto hyayam || 1.196.100 ||
caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe vai liṃgapāto’bhavattadā |
tatra dine’rhaṇīyāni liṃgāni daśa ca dvayam || 10 1||
caitre māse trayodaśyāṃ divyanakṣatrayogataḥ |
śukrārkacandrasaṃyoge dine puṇyatame śubhe || 10 2||
pratiṣṭhitaṃ sthāṇuliṃgaṃ brahmaṇā lokadhāriṇā |
ṛṣibhirdevasaṃghaiśca pūjitaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 103 ||
evaṃ dvādaśaliṃgāni jyotirliṃgāni tāni vai |
śaṃkarasya mahājyotirmayaliṃgāni santi hi || 1 04||
sacetanasvarūpāṇāṃ khaṇḍānāṃ yatra saṃsthitiḥ |
pūjanaṃ ca pratiṣṭhānaṃ kṛtaṃ sa eva śaṃkaraḥ || 1 05||
sākṣādastīti tānyeva mūrtimān śaṃkaraḥ svayam |
virājate mahadbrahma jyotīrūpaḥ sa sarvadā || 106||
jyotirliṃgāni tānyeva kathayāmi śṛṇu priye |
saurāṣṭre somanāthaṃ ca śrīśaile mallikārjunam || 107 ||
ujjayinyāṃ mahākālam oṃkāre cāmareśvaram |
kedāraṃ himavatpṛṣṭhe ḍākinyāṃ bhīmaśaṃkaram || 1 08||
vārāṇasyāṃ ca viśveśaṃ tryambakaṃ gomatītaṭe |
vaidyanāthaṃ citābhūmau nāgeśaṃ dārukāvane || 10 9||
setubandhe ca rāmeśaṃ ghuśmeśaṃ ca śivālaye |
grāhyameṣāṃ tu naivedyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || 1.196.11 0||
tatastattatsthale hrāse sthāpitāni punaḥ punaḥ |
bhaktairliṃgāni tānyatra kathayāmi śṛṇu priye || 111 ||
saurāṣṭre somanāthastu candraduḥkhakṣayaṃkaraḥ |
candrasaṃsthāpito devaḥ pratyakṣo līnatāṃ gataḥ || 112||
kṣayakuṣṭhādirogāṇāṃ nāśakaḥ pūjanāt priye |
śivāvatāraḥ someśo liṃgarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 113 ||
mallikārjunasaṃjñaścāvatāraḥ śaṃkarasya vai |
dvitīyaḥ śrīgirau prokto liṃgarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 1 14||
gaṇeśasya vivāhena kārtikeyastu roṣataḥ |
vrahmacārivratapratijñāṃ kṛtvā saṃyayau yadā || 1 15||
tatra putraviyogena saśokaḥ śaṃkaro yayau |
saṃsthito liṃgarūpeṇa dvitīyaḥ sa haraḥ svayam || 116 ||
ujjayinyāṃ nagaryāṃ tu mahākālābhidhāharaḥ |
vedaviprasya rakṣārthaṃ mūrtimān śaṃkaro yayau || 1 17||
vedadharmaviloptāraṃ dūṣaṇākhyāsuraṃ tadā |
huṃkāreṇaiva tūrṇaṃ vai bhasmasāt kṛtavān haraḥ || 1 18||
mahākālābhidhaḥ so’yaṃ liṃgarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ |
devaiḥ samprārthitaḥ śaṃbhurjyotirliṃgasvarūpavāna || 1 19 ||
atha vindhyācaladhyāto mūrtimān śaṃkaraḥ svayam |
brahmaṇā sthāpitastatra jyotirliṃgacaturthakam || 1.196.1 2 0 ||
oṃkāreśvaramityākhyaṃ śaṃbhustatra vyavasthitaḥ |
kedāre parvate sākṣātsvayaṃ himagirau haraḥ || 121 ||
kedāreśvara ityākhyo naranārāyaṇecchayā |
tiṣṭhati pañcamo divyo mūrtimān bāṇarūpataḥ || 122 ||
atha ṣaṣṭhaḥ śivajyotirliṃgāvatāra uttamaḥ |
sudakṣiṇākhyaṃ rājānaṃ kāmarūpādhipaṃ haraḥ || 123 ||
saṃrarakṣāsuraṃ bhīmaṃ hatvā bhīmeśvaro hi saḥ |
jyotirliṃgasvarūpeṇa ḍākinyāṃ saṃsthitaḥ svayam || 124 ||
mandarādreḥ samāgatya svayaṃ kāśyāṃ tu yaḥ sthitaḥ |
jyotiḥsvarūpaḥ kāśīviśveśvaraḥ sa tu saptamaḥ || 125 ||
atha gautamasaṃstutyā prāvirbhūto haraḥ svayam |
godāvaryāstaṭe tryambakeśvarākhyastathāṣṭamaḥ || 126 ||
atha rāvaṇasaṃstutyā citābhūmau haraḥ svayam |
āvirbhūto vaidyanāyeśvaro jyotirvyavasthitaḥ || 127 ||
daśamo dārukasaṃjñaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatavān haraḥ |
rarakṣa bhaktaṃ vaiśyaṃ saḥ supriyākhyaṃ tataḥ svayam || 128 ||
santasthau sāmbikaḥ śaṃbhurjyotirliṃgasvarūpadhṛk |
athaikādaśasaṃkhyāko rāmādityapratiṣṭhitaḥ || 129 ||
rāmeśvarasvarūpaḥ sa jyotirliṃgātmakaḥ svayam |
śaṃbhurvirājate bhaktebhyo vijayavarapradaḥ || 1.196.130 ||
bhaktena ghuṣmanā saṃrādhito haraḥ svayaṃ yayau |
ghuṣmāputrasya rakṣārthaṃ sudehyena hatasya vai || 131 ||
tato ghūṣmeśvarajyotirliṃgarūpo virājate |
iti te kathitā lakṣmi haradvādaśamūrtayaḥ || 132||
tān dṛṣṭvā ca samabhyarcya dhyātvā śrutvāpi mānavaḥ |
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati || 133 ||
evaṃ nimittamālambya jyotirliṃgāni cābhavan |
atha kālāntare sthānahrāsācca yugabhedataḥ || 1 34||
anye’nye sthāpayiṣyanti prajīrṇoddhārakarmabhiḥ |
yugāntaraprabhedena kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 1 35||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dāruvane bhikṣārthaṃ gatasya nagnasya śaṃkarasya darbhaśalākayā liṃgapatanaṃ dvādaśakhaṇḍāśca jyotirliṃgānīti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 196 ||

<1.197>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
ācāryapūjanaṃ vyāsapūjanaṃ gurupūjanam |
brūhi me bhagavandeva nityapūjātmakaṃ tu yat || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyācāryaṃ vyāsaṃ guruṃ tathā |
pūjāpātraṃ sopacāraṃ nītvā gatvā guroḥ puraḥ || 2 ||
namaskuryātprathamaṃ vai śirasā pādayoḥ spṛśet |
jalena dakṣiṇapādāṃguṣṭhābhiṣecanaṃ tataḥ || 3 ||
sthālyāṃ kuryāt tatastatra sapuṣpakuṃkumākṣatām |
arpayeccandanaṃ caiva lepayet tatra bindunā || 4 ||
paścāt taccandanaṃ bhāle lepayedūrdhvarekhayā |
candrakaṃ kauṃkumaṃ madhye sākṣataṃ kalpayecchubham || 5 ||
mastake paṭṭakaṃ dadyāt bahumūlyaṃ samujjvalam |
svarṇatārāvaliprotaṃ raṃgāḍhyaṃ dīrghamuttamam || 6 ||
galapaṭṭaṃ tathā dadyādaurṇaṃ satkaṃcukaṃ tathā |
uttarīyaṃ svarṇatāraṃ dhautre dve ca tathā vidhe || 7 ||
kaṭivastraṃ snānavastraṃ tathā prāvaraṇaṃ navam |
dadyācca gendukaṃ ramyaṃ mṛdu vai guptadorakam || 8 ||
mañcaṃ dadyācca kaśipuṃ vastrakhaṇḍām̐śca naktakam |
pattrāṇe komale dadyādyajñopavītamityapi || 9 ||
skandhapaṭṭaṃ tathā dadyādāsanaṃ śreṣṭhamityapi |
pārśvake dve ca kārpāse dadyāt tūlapaṭīṃ tathā || 1.197.10 ||
sthālikādvayamevaṃ ca vāṭikādvayamityapi |
ācamanīṃ homapātraṃ pūjāpātraṃ tribhāṇakam || 11 ||
vṛttapātraṃ tathā pānapātraṃ ca kalaśaṃ varam |
tāmbūlapātraṃ sacchatramupānahau sukomalau || 12||
pāduke yaṣṭikāṃ caiva kaṭibandhanamuttamam |
dadyādvividhadhātūnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kāritāni vai || 13 ||
karṇayoḥ svarṇabhūṣāśca kaṇṭhabhūṣāstathā śubhāḥ |
hastabhūṣāḥ kaṭibhūṣāḥ pādabhūṣāśca sarvaśaḥ || 14||
śṛṃkhalāḥ kaṭakān mālāścormikāḥ kaṇṭhikā varāḥ |
raśanāṃ pauraṭīṃ dadyāt sugandhidravyamuttamam || 15||
kastūrīṃ karpūrakaṃ ca snehaṃ vividhasaurabham |
śrāṃgārikaṃ ca śārīraṃ dadyādvai bahubhāvataḥ || 16 ||
yānaṃ vimānaṃ gantrīṃ ca vāhanaṃ gāṃ ca dugdhadām |
dāsān dāsīṃstathā dravyaṃ svarṇaṃ rūpyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 1 7||
dadyācca vividhaṃ svannaṃ dhānyaṃ ca dvidalādikam |
saṃskāravastu pātrādi jīrakādi tathāmlakam || 18||
aikṣavaṃ navanītaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ bhojyaṃ ca naikadhā |
dadyācchrīgurave sākṣānnārāyaṇāya yogine || 19||
brahmaṇe jñānadātre ca mantradātre kṛpālave |
yadyatsvasya bhavet hṛdyaṃ tattacchrīgurave’rpayet ||1.197.20 ||
evaṃ sarvaṃ vidhāyāṃkasamīpe ca tataḥ punaḥ |
vividhāni phalānyeva śuṣkāṇyārdrāṇi vā tathā ||2 1||
dadyācchrīgurave yo vai mokṣaṃ dānaṃ dadāti ca |
tataścaraṇayornatvābīraṃ gulālamityapi ||22||
dadyāchrītulasīpatraṃ puṣpāṇi vividhāni ca |
dugdhaprakṣālanaṃ kuryāccaraṇayoḥ pavitrayoḥ ||23||
snapanaṃ cāpi dugdhena guroḥ kuryādvidhānataḥ |
evaṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snapayitvā śuddhodakena ca |||24||
malanāśakadravyeṇa snapayitvā punaḥ punaḥ |
pariśramavināśārthaṃ gurvaṃgāni pramardayet ||25||
vastraiḥ sammārjayeddehaṃ sugandhaṃ tvarpayettataḥ |
vastrāṇyādhārayedbhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārāṇi ca dhārayet ||26||
candanākṣatamālābhiḥ kajjalairgandhamūrdhakaiḥ |
svarṇahāraiśca maṇibhirhīrakādibhirādarāt ||27||
pūjayeddhūpadīpaiśca naivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
miṣṭairhṛdyaiḥ svādutamaiḥ pūjayedbhojayet sukham ||28||
jalaṃ sugandhaṃ pānārthaṃ dadyāttāmbūlamuttamam |
phalaṃ dadyāttathā saumyaṃ cārārtrikaṃ vidhāpayet|||29||
daṇḍavat sustutiṃ namaskārān kṣamāpanaṃ tataḥ |
pradakṣiṇaṃ prāṃjaliṃ ca puṣpāñjaliṃ samarpayet || 1.197.30 ||
āśīrvādān gurūktāṃśca gṛhītvāttvā prasādakam |
āpṛcchya ca gṛhaṃ gacchet saha nītvā prasādikam ||3 1 ||
svasambandhijanebhyaśca datvā prasādameva tam |
guruṃ dhyātvā sadā prātaḥ pūjayet kramaśastathā ||32||
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ |
guruḥ sākṣātparabrahma mokṣadaḥ pāvako hi saḥ ||33||
nāsti gurusamaṃ dravyaṃ nāsti devo guroḥ paraḥ |
nāsti mokṣo guroranyo nāsti puṇyaṃ guroḥ param ||34||
gurordehe parabrahma sarvadā rājate hariḥ |
mūrdhani cākṣaraṃ brahma vāsudevo lalāṭake ||35||
netrayoḥ sūryacandrau ca nasyaśvinīkumārakaḥ |
mukhe nārāyaṇo yajño jihvāyāṃ vedamaṇḍalam || 36||
sarasvatī gurorvāṇyāṃ hṛdi viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ |
udare bhagavānvaiśvānaro vasati sarvadā || 37||
haste padmaṃ ca kamalā mahālakṣmīstu mānase |
caraṇe vasavaḥ santi tīrthāni pāvanāni ca || 38||
sarvendriyeṣu tattvāni devatāḥ santi romasu |
gurormūrtiḥ puṇyamūrtirmantramūrtirmaheśvarī ||39||
svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ gurormūrtau vyasthitam |
brahmānando gurāvasti śāśvato nirupādhikaḥ || 1.197.40 ||
ānando brahmaṇo vidvān gurureva na cāparaḥ |
gapadaṃ kiraṇe jñāne rapadṃ dravyadānayoḥ ||41 ||
jñānadānādguruḥ proktaḥ prakāśadravyavān svayam |
gapadaṃ mantravijñānaṃ rapadaṃ dāpanaṃ tathā ||42||
mantradāpanasāmarthyāśrayo gururhariḥ svayam |
gurave bhojanaṃ dattaṃ rājasūyaphalaṃ kriyāt|||43||
gurave vastradānādi jyotiṣṭomaphalapradam |
gurupūjā hareḥ pūjā gururyogaphalaṃ matam ||44||
gururvrataṃ gururyajñaḥ samādhirgurureva ca |
sampradāyo guruḥ proktaḥ sākṣātkāro gururmataḥ ||45||
guroḥ prasannatāyāṃ syuryamāśca niyamāḥ śamaḥ |
sādhanāni ca sarvāṇi gurau tuṣṭe kṛtāni vai ||46||
janmadau pitarau proktau gurū nāmakaro guruḥ |
bhāṣāyāḥ śikṣikā mātā kāryādiśikṣikā svasā ||47|||
yajñopavītado vipraḥ śāstrādhyāpaka eva ca |
mantrado jñānadaścaiva mokṣado gururuttamaḥ ||48||
anādyajñānamagno’yamātmā bhramati yoniṣu |
tasyājñānaṃ vināśyaiva jñānadānena nityadā |||49||
vāsanānāṃ karmaṇāṃ ca kārayitvā kṣayaṃ tataḥ |
haryārādhanayā bhuktimārgaṃ darśayati dhruvam ||1.197.50 ||
mokṣasthitiṃ gamayati so’yaṃ sarvaprado guruḥ |
duḥkhahartā sukhadātā konyastasmātparo guruḥ ||5 1 ||
guroḥ śaktirjñānarūpā śiṣyātmani praviśya ca |
svāparokṣānubhūtyā ca mokṣaṃ saṃprāpayed guruḥ ||52||
śaktijñānavaṃtī dīkṣā śiṣyadehaṃ praviśya ca |
muktatāṃ nayate dānāt kṣālanācca gurorbalāt ||53||
dīkṣāśikṣānusāreṇa śiṣyo’nugrahamarhati |
dīkṣāśikṣāviyoge tu na vidyāsiddhimuktayaḥ ||54||
ato dīkṣākhyasaṃskārāt śikṣākhyajñānasaṃgrahāt |
gurudvārā sadā śiṣyaḥ śuddhatāṃ prāpnuyāt kramāt ||55||
śiṣyastu śikṣaṇīyatvād gurorgauravakāraṇāt |
vyavahārācca śiṣṭānāṃ gurorgauravamācaret ||56||
yo guruḥ sa hariḥ prokto yo hariḥ sa guruḥ smṛtaḥ |
gururhariḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo vidyāśikṣātmakaḥ sthitaḥ ||57||
yathā kṛṣṇastathā vidyā yathā vidyā tathā guruḥ |
kṛṣṇavidyāgurūṇāṃ ca pūjayā sadṛśaṃ phalam ||58||
sarvadevātmakaścāsau sarvamantramayo guruḥ |
śiṣyaḥ sarvaprayatnena gurvājñāṃ śirasā vahet ||59||
śreyorthī yadi gurvājñāṃ manasāpi na laṃghayet |
gurvājñāpālakaḥ śiṣyo jñānasampattimaśnute ||1.197.6 0 ||
gaccham̐stiṣṭhansvapanbhuṃjan gurorvacanamācaret |
gurvājñayānyakarmāṇi kuryādātmanivedivat ||6 1 ||
samakṣaṃ karma kurvīta sarvaṃ cānujñayā guroḥ |
gurorgṛhe samakṣaṃ vā na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet ||62||
gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāttadgṛhaṃ devamandiram |
yatheha vahnisamparkānmalaṃ tyajati kāṃcanam ||63||
yathā vahnisamīpasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ pralīyate drutam |
yathā prajvalite vahnau śuṣkaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ pradahyati ||64||
tathaiva gurusamparkānmalaṃ tyajati mānavaḥ |
pāpaṃ vilīyate sarvaṃ vāsanā ca pradahyati ||65||
manasā karmaṇā vācā guroḥ krodhaṃ na kārayet |
tasya krodhena dahyanti hyāyuḥśrījñānasatkriyāḥ ||66||
tatkrodhakāriṇo ye syusteṣāṃ yajñāśca niṣphalāḥ |
yamāḥ saniyamāścāpi niṣphalāḥ saṃbhavanti hi ||67||
kadāpi na gurormarmabhedi viruddhamāvadet |
vaded yadi mahāgarvād yāti śiṣyo hyadhogatim ||68||
manasā karmaṇā vācā na mithyācāramācaret |
gurorhitaṃ priyaṃ kuryādādiṣṭo vā navā sadā ||69||
asamakṣaṃ samakṣaṃ vā guroḥ priyakaro bhavet |
svakāryaṃ paritastyaktvā guroḥ kāryaṃ samācaret ||1.197.70 ||
saṃvitsaṃjanana tattvaṃ paramānandamiśritam |
yenātra vidita loke sa evātra pramuktidaḥ ||7 1||
āśritaṃ tārayennaukā kiṃ śilā tārayecchilām |
brahmahīne kuto bodhaḥ kuto hyātmaparigrahaḥ ||72||
brahmatattvasameto’tra mukto mocayati prajāḥ |
yasyānubhavasantuṣṭā buddhirānandakāṣṭhikā ||73||
tasya darśanamātreṇa parānando’bhijāyate |
tasya sevanakāryeṇa naiṣkarmyaṃ siddhyati dhruvam ||74||
tasya śuśrūśayā sarvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati dehinaḥ |
sa evānandapūrṇastu sevanīyo mumukṣubhiḥ ||75||
yasmād vidyā cātmavittirbrahmalabdhirna muktatā |
ānando’pi na cāpyeta na bhāvyaḥ sa gurusthitau ||76||
gurorbhrātṝṃstathā putrān bodhadān bhaktisaṃgrahān |
seveta bhāvato nityaṃ gurumārādhayetsadā ||77||
sarvābhayapradātāraṃ karuṇākrāntamānasam |
toṣayed bahudhā bhaktyā sarvasvārpaṇapūjayā ||78||
tāvadārādhayecchiṣyaḥ prasanno’sau bhavedyathā |
gurau prasanne śiṣyasya sadyaḥ pāpakṣayo bhavet ||79||
tasmāddhanāni ratnāni kṣetrāṇi ca gṛhāṇi ca |
bhūṣaṇāni ca vāsāṃsi yānaśayyāsanāni ca ||1.197.8 0 ||
etāni gurave dadyādbhaktyā vittānusārataḥ |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchecchreyamātmanaḥ ||81 ||
sa eva janako mātā bhartā bandhurdhanaṃ sukham |
sakhā mitraṃ ca yat tasmātsarvaṃ tasmai nivedayet ||82|||
ākrūṣṭāstāḍitā vāpi ye viṣādaṃ na yāntyapi|
ahiṃsakā dayāvanto mokṣodyatasucetasaḥ |||83||
amānino buddhimantastyaktaspardhāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ |
ṛjavo mṛdavaḥ svacchā vinītāḥ sthiracetasaḥ ||84||
etādṛśā nityasattvamayā nārīnarāḥ śubhāḥ |
śrayeyuḥ sadguruṃ śiṣyāḥ kanyakāśca kumārakāḥ ||85||
śiṣyāḥ pariśritāḥ sevāṃ guroḥ kurvanti naiva ye |
asvātantryakṛto doṣo nāsti teṣāṃ parārthataḥ ||86||
bahunātra kimuktena yopi kopi guruśritaḥ |
brahmamārgagato bhāvī muktibhāṅnātra saṃśayaḥ ||87||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gurupūjāmāhātmyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 197||

<1.198>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kāmo nārāyaṇamūrteḥ samutpannaḥ purā śrutam |
īśvareṣu nivāso’sya tadābhūnmānasātmakaḥ || 1 ||
punaścāyaṃ vedhasastu kadā sṛṣṭau prakāśitaḥ |
tad brūhi me yathātattvaṃ purāṇapuruṣottama || 22 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
nārāyaṇaṃ samārādhya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
prajāḥ sasarja sarvāstāḥ surāsuranarādikāḥ || 3 ||
sṛṣṭvā prajāpatīn dakṣapramukhān devasattamān |
sasarja mānasīṃ cārurūpāṃ sandhyāṃ japantikām || 4 ||
atīva sundarīṃ subhrū municetovimohinīm |
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ narayogyāṃ ca sampūrṇaguṇaśālinīm || 5 ||
sarveṣāṃ mānasā bhāvāstadāsanpramadāmayāḥ |
subhagāḥ santu cedṛśyo nāryo ratiguṇāśrayāḥ || 6 ||
teṣāṃ tu mithunānāṃ ca snehavardhanakārakam |
sāmarthyaṃ sarvadā cāstu samākarṣaṇarūpakam || 7 ||
iti teṣāṃ tu saṃkalpān vijñāya sṛṣṭikṛtsvayam |
tathaivāstviti manasākalpayat tādṛśaṃ naram || 8 ||
tāvattu brahmaṇastatra mānaso mañjulo naraḥ |
prāvirāsītsvarṇavarṇaḥ pīnoraskā sunāsikaḥ || 9 ||
suvṛttorukaṭijaṃgho nīlābhugnāgrakeśaraḥ |
lagnabhrūyugalo lolaḥ pūrṇacandrātibhānanaḥ || 1.198.10 ||
sudṛḍhāyatasadvakṣā romabhramararājitaḥ |
surūpo meghavarṇaśca pīno nīlasuvāsakaḥ || 11 ||
āraktapāṇinayanamukhapādakarodbhavaḥ |
tanumadhyaścārudantaḥ pramattagajagaṃdhanaḥ || 1 2||
praphullapadmapatrākṣastāmbūlamukhavāsakaḥ |
kambugrīvo mīnaketuḥ prāṃśurmakaravāhanaḥ || 13||
paṃcapuṣpāyudho garvī puṣpakodaṇḍamaṇḍitaḥ |
kāntaḥ kaṭākṣapātena bhrāmayannayanadvayam || 14||
caṃcalaścārunetrābhyāṃ śṛṃgārarasasevitaḥ |
yaṃ vīkṣya puruṣāḥ sarve dakṣādyāḥ brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ || 15||
autsukyaṃ paramaṃ prāptā vismayākṛṣṭamānasāḥ |
abhavadvikṛtaṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca mano drutam || 16||
dhairyaṃ naivābhavattatra kāmākulitacetasām |
tataḥ kāmaḥ svayaṃ natvā brahmāṇaṃ prāha satvaram || 17||
kiṃ karomi ca dāso’smi brahman kārye niyojaya |
guṇarūpānusāreṇa yojyo dāsastu jānatā || 18||
śrutvā brahmā svakaṃ putraṃ kāmamāha sukhapradam |
anena tvaṃ svarūpeṇa puṣpavāṇaiśca paṃcabhiḥ || 1 9||
mohayan puruṣān strīśca kuru sṛṣṭiṃ sanātanīm |
saprāṇāścetanāḥ sarve tvahaṃ viṣṇustathāpare |||1.198.20||
bhaviṣyāmastava vaśe tava poṣaṇakārakāḥ |
janānāṃ mānase’dṛśyarūpo bhūtvā praviśya ca || 21 ||
sukhaprado mahān bhūtvā kuru sṛṣṭiṃ sanātanīm |
prāṇināṃ tvadbāṇalakṣyaṃ mānasaṃ sukhalālasam || 22 ||
bhavatveti tava sthānaṃ kṛtaṃ sattvaṃ tu dehajam |
indriyaṃ te samudyānastatrāstu madakṛdbhavān || 23 ||
iti te karma kathitaṃ sṛṣṭiprāvartakaṃ mahat |
yathā pramanthasyasmākaṃ mānasāni tatastava || 24 ||
manmathākhyā tathānyonyakāmanāt kāma ityapi |
manaso jāyamānena manobhava iti prathā || 25 ||
madakārānmadanastvaṃ kandarpaḥ kasya darpaṇāt |
puṣpabāṇo ratipatiriti khyātirbhaviṣyati || 26 ||
deveṣu tvatsamaḥ kaścid vyāpivīryo na vai bhavet |
ataḥ sthānāni sarvāṇi bhavantu vyāpinastava || 27 ||
harṣaṇaṃ rocanaṃ caiva mohanaṃ śoṣaṇaṃ tathā |
māraṇaṃ ceti coktāni tavāstrāṇi sadānagha || 28 ||
taiḥ sahitasya tu te syād vijayaḥ sarvasṛṣṭiṣu |
ityāśīrvacanaṃ labdhvā sandhyāyāḥ sannidhau hi saḥ || 29||
sāphalyasya parīkṣārthaṃ bāṇānmumoca vedhasi |
evaṃ punaḥ punardhanuryojayāmāsa mārgaṇaiḥ || 1.198.30 ||
ālīḍhasthānamāsādya dhanurākṛṣya yatnataḥ |
cakāra valayākāraṃ vavurvātāḥ sugandhinaḥ || 31 ||
munīṃśca mānasānsarvānmohayāmāsa mohanaḥ |
sandhyāṃ sarve nirīkṣanto vikārāvegapūritāḥ || 32 |
āsanpravṛddhamadanā indriyottejanānvitāḥ |
sandhyāṃ dṛṣṭvonapaṃcāśadbhāvā jātāḥ śarīrataḥ || 33 ||
kāmena brahmaṇoddiṣṭaṃ kartuṃ śakyaṃ vibhāvitam |
atha brahmaśarīrāttu dhātvaṃbhaḥ patitaṃ tadā || 34||
agniṣvāttāḥ pitṛgaṇā jātāste pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ |
nīlavarṇāśca yatayaḥ saṃsāragṛhaśūnyakāḥ || 3 5||
catuḥṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi tvagniṣvāttā hi pāvanāḥ |
ṣaḍaśītisahṛsrāṇi tathā barhiṣado’pare || 3 6||
atha dakṣaśarīrācca dhātvaṃbhaḥ patitaṃ bhuvi |
samastaguṇasampannā tasmājjātā varāṃganā || 37 ||
saumyāṃgī tanumadhyā ca svarṇasūkṣmaśiroruhā |
mṛdvaṃgī kalidaśanā tejomaṇḍalasūjjvalā || 38 ||
svarṇābhāvayavā ramyā candrakāntimayāṃganā |
dvādaśavarṣaśarīrā ratināmnī sumohinī || 39 ||
kāmabhāvaprapūrṇā ca sarvasaundaryasatkhaniḥ |
atha kratorvaśiṣṭhasya pulastyāṅgīrasostathā ||1.198.40 ||
anigṛhītendriyāṇāṃ bījaṃ bhūmau papāta ca |
tebhyaḥ pitṛgaṇā jātāḥ somapā ājyapāstathā ||4 1 ||
sukālinastathā haviṣmantaste kavyavāhakāḥ |
kratostu somapā jātā vāśiṣṭhā ūrdhvakālinaḥ ||42||
pulastyasyājyapā jātā haviṣmantoṃ’ṅgiraḥ sutāḥ |
ayaṃ pitṛgaṇaḥ sarvaḥ kavyavāṭ sarvathābhavat ||43 ||
sandhyā pitṛprasūrbhūtvā taduddeśayutābhavat |
atha dakṣaḥ kāmamāha sadrūpaguṇasaṃyutām || 44||
enāṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhāryārthaṃ matputrīṃ sadṛśīṃ guṇaiḥ |
ityuktvā pradadau tasmai dehasvedāmbusaṃbhavām ||45||
ratināmnīṃ tu bhāryārthaṃ kandarpāya sahārthinīm |
vivāhya tāṃ smaraḥ sopi mumodātīva sadratim ||46||
tasyā bhrūyugalaṃ vīkṣya visasmāra dhanuḥ svakam |
kaṭākṣayorgatiṃ dṛṣṭvā visasmārāstranirgatim ||47||
sugandhiśvasamāghrāya visasmāra sumānilam |
kāntavṛttānanaṃ dṛṣṭvā visasmāra śaśāṃkinam ||48 ||
suvarṇapadmakalikātulyaṃ tasyāḥ kucadvayam |
dṛṣṭvā cūcukayugmāḍhyaṃ sasmāra tārakādvayam || 49 ||
dṛḍhapīnonnatastanadvayamadhyasulambinīm |
ānābhipattalaṃ mālāṃ dṛṣṭvā sasmāra kaumudīm ||1.198.5 0 ||
visasmāra svadhanuṣo jyāṃ ca śiñjitaṣaṭpadām |
akṣidvandvaṃ samālokya visasmārābjapatrike ||5 1 ||
udaraṃ tanu cālokya sasmāra svarṇavedikām |
ūrudvayaṃ samālokya sasmāra kadalīdvayam ||52||
āraktapārṣṇipādāgraprāntabhāgān vilokya ca |
sasmāra cānurāgākhyaṃ mitraṃ taccaraṇasthitam ||53 ||
tasyāḥ karayugaṃ raktaṃ nakharaiḥ kiṃśukopamaiḥ |
vṛttābhiraṃgulībhiśca sūkṣmāgrābhirmanoharam ||54||
dṛṣṭvā sasmāra haribhujaṃgasanmaṇibhogakam |
tasyāśca bāhuyugalaṃ mṛṇālayugalāyatam ||55 ||
mṛdu snigdhaṃ pravālābhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmo jaharṣa vai |
nīlanīradasaṃkāśakeśapāśo manoharaḥ || 56 ||
camarīvāladhiprakhyo vibhāti smarajīvanaḥ |
etādṛśīṃ cakrapadmāṃ mṛṇālaśakalānvitām ||57||
sarvalāvaṇyasadanāṃ sarvāṃgarāmaṇīyikām |
dvādaśābharaṇairyuktāṃ śṛṃgāraiḥ ṣoḍaśairyutām || 58||
mohinīṃ tāṃ ratiṃ vīkṣya kāmo jagrāha sotsukaḥ |
vivāhaṃ vidhivattatra tayorbrahmā cakāra vai |||59 ||
tadā mahotsavastatra babhūva sukhavartanaḥ |
dakṣaḥ prītataraścāsīnmumude tanayā ratiḥ ||1.198.6 0 ||
kāmo’tīva sukhaṃ prāpto rarājāti tayā saha |
vāraṃ vāraṃ ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jagṛhe hṛdayopari || 61 ||
yā ca sandhyā brahmasutā manojātā purābhavat |
tapastaptvā tanuṃ tyaktvā saiva jātā tvarundhatī || 6 2||
medhātitheḥ sutā bhūtvā vavre patiṃ vaśiṣṭhakam |
candrabhāgānadītīre tepe yugacatuṣṭayam || 63 ||
tato vai prārthitaṃ jātamātrānmāviśatu smaraḥ |
brahmaṇāpi tathāstviti pradattaṃ varadānakam ||64 ||
taddināttu smaro dvādaśottaraṃ viśati prajāḥ |
sāpyevamupasaṃhṛtya tapo jagāma cāmbaram ||65||
saptarṣimaṇḍale cāste vaśiṣṭhasahacāriṇī |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi punaḥ kāmakathānakam ||66 ||
kalpādau sābhavatputrī cāṇḍālasyātidharmiṇī |
ṛṣayo dvādaśe’vagrahakāle’nnasamīhayā || 6 7||
bhikṣārthaṃ ca samājagmustadā pitrā samarpitā |
sākaṃ tu bhikṣayā vaśiṣṭhāya pāvanakāriṇe || 68 ||
niḥsāritā ca gomadhyāt pāvitā ca vivāhitā |
saivāstyarundhatī devī pātivratyaparāyaṇā ||6 9 ||
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā bhavati tattathā |
kalpabhede sṛṣṭibhedaṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi ||1.198.7 0 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jīvasṛṣṭau sandhyāpitṛkāmaratyarundhatyutpattipradarśananāmāṣṭanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 198 ||

<1.199>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
samudramanthane daityamohārthaṃ tvamabhūḥ prabho |
mohinīrūpamāpannastvāṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṃkarastadā || 1 ||
māyeśopi kathaṃ māyāmohamavāpa nirguṇaḥ |
iti me saṃśayaṃ chindhi tāṃ kathāṃ kathaya prabho || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ tanmahālakṣmi sarvaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ yathā |
ahaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ sākṣātparaṃbrahma parātparaḥ || 3 ||
nirguṇo’pi sadā divyaguṇākaro bhavāmyapi |
madicchāyā jagatsarvaṃ nirguṇānmama varṣmaṇaḥ || 4 ||
samutpannaṃ saguṇaṃ tat sattvādiguṇamiśritam |
prakṛteśca guṇānāṃ ca prerako’haṃ prayojakaḥ || 5 ||
yathā yatra yādṛśaṃ ca kārye bhavati tādṛśam |
rūpamāsthāya tatsarvaṃ sādhayāmi svayaṃ yathā || 6 ||
anyapraveśamāsthāya sādhayāmi guṇārthivat |
śaṃkaro mama bhakto’sti nirlepo māyayā sadā || 7 ||
māyāguṇairanudvejyo māyayā sa na lipyate |
tathāpyanyapraśikṣārthaṃ mohanaṃ darśitaṃ mayā || 8 ||
sādhvyaśca sādhavaścāpi tyāgavrataṃ samāśritāḥ |
te tu mohaṃ prajitvaiva divyabhāvā bhavanti hi || 9 ||
tathāpīndriyavegena kadācidyogasaṃbhave |
grāmyakriyāprakartāro bhaveyurmohasaṃbhave || 1.199.10 ||
śaṃkaro yogirāṭ bhakto māyāmohamavāptavān |
tasmānmuktiṃ samicchadbhirbhettavyamindriyāditaḥ || 11 ||
apramādaḥ sadā rakṣyaḥ pramādo mṛtyurucyate |
moha eva pramādo’sti naranārīprayogajaḥ || 1 2||

pāyayitvāmṛtaṃ devānapāsarat yato haraḥ |
ṣoḍaśahāyanā nārī kāmapūrabharānvitā || 18||
kabarīkeśaveṣāḍhyā caṃcatpatralatānvitā |
śaratpūrṇaniśānāthanibhānanamanoharā || 19 ||
kāmabāṇāśritabhālabhrṛkuṭidvayahṛdgamā |
raktapītasudhavalapuṣpāvataṃsaśobhitā || 1.199.20 ||
sthalapadmakṛtagucchagrathitadhammilottamā |
sugandhacandanamiśrakuṃkumapatrikānvitā || 21 ||
madhyasūkṣmaprabhābindvīsmāritānaṃgasadguhā |

sūkṣmaratnamaṇisvarṇahīrakāñcitakuṇḍalā |

suprabhahīrakāñcitasvarṇacandrakapolikā |
tanutārātmasauvarṇavālīmaṇibhanāsikā || 24||
pakvabimbauṣṭhayugalasmāritācumbanakriyā |

prodyatadsūryasamakāntikaustubhavaramaṇḍanā |

kambukaṇṭhī niṣkakaṇṭhī kadalīgarbhasadbhujā |
raktapallavasatkānticandranakhāṅguliprabhā || 27 ||
svarṇormikāṃgadaramyakaṭakavaṃgiḍīyutā |
śaṃkhalāraśanānūpurarājicaraṇadvayā || 28 ||

svarṇaraktaraṃgacitravicitraghargharīyutā || 29 ||
svarṇatārāñcitaprāntaśobhacchāṭīsamambarā |
nava raṃgaphalakalpastanāptakaṃcukīyutā || 1.199.30 ||
candravidyudvilāsābhaṃ naktakaṃ bibhratī kare |
kūrdatkandukavaryeṇa sakrīḍā ca muhurmuhuḥ || 31 ||
puṣpapallavaśobhāḍhye vṛkṣakuṃje gatīmatī |
īṣatkampāñcitastananitambacāpalānvitā || 32 ||
viguṇṭhadvastravaivartagocarībhavadaṃkanā |
hāvabhāvavilāsādicaṃcalāyatalocanā || 33 ||

evaṃvidhāmekatānāmekatānena lokayan |

jñaptismṛtivilopenābhavadbhānavivarjitaḥ |
kāmabhāvaprabhāmātrārūḍhasaṃkalpatanmayaḥ || 38 ||

ślathannīvyapatadbhūmau ghargharyapi tadantare || 39 ||

mahāprakāśatejasvi svarṇacampakabhānvitam ||1.199.40||

vāyurharati vastrāṇi sā ca harati śaṃkaram ||41||

kāmavegāptakārkaśyendriyo vīryaprapūritaḥ |||42|||
so’nugatvātidārḍhyena keśāndhṛtvā ca tadvapuḥ |
samākṛṣya samunnīya bāhubhyāṃ pariṣasvaje ||||43 ||

retaso vegaprābalyātsrāvabhavatpradhāvataḥ ||45||

reto mahyāṃ cāpatad yat tā hemnaḥ khanayo’bhavan ||46||
