mugdho maheśvaraḥ kāmavegastāmanudhāvati ||47||
bhūmāvaraṇyaśailādau cāpagāsu vaneṣu ca |
yatrādhāvanmahādevo dhātustasyāpatattathā ||48||
tatra tatra ca tadyogāt pṛthvī raupyamayī hyabhūt |
śaṃkarasya samagrasya dhātorvai kṣaraṇādanu ||49||
samajāyata śaithilyaṃ prabodho’bhūttataḥ punaḥ |
keyaṃ vai mohinīrūpā ko’haṃ gacchāmi kutra ca ||1.199.50 ||
kathaṃ me kalmaṣaṃ prāptamavikṛtasya vikṛtiḥ |
naitādṛśaṃ bhavedrūpaṃ jagaddhātāramantarā ||5 1||
amāyikasya kā māyā yena māyā vaśīkṛtā |
māṃ yāhīti kṛtayatnā māyeyaṃ vaiṣṇavī nanu ||52||
tasyaiva māyayā vyāptaṃ jagadetaccarācaram
yadyahaṃ tena cākṛṣṭastadā nāstyadbhutaṃ hi me ||53 ||
tenaiva saṃyojito’haṃ ramāmi śivayā sadā |
tenaiva preritaścāhaṃ viharāmi tadicchayā || 54||
iti vicārya mumude na mlānimagamaddharaḥ |
bhagavānapi taṃ bhaktaṃ pramātāraṃ vicintya ca ||55||
mohinīrūpadhṛk prāha kastvaṃ kasmājjaḍīkṛtaḥ |
kva gataṃ tava satsattvaṃ vinā yogamasatvavat ||56||
samarthasyāpi te kena gamitaitādṛśī daśā |
ehyāgaccha nikuṃjeṣu ramāvo nirjane vane ||57||
naitādṛśī punarnārīṃ prāpsyase’kṣatamadhyamām |
iti kṛtvā svayaṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇaścucumba tam ||58||
harastu dhātunirbhinnaḥ śaithilyākrāntameḍhrakaḥ |
notsāhavānabhūttatra tayā sākaṃ riraṃsitum |||59||
sa prāha mohinīṃ tatra nārāyaṇamṛte kvacit||
yogināṃ manaso dhairyaṃ hartuṃ śakto na vai paraḥ ||1.199.60 ||
tasmai namo bhagavate māyārūpadhārāya ca |
namaḥ kṛṣṇāya devāya nārāyaṇāya viṣṇave ||6 1 ||
mohinyātmasvarūpāya moharūpāya te namaḥ |
tvayi nātra mama śoko nārāyaṇe parātpare ||62||
tathāpi devadeveśa rakṣa māyāvimohanāt |
moho’yaṃ jagatāṃ bandhakaro’sti vāsanodayaḥ ||6 3 ||
tava yogo’pi mohātmā muktyātmā nirguṇo mataḥ |
tavedaṃ rūpamatyarhasaundaryabhājanaṃ param ||64||
na me cānyasya bandhāya mokṣamātrapradaṃ hi tat |
tasmāt tvayā kṛtaṃ yadvai tadvai me lābhadaṃ param ||65||
pārvatyāḥ sahavāse’pi smṛtvā tvāṃ mohinīṃ sadā |
vinirbandho bhaviṣyāmi lapsye nairguṇyameva ca ||6 6 ||
śrutvaitacchaṃbhuhārdajño bhagavān kamalāpatiḥ |
yoṣidrūpaṃ ca saṃhṛtya caturbāhuḥ kṣaṇe’bhavat ||67||
prahasanprāha sarvātmā samāśliṣya haraṃ hṛdā |
madbhakto matkṛtāṃ māyāṃ jītavānasi śaṃkara ||68||
jñānena cāpi dhairyeṇa bhaktyā ca parayā tathā |
nānyaścātitarenmāyāṃ yoṣidrūpāṃ hi tvadṛte ||69||
seyaṃ bhāvānsṛjamānā mohinīvadviḍambanā |
rajjūrūpā bandhanākhyā spṛśatyeva na macchritān ||1.199.70||
abhaktānāṃ mohikā sā bhaktānāṃ bhuktimuktidā |
saiva madyogamāpannā bhaktānāṃ nirguṇā sadā ||7 1 ||
mahāmāyā mahālakṣmīḥ kamalā rādhikā ramā |
sarasvatī ca sāvitrī pārvatī naiva bandhadā ||72 ||
rukmiṇī kambharā brāhmī pativratā ca jānakī |
mohinī tulasī caitā mokṣadā na tu bandhadāḥ ||73||
prabhā ca māṇikī jayā lalitā naiva bandhadāḥ |
kṛṣṇarūpāstu tāḥ sarvā muktidā yogataḥ smṛtāḥ ||74||
haṃsā ca maṃjulā campā haimī dayā ramā tathā |
puṣpā muktā tathā devī śāntā godāvarī manuḥ ||75||
ojasvatī ca jīvā ca maṃgalā tāḥ sakhīvarāḥ |
divyāstāsāṃ mūrtayo yāḥ sādhvyo yoginya eva ca ||76||
sākṣātkṛṣṇāṃkavāsāstāḥ pāvanā mokṣadāstataḥ |
sāṃkhyayoginya evātra sanyāsinyaśca yāstathā ||77||
virāgiṇyaśca madrūpā yatinyaścāpi mokṣadāḥ |
macchaktayastu tāḥ sarvā madrūpā eva nirguṇāḥ ||78||
tāsāṃ yogaṃ gatā ye ye te jīvā nirguṇāḥ sadā |
pavitrāścātra jīvanto muktā eva na saṃśayaḥ ||79||
yathā tāsāṃ yogavanto brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ |
kṛṣṇarāmādayo nityamuktā nityapareśvarāḥ ||1.199.80||
atha tāsāṃ kṛpāpātrajīvā mukteśvarāḥ sadā |
iti te kathitaṃ śaṃbho manmāhātmyamanuttamam ||8 1||
nedṛksamyagvijānanti ye doṣādṛtadṛṣṭayaḥ |
matsvarūpaprasaktā ye matto bodhagrahāśca ye ||82||
madātmakamidaṃ sarvaṃ jānanto’nidameva yat |
ta evedṛksumatayo nirbandhāḥ santi sarvathā |||83||
ityuktvā śaṃkaraṃ viṣṇurantardhānaṃ gataḥ kṣaṇāt |
mahādevo’pi gaṃgāyāṃ snānārthamagamattadā ||84||
iti te lakṣmi sāmarthyaṃ mohinyā śaṃkarāya yat |
darśitaṃ kathitaṃ sarva kiṃ punaḥ śrotumicchasi ||85||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śaṃkarasya mohinīdarśanena dhātupātāt svarṇakhanyutpattiḥ tatsakhīnāṃ divyatā cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā navanavatyadhikaśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1 99||

<1.200>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nāradasya punarjanma dāsīputratvamityapi |
kadā jātamiti brūhi śrotumicchāmi mādhava || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ sarvathā pāpanāśinīm |
brahmā viśvaṃ vinirmāya sāvitryāṃ gṛhadharmataḥ || 2 ||
cakāra vīryādhānaṃ ca śatavarṣottaraṃ tu sā |
suṣuve caturo vedān tadaṃgāni ca sarvathā || 3 ||
ṣaṭtriṃśadrāgiṇīścaiva ṣaḍrāgān tālasaṃyutān |
caturyugām̐śca kālaśca yogām̐śca ṣaṭsukṛttikāḥ || 4 ||
devasenāṃ mahāṣaṣṭhīṃ kārtikeyapriyāṃ satīm |
mātṛkāsu pradhānāṃ tāṃ bālānāmiṣṭadevatām || 5 ||
caturvidhaṃ layaṃ mṛtyukanyāṃ vyādhigaṇām̐stathā |
pṛṣṭhādadharmaṃ cālakṣmīṃ vāmapārśvata eva ca || 6 ||
nābhestu viśvakarmāṇaṃ vasūnaṣṭau mahābalān |
mānasāt caturaḥ putrān kumārān sanakādikān || 7 ||
mukhāt svāyaṃbhuvaṃ putraṃ śatarūpāsamanvitam |
tānsarvān sṛṣṭikṛdbrahmā sṛṣṭiṃ kartumuvāca ha || 8 ||
jagmuste ca nahītyuktvā taptuṃ kṛṣṇaparāyaṇāḥ |
cukopa hetunā tena brahmā tasya lalāṭataḥ || 9 ||
rudrā ekādaśotpannāsteṣāmeko vināśakṛt |
pulastyo dakṣakarṇācca pulaho vāmakarṇataḥ || 1.200.10 ||
dakṣanetrāttathātriśca vāmanetrāt kratuḥ svayam |
araṇirnāsikārandhrādaṅgirāśca mukhādruciḥ || 11 ||
bhṛgustu vāmapārśvācca dakṣo dakṣiṇapārśvataḥ |
chāyāyāḥ kardamo jāto nābheḥ paṃcaśikhastathā || 12||
vakṣasaścaiva voḍuśca kaṇṭhadeśācca nāradaḥ |
marīciḥ skandhadeśāccaivāpāntaratamā galāt || 1 3||
vasiṣṭho rasanādeśātpracetā adharauṣṭhataḥ |
haṃsaśca vāmakukṣeśca dakṣakukṣeryatistathā || 1 4||
sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ sutānsarvānājñāṃ cakāra viśvasuṭ |
nāradastu tadā prāha yuktiyuktaṃ śubhaṃ vacaḥ || 15||
pūrvamānaya majjyeṣṭhānsanakādīn pitāmaha |
kārayitvā dārayuktānasmānvada jagatpate || 16||
te tapaḥsu yojitāścet saṃsārāya vayaṃ katham |
ekasmāyamṛtaṃ dattamanyasmai tu viṣaṃ katham || 17||
ghore saṃsāravārdhau saṃpatitasya na nistariḥ |
koṭikalpe’pi bhavati tasmātsaṃsārasāgare || 18||
māsmānpātaya hitakṛtpitā bhūtvājñavat pitaḥ |
nārāyaṇaḥ svayaṃ bījaṃ nistārasyeha kathyate || 1 9||
sarvado bhaktido mokṣapradaścāpi sa eva hi |
bhaktekaśaraṇo bhaktavatsalaḥ karuṇānidhiḥ ||1.200.20 ||
bhaktapriyo bhaktanātho bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ |
bhaktārādhyo bhaktasādhyaḥ sa eva tārakaḥ svayam || 21||
vihāya taṃ paraṃbrahma ko mūḍho viṣaye bhramet |
kṛṣṇasevāmṛtaṃ tyaktvā viṣamaśnāti ko’budhaḥ ||25||
viṣayā naśvarāḥ sarve tucchāśca mṛtyuhetavaḥ |
svapnavanna sthirāḥ santi dīpajvālāgravartanāḥ ||23 ||
baḍiśapiṣṭavat matsyāpātābhikārakā iva |
duḥkhadā mṛtyudāstāpāḥ kastānseveta sanmatiḥ ||24||
tasmādayaṃ brahmabhājo brahmānvayaprakāśakāḥ |
vicintayāmo brahmaiva na kurmaḥ sarjanaṃ pitaḥ ||25||
ityuktvā nārado mauno’bhavat pratyuttarecchukaḥ |
tāvadbrahmābhavat kruddhaḥ provāca sphuritādharaḥ || 16||
nārad tvaṃ piturvākyamanādṛtyābhimānavān |
jñānīvopadiśanmāṃ ca niṣedhasi tu sarjanam ||27||

sthirayauvanayuktānāṃ surūpāṇāṃ vilāsakṛt ||28|||
pañcāśatkāminīnāṃ tvaṃ bhartā śṛṃgāravidbhava |
śṛṃgāraśāstravettā ca mahāśṛṃgārakārakaḥ |||29||
nānāśṛṃgāravijñānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca gururbhava |
gandharvāṇāmagragaṇyo gāyakaḥ susvaro bhava ||1.200.30||
vīṇāvādananiṣṇātaḥ sarvadā sthirayauvanaḥ |
bhaviṣyasi na sandeho dvilakṣābdasujīvanaḥ |||3 1||
punarmadīyaśāpena dāsīputro bhaviṣyasi |
tadā vaiṣṇavasaṃsargād vaiṣṇavocchiṣṭabhojanāt |||32||
śrīkṛṣṇasya prasādena bhaviṣyasi mamātmajaḥ |

adhunā bhava naṣṭastvaṃ matsuto nipata dhruvam |

śapetparityajedvidvān putramutpathagāminam |

koṭijanmārjita pāpapuñjā naśyanti mantrataḥ || 42||

gṛhaṃ dāsām̐stathā dāsīrapatyāni ca bāndhavān |
sutāndārām̐stathā śiṣyānsevakām̐śca kuṭumbinaḥ ||44||
yo darśayati sanmārgaṃ sopi sadgatimṛcchati |

yo darśayatyasanmārgaṃ taistairviśvasito janaḥ |

tvaṃ na dadāsi me bhaktiṃ nirodhayasi māmuta |

paramaiśvaryasaṃyuktaḥ putrahīno’bhavaddhi saḥ ||1.200.50||
gurvājñayā puṣkare saḥ tapaścacāra dāruṇam |

śivasya kavacaṃ mantraṃ varṣaśataṃ jajāpa saḥ |
nirāhārastapaḥ kurvan dadarśa purataḥ śivam ||52||
mahattejaḥsvarūpaṃ ca bhaktānugrahakārakam |
īṣaddhāsaṃ prasannāsyaṃ tapasyāphaladāyakam ||53|||
śaraṇāgatabhaktāya dātāraṃ sarvasampadām |
triśūlapaṭṭiśadharaṃ vṛṣasthaṃ candraśekharam ||54||
taptasvarṇajaṭājūṭaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trinetrakam |
nāgayajñopavītaṃ ca carmavastraṃ subhaktidam ||55||
dṛṣṭvā nanāma gandharvarājaḥ sa daṇḍavat bhuvi |
tuṣṭāva paramantreṇa prasannaṃ dhavalaṃ haram ||56||

sa yayāce harerbhaktiṃ bhaktaṃ putraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam |||57||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha kṛtārthastvaṃ sarvaṃ bhaktau pratiṣṭhitam |
varādekād vṛtaṃ sarvamanyaccarvitacarvaṇam ||58||
yasya bhaktirharau tasya sarvaṃ caiśvaryamasti hi |
sarvāśca siddhayastasya na nyūnaṃ vidyate’pyaṇu ||5 9||
saḥ samarthaḥ sarvaviśvān pātuṃ kartuṃ bhavediha |
ātmanaḥ kulakoṭiṃ ca śataṃ mātāmahasya ca ||1.200.6 0 ||
puruṣāṇāṃ samuddhṛtya golokaṃ dhāma yāti saḥ |
koṭijanmaprapāpāni hatvā dāsyaṃ harerlabhet ||6 1||
tāvatpatiśca patnī ca sutāḥ putrā dhanādayaḥ |
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ nṛṇāṃ tāvad yāvadbhaktirharau nahi ||62||
harau bhaktiḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ sarvepsitaṃ dadāti vai |
bhaktirmahām̐stīkṣṇakhaḍgaḥ karmadrumūlakṛntanaḥ ||6 3 ||
harau tu mānase lagne sarvaṃ siddhaṃ bhavatyapi |
yeṣāṃ tu sukṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ teṣāṃ putrāstu vaiṣṇavāḥ ||64||
bhavantyuddhārayantyeva kulakoṭiṃ tu sevayā |
sukhe vaiṣayike yadvā sāmrājye pārameṣṭhyake ||65||
prāpte sarvavidhe cāpi maṃgale naiva tuṣyati |
bhaktirbhaktaśca putraḥ syādityekātsarvamarthitam ||66||
caritārthaḥ pumānekādīdṛśāttu varottamāt |
kiṃ vareṇa dvitīyena yasmāt tṛptirna śāśvatī ||67||
vaiṣṇavānāṃ dhanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kṛṣṇe bhaktirhi śāśvatī |
sañcitaṃ bhaktidāsyaṃ yat sarvaṃ tena hi sañcitam ||68||
yadyapi tvarthitaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvasmāchreṣṭhameva ca |
tathāpi na vayaṃ dātuṃ samarthāstādṛśaṃ varam ||69||
varayānyaṃ varaṃ rājan yatte manasi vartate |
mahendratvamamaratvaṃ brahmatvamīśatāṃ labha ||1.200.70||
siddhīryogaṃ ca vijñānaṃ mṛtyuñjayabalaṃ tathā |
sarvaṃ dāsyāmi labha tat kṛṣṇadāsyaṃ tyaja dhruvam ||71 ||
śrutvā gandharvarājaścovāca śrīśaṃkaraṃ tadā |
yatpakṣmacālanenaiva brahmādeḥ patanaṃ bhavet ||72||
tadbrahmatvaṃ mahendratvamamaratvaṃ na me priyam |
siddhayaśca mahaiśvaryaṃ yogo mṛtyuñjayastathā ||73||
na me’styatipriyaṃ deva jñānaṃ ca bhaktimantarā |
sālokyasārṣṭisāmīpyasāyujyaikatvamityapi ||74||
vaiṣṇavā nahi vāñcchanti vinā tatsevanaṃ kvacit |
vāñcchanti dāsyabhaktiṃ ca śāśvatīṃ svāpajāgratoḥ ||75||
tasmāt taddāsyabhaktiṃ ca bhaktaputraṃ vṛṇomyaham |
anyatsarvaṃ parityajya tuṣṭāt tvatto varapradāt ||76||
na vā dāsyasi cecchaṃbho duṣkṛtaṃ me’sti niścitam |
śiraśchitvā sannidhau te pradāsyāmi hutāśane ||77||
śrutvā kṛpānidhirbhaktadayāluḥ prāha śaṃkaraḥ |
labhasva śrīharerdāsyabhaktiṃ putraṃ suvaiṣṇavam ||78||
gāndharvavidyākuśalaṃ cirāyuṣaṃ jitendriyam |
jñāninaṃ gurubhaktaṃ ca śaśvatsusthirayauvanam ||79||
varaṃ datvā yayau śaṃbhurgandharvaḥ svālayaṃ yayau |
kālena tasya bhāryāyāṃ lebhe janma ca nāradaḥ ||1.200.80 ||
vaśiṣṭhastannāma cakre gandhamādanaparvate |
upabarhaṇanāmāsau gandharvaḥ khyātimāptavān ||8 1 ||
upārthaścādhiko bodhyaḥ pūjyaśca barhaṇārthakaḥ |
adhikapūjya ityarthe upabarhaṇa nāma tat ||82||
cakāra saḥ sutajanmamahotsavaṃ mudānvitaḥ |
dadau ratnāni dhānyāni dravyāṇi hīrakāṇi ca ||8 3 ||
dhanāni kṣetravastrāṇi paśūn dānāni bhūriśaḥ |
upabarhaṇagandharvo vaśiṣṭhānmantramuttamam ||84||
prāpya kṛṣṇārādhanāyāścakāra duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ |
gaṇḍakyāḥ saritastīre vṛkṣajālasamāvṛte ||85||
tapantaṃ projjvalaṃ prāptayauvanaṃ sumanoharam |
dṛṣṭvā kāmāt tadā mūrchāmavāpuḥ pramadā muhuḥ ||86||
snānārthaṃ ca jalāptyarthaṃ yā yāstatra samāgatāḥ |
gandharvapatnyastāḥ sarvā mumuhuḥ kāmabhāvataḥ ||87||
tāśca tīvraṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā prāṇān santyajya yogataḥ |
pañcāśat tā babhūvuśca kanyāścitrarathasya vai ||88 ||
upabarhaṇagandharvaṃ tāśca taṃ vavrire patim |
kāmukyaḥ kanyakā mālā dadustasmai tapasvine ||8 9 ||
patnyastasya babhūvuśca tābhiḥ saha yayau gṛham |
divyaṃ dvilakṣavarṣaṃ ca tābhiḥ reme sa kāmukaḥ || 1.200.90 ||
atha kālāntare satyaloke devasamājake |
sabhāyāṃ brahmaṇastatra jagāma gāyanaṃ jagau || 91 ||
tatra rambhāpsaronṛtyakrame tu samupasthite |
tasyā ūrū stane rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrchāmavāpa saḥ || 9 2||
kāmavegena sattvapraskhalanaṃ saṃbabhūva ha |
tyaktvā saṃgītamevāyaṃ niṣasāda sabhātale || 93 ||
uccaiḥ prajahasurdevā brahma krodhācchaśāpa tam |
upabarhaṇa jānāsi pañcāśatpramadāpatiḥ || 94||
bhūtvāpi mohamāpanno raṃbhāṃ dṛṣṭvā hyadhīravat |
tasmādvihāya gāndharvī tanuṃ śūdro bhava drutam || 95 ||
tatra prāpya harerbhaktiṃ sāttvatānāṃ samāgamam |
punaḥ kāle samāpanne matputrastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 96 ||
vinā vipattimahimā sukhaśāntyorbhavennahi |
ataḥ kramātsukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ sarveṣāṃ bhāvyameva yat || 97||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
upabarhaṇagandharvo jagāma svagṛhaṃ prati || 98 ||
sarvāḥ patnīḥ samāhūya vṛttāntamabhidhāya ca |
āsane yogamāsthāya jahau tāṃ tanumādarāt || 99||
mūlādhāraṃ svādhiṣṭhānaṃ maṇipūramanāhatam |
viśuddhamājñācakraṃ ca bhittvā ṣaṭcakrameva saḥ || 1.200.100 ||
iḍāṃ suṣumṇāṃ medhāṃ ca piṃgalāṃ prāṇahāriṇīm |
sarvajñānapradāṃ cāpi manaḥsaṃyaminīṃ tathā || 101 ||
viśuddhāṃ ca niruddhāṃ ca vāyusaṃcāriṇīṃ tathā |
tejaḥśuṣkarīṃ caiva balapuṣṭikarīṃ tathā || 10 2 ||
buddhisaṃcāriṇīṃ caiva jñānajṛmbhaṇakāriṇīm |
etāḥ ṣoḍaśadhā nāḍīrbhitvā haṃsaṃ manoyutam || 103 ||
brahmarandhraṃ samānīyātmānaṃ yuyoja keśave |
dehaṃ tatyāja yogīndraḥ samprāpa brahma śāśvatam || 1 04||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇā sāvitryāṃ mānasaputrā utpāditāḥ nāradotpattiḥ sṛṣṭyarthaṃ niyoge nāradasya tanniṣedhaḥ brahmaṇaḥ śāpādupabarhaṇākhyagandharvabhavanam punaḥ brahmasabhāyāṃ gāyanakāle śāpāt tanutyāgaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 200 ||

<1.201>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
upabarhaṇagandharvo yogamāsthāya mṛtyave |
yadāsanaṃ prasaṃkalpya saṃsthito’bhūttadā hi saḥ || 1 ||
vīṇāṃ tritantrīṃ duṣprāpyāṃ vāmaskandhe nidhāya ca |
śuddhasphaṭikamālāṃ ca sandhṛtvā dakṣiṇe kare || 2 ||
saṃjalpannakṣaraṃ brahma kṛṣṇa ityakṣaradvayam |
prācyāṃ kṛtvā śiraḥsthānaṃ paścime caraṇadvayam || 3 ||
śayitvā darbhaśayane śrīkṛṣṇaṃ manasā smaran |
yogena brahma samprāpa patnyādyā rurudurbhṛśam || 4 ||
pañcāśadyoṣitāṃ mukhyā rājñī mālāvatī tadā |
uccaiḥ ruroda sā tīvraṃ kāntaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi || 5 ||
uvāca bhagavanmūrteḥ saṃsargo’pi vimuktikṛt |
nārīṇāṃ devasaṃsargo bahubhāgyāddhi jāyate || 6 ||
sādhunā saha saṃsargo vaikuṇṭhādapi durlabhaḥ |
sādhunā saha vicchedo maraṇādapi duḥsahaḥ || 7 ||
tato’pi bandhuvicchedo mahāśokaprado mataḥ |
tato’patyaviyogo’pi maraṇādatiricyate || 8 ||
tasmādapi ca sarvasmāt pativicchedajaṃ mahat |
kaṣṭaṃ tu saṃkaṭaṃ ghoraṃ nāsti kaṣṭaṃ tataḥ param || 9 ||
śayane bhojane snāne yāne svāpe ca jāgrati |
svāmivicchedajaṃ duḥkhaṃ nūtanaṃ vai dine dine || 1.201.10 ||
svāmisaṃyogamātreṇa sarvaduḥkhāni vismaret |
nānyat tādṛk prapaśyāmi yacca vismārayetpatim || 11 ||
sādhvīnāṃ kulajātānāṃ na bandhuḥ svāminā vinā |
etāsāṃ matsvasṝṇāṃ ca mamāpi svāminā vinā || 12||
kā gatirvai duḥkhadātrī bhaviṣyati patiṃ vinā |
he digīśāśca dikpālā he dharma he prajāpate || 13 ||
he śaṃbho he ramākānta patidānaṃ tu dehi me |
ityuktvā prāpa mūrchāṃ ca kanyā citrarathasya sā || 14||
punaśca cetanāṃ prāpya vilalāpa bhṛśaṃ muhuḥ |
anyāścātivilapantyaḥ sambodhya rurudurharim || 15||
he kṛṣṇa jagatāṃ nātha jagadrakṣaka īśvara |
abalāṃ nirbalāṃ kṛtvā kathaṃ mārayasi vṛthā || 1 6||
bhartā bhāryā vapuste’sti na kathaṃ rakṣyate tvayā |
karmaṇā ca patirlabdhaḥ karmaṇā ca viyojitaḥ || 17||
saṃyoge paramānando viyoge saṃkaṭaṃ mahat |
patiḥ putrastathā patnyo bāndhavāḥ karmaṇā sadā || 18 ||
svayaṃ tyaktāḥ sukhāyaiva duḥkhāya tyājitāḥ paraiḥ |
ataḥ santaḥ svayaṃ tyaktvā bhavanti sukhinaḥ sadā || 1 9||
vayaṃ nāryo na vai satyo jñānavatyo’pi naiva ca |
tasmāt kṛṣṇa varaṃ kāntaṃ punardehi prajīvaya || 1.201.20 ||
nedṛśaḥ sundaraḥ kāntaḥ kābhiścillabdha ātmavit |
rūpeṇa ca guṇenaiva tejasā vikrameṇa ca || 21 ||
jñānena śāntyā santuṣṭyā haritulyaḥ prabhurhi naḥ |
haribhakto harisamo gāṃbhīrye sāgaropamaḥ || 22 ||
dīptau sūryasamaḥ śuddhau vahnitulyaśca pāvanaḥ |
darśane candratulyaśca kāme kandarpasadṛśaḥ || 23 ||
buddhau bṛhaspatitulyaḥ kāvye kavisamastathā |
vāṇyāṃ sarasvatītulyaḥ pratibhāyāṃ bhṛguprathaḥ || 24||
dhane kuberasadṛśo dāne manurivāparaḥ |
dharme dharmasamo dharmī satye satyavrato’paraḥ || 25 ||
tapasi skandatulyaḥ sadācāre brāhmaṇopamaḥ |
aiśvarye śakratulyaśca kṣamāyāṃ bhūmisadṛśaḥ || 26||
evaṃbhūte mṛte kānte prāṇā yānti na naḥ katham |
are surā yajñabhājo ghṛtaṃ bhoktuṃ kṣamāḥ katham || 27 ||
nārāyaṇa jagatkānta śīghraṃ jīvaya naḥ patim |
prajāpate mahādeva dharmadeva yameśvara || 28 ||
jīvayata svāminaṃ no nirdayāḥ syāta vai katham |
jīvayatānyathā yuṣmān praśapsyāmaśca mā ciram ||29 ||
tadā brahmādayaḥ sarve glāniṃ jagmurbhayāt khalu |
imā devānpraśapsyanti nāśaṃ yāsyanti devatāḥ || 1.201.30 ||
aho pativratātejaḥ sarveṣāṃ tejasāṃ param |
kimatra pratikartavyaṃ vicārayanti devatāḥ || 31 ||
etasminnantare’kasmādvāgbabhūvāśarīriṇī |

yogāsanaṃ kurvatī ca śavaṃ kṛtvā svavakṣasi |
devā jagmuśca kauśikītīraṃ yatra pativratā || 33 ||

ruroda kāntaṃ saṃsthāpya devānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ bahu || 34||
etasminnantare tatra viprabālakaveṣadhṛk |
ājagāma svayaṃ viṣṇurbibhrattilakamujjvalam || 35 ||
prāha mālāvatīṃ devāḥ kathamatra samāgatāḥ |
brahmā śaṃbhuśca dharmaśca raviścandro hutāśanaḥ || 36 ||
kālo yamaśca deveśāḥ keyaṃ śavavatī satī |
śrutvā mālāvatī natvā tamuvāca vicakṣaṇam || 37 ||
upabarhaṇabhāryāhaṃ nāmnā mālāvatī satī |
imāścānyāḥ svasāro me śavo’yaṃ svāmino’sti naḥ || 38 ||
divyaṃ dvilakṣaṃ varṣāṇāṃ krīḍitāḥ svāminā vayam |

akasmād brahmaṇaḥ śāpāt prāṇām̐statyāja naḥ patiḥ |
devānuddiśya vilape yathā jīvetpatirhi naḥ ||1.201.4 0 ||
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhayaṃ śokaḥ santāpo bhadramutsavaḥ |
aiśvaryaṃ paramānando janma mṛtyuśca mokṣaṇam ||4 1 ||
eteṣāṃ janakā devāḥ karmaphalapradāyakāḥ |
mūlacchedakarāste ca mūlāṃkurapradāśca te ||42 ||
nahi devāt paro bandhurna devādrakṣako’paraḥ |
dayāvānduḥkhahartā ca na devādvidyate paraḥ || 43 ||
sarvāndevānahaṃ yāce patidānaṃ mamepsitam |
yadi dāsyanti kāntaṃ me bhadraṃ sarvavidhaṃ bhavet || 44||
anyathā tām̐stu śapsyāmi dāruṇaṃ durnivārakam |
śrutvaitadviṣṇuravyagraḥ prāha mālāvatīṃ tadā ||45 ||
karmaṇāṃ phaladātāro devāḥ satyaṃ hi mālike |

dṛṣṭastatra yamaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ krūrasvarūpakaḥ||
dṛṣṭvā mālāvatī pūrvaṃ papraccha dharmaśāsakam ||8 1 ||
dharmarāja hyakāle tvaṃ kāntaṃ harasi me katham |
yamaḥ prāhāprāptakālo na kaścin mriyate bhuvi ||82||
īśvarājñāṃ vinā sādhvi nānṛtaṃ cālayāmyaham |
ahaṃ kālo mṛtyukanyā vyādhayaśceśakiṃkarāḥ ||8 3 ||
niṣekeṇa yathābhāgyaṃ kālayāmaśca dehinam |
mṛtyukanyāpi saṃprāha mālike śṛṇu sādaram ||84||
purā viśvasṛjā sṛṣṭāpyahamevātra karmaṇi |
na ca kṣamā parityaktuṃ prāptamṛtyuṃ tu dehinam || 85||
satī ca bhasmasātkartuṃ kṣamā yadi bhavet bhave |
tadāhaṃ bhasmitā naiva mārayiṣyāmi dehinaḥ ||86 ||
kālena preritāhaṃ ca matputrā vyādhayastathā |
kurmo kāryaṃ yathādiṣṭaṃ na doṣo no’tra kaścana ||87||
mālāvatī tadā kālaṃ prāha nārāyaṇāṃśajam |
kathaṃ harasi matkāntaṃ jīvitāyāṃ mayi prabho || 88 ||
kālaḥ prāha śṛṇu mālāvati sarvaṃ harikṛtam |
ko vāhaṃ ko yamaḥ kā ca mṛtyukanyā tathādhayaḥ ||8 9 ||
vayaṃ bhramāmaḥ satataṃ kṛṣṇājñāparipālakāḥ |
yasya sṛjyā vayaṃ sarve māyā brahmādayastathā || 1.201.90 ||
vairājā ṛṣayo devā mānavāḥ sarvajantavaḥ |
yadbhayādvāti vātaśca sūryastapati yadbhayāt || 91 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca sṛṣṭṛpālakahārakāḥ |
yadbhayācca karmasākṣī yamo dharmaśca vartate || 92 ||
rāśayaśca grahāścaiva bhramanti yadbhayāt kramāt |
digīśāśca diśāṃpālā yasyājñāṃ saṃvahantyapi || 93 ||
ṛtavo yadbhayādvṛkṣādiṣu caranti puṣpadāḥ |
jaladāśca pravarṣanti pṛthvī ca vasudā tathā || 94||
sarvādhārā kṣamāyuktā sarvān rakṣati mātṛvat |
māyā sarvaprasūryasya bhayādāpūrikā matā || 95 ||
yasyāntaṃ na viduḥ sarve yaḥ sarvajño’sti hṛdgataḥ |
ṣoḍaśāṃśo’smi tasyāhaṃ kālaḥ sa kālakālakṛt || 96 ||
tatastaṃ mṛtyumṛtyuṃ cābhīṣṭadaṃ cintayācyutam |
so’yaṃ kṛpānidhiḥ kṛṣṇo bhartāraṃ te pradāsyati || 97 ||
vayaṃ yatpreritāḥ sarve sa dātā sarvasampadām |
ityuktvā virarāmāsau kālaḥ prāha haristu tām || 98 ||
dṛṣṭaḥ kālo yamo dṛṣṭo mṛtyukanyā tathādhayaḥ |
śīghraṃ sati tvayā dṛṣṭāḥ praccha kiṃ te manogatam || 99 ||
mālāvatyāha durvāro yathā vyādhirna saṃcaret |
tadupāyaṃ tu sakalaṃ bhavān vaktumihārhati || 1.201.100 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne upabarhaṇagandharvātmakanāradamṛtyuḥ patnīnāṃ vilāpaḥ brahmādibhyaḥ patijīvanābhyarthanāceti nirūṇanāmaikādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 201 ||

<1.202>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
mālāvatyā vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavān bhūtabhāvanaḥ |
prāha mālāvatīṃ māle śṛṇu vacmi yathātatham || 1 ||
sarvavyādhipraśamanaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
sa īśaścaturo vedān sasṛje maṃgalāyanān || 2 ||
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyān dṛṣṭvā vedān prajāpatiḥ |
vicintya teṣāmarthaṃ caivāyurvedaṃ cakāra saḥ || 3 ||
kṛtvā taṃ paṃcamaṃ vedaṃ bhāskarāya dadau prabhuḥ |
cakāra bhāskarastarhi svayaṃ bhāskarasaṃhitām || 4 ||
bhāskarastu svaśiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau tāṃ tataśca te |
cakruśca saṃhitāścānyā vyādhicikitsakakriyāḥ || |9 ||
cikitsātattvavijñānaṃ dhanvantariścakāra ha |
ghanvantarirdivodāsaḥ kāśīrājo’śvinīsutau || 6 ||
nakulaḥ sahadevo’rkiścyavano janako budhaḥ |
jābālo jājaliḥ pailaḥ karatho’gastya ityapi ||| 7 ||
ete cikitsakāḥ sarve ṣoḍaśa vyādhināśakāḥ |
svasvadehacikitsāyāṃ sva eva tu gururbhavet || 8 ||
tadā rogā na cāyānti naśyanti ca samāgatāḥ |
śṛṇu svāsthya yathārakṣyaṃ sāvadhānatayā sati || 9 ||
cakṣurjalaṃ ca vyāyāmaḥ pādādhastailamardanam |
karṇayormūrdhni tailaṃ ca jarāvyādhivināśanam || 1.202.10 ||
vasante bhramaṇaṃ vahnisevāṃ svalpāṃ karoti yaḥ |
bālāṃ ca sevate kāle jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 11 ||
prātaḥ śītodakasnānaṃ sevate candanadravam |
nidāghe pavanaṃ yaśca nopayāti jarā tu tam || 12 ||
prāvṛṣyuṣṇodakasnānaṃ ghanatoyaṃ na sevate |
āhāraṃ samaye pathyaṃ jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 13 ||
atiśaityaṃ na sahate hemante khātajāplavaḥ |
bhuṃkte navānnamuṣṇaṃ ca jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 14||
sadyomāṃsaṃ navānnaṃ ca bālāstrīṃ kṣīrabhojanam |
ghṛtaṃ ca sevate yo hi jarā taṃ nopagacchati || 15 ||
bhuṃkte sadannaṃ kṣutkāle tṛṣāyāṃ pīyate jalam |
nityaṃ bhuṃkte ca tāmbūlaṃ navanītaṃ tathā guḍam || 16 ||
dadhiṃ haiyaṃgavīnaṃ ca taṃ jarā nopagacchati |
nityaṃ vyāyāmakartṛṇāṃ jarā dūraṃ palāyate || 17 ||
vṛddhastriyaṃ śuṣkamāṃsaṃ bālārkaṃ taruṇaṃ dadhi |
saṃsevantaṃ jarā yāti prahṛṣṭā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha || 18 ||
mṛtyukanyāsutāścatuḥṣaṣṭiḥ rujaḥ sutā jarā |
jarā ca bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ śaśvad bhramati bhūtale || 19 ||
rātrau ye dadhi sevante vṛddhāṃ nārīṃ rajasvalām |
bahuvyavāyakartārastān jarā grasate drutam || 1.202.20 ||
kṣudhi jājvalyamānāyāmāhāro labhyate nahi |
prāṇināṃ jāyate pittaṃ cakre ca maṇipūrake || 21 ||
tālabilvaphalaṃ bhuktvā jalapānaṃ ca tatkṣaṇam |
tadeva tu bhavet pittaṃ sadyaḥ prāṇaharaṃ param || 22||
taptodakaṃ ca śirasi bhādre tiktaṃ bhunakti yaḥ |
apathye ca punarbhuṃkte pittaṃ tasya prajāyate ||23 ||
saśarkaraṃ tu dhānyākaṃ piṣṭaṃ śītodakānvitam |
caṇakaṃ sarvagavyaṃ ca dadhitakravivarjitam || 24||
bilvatālaphalaṃ pakvaṃ sarvabhaikṣavamityapi |
ārdrakaṃ mudgayūṣaṃ ca tilapiṣṭaṃ saśarkaram || 25||
pittakṣayakaraṃ sadyo balapuṣṭipradaṃ param |
bhojanānantaraṃ snānaṃ jalapānaṃ vinātṛṣām || 26||
paryuṣitānnaṃ takraṃ ca pakvaṃ raṃbhāphalaṃ dadhi |
meghāmbuśarkarātoyaṃ āvilavārisecanam || 27||
nārikelodakaṃ mūlakaṃ tathā karkaṭīphalam |
khātasnānaṃ ca varṣāsu sarvaṃ tacchle’ṣakārakam || 28 ||
brahmarandhre ca tajjanma mahadvīryavināśanam |
marīcaṃ pippalī śuṣkamārdrakaṃ jīvakaṃ madhu || 29||
vahniseveti vastūni sadyaḥ śleṣmaharāṇi hi |
balapuṣṭikarāṇyeva roganāśakarāṇi ca || 1.202.30 ||
tvatkāntaḥ kena doṣeṇa mṛtaḥ kathaya śobhane |
śrutvā mālāvatī prāha mṛto yogena me patiḥ || 31 ||
adhunā prāṇakāntaṃ me dehi dehi janārdana |
natvā vaḥ svāminā sārdhaṃ yāsyāmaḥ svagṛhaṃ striyaḥ || 32 ||
śrutvā janārdanaḥ śīghraṃ yayau vai devasaṃsadam |
prāhopabarhaṇabhāryā kanyā citrarathasya ca || 3ā ||
yayāce jīvadānaṃ svasvāminaḥ svasṛbhiḥ saha |
śaptukāmā surānsarvān śāntyarthaṃ bodhitā mayā || 3 4||
anuṣṭhānamadhunā ki tvasya kāryasya niścitam |
brahmā prāha tadā viṣṇuṃ nāradaścopabarhaṇaḥ || 35||
prāṇān yogena tatyāja punaḥ śāpānmamaiva tu |
kālaṃ lakṣayugaṃ vyāpya sthitistvasya mahītale || 36||
śūdrayoniṃ tataḥ prāpya bhavitā matsutaḥ punaḥ |
asya kālāvaśeṣasya kiṃcidasti pareśvara || 37||
tattu varṣasahasraṃ caivāyurasyāsti sāmpratam |
dāsyāmi jīvadānaṃ ca svayaṃ viṣṇoḥ prasādataḥ ||38 ||
yathaitānna bhavecchāpastatkariṣyāmi niścitam |
viṣiśca vyāptivacano nuśca sarvatravācakaḥ || 3 9||
sarvavyāpī sa vai viṣṇurjīvadānaṃ karotu vai |
ityuktvā ca prayayuste yatra mālāvatī vadhūḥ ||1.202.4 0 ||
brahmā kamaṇḍaluvāri dadau gātre śavasya ca |
sañcāraṃ manasastasya cakāra sundaraṃ vapuḥ ||41 ||
śivo jñānaṃ dadau tasmai dharmo dharmaṃ dadau tataḥ |
jāṭharaṃ ca dadau vahniḥ prāṇaṃ dadau tadānilaḥ |||42||
sūryo dṛṣṭiṃ dadau tasmai vāṇī vākyaṃ dadau tadā |
lakṣmīrdadau ca saundaryaṃ kriyāṃ dadau śacīpatiḥ ||43||
śavastathāpi nottasthau jīvaṃ viṣṇurdadau tadā |
viśiṣṭabodhanaṃ prāpa nottasthau sākṣiṇaṃ vinā ||44||
tadā mālābatī śokaṃ prāptā nanāma mādhavam |
tvāṃ vinā me patirnāsti patirūpastvameva me ||45||
prāṇarūpaḥ prāṇināṃ tvaṃ samujjīvaya me patim |
hariḥ svaśaktibhistatra tvadhiṣṭhānaṃ cakāra vai ||46||
tāvadutthāya gandharvo vīṇāṃ dhṛtvā ca vāsasī |
devasaṃghaṃ praṇanāma viṣṇuṃ ca purataḥ sthitam || 47||
nedurdundubhayastatra puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūttadā |
sarve devāśca dampatyoḥ pradaduḥ paramāśiṣaḥ ||48||
upabarhaṇanāmāsau nanarta ca jagau tadā |
jīvitaṃ purataḥ prāpa devānāṃ vai prasādataḥ ||49||
jagāma sārdhaṃ palībhirgandharvanagaraṃ punaḥ |
ratnakoṭiṃ tadā rājñyo dhanāni niyutaṃ gavām ||1.202.50||
pradadurbrāhmaṇebhyo bhojayāmāsuśca tānbahūn |
mahotsavaṃ ca vividhaṃ kārayāmāsurādarāt ||51||
cakruśca vividhānveṣān svāsāṃ ca svāminaḥ kṛte |
bhartuścakruśca śuśrūṣāṃ pūjāṃ ca samayocitām ||52||
tena sārdhaṃ surucirā remire suciraṃ ca tāḥ |
yena mantreṇa tāḥ sarvā gandharvaṃ lebhire patim ||53||
vaśiṣṭhena pradattena mantraṃ taṃ ṣoḍaśākṣaram |
stotraṃ ca kavacaṃ tadvai śṛṇu tvaṃ kamaleśvari ||54||
oṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśāya svāhā |
imaṃ mantraṃ kalpavṛkṣaṃ jānāhi ṣoḍaśākṣaram || 55||
goloke kṛṣṇa īśāya dattavān ca tataḥ param |
brahmaṇe tu purā kṛṣṇaḥ puṣkare dattavām̐stathā ||56 ||
kumārāya dattavām̐śca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ |
brahmāṇḍapāvanasyāsya kavacasya hariḥ svayam ||57||
ṛṣiśchandaśca gāyatrī devo’haṃ bhagavānhariḥ |
dhamārthakāmamokṣeṣu viniyogaḥ sadā mataḥ ||58||
trilakṣavārajapanāt sarvasiddhiprado bhavet |
praṇavo me śiraḥ pātu namo rāmeśvarāya ca ||59||
bhālaṃ pāyānnetrayugmaṃ namo rādheśvarāya ca |
kṛṣṇaḥ pāyācchrotrayugmamaṃ śrīharirghrāṇamityapi ||1.202.60 ||
jihvikāṃ vahnijāyā tu kṛṣṇāya sarvato namaḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti ca kāṣṭhaṃ pātu ṣaḍakṣaraḥ ||6 1 ||
hrīṃ kṛṣṇāya namo vaktraṃ klīṃ pūrvaśca bhujadvayam |
namo gopāṃganeśāya skandhāvaṣṭākṣaro’vatu ||6 2||
dantapaṃktimoṣṭhayugmaṃ namo gopīśvarāya ca |
oṃ namo bhagavate rāsamaṇḍaleśāya svāhā || 63 ||
harirvakṣaḥsthalaṃ pātu mantrātmā ṣoḍaśākṣaraḥ |
śrīkṛṣṇāya svāheti oṃ karṇayugmaṃ sadāvatu || 64|||
oṃ viṣṇave svāheti ca kapolaṃ sarvato’vatu |
oṃ haraye nama iti pṛṣṭhaṃ pādau sadāvatu ||65||
oṃ govardhanadhāriṇe svāhā sarvaśarīrakam |
prācyāṃ māṃ pātu śrīkṛṣṇa āgneyyāṃ pātu mādhavaḥ ||66 ||
dakṣiṇe pātu gopīśo nairṛtyāṃ nandanandanaḥ |
vāruṇyāṃ pātu govindo vāyavyāṃ rādhikeśvaraḥ ||67||
uttare pātu rāseśa aiśānyāmacyutaḥ svayam |
satataṃ sarvataḥ pātu harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam ||68||
gurumabhyarcya vidhivad vastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ |
snātvā taṃ ca namaskṛtya kavacaṃ dhārayet sudhīḥ ||69||
kavacasya prasādena jīvanmukto bhavennaraḥ |
yadi syāt siddhakavaco viṣṇureva bhavet priye ||1.202.7 0 ||
asya pāṭhāt mahatpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ bhavet |
aputro labhate putram abhāryo labhate satīm ||7 1 ||
vidyārthī labhate vidyāṃ dhanārthī dhanamāpnuyāt |
bhraṣṭarājyo labhedrājyamaiśvaryaṃ siddhikāmanaḥ |||72||
rogārto mucyate rogād baddho mucyeta bandhanāt |
bhaktiṃ prāpya hareścānte labhate dhāma cākṣaram ||73||
iha loke sukhaṃ bhuktvā kṛtvā kīrtiṃ sudurlabhām |
pārṣadapravaro bhūtvā golokaṃ dhāma yāti ca ||74||
evaṃ gandharvapravaraḥ upabarhaṇasaṃjñakaḥ |
reme kālāvaśeṣaṃ ca tābhiḥ patnībhirādarāt ||75||
nānāvidhān kratuvarān cakāra ca sutaiḥ saha |
atha kāle brahmaśāpāt prāṇān tyaktvopabarhaṇaḥ ||76||
sa jajñe vṛṣalīgarbhe brahmabījena śāpataḥ |
mālāvatī vahnikuṇḍe prāṇām̐statyāja vai satī ||77||

manuvaṃśaprajātasya nṛpasya saṃjayasya sā ||78||
patnyāṃ jātismarā jajñe patirme bhaviteti saḥ |
upabarhaṇagandharvapramadāhaṃ sadābhavam ||79||
kānyakubje ca deśe vai drumilo nāma rājakaḥ |
tasya kalāvatī patnī vandhyā cāpi pativratā ||1.202.80||
svāmidoṣeṇa sā vandhyā ṛtau bhartuḥ samājñayā |
upatasthe vane ghore nāradaṃ kāśyapaṃ munim ||8 1||
yo vai dakṣasya śāpena kaśyapasya suto’bhavat |
taṃ ca kaśyapaputraṃ vai dvitīyaṃ nāradaṃ yayau ||82||
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhyāyamānaṃ ca jvalantaṃ brahmatejasā |
tasthau suveṣaṃ kṛtvā sā dhyānānte ca muneḥ puraḥ ||83||
dadarśa nāradaścāgre sundarīṃ sthirayauvanām |
svarṇavarṇāṃ svarṇabhūṣāṃ candrāsyāṃ kaṃjalocanām ||84||
putrecchayā ca samprāptāṃ kāmaśṛṃgāraśobhitām |

kalāvatī hariṃ smṛtvā tadā provāca nāradam |
drumilasyāsmi bhāryāhaṃ gopikā bharturājñayā ||86||

tejīyasāṃ na doṣāya vahneḥ sarvabhujo yathā |

adhikāravihīnaḥ syāt śūdryāṃ gacchati vai dvijaḥ || 1.202.90||
tadiṣṭadevo gṛhṇāti naivedyaṃ na tajjalam |
sa vipro śūdrayonau ca gṛhṇāti janma tatphalam ||9 1 ||
tvayoktaṃ na ca doṣāya tejīyasāmṛtaṃ ca tat |
dūrād dadāmi te bījaṃ gṛhāṇa śaktirasti cet |||92||
garbhe dhāraya sāmarthyāt tadā doṣo na vidyate |

ityuktā sā śūdrapatnī pātivratyaparāyaṇā |

sarjapatrastare tatra munervīryaṃ papāta ha |
drāgeva śūdrī jagrāha pītvā garbhe rarakṣa sā ||97||
muniṃ praṇamya prahṛṣṭā saṃgaṃ vinārthasādhikā |

gatvā bhartuḥ sannidhau sā vṛttāntaṃ prāha sarvathā |
drumilo’pi prasanno’bhūt prāha kāntāṃ sukhāvaham ||99||
nāradasya vaiṣṇavasya tvadgarbhe vīryameva yat |
vaiṣṇavo bhavitā bālo nāradāṃśaḥ sa eva saḥ || 1.202.10 0||
yadgarbhe vaiṣṇavo jāto yasya vīryeṇa vā sati |
tayoryāti ca vaikuṇṭhaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam || 10 1||
tau ca viṣṇuvimānena divyena ratnaśobhinā |
yātārau vaikuṇṭhapuraṃ janmamṛtyujarāharam || 1 02||
ityuktvā goparājaḥ saḥ snātvā kṛtvā ca tarpaṇam |

gajāśvarathagohaṃsadāsadāsīsahasrakam |
pātrabhūṣāmbararatnaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo dadau mudā || 104||
patnīṃ putrānvitagarbhāṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṃ hṛdi smaran |
vaṃśatantuṃ śubhaṃ jñātvā vairāgyamagamat tataḥ || 1 05||
jagāma badarīkṣetraṃ prāṇān tatyāja yogataḥ |
vimānena harerdūtairvaikuṇṭhaṃ sa jagāma ha || 1 06||
tatra prāpa harerdāsyaṃ haridāso babhūva saḥ |
brāhmaṇaiḥ rakṣitā devī kalāvatī samāntare || 107||

<1.203>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
brahmā ca prerayāmāsa sṛṣṭiṃ kartuṃ ca nāradam |
sarveṣāmapi vandyānāṃ janakaḥ paramo guruḥ || 1 ||
vidyāgururmantragururdvau śreṣṭhau pitrapekṣayā |
tavāhaṃ janmadātā ca vidyādātā ca mantradaḥ || 2 ||
mamājñayā ca matprītyā kurupatnīparigraham |
gurorājñākaraḥ śiṣyaḥ putraḥ santārayet pitṝn || 3 ||
kṣemaṃ ca labhate nityaṃ śāśvataṃ laukikaṃ tathā |
saḥ paṇḍitaḥ sa ca jñānī kṣemī ca puṇyavānsa ca || 4 ||
medhāvī vinayī bhāgyaśālī svargādhikāravān |
gurorvacaskaro yaḥ syāt kṣemaṃ tasya pade pade || 5 ||
sarvāśramāśrayadātā gṛhyāśramo hi puṇyavān |
putrapautrakalatrāḍhyaṃ bhavanaṃ tapasaḥ phalam || 6 ||
pitaraḥ parvakāle ca pūjākāle tu devatāḥ |
bhikṣākāle ca munayaḥ samāyānti gṛhigṛham || 7 ||
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāryamarjayanti gṛhāśramāḥ |
bhuktvā sarvaṃ sukhaṃ tvatra yānti svargaṃ mahatsukham || 8 ||
gṛhastho dhanavān kīrtidharmānandādimān sukhī |
jīvanmukto mṛte’mutra mukta eva na saṃśayaḥ || 9 ||
mṛtasyāpi yaśodeho vartata sa ca jīvati |
jīvato’pi yaśodeho nāsti mṛtaḥ sa vai sadā || 1.203.1 0||
vidyā labhyā tathā kīrtirlabhyā bhaktiśca mādhave |
dārā labhyāḥ śubhā lakṣmīḥ svargaṃ labhyaṃ sutādibhiḥ || 11 ||
puṇyaṃ labhyaṃ tathārogyaṃ labhyaṃ vai śāśvataṃ sukham |
aihikaṃ ca tathā pāralaukikaṃ labhyamuttamam || 12 ||
kāryaṃ bhogyaṃ gṛhirītyāsaṃgena yativat sadā |
sadā vai bandhanaṃ nāstītyāha nārāyaṇo hi mām || 13 ||

na me’stīṣṭasādhanatvamaniṣṭānanubandhitā || 14||

yaḥ śrīnārāyaṇabhaktiṃ bodhayetkāraye dṛḍhām || 1 7||

gatvā namāma tuṣṭāva tritantrīṃ kvaṇayan jagau ||1.203.80||
dadau ca śaṃkarastasmai cāsanaṃ yogyamarhaṇam |
papracchāgamasaddhyeyaṃ cātithyaṃ pracakāra ca ||8 1 ||
munirnivedanaṃ cakre mantrārthāgamanādikam |
śrutvā śaṃbhuḥ prasanno’bhūtprāha nāradamomiti ||82||
haristotraṃ ca kavacaṃ mantraṃ śrīharaye namaḥ |
dhyānaṃ jñānaṃ nāradāya dadau samyaṅmaheśvaraḥ ||83 ||
nāradaḥ prāha deveśaṃ cāhnikaṃ me vad prabho |
śaṃbhurbrāhmaṇadharmāṃśca kathayāmāsa taṃ tataḥ ||84||
saṃkṣepeṇa sadācārān ihāmutra sukhapradān |
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca te sarvān kathayāmi sanātanān ||85||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne brahmaṇā nāradāya sṛṣṭyarthamupadiṣṭam nāradena jñānadvārā tadaṃgīkṛtaṃ vaiṣṇavagurumantrārthaṃ kailāsagamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā tryadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 20 3||

<1.204>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śaṃbhuḥ prāha ca devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ śṛṇu cāhnikam |
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya guruṃ bhāle vicintayet || 1 ||
brahmarandhre hariṃ dhyāyeddhṛdaye kṛṣṇamarcayet |
prasannavadanaṃ śāntaṃ projjvalaṃ ca manoharam || 2 ||
guruṇā dīyate devo mantraḥ pūjā vidhirjapaḥ |
guruṇā pūyate śiṣyastasmāddevātparo guruḥ || 3 ||
gururbrahmā gururviṣṇurgururdevo maheśvaraḥ |
guruḥ prakṛtirīśādyā guruścandro’nalo raviḥ || 4 ||
gururvāyuśca varuṇo gururmātā pitā suhṛt |
gurureva paraṃbrahma nāsti pūjyo guroḥ paraḥ || 5 ||
abhīṣṭadeve ruṣṭe ca samartho rakṣaṇe guruḥ |
na samarthā gurau ruṣṭe rakṣaṇe sarvadevatāḥ || 6 ||
yasya tuṣṭo guruḥ sākṣājjayastasya pade pade |
yasya ruṣṭo gurustasya vināśaḥ sarvaśo mataḥ || 7 ||
asaṃpūjya guruṃ devaṃ kevalaṃ yaśca pūjayet |
duritaṃ gurvasevotthaṃ na nāśayati devatā || 8 ||
devāpūjanajaṃ pāpaṃ guruḥ śakto vyapohitum |
tasmādabhīṣṭadevācca guruḥ pūjyatamo mataḥ || 9 ||
guruṃ hariṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca dhyātvā smṛtvā sato janān |
malamūtratyajanāya gacchet tadyogyabhūmikām || 1.204.1 0|| 
jaladevālayavṛkṣavartmagoṣṭhaśubhasthalam |
gṛhavahnicatuṣkārdrasasyavalmīkakandaram || 11 || 
udyānadarbhaphaladruśmaśānakrīḍanasthalam |
evamādyasthalaṃ hitvā tyājyaṃ malādikaṃ sadā || 1 2||
ekāṃ liṃge mṛdaṃ dadyād vāmahaste catuṣṭayam |
ubhayorhastayodvai tu mūtraśaucaṃ prakīrtitam || 13|||
maithunānantaraṃ śaucaṃ dviguṇitaṃ samācaret |
ekā liṃge gude tisrastathā vāmakare daśa || 14||
ubhayoḥ sapta dātavyā pādayostrirviśuddhyati |
purīṣaśaucaṃ sarveṣāṃ sāmānya caitadeva hi || 15||
gandhalepakṣayakaraṃ vastunā payasā mṛdā |
kṛtaṃ śaucaṃ hi śaucaṃ tadanyathāśaucameva vai || 16||
aśuddhāṃ jantusampannāṃ marditāṃ varjayenmṛdam |
kṛtvā śaucaṃ tato vārbhiḥ svasya prakṣālayenmukham || 17||
dantakāṣṭhena dantāṃśca vāriṇā ca pramārjayet |
sakṣīraṃ sakaṇṭakaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ dantapraśodhakam || 18||
aṣṭāṃgulottara grāhyaṃ jihvollekhyārdhacīrayā |
jalasnānaṃ prakurvīta smṛtvā devaṃ guru harim || 1 9||
raviṃ viṣṇuṃ haraṃ lakṣmīṃ satīṃ brahmādikānsurān |
nadyāṃ nade taḍāge vā tīrthe vāpyāṃ samudrake ||1.204.20 ||
kṛtvā saṃkalpamevādyaṃ mṛdaṃ gātre vilepayet |
aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare |||2 1||
mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam |
uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā |||2||
āruhya mama gātrāṇi sarvaṃ pāpa pramocaya |
puṇyaṃ dehi mahābhāge snānānujñāṃ kuruṣva mām ||23||
gaṃge ca yamune caiva godāvari sarasvati |
sindho narmade kāveri jale’smin sannidhiṃ kuru ||24||
nalinī nandinī sītā mālinī pārvatī prabhā |
viṣṇupādābjasaṃbhūtā gaṃgā māṇakī gaṇḍakī ||25 ||
padmāvatī bhogavatī svarṇarekhā ca kauśikī |
dakṣā pṛthvī ca śubhagā viśvakāyā śivāmṛtā ||26||
vidyādharī suprasannā tathā lokaprasādhinī |
kṣemā ca kaṃbharā śāntā śāntidā gomatī satī ||27||
sāvitrī tulasī durgā mahālakṣmīḥ sarasvatī |
kṛṣṇāprāṇādhikā rādhā lopāmudrā ratirditiḥ |||28||
ahalyā cāditiḥ saṃjñā svadhā svāhāpyarundhatī |
śatarūpā devahūtirityādyāḥ saṃsmaretsudhīḥ ||29||
snātvā jalena saṃdhṛtvā yogye dhautre ca vāsasī |
jalena candanenāpi kuryāttu tilakaṃ budhaḥ ||1.204.30 ||
bāhvormūle lalāṭe ca kaṇṭhadeśe ca vakṣasi |
tanmadhye candrakaṃ kuryāt kauṃkumaṃ vartulaṃ śubham ||3 1||
ācamya cāsane sthitvā tataḥ sandhyāṃ samācaret |
tataḥ pūjāṃ tu devānāṃ kuryācchoḍaśasādhanaiḥ ||32||
śālagrāme maṇau mantre pratimāyāṃ jale sthale |
gopṛṣṭhe ca gurau vipre praśasta tvarcanaṃ hareḥ || 33||
āsanaṃ vasanaṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyakam |
puṣpaṃ ca candanaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyamuttamam || 34 ||
sugandhatailaṃ bhūṣāśca tāmbūlaṃ ca jalaṃ phalam |
arārtrikādikaṃ deyaṃ ṣoḍaśātmaprapūjanam || 35 ||
snānaṃ paṃcāmṛtaiścāthābhiṣekasnānamapyatha |
vastrāṇi candanādīni puṣpāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca || 36 ||
āsanaṃ ca pradīpaśca dhūpo nevedyamityapi |
jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ cārārtrikaṃ pradakṣiṇam || 37||
sastotranamanaṃ puṣpāṃjaliścaite’pi ṣoḍaśa |
upacārā hareḥ pūjākārye’rpyā bhāvataḥ sadā || 38 ||
ādau kṛtvā bhūtaśuddhiṃ prāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ param |
aṃgapratyaṃgayornyāsaṃ mantranyāsaṃ tataḥ param || 39 ||
varṇanyāsaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā cārghyapātraṃ vinirdiśet |
trikoṇamaṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā tatra kūrmaṃ prapūjayet ||1.204.40 ||
jalenāpūrya śaṃkhaṃ ca kūrme saṃsthāpayettathā |
jale tīrthāvāhanaṃ ca kṛtvā vastūni mārjayet ||4 1 ||
ghaṇṭāṃ ca pūjayecchaṃkhaṃ pūjayetkalaśaṃ tathā |
śālagrāmaṃ pūjayecca tatau vai pūjayeddharim || 42 ||
ṣoḍaśopakaraṇaiḥ saṃpūjya devān visarjayet |
devayajñaṃ tathā śrāddhaṃ kuryādvittānusārataḥ ||42 ||
atithipūjane bhūtayajñaṃ kuryāśca śaktitaḥ |
vṛddhānvandeta sūryādīnnamaskuryācca sarvadā || 44||
poṣyām̐śca bhojayitvā vai gṛhī bhuñjyāttu nityaśaḥ |
haviṣyānnaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ praśastaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ sadā ||45 || 
nārāyaṇocchiṣṭamiṣṭamabhakṣyamaniveditam |
nityaṃ naivedyabhojī yaḥ śrīviṣṇoḥ sa hi vaiṣṇavaḥ ||46 ||
annaṃ jalaṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ patraṃ śrīharaye’rpitam |
bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ tadanyattvapeyaṃ cābhakṣyamityatha || 47 ||
jātiduṣṭaṃ rūpaduṣṭamākṛtiduṣṭameva yat |
guṇaduṣṭaṃ pariṇāmaduṣṭaṃ na bhakṣyameva tat || 48 ||
vrateṣvannaṃ na vai bhakṣyaṃ na bhakṣyaṃ prāk prapūjanāt |
ahiṃsāsatyamasteye brahmacaryāparigrahau || 49 ||
yamā hyete rakṣaṇīyāḥ sukhadā mokṣadā api |
śaucaṃ tuṣṭistapaḥ pāṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapūjā ca mokṣadāḥ ||1.204.5 0 ||
nindanaṃ naiva kartavyaṃ kvacitkasyāpi kenacit |
parapīḍākaraṃ satyaṃ na vācyaṃ duḥkhadaṃ hi tat ||5 1 ||
preraṇālakṣaṇo hyartho dharmo nānartha eva yaḥ |
kṛtaghnatā na kartavyā śāṭhyaṃ kāryaṃ na kutracit ||52 ||
vyavahāryaṃ yathānyāyaṃ copārjyaṃ dravyamityatha |
dhanadhānyajīvikāścodyamaḥ kāryo yathābalam ||53||
mithyābhiśaṃsanīyaṃ na parasvaṃ nāharet kvacit |
divase codyamaḥ kāryaḥ sāyaṃ sandhyājapādikam |||54|||
harermandiragamanaṃ stavanaṃ kīrtanādikam |
kṛtvā cāyavyayamantraṃ suptavyaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ ||55||
pramadāḥ sarvathā rakṣyāḥ santoṣṭavyāśca vastubhiḥ |
na codvegavatā bhāvyaṃ kleśaḥ kāryo na vai kvacit ||56||
ātmānātmavicārādi kartavyaṃ vai mumukṣubhiḥ |
paramātmā parabrahma sarvadehiṣvavasthitaḥ ||57||
sākṣī ca phaladātā ca vartate dehikarmaṇām |
pañcaprāṇāḥ svayaṃ viṣṇustarpitavyaḥ subhojanaiḥ ||468||
mano brahmā tarpitavyaścānandarañjanādibhiḥ |
indro rudraścendriyāṇāṃ tarpitavyaḥ sadarthakaiḥ ||59||
jñānarūpā tarpitavyā māyā tu śravaṇādibhiḥ |
ātmā sākṣī svayaṃbrahma tṛptavyaṃ yāvadarpaṇaiḥ ||1.204.60||
parabrahma harikṛṣṇaścetaneṣu sadā sthitaḥ |
tadadhīnāścetanā vai ātmāno bhinnakarmaṭhāḥ ||6 1||
karmaphalānvitā jīvā jaḍeṣu vṛttijīvinaḥ |
jaḍāḥ parārthāḥ pareṇa yujyante bhogyatāptaye ||62||
cetanāśca sadarthairvai yujyante bhogalabdhaye |
triguṇātmā jaḍā māyā mahattattvaṃ tato hyabhūt || 33 ||
ahaṃkārastato jātastasmādindriyadevatāḥ |
sūkṣmabhūtāni sūkṣmebhyaḥ sthūlabhūtāni niryayuḥ ||64||
teṣāṃ kalevaraṃ labdhaṃ cetanena svakarmabhiḥ |
jñānena karmaṇā nāśo vairāgyeṇāvibandhanam ||65||
dharmeṇāgragateḥ puṇya bhaktyā yānaṃ harergṛhe |
kartāpi naiva mantavyaḥ karoti bhagavān nanu ||66||
ātmā dehī na ca kartā kartā dhartā hariḥ svayam |
baddhā muktā svabhāvena prakṛtirna tu cetanaḥ ||67||
śarīraṃ bhūtasaṃghātairjāyate nātmano janiḥ |
śarīraṃ śīryate bhāvairna tvātmano viśīrṇatā ||68||
sajātīyaṃ sajātīyadehena bhujyate sadā |
śarīraṃ tu śarīreṇa bhujyate bhogavaddhi tat ||69||
sthūlaṃ bhogāśrayaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vividhaṃ rūpamāsthitam |
idaṃ labdhaṃ cānubhūtaṃ sukhyahaṃ ceti cāntare ||1.204.70||
ahaṃkārakṛte buddhitattve bhavati nātmani |
anyatra bhavati svasmin jānātyeṣo bhramo nanu ||7 1 ||
bhrama ityapi saṃsārastajjanyavāsanānvitaḥ |
bhramābhāve gṛhābhāvaḥ saṃsārābhāva eva vai || 72||
bhramasattve gṛhasattvaṃ gṛhiṇībhāvanā tathā |
kva gṛhaṃ kva gṛhiṇī ca vāsanā sarvamucyate || 73 ||
tadbhāve kva gṛhaṃ ca gṛhiṇī kva sutādayaḥ |
śarīraṃ cāpi nāstyeva kā kathā tatsuyoginām ||74||
tasmādātmā parabrahmabhakto’sti kiraṇaṃ hareḥ |
māyāguṇaiḥ rahito’sti na kālena sa lipyate ||75 ||
karmaṇāpi na lepo’sti svabhāvo nāsti tatra ca |
nirguṇasya cita ānandamūrterbandhanaṃ nu kim ||76||
prabhuḥ karoti sarvaṃ vai mantavyaṃ tvevameva hi |
vapate karṣuko bījaṃ jalaṃ siñcati karṣukaḥ || 77||
rakṣati karṣukaḥ khādyaṃ dadātyapi ca karṣukaḥ |
lunāti dhānyaṃ kṛṣikṛdbhakṣayatyapi karṣukaḥ ||78 ||
karoti sarvaṃ kṛṣikṛt sasyaṃ naiva karoti saḥ |
mahām̐stu karṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo bījamutpādayatyayam ||79||
bījaṃ tvavati garbhe saḥ dadāti janma mādhavaḥ |
bālye yauvane vārdhakye sa vai rakṣati keśavaḥ ||1.204.8 0 ||
annaṃ jalaṃ ca vastraṃ ca dadāti kṛṣṇa eva vai |
mṛtyuṃ prerayati kṛṣṇo layaṃ nayati mādhavaḥ ||8 1 ||
karoti sarvaṃ sākṣī śrīkṛṣṇo nāhaṃ karomi vai |
evaṃ sarvaṃ samarpyaṃ vai kṛṣṇe nirbandhanāya tat ||82||
upāsanā sadā kṛṣṇe hyārādhanāpi mādhave |
bhaktiḥ sevā ca yā kācit sarvaṃ vai kamalāpatau ||8 3 ||
samarpyaṃ sarvathā tadvai mokṣaṇaṃ cātra jīvataḥ |
sarvatra vyāpakaścāntaryāmī śrīpatirīśvaraḥ ||84||
sarvadivyaguṇairyukto goloke cākṣare pare |
vaikuṇṭhe śvetabhūmau ca badaryāṃ cāmṛte’mbare ||85||
kṛṣṇo harirnarāvāso nārāyaṇaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ |
rādhāpatiḥ prabhāsvāmī māṇikyādhipatiḥ sa hi ||86 ||
lakṣmīpatiḥ kambharāsatpatiḥ śrīharireva saḥ |
sītāpatiḥ satīsvāmī pārvatīpatireva saḥ ||87||
sarvapatiḥ svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ sākṛtiḥ sadā |
paro vyūho vibhavaścāntaryāmi mūrtireva saḥ ||88 ||
svarūpaśceti ṣaḍrūpo vartate bhagavān hariḥ |
nirākāraśca sākāro bhūmā sumūrtiko’pi san ||8 9 ||
adṛśyo’pi sudṛśyo’sti tādṛccakṣuryutaiḥ sa hi |
yogināṃ dhyānaviṣayo bhaktānāṃ premabandhanaḥ || 1.204.90 ||
nārīṇāṃ bhartṛviṣayo dīnānāṃ dīnatātmakaḥ |
dṛśyādṛśyo’pi divyena cakṣuṣā dṛśya eva saḥ ||91 ||
dhyāyante yogino nityaṃ taṃ vai kṛṣṇaṃ parātparam |
paramānandarūpaṃ ca sarvakāraṇakāraṇam ||92||
yathā mṛdā kulālo hi ghaṭaṃ nirmāti tattathā |
parabrahma prakṛtyā ca sṛṣṭiṃ nirmāti sarvathā ||93||
nityaṃ tatparamaṃ brahma nityā vai prakṛtirmatā |
tadbrahmaśaktiḥ prakṛtiḥ śarīraṃ bījarūpiṇī ||94||
prakṛtiśaktimadbrahma tejoyuktaṃ sadāsti vai |
yasya tejaśca tatrāsti sa vai paramapūruṣaḥ ||95||
kāraṇena vinā kāryaṃ kuto vā vartate katham |
tasya tejo mahatkāryaṃ na syādvai puruṣaṃ vinā ||96||
vaiṣṇavāḥ sarvathā tasya saumyaṃ rūpaṃ manoharam |
divyaṃ muktādisaṃsevyaṃ dhyāyante paramātmanaḥ ||97||
navīnanīradaśyāmaṃ kiśoravayasaṃ prabhum |
śaranmadhyāhnamārtaṇḍaprabhodbhāsisulocanam ||98||
śaratpārvaṇapūrṇendukoṭyadhikaprabhānanam |
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyalīlānanditamanmatham ||99||
puṣṭaṃ sarvāṃgasaundaryamādhuryapūritābharam |
sasmitaṃ mūralīhastaṃ pītāmbaradharaṃ harim || 1.204.1 00||
candanokṣitasarvāṃgaṃ kaustubhena virājitam |
ājānu mālatīmālāvanamālāvirājitam || 101 ||
tribhaṃgabhaṃgyā tiṣṭhantaṃ maṇiratnādibhūṣitam |
mayūrapicchacūḍaṃ ca hīrakamukuṭojjvalam || 10 2||
ratnakeyūravalayaratnamañjīrarājitam |
ratnakuṇḍalayugmena gaṇḍasthalasuśobhitam || 1 03||
muktābhadaśanaṃ pakvabimbauṣṭhaṃ śukanāsikam |
sthirayauvanayuktābhiḥ sasmitābhiśca sādaram || 104||
vīkṣitaṃ gopikābhiśca ramārādhājayādibhiḥ |
bhaktapriyaṃ bhaktanāthaṃ bhaktānugrahakārakam || 105||
rāseśvaraṃ surasikaṃ mahāmuktaiḥ susevitam |
akṣaraṃ paramaṃ brahma bhagavantaṃ sanātanam || 1 06||
evaṃrūpaṃ hariṃ lakṣmi cātra dhyāyanti vaiṣṇavāḥ |
sa eva bhagavānādigoloke dvibhujaḥ prabhuḥ || 1 07||
gopaveṣaiśca gopālaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ parisevitaḥ |
paripūrṇatamaḥ śrīmān śrīkṛṣṇo rādhikāpatiḥ || 108||
sarvāntarātmā sarvatra pratyakṣo bhaktabhāvataḥ |
kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāraścātmavācakaḥ || 10 9|
sarvātmā ca parabrahma svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
kṛṣiśca sarvavacano nakāraścādivācakaḥ || 1.204.110 ||
sarvādipuruṣo vyāpī svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
kṛṣirbhū(rmū?)vācakaḥ śabdo ṇaśca nirvṛttivācakaḥ || 111 ||
ānandabhūḥ parabrahma kṛṣṇa ityasti sarvathā |
kṛṣistu vāsanānāśo naśca svālaya prāpaṇam || 112|
śuddhasya muktidastasmāt svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ prakīrtitaḥ |
kṛṣiśca karṣaṇaṃ naśca nayanaṃ divyamakṣare || 113 ||
nītvā dhāmni svayaṃ sākṣād bhavati kṛṣṇa eva saḥ |
sa evāṃśena bhagavān vaikuṇṭhe tu caturbhujaḥ || 1 14||
caturbhujaiḥ pārṣadaiḥ saṃsevitaḥ kamalāpatiḥ |
sa eva phalayā viṣṇuḥ pātā ramāpatiḥ svayam || 115 ||
sa eva śvetaloke’bdhikanyāsvāmī caturbhujaḥ |
sa eva kṣīravārdhisthaśeṣaśāyī hariḥ svayam || 116 ||
sa eva kāraṇaṃ sarvarūpāṇāmakṣare sthitaḥ |
parabrahma śrīharirvai paramātmā parameśvaraḥ || 117 ||
etatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ te cintanīyaḥ sa hi tvayā |
ityuktvā viramantaṃ nāradaḥ śaṃbhuṃ pratuṣṭuve || 118 ||
jñānamāsādya mantrādi sarvamāsādya nārada |
praṇamya śaṃkaraṃ divyaṃ yayau nārāyaṇāśramam || 119 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāradāya śaṃkareṇāhnikaṃ nārāyaṇapūjanaṃ tattvajñānaṃ bhakṣyābhakṣyaṃ parabrahmādi ca kathitamitinirūpaṇanāmā caturadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 204 ||

<1.205>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi cātiramyaṃ badarīvanasaṃyutam |
jagāmāśramavaryaṃ śrīnāradaśca dadarśa tam || 1 ||
divyavṛkṣaramyavallīmahābhūruhaśobhitam |
cātakamenakākīrapum̐skokilarutaśrutam || 2 ||
śarabhakesarivyāghrakarigoveṣṭitam |
naranārāyaṇayogāddhiṃsābhayavivarjitam || 3 ||
siddharṣimunigandharvatrikoṭyāśramamaṇḍitam |
kalpacandanatulasīpārijātavanānvitam || 4 ||
divyaṃ divyacidacidvastujātasamanvitam |
śāntipradaṃ mahāraṇyamagamyaṃ bhūmivarṣmabhiḥ || 5 ||
nārāyaṇo naro yatra tāpasau lokarakṣakau |
bhagavantau surājete’saṃkhyātā munayo’pare || 6 ||
badarīcchāyayā rājadramyānilasugandhini |
badaryadhaḥ sabhāsthāne munimadhye manoharau || 7 ||
dadarśa bhagavantau tau ratnasiṃhāsanasthitau |
japantau paramaṃ brahma śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram || 8 ||
praṇanāma ca tau dṛṣṭvā yogināṃ paramau gurū |
utthāya tau tamāliṅgya yuyujāte śubhāśiṣaḥ || 9 ||
papracchatuśca kuśalaṃ cakrāte’tithipūjanam |
ratnasiṃhāsane niṣādayāmāsaturādarāt || 1.205.10 ||
āsane nivasan ramye vartmaśramavivarjitaḥ |
uvāca tāvṛṣiśreṣṭhau bhagavantau sanātanau || 11 ||
adhītya vedānsakalān pitureva hi sārthakān |
jñānaṃ mantraṃ ca saṃprāpya kailāse śaṃkarādaham || 1 2||
labdhuṃ jñānaviśeṣaṃ ca kṛpāṃ ca pārameśvarīm |
āgato’smi bhagavantau vande saṃsāratārakau || 13 ||
ityuktvā svīyatantryā saṃjagau stotraṃ suchandasā |
susvareṇa sunṛtyena satālena ca nāradaḥ || 14||
jaya jaya harikṛṣṇa svāmin nārāyaṇa rādhāramaṇakaram |
jaya sati siddhapate trayavikrama | raṇamocana daharam ||
raṇamocanadaharaṃ numastvāṃ brahmaparaṃ graharam |
jaya sati siddhapate trayavikrama raṇamocanadaharam || 15||
jaya jaya sadasattaditarakalpana tatvamasiśrutisañcaraṇam |
aśvatthākhyatarūrdhvakamūlaṃ cidacittanudharaṇam ||
cidacittanudharaṇaṃ stumam̐stvāṃ vyaṣṭisamaṣṭyaraṇam |
aśvatthākhyatarūrdhvakamūlaṃ cidacittanudharaṇam || 1 6||
jaya jaya viśvaṃbhara viśvātman svātmani jagaduḥ suvivaraṇam|
pariṇatimadhyasitiṃ śrutayastvayi jagatastvadhikaraṇam ||
jagatastvadhikaraṇaṃ imam̐stvāṃ duritadalanacaraṇam |
pariṇatimadhyasitiṃ śratayastvayi jagatastvadhikaraṇam || 17||
jaya jaya bhūtraya | saguṇa trīśvara vṛṣasuta tattvatrayabharaṇam |
aṅkahṛdayapārśvasthitadevyā vartitaparicaraṇam ||
vartitaparicaraṇaṃ vṛṇīmovittyavayunaharaṇam |
aṅkahṛdayapārśvasthitadevyā vartitaparicaraṇam || 18 ||
jaya jaya śāstracchandāṃgādyabhivedya vyāhṛtiphalaphalanam |
jaya bhoktar hotar jaya havya svātmaramaṇakalanam ||
svātmaramaṇakalanaṃ bhajāmo munijanakaralalanam |
jaya bhoktarhotarjaya havya svātmaramaṇakalanam || 1 9||
jaya jaya naiṣṭhikaguṇapoṣaka jaya tāpasa karuṇākaraśaraṇam |
jaya dakṣiṇa jaya savya dvyātman prākṛtamatiharaṇam ||
prākṛtamatiharaṇaṃ namāmaḥ svāṃghrisugatikaraṇam |
jayadakṣiṇa jaya savya dvyātman prākṛtamatiharaṇam |||1.205.20 ||
stutvaivaṃ daṇḍavat kṛtvā pulakāṃcitavigrahaḥ |
aśruprāvilacakṣuṣkaḥ praṇanāma muhurmuhuḥ ||2 1||
śrutvā nārāyaṇaścātiprasannaḥ prāha nāradam |
aho gandharvavaryādya śratvā gītiṃ sanṛtyakām ||22||
satālāṃ sasvarāṃ sārdramānasāṃ bhāvagarbhitām |
prasanno’smyatigāndharve pārāvāro’tra saṃ bhava |||23 ||
bhaktipravartako me syāḥ sadārādhanakṛdbhava |
sarvavidyāguṇābdhiḥ syāḥ śāśvatasthirayauvanaḥ |||24||
anenaiva hi dehena muktadeho’kṣaro bhava |
na te mṛtyurna te vyādhirna jarā na vivartanam ||25||
naro yathā yathā cāhaṃ tathā tvaṃ mānasaṃ mama |
matsvarūpaḥ sadā tiṣṭha bhakto’pi bhagavān bhava ||26 ||
ityāśīrvādamāsādyāvatāro brahmaṇaḥ svayam |
kalāṃśo hyabhavatso’yaṃ nārāyaṇaprasādataḥ |||27|||
nārāyaṇaḥ punaḥ prāha mūrdhni spṛṣṭvā kareṇa vai |
mamādya hṛdyaṃ tvaṃ vai svīkṛto’si mahāmune |||28||
mayi yādṛk susārvajñyaṃ tvayyapyastvanivartanam |
mama bhaktipradaṃ śāstraṃ vidhehi pañcarātrakam ||29||
viṣṇuḥ śivo viśvasṛṭ ca śeṣo gaṇapatiḥ surāḥ |
manavo munayaśceśā bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja |||1.205.30 ||
lakṣmīḥ śivā ca sāvitrī ramārddhisiddhidevikāḥ |
mānavya īśvariṇyaśca bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||3 1||
gaṃgā ca gomatī revā gaṇḍakī ca sarasvatī |
yamunā svarṇarekhā ca bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja || 32||
pārvatī ca prabhā caivāmṛtā lakṣmīśca māṇikī |
dīpotsavī tathā rādhā bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||33||
saṃsārasāgaraṃ tartuṃ bhavadāvaṃ vilaṃghitum |
jagatsarpādavituṃ ca harerdāsyaṃ gṛhāṇa vai ||34||
janmāraṇyaṃ samullaṃghya mṛtyuśailamullaṃghitum |
dhāmadeśamabhiyāsyan śraya kṛṣṇavimānakam ||35||
romasu yasya viśvāni daśanāgre samagrabhūḥ |
govardhano’ṅguliprānte bhūsthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||36||
yasyāsye nigamāḥ santi so’yaṃ yasmādviniḥsṛtaḥ |
akhilāgamasañcāriśrīkṛṣṇaṃ bhaja nārada ||37||
kālamāyāpāpakarmasvabhāvayamakiṃkarāḥ |
yacchaktyaṃśādīśvarāste taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ sarvadā bhaja ||38||
bhūḥ sītā bhārgavī padmā gopyo vṛndā ca kubjikā |
śabarī piṃgalā devyo bhajante yaṃ ca taṃ bhaja ||39||
virāṭ yasya kalā muktāḥ kalāśca manavaḥ kalāḥ |
kalākalāṃśāśca munayastaṃ hariṃ bhaja sarvathā ||1.205.40 ||
pṛthvī sahasraśīrṣāṇaṃ śeṣaḥ kūrmaṃ jalaṃ sa ca |
tattejastanmahotejastadādhāraṃ hariṃ bhaja ||41 ||
dhāmasthā lokadhīṣṇyasthā yogasthā brahmaṇi sthitāḥ |
svasthitasya na vai pāraṃ yāntyapāraṃ hariṃ bhaja |||42||
yasya muktāstvasaṃkhyātā dāsyaścānantasaṃkhyakāḥ |
śrutayaḥ sṛṣṭayo’nantāstamanantaṃ hariṃ bhaja ||43||
śriyo lakṣmyo dhiyo brāhmyaḥ sādhvyo māyāśca śaktayaḥ |
mūrteryasya kalaikāṃśāstaṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ bhaja ||44||
nārāyaṇī hareḥ śaktistadaṃśāḥ pramadāḥ kṛtāḥ |
patnīṃ vivāhya vatsa tvaṃ nārāyaṇīṃ vadhūṃ bhaja ||45||
mamājñāṃ piturājñāṃ ca tvājñārūpāṃ vadhūṃ bhaja |
evaṃ dharmapratipālaḥ pūjyaśca vijayī bhava ||46 ||
svapatnīṃ raṃjayedyo vai vastrālaṃkāravastubhiḥ |
tasya nārāyaṇī tuṣṭā tārayatyeva kṛṣṇavat ||47||
lakṣmīrnārāyaṇaśaktiḥ sā vai yoṣitsvarūpiṇī |
yoṣitāmavamānena parābhūtā tu sā bhavet ||48||
tayāvamānitayā ca naro’vamānito bhavet |
tayāvamānito’bhāgyaḥ saukhyaṃ kvāpi na vindate ||49||
divyā strī pūjitā yena tadabhīṣṭapradāyinā |
satī putravatī sā syāt sarvamaṃgaladāyinī ||1.205.50||
mūlaprakṛtirekā sā pūrṇabrahmasvarūpiṇī |
sā cāsti ṣaṭsvarūpā vai pūjanīyā śubhārthibhiḥ ||51||
śrīkṛṣṇaprāṇarūpaikā preyasī rādhikā hi sā |
lakṣmīḥ sampatpradā nārāyaṇaprāṇā dvitīyakā ||52||
vāgadhiṣṭhātṛdevī yā sarasvatī tṛtīyakā |
sāvitrī vedamātā yā brahmaprāṇā caturthikā ||53 ||
śaṃkaraprāṇarūpā ca satī pārvatī paṃcamī |
kanyā vivāhitā sā tu vadhūḥ sarvasya dehinaḥ ||54||
mūlaprakṛtirūpaiṣā ṣaṣṭhī bodhyā ca vaṃśadā |
tāṃ ca sevaya yogīndro bhūtvā kṛṣṇa ivāparaḥ ||55||
mā te’stu bandhanaṃ tatra matsvarūpo mayā kṛtaḥ |
iti jñānaṃ mayā dattaṃ sadā dhāraya nārada ||56||
nāradaśca harerājñāmāsādya praṇanāma ca |
kṛtvā ca daṇḍavat premṇā vidhāya ca pradakṣiṇam ||57||
dhyātvā nārāyaṇaṃ taṃ ca kartuṃ tīrthāni tatra ca |
yayau nareṇa sārdhaṃ sa tartuṃ ca tārito’pi san ||58 ||
prāgvai cālakanandāyāṃ sasnau śītena vāriṇā |
tāvaddivyamabhūttasya varṣma nārāyaṇasya tat ||59||
deśataḥ kālato vastutaścābādhyamabhūttadā |
cinmātraṃ sarvasāmarthyāśrayaṃ kṛṣṇasya varṣmavat || 1.205.60 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nāradasya badarikāśramagamanaṃ naranārāyaṇadarśanaṃ gītyāstavanam divyatāprāpaṇaṃ bhaktyupadeśanaṃ vivāhakaraṇājñāpanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 205 ||

<1.206>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
tatrāśrame ca muninā tīrthāni kāni kāni vai |
kṛtāni bhagavan brūhi pāvanāni samāsataḥ || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
gaṃgāyāṃ nāradaḥ snātvā bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ |
yayau prāk badarīṃ yāstyakṣarabrahmāvatāriṇī || 2 ||
natvā stutvā pūjayitvā tathā kṛtvā pradakṣiṇam |
patraṃ ca badaraṃ tasyā attvā prasādarūpakam || 3 ||
snigdhaṃ cākaṇṭakaṃ divyaṃ haritaṃ pallavānvitam |
sapuṣpaṃ saphalaṃ ramyaṃ dhyātvā tadrūpamāntare || 4 ||
jagāma ca tato vahnitīrthaṃ vai pāvanaṃ muniḥ |
jalaṃ papau tadākhyānaṃ śuśrāva ca narānanāt || 5 ||
purā samājaḥ samabhūdṛṣīṇāmūrdhvasrotasām |
gaṃgāyamunāsaṃyoge prayāge puṇyabhūtale || 6 ||
tatrāśvamedhe hutabhuk saṃpraṣṭumupacakrame |
sarvadurbhakṣaṇodbhūtapātakāliptacetasaḥ || 7 ||
kathaṃ syātpātakānmuktirmama brahmavittamāḥ |
vyāsaḥ prāha tadā vahniṃ badarīṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja || 8 ||
yatrāste bhagavān bhaktapāpahāḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
tatra gaṃgājale snātvā hareḥ kṛtvā pradakṣiṇām || 9 ||
daṇḍavatpraṇipātena sarvadoṣakṣayo bhavet |
tato’gnirbadarīṃ prāpya snātvā gaṃgāṃbhasi tathā || 1.206.1 0||
naranārāyaṇaṃ gatvā natvā stutiṃ cakāra saḥ |
agneśca pāvakaṃ cātmapāvakaṃ brahmapāvakam || 11 ||
māyāyāḥ pāvakaṃ tīrthapāvakaṃ praṇamāmyaham |
ṛṣīṇāṃ tapasāṃ puṇyaphaladaṃ mokṣadaṃ prabhum || 12 ||
vidyāpradaṃ dharmadaṃ ca yogadaṃ tāpasaṃ harim |
sukhadaṃ valkalavastramīḍe śaktyaṣṭakaṃ gurum || 13 ||
śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha varaṃ varaya pāvaka |
agniḥ prāha hare sarvabhakṣo’haṃ dūṣaṇaṃ mahat || 14 ||
doṣanāśaḥ kathaṃ syādvai bhayaṃ doṣāt sudustaram |
nārāyaṇastadā prāha kṣetrasyāsya tu darśanam || 15 ||
matprasādātprāṇināṃ ca tava māstu ca pātakam |
yatra snātaśca vahne tvaṃ tadagnitīrthamadyataḥ || 16 ||
khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati kṣmāyāṃ sarvabhakṣaṇapāpahṛt |
tava vāsaśca kalayā matpratāpātsadāstu ca || 1 7||
tataḥ snātvā ca tattīrthe nārado lokapāvanaḥ |
jagāma ca śilāpañcatīrthāni kartumādarāt || 18 ||
nāradī nārasiṃhī ca vārāhī gāruḍī tathā |
mārkaṇḍeyīti vikhyātāḥ śilāḥ paramapāvanāḥ || 19 ||
nāradaśca munirbrāhmaḥ prathame janmani svayam |
darśanārthaṃ mahāviṣṇostapastepe’tidāruṇam || 1.206.20 ||
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi śilāyāṃ vāyubhojanaḥ |
vṛkṣavṛttisthitaṃ taṃ ca viṣṇurbrāhmaṇarūpadhṛk || 2 1 ||
darśanaṃ dattavānprāha kimiti kliṣyate mune |
yadīpsitaṃ mama brūhi tapasāsti śucirbhavān || 22 ||
nāradaḥ prāha karuṇākaro’raṇye’sti ko bhavān |
tava darśanamātreṇa mano yāti prasannatām || 23 ||
tāvannārāyaṇastatra śaṃkhacakragadābjavān |
pītāmbaraḥ sakaustubhavanamālopavītakaḥ || 24||
śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣāśca kamalāsvarṇarekhakaḥ |
sunandādyaiḥ pārṣadaiśca sevamānaḥ suhāsyavān || 25||
darśayāmāsa rūpaṃ svaṃ nāradāya tapasvine |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ sahasotthāya namaskṛtya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 26 ||
tuṣṭāva paramātmānaṃ karuṇāsāgaraṃ prabhum |
jagatāmīśvaraṃ sākṣirūpaṃ bhaktakṛtādaram || 27 ||
kṛpāluṃ tāpasaṃ divyaṃ vande prasīda pāvana |
satāṃ lokasya rakṣāyai hitāya tapa ādadhan || 28 ||
tapaḥphalapradātarme prasīda sattvamūrtiman |
koṭikandarpalāvaṇyavilāsaḥ kāmavarjitaḥ || 29 ||
brahmacāryasi deveśa prasīda satyavāg vibho|
āśritānāṃ kalpavṛkṣo dīnānāṃ duḥkhahārakaḥ || 1.206.30 ||
jñānena bandhahā brahmasukhadātā prasīdatām |
jīvāntarindriyasūkṣmabhūtāntaryāminīśvara || 31 ||
brahmasukhānubhūte tvaṃ prasīda cidacinmaya |
yadāśritāḥ surā duḥkhāmbudhiṃ taranti gopadam || 3 2||
namaste sarvadā parabrahmaṇe brahmaṇe tathā |
vāsudevāya kṛṣṇāya bhūmne nārāyaṇāya ca ||33 ||
mahāviṣṇusvarūpāya vairājāya ca te namaḥ |
namo hiraṇyakośāya tridevebhyo namo namaḥ || 24 ||
adya me saphalaṃ janma cādya me saphalaṃ tapaḥ |
adya me saphalaṃ jñānaṃ śrīhare tava darśanāt || 35||
śrutvā prāha haristaṃ ca tuṣṭo’haṃ tapasā tava |
stotreṇātisutuṣṭo’haṃ varado’haṃ tavāgrataḥ || 36 ||
sarvaśreṣṭho mama bhaktastvaṃ cāsi siddhakāmanaḥ |
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te sarvaṃ dadāmi mā ciram || 3 7||
nāradaḥ prāha bhaktiṃ te padayordehi niścalām |
eṣā śilā me tapasāṃ sthānaṃ tīrthaṃ sadāstu ca || 38 ||
macchilāsannidhānaṃ tu na tyājyaṃ bhavatā kvacit |
mattīrthadarśanātsparśātsnānādācamanāt tathā || 39 ||
punardehaṃ na cāpnuyāt tṛtīyo’stu varaśca me |
śrutvā nārāyaṇaḥ prāha evamastu sadānagha ||1.206.40 ||
carācaravideho’haṃ tava tīrthe vasāmyaham |
tava bhaktiḥ śāśvatī ca mayi bhavatu nārada ||4 1 ||
ityuktvā ca haristatra mūrtāvantaradhīyata |
prathamo nārado hṛṣṭo yayau madhupurīṃ tataḥ || 42 ||
ityasti nāradaśilā tīrthaṃ paramapāvanam |
caturtho nāradastatra tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau punaḥ ||43 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaśilāyāśca tīrthārthaṃ narasaṃyutaḥ |
purā tretāyugasyānte mṛkaṇḍutanayo mahān ||44||
mārkaṇḍeyastapaścakre śilāyāṃ tatsthalaṃ yayau |
purā nāmnā mṛgaśṛṃgo munistvāsīt tapodhanaḥ ||45||
tasya bhāryāścatasraśca pātivratyaparāyaṇāḥ |
suvṛtā kamalā caiva vimalā surasā tviti ||46 ||
kālena mahiṣī tasya suvṛtā suṣuve sutam |
jātakarma kumārasya pitā cakre vidhānavat ||47||
cakāra nāmakaraṇaṃ mṛkaṇḍumiti viśrutam |
niḥśaṃkāśca mṛgagaṇāḥ kaṇḍūyante’sya vigrahe ||48||
tasmānmṛkaṇḍuriti ca nāma sārthakameva tat||
kṛtopanayanaḥ pitrā vedānadhyaiṣṭa sarvaśaḥ ||49||
mudgalasya muneḥ kanyāmupayeme marudvatīm |
mṛkaṇḍuranapatyo’bhūdidamevābhyacintayat || 1.206.50 ||
ahaṃ sadāro gacchāmi rājadhānīṃ śivasya vai |
bhaktapriyaḥ śivo yatra karṇe japati tārakam || 51 ||
gatvā tatra prathamato maṇikarṇyāṃ vidhānataḥ |
snānaṃ kṛtvā mahādevaṃ natvovāsa yathāsukham || 52 ||
śaṃkaraṃ toṣayāmāsa tapasā saha bhāryayā |
tuṣṭaścāha pinākī tvaṃ matto varaṃ gṛhāṇa ca ||5 3 ||
so’pi vavre varaṃ śaṃbho putraṃ dehīti mā ciram |
śaṃbhustasyānapatyasya bhālaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyuvāca tam || 54 ||
saptajanmasu te’patyaṃ nāstīti vaidhasī lipiḥ |
tathāpi tapasā tuṣṭo dadāmi putramekalam ||55||
kimihecchasi putraṃ tvaṃ nirguṇaṃ cirajīvinam |
āhosvidekaṃ saguṇaṃ sarvajñaṃ ṣoḍaśābdikam ||56||
ityuktaḥ sopi dharmātmā nāhamicchāmi nirguṇam |
alpāyurapi putro vā sarvajño’stu jagatpate || 57 ||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha bhavitā te ṣoḍaśāyuḥ suto mune |
dhārmiko guṇavān khyātaḥ sarvajñaḥ kīrtimām̐stathā || 58 ||
ityuktvā prayayau śaṃbhurmuniryayau nijāśramam |
kāle bhāryābhavattasya cāntarvatnī marudvatī || 59 ||
tanayaḥ samaye tasyāṃ marudvatyāmajāyata |
jātakarma nāmakarma pitā cakāra yatnataḥ || 1.206.60 ||
saṃskārān kṛtavān sarvān pañcame’bde vrataṃ dadau |
vedānsa vidhinādhyaiṣṭa vidyāṃ jagrāha śaktimān || 61 ||
saṃprāpte ṣoḍaśe’bde tu pitā tasya mṛkaṇḍukaḥ |
śokamagno’bhavat dṛṣṭvā putramantikamṛtyukam || 6 2||
putro’pi pitaraṃ prāha kiṃ te śokasya kāraṇam |
mṛkaṇḍaḥ prāha tanayaṃ śocāmi tava kāraṇam || 63 ||
āyuḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣāṇi tava dattaṃ pinākinā |
sa kālo’yaṃ samāyātastasmācchocāmi putraka || 64 ||
pitreti kathitaṃ śrutvā mārkaṇḍeyo’bravīdidam |
mannimittaḥ pitaḥ śokaṃ kadācittvapi mā kṛthāḥ || 65||
prayatiṣye yathā tāta yathā yāsyāmyamartyatām |
samārādhya parātmānaṃ hṛdayasthaṃ hariṃ prabhum || 66||
iti nirṇīya tātena sahitaḥ sa yayau drutam |
mathurāyāṃ yamunāyāṃ snātuṃ rādhayituṃ harim || 67||
gatvā tatra yamunāyāstīre tasthau smaran harim |
dvādaśākṣaramantrasya japaṃ kurvanpupūja tam ||68||
yadṛcchayā nārado’pi mathurāyāmagāttadā |
mṛkaṇḍustaṃ nirīkṣyaiva saputrastaṃ nanāma ca ||69||
satkṛtaḥ svāgatādyaiśca nārado mlānabhāvataḥ |
prāha dṛṣṭvā putrabhāle lekhāṃ mṛtyuprayāyinīm ||1.206.70 ||
mṛkaṇḍo’yaṃ tava putraḥ svalpāyurdṛśyate khalu |
mṛkaṇḍuḥ prāha devarṣe dīrghāyuṣyaṃ prakalpaya ||71 ||
nāradaḥ prāha viprarṣe lekhāṃ vedhaḥprakalpitām |
mārjayituṃ na vai śaktāḥ surāsurāstathāpare ||72||
karmasāpekṣakā lekhā likhyante janmanā saha |
āyurvidyā ca vittaṃ ca yaśo nidhanamityapi ||73||
pañcaivaitāni sṛjyante garbhasthasyaiva dehinaḥ |
tathāpi santi santo vai lipiṃ mārjayituṃ kṣamāḥ ||74||
satāmāśīrvacanaiśca sadā duḥkhaṃ sukhāyate |
kubhāgyaṃ līyate caivotpadyate bhāgyasauṣṭhavam ||75||
pāpaṃ pralīyate puṇyaṃ janyate ca satāṃ balāt |
māyāṃ pāpaṃ ca karma ca kālaṃ durbhāgyamityapi ||76||
tasya vai parivartante yena santaḥ pratoṣitāḥ |
mahābhāgavatāḥ santaḥ ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ ||77||
prasannā yatra jāyante tatra bhadrāṇi koṭiśaḥ |
santaḥ prasannā jāyante praṇāmastutisevanaiḥ ||78||
tasmādatithayo ye ye samāgaccheyuratra hi |
tathā ca tīrthayātrāyāṃ mileyurye ca tārakāḥ ||79||
tebhyaḥ sarvebhya eva drāk praṇatiḥ sāṃjalistathā |
kartavyānena bālena nālasyaṃ kāryameva yat ||1.206.80||
tatraivaṃ ca kvacitkasyacinmahatpuruṣasya vai |
ciraṃjīvetyāśiṣāyaṃ vardhitaḥ sabhaviṣyati ||8 1||
tasmāttīrthāṭanaṃ samyak kuru kṣemaṃ bhaviṣyati |
tato badrīmahākṣetraṃ sthānaṃ tu nityadā hareḥ ||82|||
yāhi yatra svayaṃ sākṣāddhariṃ paśyasi cakṣuṣā |
ciraṃjīvī tava putro bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||83||
śrutvetyāśīrvaco labdhvā mṛkaṇḍuḥ sasutastataḥ |
yayau tīrtheṣu sarvatra prabhāse raivatācale ||84||
dvārikāyāṃ puṣkare ca narmadāyāṃ ca bhārgave |
sarayvāṃ yamunāyāṃ ca gaṃgāyāṃ tryambakeśvare ||85||
kāveryāṃ tāmraparṇyāṃ cāruṇācale’tidakṣiṇe |
rāmeśvare’tha sāmudre tīrthāni pracakāra saḥ ||86||
pituranujñāṃ saṃprāpya dakṣiṇārṇavarodhasi |
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivanmārkaṇḍeyo nijāhvayam ||87||
kṛtvā triṣavaṇaṃ snānaṃ trikālaṃ śivapūjakaḥ |
prārthyaṃ trikālapūjānte’rthayitvā nṛtyati priyam ||88 ||
tenārhaṇena santuṣṭo dinenaikena śaṃkaraḥ |
pūjitaśca mahābhaktyā mārkaṇḍeyena vastubhiḥ ||89 ||
tāvattatrārṇave snātuṃ saptarṣaya upasthitāḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ samutthāya nanāmarṣīṃśca pādayoḥ || 1.206.90 ||
ciraṃjīveti saptoktaḥ praharṣa paramaṃ yayau |
mṛkaṇḍuḥ prāha saptarṣīn nāsyāyurvardhate’dhikam || 91 ||
kathaṃ cirāyurbhavitā satyavācāṃ vaco mṛṣā |
yadvā lalāṭalekhā sā vedhaso’līkatāṃ vrajet || 92 ||
maharṣibhistadālokya nīto drāk brahmaṇaḥ sabhām |
natvā ca tiṣṭhati cāgre ciraṃjīvetyajo jagau || 93 ||
ṛṣibhiḥ kathitaṃ cāsya rekhā saṃpūrṇatāṃ gatā |
kathaṃ ciraṃjīvano’yaṃ saṃbhavettava vākyataḥ || 94||
yadi vākyaṃ tava tathyaṃ rekhāmanyāṃ vidhāpaya |
śratvā ca vedhasā lekhā ciraṃjīveti nirmitā || 95 ||
drāgeva saḥ ṛṣibhirānīto dakṣiṇasāgare |
tāvadāyāta evātra kālo mṛtyusahāyavāna || 96||
vṛttaraktāntanayanaḥ sarpavṛścikaromavān |
daṃṣṭrākarālavadanaścūrṇitāṃjanasannibhaḥ || 97||
samāgatya ca tasyāsau yamasyājñānusārataḥ |
adṛṣṭvā nūtanāṃ rekhāṃ pūrvarekhāvidhānataḥ || 98 ||
pāśamavāsṛjatkālo mārkaṇḍeyastamabravīt |
kāla tāvatpratīkṣasva pūjāṃ nirvartayāmyaham || 99||
maheśvaraḥ prasīdatāt satataṃ pūjayānayā |
tamabravīt tataḥ kālo mārkaṃḍeyaṃ hasanmuhuḥ || 1.206.100 ||
saptarṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ ca nītivākyāni tatra ha |
prathame vayasi puṇyaṃ yo na karoti śucyate || 101 ||
māsāṣṭakena tatkuryād yena varṣāḥ sukhaṃ vaset |
divase caiva tatkuryād yena rātriṃ sukhaṃ vaset || 10 2||
pūrve vayasi tatkuryādyena vṛddhaḥ sukhaṃ vaset |
yāvajīvaṃ tu tatkuryād yena pretya sukhaṃ vaset || 103 ||
śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāṅge cāparāhṇikam |
na ca pratīkṣate kālaḥ kṛtamasya na vā kṛtam || 10 4||
idṃ kṛtamidaṃ kāryamidamanyatkṛtākṛtam |
evamīhāsamāyuktaṃ kṛtāntaḥ kurute vaśe || 10 5||
nāprāptakālo mriyate viddhaḥ śaraśatairapi |
kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati || 106 ||
cakravartisahasrāṇi purandaraśatāni ca |
prāpitāni mayā yābhyāṃ prāptakālastvamehi ca || 107 ||
mārkaṇḍeyastadā prāha tvayā naitacchrutaṃ ca kima |
nṝṇāmīśvarabhaktānāṃ na bhavantyāpadaḥ kvacit || 108 ||
brahmādayo’pi tān kruddhā na śaktā hantumīśvarāḥ |
kālaḥ prāha ca yāvatyo gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā mune || 109 ||
tāvanta eva brahmāṇo mayā kālena saṃhṛtāḥ |
tvāṃ ca nayāmi sāmarthyād yasya bhaktaḥ sa rakṣatu || 1.206.110 ||
tenaivaṃ garjatā tatra kālenāsau mahāmuniḥ |
haṭhādgrasituṃ cārabdhaḥ kṣiptaḥ pāśaḥ galopari || 111 ||
tāvalliṃgātsamuttasthau śaṃbhurhuṃkāragarjanaḥ |
uddhṛtya pādakamalaṃ prajahāra bhujāntare || 112 ||
pāśo vicchinnatāṃ yāto dūre mṛtyuḥ papāta ha |
saptarṣayo’pi sattoyairavardhayan mṛkaṇḍujam || 113 ||
prāhurmṛtyuṃ paśya mṛtyo ciraṃjīveti nūtanām |
rekhāṃ lalāṭalikhitāṃ brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā || 114 ||
etasminnantare citraguptāyāveditaṃ navam |
śrāvaṇaiḥ pitṛbhirlekhyaṃ ciraṃjīva mṛkaṇḍujaḥ || 115 ||
tāvad dūtāḥ preṣitāścāpare datvāmṛtāvalim |
mānayantu mṛkaṇḍośca sutaṃ kalpāntareṣvapi || 116 ||
iti mṛtyuśca kālaśca dūtāśca viphalā yayuḥ |
mārkaṇḍeyaḥ pralaye’pi kṣīrābdhau viṣṇusannidhau || 117 ||
samādhau tiṣṭhate naiva mriyate cirajīvanaḥ |
svasthānamṛṣayo jagmuḥ śaṃbhurliṃge tiro’bhavat || 118 ||
mṛkaṇḍuśca yayau svasyāśramaṃ putraśca kevalaḥ |
nāradasyopadeśena yayau badarikāśramam || 119 ||
snātvā cālakanandāyāṃ śilāmupāviśattataḥ |
jajāpāṣṭākṣaraṃ mantraṃ trirātryante narāyaṇaḥ || 1.206.120 ||
prasannaścājagāmāśu darśanaṃ maṃgalaṃ dadau |
śaṃkhacakragadāpadmavanamālāvibhūṣitam || 121 ||
hariṃ dṛṣṭvā samutthāya premagadgadayā girā |
tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā mārkaṇḍeyo narāyaṇam || 122 ||
aśāśvate’tra saṃsāre’śāśvate varṣmaṇi sthitam |
cetanaṃ māṃ kṛthāścirajīvinaṃ muktameva hi || 123 ||
kālamṛtyū kṛtau dūrau śaṃbhurūpeṇa sarvathā |
mṛtaṃ jīvantaṃ bhrāntaṃ māṃ sadaivaṃ trāhi keśava || 1 24||
ṛṣistvaṃ carṣirūpeṇa mṛtān jīvayase vibho |
śāśvate’mṛtadhāmākhye sadā jīvaya māṃ prabho || 125 ||
dehi dīkṣāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ me pūjāyāṃ darśanaṃ tava |
niścalāṃ dehi me bhaktiṃ śilāyāṃ tava sannidhim || 126 ||
tathetyuktvā naranārāyaṇaḥ śrībhagavānsvayam |
dadau ca vaiṣṇavīṃ dīkṣāṃ mantramaṣṭākṣaraṃ śubham || 127||
śilāyāṃ harisānnidhyaṃ pūjāyāṃ daśanaṃ sadā |
dadau tasmai cirajīvimārkaṇḍeyāya yogine || 128 ||
mārkaṇḍeyo vaiṣṇavo’bhūcchilāyāmatra nārada |
nārāyaṇastathā cātra śilāyāṃ samavasthitaḥ || 129 ||
mārkaṇḍeyaśilā ceyaṃ dvitīyā kīrtitā ca te |
haristiro’bhavattatra yayau gṛhaṃ mṛkaṇḍujaḥ || 1.206.130 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vahneḥ sarvabhakṣitvadoṣaparihārakāgnitīrtha nāradātapaḥsthalanāradaśilātīrthamārkaṇḍeyacirajīvitvākhyāna mārkaṇḍeyaśilātīrthamiti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 206 ||

<1.207>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato lakṣmi nāradaḥ sa nareṇa sahayāyinā |
vainateyaśilāṃ nītaḥ kathitākhyānakaśca vai || 1 ||
kaśyapasya vinatāyāṃ garuḍo’ruṇa eva tau |
sutau caikā ca kanyā saudāminī nabhasi sthitā || 2 ||
garuḍo viṣṇuvāho’bhūdaruṇaḥ sūryasārathiḥ |
viṣṇubhaktau samarthau tau mahābalaparākramau || 3 ||
badaryā dakṣiṇe gandhamādane śikhare hime |
garuḍastapa ātepe harervāhanakāmyayā || 4 ||
kvacitphalaṃ kvacinmūlaṃ kvacidvāri tato’nilam |
nārāyaṇajapaṃ kurvansmaranmūrtiṃ hareḥ śubhām || 5 ||
padaikenopasaṃkramya kṣmāyāṃ jepe’tisaṃyamaḥ |
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi tapaścacāra duścaram || 6 ||
tataḥ prasanno viṣṇuśca divyapītāmbaradvayaḥ |
caturbhujo nijaśastradharo hāsyasuśobhanaḥ || 7 ||
āvirbabhūva purataḥ koṭīndukāntisūjjvalaḥ |
ājuhāva garuḍaṃ saḥ vatsa nibodha jāgṛhi || 8 ||
tathāpi notthito dhyānād dadhmau śaṃkhaṃ haristadā |
tathāpi na bahiryātastadā yogeśvaro hariḥ || 9 ||
tataḥ praviśya garuḍe prāṇendriyāntarātmasu |
bahirānīya ca jāgrataṃ kṛtvā purataḥ sthitaḥ || 1.207.10 ||
garuḍo’tiprasannaḥ san dṛṣṭvā nanāma daṇḍavat |
pulakāṃkitasarvāṃgastuṣṭāva ca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 11 ||
jaya trilokajīvānāṃ prāṇarūpa prabho hare |
aghanāśakagīrvāṇavanditacaraṇāmbuja || 12 ||
surāridhvaṃsasāmarthya surāsuranamaskṛta |
svabhaktahṛdgatamohadhvaṃsakṛt te namonamaḥ || 13 ||
tāpatrayapraśāntikṛccaraṇobha namo’stu te |
jagajjanmasthitidhvaṃsakāryakṛttrisvarūpaka || 1 4||
bhaktamānasasadgamya śāstravedādirūpita |
surāsurapravanditapādapadma namo’stu te || 15 ||
aṣṭaiśvaryasamāyukta vanamālāvirājita |
kaṃjanetra tilapuṣpanāsikālakta pattala || 16 ||
sthalapadmapatratulyakaradvaya namo’stu te |
bhaktahṛtkṛtanityāsa divyaguṇagaṇānvita || 1 7||
avitātmajana dharmamūrte hare namo’stu te |
divyaiśvaryasamajuṣṭa pātu māṃ parameśvara || 18 ||
ekaḥ sannapi sarvatrānantarūpadhara prabho |
bhaktakāryakṛte drāk cāyāsi nātha namo’stu te || 19 ||
kvāhaṃ pakṣī tamovyāptaḥ kva tvaṃ sattvamayaḥ prabhuḥ |
kṛpā te darśane hetuḥ kṛpālo’stu ca te namaḥ || 1.207.20 ||
sāparādhasya lokasya rakṣāṃ karoṣi sarvathā |
hitakṛt sukhakṛccaiva guṇāśraya namo’stu te || 21 ||
yajñabhuk viśvasaṃpuṣṭikṛt trāhi māṃ janeśvara |
kanyāmbarāṇi nītvā ca kadambavṛkṣamāsthita || 22 ||
premabhaktisamālabhya dāsaikakaruṇāva mām |
viśvaduḥkhapraśamana me dāsyaṃ dehi keśava || 23 ||
evaṃ stuto hariḥ sākṣād garuḍena mahātmanā |
samājuhāva gaṃgāṃ ca pūjārthaṃ svasya tatra vai || 24||
tataḥ paṃcamukhī gaṃgā hyāvirāsīnnagopari |
tajjalena hareḥ pūjāṃ cakāra vinatāsutaḥ || 25 ||
vriyatāṃ vara ityukto garuḍo hariṇā tataḥ |
tavaikavāhanaḥ śrīmān balavīryaparākramaḥ || 26 ||
ajeyo devadaityānāṃ syāmahaṃ te prasādataḥ |
śileyaṃ mama nāmnā ca tīrthībhūtāstu sarvadā || 27||
etasyāḥ smaraṇātpuṃsāṃ viṣavyādhirna jāyatām |
śrutvā prāha haristasmai sarvaṃ bhavatu te’ṇḍaja || 28 ||
badarīṃ tvaṃ prayāhyeva nārāyaṇasamīpataḥ |
snānaṃ nāradatīrthādāvupavāsatrayaṃ tathā ||29||
kṛtvā me darśanaṃ te vai sulabhaṃ hi bhaviṣyati |
garuḍaḥ śīghramāgatya natvā ca badarīṃ tathā || 1.207.30||
vahnitīrthe kṛtasnānastīrthe ca nārade’pi ca |
snātvā śilāṃ samāśritya bhakticaryāparo’bhavat ||3 1 ||
śilā seyaṃ gāruḍī vai kathyate tatprasaṃgataḥ |
gandhamādanapāṣāṇo vainateyī śilocyate || 32||
tatrāgatya svayaṃ viṣṇurlīno nārāyaṇe tadā |
śilāsānnidhyamāptaśca tena tīrthaṃ hi tanmatam ||33||
garuḍaśca yayau viṣṇorvāhano viṣṇudhāma yat |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ divyatāmāptaḥ prabhoryogātprabhurbhavet ||34||
vārāhyāḥ śṛṇu māhātmyaṃ nāradātra purā hariḥ |
rasātalātsamānīya pṛthvīṃ saṃsthāpya vāridhau ||35||
hiraṇyākṣaṃ nihatyaiva badarīṃ samupāgataḥ |
yogadhāraṇayā cātra vārāho bhagavān sthitaḥ ||36||
seyaṃ śilā ca vārāhī procyate muktidā sadā |
gaṃgājalena saṃsnātvā cāhorātre japet sthitaḥ ||37||
śilāyāṃ divyadṛṣṭiśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
nārasiṃhyāśca māhātmyaṃ śilāyāḥ śrūyatāṃ śubham ||38||
hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā gatavān nṛharistadā |
atyugrakrodhadīptāṃgaḥ pralayānalasannibhaḥ ||39||
abhūddevaiśca śāntyarthaṃ stutaḥ sthitvā sudūrataḥ |
prasanno’bhūduvācaitānāvṛṇīdhvaṃ varaṃ surāḥ ||1.207.40||
śrutvā brahmā hariṃ prāha rūpaṃ bhayāvahaṃ tava |
cātyugraṃ saṃhara nātha gṛhāṇa ca caturbhujam ||41 ||
tato harirvicāryaiva viśālāṃ prayayau drutam |
gaṃgājale svayaṃ snātaḥ śānto’bhūcca caturbhujaḥ ||42||
yatra sthito hariḥ seyaṃ śilā ca nārasiṃhikā |
nṛsiṃhopi śilārūpī jalakrīḍāparo’bhavat ||43 ||
evaṃ rūpaṃ śilāprakhyaṃ kṛtvā dvitīyarūpataḥ |
samāgacchaddhariḥ siṃhāraṇyaṃ raivataparvate ||44||
tatrābhavanmahadyuddhaṃ śarabheṇa śivena vai |
tato dehaṃ hi tatyāja nṛsiṃho līlayā bhuvi ||45||
ityevaṃ nāradaḥ pañcaśilātīrthaṃ vidhāya ca |
śrutvā sahetukaṃ sarvaṃ nareṇa kathitaṃ tadā ||46 ||
yayau snātvā tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā tīrthāntaraṃ tataḥ |
brahmatīrthaṃ yayau tatra śrutavān vṛttameva saḥ ||47||
ekadā nābhikamale sthitasya brahmaṇo mukhāt |
vedānnītvā hyasurau dvau jagmaturmadhukaiṭabhau || 48 ||
tadā hatasmṛtirbrahmā kicitkartuṃ śaśāka na |
ato badarikāmetya tuṣṭāva parameśvaram ||49 ||
tataḥ kuṇḍātsamutpanno hayaśīrṣo nijāyudhaḥ |
pītāmbaradharaḥ śuklasvarṇavarṇaścalacchaṭaḥ ||1.207.5 0 ||
brahmaṇā prārthito’suravināśāya yayau prabhuḥ |
vinihatyāsurau vedānādāya brahmaṇo’ntikam ||5 1 ||
upāyayau hayaśīrṣā bhagavān pradadau ca tān |
yatra sthale dadau vedān svastho’bhavacca viśvasṛṭ || 52||
līno’bhavacca bhagavān tattīrthottamamucyate |
brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ divyaṃ jñānapradaṃ śubham ||| 53 ||
darśanātpāpanāśaśca brahmalokagatirbhavet |
snānādviṣṇostu vaikuṇṭhaṃ yānti prāṇadharā yataḥ ||54||
siddhaistatra stutā vedā dhartuṃ rūpaṃ dvayaṃ dvayam |
ekānte dravarūpeṇa mūrtirvo’trāvatiṣṭhatām ||55||
dvitīyā brahmaṇā sārdhaṃ brahmalokaṃ vrajetpunaḥ |
tato vedāstu catvāro dvaidhīkṛtātmarūpakāḥ ||56 ||
brahmaṇā brahmalokaṃ te yayuḥ sārdhaṃ praharṣitāḥ |
dravarūpā badaryāṃ cāvasan śāśvatasaṃsthitāḥ ||57||
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇo bhagavatpārśvavartinaḥ |
vartante tīrtharūpāste tatra snānādikaṃ kṛtam ||58 ||
nāradenātha vedānāmudagasti sarasvatī |
tatra jale kṛtaṃ snānaṃ tīrthe sārasvate śubhe ||59||
darśanasparśanasnānapūjāstutyabhivandanaiḥ |
sarasvatyā na vicchedaḥ kule tasya kadācana ||1.207.6 0 ||
mantrasiddhiśca jāyeta vāṇī vāgvibhavapradā |
dravarūpadharā tatra tīrthakṛtāṃ hi jāyate ||6 1 ||
tatra kṛtvā tīrthavidhiṃ tato’rvāgdakṣiṇe manāk |
dravadhārāsti yatrendrastapaścakre tu pūrvaje || 62||
indrapadaṃ ca tannāma dvitīyamapi viśrutam |
tapaḥ kṛtvā mahāghoraṃ prasantuṣya narāyaṇam ||6 3 ||
lebhe cendrapadaṃ sarvasurāsuranamaskṛtam |
pratimāsaṃ trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ haritoṣaṇe || 64||
upavāsadvayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā janārdanam |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śakraloke mahīyate ||65||
tatraiva mānasodbhedanāmakaṃ tīrthamasti hi |
yatra sthalyāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ vāso’sti nityadā mataḥ ||66 ||
mānasaṃ cidacidgranthimudgrathnanti ca sarvaśaḥ |
bhindanti hṛdayagranthīśchindanti bahusaṃśayān ||67||
karmāṇi kṣapayantyasmānmānasodbheda ityabhūt |
paritaḥ ṛṣayastatra vasanti tāpasāḥ sadā ||68||
giridarīṣu phalasumūlavāryanilāśanāḥ |
te triṣavaṇasnātāraḥ sadā jītendriyāntarāḥ ||69||
yadā tatra jalabinduṃ labhate puṇyavān janaḥ |
bhavati vyāsasadṛśo yamapitṛsamaḥ kramāt ||1.207.70||
sakāmo vā ca niṣkāmo mānasodbhedake ca yat |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samicchanvā karoti karma sadvidham ||7 1||
phalaṃ bhuktvā punarmuktiṃ labhate hi na saṃśayaḥ |
svargādiṣu phalaṃ bhuktvā puruṣārthaṃ paraṃ labhet ||72||
atha tasmātpaścime’sti vasudhāretisaṃjñitam |
tīrthaṃ tatra yayau so’yaṃ nārado narasaṃyutaḥ ||73||
trilokyāṃ sarvatīrthebhyaḥ śreṣṭho badarikāśramaḥ |
śrutveti vasavaścāṣṭau nāradātprathamāt yayuḥ ||74||
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi dalāṃbuprāśanāstapaḥ |
cakrurupāyayuḥ siddhiṃ nārāyaṇasya darśanam ||75||
darśanena prasaṃhṛṣṭā avāpuḥ sukhamuttamam |
vaiṣṇavīṃ prāpya dīkṣāṃ te yayuḥ sthānaṃ svakaṃ svakam ||76||
atra puṇyavatāṃ jyotirdṛśyate jalamadhyataḥ |
tatra snātvā pūjayitvā nārāyaṇaṃ naraṃ tathā ||77||
iha sarvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā yāntyante cākṣaraṃ padam |
dinatrayamupoṣitāḥ siddhānpaśyanti sādhavaḥ ||78||
āmo bhavaśca somaśca dharaścaiva nalo’nilaḥ |
pratyūṣaśca prabhāvaśca vasavo’ṣṭau vasanti ye ||79||
tānapi tatra paśyanti divyarūpām̐śca tairthikāḥ |
malināścāpi śuddhyanti muktibhājo bhavanti ca ||1.207.80 ||
vasudhārātmake tīrthe snātvā ca nāradastataḥ |
pañcadhārātmakaṃ tīrthaṃ yayau nairṛtyadigbhavam ||8 1||
prabhāsaṃ puṣkaraṃ kurukṣetraṃ gayāṃ ca naimiṣam |
etāni pañcatīrthāni pāpināṃ pāpadoṣataḥ ||82||
malināni yayurviśvasṛjaṃ nairmalyahetave |
śrutvā brahmāgamahetuṃ smṛtvā badarikāśramam ||83 ||
prāha pragacchata kṣipraṃ harerbadarikāśramam |
yatra praveśamātreṇa puṇyaṃ syātpāpanāśakam ||84||
tato natvā yayuḥ sarvatīrthāni badrikāśramam |
tatra praveśamātreṇa niraināṃsi babhūvire ||85||
tato dvirūpamāsthāya tiṣṭhanti dravarūpataḥ |
svasthāne’pi gatānyeva vasanti svīyarūpataḥ ||86||
teṣu snātvā hariṃ natvā pañcopavāsakṛjjanaḥ |
iha bhogānbahūn bhuktvā hareḥ sālokyamāpnuyāt ||87||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vainateyaśilā gāruḍīśilā paṃcamukhīgaṃgā nārasiṃhīśilābrahmatīrtha sarasvatītīrtha dravadhārendrapadatīrtha mānasodbheda vasudhārā paṃcadhārātīrthādinirūpaṇanāmā saptādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||207||

<1.208>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato yayau nāradaḥ somakuṇḍakam |
tapaścacāra bhagavān somo yatra sthale purā || 1 ||
atrestu tanayaḥ somaḥ divyaṃ svargasukhaṃ mahat ||
gandharvebhyo’sakṛcchrutvā pitaraṃ prāptikāraṇam || 2 ||
papraccha ca punaḥ prāha bhavāmyahaṃ yathā pitaḥ |
grahanakṣatratārāṇāmoṣadhīnāṃ patiḥ paraḥ || 3 ||
tathā me sādhanaṃ brūhi śrutvātriḥ samuvāca tam |
tapasā prāpyate sarvaṃ samārādhya hariṃ tathā || 4 ||
na cāsti durlabhaṃ kiñcitsādhūnāmubhayatra vai |
tādṛśaṃ ca paraṃ tīrthaṃ badrikāśramamasti hi || 5 ||
śrutvā jagāma badarīṃ somo viṣṇoḥ prapūjanam |
aṣṭākṣaramanorjāpapūrvakaṃ pracakāra vai || 6 ||
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇi bhagavatparaḥ |
nityatriṣavaṇasnāyī tapastepe’tidāruṇam ||7 ||
śrīharistattapasā ca prasannaḥ san samāgataḥ |
somaṃ provāca tu varaṃ varayeti muhurmuhuḥ || 8 ||
somo natvā hariṃ tatra daṃḍavat prahasaṃstadā |
grahanakṣatratārāṇāmoṣadhīnāmahaṃ patiḥ || 9 ||
dvijānāmapi sarveṣāṃ bhūyāsaṃ te prasādataḥ |
hariḥ prāha na te tādṛk tapo’styanyadvṛṇuṣva ca || 1.208.1 0||
somo nānyaṃ yayāce vai varaṃ tepe punastapaḥ |
triṃśadvarṣasahasrāṇi tataśca bhagavānagāt || 11 ||

vavre śrutvāntardadhe ca hariḥ somaḥ punastadā || 12||
catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi tapastepe’tidāruṇam |
tatastuṣṭo haristatra śaṃkhacakragadābjadhṛk || 1 3||
prāvirbabhūva covāca vṛṇuṣva varadānakam |
somaḥ prāha yadi tuṣṭastaṃ varaṃ saṃprayaccha me || 14||
grahanakṣatratārāṇāmādhipatyaṃ prayaccha me |
tathauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ yāminyāśca jagatpate || 15||
bhagavānāha somaṃ vai prārthitaṃ durlabhaṃ tvayā |
tathāpi vitarāmyadya bhava rājā tathāvidhaḥ || 16||
tato divaukasaḥ sarve militā badarīvane |
abhiṣiṣicurvidhivatsomaṃ rājānamādṛtāḥ || 17||
tato vimānamāruhya rājā bhūtvā niśākaraḥ |
divaṃ yātaśca tīrthaṃ tatsomakuṇḍeti viśrutam || 18||
darśanādgatadoṣāḥ syuḥ somalokaṃ prayānti ca |
tatsparśanād yadvā snānādviṣṇulokaṃ prayānti ca || 19||
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi |
trirātreṇa sthito mantraṃ japan siddhiṃ suvindati || 1.208.20||
somatīrthaṃ tadā kṛtvā yayau śrīnārado muniḥ |
dvādaśādityatīrthe saḥ snānaṃ cakre vidhānataḥ || 21 ||
kaśyapasyāditeḥ putrāstapastaptvātidāruṇam |
ādityāḥ sūryatāṃ prāptāstīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ hi tat ||22||
ravivāreṣu saptamyāṃ saṃkrāntyāṃ vidhivajjanaḥ |
snānena saptajanmāptapāpanāśaṃ karoti hi ||23||
pārākakṛchravrataṃ tu vidhivacca karoti yaḥ |
sūryaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāti saḥ ||24||
snātvā pītvā mahārogānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ |
tīrthaṃ kṛtvā yayau catuḥsrotaṃ tīrthavaraṃ tataḥ || 25||
dharmārthakāmamokṣāśca vartante’tra dravātmakāḥ |
pūrvādidikṣu kramaśo bhūtānāṃ muktirūpakāḥ ||26||
vartante’tra pare kṣetre harerājñānusārataḥ |
nānyakṣetre milantyete devānāmapi durlabhaḥ ||27||
puruṣārthānmūrtimantaste paśyantyatra sāttvikāḥ |
yaistu puṇyānyarjitāni nārāyaṇasya sevayā || 28||
pumarthatīrthe brahmādyāḥ ṛṣayo munayastathā |
parvaṇi prayatāḥ snātumāyānti tatprasiddhaye ||29||
tattīrthaṃ samanuṣṭhāya yayau śrīnārado naraḥ |
tīrthaṃ satyapadaṃ nāma trikoṇakuṇḍamaṇḍitam ||1.208.30||
brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca trikoṇasthāḥ samāhitāḥ |
tapaḥ kurvanti lokānāṃ toṣāya saharṣibhiḥ ||3 1 ||
ekādaśyāṃ haristatra svayamāyāti pāvanaḥ |
ṛṣayo munayaścaiva surāścānye tapodhanāḥ ||32||
snātumāyānti kuṇḍe’tra harerbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
japaṃ tapaḥ stutiṃ dhyānaṃ vaṃdanaṃ pūjanaṃ hareḥ ||3 3||
kurvatāṃ brahmaṇā puṇyapuñjaṃ vaktuṃ na pāryate |
snātvā kṛtvā copavāsaṃ pūjayitvā hariṃ prabhum || 34||
jīvanmuktaścātra bhūtvā brahmamuktastato bhavet |
snātvā prāpya satyalokaṃ tato mokṣapadaṃ vrajet || 35 ||
gandharvāpsarasāṃ yatra madhyāhne harivāsare |
gānaṃ divyaṃ śrūyate vai satyavrataparāyaṇaiḥ ||36||
darśanātpātakādīni līyante tatpratāpataḥ |
yayau tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā naranārāyaṇāśramam ||37||
tīrthaṃ tīrthādimūrdhanyaṃ jalaṃ paramanirmalam |
dvividhaṃ dṛśyate tatra śvetaṃ cāśvetamityapi ||38||
tatra snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ pāpāt pramucyate |
tatra tīrthavidhiṃ kṛtvā hyurvaśītīrthamuttamam ||39||
