jātihīnā janāḥ sarve mlecchā bhūpatayastathā || 124 ||
bhṛtyavat tāḍayet tātaṃ putraḥ śiṣyastathā gurum |
kāntaṃ ca tāḍayet kāntā lubdhakukkuṭavad gṛhī || 125 ||
dharmo layaṃ yadā yāto bhaviṣyati tadā janāḥ |
hṛdyeṣu mṛṣākalpā bhaviṣyanti kalau yuge || 126 ||
svārtha eva susambandho bhaviṣyati navo navaḥ |
pratārakāḥ kalipuṣṭā bhaviṣyanti gurūttamāḥ || 127 ||
adhamebhyopyadhamāśca nīcakarmāṇa eva ca |
harerbhaktiṃ vinā naiva tariṣyanti kalau khalāḥ || 128 ||
teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya dvārakā sarvapāvanī |
sarvatīrthamayī bhūmiḥ kāleyatāraṇakṣamā || 129 ||
yatra nāsti kalerleśastādṛśī sthāpitā bhuvi |
tatra snānaṃ darśanaṃ ca vrataṃ cārcanamarthanam || 1.218.130 ||
bhajanaṃ jalapānaṃ ca rajaḥsnānaṃ ca kīrtanam |
kariṣyanti janā bhāvāt te yāsyanti paraṃ padam || 131 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne divyadvārikāvarṇanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇatmatāsaṃkhyasuramunyādyāgamanatatpūjanatannivasana tattīrthamāhātmyakalitāraṇapratāpāścetyādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭādaśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 218 ||

<1.219>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi sarvā tīrthamayī hi sā |
dvārakā bhagavadvāsā kimu varṇyaṃ viśeṣakam || 1 ||
tathāpi varṇayiṣyami tīrthāni kānicid yathā |
tatra mukhyāṃ gomatīṃ vai pragacchet kṛṣṇasaṃśrayām || 2 ||
yasyā darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ|
amaṃgalānāṃ pāpānāṃ nāśakaṃ sparśamātrataḥ || 3 ||
sarvecchāpūrakaṃ puṇyaṃ praṇamet gomatījalam |
ubhaśreyaḥpadaṃ gatipradaṃ vai gomatījalam || 4 ||
ekārṇave purā jāte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame |
brahmā jajñe nābhipadme tena vai sanakādayaḥ || 5 ||
samutpāditā ājñaptāḥ sṛṣṭikāryārthameva ca |
agṛhītavacasaste yayurvai tapase tataḥ || 6 ||
paścimāṃ diśamādāya tīre nadanadīpateḥ |
tejomayasvarūpasya draṣṭukāmā harestadā || 7 ||
harau manaḥ samādhāya tepire dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ |
bahuvarṣasahasraiśca prasanno bhagavān svayam || 8 ||
babhūva prerayāmāsa cakraṃ svīyaṃ sudarśanam |
pṛthvīṃ bhittvā jalaṃ nītvā tejomayaṃ sudarśanam || 9 ||
bahirāyāt sūryasamaṃ sahasrāraṃ durāsadam |
daityadānavahantṛ ca bhaktarakṣā karaṃ sadā || 1.219.10 ||
dṛṣṭvā cakraṃ vismitāśca brahmaputrāḥ parasparam |
tadā nabhogatā vāṇī prāha tāṃśca kumārakān || 11 ||
bho brāhmaṇā yogisiddhāḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇo hariḥ |
prasannastapasā sākṣācchīghramāvirbhaviṣyati || 12||
tasyārhatākṛte cetajjalamāvirbabhūva ha |
jalenānena pūtena śīghramarghaṃ prayacchata || 13 ||
yadidaṃ tejasā vyāptamāyudhaṃ tatsudarśanam |
śrīharerlokanāthasya tasmādarghaṃ prayacchata || 1 4||
tacchrutvā ca sanakādyāstuṣṭuvurvai sudarśanam |
namo jyotiḥsvarūpāya brahmaśastrāya te namaḥ || 15 ||
namo bhaktasurakṣāya viṣṇuśastrāya te namaḥ |
sahasrāśaya sūryāyāmoghāya te namo namaḥ || 16 ||
iti stutvaḥ namaskṛtvā pūjayāmāsurakṣataiḥ |
puṣpaiḥ patrairjalaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇemuśca punaḥ punaḥ || 17||
harirbrahmā vasiṣṭhaśca samāyātāśca tatsthale |
putrāṇāṃ tapasā hṛṣṭā daduḥ svadarśanaṃ tadā || 18 ||
satyalokasthitā gaṃgā mūrtāpi tatra cāgatā |
brahmā prāha tadā gaṃgāṃ vaśiṣṭhaṃ mama putrakam || 19 ||
anuyāhi samudrāntaṃ jalaṃ bhūtvā jale vasa |
yatra sudarśanādvāri puṇyaṃ cātra samudgatam || 1.219.20 ||
tatra sthānaṃ sadā te syāt tīrthaṃ sarvāghanāśanam |
śrīkṛṣṇasya pādasparśāt sadā puṇyā sute bhava || 21 ||
gavāṃ kiraṇamukhyānāṃ jale sudarśanodbhave|
sthitimattvāt sadā te vai saṃjñāstu gomatī śubhā ||22|
vaśiṣṭhasyānugā bhūtvā nadīrūpā sute bhava |
piteva putrīti yathā vaśiṣṭhatanayā bhava || 23 ||
bāḍhamityeva tānuktvā prasthitā jalabhāvataḥ |
vasiṣṭhaścāgrato yāti gaṃgā taṃ pṛṣṭhato’nvagāt || 24||
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavāḥ sarve devāśca tīrthakoṭayaḥ |
namaścakrurmahāpuṇyāṃ gacchantīṃ paścimārṇavam || 25||
vaśiṣṭhamanugacchantī prasthitā varuṇālayam |
samākiran mahābhāgā sumanobhiśca tāṃ nadīm || 26||
divyairmālyaiḥ sugandhaiśca garndhairdhūpaistathākṣataiḥ |
pūjayāmāsurāścaryasametā vai surādayaḥ || 27||
asyā darśanamātreṇa muktiṃ yāsyanti mānavāḥ |
kiṃ punaḥ snānadānādi kṛtvā yānti hareḥ padam || 28 ||
ityuktvā cārpayitvārghyaṃ śrīkṛṣṇamīḍire harim |
pītakauśeyavasanaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 29||
divyagandhasugandhāḍhyaṃ divyasvarṇāṃgadānvitam |
divyābharaṇahetiṃ ca makarākārakuṇḍalam || 1.219.30 ||
jvalatkirīṭamukuṭaṃ śrīvatsāṃkitavakṣasam |
bhaktābhayapradahastaṃ pralambitacaturbhujam || 31 ||
ghanaśyāmaṃ prasannāsyaṃ lakṣmīsevitapatkajam |
natāḥ smaśca natā smaśca tuṣṭuvuśca punaḥ punaḥ || 32 ||
nārāyaṇo hariḥ kṛṣṇaḥ prasannamanasā dvijān |
uvāca paramaprītyā surān kumārakām̐stathā || 33 ||
yūyaṃ sarve tiṣṭhatātra cāspṛṣṭā mama māyayā |
jñānino mokṣiṇaścaiva pāvanā vasatātra vai || 34||
iyaṃ vai gomatī gaṃgānītā bhavatkṛte mayā |
sarveṣāṃ bhavatāṃ caiva tīrthānāṃ śraiṣṭhyamāsthitā || 35|||
mokṣyarthibhiḥ kumāraiścāpyahamatra prasāditaḥ |
tasmādidaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ gomatyākhyaṃ ca mokṣadam || 36||
anugrahāya bhavatāṃ mayā cakraṃ sudarśanam |
darśitaṃ prathamaṃ viprā bhuvaṃ bhitvā jalaṃ tathā || 37||
bhitvā tejomayaṃ divyaṃ samāyātaṃ mamāgrataḥ |
cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ gomatyāṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || 38 ||
mamāpi niyataṃ vāso bhavatāmapi sarvathā |
cakratīrthe sadāvāso bhaviṣyati hi śāśvataḥ || 39 ||
gomatyarṇavasaṃyoge ye snāsyanti janādayaḥ |
cakratīrthe ca ye snātāsteṣāṃ muktiḥ kare sthitā ||1.219.40 ||
gomatyāṃ sāgare sarvatīrthāni pravasanti hi |
sarve devāśca ṛṣayaḥ pravasanti hi saṃgame ||41||
sanakādibhirācamya snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tadā |
hareścaraṇau prakṣālya dhṛtaṃ mūrdhni jalaṃ tadā |||42||
sarvadevaistathā caturdaśalokanivāsibhiḥ |
gomatī pūjitā tatra pītaṃ puṇyaṃ jalaṃ tathā ||43||
mūrdhni dhṛtaṃ jalaṃ tasyāḥ pādau prakṣālitau hareḥ |
gomatī cāpi kanyā ca bhūtvā dhṛtvā ghaṭe jalam ||44||
avanījya hareḥ pādau mūrdhnā jalamadhārayat |
kṛtvārghaṃ śrīharaye ca datvā sā ca jalāṃjalim ||45||
vikīrya kusumānyatra praviṣṭā varuṇālaye |
sanakādyā maharṣayo devāśca munayastathā ||46||
ye ye tatra ca tīrthāni pūryo’raṇyāni cāyayuḥ |
te te tatra kṛtasthānāstīrtharūpaiḥ samasthitāḥ ||47||
evaṃ sā gomatī sarvatīrthamayī mahodayā |
saṃjātā śrīhareryogāt pāvanī mokṣadā śubhā ||48||
hariśca paśyatāṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ vai tiro’bhavat |
sarve devādayo natvā tāṃ diśaṃ svālayān yayuḥ ||49||
evaṃ sā gomatī lakṣmi saṃjātā sāgaraṃgamā |
kṛṣṇayogātsarvapāpaharā gaṃgā saridvarā ||1.219.50||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gomatītīrthacakratīrthetihāsamāhātmyakathananāmaikonaviṃśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 219 ||

<1.220>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
gatvā ca gomatītīre praṇamya daṇḍavacca tām |
hastapādau ca saṃśodhya jalena kuśahastakaḥ || 1 ||
akṣatām̐śca phalaṃ dadhan dadyādarghaṃ ca prāṅmukhaḥ |
sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ dadāmyarghaṃ ca gomati || 2 ||
trailokyavandite devi pāpaṃ me hara gomati |
ityuccārya mṛdaṃ labdhvā viṣṇuṃ smṛtvā hyudīrayet || 3 ||
aśvakrānte rathakrānte viṣṇukrānte vasundhare |
uddhṛtāsi varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā || 4 ||
mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā pūrvasaṃcitam |
tvayā hatena pāpena sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 5 ||
ityevaṃ mṛttikāṃ dhṛtvā snānaṃ kuryānnadījale |
kurukṣetre sūryagrahe yatpuṇyaṃ tacca labhyate || 6 ||
snānamātreṇa vidhinā gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau |
devān pitṝn manuṣyāṃśca tarpayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥ || 7 ||
gomatīnīradānena muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ |
viprānāhūya vedajñān pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret || 8 ||
dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇaṃ rajataṃ cāmbarādikam |
suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ khurarājatabhūṣitām || 9 ||
ratnapucchāṃ dugdhayutāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ savatsakām |
dadyād dhenuṃ samabhyarcya vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 1.220.10 ||
saptadhānyāni dadyācca viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti |
gomatī gorajaḥsnānaṃ godānaṃ gopicandanam || 1 1||
gopīśadarśanaṃ ceti gakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ |
gomatyāṃ śrāddhakaraṇāt pretā muktā bhavanti vai || 12||
nārakāḥ sthāvarāścaiva vāyavaḥ kīṭatāṃ gatāḥ |
sarve te muktimāyānti gomatyāṃ śrāddhadānataḥ || 1 3|||
hayamedhasya yajñasya prayāgāplavanasya ca |
pratyahaṃ hutabhoktuśca phalaṃ tadgomatījalāt || 14||
viṣṇulokaṃ hi gacchanti pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ |
anekajanmasāhasraṃ vāṅmanaḥkarmabhiḥ kṛtam || 15||
pāpaṃ pravilayaṃ yāti gomatīdarśanena vai |
gomatyāṃ kārtike snātuḥ prasannaḥ śrīyuto hariḥ || 16||
sampūrṇe kārtike māse samprāpte budhavāsare |
paṃcāmṛtena tīrthasya jalena snāpayeddharim || 17||
kasturīkesaramiśraśrīkhaṇḍaṃ ca vilepayet |
puṣpahāraiḥ phalairdīpairdhūpaiśca pūjayeddharim || 18||
naivedyaṃ ruciraṃ dadyād viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti |
gītavādyakathāstotranṛtyairjāgaraṇaṃ caret || 19||
kārtikānte gomatīsaṃgame’bdhau snānamācaret |
ramāpatiṃ prapūjyaiva vrataṃ sampūrṇatāṃ vrajet ||1.220.20||
māghasnānaṃ ca gomatyāṃ kartuḥ śrīsaṃyuto hariḥ |
prasanno bhavati tatra muktiṃ cāpi dadāti saḥ ||21||
tilā hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ modakā guḍamiśritāḥ |
dakṣiṇāścāpi dātavyā brāhmaṇāya sarittaṭe ||22||
tilairājyena dhānyaiśca phalairhomopi sammataḥ |
vratānte raktasadvastrakaṃcukoṣṇīṣamityapi |||23|||
dadyādupānahau caiva miṣṭānnaṃ cāpi bhojanam |
tailapakvaṃ ghṛtapakvaṃ viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti |||24||
sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tathā |
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam || 25||
prāpnoti cātra gomatyāṃ māghasnānena vai janaḥ |
māghaṃ samāpayenmāghyāṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame ||26||
brāhmaṇānujñayā sarvaṃ nyūnaṃ sampūrṇatāṃ vrajet |
brahmadevasvahartṝṇāṃ pāpaṃ snānādvinaśyati ||27||
mitradrohagurughātapāpaṃ naśyati sparśanāt |
brahmarudrapadādūrdhvapadaṃ prāpnoti darśanāt || 28||
bhītābhayapradānena yatphalaṃ labhate janaḥ |
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gomatīvārisaṃgamāt |||29||
kṛtakṛtyo bhavennīraṃ gomatyāḥ pātiyo janaḥ |
gaṇḍūṣaṃ pibati yaśca ṛṇānmucyeta vai trayāt || 1.220.30 ||
gomatīsevino bhaktā vasanti kṛṣṇasannidhau |
vanamālāścaturbhujā divyagandhānulepanāḥ || 31 ||
narā viṣṇusvarūpāśca nāryo lakṣmīsvarūpikāḥ |
bhūtvā viṣṇupadaṃ yānti cāpunarbhavalakṣaṇam ||32||
kṛtvā ca gomatītīrthaṃ gacchedvai cakratīrthakam |
cakrāṃkitāśca pāṣāṇā dṛśyante yatra sarvathā ||33 ||
gale dhṛtaśca pāṣāṇo dhārakaṃ tīrthakṛnnaram |
goloke preṣayatyeṣaścakralāṃchanasadbalāt || 34||
yatrāsthi patitaṃ yasya sopi yāti parāṃ gatim |
prayāgādadhikaṃ caitaccakratīrthaṃ vimuktidam || 35||
yatra cakrāṃkanaṃ labdhaṃ tatra ṣaṇmāsasaṃsthiteḥ |
vidhūya sarvapāpāni naro yāti harergṛham ||36||
cakratīrthe jano gatvā prakṣālya pādahastakān |
ācamya ca punaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ praṇamed daṇḍavat tataḥ || 37||
gṛhītvā paṃcaratnāni patraṃ puṣpaṃ tathākṣatān |
gandhaṃ phalaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca candanaṃ cārghamityapi |||38|||
vilokya ca samudraṃ vai dadyāccakrāya viṣṇave |
namo viṣṇusvarūpāya viṣṇucakrāya te namaḥ || 39||
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmaprado bhava |
agniyoniryajñadeho viṣṇubalaśca muktidaḥ ||1.220.40||
viṣṇucakradharo’bdhistvaṃ cakratīrthānvitaḥ sadā |
snānaṃ karomi tīrthe’tra muktiṃ dehi rathāṃgadhṛk ||41 ||
mṛdaṃ śirasi dhṛtvā ca snātvā bhajan hariṃ tadā |
santarpya devatāḥ pitṝn narān hariṃ ca pārṣadān ||42||
arghayitvā tathā kṛṣṇaṃ sahasrāśvayajeḥ phalam |
snānamātreṇa labhyeta cakratīrthe vidhānataḥ ||43||
viśvedevāḥ svarṇadānād rūpyadānātu pitṛkāḥ |
bhojanenāpi saṃtṛptā bhavanti cakratīrthake ||44||
dīnebhyaḥ kṛpaṇebhyaśca deyaṃ vastravibhūṣaṇam |
rathadānaṃ mukhyamuktaṃ vāhopaskarasmṛddhayaḥ ||45||
aśvā vṛṣāḥ pradātavyā gantryaścāpi viśeṣataḥ |
dakṣiṇā cāpi dātavyā prīṇanārthaṃ jagatpateḥ ||46||
pitarastrikule jātāḥ pretāḥ kīṭāśca nārakāḥ |
sarve te muktimāyānti cakratīrthaprabhāvataḥ || 47||
śrāddhe gayāphalaṃ bodhyaṃ snāne yajvigatirmatā |
tarpaṇe somaparvotthaṃ dāne sūryagrahādhikam ||48||
phalaṃ labhyeta cakrāṃkaṃ grāhyaṃ bāhvostu mānavaiḥ |
manovākkarmabhirjanyaṃ pāpaṃ snānād vinaśyati ||49||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi cakratīrthamapi dhruvam |
tīrthakṛto janāḥ śuddhā viṣṇusāyujyamāpnuyuḥ ||1.220.50 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gomatītīrthacakratīrthavidhiphalādikathananāmā viṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 220 ||

<1.221>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato gacchenmahālakṣmi gomatyudadhisaṃgame |
muktidvāraṃ tu tatproktaṃ kalikāle na saṃśayaḥ || 1 ||
gaṃgāsāgarasaṃyoge sindhusāgarasaṃgame |
phalaṃ yat tallabhyate’tra gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 2 ||
pāpaṃ praṇaśyate snātvā hyarghyaṃ dadyādvidhānataḥ |
kuśāṃśca karayordhṛtvā nārikelaphalaṃ tathā || 3 ||
arghaṃ dadyānnamaskṛtya śrīkṛṣṇaparamātmane |
tīrtharāja namastubhyaṃ trāhi saṃsārasāgarāt || 4 ||
ratnākara gṛhāṇārghaṃ gomatyā saha te namaḥ |
arghaṃ datvā śikhāṃ badhvā smṛtvā ca jalaśāyinam || 5 ||
kuryāt snānaṃ prāṅmukhaśca pitṝn saṃtarpayet tataḥ |
pitṛśrāddhaṃ tathā kṛtvā dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām || 6 ||
suvarṇaṃ vāsasī dadyāt kañcukoṣṇīṣamityapi |
mahādānāni dadyācca yadīcchet kṣemamātmanaḥ || 7 ||
lakṣmyāḥ saha hariḥ sākṣādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti |
uktvā dadyād vividhāni dānāni bhojanāni ca || 8 ||
tulāpuruṣadānaṃ ca kuryātsāgarasaṃgame |
sapta dvīpanṛpo bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ || 9 ||
tulayā tolayet svaṃ yaḥ suvarṇarajatādibhiḥ |
vastrakuṃkumakarpūraśarkarāphalasadrasaiḥ || 1.221.10 ||
sotra bhogān sukhān bhuktvā mokṣaṃ yāti surārcitaḥ |
svarṇadānaṃ vājapeyaṃ snānaṃ gomatīvāriṇī || 11 ||
kanyādānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ vidyādānaṃ vidhānataḥ |
gomatyāḥ saṃgame kuryāt yāti brahmapadaṃ hi saḥ || 1 2|||
svarṇadhenuṃ ghṛtadhenuṃ tiladhenuṃ pradāya vai |
vastrādiśarkarādhenuṃ datvā yāti paraṃ padam || 1 3|||
yugāditithimukhyāsu pañcakāsvaṣṭakāsu ca |
vaidhṛtau ca vyatipāte gajacchāyāhvaye tathā || 14||
ṣaṣṭhyamaikādaśyaṣṭamīdvādaśīśrāddhasadvrate |
snātvā nīranidhau tadvat gomatīcakratīrthayoḥ || 15||
gomatyudadhisaṃyoge snātvā brahmapadaṃ labhet |
amāvāsyādine śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ gomatisaṃgame || 16||
pakṣaśrāddhakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ dinaikena labhejjanaḥ |
śraddhāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ pātrahīnamathāpi vā || 17||
dravyahīnaṃ kālahīnaṃ manaaikāgryavarjitam |
paripūrṇamamāśrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāmudadhau bhavet || 18||
gomatī kamalā candrabhāgā tadodadhau vaset |
gayāyāṃ piṇḍadānena prayāge cāsthipātanāt || 19||
amāyāṃ śrāddhadānena śāśvataṃ puṇyamāpyate |
yadīcchet sarvatīrtheṣu snānaṃ vratadharaḥ pumān ||1.221.20|||
snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktyā vai gomatyudadhisaṃgame |
aputrā mṛtaputrā vā kākavandhyā sravatsutā ||21 ||
doṣaiḥ pramucyate nārī gomatyudadhisaṃgame |
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ tathā pitṛtarpaṇaṃ jaladarśanam |||22||
vrataṃ snānaṃ tathā puṇyaṃ japo homaśca kīrtanam |
śāśvatītṛptikṛtpuṇyaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame |||23 ||
mātṛpakṣāḥ pitṛpakṣā bhaginīpakṣakāstathā |
putrīpakṣāḥ śvaśrūpakṣāstathā śvaśurapakṣakāḥ |||24||
pitṛsvasṛpakṣagāśca snuṣāpakṣāstathā janāḥ |
sapatnīpakṣagāścāpi rakṣikāpakṣagā api ||25||
bhrātṛjāyāpakṣagāśca svasṛputryādipakṣagāḥ |
pitṛbhrātṛsutāpatnīprabhatipakṣakā api |||26||
mitrabāndhavabhṛtyānāṃ ye’pi sambandhadhārakāḥ |
janmāntaragatā ye ca nārakāḥ khanigarbhagāḥ ||27||
te sarve saṃsmṛtāḥ śrāddhe gomatyudadhisaṃgame |
snāne dāne saṃsmṛtāśca tṛptiṃ yānti tu śāśvatīm |||28||
sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyante muktiṃ yānti na saṃśayaḥ |
śrāvaṇadvādaśīyoge samabhyarcya tu vāmanam ||29||
paramaṃ lokamāpnoti snātvā gomatisaṃgame |
pītāmbaradharo bhūtvā divyābharagabhūṣitaḥ || 1.221.30||
caturbhujadharaścaiva vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ |
sevyamānaḥ surastrībhirvimānakṛtavāhanaḥ ||3 1 ||
saṃstūyamānaḥ ṛṣibhiḥ śrīharerarcako janaḥ |
gomatīsaṃgame pūto yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||32|
gomatīsāgare snātvā gacchet saptaprakuṇḍakān |
sarvairārādhitaḥ kṛṣṇo harirāvirbabhūva ha || 33 ||
saha lakṣmyā hariṃ dṛṣṭvā sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ |
saptamiṣṭajalagartān kṛtvā siṣicurindirām ||34||
tato lakṣmīhradā ete kalau te rukmiṇīhradāḥ |
bhṛguṇā sevitāścaite bhagutīrthamiti smṛtam ||35||
tatra prakṣālya caraṇau tathācamya kuśām̐stataḥ |
saṃgṛhya prāṅmukho bhūtvārghaṃ gṛhṇītvākṣatādibhiḥ || 36||
hastau ca mastakopari samunnīya phalādibhiḥ |
arghaṃ dātavyamevātra hrade rukmiṇisaṃjñite ||37||
snānaṃ kuryāttato dhyātvā tīrthāni pitṛdevatāḥ |
devamānavapitṝm̐śca santarpya haribhāvataḥ ||38||
viprānāhūya ca śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta ca bhaktitaḥ |
dakṣiṇāṃ rajataṃ svarṇe phalaṃ miṣṭānnamambaram |||39||
bhojanaṃ cāpi dampatyordadyācca bhūṣaṇādikam |
śāṭīṃ ca kaṃcukīṃ śreṣṭhāṃ ghargharīṃ karpaṭādikam ||1.221.40 ||
pitṛpaṃktīśca saṃpūjya nārīścānyāḥ kumārikāḥ |
sampūjya dadyād dānāni rukmiṇī prīyatāmiti ||4 1 ||
vasate ca sadā lakṣmīstasya gehe na saṃśayaḥ |
smṛddhiṃ sarvāṃ samāpnoti lakṣmīstasya prasīdati |||42||
saptasvapi hṛdeṣveva dānaṃ dadyāt pṛthak pṛthak |
tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ vindellakṣmīloke sukhapradam ||43|||
alakṣmīrnaśyati tasya lakṣmīryasya prasīdati |
paśuputragṛhavāṭīkṣetrabhavanaśālayaḥ ||44||
bhavanti satataṃ śreṣṭhā lakṣmīryasya prasīdati |
svarṇādivardhanaṃ tasya lakṣmīstuṣṭā tu yaṃ prati ||45||
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati |
saptahradeṣu lakṣmyātmanārīṇāṃ bhojanaṃ varam ||46||
dānaṃ ca pūjanaṃ caiva sammānaṃ bhūṣaṇādikam |
śṛṃgāraṃ vāhanaṃ yānaṃ dehopakaraṇādikam ||47||
pṛthak pṛthak pradadyādvai lakṣmīrme prīyatāmiti |
vasatyeva sadā gehe lakṣmīstasya na saṃśayaḥ ||48||
hīnabhāgyo na ca bhavenna bhavetparayācakaḥ |
agryo bhavati sarveṣu yaḥ snāti rukmiṇīhrade ||49||
punarāgamanaṃ na syād vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti mānavaḥ |
sapatnīkaścaturbhujaḥ śāśvataṃ sukhamaśnute |||1.221.50||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gomatīsāgarasaṃgamatīrthalakṣmīsaptahradatīrthavidhānanirūpaṇanāmaikaviṃśādhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 221 ||

<1.222>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato gacchenmahattīrthaṃ kṛkalāsavimuktidam |
nṛgatīrthamitikhyātaṃ nṛgo’bhūcca mahīpatiḥ || 1 ||
anekaśatasāhasrā bhūmipālāstu yadvaśe |
sa nityaṃ gurubhaktaśca devapūjanatatparaḥ || 2 ||
mahādānāni sudadau nityaṃ nityaṃ sahasraśaḥ |
viprebhyo gosahasraṃ ca pradadau nityameva saḥ || 3 ||
prakṣālya caraṇau bhaktyā dattvā kṣaumayugaṃ tathā |
candanapuṣpaiḥ sampūjya prativiprāya gāṃ dadau || 4 ||
dadau ca dakṣiṇāṃ dravyaṃ gavārthe ca tṛṇāni vai |
datvā tāmbūlamavadat viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 5 ||
dānāni dadatastasya yajñām̐śca kurvatastathā |
bhogāṃśca bhuṃjatastasya bhajataḥ śrīhariṃ tathā || 6 ||
dharmeṇa pālayataḥ kṣmāṃ yayau kālaḥ sukhānvitaḥ |
ekadā gautamaṃ vipraṃ sarvadā cāparigraham || 7 ||
samāhūya ca sampūjya tasmai sa gāṃ dadau nṛpaḥ |
suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ raupyakhurādiśobhitām || 8 ||
gāṃ nītvā svagṛhaṃ yāto gautamastāṃ savatsikām |
sutṛptāṃ śobhanāṃ gāṃ ca dāmabaddhāṃ jalāśayam || 9 ||
jalaṃ pāyayituṃ vipro gṛhītvā niryayau gṛhāt||
mārge coṣṭraṃ pradṛṣṭvā sā trastā cācchidya hastataḥ || 1.222.10 ||
dhāvitvā sā yayau dhenuḥ sumahadrājagodhanam |
vicinvan gautamo gāṃ tāṃ na prāpat svagṛhaṃ yayau || 11 ||
dvitīye’hni punarviprānāhūya nṛgabhūpatiḥ |
dadau dānāni vidhivadgodānāni bahūnyapi || 12||
sampūjya bhaktyā satkṛtya vastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ |
vidhivadgāṃ dadau tāṃ ca sa nṛgaḥ somaśarmaṇe || 1 3||
gṛhītvā rājabhavanānniryayau so’pi gāṃ ca tām |
gautamo’pi vicinvāno tāmeva ca dadarśa gām || 14||
saṃyāntīṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ somaśarmaṇaḥ samuvāca tam |
mamemāṃ cāpahṛtvā tvaṃ dasyuvat kiṃ prayāsyasi || 15||
śrutvā dasyuṃ svamātmānaṃ vismito’bhūt sa somakaḥ |
prāha taṃ rājato labdhvā dāne’dya nāsmi dasyukaḥ || 16||
mama svatvaṃ gavi cātra gāṃ nayāmi svamandiram |
gautamaḥ prāha nṛpato hyo mayā prāpitā nviyam || 17||
dāne mamaiva gavyatra svatvaṃ bhavati te nahi |
kathaṃ nayasi soma tvaṃ mayi jīvati gautame || 18||
vivadantau tathā viprau rājadvāramupāgatau |
kurvāṇau kalahaṃ ghoraṃ dvāḥsthau praṇayapūrvakau || 19||
nṛgā dvāri dvijau dṛṣṭvā natvā pupūja tau punaḥ|
prārthayāmāsa kalahaṃ śāmayituṃ nṛpottamaḥ ||1.222.20 ||
ekasyā goḥ prati dravyaṃ lakṣaṃ suvarṇamudrikāḥ |
sahasraṃ ca gavāṃ cāpi dadāmi pratibhūdhanam ||2 1||
eko gāṃ pratigṛhṇātu caināṃ dattā mayā dvijau |
anyo gavāṃ sahasraṃ ca sahasrasvarṇamudrikāḥ |||2 2||
gautamaśca tathā somaḥ prāhaturvai pragarvataḥ |
haṭhāveśāccocaturgāṃ gṛhṇāvo na sahasrakam || 13||
gautamaḥ prāha gāmenāṃ gṛhṇāmyeva hi māmakīm |
somaḥ prāha ca gāmenāṃ gṛhṇāmyeva ca madvaśām ||24||
na gṛhṇāmi sahasraṃ tu gavāṃ svarṇasahasrakam |
naiva prayojanaṃ dravye sahasre’pi tu madgavi |||25||
rājñā bahuprārthitau bodhitau ca pūjitāvapi |
kopavyākulacetaskau trirātraṃ samupoṣitau ||26 ||
avajñātau nṛpeṇātha kupātre mūrkhabhūsurau |
gacchataṃ svagṛhaṃ viprau mūrkhau stho bhānavarjitau || 27||
prāpte viṣamasamaye mārgaṃ kuryāt sa vai budhaḥ |
ekena bhāvya namreṇa cānyena ruṣatā yadā ||28||
mānaṃ tyājyaṃ haṭhastyājyo yatra nānyā gatistadā |
tattu na kriyate viprau kiṃ karomi samānake ||29||
ekasmin vastuni tvatra kliṣṭāvubhau bhaviṣyathaḥ |
tasmād gaccha tamatyugrau yatheṣṭaṃ kurutaṃ dvijau || 1.222.30 ||
evamuktau tadā viprau rājānaṃ prati krodhataḥ |
ūcatuḥ kupitau vākyaṃ samarthau nṛpatiṃ prati ||3 1||
avamānayase tvasmānna nyāyaṃ ca dadāsi yat |
bhaviṣyati bhavānasmāt kṛkalāso na saṃśayaḥ || 3 2||
evaṃ śaptvā tadā viprau parityajya ca gāmubhau |
duḥkhitau svagṛhaṃ gantumudyatau ca tadā nṛpaḥ || 33||
nṛgo dvāraṃ samāgatya daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca |
cakre ca prārthanāṃ yūyamamoghavacanā dvijāḥ || 34||
mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā śāpāntaṃ diśatāśu yat |
somaśarmā tadā prāha dvāparānte hariḥ svayam || 15 ||
dvārakāyāṃ samāgatya tava muktiṃ kariṣyati |
vāsudevaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇastvāṃ golokaṃ ca neṣyati || 36 ||
ityuktvā tau tadā viprau jagmatuḥ svaniketanam |
rājā nṛgo’pi tacchāpātkāladharmamupeyivān || 37||
dharmarājagṛhaṃ prāptaḥ pṛṣṭhaśca bhogyakarmaṇi |
prathamaṃ bhokṣyase puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ vā brūhi satvaram || 38 ||
puṇyaṃ cānantakaṃ te’sti pāpaṃ govaiparītyajam |
śrutvā nṛgaḥ samuvāca bhokṣyaṃ svalpaṃ hi duṣkṛtam || 3 9||
yamasyānumatenāya kṛkalāso’bhavanmahān |
so’yaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi kūpataḍāgasaṃsthitaḥ ||1.222.40 ||
jātismaro’bhavad bhuṃkte’nnakaṇādīn vanauṣadhīn |
ekadā yadubālairākṛṣyamāṇa itastataḥ ||4 1 ||
reme taiḥ svamokṣakālaṃ manyamāno hariṃ smaran |
kintu guruśarīraḥ sa śramayukto’bhavad yadā ||42||
pṛthvyāṃ mūrchāṃ gato bhūtvā papāta na cacāla vai |
sthūlāt sthūlatamaṃ dehaṃ kṛtvā yogena saṃsthitaḥ || 43 ||
bahubhirbālakaiḥ kṛṣyamāṇopi na cacāla saḥ |
atīva sthaulyamāpanno vardhate ca kṣaṇe kṣaṇe ||44||
bālā dṛṣṭvā cakitāśca bhayayuktāśca kecana |
kṛṣṇaṃ nivedayāmāsuḥ kṛṣṇo’pyavetya taṃ mṛgam ||45 ||
samāgatya ca hastena pasparśa taṃ nṛgaṃ tadā |
śāpabandhād vinirmukto divyo rājā nṛgo’bhavat ||46 ||
devatulyaśarīraḥ saḥ tadā bhaktyā kṛtāṃjaliḥ |
tuṣṭāva parameśānaṃ mokṣadaṃ kṛṣṇamuttamam ||47||
bhagavan karma sampūrṇaṃ bhuktaṃ nānyacca vidyate |
śubhaṃ te śaraṇe nyastaṃ mokṣaṃ kuru mamācyuta ||48 ||
tadā kṛṣṇaśca taṃ prāha mama yogācca pārthiva |
yāhi puṇyakṛtān lokān bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān ||49 ||
prāpnoṣyante mama dhāma cāpunarbhavalakṣaṇam |
uvāca ca nṛgaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ yadi tuṣṭo’si me hare |1.222.5 0 ||
garto’yaṃ mama nāmnā ca tīrthaṃ bhavatu puṇyadam |
atra snātvā tarpaṇaṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati ||51 ||
tvatprasādena pitaro gacchantu tava dhāma te |
atra yātrāṃ ca ye kuryuste syurvai mokṣabhāginaḥ ||5 2 ||
tathāstviti nṛpaṃ tūktvā tataḥ kṛṣṇastvapāsarat |
rājā divyavimānena yayau yajñakṛtāṃ gṛham ||53 ||
vaikuṇṭhaṃ dvitīyaṃ yadvai vairājapadamucyate |
tadārabhya nṛgakūpastīrthottamamabhūdbhuvi ||54||
arghaṃ nṛgāya kṛṣṇāya dadyāt snāyājjalaṃ pibet |
santarpayet pitṝn devān manuṣyān śrāddhamācaret ||55 ||
dadyācca dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇāṃ dānāni vividhāni ca |
akṣayyaṃ phalamāpnoti cānte vai paramāṃ gatim ||56 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne nṛgarājño godānavyatyāse kṛkalāsajanma śrīkṛṣnākṛtamuktatā nṛgakūpatīrthaṃ ceti nirūpaṇanāmā dvātriṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 222 ||

<1.223>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato gacchenmahālakṣmi tīrthaṃ viṣṇupadodbhavam |
yatra gaṃgā samutpannā viṣṇupādāśrayā ca yā || 1 ||
ekadā khalu durvāsā yātrārthaṃ samupāgataḥ |
tacchrutvā sahasotthāya bhagavān ramayā yutaḥ || 2 ||
yayau cātithyavidhyarthaṃ durvāsasaṃ prati prabhuḥ |
gṛhiṇī na gṛhe yasya satpātragamanaṃ ca na || 3 ||
tasya devā na gṛhṇanti pitaraścodakaṃ tathā |
iti kṛtvā yayatustau śrīśca kṛṣṇaśca harṣitau || 4 ||
rathamāruhya śrīkṛṣṇo rukmiṇyā sahito yayau |
samudrasya taṭe śrāntaṃ snātaṃ jvalanamojasā || 5 ||
praṇamya bhagavān bhaktyā papracchānāmayaṃ tathā |
muniruvāca kuśalaṃ kva vāsaḥ kṛṣṇa te’dhunā || 6 ||
kati dārā dhanānyeva kaccitte kuśalaṃ sadā |
kṛṣṇa prāha bhavadāśīrvādairvai kuśalaṃ mama || 7 ||
darśanācca viśeṣeṇa pāvitaṃ me kulaṃ tvayā |
samudreṇa pradattā me bhūmistu daśayojanā || 8 ||
daśayojane bhūbhāge purī hemamayī mayā |
kāritā tatra prāsādā navalakṣāṇi kāritāḥ || 9 ||
tasyāṃ vasāmi saṃhṛṣṭo nirbhayaste prasādataḥ |
durvāsāḥ prāha śrutvā tat saṃkhyāṃ vadasva me tava || 1.223.10
yāvatyaśca mahiṣyo vai putrāḥ parijanāstathā |
śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāha bhagavan kṛpayā te mama gṛhe || 11
santi ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ bhāryāścāṣṭādhikaṃ śatam |
ekaikasyāṃ daśa putrāḥ kanyā caikā prajā mama || 12|
ṣaṭ paṃcāśat jñātayo me santi parijanāstathā |
iyaṃ mukhyā mama patnī rukmiṇī yā ramā smṛtā || 13|
bhavān muniprapūjyo’sti samāgacchatu me gṛham |
śirasādhāya pādāstu tato yāmi pavitratām || 14|
durvāsāḥ prāha bho kṛṣṇa sadākṣamo bhavāmyaham |
kṣaṇe ruṣṭo bhavāmyeva kiṃ māṃ nayasi keśava || 15|
naya māṃ yadi madvākyaṃ karoṣi sahabhāryayā |
yadi māṃ netukāmo’si sabhāryastvaṃ rathaṃ vaha || 16||
śrutvā kṛṣṇaḥ prasanno’bhūt rukmiṇyā sahitastadā |
rathadhuryo’bhavacchīghraṃ pāvitohamiti bruvan || 17||
tadā ca ṛṣivaryaḥ saṃyujya kṛṣṇaṃ ca rukmiṇīm |
rathe sthitvāgṛhya rajjuṃ yāhi yāhītyabhāṣata || 18||
devaiśca kusumaiḥ kṛṣṇa pūjyamāno jagāma ha |
vāhyamāne rathe tābhyāṃ rukmiṇī tṛṣitābhavat || 19||
prāha kāntaṃ jalaṃ dehi tṛṣā māṃ bādhate’dhunā |
tacchrutvā pṛthivī kṛṣṇastatāḍa pādalattayā ||1.223.20||
bhūmirbhinnā tato gaṃgā nirgatā śītalā tadā |
sugandhasalilā śvetā jalarūpā babhau śubhā ||21||
apṛṣṭvā ca muniṃ payau rukmiṇī jāhnavī jalam |
dṛṣṭvā ṛṣiścukopāśu śaśāpa parameśvarīm ||22||
māmapṛṣṭvā pītavatī jalaṃ tasmācca tatphalam |
kṛṣṇaviyogarūpaṃ tvaṃ prāpnuhīti bruvan rathāt ||23||
samuttīryātiraktākṣo bhūmāvevādhyatiṣṭhata |
śrīkṛṣṇastaṃ vinayena tuṣṭāva ramayāyutaḥ ||24||
ṛṣivarya yathārthaṃ te vākyaṃ bhavatu sarvathā |
rukmiṇī madviyuktāstu vane’tra jalarūpiṇī ||25||
gaṃgayā saha nityaṃ vai gaṃgārūpeṇa tiṣṭhatu |
yatra jalaṃ vinirbhidya bhūmiṃ prakaṭatāṃ gatam ||26||
tajjalaṃ rukmiṇī rūpaṃ tīrthaṃ samastu śāśvatam |
atraiva rukmiṇīvāso mandire’stu sadā vane ||27||
mokṣaścāpi tairthikānāṃ cāstu ramāprasādanāt |
durvāsāśca tadā prāha kṛṣṇa prātarniśāmukhe ||28||
rukmiṇyāstava yogo’stu nityaṃ karomyanugraham |
ityuktvā prayayau tasmātsthalānmunistadātrijaḥ || 29||
rukmiṇī saṃsthitā tatrodyānaprāsādapuṃgave |
jalarūpā dvitīyena rūpeṇāpi pratiṣṭhitā ||1.223.3 0||
tīrthaṃ tajjalarūpaṃ vai viṣṇupādodakaṃ smṛtam |
mukhyarūpeṇa mahiṣī sadā kṛṣṇasya sevane || 31 ||
sadā tiṣṭhatu prāsāde ityapyanugrahaṃ vyadhāt |
durvāsā varadānaṃ tadgatvā pūjāmavāpya ca || 32||
yayau kailāsamevāsmātsthānāt kṛṣṇo gṛhaṃ yayau |
rukmiṇī ca trirūpābhūt kṛṣṇāpādodake jalam || 33 ||
tatrodyānasthasaudhe sā mūrtirūpā dvitīyakā |
tṛtīyā ca mahārājñī śrīkṛṣṇe nityayoginī || 34||
ityevaṃ rukmiṇītīrthaṃ kṛṣṇapādodakaṃ hi tat |
gaṃgārūpaṃ samajani snāturmokṣapradaṃ śubham || 35||
śrāddhakartuśca pitṝṇāmakṣayyapuṇyadaṃ tathā |
akṣayyatṛptidaṃ cāpi tathā golokadhāmadam || 36||
dānaṃ homaṃ japaṃ dhyānaṃ pūjāṃ cārghaṃ karoti yaḥ |
tatsarvamakṣayapuṇyapradaṃ bhavati tatsthale || 37||
yatra sākṣācchriyā yuktaḥ kṛṣṇo vasati sarvadā |
tatra kiṃ vai bhavennyūnaṃ golokāttīrthavāsinām || 38 ||
tīrthakṛto’pi na nyūnaṃ golokātprāpyate phalam |
bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād dakṣiṇāṃ svarṇarājatīm ||39||
dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ deyaṃ vidhānataḥ |
upānahau pradātavye jalakuṃbhaḥ savastrakaḥ || 1.223.40 ||
dadhyodanaṃ pradātavyaṃ dhānyāni vividhāni ca |
raktavastraṃ tathā śāṭī kaṃcukī ghargharī tathā ||4 1 ||
rukmiṇyai saṃpradātavyā bhūṣāḥ śṛṃgārakāṇi ca |
pūjayed viprayugalaṃ viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti ||42||
evaṃ tīrthe kṛte tatra pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ |
tṛptā yānti harerlokaṃ prasannaḥ śrīyuto hariḥ ||43 ||
iha kāmān sadā bhuktvā bhuktvā svargādivaibhavān |
ante yānti harerdhāma rukmiṇītīrthapāvanāḥ ||44||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne durvāsorathavahanakarmaṇi vyāpṛtāyāḥ rukmiṇyāstṛṣānivṛttyarthaṃ śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇaghātaniḥsṛta gaṃgājalākhyarukmiṇītīrtha rukmiṇītrisvarūpatā ceti nirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 223 ||

<1.224>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato gacchenmahādivyaṃ gopītaḍāgatīrthakam |
yatra kṛṣṇena gopīnāṃ prathamaṃ melanaṃ hyabhūt || 1 ||
śrāyaṇe tatra dānena snānena japanena ca |
muktiṃ vai mānavo yāti śrāddhena bhajanena ca || 2 ||
śrīkṛṣṇo dvārikāsaṃsthaścoddhavaṃ bhaktapuṃgavam |
gokulaṃ preṣayāmāsa gopīnāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā || 3 ||
gopānāṃ ca priyaṃ kartuṃ vaktuṃ ca kuśalaṃ svakam |
āgataṃ coddhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā sotkaṇṭhā gokulāgṛhāḥ || 4 ||
uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsurvastrālaṃkārabhojanaiḥ |
bhuktavantaṃ ca viśrāntaṃ yaśodā sutavatsalā || 5 ||
papracchānāmayaṃ nandaḥ papraccha kuśalaṃ hareḥ |
kaścidāste sukhaṃ kṛṣṇo rāmaśca sukhamedhate || 6 ||
kaścitsmarati śrīkṛṣṇaścātratyān svapriyān janān |
kaccideṣyati śrīkṛṣṇastārayiṣyati no’sukhāt || 7 ||
kaccit kṛṣṇakuṭumbaṃ ca susukhyāste tathoddhava |
iti pṛṣṭvā snehabāṣpapūrṇākṣau saṃbabhūvatuḥ || 8 ||
uddhavastau tathā tām̐śca gokulasthān janām̐stadā |
madhuraiḥ kṛṣṇasandeśaiḥ snehaplutairajījanat || 9 ||
namaskurvanti pitṛbhyāṃ kṛṣṇo rāmo vadhūjanaḥ |
anāmayaṃ ca pṛcchanti tiṣṭhanti kṣemataśca te || 1.224.1 0||
sameṣyati drutaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ saha rāmeṇa gokulam |
vidhāsyati sukhaṃ sarvaṃ kariṣyati ca vo hitam || 1 1||
iti śrīkṛṣṇasandeśaiḥ samāśvāsyoddhavaśca tān |
sukhaṃ suṣvāpa caikānte śramanāśāya vai saḥ || 12||
tāvad gopyo rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā muhuḥ sūryasamojjvalam
kasyāyaṃ kaścāgato’tra vismitāścāyayustadā || 13||
parasparaṃ samāgatya sarvāstā vrajayoṣitaḥ |
vivikte kṛṣṇasandeśaṃ prapracchuḥ śokakarṣitāḥ || 14||
kṛṣṇaḥ kaccit sukhamāste kathaṃ nātra samāgataḥ |
asmatprāṇānparigṛhya gataḥ kathaṃ na cāgataḥ || 15||
iti smṛtvā tadā gopyo ruruduḥ śokamohitāḥ |
īkṣamāṇāḥ kṛṣṇadāsaṃ kṛṣṇasnehavaśīkṛtāḥ || 16||
āśvāsayāmāsa tāścoddhavo vākyaiḥ sukhāvahaiḥ |
kṛṣṇo’pi ca divārātraṃ yuṣmānsmṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ || 17||
kandarpapīḍito duḥkhī bhavate cintayan hi vaḥ |
tāvad gopyo’bhavan vyagrāḥ prāhurvākyāni naikadhā || 18||
nirdayo’smān parigṛhya paścācca parityajya saḥ |
gato punarna cāyāti pūtanāghnasya kā priyā || 19||
gamyate yatra tatraiva nūtanā prāpyate priyā |
nāgarastrīsaṃvṛtasya nāstyasmābhiḥ prayojanam ||1.224.20||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ kathaṃ miliṣyati prabhuḥ |
vilapantya iti vākyaiḥ smarantyo rurudurharim || 21 ||
bhaktimekāntikīṃ tāsāṃ dṛṣṭvovāca tadoddhavaḥ |
sarvāsāṃ saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ yauvanaṃ dhanam |||22 ||
yāsāṃ bhavati śrīkṛṣṇe bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī |
tāśca prāhurnayāsmām̐stvaṃ yatrāste prāṇavallabhaḥ || 23 ||
tāsāṃ bhāvaṃ dṛḍhaṃ jñātvoddhavaśca bāḍhamāha tāḥ |
uddhavena samaṃ sarvā jagmuḥ kṛṣṇekṣaṇecchayā || 24|||
gāyantyaḥ kṛṣṇagītāni yayustā dvārakāṃ prati |
adhvaśramo na vai spṛṣṭaḥ kṛṣṇamānasayogataḥ || 25||
samprāptā mayakhanitataḍāgasya taṭe tu tāḥ |
uddhavaḥ praṇipatyāha tiṣṭhantu cātra gopikāḥ || 26 ||
nivedayituṃ gacchāmi kṛṣṇo hitaṃ vidhāsyati |
uktvaivaṃ ca yayau kṛṣṇaṃ pratyuddhavo jagāda ca || 27||
sarastaṭe sthitā gopyo yathecchasi tathā kuru |
kṛṣṇaḥ śīghraṃ taḍāgaṃ vai narayānena saṃyayau || 28 ||
āyāntaṃ prāṇarūpaṃ taṃ bhrājamānaṃ vibhūṣitam |
jvalatkirīṭamukuṭahāramakarakuṇḍalam || 29 ||
śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābāhuṃ pītāmbarasuvāsasam |
sātapatrasucāmarasvarṇayaṣṭisunaktakam || 1.224.30 ||
dṛṣṭvā kāntaṃ ca tāḥ pariṣasvajire samantataḥ |
haste pṛṣṭhe stane gaṇḍe kaṇṭhe mūrdhni kapolake || 31 ||
mukhe netre cibukeṃ’se urasyurau ca pārśvayoḥ |
kaṭyāṃ sakthni pade cāgre vastre dhautre tathodare || 32||
spṛṣṭvāśliṣya muhuḥ kṛṣṇa cucumbaḥ premavihvalāḥ |
priyaṃ priyāściraṃ dṛṣṭvā mumuhuḥ rurudurbhṛśam || 33 ||
hā nātha kānta hā svāmin hā vrajeśa manohara |
sarvāstvayā parityaktāḥ kathaṃ ruṣṭo’si śuṣkahṛt || 34||
pitṛmātṛparityāgin bhaktatyāgin janārdana |
parityaktā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa punarnāvekṣitāstvayā || 35||
kathaṃ sahyo virahaste kathaṃ neṣyāma ārtihan |
divasānnāthavidhurān yathecchasi tathā kuru || 36||
bhāvajño bhagavām̐stāsāṃ śrutvā tā anvaśikṣata |
bhavatīnāṃ viyogo me kadācidapi nāsti vai || 37||
ahaṃ sarvāntarātmāsmi bhavatīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ |
patirūpeṇa me yogo vittha bhavati sarvadā || 38||
kāmaḥ sukhaṃ sadānando mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate |
etajjñātvā mahāsādhvyo mā kurudhvaṃ vṛthā śucam ||3 9||
iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā samāśliṣya muhurmuhuḥ |
dīrghavirahajaṃ tāpaṃ tatyajuścātinirvṛtāḥ ||1.224.40||
adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma tvadya naḥ saphalā dṛśaḥ |
paśyāmastvāṃ hare kṛṣṇa prāhuśceti ca tā muhuḥ ||41||
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha ca tāḥ sarvāstaḍāgaṃ cātra kāraye |
gopītaḍāganāmnā vai prasiddhiṃ yāsyati dhruvam ||42|||
yatra maddarśanaṃ jātaṃ pūrṇakāmāḥ kṛtā mayā |
mayā sahaiva snānaṃ ca kurvantvadya hi gopikāḥ ||43||
iti kṛtvā hariḥ snāto gopikābhiḥ samaṃ tadā |
bhojitā gopikāstatra miṣṭānnaiḥ piṇḍakādibhiḥ ||44||
vihṛtyaivaṃ jale kṛṣṇo nityaṃ cāyāti mandiram |
sarvāśca sma sukhayati kāmena sukhado hariḥ || 45||
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe snātvā sarasi vai pitṝn |
tarpayiṣyati dvādaśyāṃ teṣāṃ tṛptistu śāśvatī ||46||
dānaṃ dadyāttathā pitṝnuddiśya māṃ vicintya yaḥ |
labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha śāśvatam ||47||
arghaṃ deyaṃ tathā kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ deyā ca dakṣiṇā |
pāyasānnaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhojanīyaṃ saśarkaraṃ śubham ||48||
vastraṃ chatraṃ kambalaṃ ca śāṭī kaṃcukī ghargharī |
dāne deyāstaḍāge’tra smṛtvā māṃ bhavatīstathā ||49||
putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ |
bhuktvā bhogānbahūnatrānte prāpsyantyakṣaraṃ padam ||1.224.50||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne uddhavena saha gokulagopīnāṃ kṛṣṇena saha gopītaḍāke samāgamena tīrthamāhātmyakathananāmā caturviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 224 ||

<1.225>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
sannidhau mayasarasaḥ sarastvanyaccakāra saḥ |
tacca gopīsaraḥkhyātaṃ mahattīrthaṃ hi padmaje || 1 ||
sevitaṃ yadunārībhistathā yadukumārakaiḥ |
kāraṇād gopikānāṃ ca kṛṣṇena kāritaṃ śubham || 2 ||
govacaḥvācako śabdo bhavatībhirmayā saha |
gopracāreti vai nāma gopīsaraitipratham || 3 ||
gopītaḍāgaityevaṃ khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati |
arghaṃ datvā vidhānena snānaṃ kuryād vicakṣaṇaḥ || 4 ||
gāṃ pradadyāt savatsāṃ ca vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitām |
yathoktadakṣiṇopetāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || 5 ||
pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ cātra godānena hi labhyate |
snānamātreṇa godānaphalaṃ vai labhate janaḥ || 6 ||
yāvatpadāni manujo gacchati gopikāsaraḥ |
kulāni divi tāvanti modante harimandiram || 7 ||
kṛṣṇakīrtanakartāro ye gacchanti sarovaram |
na māturjaṭhare teṣāṃ punarvāso bhavediha || 8 ||
gopīsarastīratīrthaṃ yaḥ karoti janaḥ sa tu |
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 9 ||
śrāddhaṃ kuryāttathā pitṝn tarpayedvai viśeṣataḥ |
tāmbūlaṃ kajjalaṃ svarṇaṃ dāne dadyācca vastrakam || 1.225.10 ||
dampatyorvāsasī dadyād bhūṣaṇāni dhanāni ca |
kanyābhyo bhojanaṃ dadyād vastrabhūṣādhanādikam || 11 ||
gopyastena prasannāḥ syu saubhāgyasmṛddhidāḥ sadā |
gāvo deyāśca vṛṣabhā gajāścāśvāśca kanyakāḥ || 12||
yadyat kāmayate lokastattad dadyānmiletpunaḥ |
yāvallokā bhaviṣyanti tāvat sthāsyati vai saraḥ || 13 ||
gopyaśca patibhāvena brahmabhāvena vā punaḥ |
cintayānāḥ paraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vasānā dvārikāpure || 14||
sevayamānā nityaṃ tāḥ kṛtārthā hyabhavaṃstataḥ |
kṛṣṇājñayā namaskṛtya kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsevya tṛptitaḥ || 15||
uddhavena saha yātā gokulaṃ svagṛhaṃ śubham |
kṛṣṇena gopikānāṃ tattīrthaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhuvi kṛtam || 1 6||
gopīsarorajo divyaṃ divyā dhūlī ca piṃgalā |
divyaṃ jalaṃ tathā divyā vṛkṣavallyastaṭasthitāḥ || 17||
divyā vasatayastasya paśupakṣyādicetanāḥ |
divyā golokadhāmnaste hyadhikāriṇa eva vai || 18||
gopīcandanaliptāṃgo gopīdhūlyūrdhvapuṇḍrakaḥ |
gopīmṛtkaṇikāsyaśca mukto bhavati mānavaḥ || 19 ||
gopīcandanabinduyuklalāṭaṃ yasya dṛśyate |
dṛṣṭvā taṃ yamadūtāśca dūraṃ yānti hi padmaje || 1.225.20 ||
gopīcandanatilakaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ devatāḥ sadā |
paśyanti nityadā prātarlayaṃ pāpāni yānti ca || 21 ||
gopīcandanabindurvai kaṇṭhe vātha lalāṭake |
bhujayorvā kṛto yena muktistasya na saṃśayaḥ || 22||
gopīdhūlīkṛtacandrā nārī yā sadhavāthavā |
vidhavā vātha kanyā ca kumārī vidhurāthavā ||23||
gaṇikā kiṃkarī dāsī śaraṇāptā ca sāśritā |
nirāśritāthavā vyagrā vicittā bahugāminī || 24||
smṛddhā raṃkā ca viduṣī mūrkhā ca kūṭinī tathā |
yādṛśī tādṛśī caurā kāmukī vāsanāvatī || 25||
sadyaḥ śuddhyati pāpebhyo yujyate puṇyakoṭibhiḥ |
divyā bhavati gopīvat vrajet kṛṣṇāṃkayogyatām ||26 ||
svarge bhogānakṣayām̐śca bhuktvā koṭiyugāni sā |
devaiśca vanditā yāyādante golokadhāma sā || 27||
tatra rādhāsamā gopī bhūtvā kṛṣṇena modate |
gopīsarovare yacca kīṭapataṃgamakṣikam || 28 ||
paśupakṣisarīsṛpapipīlikāmṛgādikam |
mṛtiṃ yāsyati tatsarvaṃ golokaṃ yāsyati dhruvam || 29 ||
kṛṣṇamṛttikayā snāto gopīmṛttikayāplutaḥ |
premasarovare magno golokādhikṛto’sti saḥ || 1.225.30 ||
na yajñairna ca dānairna japaiḥ svādhyāyatāpanaiḥ |
prāpyate tādṛśaṃ sthānaṃ gopīdhūlyāpyate yathā || 31 ||
gomatī gopikātālo gopālakṛṣṇa eva ca |
gopīdhūlī gavāṃ dānaṃ gakārāḥ pañca mokṣadāḥ || 32 ||
gakarāḥ pañca yaiḥ prāptāḥ prāptaṃ sarvaṃ ca tena vai |
prāptaḥ kṛṣṇo hariryena kiṃ tasyātrāvaśiṣyate || 33 ||
maraṇe yasya kasyāpi mukhe ca kaṇikā patet |
gopīdhūlyāstataḥ sopi muktiṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 34 ||
gomatyāḥ gopikātālasyāgre vā sannidhau mṛteḥ |
golokaṃ dhāma tasyārthe niścitaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ || 35 ||
ākāśamārgato yātā pakṣiṇo’pi divaṃ gatāḥ |
bhavanti gopikātāloparitaḥ kimutāplave || 36 ||
haraye na ca naivedyaṃ dhṛtaṃ vā jalamityapi |
gopīcandanamiśraṃ cet prasādastadbhavetkhalu || 37|||
deśakālādivaiṣamye hareḥ prāsādikaṃ yadi |
milennaiva tadā bhojye peye vā kaṇikāṃ kṣipet || 38 ||
tato bhuñjyācca vai peyāt prasādastaddhi jāyate |
nāniveditabhojyasya pratyavāyo bhavet khalu || 3 9||
bhūtapretapiśācānāmāveśaduḥkhavān janaḥ |
kaṇṭhe vai dhārayed gopīcandanagūṭikāṃ śubhām ||1.225.40 ||
bhakṣayed gopikāsa rorajaḥ snāyācca tajjale |
candrakaṃ bhālamadhye ca kuryānnityaṃ samāhitaḥ ||4 1 ||
evaṃkṛte piśācādyāveśo naśyati vai dhruvam |
svastho bhavati puṇyātmā pūto bhavati sarvathā ||42 ||
daridrasyāpi bhāgyaṃ vai vardhate smṛddhisa mpradam |
roganāśo bhavet duḥkhanāśaścāpi bhavettathā |||43||
kṛṣṇasya divyamūrteśca sambandhāddivyatāṃ gatāḥ |
mṛttikāśca tathā hyāptā nirguṇā muktidā matāḥ ||44||
kṛṣṇayogāt kṛṣṇarūpā gāvo gomatīgopikāḥ |
svaprasaṃgāgatān jantūnnayanti nirguṇātmatām ||45||
kṛṣṇasambandhasambaddhā nirguṇā jaḍacetanāḥ |
mokṣayanti tathā cānyān kṛṣṇavat kṛṣṇamānasāḥ ||46 ||
kāmo lobhastathā krodho māno mohaśca ma tsaraḥ |
doṣatvaṃ svaṃ parihāya guṇatvaṃ yānti kṛṣṇake ||47||

vastraṃ bhojyaṃ tathā peyaṃ sarvaṃ nirguṇatāṃ vrajet ||48||
māyāpi nirguṇā divyā yatsambandhād bhavatyapi |
kimvanyat tatra vaktavyaṃ nirguṇakṛṣṇasaṃgatam ||49||
dhanyaṃ vai gopajātīyaṃ dhanyaṃ gojātikaṃ tathā |
dhanyaṃ golokajātīyaṃ yatkṛṣṇānandasaṃbhṛtam ||1.225.50||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne gopīcandanamahimakathananāmā paṃcaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 225 ||

<1.226>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
tato gacched brahmakuṇḍaṃ tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam |
kṛṣṇasya darśanārthaṃ vai daivataiḥ parivāritaḥ || 1 ||
brahmājagāma ca puryāṃ dvāravatyāṃ samutsave |
pāśīndrayamavitteśāḥ sūryācandramasau tathā || 2 ||
anye ca dikprapālādyā darśanārthaṃ samāgatāḥ |
tadā ca brahmaṇā yatra samājaḥ parikalpitaḥ || 3 ||
tatsthale vai mahattīrthaṃ brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca tattaṭe |
brahmaṇā sthāpitaḥ sūryaḥ sarvadā yaśca tiṣṭhati || 4 ||
sūryatīrthaṃ ca tatproktaṃ sarvapāpavināśakam |
brahmatīrthaṃ sūryatīrthaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakre saraḥ śaśī || 5 ||
taḍāgaṃ candranāmnā tatprasiddhaṃ samajāyata |
sūryasthānaṃ mūlasthānaṃ śrāddhapuṇyasahasradam || 6 ||
pitṛtṛptikaraṃ ramyaṃ koṭipātakasaṃharam |
māghe śukle tu saptamyāṃ snātvā liptvā sthalaṃ raveḥ || 7 ||
pūjayiṣyati sūryaṃ yo puṣpadhūpanivedanaiḥ |
jalapatraphaladravyadakṣiṇābhiśca mānavaḥ || 8 ||
sarvān kāmānatra bhuktvā brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyati |
tataśca brahmaṇā sūryamandirasya ca sannidhau || 9 ||
sāvitryā mandiraṃ kārayitvā sūryarathe ca tām |
sthāpayitvāyatane tāṃ sāvitrīṃ nāmataḥ svayam || 1.226.1 0||
padmajaḥ pūjayāmāsa mūrtau devyā vidhānataḥ |
candrasarastathā sāvitryāśca sanmandiraṃ sthalam || 1 1||
tīrthottamaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vedhasā parameṣṭhinā |
brahmā svayaṃ tathā svasya mūrtau nivāsamācarat || 12|
pratiṣṭhāvidhinā svasya pratiṣṭhāmakarodajaḥ |
brahmatīrthaṃ ca tajjātaṃ vyādhyādhibalanāśakam ||1 3|||
brahmāṇaṃ cāpi sāvitrīṃ sūryaṃ candramasaṃ tathā |
pūjayiṣyanti ye dṛṣṭvā te yāsyanti parāṃ gatim || 14||
tataśca brahmaṇā tatra gāyatrī sthāpitā śubhā |
svenaiva ca pratiṣṭhāyā vidhistatra kṛtaḥ śubhaḥ || 15||
gāyatrītīrthamityetat brahmalokapradaṃ param |
tāṃśca devām̐stathā devīḥ puṣpārghajalakuṃkumaiḥ || 16||
snāpayetpūjayed bhaktyā vastranaivedyabhojanaiḥ |
bhūṣaṇaiśca tathā pātraiḥ karpūrailādibhistathā || 17||

anyaiḥ puṣpai sugandhaiścārārtrikaiḥ stutibhistathā || 19||
pradakṣiṇaiścatān devān viṣṇunā saha pūjayet |
kṛṣṇaṃ ca pūjayettatra śālagrāmaṃ ca pūjayet ||1.226.20 ||
śaṃkaraṃ pārvatīyuktaṃ sagaṇaṃ pūjayet tataḥ |

na vaidhavyaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na vandhyātvaṃ bhavet tataḥ |

indraścakre tathā tatra saraḥ paramaśobhanam ||25||
brahmāṇaṃ sthāpayāmāsa mahendraṃ ca śacīyutam |
tatra cendrapade snātvā svargaṃ satyaṃ ca vidanti ||26||
brahmeśvaraṃ tathā cendreśvaraṃ vṛddhīśvaraṃ tathā |
snāpayitvā pūjayitvā dṛṣṭvā ca mucyate janeḥ||27||
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛtamakṣayapuṇyadam |
pitṝṇāṃ śāśvatī tṛptirjāyate tatra śrāddhataḥ ||28||
viśeṣatastu sampūjyā makarasthe divākare |
uttarāyaṇasaṃkrāntiśivarātryādiṣu prage |||29||
snātvā tattatsaraḥsveva tattattīrthāni sañcaret |
pūjayitvā ca taddevān muktibhāṅ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.226.3 0 ||
śaṃkaraśca tathā satyā sahitaścākarotsaraḥ |
tatrāpi ca jale snātvā pūjayet śaṃkaraṃ satīm ||3 1 ||
brahmaṇā viṣṇunā sārdhaṃ snātastatra pinākadhṛk |
mahādevasaronāmābhavat tajjagatītale ||32|||
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ śrāddhaṃ tatrākṣayasukhapradam |
darśanātpāpanirmuktirmahādevasarovare ||33|
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ surapūjanam |
sarvaṃ tadakṣayaphalapradaṃ bhavatyanuṣṭhituḥ ||34||
na daurbhāgyaṃ narasyāsti nāprajātvaṃ striyastathā |
snātvā gaurīsarasyatra sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||35||
varuṇo’pi ca tānyeva dṛṣṭvā sarvasthalāni vai |

tattīre vāruṇīṃ devīṃ jaladevīṃ tathā svakām |
mūrtiṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa pūjayāmāsa cādarāt ||37||
bhādrasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu kṛtvā varuṇadarśanam |
śrāddhaṃ kuryāttarpaṇaṃ ca kuryāttatrākṣayaṃ phalam ||38|||
pradadyādudakuṃbhām̐śca dadhyodanasubhojanam |

dāturbrahmagatiścāsti yatra gatvā na śocati |

suvarṇadānaṃ dadyācca dhaneśastuṣyati drutam ||43||

rajataṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ vā pittalaṃ trapu ||44||
hīrakaṃ vātha ratnaṃ vā maṇiṃ vā cāmbarādikam |
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā gāśca mahiṣīścāpi kanyakāḥ ||45||
vastraṃ khaṭvā gendukādi kalaśaṃ pātramityapi |
puṣpaṃ phalaṃ ca miṣṭānnaṃ tailaṃ sugandhameva vā ||46||
kapūraṃ cāpi śṛṃgāradravyaṃ ca candanādikam |
upānahau tathā chatraṃ cāmaraṃ vāhanaṃ tathā ||47||
yānaṃ nārīṃ sutaṃ bhṛtyaṃ paśuṃ svaṃ śakaṭaṃ tathā |
peṭikāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ cānyad bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ ca bhojanam ||48||
yadyad dadyānmārjanīṃ vā kaṇḍanīṃ peṣaṇīṃ tathā |
cullīṃ gargarikāṃ sthālīṃ sarvaṃ sahasradaṃ bhavet|||49||
kṛṣṇaṃ smṛtvā kuberaṃ ca sūryaṃ śivaṃ vicintya ca |
rukmiṇyādimahādevīḥ smṛtvā dadyādanantadam ||1.226.50||
mahāpuṇyaṃ mahāsvargaṃ tathā cānte hareḥ padam |
prāpnotyeva ca kuberatīrthakṛnmānavo’vyayam ||51 ||
tataḥ pañcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchedvai pāvanaṃ param |
gomatīṃ ca tathā lakṣmīgaṃgāṃ dvārāvatīṃ tathā ||552||
gopītālaṃ tathā cānyasarāṃsi pravilokya ca |
prajānāṃ patayastīrthaṃ cakruḥ pañcanadātmakam ||53||
pañcanadyaḥ samāhūtāstatrājagmustvarānvitāḥ |
marīcigomatīmatrirlakṣmaṇāmājuhāva vai ||54||
aṅgirāścandrabhāgāṃ ca pulahaśca kuśāvatīm |
kraturjāmbavatīṃ tatra nadīṃ samājuhāva ca ||55||

pañcanadīsamākhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ tanmokṣadaṃ param ||56||
snātavyaṃ tatra vidhivat dātavyamarghamityapi |
gṛhṇantvarghamimaṃ nadyo bhavantu svargamokṣadāḥ ||57||
snānaṃ kuryājjalaṃ peyāt pitṝn santarpayettathā |
pañcaratnāni dhānyāni sapta dadyād dvijātaye ||58||

sarvān kāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati |||59|||
putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ paraṃ saukhyamavāpnuyāt |
pretāśca pitaraḥ sarve muktiṃ yāsyanti tatsthale ||1.226.6 0||
tato gacchenmahattīrthaṃ siddheśvaramiti dhruvam |
sanakādyaiścatuḥsiddhaiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgameva tat ||61||

viṣuve ca manūnāṃ ca tithiṣu yugaraṃbhaṇe ||64||

ṛṣitīrthe vasan japan paraṃbrahma sanātanam ||65||
snātvā devaṃ pūjayitvā naman kuryācca tarpaṇam |
śrāddhaṃ kuryāttathā dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca ||66 ||

dātavyāni rasavanti phalānyatra viśeṣataḥ ||67||
deyau śyāmākanīvārau vidrumaśca tilā api |
śālayaḥ saptadhānyāni saktavaḥ śarkarāyutāḥ ||68||
ghṛtaṃ mālyāni tāmbūlaṃ gandho vastrāṇi gopayaḥ |
deyānyevaṃ dīnaraṃkaviprasādhubhya eva ca ||69||
siddheśvaraṃ ca dugdhena snāpayet mokṣabhāgbhavet |
siddheśvaramahādevadarśane sati mānavāḥ ||1.226.70 ||
aputrāḥ putriṇaḥ pautriṇaśca bhavanti sarvathā |
nirdhanā dhanavantaśca bhaveyuḥ sukhavedinaḥ ||71||

tato gacchenmahattīrthaṃ candrabhāgābhidhaṃ param ||77||

candrabhāgā śaktihastā khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇī ||78||

yasyā darśanamātreṇa sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt ||79||

tajjalaṃ mastake dhṛtvā svargalokamavāpnuyāt |

sūryaputrī yamī cātrāgatya tiṣṭhati sarvathā |
kṛṣṇasevāparā nityā snānānmuktimavāpnuyāt ||82||

tatra snātvā jano bhaktyāpnuyād rūpaṃ suvarṇakam ||84||
lakṣmīnadīṃ tatau gacchennāyaṇasamāśritām |
lakṣmīstatra jalarūpā hyavasat kṛṣṇalālasā ||85||

kambusarastato gacchennirmalaṃ jalamāpibet ||86||
nārāyaṇena śaṃkhasya jalaṃ yatrāsti vai dhṛtam |
tatra tadvai sarorūpaṃ jātaṃ śaṃkhaśca saṃsthitaḥ ||87||
śaravatīrthaṃ ca tatproktaṃ snātvā muktimavāpnuyāt |
jāleśvaraṃ tatastīrthaṃ gacchedvai lokapāvanam ||88||
kaṇvarṣiṇā purā yadoḥ śaptāścātra kumārakāḥ |
vināśāya yadoḥ kulasyaiveti śāpajālataḥ ||89||
jāleśvaro mahādevaḥ sthāpitastatra bālakaiḥ |
śāntyarthaṃ tasya śāpasya tattīrthaṃ sukhadaṃ param ||1.226.90 ||
sampūjayitvā jāleśaṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt |
tato gacchejjaratkārutīrthaṃ paramapāvanam ||91||
yatra vai nāgakanyaikā jaratkārvīti vartate |
vivāhitā jaratkāruṛṣiṇā pitṛtāraṇe |||92||
putralābhena pitara uddhṛtāstena sarvathā |
tacca tīrthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vai tārakaṃ snānadānataḥ ||93||
ānakadundubhitīrthaṃ hyakrūratīrthamityapi |
balatīrthamugrasenatīrthaṃ cārjunatīrthakam ||94||
devakītīrthamevādyaṃ rohiṇītīrthamityapi |
subhadrātīrthamevāpi kardamatīrthamityapi || 95||
kṛṣṇapārṣadatīrthāni patnītīrthāni caiva ha |
bhaktatīrthāni cāpyatra camatkārakṛtāni ca ||96||
prasiddhāni ca luptāni tīrthāni santi koṭiśaḥ |
sākṣādyatra tu golokaṃ vartate tatra kiṃ nahi ||97||
sarvatīrthāni santyeva pade pade na saṃśayaḥ |
plāvitāni ca sāmudrajalena pāṃśunā muhuḥ ||98||

jalaṃ dityatanudātṛ kṛṣṇayogānna saṃśayaḥ ||99||
mokṣadvāraṃ svargadvāraṃ sukhadvāraṃ ca dvārikā |
lakṣmi tadvai sadā sevyaṃ tīrthaṃ tu dvārikāhvayam || 1.226.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārakāyāṃ brahmakuṇḍasūryavaruṇakuberaprabhatidevasaro varādi pañcanadyādiṣaḍtriṃśattīrthapradarśananāmā ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 226 ||

<1.227>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi dvārapālān pratidikṣu vasanti ye |
dvārakāṃ paritaḥ sthitvā rakṣanti kṛṣṇadeśataḥ || 1 ||
pūrve jayanta indrasya putrastiṣṭhati sarvadā |
tasya śiṣyā danujāśca tiṣṭhantyājñāvahāstathā || 2 ||
vajranābhaḥ sunābhaśca vajravāhurmahāhanuḥ |
vajradaṃṣṭo vajradhārī vajrahā vajralocanaḥ || 3 ||
śvetamūrdhā śvetamālī naranātho vināyakaḥ |
sūryaśca mātaraḥ sapta śaṃbhuścāpi ca takṣakaḥ || 4 ||
kārtikeyo rājasaśca dīrgharomākhyadānavaḥ |
viśvāvasuśca gandharvo menakā cāpsarāstathā || 5 ||
sanatkumāro vaśiṣṭho nyagrodhaśca mahāvaṭaḥ |
athāgnidiśi tiṣṭhanti jvālāmukho’ruṇākṣakaḥ || 6 ||
kuśaḥ śmaśānanilayo māṃsāśī rudhirāśanaḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇajaṭādhārī trāsano bhañjanastathā || 7 ||
agnisthālī cāpsarā ca gandharvo’māvasustathā |
atha dakṣiṇakāṣṭhāyāṃ daṇḍapāṇirmahāsvaraḥ |
pāśahastastrinetraścātivarto māraṇastathā || 8 ||
dundubhisvarakaḥ kharasvaro ghargharavastathā |
maunapriyo mallikaśca durdarśaśca vināyakaḥ || 9 ||
mahiṣīkaśca sūryaśca bhūṣaṇaścaturastathā |
citrāṃgadaḥ sugandhaścāpsarorvaśyabhidhānikā || 1.227.1 0||
gorajo dānavaścaiva śālo mahādrumastathā |
sanātanarṣiragastyo dakṣiṇadvārarakṣakāḥ || 11 ||
atha nairṛtakāṣṭhāyāṃ gomukho muṇḍanastathā |
nagnaśca kambalī caiva rodano hasanaśca vai || 12||

muśalī menakā cāpi rakṣanti nairṛtīṃ diśām || 1 3||
atha paścimakāṣṭhāyāṃ svastikaḥ śaṃkhamastakaḥ |

ekapāda ekanetraḥ sthūlajaṃgho mahacchirāḥ |
puṣpadanto gaṇeśaśca sūryaḥ satrājiteśvaraḥ || 15||
tumburuśca ghṛtācī ca mahodarasarīsṛpaḥ |
ghaṭotkacaḥ paṃcajanaḥ kāśyapaśca kapālinī || 16||
aśvatthadruḥ kapilaśca rakṣanti paścimāṃ diśam |
atha vāyavyakāṣṭhāyāṃ bhaṃjano bhairavastathā || 17||
ghaṭodaraśca kāliko daṇḍako mardano ruruḥ |
ṣaṅgaḥ sarvabhujo ghṛṇī supārśvo vāyudigbhavāḥ || 18||
athottare mūlasthānaḥ sūrya indreśvaraḥ śivaḥ |
kaṇṭheśvarī khaṃjanaśca vāsukiḥ kūrmadānavaḥ || 19||
sanakaśca golakākhyarākṣaso nāradastathā |
raṃbhāpsarāḥ plakṣavṛkṣo rakṣanti cottarāṃ diśam || 1.227.20 ||
atheśānyāṃ kilīkaśca durdharo bhairavānanaḥ |
dīrghāsyo meghavaktraśca karālo vikacastathā ||2 1 ||
mūkaśca balibhuk caiva balipriyaśca māṃsabhuk |
ete sarve diśāṃ pālāstatratyāḥ saṃti padmaje || 22||
jayantaḥ sarvamūrdhanyo nāgo rakṣati pattalam |
etānprapūjya kṛṣṇasya kāryaṃ vai pūjanaṃ mahat |||23 ||
atha rukmigaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ darśanaṃ tathā |

śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayettasya mandire dhāmasannibhe |

durvāsāśca tadā cintāmakarot sukhakāriṇīm |
vāmanaṃ prati śaraṇaṃ jagāma balisevitam || 37||
āyāntamṛṣimālokya balirdaityapatistadā |
pratyutthāyārhaṇāṃ cakre cāsane sannyaveśavat || 38 ||
provāca praṇato brūhi cātrāgamanakāraṇam |
durvāsāśca balerdvāre dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ caturbhujam || 39 ||
rudan śvasan muhurvegāt trāhi trāhītyabhāṣata |
brāhmaṇaṃ duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dayāluḥ prāha mādhavaḥ || 1.227.40 ||
kiṃ kasmād duḥkhamāpannaṃ vada śīghraṃ tu me mune |
durvāsāḥ prāha bhagavan jñātvā tīrthaṃ tu muktidam || 41 ||
cakratīrthaṃ gataḥ snātuṃ cākṛtasnāna eva ca |
gale gṛhīto daityaiśca muṣṭibhiścātitāḍitaḥ || 42||
balād gṛhītvā vāsāṃsi kuśām̐ścaivākṣatāṃstathā |
niṣkāsitaścākruṣṭa haniṣyāmo yadyāgataḥ ||43 ||
snātvā ca cakratīrthe’haṃ kariṣye bhojane tataḥ |
tasmād snāpaya govinda rakṣa māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 44||
virarāmetyabhidhāya durvāsāḥ krodhano muniḥ |
brahmaṇyadevo bhagavān brāhmaṇaṃ tamuvāca ha || 45||
hatvā daityān snāpayiṣye samāgaccha mayā saha |
trivikramaśca bhagavān āyayau muninā saha ||46||
kṛṣṇaśca prāha snānaṃ tva kuru śāntyā mune hyatha |
durvāsāstadvacaḥ śrutvā snānaṃ cakre tvarānvitaḥ ||47 ||
sandhyādikaṃ nityakarma kartumārabhata dvijaḥ |
durmukho dānavastatra krodhāsaṃraktalocanaḥ ||48 ||
samāyayau tathā durvāsasaṃ hantumiyeṣa vai |
kṛṣṇaścakreṇa durmukhaśiraściccheda līlayā ||49||
tato daityāḥ samājagmuryuddhārthaṃ śastrakovidāḥ |
viṣṇuḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vāmanaśceti sarvaśaḥ ||1.227.5 0 ||
mārgaṇairastraśastraiśca raṇe daityān nijaghnire |
duḥsahaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ ca golakaṃ vedadūṣakam ||5 1 ||
yajñaghnaṃ yajñahantāraṃ dharmānta ca nijaghnire |
kuśastadā samāyāto yuddhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ ||52||
anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ nāgānāmayutaṃ tathā |
ayute dve rathānāntu cāśvānāṃ ca daśāyutam |||53 ||
vakrago dīrghanakhaśca nighasaḥ prasavastathā |
ūrdhvabāhurvakraśirāḥ kaṃcukaśca śilonmukhaḥ || 54||
yajñadhnaśca tathā rāhurbabarako mahāhanuḥ |
sunāmā vasunāmā ca daityā yuddhāya niryayuḥ || 55||
kuśastadā mahādevaṃ pupūja jayavāñcchayā |
yayau khaḍgaṃ kare dhṛtvā keśavaṃ prati vegataḥ ||56 ||
uvāca yadi jeṣyāmi kīrtirme hyatulā bhavet |
patito’haṃ tvayā yadvā yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim ||57||
ityuktvā dhāvamānasya śiraściccheda līlayā |
patitaḥ śivasānnidhye punarjīvita utthitaḥ ||98||
uvāca viṣṇumānamya daityeste’pakṛtaṃ ca kim |
durvāsasaṃ snāpayitvā yathecchasi tathā kuru ||59||
kṛṣṇaḥ prāha bhavadbhiśca tīrthaṃ ruddhaṃ hi sarvathā |
tasmāt sarvān haniṣyāmi dānavānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||1.227.60||
yuyudhe ca tadā kuśaḥ kṛṣṇena saha vegataḥ |
bhagavān krodhasaṃyuktaścakreṇāpātayacchiraḥ ||61 ||
tadā daityaiḥ kuśadeho mastakaṃ ca śivālaye |
nikṣipto tāvadevāyaṃ prasādācchaṃkarasya vai ||62||
upasthitaḥ sahasā dhṛtvā gadāṃ yoddhumupasthitaḥ |
mahādevena tuṣṭena yato’maraḥ sa vai kṛtaḥ ||63||
punaśca hariṇā svasya gadayā bhinnamastakaḥ |
kuśo garte tadā kṣipto mṛtpāṣāṇaiśca bhāritaḥ ||64||
tadupari śivaliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ viṣṇunā tadā |
jīvito’pi punarnāyamutthito’bhūduvāca ca ||65||
śivaliṃgaṃ tvayā viṣṇo sthāpitaṃ yanmamopari |
mama nāmnā bhavatvetat kuśeśa itiviśrutam ||66||
kuśasthalyāṃ kuśeśaśca tīrthaṃ kṛtaṃ mahattathā |
kṛṣṇena tattathāstviti kuśānugrahakāraṇāt ||67||

rasātalagatāḥ kecitkecid bhṛtyatayā sthitāḥ ||68||
vāmanaśca tathā viṣṇuranantaḥ krodhano muniḥ |
ete’nyepi dvāravatyāṃ sthānaṃ kṛtvā sadā sthitāḥ ||69||
dvitīyena ca rūpeṇa tāni tīrthāni santi vai |
kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanaṃ ca saṃkarṣaṇaṃ durvāsasam ||1.227.70||
tīrthakṛtpūjayed gandhaiḥ puṣpanaivedyabhūṣaṇaiḥ |
vastraiḥ phalaiśca tāmbūlākṣatacandanakuṃkumaiḥ ||71||
ārārtrikeṇa dhūpena dīpavāditrakīrtanaiḥ |
pradakṣiṇādakṣiṇābhiḥ stutibhirvandanaistathā ||72||
sarvārpaṇaiśca sampūjya kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ niśi |
bhādreṣṭamyāṃ dvādaśyāṃ ca pūjayitvā tu tānsurān ||73||
golokaṃ dhāma cāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati |
snāpayitvā hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ ||74||
tulasīṃ pūjayitvā cārcayed durvāsasaṃ tataḥ |
gaṇeśaṃ vainateyaṃ ca pūjayecca tataḥ param ||75||
rukmiṇīṃ pūjayecchaktyā ṣoḍaśopasuvastubhiḥ |
grahapīḍā na jāyeta vyādhayo na bhavanti ca ||76 ||
bhūtapretādipīḍā ca naśyed rukmiṇīkārcanāt |
rukmiṇīṃ snāpayed dadhnā kṣīreṇa madhunā tathā ||77||
śarkarayā ghṛtenāpi gandhaiḥ sugandhicandanaiḥ |
utaraiḥ śreṣṭhatailaiśca tato’bhiṣekasajjalaiḥ ||78 ||
śrīkhaṇḍakuṃkumenāpi kastūrīkesaraistathā |
vilepayeyenmahālakṣmīṃ rukmiṇīṃ cātibhāvataḥ || 79 ||
aputrasya bhavetputro’dhanaśca dhanamāpnuyāt |
dāsān bhṛtyān paśūn gāśca prāpnuyād bhogavaibhavān || 1.227.80 ||
pūjayenmālatīpuṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ |
karavīrairmallikābhistulasīrājacampakaiḥ ||8 1 ||
karavīraiḥ ketakaiśca dhūpairvastrairdhanaistathā |
bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayed devīṃ maṇiratnairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||8 2||
evaṃ pūjayamānasya na kule nirdhanaḥ kvacit||
nāputro nāpyasadbhāgyo na nīcasevako bhavet ||8 3 ||
naivedyaṃ bhakṣyabhojyādi tato dadyāt priyaṃ priyam |
tāmbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ bhāvena vinivedayet ||84||
phalaṃ jalaṃ tathārghaṃ ca dadyādārārtrikaṃ tataḥ |
nīrājanaṃ karpūreṇa kṛtvā śaṃkhajalaṃ tataḥ ||85||
bhrāmayet sarvato rakṣākaraṃ śirasā dhārayet |
daṇḍavat praṇamed bhūmau namaḥ kṛṣṇapriye vadan ||86||
viprapatnyai tato dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca |
sindūrahāravastrāṇi gandhakusumakuṃkumam || 87||
kajjalaṃ cāpi tāmbūlaṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ navaṃ navam |
athaivaṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca devīṃ jāmbavantīṃ tathā ||88 ||
mitravindāṃ ca kālindīṃ bhadrāmagnijitīṃ tathā |

tasmātsarvaprayatnena rājñyaśca kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ || 1.227.90 ||
toṣaṇīyāścātibhaktyā bhaveyuḥ svargamokṣadāḥ |
saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāṃ saphalāśca manorathāḥ || 91 ||
māghe māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ caitrasya dvādaśīdine |
vaiśākhe cāpi jyeṣṭhasyāṣṭamyāṃ bhādre ca kārtike || 92||
dvādaśyāṃ sitapakṣe sā pūjitā kṛṣṇasaṃyutā |
dadyādvai cirajīvitvaṃ cākṣayāṃ putrasantatim || 93 ||

tasya golokadhāmnyeva vāsaḥ kṛṣṇasya mandire || 94||

tasya dhāmni harernityaṃ prasādaprāpaṇaṃ bhavet ||95||
vastravyajanasacchatracāmarakalaśādikam |
arpayed yaḥ śrīkṛṣṇāya tasya taddhāmnyanantakam ||96||
kṛṣṇalakṣmīcaraṇānāṃ sevakasya susmṛddhayaḥ |
sadā divyā bhavantyeva nāryāśca kṛṣṇabhogyatā ||97||
snāyācca sarvatīrtheṣu dānaṃ śaktyā dadāti yaḥ |
sarvayajñaphalaṃ naiva kalau kṛṣṇaśriyo’rcanāt || 98||

labhyate ca mahālakṣmi kṣetraṃ divyaṃ ca me’sti tat ||9 9 ||
iti te kathitaṃ mukhyaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam |
janaḥ śrutvā paṭhitvā ca tattīrthaphalamāpnuyāt || 1.227.10 0||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikākṣetrarakṣakāṇāṃ nāmāni durvāsasaḥ snānanimittaṃ kuśādidaityānāṃ nāśaḥ kuśeśvarāditīrthāni vāmanāditīrthāni paṭṭarājñītīrthādīni cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||227||

<1.228>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
kalau kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvanti paṭhanti ca |
teṣāṃ vaikuṇṭhagolokadhāmnorvāso mataḥ sadā || 1 ||
nityaṃ kṛṣṇakathā yasya prāṇādapi garīyasī |
na tasya durlabhaṃ cātra paratrāpi yathepsitam || 2 ||
manvantarasahasreṇa kāśīvāsasya yatphalam |
tatphalaṃ dvāravatyāṃ tu pañcadivasavāsataḥ || 3 ||
śvapacopi vasannatra yatīnāṃ gatimāpnuyāt |
dvārakāṃ prati yātasya puṇyaṃ syāttu pade pade || 4 ||
kurukṣetre ravigrahasnānasyetyāha padmajaḥ |
candragrahe bhaved yaśca phalaṃ tadatra darśane || 5 ||
puṣkare kārtikasnānaphalaṃ yadvarṣakoṭibhiḥ |
tatphalaṃ dvārakāvāse nityaṃ bhavati dehinaḥ || 6 ||
avantyāṃ yatphalaṃ manuśatena bhavati priye |
tatphalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ tu dinaikavāsato bhavet || 7 ||
kṛṣṇadarśanapuṇyaṃ tu mataṃ koṭivratādhikam |
rukmiṇīkṛṣṇasevāyāḥ phalaṃ golokamokṣaṇam || 8 ||
dhanyāste kṛtakṛtyāste dṛṣṭaṃ yaiḥ kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam |
dvādaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapūjā ca karoti yastu bhāvataḥ || 5 ||
kṣīrasnānaṃ kārayati śatāśvamedhajaṃ phalam |
dugdhād daśaguṇaṃ darbhād ghṛtāttasmād daśottaram || 1.228.10 ||
ghṛtāddaśaguṇaṃ kṣaudraṃ śaṃkhena taddaśottaram |
puṣpodakaṃ ca darbhodaṃ vardhate taddaśottaram || 1 1||
mantrodakaṃ ca gandhodaṃ tato’pi ca daśottaram |
snānamikṣurasenāpi śatavājimakhaiḥ samam || 1 2||
tīrthanīreṇa saṃsnānaṃ tato daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam |
sakāmastvāpnuyātsvargaṃ niṣkāmo muktimāpnuyāt || 13 ||
kṛṣṇasnānārdragātraṃ yo vastreṇa mārjayejjanaḥ |
tasya janmāntaralakṣapāpaṃ bhavati mārjitam || 1 4||
snāpayitvā hariṃ tasmai puṣpahāraṃ dadāti yaḥ |
tasya puṇyaṃ svarṇaniṣkākoṭidānaphalaṃ bhavet || 15||
snānakāle kṛṣṇanāmnāṃ jātastu sahasrakam |
pratyakṣaraṃ miletpuṇyaṃ kapilāśatagopradam || 16||
snānakāle ca kṛṣṇāgre nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ ca vā |
karoti sa tu kṛṣṇasya goloke jāyate priyaḥ || 17||
snānakāle hare jaya kṛṣṇā jayetivādinaḥ |
tālikā vādayataśca na yoniyantranirgamaḥ || 18||
vastrairdhūpena sauvarṇabhūṣaṇaiḥ pūjayanti ye |
śatamanvantaraṃ vāso vaikuṇṭhe ca tataḥ param || 19||
goloke śāśvato vāso bhavati kṛṣṇasevane |
ketakyā cātha tulasīmaṃjaryā kusumaistathā ||1.228.20 ||
mālatyā rukmiṇīpatiṃ pūjayanti ca yā striyaḥ |
krīḍanti saptasu svargabhūmiṣu patinā saha ||21 ||
manvantaraśatapūrṇaṃ tato golokamāpnuyuḥ |
yogināṃ yajñināṃ caiva dānināṃ tīrthasevinām || 22||
pitṛmātṛprabhaktānāṃ dvādaśīvratināṃ tathā |
ekādaśyāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kurvatāṃ nṛtyatāṃ tathā ||23||
gāyatāṃ smaratāṃ vedaghoṣaṇāṃ kurvatāṃ tathā |
viṣṇunāmnāṃ sahasraṃ ca paṭhatāṃ cāpi yatphalam || 24||
tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇapūjāyāṃ tulasyarpaṇato bhavet |
rukmiṇīkṛṣṇapūjāyāḥ phalaṃ cāpi tato’dhikam ||25||
yathā lakṣmīḥ priyā viṣṇoḥ tulasī ca tatodhikā |
yatra kvāpi tulasyā vai pūjito bhavati hariḥ ||26 ||
tatra tasya dvārakāyāstīrthayātrāphalaṃ bhavet |
ketakyāpyarcayet kṛṣṇaṃ pratipuṣpāśvamedhajam ||27||
phalaṃ vai prāpyate cānte golokagatirāpyate |
mālatyā pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ prāpyate ca hareḥ padam ||28||
yathāptapatrapuṣpairvā pūjayecchrīpatiṃ harim |
divyām̐śca mānuṣān bhogān bhuktvā yāti hareḥ padam ||29|
aṣṭākṣaro’yaṃ mantrastu śrīkṛṣṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama |
taṃ japan pūjayetkṛṣṇaṃ candanena sugandhinā ||1.228.30 ||
karpūreṇa ca kastūryā sa ceyāt kṛṣṇatulyatām |
ājyena guggulenāpi dhūpaṃ kuryācca yo hareḥ ||3 1 |
pātakaṃ pravidhūyāsau surūpo jāyate’kṣare |
kṛṣṇāyane dīpamālāṃ kārayati dine dine || 32||
saptadvīpanṛpaḥ syādvai dīpe dīpe phalaṃ hi tat |
naivedyāni vividhāni kṛṣṇāya yo nivedayet ||33||
tasya vai pitarastṛptāḥ śāśvatīṃ muktimāpnuyuḥ |
tāmbūlaṃ karpūrayutaṃ pūgādicūrṇikānvitam || 34||
kṛṣṇāya yacchato nāsti punarjanmātra māyike |

nityā tṛptirbhavet tasya nityāmṛtādipānataḥ |
phalāni cārumiṣṭāni pakvānyarpayatastathā ||36||
anyadapi mukhasyaiva śuddhyarthaṃ dadatastathā |
goloke nityatṛptiḥ syāt sugandhaśvāsavānbhavet ||37||
śrīkṛṣṇasya prakramaṇaṃ karturvairājadhiṣṇyakam |
śrīkṛṣṇamandire puṣpodyānaṃ yaḥ kārayetpari ||38||

cāmarairvyajanairvāyuṃ kṛṣṇāya yā prayacchati || 3|||
tasyā dhāmni svayaṃ kṛṣṇaścūmbati mukhapaṃkajam |
śayyākartryāśca śayyāyāṃ saha svapiti keśavaḥ ||1.228.40 ||
śrīkṛṣṇamaṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ kārayettu yaḥ |
tasya sevāmapsarasaḥ kurvanti kadalīsamāḥ ||41 ||
kṛṣṇālaye patākābhiḥ śobhāṃ karoti yo janaḥ |
sūryaloke tasya vāso sadā bhavati sūryavat ||42||
dhūpacandanasaugandhyuttaraiśca vāsayed hareḥ |
mandiraṃ tasya bhavanaṃ divi vai vāsitaṃ bhavet ||43||
kṛṣṇapādaprasaṃvāhaṃ yā karoti hṛdā sadā |
kṛṣṇena saha goloke ramā bhūtvā pramodate ||44||
bhojanaṃ nūtanaṃ kṛtvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ saṃprabhojayet |
sā vai lakṣmīḥ sadā bhūtvā vaikuṇṭhe śrīhariṃ bhajet ||45||
śrīkṛṣṇasya sadā sevāṃ ye kurvanti janā bhuvi |
devakanyāvṛtāḥ svarge sevyante cāpsarogaṇaiḥ ||46 ||
śrīkṛṣṇaśikhare yaśca dhvajamāropayecchubham |
tasyākṣare pare dhāmni sadhvajaṃ bhavanaṃ bhavet ||47||
śrīkṛṣṇamandire citrakāryaṃ kārayate tu yaḥ |
tasya citramayaṃ dhāmni vimānaṃ bhavati dhruvam ||48||
darpaṇaṃ yaśca kṛṣṇāgre dadyātsa somalokagān |
bhogānākalpamābhuktvā golokaṃ śāśvataṃ vrajet ||49||
chatraṃ bahuśalākaṃ sakṣaumaṃ dadyāttu śārṅgiṇe |
sa vai vairājalokeṣu samrāṭ bhūtvā hariṃ vrajet ||1.228.50||
dadyād yānaṃ vimānaṃ vā vāhaṃ khaṭvāṃ bṛsīṃ kaṭam |
kuberaḥ kalpaparyantaṃ bhūtvānte yānti mokṣaṇam ||51 ||
ārārtrikaṃ hareḥ kuryāt bahuvarttighṛtādibhiḥ |
tasyārārtrikamanvahaṃ kriyate devakoṭibhiḥ ||52||
keśavopari sajalaṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca bhrāmayettu yaḥ |
sa kṣīre sāgare kṛṣṇasannidhau vāsabhāg bhavet ||53||
kṛṣṇapradakṣiṇāṃ kuryāt pṛthvīdānaphalaṃ pade |
kuryād daṇḍanamaskāraṃ cāśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||54||
kīrtanaṃ śrīhareḥ kuryāt sāmavedaphalaṃ labhet |
nṛtyaṃ kuryāddhareragre koṭipāpavināśanam ||55||
vasatāṃ dvārakāṃ golokadhāmāvāsajaṃ phalam |
gomatīnīrapānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryāttasya mokṣaṇam ||56||
gaṃgādvāre prayāge ca gaṃgāyāṃ kurujāṃgale |
puṣkare ca prabhāse ca śrīsthale śuklatīrthake ||57||
cāndrāyaṇasahasrasya phalaṃ tvekadine’tra vai |
dvārikāgomatīkṛṣṇagopītālaprasevinaḥ ||58||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikāvāsakṛṣṇapūjanamāhātmyaphalādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭāviṃśatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||228||

<1.229>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatā ca mahālakṣmi dvārikā gomatī tathā |
nirmitā svarganiḥśreṇiḥ kalau kṛṣṇena gomatī || 1 ||
sukhadā sevināṃ nityaṃ snānamātreṇa mokṣadā |
śilāścakrāṃkitā yatra gomatyudadhisaṃbhavāḥ || 2 ||
dṛṣṭā api paraṃ mokṣaṃ prāpayanti tu darśakān |
yanmṛttikā mokṣadāsti tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevayet || 3 ||
āvantyo brāhmaṇaḥ kaścitsomaśarmetināmakaḥ |
śivabhakto na jānāti tadanyadevatāvratam || 4 ||
caturdaśīṃ karotyeva viṣṇuṃ tu manute nahi |
prativarṣaṃ karoti sma somanāthasya darśanam || 5 ||
saptāyutaṃ gataṃ tasya varṣāṇāṃ jarjaro hyabhūt |
somanāthasya yātrāyāṃ koṭiśo hyabhavan janāḥ || 6 ||
te ca sarve mahattīrthaṃ kṛtvā gatvā ca raivatam |
tato gatāśca dvārikāyātrārthaṃ na gato dvijaḥ || 7 ||
somaśarmā yayau naijaṃ gṛhaṃ suṣvāpa caikalaḥ |
svapne ca pitarastasya pitāmahāḥ samāyayuḥ || 8 ||
prapitāmahayuktāśca bāndhavā vṛddhasantateḥ |
pretarūpāḥ kṣudhāvyāptā raudrāḥ śokasamanvitāḥ || 9 ||
dṛṣṭvā tān bhayamāpannaścovāca saḥ prakampitaḥ |
ke yūyaṃ raudrarūpāḥ stha kutaḥ kasmāt samāgatāḥ || 1.229.10 ||
pretāḥ prāhuśca taṃ putraṃ te smo vayaṃ pitāmahāḥ |
duḥkhitā kṣudhitāścātra tvatsamīpe samāgatāḥ || 11 ||
putraḥ prāha mayā dattaṃ taptaṃ hutaṃ ca bhojitam |
bhavatāṃ tuṣṭilābhāya bhavadbhiścāpi tatkṛtam || 12 ||
kathaṃ tiṣṭhatha pretatve brūta kāraṇamatra me |
pretā ūcuḥ śṛṇu putra viddho vai harivāsaraḥ || 13 ||
kṛto’smābhistvayā cāpi kriyate na harerdinam |
tena doṣeṇa cāsmākaṃ pretatvaṃ duḥkhadaṃ vṛtam || 1 4||
na cāpyuddhāra evāsti tava pāpānmahattarāt |
na tvaṃ kuruṣe bhagavadvrataṃ yātrāṃ karoṣi na || 15 ||
kṛṣṇaṃ na manuṣe putra dvārikāṃ na ca gacchasi |
kevalaṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ bhajase nindasi prabhum || 1 6||
tena doṣeṇa pretatvaṃ prāptāstvamapi prāpsyasi |
na viṣṇudveṣiṇaḥ śaṃbhuḥ kariṣyati hi sadgatim || 17||
śaṃkaro viṣṇubhakto’sti vaiṣṇavāgryaḥ sa vartate |
kṛṣṇanindākarasyāyaṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti naiva ca || 18 ||
haribhaktivihīnānāṃ dvādaśīvratavarjinām |
pāpaṃ nāśaṃ na cāyāti pretatvaṃ na nivartate || 19 ||
vinā keśavapūjāṃ tu pūjyamāne’pi śaṃkare |
nārakaṃ duḥkhadaṃ kaṣṭaṃ pāpaṃ bhavati govadham || 1.229.20 ||
prathamaṃ keśavaḥ pūjyaḥ paścācchrīśaṃkaro’rhati |
pūjanaṃ ca tato devāḥ pūjyāścānye vyavasthitiḥ || 21 ||
tvayā nāstikabhāvena pūjyate na hariḥ svayam |
na pūjā rakṣati śaivī bhāskarī na pitāmahī || 22|
pretabhāvaṃ nārdayati viddhavāsarajaṃ khalu |
vaiśākhe tu tṛtīyāṃ ca viddhāṃ tithiṃ karoti yaḥ || 23 ||
havyaṃ devā na gṛhṇanti kavyaṃ naiva pitāmahāḥ |
kurute yadi mohāttāṃ pretatvaṃ tasya vai dhruvam || 24||
dvādaśī pūrṇamāsī ca pitroḥ samvatsaraṃ dinam |
pūrvaviddhaṃ prakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || 25||
praṇamya somanāthaṃ tvaṃ dvārakāṃ naiva gacchasi |
karoṣi kṛṣṇasevāṃ na yātrāyāste phalaṃ nahi ||26||
tasmāt someśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā gantavyaṃ dvārakāpurīm |
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ dvārakāṃ yāti naiva yaḥ ||27||
sa patennarake ghore pitṛbhiḥ saha putraka |
tadvayaṃ patitāḥ sarve pātitāśca punastvayā ||28|||
nirgamo yamalokācca tadasmākaṃ na dṛśyate |
gomatīnīrasamparkāt kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokanāt ||29||
gopīsaraḥśrāddhadānāt taranti pitaraḥ suta |
kṛṣṇasya dvārakāṃ gatvā paśyānanaṃ hareḥ prabhoḥ || 1.229.30 ||
śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ samudrasya gomatīsaṃgame kuru |
tarpaṇaṃ gopikātāle kuru kṛṣṇasamarpaṇam || 3 1||
tava puṇyaṃ bhavecchubhraṃ cāsmākaṃ ca gatirbhavet |
pūjite devadeveśe kṛṣṇe rukmiṇīsevite ||32 ||
pūjitāśca vayaṃ puṣṭiṃ kurmaḥ putrapautrikīm |
pretayonivinirmuktā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim ||33||
gomatīniradhau tasya na vai pretatvamasti hi |
tatra śrāddhapradānena pitṛtṛptiśca mokṣaṇam ||34||
tīrthakoṭisahasraiśca tatra śrāddhaiśca yatphalam |
tatphalaṃ labhyate sarvaṃ dvārakāyāṃ jalārpaṇāt ||35||
yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ kṛṣṇabhojane cāpi yatphalam |
tatphalaṃ prāpyate koṭikalpatṛptikaraṃ śubham ||36||
dvārakāvāsināṃ muktiḥ śāśvatī sarvathā matā |
na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||37||
yā nārī vidhavā nityaṃ kurute dvārakāśrayam |
sā tu lakṣmīrbhavatyeva kṛṣṇasya priyakāriṇī ||38||
kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ gatvā yo’rcayet tulasīdalaiḥ |
prāptaṃ janmaphalaṃ tena tāritāśca pitāmahāḥ ||39|||
tulasīdalamālāṃ ca kṛṣṇottīrṇāṃ tu yo vahet |
patre patre’śvamedhānāṃ daśānāṃ jāyate phalam ||1.229.40 ||
tulasīmālayā yuktaḥ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ samācaret |
pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca svalpaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet ||41 ||
tulasīkāṣṭhamālāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dravanti yāmakāḥ |
yadgṛhe tulasīkāṣṭhaṃ patraṃ śuṣkamathārdrakam 42||
bhavate tadgṛhe naiva pāpasaṃkramaṇaṃ kvacit |
tasmātputra tulasyāśca mālāṃ dhṛtvā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||43|||
bhūtvā gaccha hareḥ saumyāṃ dvārakāṃ śrāddhamāvaha |
tarpaṇaṃ ca kuru tīrthajalaiścātaḥ pramokṣaya ||44||
unmolanī ca śayanī triḥspṛśā pakṣavardhinī |
tvayā putra prakartavyā jayantī vijayā jayā |||45||
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī prakartavyā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī |
sarvasampatpradā mokṣapradā gaccha sukhān kuru ||46||
iti śrutvā ca pitṝṇāṃ pretānāṃ dvārakāṃ dvijaḥ |
candraśarmā yayau nityagolokadhāmasadṛśīm ||47||
yatra śrīrukmiṇīkṛṣṇaḥ tīrthāni santi sarvadā |
yajñāśca devatā yatra tiṣṭhanti munayo’malāḥ ||48||
kinnaraiḥ siddhagandharvaiḥ sevyate yā ca dvārakā |
svargārohaṇaniḥśreṇirvartate yatra gomatī || 49||
yasyāḥ sīmapraviṣṭasya naśyanti pāpaparvatāḥ |
sā purī dvijavaryeṇa dṛṣṭā nirmalanetrataḥ ||1.229.50 ||
mudaṃ prāpto dvijastatra gomatīṃ kṛṣṇamandiram |
kṛṣṇaṃ ca sāgaraṃ dvārāvatīṃ nanāma bhāvataḥ ||51 ||
mene ca kṛtakṛtyaṃ svaṃ dhanyaṃ bhāgyodayānvitam |
tīrthakoṭisahasrāṇāṃ nādyāsti me prayojanam |||52||
śuklā vaiśākhamāsasya samprāptā madhusūdanī |
dvādaśī triḥspṛśā nāma koṭipāpanikṛntanī ||53||
ahau puṇyodayo jāto mayā dṛṣṭādya dvārakā |
iti kṛtvā tvapaḥ spṛṣṭvā snātvā santarpya devatāḥ ||54||
cakratīrthaṃ samāsādyānarca cakrāṃkitāṃ śilām |
kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ ṣoḍaśopacāraśca pūjanam ||55||
śivasya pūjanaṃ caiva cakre bhāvasamanvitaḥ |
pitṝṇāṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca jalaṃ datvā vidhānataḥ ||56||
hareḥ snāpanaṃ dugdhena candanena vilepanam |
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ navānnaṃ kandamūlakam ||57||
tāmbūlaṃ karpūraṃ vastraṃ phalamārārtrikaṃ tathā |
pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskāraṃ stavanaṃ kusumāñjalim ||58||
daṇḍavacca kṣamāyāñcāṃ kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ tathā |
rātrau yāmatraye’tīte prārthanā sa cakāra vai ||59||
kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa hare kṛṣṇa nārāyaṇa namo’stu te |
dīnāndhaduḥkhamagnānāṃ tvameva śaraṇaṃ sukham ||1.229.6 0 ||
tava pādaprasevāyāḥ phalaṃ nityaṃ mahāsukham |
duḥkhaṃ sarvaṃ vinaśyedvai tava dvādaśīsevinām ||6 1 ||
daśamīvedhajaṃ pāpaṃ yatkṛtaṃ mama pūrvajaiḥ |
tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yātu mokṣaṃ yāntu ca pūrvajāḥ ||62||
yathā pretatvaśūnyāḥ syurmama pūrvapitāmahāḥ |
muktiṃ prayānti deveśa tathā kuru jagatpate ||63||
mayā śivaprabhaktena tavāpi helanaṃ kṛtam |
pūjanaṃ vandanaṃ tīrthaṃ me darśanaṃ naiva yat kṛtam ||64||
tajjanyaṃ yanmahatapāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu me sadā |
na kṛtā dvārakāyātrā na kṛṣṇo’tra prasevitaḥ ||65||
na snātā gomatī yacca doṣa mārjaya taddhare |
adyaprabhṛti dāso’smi vaiṣṇavastava keśava ||66||
tava pūjā tava vrataṃ tava pāṭhaṃ ca sevanam |
lepanaṃ kīrtanaṃ stotraṃ kariṣye vandanaṃ tava ||67||
śravaṇaṃ te kathāyāśca pādodakasya dhāraṇam |
naivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ te ca kariṣyāmi hare sadā ||68||
prasanno bhava bhagavan pāpaṃ prajvālaya mama |
muktiṃ kuru ca pitṝṇāṃ prārthanāṃ svīkuru prabho ||69||
śrutvaitadvacanaṃ devaḥ śrīkṛṣṇaḥ prāvirāsa vai |
candracaryan tava bhaktyā tuṣṭo’smi pitaraśca te ||1.229.70||
tvaṃ ca pāpāni nirdhūya gantāro mama dhāma yat |
uktvā kṛṣṇastiro’bhūcca pitaraḥ samupasthitāḥ ||71 ||
procuḥ putra tava yatnānmuktiṃ prāptā na saṃśayaḥ |
gomatī nīradānena piṇḍadānena darśanāt ||72||
pretayonivinirmuktā gacchāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim |
dhanyāste pitaro loke yatkule dvārakāṃ sutaḥ ||73||
gatvā tu tārayet pitṝn kṛṣṇasevādibhiḥ sadā |
dhanyā sā vidhavā nārī kṛṣṇayātrāṃ karoti yā ||74||
tārayatyeva janakaṃ svāminaṃ ca kulaṃ śatam |
śvapaco’pi yadi tīrthaṃ karoti kṛṣṇamānasaḥ || 75||
sa yāti paramāṃ muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
yasmāt sarvāṇi tīrthāni sarvadevāstathā makhāḥ ||76||
dvārakāyāṃ samāyānti trikālaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau |
phalaṃ samagratīrthānāṃ tato’tra labhate janaḥ ||77||
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ yastu dvārakāṃ naiva paśyati |
dhik sutaṃ ca kulaṃ tasya pitaro narake sthitāḥ ||78||
brahmā rudrastathā sūryo mahendrādyāśca devatāḥ |
mānavāśca nṛpā viprāḥ sarpā nāgāśca pattalāḥ ||79||
nadā nadyaśca śailāśca vanānyupavanāni ca |
puryo grāmā nagaryaśca sāgarāśca sarāṃsi ca ||1.229.80 ||
yakṣā gaṇāśca gandharvāḥ siddhā vidyādharāstathā |
apsarasaśca paryaśca dhanado daityarākṣasāḥ ||81||
ṛṣayo munayo yogāḥ sanakādyāśca sādhavaḥ |
sādhvyaśca yoginīcakraṃ sāṃkhyayoginya ityapi ||82||
gṛhanakṣatrayogāśca dhruvaśca lokapālakāḥ |
yatkiṃcittu trilokyāṃ vai vartate sthāṇujaṃgamam |||83 ||
śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau nityaṃ tiṣṭhate pratyahaṃ hi tat |
na tyajati purīṃ puṇyāṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇamaṇḍitām ||84||
sā tvayā sevitā putra vayaṃ ca kṛṣṇadarśanāt |
pretayonipramuktāḥ smo gacchāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim ||85 ||
svasti te’stu na gacchāmo golokaṃ divyadhāma tat |
prāptaṃ kṛṣṇapadaṃ putra tvaṃ ca gantāsi dhāma tat ||86||
na kalau phaladā vedā na dānāni makhā na ca |
gomatī phaladā svargamokṣadā sarvathā matā ||87||
kalau kāśī ca mathurā hyavantī revatācalaḥ |
ayodhyā kuṃkumavāpī kāṃcī ca puruṣottamā ||88||
śālagrāmā nadī māyā badarī ca tathā gayā |
kurukṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ śuklatīrthakam ||89||
prayāgaśca prabhāsaśca hāṭakeśvara ityapi |
gaṃgādvāraṃ ca vārāhaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamaḥ ||1.229.9 0||
naimiṣaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ tathā vṛndāvanaṃ suta |
sindhukṣetraṃ cārbudaṃ ca sarvāraṇyāni yāni ca ||9 1 ||
vanānyāyatanānyeva tathoparāṇi yāni ca |
śailā śaileyatīrthāni himāni ca vanāni ca ||92||
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve kṛṣṇasevanalālasāḥ |
pāpanāśaprakāmāśca divyānandābhilāṣukāḥ ||93||
tiṣṭhanti gomatīnīre dvārakāyāṃ kalau yuge |
nāsti vai triṣu lokeṣu purī tu dvārakāsamā ||94||
tavāyuḥpūrṇatāprāptau mṛtyurdivyo bhaviṣyati |
triḥspṛśāvāsare śukle vaiśākhe budhavāsare || 95||
brahmarandhreṇa te yānaṃ bhaviṣyati harergṛhe |
ityuktvā pitarastasya caturbhujasvarūpiṇaḥ ||96||
divyavimānasaṃsthāśca yātā golokadhāma tat |
somaśarmā yayau svasya gṛhaṃ bhūtvā ca vaiṣṇavaḥ ||97||
āyuṣo’nta tu samprāpte gatvā dvāravatīṃ purīm |
prāṇān kṛṣṇopadeśena tyaktvā mokṣaṃ jagāma saḥ ||98||
śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam |
jāyate vai phalaṃ sarvaṃ cānte mokṣo bhaved dhruvaḥ ||99||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śivabhaktasya somaśarmaṇaḥ pitṝṇāṃ dvārakāyātrādinā mokṣaṇanirūpaṇanāmaikonatriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||229||

<1.230>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śaṃkhoddhāraṃ mahātīrthaṃ śaṃkhāsuro’tra śārṅgiṇā |
uddhārito’sti kṛṣṇena tatra gacchettu muktaye || 1 ||
prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni gaṃgādyā āpagāstathā |
śailāḥ samudrāḥ kṣetrāṇi divyāścaityadrumāstathā || 2 ||
aśvamedhādayo yajñā mahendrādyāśca devatāḥ |
bhṛgvādyāḥ ṛṣayaścaiva gandharvāstumburuprathāḥ || 3 ||
dhaneśāśca kuberādyā viśvaksenādipārṣadāḥ |
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca siddhāścāpsarasastathā || 4 ||
paryo’tha kiṃ bahuktena trailokyaṃ jaḍacetanam |
adhyātmasaṃsargagataṃ śaṃkhoddhāre pratiṣṭhati || 5 ||
ye smaranti gṛhe nityaṃ śaṃkhoddhāraṃ mahatsaraḥ |
teṣāṃ na punarāvṛttiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 6 ||
ye tu smaranti manasā śaṃkhoddhāraṃ ca śaṃkhinam |
kulakoṭiśatairyuktāḥ kṛṣṇaloke vasanti te || 7 ||
yatphalaṃ tu sarasvatyāṃ sūryagrahaṇakoṭibhiḥ |
yo yatīn bhojayed bhaktyā nityamabdaśataṃ naraḥ || 8 ||
śaṃkhoddhāre ca nuḥ snātuḥ kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm |
trīṇi koṭīni sārdhāni tīrthānāṃ ca mama priye || 9 ||
śaṃkhoddhāre nivāso’sti sarvatīrthaphalaṃ tataḥ |
brahmahatyāsahasrāṇi cāgamyāgamanāni ca || 1.230.10 ||
pāpāni nāśamāyānti śaṃkhoddhārajalaspṛśeḥ |
yo dadyād gāṃ gṛhaṃ svarṇe labhate koṭijaṃ phalam || 11 ||
kurukṣetrasya vāsena gaṃgāyāṃ maraṇena ca |
gomatīsnānamātreṇa phalaṃ śaṃkhasthadarśanāt || 12||
jalamadhye samudrasya dvārakā cātidurjayā |
tasyā madhye sthito devaḥ śaṃkhī pāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 1 3||
tataḥ piṇḍārakaṃ tīrthaṃ gacchedvai pāpanāśakam |
yatra kṛṣṇaścaturbāhuḥ svayaṃ santiṣṭhate sadā || 14||
sarit rukmavatī yatra tatra snātvā vimucyate |
agastyasya ṛṣestatra taḍāgaṃ lokaviśrutam || 15||
snātvā śrāddhaṃ tathā kṛtvā pitṝnvai mocayet sutaḥ |
yajñavāṭastathā tīrthaṃ yatra pūrvaḥ prajāpatiḥ || 16 ||
yajñaṃ cakāra vidhinā savalokahitāya vai |
yajñanāśayiturhastau yatra daityasya kartitau || 17||
viṣṇunā devadevena taddṛṣṭvā mucyate hyaghāt |
pitarastatra piṇḍān vai samicchanti sutṛptaye || 18||
vaiśākhe tu kṛte śrāddhe mucyate pātakatrayāt |
dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ vrataṃ jāpastarpaṇaṃ kāryamityapi || 19||
aśvamedhasahasrasya rājasūyaśatasya ca |
pade pade phalaṃ syācca dvārakāṃ gacchatastu nuḥ ||1.230.20||
piṇḍārakaṃ smarataśca tatphalaṃ bhavati dhruvam |
śrīkṛṣṇaṃ mandire dṛṣṭvā śaṃkhoddhāre tu śaṃkhinam || 21 ||
piṇḍārake caturbāhūm vīkṣya muktimavāpnuyāt |
śrīḥ kṛṣṇaścakratīrthaṃ ca piṇḍārakaṃ ca gomatī ||22|
gopīcandanamevāpi tulasī durlabhā kalau |
tāni milanti tu dvāravatyāṃ kṛṣṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||23||
varddhinī dvārakā gaṃgā lakṣmīrgovinda ityapi |
gomatī gopikātālamṛttikā ceti durlabhāḥ ||24||
yasya jāgaraṇaṃ jātaṃ vardhinī dvādaśīdine |
punarjanmakṛtaṃ dagdhaṃ tena bhaktena sarvathā |||25|||
trispṛśāvāsare yena kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ priye |
keśavasya śarīre vai sa līno bhavati dhruvam ||26 ||
kṛṣṇāya preṃkhā dātavyā tasyāḥ puṇyamanantakam |
svarṇapreṃkhā rājatīṃ vā kāṣṭhīyā vā tathāmbarī || 27||
deyā vai viṣṇave tasyāḥ phalaṃ vaikuṇṭhavāsanam |
preṃkhāyāṃ ca hariṃ kṛṣṇamāndolayenmuhuḥ śanaiḥ || 28||
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ caiva mokṣadaṃ puṇyamatra yat |
kanyādānaṃ gayāśrāddhamaśvatthāropaṇaṃ tathā ||29|||
dvādaśyāṃ jāgaraścāpi vājimedhāyutaiḥ samam |
nimiṣe nimiṣe lakṣmi cāśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet ||1.230.30 ||
sarve devāśca tīrthāni muktāśca munayastathā |
samāyānti jāgaraṇe hyekādaśyāṃ niśi prabhoḥ ||3 1 ||
yāvatpadāni gṛhataḥ kṛṣṇasyāyatanaṃ prati |
jāgarārthaṃ gacchataśca pādayoḥ pāṃsavaḥ khalu ||32||
spṛśanti yāvatsaṃkhyāni tāvatsahasravatsarāḥ |
diviṃ bhogān prabhuktvā ca golokaṃ dhāma cāpnuyāt||| 32 ||
ekadā śaṃkaraṃ devī pārvatī prāha jāgare |
kathaṃ śaṃbho vādayan vai rātrau ḍamaruṃ nṛtyasi ||34||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha mayā devī harivāsarajāgaraḥ |
kriyate kṛṣṇatuṣṭyarthaṃ yatrālasyaṃ bhavennahi ||35||
yathākathaṃcidapi tu jāgaritavyameva vai |
saṃgītena sunṛtyena kīrtanena surāsataḥ |||36 ||
naranārīsamudāyakṛtotsavena krīḍayā |
kathayā vārtayā tālīvādanena ca sevayā ||37||
kṛṣṇaṃ smaratā bhaktena jāgaritavyameva yat |
yatrālasyaṃ pramādo vā bhavennaiva tathācaret || 38 ||
ityahaṃ kṛṣṇatuṣṭyarthaṃ karomi nṛtyajāgaram |
tvayā punaridaṃ kāryaṃ smartavyaḥ kamalāpatiḥ || 39 ||
ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kartavyo jāgarastathā |
goṣṭhyāṃ samāgatastatra sopi yāti parāṃ gatim || 1.230.40 ||
merumandaramātrāśca kṛtāḥ pāpasya rāśaya |
kṛṣṇajāgaraṇe sarve uhyanti tūlarāśivat || 41 ||
sarvatīrthakratubhyo’pi jāgaraḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ |
sarve devāḥ samāyānti jāgare kṛṣṇavallabhe || 42||
nāryo bhavanti hṛdyāśca jāgare kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ |
ityuktvā ca haropi virarāma kṛṣṇavallabhe || 43 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne dvārikāyāṃ śakhoddhāratīrthapiṇḍārakatīrtharukmavatī saridagastyataḍāgayajñatīrthaikādaśīdvādaśī vratajāgaraṇādipraśaṃsananāmā triṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 230 ||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca 
śṛṇu lakṣmi siṃharāśigate bṛhaspatau muniḥ |
