hareryogānmahālakṣmi tvatsamā sābhavad divi |
rūpakāntisamāyuktā vaiṣṇavī mama vallabhā ||96 ||
ṣaṭtilāphalalābhena saudho’nnāmṛtasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
samabhavattadā drākca nānyatrāto’dhikaṃ hyabhūt ||97||
bhavanaṃ bahusampannaṃ ṣaṭtilāpuṇyalābhataḥ |
dhanadhānyasuvastrādisvarṇarūpyādisaṃbhṛtam ||98||
bhuktaṃ ca kalpaparyantaṃ tataḥ kapilayā tayā |
nitye laye samāyātā kapilā mama mandiram ||99||
caturbhujābhavattatra ramārūpā mama priyā |
bhajate māṃ sakhī te sā sevanānme’tibhāvataḥ || 1.242.10 0||
tato yaistu kṛtaṃ sākṣāt ṣaṭtilāvratamuttamam |
kiṃ kiṃ tena na cāpyeta sarvaṃ prāpyeta sarvathā || 101 ||
labhed bhuktiṃ ca muktiṃ ca madyogāttiladāvratī |
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ lobhaḥ kāryo na tu kvacit || 1 02|||
dānaṃ sarvavidhaṃ deyaṃ dattaṃ prāpyeta bhāvini |
ātmavittānusāreṇa tilān dhānyāni dāpayet || 1 03||
vastrānnavāhanayānagṛhavāryupasādhanam |
nairogyaṃ labhate’mutra dadate yo’tra janmani || 1 04||
na dāridryaṃ na ca kaṣṭaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na śūnyatām |
na bhinnatvaṃ vrajed bhaktaḥ ṣaṭtilāyā upoṣaṇāt || 1 05||
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ tiladānaṃ vidhānataḥ |
pātakairmucyate bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca labhate’tigām || 1 06||
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyād yadvā śrāvayecca paṭhecca vā |
tasya puṇyaṃ ṣaṭtilāyā vratajaṃ bhavati priye || 1 07||
nāśubhaṃ śiṣyate kiṃcitparatrātra virodhakṛt |
ātmapuṇyaṃ vrajedvipro vijayaṃ kṣatriyo vrajet || 108||
dhanasmṛddhiṃ vrajed vaiśyaḥ sukhaṃ cānyo lasetparam |
dharmaṃ prāpnoti dharmārthī kāmārthī pramadāṃ labhet || 1 09||
dhanārthī dhanamāpnoti putrārthī satsutaṃ laset |
yaśovipulamāpnoti jñātimūrdhanyamityapi || 1.242.11 0||
acaṃcalā śriyaṃ labdhvā śreyaḥ paramavāpnuyāt |
bhayanāśo bhavatyasya tejovīryaṃ ca vindati || 11 1||
ṣaṭtilāvratasampannā nārī priyapatiṃ laset |
putrapautradhanadhānyākhaṇḍasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 1 12||
labdhvā kāmasukhaṃ cātra divi devī pramodate |
vaiṣṇavī ca ramā bhūtvā hareḥ śayyāsu modate || 1 13||
vaikuṇṭhe cātha goloke yauvanārthasukhāni 3 |
aśnute svapatikṛṣṇahariṇā saha sarvadā || 1 14||
ṣaṭtilāyāḥ samaṃ cānyad vrataṃ nāsti sukhapradam |
padmayā ca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ sā tvaṃ lakṣmīrmamāsi vai || 1 15||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māghakṛṣṇaṣaṭtilaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vratapuṇyāt kapilānāryā devītvaṃ ramātvaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvicatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 242 ||

<1.243>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
hare kṛṣṇa kṛpāsindho jagaduddhārakāraka |
māghaśuklaikādaśīṃ me kathayasva prasādataḥ || 1 ||
ko vidhiḥ ko’dhidevo’tra vratasya phalamityapi |
kathayasvodyāpanaṃ ca vratino bhuktimuktidam || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi māghaśukle jayānāmetipuṇyadā |
pāpahantrī mokṣakartrī kāmadātrī sukhapradā || 3 ||
ekādaśī samākhyātā kartavyā vratinā śubhā |
brahmahatyādihantrī ca piśācatvādināśinī || 4 ||
sarvasampatkarī rājñāṃ saṃgrāme jayadāyinī |
svarge jayapradā loke vyavahāre jayapradā || 5 ||
yatra kutrāpi kārye sā kṛtā jayaphalā matā |
tatphalaṃ jayadaṃ proktaṃ triṣu lokeṣu yāyinām || 6 ||
etasmātkāraṇāllakṣmi kartavyā sā prayatnataḥ |
daśamyāmekabhuktena naktamātreṇa vā svayam || 7 ||
dehayātrāṃ nirvaham̐śca rātrau bhūśayanaṃ caret |
prātarutthāya ca brāhme muhūrtte śrīhariṃ smaret || 8 ||
śaucasnānādikaṃ kṛtvā sandhyāvandanamācaret |
gāyatrīṃ ca japitvātha hareḥ pūjāṃ samācaret || 9 ||
nityayā saha saṃpūjyo mādhavastatpatiḥ prabhuḥ |
pañcāmṛtena vai pūrvaṃ snāpayedabhiṣecanaiḥ || 1.243.1 0||
śuddhatīrthajalaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ snāpayellepayed dravam |
sugandhasārottamatailacandanādi vilepayet || 11 ||
punaśca snāpayettīrthajalairvastrāṇi dhārayet |
mukuṭaṃ kuṇḍale hārān kaṭakāṃgadasūrmikāḥ || 12||
śṛṅkhalāraśanāratnahīrakādikṛtāni ca |
vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi tathā divyāni dhārayet || 13||
gulālākṣatakuṃkumābīraiḥ saṃpūjayet prabhum |
dhūpadīpaistathā puṣpairbakulasya prapūjayet || 14||
tatkālaprodbhavaiścānyaiḥ kamalai sthalapadmakaiḥ |
śṛṅgārahāraiḥ satpatraistulasīmaṃjarīyutaiḥ || 19||
pūjayecchrīhariṃ cātha candanairgandhivastubhiḥ |
miṣṭānnāni tu naivedye bījapūraphalāni ca || 16||
maṇḍakā laḍḍukā mudgabhavā meśubhamauktikāḥ |
dātavyā haraye dugdhapākaḥ sugandhamiśritāḥ || 17||
dāḍimaṃ navaraṃgaṃ ca nārikelaphalaṃ tathā |
dātavyāni tathā drākṣāphalāni kadalāni ca || 18||
ārārtrikaṃ tathā kāryaṃ pradakṣiṇādikaṃ tataḥ |
puṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣamāṃ prārthya tato vai vratamarthayet || 19||
adyāhaṃ vai jayānāmnyā ekādaśyā vrataṃ śubham |
karomi kṛṣṇa te’tīva prasannatvaprasaktaye ||1.243.20||
tad vrataṃ me prasaṃpūrṇaṃ bhavatvatra kṛpāṃ kuru |
iti prārthya tato natvā devadevaṃ ca mādhavam ||21||
śobhitaṃ saptadhānyaiḥ san maṇḍalaṃ kārayed vratī |
madhye svarṇaghaṭaṃ saṃsthāpayet tāmraghaṭaṃ ca vā ||22||
pañcapallavaratnādijalavastrādiśobhite |
tilapātraṃ ghaṭe tatra sthāpayet phalasaṃyutam ||23||
ghaṭaṃ prapūjayettatra tīrthānyāvāhayettathā |
svarṇamūrtiṃ mādhavasya jayayā saha nirmitām ||24||
nityayā ca tathā patnyā sahitāṃ sthāpayettathā |
pūjayeccāvāhanādikrameṇa snāpayettathā ||25||
vibhūṣayettathā puṣpabhojanādi samarpayet |
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyairarcayedbahubhāvataḥ ||26||
jalapānaṃ samarpyātha nīrājayecca mādhavam |
tāmbūlaṃ cārpayettatrāparādhām̐śca kṣamāpayet ||27||
vratārthaṃ prārthayet pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ me ca bhavediti |
gośca prapūjanaṃ kuryād godānaṃ cāpi kārayet ||28||
bhūdānaṃ vastradānaṃ ca svarṇadānaṃ ca kārayet |
paścātpūjāṃ samāpyaivaṃ kuryātkāryaṃ svakaṃ dine || 29||
madhyāhne’pi tathā bhakṣyabhojyalehyasucośyakam |
annaṃ caturvidhaṃ dadyāddevāya mādhavāya vai || 1.243.3 0||
sāyaṃ niśi tathā kṛṣṇapūjārthaṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubham |
kārayettu mahāntaṃ ca tatrolleccaṃ prabandhayet ||3 1 ||
pūjanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtvā nīrājayedvidhānataḥ |
naivedyaṃ ca kṣamādānaṃ kṛtvā tato hareḥ puraḥ ||32||
maṇḍape rāsarītyā śrīhareḥ padyāni gāpayet |
kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ rātrau raṃjayetkṛṣṇamatyati ||33||
bhaktairnṛtyaṃ kīrtanaṃ ca savāditraṃ ca jāgaram |
kartavyaṃ ca tataḥ prātaḥ snātvārcyo mādhavaḥ prabhuḥ ||34||
dānāni vividhānyeva deyāni ca yathābalam |
sādhūn sādhvīrbrāhmaṇām̐śca bhojayecca niveditam ||35||
tataḥ svayaṃ pāraṇāṃ ca kuryādevaṃ vrataṃ kṛte |
phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhavatyeva vijayaḥ sarvathā bhavet|||36||
śṛṇu tvatra vrate pūrvāṃ kathāṃ lakṣmi vadāmi te |
svarge loke mahendre vai śāsati devatāgaṇāḥ || 37||
vasanti sukhinaḥ sarve pīyūṣapānapoṣitāḥ |
apsarobhiśca devībhiḥ parībhiśca samarcitāḥ ||38||
pūjitāḥ sukhitā devā ramante nandane vane |
ramayanti ca devīśca nṛtyanti kīrtayanti ca ||39||
nandanākhye vane divye svargaṃgā yā jalāntike |
udyāne puṣpaśobhāḍhye sugandhyanilasevite ||1.243.40||
pravṛttaṃ nartanaṃ cāpsarasāmindrasya tuṣṭaye |
gandharvāstatra gāyanti nṛtyantyapsarasastadā ||41 ||
vādayanti ca gandharvāstālasyāpūrikāḥ striyaḥ |
evaṃ tu gāyane nṛtye pravṛtte’tipraharṣataḥ ||42||
darśako’pi mahendraḥ svecchayā raṅge hyupasthitaḥ |
nanartendraḥ saharṣaḥ svapañcāśatkoṭināyakaḥ ||43||
gandharvāḥ sahagāyanti puṣpadantaśca susvaraḥ |
citrasenastathā tasya patnī puṣpavatī tathā ||44||
puṣpadantasya putraśca mālyavānnāmatastathā |
puṣpavatyāḥ svarūpe ca mālyavānmohitastadā ||45||
puṣpavatyā kaṭākṣaiśca mālyavān svavaśe kṛtaḥ |
puṣpavatī mālyavām̐śca nṛtyārthamindratuṣṭaye ||46||
samāgatau ca kāmena parītāṃgau babhūvatuḥ |
cittabhramasamāyuktau kāmabāṇavaśaṃgatau ||47||
gāyataḥ śuddhagānaṃ na baddhadṛṣṭī ca rāgataḥ |
nṛtyatīndrastu vai samyaṅ nṛtyānusāri gāyanam ||48||
tayoḥ kṣatiṃ samagacchattālamānavilopanam |
cintayitvā tu maghavā saṃgataṃ mānasaṃ tayoḥ ||49||
samakālīnavaigaṇyaṃ tāle māne ca gāyane |
kramalopaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā matvāvajñāṃ tathātmanaḥ ||1.243.50||
kupitaśca tayostatra śaśāpa ca vadannidam |
dhiṅyuvā patitau mūḍhau manmahattāprabhaṃjakau ||5 1||
svarge viṣayabāhulye bhujyamāne’pi sarvadā |
tṛptirnāsti na me śreṣṭhyamaryādārakṣaṇe matiḥ ||52||
nṛtyakāle mama dākṣye protsāhe’pi yuvāṃ yataḥ |
vigaṇayya sabhāmadhye nṛtyaṃ vai mohitau kimu ||53 ||
tasmāt piśācau bhavataṃ dampatīrupadhāriṇau |
na gandharvasthitiyogyau gauravabhaṃgakārakau ||54||
martyalokamanuprāptau bhuṃjānau karmaṇaḥ phalam |
duḥkhaṃ cānubhavantau vai tiṣṭhataṃ tu ciraṃ samāḥ ||55||
evaṃ mahendraśāpāttau himādrau tvatidāruṇe |
piśācatāṃ gatau duḥkhaistaptau śāntiṃ na ceyatuḥ ||56||
gandharvatvaṃ cāpsaratvaṃ vismṛtau ceraturvane |
tuṣāreṇātivegena pīḍyamāno muhurmuhuḥ ||57||
dantagharṣaṃ prakurvāṇau vadataśca parasparam |
piśācaḥ samuvāca svāṃ priyāṃ patnīṃ piśācikām ||58||
aho cālpāparādhasya phalaṃ duḥkhatamaṃ mahat |
narakaṃ dāruṇaṃ cedaṃ piśācarūpakaṃ khalu ||59||
kadā syādantavaccaitat kadā śāntirmiliṣyati |
śaityaṃ cātitamaṃ tvatra pīḍā tenātijāyate ||1.243.60||
iti cintāparau tau ca kṣudhāduḥkhātikarṣitau |
pippalākhyadevataroḥ stambe vāsaṃ pracakratuḥ ||61 ||
himapātena daśamīrātrau caikādaśīdine |
caikādaśyāstathā rātrau himajhaṃjhānilena tau ||62||
vepamānau bhojanārthaṃ nirgatau na svavāsataḥ |
daivayogātsa divaso māghasyaikādaśī jayā ||63||
upoṣitā niśā tābhyāṃ sujāgarayutā kṛtā |
tatrāstāṃ tāvubhau bhojyajalapānādivarjitau ||64||
kaṣṭena himavātena sarvāhāravivarjitau |
na kṛto jīvaghātaśca na prāptaṃ phalabhakṣaṇam ||65||
na pānaṃ salilasyāpi jātaṃ nendriyaraṃjanam |
na ca nidrāpi saṃjātā na tau saukhyamavindatām ||66||
tayorduḥkhitayoritthaṃ nirjagāma niśīthinī |
prātaḥ sūryodaye prāpte dvādaśyāṃ ca mayā tayoḥ ||67||
pippalavṛkṣarūpeṇa kṛtā bhaktidhṛtā hṛdi |
aśvattho’haṃ hi vṛkṣāṇāṃ bhavāmi mūrtimān yataḥ ||68||
tayorāśrayadātāhaṃ vrataṃ jayātithestayoḥ |
gaṇayan jāgarāḍhyaṃ ca phalaṃ vratasya vai dadau ||69||
tena phalaprabhāveṇa piśācatvaṃ gataṃ tayoḥ |
divyarūpau tu gandharvau pūrvarūpau babhūvatuḥ ||1.243.70 ||
purātanasnehayutau pūrvālaṃkāraśobhitau |
puṣpāvatīmālyavantau vimānavaramāsthitau ||71 ||
gatau svargaṃ ca devendraṃ praṇāmaṃ cakraturmudā |
tau devau devagandharvau vīkṣyendro vismito’bravīt ||72 ||
vadataṃ kena puṇyena vinaṣṭā vāṃ piśācatā |
mama śāpāttu muninā kena vai mocitau yuvām || 73 ||
prā śca tadā tau taṃ daivayogena devarāṭ |
vāsudevaprasādena jayāyāstu vratena ca ||74||
piśācatvaṃ vinaṣṭaṃ nau tava bhaktiprabhāvataḥ |
śrutveti maghavā hṛṣṭaḥ punastāvāha cādarāt |||75 ||
yuvāṃ hareḥ kṛpāpātravaryau jātau vratāhataḥ |
tasmātpūjyau mama jātau vratapuṇyaprabhāvataḥ ||76||
sadā sudhāṃ tu pibata vacanānme’tiharṣataḥ |
ramethāṃ ca sadā svarge yathāsaukhyaṃ yuvāṃ priyau ||77||
harivrataprakartāro harerbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ |
martyā amartyā ye kecittvasmatpūjyāḥ sadaiva te ||78||
evaṃ lakṣmi ca tau gandharvīgandharvau piśācakau |
punarjātau svarnivāsau jayāyā vratavaibhavāt ||79||
etasmātkāraṇāllakṣmi kartavyaṃ ca jayāvratam |
jayā pāpaharā puṇyapradā svargapradā tathā ||1.243.80 ||
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśinī mokṣadāyinī |
sarvadānāni dattāni kṛtaṃ yena jayāvratam ||8 1 ||
sarve’pi kratavastena kṛtāḥ kṛte jayāvrate |
kṛtāḥ paropakārāśca kṛte śreṣṭhe jayāvrate ||82||
dhanadhānyasutapatnīgṛhagovājisatpatim |
labhate māghaśuklaikādaśījayāvratena vai ||83 ||
nātra paratra kiñcidvai durlabhaṃ vratino bhavet |
sulabhaṃ syāddhareryogād durlabhaṃ naiva vidyate ||84||
kartavyaṃ sarvathā tasmādvrataṃ jayāsuvāsare |
kalpakoṭiṃ vaset kartā vaikuṇṭhe modate dhruvam ||85 ||
vratasyāsya kathāyāśca śravaṇātpaṭhanādapi |
agniṣṭomaphalaṃ syādvai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ ca vindati ||86 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne māghaśuklajayaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ mālyavatīmālyavannāmagandharvayoḥ piśācatvaprāptayoḥ vratena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā tricatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 243 ||

<1.244>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
bhaktavallabha bhakteśa ramāvallabha matpate |
mama sarvasva gopāla lakṣmīpāla dayānidhe || 1 ||
dharmapāla sadācārapravartaka surārcita |
phālgunasya kṛṣṇapakṣe kābhidhā kathayasva sā || 2 ||
ekādaśyāstathā devaḥ kaḥ pūjyaḥ kīdṛśaṃ vratam |
kiṃ deyaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tatsarvaṃ vada me hare || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
phālgunasyāsite pakṣe vijayā nāma nāmataḥ |
ekādaśī matā sarvapāpakṣayakarī priye || 4 ||
pradyumno vratibhistatra pūjanīyo dhiyā saha |
pūjāyāṃ tulasī deyā phalaṃ jambīramarhaṇe || 5 ||
naivedye tu pradeyaṃ ca sohālikādi bhojanam |
dāne tūpānahau mukhyau yathāśraddhaṃ dhanādikam || 6 ||
ādarāccotsavaḥ kāryo viṣṇubhaktasamarhaṇam |
bhaktaiḥ śraddhāsamāyuktaistathā śrīśaparāyaṇaiḥ || 7 ||
kartavyaṃ ca prayatnenopoṣaṇaṃ vijayapradam |
yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā hyupoṣyā dhyeyasiddhaye || 8 ||
asakṛjjaladugdhādipānānmithunasevanāt |
krodhanādaśrupātācca klośādikaraṇāttathā || 9 ||
cauryādidoṣaleśācca nopavāsaphalaṃ bhavet |
dānaṃ cātmavicāraśca dhyāna homo japo’rhaṇam || 1.244.1 0||
kartavyāni prayatnena vratinā phalakāṃkṣiṇā |
tajjapastatkathā śravyā hyekādaśyāṃ jayo bhavet||| 11 ||
upavāsavirodhī cedannadarśanasaṃspṛśaḥ |
tyājyaḥ sa sarvathā sparśo hyupavāsadine priye || 12||
upavāsāsamarthastu kuryāt phalakṛtaṃ vratam |
mūlaṃ phalaṃ payastoyamupabhogyaṃ bhavecchubhe || 1 3||
aśaktasya tathā naktaṃ haviṣyānnamanodanam |
phalatilāśanaṃ cājyakṣīrāmbupānamityapi || 14||
gandhatāmbūlabhogām̐śca varjayed vratasiddhaye |
jāgaraṃ viṣṇupūjāṃ ca vinā tvardhaphalaṃ vratam || 15||
jāgaraṃ pūjanaṃ pūrṇaphaladaṃ vratino bhavet |
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi vṛttāntaṃ vijayapradam || 16||
satyayugottare kāle jamadagnirmahāmuniḥ |
kauśikyāḥ sarito’raṇye hyavasaddhārmiko hi saḥ || 17||
snānasandhyādisatkarmaparaścāntaḥśuciḥ sadā |
dayādākṣiṇyamaunādikṣāntyādiguṇaśobhitaḥ || 18||
yajñayāgādinipuṇo devasevāparāyaṇaḥ |
yatkuṭyāṃ mūrtimānagnirjamatyarpitabhojanam || 1 9||
jamadagniḥ sa vai khyāto narmadātaṭamāvasan |
vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kurvannārādhayati mādhavam || 1.244.20 ||
reṇukā tasya patnyāsīt sāpi dharmapativratā |
patidharmaparā sādhvī patiṃ saṃsevate’nvaham ||21 ||
yadṛcchālābhasantuṣṭau gate kālepi śāntigau |
brahma cārādhayatastau nāpatyaṃ prāpaturhi tau || 22||
ekadā reṇukā snātvā hareḥ pūjanapūrvikām |
patyuḥ pūjāṃ karoti sma tadā cintāṃ jagāma sā ||23||
patiḥ putrasvarūpeṇa jāyate iti vai śrutiḥ |
patirme darśanīyo’sti tathā putro’pi me bhavet || 24||
patirme navasṛṣṭeśca sarjane poṣaṇe’pi ca |
sṛṣṭeḥ saṃharaṇe cāpi samartho’sti tridevavat ||25||
devā yenākāritāścāyānti yasya makhe’nvaham |
pūrayantīcchayā sarvaṃ tathā putro’pi me bhavet ||26||
kalpadrumāḥ kāmagāvo vasanti yasya mānase |
satpatirdevatulyo me bhavetputraḥ samīśitā ||27||
svargatulyāni saudhāni vaikuṇṭhasya samṛddhayaḥ |
golokasya rasā yasya saṃkalpe nivasanti hi || 28||
brahmatulyā pratiṣṭhā ca śaṃbhutulyā virāgatā |
śeṣasamāḥ siddhayaśca yatsaṃkalpe vasanti ca ||29||
muktiḥ karatale yasya lakṣmīścāśīrvaco’mṛte |
bhogāśca satyakāmādyā vasanti yasya sannidhau || 1.244.30||
vedā vidyāḥ kalā dākṣyaṃ yanmūrtau pravasanti ca |
brahmacaryādayaḥ sarve dharmāḥ santi ca yaddhṛdi ||3 1||
tasyarṣerjamadagneśca sutastatsadṛśo bhavet |
devā āśīḥpradānānme prayuñjantu sutāptaye ||32||
iti cintayamānaiva pūjayitvā svakaṃ patim |
dakṣapādāṃguṣṭhavāri hyapibad viṣṇumānasā || 33 ||
tāvattatrābhavadvāṇī vyomagātimanoharā |
prasanno’smi ca te devi sadā te patisevayā || 34||
viṣṇurasti svāmirūpe sevāṃ gṛhṇan vasan sadā |
dadāmi te vaco devi reṇuke tava garbhajaḥ || 35|||
bhavāmi tava putro’haṃ prabhuste patisadṛśaḥ |
nānyo’sti te patiprakhyaḥ patirūpo’smyahaṃ striyāḥ || 36 ||
tasmātpatyau kalpavṛkṣatulye kāmān dadāmi vai |
pativratābhyaḥ samyagvai vratasthābhyaḥ sutām̐stathā ||37||
śṛṇu mātarvrataṃ tatra kartavyaṃ ca tvayā yataḥ |
phaladaṃ putradaṃ loke khyātikṛnmokṣasādhanam ||38||
ekādaśyā vijayāyā vrataṃ saṃkalpapūrakam |
putraprāptau vijayaste bhaviṣyati yuge yuge ||39||
ityuktvā virarāmeyaṃ vāṇī ca reṇukāpi vai |
vrataṃ cakāra phālgunakṛṣṇaikādaśikātitheḥ ||1.244.40 ||
dānāni ca dadau viṣṇutuṣṭaye vividhāni hi |
prāpa putraṃ harestasya prasādācca vratāttathā ||41||
paraśurāmasaṃjño’sau viṣṇoraṃśo mahāprabhuḥ |
janmottaraṃ caturbāhuṃ rūpaṃ svaṃ dhṛtavān hariḥ |||42||
mātre svadarśanaṃ divyaṃ dadau śrīkamalāpatiḥ |
evaṃ kṛtvā vijayāṃ sā reṇukā sutavatyabhūt ||43||
śṛṇu priye tataścāyaṃ bālo viṣṇurdvijo’rbhakaḥ |
jamadagnisutaścāyaṃ munidharmaparo’bhavat ||44||
vipradharmānpālayam̐śca mānayan ṛṣidevatāḥ |
pūjayan śrīpatiṃ nityaṃ yajñopavītamāptavān ||45||
pitrā tu śikṣito vedānadhyagacchatsahāṃgakaiḥ |
vidyayā tejasā cānyo divākara ivābhavat ||46||
bālyādevābhavaccāpi pitranyūnaparākramaḥ |
trilokamārgāvyāhatagatikaḥ kamalāpatiḥ ||47||
viprakumāro brahmiṣṭho brahmacaryaparāyaṇaḥ |
yasya saṃdarśanānmuktiṃ yānti vai mānavā bhuvi ||48||
yasya saṃsevanād devā devatvaṃ svargasampadaḥ |
avāpuścānyajīvāśca lokapālakatāṃ parām ||49||
so’yaṃ bhikṣukakuṭyāṃ vai vartate’raṇyabhūmiṣu |
līlā nārāyaṇasyaiva dīnānāṃ mokṣakāriṇī ||1.244.50 ||
athaikadā śṛṇu lakṣmi jātaṃ kṣatraṃ samuddhatam |
gaṇayatyeva naiva svapūjyānāraṇyakāndvijān ||11 ||
māhiṣmatyā bhūpatiśca sahasrārjunanāmakaḥ |
candravaṃśī kṛtavīryātmajo bāhuparākramaḥ ||52||
nārāyaṇāvatāraṃ saḥ dattātreyaṃ tapasvinam |
prasannīkṛtya sevābhiryudhi bāhusahasrakam ||53||
tathā yogaprabhāvasya siddhiṃ lebhe śrīdattataḥ |
yadṛcchayā sa mṛgayāṃ vicaran gahane vane ||54||
mahatā svasya sainyena sahito’raṇyabhūmiṣu |
paryaṭannāśramaṃ cāyājjamadagnermahāmuneḥ ||55||
tasmai rājñe tu ṛṣiṇā pūjāsatkāramānanam |
sasainyāmātyavāhāya dattaṃ yogabalād bahu ||56 ||
kāmadhenoḥ prasādena svargādadhikavaibhavān |
prakaṭīkṛtya tatraiva tadānīṃ saḥ tamārcayat ||57||
rājālokya gatāścātivismayaṃ munivaibhavam |
svaiśvaryātiśayitaṃ cādṛṣṭaṃ caivāśrutaṃ kvacit ||58||
sarvavibhūtisaudhādisamutpattiparākramām |
kāmadhenuṃ sa tu jñātvā hyupājahāra tāṃ balāt ||59||
krandantīṃ vatsasahitāṃ ninye svanagaraṃ hi saḥ |
tadānīṃ paraśurāmo gato’bhūttu gṛhādbahiḥ ||1.244.60 ||
āgataḥ san gṛhe dṛṣṭavān krandantīṃ svamātaram |
tataḥ śrutvā tu nṛpaterdaurātmyaṃ krodhamāpa saḥ ||6 1 ||
mātre prāha tu kiṃ kāryaṃ mayā putreṇa me vada |
vijayo me bhaveccaiva yathā tanniṣkrayo bhavet ||62||
tathā darśaya me mātaḥ kiṃ karomi vadādhunā |
śikṣaye’smyapradhṛṣyo’haṃ kṣatramutpathagāminam ||6 3||
tathā me śādhi me mātaḥ putro’haṃ sevakastava |
mātroktaṃ putra te samyag vijayo’stu tathā kuru ||64||
anapatyā ca pūrvaṃ yad vrataṃ putrecchayā hyaham |
vijayaikādaśītitheḥ tadā kṛtavatī hariḥ |||65||
prasanno’bhūcca matkukṣau tvadrūpo janma cāptavān |
tvaṃ vai hariḥ svayaṃ cāsi paśya haste dhanuḥ śubham ||66 ||
paraśuṃ ca patākāṃ ca rekhārūpān vilokaya |
kuru ca tvaṃ vijayaikādaśītithervrataṃ śubham ||67||
vijayaste sadā bhaviṣyati kṣatriyayodhane |
kṣatriyāṇāṃ śikṣaṇāya vrataṃ kuru suputraka ||68||
tato daṇḍapradānāya yāhi te vijayo’stu vai |
ityuktaḥ paraśurāmaścakāra vijayātitheḥ ||69||
vrataṃ phālgunakṛṣṇe tu nirjalaṃ mātṛvākyataḥ |
daśamyāṃ naktabhojī ca rātrau bhūśayanastathā ||1.244.70 ||
prātaḥ snānottaraṃ devaṃ pradyamnaṃ dhīyutaṃ tathā |
vijayāsahitaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pupūja bhāvabhaktitaḥ || 7 1 ||
kṛtvā tu sarvatobhadramaṇḍale tatra sadghaṭam |
ratnapallavavastrādijalagandhādisaṃyutam ||72||
saṃsthāpya ca tatastasyopari tilabhṛtāṃ śubhām |
sthālīṃ sannyasya mūrtiṃ sthāpayitvā svarṇanirmitām ||73||
prādyumnīṃ dhīsthitapārśvāṃ pupūja bahuvastubhiḥ |
pañcāmṛtajalaiḥ snāpayitvā datvopavītakam ||74||
vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkārairbhūṣayitvā samarcya ca |
candanādisugandhaiścākṣatādyaiśca supuṣpakaiḥ ||75||
phalādibhiśca saṃpūjya tulasīmañjarīdalaiḥ |
dhūpadīpādidānaiśca pradakṣiṇāstavādibhiḥ ||76||
ārārtrikaistathā kṣamāparādhanaiḥ pupūja saḥ |
madhyāhnepi tathā saṃpūjyārpayadbhojana jalam ||77||
sāyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śreṣṭhairupacāraiḥ pupūja saḥ |
vedaghoṣaiḥ kathākhyānairjāgaraṇaṃ cakāra saḥ ||78||
yāvad brāhmamuhūrtaṃ ca jātaṃ tāvatsvayaṃ punaḥ |
snātvā cakāra devasya pūjanaṃ praṇayānvitaḥ ||79||
cakāra prārthanāṃ deva vijayāyā vratena me |
viprasyānatiśaktasya svabhāvamṛdulasya ca ||1.244.80 ||
krūrakāpathagenaiva kṣatreṇa saha yodhane |
vijayo bhavatāt kṛṣṇa hyakṣato’dhṛṣya eva ca ||81 ||
śikṣituṃ kāpathasthaṃ vai kṣatraṃ kālo’yamāgataḥ |
mama miṣeṇa bhagavān kuru tvaṃ vijayaṃ svayam ||82||
yāvadabhyarthayatyevaṃ tadā viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ |
prādurbhūya tamuvāca vijayaste’stu sarvathā ||83||
vijayāyā vratenāhaṃ prasanno’smi dvijottama |
mama rūpo’si viprendra nārāyaṇāṃśa eva ha ||84||
vijayaikādaśikāyāḥ phalena vijayastava |
bhavatād bhūmipālānāṃ śikṣaṇaṃ tvannimittakam ||85||
śāstṛṇāṃ kṣitipānāṃ cetkupaye vai gatirbhavet |
tadā teṣāṃ praśāstāro brāhmaṇāstu mayā kṛtāḥ ||86||
kṣatriyāṇāṃ balaṃ dharmād viprāṇāṃ brahmajaṃ balam |
adhārmikāṇāṃ kṣatrāṇāṃ śāsanaṃ viprasātkṛtam ||87||
tasmād viprendra yuddhyasva śādhi kṣatraṃ vigarvagam |
vijayāyā vratenātra bhūloke vijayastava ||88||
māṃ vihāyāstu trailokye vijayaste’bhito diśi |
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇustatra cādṛśyatāṃ gataḥ ||89||
parśurāmo’pi paraśuṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ dhanustathā |
bāṇān khaṅgaṃ carmaśaktiṃ cakraṃ cādāya caikalaḥ ||1.244.90||
yayau yatra kārtavīryo māhiṣmatyāḥ patirnṛpaḥ |
sahasrārjunanāmāsau sahasrakaraśobhitaḥ ||91 ||
virājate svabhavane tatra tvākṣipya bhūpatim |
rāmaḥ prāha mahāduṣṭa kāmadhenuprahāraka ||92||
prāṇaglahārthaṃ nirgaccha kurvāsvādaṃ svakarmaṇaḥ |
prāṇāndehi raṇaṃ dehi kāmadhenuṃ pradehi me ||93||
yadvā parājayaṃ dehi rāmavākyaṃ hi śāśvatam |
śrutvaivaṃ krodhamāpanno yuyodhātibalo’rjunaḥ ||94||
kintu bāhusahasraṃ vai chinnamasya pramūlataḥ |
tīkṣṇayā divyayā yuddhe rāmaparaśudhārāyā ||95||
bahvyo’kṣauhiṇya evāsya vidāritā dvijena vai |
nāśitāstasya putrāścārjuno’pi māritastadā ||96 ||
kāmadhenuṃ punaḥ prāpya tato divaṃ yayau svayam |
kṣatriyāṇāṃ vināśāya pṛthivyāṃ vicacāra ha ||97||
ekaviṃśatikṛtvaḥ saḥ kṣatriyāntakaro’bhavat |
vijayaikādaśīvratabalena vijayī bhuvi ||98||
samabhūdvipravaryo’sau rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ |
prāptā dhenurjitaṃ kṣatraṃ hyarjuno nihato raṇe || 99||
iha loke jayaḥ prāpto rāmeṇa vijayāvratāt |
viṣṇoḥ sudarśanacakrāvatāro’rjuna āsa ha || 1.244.100 ||
tathāpi nihataḥ parśurāmeṇa kāpathavrataḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāścāpi vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet || 101 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne phālgunakṛṣṇavijayaikādaśīvratamāhātmye sahasrārjunanāśārthaṃ tapasā parśurāmavijayaścaityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuścatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 244 ||

<1.245>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
svayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ paraṃbrahma lokarakṣaṇahetave |
avatāraṃ parigṛhya karotyapi vrataṃ svakam || 1 ||
lokasaṃgrahakāryāya samācarati vai svayam |
śikṣayati janān sattvamayān cācaryyamityapi || 2 ||
vada kṛṣṇa mayāpyatra bhavateva vrataṃ śubham |
kāryaṃ yasya pratāpena muktiḥ syāddhastagāminī || 3 ||
janā api vrataṃ kṛtvā paraṃ phalamavāpnuyuḥ |
phālgunasyārjune pakṣe yannāmnyekādaśī matā || 4 ||
vada tāṃ dharmaputra tvaṃ nārāyaṇa pate mama |
ityāpṛṣṭo harirviṣṇurvrataṃ provāca tāṃ priyām || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu kalyāṇade devi sarvasampatkari priye |
yadvratena janānāṃ susmṛddhayo yānti poṣaṇam || 6 ||
vardhante ca sadā lakṣmyaḥ sampadaśca bhavanti vai |
bahumuktirmahāmuktistasya saṃkalpavartinī || 7 ||
phālgunasyārjune pakṣe bhavetyekādaśī śubhā |
āmalakītināmnā sā viṣṇulokaphalapradā || 8 ||
vaikuṇṭhe śrīharirlakṣmī papraccha kimapekṣyate |
kimiṣyate tvayā lakṣmi yat tad brūhi dadāmi te || 9 ||
nānavāptamavāptavyaṃ tvatkṛte brahmarūpiṇī |
yanmadīyaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ tvadīyaṃ ca tvadātmakam || 1.245.10||
tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te karomi tava kāmanām |
mā saṃkocaṃ vaha lakṣmi yattavāsti mamāsti tat || 1 1||
lakṣmīrevaṃ hareḥ śrutvā provāca bhagavanmama |
lalāṭabhūṣā preṣṭhāsti tantikā dehi tāṃ prabho || 12||
haristadānīṃ saṃkalpyābhūṣaṇārthaṃ navaṃ śubham |
suvarṇavarṇaṃ sarasaṃ lalāṭe śītalaṃkaram || 13||
svacchaṃ divyaṃ maṇiprakhyaṃ śaśitulyaṃ guṇānvitam |
prakaṭīkṛtavān bhāle bindvātmakaṃ vibhūṣaṇam || 14||
binduḥ sa phalarūpo’bhūnmaṇiśreṣṭhaḥ prabhānvitaḥ |
akṣato vartulaḥ saumyaḥ suvarṇamaṇisadṛśaḥ || 15||
tasmāccānye’pi maṇayo divyā jātāstvanekaśaḥ |
hārastantimayasteṣāṃ kṛto’laṃkāraśobhanaḥ || 16||
sūryakāntanibho dṛśye candrakāntasamo guṇe |
kaustubhena samo hṛdye tantikābhūṣaṇātmakaḥ || 17||
cūḍāmaṇisamo dhārye spṛśye komalapeśalaḥ |
puṇye viṣṇuśilātulyo dhārye candanaśītalaḥ || 18||
sugandhe divyagandhāḍhyaḥ puṣṭau stanyasamastathā |
śāśvataśca mahādivyo harerbhālasya bindujaḥ || 19||
tantikātmakabhūṣākhyo hāro nirmalanūtanaḥ |
saṃskṛto hariṇā caikacatvāriṃśatphalātmakaḥ ||1.245.20 ||
madhye saptaphalānyatra pārśvayośca dvisūtrayoḥ |
aṣṭāviṃśatimaṇyāḍhyaḥ prāntayoḥ ṣaḍphalātmakaḥ ||2 1||
arpitaśca mahālakṣmyai hariṇā paramātmanā |
samprāpya sūryasadṛśaṃ tejasvinaṃ praśītalam ||22||
sarasaṃ śāśvataṃ hāraṃ jaharṣa prajaharṣa sā |
jighrāti spṛśati cainaṃ vilokayati sādaram ||23|||
muhurbhāle dhārayati paśyati sma punaḥ punaḥ |
nūtanaṃ kanakaprakhyaṃ sugandharasasaṃbhṛtam ||24||
lalāṭe śāntidaṃ snigdhasparśaṃ rekhābhiranvitam |
svakṛte eva hariṇā kṛtaṃ vīkṣya mumoda sā ||25||
stauti praśaṃsati haste gṛhṇāti sma muhurmuhuḥ |
sakhībhyaḥ sma darśayati prasannā saṃbabhūva sā ||26||
nārāyaṇo’pi bhagavān āsamantāt phalasya vai |
nairmalyaṃ tu vilokyaiva nāmākarod yathāguṇam |||27|||
āmalakaṃ phalaṃ ceti tantikāmalakaiḥ kṛtā |
bhāle babandha lakṣmīstāṃ śuśubhe sarvato’dhikā ||28|||
dyauryathānekaśaśikṛtpaṃktibhiḥ śobhate tathā |
śuśubhe tu mahālakṣmī samāsādya sutantikām ||29||
evaṃ jāte mahānande sṛṣṭāvatrāpi vedhasaḥ |
kalpādau prākṛte jāte sarge sthāvarajaṃgame ||1.245.30||
lakṣmyā yuto hariḥ sākṣātparamātmā parātparaḥ |
samājagāma bhūmau ca lakṣmīkāntaḥ samādarāt ||3 1||
lakṣmyā lalāṭadeśācca tantikāyāḥ śubhaṃ phalam |
śrīhariḥ pātayāmāsa pṛthvyāṃ tatsattvasiddhaye ||32||
tasyātphalātsamutpannaḥ phalabhāreṇa nāmitaḥ |
śākhāpraśākhābahulaḥ svayaṃ dhātrītarurmahān ||33||
sarveṣāṃ caiva vṛkṣāṇāmatiśreṣṭhaḥ sa kīrtitaḥ |
svarṇanibhaphalopeto vṛkṣo lakṣmīpriyaḥ śubhaḥ ||34||
yathā nārāyaṇabhālaṃ priyaṃ vṛkṣaḥ priyastathā |
nārāyaṇasvarūpo’yaṃ nārāyaṇena nirmitaḥ ||35||

badarikāśrame so’yaṃ prathamaḥ prakaṭīkṛtaḥ ||36||
tasmācca raivatādrau saḥ samāyātastarurmahān |
ta ete muktidāḥ sarve vṛkṣā āmalakāhvayāḥ ||37||
yasmindine hariṇāyaṃ vṛkṣastu prakaṭīkṛtaḥ |
so’yaṃ tu divaso’pyāsīdekādaśīsamāhvayaḥ ||38||
tatra tvāmalakīvṛkṣotpatterekādaśī tithiḥ |
āmalakītināmnā vai kṛtā devarṣisattamaiḥ ||39||
devadānavagandharvayakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ |
kinnarā mānavā nāgāḥ ṛṣayo munayo’pare ||1.245.40||
vidyādhrāḥ kiṃpuruṣāśca yogino bhūsurāstathā |
yatayo nyāsinaḥ sādhvyo yoginyo brahmacaryagāḥ ||41 ||

praśaṃsanto’tibhūṣārhaphalānyāmalakāni ca ||43||

vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇugamakaṃ bhakṣaṇātpāpaśodhakam |

dhṛtāni bhālakaṇṭhādau karakarṇādikeṣvapi ||5 1||

sarvadevamayī hyeṣā dhātrī bodhyā jagatprasūḥ ||1.245.6 0||

nayatyenaṃ harerdhāma divyaṃ vaikuṇṭhamakṣaram |

dhanadhānyapradaṃ puṇyamātmanastuṣṭikārakam ||72||
alpāyāsaṃ bahuphalaṃ vratānāṃ vratamuttamam |

phālgune śuklapakṣe tu puṣyeṇa dvādaśī yadi |

<1.246>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
aho cātiprahṛṣṭaṃ me cittaṃ bhavati keśava |
āmalakyā vrataṃ śrutvā dhātrīmāhātmyamityapi || 1 ||
caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā |
ko devastatra pūjyo’sti kā ca patnī harestathā || 2 ||
kiṃ phalaṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca dānaṃ pūjāṃ ca me vada |
śrutvā lakṣmīvacaḥ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇohyuvāca tām || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi caitrasya prathame dale |
ekādaśīṃ pāpamocanikānāmnīṃ mahāphalām || 4 ||
kāmānāṃ pūraṇī siddhidāyinī dharmavardhinī |
nirjalā tu kṛtā yena prāpnuyādbrahma sa vratī || 5 ||
daśamyāṃ naktabhojī ca rātrau bhūśayanastathā |
brahmacārī vratī prātaścāniruddhaṃ vicintayet || 6 ||
suśilāsahitaṃ devaṃ pāpamocanikāyutam |
pūjāyāṃ kundakalikāpuṣpāṇi tvarpayettathā || 7 ||
naivedye sevikāṃ dadyādarghye badarikāphalam |
tathānyāni phalānyatra miṣṭānnāni bahūnyapi || 8 ||
dadyāccāpyaniruddhāya dāne tu tilagaurmatā |
evaṃ prātaḥ samutthāya dhyātvā hariṃ tu mānase || 9 ||
snātvā ca mānasaṃ cāniruddhasya pūjanaṃ caret |
arpayenmānasānyevopakaraṇāni ṣoḍaśa || 1.246.10||
tato vai bāhyapūjāṃ tu kuryādvai kramaśo vratī |
āvāhayedaniruddhaṃ suśīlāsahitaṃ prabhum || 1 1||
svarṇamūrtau samāhūyāsanaṃ dadyānmahattamam |
pādyaṃ cārghyaṃ tathā dadyādācamanīyakaṃ jalam || 12||

bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyād dugdhaṃ ca śarkarāyutam |
jalaṃ phalaṃ mukhavāsaṃ tāmbūlaṃ gandhacūrṇakam || 18||
dadyāttvattaratailādi sugandhyarthaṃ tu śārṅgiṇe |
ārārtrikaṃ tataḥ kuryānnamaḥ stotraṃ kṣamāpanam || 19||
pradakṣiṇaṃ daṇḍavacca puṣpāṃjaliṃ ca dakṣiṇām |
dadyācca vratakaraṇāyārthayetparameśvaram ||1.246.20||
adyaikādaśikā nāmnā pāpamocanakāriṇī |

prasanno bhava deveśa suśīlādhipa keśava ||22||
iti vai pūjanaṃ cātha samāpya saptadhānyakam |
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayetsthāpayettataḥ || 23||

ratnaiḥ pañcavidhaiścāpi jalavastrādibhiryutam |||24||
tasyopari śubhaṃ pātraṃ tilaiḥ saṃbhṛtamarpayet |

kṣamāṃ dhairyaṃ samālambya gacchāmyanyadvanaṃ yataḥ |

yāvadgacchati viprendrastāvatkāmo’pi vegavān ||69 ||
śivabhaktaṃ vijetuṃ vai vane bahiḥ sumūrtimān |
abhavacca prayantaṃ saṃcakāra sarvatomukham ||1.246.70 ||
kṛtvā bhruvaṃ dhanuṣkoṭi guṇaṃ kṛtvā kaṭākṣakam |
mārgaṇe nayane kṛtvā pakṣmayukte yathākramam ||7 1 ||
kucau kṛtvā parakuṭau mohanāyopacakrame |
mañjughoṣābhavattasya kāmasyātra varūthinī ||72||
kāmena pañcabāṇāstu ṛṣerupari cāhitāḥ |
camatkṛtaṃ tu prathamaṃ dvitīyaṃ jāgratātmakam ||73 ||
tṛtīyaṃ rasavāhākhyaṃ caturthaṃ mohanātmakam |
paṃcamaṃ mithunībhāvagamakaṃ sa mumoca ha ||74||
medhāvī tadvaśaṃ nīto yuyuje mañjughoṣayā |
medhāvinaṃ muniṃ dṛṣṭvā sāpi kāmena pīḍitā ||75||
yauvanodbhinnadehena yuyuje ṛṣiṇā tadā |
gāḍhamāliṃgya tau tatra rājete smarayojitau ||76||
sitopavītasaṃyukto dṛṣṭaḥ smara ivāparaḥ |
mañjughoṣāyuto vipro rājate dyauryutaḥ śaśī ||77||
suratasya vaśaṃ yātā mandaṃ mandaṃ jahāsa sā |
raṇadvalayahastābhyāmāślikṣat taṃ muniṃ hṛdi ||78||
premakaṇṭhasvaraṃ sūkṣmaṃ līnaṃ kṛtvā tu mūkavat |
netre pramīlya cauṣṭhābhyāmāsvādayadṛṣermukham ||79||
sparśamagnānandamagnā śāntanūpuramekhalā |
sparśaibhāvaistathā netrairvarṣmaṇā sasvaje munim ||1.246.8 0 ||
vīṇā tu patitā bhūmau patitā svaṃ ca sasvaje |
balādiva latā vṛkṣaṃ vātavegena kampitam || 81 ||
sopi reme tayā sārdhaṃ kāmabhedairanekaśaḥ |
śivatattvaṃ tu vismṛtya kāmatattvavaśaṃgataḥ ||8 2 ||
tapasā sādhite saudhe sodyāne savimānake |
vāhane copakaraṇe bhakṣyabhojyasulehyake || 83 ||
dhāraṇe’laṃkaraṇe cotsave samānake ṛtau |
vividhe gṛhayogye ca bhogye tatsādhane sati ||84||
niratiśayatāṃ prāpte tṛptiṃ lebhe tayā saha |
punastṛṣṇāṃ punastṛptiṃ punastṛṣṇāṃ jagāma saḥ ||85||
tṛṣṇāyā naiva cāntosti bhuktvā bhuktvā vivardhate |
evaṃ tāruṇyabharayā tṛṣṇayā taruṇo’pi saḥ ||86||
na niśāṃ na dinaṃ sopi ramañjānāti kāmukaḥ |
dīrghaḥ kālo gato ramamāṇasyācāralopataḥ ||87||
navaśatāni varṣāṇāṃ gatānyasya tayā saha |
sā reme muninā tasya niśārdhamiva cābhavat ||88||
mañjughoṣā devaloke gamanāyopacakrame |
sannaddhā taṃ pratyuvāca satṛṣṇaṃ munisattamam ||89||
ājñā me dīyatāṃ vipra svarlokagamanāya vai |
medhāvī tu samākarṇya tāmuvāca vimohitaḥ ||1.246.9 0||
yāvatprabhātasandhyā syāt tāvattiṣṭha mamāntike |
śrutvā vicārayāmāsa mañjughoṣā hṛdantare || 051 ||
aho kāmena vaiklavyaṃ jānātyayaṃ na vatsarān |
niśārdhamātraṃ jānāti kāmamūrchāparājitaḥ |||92||
pratyākhyāne śāpabhītisamudvignā babhūva sā |
punarvai ramayāmāsa tamṛṣiṃ bahuvatsarān || 93 ||
varṣāṇāṃ pañcapañcāśannava māsān dinatrayam |
sā taṃ punaruvācātha tathā kāle gate munim || 94||
ādeśo dīyatāṃ brahman gantavyaṃ svagṛhaṃ mayā |
medhāvyuvāca kāmāndhaḥ kālabhānavivarjiṃtaḥ ||95||
niśāntasamayastvāste śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama |
kṣaṇaṃ māṃ ramayitvā tvaṃ gantumarhasi śobhane ||96||
tvāṃ vinā me kṣaṇaścāpi yugatulyo bhaviṣyati |
tvayā sārdhaṃ niśāmātraṃ vyatītaṃ tiṣṭha me ciram ||97||
punaḥ śāpaprabhītā sā ramayāmāsa tamṛṣim |
varṣāṇāṃ pañcacatvāriṃśadityadhikabhāvataḥ ||98||
punaḥ prāha muniṃ namrā brahmam̐stṛpto’si vā nahi |
ādeśo dīyatāṃ vipra gantavyaṃ svagṛhaṃ mayā ||99||
medhāvyuvāca tāṃ snigdhāṃ rakṣituṃ svāntike tadā |
prātaḥkālo’dhunā tvāste śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama || 1.246.100 ||
sarvadā tiṣṭha me saudhe māṃ ca ramaya kāmataḥ |
ekā niśā sthitā cātra kā me tṛptirbhaved vada || 10 1||
sandhyāṃ yāvacca kurve’haṃ tāvattvaṃ vai sthirā bhava |
iti śrutvā munervākyaṃ smitaṃ kṛtvā hyuvāca tam || 1 02||
kiyatpramāṇā viprendra tava sandhyā gatādhunā |
kativatsarakālaste gataśceti vicāryatām || 1 03||
ekāṃ sandhyāṃ niśāṃ vetsi kā te suptiryugātmikā |
iti tasyā vacaḥ śrutvā prodbhinnāntaralocanaḥ || 104||
tāṃ pṛṣṭvā gatakālasya medhāvī mānamācarat |
navanavatyadhikāni navaśatāni saṃkhyayā || 1 05||
jātānyeva gatānyeva varṣāṇi priyayā saha |
suviditvaikonadaśaśatānyekaniśāmukhe || 106 ||
tathāpi tṛṣṇayā vyāpta iti svaṃ dhik cakāra saḥ |
cukrodha tasyai kāmāya svasmai ca yauvanāya ca || 1 07||
mokṣahāniṃ tapohāniṃ cātmahāniṃ vilokya ca |
netrābhyāṃ vispulliṃgānsa mumocātīva kopataḥ || 1 08||
tapaḥkṣayakarīṃ nārīṃ mṛtyurūpāṃ ca rākṣasīm |
ātmamuktirodhakartrī kaṣṭāptapuṇyabhakṣiṇīm || 10 9||
hānidāṃ tāṃ sakmpauṣṭho muniruvāca vegataḥ |
dhik tvāṃ priye durācāre kulaṭe kāmanāpriye || 1.246.110 ||
sevāmiṣeṇa muniṣu svairiṇi puṇyanāśini |
tapolopakari yāmyamārgasaṃsargadāyini || 111 ||
piśācī bhava duṣṭe tvaṃ kāmacchidrapradāyini |
medhāvī tāṃ śaśāpaivaṃ sāpi namrā hyuvāca tam || 11 2||
naikasyā me hi doṣo’sti yuvā tvaṃ suvicāraya |
dvayoḥ kārye jaye prāpte sabala paripūjyate || 113 ||
parājaye tu samprāpte nirbalastatra hanyate |
maivaṃ bhavatu medhāvin hāniste naiva kevalā || 114 ||
mamāpi svaparityāgastvayā tyaktā sadhikkṛtā |
ātmahānirlokahāniryaśohānistu me tathā || 1 15||
śāpaṃ dātuṃ samarthāsmi yathā vadasi tattathā |
tathāpi praṇayikānte naivaṃ kāryaṃ striyā kvacit || 116 ||
kṣamā dattā hi nārībhyo brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā |
adoṣā api patyustāḥ sahante krauryamavyathāḥ || 1 17||
prasādaṃ kuru tasmāt tvaṃ śāpasyānugrahaṃ kuru |
satāṃ saṃgaḥ sukhakaraḥ sāptapadīna eva saḥ || 118 ||
tvayā saha mayā vipra yoṣitā patnīrūpayā |
nītāśca sevayā śaśvat kati sahasravatsarāḥ || 119 ||
etasmāt kāraṇātsvāmin tyaja krauryaṃ prasīda ca |
iti tathyaṃ priyāvākyaṃ doṣaṃ svīyaṃ ca cintayan || 1.246.120 ||
prahvībhāvaṃ tathā patnyā vilokyovāca tāṃ muniḥ |
śṛṇu me vacanaṃ bhadre śāpānugrahakārakam || 121 ||
kiṃ karomi tvayā sākaṃ kṣayaṃ nītaṃ mahātapaḥ |
gataṃ tattu gataṃ tveva naṣṭaṃ nāyāti vai punaḥ || 122 ||
punaḥ saṃpādayiṣyāmi tavāpi śubhamastu vai |
caitrasya kṛṣṇapakṣe tu bhavatyekādaśī śubhā || 1 2 3 ||
pāpamocanikā nāma sarvaśāpakṣayaṃkarī |
tasyā vrate kṛte subhru piśācītvaṃ viyāsyati || 1 24||
śrutvaitanmañjughoṣā sā yayau vanāntaraṃ tadā |
piśācī tu babhūveyaṃ yāvaccaitro na saṃgataḥ || 125 ||
prāpte caitre mañjrughoṣā vrataṃ jātismarā tadā |
cakāra vidhinā caitrakṛṣṇaikādaśikādine || 126 ||
pupūja parayā bhaktyā śrīhariṃ mānase hi sā |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ kṛtyaṃ vidhāya ca || 127 ||
piśācītvādvinirmuktā pāpamocanikābalāt |
divyarūpadharā sā vai gatā svarge svake gṛhe || 128 ||
medhāvyapi tayā tyakto jagāma piturāśramam |
cyavanasya ṛṣerdivyaṃ tapastejo’tiśobhitam || 129 ||
nistejaskaṃ ciraṃ yāntaṃ vilokya cyavanaḥ pitā |
prāhaitat kiṃ kṛtaṃ putra tvayā puṇyakṣayaḥ kṛtaḥ || 1.246.130 ||
kathaṃ na dṛśyate tejastapobāhulyasaṃbhavam |
medhāvī prāha tātāsminvane tu tapasā mayā || 131 ||
prāptāpsarā tayā sārdhaṃ pātakaṃ vai kṛtaṃ bahu |
ramitā bahukālaṃ sā tapo naṣṭaṃ mamādbhutam || 132 ||
prāyaścittaṃ brūhi tāta yena pāpakṣayo bhavet |
pitā prāha tadā putraṃ vrataṃ vacmi nibodha me || 133||
caitrasya tvasite pakṣe nāmnā tu pāpamocanī |
ekādaśī matā hyasyā vrate tu vidhitaḥ kṛte || 134||
pāparāśiḥ kṣayaṃ yāyānmuktiṃ cānte vrajed vratī |
iti śrutvā piturvākyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena vratottamam || 135||
gataṃ pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ tasya tapovṛddhirbabhūva ca |
tejo vyāpto’bhavacchīghraṃ pāpamocanikāvratāt || 1 36||
yathāpūrvaṃ tapoyukto hyabhūd babhūva vai tathā |
pāpamocanikāṃ lakṣmi ye kurvanti janā bhuvi || 137||
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ tu yatkiṃcit sarvaṃ vilayatāṃ vrajet |
vājapeyasahasrasya phalaṃ tasyāpi jāyate || 1 38||
bhuktirmuktirmahāmuktiḥ sarvaṃ caikavratena hi |
prāpyetaitādṛśī śaktā phaladāne tviyaṃ tithiḥ || 1 39||
brahmahā hemahārī ca surāpo gurutalpagaḥ |
vratasya cāsya karaṇānmukto bhavati tadvratī || 1.246.140 ||
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi smaraṇātkīrtanādapi |
bahupuṇyapradaṃ caitad gosahasraphalapradam || 141 ||
kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi śāpapāpanivṛttaye |
nātaḥ parataraṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ sacarācare || 142||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caitrakṛṣṇapāpamocanyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ medhāvinā tapasvinā sahasravatsaraṃ bhuktāyā majjughoṣākhyāpsarāyāḥ ṛṣiśāpātpiśācītvamanugrahād vratakaraṇān muktiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 246||

<1.247>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
bhagavantaṃ vinā nātra loke tūddhārakaḥ paraḥ |
vinā ca sātvatān loke na paraḥ pāvano’paraḥ || 1 ||
sādhūn vinā ca jīvānāṃ nāparaḥ pāpanāśakaḥ |
vrataṃ vinā tathā loke nānyadbhuktipramuktidam || 2 ||
ekādaśīṃ vinā nānyacchāpapāpapraṇāśakam |
svargadaṃ siddhidaṃ dravyaputradaṃ mokṣadaṃ tathā || 3 ||
bhagavan śrotumicchāmi kathayasva mamāgrataḥ |
caitrasya śuklapakṣīyā kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā || 4 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
caitrasya śuklapakṣe tu kāmadā nāma nāmataḥ |
ekādaśī puṇyatamā pāpendhanadavānalā || 5 ||
vimalākhyāpi saivoktā sarvavāñchitadāyinī |
ramayā sahito viṣṇurasyāḥ patirhi pūjyate || 6 ||
ṣoḍaśopacārakaistu yathāvittaṃ yathāvidhi |
phalaṃ cārghye cirbhaṭādi cūtapuṣpāṇi pūjane || 7 ||
naivedye saktavo laḍḍukāśca pakvānnamityapi |
arpaṇīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa vratinā phalasiddhaye || 8 ||
daśamyāmekabhaktaṃ vā vratī naktaṃ vrataṃ caret |
rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryād rakṣayed brahmacāritām || 9 ||
prātastvekādaśīkāle samutthāya hariṃ smaret |
dhyāyecca śrīhareḥ rūpaṃ snātvā devaṃ prapūjayet || 1.247.10 ||
snāpayedamṛtaiḥ pañcabhirjalaistīrthasaṃbhavaiḥ |
arpayedatimūlyāni vastrāṇi bhūṣaṇāni ca || 11 ||
śṛṃgārayed vastubhiḥ śrāṃgārikaiśca sugandhibhiḥ |
puṣpairhāraistathā dhūpadīpanaivedyasatphalaiḥ || 12||
jalapānamukhavāsatāmbūlailālavaṃgakaiḥ |
ārārtrikaiḥ stutipradakṣiṇādyaiśca prasādayet || 13||
kṣamāpayet tvavarān vai tataśca stavanaṃ caret |
ekādaśyā vrataṃ kṛṣṇa karomi phalasiddhaye || 14||
kṛpayā tava tatpūrṇaṃ bhavatvavighnakaṃ mama |
ityabhyarthya tato dhānyaiḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam || 15||
kṛtvā svarṇaghaṭaṃ tatra yadvā tāmraghaṭaṃ śubham |
pañcaratnairnavapatrairjalairvastreṇa candanaiḥ || 16||
akṣataiśca phalaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjanārthaṃ nyadhāpayet |
tilapātraṃ ghaṭe tatra tatra mūrtiṃ harestathā || 17||
ramāyāḥ kāmadāyāśca sthāpayed vidhinā vratī |
āvāhanādimantraiḥ saṃpūjayetsnāpayejjalaiḥ || 18||
pūjādravyaiḥ pūjayecca vastrābhūṣaṇahetibhiḥ |
śṛṃgārayeddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ ramāṃ śāṭyādibhistathā || 19||
bhūṣāśṛṃgārakairdravyairvividhairabhibhūṣayet |
yathā viṣṇuṃ tathā lakṣmīṃ bhūṣayed bahubhūṣaṇaiḥ ||1.247.20||
keśānprasādhayettailasugandhidravavastubhiḥ |
dhammilaṃ racayettatra bhūṣaṇaṃ stabakaṃ tathā ||21||
catuḥsaraṃ vā dvisaraṃ keśagranthanamācaret |
sūtraṃ puṣpāṇi cipiṭaṃ svarṇaśṛṃkhalikāṃ tathā ||22||
trisaraṃ granthanaṃ sarvaṃ kārayettu caturvidham |
agre kuryāttu kabarīṃ sindūraṃ dāpayecchubham || 23 ||

madhye sūkṣmātisūkṣmābhirbindvikābhiḥ prapūritāḥ |
racayedraṃjayedbhālaṃ lakṣmīvāsamivāparam || 26||

rūpalāvaṇyasamabhivyañjanārthaṃ samastaram |
kapole ṭibakī kuryāt raktavarṇaṃ suśobhitām || 28 ||
cibuke’pi tathā kuryād bindvīṃ svalpāṃ suraktakām |
oṣṭhayoḥ sthalapadmasya rūpaprākaṭyahetave || 29 ||

yathā ramā tathā tvekādaśī patnī hareḥ priyā |
sarvopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ suvastukam || 41 ||

dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlapānakam

pradakṣiṇaṃ kṣamāyāñcāṃ stutiṃ namaskriyāṃ tataḥ |

āndolayeddhariṃ viṣṇuṃ vimalākāmadāyutam |

rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryād nṛtyagītamahotsavaiḥ |

prātaḥ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā pūjayitvā janārdanam |
dānaṃ ca vividhaṃ datvā nīrājayitvā mādhavam || 51||
ārdravastraṃ bhrāmayitvā śaṃkhenottārya vai jalam |
tulasīdalasaṃyuktaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ vyaṃjanādikam ||52||

visarjayitvā kuryācca vratī vai pāraṇāṃ tataḥ ||53||
evaṃ kṛtena vidhinā puṇyaṃ bhavati śāśvatam |
aihikaṃ paralokotthaṃ yadicchet tadbhaved dhruvam ||54||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ gandharvadvayamuktidām |
purā nāgapure ramye hemaharmyānvite śubhe ||55||
gandharvāḥ puṇḍarīkākhyajñātayaḥ sma vasanti hi |
madoddhatā mahākrūrā mahāmadabalānvitāḥ ||56||
gandharvāḥ kinnarā yakṣā vidyādhrāḥ kiṃjanāstathā |
satparyo’psaraso devyaḥ kumāryaḥ sma vasanti ca ||57||
tasminpure nṛpaḥ puṇḍarīko rājyaṃ cakāra ha |
nāmnā pauṃḍra iti khyātastenotsave suyojite ||58||
gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtā māgadhā bandinastathā |
kiṃpuruṣā gāyakāśca vyākhyātāro’pi cāraṇāḥ ||59||
śrotrīyavargā viprāśca rājasā daivayonayaḥ |
tatrotsave samāyatā gāndharvavedapaṇḍitāḥ ||1.247.60||
nṛtyaṃ pravartate tatra samāje raṃgamaṇḍape |
gāyanti sma svaradhanā vādayanti ca vādakāḥ ||6 1||
nṛtyanti nartakījanāḥ paśyanti cetare janāḥ |
pātālānnāgalokācca kāmarūpā bhujaṃgamāḥ ||62||
daiteyā dānavāścāpi samājagmustadutsave |
te’pi devasamā rūpe bhūtvotsave vyavasthitāḥ ||6 3 ||
anyeṣāṃ gāyakānāṃ ca nṛtye gīte vyavasthite |
nartakīnāṃ tathā nṛtye gīte nirvartite tataḥ ||64||
pauṃḍrasya rājño gandharveśvaro’tikuśalāgraṇīḥ |
lalito nāma gandharvo raṃge hyavātatāra ha ||65||
lalitā nāma gandharvapatnī tu gṛhakāryataḥ |
nāyātā tatra raṅge vai lalitastvekalastadā ||66||
gītaṃ gānaṃ prakurute lalito dayitā vinā |
dayitāyāstadānupasthityā tu lalitaḥ khalu ||67||
pārśvahīnaśca sāhāyyarahito manasā tu tām |
smaran gāyati nṛtyam̐śca vādayati yathākalam ||68||
hṛdye tasya lalitā nityaṃ vasati bhāminī |
prasaṃge tu viśeṣeṇa susmṛtā sā bhavatyapi ||69||
lalitāyāstu hṛdye patirvasati nityadā |
ubhau rāgeṇa saṃraktau dampatī premabandhanau ||1.247.70 ||
remāte sma gṛhe yadvat tat lalitena saṃsmṛtam |
raṅge patnyāḥ smaraṇena vyagramānasanartakaḥ ||7 1||
pādabandhaḥ skhalajjihvo babhūva lalitāṃ smaran |
pādabandhacyutirjātā jātaṃ svarāvarohaṇam ||72||
gandharvāṇāṃ sabhāmadhye hāsyapātraṃ tu so’bhavat |
pauṃḍrasyāpi yaśohānistadā jātā hi tatkṣateḥ ||73||
tadā pauṃḍraḥ puṇḍarīko babhūva krodhapīḍitaḥ |
śaśāpa lalitaṃ raṅge gāyanta ca smarāturam ||74||
rākṣaso bhava durbuddhe kravyādaḥ puruṣādanaḥ |
yataḥ patnīṃ smaram̐ścātra gāyamāno mahotsave ||75||
samāje’navadhānāt tvaṃ kalāyāṃ kṣatimāptavān |
hāsyapātraṃ tvaṃ tathāhaṃ samājena kṛtāvubhau ||76||
tasmāttvaṃ rākṣaso bhūtvā duḥkhaṃ paśya ciraṃ samāḥ |
iti pauṃḍrasya vacanād rakṣārūpo babhūva saḥ ||77||
raudrānano virūpākṣo dṛṣṭamātro bhayaṃkaraḥ |
bahuyojanavistīrṇo mukhe kandarasannibhaḥ ||78||
sūryadvayanibho netre grīvāyāṃ parvatopamaḥ |
nāsāyāṃ parvatamālānibho randhre guhāsamaḥ ||79||
oṣṭhayorgavyūtikalpa ucchrāye yojanadvayam |
īdṛśo rākṣaso bhūtvā bhuṃjānaḥ karmaṇaḥ phalam ||1.247.80 ||
yayau gṛhaṃ ca lalitā svakāntaṃ vikṛtākṛtim |
ālokya cintayāmāsa patiduḥkhena duḥkhitā ||8 1 ||
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi patiḥ pāpena pīḍitaḥ |
jñātvā sarvaṃ tu vṛttāntaṃ patisevāparāyaṇā ||82||
cacāra patinā sārdhaṃ lalitā gahane vane |
pūrvaṃ saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya manasā śarma nālabhat ||83||
babhrāma vipine durge kāmarūpadharāpi sā |
kāmarūpadhareṇāpi patinā saha sarvadā ||84||
lalito vipine durge kāmarūpī bhavannapi |
nirghṛṇaḥ pāpanirato virūpaḥ puruṣādakaḥ ||85||
na sukhaṃ labhate rātrau na divā pāpapīḍitaḥ |
lalitā duḥkhitātīva patiṃ dṛṣṭvātiduḥkhinam ||86||
babhrāma tena sārdhaṃ sā kṣuttṛṣādyatimarditāḥ |
patirvai rākṣasarūpaḥ patnī gandharvarūpiṇī ||87||
vicitraṃ tu tayoryogaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai vanavāsinaḥ |
āścaryaṃ paramaṃ prāpurbhītāśca dudruvuḥ sthalāt|||88||
atha śātātapamunerāśramaṃ tāvavāpatuḥ |
śīghraṃ jagāma lalitā namaskṛtyāgrataḥ sthitā ||89||
dayāluḥ sa muniḥ prāha kā tvaṃ kasmādupasthitā |
lalitovāca gāndharvī vīradhanvasutāsmyaham ||1.247.90||
lalitānāma me tvasti patyarthamiha cāgatā |
bhartā me lalitaprakhyaḥ pauṃḍraśāpena rākṣasaḥ ||9 1||
bhūtvā bhramatyaraṇye’smin dṛṣṭvā taṃ nāsti me sukham |
yena puṇyena me svāmī rākṣasatvādvimucyate ||92||
tādṛśaṃ puṇyakṛtyaṃ me śādhi śātātapa prabho |
śrutvā śātātapaḥ prāha śāpapāpaharā śubhā ||93||
kāmadaikādaśī caitraśuklasya puṇyasaukhyadā |
vrataṃ tasyā vidhānena kuru tvaṃ bhāmini dhruvam ||94||
bhaviṣyati phalaṃ puṇyaṃ tat svabhartre pradīyatām |
datte puṇye kṣaṇāttasya śāpadoṣaḥ prayāsyati ||95||
śātātapamunervākyaṃ śrutvā sā harṣitābhavat |
tatrāśrame’vasaccaikādaśīpratīkṣaṇāya sā ||96||
patistasyā vane tatrābhito vasati nityadā |
kāmadaikādaśī prāptā nirjalā samupoṣitā ||97||
jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtaṃ rātrau dvādaśyāṃ prātareva ca |
śātātapasya nikaṭe harermūrteśca sannidhau ||98||
vākyamuvāca lalitā svapatyustāraṇāya vai |
mayā tvetadvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ kāmadāyā upoṣaṇam ||99||
tasya puṇyaprabhāveṇa naśyatvasya piśācatā |
lalitāvacanāttasmin kṣaṇe eva piśācatā || 1.247.10 0||
gatā rākṣasatā tasya jātā gandharvatā punaḥ |
gatapāpaḥ sa lalito divyadeho babhūva ha || 101 ||
svarṇaratnasamākīrṇo reme lalitayā saha |
tau vimānasamārūḍhau pūrvarūpādhikau śubhau || 102||
dampatī cānyaśobhetāṃ gatau nāgapuraṃ hyubhau |
kāmadāyā vratajanyapuṇyenaivaṃ piśācatā || 1 03||
vinaṣṭā śāpanāśaśca svasvarūpasamāgamaḥ |
iti jñātvā mahālakṣmi kartavyaiṣātibhāvataḥ || 104||
vrahmahatyādipāpaghnī piśācatvavināśinī |
paṭhanāchravaṇāccāpi vājapeyaphalapradā || 1 05||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne caitraśuklakāmadaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ lalitalalitāgandharvayoḥ pauṃḍrasya śāpena jātasya piśācatvasya vratena muktirityādinirūpaṇanāmā saptacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ |||247||

<1.248>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
mokṣadātarhare kṛṣṇa janoddhārakara prabho |
pāpināṃ śāpināṃ cāpi śāpināṃ pāpanāśaka || 1 ||
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ tvayā pradarśitaṃ vratam |
śrutvā śrutvā praharṣāmi śravaṇe jāyate ruciḥ || 2 ||
vada nātha kṛpāsindho vaiśākhakṛṣṇapakṣake |
kiṃnāmnyekādaśī tasyāḥ ko devaḥ ko vidhistathā || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
saubhāgyadāyinī putrapautrasampatpradāyinī |
atra paratra sukhadā smṛddhidā pāpanāśinī || 4 ||
vaiśākhakṛṣṇapakṣīyā nāmnā cāsti varūthanī |
tasyā vratena vratinaḥ saukhyaṃ bhavati sarvathā || 5 ||
pāpahāniśca bhavati saubhāgyaprāptirityapi |
durbhagāpi vratakartrī sarvasaubhāgyamāpnuyāt || 6 ||
vratināṃ tvatra sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyinī |
sarvapāpaharā puṇyapradā janmaharā śubhā || 7 ||
vāsanānāśinī nityānandamuktipradāyinī |
śāśvatyāśca sthiterdātrī kartavyā vratinā hi sā || 8 ||
māndhātṛdhundhumārādyā vratinaḥ svargatiṃ gatāḥ |
nandayā sahitaḥ śaktyā tvatrārcyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 9 ||
jātiphalādi pūjāyāṃ naivedye vaṭakāḥ śubhāḥ |
campakādini puṣpāṇi kundasya kalikāstathā || 1.248.10||
sthalapadmāni deyāni deyaṃ dānaṃ bhuvastathā |

tāmasānnaṃ masūrānnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ parivarjayet |

pūjayennūtanadravyaiḥ ṣoḍaśottamavastubhiḥ |
āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtavilepanam || 18||
śuddhatīrthodakasnānaṃ vastrābhūṣaṇadhāraṇam |

kuṃkumādimāṃgalikabhūrṇatilakacandrakam |
gucchaṃ pauṣpaṃ tathā hārān pauṣpāṃśca śekharādikān ||1.248.20||
arpayeddharaye tatra dhūpadīpādi kārayet |
nīrājayitvā natvā ca pradakṣiṇaṃ vidhāya ca ||2 1||

evaṃ prātaḥ pūjayitvā mahāpūjanamācaret ||22||

tīrthajalaistathā snānārpaṇaṃ bhūṣāmbarārpaṇam |

prakuryācca vratasiddhyai prārthanāṃ vighnanāśinīm |

daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tapastapati yo naraḥ |

viṃśatinyūnavarṣīyo vedādyadhyayanavrataḥ |

gurorvākyaṃ vedavākyaṃ vedo gurumukhodgatam |

gururdharmo gururmuktirgururjñānaṃ gururmakhaḥ |

yena kena prakāreṇa toṣaṇīyo gururyataḥ |

tathāpi gurupatnyāśca varūthasya ca bhālayoḥ |
āyurekhābhavatpūrvaṃ pūrṇā yā sā kṣatiṃ gatā ||82||
vicchinnābhūt paridṛṣṭā pratyakṣeṇa marīcinā |
marīciḥ prāha tau tatra kathaṃ tvāyuḥ kṣayaṃ gatam ||83||
prāhatustau yathā tathyaṃ marīcirvismayaṃ gataḥ |
akṛtaṃ tu kṛtaṃ hyābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ vai vacanānmama ||84||
nirdoṣaṃ tad gurorbhaktakṛte vākyaṃ guroḥ sadā |
anena pālitaṃ vākyaṃ madīyaṃ kintu hānidam ||85||
brahmasvaharaṇaṃ gurutalpagāmitvamityapi |
viśvāsaghātitā kṛtaghnatā hyāyurvināśakāḥ ||86||
ābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ tattu mayā kāryaṃ śubhaṃ tayoḥ |
yāvadevaṃ cintayati tāvad yamasya sevakāḥ ||87||
āyayustau samānetuṃ purīṃ yāmyāṃ prati dhruvam |
marīcistatra nāvocad yāmyā nītvā yayurdrutam ||88||
marīciranuyātaśca tadā tanaiva varṣmaṇā |
dūtaistau dharmarājasya purataḥ saṃkṛtāvubhau ||89||
daṇḍaśca taptalohasya sūrmyā yogo’nayoḥ kṛtaḥ |
marīciḥ prāha dharmeśaṃ tvayā yogyaṃ kṛtaṃ vibho ||1.248.90 ||
kintu madvacanātsarvaṃ kṛtaṃ doṣo na vai tayoḥ |
duṣṭaṃ yadi gurorvākyaṃ doṣapātraṃ bhavāmyaham ||9 1 ||
yamasmṛtau tathā coktaṃ gurorvākyaṃ na doṣakṛt |
yamavākyaṃ tu cetsatyaṃ mamavākyaṃ na doṣakṛt || 92|||
mama vākyena saṃsaktau kathaṃ tau doṣasaṃyutau |
tasmānnaitau daṇḍapātre yathecchasi tathā kuru ||93||
yāvadetau na muñcethāstāvannaiva jalādikam |
gṛhṇāmyatra tavātithyaṃ yathecchasi tathā kuru ||94||
dharmastu pitṛvṛddhasya marīcervacanaṃ tadā |
śrutvā vicārayāmāsa naṣṭaṃ tvāyurvikarmaṇā ||95||
sandhīyetānayoḥ kenopāyena prabalena tu |
madvākyaṃ ca gurorvākyaṃ supramāṇaṃ bhavettathā ||96||
kiṃ kartavyaṃ mama tvatra viruddhe viṣaye khalu |
yadi vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ me naitau daṇḍārhaṇau tadā ||97||
yadi daṇḍārhaṇau tvetau nāsmadvākyapramāṇatā |
tasmāt kimatra kartavyaṃ tvāyuḥsandhānakarmaṇi ||98||
varūthena tadā tatra saṃkalpitaṃ gurorbalam |
yadyahaṃ gurubhakto’smi gurvājñāṃ prakaromi ca || 99||
tadā gurvātmakaḥ kṛṣṇo gurorvākyāt prarakṣatu |
smaratyevaṃ tu yāvat saḥ varūtho gururūpiṇam || 1.248.10 0||
hariṃ tāvattadā tatra vyomavāṇī babhūva ha |
dharmarāja śṛṇu tvaitau nirjalau nāptabhojanau || 10 1||
marīciścāpyannajalavihīno vartate’dya vai |
gururūpo’smyahaṃ cāpi guruṃ tau smarato yataḥ || 102|||
etairmadāśrayaṃ manye kṛtaṃ tvekādaśīvratam |
kalāvarūthayorāyūrekhā pūrṇādya jāyatām || 1 03||
varūthasyoddharaṇena nāmnā tvekādaśī tvapi |
varūthinī prasiddhāstu varūthoddhārakāriṇī || 1 04||
kalāyuṣaḥ pratisandhānena saṃjīvanī tu sā |
ānandapradayā vyomavāṇyā hyānanditā hyapi || 1 05||
nandayā sahitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svāmyasyāḥ saṃbhavāmi ca |
nandayā sahitaṃ māṃ tu ye’rcayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 106 ||
gurudāraratāścāpi bhaviṣyanti hi pāvanāḥ |
śiṣyaratiprakartryaśca śuddhiṃ yāsyanti yoṣitaḥ || 1 07||
varūthinyā vratinaśca niṣpāpā vai narāḥ striyaḥ |
cirāyuṣkā bhaviṣyanti naṣṭāyuṣo’pi madbalāt || 1 08||
paradravyaharā ye ca paradāraprasaṃginaḥ |
varūthinīvratapūtā bhaviṣyanti dyuvāsinaḥ || 1 09||
yamarājabhayaṃ teṣāṃ na syānnāyurvināśanam |
na vaidhavyaṃ na vai duḥkhaṃ vidhuratvaṃ na vā bhavet || 1.248.11 0||
sūryaputrādatibhīto janaḥ kuryād varūthinīm |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ prayāti paramāṃ gatim || 111 ||
tasmāt sarvaprayatnena kartavyā pāpabhīrubhiḥ |
śravaṇāt paṭhanāttvasyā gosahasraphalaṃ bhavet || 112||
ajñānācca haṭhāccāpi varūthinyā vrataṃ caret |
sarvapāpavinirmuktaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ nayāmyaham || 113 ||
tasmādetau pramuñca tvaṃ yamarāja varūthakam |
kalāṃ cātharṣivaryaṃ ca marīciṃ tvatithiṃ kuru || 1 14||
satkāraṃ kuru datvaiva patnīṃ śiṣyaṃ sukhī bhava |
anyathā vratapuṇyena śāpaṃ dāsyati cedṛṣiḥ || 1 15||
bhasmībhūtaṃ tu te sarvaṃ sthalaṃ yāmyaṃ bhaviṣyati |
varūthinyā vratakarturgṛhaṃ mā yāntu te carāḥ || 116 ||
varūthinīdine copoṣitāraṃ cāpyamānakam |
mā prayāntu ca te dūtā yato me vratakṛddhi saḥ || 1 17||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau vyomavāṇī harikṛtā |
yamarājo’pi tau pūrṇāyuṣau dṛṣṭvā mumoca ha || 1 18||
nirdoṣau guruvākyasthau doṣāliptau kalāruthau |
marīcinā samaṃ yātau nijāvāsaṃ yamālayāt || 119 |
evaṃ te kathito lakṣmi varūthinīvratotsavaḥ |
kṛtvā śrutvā paṭhitvā taṃ viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 1.248.120 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vaiśākhakṛṣṇavarūthinyekādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ marīceḥ patnyāḥ kalāyāḥ varūthena śiṣyeṇa gurupatnīvākyabhaktena saṃgadoṣe’pi vratena taduddharaṇādītinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 248||

<1.249>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
bhagavan devadeveśa bhaktānāmabhayaṃkara |
āyuḥpradaṃ vrataṃ samyak śrāvitaṃ bhavatā vibho || 1 ||
śrutvā varūthaviprasya mahāpātakanāśanam |
prasannaṃ jāyate cetaḥ kṛpāsāgara keśava || 2 ||
vaiśākhaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃ nāmnyekādaśī matā |
kiṃ phalaṃ ko vidhistatra ko devo vada mādhava || 3 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
padmaje kathayiṣyāmi lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yadvratānāmuttamaṃ vratam || 4 ||
vaiśākhasyārjune pakṣe nāmato mohinī tu sā |
bhavedekādaśī lakṣmi sarvapātakanāśinī || 5 ||
pāpajālāni naśyanti moho naśyati tadvratāt |
mahāduḥkhāni naśyanti sukhaṃ bhavati tadvratāt || 6 ||
yasyāḥ kartavyatābhāvādapi pāpaṃ vinaśyati |
daśamyāmekabhaktena naktenāpi vratārthinā || 7 ||
vartitavyaṃ tathā rātrau brahmacaryavratena ca |
prātarutthāya kṛṣṇaśca smartavyo vratinā sadā || 8 ||
snātvā hariḥ supūjyaśca pūjanīyo vratārthinā |
nityavidhyanusāreṇa vratārthaṃ prārthanāṃ kriyāt || 9 ||
adyāhaṃ devadeveśa kariṣye vratamacyuta |
tavānugrahaleśena saṃpūrṇaṃ tadbhavediti || 1.249.10 ||
evaṃ tu pūjanaṃ nityatayā prāptaṃ samāpya ca |
kārayet sarvatobhadramaṇḍalaṃ taṇḍulādibhiḥ || 11 ||
tanmadhye sughaṭaḥ sthāpyaḥ suvarṇasyātha vā navaḥ |
tāmrajaḥ sajalaḥ pañcaratnayuk pañcapallavaḥ || 1 2||
vastraveṣṭitakaṇṭhaśca candanākṣatapūjitaḥ |
phalaṃ nyasyennārikelaṃ pārśve tasyāntarābbhṛtam || 13 ||
nyasyenmukhopari ramyāṃ sthālīṃ tilaprapūritām |
tatra nyasyet svarṇarūpyatāmradravyaṃ ca śarkarām || 14||
kārayitvā kanakasya mūrtiṃ tvekādaśīpateḥ |
madhusūdanadevasya mādhavyā saha śobhitām || 15||
mohinyā ca yutāṃ tatra sthālyāṃ vai sthāpayettu tām |
svarganiḥśreṇikāṃ kūpyamayīṃ nyasyetprapūjayet || 1 6||
svastikaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca candrakaṃ tilakaṃ tathā |
svarṇaraupyaṃ kārayitvā ghaṭapārśve nidhāpayet || 17||
phalāni vividhānyeva pūgīphalādikāni ca |
elālavaṃgatvaksārajātīphalāni cūrṇakam || 18 ||
śarkarāṃ gūḍadhānādīn navavastūni dāpayet |
paryaṃkaṃ gendukaṃ guptadorakaṃ pārśvakaṃ tathā || 1 9||
darpaṇaṃ vyajanaṃ chatraṃ cāmaraṃ yaṣṭikāṃ śubhām |
pāduke keśasaṃskartrīṃ sugandhadravyasaṃyutām || 1.249.20 ||
sajalaṃ mṛdghaṭaṃ navyaṃ pakvānyāmraphalāni ca |
vinyasyet pūjanaṃ kuryād vidhinā vratakārakaḥ || 21 ||
puṣpeṣu mallikāṃ dadyānnaivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ śubham |
arghyaṃ phalaṃ tu panasaṃ śayyādānaṃ samuttamam || 22||
prathamaṃ tilapātre taṃ madhusūdanamacyutam |
āvāhayet tato dadyādāsanaṃ cottamottamam || 23 ||
pādaprakṣālanavāri tathārcanajalaṃ śubham |
ācamanārthe salilaṃ dadyād devāya bhāvataḥ || 24||
dantadhāvanamārdraṃ ca dadyāccūrṇaṃ sugandhavat |
mukhaprakṣālanaṃ tasya kārayet tīrthavāriṇā || 25 ||
śaucādikalpayeddhastapādaśuddhiṃ prakalpayet |
paṃcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayecca śuddhodakena tatparam || 26 ||
vastrairāmārjanaṃ kuryāt suvastrāṇi samarpayet |
dhautraṃ sūkṣma śubhaṃ prāvaraṇaṃ śvetaṃ navaṃ tathā || 27||
arpayeccandanaṃ tailaṃ sugandhaṃ dravyamattaram |
gandhasāraṃ maṇiṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca kajjalādikam || 28 ||
kuṃkumaṃ tvarpayeccābīraṃ gulālaṃ śubhākṣatān |
puṣpāṇi kundakalikārūpāṇi puṣpamālikāḥ || 29||
vibhūṣaṇāni sarvāṇi śṛṃgāradravyamuttamam |
alaṃkārāṇi ramyāṇi tvarpayeddharaye tadā || 1.249.30 ||
tilakaṃ candrakaṃ bhāle kārayeccandanena vai |
lepayeccābhito varṣmaṇi vratī hṛdayādike || 31 ||
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca naivedyaṃ dadyānmiṣṭānnamuttamam |
śārkaraṃ dadhisāraṃ śrīkhaṇḍaṃ dadyāttu pūrikāḥ || 32||
śārkaraṃ śītasalilaṃ phalaṃ cāmraṃ ca bīṭikām |
nāgavallīparṇakṛtāṃ dadyāttvanyattu yat kṛtam || 33 ||
ārārtrikaṃ namaskāraṃ stutiṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ tathā |
daṇḍavacca kṣamāyāñcāṃ phalapūrṇatvayācanām || 34 ||
puṣpāñjaliṃ dakṣiṇāṃ ca dadyāt paścād visarjayet |
kuryāccāvaśyakaṃ kāryaṃ vratī bhaktyātmakaṃ tadā || 35 ||
madhyāhne pūjayet kṛṣṇaṃ bhojanaṃ kārayed bahu |
ṣaṭpaṃcāśatprabhogām̐śca dadyādarthānvitastadā || 36 ||
jalapānaṃ pradadyācca tāmbūlaṃ mukhaśodhakam |
dadyācca taṃ namaskṛtya vratī bhaktyādikaṃ caret || 37||
sāyaṃ cārārtrikaṃ kuryānnaivedyaṃ ca jalārpaṇam |
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaiḥ kārayed bandhayecca saḥ || 38 ||
preṃkhāṃ suśobhitāṃ ramyāṃ navapallavatoraṇām |
āndolayeddhariṃ tatra sthāpayitvā svayaṃ vratī || 39 ||
pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastūttamairnirvartayedvratī |
rātrau bhaktiyutaṃ kālaṃ bhaktaiḥ saha tu yāpayet ||1.249.40 ||
evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānmahotsavapuraḥsaram |
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gītiṃ tālamānādisaṃyutām ||4 1 ||
smaraṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi kathākhyānāni kārayet |
gāpayet kṛṣṇapadyāni narā nāryaśca sarvathā ||42||
harikīrtanayuktāśca kuryurjāgaraṇaṃ tathā |
prātaḥ smareddhariṃ snātvā punaḥ pūjanamācaret ||43 ||
vratī dānāni dadyācca gurave’tisubhāvataḥ |
bhojayed brāhmaṇān sādhūn sādhvīrbālām̐ca pūjayet ||44||
dīnān kṛpaṇān bālikāśca parādhīnām̐śca bhojayet |
āśritān karmacārām̐śca pramadāśca kuṭumbinaḥ ||45||
pūjyām̐śca bhojayenmiṣṭaṃ mātṛm̐śca janakām̐stathā |
vṛddhām̐śca bhojayennamrabhāvanāṃ ca pradarśayet ||46||
tato vratī svayaṃ kuryātpāraṇāṃ tu hariṃ smaran |
śayyādānaṃ gajavājigodānaṃ bhūgṛhārpaṇam ||47||
susatpātre prakuryāttu yānavāhadhanārpaṇam |
evaṃ vratī vrataṃ kurvannāpnoti paramaṃ padam ||48 ||
śāśvataṃ ca sukhaṃ svarge yatheṣṭaṃ kṛpayā hareḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ pūrvabhavāṃ vaiśyasya pāvanīm ||49||
saurāṣṭre tu sarasvatyāḥ prācyā nātividūrake |
uttare tu pradeśe vai bhadrāvatyāstu dakṣiṇe ||1.249.5 0 ||
bhāṇḍīrākhyanagaryāṃ vai dhṛtisiṃho’bhavannṛpaḥ |
tasya śreṣṭhī dhanapālo hyabhavaddhanaśevadhiḥ ||5 1 ||
dhanapālaḥ sadā khyātaḥ puṇyakāryapravartane |
prapākūpamaṭhārāmataḍāgagṛhakārakaḥ ||52||
viṣṇubhaktaḥ sādhusevī paropakṛtisadvrataḥ |
kathāśravaṇasuśraddhaḥ sarvadā bhaktitatparaḥ ||53||
putrāstasyābhavan pañca śreṣṭhino dhanaśālinaḥ |
sumanā dyutimām̐ścaiva medhāvī sukṛtistathā ||54||
catvāraḥ puṇyapātrāṇi pañcamaścātipāpakṛt |
dhṛṣṭabuddhiriti khyātaḥ parastrīsaṃgasaṃrataḥ |||55|||
dyūtādivyasanāsakto vārastrīratikārakaḥ |
devapūjāvihīnaśca pitṛtarpaṇanāstikaḥ ||56||
dvijānāṃ nindako vedanindako nyāyavarjitaḥ |
duṣṭātmā svapiturdravyanāśako madirāpibaḥ ||57||
abhakṣyabhakṣaka pāpī sarvasampatkṣayaṃkaraḥ |
cauryādikarmanirato duṣṭasaṃgo hyakarmakṛt ||58||
pitrā catuṣpathe dṛṣṭo veśyāskandhasthahastakaḥ |
pāpācārarataścaivaṃ vijñāto bandhubhistataḥ ||59||
pitrā niṣkāsito gehād bāndhavaiśca vivāsitaḥ |
dāyabhāgena yatkiṃcillabdhaṃ nirvāhakaṃ dhanam ||1.249.60 ||
sarvaṃ nītaṃ kṣayaṃ tena veśyāsaṃgena nityadā |
ābhūṣaṇāni pātrāṇi vastrāṇyupaskarāṇi ca ||61 ||

dhanahīnaḥ parityakto gaṇikābhistataḥ sa tu ||62||
cintāturobhavad vastradhanahīnaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ |
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi jīvanopāyavarjitaḥ ||63||
tasmāt kāryaṃ taskaratvaṃ cauryaṃ kāryaṃ prasahya ca |

evaṃ balāpaharaṇaṃ karoti vanage pathi |
pitustu nagare rātrau taskaratvaṃ karoti ca ||65||
surāṃ pibati nityaṃ sa māṃsaṃ khādati nityadā |
cauryaṃ nityaṃ karotyeva puṃścalīsaṃgatiṃ gataḥ ||66||
rātrau cauryaṃ suvarṇasya kṛtaṃ tena tu tatkṣaṇe |

muktiṃ prāpya gato’raṇye punaścauryaṃ cakāra saḥ ||68||

bandhanānmuktimāsādya gato’raṇyaṃ punastathā ||69||

janānāmardanaṃ cakre saṃghānāṃ luṇṭanaṃ tathā ||1.249.70||
punaśca nagare caurye kartuṃ rātrau yayau tadā |
manuṣyaiḥ sa durācāro nibaddho raśmibhirdṛḍhaiḥ ||7 1 ||
nigaḍairdaṇḍito rājñā kaśāghātaiśca tāḍitaḥ |

nirbandho vanamāsādya bhojanārthaṃ pradhāvati |
siṃhavadghātayatyugro mṛgaśūkaravānarān ||73 ||
āmiṣāhāranirato vane bhramati sarvathā |

āraṇyakān paśūn patatriṇo hanti padā caran |
cakravākānkapotām̐śca pārāvatām̐śca tittirān ||75||

pūrvapāpaiḥ pāpamārge pravṛttaḥ pāpakarmasu ||77 ||
duḥkhāviṣṭaḥ sukhaleśarahito’bhūdaharniśam |
evaṃ vṛkṣeṣu śaileṣu durge cāraṇyabhūmiṣu ||78||
anāsano’ṭati daivāt prāptaḥ kuṇḍinanāmakam |
puraṃ hyudyānaśobhāḍhyaṃ nikaṭe vanabhūmikam ||79||
nātidūre vane tatra kauṇḍinyākhyo mahānṛṣiḥ |
svāśrame vartate nityaṃ pānthānāṃ śāntisampradaḥ ||1.249.8 0 ||
atithīn satkarotyeṣo bhakṣyapānāsanādibhiḥ |
gato’yaṃ tvāśramadvāre muniṃ śrutvā tapodhanam ||8 1 ||
vaiśākhe māsi sarasi kṛtasnānaṃ tapodhanam |
āsasāda dhṛṣṭabuddhiḥ svoddhārodayasanmukhaḥ ||8 2||
pādayoḥ patitaḥ prahvībhāvenaivārdramānasaḥ |
tāvadṛṣerārdravastrabindavaḥ patitāstadā ||8 3 ||
mastake dhṛṣṭabuddhestu skandhayoḥ karayostathā |
nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi ||84||
vadato munirājasya śabdo’pi śravaṇe gataḥ |
evaṃ mantreṇa ṛṣiṇā salilena tu pāvitaḥ ||85 ||
caraṇasparśamātreṇa naṣṭapāpo babhūva saḥ |
mumukṣutāṃkurodbhedo jātastatra kṣaṇe’sya ca ||86 ||
kauṇḍinyasyāgrataḥ sthitvā samuvāca kṛtāṃjaliḥ |
bho bho brahmanmokṣadātardayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari ||87||
yena puṇyaprabhāveṇa muktirbhavati pāpinaḥ |
tādṛśaṃ puṇyakāryaṃ me vrataṃ vā vada mokṣadam ||88 ||
mahātmanāṃ prasaṃgena mahāpātakino’pi ca |
taranti pāvanā bhūtvā pāvayantyaparānapi ||8 9||

tathā tvaṃ yatase nātha kṛpā kevalakāraṇam || 4 ||

devaṃ pūjāṃ ca māhātmyaṃ kṛpālo dānamityapi || 9 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
aṣāḍhakṛṣṇapakṣīyā yoginīsaṃjñikā matā |
kṣemaṃkaryā sahātrārcyo nṛsiṃhākhyo hariḥ prabhuḥ || 6 ||
bhṛṃgarājo’tra puṣpeṣu tathārghye jāmbavaṃ phalam |
naivedye piṇḍakā deyā dāne tu jalagaurmatā || 7 |

sarvapāpakṣayakṛcca sarvabhuktipradāyakam || 8 ||
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ potarūpaṃ sanātanam |
jagattraye sārabhūtaṃ yoginīvratamuttamam || 9 ||
daśamyāmekabhaktena naktena vratinā khalu |
bhūśāyinā vartitavyaṃ brahmacaryādinā tathā || 1.252.10||
ekādaśyāṃ vratī prātarutthāya śrīhariṃ smaret |
dhyātvā snātvā pūjayitvā hariṃ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 1 1||
prārthayed bhagavan kṛṣṇa yoginyā vratamuttamam |

ityabhyarthya tato dhānyaiḥ kārayet sarvataḥ śubham || 13||

madhye saṃsthāpayetsvarṇakalaśaṃ ratnagarbhitam || 14||

śālagrāmaṃ pūjayecca gaṇeśaṃ pūjayettathā || 16||
pūjādravyaiḥ pūjayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ narasiṃhakam |
pūjayetparayā bhaktyā svarṇanirmitamūrtikam || 17||

āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtaiḥ sugandhicandanaiḥ || 18||

dhūpadīpasunaivedyaphalatāmbūlavāribhiḥ || 19||
ārārtrikastutipuṣpāṃjalyādibhiḥ samarcayet |
kṣamāparādhaṃ tvabhyarthya svakāryaṃ cet kriyāt tataḥ ||1.252.2 0||
madhyāhnepi sunaivedyaṃ tvāmrarasaśrīkhaṇḍakam |
śītalaṃ madhuraṃ vāri pūrikā dadhi śarkarām ||21 ||

bhojayenmukhavāsaṃ ca pūgīphalaṃ ca vīṭikām ||22||
dadyātsāyaṃ tathā saumyaṃ kārayenmaṇḍapaṃ navam |
tatra dolāṃ bandhayitvā sthāpayitvā hariṃ tataḥ ||23 ||
āndolayetsamudyāne vihārayeditastataḥ |
śādvale śītale bhāge viśramayejjanārdanam ||24||
pūjayed vividhaiḥ śreṣṭhairvastubhiśca tataḥ param |
nīrājayennarasiṃhaṃ stutiṃ kuryācca saiṃhikīm || 25||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛsiṃhapadagāyanaiḥ |
prātarutsāhapūrvaṃ taṃ dhyātvā snātvā prapūjayet||| 26 ||
vidhivadvastubhiḥ sarvairnivedya miṣṭamiṣṭakam |

jaladānaṃ jaladhenuṃ svarṇadhenuṃ ghṛtādikam |
dadhi dugdhaṃ navanītaṃ śarkarāṃ gūḍamityapi ||28 ||
dadyād dānaṃ supātrāya yānaṃ vāhanamarthakam |
gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dadyād ghaṭaṃ mūrtiṃ harestathā ||29||
miṣṭānnāni tathānyāni dāpayet sadbhya eva ca |
gṛhakṣetrapaśūdyānadāsadānāni kārayet || 1.252.3 0||
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhakto yoginyā_ śraddhayā yutaḥ |

svānucaro mahāyakṣo hemamālīti nāmataḥ || 33 ||

evaṃ nityaṃ śaṃkarasya pūjopakaraṇāni saḥ || 34||
upasthāpayati tatra sadā kuberasannidhau |
sa kintu yauvanodbhedāt kāmapūreṇa saṃbhṛtaḥ || 35||
svapatnyā tu viśālākṣyā saha kāme viśeṣataḥ |
kāmabāṇena cākṛṣṭo vartate divase’pi ca || 36||
kāryaṃ cāpi parityajya kāmanāyāṃ pravartate |
evaṃ cātīva kāmārthī patnyā saha kvacitkvacit || 37||
kusumādīni cānetuṃ gacchatyeva drumādiṣu |
ekadā tu kubereṇa mānasākhyasaraḥ prati ||38 ||
preṣito hemamālī saḥ kamalānayanāya vai |
so’pi nūtnaṃ saro ramyaṃ dṛśyārhaṃ tvabhimatya ca || 39 ||
patnyā saha gatastatrānetuṃ su kamalāni tu |
jalaṃ ca śādvalaṃ sūkṣmavālukācākacakyatām ||1.252.40 ||
ramaṇīyapradeśaṃ ca sugandhikusumādikam |
rājasaṃ vividhaṃ bhāvaṃ vihārakṣobhakārakam ||4 1 ||
dṛṣṭvā vikṛtimāyāto visṛjya kusumāni ca |
patnyā saha tadā reme mānase tu sarovare ||42||
patnyā muhurdhṛtaḥ kāme saṃsakto na nivartate |
tṛptāpi tu punaḥ patnī pravṛttā na nivartate ||43||
evaṃ parasparaṃ prāptau kāmabhāvau viśeṣataḥ |
punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttau tau vividaturna mohitau ||44||
kālātikramaṇaṃ jātaṃ pūjāyāśca tathāpi tau |
puṣpāṇyādāya nāyātau kubero’pi pratīkṣate ||45||
kāmapremarasāsaktau na kuberālayaṃ gatau |
kubero devasadane karoti śivapūjanam ||46 ||
prātaḥ kālo vyatītaśca madhyāhnasamaye tataḥ |
kuberaḥ pūjanārthaṃ tu puṣpāgamasamīkṣakaḥ ||47||
cintayāmāsa vighnaṃ vai yato nāyāti yakṣakaḥ |
dvitīyo yakṣakastatra preṣito’nveṣaṇāya yat ||48||
sa gatvā ramamāṇaṃ taṃ dadarśa hemamālinam |
hemamālī tu salile ramate kāntayā saha ||49||
preṣyastau prāha puṣpāṇi sa kāṃkṣati kuberarāṭ |
śīghraṃ vai tatra gantavyaṃ madhyāhne pūjanaṃ bhavet ||1.252.50||
iti kṛtvā gatau puṣpāṇyādāya rājarājakam |
kuberaṃ tau tato natvā yayācāte kṣamāṃ muhuḥ ||5 1||
yakṣarāṭ pratyuvācātha kālātikramakopitaḥ |
vanitākāmukaṃ jñātvā ramamāṇaṃ nijecchayā ||52||
āḥ pāpa duṣṭa durvṛtta kāmāsaktatayā tvayā |
anādāya tu puṣpāṇi kṛtaṃ vai devahelanam |||5 3 ||
kāmabhogo mahān vighnaḥ sa ca doṣo mahānmataḥ |
daṇḍastatra pradātavyo na kartavyā mayā kṛpā ||54||
bhavāṣṭādaśakuṣṭhī tvaṃ viyukto kāntayā tayā |
asmātsthānādapadhvasto gacchasvādhama bhūtalam ||55||
ityukte vacane yakṣastasmātsthānātpapāta ha |
mahāduḥkhābhibhūtaśca kuṣṭhaiścitritavigrahaḥ ||56||
galatkuṣṭhaḥ śvetakuṣṭho raktakuṣṭho’bhavattadā |
carmakuṣṭho lalatkuṣṭho durgandhapūyakuṣṭhakaḥ |||57|
evaṃ jātaḥ śarīre sa hemamālī svakarmaṇā |
divā sukhaṃ na labhate na nidrāṃ labhate niśi ||58||
chāyāyāṃ vā nidāghe vā gṛhe kuṃje ca gahvare |
kuṭyāṃ bhūmau latāmadhye labhate na sukhaṃ kvacit |||59||
dāhena pīḍyate cāti kharjanena jvalatyapi |
pātakenābhibhūtopi pūrvakarma smaratyasau ||1.252.60||
śivārpitasu puṣpādiphalaprābalyato nanu |
patitasyābhibhūtasya smṛtistasya na lupyati ||61||
himālaye mahāraṇye ghorarūpa itastataḥ |
bhramamāṇo yayau devān mārkaḍeyāśramaṃ śubham ||62|||
taponidhiṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ brahmadhyānaparāyaṇam |
yasyāyurvidyate lakṣmi brahmaṇo dinasaptakam ||63|||
vavande caraṇau tasya dūrataḥ kuṣṭhavigrahaḥ |
mārkaṃḍeyo dayāṃ kṛtvā kampitaṃ duṣṭavigraham ||64||
paropakaraṇārthāya samāhūyedamabravīt |
kasmātkuṣṭhābhibhūtastvaṃ kuto nindyatamo hyasi ||65||
śrutvā prāha tadā sopi muniṃ pāpavināśakam |
rājarājasyānucaro hemamālīti nāmataḥ ||66||
udyānātpadmanicayaṃ tvānīya pratyahaṃ mune |
śivapūjanavelāyāṃ kuberāya samārpayam ||67||
ekasmindivase patnyā sahito’haṃ kṛpālunā |
saṃpreṣitaḥ kubereṇa tvānetuṃ kamalāni hi ||68||
atisugandhicitrāṇi mānasākhyasarovaram |
dṛṣṭvā tu nūtanaṃ ramyaṃ bhūtalaṃ sajalaṃ śubham ||69||
kāmasukhaprasaktābhyāṃ kālaścāvidito gataḥ |
puṣpaṃ vinā śivapūjā prātarjātā tato hyaham ||1.252.70||
atikruddhena śapto’smi rājarājena vai mune |
kuṣṭhābhibhūtaḥ saṃjāto viyuktaḥ kāntayā tayā ||7 1||
bhramamāṇo’tra sānnidhye prāptohaṃ me śubhaṃ kuru |
satāṃ svabhāvataścittaṃ paropakaraṇe kṣamam ||72||
iti madarthaṃ bhagavan kuru saukhyaṃ bhaved yathā |
śrutvā tathyaṃ tadovāca mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ ||73||
śṛṇu vratopadeśaṃ te kathayāmi śubhapradam |
āṣāḍhe kṛṣṇapakṣasyaikādaśīvratamācara ||74||
yoginīvratapuṇyena kuṣṭhaṃ yāsyati vai dhruvam |
punaḥ prāpsyasi patnīṃ tvaṃ lapsyase śāśvataṃ sukham ||75|||
itivākyamṛṣeḥ śrutvā daṇḍavatpatito bhuvi |
āśīrbhirvardhitastena babhūvātīva harṣitaḥ ||76||
yoginyekādaśīṃ cakre vratī tvāśramasannidhau |
mārkaṃḍeyasya kṛṣṇasya pūjanaṃ pracakāra saḥ ||77||
munervacanataḥ samyag vrate cīrṇe’bhavatsukhī |
aṣṭādaśaiva kuṣṭhāni tanau naṣṭāni sarvathā ||78||
gato natvā svakaṃ lokaṃ yakṣo bhūtvā yathāyatham |
labdhvā patnīṃ punastvevālakāyāṃ nyavasatsukham ||79|||
evaṃ śāpanivṛttirvai yoginīvratato bhavet |
kuṣṭhādiroganāśaśca patnī naṣṭāpi labhyate ||1.252.8 0||
lokaḥ sthānaṃ gṛhaṃ smṛddhirnaṣṭaṃ vai prāpyate punaḥ |
yoginyā vratapuṇyena yogalabhyaṃ lased vratī ||8 1 ||
idṛgvidhaṃ mahālakṣmi kathitaṃ yoginīvratam |
nāryā bhūtvā tu yoginyā yoginā tu nareṇa ca ||82|||
kartavyaṃ yogaphaladaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ vratam |
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi sādhūn bhojayate tu yaḥ ||83||

yogābhyāsaphaladātrī yogilokapradāyinī ||84||

<1.253>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kālo māyā tathātmānaḥ śaktayaḥ santi yasya tāḥ |
namastasmai bhagavate śaktisvāmiparātmane || 1 ||
yoginīphaladātre te yogapuṇyaphalātmane |
yogilabhyāya yogāya yoginīpataye namaḥ || 2 ||
tvameva phaladātāsi tvamevāsi ca muktikṛt |
tvamevādhipatiścāsi namastasmai mahātmane || 3 ||
sarvadevasvarūpastvaṃ sarvatīrthātmako’si ca |
sarvavratātmakastvaṃ vai tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ || 4 ||
āṣāḍhasya site pakṣe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet |
ko devaḥ ko vidhistvasyāḥ phalaṃ dānaṃ ca me vada || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
kathayāmi mahāpuṇyāṃ svargamokṣapradāyinīm |
śayanīṃ nāma nāmnā tu sarvapāpavināśinīm || 6 ||
niyamāṃ bhāmikāṃ cāpi tāmeva viddhi nāmataḥ |
yasyā vratena pāpātmā pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 7 ||
yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa vājapeyaphalaṃ bhavet |
ataḥ parā na cānyāsti svargamokṣapradā śubhā || 8 ||
asyāstvadhipatirdevo vāmano’sti haristataḥ |
kamalākhyapriyāyuktaḥ pūjanīyo hi vāmanaḥ || 9 ||
vāmanaḥ pūjito yena kamalaiḥ kamalekṣaṇaḥ |
niyamākhyaśayanyāṃ tu tenārcitaṃ jagattrayam || 1.253.1 0||
trayo devāḥ pūjitāśca pūjitāḥ sarvadevatāḥ |
kṛtā tvekādaśī yena harivāsara uttamaḥ || 11 ||
āṣāḍhaśuklaikādaśyāṃ śete kṣīranidhau hariḥ |
sarvendriyapravāhām̐stu parāvṛtyātiyogataḥ || 12 ||
tasya pūjā tvapāmārgaiḥ pūrikādinivedanaiḥ |
nālikerīphalādyaiśca svarṇagodānapūrvikā || 13 ||
kartavyā vratinā bhaktyā niyamagrahaṇaṃ tathā |
śrūyatāṃ ca mahālakṣmi kathā puṇyapradāyinī || 14||
balirvai dānavaḥ pūrvamāsīt tretāyuge priye |
pūjayam̐ścaiva māṃ nityaṃ madbhakto matparāyaṇaḥ || 15||
yajñaistu bahubhirdaityo vidhinā yajati sma mām |
parayā snehasadbhaktyā vratopoṣaṇapūjanaiḥ || 16||
evaṃ puṇyaprabhāveṇa mamopāsanayā tathā |
rasātalātsamāyātaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sa nṛpo’bhavat || 17||
pṛthvyāṃ cāpi mama pūjābalena vardhito’bhavat |
svargaṃ tenaiva dehena yayau puṇyaprabhāvataḥ || 18||
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ vaśe svasya svargabhūlokasaṃyutam |
indrādayo’pi tasyāgre tvabhavannirbalāḥ surāḥ || 19||
dānavā vardhitāḥ puṣṭāstrilokyāmabhavannṛpāḥ |
indrādibhistadā devairarthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ ||1.253.20|
hariḥ śaṃbhustathā brahmā taistu yuktiḥ parā kṛtā |
baliḥ karotu yajñaṃ ca dātā bhavatu cādhvare || 21 ||
bhūtvā tu bhikṣukaḥ kṛṣṇo mahībhikṣāṃ karotu saḥ |
evaṃ tu samayaṃ kṛtvā yajñārthaṃ prairayad balim ||22||
ṛṣayo munayo devā hyahaṃ sarve gatāḥ kṛtau |
revatācalasānnidhye yatra yajñaḥ pravartate |||23||

atimahatsvarūpeṇa sarvabrahmāṇḍayoginā ||24||
vākchalena jito dātā satyamāśritya yaḥ sthitaḥ |
śukrastaṃ vārayāmāsa yannārāyaṇa ityaham ||25|||
yācitā vasudhā lakṣmi mayā sārdhapadatrayā |
saṃkalpodakamātre tu kare tenaiva cārpite |||26|||
rūpaṃ brahmāṇḍapūrṇaṃ vai tadā lakṣmi mayā kṛtam |
bhūrloke caraṇau nyasya bhuvarloke tu jānunī ||27||

janaloke tu hṛdayaṃ tapoloke galaṃ tathā |||28||
satyaloke mukhaṃ nyasya vairāje mastakaṃ nyadhām |
sūryacandragrahatārā nakṣatradhūmraketavaḥ ||29||
devāḥ sendrāśca nāgāśca yakṣagandharvakinnarāḥ |
astuvanvedamantraiste sūktaiśca vividhaistadā || 1.253.30||
baliṃ dhṛtvā kare tatra padenāpūritā mahī |
dvitīyena svarāptaṃ cāṇḍakaṭāhasamanvitam ||3 1||
tṛtīyaṃ tu baleḥ pṛṣṭhe tadā nyastaṃ padaṃ mayā |

evaṃ yaḥ kurute lakṣmi śayanyāstu vratottamam |

āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt pañcāmṛtasusecanam ||47||
vastrālaṃkārabhūṣādihāracandanakajjalam |
sarvaśṛṃgārarāgām̐śca tvarpayettilakādikam ||48||
dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlasatphalam |
nīrājananamaskārastutibandikṣamāpanam ||49||

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
śrīkṛṣṇasya hareryogāt sarvaṃ bhavati nirguṇam |
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi caturbāhusvarūpadam || 1 ||
yatkiṃcitkarma kāmyaṃ vā phalecchāvidhuraṃ ca vā |
kṛṣṇatuṣṭyai kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ golokapradameva tat || 2 ||
tadvrataṃ sā kriyā ramyā sa dharmastattu pūjanam |
yena tuṣṭo bhavetsvāmī harikṛṣṇaḥ satāṃ patiḥ || 3 ||
cāturmāsyavrataṃ tadvai yena tuṣyati mādhavaḥ |
yamāśca niyamāste vai yena tuṣṭo hyadhokṣajaḥ || 4 ||
vada śrāvaṇakṛṣṇe me kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā |
ko devaḥ ko vidhistasyāḥ kiṃ puṇyaṃ kathaya prabho || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi ca te vakṣye lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā |
śrāvaṇaikādaśī kṛṣṇā kāmikā nāma nāmataḥ || 6 ||

na gaṃgāyāṃ na ca kāśyāṃ naimiṣe na na puṣkare |

godāvaryāṃ gurau siṃhe vyatīpāte ca daṇḍake |

raktamauktikavaidūryapravālādibhirarcitaḥ |

anekajanmapāpāni tasya yānti hi saṃkṣayam || 1.254.20 ||
yā dṛṣṭā pāpaśamanī spṛṣṭā dehasya pāvanī |
stutā roganirasanī siktāntakanivāriṇī || 21 ||

arpitā muktiphaladā tattulasyai namo namaḥ || 22||
ityuktvā tulasīṃ dadyād devāya paramātmane |

acyutasya svarṇamūrtiṃ vijayāsahitasya vai |

kīrtyārogyasusammānarājyasattārthī tallabhet | 2.254.40 ||
dharmārthakāmamokṣārthī vrataṃ kṛtvārjayettu tat |
śatrūpadravavighnāttikṣayārthī tatkṣayaṃ vrajet || 41 ||
evaṃ sarvapradaṃ tvetat kāmikāvratamuttamam |
svargadaṃ satyadaṃ tadvai tathā vairājalokadam ||42||
golokadaṃ vrataṃ caitadakṣarapradamuttamam |
sarvasiddhipradaṃ tvasyā ākhyānaṃ śṛṇu pūrvajam || 43 ||
śravaṇāḥ pitaraḥ pūrvaṃ dharmarājakulodbhavāḥ |
dharmeṇa yojitāḥ prāṇivṛttāntānayanāya te ||44 ||
yatra gacchanti jīvānāṃ vṛttāntānayanāya te |
na śṛṇvanti na paśyanti karma sūkṣmāt susūkṣmakam ||45||
na jānanti ca vṛttāntaṃ tvānayeyuḥ kathaṃ tu te |
ajānanto yama te nivedayeyuḥ kathaṃ tadā ||46 ||
iti cintāparā sarve militvāhuryamaṃ puraḥ |
sūkṣmakarmakṛtāṃ sarvaṃ yathā vidmo vayaṃ tathā || 47 ||
dharmarāja vidhehyeva jānīmo jīvakarma yat |
vayaṃ dvādaśasaṃkhyākā jīvāścāsaṃkhyakoṭayaḥ ||48 ||
kathaṃ kutra bhaved vyāptirasmākaṃ siddhimantarā |
tasmāt siddhiṃ pradehi tvaṃ yadvā darśaya tattapaḥ || 49 ||
yena syāma tavāgre vai sarvāvedanaśaktayaḥ |
śrutvā yamastu tānprāha sevadhvaṃ kāmikāvratam ||2.254.50 ||
śrāvaṇe kṛṣṇapakṣe sā kāmikaikādaśī matā |
sarvakāmasusaṃsiddhiyātrī tvaiśvaryasamprada || |5 1 ||
vidhiṃ śrutvā kāmikāyā vratasya śravaṇāstataḥ |
cakrurvrataṃ kāmikāyā dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ ||5 2 ||
dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇākāle prasanno dharmarājakaḥ |
svayaṃ viprasvarūpeṇātithirbhūtvā samāgataḥ || 53 ||
bhikṣāṃ dehīti sūccārya tasthau tvaṃgaṇabhūtale |
śravaṇairarpitāṃ bhikṣāṃ jagrāha bahubhāvataḥ ||54 ||
varaṃ vṛṇuta bho kṣatrāḥ prasanno’smi vratena vaḥ |
ityāha tān dharmadevo’cyutasya janakaḥ svayam ||55 ||
prāhuste śravaṇā taṃ vai jīvānāṃ sūkṣmakarmakam |
yathā jānīma evātra sārvajñyaṃ dehi tadvidham ||56 ||
dūraśravaṇamevāpi dūradarśanamityapi |
guptakartavyavettṛtvaṃ bahurūpadhṛtiṃ tathā ||57 ||
sarvadeśādisaṃstheṣu jīveṣu vyāpitāṃ tathā |
sarveṣāṃ sarvathā sarvavettṛtvaśaktimuttamām || 58 ||
śāśvatīṃ tatsmṛtiṃ cāpi yathārthāṃ dehi yadyathā |
śrutvaivaṃ dharmarājastu samuvāca tu tām̐stadā || 59 ||
kāmikāyā vrataṃ yuṣmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tatphalaṃ bahu |
sarvasiddhimayaṃ ceṣṭapradaṃ labdhaṃ yato hyaham || 2.254.60 ||
dadāmi sarvasiddhīśca tathā yūyaṃ bhavantviti |
īśavatsarvadā sarvajīvānāmitivṛttajam || 61 ||
sarvaṃ jñānaṃ bhavatsveva bhavatviti dadāmyaham |
evaṃ varaṃ paraṃ datvā dharmarājastirodadhe || 62 ||
śravaṇā dvādaśasaṃkhyāstata āramya sarvadā |
asaṃkhyarūpadhartāro jīvakarma nivedakāḥ || 63 ||
sarvajñā iva saṃjātāścitraguptāgrataḥ sadā |
nivedayanti vṛttāntaṃ mṛtānāṃ pūrvagāminām || 64||
sarvakāmaphalaṃ prāptāḥ kāmikāyā vratena te |
sarvasiddhipradā tasmātkartavyā kāmikā janaiḥ || 65 ||
śṛṇu tvanyakathāṃ lakṣmi rate rjātāṃ purā yathā |
śaṃkareṇa yadā dagdhaḥ kāmadevo himālaye || 66 ||
kāmapatnī ratirjātā vidhavā patimantarā |
bahu sā pīḍitā jātā vaidhavyārttyatikarṣitā || 67||
śaṃkaraṃ prati gatvā sā prāha nātha kṛpāṃ kuru |
patiṃ vinā tu me prāptaṃ hyamāṃgalyaṃ duḥkhapradam ||68 ||
tanme vināśayārttinyāḥ śaṃbho śaṃ kuru yoṣitaḥ |
śrutvā śaṃbhuśca tāṃ prāha kāmikāyā vrataṃ kuru || 69 ||
amāṃgalyaṃ sadā te vai dūraṃ yāsyati niścitam |
adeho’pi patiste vai ratisthāne miliṣyati || 2.254.70 ||
avaidhavyamamāṃgalyaṃ sarvaṃ te yāsyati kṣayam |
kṛṣṇaputrastu vai pradyumnanāmā te patistataḥ ||7 1 ||
suśarīro’tisaubhāgyavatyā vai prāpsyate tvayā |
śrutvaivaṃ sā kāmikāyā vrataṃ cakre ratirmudā ||7 2 ||
vidhivacca dadau sarvadānāni bahubhaktitaḥ |
śaṃbhustu pāraṇākāle bhūtvā bhikṣuka eva ha ||7 3 ||
samāyayau subhikṣārthaṃ tayā bhikṣā samarpitā |
bhuktvā prāha tataḥ śaṃbhurvaraṃ yācasva dadmyaham ||74||
kāmikāyā vratenāsmi prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ svayam |
śrutvā ratistadā prāha patiṃ kāmaṃ pradehi me ||75||
tathāstviti samuccāryādṛśyo’bhūcchaṃkarastataḥ |
ratyā labdhaḥ patiḥ svasyā ratyāḥ kāle pratisthale ||76||
bhūte bhūte sarvayonau pati prāptaḥ sa maithune |
mūrtaḥ pradyumnanāmāpi prāptaḥ kṛṣṇasutastataḥ ||77||
evaṃ vrataprabhāveṇa ratiḥ saubhāgyatāṃ gatā |
brahmāṇḍaprāṇiṣu vyāptiṃ prāptā siddhiṃ tu śāśvatīm ||78||
vrataṃ tvevaṃ kāmikāyāḥ sarvakāmaprasādhakam |
sarvasaṃkalpasiddhidhṛk sarvasmṛddhipradāyakam ||79||
sarvārttināśakaṃ saumyaṃ svargamokṣapradaṃ śubham |
sarvayajñaphaladātṛ yogasiddhikaraṃ tathā ||2.254.80||
naṣṭavastupradaṃ cāpi sadaiśvaryapradaṃ mahat |
ratidaṃ kāmadaṃ patnīpradaṃ svāmipradaṃ tathā ||8 1||
duḥkhaghnaṃ tvārttiśamanaṃ kāmabhogasukhapradam |
vighnanāśakaraṃ vāñchāpūrakaṃ narayoṣitām ||82||
kartavyaṃ sarvathā lakṣmi cāvaidhavyakaraṃ param |
ratiśaktikāmaśaktisiddhidaṃ kāmyamityapi ||83||
niṣkāmānāṃ tu vaikuṇṭhaprāpakaṃ puṇyabhājanam |
lakṣāśvamedhayajñānāṃ puṇyadaṃ śravaṇādapi ||84||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrāvaṇakṛṣṇakāmikaikādaśīmāhātmyaṃ śravaṇākhyapitṝṇāṃ sarvasiddhiprāptiḥ rateśca kāmākhyapatiprāptiśceti nirūpaṇanāmā catuḥpaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 254 ||

<1.255>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
sarvakāmapradaḥ kṛṣṇo harirnārāyaṇaḥ svayam |
phaladātā sukhadātā vratapūrtikaraḥ sa hi || 1 ||
śraddhayā tvāpyate puṇyaṃ śraddhāyāṃ sa sadā sthitaḥ |
bhāvanāsahito viṣṇuḥ phalatyeva vratāśrayaḥ || 2 ||
mokṣado mādhavo devaḥ sādhane vasati dhruvam |
sādhanāni vinā taṃ vai no phalaṃ dadati kvacit || 3 ||
sa eva sarvathārādhyo viṣṇurnārāyaṇo hariḥ |
lakṣmīśaśca rameśaśca śrīśo dhvajadhanuḥkaraḥ || 4 ||
kṛpayā vada me matsyasvastikacihnahastaka |
svāminprabhāṣate pārvatīpate māṇikīśvara || 5 ||
śrāvaṇaśuklapakṣasyaikādaśī nāmatastu kā |
kau vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ tasyāḥ ko devo’rcyo vrate’tra vai || 6 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ekādaśī putradākhyā śrāvaṇasya sitā matā |
śrīdharaḥ pūjanīyo’tra kāntimatyā saha prabhuḥ || 7 ||
kamalaiḥ pūjanīyo’sau bhojanīyastvapūpakaiḥ |
arghyaḥ sītāphalaiḥ kṛṣṇo dātavyaṃ pādukādvayam || 8 ||

śrotavyāsyāḥ kathā divyā bhuktimuktipradāyinī || 9 ||

rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryādekādaśyāṃ prage vratī || 1.255.1 0||
snātvā nityaṃ mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā vai maṇḍapāntare |

āvāhanādikaṃ kuryāt paṃcāmṛtābhiṣecanam || 13||

ārārtrikastutidaṇḍavatpradakṣiṇadīpanaiḥ |
pūjayitvā hariṃ nirvighnaṃ vrataṃ prārthayet tataḥ || 15||
madhyāhne bhojanaṃ dadyāttāmbūlaṃ ca jalaṃ tathā |
sāyaṃ dadyād dugdhapākaṃ pūrikāḥ śākamityāpe || 16||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt kathākīrtananartanaiḥ |
dvādaśyāṃ tu prage snā tvā pūjayitvā ca mādhavam || 17||
dadyāddānāni sarvāṇi yathāśakti yathādhanam |
bhojayet sādhuviprāṃśca sādhvīrbālām̐śca bālikāḥ || 18||
tato vai svajanān bhojayitvā svaḥ pāraṇāṃ caret |
evaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhuktimukti dam || 1 9||
dhanadhānyasutadārākṣetrodyānagṛhādikam |
ārogyamānakīrtyādi labhate tu vratī śubham || 1.255.20 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ yābhūsūpūrve kṛte yuge |
rājā pururavā nāmnā babhūva candrapautrakaḥ ||21 ||
budhaputraḥ pururavā rājyaṃ pālayati svakam |
śrīpure narmadātīre vasati sma nirantaram || 22||

aputrasya sukhaṃ nāsti loke’smim̐śca paratra ca |

anyāyo na kṛtasteṣu sutabandhuprajāsu ca |

tapantaṃ ghorasutapo nirāhāraṃ nirīhakam |
śāntaṃ sudharmatattvajñaṃ śāstravedaviśāradam || 35 ||
dīrghāyuṣaṃ trikālajñaṃ jaṭāśmaśrusuśobhitam |

tāṃstathā sāgrajān vīkṣya muniḥ provāca lomaśaḥ || 37 ||
kathaṃ kimarthamāyātā brāhmaṇā vṛddhasevakāḥ |

pālayitvā tu vo vākyaṃ tvavāpsye janmanaḥ phalam ||1.255.40 ||
paropakṛtaye janma tapasvināṃ na saṃśayaḥ |
aho’dya saphalaṃ janma kariṣye viprasevayā ||41 ||
itikṛtvā cakārāsāvātithyaṃ pūjanādi ca |

saṃśayasya nirāsāya vayaṃ svārthaparā prabho ||43 ||
iha kāryavaśātprāptāḥ samīpaṃ bhavato vayam |

sarvaṃ dātuṃ samartho’si brahmātmaikyabalānmune |

athātrāvasare rātrau nṛpaṃ vīkṣya vivastrakam ||1.255.80 ||
