antarvatnī tu sāraṇye vahnisthālīsvarūpiṇī ||8 1 ||
suṣuve susutaṃ jātavedasaṃ hi vibhāvasum |
ekādaśyā vratenaivaṃ vahniḥ putro’sya cābhavat ||8 2 ||
evaṃ vai putradāścaikādaśyaścānyāstu ṣaṭkṛtāḥ |
lakṣagavāṃ pradānaṃ saḥ pracakāra prativratam ||8 3 ||
tena tasyorvaśīgarbhāt ṣaḍāsannātmajāḥ pare |
āyuḥ śrutāyuḥ satyāyuḥ rayo’tha vijayo jayaḥ || 84 ||
teṣāṃ putrāḥ praputrāśca hyāsanvaṃśavivardhanāḥ |
agninā prajayā rājā lokaṃ gāndharvamāptavān || 85 ||
bhuktvā bhogānanekān sa kāle tyaktvā kalevaram |
svargād yātaḥ sa vaikuṇṭhaṃ caturbhujadharaḥ svayam || 86 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi svarṇabhūṣānantyaṃ rājya yadicchati |
kartavyaṃ tena godānapūrvakaṃ vratamuttamam || 87 ||
śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe karkaṭasthe divākare |
dvādaśyāṃ vāsudevāya pavitrāropaṇaṃ caret ||88 ||
sūtraiḥ kṣaumairhemarūpyatāmraiḥ kauśeyapadmajaiḥ |
kuśaiḥ kāśaiḥ sukārpāsaiḥ śaṇajaiḥ śobhanaiśca taiḥ ||8 9 ||
tantubhistriguṇitaṃ tat triguṇīkṛtya sūtrakam |
śodhayet sumaṇidṛśyaṃ kārayetpāvanaṃ hi tat || 1.255.90 ||
haraye tvarpayettadvai pavitraṃ svarṇapuṇyadam |
ekādaśyāṃ dhārayecca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 91 ||
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāstathā śūdrā narāḥ striyaḥ |
harerbhaktau sthitāḥ sarvai śubhaṃ kuryuḥ pavitrakam || 92||
haraye tvarpayeccāpi gurave’pi samarpayet |
pavitrāropaṇenāhaṃ supavitro bhavāmyaham || 93 ||
svarṇarūpyakṣaumavastrādyalakārām̐stathārjayet |
pratyabdaṃ tu putradāyāṃ pavitrāropaṇaṃ janaiḥ || 94||
kartavyaṃ tūktamantreṇa dhanāḍhyastena jāyate |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ tathāpnoti pavitrāropaṇena ca ||95||
na karoti vidhānena pavitrāropaṇaṃ tu yaḥ |
tasya sāṃvatsarī pūjā niṣphalā bhavati kṛtā || 96 ||
śrutvā putrapradāyāśca māhātmyaṃ mucyate tvaghāt |
sukhaṃ svargaṃ paraṃ prāpya paraṃ mokṣamavāpnuyāt || 97||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne śrāvaṇaśuklaputradaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ pūrvabhavegavāparādhino vaṇijaḥ purūravo’vatāre’putrasya vratakaraṇe ūrvaśyāṃ putralābhaḥ pavitrāropaṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā paṃcapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 255||

<1.256>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇasmaraṇena janmasaṃsārabandhanam |
naśyatyeva janānāṃ vai vande nārāyaṇa tu tam || 1 ||
kartāraṃ karaṇaṃ kāryaṃ preritāraṃ vibhuṃ prabhum |
sukhadaṃ putradaṃ śāntipradaṃ vande patiṃ harim || 2 ||
nārāyaṇa hare kṛṣṇa lakṣmīnātha ramāpate |
māṇikyeśa prabhāsvāmin pārvatīśvara te namaḥ || 3 ||
tvanmukhānme kathālābhe tṛptirnaiva hi jāyate |
vada bhādrapade kṛṣṇe kiṃnāmnyekādaśī matā || 4 ||
ko devaḥ kiṃ phalaṃ dāne deyaṃ puṣpādikaṃ ca kim |
ko vidhistadvratasyāsti vistarāt kathaya prabho || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇuṣvaikamanā lakṣmi kathayiṣyāmi vistarāt |
ajānāmnī bhādrakṛṣṇaikādaśī pāpanāśinī || 6 ||
sundaryā tu sahaivārcyastasyāṃ devo janārdanaḥ |
puṣpeṣu pāṭalā deyā tvarghye pūgīphalaṃ matam || 7 ||
dāne tu mahiṣī deyā naivedye gūḍalaḍḍukāḥ |
yathākālaṃ yathālabhyaṃ tathākāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 8 ||
daśamyāmekabhuktena tathā bhāvyaṃ vratārthinā |
svaptavyaṃ bhūtale rakṣaṇīyaṃ vai brahmaśīlakam || 9 ||
ekādaśyāṃ prage dhyātvā nārāyaṇajanārdanam |
snātvā pūjāṃ naityakīṃ tu kuryāt ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ || 1.256.10 ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ bahustambhasuśobhitam |
madhye tu sarvatobhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayedvratī || 11 ||
tanmadhye svarṇakalaśaḥ pañcaratnajalānvitaḥ |
savastraphalapatropavītacandanataṇḍulaḥ || 1 2||
sthāpanīyaśca tatpārśve ghaṇṭāṃ śaṃkhaṃ ca rakṣayet |
pūjayedvidhinā mantraistilasthālī ghaṭe nyaset || 13 ||
mūrtiṃ tu kānakīṃ janārdanasundarikāyutām |
ajaikādaśikāṃ sthālyāṃ sthāpayed rājatīṃ ca vā || 14||
āvāhanādibhiḥ pañcāmṛtairdravitacandanaiḥ |
pūjayenmardayet devaṃ snāpayettīrthavāribhiḥ || 12 ||
vastrālaṃkāraśṛṃgārābhūṣāhārādirājibhiḥ |
sugandhidravyavaryaiśca dhūpadīpanivedanaiḥ || 16||
kuṃkumāgurukastūrītailadravasusaurabhaiḥ |
kajjalaśvetapāṇḍuracūrṇaśekharanaktakaiḥ || 17||
yaṣṭyrupānahasacchatracāmarairyānavāhanaiḥ |
ārārtrikastutinamrabhāvadaṇḍavadādibhiḥ || 18 ||
puṣpāṃjalijalatāmbūlailālaṃvagacarvaṇaiḥ 19 |
kṣamārthanādibhirdevaṃ pūjayedbahubhāvataḥ || 19 ||
śayyāṃ svarṇamayīṃ satkomalāstaraṇasaṃyutām |
dadyāddevāya cādarśapārśvakavyajanānvitām || 1.256.20 ||
evaṃ samarcya govindaṃ vratārthaṃ prārthayed vratī |
karomyajāvrataṃ kṛṣṇa nirvighnaṃ pūrṇatāmiyāt || 21 ||
dānaṃ dadyād vividhaṃ sadratnasārasuvarṇakam |
dadyād gomahiṣīprabhṛtyapi dugdhānvitaṃ śubham || 22 ||
madhyāhne’pi hariṃ kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā nivedayet |
meśubhaṃ mohanasthālaṃ mauktikām̐ścūrṇamodakān || 23 ||
apūpām̐śca tathā pūpān polikā miṣṭapolikāḥ |
pūrikāḥ puṣpavaṭikā rājikārāddhamityapi || 24 ||
śākāni vividhānyāranālāni svādavanti ca |
dadhidugdhapramiṣṭaṃ sadrasasārāṇi cārpayet || 25 ||
dadyātphalāni pānīyaṃ mukhavāsādikaṃ tathā |
sāyaṃ caiva mahatsamyagarcanaṃ kārayedvratī || 26 ||
āndolayeddhariṃ preṃkhāṃ baddhvā vṛkṣādike’mbare |
rātrau dugdhapracūraṃ vai bhojyaṃ dadyādbalapradam || 27 ||
ārārtrikaṃ stutiṃ kṣāntyarthanaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ tathā |
arpayedanyayogyaṃ yattvapekṣitamatho hareḥ || 28 ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryānnṛtyagāyanavācanaiḥ |
harekīrtināmabhaktyā kathāśravaṇakhelanaiḥ || 29 ||
dvādaśyāṃ ca prage snātvā pūjayitvā janārdanam |
bhojayitvā hariṃ dadyād dānāni vividhāni ca || 1.256.30 ||
anyānsamāśritān miṣṭaṃ bhojayitvā sato dvijān |
bālām̐śca pāraṇāṃ paścāt kuryād vratī vratottare || 31 ||
evaṃ kṛte vrate sarvakāmanā vratinaḥ phalet |
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca sāmrājyaṃ yadicchet tadvratī vrajet || 3 2||
īdṛgvidhaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmi ye kurvanti tu mānavāḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktāstridivaṃ yānti śāśvatam || 33 ||
śṛṇu kathāṃ vratayuktāṃ duḥkhanāśakarīṃ śubhām |
hariścandrasya nṛpateḥ sakalatrasutasya vai || 34||
vādau satyaguṇopetaḥ yuge satye babhūva saḥ |
hariścandrābhidho rājā sāketapurabhūpatiḥ || 35 ||
sarayūsaritastīre pañcayojanavistṛtām |
sāketanagarīṃ śāsan bhūpo rarakṣa tatprajāḥ || 36 ||
cakravartī satyasaṃdhaḥ samastāyā bhuvaḥ patiḥ |
atithīnsma pūjayati yatheṣṭaṃ sma dadāti ca || 37 ||
nārthī kaścidgṛhāttasya nivartate na satkṛtaḥ |
arthī yadicchati tattad dadātyeva tu sarvadā || 38 ||
viprā miṣṭānnabhikṣādyaiḥ kṣatriyā bahumānakaiḥ |
vaiśyāḥ sahāyatālābhaiḥ śūdāścāśramamīlanaiḥ || 39 ||
devā yajñīyahavyānnaiḥ ṛṣayaścātitheyakaiḥ |
munayo brahmabhaktyādyaiḥ sakāmā vāñchitārthakaiḥ ||1.256.40 |
nāryo vṛttipāla tādyairbālā vidyādiraṃjanaiḥ |
anye yatheṣṭasamprāptaiḥ pūjyante tena sarvathā || 41 ||
tuṣṭāḥ sarve gṛhaṃ yānti sukhaṃ jīvanti tatprajāḥ |
nāsya rājye dhanahīno bhaktihīnaśca mānavaḥ ||42 ||
pitṛsevāvihīno na pramadāsu ghṛṇākaraḥ |
vedaghoṣo yajñahomaścārthidānapravāhakaḥ || 42 ||
sarvo dharmo harernāma pañcaka virarāma na |
evaṃ vartayatastasya kīrtirdikṣu vidikṣu ca || 44 ||
vyāptā babhūva trailokye na satyāccalatīti saḥ |
tadā brahmā hariḥ śaṃbhurviśvāmitrādayaḥ khalu ||45 |
parīkṣārthaṃ samāyātāḥ kiyatsatyaṃ nu lambate |
hariścandreṇa sammānaṃ dvijarūpadhareṣu vai || 46 |
kṛtaṃ cātithyasevādi sveṣṭavyārtho niveditaḥ |
viśvāmitrastataḥ prāha rājyaṃ sarvamapekṣyate || 47 |
dīyatāṃ me mahārāja nirṛṇo’haṃ bhavāmyataḥ |
tathāstviti nṛpaḥ prāha jalaṃ muktvā dadau tataḥ || 48 |
rājyaṃ pragṛhya ca pṛthag yayāce dakṣiṇāṃ muniḥ |
dakṣiṇārthaṃ pṛthagadrvyaṃ nāsīt tatpūrtaye nṛpaḥ ||4 9 |
babhūva rājyabhraṣṭo’sau sevākaiṃkaryamāptavān |
vikrītvā vanitā putrau sa cakārātmavikrayam ||1.256.5 0 |
pulkasasya tu dāsatvaṃ prāpto rājā sa puṇyabhāg |
śmaśāne satyamālambya mṛtacailāpahārakaḥ |||5 1 |
so’bhavannṛpatipūjyo na satyāccalitaḥ khalu |
evaṃ vai tasya nṛpaterbahavo vatsarā gatāḥ || 52|
vetanaṃ tu dadātyeva viśvāmitrāya dakṣiṇām | 
tathāpi dakṣiṇā pūrṇā na jātā ṛṣituṣṭaye ||5 3 |
vastraṃ pātraṃ bhavellabdhaṃ sarvaṃ taddakṣiṇākṛte |
dadātyeva prapūrtyarthaṃ svayaṃ duḥkhaṃ tu vindati ||54|
evaṃ prapūritā karmacārikaiṃkaryavartinā |
dakṣiṇāpi tatā dāsyaṃ vṛttyarthaṃ prakaroti saḥ ||55 |
duḥkhasyānto na cāyātastataścintāparo’bhavat |
kiṃ karomi kva gacchāmi duḥkhasyāntaḥ kathaṃ bhavet ||5 6 ||
patnī vaṇiggṛhe dāsī putrastvanyatra kiṃkaraḥ |
ahaṃ śmaśānasevī cāpyaho cāṇḍālakiṃkaraḥ ||57||
kva rājyaṃ kva ca kaiṃkarya cakraṃ māyāmayaṃ nvidam |.
tathāpi duḥkhanāśaḥ syāttathā yatnaṃ karomi vai ||58 ||
iticintayatastasya magnasya duḥkhasāgare |
ājagāma munistatra jñātvā rājānamāturam ||59 ||
vaiṣṇavaṃ ca prajāśīrvādapātraṃ nyāyavartinam |
gautamākhyaḥ kṛpāluśca paropakṛtikārakaḥ ||1.256.6 0 ||
āśīrvādān dadau rājñe sukhī bhaveti sarvathā |
nṛpo nanāma taṃ vipraṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ ||6 1 ||
kathayāmāsa vṛttāntamātmano duḥkhasaṃbhṛtam |
śrutvā sarvaṃ gautamastu babhūva cātivismitaḥ || 62||
duḥkhanistaraṇopāyaṃ vrataṃ tūpādideśa tam |
māsi bhādrapade rājan kṛṣṇapakṣe’tipāvanī ||63 ||
ekādaśī tvajānāmnī bhavati duḥkhanāśinī |
asyāḥ kuru vrataṃ rājan duḥkhadhvaṃso bhaviṣyati || 6 4||
tava patnī vratamasyāḥ karotvapi sukhāvaham |
putraste tvekabhuktaṃ vā vrataṃ kuryāt sukhāptaye || 65||
ityādiṣṭo hariścandraścakārājāvrataṃ param |
muniryayau ca tatpatnīṃ putraṃ nirdiśya tadvratam || 66 ||
jagāma svāśramaṃ rājñī kumāraśca yathoditam |
cakratuśca yathāśakti tvajāvratamaharniśam ||6 7||
kṛte tasmin vrate rājño duḥkhasyānto’bhavatkṣaṇāt |
rājñyāścāpi ca kiṃkaryā duḥkhasyānto’bhavatkṣaṇāt || 68 ||
putro mṛto’bhavattatra vratottaraṃ divāpi saḥ |
rohito jīvanaṃ prāpa vratasyaiva prabhāvataḥ || 69 ||
tadduḥkhaṃ bahubhirvarṣairbhoktavyaṃ kṣayatāṃ gatam |
nistīrṇaduḥkho rājāsīd vratasyāsyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 1.256.70 ||
patnyā saha samāsaṃgaṃ putrajīvanamityapi |
putreṇa ca samāsaṃgaṃ hariścandrastvavāpa vai || 71 ||
brahmaviṣṇumaheśāśca viśvāmitrādayastadā |
svasvarūpāḥ samāyātāḥ pratyakṣā duḥkhanuttaye ||72 ||
te satyasya parīkṣādya pūrṇā jāteti cocire |
sarve devāśca devyaśca samāyātāstadutsave || 73 ||
āśīrvādapradānārthaṃ hariścandrāya bhūbhṛte |
divi dundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣamabhūd divaḥ ||74||
ekādaśyāḥ prabhāveṇa hariścandraḥ saputrakaḥ |
sadāraśca svakaṃ sarvaṃ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam ||75 ||
bhuktvā tu bahuvarṣāṇi kṛtvā bhaktiṃ harestataḥ |
putraṃ rājye sthāpayitvā patnyā saha virāgavān ||76 ||
svargaṃ lebhe hariścandraḥ sapuraḥ saparicchadaḥ |
anantakālaṃ tad bhuktvā yayau sāketadhāma saḥ || 77||
īdṛgvidhaṃ vrataṃ lakṣmi ye kariṣyanti mānavāḥ |
sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ sarvaduḥkhavihīnakāḥ ||78 ||
svargaṃ mokṣaṃ paraṃ sarve yāsyanti paramaṃ padam |
paṭhanācchravaṇād vāpi tvaśvamedhaphalaṃ bhavet || 79 ||
tasmādasyāḥ kathā śravyā kartavyaṃ śraddhayā vratam |
tadaṃgabhūtadānārcāpūjanaṃ vidhivattathā ||1.256.8 0 ||
vratakartā tadanyeṣāṃ pāpakṣālanako bhavet |
svargaṃ prāpayitā cāpi yāmyādibhayavārakaḥ ||8 1 ||
kimu tarhi svātmakṛte bhuktimuktisamarjane |
samarthaśceti vaktavyaṃ nārāyaṇaprasaṃgataḥ ||82||
asyā vratī punarnaiva jāyate’tastvajā matā |
ajā muktirbhavedasyā vratādasmādajā hi sā ||8 3 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne bhādrapadakṛṣṇājaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ viśvāmitrakṛtā hariścandrasya satyavrataparīkṣā rājyastrīputrahāniḥ gautamapradarśitājāvratena duḥkhanivṛttirityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaṭpaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 256 ||

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
duḥkhahārinsukhakārinsampatkārinkṛpānidhe |
uddhārastvāṃ vinā naiva pāpināṃ jāyate dhruvam || 1 ||
tava tvadīyabhaktānāṃ bhaved yasyopari kṛpā |
mahāpāpātipāpo’pi śuddhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ || 2 ||
kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhāllābhādvāpi samāśrayet||
yastvāṃ mucyeta saṃsāripāśānmuktiṃ labheta saḥ || 3 ||
vrataṃ yajño dayā dānaṃ jñānaṃ dhyānaṃ japastapaḥ |
tvamevāsi kṛpāsindho tvadyogānmuktidā ime || 4 ||
vada bhādrapade śukle kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet |
ko devaḥ ko vidhistasyāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ pūjanaṃ katham || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
padmānāmnī bhādraśuklaikādaśī muktidāyinī |
ṛṣikeśo’tra saṃpūjyastvaparājitayā saha || 6 ||
kāśapuṣpāṇi pūjāyāṃ tilapāko nivedane |
kūṣmāṇḍamarghye vai deyaṃ dāne brahmagṛhaṃ śubham || 7 ||
mandiraṃ bhavanaṃ saudhaṃ kārayeddharyadhiṣṭhitam |
dadyādvai gurave devapūjakāya sumandiram || 8 ||
daśamyāmekabhaktena bhāvyaṃ tu vratinā niśi |
kāryaṃ bhūśayanaṃ brahmavrataṃ rakṣyaṃ tu yatnataḥ || 9 ||
iyaṃ pārśvaparivartinyekādaśī harermatā |
śeṣaśāyī parivartayati pārśvaṃ dine’tra vai || 1.257.10 ||
śayanyāṃ pārśvavartinyāṃ prabodhinyāṃ ca mānavaiḥ |
vrataṃ niraśanaṃ kāryaṃ nirjalaṃ śaktito’pi ca || 41 ||
atrānnabhojinaḥ śūlaṃ pārśve dadati me’ghṛṇāḥ |
tasmādannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ bhoktavyaṃ phalameva vā || 12 ||
dugdhaṃ peyaṃ saśaktena nirjalaṃ samupoṣaṇam |
kartavyaṃ tena bhagavām̐stuṣyati kamalāpatiḥ || 13 ||
ekādaśyāṃ brāhmakāle samutthāya vratī harim |
smareddhyāyecca nāmāni gṛṇan snānāya saṃvrajet || 1 4||
snātvā ca naityikīṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya vai vratī |
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ saddhānyaiḥ kārayecchubham || 15 ||
madhye ghaṭaṃ tu sauvarṇaṃ tāmrajaṃ sthāpayecca vā |
pañcaratnākṣatapuṣpajalavastraphalānvitam || 16 ||
śaṃkhaghaṇṭādisaṃyuktaṃ pūjayeccandanādibhiḥ |
sthālīṃ tilabhṛtāṃ dhṛtvā ghaṭopari tu tatra vai || 1 7||
ṛṣikeśāparājitāpratimāṃ sthāpayed vratī |
padmāṃ tvekādaśīṃ cāpi sthāpayetpūjayecca tām || 18 ||
āvāhanādibhiḥ paṃcāmṛtasnānādibhistathā |
vastrābhūṣaṇaśṛṃgārakajalaiścandanādibhiḥ || 19 ||
hārakeyūrakaṭakairmukuṭaiḥ śekharādibhiḥ |
pādukāyaṣṭinaktakapuṣpagucchāttarādibhiḥ || 1.257.20 ||
dhūpadīpasunaivedyairjalatāmbūlasatphalaiḥ |
ārārtrikastutidaṇḍavannamanapradakṣiṇaiḥ || 21 ||
kṣamābhyarthanakusumāṃjalisaddakṣiṇādibhiḥ |
prapūjya bhagavantaṃ ca vratanirvighnasiddhaye || 22 ||
prārthayecchrīhariṃ paścānnatvā kāryāntaraṃ caret |
madhyāhne’pi bhagavate miṣṭānnānyarpayedvratī || 23 ||
tāmbūlakaṃ vāripānaṃ tvarpayed vācayetkathām |
aparāhṇe tataḥ sāyaṃ nīrājayedvidhānataḥ ||24||

śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ ramyāṃ vratena pitṛtṛptidām ||46 ||
adhoyonigatānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ gatidāyinī |
indiraikādaśī śreṣṭhā vājapeyaphalapradā ||47||
indrasenena vai rājñopoṣitā pitṛtāraṇī |
nārmadākhye mahārāṣṭre candrāvatīpurīpatiḥ ||48||
indrasenākhyanṛpatirbabhūva prākkṛte yuge |
dharmeṇa pālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān ||49||
putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ |
gajavājiyānayukto viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ ||1.258.50 ||
japan śrīharināmāni muktidāni tu sarvadā |
kālaṃ nayati bhaktyaivādhyātmadhyānavicintakaḥ ||5 1 ||
tasyaikadā gṛhe śāntyāsīnasya purato muniḥ |
nārado vyomamārgeṇāvatīrya samupasthitaḥ ||52||
āgataṃ nāradaṃ vīkṣya pratyutthāya kṛtāṃjaliḥ |
kṛtātithyaṃ muniṃ bṛṣyāsane ramye nyaveśayat ||53||
provāca svāgataṃ te’haṃ karomi brahmavittama |
adya me saphalaṃ rājyaṃ janma karma kulaṃ dhanam ||54||
dānaṃ kraturjapo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ saphalā mama |
tvatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha bhāgyaṃ dhanyatamaṃ mama ||55||
sutapraputradārādidāsadāsīśatāni me |
gajavājivāhanāni saphalāni tavāgamāt ||56 ||
sādhorvai darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ sparśanaṃ pāpanāśakam |
sevanaṃ svargadaṃ divyamokṣadaṃ tvātmano’rpaṇam ||57||
yeṣāṃ gṛhe na sādhūnāṃ caraṇadhūlikārajaḥ |
tāni śmaśānatulyāni bhavanāni gṛhāṇi ca ||58||
tāritaṃ mama sambandhikuṭumbaṃ sarvameva yat |
prasādaṃ kuru devarṣe nispṛhāgamakāraṇam ||59||
nāradaḥ prāha rājarṣe śṛṇu vismayakārakam |
brahmalokādahaṃ prāpto yamalokaṃ mahīpate ||1.258.60 ||
dharmeṇa satkṛto bhaktyā hyupaviṣṭo varāsane |
dharmarājaṃ satyaśīlā dhārmikāḥ samupāsate ||6 1 ||
teṣāṃ sadasi pṛṣṭhasthaṃ nistejaskaṃ sthitaṃ tava |
pitaraṃ prahasantyanye bahupuṇyātimāninaḥ ||62||
sabhāyāṃ śrāddhadevasya prāha mahyaṃ pitā tava |
sandeśaṃ duḥkhanāśāya taṃ nibodha mahīpate ||6 3 ||
indrasena iti khyātaṃ candrāvatyā nṛpaṃ sutam |
brahman kathaya sandeśaṃ pitā te candrasenakaḥ ||64||
tiṣṭhati dharmarājasya nagaryāṃ puṇyapuṃjataḥ |
dānaṃ bahukṛtaṃ tena na kṛtaṃ vratameva yat ||65||
tena puṇyena dharmasya nagaryāmasti saṃsthitaḥ |
vratapuṇyena vidhuro nistejasko’tipṛṣṭhagaḥ ||66||
niṣīdati sabhāyāṃ vai cātiduḥkhānvitaḥ sadā |
tasmāt kuryād vrataṃ caikādaśyā uddiśya māṃ sutaḥ ||67||
mokṣaṃ kuryātsa me putra indirāpuṇyadānataḥ |
ityukto’haṃ samāyātaḥ samīpaṃ tava bhūpate ||68||
piturmokṣakṛte rājannindirāvratamācara |
tvatpitā tena puṇyena vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāsyati dhruvam ||69||
śrutvā pituḥ sa sandeśaṃ nāradaṃ pṛṣṭhavān vratam |
vidhinā kena kartavyaṃ kasmin pakṣe tithau tathā ||1.258.70||
nāradaḥ prāha rājānamāśvināsitapakṣake |
daśamyāṃ prātarutthāya smṛtvā kṛṣṇaṃ tataḥ param ||71||
snātvā devaṃ pūjayitvā madhyāhne snānamācaret |
datvā haraye naivedyamekabhuktaṃ samācaret ||72||
sāyaṃ snātvā hariṃ dhyātvā rātrau bhūmau śayīta ca |
ekādaśyāṃ prabhāte’yaṃ vratī nidrāṃ vihāya vai ||73||
smṛtvā dhyātvā hariṃ nāma raṭan śaucādikaṃ caret |
mukhaprakṣālanaṃ kuryājjalairdvādaśadhā muhuḥ ||74||
snānaṃ tīrthajalaiḥ kuryād devapūjāṃ samācaret |
harermūrtiṃ namaskṛtyācamanādigrahottaram ||75||
ṣoḍaśopaskaraiḥ kṛṣṇamupendraṃ pūjayed vratī |
upavāsasya niyamaṃ gṛhṇīyācca tadagrataḥ ||76||
adya sthitvā nirāhāraḥ sarvabhogavivarjitaḥ |
śvo bhokṣye puṇḍarīkākṣa vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru prabho ||77||
evaṃ niyamamāsthāya sarvatobhadramaṇḍale |
ghaṭe kṛṣṇaṃ sthāpayitvā mahāpūjanamācaret ||78||
samāpya vidhinā pūjāṃ nīrājayecca bhojayet |
madhyāhnepi svayaṃ snātvā śrīhariṃ bhojayettathā ||79||
nīrājayet svāpayeccotthāpayet pāyayejjalam |
vījayenmardayennāthaṃ sukhayediṣṭadānakaiḥ ||1.258.80 ||
śālagrāmaśilāgre ca śrāddhaṃ kuryād yathāvidhi |
pitṝṇāṃ prītaye śrāddhaṃ kuryāt śraddhāsamanvitaḥ ||8 1 ||
godhūmacūrṇairyacchrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tanmadhyamaṃ bhavet |
yavairvrīhitilairmāṣairgodhūmaiścaṇakaistathā ||82||
śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavecchreṣṭhaṃ kartavyaṃ vratinā tu taiḥ |
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vratinā na bhoktavyaṃ pitṛsevitam ||83||
vratarakṣaṇalābhāya ghrātavyameva cārpitam |
paitryamannaṃ samāghrāya gave dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ ||84||
rātrau mahārcanaṃ kuryājjāgaraṃ sotsavaṃ tathā |
dvādaśyāṃ prātarevāyaṃ snātvā samarcya mādhavam ||85||
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle tvarpayitvā tato vratī |
ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā kṣamāyācanikāṃ tathā ||86||
dadyād dānāni bhūrīṇi brāhmaṇādīn prabhojayet |
sādhūnsādhvīrbhojayecca bandhūn dauhitraputrakān ||87||
bhojayitvā ca dīnāndhān svayaṃ bhuñjīta vāgyataḥ |
anena vidhinā rājan kuru vratamatandritaḥ ||88||
viṣṇulokaṃ prayāsyanti pitarastava bhūpate |
ityuktvā nṛpatiṃ lakṣmi nārado’ntaradhīyata ||89||
yathoktavidhinā hīndrasenaścakāra tadvratam |
antaḥpureṇa sahitaḥ putrabhṛtyasamanvitaḥ ||1.258.90 ||
kṛte vrate gavāṃ dāne puṣpavṛṣṭirabhūd divaḥ |
puṇyārpaṇe kṛte cendrasenasya janakaḥ khalu ||9 1||
candrasenastathānye tatpitaro’pi vyavasthitāḥ |
garuḍasthā vimānasthā yayurvai viṣṇumandiram ||92||
indraseno’pi kṛtvā tadvrataṃ vaiṣṇavapālitāḥ |
rājyaṃ tvakaṇṭakaṃ bhuktvā datvā jyeṣṭhasutāya ca ||93||
mahīsenāya tatpaścājjagāma tridivaṃ svayam |
tatra puṇyaṃ samāpyaiva vaikuṇṭhamagamaddhi saḥ ||94||
ityevaṃ vratamāhātmyaṃ lakṣmi te kathitaṃ mayā |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratapuṇyaṃ bhavedapi ||9 5||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āśvinakṛṣṇendiraikādaśīvratamāhātmyam indrasena
nṛpapitṛcandrasenaprabhṛtīnāṃ pitṝṇāṃ vratapuṇyabalād yamalokānmokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭapaṃcāśadadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||258|||

<1.259>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
sarvapuṇyamayo devastvameva bhagavān svayam |
dadāsi karuṇāsindhuḥ phalāni karmaṇāṃ yathā || 1 ||
tvāṃ vismṛtyānutiṣṭhanti kurvanti mānavāstu yat |
tatphalaṃ labhyate cātra paratra bhayayuk tu taiḥ || 2 ||
tvāṃ smṛtvā ye’nutiṣṭhanti kurvanti yāni yāni vai |
tatphalaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityānandamokṣātmakaṃ tvayā || 3 ||
dayite bhagavam̐stasmai śaraṇāgatiśāline |
evaṃ phalapradātāsi sarvakarmamayo’si yat || 4 ||
sarvajño’si kṛpāṃ kṛtvā vada me parameśvara |
āśvinaśuklapakṣe tu kiṃnāmnyekādaśī bhavet || 5 ||
ko devastatra saṃpūjyaḥ ko vidhiḥ kiṃphalaṃ tathā |
kiṃ dānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ vada sarvaṃ hare’tra me || 6 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca 
iṣaśuklaikādaśī tu nāmnā pāśāṃkuśā matā |
sarvapāpaharā puṇyapradā mokṣapradā tathā || 7 ||
padmanābhaḥ padmavatyā saha pūjyo’tra bhaktitaḥ |
śamīpatrāṇi pūjāyāmarghye kāmaphalaṃ matam || 8 ||
śālipākastu naivedye dāne taṇḍulamodakāḥ |
sarvābhīṣṭaphalaprāptyai sarvaṃ deyaṃ janārdane || 9 ||
tapastaptvā cātitīvraṃ ciraṃ muniryatendriyaḥ |
yatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tannatvā padmanābhakam || 1.259.10 ||
bahupāpāni kṛtvāpi mohito mānavo vrate |
padmanābhaṃ hariṃ natvā na yāti narakaṃ hi saḥ || 11 ||
pṛthivyāṃ tīrthamātrāṇi puṇyānyāyatanāni ca |
kṛtāni tena sarvāṇi padmanābhaprapūjanāt || 12 ||
devadevaṃ padmanābhaṃ ye prapannā janārdanam |
na teṣāṃ yamalokasya yātanāsti kadācana || 13 ||
ekāmekādaśīṃ kṛtvā prasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ |
yadyapi ghorapāpastho na yāti yamayātanām || 14||
nedṛśaṃ pāvanaṃ kiñcit triṣu lokeṣu vidyate |
yādṛśī padmanābhasyaikādaśī pāpanāśinī || 15 ||
tāvatpāpāni vai vyaktau nirbhayāni vasanti hi |
yāvannopāvasetprāṇī padmanābhadinavrate || 16||
aśvamedhasahasrāṇi rājasūyaśatāni ca |
ekādaśyupavāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm || 17||
naikādaśīsamaṃ loke pāpakṣālanakārakam |
svargamokṣapradaṃ tvatra dhanamitrādidāyakam || 18 ||
śarīrārogyadaṃ dārāsutaputrīkulapradam |
vyājenāpi kṛtaṃ yena na sa yāti yamālayam || 19 ||
na gaṃgā na gayā lakṣmi na kāśī na ca puṣkaram |
na cāpi kauravaṃ kṣetraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ puṇyaṃ harerdināt || 1.259.20 ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ hareḥ kāryaṃ mahārcanam |
nirjalaṃ cāpi kartavyaṃ harerdine hyupoṣaṇam || 21 ||
tena vai labhyate lakṣmi śāśvataṃ dhāma vai mama |
daśaiva mātṛpakṣīyāḥ pitṛpakṣasthitā daśa || 22 ||
daśa patnīpakṣagatā uddharanti vratād dhruvam |
caturbhujā divyarūpā garuḍāṃsakṛtāsanāḥ || 23 ||
sragviṇaḥ pītavastrāste viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥ |
nāryo lakṣmīsamā bhūtvā prayānti harimandiram || 24||
bālatve yauvane vāpi vārdhakye pāravaśyake |
upoṣyaikādaśīṃ dehī naiti pāpo’pi durgatim || 25||
pāśāṃkuśāmupoṣyaiva harerlokaṃ prayāti vai |
datvā hematilān gāśca jalamannaṃ tathāmbaram || 26 ||
upānacchatramanyadvā yamalokaṃ na paśyati |
puṇyavratavihīnasya jīvanaṃ niṣphalaṃ matam || 27||
yasya puṇyavihīnāni dinānyāyānti yānti ca |
sa lohakārabhastreva śvasannapi na jīvati || 28 ||
snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ homaṃ dhyānaṃ satrādikaṃ tathā |
samācaran yathāśakti hyavandhyaṃ divasaṃ nayet || 29|||
dīrghāyuṣo dhanāḍhyāśca kulīnā rogavarjitāḥ |
dṛśyante mānavā loke puṇyakartāra īdṛśāḥ || 1.259.30 ||
tasmād vrataṃ prakartavyaṃ pāśāṃkuśādinātmakam |
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād brahmacārī bhavettathā ||3 1 ||
bhūśāyī syānniśi prātaḥ snātvā svanaityakārcanam |
kuryāt ṣoḍaśasaṃcārairarthayed vratapūrṇatām || 32||
maṇḍalaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ kārayetsaptadhānyakaiḥ |
madhye ghaṭaṃ vāripūrṇaṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitam || 33 ||
dhanapūrṇaṃ ca vā kṛtvā savastraṃ saphalaṃ nyaset |
ghaṭopari tilasthālīṃ sthāpayetkānakīṃ śubhām || 34||
mūrtiṃ śrīpadmanābhasya padmāvatyanvitāṃ śubhām |
pāśāṃkuśāsahitāṃ ca sthāpayedarcayettathā || 35 ||
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā paṃcāmṛtādibhistataḥ |
tīrthajalairhariṃ saṃsthāpayed vastrāṇi dhārayet || 36 ||
candanāttarasaugandhyaṃ tvarpayetkajjalādikam |
puṣparatnasuvarṇādihārābhūṣāḥ samarpayet || 37||
bhojanaṃ vividhaṃ dadyājjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ samarpayet |
mukhavāsaṃ phalaṃ datvā nīrājayennamenmuhuḥ || 38 ||
stutvā pradakṣiṇādaṇḍavataḥ kṛtvārthayetkṣamām |
dhūpadīpādisaṃjuṣṭe dolāṃ vyomni prabandhayet || 39||
hariṃ saṃsthāpayettatra madhyāhne’pi subhojayet |
tāmbūlajalapānādi datvā sāyaṃ tathācaret ||1.259.40 ||
ṣoḍaśopaskaraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samarcyārārtrikādikam |
kuryātsarvaṃ suvidhinā bhojyaṃ peyaṃ samarpayet || 41||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād bhāgavateṣu saṃsthitaḥ |
nartanaṃ gāyanaṃ gītaṃ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā |||2||
vandanaṃ caraṇāṃgānāṃ mardanaṃ sevanādikam |
kuryātprātarhariṃ dhyātvā snātvā saṃpūjya keśavam ||43||
bhojayedbhagavantaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ jalamarpayet |
sādhūn sādhvīḥ svāśritām̐śca bhojayenmānayettataḥ ||44||
vṛddhānnatvā hariṃ smṛtvā kṛtvā paṃcamakhān pṛthak |
tato vai pāraṇāṃ kuryād dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ||45||
evaṃ vrataṃ samāpyaiva dvādaśyāṃ vai hariṃ bhajet |
bhavapāśavināśo’sya vratino bhavati dhruvam ||46 ||
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ divyāṃ yamapāśavimocanīm |
āsītpūrve kṛtayuge vāmadevābhidhaḥ ṛṣiḥ ||47||
āsan śiṣyā aneke’sya brahmavettṛsamagragāḥ |
munayastyāginaścānye gṛhasthā brahmavittamāḥ ||48||
snānaṃ sandhyāṃ japaṃ homaṃ svādhyāyaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam |
kurvanti sma ravau prāpte ratāḥ prāptaḥ svakarmasu ||49||
ekasteṣu karmakāṇḍī ṛṣirvedaśirā iti |
nāmnābhavatsuvaidikakriyāniṣṇāta eva ca ||1.259.50||
cāturmāsyaṃ vratī kandāhāraṃ kurvannināya saḥ |
kandavikṛtijanyo vai rogastasyodare’bhavat ||51 ||
jāṭharasyātimandatvamāntrāṇāmuṣṇaphullatā |
apācanaṃ bhavatyasya yatkiṃcidbhakṣitaṃ bhavet ||52||
evaṃ śarīrakṣīṇatve’śaktiḥ samyag vyavardhata |
ālasyaṃ snānagāyatrījapapūjādike’bhavat ||53||
evaṃ nityaṃ kṣīṇabhāvāt tyaktvā snānaṃ ca pūjanam |
śūdravad vartayandehayātrāṃ karoti vai muniḥ ||54||
karmatyāgena ca vedaśirasaḥ pratyavāyakam |
jātaṃ tatpratyavāyena puṇyaṃ vai kṣīṇatāṃ gatam ||55||
āyuṣyāntaḥ samāyāto yāmyā netuḥ samāgatāḥ |
vedaśirāstadā samyagākulo hyavadattu tān ||56||
kathaṃ me yamadūtānāṃ darśanaṃ kena karmaṇā |
pratyūcuryamadūtāstaṃ vedakarma vihāya vai ||57||
yatheṣṭaṃ vartase tvaṃ yatphalaṃ tad yāmyavāsadam |
utpathapratipannasya brāhmaṇasya yamālayaḥ ||58||
prāyaścittārthamevāsti bhuṃkṣva tatpratyavāyakam |
uktvaivaṃ bedaśirasaṃ yayurnītvā yamagṛham ||59||
yamarājastadīyaṃ vai dṛṣṭvā karma yathārthataḥ |
citraguptaṃ tadā prāha pratyavāyo’sya vai mahān ||1.259.60 ||
adhītavedavismārātmakaṃ yatpātakaṃ mahat||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ proktaṃ pāśairbadhvā hi nīyatām ||6 1 ||
pātyatāṃ narake brahmaghātināṃ kālasūtrake |
asipatravane tvenaṃ nītvā saṃpraharantvapi ||62|||
ityuktvā virarāmāsau yamarājastu nītikṛt |
vedaśirāstadā prāha yamarājaṃ subuddhimān ||63||
āpatkāle śarīrasya mayā vedastu vismṛtaḥ |
tyaktaṃ karmāpyaśaktyā vai kathaṃ me narakaṃ bhavet ||64||
āpatkālasya dharmā vai nādharmagaṇanāṃ gatā |
tasmātpāpaṃ na me tvasti nāsti me yamapūrakam ||65||
dharmarājastataḥ prāha yāvadrāgo’pi vidyate |
tāvadāpatkṛto dharmo rugṇābhāve sa no mataḥ |||66|||
svalpāpadi bahutyāgaḥ sa tvadharmo mahānmataḥ |
na te’sti tādṛśo rogo yena noccāritā śrutiḥ ||67||
vismṛtā ca tvayā tvālasyena vai sakalā śrutiḥ |
pratyavāyastato jātastyaktaṃ karmāpi sarvathā ||68||
yathāśaktiprakartavyaṃ brāhmaṇena vijānatā |
sujānatā tadā sarvaṃ tyaktavyaṃ saṃbhavet katham ||6 9||
tasmādālasyadoṣeṇa karmadharmātivarjitaḥ |
cyuto brahmakriyāmārgād daṇḍamarhati sarvathā ||1.259.70 ||
tadā vedaśirāstatra mānase’cintayadgurum |
vāmadevaṃ mahābrahmāvatāraṃ so’pi cāyayau ||71 ||
dharmarājena tu tadā satkṛto vāmadevakaḥ |
niṣasādāsane datte śiṣyeṇāpi namaskṛtaḥ ||72||
vāmadevena sarvaṃ tatkarma yamamukhācchrutam |
pratyavāyātmakaṃ tathyaṃ vinā daṇḍaṃ na naśyati ||73 ||
vāmadevaḥ kṛpālurvai cintayāmāsa tatkṛte |
yathā daṇḍo na bhoktavyaḥ karmāpi niṣphalaṃ bhavet ||74||
tādṛśaṃ cintayitvaiva kathayāmi taredayam |
vilokya sarvatastatra prāha śiṣyaṃ yamaṃ tathā ||75||
śṛṇutaṃ dvāvapi śiṣyau yama vedaśirastathā |
vrataṃ cāsti mahatkālasūtrāsipatranāśakam ||76||
āśvinaśuklaikādaśikāvrataṃ balavanmattam |
brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ tatsamānāṃ ca nāśakam ||77||
kartavyaṃ śraddhayānena prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet |
evamekādaśīnāmamātraśravaṇatastadā ||78||
bratasaṃkalpataścāpyāyuṣyaṃ susandhitaṃ punaḥ |
guroścāpi pratāpena punarāyuṣyamāptavān ||79||
gṛhītvātīthyasatkāraṃ yayaturyatra vai śavam |
śiṣyaṃ praveśayāmāsa guruḥ prāha tato vratam ||1.259.80 ||
snātvā guroḥ pūjanaṃ ca kṛtvā svāsthyena saṃsthitaḥ |
āgataṃ ceṣaśuklaikādaśīvrataṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ ||8 1 ||
vedavismaraṇotpannapāpadhvaṃso’pyabhūt kṣaṇāt |
karmatyāgādipāpānāṃ bhasmabhāvo’bhavattadā ||82||
tato vedaśirā dīrghamāyuṣyaṃ cāptavān śubham |
gurorbalāttu karaṇādekādaśīvratasya vai ||83||
yamapāśavināśo’syābhavatsevāvratena ca |
iyamekādaśī tasmātpāśānāmaṃkuśaṃ matam ||84||
kariṇāmaṃkuśaṃ yadvat tathā pāśāṃkuśāvratam |
kartavyaṃ yamapāśānāṃ nāśanāya janaiḥ śubham ||85||
svargamokṣapradaṃ sarvasampatkaraṃ sukhapradam |
ārogyadaṃ trividhānāṃ tāpānāṃ śamanaṃ param ||86||
vāsanāpāśabandhānāṃ nāśakaṃ pāpanāśakam |
dehadaihikapāśānāṃ nāśakaṃ vipadāṃ tathā ||87||
ahaṃmamatvapāśānāṃ dhvaṃsakaṃ dveṣarāgayoḥ |
śamanaṃ subhagadātṛ dārāpatitvadāyakam ||88||
kleśadāvānalaśāntikaraṃ śāśvatadhāmadam |
hareryogapradaṃ vaikuṇṭhadaṃ golokadaṃ tathā ||89||
pāśāṃkuśāvrataṃ lakṣmi prakartavyaṃ prayatnataḥ |
paṭhanācchravaṇāccāpi vratapuṇyapradaṃ hi tat ||1.259.90 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne āśvinaśuklapāśāṃkuśaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ vāmadevarṣiśiṣyavedaśiraso’jīrṇarogādālasyena dharmakarmādivarjanātpātakabalena yamalokaprāptau smṛtaguruvāmadevopasthityā vratena ca yamapāśavimokṣaṇamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ekonaṣaṣṭyadhikadvipañcāśattamo’dhyāyaḥ ||259||

<1.260>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
mahākālo mahārudro yamo yamasya kiṃkarāḥ |
yadātmāno jagatsarvaṃ niyamayanti te namaḥ || 1 ||

sevetāthāmbarabhūṣāśṛṃgārādi samarpayet || 17||

dhūpadīpasunaivedyajalatāmbūlakādikam || 18||
ārārtrikādyarpayecca kuryāt stotraṃ kṣamārthanām |

sāyaṃ snātvā pūjayitvā nīrājanaṃ vidhāpayet ||1.260.20 ||
stutyādikaṃ vinirvṛtya bhojayet sevayettathā |
rātrau tu jāgaraṃ kuryādbhaktamaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ || 2 1 ||
gītanṛtyakathāvārtākhyānaraṃjanatāṃ caret |
dvādaśyāṃ tu vratī prātaḥ snātvā samarcya keśavam || 22 ||

tyāgī vāpi gṛhī vāpi nārī vāpi naropi vā || 23 ||

yānavimānakaiḥ so’yaṃ trilokyāṃ yāti sarvataḥ || 29 ||
viṣṇubhaktaḥ satyasandhaḥ śāsti rājyamakaṇṭakam |

na bhoktavyaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ samprāpte tu harerdine || 32 ||
gajairaśvaiśca kalabhairanyaiśca paśubhistvapi |
tṛṇamannaṃ tathā vāri na bhoktavyaṃ harerdine || 33 ||
evaṃ kārayati sarvān rājyasthān vratamuttamam |

tatputrāya śaśisenāhvayāya guṇaśāline |

vratasya divase tvatra pitā me tūgraśāsanaḥ ||1.260.4 0 ||
saśakto vāpyaśakto vā vrataṃ karotu śāsanam |

iti vicintya sā tvāste vratāhaścāpi saṃsthitam || 42 ||
paṭahastāḍyate tasya saṃprāpte daśamīdine |

prayāsyasi vigarhāṃ ca tasmātkuru mano dṛḍham |
śrutvāhaśaśisenastāṃ kariṣye’hamupoṣaṇam || 88 ||

kṣudhātṛṣātisaṃvyāpto babhūva bahuvihalaḥ |
rātrau mūrchābhibhūtaḥ sa brahmarandhraṃ samāśritaḥ || 1.260.5 0 ||
raverudayavelāyāṃ śaśiseno mṛti gataḥ |

karāttavyajanacchatracāmarābhijanairvṛtaḥ |

mucukundagṛhe kāryavaśādindreṇa moditaḥ ||59||

mucukundastadā daityān vijitvendrasahāyavān ||1.260.6 0 ||

indrādanyūnasāmarthyasmṛddhivaibhavavāridhiḥ ||6 3 ||

tadūrdhvaṃ divyalokaṃ sa gantumicchati nākataḥ ||72 |
svīyapatnyānuṣṭhitasya ramāvratasya vai balāt |
śrutvā tatra sthitā candrabhāgā hṛṣṭāha vai muhuḥ ||73 |
nāthadarśanavegāḍhyā mucukundasya putrikā |
tatra māṃ naya dūta tvaṃ yatrāste me priyaḥ patiḥ ||74|
neṣye taṃ brahmadhāmāpi ramāvratasya puṇyataḥ |
āvayordūta saṃyogo yathā bhavati tat kuru ||75|
śrutvā dūto mucukundasyājñāṃ prāpya tadāmbare |
candrabhāgāṃ divyadehāṃ kṛtvā nītvā jagāma ha ||76|
sāpi svargasahaṃ divyaṃ rūpaṃ yauvanamityapi |
divyaṃ coḍḍayanaṃ prāpya bhartuḥ samīpamāgatā ||77
bhartuḥ svargaṃ mahārājyaṃ dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa sā |
indraseno jaharṣāti dṛṣṭvā kāntāṃ samāgatām || 78 ||
samāhūya svake vāme pārśve tāṃ sa nyaveśayat |
dūtaḥ prāpya susatkāramindraṃ prati jagāma ha | 79 ||
athovāca priyaṃ harṣāccandrabhāgā priyaṃ vacaḥ |
śṛṇu kānta hitaṃ vākyaṃ yatpuṇyaṃ vidyate mayi ||1.260.8 0 ||
aṣṭavarṣādhikā jātā yadāhaṃ pitṛveśmani |

<1.261>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kārtikaścaturo māsān varṣāḍhyān puṇyakāryataḥ |
antarbhūyātimāhātmyaśālinaḥ saṃkaroti hi || 1 ||
cāturmāsye na vai jātaṃ vrataṃ puṇyaṃ samarpaṇam |
kārtike tasya karaṇāccāturmāsyaphalaṃ bhavet || 2 ||
pāpānāṃ nāśakaḥ svargasatyavairājalokadaḥ |
golokavaikuṇṭhadaścākṣaralokaprado hi saḥ || 3 ||

ko devaḥ ko vidhistatra kiṃ dānaṃ ca vrataṃ phalam || 5 ||
cāturmāsyāntimamāse vaiśiṣṭyaṃ kiṃ hi gaṇyate |
yena vai vratino muktiṃ prayāntyapi ca me vada || 6 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi kārtikasya site dile |

mahāpāpātipāpāni saṃkarīkaraṇāni ca |
śuṣkārdrāṇi ca sarvāṇyupoṣitā dahati nviyam || 17||
anekajanmasamprāptapāpaduritaparvatāna |
kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau dahati bodhinīvrate || 18||
jñātvājñātvāthavā rogādibhiśceyamupoṣitā |
pāravaśyopoṣitā vā svargaṃ mokṣaṃ dadāti sā || 19||
śraddhayā bhāvataścātra vidhivat kṛtameva yat |
api svalpaṃ kṛtaṃ tasya phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet ||1.261.20 ||
ajñātenāpyavidhinā cāmanaskena vāpi yat |
nindādrohānvitaṃ merupramaṃ kṛtaṃ tu niṣphalam ||2 1 ||
kartavyaṃ khalu svalpaṃ vā nindādrohau na vai caret |
nindādrohāpekṣayā nu na kartavyaṃ varaṃ matam ||22||
pitṝnsaṃsmṛtya ye tvatra puṇyaṃ kurvanti mānavāḥ |
gacchanti pitarasteṣāṃ tṛptā viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam ||23||
brahmahatyādipāpāni vrate naśyanti jāgarāt |

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kāni vratāni cānyāni kārtike puṇyadāni vai |

upāvasedekadainaṃ taptakṛcchravrataṃ tu tat || 9 ||

gomūtraṃ tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāyāścaiva gomayam ||49 ||

kṛṣṇāyāstu ghṛtaṃ yadvā kapilāyāstu paṃcakam ||1.262.5 0 ||

tṛtīyā sā tu raktākṣī caturthī gūḍapiṃgalā || 51 ||

dvādaśāhaṃ tilāḥ prāśyā agnikṛcchravrataṃ tu tat |

devaprīṇanakāmaśca kṛcchraṃ kurvīta bhaktitaḥ || 69 ||

pāpaghnāni muktidāni sarveṣāmapi padmaje || 1.262.70 ||

dhautavastradharaḥ śāntaḥ snātvā saṃpūjayeddharim || 71 ||

<1.263>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kṛcchre kaṣṭamiti proktaṃ sukhaṃ tvayyarpitaṃ tu tat |
sukhadaṃ puṇyadaṃ kṛcchravrataṃ tatte prasaṃgataḥ || 1 ||
vrataṃ puṇyaṃ tathā peyaṃ bhakṣyaṃ sarvaṃ tvameva hi |
tvāṃ vinā niṣphalaṃ sarvaṃ yato nāsti dhruva hi tat || 2 ||
brūhi me bhagavan māse puruṣottamasaṃjñake |
ekādaśī kṛṣṇapakṣe kiṃnāmnī kiṃ phalaṃ vrate || 3 ||
ko vidhiḥ pūjanaṃ kīdṛk ko devaścātra pūjyate |
kiṃ dānaṃ ke ca niyamāḥ sarvaṃ brūhi suvistaram || 4 ||
kathaṃ snānaṃ ca kiṃ jāpyaṃ kiṃ bhojyaṃ tūttamaṃ matam |
kiṃ tyājyaṃ cātra māse’pi tanme brūhi janārdana || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ekādaśyadhike māsi kamalā nāma nāmataḥ |
puruṣottama ityuktaḥ pūjanīyaśca tatpatiḥ || 6 ||

sugandhatailasaṃtyāgaḥ puṣpabhogavivarjanam || 17||
kaṭvamblamadhurakṣāratiktakaṣāyavarjanam |

sthālīpākaparityāgaḥ śākamātravivarjanam |
annamātraparityāgaḥ phalānyatamavarjanam ||21 ||
śilopari prāśanaṃ ca kadalīpatrabhojanam |

kapilāgopradānaṃ ca padmapatraprabhojanam ||29||
bhikṣānnaṃ tvamṛtakalpaṃ vrataṃ mokṣakaraṃ śubham |

nityaṃ yathābalaṃ dānamannādīnāṃ supuṇyakṛt |

annaṃ miṣṭaṃ suvarṇāḍhyaṃ dadyādvai bahubhāvataḥ |
pālāśapātrabhojī tu dadyānmiṣṭaṃ ghṛtādikam ||69||
naktabhojī pradadyādvai bhojanaṃ ṣaḍrasānvitam |
ayācite tvanaḍvāhaṃ sopaskaraṃ samarpayet ||1.263.70||
māṣatyāgī pradadyāttu savatsāṃ gāṃ sulakṣaṇām |
dhātrīsnāne vratī dadyāt suvarṇaṃ māṣamātrakam ||7 1 ||
phalānāṃ niyame dadyāt phalāni vividhāni vai |
dhānyānāṃ niyame dadyāt dhānyāni śāligodhūmān ||72||
dadyādbhūśayane śayyāṃ satūlāṃ gendukānvitām |
brahmacaryakṛte dadyād dampatyorbhojanāni vai ||73||
śākatyāge tu śākāni nairlāvaṇye rasādikam |
nityasnāne ca niḥsnehe dadyād ghṛtaṃ ca saktukān || 74||
nakhakeśavrate dadyādādarśaṃ vyajanādikam |
upānahoḥ parityāge dadyādupānahau mudā ||75||
dugdhādisaṃparityāge dadyādvai kapilāṃ tu gām |
dīpavrate pradadyādvai sauvarṇa dīpapātrakam ||76||
maithunānāṃ tu niyame raupyaṃ dadyād dhanādikam |
evaṃ yadyad vrataṃ sveṣṭaṃ kṛtaṃ ca niyamo dhṛtaḥ ||77||
tattad datvā niyamasya prapūrtiṃ parikalpayet |
godānaṃ śarkarādānaṃ gṛhadānaṃ dhanārpaṇam ||78||
bhūdānaṃ kanyakādānaṃ brahmasūtrapradānakam |
vidyādānaṃ mokṣadānaṃ svasarvārpaṇamityapi ||79||
svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ cāpi bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ |
kiṃ bahunātra coktena yadyadiṣṭatamaṃ bhavet ||1.263.80 ||
punaḥ prāptyarthamevāsya dānaṃ kuryādasaṃśayaḥ |
svasya svīyasya sarvasya haraye dānamuttamam ||8 1 ||
gurave mokṣadātre vā dadyāt sarvasvameva vai |
adhruveṇa dhruvaṃ mokṣaṃ sādhayet kuśalo janaḥ ||82||
kamalāyā vratakarturgṛhe tu kamalāgamaḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathayāmi prāgvṛttaṃ tu kathānakam ||83||
haridvāre’bhavat kaścit śākaṭāyanabhūsuraḥ |
svalpaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ tasya gṛhamāsanamāśrayam ||84||
bhikṣāhārastṛṇatūlaḥ kaṭagenduka eva saḥ |
vartate devagaṃgāyā nikaṭe karapātrakaḥ ||85||
ekadā sa gato bhikṣāyācanāya digantare |
vṛṣṭyākasmikayā tasya hṛtaṃ vai śakaṭaṃ priye ||86||
asvo dṛṣṭvā hṛtaṃ svasya śakaṭaṃ sa yayau tataḥ |
padbhyāṃ prayāgarājākhyaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthāya caikalaḥ ||87||
kṣutkṣāmo dīnavadanastriveṇyāṃ snānamācarat |
munīnāmāśramām̐statra gaveṣayan kṣudhārditaḥ ||88||
bhāradvājāśramaṃ tatra dadarśa divyamadbhutam |
puruṣottamamāse vai janānāṃ saṃsad tathā ||89||
tatrāśrame tu sulabhāṃ kathāṃ kalmaṣanāśinīm |
bhāradvājamukhād ramyāṃ śuśrāva kamalāmayīm ||1.263.90||
ekādaśyāḥ kathāṃ śrutvā bhuktimuktipradāyinīm |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitāyāṃ proktāṃ dhanapradām ||9 1||
śākaṭāyanavipro’sau śrutvā tāṃ kamalākathām |
vrataṃ taiḥ kṛtavān sārdhaṃ sthitvā munyāśrame tadā ||92||
rātraṃ jāgaraṇaṃ cakre kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ smaran hṛdi |
brāhmemuhūrte dvādaśyāṃ lakṣmīstatra samāgatā ||93||
divyāṃgā divyatejaskā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā |
prāha varaṃ dadāmyatra prasannāsmi vratānmama ||94||
śākaṭāyanavipro’pi papracchāścaryasaṃbhṛtaḥ |
kā tvaṃ kasyāsi rambhoru prasannāpi kathaṃ mama ||95||
lakṣmīḥ prāha prasannāhaṃ jātā vrataprabhāvataḥ |
preritā devadevena vaikuṇṭhādahamāgatā ||96 ||
puruṣottamamāsasya kamalāyā vratāttu te |
kamalāṃ vipulāṃ lakṣmīṃ dātumatra samāgatā ||97||
mamavrataṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ prayāge ṛṣiyogataḥ |
āśiṣo vratavaśagā dade tvāṃ dhanavān bhava ||98||
ravāvekādaśī yatra madhyādau dvādaśī tathā |
trayodaśī niśāśeṣe vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam ||99||
tatra kratuśanaṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe |
etadvrataṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ prasannāsmi mahāmune || 1.263.10 0||
gṛhāṇemaṃ maṇiṃ divyaṃ yasmātsvarṇaṃ prapadyate |
ityuktvā kamalā tasmai maṇiṃ datvā tirodadhe || 101 ||
śākaṭāyanavipro’pi maṇiṃ nītvā gṛhaṃ gataḥ |
nityaṃ svarṇaśataṃ prātardadātyeṣo maṇirmahān || 1 02||
śākaṭāyanavipro’pi datte dānaṃ tvaharniśam |
evaṃ sa ṛṣivaryo’pi śākaṭāyanabhūsuraḥ || 10 3||
indrādapyadhikāṃ smṛddhiṃ labdhavān kamalāvratāt |
yācakāya pradātavyaṃ yadyad vāñchati madgṛhāt || 1 04||
evaṃ prakāśitaṃ śākaṭāyanena bhuvastale |
athaikadā pulastyo vai brāhmaṇo brahmaṇaḥ sutaḥ || 1 05||
śrutvaivaṃ dānakīrtiṃ ca maṇerbhikṣecchayā svayam |
śākaṭāyanabhavanaṃ tvājagāma vicārya ca || 106||
yayāce tanmaṇerbhikṣāṃ nispṛho’pi munirdadau |
pulastyo’pi maṇiṃ nītvā yayau dvīpaṃ tu siṃhalam || 1 07||
tatra svarṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ cakre puravanādikam |
tenārpitaḥ kuberāya dhanādhipataye maṇiḥ || 1 08||
rāvaṇastaṃ jahārātha svarṇalaṃkāṃ cakāra saḥ |
evaṃ vai kamalā devī vratena yadi tuṣyati || 1 09||
sarvaṃ dadāti bhaktāya vrataṃ yat toṣakārakam |
śṛṇuyādvā paṭhedvāpi kamalāyāḥ phalaṃ bhavet || 1.263.110 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsasya kṛṣṇapakṣakamalaikādaśīmāhātmyaṃ niyamāḥ udyāpanam śākaṭāyanasya vratena maṇiprāptirlakṣmīprāptistato pulastyakuberarāvaṇasuvarṇalābhādiścetikathananāmā triṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 263 ||

<1.264>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
śrotṝṇāṃ paramaṃ śrāvyaṃ pavitrāṇāmanuttamam |
duḥsvapnanāśakaṃ divyaṃ śrotavyaṃ yatnato mayā || 1 ||
māsānāṃ paramo māsaḥ puruṣottamasaṃjñakaḥ |
yasya devaḥ svayaṃ sākṣātpuruṣottama eva vai || 2 ||
svargīyā nirjarāḥ sarve bhūtale janma lipsavaḥ |
tamarcayanti puruṣaṃ tūttamaṃ tu narāyaṇam || 3 ||
ye japanti sadā bhaktyā devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
tānarcayanti satataṃ brahmādyā devatāgaṇāḥ || 4 ||
tasya te devadevasya māsasya puruṣottama |
śuklapakṣaikādaśī kiṃnāmnī bhavati me vada || 5 ||
ko vidhiḥ kiṃ phalaṃ dānaṃ ko devo vada me prabho |
yadvrataṃ manujaḥ kṛtvā prāpnuyātsvargamakṣaram || 6 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
puruṣottamamāsasya śuklapakṣe tu dhāmadā |
bhavatyekādaśī nāmnā yadbhūtaṃ brahmadhāmadam || 7 ||
vidhirbrahmamayaścātra phalaṃ brahmamayaṃ smṛtam |
brahmadhāmeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ patirmataḥ || 8 ||
akṣarātīta evāyaṃ bhagavānpuruṣottamaḥ |
akṣarayā svapatnyā tu sahito dhāmadāyutaḥ || 9 ||
pūjanīyo muktalatākusumaiścāmṛtaiḥ phalaiḥ |
dānamupaniṣadvidyāśca vai mokṣadānakam || 1.264.10 ||
dīkṣādānaṃ brahmadānaṃ vedadānaṃ nijārpaṇam |
sarvasvārpaṇamevātra dānānāmuttamaṃ matam || 11 ||
bhagavaddhāmadānāgre dānamanyat samalpakam |
dhāmaprāptikaraṃ dānaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dānaṃ mataṃ priye || 12 ||
daśamyāmekabhuktaḥ syād bhūśāyī brahmacaryavān |
prātarutthāya saṃdhyāyedakṣarāṃ puruṣottamam || 13 ||
dhāmadāṃ cāpi saṃsmṛtya kuryātsnānaṃ yathāvidhi ||
naityakaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā mahāpūjāṃ samācaret || 14 ||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayed ramyaṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam |
kārayeccāvraṇaṃ kuṃbhaṃ ratnagarbhaṃ sakācanam || 15 ||
vastravāriphalayuktaṃ sthāpayenmaṇḍale tataḥ |
viśālaṃ tāmrajaṃ pātraṃ kuṃbhopari nidhāpayet || 16 ||
kamalaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ kuṃkumaistatra darśayet |
tatrārcayedakṣarayā sahitaṃ puruṣottamam || 1 7||
tathā kamalayopetaṃ sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmahāpūjāṃ samācaret || 18 ||
divyaṃ divyamahāmuktaiḥ sevitaṃ ca prabhādibhiḥ |
rādhālakṣmyādibhiryuktaṃ dhyāyāmi sundaraṃ varam || 19 ||
bhaktakṛpākaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ manasāvāhayāmyaham |
svarṇasiṃhāsane kṛṣṇa niṣīda puruṣottama || 1.264.20 ||
gaṃgodakaṃ jalaṃ pādyaṃ gṛhāṇākṣarayā saha |
gandhapuṣpādisaṃyuktaṃ jalamarghyaṃ gṛhāṇa vai || 21 ||
gālitaṃ tīrthasalilaṃ gṛhṇīṣvācamanīyakam |
dugdhaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarāṃ ca janārdana || 22 ||
paṃcāmṛtaṃ snapanārthaṃ kṛpayā pratigṛhyatām |
vāridheḥ saritāṃ toyaṃ snānārthaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 23 ||
dhautraṃ prāvaraṇaṃ kaṃcukādikaṃ pratigṛhyatām |
śāṭīṃ ghargharikāṃ kaṃcukyādikaṃ pragṛhāṇa vai || 24||
paṭṭasūtraṃ brahmasūtraṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama |
keyūraṃ kaṭakeṃ’gulīyakaṃ mukuṭanūpure || 25 ||
raśanāṃ tantikāṃ natthīṃ jhaṃjhirairāṇi gṛhyatām |
ratnaṃ svarṇaṃ puṣpahārān śṛṃgārādi pragṛhyatām || 26 ||
kastūryagurukarpūraiścandanairlepanaṃ kuru |
kadambaṃ campakaṃ padmaṃ kundaṃ jātīṃ ca gṛhyatām || 27||
dhūpa sugandhadaṃ nārāyaṇa gṛhāṇa bhāvataḥ |
dīpaṃ ghṛtakṛtaṃ ramyaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama || 28 ||
kuṃkumābīragūlālakajjalāttaramāvaha |
ārārtrikaṃ suprakāśaṃ gṛhāṇa puruṣottama || 29 ||
annaṃ ca pāyasaṃ śaṣkulyādi goghṛtapolikāḥ |
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ miṣṭaṃ gṛhāṇa kamalāpate || 1.264.30 ||
jalaṃ tairthyaṃ sugandhāḍhyaṃ śītalaṃ piba mādhava |
pūgyelākhadirāḍhyaṃ tu tāmbūlaṃ pratigṛhyatām || 31 ||
kadalāmrāmṛtadāḍimaśrīphalaṃ pragṛhyatām |
dakṣiṇāṃ kāṃcanīṃ kṛṣṇa gṛhāṇa hīrakādikam || 32||
aṃjalisthāni puṣpāṇi hyakṣatām̐śca gṛhāṇa vai |
namaste kamalākānta namo’kṣarādhināyaka ||3 3 ||
karomi daṇḍavat tvakṣareśa svāmin gṛhāṇa ca |
tvāṃ vinā śaraṇaṃ nānyastvameva śaraṇaṃ mama || 34||
vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kuru śrīśa rakṣa māmakṣareśvara |
annaṃ vastraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca śākaṃ śayyāṃ ghṛtādikam || 35||
arpayāmi harerbuddhyā dvijāyaitad gṛhāṇa vai |
iti saṃpūjya sadbhaktyā divāśeṣaṃ nayed vratī || 36||
dāna dadyād yathāśakti kurvītāvaśyakīṃ kriyām |
madhyāhne’pi sumiṣṭānnaṃ naivedyaṃ ca jalādikam || 37||
sāyaṃ cāpi mahāpūjāṃ kārayed bahuvastubhiḥ |
kuryānnīrājanaṃ tvājyapañcavartisamanvitam || 38||
naivedyaṃ jalapānaṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ pādamardanam |
datvā kṛtvā kīrtanaiśca rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 39 ||
haryālayaṃ jāgarārthaṃ satāṃ vā tu maṭhaṃ prati |
gacchato’styaśvamedhasya phalaṃ puṃsaḥ pade pade ||1.264.40 ||
prātaḥ snātvā punaḥ pūjāṃ nityāṃ naimittikīṃ tathā |
kuryācca bhojayed devaṃ tato bhaktām̐stu bhojayet ||4 1 ||
gurave svarṇamūrtīnāṃ dānaṃ kuryāt vratī tataḥ |
bahūni tvanyadānāni kuryāṃccābhimatāni vai ||42||
sādhūm̐śca vaiṣṇavān sādhvīrbhojayenmṛṣṭabhojanam |
haviṣyānnena kurvīta pāraṇāṃ ca tato vratī ||43 ||
divānidrāṃ parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune |
dvādaśyāṃ varjayet tailaṃ tāmasaṃ cāpi bhojanam ||44||
pāraṇāhe tu labhyeta svalpāpi dvādaśī yadi |
tatraiva pāraṇāṃ kuryānna tāmullaṃghayed vratī ||45 ||
dvādaśyāḥ prathamaḥ pādo harervāsara ucyate |
tatra naiva hi bhoktavyaṃ puṇyāsyākṣayamicchatā ||46 ||
evaṃ dhāmapradāyāśca vrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ |
vimānena ca taṃ bhaktaṃ hyante dhāma nayet prabhuḥ ||47||
śṛṇu lakṣmi purā jātaṃ vṛttāntaṃ dhāmadāvrate |
āsīt kṛtayuge rājā puṇḍarīkasamāhvayaḥ ||48||
viṣṇubhaktaścakravartī sarvatra samadarśanaḥ |
sāghuvatsarvathā dehe daihike niṣparigrahaḥ ||49||
ardhaṃ dinaṃ tu pūjāyāṃ śeṣaṃ nyāyapradāpane |
yāpayati vratāhe tu pūjāmātraṃ karoti vai ||1.264.50 ||
rājñī kumudvatīnāmnī tasya tvāsītpativratā |
patyājñāmeva śāstrājñāṃ matvā saṃsevate patim ||51 ||
apṛṣṭvā svapatiṃ kiṃcinnaiva karoti mānasam |
ekadāsītpuṇḍarīko dhāmadāvratapūjane ||52||
rājñī jvarābhibhūtāsīdantaḥpurādhivāsinī |
sāyaṃ svāsthyaprarakṣārthaṃ vinā pṛṣṭvā tu tatpatim |||53||
dāsībhiḥ saha vāṭikāyāmudyānaṃ prajagāma sā |
kṣudhayā cānukūlaṃ tu jvarānuttejakaṃ phalam ||54||
navaraṃgaṃ gṛhītvā tadrasaṃ papau pativratā |
patiṃ tvapāyāyitvāsau papau pativratā yataḥ ||55||
pātivratye’bhavadbhaṃgo jvaraścātivyavardhata |
tṛṣayā ca jalaṃ pītvā rātrau tatraiva saṃsthitā ||56||
prātaḥ patyurnityasevā na jātādya dine tathā |
prātarbharturmukhadarśanaṃ na jātaṃ tathā param |||57||
patyaṃguṣṭhajalapānaṃ prāptaṃ naiva ca naiva ca |
pāravaśyaṃ gatā rugṇā pātivratyaṃ kṣatiṃ gatam ||58||
jvaraścātiprabalo’bhūd varṣma śuṣkāyitaṃ tadā |
pātivratyasya bhagena rājñī tvapuṇyabhāginī ||59||
maraṇasyonmukhī jātā pīḍyate’tīva śoṣitā |
duritācca kumudvatyāḥ prāṇāḥ prayānti naiva ca ||1.264.60 ||
puṇḍarīkaśca śuśrāva rājñyā āmayamityapi |
vrate pūrṇe samāgatya sevāṃ tasyāścakāra ha ||6 1 ||
āyuṣyaṃ pūrṇatāṃ yātaṃ prāṇā niryānti naiva ca |
tadā rājñā jalaṃ datvā dhāmadāphalamarpitam ||62||
śīghraṃ prāṇāstu niryātā vimānaṃ divyamāgatam |
viṣṇunā ca tathā lakṣmyā pārṣadaiśca suśobhitam ||63||
akṣarāsahitaśrīmatpuruṣottamaśobhitam |
dvitīyaṃ ca vimānaṃ tvāgatamakṣaradhāmadam ||64||
prathamaṃ viṣṇunā nītā vimāne sā ramāyute |
vaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpitā paścādārūḍhānyavimānake ||65||
akṣaraṃ dhāma nītā śrīpuruṣottamadhāminā |
evaṃ vai dhāmadāyāḥ sā puṇyalābhena dhāmagā ||66||
abhavacca kimu tarhi dhāmadāvratinaḥ punaḥ |
tasmāddhāmapradāyāstu vrataṃ kāryaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||67||
puruṣottamamāsasya śuklaikādaśikāvratam |
paraṃ dhāmapradaṃ mokṣapradaṃ sampatpradaṃ tathā ||68 ||
śrutvā cāpi paṭhitvāpi vratatulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavet |
sakāmānāṃ mahāsmṛddhapārameṣṭhyādi saṃbhavet || 69 ||
yathābalaṃ prakartavyaṃ tadidaṃ śubhakāṃkṣiṇā |
akṣarā dhāmadā cāsmai bhuktiṃ muktiṃ pradāsyati ||1.264.7 0 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsasya śukladhāmadaikādaśīvratamāhātmyaṃ puṇḍarīkanṛpasya kumudvatīpatnyāḥ kiṃcitpatisevālābhaśūnyāyā api vratenākṣaradhāmaprāptirityādinirūpaṇanāmā catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 264||

<1.265>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
udyāpanāni sarvāṇi sarvadevaprapūjanam |
bhagavan kathitaṃ sarvaṃ tanmayā viditaṃ prabho || 1 ||
ekādaśīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ yadyudyāpanamekalam |
kartavyaṃ syāttadā vistāraḥ kiyām̐staṃ ca me vada || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pravakṣyāmi sarvāsāmekalakṣaṇam |
udyāpanaṃ samastaṃ vai sampūrṇaphaladaṃ yathā || 3 ||
maṇḍape nirmite ramye kadalīstambhaśobhite |
vidhāya sarvatobhadraṃ tanmadhye sthāpayed ghaṭam || 4 ||
aśvatthodumbaraplakṣacūtanyagrodhapallavaiḥ |
yuktaṃ ratnairvastrakaṇṭhaṃ tathā salilasaṃbhṛtam || 5 ||
tanmukhe sumahatpātraṃ nidadhyātkuṃkumānvitam |
kamalaṃ dvādaśapatraṃ daladvādaśakānvitam || 6 ||
kṛtvā madhye ramājuṣṭaṃ vāsudevaṃ suvarṇajam |
sthāpayetparitaścaturviṃśatyekādaśapatīn || 7 ||
tattatpatnīsametām̐śca sthāpayetpūrvataḥ kramāt |
ādye śrīkeśavau padmānārāyaṇau tato dale || 8 ||
mādhavo nityayā sākaṃ govindaścandrayā saha |
ramayā saha viṣṇuśca mādhavyā madhusūdanaḥ || 9 ||
trivikramaśca padmākṣyā vāmanaḥ kamalāyutaḥ |
śrīdharaḥ kāntimatyā ca hṛṣīkeśāparājite || 1.265.10 ||
padmanābhaḥ padmavatyā rādhādāmodarau tataḥ |

piṇḍakān vaṭakām̐ścaiva śatacchidrām̐śca śaṣkulīḥ || 18 ||

stutiṃ namo daṇḍavacca kṣamāyācanamityapi || 21 ||

tataḥ sa pāraṇāṃ kuryād bhojayitvā janānsvakān |
evaṃ kṛte caturviṃśatyekādaśīphalaṃ bhavet || 28 ||
vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyamudyāpanamahotsave |

gāścaturviśatiṃ dadyād viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā ||1.265.50||
lavaṇādriṃ guḍādriṃ ca hemādriṃ tilaparvatam |
kārpāsādriṃ ghṛtādriṃ ca ratnādriṃ rājatācalam ||51||
śarkarādriṃ yathāśakti nagānnava prakārayet |
pārśvasthānparvatām̐ścāpi caturaścaturo yathā ||52||
racayitvā pūrvavacca śobhāṃ kuryādanekadhā |
pūjayedvidhinā sarvān dadyācca gurave tu tān ||53|||
godānaṃ pṛthivīdānaṃ kanyādānaṃ gṛhārpaṇam |
yānavāhananagaragrāmadānaṃ vidhāpayet ||54||

bhikṣukebhyastvannadānamanyebhyo yadapekṣitam ||55||

sarvaṃ tadgurave dadyād devālayāya vārpayet |||56||
vrateṣu tyājyavastūnāṃ gṛhītā niyamāstu ye |

viprān sādhūn bhojayecca dadyād dānāni bhūriśaḥ |
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryād bhuktiṃ muktimavāpnuyāt ||78 ||
śucau śuklapratipadi brahmā jajñe jagadguruḥ |
tasyātra pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ deyaṃ dānaṃ suvarṇavat ||79 ||
ekabhaktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ sarvasiddhipradaṃ bhavet |
satyalokapradaṃ tvante bhuktimuktipradaṃ bhavet ||1.266.8 0 ||
evaṃ pratipaddivase vārṣikāṇi vratāni te |
uktānyatra brahmacaryaṃ haviṣyānnaṃ phalapradam ||8 1 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapratipadvrateṣu jagatsarjanasarasvatījanmakūrmajanmakaravīrāgamanalakṣmīvratamaunavratāśokavratanavarātrānnakūṭadhanavratadvādaśabhānuvratavahnyutpattisatībhasmadhūlīvratanaranārāyaṇajanmaviṣṇujanmabrahmajanmavratānāṃ kathananāmā ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 266 ||

<1.267>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi dvitīyāyā vārṣikāṇi vratāni vai |
bhogamokṣobhau prāpnuvantīha mānavāḥ || 1 ||
caitraśukladvitīyāyāṃ brahmā vivāhito’bhavat |
sāvitryā saha lagnasyotsavaṃ kuryād vrataṃ tathā || 2 ||
mahāntaṃ maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā sāvitryajau tu kānakau |
pūjayitvā sotsavau ca haviṣyānnaṃ prabhojayet || 3 ||
vratī syādekabhuktaśca sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet |
kanyādānaṃ ca godānaṃ dadyāt sadvaibhave sati || 4 ||
phalaṃ labdhvākhilānkāmānante brahmapadaṃ vrajet |
asminneva dine lakṣmi candro jātastu vāridheḥ || 5 ||
candravrataṃ hyataḥ kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam |
samabhyarcya niśārambhe bālendumuditaṃ mudā || 6 ||
rūpyacandraṃ pradadyādvai dāne vipraṃ ca bhojayet |
kumudaiḥ pūjanīyaśca vipraścandrapratikṛtiḥ || 7 ||
arthanīyastathā candro dvitīyā jananīva me |
cullikāṃ bhrāṣṭrasaṃyuktāṃ vṛṣabhau dvau gavāṃ kulam || 8 ||
dhanadhānyayutaṃ gehaṃ samārogyaṃ janeṣu me |
samādiśatu me nityaṃ dvitīyeśa namo’stu te || 9 ||
bhavauṣadhyannadātā me tejovṛddhiṃ pradehi me |
bālapuṣṭikaro me’tra sarvadā sukhado bhava || 1.267.10 ||
asminneva dine tvaśvarūpātsūryāttu bālakau |
saṃjñānāmnyā svapatnyāṃ tvaśvinyāṃ dasrau babhūvatuḥ || 11 ||
aśvinībālakau vaidyau pūjanīyau vrataṃ hi tat |
kartavyaṃ tvekabhuktaṃ ca dāne tvauṣadhamiṣyate || 12 ||
suvarṇarajate netre pra dadyācca dvijātaye |
aśvinyā vājinaścāpi dānaṃ deyaṃ tu śaktitaḥ || 13 ||
aśvāśvinīvrataṃ kāryaṃ puṃsā nāryā ca bhaktitaḥ |
aśvebhyaścaṇakā deyā vratī tvadyād ghṛtaṃ dadhi | 14 ||
vratametad dvādaśābdaṃ netrāśvadānapūrvakam |
kṛtvā syād bhūpatiśreṣṭhaścātirūpo nṛpāgraṇīḥ || 15 ||
rādhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ samārebhe tapo hyajaḥ |
tapovratamidaṃ kuryāt kṛtvā kamalamuttamam || 16 ||
brahmāṇaṃ tāpasaṃ tatra vinyasya pūjayed vratī |
saptadhānyānvitaṃ bhadraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kārayecca vā || 17 ||
tatra kuṃbhopari viśvasṛjaṃ vinyasya pūjayet |
kamaṇḍaluṃ tathā dhautraṃ valkalaṃ cāsanaṃ tathā || 18 ||
phalāni bhojanaṃ dadyātpāduke brahmasūtrakam |
godānaṃ tvanyadānāni dadyād viprāya sādhave || 19 ||
viṣṇulokamavāpnoti bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān |
jyeṣṭhaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaro dyumaṇirmahān || 1.267.20 ||
samudbhūto harernetrāt dyotayan bhuvanatrayam |
caturvaktrasvarūpaṃ ta gāyatrīsahitaṃ harim || 21 |
sarathāśvāruṇaṃ sūryaṃ samabhyarcya vidhānataḥ |
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kṛtvā bhojayitvārbhakān sataḥ || 22 ||
svarṇasūryapradānaṃ ca hiraṇyārpaṇamityapi |
kṛtvā vratī susamṛddhaṃ bhāskaraṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 23 ||
aṣāḍhaśukladvitīyā proktaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ vratam |
rāmarūpeṇa jāto’tra śeṣanārāyaṇaḥ svayam || 24 ||
bhadrakayā samaṃ rāmaṃ devā vai prathame yuge |
rathaṃ tvārohayitvā ca parikramya purādikam || 25 ||
jalāśayāntikaṃ gatvā pupūjustamanantakam |
tato vai mānavaiḥ sarvaiḥ kāraṇīyo mahotsavaḥ || 26 ||
tadante devabhavane sthāpayitvā yathāvidhi |
ārārtrikaṃ namaḥ kuryād brāhmaṇān bhojayed bahūn || 27||
sataśca bhojayetsādhvīrbālān dāne halādikam |
rathadānaṃ tathā kṣetragrāmadānādikaṃ caret || 28 ||
śrāvaṇaśukladvitīyā viśvakarmavrataṃ śubham |
viśvakarmā svapityatra hyaśokaśayanaṃ vratam || 29 ||
mūrtiṃ caturmukhīṃ patnīyutāṃ śayyāsthitāṃ śubhām |
kṛtvā viśvakarmaṇaśca prapūjya jagatāṃ patim || 1.267.30 ||
prārthayed viśvakarmāṇaṃ bhagavantaṃ jagatkaram |
śrīvatsadhārin śrīkānta śrīvāsa śrīpate prabho || 31 ||
gārhasthyaṃ bhavanādyaṃ ca mā nāśaṃ yātu me vibho |
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ viyogo māstu me kvacit || 32 ||
gṛhadānaṃ tathā patnīdānaṃ candrārdhadānakam |
kanyādānaṃ suvarṇāderdānaṃ kuryād vrate’tra vai || 33 ||
bhādraśukladvitīyāyāmindrajanmābhavad yataḥ |
indraṃ hariṃ prapūjyaiva sarvakratuphalaṃ laset || 34||
tatputraśca jayantyākhyaḥ śacī vimānamityapi |
sarvaṃ vai kānakaṃ kṛtvā vajraṃ dhanuśca mārgaṇam || 35 ||
gajaṃ svarṇamayaṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ |
sarvaṃ vai gurave dadyādekabhukto vratī bhavet || 36 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā vratī svargaṃ mahendrālayamityatha |
prāpnuyāccirakālaṃ ca muktiṃ vairājalokagām || 37 ||
āśvinaśukladvitīyāvrataṃ durgākṛtaṃ matam |
dānaṃ pradattametasyāmanantaphaladaṃ bhavet || 38 ||
ūrjaśukladvitīyāyāṃ yamo yamunayā purā |
bhojitaḥ pūjito bhrātrā svagṛhe bahumiṣṭakaiḥ || 39 ||
vrataṃ yamadvitīyāyāḥ kuryāt svasā gṛhe gṛhe |
puṣṭivivardhanaṃ cedaṃ bhaginyālayabho janam ||1.267.4 0 ||
bhuktvā bhrātrāmbarabhūṣāḥ svasre deyā dhanādayaḥ |
tena svayaṃ bhavetsvarṇadhanadhānyaprapūritaḥ ||4 1 ||
asyāṃ tithau yamunayā yamarājaḥ prabhojitaḥ |
tasyāṃ svasurhastatalāt sauhṛdena bhunakti yaḥ || 42 ||
sa bhrātā svarṇaratnādidhanadhānyādimān bhavet |
dānaṃ svasre bhṛśaṃ deyaṃ svasrīyāyāpi mudrikāḥ || 43 ||
mārgaśukladvitīyāyāṃ pitarastvaryamādayaḥ |
samutpannā brahmadehāt pitṛśrāddhavrataṃ hi tat || 44||
prātaḥ prapūjanaṃ sūryanārāyaṇasya kārayet |
madhyāhnottarakāle tu śrāddhaṃ kuryācca tarpaṇam || 45 ||
pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ caiva kārayet piṇḍamarpayet |
vratakartā bhavennaktabhojī dāne tu dhānyakam || 46 ||
bhojanaṃ bhūsurāyāpi dadyād vastrādikaṃ tathā |
godānaṃ ca yathāśakti kartavyaṃ vratinā tadā || 47 ||
vṛddhānsarvānpūrvajān saṃsmṛtya dvijāya vai namaḥ |
kuryādārogyamāpnuyāllabhate putrapautrakān || 48 ||
pauṣaśukladvitīyāyāmutpannāḥ kāmadhenavaḥ |
kāmadhenuvrataṃ kāryaṃ haviṣyāśī bhaved vratī ||49||
sarvakāmapradaṃ kuryād gośṛṃgodakamārjanam |
gośṛṃgodakamṛdbhyāṃ ca saṃsnāyāt pūjayecca gām ||1.267.50 ||
dadyāddānaṃ gavādīnāṃ dharmakāmārthasiddhaye |
tṛṇādikaṃ pradadyācca gavāṃ grāsādilabdhaye ||5 1 ||
bālendudarśanaṃ sāyaṃ prakuryāccārghyasarjanam |
bhavedevaṃ vratakartā godhano’tighano’pi ca ||52 ||
māghaśukladvitīyāyāṃ bhāskaro viśvakarmaṇā |
śāṇopari samanyastaḥ surūpaḥ kṛta eva vai ||53 ||
bhānurūpaṃ hariṃ tvatra pūjayedraktapuṣpakaiḥ |
raktairgandhaistathā svarṇamūrtiṃ nirmāya śaktitaḥ ||54||
tataḥ pūrṇaṃ tāmrapātraṃ godhūmaiścāpi taṇḍulaiḥ |
sūryāya cārpayed bhaktyā jalenārghyaṃ samarpayet ||55||
mūrtiṃ dadyād sādhave ca dānaṃ viprāya śaktitaḥ |
evaṃ kṛte vrate lakṣmi sākṣāt sūrya iva vratī |||56||
durāsado durādharṣo jāyate bhuvi bhūsuraḥ |
yadvā rājā prajāyeta cakravartī mahānnṛpaḥ ||57||
iha kāmānvarān bhuktvā yātyante ca raveḥ padam |
sarvadevastutastvante yāti vā brahmaṇaḥ padam |||8||
atha phālgunaśuklāyāṃ dvitīyāyāṃ svayaṃ haraḥ |
tapase prasthito haime śaile nārāyaṇāśrame ||59||
tato harasya sauvarṇīṃ kāryā mūrtirjaṭānvitā |
puṣpaiḥ śivaḥ samabhyarcyaḥ suśvetaiśca sugandhibhiḥ ||1.267.60 ||
puṣpairvitānakaḥ kāryaḥ puṣpālaṃkaraṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
naivedyairvividhairdhūpairdīpairnīrājanādibhiḥ ||61 ||
toṣaṇīyo mahādevo vratinā sukhalabdhaye |
evamabhyarcya deveśaṃ vratī vyādhivivarjitaḥ ||62||
dhanadhānyasmṛddhiyukto jīvedvarṣaśataṃ dhruvam |
vrateṣveteṣu homādi kāryaṃ yathādhanādikam ||63||
vahnireva pṛthaṅmāssu nānārūpo harervapuḥ |
pūjanīyo homakṛtā brahmacaryādi rakṣatā ||64||
yadvidhānaṃ dvitīyāsu śuklapakṣagatāsu vai |
proktaṃ tadeva kṛṣṇāsu kartavyaṃ vidhikovidaiḥ ||65||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadvitīyāvrateṣu brahmasāvitrīlagnacandrotpattyaśvinīkumārotpattibrahmatapaḥsūryotpattisaṃkarṣaṇarāmotpattiviśvakarmāśokaśayanendrajanmadurgāvratayamayamunābhojanāryamapitrutpattikāmadhenūtpattisūryaśāṇollīḍhatāśaṃbhutapaiti vratānāṃ nirūpaṇanāmā saptaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 267||

<1.268>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca 
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi tṛtīyāyā vratāni vai |
yāni kṛtvā naro nārī bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt || 1 ||
caitraśuklatṛtīyāto gauryā tapaḥ sudāruṇam |
kṛtaṃ śaṃkaraprāptyarthaṃ gaurīvrataṃ hi tanmatam || 2 ||
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ gaurīṃ kṛtvā saśaṃkarām |
sauvarṇāṃ rājatīṃ vāpi tāmrīṃ vā mṛṇmayīṃ ca vā || 3 ||
abhyarcya gandhapuṣpādyairvastrairābharaṇaiḥ śubhaiḥ |
durvākāṇḍaiśca vidhivatsopavāsā tu kanyakā || 4 ||
varārthinī sutāputrārthinī bhartrarthinī tathā |
nīrājayenmahāgaurīṃ śāṃkarīṃ śaṃkarānvitām || 5 ||
punaḥ punaḥ praṇamyaiva prārthayenmanasi sthitam |
sapta navaikādaśa cādhikā vā dvijayoṣitaḥ || 6 ||
bhartṛmatīśca vā kanyā gaurīrūpā sulakṣaṇāḥ |
samāhūya bahumānapūrvakaṃ tu ca tāstataḥ || 7 ||
sindūrāṃjanavastrādyairbhūṣābhiḥ prītamānasā |
vratakartrī pūkayettā tathā dānaiśca toṣayet || 8 ||
miṣṭānnāni piṇḍakādīn phalānyapi samarpayet |
evaṃ santoṣayitvā tāḥ vratinī phalamāpnuyāt || 9 ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryād vratasampūrtikāmyayā |
prātastāṃ ca punaḥ saṃpūjyārpayed gurave mudā || 1.268.10 ||
yadvā visarjayenmūrtiṃ tīrthe vāryāśaye kṣipet |
evaṃ dvādaśavarṣāṇi kṛtvā gaurīvrataṃ śubham || 11 ||
kanyā tu labhate śaṃbhusadṛśaṃ guṇinaṃ patim |
dhenūrdvādaśa saṃkalpya dadyādvratasya siddhaye || 12 ||
kimatra bahunoktena gaurī saubhāgyadāyinī |
strīṇāṃ yathā tathā nānyā vidyate bhuvanatraye || 13 ||
dhanaṃ putrānpatiṃ putrīṃ vidyāṃ siddhiṃ yaśaḥ sukham |
dadāti sarvameveṣṭaṃ gaurī vratena toṣitā || 14||
pārvatyā prabhayā lakṣmyā māṇikyā ramayā kṛtam |
vrataṃ labdhaḥ patirīśaḥ kṛṣṇo dhvajadhanuḥkaraḥ || 15||
mīnatriśūlacakrasvastikacihnakaro hariḥ |
tasmādidaṃ vrataṃ rūpasaubhāgyabhogamuktidam || 16 ||
vaiśākhaśuklatṛtīyā tvakṣayatṛtīyāvratam |
tithistretāyugādyā sā kṛtasyākṣayakāriṇī || 17||
atra tretāyugaṃ svarṇamūrtirūpaṃ vidhāya ca |
yadvā lakṣmīyutaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ samarcayet || 18||
puṣpadhūpavilepādyairgaṃgāvārbhistathākṣataiḥ |
vividhairbhojanaiścaiva toṣayecchrījagadgurum || 19||
saktūn saṃbhojayed viprān vratītvekādano bhavet |
evaṃ kṛtavidhestasya vratito’nāśanaṃ phalam ||1.268.20 ||
kāryārambhopi saphalo nirvighno yāti pūrṇatām |
naro nārī vrataṃ cāsmin kṛtakāryatvamāpnuyāt ||21 ||
vaiśākhasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ punarvasau |
jamadagnigṛhe prādurāsītparaśudhṛk hariḥ ||22||
asmin rāmaṃ saparaśu sauvarṇaṃ kārayed vratī |
madhyāhne tu mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā kurvīta bhojanam ||23||
ita ārabhya nityaṃ ca jyeṣṭhapūrṇāvadhiṃ prabhum |
dhārayed gandhavāsāṃsi vāsāṃsi ca sitānyapi ||24||
uśīratālavṛntaiśca vejayetpratyahaṃ prabhum |
naivedye śarkarāyuktaṃ dadyādāmrarasādikam ||25||
jyeṣṭhaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ raṃbhā svargād bhuvaṃ gatā |
rabhāphalaṃ vrate bhakṣyaṃ raṃbhā pṛjyākṣatairjalaiḥ ||26||
gandhapuṣpāṃśukādyaiśca sabhāryaṃ pūjayed dvijam |
raṃbhāvrataṃ karotyatra nārī saubhāgyakāmyayā ||27||
vittaṃ labhate putrām̐śca matiṃ lakṣmīṃ dhanādikam |
patiṃ gāṃ pṛthivīṃ saudhaṃ tathopakaraṇāni ca ||28|||
labhate kadalīsāmyaṃ saukumāryaṃ vratārthinī |
dāne raṃbhāphalānyatra śarkarāghṛtamityapi |||29||
athāṣāḍhatṛtīyāyāṃ samārebhe tapo ramā |
keśavārthamato lakṣmīvrataṃ kāryaṃ tu yoṣitā ||1.268.3 0||
keśavaṃ tu salakṣmīkaṃ suvarṇapratimātmakam |
ṣoḍaśopasuvastvādyaiḥ pūjayettu vidhānataḥ ||3 1||
bhojanaiḥ surabhīdānairvastraiścāpi vibhūṣaṇaiḥ |
ārārtrikanamaskārairdakṣiṇābhiśca pūjayet ||3 2||
sastrīkaṃ ca dvijaṃ tatra pūjayed bhojayettathā |
vipravākyairmānayecca toṣayeddharṣayettathā || 33 ||
evaṃ vrate prasādyaināṃ lakṣmīrūpāṃ tu bhūsurīm |
vipraṃ viṣṇusvarūpaṃ ca visarjayecca tau gṛham || 34||
vratakartrī gṛhayuktā nārī saubhāgyavāñcchayā |
devadevaprasādena dhanadhānyasamanvitā || 35 ||
putrapautrayutā bhūtvā viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt |
kanyā vindetsurūpaṃ supatiṃ sveṣṭasubhogadam || 36 ||
śrāvaṇaśuklatṛtīyā svarṇagaurīvrataṃ matam |
kālī tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtvā svarṇagauryabhavad yataḥ || 37||
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirbhavānī pūjayet vratī |
prārthayedtpūjanānte ca rūpaṃ gauraṃ pradehi me || 38 ||
putrāndehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ dehi suvrate |
anyām̐śca vividhānkāmānpūrayātra namo’stu te || 39 ||
tato bhavayutāṃ devīṃ vāyanaṃ tu dadecchubham |
ṣoḍaṣavarṣaparyantaṃ vratametatprakīrtitam || 1.268.40 ||
tadante subhagā nārī kuryādudyāpanaṃ mahat |
kadalīmaṇḍape sarvabhadrākhyamaṇḍale satīm ||4 1 ||
madhye saṃsthāpayetsvarṇaghaṭe ratnādisaṃyute |
paritaḥ śrīgaṇeśādipaṃcāyatanamarcayet ||42|||
kalaśopari tāmrasyākṣatayukte supātrake |
sauvarṇī pratimāṃ śaṃbhubhavānyāḥ pratipūjayet ||43 ||
ṣoḍaśabhirvastubhiśca tato homaṃ samācaret |
veṇupātraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pakvānnaparipūritaiḥ ||44||
samarpya satyai naivedyaṃ sādhuṣvetannivedayet |
vāyanaṃ ca tato dadyāduttamaṃ bāndhavādiṣu ||45||
pratimāṃ gurave dadyād dvijebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ tathā |
bahudānāni kurvīta vratasāphalyahetave ||46 ||
pūrṇaṃ vindet phalaṃ nārī kanyā vā sadhavādhavā |
dhanadhānyādisusmṛddhā bhūtvā yāti paraṃ padam ||47||
bhādraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ vrataṃ vai haratālikam |
harahastena pārvatyā hastasya melanaṃ hyabhūt || 48 ||
tadidaṃ haratālyākhyaṃ vrataṃ saubhāgyavardhanam |
kuryād bhaktyā vidhānena pādyārghyārcanapūrvakam ||49 ||
atra vai kāṃcane pātre rājate vātha tāmrake |
vaiṇave mṛnmaye vātha vinyasyānnaṃ sadakṣiṇam ||1.268.5 0 ||
bharjitaṃ tilataṇḍulacaṇakādikamityapi |
phalaṃ vastrādikaṃ bhūṣāṃ vinyasyātraiva pātrake ||5 1 ||
dadyāttu gurave tadvai kuryātpaścāttu pāraṇām |
bhojayed brāhmaṇānsādhūnsādhvīḥ kanyāśca bālakān ||52 ||
saubhāgyadravya pātrāṇi vaṃśapātrāṇi ṣoḍaśa |
pradadyācchraddhayā tvevaṃ viprebhyo vidhinā tathā ||5 3 ||
anyebhyo brāhmaṇebhyaśca bhūyasīṃ dakṣiṇāṃ śubhām |
dadyād vratavatī nārī tena saubhāgyamāpnuyāt ||54||
evaṃ kṛtavratā nārī bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān |
vrataprabhāvato’mutra gaurosahacarī bhavet |||55|||
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sutāṃ putrān labhate’tra paratra śam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ devīprasādāpyaṃ vrataṃ matam || 56 ||
yadā tṛtīyā bhādre’tra bhaveddhastarkṣasaṃyutā |
sāmagaistvatra kartavyaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam ||57||
navaṃ yajñopavītaṃ ca dhāryaṃ śākhoktakarmaṇā |
hastagaurīvrataṃ nāma kartavyaṃ bhūtihetave ||58 ||
viṣaprāṇipradaṃśādinivārakamidaṃ bhavet |
mahiṣāsuranāśārthaṃ koṭirūpadharā yadā ||59 ||
babhūva sā tadā durgā koṭīśvarīti nāmataḥ |
pinākinā svayaṃ proktā koṭīśvarīvrataṃ tu tat || 1.268.60 ||
lakṣacaṇḍīsvarūpāṇi yadā dhṛtavatī hi sā |
lakṣeśvarī tadā proktā svayaṃ pinākinā satī ||6 1 ||
lakṣeśvarīvrataṃ kāryaṃ yāvadvarṣacatuṣṭayam |
sopavāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ lakṣeśvaryāḥ prapūjanam ||62 ||
akhaṇḍānāṃ taṇḍulānāṃ tilānāṃ vāpi padmaje |
lakṣamekaṃ viśodhyātra kṣiped dugdhe’gnasaṃśrute ||63 ||
yāvadvai kaṭhino dravyasāro bhavetsupiṇḍakaḥ |
tena piṇḍena nirmāya devyā mūrtiṃ surūpiṇīm ||64||
gandhapuṣpākṣataratnaromavastravibhūṣitām |
pārvatīṃ tatra cāvāhya pūjayed bhaktibhāvataḥ || 65 ||
gandhaiḥ puṣpairjalairdhūpairdīpairnaivedyaprārthanaiḥ |
vividhaiḥ satphalaiḥ śreṣṭhadakṣiṇābhiśca vandanaiḥ || 66||
ārārtrikairdaṇḍavadbhirvardhayecca kṣamāpayet |
arthayeddhanadhānyādisutāputragṛhādikam ||67 ||
tato visarjayed durgāṃ jalamadhye’tha dakṣiṇām |
datvā śrīgurave paścād rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ caret || 68 ||
datvā dānāni viprebhyo bhuñjītāyaṃ pare dine |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi koṭilakṣeśvarīvratam ||6 9||
vratakartryā gṛhe lakṣmīrdhanadhānyamayī sadā |
rājate vardhate nityaṃ vratasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ||1.268.7 0 ||
gaurīlokaṃ prayātyante bhogamokṣau hi vindati |
iṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ bṛhadagaurīvrataṃ matam ||7 1 ||
pañcavarṣaṃ prakartavyaṃ koṭikundanamāpnuyāt |
durgāṃ tu pūjayetprātaḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ suvastubhiḥ ||72||
suvāsinyaḥ paṃca pūjyā vastrālaṃkāracandanaiḥ |
śāṭīkaṃcukatāṭaṃkakaṇṭhasūtravibhūṣaṇaiḥ ||7 3 ||
dhātupātrāṇi paṃcaiva vāṭikāsthālikāstathā |
sindūraṃ jīrakaṃ miṣṭaṃ saubhāgyadravyamaṃjanam ||74||
godhūmapiṣṭajātaṃ ca navāpūpaṃ phalādikam |
vastrāṇi vividhānyeva vāyanāni ca pañca vai ||75 ||
tābhyo dadyād bhojayecca paścād bhuñjīta vāgyatā |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt kṛṣṇakīrtanamiśritam ||76 ||
phalaṃ tu dhārayetkaṇṭhe pūgīṃ vānyad yadarpitam |
rātrau kaṇṭhagataṃ sarvakāmasmṛddhipradaṃ phalam ||77||
tata prātaḥ samutsāhā sālaṃkārā sakhījanaiḥ |
gītavādyayutā gacchet saritaṃ snānamācaret ||78 ||
gaurīṃ sambodhayettatra prārthanāṃ saṃvadedimām |
āhūtāsi mayā bhadre pūjitā ca yathāvidhi ||79 ||
mama saubhāgyade devi sarvaṃ rakṣaya nityadā |
nyūnaṃ ca kṣamyatāṃ devi yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ tvayā ||1.268.8 0 ||
ityabhyarthya namaskṛtya jayaśabdaiśca vādanaiḥ |
sotsāhapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭvā jale gaurīṃ visarjayet ||8 1 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhaktyā vratī devīprasādataḥ |
bhuktvā bhogām̐stu dehānte gaurīlokamavāpnuyāt ||82 ||
ūrjaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ viṣṇugaurīvrataṃ matam |
gauryā prapūjito viṣṇustapasaḥ phalasiddhaye ||8 3 ||
tasmād vratamidaṃ proktaṃ viṣṇugauryabhidhaṃ śubham |
tatra vai pūjanīyāsau gaurī viṣṇuyutā mudā ||84||
ṣoḍaśabhistūcārairbhojanaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ |
suvāsinīrūpāṃ gaurīṃ lakṣmīnāmnā prabhojayet ||85 ||
pūjayenmaṃgaladravyaiviṣṇugaurīpratuṣṭaye |
visarjayetpraṇamyaināṃ dadyād dānāni bhāvataḥ ||86||
putraṃ vai labhate nārī vratakartrī na saṃśayaḥ |
mārgaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ haragaurīvrataṃ matam ||87||
haraśayyāgatā gaurī harayogamupāgatā |
harayogena sā tṛptābhavat svāmisukhānvitā ||88 ||
haraṃ gaurīṃ vrate tvatra caikaśayyāṃ prakalpya ca |
svāpayetpūjayed bhaktyā sevayed divyabhāvataḥ ||8 9||
etadvrataprabhāveṇa bhuktvā bhogānmanoramān |
gaurīlokaṃ samāsādya hareṇa saha modate ||1.268.90 ||
pauṣaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ brahmagaurīvrataṃ matam |
brahmaṇā tu samāgatyāśīrvādāḥ śaṃkarāptaye ||91 ||
pradattā tad vrataṃ proktaṃ kartavyaṃ suvidhānataḥ |
gaurīṃ ca vedhasaṃ kṛtvā suvarṇasya prapūjayet ||92|||
ṣoḍaśabhiścopacārairekabhuktaṃ samācaret |
dānaṃ dadyād yatheṣṭaṃ tu gurave bhojayed dvijān ||93||
brahmagaurīprasādena modate tatra saṃgatā |
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ lakṣmīḥ saubhāgyasundarī ||94||
viṣṇau varamālikāyā arpaṇāt samabhūt priyā |
tasmāt saubhāgyasundaryātmakaṃ kāryaṃ vrataṃ mudā ||95||
lakṣmīstatra pūjanīyā nālikerārghyadānataḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśabhirmiṣṭānnairbhūṣaṇādibhiḥ ||96||
saubhāgyadā prasannā syāt svīyaṃ dhāma nayatyapi |
dānaṃ śrāṃgārikaṃ sarvaṃ deyaṃ vastu tu yoṣite ||97||
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ hāraścārpyastu viṣṇave |
prasādamālā sā cārpyā patikaṇṭhe tu putradā ||98||
phālgunasya site pakṣe tṛtīyāyāṃ niśottare |
harayogātsatī labdhavatī putrām̐stu rudrakān ||99||
tasmātsoktā tṛtīyā tu kulasaukhyavratātmikā |
pūjitā gandhapuṣpādyairgaurī kulakarī bhavet || 1.268.100 ||
evaṃ sarvavrateṣvatra dānaṃ homo visarjanam |
devadevīprapūjā ca vipraguruprapūjanam || 10 1||
ekabhuktādikaṃ sarvasāmānyaṃ prasamācaret |
bhaktyā kṛtāni sarvānvai kāmān dadyurmanogatān || 10 2||
sarvadeveṣu tatsarvāntarātmā śrīhariḥ svayam |
vartate pūjanīyo’sau sarvakarmaphalapradaḥ || 103 ||
yadyad vratyarthayed vastu naro nārī tathānyakaḥ |
samāpnoti ca tatsarvaṃ śrīhareḥ samanugrahāt || 1 .4||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikatṛtīyāvrateṣu gaurītapovratākṣayatṛtīyātretādya
tithiparśurāmajayantīkadalīvratalakṣmītapovratakālī gaurīvrataharagaurīlagnavratasāmagaśrāvaṇīkoṭīśvarī māhiṣaghnalakṣeśvarībṛhadgaurīviṣṇugaurīharagaurīyogabrahmāśīrgaurīviṣṇuvaramālā kulavṛddhivratādinirūpaṇanāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||268||

<1.269>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
lakṣmi śṛṇu kathayāmi caturthīnāṃ vratāni te |
yāni kṛtvā naro nārī bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vrajet parām || 1 ||
golokādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārvatyāḥ śaṃkaragṛhe |
śarīrāktadhātuyogādutpanno yastvabhūt prabhuḥ || 2 ||
sa vai kṛṣṇaścaturdhāsti vāsudevasvarūpakaḥ |
saṃkarṣaṇasvarūpaśca pradyamnarūpakastathā || 3 ||
aniruddhasvarūpaśca tasmāt sa gaṇanāyakaḥ |
caturmūrtisvarūpo’sti vratānyapi tathā tathā || 4 ||
caitramāsacaturthyāṃ tu vāsudevasvarūpiṇam |
gaṇeśaṃ samyagabhyarcya datvā suvarṇadakṣiṇām || 5 ||
āvāhanādi cārabhya visarjanāntameva yat |
kṛtvā vidhānataḥ sarvaṃ viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || 6 ||
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kāryaṃ bhojye deyāstu laḍḍukāḥ |
dūrvāsindūrakau deyau pūjane vratinā tathā || 7 ||
anyānyapi ca dānāni deyāni kṛṣṇatuṣṭaye |
svayaṃ tu pāraṇāṃ laḍḍukānāṃ kuryād vratī śubhām || 8 ||
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ loke bhuktiṃ muktiṃ samāpnuyāt |
prasādya viṣṇuṃ vaikuṇṭhaṃ gacched devābhivanditaḥ || 9 ||
vaiśākhasya caturthyāṃ tu pūjyaḥ saṃkarṣaṇābhidhaḥ |
āvāhanādvisarjanaparyantaṃ vividhaṃ vidhim || 1.269.1 0||
kṛtvā saṃpūjayed devaṃ gaṇeśaṃ bhojayed bahu |
śaṃkhadānaṃ tathā cānyaddānaṃ kuryād yathābalam || 11 ||
tena puṇyena vratakṛd bhūtvā divyavapurdharaḥ |
prāpya saṃkarṣaṇaṃ lokaṃ modate bahukalpakam || 1 2||
jyeṣṭhaśuklacaturthyāṃ tu pūjyaḥ pradyumna īśvaraḥ |
ṣoḍaśabhirupacāraiḥ pūjayitvā gaṇādhipam || 1 3|||
phalaṃ mūlaṃ jalaṃ dūrvāṃ datvā vai bhāvato vratī |
tena puṇyena saṃyāti prādyumnaṃ svargameva vai || 14||
āṣāḍhasya caturthyāṃ tu pūjanīyo’niruddhakaḥ |
āvāhanātsamārabhya visarjanāntamarcanam || 15||
kuryād vividhapuṣpādyaiḥ phalairbhojyādibhistathā |
dadyād dānāni bahūni kuryānnīrājanādikam || 16||
kṣamāṃ ca prārthayed dāne’lābupātrāṇi tumbikā |
kāṣṭhapātrāṇyapi dadyāt sādhave nyāsine vratī || 17||
evaṃ kṛtvā vratī yāyādaniruddhālayaṃ param |
caturmūrtivratānyevaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśa vatsarān || 18||
mahadudyāpanaṃ kuryānmaṇḍape maṇḍale śubhe |
suvarṇasya ghaṭaṃ nyasya paṃcaratnādisaṃyutam || 19||
pañcāyatanaṃ gāṇeśaṃ vinyasya vidhinā tataḥ |
pūjanaṃ ṣoḍaśavastūttamaiḥ kuryād vratī janaḥ ||1.269.20 ||
gītavāditranirghoṣairvedamantraiḥ stavaistathā |
homairjapaistathā bhojyairvastudānādibhistathā ||21 ||
mahotsavaṃ śubhaṃ kuryādgaṇeśakṛṣṇatuṣṭaye |
evaṃ vodyāpane jāte pūrṇaṃ vrataphalaṃ bhavet || 22||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ svayaṃ kṛṣṇo dadātyatra paratra ca |
yadyadicchati vratakṛt svargaṃ sarvamavāpnuyāt ||23||
anyajjyeṣṭhacaturthyāṃ tu satīvratamudāhṛtam |
brāhmadakṣādasiknyāṃ vai satī jātā purā yataḥ ||24||
satījanmotsavaṃ kuryād vratī tvekānnamityapi |
phalaṃ vā copavāsaṃ vā mahat kuryācca pūjanam ||25||
evaṃ satīvrataṃ kṛtvā datvā dānāni viṣṇave |
vratī gaṇapatermāturloke modeta tatsamam ||26||
tathāṣāḍhacaturthyāṃ tu vrataṃ cānyad bhavecchubham |
rathantarāhvakalpasyādyabhūtaṃ vai dinaṃ yataḥ ||27||
śraddhāpūtena manasā kalpaṃ rathantarāhvayam |
kālarūpaṃ kṛṣṇarūpaṃ gaṇeśaṃ vā prapūjayet ||28||
ekabhuktaṃ vrataṃ kuryāt phalaṃ svargaṃ labhed vratī |
śrāvaṇasya caturthyāṃ tu prage madhye niśāmukhe || 29||
śrīgaṇeśaṃ pūjayedvai sarvavidhiprapūrvakam |
candrodaye tathā jāte punastaṃ pūjayed vratī ||1.269.30||
arghyaṃ dadyād bhojanādi sindūrādi samarpayet |
lambodaraṃ caturbāhuṃ trinetraṃ raktapāṇḍuram ||3 1 ||
naikaratnavibhūṣāḍhyaṃ prasannāsyaṃ vicintayet |
āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiḥ samarcayet ||32||
naivedye modakān dadyād gaṇeśatuṣṭidān vratī |
evaṃ vrataṃ vidhāyaiva bhuktvā prasādamodakān ||33||
rātrau bhūśayanaṃ kuryātprātaḥ samarcayetpunaḥ |
dānāni dadyād bahūni gaṇeśakṛṣṇatuṣṭaye || 34||
vratasyāsya pratāpena kāmān labdhvā manogatān |
pare loke paraṃ sthānaṃ gaṇeśapadamāpnuyāt ||35||
tasmātkāryaṃ prayatnena kāmānsarvānabhīpsatā |
nānena sadṛśaṃ tvanyat vidyate vratamuttamam || 36||
asminneva dine lakṣmi dūrvāgaṇeśapūjanam |
kartavyaṃ tadvidhānaṃ te vadāmi pūrṇapuṇyakṛt || 37||
suvarṇasya gaṇādhyakṣaṃ vidhāya tāmrapātrake |
sthāpayitvā ca tatpātraṃ sarvatobhadramaṇḍale || 38 ||
nyasyet tadveṣṭitaṃ kuryād raktāmbareṇa vai tataḥ |
pūjayedraktakusumaiḥ patraiḥ pañcabhireva ca || 39 ||
bilbapatramapāmārgaḥ śamī dūrvā haripriyā |
etatpatraiśca kusumaiḥ pūjayet satphalādibhiḥ ||1.269.40 ||
bhojayenmodakādīni śubhāṃ dadyāttu dakṣiṇām |
arghyaṃ dadyādupahāraṃ śayyāṃ sopaskarāṃ tathā ||4 1 ||
vighneśātmakagurave satkṛtya vinivedayet |
kṛtvaivaṃ pañcavarṣāṇi vrataṃ gaṇapateḥ śubham |||42 ||
bhuktveha bhogānakhilān lokaṃ gaṇapatervrajet |
iha loke bhavetsmṛddhaḥ pare loke mahāsukhaḥ || 43 ||
śrāvaṇe śukla pakṣe tu caturthyāṃ bhaumavāsare |
madhyāhne brahmaṇo nasto varāho jajña īśvaraḥ ||44||
varāharūpaṃ sauvarṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ pūjayed vratī |
dhārayet tatra vāsāṃsi kausuṃbhāni ramāpatim ||45 ||
naivedye pāyasaṃ dadyādghaṭakām̐śca viśeṣataḥ |
varāhajanmapadyāni gāpayetpūjayettathā ||46||
ṣoḍaśābhisūpacāraistataḥ kuryāttu bhojanam |
narāṃgaṃ sūkarāsyaṃ ca caturbāhuṃ ca sāyudham ||47 ||
dharāṃ gṛhītvā dantāgre śobhantaṃ dānamācaret |
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ viṣṇorvaikuṇṭhaṃ prāpnuyād vratī ||48||
athabhādracaturthyāṃ tu bahulādhenusadvratam |
gaṇeśo’pi samutpannaḥ pārvatīśayane sutaḥ ||49||
gaṇeśasya vrataṃ cāpi prakṛṣṭotsavapūrvakam |
kartavyaṃ vidhinā lakṣmi dinacatuṣṭayātmakam ||1.269.5 0 ||
haritavallikāvṛkṣaśākhākadalītoraṇaiḥ |
maṇḍapaḥ śobhanaḥ kāryaḥ sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam |||5 1 ||
kartavyaṃ ca gaṇeśo’pi mṛdā vā dhātunāpi vā |
suvarṇena ca raupyeṇa tāmreṇa maṇināpi vā |||52||
kartavyaścāpi sindūrakuṃkumādibhirityam |
śobhanīyastathā pūjanīyaḥ ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ ||53 ||
nityaṃ rātrau pūjanīyo vratinā laḍḍukādibhiḥ |
toṣaṇīyaśca nityaṃ saḥ prārthanīyaḥ sukhāptaye ||54||
dānaṃ deyaṃ ca vividhaṃ naktabhojī vratī bhavet |
ante visarjanaṃ vārṣuṃ kāryaṃ gaṇapatermudā ||55||
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ bhuktiṃ muktiṃ vai prāpnuyād vratī |
pūrṇe varṣe gate māturājñayā śraddhayā tathā ||56 ||
gaṇeśena kṛtā pradakṣiṇā goratra vai dine |
tasmādvratamidaṃ proktaṃ bahulādhenusaṃjñakam ||57||
pūjanīyātra yatnena sraggandhayavasādibhiḥ |
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kuryācchaktaśceddānamācaret ||58||
aśaktaḥ punaretāṃ tu namaskṛtya visarjayet |
paṃcābdaṃ vā daśābdaṃ vā ṣoḍaśābdamathāpi vā ||59||
vrataṃ kṛtvodyāpanaṃ ca dhenuṃ datvā payasvinīm |
vrataṃ samāpayetpatnīṃ padminīmāpnuyātphalam ||1.269.60 ||
atra bhogānparān bhuktvā satkṛto devatāgaṇaiḥ |
patnyā putrādinā sākaṃ golokaṃ samavāpnuyāt ||61||
atra śuklacaturthyāṃ vai siddhivaināyakavratam |
kartavyaṃ śrīgaṇeśasya pūjanaṃ vratinādarāt ||62 ||
āvāhanādibhiḥ sarvairupacāraiśca modakaiḥ |
ekāgramanasā dhyāyed gaṇeśaṃ siddhināyakam ||6 3 ||
viśvakarmasutāyāśca ṛddheḥ siddheśca nāyakaḥ |
vivāhenādya saṃjāto gaṇeśaḥ siddhināyakaḥ ||64||
tasmāttaṃ pūjayedekadantaṃ suvarṇasannibham |
pāśāṃkuśadharaṃ devaṃ gajavaktraṃ caturbhujam ||65 ||
śūrpakarṇaṃ sindūrādicarcitaṃ tundilaṃ śubham |
dhyātvā cārghyaṃ samarpyaiva punaśca pūjayed vratī ||66 ||
ekaviṃśatipatrāṇi tvekaviṃśatināmabhiḥ |
samarpayet vratī tāni nāmāni ca yathā śṛṇu ||67||
sumukhāya śamīpatraṃ gaṇādhīśāya bhṛṃgajam |
umāputrāya bailvaṃ tu dūrvāṃ gajamukhāya ca ||68||
lambodarāya badarīṃ dhattūraṃ harasūnave |
śūrpakarṇāya tulasīṃ vakratuṇḍāya śiṃbijam ||6 9||
apāmārgaṃ guhabhrātre bārhataṃ tvekadantine |
herambāya tu sindūraṃ caturhotre tu patrajam ||1.269.70||
sarveśvarāya śāntāyāgastyapatraṃ pradāpayet |
gandhapuṣpākṣatadūrvāpatrayugmaṃ samarpayet ||71 ||
modakapañcakaṃ dadyājjalaṃ miṣṭaṃ samarpayet |
datvā tāmbūlakaṃ natvā samprārthya ca visarjayet ||72||
mūrtiṃ sopaskarāṃ haimīṃ gurave brāhmaṇāya bā |
arpayed dakṣiṇāṃ dadyānmodakādīni bhojayet ||73||
ekaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ pañcavarṣāṇi mānavo bhuvi |
upāsya labhate kāmānehikānpāralaukikān ||74||
asyāṃ caturthyāṃ candraṃ tu na paśyedvai kathaṃcana |
paśyan mithyābhiśāpaṃ tu prāpnuyānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||75 ||
atastaddoṣanāśāya mantraṃ tu śāśvataṃ paṭhet |

śrīkṛṣṇaṃ pūjayeccaiva raṃgaiḥ krīḍāṃ vidhāpayet |
evaṃ kṛtvā vrataṃ lājāṃ kharjūraṃ dāpayejjanām ||62||
bhuktimuktisukhaprāptikaraṃ caitadvrataṃ bhavet |
phālgunakṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ jajñe lakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ||6 3 ||
prātaḥ premagṛhe omālaye kāryastadutsavaḥ |
caturbhujā mahālakṣmīḥ pūjanīyā hi kānakī ||64||
vrataṃ sāṃgaṃ prakartavyaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam |
phālgunaśuklapaṃcamyāṃ pūjyaḥ śrīkṛṣṇa eva ca || 65 ||
holikādivyaṃgyadoṣān śamayed bhagavām̐stataḥ |
itivratāni kāryāṇi yathāśakti sukhārthinā || 66 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikapañcamīvrateṣu matsyajayantīśrītapovratavārāhapṛthvīvratacandrakṣayanāśavratahayagrīvajayantīnāgapaṃcamīpitṛvratavāyuvratānnavṛddhivratajīvantikānāgavrataṛṣipaṃcamīgopālakṛṣṇajayantīlalitāvratajayāvratanāgavratavasantapaṃcamīkaṃbharālakṣmīvratādinirūpaṇanāmā saptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 270 ||

<1.271>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

sūryaṣaṣṭhīyamevāpi bhāskarasya prasādataḥ || 1.271.3 0 ||
japo homastathā dānaṃ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam |

ravivārayutā seyaṃ cettu śatabhiṣānvitā ||4||

<1.272>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
vārṣikasaptamīnāṃ vai vratāni kathayāmi te |

nayanti puruṣaṃ nārīṃ svakaṃ dhāma parākṣaram || 1.273.120 ||
phālgune tvasitāṣṭamyāṃ bhīmādevīvrataṃ matam |
bhīmāyāḥ pūjanaṃ kāryaṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 121 ||
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ phālgunasya śivaṃ śivāṃ samarcayet |

visphoṭanāśinīṃ devīṃ jale japedatandritaḥ || 123 ||
tasya tu śītalā devī syād visphoṭakaśāntidā |
śītalāyā vratakarturvarṣaṃ śāntimayaṃ bhavet || 1 24|||
caitrasyādhavalāṣṭamyāmṛṣabho’haṃ babhūva vai |
kartavyaṃ pūjanaṃ viṣṇorvratinā puṇyadaṃ param || 125|
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikāṣṭamīvrateṣu pārvatījayantīdurgāṣṭamīdaśāhaphalavratakṛṣṇāṣṭamīrādhāṣṭamīṭrūrvāṣṭamījyeṣṭhāṣṭamīkaṃbharālakṣmī jayantīdurgāvratakarakāvrataśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇabhagavajjayantīkālāṣṭamīgopāṣṭamīdarbhavrataśrāddhāṣṭamībhairavāṣṭamīśrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇakāśyavataraṇavratavidyāvratapaṭṭarājñīkṛtapūjanavratabhīmādevīvrataśītalāṣṭamīṛṣabhajayantyādivratānāṃ nirūpaṇaṃnāma trisaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||273 ||

<1.274>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca

<1.275>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
athānyāni daśamyāste vratāni kathayāni vai |

ātmā hyāyurmano dakṣo madaḥ prāṇo gaviṣṭhakaḥ || 38 ||
dattaḥ satyaśca varhiṣmān daśārcayet suvastubhiḥ |
upacāraiḥ ṣoḍaśādyairmūrtīrdadyād dvijātaye || 39 ||
āṃgirasānparān lokānāpnotyevaṃ vratī vrate |
phālgunaśukladaśamītithau yamān prapūjayet || 1.275.40 ||
yamaśca dharmarājaśca mṛtyuścaivāntakastathā |
vaivasvataśca kālaśca sarvabhūtakṣayastathā ||4 1 ||
audumbaraśca dadhnaśca nīlaścaiva vṛkodaraḥ |
parameṣṭhī tathā citraścitraguptaścaturdaśa ||42 ||
pūjayettān bhojayecca tarpayecca tilāṃbubhiḥ |
tataḥ sūryāya cārghyaṃ ca dadyādvai tāmrapātrataḥ |||43 ||
raktacandanasammiśratilākṣatayavāṃbubhiḥ |
bhojayed vāḍavān paścād vratī bhuṃjīta vāgyataḥ ||44||
evaṃ vratī dharmarājaprasannatāmavāpya ca |
atra bhogānparān bhuktvā dehānte viṣṇudhāmabhāk || 45 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne vārṣikadaśamīvrateṣu dharmarājavrataviṣṇuvratagaṅgādaśaharāmanvāditithisarvāśāpūrtivratadaśāvatārapūjāvijayādaśamīsārvabhaumavratārogyavrataviśvedevāṃgirasayamavratādipradarśananāmā pañcasaptatyadhikadviśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 275 ||

<1.276>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
prāk kathitāni te lakṣmi hyekādaśīvratāni yat |
tāni tridinasādhyāni sampūrṇāni vratāni vai || 1 ||
tyajeccatvāri bhuktāni padmaje vai dinatraye |
ādyantayorekamekaṃ madhyame dvayameva ca || 2 ||
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ masūrānnaṃ caṇakānkodravām̐stathā |
śākaṃ madhu parānnaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithunaṃ || 3 ||
daśamyāṃ daśa vastūni varjayettu vratī sadā |
dyūtakrīḍāṃ ca nidrāṃ ca tāmbūlaṃ dantadhāvanam || 4 ||

kopaṃ hyanṛtavākyaṃ ca hyekādaśyāṃ vivarjayet || 5 ||
kāṃsyaṃ māṃsaṃ surāṃ kṣaudraṃ tailaṃ viṇmlecchabhāṣaṇam |
vyāyāmaṃ ca pravāsaṃ ca punarbhojanamaithune || 6 ||
aspṛśyasparśamityetān dvādaśyāṃ daśa varjayet |
ekabhuktaṃ ca vā naktaṃ kṛtvāpi vratamācaret || 7 ||
śrāvaṇaśuklaikādaśyāṃ pavitraṃ haraye’rpayet |
haimaṃ raupyaṃ kauśeyajaṃ kṣaumaṃ kauśaṃ kārpāsajam || 8 ||
ṣaṣṭyādhikatriśatatantujaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pavitrakam |
sādhāraṇaṃ trisūtrotthaṃ madhyamaṃ tu yatheṣṭakam || 9 ||
uttamaṃ śatagranthi ṣaḍtriṃśadgranthi kaniṣṭhakam |
śreṣṭhamājānulambi kaniṣṭhaṃ nābhispṛśaṃ matam || 1.276.10 ||
pūjanaṃ śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya ramayā saha |
kurvīteha sukhī devā vaikuṇṭhaṃ cāpnuyātparam || 11 ||
