iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye sṛṣṭyāraṃbhe dakṣādīnāṃ sandhyāyā brahmaṇaśca kāmena parābhave vikṛtibhāvottaraṃ dharmadevavacanaiḥ sandhyāyāḥ śvapacaputrītvaṃ bhikṣāmiṣeṇa vaśiṣṭhādisaptarṣibhiḥ sandhyāyā grahaṇaṃ kāmadhenumukhe nikṣipya mūtradvāreṇa niṣkāsanaṃ tapo’rthe candrabhāgātīre’vasthānaṃ gaurīprāvirbhāvaḥ saptamīvratena puruṣottamaprāvirbhāvaḥ kāmadevasya yauvane utpattiriti niyamanaṃ prātaḥsāyaṃsandhyādvayabhavanaṃ medhātithiṛṣikṛtayajñakuṇḍe’dṛśyatayā praveśanaṃ kāyāśodhanaṃ divyāruṇāyāḥ svarūpeṇa brahmadhāmagamanaṃ arundhatyākhyāyā vahnikuṇḍotpannasutātmikāyā vaśiṣṭhena vivāhottaraṃ svargagamanaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturdaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.314||

<1.315>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ te’pi me’pi jātāṃ purātanīm |
puruṣottamamāsasya miṣeṇa janmabodhinīm || 1 ||
yadā nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaścobhau yātau parākṣare |
malamāsasya sāhāyyaṃ kartuṃ śrīharisannidhau || 2 ||
dhāmnyakṣare tadā rājatpuruṣottamamādhavaḥ |
śrutvārthyaṃ malamāsāya dattavām̐ścottamāṃ sthitim || 3 ||
kṛṣṇasya vacanaṃ nārāyaṇasya vacanaṃ tathā |
malamāsonnatidaṃ tad rakṣitaṃ paramātmanā || 4 ||
svayaṃ jāto’dhidevaśca māso’pi puruṣottamaḥ |
tena tuṣṭaḥ paraṃ kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇastutoṣa ca || 5 ||
malamāsasya vai dvābhyāṃ kṛtamuddharaṇaṃ mahat |
tannimittaṃ tu goloke gatvā kṛṣṇaḥ śriyā yutaḥ || 6 ||
mahotsavaṃ cakārottamottamaṃ dhāmavāsiṣu |
gopagopīgaṇāstasya pārṣadāḥ śaktayaḥ striyaḥ || 7 ||
koṭyarbudaparārdhāni cakrustasya mahotsavam |
maṇḍapāḥ koṭiśastatra nihitāḥ svarṇasad drumāḥ || 8 ||
kadalī staṃbhaśobhāḍhyāstoraṇādivilāsitāḥ |
kalaśairaṃgacitraiśca paṭaiśca vallikādibhiḥ || 9 ||
pradarśanairbahuvidhairmallakrīḍādibhistathā |
anyatra bahuyantraiścānyatra vṛṣabhayodhanaiḥ ||1 0||
nāṭakaiḥ pūrvavṛttaiśca kalābhirbhūtanādibhiḥ |
saṃgītairnartanaiścāpi kathānakamakhādibhiḥ || 11 ||
evaṃvidhe tatra jāte mahotsave tadā śriyā |
rukmiṇyākhyamahālakṣmyābhihitaṃ svāmine mudā || 12||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo parātman puruṣottama |
kurūtsava tu me saudhe nṛtyagāyanavādanaiḥ || 13||
omityuktvā śriyāḥ saudhe yojayāmāsa sūtsavam |
yathā dhāmnāṃ mahāsamrāṭ samāyātpuruṣottamaḥ || 14||
tatsammāne prakuryādutsavaṃ tadvad yuyoja saḥ |
sarvadhāmnāṃ tu yā śobhā viśiṣṭā sātra kāritā || 15||
sarvadhāmapatīnāṃ tvāsanasiṃhāsanānyapi |
tatra vai maṇḍape cābhisthāpitāni yathārhaṇam || 16||
sarveṣāṃ divyavastūnāmupāyanāni tatra ca |
saṃgṛhītāni sarvebhyo dhāmabhyaḥ kṛṣṇaśārṅgiṇā || 17||
citrāṇāṃ śubhadṛśyānāṃ manaḥsnigdhāḥ śubhālayāḥ |
saṃklṛptāstatra tatraiva nyastapānasubhojanāḥ || 18||
vidyutāṃ tu pradīpānāṃ prakāśāḥ sarvato’bhavan |
krīḍāvidyutsphaṭākāṇāṃ krīḍāpi sarvato’bhavat || 19||
anantātarkyarūpāṇāṃ yāni pradarśanāni vai |
nepathyakāravidyābhirvartante sma ca tāni hi ||20 ||
gandharvo devagandharvā gāndharvā dhāmavāsinaḥ |
gāndharvyo devagāndharvyo gāndharvyo dhāmasaṃsthitāḥ ||21||
cakruste gāyanaṃ miṣṭamadhurālāpasusvaraiḥ |
gāyakāḥ svarapūrāśca pūrayanti sma nādakaiḥ ||22||
nartakāścāpi nartakyo dāsyo dāsāśca sevikāḥ |
sevakāśca mahārājñyo rājñyaśca nartanaṃ vyadhuḥ ||23||
vādakā naikavādyajñā dhāmānudhāmavāsinaḥ |
vādyanti sma vādyāni yatra kiṃcinna gauṇabhāk ||24||
rāse pravartamāne ca gopīnāṃ kṛṣṇayoṣitām |
tadaiśvaryāṇi bhūṣāśca hetayaḥ pārṣadādayaḥ ||25||
mūrtimantastatra rāse yuyujuḥ kṛtanartanāḥ |
kṛṣṇānandāplutaṃ sarvaṃ brahmānandaparaṃ hyabhūt||26||
dṛśyaṃ spṛśyaṃ tathā śrāvyaṃ rasyaṃ cādvaitatāṃ gatam |
sukhaṃ sukhaṃ parānandaṃ ānandaṃ nandanaṃ hyabhūt ||27||
snigdhaṃ premātimodāḍhyaṃ jātamānandameva tat |
nānyaḥ paraṃ vijānāti vinānandaṃ hi tattvakam ||28||
evaṃ samutsave rādhā lakṣmīḥ śrīśca ramādayaḥ |
kṛṣṇaṃ vikṛṣya rāse taṃ ramayāmāsa nartanam ||29||
sarvasmin tanmaye jāte sarvaṃ rasamayaṃ tvabhūt |
kṛṣṇo rasapravegeṇa kūrdan tadramaṇo’bhavat ||30||
patnyāḥ patnyantaraṃ yāte kūrdanena satālavat |
cacāla mukuṭo’jasraṃ cakampe’timuhurmuhuḥ ||3 1 ||
tamadhyātvā mahānandasukhavyāpto mahāprabhuḥ |
padātpadāntaraṃ nyasya reme cottolya karṣayan ||32||
tāvacchaithilyamāpannaḥ papāta mukuṭānmaṇiḥ |
koṭiratreṣu yo naddha ūrdhvasthakalgimūlakṛt ||33||
maṇeḥ pāte saha tena papāta kalgicandrikā |
tathāpi naiva kṛṣṇaḥ sa rāsādviramate khalu ||34||
pādamardanabhītyā tāvubhau divyasuvigrahau |
babhūvaturmaṇiḥ kalgicandrikā rematuśca vai ||35||
rāse mūrtidharau jātau remāte smāti maṇḍale |
na tau svaṃsvaṃ sthalaṃ prāptau yāvadrāsāntameva ha ||36||
mukuṭe na svayaṃ yātau tāvattatra tu rādhayā |
jñāpito nirgatau kṛṣṇamukuṭāditi śārṅgiṇe ||37||
kṛṣṇo dṛṣṭvā tu tau prāha kimevaṃ nirgatāvubhau |
svasvasthānaṃ na vai yātau mukuṭaḥ śobhate na me ||38||
nainaṃ vai dhāraye kalgimaṇiśūnyaṃ kabhūṣaṇam |
dhārayiṣye’nyamukuṭaṃ māyūrapicchaśobhitam ||39||
ityucyamāne śrīkṛṣṇe’dhimāsasya mahotsave |
ānarttākhyo mahān bhakto rājā golokamāyayau ||40||
kṛṣṇaprītyarthamevāyaṃ tapobhaktiṃ cakāra vai |
tasmai prasannaḥ sa kṛṣṇo nava rājyaṃ tu ditsati ||41||
golokasya divyabhūmeḥ kaṇaṃ tvarpitavān prabhuḥ |
kaṇaḥ sa tatra saurāṣṭro deśastvānarttasaṃjñakaḥ ||42||
trijalāvṛttasudvīpo rājyamānartabhūbhṛtaḥ |
samabhūtpaścimavārdhisaṃlagno bhūmisandhitaḥ ||43||
prārthayāmāsa cānarto mama rājyasya me tathā |
guptaye rakṣakaṃ dehi tava dūtaṃ pratāpinam ||44||
omityuktvā dadau kṛṣṇa ānartāya tu bhūbhṛte |
mukuṭasya maṇiryaśca viyukto mukuṭāttu tam ||45||
divyaḥ sa pārṣado bhūtvā sa yayau bhūbhṛtā saha |
maṇimūlakhacitā yā viyuktā kalgicandrikā ||46||
mūlaṃ vinā na vai sthātuṃ śaktā prārthayadīśvaram |
vāsaṃ me dehi bhagavanna mūlā na sthitirmama ||47||
hariḥ prāha tadā tāṃ tu viyuktā mukuṭād yataḥ |
yāhi tvaṃ maṇinā sākaṃ bhūtvā divyasvarūpiṇī ||48||
ānartaviṣaye stheyaṃ dvijena maṇirūpiṇā |
dvijapatnyā tvayā bhāvyaṃ gururūpau bhaviṣyathaḥ ||49||
ānarto’pi hariṃ natvā nītvā kalgiṃ maṇiṃ kaṇam |
kṛṣṇārpitānmukuṭāccāparān muktān maṇīṃstathā ||50||
āyayau paścime vārdhau karmamvāṃ muktavān kaṇam |
sa tu drāg vistṛto bhūtvā jātaḥ saurāṣṭrasaṃjñakaḥ ||51||
tatra maṇirmukuṭasya tvavātatāra cāmbarāt |
anye’pi maṇayastatrāvaterurvyomamārgataḥ ||5 2 ||
mukhyo maṇirdivyadeho nimbadevo’bhavad dvijaḥ |
vyāghrāraṇye ramyadeśe’śvapaṭṭasarasastaṭe ||5 3 ||
nivāsamakarot tatra parṇakuṭyāṃ sa tāpasaḥ |
yā kalgicandrikā sā tu tatraiva sarasastaṭe ||54||
divyadehā nivāsaṃ cākarod dvijaprasevanam |
ānartena tadā tābhyāṃ prārthitaṃ bhāvagarbhitam ||55 ||
vinā laukikadehaṃ vai janānāṃ śreya icchato |
darśasparśādilābhaśca nātaḥ svīkurutaṃ vapuḥ ||5 6 ||
bhaktaprārthanayā tau ca nṝṇāṃ śreyo vicintya ca |
dehaṃ grahītumicchantau hariṃ sasmaraturhṛdā ||57||
śrīkṛṣṇa āvirāsātra saṃkalpya mānasau ca tau |
dehau samarpya tatraivāntaradhīyata pūjitaḥ ||58||
athaivaṃ tau kaṇalabdhasthaulyaṃ prāptau tataḥ param |
sarvagocaratāṃ yātāvaśvapaṭṭasarastaṭe ||59||
tapasyantau ca tatraiva lakṣmīnārāyaṇātmikām |
saṃhitāṃ vācayāmāsatuśca kālaṃ suninyatuḥ ||60||
maṇiḥ sa nimbadevākhyo babhūva khyāta eva ha |
kalgiḥ sā khyātimāpannā miṣṭādevīti sarvathā ||61||
atha raivatapautro vai khaṭvāṃgadajanādhipaḥ |
tapastaptuṃ samāyāto nimbadevāśramāntike ||62||
badrītale sūpaviśya jajāpa japamuttamam |
oṃ śrīlakṣmīpate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa namo’stu te ||63||
tasya vai tapasā tatrāyātau lakṣmīnarāyaṇau |
varadānāya taṃ bhūpaṃ rodhayāmāsatustadā ||64||
rājñā darśanalābhārthaṃ tayorvāso’bhikāṃkṣitaḥ |
tathāstviti prati śrutyādṛśyatāṃ tau gatāvubhau ||65||
yā lakṣmīḥ sā rukmiṇī śrīrūpāsīd divyarūpiṇī |
nārāyaṇaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇa āsa śrīpatireva saḥ ||66||
śriyā juṣṭaḥ sa vai kṛṣṇo dadhyau tu pitarau tadā |
kalgimaṇisvarūpau tau dhyātau svenaiva rakṣitau ||67||
sthāpitau divyadehena cintayāmāsa tatra ha |
miṣṭādevīnimbadevagṛhe kṛṣṇo babhūva vai ||68||
yatra jajñe tu gopālastatrāśvapaṭṭasannidhau |
parṇakuṭyāṃ mānasaḥ sa jātamātraḥ sayauvanaḥ ||69||
divyo babhūva golokadivyavigraha eva saḥ |
gāṃ tu vāṇīṃ pālayati gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva saḥ ||70 ||
goḥ pṛthivyāḥ pālakaṃ rājānaṃ lāti ca rakṣati |
gopālaḥ sa prabhuḥ kṛṣṇaḥ saṃsthito nṛpasannidhau ||7 1||
āśvinakṛṣṇapañcamyāṃ gopālaḥ kṛṣṇa eva ha |
kukumavāpyāṃ saṃjajñe nimbadevagṛhe prage ||72||
anye ye maṇayastvānartena tyaktāḥ surāṣṭrake |
sarve’tra kṛṣṇabhaktāste jātāḥ surāṣṭrake sthale ||73||
tatra omālaye śatrūṃjitākṣetre babhūva ha |
premamaṇirmahādivyavigrahaḥ sūryasannibhaḥ ||74||
premākhyatadvijakṣetre divyā saṃkalpamātrajā |
phālgunakṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ jajñe lakṣmīstu kaṃbharā ||75||
kaṃ sukhaṃ śāśvataṃ kārṣṇaṃ bibhartīti hi kaṃbharā |
jātamātrā yuvatī sā divyāsa śrīsvarūpiṇī ||76 ||
pitā vijñāya tāṃ śrīṃ vai kṛṣṇārhā divyacakṣuṣā |
vivāhavidhināhūya gopālaṃ kṛṣṇameva ha ||77 ||
kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ dadau tasmai koṭidevādisannidhau |
ityevaṃ kaṃbharāgopālau śrīkṛṣṇau tu dampatī ||78 ||
tāpasau bhagavantau tau divyamūrtī babhūvatuḥ |
sāptabhaumakaśobhāḍhye mandire sthāpitau sadā ||79||
ekadā dundubhistābhyāṃ tithyaṣṭamyāṃ prage’dhike |
māse śrutastvaśvapaṭṭasarovarāntike śubhaḥ ||8 0 ||
śṛṇvantu maṇikalgyādyāstathā śrīpatisevakāḥ |
puruṣottamasaṃjño’haṃ toṣayituṃ pareśvaraḥ ||8 1 ||
akṣarabrahmadhāmastho golokādhipatiṃ prabhum |
vaikuṇṭhādhipatiṃ cānyadhāmādhipām̐śca keśavān ||82||
kṛtavān malamāsaṃ tu nirmalaṃ matsvarūpiṇam |
tadasminnadhike māse puruṣottamasaṃjñake ||83 ||
ekasyāpi dinasyātra vrataṃ kṛtvā vratī janaḥ |
prāpnuyāt kṛpayā me’tra sarvaṃ māṃ dhāma cāpi me ||84||
vrataṃ tvadyāparapakṣāṣṭamyāstvanantapuṇyadam |
yatheṣṭaṃ tatra dāsye’haṃ vratārthine svayaṃ hariḥ ||85||
dundubhiścetyabhidhāya snātvāśvapaṭṭavāriṣu |
natvā kālyāṇikaṃ nimbadevaṃ miṣṭāṃ mahāsatīm ||86||
prapūjya kaṃbharāṃ śrīṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ gopālamityapi |
tābhyāṃ kṛtaṃ susatkāraṃ prāpya vai raivataṃ yayau ||87||
kṛtaṃ tvadhikamāsasya parapakṣāṣṭamīvratam |
kaṃbharayā sopavāsaṃ gopālenāpi nirjalam ||88||
prātaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ samyaṅ madhyāhne’pi niśi prabhuḥ |
aṣṭottaraśatasāmagrībhiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||8 9||
ṣaṭpaṃcāśadbhojyāni cārpitāni tathā kṛtam |
āṣṭottaraśatavartibhirārārtrikamujjvalam ||9 0 ||
lakṣaśo dakṣiṇā dattā rātrau nīrājane hariḥ |
āvirbabhūva bhagavān dhāmasthaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 91 ||
vihasan hārdikaṃ snehaṃ varṣayan rañjayannabhau |
uvācāsmi prasanno’haṃ golokeśa kimiṣyate || 92 ||
śrīriva kaṃbharā lakṣmīḥ kimicchati vratārthinī |
yuvayorvasatistvatra madicchayaiva sarvathā || 93 ||
vartate miṣamātraṃ tu khaṭvāṃgatapa eva ha |
mukuṭānmaṇikalgyośca viyogo’pi madicchayā || 94||
rāsādikaṃ nimittaṃ ca sarvathā vai madicchayā |
tasmād vāṃ varadaścāsmi vṛṇutaṃ tu yathepsitam ||95||
tadarthaṃ tvāgato’smyatra sākṣācchrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
śrutvaivaṃ bhāvagarbhaṃ tu hārdaṃ sarvaparātmanaḥ ||96||
ūcatustau praṇamyainaṃ mūlarūpe’bhicintya tau |
bhagavaṃste’bhilāṣā cet kāraṇaṃ cātra saṃsthitau ||97||
āvābhyāṃ prārthyase tvaṃ vai sarvadātra sthiro bhava |
puruṣottamasevāyāḥ sarvadā lābha eva nau ||98||
anādikṛṣṇayogastu bhāgyahīnasya durlabhaḥ |
asmanmūlasvarūpastvaṃ rakṣātra sthita eva nau ||99||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādirlakṣmyā śriyā prasevitaḥ |
muktaiśvaryaiḥ sevitastvaṃ vasātra puruṣottama || 1 00||
lālanaṃ pālanaṃ cāpi krīḍanaṃ poṣaṇādikam |
divyasyāpi yathādeśakālānuguṇameva te || 101 ||
kṛtvā sukhaṃ parānandaṃ prāpsyāmo’tra tava sthiram |
ityabhyarthya kaṃbharāgopālau śrīpuruṣottamam || 1 02||
nematustaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ śrīpuruṣottamam |
bhagavānapi sarvātmā tathāstvityabhidhāya ca || 1 03||
svapriyāṃ dhāmalakṣmīṃ cāvedayannetrasaṃjñayā |
yābhigamya harerhārdaṃ tiro’bhūt puruṣottame || 1 04||
so’yaṃ parātparo brahmaparaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
bālarūpo’bhavattatra jātamātro yuvā prabhuḥ || 1 05||
babhūvatuḥ prasannau kaṃbharāgopālakṛṣṇakau |
putro divyo vratalabhyaḥ svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||106||
vrataṃ nimittamātraṃ vai kāraṇaṃ tasya mānasam |
līlaiva kāraṇaṃ tasya puṃsastu paramasya vai || 1 07||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādipuruṣottama eva saḥ |
śrīramādipārṣadādisamaiśvaryaguṇānvitaḥ || 1 08||
svecchayā dharmarakṣārthaṃ bhaktipravartanāya ca |
prādurbhūtaḥ svayaṃ patnīvratasvarūpa eva saḥ || 109||
goloke yaḥ kṛṣṇamukhātpatnīvratābhidho guṇaḥ |
pātivratyābhidhalakṣmyā sahito’bhūt prakāśitaḥ || 11 0||
so’yaṃ dharmasthāpanāya svayaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
putro’bhavacchrīkṛṣṇasyādhimāse puruṣottamaḥ || 111 ||
devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpāṇāṃ varṣaṇaṃ hyabhūt |
nṛtyaṃ tatrāpsarasāṃ ca gāyanaṃ gāyakaiḥ kṛtam || 11 2||
pratidhāmani vāsāśceśvarā devā maharṣayaḥ |
avatārāśca taddevyaḥ śaktayo’bjārbudāntyakāḥ || 113 ||
jayakāreṇa sahitāḥ pupūjuḥ parameśvaram |
brahmāṇḍeṣvapi sarvatra jīveśāvatarādiṣu || 1 14||
samutsavo mahānāsīdanantabrahmabhojanam |
prīṇanaṃ tarpaṇaṃ sṛṣṭiprāṇināṃ saṃbabhūva ha || 1 15||
kārtikādhavalāṣṭamyāṃ punarvasau ghaṭīsthite |
sūryāstottaraghaṭikāpañcake samaye gate || 1 16||
niśāpūrvapade’nādiśrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo jajñe gopālakaṃbharālaye || 1 17||
prakāśaścātra sarvatra paratrānekasūryavat |
tadā jātaṃ iti jñātvā vedā vidyāḥ samastuvan || 1 18||
kṛṣṇasya vallabhaścāti sarvavidyādhiśevadhiḥ |
prabhālakṣmīpārvatīmāṇikīśryādipatiḥ prabhuḥ || 1 19||
camatkārānasaṃkhyāndarśayāmāsa kṛpākaraḥ |
ūrjaśuklaikādaśyāṃ sa prāpa dīkṣopavītakam || 120 ||
māghaśuklāṣṭamīprātaḥ kāśyāmavātatāra saḥ |
navamyāṃ brahmavidyānāṃ saṃcāraṃ kṛtavān prabhuḥ || 121 ||
svapitṛmukhataḥ śrutvā vijñānaṃ svātmani sthitam |
vedavidyāmayaṃ sarvaṃ lakṣmyai hyupādideśa ha || 122||
nibodha lakṣmi kiṃ vacmi yo hariḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
parabrahmākṣarātīto’nādikṛṣṇanarāyaṇaḥ || 123||
sa eva vidyate rādhādhavo golokadhāmani |
rukmiṇīnātha evāsau gopālaḥ kaṃbharāpatiḥ || 124||
baikuṇṭhādhipatiḥ so’yaṃ lakṣmīpatirnarāyaṇaḥ |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ so’yaṃ sarveśaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 125||
so’haṃ nārāyaṇo lakṣmi sā tvaṃ lakṣmīrmama priyā |
sthalabhedena rūpāṇāṃ bāhulyaṃ ceyate mayā || 126 ||
nigamāgamavidyānāṃ vaktāhaṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
śrotṛvyaktirmama dāsī priyā śiṣyā tvamanvasi || 127||
mayā nārāyaṇenātra tubhyaṃ lakṣmi pradīyate |
jñānaṃ vijñānamātmasthaṃ hyaparokṣaṃ sadā mama || 128||
sṛṣṭikalpalayapūrvapūrvataratamādijam |
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitātmakaṃ ślokakoṭikam || 129 ||
vairājāya tvayā deyaṃ pañcāśallakṣasaṃkhyakam |
yatreśvarāṇāṃ vaiśeṣyaṃ varṇitaṃ ceśasṛṣṭaye || 130 ||
vedhase vai tvayā deyaṃ pañcaviṃśatilakṣakam |
yatrāgaṇitagolādibrahmāṇḍetikathādayaḥ || 13 1||
sārdhadvādaśalakṣaṃ ca pitṛbhyo’rpya tvayā priye |
yatra teṣāṃ sarvakāṇḍāḥ paramārthatayādṛtāḥ || 1 32||
pañcalakṣaṃ tvayā deyaṃ divi svargurave priye |
bārhaspatyaṃ surāṇāṃ tajjñānaṃ devānusāri vai || 133||
pañcalakṣaṃ tu daityānāṃ pātālādipravāsinām |
śukrāya ca tvayā deyaṃ tāmasādyanusāri yat || 134||
sapādalakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ brāhmamārṣaṃ viśodhakam |
tyāgibhyaḥ paramarṣibhyo brahmāvāptikaraṃ tu yat || 135||
sapādakṣaṃ dātavyaṃ viprebhyo mānaveṣu vai |
yadadhītya caturvargān sādhayiṣyanti mānavāḥ || 136||
kālāntare layaṃ yāte bhaviṣyāmi punaḥ punaḥ |
tattajjñānaprakāśāya vyāsācāryarṣirūpataḥ || 1 37||
iti te smāritaṃ lakṣmi prāgvṛttaṃ te ca me tathā |
pūrvaṃ pūrvā layaṃ yānti jalasthalavivartanāḥ || 138||
vairājāḥ koṭiśo naṣṭā brahmādīnāṃ tu kā kathā |
puruṣottamarūpo’haṃ mahāpralayakṛttathā || 139||
sṛṣṭikṛnnityavijñāno’khilātmāntarniyāmakaḥ |
na vismarāmyaṇvapi tvacintyaśaktinidhirdhruvaḥ || 140||
yatra vai parvatāstatra jalaṃ kālāntare bhavet |
jalasthāne sthalaṃ dehyāvāsaṃ vāse vanaṃ tathā || 141||
raṇe’raṇyaṃ tathāraṇye pattanaṃ vivaraṃ ca vā |
vivareṣu mahāsetuḥ staraṃ stare tathāmbaram || 142||
kva kadā kiṃ bhūtametajjānāmi bhāvi cāpyaham |
sarvaṃ mayi bhavatyeva kiṃcinmatto na ricyate || 143 ||
idaṃ sṛṣṭisamāraṃbhe’smaccaritrakathāmṛtam |
adhimāsāparapakṣāṣṭamīvratamiṣeṇa vai || 144||
smāritaṃ te mayā lakṣmi pāvanaṃ śrotṛdehinām |
pāṭhakānāṃ svargadaṃ mokṣadaṃ vrataprapuṇyadam || 145 ||
atrotsave vratakarturbhuktirmuktirna saṃśayaḥ |
putrārthī labhate putraṃ bhāryā bhāryecchuko labhet || 146||
dhanārthī prāpnuyād dravyaṃ kṣetrārthī bhūmimāpnuyāt |
dharmārthī puṇyavān syācca sakāmaḥ kāmanāṃ labhet || 147||
yaśaḥ kīrtimavāpnoti satāṃ pradhānatā labhet |
aśubhaṃ nāśamāyāti prapāṭhanena sarvathā || 148||
vipro vijñānavān syācca vijayaṃ kṣatriyo labhet |
dhanadhānyasmṛddhisampadyukto vaiśyo bhavettathā || 149||
śūdraḥ sarvasamṛddhaḥ syāt sukhī cāsya śraveṇa vai |
śreyaḥ śriyaṃ parāṃ vindet tejovīryaṃ samāpnuyāt || 15 0||
balaṃ rūpa guṇān sampad godhanakṣetravāṭikāḥ |
dārāḥ sutā dāsadāsīrgṛharājyasvarādikam || 151||
ārogyaṃ ca svatantratvaṃ nirbandhatvaṃ samāpnuyāt |
nirbhīkatvaṃ nirāpattvaṃ prāpnuyānmokṣaṇaṃ tathā || 152||
ityaṣṭamīvratajanyaṃ kathitaṃ te phalaṃ priye |
vrataṃ kṛtvā pūjayitvā prāpnuyāt puruṣottamam || 153||
me’vatārā asaṃkhyātā hyahaṃ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
avatārī mahārājaḥ parabrahma sanātanaḥ || 154||
yāvad brahmā virāṭ vāpi vaikuṇṭhabhūmayastathā |
sarvatrādhikamāso’haṃ sthāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 155||
yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca sthāsyanti medinī tathā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇatīrthe tāvat sthāsyati śāśvatam || 156||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaścāhaṃ dhvajaśārṅgādiśobhitaḥ |
lakṣmyādisevitastatra sthāsyāmi puruṣottamaḥ || 157||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye malamāsasyādhidaive puruṣottame jāte goloke kṛtamahotsavarāse kṛṣṇamukuṭamaṇikalgicandrikayoḥ mukuṭādviyoge tayorbhuvi ānartadeśe nimbadevamiṣṭādevīrūpeṇāvataraṇaṃ tayorgṛhe kṛṣṇasya gopālakṛṣṇarūpeṇāvataraṇaṃ premamaṇigṛhe rukmiṇīlakṣmyāḥ kaṃbharārūpeṇāvataraṇaṃ kaṃbharālakṣmīgopālakṛṣṇayorvivāhottaraṃ dundubhiśravaṇenāṣṭamīvratakaraṇena śrīpuruṣottamasya tayorgṛhe’vataraṇaṃ koṭiślokasaṃhitākaraṇaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.315||

<1.316>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi navamyāścādhikamāsāntitame dale |
vratasya pūrvakalpīyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || 1 ||
pūrvāt pūrvatare kalpe babhūvendro dyumerujit |
sāyaṃ tasya laye jāte puṇyaśeṣeṇa vai punaḥ || 2 ||
satyaloke niśāṃ bhuktvā kalpāraṃbhe prage tu saḥ |
sṛṣṭau tretāyuge cādye samrāṭ śatamakho’bhavat || 3 ||
dānadharmadayāyukto lokarakṣaṇatatparaḥ |
devadānavamartyānāṃ mānakṛd vijitendriyaḥ || 4 ||
vyomayānena viharan trilokyāṃ vicacāra saḥ |
gobhūtīrthadvijanyāsisatīsādhuprapūjakaḥ || 5 ||
yasya hastatale vajracchatrakhaṅgāṃkakāni vai |
vidyotante sma divyāni devatvāvedakāni vai || 6 ||
tasya patnī mahārājñī dyuvarṇābhūt pativratā |
patisevāparā nityaṃ devasevāparā tathā || 7 ||
ātithyadharmiṇī dīnānāthadāridyanāśinī |
kanyānāmunnatikartrī sadā strījātirakṣikā || 8 ||
gāndharvyo nāgakanyāśca devyo dānavya etya ca |
kinnaryaścāpi mānuṣyaḥ śikṣārthaṃ sma vasanti vai || 9 ||
sāvitrī cāpi gāyatrī saṃjñā svāhāpyarundhatī |
mahendrāṇī satī lakṣmīḥ rohiṇī pārvatī svadhā || 10 ||
prabhā ca māṇikī śrīśca jayā bhaktirdiśastathā |
anyā nadyaḥ kṛttikādyāstasyāḥ sakhyo’bhavam̐stadā || 1 1||
campā dayā ramā hemnī muktā godā jayantikā |
śāntiḥ śāntā premapātrā dīpotsavī ca nandinī || 12||
ojasvatī suratnā ca damayantī caturmatiḥ |
devikā kāntikā revā savitā mūlayoginī || 13||
kastūrikā maṃgalā ca haṃsā ruciśca maṃjulā |
nirmalā cāmṛtā rālijaṭinī pānaputtalī || 14||
vanitā miṣṭikā puṣpā manuḥ kṛṣṇā ca dāsikāḥ |
kāntā sarasvatī padmā śāradā upadāsikāḥ || 15||
kalpadrumāśca maṇayaḥ kāmadhenava iṣṭadāḥ |
kalpavallyo’bhavaṃstasyā rājye prāgjyotiṣāhvaye || 16||
evaṃ śatamakho rājā rājñī dyuvarṇikā tathā |
strīnarau rājyadharmeṇa vartete sma bhuvastale || 17||
daivayogena tadrājyamabhūcchītādridurgavat |
rājadhānī kṛtā tābhyāṃ sāketā sarayūmanu || 18||
pradhānaṃ rakṣakaṃ kṛtvā yātrārthaṃ kṛtaniścayau |
tatastau saṃprayātau vai badrīyātrārthamādarāt || 19||
parimeyacaracārabhṛtyadāsījanau śubhau |
tīrthasya niyamānsarvānpālayantau prajagmatuḥ ||20 ||
prātaḥ snānaṃ brahmacaryaṃ satyavrataṃ phalādanam |
bhūśāyitvaṃ parityaktaśṛṃgārāsanādikam ||21||
ahiṃsanaṃ parivādarāhityaṃ mālikājapam |
rāgadveṣavihīnatvaṃ dānaṃ devādipūjanam ||22||
tīrthavṛddhārcanaṃ tīrthagurusāhāyyakāritām |
godarśanaṃ hareḥ pādāmṛtapānaṃ kathāśravam ||23||
viṣayāṇāṃ parityāgaṃ sādhuvadvartanaṃ tathā |
rātrau nārāyaṇadhyānaṃ divā tīrthāṭanaṃ śubham ||24||
sāyaṃ nīrājanāstotrakīrtanasmaraṇādikam |
jaṃgamānsthāvarānpratyanudvejanaṃ titikṣaṇam ||25||
pālayantau tāpasau tau bhūtvā badarikā gatau |
devanadyāṃ tadācamya snātvā pītvā jalaṃ tataḥ ||26||
dadṛśaturmunīṃstīrthātmakām̐stīrthāni cāṃjasā |
naranārāyaṇau dṛṣṭvā pūjāṃ kṛtvopacārakaiḥ ||27||
sādhuviprānatithīṃśca bhojayāmāsatustadā |
rājñā rājñyā naranārāyaṇayostoṣaṇāya vai ||28||
tatraiva tu kṛtaṃ nṛtyaṃ gāyanaṃ mūrtisannidhau |
arpitaṃ kānakacchatrayugalaṃ mukuṭadvayam ||29||
yugakuṇḍalayugalaṃ cāmarāṇāṃ catuṣṭayam |
yaṣṭikāyugalaṃ hārāścormikāviṃśatistathā ||30 ||
kaṭakadvayayugalaṃ śṛṃkhalāraśanādvayam |
pādukādvayayugalaṃ tathā siṃhāsanadvayam ||3 1 ||
dakṣiṇā bhūyasī caiva svarṇapātrottamāni ca |
valkalājinavastrāṇi phalāni daiśikāni ca ||32||
samarpitāni sarvāṇi tava sva iti śabditam |
pādau spṛṣṭau jalaṃ pītaṃ caraṇāmṛtamityapi ||33||
svarṇamālāpādayoścārpitā naranareśayoḥ |
candanādisuvastvādyaiḥ pūjitau parameśvarau ||34||
āśīrvādāstadā labdhā putravān bhava pārthiva |
rājñī putravatī bhūyāditi śrutvā praśaṃ gatau ||35||
tāvattatrādhikamāsanavamyāṃ prātareva ha |
saṃśruto dundubhiḥ samyaṅmanovācchāprapūrakaḥ ||36||
adya vrataṃ prakurvantu gṛhṇantu vāñcchitaṃ phalam |
puruṣottamamāso’yaṃ phaladaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ||37||
hṛdi sthitān śubhān kāmāna gṛhṇantu puruṣottamāt |
māṃ ca dhāma vibhūtiṃ ca dāsye smṛddhiṃ vratārthine ||38||
agamyaṃ buddhigamyaṃ syādalabhyaṃ labhyameva ca |
atarkyaṃ cāpi tarkyaṃ syānnavamīvratakāriṇaḥ ||39||
sarvasaṃkalpasiddhiḥ syāt prāptiḥ pumuttamasya ca |
dundubhiścetyabhidhāya dṛṣṭvā naraṃ nareśvaram ||40 ||
pūjayitvā ṛṣivaryau jagāmottaradigbhuvam |
dampatī prasamākarṇya dhyātvā naranareśvarau ||41 ||
tallīnau cābhavatāṃ drāṅ naro nārāyaṇastadā |
tayorhṛdordadṛśāte divyarūpau suśobhanau ||42||
manoharau mañjuvākyau mañjulakeśasajjaṭau |
puṣṭau yuvānau divyau ca tāpasau śrīniṣevitau ||43 ||
munibhirvanditapādau vaikuṇṭhavāsināvubhau |
rājabhavanayogyau tau lālanapālanārhaṇau ||44||
padmapatrāyatanetrau sucandrāsyau guṇālayau |
ghanaśyāmau hṛdayaṃgamau manojñasundarau ||45||
vīkṣya saṃkalpitaṃ putrāvīdṛśau bhavatā tu nau |
atha dhyānād bahiryātau rājñīnṛpau vilokya ca ||46||
naranārāyaṇaḥ prāha saṃkalpaḥ phalatāttu vām |
śrutvā tṛptau cāti jātau tīrthavidhiṃ vidhāya tau ||47||
nivartitau tataḥ sthānādāyayaturnadītaṭe |
ācamya kānakīṃ mūrtiṃ snātvā pupūjatustadā ||48||
gaṃgājalairhariṃ tau saṃsnāpya pramṛjya cāmbaraiḥ |
pañcāmṛtaṃ samarpyathābhiṣekaṃ cakraturjalaiḥ ||49||
saṃpramṛjya suvastrāṇyābhūṣaṇāni samarpya ca |
śṛṃgāraśobhāṃ saṃklṛptvā dhūpadīpau samarpya ca ||50 ||
candanākṣatakuṃkumakajjaladravasārakaiḥ |
sugandhayitvārārtrikaṃ kārayāmāsatustataḥ ||51 ||
bhojayāmāsaturdevaṃ vardhayāmāsatuḥ stavaiḥ |
puṣpāṃjaliṃ samarpayāmāsatuśca phalādikam ||52||
tāmbūlacarvaṇaṃ datvā yācayāmāsatuḥ kṣamām |
evaṃ sūryodayāt paścāt pañcaghaṭīgate punaḥ ||53||
samaye cāpi tau kṛtvā snānārcanastavādikam |
naivedyapānatāmbūladakṣiṇādisamarpaṇam ||54||
ṛṣidevakṣitidevabhojanaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ tathā |
nirvartyārghyaṃ kusumānāmañjaliṃ cākṣatām̐stathā ||55||
datvā stutiṃ cakratuśca visarjanaṃ pracakratuḥ |
evaṃ prapūjya deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam ||56 ||
naraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ natvā tīrthavidhiṃ samāpya ca |
pūrvaṃ madhyāhnasamayād rājadhānīṃ navīkṛtām ||57||
vimānena samāgatya sāketāṃ sarayūmanu |
udyāne mahatī saudhe vṛkṣavallīsuśobhite ||58||
maṇḍapaṃ kārayāmāsatustau svarṇādiśobhitam |
kalaśairhāraśṛṃgārairvastrabhūṣādhvajādibhiḥ ||59||
śobhitaṃ raṃgavallībhiḥ siktaṃ gandhajalādibhiḥ |
vahnikuṇḍasamāyuktaṃ vedikāsuvirājitam ||6 0||
kaṭaparyaṃkabṛsikāsūrṇāstaraṇaśobhitam |
kammānikātoraṇāḍhyaṃ kadalīstaṃbhasaṃdhṛtam ||6 1||
ādarśacandrakaḍaṃkā niśāna bherikānakaiḥ |
jalataraṃgayantraiśca śītavāyupravāhakaiḥ ||62||

jalasthalavyatyayena dṛṣṭirjālairvilakṣitam ||63||

dūragrahaṇasiddhyādyairalaṃkṛtaṃ vimānavat ||64||
tatra maṇḍapamadhye tu sahakāratarū kṛtau |

śākhāsu divyadolā ca bandhayāmāsatuśca tau |

saṃklṛptayāmāsatuśca komalāstaraṇāni ca |
tatra mūrtiṃ kānakīṃ vai puruṣottamarūpiṇīm ||67||
āropyāndolayāmāsatuśca rājñī nṛpastathā |

saptadhānyaiḥ sbarṇaratnahīrakādisumiśritam |
racayāmāsaturmadhye suvarṇakalaśaṃ śubham ||69||
paṃcaratnajalapuṣpaphaladravyāmbarānvitam |
sthāpayāmāsatustasyopari sthālīṃ tilānvitām ||70||
śrīphalamudrikāyuktāṃ dhārayāmāsatustataḥ |

tatsthālyāṃ sthāpayāmāsatuśca ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ |
pūjayāmāsaturārārtrikaṃ cakraturādarāt ||72||
nṛtyagītāni tatraiva kārayāmāsatustadā |
homaṃ tvagnau kuṇḍamadhye kārayāmāsatustathā ||73||
bhojayāmāsaturviprāndevānsādhvīḥ satastathā |
dīnānāthābalāvargāndaridrān bhikṣukādikān ||74||
dakṣiṇā dāpayāmāsatuśca puṣpākṣatāñjalīn |

āśīrvādaparahastaḥ sevākṛpāḍhyamānasaḥ ||79||

dṛṣṭvā taṃ jātamātraṃ ca yuvānaṃ keśavaṃ prabhum |

prasanno’smi varaṃ yācata yatheṣṭaṃ dadāmyaham ||84||

yo badaryāṃ harirdṛṣṭo nareṇa saha tāpasaḥ |

tatrotsave samāyātā mantrā vedāśca vittayaḥ |
tattvāni cetarā sarve brahmaputrāśca mānasāḥ || 10 1||
pitaro devarājāśca pārthivā lakṣakoṭayaḥ |
samāyātā navamyāṃ vardhayituṃ cāśiṣāśiṣā || 10 2||
adhimāsāparapakṣanavamyāṃ madhyage ravau |
rāmādityajayantyāṃ te rāma vīkṣya naraṃ tathā || 10 3||
kṛtārthāścābhavan labdhvā satkāraṃ bhojanādikam |
rāmaprasannatāṃ prāpya cakrurgānaṃ sunartanam || 1 04||
dānaṃ śatamakhaḥ koṭyarbudāni ca gavāṃ dadau |

yayurnijasthalaṃ sarve svasvalokān yayurjanāḥ |
madhyāhnapūjanaṃ rājñyā nṛpeṇa tatra maṇḍape || 106||
samāptaṃ vai kṛtaṃ tadvat sāyaṃ niśi prapūjanam |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cātha prātaḥ snānādikaṃ kṛtam || 1 07||
mūrteḥ saṃpūjanaṃ pātrabhojanaṃ dakṣiṇādikam |
kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ suvidhinā vrataṃ pūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ tataḥ || 108||
pāraṇā ca kṛtā tena patnyā saha suputriṇā |
ānandaḥ samabhūt tasyātarkyo vai navamītitheḥ || 1 09||
puruṣottamamāsasya vratena putradāyinā |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vratānāmuttamaṃ vratam || 11 0||
rāmādityajayantyākhyaṃ vratapuṇyaṃ mahattamam |
idaṃ prāgrāmacaritaṃ paṭhet saṃśṛṇuyāttu yaḥ || 111 ||
śrāvayetparayā bhaktyā sa bhaved vratapuṇyabhāk |
sveṣṭaṃ labhellabhedrājyaṃ labhet putraṃ dhanādikam || 1 12||
labhet tīrthaphalaṃ cāpi sāketasarayūkṛtam |
labhecca balavatputraṃ puruṣottamasannibham || 1 13||
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ sukhaṃ svargaṃ dhāma vaikuṇṭhamityapi |
yadyadiṣṭaṃ labhet sarvaṃ kṛpayā paramātmanaḥ || 1 14||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye sāketanagaryāḥ śatamakharājñaḥ dyuvarṇā rājñyāśca badarikāśramayātrāyāṃ naranārāyaṇadarśanottaraṃ dvitīyapakṣanavamīvratakaraṇena sāketanagaryāṃ śrīrāmādityanarādityanāmānau prathamau puruṣottamāvatārau divyaputrau babhūvaturityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.316||

<1.317>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi vikuṇṭhā yā goloke rādhikāsutā |
saṃkalpamātrajā kanyā tasyā vṛttaṃ vratānvitam || 1 ||
adhimāsasya devo’bhūd bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
rādhayā sahitaḥ kṛṣṇo rāsaṃ cakre tadutsave || 2 ||
tatrāyātā gopagopyaḥ kanyāḥ koṭyarbudārbudāḥ |
kuṭumbinīḥ sakanyāśca rūpalāvaṇyasampadaḥ || 3 ||
gopīrvīkṣya svayaṃ rādhā tvaputrīyeṣu putrikām |
gopīnāṃ kanyakā divyā āhvayanti svamātṛkāḥ || 4 ||
mām̐ ambe janani caivaṃ hyānandayanti mātṛkāḥ |
putrīhīnā patiyuktā na pūrṇā sukhinī hi sā || 5 ||
putrī mātṛsvarūpāsti māturvai kāryadāsikā |
sarvathā sāhacaryeṇa sevate mātaraṃ sutā || 6 ||
bhojane cotsave yāne rahasyāplavane gṛhe |
śayane vā pravāse vā sāhāyye sevikā sutā || 7 ||
nārīvargasya nāryaiva śārīrasahasevikā |
tatrāpi svasutā tulyā na snuṣā nāpi bhṛtyakā || 8 ||
na vā kuṭumbinī tadvad yathā putrī tu sevikā |
tasmāt sutāṃ binā nārī tvardhasaubhāgyaśālinī || 9 ||
prātaḥ putrīmukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā svargādapyadhikaṃ sukham |
jananī vindati loke na tathā putradarśanāt || 1 0||
pituḥ putre yathā sneho mātuḥ putryāṃ tato’dhikaḥ |
abalā gosamā putrī kumārī mātṛsevikā || 11 ||
paścāt patiparā sā syāttasmānmāturviśeṣataḥ |
pūrṇāyuṣyasukhaṃ putryāḥ kaumārye labhyameva ha || 12||
ataḥ putrī daśaguṇā preṣṭhā bhavati sarvathā |
mātuḥ kalāsukauśalyaṃ gṛhakāryādiśikṣaṇam || 13||
putryātmake nijapātre vasatyeva sadā ciram |
satputryā jāyate mātā yaśasvinī kuladvaye || 14||
putrī kīrtiryaśaḥ putrī putrī piṇḍastu mātṛjaḥ |
svātmikāṃ putrikāṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā hṛṣyanti mātaraḥ || 15||
putraḥ pitṛsvarūpo’sti putrī mātusvarūpiṇī |
suputrī jananī putrīmatsu mānyā bhavatyapi || 16||
aputrī tu samājādau mlāneva dṛśyate khalu |
putrīmaṇḍalamadhyasthā mātā tatra prakāśate || 17||
aputrī tu yathā nidrotthitā tadvaddhi dṛśyate |
bahvayaḥ suputrikā yasyāḥ sā dhanāḍhyāsu pūjyate || 18||
putryātmakaṃ dhanaṃ tasyāḥ sarvaśrībhyo viśiṣyate |
jāmātāro’pi bahavo bahuputryā dhanaṃ mahat || 19||
putrīputrāśca tatputrā dhanaṃ vistṛtameva tat|
bahuśākhaśca vṛkṣasya chāyāṃ śrayanti lakṣaśaḥ ||20||
aśākhasya na vai chāyā nāśritā nahi mānyatā |
paropakāro nāpyasti tathāputrī vigaṇyate ||2 1||
putrīsukhaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā mātā toṣaṃ prayāti vai |
na me putrī na vā putraḥ kathaṃ rādhā sukhāśrayā || 22||
sapatnīduḥkhamāpannā yadi putrīmatī bhavet |
tadā sāpatnyaduḥkhaṃ vai putrīṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartate ||23 ||
virajā rukmiṇī lakṣmīḥ ramā śrīḥ pārvatī prabhā |
jayā ca vijayā bhāmā maṃgalā māṇikī yamī ||24||
anyāścāsaṃkhyakoṭyaśca sapatnyaḥ sānti me sadā |
saputryastāḥ sadā dṛśyā mayā putrīvihīnayā || 25||
tasmāt putrī mayā prārthyā kṛṣṇāchrīpuruṣottamāt |
yayā putrīmatīnāṃ maurdhanyaṃ mama yathā bhavet ||26||
iti saṃcintya rādhā sā mahotsavottaraṃ nijam |
bhāvaṃ prakāśayāmāsa rahaḥ śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau ||27||
putrī me dayitāṃ nātha vinā putrīṃ mṛtirvarā |
putrīmatīṣu sarvāsu na śobhe’haṃ samutsave ||28||
apatyāni vinā nārī śobhate naiva caikalā |
kadalī śobhate naiva pārśvāpatyāni yatra na ||29||
virullatā na śobhante kvacicchākhālatāmṛte |
hariṇī śobhate naiva bālāpatyāni vai vinā || 30||
vidyuttu śobhate tatra yatra vṛṣṭiḥ pravartate |
kulyā vinā mahattvaṃ na nadyāḥ kvāpi prasiddhyati ||3 1||
vināṅgulīḥ phaṇā naiva śobhate śobhitāpi vai |
śāntiṃ vinā na vā vidyā śobhate sā mahatyapi ||32||
muktiṃ vinā parāvidyā śobhate na parāpi sā |
tṛptiṃ vinā yathā bhuktirniṣphaleva prajāyate ||33||
patnīṃ vinā yathā śayyā yauvanodvegadāyinī |
putrīṃ vinā tathā mātā vārdhakye duḥkhadarśinī ||34||
tasmāt putrīṃ samicchāmi sarvasadguṇaśālinīm |
mātrājñāpālayitrīṃ ca kuladharmānuyāyinīm || 35||
mātṛsevākarīṃ divyāṃ gṛhakāryasahāyinīm |
annavārisamitpatraśākapuṣpādirakṣiṇīm ||36||
mārjanaṃ mañjanaṃ vasturakṣaṇaṃ kṣālanaṃ tathā |
pācanaṃ saṃskaraṇaṃ ca jalāharaṇaprabhṛti ||37 ||
kuryāt snigdhā sutā yā syānmātṛvātsalyaśobhitā |
tasmānmayā suputryatra kṛṣṇa kānta guṇālayā ||38||
sarvaśreṣṭhā ca vikhyātā mātāpitṛsahāyinī |
dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā ca yāṃ śāntirbhavet samiṣyate hare ||39||
yadyahaṃ te priyā patnī mayi tuṣṭo bhavān yadi |
yadyahaṃ te priyā dāsī priyaḥ kānto’si me yadi ||40||
tadā rādhā vṛṇute’tra kṛṣṇātputrīṃ sulakṣaṇām |
sarvaputrīmatīputrīrvismārayettu yā nu mām ||4 1 ||
ityabhyarthya priyā rādhā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum |
kṛtvā vakṣasi saṃśliṣṭaṃ sevayāmāsa bhāvataḥ ||42||
kṛṣṇastvānandayitvā tāṃ dadau tasyai suputrikām |
divyāṃ rādhāsamākārāṃ rādhārūpātirūpiṇīm ||43 ||
saṃkalpamātrajanyāṃ ca jātamātrā suyauvanām |
divyāṃ divyasahasrābjagopīrūpātirūpiṇīm ||44||
yathā rādhā tathā sāsti yathā sā rādhikā tathā |
āntaraṃ naiva sarvātmatulyatayā vibhāsate ||45||
mumuhurgopikāḥ sarvāḥ kṛṣṇapatnyaśca mohitāḥ |
stabdhāśca citritā yadvat tadānīmabhavan kṣaṇam ||46 ||
etādṛśī darśanārhā vṛttīnāṃ kuṇṭhitā parā |
tatraiva putryāṃ sarvāsāṃ sarveṣāṃ cābhavattadā ||47||
kṛṣṇo’pi rūpasampannāṃ sutāṃ dṛṣṭvā jaharṣa vai |
vṛttīnāṃ kuṇṭhito bhāvo jātaṃ sthairyaṃ yato’tra vai ||48||
pitrā kṛṣṇena vātsalyād vikuṇṭheti samādarāt |
samāhūtā sutā tadvat samāhūtā hi rādhayā || 49 ||
vikuṇṭhākhyā ca sā kārṣṇī rādheyīnāmato’bhavat |
golokavasatiḥ sarvā draṣṭuṃ kanyāṃ samāyayau ||5 0 ||
praśaṃsanti striyastāṃ tā aho rādhā mahodayā |
aho putrī divyarādhārūpātirūpabhājanā ||5 1 ||
aho bhāgyena kasyāpi jāteyaṃ sumanoharā |
kṛṣṇādapyuttamaṃ bhāgyaṃ tasya syād yasya sā bhavet ||52||
vivāhavidhinā bhāryā bhavedyasya tu kanyakā |
sa vai kṛṣṇottamaḥ kṛṣṇo bhavedvai puruṣottamaḥ ||53 ||
ityuktvāśiṣa āyujya jagmuḥ svasvālayaṃ janāḥ |
rādhā tāṃ pāyayāmāsa stanyaṃ tatkālasaṃbhavam ||54||
kṛṣṇaḥ saṃskārayāmāsa vidhinā bhojanaṃ dadau |
ramayāmāsa mātā tāṃ lālanaiḥ pālanādibhiḥ ||55 ||
atha sā rādhikāsevāṃ karoti smātibhāvataḥ |
gṛhakāryāṇi sarvāṇi nirvartayati śikṣitā ||56||
evaṃ vivartamānā sā varārohātiyauvanā |
nityaṃ pitrā samaṃ yāti draṣṭuṃ śrīpuruṣottamam ||57||
akṣarādhipatiṃ brahmaparaṃ śrīparameśvaram |
anantakṛṣṇasaṃsevyaṃ nārāyaṇābjavanditam || 58 ||
yatkāntyā leśamātreṇa kāntāḥ kṛṣṇādayo matāḥ |
tamanādibrahmayuktaiḥ sevitaṃ puruṣottamam ||59||
prātaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sadā yāti paraṃ pūjayituṃ prabhum |
śvetadivyamahāyuktasapakṣahastisaṃsthitaḥ ||6 0 ||
upāyanādikaṃ nītvā bhagavān rādhikāpatiḥ |
nivartate tu sampūjya tadvā kṛṣṇasutā tu sā || 61 ||
cakame rādhikāputrī dṛṣṭvā śrīpuruṣottamam |
tasyā manaḥ samākṛṣya svasmin sthāpayati prabhuḥ ||62||
vikuṇṭhā dhyāyati dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ harim |
sarvakriyāsu cānādikṛṣṇānārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||63 ||
gāyati smarati paśyatyapi śrīṣuruṣottamam |
evaṃ nityaṃ tayā sārdhaṃ samāyāti ca pūjanam ||6 4||
kṛtvā kṛṣṇaḥ svakaṃ dhāma gacchati nityameva ha |
vikuṇṭhāpi tanmayābhūt sarvakriyāsu sarvadā ||65||
puruṣottamapatnītvaṃ prāptuṃ dhyāyatyaharniśam |
tāvattatra tadāvādīd dundubhiḥ śrīharermahān || 66||
adyāsti daśamī ramyā puṇyadādhikamāsikī |
pare pakṣe’tra vratakṛllabhate sveṣṭavastukam ||67||
api kanyā ca vā nārī naro vā dīnamānavaḥ |
adya vratena vai sveṣṭaṃ prāpsyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ ||68 ||
akṣarādhipatyanādiśrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamaḥ |
yadyadicchati tatsarvaṃ pradāsye vai vratārthine ||69 ||
mā saṃkocaṃ prakurvantu prārthanākaraṇe janāḥ |
gopyaṃ rakṣyaṃ cānivedyaṃ dāsye saṃkalpitaṃ khalu ||70 ||
ityāśrutya vikuṇṭhā sā cakre vai daśamīvratam |
puruṣottamalabdhyarthaṃ sajāgaraṃ divāniśam ||7 1 ||
prātastayā kṛtā pūjā śubhā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ |
puruṣottamamūrteśca bhojanārārtrikādikam ||72||
khānapānasunaivedyaphalapuṣpajalādikam |
prātarmadhye tathā sāyaṃ rātrau cakāra pūjanam ||73 ||
kṛṣṇacandraśītaraśmitejomaye’tisūjjvale |
virāmākhye niśāvācye samaye puruṣottamaḥ ||74||
samāyāt tatra mūrtyākhye svarūpe’kṣaradhāmataḥ |
koṭikṛṣṇasamaḥ kānto vikuṇṭhābhāgyaniścitaḥ ||75 ||
prahasan tāṃ prabhuḥ prāhāgato’smi vratapuṇyadaḥ |
tava bhaktyā prasanno’smi vṛṇu kṛṣṇasute’naghe || 76 ||
adeyaṃ nāsti te kiñcit smṛtavatyai sadā tu mām |
ananyāyai bhaktimatyai kārṣṇyai deyaṃ yathepsitam ||77||
tadā prāha vikuṇṭhā taṃ prasannā lajjitā tathā |
hṛdaye prāṇanātha tvaṃ vartase’viditaṃ na te ||78 ||
tathāpi bhaktavātsalyājjijñāsāṃ tvaṃ karoṣi vai |
bhagavanmama nātha tvaṃ bhava prāṇapatiḥ prabhuḥ ||79||
iyaṃ samarpyate svāmin varamālādiśa prabho |
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha tathā prāhādhikaṃ hariḥ ||8 0 ||
śṛṇu naikasvarūpo’haṃ vasāmi vividhāśrayaḥ |
vasāmyahaṃ sadā dhāmnyakṣare śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||8 1 ||
dvitīyo’haṃ vasāmyeva mahāvaikuṇṭhadhāmani |
tathā jalāvaraṇāntavaikuṇṭhe’haṃ tṛtīyakaḥ ||82 ||
śvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhe caturtho’haṃ vasāmyapi |
kṣīrāntaḥsthe tu vaikuṇṭhe vasāmi paṃcamo’pyaham ||83 ||
tasmāt tvayāpi sarvatra vastavyaṃ divyarūpayā |
naikena vai svarūpeṇa sthātuṃ sarvatra pāryate ||84||
tato’nekasvarūpatvaṃ kartavyaṃ bhavati dhruvam |
kiṃca mātrā tava rādhikayā sevārthamityapi ||85||
nirmitā tvaṃ tato tāṃ vai tyaktuṃ nārhasi sundari |
rādhāsevārthamevāpi sthātavyaṃ sarvadā tvayā ||86 ||
iti rūpāṇi ṣaṭ kṛtvā sthātavyaṃ sarvathā tvayā |
kṛpayā mama tasmātte rūpāṇi ṣaḍ bhavantu vai ||87||
ityuktā sā ṣaṭsvarūpābhavattasya kṛpākaṇāt |
tatraikaṃ tvakṣaradhāmavāsārha sarvato’dhikam ||88 ||
puruṣottamayogyaṃ sababhūva nityamuktikam |
patnītvena vikuṇṭhā tāṃ jagrāha puruṣottamaḥ ||89 ||
dvitīyaṃ rādhikāsevāyogyaṃ putrīsvarūpakam |
goloke tāṃ kumārīṃ vai sthāpayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 90 ||
vikuṇṭhā kanyakā pūrvaṃ yathā tatraiva tiṣṭhati |
tṛtīyaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā vyāpakaṃ mūrtimattathā || 91 ||
rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattatra vyāpakaṃ tattu sarvathā |
vaikuṇṭhākhyaṃ dhāmarūpamadhidaivaṃ babhūva tat || 92 ||
mahāvaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ tad vyāpakaṃ dhāma cocyate |
tatra nārāyaṇapatnī mahālakṣmīrbabhūva sā || 92 ||
caturthaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattathā |
jalāvaraṇavaikuṇṭhaṃ tejomayādhidaivatam || 94||
vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam |
vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt || 95||
pañcamaṃ tu vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattadā |
śvetadvīpākhyavaikuṇṭhaṃ tejomayādhidaivatam || 96||
vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam |
vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt || 97||
ṣaṣṭhaṃ cāpi vikuṇṭhāyā rūpaṃ dvedhābhavattadā |
kṣīravaikuṇṭhasaṃjñaṃ tattejomayādhidaivatam ||98||
vyāpakaṃ saṃbabhūvaikaṃ lakṣmīrūpaṃ dvitīyakam |
vikuṇṭhā sā viṣṇupatnī sevate viṣṇumādarāt || 99||
evaṃ ṣaṇmūrtayastasyāḥ surūpā divyayoṣitaḥ |
ṣaṭsthaleṣu hi vartante vikuṇṭhā bhagavatstriyaḥ || 10 0||
vaikuṇṭhāni tu catvāri dhāmāni divyabhūmayaḥ |
babhūvustadadhiṣṭhātrīdevatāstā harīcchayā || 10 1||
catasro vyāpikā devyo militvā daśa tāḥ sadā |
pṛthagrūpā babhūvurvai vratena haritoṣaṇāt || 10 2||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasvāmipuruṣottamasatkṛpā |
kiṃ kiṃ na kurute lakṣmi sā vikuṇṭhā bhavatyapi || 102 ||
svātmānaṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi sa cāha puruṣottamaḥ |
ityapi tvaṃ vijānīhi patiṃ te puruṣottamam || 1 04||
jñātvā māṃ bhajase tatra sarvatrātra ca matpriye |
ahaṃ jānāmi tatsarvaṃ nityapratyakṣavattayā || 1 05||
tvaṃ na vetsi tathā sarvaṃ madicchā tatra kāraṇam |
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi vṛttaṃ daśamikāvratāt || 10 6||
vikuṇṭhāyāstava rūpāṇyabhavan daśadhā phalam |
madicchayā tathā jātaṃ mamānugrahakāraṇam || 1 07||
paṭhedvā śṛṇuyādvāpi phalaṃ tasyāpi tādṛśam |
dadāmīṣṭaṃ pūrayāmi kṛpayā puruṣottamaḥ || 108||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye śrīkṛṣṇena dattāyā mānasyā rādhikāputryā vikuṇṭhānāmnyā daśamīvratena santuṣṭapuruṣottamakṛpayā ṣaṭlakṣmīrūpāṇi catvāri vaikuṇṭhadhāmādhidevatārūpāṇi cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.317||

<1.318>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi pūrvakalpe bhavāṃ vamryāḥ kathāṃ śubhām |
rudraputrī kṛte cādye samabhūd vamrikā sutā || 1 ||
satyāḥ sā mānasī putrī vaṭe tiṣṭhati nityadā |
mandare parvate rudrāvatāre vaṭapādape || 2 ||
pitrāśraye kṛtāvāsā tvāste śuddhā kumārikā |
satyā cāprajayā dṛṣṭā vikuṇṭhā rādhikāsutā || 3 ||
tadā putrīmatī syāṃ cetyārthayacchaṃkarānmuhuḥ |
tathāstviti prasannaḥ śaṃkaraḥ saṃkalpamācarat || 4 ||
yatra vai mandare’raṇye svāvatāravaṭāśraye |
tatraiva ramaṇāt satyā mānasī divyarūpiṇī || 5 ||
jajñe koṭicandratejo’dhikatejomayī sutā |
jātamātrā surūpā suyauvanā yādṛśī satī || 6 ||
tato’pyadhikasaundaryā sarvadivyaguṇālayā |
jātamātrā divyabodhā nanāma pādayoḥ pituḥ || 7 ||
mātṛcaraṇayoścāpi nanāma sevikā yathā |
satī cātiprasannābhūd rudro’pyatitarāṃ sukhī || 8 ||
anapatyastu sāpatyo bhavatyutsavavardhitaḥ |

seveta sarvadā prāṇī phalaṃ tacchāśvataṃ bhavet ||37||
iti joṣṭrī sadā satye sevate parameṣṭhinam |
putrībhiśca prajāsevāṃ karotyanudivaṃ śubhām ||38||
ekadā tu samājo’bhūt sudharmāyāmajagṛhe |
ṛṣayo munayo devāḥ pitaro mānavā drumāḥ ||39 ||
piśācādyāstathā kandā vallayo daityadānavāḥ |
samāyātāścaturdaśabhuvanasthāstu dehinaḥ ||40 ||
adṛśyāśca tathā dṛśyāḥ sastrīkā samupāyayuḥ |
taistaiḥ samājamūrdhanyairāyayurdvādaśāpi tāḥ ||41 ||
sevikā dāsikārūpā joṣṭrīputryo’śanādikāḥ |
samājāḥ sevitāstābhiryogyā yeṣāṃ kṛte tu yā ||42||
tāṃ tāṃ sevāṃ vidhāyaiva toṣitāḥ sarvayonayaḥ |
tuṣṭāstābhyo daduḥ pāritoṣikāṇyāśiṣastathā ||43||
sarvā bhavantu sadbhāgyāḥ śāśvatānandapūritāḥ |
dhanadhānyayaśaḥkīrtisanmānaguṇapūjitāḥ ||44||
siddhyaiśvaryayutā ramyarūpadhāriṇya eva ca |
joṣṭrīvaṃśapravardhinyo mahātejodharāḥ sadā ||45 ||
lokaprakāśakāriṇyo devyo yadyapi sevikā |
bhavantu sarvadā brāhmyaḥ śāśvatasthirayauvanāḥ ||46 ||
iti labdhāśiṣaḥ sarvāḥ samāje tu nivartite |
svasāro dvādaśamāturjoṣṭryā gṛhaṃ yayuḥ kṣaṇam ||47||
tatra tāvat satyaloke dundubhiḥ śrīharermahān |
aśrūyata vadan śabdaṃ puruṣottamadeśitam ||48||
atrādhike tu me māse dvādaśyāṃ mama pūjanam |
vrataṃ mamaikaśaraṇaṃ kurvantu dehino yathā ||49 ||
bhavanmano’bhilaṣitaṃ dāsye’haṃ puruṣottamaḥ |
mātra pramaditavyaṃ vai kṛcchre svalpaṃ vrataṃ bahu ||5 0||
bhāgyaṃ yeṣāmujjvalaṃ vai gṛhṇantu te’ti tatphalam |
dātāhaṃ kṛpayā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’smi sarvathā ||5 1 ||
siddhīrdāsye dhāma dāsye dāsye vai śāśvataṃ sukham |
sarvaṃ dāsye ca māṃ dāsye na dāsye nepsitaṃ tu yat ||5 2||
ekabhuktena naktena phalāhāreṇa vā vratam |
jalāhāreṇa dadhnā vā munnyannena ca bhājayā ||5 3||
patreṇa kandamūlaiśca vāyubhakṣeṇa vā vratam |
mama prasādaleśena kṛtaṃ vā yadyapi vratam ||54||
takreṇa payasā vāpi tilaiśca māṣamuṣṭibhiḥ |
yena kenāpi bhāvena dvādaśīvratamāhitam ||55 ||
tasyāhaṃ vāñchitaṃ sarvaṃ pūrayiṣyāmi sarvathā |
pūjanaṃ mama kartavyaṃ prātarmadhye niśāmukhe ||56||
jāgaraṃ ca prakartavyaṃ deyāni bhojanāni ca |
dānānyapi pradeyāni yathāśakti yathārjanam ||57||
mahyaṃ puṣpāṃjaliṃ dadyād dadyāttathākṣatāñjalim |
jalāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca dadyācca bhāvanāṃjalim ||58||
snehāṃjaliṃ pradadyācca dadyādātmāṃjaliṃ vratī |
pradadyātsarvataḥ śreṣṭhāṃ sarvasamarpaṇāṃjalim ||5 9 ||
bhāvagamyaḥ snehagamyaḥ premagamyo bhavāmyaham |
vastugamyaḥ svārthagamyo yadvā tadvā bhavāmyaham ||60 ||
gamiṣyati ca dīrghāyurgamiṣyati ca yauvanam |
yāsyanti sampado nāśaṃ matkṛpā śāśvatī matā ||6 1 ||
yāsyanti śīrṇatāṃ yogāḥ puṣṭiryāsyati jīrṇatām |
varṣma yāsyati bhasmatvaṃ matkṛpā śāśvatī matā ||62||
utpannaṃ tadvinaṣṭaṃ syāt puṇyaṃ rājyaṃ dhanādikam |
śāśvatī me kṛpā bodhyā yannāśo naiva vidyate ||63||
kṛpāṃ gṛhṇantu kṛpaṇā dūrayāntu daridratām |
madājñayā vratenaiva śāśvatāḍhyā bhavantu vai ||64||
ityevaṃ dundubheḥ śabdaṃ śrutvā tā mātṛvardhitāḥ |
vrataṃ cakrurhi payasā dvādaśyā dvādaśaiva tāḥ ||65||
api joṣṭrī vrataṃ cakre vāriṇā bhāvagarbhitam |
snātvā prātaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ smṛtvā trayodaśa ||66||
svarṇamūrtiṃ vidhāyaivāpūjayan puruṣottamam |
maṇḍapaṃ kadalīstabhaṃ hyaśokāmrāditoraṇam ||67||
puṣpahārāvalijuṣṭaṃ svarṇavastrādiśobhitam |
raṃgadīpasukalaśairmaṇḍitaṃ toraṇādibhiḥ ||68||
tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ kārayitvā sumaṇḍalam |
ramyaṃ suvarṇakalaśaṃ pañcaratnasupallavam ||69 ||
vastraṃ phalaṃ candanaṃ cākṣatān madhye nidhāya ca |
tanmūrdhni kānakaṃ nyasya pātraṃ satilaśarkaram ||70||
tatra nidhāya deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇapuruṣottamam |
vai ṣoḍaśapadārthaiśca pūjayāmāsurādarāt ||71||
āvāhanādikaṃ kṛtvā pañcāmṛtaiśca vāribhiḥ |
saṃsnāpya mārjanaṃ kṛtvāmbarāṇyābhūṣaṇāni ca ||72||
kuṃkumaiḥ kajjalairgandhasārairakṣatacandanaiḥ |
śṛṃgārayitvā śrīkṛṣṇaṃ dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ vidhāya ca ||73||
naivedyaṃ pāyasaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ miṣṭānnaṃ pūrikādikam |
phalaṃ tvāmrādikaṃ pānaṃ cāmṛtaṃ madhuraṃ jalam ||74||
tāmbūlakaṃ phalaṃ cānyad yadyattvapekṣitaṃ prabhoḥ |
tattatsarvaṃ pradāyaivārārtrikaṃ dadhire ca tāḥ ||75||
daṇḍavat namanaṃ stotraṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ sumāñjalim |
aparādhakṣamāyāñcāṃ cāntimārghyaṃ daduḥ prage ||76||
madhyāhne’pi tathā cakruḥ sevanaṃ niśi cāpi tāḥ |
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ cakrurnartanaṃ gāyanādibhiḥ ||77||
dvādaśaiva ca tāḥ kanyā hāvabhāvasamanvitam |
yathā kṛṣṇaharirnārāyaṇaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||78||
śṛṃgārarasabhāvena prasannaḥ syātpumuttamaḥ |
ākṛṣṭaḥ san dayāluḥ sa darśanaṃ ca dadedyathā ||79||
tathā tābhirmahāharṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ nartanagāyanam |
prātarharirbrāhmakāle prādurbabhūva saṃhasan ||80||
yuvā puṣṭaḥ surūpaśca yuvatīmānasāśrayaḥ |
koṭikāmātisaundaryo vīryasaṃbhṛtagātrakaḥ ||8 1||
pratiromarativyāptaḥ pratyaṃgānaṃgabhāsitaḥ |
prasanno’smi prasanno’smi sevayā saṃvadan muhuḥ ||82||
sevikā varadānāni vṛṇuteṣṭāni sarvathā |
indrāṇītvaṃ śivātvaṃ vā brahmāṇītvaṃ tato’pi ca ||83||
kṛṣṇātvaṃ vaiṣṇavītvaṃ ca brāhmītvaṃ tatparaṃ ca vā |
yadyadicchā bhavet tattad dadāmyadya na saṃśayaḥ ||84||
dvādaśātmabhavatībhirjitā lokāḥ parātparāḥ |
sevayā śraddhayā bhāvanayā snehārdrayāṅganāḥ ||85||
dāsyo’pi yūyamevādyādāsyo jātā hi sevayā |
mānasasthaṃ vṛṇutādya mā ciraṃ hṛdayaṃgamāḥ ||86||
sevikānāṃ sevako’haṃ śāstrīṇāṃ śāsako’smyaham |
mitrāṇīnāmahaṃ mitraṃ vāmānāṃ dakṣiṇo’smyaham ||87||
snigdhānāṃ snehilaścāsmi śaraṇyānāṃ tu rakṣakaḥ |
madarthatyaktasarvasvānāṃ tu sarvasvado’smyaham ||88||
tathā na toṣamāpnomi dhanairbhṛtyaiśca sevayā |
yathā santoṣamāpnomi svenaiva kṛtasevayā ||89||
sevako’hamahaṃ svāmī yatra sevā na bhidyate |
yatra bhaktaḥ svayaṃ māṃ vai svayaṃ bhāvena sevate ||90||
tasmāt priyāḥ pravadantu kiṃ dadāmi vadāmi kim |
priyābhyaḥ kiṃ prayacchāmi sarvasvaṃ hṛdayānvitam ||91||
priyāḥ prāhurvayaṃ sarvā arpitāḥ paramātmani |
sarvakānte pare kānte patyau śrīpuruṣottame ||92||
dāsīnāṃ tu tathā dharmaḥ sarvārpaṇaṃ tu śāstari |
priyāṇāṃ tu tathā dharmaḥ kānte sarvārpaṇaṃ priye ||93||
svāminaśca tathā dharmo’rpitānāṃ grahaṇaṃ sadā |
kāntapriyasya dharmo vai kāntānāṃ priyakāritā ||94||
priyā priyasya sarvasvaṃ priyaḥ sarvaṃ priyākṛte |
priyāyāścāpi sarvasvaṃ priya eva dayānidhiḥ ||95||
iti cātra mahatyarthe yatheṣṭaṃ kuru keśava |
mānasaṃ tvayi sarvasvaṃ cārpitaṃ kuru yanmatam ||96||
śrutvā prāha tadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhūttamaḥ |
sarvaṃ vedmi tathā sarvāḥ svīkaromi hṛdantare ||97||
bāhyato’pi karāndhṛtvā karomi hṛdayaṃgamāḥ |
bhavantu matkarasparśād divyarūpadharā mama ||98||
priyāḥ patnyo bhavantvakṣarākhye dhāmani sarvadā |
joṣṭrī mama svarūpe’stu tejomayī tu śaktikā ||99||
sarvānandapradā devī cinmayī matsvarūpiṇī |
saccidānandarūpe me cinmayī sā mayā kṛtā || 10 0||
anyāśca dvādaśapatnyaḥ santu śāśvatikā mama |
tattannāmnā tu tāḥ patnyastatra vasantu madgṛhe || 101 ||
matsamākṛtayaḥ sarvāḥ patnyastā arthato yathā |
māṃ vinānyasukhāderyāśanaṃ naiva karoti hi || 102||
iti sārthānaśanākhyā pipāsāṃ tvarthataḥ śṛṇu |
madrasaṃ sarvadā pātumicchati nānyameva yā || 103||
sā pipāsā mayā patnī rakṣitā matsvarūpiṇī |
athāśanā mama patnī yā samaśnāti māṃ sadā || 104||
sarvān kāmānaśnute sā brahmaṇā viduṣā saha |
iti sārthāśanākhyā sā patnī me rakṣitā mayā || 1 05||
yā ca svātmani nityaṃ māṃ paraṃ vāsayate patim |
sā mayā bhāvapūrṇā vāsanā patnī surakṣitā || 106 ||
yasyā nāmātra vaktavyaṃ bhāvanā bhāvitā mayā |
āyāti matkaraṃ dhṛtvā karāyā me priyā hi sā || 1 07||
kaṃ sukhaṃ matparānandaṃ śaṃ lakṣmīṃ divyasaṃpadam |
sevayā yāti gṛhṇāti matto yā sā karāyikā || 1 08||
madarthameva sarvasvaṃ kṛtaṃ kriyātmakaṃ yayā |
iti niścayasārthakyā vyavasāyā priyā mama || 1 09||
soḍhuṃ yogyā mama sarvā kriyājñā sā priyā mama |
prakarṣeṇa sahate yā madratiṃ sā prasahyakā || 110 ||
madarthe sarvathā divyā vilasyati madarthikā |
vilāsākhyā mama patnī me’nuvilāsakāriṇī || 11 1||
yasyāḥ śvāso vinā māṃ tu sthātuṃ śakto bhavennahi |
yasyā hyahaṃ ca me sāsti patirme’sti sukhāya vai || 1 12||
iti viśvāsamāpannā viśvāsā sā mama priyā |
māṃ vinā jīvanaṃ śvāso nāsti yasyāḥ pratikṣaṇam || 11 3||
mehati varṣate patyau prema varṣayati prabhau |
mayi snehaṃ karotyeva meghā sā matpriyā matā || 1 14||
sarvaṃ karmaṃ mayi yā svāṃ damayatibhāvataḥ |
madarthaṃ damanaṃ yasyāḥ karmaṇāṃ kardamā priyā || 1 15||
kuṃ kṣetraṃ svātmakaṃ yā bhāvayati matkṛte’nvaham |
kuṃbhe jalaṃ yathā tadvanmāṃ bibharti nijātmani || 116 ||
sā patnī kuṃbhikā me’sti yūyaṃ patnyaḥ prakīrtitāḥ |
divyā yāstā dvādaśaivākṣare dhāmni vasantu me || 1 17||
athānyaistu svarūpairdvādaśaśaktyātmikāstu vai |
vartantāmanyarūpiṇyo mahākālāya cārpitā || 1 18||
tato viśvaṃ saṃvyakrāmat sāśanānaśane hyabhi |
pipāsayā pravāhastu dhāvatyagre’sya saṃsṛteḥ || 1 19||
vāsanayā vasatyetajjaḍacetanamiśritam |
karāyayā bhavatyatra vinimayastu dehinoḥ || 12 0||
dhāryate puṣyate kālavāhayā vyavasāyayā |
prasahyayā kṣamate tvārtavān dvandvām̐śca vatsaraḥ || 121 ||
vilāsayā śramaṃ hāpayitvā jīvān yunakti saḥ |
viśvāsayā phale lobhātpravartante tu dehinaḥ || 122||
meghayā snehavṛṣṭyā vai rañjayanti prajāḥ samāḥ |
kardamayā prajā bhūtā mayi tiṣṭhanti kardame || 123 ||
kuṃbheṣvatra golakeṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca sarvathā |
tattatsthāne sthāpayitrī kuṃbhikā rakṣikā matā || 1 24||
evaṃ kālasya macchaktibhūtasya śaktayo’nvaham |
bhavantu kāryakāriṇyo loke kālāya cārpitāḥ || 1 25||
atha yatra joṣṭrikāyāḥ putryaḥ santyuṣitā yathā |
tāstathaiva tu vedhaḥ kṛdbrahmāṇḍe’pi vasantviti || 126 ||
vasantu śrīkṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya mama vācchayā |
tṛtīyaistu svarūpaiḥ svairjyoṣṭrījananya eva ha || 1 27||
evaṃ trividharūpairvai mayā samyaṅniyojitāḥ |
kurvantu dāsyamevātra mahākāle tathā mayi || 128|||
bhavatīnāmahaṃ svāmī patiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
ramantāṃ tu mayā sārdhaṃ svatantrā akṣare pare || 129||
tathānyā macchaktirūpamahākālasahāyikāḥ |
tathāparā mama sṛṣṭau tattatkāryavahāḥ sadā || 130||
iti tredhā mayā dattaṃ bhavatībhyaḥ prasevanam |
dvādaśyāstu vratasyaiva phalaṃ dattaṃ hi śāśvatam || 13 1||
ityuktvā bhagavān kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ |
divyāstāḥ saha nītvaiva vyavasthāpya tathāparāḥ || 1 32||
mahākālāya datvānyā yayau dhāmākṣaraṃ hariḥ |
vada lakṣmi kṛpāpārāvāraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pumuttamaḥ || 133||
kiṃ kiṃ dadāti kṛpayā svalpasyānantakaṃ phalam |
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ joṣṭrīdevyāḥ kathānakam || 134||
devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindraṃ vayodhasam |
prāpyāvardhata bṛhatī brāhmyāsa puruṣottamam || 1 35||
ya idaṃ śrāvayeccāpi śṛṇuyādvā paṭhecca vā |
tasyāpi tādṛśaṃ syācca phalaṃ vratasya niścitam || 136||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye vairājaputryā joṣṭryā anaśanādidvādaśaputrīṇāṃ sevayā dvādaśyāvratena ca prasannasya puruṣottamanārāyaṇasya prāptistredhārūpadhāraṇādika cetyādinirūpaṇanāmaikonaviṃśādhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.319 ||

<1.320>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi rādhikāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā putrīmatīṃ varām |
śrīrapi prāha deveśaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ parameśvaram || 1 ||
kānta rādhā yathā putrīmatī saṃśobhate hare |
mānyatā yāti sarvāsu putrīmatīṣu sarvathā || 2 ||
yathā tathā kadā putrīmatī syāṃ puruṣottama |
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā tu mahyaṃ vai dehi putrīṃ śubhāśrayām || 3 ||
evaṃ tayārthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ śriyaṃ tadā |
tathāstviti varaṃ datvā reme tayā sulīlayā || 4 ||
śrīkṛṣṇasyekṣaṇādeva śriyaḥ paryaṃkaśobhanā |
divyā kṛṣṇasamā rūpe saundarye śrīsamā sutā || 5 ||
prādurbabhūva sahasā jātamātrā suyauvanā |
kāmadugheva sampannā sudughā nāmataḥ kṛtā || 6 ||
śrīkṛṣṇena śriyā cāpyāhūtā sā sudugheti vai |
pradogdhi sarvakāmān sā sudughā kṛṣṇakanyakā || 7 ||
śrītulyā śrīsvarūpā ca śrīrivātisamujjvalā |
sarvāvayavapuṣṭā ca kānakīṃ chavimāśritā || 8 ||
jātamātrā nisargāt sā gavāṃ dohanakarmaṇi |
vyavasāyamayī rucyā dṛśyate gopriyā tathā || 9 ||
sā tu jātā yadā tatra mahotsavo’pyabhūnmahān |
śrīkṛṣṇasya śriyā vāse’vatārarṣisurakṛtaḥ || 10 ||
devīnāṃ nartanaṃ cāpsarasāṃ gītaṃ sunartanam |
gandharvāṇāṃ gāyanaṃ vādanaṃ cābhavanmahotsave || 11 ||
munīnāmāśiṣāmāptirabhūt kanyāsurakṣikā |
gopagopīgaṇānāṃ ca vāṇyo hyāsan suvardhikāḥ || 12 ||
tathāṃjalikusumāni nipetuḥ sudughopari |
dugdhavatkāntinivahāṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ tu kanyakāḥ || 13 ||
vayasyā jahṛṣuścāti remire ca tayā muhuḥ |
rāmayanti ramante ca viharanti tayā tu tāḥ || 14||
atha jijñāsamānā sā dughā kāryaṃ muhurmuhuḥ |
mayā kimatra kartavyaṃ mīmāṃsate hi bhāvataḥ || 15||
pitrā kṛṣṇena cādiṣṭaṃ jñātvā yogabalaṃ tathā |
ūrjāhuti dughe putri payasendramavardhatām || 16 ||
ityājñaptātisaṃhṛṣṭā sudughā pitarau tadā |
praṇamyendrasya vṛddhyarthaṃ puṣṭyarthaṃ samacintayat || 17||
yatra yatra ca goleṣu brahmāṇḍeṣu ca yādṛśam |
māhendraṃ tu padaṃ devasāmrājyaṃ vartate divi || 18 ||
tāni sarvāṇi rājyāni dhyātvā hṛdā padāni ca |
teṣāṃ śāśvatapuṣṭyarthaṃ cintayāmāsa sādhanam || 19 ||
śrīputrī sudughā cāhaṃ dugdharūpā bhavāmi ca |
divi dugdhāmṛtaṃ datvā surebhyo nivasāmi ca || 20 ||
maharādau sukṛtātmāmṛtaṃ bhūtvā vasāmi ca |
pitṛbhyo vāripiṇḍādi pāyasādi dadāmi ca || 21 ||
paśumānuṣavṛkṣebhyo dugdhāmṛtaṃ rasātmakam |
datvā puṣṭiṃ kārayāmi bhuve’pi surasāmṛtam || 22 ||
jale snehāmṛtaṃ kṛtvā pravidadhāmi poṣaṇam |
vahnaye pākamādhuryaṃ dadāmi pācanāmṛtam || 2 3 ||
ātmane dehavāsāya dadāmi viṣayāmṛtam |
indra ātmendriyāṇyasya śaktayo viṣayāśrayāḥ || 24|||
tābhiramṛtabhoktāro bhavantyātmani eva hi |
tattvagaṃ navanītaṃ ca ghṛtaṃ sarvakṛte’mṛtam ||25 ||
evaṃ bahusvarūpāhaṃ kāryātmikā bhavāmi ca |
indrasya saukhyalābhāya dughā śaktirvasāmi ca || 26||
yajñe ūrjāhutī cāhaṃ bhūtvā puṣṭiṃ karomi ca |
indrasya sarvathā rakṣā yathā syāttādṛśī tathā ||27||
bhūtvā bhūtvaiva sarvatrādyaiva kuryāṃ praveśanam |
iti vicārya sā kanyā sudughā bahurūpiṇī ||28||
babhūva dṛśyā cādṛśyā praviveśa yathāmatam |
indrasya ruciraṃ svargaṃ tataḥ smṛddhyā vyavardhata ||29 ||
sarvāmṛtāni dugdhāni vyavardhantātivegataḥ |
lokeṣu śrīmayī bhūmiḥ sampadāsīnmanoramā || 3 0||
devā devyo vyarājanta pūrvato’pyadhikādhikam |
vyayamānā bhujyamānā api sarvāḥ susampadaḥ ||3 1||
na viyanti manāṅ nāpi kṣīyante sudughānvayāt |
adṛṣṭā cāśrutā sampad babhūvānandasammukhā ||3 2||
evaṃ yāte śubhe kāle yāte cādye kṛte yuge |
ṛṣirmānyo’bhavannāmnā medhāvī yājñiko mahān ||3 3 ||
yajñān karoti vidhibhiḥ kārayatyapi vṛṣṭaye |
putrādyarthaṃ sukhādyartha svargārthaṃ sukṛtāptaye ||34||
putraputrīyugalārthaṃ putreṣṭiṃ sa cakāra vai |
viṣṇurnārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇo bahvāvirbabhūva ha ||35 ||
jagrāha svakarābhyāṃ supuroḍāśaṃ tadarpitam |
uvāca ca prasanno’smi varaṃ vṛṇu yathepsitam || 36 ||
pṛthvīṃ rājyaṃ rasān miṣṭaṃ dugdhaṃ svargaṃ sutaṃ sutām |
yathecchasi tathā tubhyaṃ dadāmi kuru mā ciram ||37||
śrutvā viprastu medhāvī prāha putraṃ pradehi me |
yajñaḥ putreṣṭināmāsau putrārthaṃ vartito mayā ||38||
bhagavān prāha putraste saptajanmasu nāsti vai |
putreṣṭyā jāyate putraścirāyuṣṭre tu saṃśayaḥ |||3 9||
janmanā yastu sukhado’nantaraṃ duḥkhado mṛteḥ |
tasmād vipra vṛṇu putrīṃ yadi cet te prarocate || 40 ||
tava patnyā bhālarekhā putryarthā bhāti cānagha |
putrādapyadhikā kīrtau sevāyāṃ sā bhaviṣyati ||4 1 ||
yayā śoko na vai syācca tathā kuru mahīsura |
patnīmataṃ samādāya vipro jagrāha tadvacaḥ ||42||
tato bhagavatā dattaḥ prasādo bhojanāya vai |
gṛhītvāha hariṃ vipraḥ putrī śrīsadṛśī mama ||43||
sukhadā nātha bhavatu śāntā kāmadugheva sā |
yā śaktiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sudhāpānapradāyinī ||44||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha prairayacchrīsutāṃ dughām |
medhāvinastu putryarthaṃ sudughāpi tadājñayā ||45||
prāvirbabhūva medhāvibhāryāyāḥ śayane tadā |
mānasī sābhavad divyā śobhate śrīrivāparā ||46||
jātamātrātisaṃśobhiyauvanā puṣṭisaṃbhṛtā |
rūpalāvaṇyalalitā nayanāpāṃgamocinī ||47||

ati vai vallabhā pitroḥ sarvasadguṇasundarī ||48||

nītisāhityakuśalā cātmatattvaviśāradā ||49||

kālena gacchatā lakṣmi tanmātā nidhanaṃ gatā ||50||

yuvatyahaṃ sakhīmadhye kumārī duḥkhavedinī ||54||

evaṃ cintākulāṃ bālāṃ vijñāyāpi ca tatpitā ||5 5 ||
medhāvī vicacārorvyāṃ vicinvan tatsamaṃ varam |
aprāpya bhagnasaṃkalpo jvaraṃ tīvramavāpa saḥ ||5 6 ||
āgacchanneva bhavanaṃ harau cittamadhārayat |
sasmāra śrīhariṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam ||57||

kare dhṛtvā muniṃ taṃ te yayuḥ kṛṣṇasaroruham ||58||
prāṇotkramaṇamālokya hāheti sā sutārudat |
aṃke kṛtvā piturdehaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitā ||5 9 ||
hā hā pitaḥ kathaṃ mātṛhīnāṃ tyaktvā nijāṃ sutām |
pitṛhīnāṃ tathā kṛtvā hyanāthāṃ kva gato’si vai ||6 0 ||
na bhrātā naiva bandhuśca na mātā na ca rakṣakaḥ |
kathaṃ tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ tāta mariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ||6 1 ||
ityādirodanaṃ śrutvā tāpasāstatra cāyayuḥ |
mṛtaṃ muniṃ dadṛśuste saśokā dadahustataḥ ||62||
samāśvāsya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ sarve te svālayān yayuḥ|
kanyā dhairyaṃ samālambyākarocchaktyaurdhvadaihikam ||63||
gate kāle bhāgyavaśād durvāsāḥ śāṃkaro muniḥ |
samāyāttadgṛhaṃ lakṣmi bhaviṣyadbalanoditaḥ ||64||
tamālokya samāyāntaṃ kumārī caraṇau muneḥ |
vavandārghyādibhiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayāmāsa sādaram ||65||
namaste’stvatriputrāya kuto’dhigamanaṃ mune |
mama bhāgyodayo jāto bhavattīrthaniṣevayā ||66||
adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ tvadya me vratam |
adya me phalavatpuṇyaṃ yad bhavādṛśadarśanam ||67||
śrutvāha tāṃ tu durvāsāḥ sādhu svasti sute tava |
kailāsādahamāgacchaṃ gacchāmi badarīvanam ||68||
draṣṭuṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ tvayārthaścennivedyatām |
medhāvatī ṛṣiṃ prāha nānāvedyaṃ prabhormanāk ||69||
ataḥ paraṃ śubhaṃ bhāvi tvaddarśanādanugrahāt |
na mātā na pitā bandhurna kaścid rakṣako’sti me ||70||
na māṃ kāmayate kaścit pāṇigrahaṇahetave |
brahman mumūrṣurasmyeva kiṃ karomi hitaṃ kuru ||7 1||
śrutvā munirupāyaṃ suvircāyākathayat sutām |
itastṛtīyaḥ subhage māsastu puruṣottamaḥ ||72||
tatra snātā janastīrthe mucyate brahmahatyayā |
etattulyo na ko’pyanyo māsottamo hi vidyate ||73||
sarve māsāstathā pakṣāḥ parvāṇi ṛtavastathā |
puruṣottamamāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||74||
sādhanāni samastāni gaṃgā godāplavāni ca |
sahasrāṇyadhimāsasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīm ||75||
śrīkṛṣṇavallabho māso nāmnā ca puruṣottamaḥ |
tasmin saṃsevite bāle sarvaṃ siddhyati vāñcchitam ||76||
tasmānniṣevayāśu tvaṃ māsaṃ taṃ puruṣottamam |
mayāpi sevate putri puruṣottamavat sadā ||77||
yadi cediṣṭamāptavyaṃ yathāruci kuru vratam |
ahaṃ putri gamiṣyāmi naranārāyaṇālayam ||78||
ityuktvā prayayau śīghraṃ hyatha medhāvatī tataḥ |
adhimāsapratīkṣāḍhyā tatkālaphaladaṃ śivam ||79||
citte dhṛtvā tamuddiśya cacāra duścaraṃ tapaḥ |
divā paṃcāgnimadhyasthā rātrau śītajalasthitā ||80||
anāhārā haradhyānā samādhāviva tiṣṭhati |
santuṣṭastapasā tasyā bhagavānpārvatīpatiḥ ||8 1||
darśayāmāsa bālāyai svaṃ rūpaṃ cākṣigocaram |
sā vavande haraṃ puṣpādibhiḥ pupūja mānasaiḥ ||8 2||
tuṣṭāva bhaktibhāvena hyāśutoṣāya te namaḥ |
anādhārasutādhāraśaṃkarāya ca te namaḥ ||8 3 ||
namaḥ sūryāgnisomatrinetrāya mṛtyave namaḥ |
pārvatītāpasīvāñcchāpūrakāyeha te namaḥ ||84||
kumāryāścāpyanāthāyā uddhāraṃ kuru śaṃkara |
iti stutvā punarnatvā virarāmarṣiputrikā ||85 ||
śrutvā prasannavadanastāmuvāca sadāśivaḥ |
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te prasanno’smi dadāmi te ||86||
bālovāca dayāsindho prasannaścenmamopari |
patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ dehi patiṃ patim ||87||
ityāśrutya mahādevo jagādarṣisutāṃ tadā |

idānīṃ paṃcasaṃkhyākā indrāḥ prākkalpasaṃbhavāḥ |
vasanti satyaloke te bhavantu patayaḥ sute || 9 0||
anenaiva hi dehena divyatāṃ prāpitena vai |
mayā sāhāyyadenādyāgaccha satye tadantikam || 91 ||

nināya satyalokaṃ vai mārge medhāvatīṃ divi || 92||
śuśrāva dundubhiṃ divyaṃ kurvantu vratamuttamam |
trayodaśyadhimāsasya yatheṣṭaphaladā bhavet || 93 ||
patiprāptirmama prāptirbhavedekavratena vai |
śrutvā medhāvatī prāha kṛṣṇaprāptiḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 94||
śrutvā tu dundubhiṃ cainaṃ jijñāsā jāyate mama |
tathā kuru yathā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo milenmama || 95 ||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha śubhe putri kalyāṇaṃ te’stu sarvathā |
prasanno’smi tava vākyāt kṛṣṇaprāptiparāyaṇāt || 96 ||
rājyaṃ svargaṃ pārameṣṭhyaṃ caiśvaraṃ padameva vā |

bhaktyā sa labhyate kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ pumān |
kuru vrataṃ trayodaśyā yathādundubhibhāṣitam || 98 ||
upavāsaṃ phalāhāraṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśavastubhiḥ |
pūjayetparamātmānaṃ bhojayellālayettathā || 99 ||
rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kuryāt sarvaṃ dadet pratoṣitaḥ |
ityuktvā tāṃ satyalokaṃ gamayitvendrapañcakam || 100 ||
datvā patnīsvarūpeṇa punaḥ prāha sutāṃ haraḥ |
puruṣottamamāsasya trayodaśyā vratena vai || 10 1 ||
miliṣyati haristvāṃ vai mānuṣe kṛtavigrahe |
ayonisaṃbhavā tatra bhaviṣyasi tapobalāt || 10 2||
tatraite pañcabhartāro bhaviṣyanti surāṃśajāḥ |
dharmamarunmahendrāśvinīkumārāṃśasabhavāḥ || 103 ||
śrīpatistu tadā kṛṣṇo miliṣyati ca rakṣakaḥ |
bhartṛjaṃ sukhamāsādya tato gantrī paraṃ padam || 1 04||
puruṣottamabhaktāstu putrāpautradhanānvitāḥ |

vadannevaṃ nīlakaṇṭhaḥ kṣipramantardadhe haraḥ || 106 ||

pañcāmṛtairjalaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃsnāpya puruṣottamam |

ārārtrikādikaṃ kṛtvā yayāce parameśvarāt || 10 9||
darśanaṃ dehi me tāta bhave sāhāyyado bhava |
tāvattatra samāyāto garuḍasthaḥ śriyaḥ patiḥ || 110 ||

rakṣayiṣye sadā putri saha sthāsye yathāvanam || 111 ||
punaḥ provāca sā putrī mokṣo me syād yathā guro |
tathānte me bhavettāta nānyaṃ kāṃkṣe manoratham || 11 2||
tathāstviti hariḥ prāha prāha cāpi viśeṣataḥ |
śṛṇu putri dvāparānte kṛṣṇo’haṃ bhagavān svayam || 113 ||

yajñasenākhyanṛpateryajñakuṇḍasya madhyataḥ || 1 14||

yājñasenī ca vairājī kṛṣṇā khyātā bhaviṣyasi || 11 5||
tatraiva ca same kāle pañcendrāḥ svāminastava |
bhaviṣyanti surāṃśāste patayo’mitavikramāḥ || 1 1 6||
taddvārā tvanmiṣaṃ kṛtvāsurāndaityām̐śca dānavān |
nāśayitvā svakaṃ dhāma yadā yāsye tadā sute || 11 7||
nayiṣye tvāṃ yathākālaṃ yathākāryaṃ niruddhya ca |
punastvaṃ prāpsyase dhāma golokaṃ yatra te januḥ || 1 18||
tadā tvāṃ sudughe putri tanvā brāhmyākṣare pare |
dhāmni saṃprāpayiṣye maccaraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ sukham || 11 9||
iti te kathitaṃ putri bhaviṣyatte kathānakam |
satye sukhaṃ vasa putri yāmyahaṃ ca mamālayam || 1 20||
ityuktvādṛśyatāṃ yātastadā śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
sudughā kṛṣṇaputrī sā yājñasenī bhaviṣyati || 12 1||
adhimāsaparapakṣatrayodaśyā vratena sā |
prāpsyatīyaṃ paraṃ dhāma puruṣottamavākyataḥ || 122||
iti te kathitaṃ lakṣmi śrīputryāstu kathānakam |
te dhanyā janmavantaśca te pūjyāḥ pāvanāstathā || 1 23||
vividhairniyamairyaistu pūjitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
śravaṇātpaṭhanāccāpi vratasyātra phalaṃ labhet || 124||
labhate kṛṣṇasāhāyyaṃ puruṣottamasammatam |
bhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheccāpi naro nārī paro’pi vā || 1 25||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīya saṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye goloke śrīputryāḥ sudughāyāḥ śrīkṛṣṇājñayā indravṛddhyarthaṃ pravṛttāyā rasāmṛtātmakatā yājñikasya medhāviviprasya gṛhe’yonijāyāstasyā janma pitrormaraṇaṃ durvāsasa āgamanaṃ puruṣottamamāsavratopadeśaḥ śaṃkaropari tapaḥ pañcakṛtvaḥ patiprārthanam satyaloke pañcendrapatiprāptiḥ trayodaśīvratena puruṣottamadarśanaṃ bhuvi pañcapatimatī yājñasenī bhūtvā mokṣaṃ yāsyasītivaradānaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā viṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||1.320 ||

<1.321>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi caturdaśyā vratena nṛpasattamaḥ |
citradharmasya satputro dṛḍhadhanveti viśrutaḥ || 1 ||
prāpad rājyaṃ putrapautrān lalanāṃ ca pativratām |
ante ca bhagavallokamavāpa yogidurlabham || 2 ||
sarvasadguṇasampanno dṛṣṭavān vedapāragaḥ |
prajārakṣākaraḥ putro babhūveti ca tatpitā || 3 ||
vicārya citradharmā taṃ svarājye tvabhyaṣecayat |
atha cārādhayāmīśaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum || 4 ||
tadarthaṃ vanabhūmirvai yogyā bhavati sarvathā |
dhruvāmbarīṣaśaryātiyayātiśaśabindavaḥ || 5 ||
bhagīratha śibi rantideva rukmāṃgadādayaḥ |
divodāsābhayakhaṭvāṃgadarājarṣisattamāḥ || 6 ||
ete cānye ca kalpeṣu kalpāntareṣu bhūbhṛtaḥ |
vanaṃ yayurmahāsattvāstyaktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ || 7 ||
adhruveṇa dhruvaṃ prāptā ārādhya puruṣottamam |
ato mayāpi kartavyamaraṇye harisevanam || 8 ||
chitvā pāśaṃ vāsanākhyaṃ dārāputragṛhādiṣu |
iti niścitya manasā citradharmā yayau vanam || 9 ||
pulahāśramamāsādya tapastepe hariṃ smaran |
śuddho bhūtvā divyatanurharerdhāma jagāma saḥ || 10 ||
dṛḍhadhanvā pituścaurdhvadaihikaṃ cākarottataḥ |
puṣkarāvartanagare rājadhānīṃ vidhāya saḥ || 11 ||
bhāryayā guṇasundaryā vaidarbhyā saha bhūpatiḥ |
śaśāsa sakalāṃ pṛthvīṃ caturbhistanayaiḥ saha || 1 2||
citravākcitravāṭcitrakuṇḍalamaṇikuṇḍalaiḥ |
ekadā niśi suptasya cintāsīd dṛḍhadhanvanaḥ || 13 ||
dānaṃ tapo japaṃ homaṃ nāhaṃ vai kṛtavān kvacit |
tathāpi vaibhavā rājyaṃ kena bhāgyena me nanu || 14||
brāhme muhūrte utthāya sa rājā mṛgayāmanāḥ |
jagāmāśvaṃ samāruhyāraṇye vai sarasastaṭam || 15||
samāgamadvaṭe tatra kaścinmānuṣavāk śukaḥ |
sa tu papāṭha suślokamekameva punaḥ punaḥ || 16 ||
satyapi vaibhave rājye dehādau sukhade tathā |
na cintayasi lakṣmīśaṃ kathaṃ pāraṃ sameṣyasi || 17||
śrutvā rājā kīravākyaṃ mumude bhavatārakam |
kṛtvā tu mṛgayāṃ rājā kīravākyaṃ vicārayan || 18 ||
ājagāma gṛhaṃ tāvat tatra vālmīkirāyayau |
rājā prapūjya vālmīkiṃ papraccha kīrabhāṣitam || 19 ||
kimuvāca kathaṃ prāha ko’sāvāsīcchuko mune |
śrutvā kṣaṇaṃ ca taddhyātvā vālmīkirāha bhūpatim || 20 ||
śṛṇu rājam̐stava pūrvajanmanaścaritaṃ yathā |
tāmraparṇītaṭe deśe draviḍe tvaṃ dvijo’bhavaḥ || 21 ||
sudevākhyaśca te patnīṃ gautamī gautamodbhavā |
aprajā sā patiṃ prāhāpatyaṃ vinā suduḥkhitā || 22 ||
santatiḥ śuddhavaṃśyā syādatra paratra śarmaṇe |
tamaprāpya varaṃ putraṃ jīvitaṃ tvatra niṣphalam || 23 ||
tasmātsatputralābhārthamāvābhyāṃ parameśvaraḥ |
ārādhanīyaḥ satataṃ tapasā puruṣottamaḥ || 24||
dharmapatnyā vaco matvā tāmraparṇītaṭe śubhe |
śuṣkaparṇajalāhārau paṃcame paṃcame dine || 25 ||
catvāryabdasahasrāṇi ceratuḥ paramaṃ tapaḥ |
lokāścakampire tena prādurbabhūva mādhavaḥ ||26 ||
garuḍastho hariḥ prāha sudeva bhadramastu te |
gautami śrīrastu te’pi kurutaṃ mā tapo bahu ||27||
śrutvā tau nematuḥ kṛṣṇamūcaturjaya mādhava |
sudevaḥ prāha bhagavan putraṃ dehi hare prabho ||28||
hariḥ prāha lalāṭe te varṇāḥ sarve mayekṣitāḥ |
tatra naivāsti te putrasukhaṃ saptasu janmasu ||29||
gautamyuvāca bhāgyāgre ramānātho nirarthakaḥ |
daivamālaṃbanīyaṃ cet hariṇā kiṃ prayojanam ||3 0||
śrutvā hariṃ garuḍastu prāha kṛṣṇaṃ janārdanam |
bhaktaduḥkhāsahiṣṇo tvaṃ haryarthaṃ sārthakaṃ kuru ||3 1 ||
tvadārādhanamāhātmyaṃ niṣphalaṃ naiva naiva hi |
kartumakartuṃ sāmarthyaṃ mā kuru tvaṃ nirarthakam ||3 2||
garuḍasyāgrahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathāstvityavadaddhariḥ |
paraṃ tajjanitaṃ duḥkhaṃ dampatyorbhavitā dhruvam ||3 3 ||
ityuktvā garuḍe sthitvā golokaṃ harirāyayau |
gate kāle sudevasya patnyāṃ putro’bhavacchubhaḥ ||34||
vyavardhata gate kāle copanīto’tha pāṭhitaḥ |
devalarṣiḥ kvacittatra samāyāt pāpanāśanaḥ ||35||
karaṃ dṛṣṭvā chatrapadmayavacāmaracihnitam |
sphuṭadāyuṣyarekhaṃ ca prāhādhunvan śirastadā ||36||
sudeva tanayo’yaṃ te dvādaśe hāyane jale |
mṛtyumeṣyati tasmātte māstu śoko’nubhāvini || 37||
śrutvā śuśūcatustau ca devalo niryayau tataḥ |
atha prāpte’niṣṭakāle’gacchadvāpīṃ hi tatsutaḥ || 38||
patito’gādhatoye’sau mamajja ca mamāra ca |
jñātvā putrasya nidhanaṃ vayasyebhyaḥ pitā prasūḥ ||39||
yayatustatra saṃgṛhya śavaṃ rurudaturbahu |
vilāpaṃ cakratuścāti tatyajaturjalānnakam ||40||
śrīkṛṣṇavallabho māsaḥ so’bhavatpuruṣottamaḥ |
ajānatostayorāsītpuruṣottamasevanam ||41||

sapatnīko namaścakre daṇḍavacchrīhariṃ dvijaḥ ||42||
hariḥ prāha sudeva tvaṃ bhāgyavānasi sāmpratam |
dvādaśābdasahasrāyuḥ putraste’yaṃ kṛto mayā ||43||
puruṣottamamāhātmyāt prasannena mayā dvija |
suciraṃ jīvito’yaṃ hi tanayaḥ sukhado’stu te ||44||
gārhasthyamatulaṃ bhuktvā saha putreṇa sarvadā |
tatastvaṃ brahmaṇo lokaṃ gatvā tatra mahat sukham ||45 ||
divyābdavarṣasāhasraṃ bhuktvā gantāsi bhūtale |
tato rājā cakravartī dṛḍhadhanvā bhaviṣyasi ||46 ||
samvatsarāṇāmayutaṃ rājyaṃ bhokṣyasi pārthivam |
gautamīyaṃ tava patnī nāmnā tu guṇasundarī || 47 |
putrāścatvāra ekā ca kanyā te tatra bhāvinaḥ |
yadā viramase māṃ tvaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ||48 ||
ayaṃ te tanayo vipra śuko bhūtvā tadā vane |
bodhayiṣyati bhaktestu vākyaṃ kṛṣṇavicintakam || 49 ||
vālmīkistvāṃ kathāṃ sarvāṃ yathārthāṃ kathayiṣyati |
tato vairāgyamāpannaḥ kṛtvā bhaktiṃ parāṃ hareḥ ||5 0 ||
gamiṣyasi sapatnīko mokṣaṃ paraṃ hareḥ padam |
vadatyevaṃ mahāviṣṇau samuttasthau dvijātmajaḥ || 51 ||
dampatī taṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahānandau babhūvatuḥ |
nanāma śukadevo’pi śrīhariṃ pitarau tu tau || 52 ||
garuḍo brāhmaṇaścāpi nemurhariṃ sabhāryakaḥ |
kṛṣṇaḥ prāhādhimāsasyānāyāsenāpi pālanāt |5 3 ||
sutadārāpatipatnīkṣetrarājyasukhāni vai |
bhavantyeva na sandehaḥ kimu putrasajīvanam ||54||
ekamapyupavāsaṃ yaḥ karoti puruṣottame |
dagdhvānantānyaniṣṭāni labdhvā puṇyanidhīn sa tu |55 ||
surayānaṃ samāruhya vaikuṇṭhaṃ yāti dehavān |
ekataḥ sarvapuṇyāni tvekataḥ puruṣottamam ||56||
tolayāmāsa vedho’bhūd gururvai puruṣottamaḥ |
īśasṛṣṭau jīvasṛṣṭau brahmasṛṣṭāvapi svayam || 57 |
puruṣottamamāsastu sarvatra vartate mahān |
tasya vai pālanenātra vijayaste bhaviṣyati |58 |
ityuktvā śrīharirdhāma yayau garuḍavāhanaḥ |
sudevaḥ saḥ sapatnīkastaṃ māsaṃ samapūjayat ||59 |
bhuktvātha viṣayān sarvān sahasrābdānyaharniśam |
jagāma brahmaṇo lokaṃ sapatnīko dvijottamaḥ |60 |
tatratyaṃ sukhamāsādya sapatnīko bhuvaṃ gataḥ |
sa eva dṛḍhadhanvā tvaṃ prathitaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 61 ||
mahiṣīyaṃ tava patnī gautamī guṇasundarī |
śukadevaśca te putro hariṇā yo’nujīvitaḥ | 62 ||
dvādaśābdasahasrāyurbhuktvā vaikuṇṭhameyivān |
sa eva vai śuko bhūtvābodhayat tvāṃ smṛtiṃ hareḥ ||6 3 ||
punnāmanarakāt trātā putraste sārthako’bhavat |
ityetat kathitaṃ rājan prāgvṛttaṃ te yathā hyabhūt ||64||

vālmīkistvāha taṃ sarvaṃ vidhiṃ vistarato nṛpam ||65 ||

tato vrajennairṛtāśāṃ śaucārthaṃ jalabhājanaḥ ||66 ||
karṇe kṛtvā brahmasūtraṃ śaucaṃ mūtraṃ visarjayet |
jalenendriyayugalaṃ prakṣālya mṛjjalādibhiḥ ||67||
gandhalepakṣayaśuddhiṃ kṛtvā gaṇḍūṣakān bahūn |
dantaśuddhiṃ tathā kṛtvā snāyāttīrthādivāriṣu ||68 ||
āyurbalaṃ yaśo varcaḥ prajā paśuvasūni ca |
brahma prajñā ca medhā ca vardhante snāyino’nvaham ||69||
śuddhe vastre paridhāya prāṅmukho baddhasaṃśikhaḥ |
sapavitreṇa hastena kuryādācamana tataḥ ||70 ||
ūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ sabinduṃ ca kuryāccandanamṛtsnayā |
śaṃkhacakrādi kuryācca dhārayet tulasīsrajam ||7 1 ||
prāṇāyāmaṃ tathā sandhyāṃ gāyatrījapanaṃ caret |
śucau deśe gomayena maṇḍalaṃ taṇḍulādibhiḥ ||72 ||
kārayitvā ca tanmadhye kalaśaṃ sajale nyaset |
kalaśasya mukhe viṣṇuḥ kaṇṭhe rudraḥ sadā sthitaḥ ||73 ||
tasya mūle sthito brahmā madhye tiṣṭhanti mātaraḥ |
kukṣau tiṣṭhanti bhūdvīpasahitāḥ sapta sāgarāḥ ||74||
tiṣṭhanti ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvāṇo’ṅgayutāstathā |
gaṃgā godāvarī sauryā kāverī ca sarasvatī ||75||
tiṣṭhantvatra jale nadyaḥ pāpanāśavidhāyikāḥ |
candanākṣatapuṣpāṇi samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ ||76 ||
naivedyaṃ phalatāmbūle samarpayāmi oṃ namaḥ |
ityabhyarcya tataḥ śaṃkhaṃ pūjayedakṣatādibhiḥ ||77||
ghaṇṭāṃ ca pūjayed ramyāmakṣataiḥ kuṃkumādibhiḥ |
pātraṃ ghaṭopari nyasyet tilayukśarkarānvitam ||78||
pītāmbaraṃ śubhaṃ cāpi haimaṃ rādhāyutaṃ harim |
puruṣottamamāsasya daivataṃ taṃ prapūjayet ||79||
analottāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kurvīta prāṇadhāraṇām |
spṛṣṭvā dvau tatkapālau tu dakṣiṇena kareṇa vai ||8 0 ||
datvā ca hṛdaye’ṅguṣṭhaṃ prāṇām̐statra sudhārayet |
asyai prāṇāḥ pratiṣṭhantu cāsyai prāṇāḥ kṣarantu ca ||8 1 ||
asyai devatvayuktāyai svāhā nārāyaṇāya vai |
dhyāyed devaṃ tata āvāhayennāthaṃ hṛdi sthitam ||8 2||
āvāhayāmi rādhāśrīsahitaṃ puruṣottamam |
āsanaṃ cārpayāmyasmai śrīkṛṣṇāya tu śārṅgiṇe ||8 3 ||
samarpayāmi salilaṃ pādaprakṣālanāya te |
arghyaṃ phalānvitaṃ caivārpayāmi paramātmane ||84||
tīrthajalānyācamanaṃ te’rpayāmi rādhikāpate |
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cārpayāmi te ||85||
pañcasnānaṃ jalasnānaṃ tathā te kārayāmyaham |
pītadhautraṃ cottarīyaṃ samarpayāmi keśava ||86||
kaustubhaṃ brahmasūtraṃ ca bhūṣāṃ dadāmi te prabho |
sugandhatailasārādi candanaṃ cārpayāmi te ||87||
kuṃkumākṣatapuṣpāṇi cārpayāni gṛhāṇa vai |

dīpaṃ ghṛtojjvalaṃ tubhyaṃ cārpayāmi hare prabho |
pāyasādyaṃ ca naivedyaṃ samarpayāmi keśava ||89||

haviṣyabhojanaṃ kuryād vratī devaprasādakam |
godhūmāḥ śālayo mudgā yavāstilāśca śarkarāḥ ||95||

tṛṣitaṃ ca mumūrṣum̐ ca hyugradevaṃ dvijaṃ tadā || 1 15||
