<1.322>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmyadhimāsānte dine tvakṣaradhāmani |
kṛtamudyāpanaṃ sarvaiḥ puruṣottamamandire || 1 ||
rādhākṛṣṇādayaḥ sarve golokasthāḥ samāyayuḥ |
vāsudevādayo vyūhāḥ svaprajābhiḥ samāyayuḥ || 2 ||
mahāvaikuṇṭhalokasthā vayaṃ nārāyaṇādayaḥ |
tvayā saha prajābhiśca gatā abhūma cākṣaram || 3 ||
avyākṛtāmṛtadhāmabhūmaśrīpuratatstriyaḥ |
nyāyeśvarādayaḥ sarve mudā tatra yayustadā || 4 ||
mahāviṣṇuprabhṛtayo hiraṇyagarbhasṛṣṭayaḥ |
pravairājāścāvaraṇā īśvarā jagmurakṣaram || 5 ||
viṣṇorjalāvaraṇordhvavaikuṇṭhasthā yayustathā |
sadāśivasya dhāmasthā mahāmāyāprajā yayuḥ || 6 ||
evaṃ ta īśvarāścāvatārā gatvākṣaraṃ param |
cakrurudyāpanaṃ tatra puruṣottamamāsikam || 7 ||
brahmaṇaḥ satyaloke carṣayo munijanāstathā |
mātṛgaṇāḥ pitaraśca devā jagmuśca vaiṣṇavaḥ || 8 ||
udyāpanaprakartāro divyā yayurnarādayaḥ |
tīrthāni devatāḥ sarvā devyo jagmurdiśastathā || 9 ||
tattvānyapi yayustatra saritaḥ sindhavastathā |
parvatāśca tathākhātā dvīpāḥ khaṇḍā yayustathā || 1 0||
grahāstārāśca nakṣatramaṇḍala vṛkṣavallayaḥ |
divyā vai bhaktavaryāstu daityā dānavarākṣasāḥ || 11 ||
oṣadhayastathā sarpā nāgāḥ patattrayo’malāḥ |
jalavāsāḥ sthalavāsā vāyuvāsā yayustadā || 1 2||
pātālasthā vivarasthā divyādivyā yayustadā |
vratinaḥ sahavāsāśca bhaktā udyāpanaṃkṛte || 13 ||
satye paitāmahe loke sannidhau yayurādarāt |
puruṣottamamāsasyodyāpanārthaṃ yayuśca te || 14||
gandharvāḥ kinnarāḥ sūtādayaśca suramānavāḥ |
bhaṭṭacāraṇabhṛtyāśca raudrā api ca śāṃkarāḥ || 15||
ete cānye vratapūrtiphalārthaṃ cotsave gatāḥ |
śṛṇu lakṣmi tatra tatra yathāśakti yathādhanam || 16 ||
kṛtamudyāpanaṃ sarvaiḥ sarveṣṭasiddhidāyakam |
bhuktimuktipradaṃ dravyadānapūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ tu taiḥ || 17||
śṛṇu taistu kṛtamudyāpanaṃ saṃśrāvayāmi te |
puruṣottamamāsasya yaduktaṃ hariṇā svayam || 18 ||
pakṣadvaye caturdaśyāmamāyāṃ pūrṇimātithau |
ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā vratāhe’ṣṭamikātithau || 1 9||
yatra tithau bhavedānukūlyaṃ tatrāpi vā tithau |
udyāpanaṃ prakuryādvai vratasampūrtihetave || 2 0 ||
puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiśca sthale sthale |
uddhoṣayati gatvaiva kurvantūdyāpanaṃ śubham || 2 1||
puruṣottamamāsasya phalaṃ pūrṇaṃ bhaviṣyati |
śrutvāpi ḍiṇḍamaṃ cānye cakrurudyāpanaṃ gṛhe || 22||
rātrau bhūśāyino bhūtvā brahmacaryaṃ prarakṣya ca |
prātarutthāya te sarve cakrurdhyānaṃ harestataḥ || 23 ||
kṛtvā śaucādikāḥ sarvā daihikīrbāhyataḥ kriyāḥ |
divyādivyaṃ yathāvarṣma kṛtvā snānādikaṃ tataḥ ||24||
japaṃ homaṃ tathā sandhyāṃ svādhyāyaṃ tarpaṇādikam |
yathālokaṃ yathāvarṣma yathāyogyaṃ vidhāya te || 25 ||
nityāṃ pūjāṃ vṛddhapūjāṃ kṛtvā pūjyārhaṇādikam |
ācamya ca bhuvaṃ kṛtvā saṃskṛtāṃ bahuvistarām || 26|||
cakruśca maṇḍapaṃ tatra bahustaṃbhasamanvitam |
ratnahīrakahārādyairāmrāśokāditoraṇaiḥ || 27||
kadalīstambhapatrādyaiḥ kalpavallyāstaroḥ phalaiḥ |
kalaśaiḥ raṃgavallībhiścāmbaraiḥ kānakānvitaiḥ || 28 ||
bandhayitvā pradīpaiśca śobhayitvā sugandhibhiḥ |
vāsayitvā ca tanmadhye pañcadhānyaiśca saptabhiḥ || 2 9||
dhānyairvā kārayitvaiva sarvatobhadramaṇḍalam |
sapatnīkān viṣṇubhaktān nimantrya ca yathābalam || 30 ||
nyasuścaturaḥ kalaśām̐ścaturdikṣu ca maṇḍale |
suvastraśrīphalapūgīnāgavallīdalānvitān ||3 1 ||
tatrākṣatān pūrayitvā śarkarādravyamiśritān |
vāsudevaṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ pradyumnaṃ cāniruddhakam ||3 2||
īśānataḥ kramānnyasya madhye ca kalaśe śubhe |
saphale sāmbare pūgīsvarṇamudrākṣatānvite || 3 3||
pañcaratnayute svarṇe nyadhuḥ śrīpuruṣottamam |
rādhālakṣmyādisahitaṃ sauvarṇe divyarūpiṇam || 34||
evaṃ tairvratibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpanaṃ śrīhareḥ kṛtam |
ācāryaśca gurustatra pūjanārthaṃ praveśitaḥ || 35||
dehaśuddhiḥ kāritā ca yajamānasya tena vai |
tata āvāhito devaścāsanaṃ ca pradāpitaḥ || 36||
pādaprakṣālanārtha vai dattaṃ jalaṃ sutīrthajam |
caturdikṣu kṛtā dīpāḥ sugandhastatra kāritaḥ ||37||
arghyaṃ phalādibhiryuktaṃ dampatyā ca samarpitam |
ācamanīyasalilaṃ dattaṃ devāya tīrthajam || 38 ||
dadhi dugdhaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ śarkarā cāmṛtaṃ tathā |
abhiṣeka jalasnānaṃ dattāni keśavāya vai || 3 9||
vastreṇa mārjito devau vastrābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ |
gandhasārottaratailasugandhādyaiḥ suvāsitaḥ ||40 ||
kuṃkumakajjalacūrṇacandanādyaiḥ suśobhitaḥ |
maṇihīrakamauttikahāropavītabhūṣitaḥ ||4 1 ||
kirīṭakuṇḍalakaṭakormikāśṛṃkhalānvitaḥ |
chatrayaṣṭinaktakacāmarapattrāṇarakṣitaḥ ||42||
paryaṃka genduka kaśipvā darśādi pradāpitaḥ |
puṣpatulasīpadmādyaiḥ puṇḍraiścandraiḥ suśobhitaḥ ||43 ||
atha tanmaṇḍape tāmrapātre homaśca kāritaḥ |
caturthyantairnāmamantraistilairghṛtena satphalaiḥ ||44||
aṣṭottaraśatavāraṃ tataśca tarpaṇaṃ kṛtam |
devāśca pitaraśceti tṛpyantāṃ puruṣottamaḥ ||45||
atha nīrājito devo bahuvartyanalaistathā |
namaskṛtaḥ stutaḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtaśca vaiṣṇavaiḥ ||46||
daṇḍavatsatkṛtaścāpi dhyātaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
kṣamāpito hariḥ puṣpāṃjalirdattaśca śārṅgiṇe ||47||
atha saṃbhojito devo miṣṭānnaistarpito’mṛtaiḥ |
arpitaśca jalairmiṣṭaphalaistāmbūlacarvitaḥ ||48 ||
sugandhairudvartitaśca karayoḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
svāsthyairviśramito devaḥ pādayorabhivāhitaḥ ||49||
evaṃ sarvaiḥ pūjitaśca bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
āvirbhūto’dṛśyatāgre phalantvanantakaṃ dadau ||5 0 ||
athācāryāya saṃdattā dakṣiṇā hemarūpyakā |
dhenudānaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpi svarṇaśṛṃgārabhūṣitam ||5 1 ||
ghṛtavastratilapātraṃ dattaṃ viprāya tatra ca |
pratimā ca pradattā saṃhitāśāstraṃ samarpitam ||52 ||
kāṃsyāni saṃpuṭātmāni triṃśaddattāni vai tadā |
tadā triṃśattriṃśadapūpaiśca madhye sampūritāni vai ||53 ||
etadbrahmāṇḍadānaṃ vai kalpitaṃ puruṣottame |
pratyaṅgaṃ tu yāvanti chidrāṇi santi padmaje ||54||
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi vaikuṇṭhe vasatirbhavet |
tato vasatirgoloke tato dhāmnyakṣare pare ||55 ||
athavāpūpasāmagryapakvā deyā dvijanmane |
atha saṃbhojitā viprāḥ santaḥ sādhyaśca bālakāḥ ||56||
pāyasānnaiśca miṣṭānnairvyañjanaiścāmṛtādibhiḥ |
caturdhā bhojanairbhakṣyabhojyalehyasucoṣyakaiḥ ||57||
rasairdugdhādibhirvārbhiḥ śarkarailādimiśritaiḥ |
tato jalaṃ mukhaśuddhistāmbūlakaṃ ca dakṣiṇā ||58||
vastrāṇyābharaṇānyuttamottamānyarpitāni vai |
devībhyo devatābhyaśca gurubhyo’pyarpitāni ca ||59 ||
tattallokaja tattvāni dānayogyāni yāni vai |
bhūtebhya āśritebhyaścātithibhyo’nnaṃ samarpitam || 60 ||
tato bhuktaṃ svajanaiśca saha vratibhirādarāt |
phalāhārādikaṃ yogyaṃ vratabhaṃgākaraṃ hi yat ||6 1 ||
madhyāhne’pi kṛtaṃ tadvanniśi rātrau ca vai tathā |
pūjito bhojito devo jāgareṇa yutairjanaiḥ ||62 ||
gītaṃ ca nartanaṃ puṇyaṃ bhajanaṃ ca kṛtaṃ janaiḥ |
prātaḥ snātvā pūjitaśca kṣamāpyātha visarjitaḥ ||6 3 ||
ācāryāya pradattaḥ sa mūrtirūpaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
evamudyāpanaṃ kṛtvā yayuḥ sarve nijālayam ||64||
phalaṃ cānantakaṃ prāptaṃ puruṣottamasevanāt |
tato lakṣmi yathāśakti vratametatsamācaret || 65||
duḥkhadāridryadaurbhāgyanāśaḥ syādiṣṭamāpnuyāt |
niyamānāṃ parityāgastataḥ kuryād vratī janaḥ ||66||
madhyabhojī naktabhojī brāhmaṇān bhojayed vratī |
ayācite vrate labdhe svarṇadānaṃ samācaret ||67||
māsopavāsinā deyā dogdhrī gaurdakṣiṇāyutā |
dhātrīvratī pradadyācca dadhiṃ kṣīraṃ ca śarkarām ||68 ||
phalānāṃ niyame lakṣmi phaladānaṃ samācaret |
tailarodhe ghṛtaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtarodhe payo’rpaṇam ||69||
dhānyānāṃ niyame dadyād dhānyāni tāni tāni ca |
bhūśāyitve tu paryaṃkagendukakaśipucchadān ||70||
phalapatrādiniyame tāni dadyād dvijanmane |
maune ghaṇṭāśaṃkhavādyān dadyād devāya padmaje ||7 1||
nakhakeśadharo dadyādādarśaṃ keśakarcikām |
upānahau pradadyācca hyupānadādivarjane ||72||
kṣāratyāge rasān dadyād dīpadāne tu dīpakān |
ekāntaropavāsī ca kuṃbhānaṣṭau pradāpayet ||73 ||
rājñāṃ yāvatya iṣṭāśca smṛddhayo’tra bhavanti vai |
deyā dāne ca tāḥ sarvā yathāśakti yathādhanam || 74||
ekānnena vratī yāyāccaturbāhuḥ parāṃ gatim |
ekabhojyupavāsyeva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||75||
pūrvāhṇe bhuṃjate devā madhyāhne munayastathā |
aparāhṇe pitṛgaṇā naktabhojī naro bhavet ||76||
dine dine’śvamedhasya phalaṃ naktādano labhet |
dvādaśīvratakṛd yāti garuḍena hareḥ padam ||77||
yasya yasya niyamaḥ syāttattaddāne niyojayet |
tena pūrṇaṃ vrataṃ syācca brahmalokapradaṃ bhavet ||78||
anityena śarīreṇa sādhyaṃ mokṣapadaṃ sadā |
puruṣottamatulyaṃ tu nāsti lakṣmi trilokake ||79||
sahasrajanmataptena tapasāpi na gamyate |
yatphalaṃ gamyate loke puruṣottamasevayā ||8 0||
trirātrasnānataścātra śākhāmṛgo’kṣaraṃ yayau |
āsīdvai kerale deśe dvijo dhanātilolupaḥ ||8 1 ||
tena kadaryanāmnā saḥ khyātiṃ jagāma dehiṣu |
sadannavastraṃ bhuktaṃ na svāhā svadhā kṛtā na vā ||82||
dhanaṃ pṛthvyāṃ rakṣitaṃ ca dharmakāryaṃ kṛta na ca |
na vrataṃ notsavaścāpi na grahaṇaṃ na kuṃbhanam ||83||
kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ bhikṣaṇaṃ tu dhanasyāṭan vidīnavat |
so’gānmālākāravāṭikāyāṃ duḥkhaṃ rudanmuhuḥ ||84||
mālākāro dayāṃ kṛtvā rarakṣa svāntike hi tam |
vāṭikārakṣakaṃ kṛtvā mālī grāme gato bhavet ||85||
paścājjaghāsa pakvāni cākrīṇata phalāni saḥ |
evaṃ stenakriyākarturjagmurayutavatsarāḥ ||86||
mamāra ca vane tatra nāvāpa vahnidāruṇī |
yamadūtairnīyamānastāḍyamāno yamālayam ||87||
gacchannuvāca duṣkarmaphalaṃ prāptaṃ mayādya vai |
mānuṣaṃ janma saṃprāpya na kiñcit sukṛtaṃ kṛtam ||88 ||
cauryādisañcitaṃ dravyaṃ sthitaṃ bhūmau nirarthakam |
na dhṛtaṃ nāttameveti puṇyaṃ cāpi kṛtaṃ nahi ||8 9 ||
na kuṭumbaṃ poṣitaṃ ca bhāryā kaṣṭena yojitā |
kadaryo vilapannevaṃ gato yamapuraṃ tataḥ || 90 ||
citragupto’vadaddharmaṃ pāpadvayaṃ bahūgrakam |
phalacauryaṃ tathā viśvāsaghātitvaṃ paraṃ bahu ||9 1 ||
śrutvā prāha yamo dūtān pretamenaṃ vidhattha vai |
tato’stu vānaro’yaṃ tu muhurnarakayātanaḥ || 92||
iti dūtaiḥ prāpitaḥ saḥ pretatāṃ nirjale vane |
tataḥ kapirabhūt kālaṃjare śaile bhayaṃkare || 93 ||
tatrendreṇa kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ kuṇḍo mṛgasutīrthakaḥ |
tatraiva vānaro jātaḥ pūrvapuṇyāt tadalpakāt ||94||
śṛṇu pūrvakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ puruṣottamaśaṃsanam |
citrakuṇḍalavaiśyo’bhūt puruṣottamasadvratī || 95||
dānakṛt taṃ ca bhikṣārthaṃ kadaryo gatavān purā |
praśaśaṃsa ca taṃ vaiśyaṃ dhanalobhena bhikṣukaḥ || 96 ||
puruṣottamamāsasya vrataṃ yad vidhinā tvayā |
kṛtaṃ tādṛk kṛtaṃ naiva kenāpi tvatra bhūtale || 97||
kṛtārtho’si tvayā yatsevitaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
dhanyado mokṣadaścāyaṃ māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ ||98 ||
dehi mahyaṃ dhanaṃ kiñciditi māsaṃ śaśaṃsa saḥ |
tena puṇyena tīrthe’tra vānaratvamupāgamat || 99||
janmatastasya vaktre’bhūtpīḍāsṛgavraṇasaṃbhavā |
dantāḥ petuḥ kṣudhā vyāpto jvarātipīḍito’bhavat || 100 ||
patitaḥ kuṇḍanikaṭe āyānmāḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
daśamīdinataḥ pañcāhāni kuṇḍajale yayuḥ || 101 ||
vyasustīrthajale jātastena divyavapurdharaḥ |
caturbhujo’bhavad divyadevīpārṣasevitaḥ || 10 2||
tīrthamṛtestathā jātaḥ snānāt pañcāhasatkṛtān |
ajñānācca tathā jātaṃ kiṃ punarvidhinā kṛtāt || 103 ||
te sadā subhagāḥ puṇyāsteṣāṃ ca saphalo bhavaḥ |
yeṣāṃ pumuttamo māsaḥ snānadānajapairgataḥ || 104 ||
tāni koṭiguṇānyeva kṛtāni puruṣottame |
kapirjagāma golokaṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 105 ||
evaṃ kadaryaścauro’pi vānaratvaṃ gato’pi ca |
puruṣottamayogena prāpto gaulokameva saḥ || 106 ||
puruṣottamamāsasya kathāyāḥ śravaṇādapi |
māsopoṣaṇapūjādiphalaṃ pūrṇamavāpyate || 1 07||
śrutvā dharmaṃ vijānāti śrutvā pāpaṃ ca naśyati |
śrutvā nivartate mohaḥ śrutvā jñānāmṛtaṃ milet || 108 ||
lakṣmīnārāyaṇasaṃhitākhyaṃ vedaṃ paṭhed vratī |
śṛṇuyācchrīpuruṣottamamāse mokṣadā hi sā || 109 ||
yayā nāryā kṛto naiva māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
tatpatinādṛtaścet sā labhet tatphalaṃ varam || 110 ||
satī nārī sadā pātivratyadharmaparā yadi |
patirūpo bhavatyasyā māsaḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ || 111 ||
kurūpo vā kuvṛtto vā duḥsvabhāvo’pi madyapaḥ |
rogī krodhī sthavīro vā mūko’ndho badhiro’pi vā || 11 2 ||
raudro dīnaḥ kadaryo vā daridraḥ kutsito’pi vā |
kātaraḥ kitavo vāpi viṣayī lampaṭo’pi vā || 113 ||
satataṃ devavatpūjyaḥ satyā sādhvyā patirhariḥ |
vidhavayā kanyayā ca patireva hariḥ sadā || 1 14||
sevanīyaḥ pūjanīyo dhyātavyo’dhyāsitavya ut |
vācā ca karmaṇā dehenāpi bhāvanayā tathā || 11 5||
na patyurviṣamaṃ kāryaṃ nodvejanīya īśvaraḥ |
bālā yuvatī jaraṭhā patyadhīnā priyā bhavet || 116 ||
kāmena lobhena balena vāpi dainyena bhāvena samāśrayeṇa |
rūpeṇa vāsena dhanādinā vā satṛṣṇayā vendriyadhātupuṣṭyā || 1 17||
sadambarairyānavaraiśca vāhanairābhūṣaṇairhīrakaratnakoṭibhiḥ |
sunṛtyagītairbahulāsanairapi nānyaṃ bhajet sā khalu sādhulakṣaṇā || 118 ||
anyasmai darśanārthaṃ śṛṃgāraṃ kurute na vai |
svānurūpaṃ naraṃ yā na cintayati priyā satī || 119 ||
surūpaṃ taruṇaṃ ramyaṃ kāminīnāṃ ca vallabham |
dṛṣṭvā na vikṛtiṃ yāti sā vai bodhyā mahāsatī || 120 ||
bhuṃkte bhukte yathā patyau duḥkhite duḥkhinā ca yā |
mudite muditā supte suptā jāgarti jāgrati || 121 ||
vṛddhabhaktā patikārye’nukūlā nādhikavyayā |
gṛhāgataṃ patiṃ pratyuttiṣṭhatyāsanavāribhiḥ || 122 ||
prasannavadanā kāle bhojanādipradāyinī |
bhuktavantaṃ śrāvayennāpriyaṃ śāntiṃ dadettathā || 123 ||
sevārthaṃ sarvadā bhāvyaṃ prītyarthaṃ priyayā sadā |
vastuvyayaṃ na cātyarthaṃ kurvīta gṛharakṣikā || 124||
śṛṃgāraścātibhūṣādi dhārayet patituṣṭaye |
tretādau pramadānāṃ syādārtavāśocameva ha || 1 25||
tatra caturahānyeva gṛhakāryaṃ na saṃspṛśet |
snātvā sūryaṃ patiṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā paścāt kriyāparā || 1 26||
bhavet bhavetputrakāmā yugmarātriratipriyā |
putrīkāmā tvayugmāsu rātriṣu svāmisevikā || 1 27||
āṣoḍaśarātrikaṃ vai garbhādhānabalaṃ bhavet |
taduttaraṃ kamalasya dvāraṃ baddhaṃ prajāyate || 128 ||
na bibhatsā bhavet kvāpi rūkṣavāṇī bhavenna ca |
śūrpavātaṃ nādadīta nopāviśettathāṃgane || 1 29|||
dvāradārau cullikāyāṃ peṣaṇyāṃ niṣadīta na |
guruṃ vātyuṣṇamāhāramajīrṇaṃ na samācaret || 130 ||
tenāpatyavatī syādanyathā garbhakṣaro bhavet|
sapatnī sthānamirṣyāyāḥ sādhvīrṣyā parivarjayet || 131 ||
gṛhakleśaṃ na janayed rakṣayet sarvathā gṛham |
nākrośet patimālakṣya bhartsayenna vimānayet || 13 2||
ratyā dadyātsukhaṃ tasmai svāmine rakṣiṇe sadā |
patyājñayā bahirgacched devadarśanahetave || 13 3||
patyau deśāntaraṃ prāpte sādhvī varteta sarvathā |
raṃgarāgavihīnā vai śvaśrvādyājñākarī sadā || 1 34||
vastrairaṃgaiśca malinā na bhavecchuddhimācaret |
svāmiśiṣṭaṃ prasādānnajalaṃ bhuñjīta bhāvataḥ || 1 35||
snāyānna vastraśūnyā vai na nagnā syāt kadācana |
nolūkhale na musale na ghaṭādau na cāśmani || 1 36||
na yantre na ca rathyāyāṃ satī tūpāviśet kvacit |
patipādodakaṃ tīrthaṃ pibet tīrthaphalapradam || 1 37||
vratopavāsaniyamān patimullaṃghya nācaret |
bhartuścaraṇāvabhyarcya bhoktavyaṃ priyayā sadā || 138 ||
patyākṣeptrī saramā syādulūkī svodaraṃbharā |
sūkarī cānyapārśvasthā vāgurī guptabhakṣikā || 13 9||
avamānakarī mūkā sāpatnerṣyā tu durbhagā |
patyuḥ kaṣṭapradā nārī kurūpā rogiṇī bhavet || 14 0||
bhartā brahmā haro viṣṇurgurustīrthaṃ vrataṃ japaḥ |
śuddhiḥ svargaṃ śubhaṃ dānaṃ tasmātpatiṃ susevayet || 141 ||
jīvahīno’śucirdehā bhartṛhīnāśuciḥ satī |
pativratā priyā svasyāḥ patiṃ svargaṃ nayet satī || 142|||
yamadūtāḥ palāyante satīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dūrataḥ |
yāvatsvalomasaṃkhyāsti tāvatkoṭyayutāni vai || 143 ||
bhartrā svargasukhaṃ bhuṃkte ramamāṇā pativratā |

darbhatilodakaiḥ piṣṭaphalairgogrāsakaistathā |
anyaiśca dānakāryaiśca puṇyaṃ samarjayettu sā || 145 |
brahmāṇḍaṃ saṃpuṭākāraṃ kāṃsyapātrakṛtaṃ dadet |
madhyatriṃśadapūpapūritaṃ tantusuveṣṭitam || 146 ||
pūjitaṃ cākṣatapuṣpakuṃkumairarpayet satī |
patnīvrato bhavet tadvanpumān patnīparāyaṇaḥ || 147||
svasya prāṇaṃ tathā dehaṃ kṣetraṃ śāntisthalīṃ śubhām |
patnīṃ sammānayennityaṃ mādhuryeṇa vilokayet || 148 ||
miṣṭaṃ dadyācca bhāṣetākārayetpremabhāvataḥ |
tiraskurvīta no patnīṃ tāḍayennākṣipenna ca || 149 ||
vastrabhūṣādyalaṃkārairdravacandanapuṣpakaiḥ |
tailatantukajjalādyaistoṣayet svapriyāṃ sadā || 150 ||
nodvejayenna prasahya bhuñjīta na ca rodhayet |
kṣudhayā tṛṣayā patnīṃ karmaṇā duḥkhayenna ca || 151 ||
na cāvigaṇayenmānahīnāṃ dāsīṃ priyāṃ patiḥ |
vaṃśadāṃ ratidāṃ vallīvadāśritāṃ prapoṣayet || 152 ||
athecchukīṃ na pravadennetyapi noccaretpatiḥ |
omityuccārya saṃdadyādapekṣitadhanādikam || 153 ||
bhojyakāryaṃ gṛhakāryaṃ ratikāryaṃ tanukriyām |
patikāryaṃ tathānyacca kurvāṇāṃ supramodayet || 1 54||
nānyāṃ nārīṃ samīkṣeta nānyāṃ vyavāyakṛtadbhavet |
nānyāṃ priyo bhavet kvāpi patnīṃ lakṣmīṃ vihāya vai || 155 ||
nānyāṃ puṣṭipradaḥ syācca nānyayā ca rameta vai |
yānavāhanadeśādyutsavasāmājakeṣu ca || 156||
nānyāparo bhavet kvāpi yadi svargaṃ hi vāñchati |
evaṃ dharmaparau tvatra dampatī mokṣabhāginau || 157||
indradyumnaḥ śatadyumno yauvanāśvo bhagīrathaḥ |
kalpakalpāntare cānye vaiṣṇavā rājabhūsurāḥ || 158 ||
puruṣottamamārādhya yayurbhagavadantikam |
puruṣottamamāsasya dundubhiryena saṃśrutaḥ || 159||
tena tena ca sarvatrotsavo’nuṣṭhita eva ha |
dundubhestu prapūjā ca kṛtā nārāyaṇena ca || 160 ||
yadā yadādhimāso’pi samāgacchet tadā tadā |
dundubhinā paṭahena kartavyājñāpraghoṣaṇā || 161 ||
dhāmnyakṣare rakṣitaḥ śrīpumuttamena sarvadā |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇena śrīpuruṣottamaśārṅgiṇā || 162 ||
rādhayā ca śriyā lakṣmyā pārvatyā prabhayā tathā |
māṇikyayā jayayā ca ramayā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 163
pratyahaṃ tvadhimāse’yaṃ pūjanīyaḥ pareśvaraḥ |
bhojanāya sevanīyo dhyātavyaḥ puruṣottamaḥ || 164||
śrotavyaṃ māsamāhātmyaṃ śloko’dhyāyaḥ prapūrṇakaḥ|
gaṃgādisarvatīrthānāṃ phalaṃ syānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 165
pṛthvīpradakṣiṇāpuṇyaṃ brahmāṇḍoddhārapuṇyakam |
śravaṇena bhavedasya māsā muktistathā bhavet || 166||
varṇāstathāśramavantaḥ śreṣṭhatāṃ sarvathā gatāḥ |
śrutvā muktiṃ samāyānti paśucaryā janā api || 167 ||
puruṣottamamāhātmyaṃ lekhayitvā sabandhanam |
dadyādasya phalaṃ vaṃśatrayaṃ golokago bhavet || 168 ||
māhātmyapustakādhāre gṛhe tīrthāni sarvaśaḥ |
vasanti devatāścāpi vartate puruṣottamaḥ || 169||
śrotā vaktā śrāvayitā varṇayitā praśaṃsakaḥ |
rakṣako vratakṛd dātā sarve te puruṣottamāḥ || 170 ||
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo’nādiśrīhariḥ puruṣottamaḥ |
saṃhitopasamādeṣṭā pūjanīyo viśeṣataḥ || 171 ||
lakṣmīḥ śrutvā cātitṛptā pupūja puruṣottamam |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ pupūja svapatiṃ harim || 172 ||
tvanmukhāmṛtapānena kṛtārthāsmītyuvāca sā |
vyāsaṃ patisvarūpaṃ saṃpupūja ca nanāma ca || 173 ||
ahaṃ nārāyaṇo vaktā lakṣmīstvaṃ ca narāyaṇī |
gṛhṇāmi tvatkṛtāṃ pūjāṃ kimanyacchrotumicchasi || 174||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye’kṣaradhāmni sarvasṛṣṭīśvaraiḥ kṛtaḥ puruṣottamamāsavratodyāpanāvidhiḥ niyamapūrtyarthaṃ dānāni dīpadānaphalaṃ kadaryamuktiḥ vānaramokṣaṇam pativratādharmāḥ patnīvratadharmāḥ kāṃsyasaṃpuṭātmaka brahmāṇḍadānaṃ dundubhipūjanaṃ śravaṇādiphalaṃ cetyādinirūpaṇanāmā dvāviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 1.322 ||

<1.323>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇa hare svāmin paramātman parātpara |
kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa viṣṇo’ntaryāmin parameśvara || 1 ||
puruṣottama cātmeśa prāṇeśa priya mānada |
yaduktā bhavatā dharmapatnyaḥ santi trayodaśa || 2 ||
kāstāḥ kasmāt kadā kutra samutpannāśca hetunā |
kena kāryaṃ ca kiṃ tāsāṃ vada vaktavyameva cet || 3 ||
tāritā pāvitā kīrtiṃ gamitāhaṃ kṛpālunā |
śrāvayitvā kathāṃ devyāṃ puruṣottamayoginīm || 4 ||
dharmapatnīsmaraṇārthaṃ vistarād vada nātha me |
svargamokṣapradā divyāṃ kathāṃ vai dharmayoṣitām || 5 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi dharmapatnīnāṃ kathāṃ mokṣadāṃ śubhām |
sṛṣṭyādau khalu saṃjātāṃ kathayāmi nibodha me || 6 ||
akṣare tu pare dhāmni vartate puruṣottamaḥ |
tasmin divyā śaktayaśca santi śatasahasraśaḥ || 7 ||
tadaiko’haṃ bahu prajāyeyeti kalpanā vyadhāt |
nityo divyaguṇāḥ śaktyātmakā mūrtāstadābhavan || 8 ||
śraddhā maitrī dayā śāntistuṣṭiḥ puṣṭiḥ samunnatiḥ |
kriyā buddhiśca medhā ca titikṣā hrīśca dvādaśa || 9 ||
mūrtiścetyadhikā bhaktināmnā tatra sadocyate |
etā hareḥ svarūpādvai jajñire śaktayaḥ striyaḥ || 10 ||
nityā harāvapi chāyā bhavanti lokamuktaye |
dvitīyarūpamādhāya vasanti jīvajātiṣu || 11 ||
yadā tā rūpayuktāśca saṃbhūtā brahmarūpataḥ |
tadā tāḥ prārthayat kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaṃ pumuttamam || 1 2 ||
vayaṃ bhavataḥ saṃkalpād yato hutāḥ sma keśava |
samūrtāśca bhavanmūrtimayya smo nānyagā yataḥ || 13 ||
ājñāpaya yathāyogyaṃ kāryamasmādṛśa prabho |
iti cābhyarthitaḥ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ pareśvaraḥ || 14||
vicārya prāha tāḥ sarvāḥ chāyārūpā bhavantu vai |
chāyātmakāni yānyatra rūpāṇi vo bhavanti vai || 15 ||
tāni sarvāṇi sṛṣṭau tu dehiṣu vicarantviti |
ityāśāṃ śrīhareḥ prāpya sṛṣṭau jātā guṇātmikā || 16 ||
vyāpikāḥ śaktayastāstu śroharericchayābhavan |
kintvasureṣu daityeṣu dānaveṣu ca sarvathā || 17||
sukhaṃ tāsāmabhavanna tāmasānāṃ gṛheṣu ca |
tataḥ sarvā militvaiva yayuḥ śrībadarīvanam || 18 ||
tapastepuratiraudraṃ parameśvaravāñcchayā |
gaṃgātīraṃ samāsādya nirjalāhārataḥ sthitāḥ || 19 ||
sahasravarṣaparyantaṃ puruṣottamamānasāḥ |
āvirāsīttadā kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ svaḥ prabhuḥ || 20 ||
prāha tāḥ kiṃ kathaṃ cedṛk tapyate dāruṇaṃ tapaḥ |
bhavatīnāṃ tapaścaryāprabhāveṇāsmi vardhitaḥ || 21 ||
madguṇāḥ śaktayo me ca mama vṛddhiparāyaṇāḥ |
matpuṣṭidāḥ sukhadāśca bhavatyaḥ santi sarvathā || 22||
sāhāyyārthaṃ bhavatīnāṃ samāyāto’smi vai yataḥ |
nivedayantvabhimataṃ tapobhiśca kimiṣyate ||2 3 ||
ityāvedya haristatra kṣaṇaṃ maunaṃ sthitastataḥ |
ūcustāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabho dānavadaityake ||24||
āsureṣu sukhaṃ naiva bhavatyasmākamīśvara |
adharmasya nivāsena vayaṃ tatra hi duḥkhitāḥ || 25||
tata ākṛṣya bhagavan kuru naḥ sukhitā sadā |
hariḥ prāha tadā tāstu vicintya kṣaṇamātrataḥ || 2 6 ||
puruṣottamamāsāntadivasasya vrataṃ mahat |
kurutātra devanadītīre sveṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati || 27||
ityuktvāntarhito devaḥ tāpasyaśca yadā punaḥ |
samayo’dhikamāsasya hyāyātastāstadantime || 28 ||
divase pūjanaṃ kṛṣṇanārāyaṇasya vastubhiḥ |
bhāvaiśca vividhaiḥ sarvāścakruḥ puṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || 29 ||
sāyaṃ prāvirbabhūvātra bhagavān puruṣottamaḥ |
varaṃ vṛṇuta vo devyo yatheṣṭaṃ dātumāgataḥ || 30 ||
cakitāśca tadā tāśca vavrire dharmarakṣaṇam |
dharmāśritā vayaṃ kṛṣṇa rakṣitāḥ syāma sarvathā || 31 ||
tvayā rakṣā prakartavyā sadā śrīpuruṣottama |
iti śrutvā hariḥ prāha tathāstviti punastataḥ || 3 2||
prāha tāḥ śaktayaḥ sarvā yāntu dakṣagṛhaṃ śubhāḥ |
asiknī putrikāḥ santu bhavatīnāṃ tataḥ pitā || 33 ||
dakṣo dāsyati dharmāya patnyarthaṃ vai trayodaśa |
taireva nāmabhiḥ khyātā bhaviṣyatha yathāyatham || 34||
tato’haṃ mūrtito brahmacaryadharmo hariḥ svayam |
nārāyaṇo narasakhā cotpatsye badarīvane || 35 ||
bhavatīnāṃ adharmāṇāṃ kariṣye rakṣaṇaṃ sadā |
ityuktvā prayayau kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo vilīnatām || 36 ||
tāśca tapaḥ parityajyāsiknyāṃ praviviśustadā |
dakṣasaṃkalpamātrāt tāḥ kanyakā abhavam̐stadā || 37||
jātamātrā yuvatyaśca sundaryo varaṇārhaṇāḥ |
jātismarāḥ surūpāśca dharmārthaṃ kṛtavigrahāḥ || 38 ||
dharmakāṃkṣāvatīrdṛṣṭvā dharmārthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ |
dakṣaḥ pratīkṣate dharmayogasya samayaṃ śubham ||39 ||
tāvat tīrthanimittena badaryāśramamārgagam |
dakṣagṛhaṃ samālokya dharmo viśrāntaye kṣaṇam ||40 ||
yayau dakṣagṛhaṃ jñātvātithisatkāraśobhitam |
brahmaputraṃ bhrātaraṃ ca jñātvā smṛtvā viśeṣataḥ ||4 1 ||
dakṣo dṛṣṭvātisantuṣṭaścātithyaṃ vidadhe bahu |
dadau sampūjya tāḥ sarvā dharmāya tu trayodaśa |||42 ||
putryo vivāhavidhinā kṛtakṛtyo’bhavattadā |
dharmo’pi tāḥ samādāya yayau badarikāśramam ||43 ||
gaṃgā pītvā jale snātvā dharmāraṇyaṃ jagāma ha |
nārāyaṇo narasakhā dharme saṃpraviveśa ha ||44||
patnībhiḥ sahito dharmo jagāma vatsarāntare |
tīrthāni saṃvidhāyaiva sarvāṇi badarīvanam ||45||
tatra kṛṣṇecchayā sākṣāt naranārāyaṇāvubhau |
mūrtestu tapasā jātau puruṣottamasadvratāt ||46 ||
dharmaputrau mūrtiputrau jātamātrau mahattamau |
yuvānau bhagavantau tau brahmacaryaparau sadā ||47||
tāpasau lokakalyāṇakarau prāvirbabhūvatuḥ |
śraddhāyāmatha dharmasya kāmaḥ putro babhūva ha ||48 ||
kāmaḥ saṃkalpa ityukto dharmapuṇyaprabhāvavān |
saṃkalpasya suto jāto vyavasāyābhidhānakaḥ ||49 ||
maitrī snehaṃ vijajñe copakāraṃ suṣuve dayā |
śāntiḥ kṣemaṃ sutaṃ jajñe santoṣastuṣṭijaḥ sutaḥ ||50 ||
puṣṭyā lābhaḥ suto hyunnatestu cābhyudayaḥ sutaḥ |
kriyāyāṃ tu nayaḥ putro daṇḍaḥ samaya ityapi ||5 1 ||
buddherbodhaḥ sutaścāpi hyapramādaśca tāvubhau |
medhāputrau śubhaśrutau titikṣāyā virāmakaḥ ||52||
hriyāḥ putro niyamaśca mūrternaranarāyaṇau |
kṛṣṇaharīti catvāro dharmavaṃśo hi badrike ||53 ||
vartate sma sukhaṃ lakṣmi sevānusevane ratam |
atha vai vedhaso loke satye brahmasabhāsthale ||54||
puruṣottamamāsānte puruṣottamapūjanam |
utsavena ca mahatā saṃbhārairbahukoṭibhiḥ ||55 ||
kṛtaṃ devarṣimunibhirmānavaiścānyajātibhiḥ |
bahubhaktyāti bhāvaiśca sarvasvārpaṇapūrvakam ||56||
tena dharmaśca tatpatnyaḥ putrāśca puruṣottamaḥ |
prasannāḥ saṃbabhūvuścāsīma toṣamupāgatāḥ ||57||
niśīthe’mādivasānte pūjā nīrojanottaram |
tadbhaktebhyo vratibhyaśca darśanaṃ dātumicchavaḥ ||58||
samājagmuradṛśyāste vyomni gītyupalakṣitāḥ |
puruṣottamabhaktānāṃ madhye tvāvirbabhūva ha ||59||
sahasā tejasāṃ puṃjaḥ sa ca drāgvyāpa cāmbare |
koṭikoṭīndusadṛśaṃ ghanībhūtaṃ ca tanmahaḥ ||60||
prādurbhūtamatha sthairyaṃ prāpa vidyotayad diśaḥ |
svarā grāmā mūrchanāśca nādāścāsanmanoharāḥ ||61||
tadā tatra ca paśyatsu surādyeṣu manoharā |
yuvatyadṛśyataikā strī divyarūpā manaḥpriyā ||62|||
divyakausuṃbhavasanā divyālaṃkāraśobhitā |
rūpānurūpasaundaryā prasannā svarṇasūjjvalā ||63||
sarvaśṛṃgāraśobhāḍhyā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā |
keśabhāradhṛtapuṣpā susmitabhrūvilāsinī ||64||
nirmalāmbarasaṃvītā kāñcīnūpurabhūṣitā |
manāṃsi mohayamānā lāvaṇyenāpi yoṣitām ||65||
vipañcīṃ vādayamānā sakhyānupūritasvarā |
gītyaiva mānahantrī ca gandharvāpsarasāmapi ||66||
anyāśca dvādaśa nāryo gānaṃ nārāyaṇasya ha |
cakruḥ satālamānaṃ vai harantyo mānasānyapi ||67||
tāsāṃ putrāśca sudivyāḥ prasannāḥ kṛtagāyanāḥ |
savāditrāśca tanmadhye kṛṣṇanārāyaṇo hariḥ ||68||
adhimāsastathā rādhālakṣmyādyā divyayoṣitaḥ |
sarve’dṛśyanta tatraiva sabhāyāṃ vedhaso gṛhe ||69||
akṣarādhipatiḥ kṛṣṇo’nādiḥ śrīpuruṣottamaḥ |
āśīrvādān vadan devo’dṛśyata padmalocanaḥ ||70||
caturhasto dharmadevo’dṛśyata śvetabhāsvaraḥ |
vedavākyairvadan bhaktān darśayam̐śca prasannatām ||71||
brahmādayaśca tān dṛṣṭvā cātyadbhutaṃ tadā viduḥ |
mugdhāstu kṣaṇamātraṃ te hṛṣṭāścātimudā ca tān ||72||
nemuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ viditvaiva tathā śrīpuruṣottamam |
rādhālakṣmyādikāścāpi dharmaṃ mūrtiṃ sutām̐stathā ||73||
śraddhādikāstathā natvā tuṣṭuvuḥ paramādarāt |
nārāyaṇa namastubhyaṃ nārāyaṇyai namonamaḥ ||74||
dharmadeva namastubhyaṃ dhārmikebhyo namonamaḥ |
śraddhādibhyo namaścāstu namo’stu bhaktimūrtaye ||75||
rādhāramādiśaktibhyo namaḥ pumuttamāya ca |
uddharaṇāya lokānāmasmākaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ ||76||
darśanaṃ dattavantaḥ stha yūyaṃ vai parameśvarāḥ |
kṛtārthāḥ sma kṛtā devā atha yuṣmābhiratra vai ||77||
kṛpāṃ kṛtvā nideśaścejjñātavyaścopadiśyatām |
śrutvovāca tadā devān brahmādīn puruṣottamaḥ ||78||
puruṣottamamāse’tra bhavadbhirlokanāyakaiḥ |
prajābhiśca mama bhaktiḥ kṛtāsminpuruṣottame ||79||
dharmaḥ kṛtastathātyarthe śraddhādyāḥ poṣitāstathā |
sakuṭumbaḥ poṣito’haṃ bhūtvā dātuṃ svadarśanam ||80 ||
samāgato’smi kṛpayā bhadraṃ vo’stu mahattamam |
nānyathā darśanaṃ me syātpratyakṣaṃ yogināmapi ||8 1 ||
varaṃ vṛṇuta tuṣṭo’smi yūyaṃ matsvābhivāñcchitam |
iti kṛpāvacaḥ śrutvā praṇemuścakrurarcanam |||82||
vavruścāsmaddhṛdayeṣu vasantu sarvadā tathā |
rakṣantvasmān nideśasthān pāhi kārye guro sadā ||83 ||
bhaktān svadhāmaṃ divyaṃ tvaṃ niṣkāmānnaya mādhava |
sakāmān pūraya sveṣṭaṃ kṛpāṃ varṣaya varṣaya ||84||
iti stutvā viremuste tathāstvityāha keśavaḥ |
sakuṭumbo varaṃ datvā brahmādibhyaḥ pumuttamaḥ ||85||
tirobabhūva sahasā tvāścaryaṃ janayaddhariḥ |
evaṃ bhagavatā tena svabhaktānāṃ manorathāḥ ||86||
pūryante sakalā lakṣmi rakṣyante tu kṣaṇe kṣaṇe |
puruṣottamabhaktānāṃ nānavāpyaṃ hi vidyate ||87||
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyāccaitatpuruṣottamatoṣaṇam |
tasya sarvamanaḥkāmān pūrayiṣyati vai hariḥ ||88||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne puruṣottamamāsamāhātmye dharmadevasya tatpatnīnāṃ tatputrāṇāṃ ca prāvirbhāvastato brahmādikṛtapuruṣottamamāsavratena prasannaśrīhariṇā sakuṭumbena brahmādibhyo darśanaṃ varadānaṃ ca dattamityādinirūpaṇanāmā trayoviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 323|||

<1.324>
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
ahaṃ lakṣmi prasannaḥ saṃbhavāmyeṣā kṛpā mama |
puruṣottamamāse me prāptau kṛpaiva kāraṇam || 1 ||
anyamāseṣvatituṣṭaṃ kartumicchati māṃ yadi |
tulasīpatramātreṇāpyatituṣṭo bhavāmyaham || 2 ||
mañjarīsahayuktena patreṇa pūjayejjanaḥ |
mañjarīyuktapatrābhyāṃ mañjarīyuktapatrakaiḥ || 3 ||
śatena vā daśaśatairlakṣeṇa vā prapūjayet |
dṛṣṭvā dṛṣṭvā ca tuṣyāmi tulasīṃ tvāmiva priye || 4 ||
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kathaṃ nārāyaṇa kṛṣṇa puruṣottama keśava |
tulasīṃ manyase toṣakāriṇīṃ māmiva prabho || 5 ||
vada sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ yadi gopyaṃ na vidyate |
gopyaṃ cāpi yadi pātraṃ matāsmi cennu me vad || 6 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi kathāṃ pūrvavṛttāṃ vistāraśālinīm |
yathā vṛndā mama toṣakāriṇī svīkṛtā mayā || 7 ||
saṃśayaṃ tatra kuru mā śrutvā cerṣyāṃ ca mā kuru |
sarvadā tu tvayā rakṣyaṃ sauhārdaṃ vṛndayā saha || 8 ||
pativratāyā dharmo’sti duḥkhaṃ na gaṇyate kvacit |
sapatnījaṃ sukhaṃ patiparā tu gaṇayet sadā || 9 ||
śrutvā śrutvā patisukhaṃ svānyanārīsuyogajam |
svātmānandaṃ paraṃ matvā tuṣyati strī pativratā || 1.324.10 ||
sahasrāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi patnīnāṃ me bhavanti vai |
vṛndāpi ca mayā patnī kṛtā sāpi ratā mayi || 11 ||
śṛṇvākhyānaṃ yathā jātaṃ tathā te vacmi sarvathā |
kāryasiddhiṃ miṣaṃ kṛtvā vṛndā patnī mayā kṛtā || 12 ||
vṛndā patnī mamaivāsīd goloke rādhikāsamā |
rādhikayā samaṃ dṛṣṭvā ramantaṃ māṃ patiṃ svakam || 13 ||
īrṣyayā hṛdaye tāpaṃ prāptā rativirodhinī |
mahyaṃ vaktumaśaktā sā novāca hṛdayasthitam || 14||

tena doṣeṇa duṣṭeyaṃ na mā sevitumarhati || 1 5||
iti saṃkalpitaṃ yāvanmayā tāvattu sā tataḥ |
avāpa tadadholoke gatā cāsurabhāvanām || 1 6||
jalaṃdharaṃ patiṃ prāpya duritaṃ svaṃ samāpya sā |
jalaṃdharamṛterheturūpāṃ bhuktāṃ mayā yadā || 1 7||
tadā pūtā punarmāṃ sā prāptā me pūrvapatnikā |

vyomamārgādvilokyaiva carantaṃ śivameva tau ||

atra dṛṣṭo’mbarapathagāmibhyāṃ śaṃkaro haraḥ ||26||
sa kvāste vada vai śīghraṃ pūjākāmau hi sevakau |
itipṛṣṭaḥ pumānnaivāvadat kiṃcit tataḥ punaḥ || 27||
tathaivendreṇa pṛṣṭo’pi punarmaunaṃ samāśritaḥ |
novāca sa mahāyogī tūṣṇīmāsa punaḥ punaḥ ||28||
pṛṣṭo’pi tāpaso naivovāca cukrodha vāsavaḥ ||

hastaṃ kṛtvordhvamādāya vajraṃ cādhikṣipan hariḥ ||
re mūḍha pṛcchyamāno’pi nottaraṃ dattavānasi ||1.324.30||
eṣa tvāṃ hanmi vajreṇa kaste trāṇaṃ kariṣyati |
ityudīrya krudhā hantuṃ yatate yāvadeva ha ||31||

savajrakarayuktaśca sadeho loṣṭakāṣṭhavat ||3||
stabdho jāto mahendro vai samadahyata manyunā ||
haro’pi vikarālākṣo drutameva bhayaṃkaraḥ ||33||
prajajvāla pralayāgnisamo dahanniva sthitaḥ ||
bṛhaspatistadā śaṃbhuṃ śātvā sattvadhiyā hi tam ||34

sabhayena hṛdayena haraṃ stotuṃ pracakrame ||35||

tryambakāya maheśāya digambarāya te namaḥ ||36||
namo raudrāya devāya dīnanāthāya śaṃbhave ||

virūpāyātitejasvisvarūpāya ca te namaḥ ||
kālāntakāya śarvāya namaste paramātmane ||38||
tvamagnistvaṃ mahāvāyurvyoma tvaṃ salilaṃ dharā ||
sūryastvaṃ candramāstvaṃ ca nakṣatrāṇi tvameva ha ||39||
jyotiścakaṃ tvayi cāste viṣṇurbrahmā tvameva vai ||
indro bṛhaspatiścānye tvadārādhanataḥ sadā ||1.324.40||
sukhinaḥ sampadāṃ bhoktāraścopadravavarjitāḥ |
bhavanti tatkathaṃ nātha staṃbho’tra suranāyake ||4 1||
iti stutvā papātāsya harasya pādayorguruḥ ||
pātayāmāsa ca śakraṃ vinayenāha vai punaḥ ||42||

kṣantavyaścāparādho’syājānatā yaḥ kṛto’dhunā ||44||
śrutvā ca vinayaṃ jñātvā saḥ krodhānalabhālakaḥ |
śaṃkaraḥ prāha taṃ bhaktaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ śanairvaram ||45|||
krodho’yaṃ nirgato netrānalo mūrto’tidāruṇaḥ ||
bahiryāto na dhartuṃ taṃ manye yogyaṃ bṛhaspate ||46||
nahi sarpa ujjhitāṃ kañcukīṃ dhatte punaśca tām ||
tiraskurvanta mevainaṃ kariṣye bhasmasāddharim ||47||
iti śrutvā bhayaṃ prāpto dīno bṛhaspatiḥ punaḥ ||
provāca bhagavān bhaktā anukampyāḥ sadaiva yat ||48||
bhaktavatsalanāmāsi sārthakaṃ kuru śaṃkara |
prāhīndraṃ cānalaṃ kṣeptumanyatrārhasi vai jaḍe ||49||
athavendraguruṃ māṃ tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ bhasmasāt kuru |
paraṃ devapatiṃ mā tvaṃ dagdhumarhasi śaṃkara ||1.324.5 0
iti śrutvātivinayaṃ bhaktavatsalanāmadhṛk |
praṇatārtiharaḥ śaṃbhurbṛhaspatimuvāca ha ||5||
prītastavāgraheṇātra vinayenārpaṇena ca |
jīvadānaṃ mahendrāya dadāmi nirbhayo bhava ||5||
indro jīveti saṃyātu tvaṃ ca jīvātviti prathām |
sukhinau bhavatāṃ cobhau kurutaṃ mama pūjanam ||53||
yadarthaṃ vai samāyātau kṛtvā tatpūjanaṃ mama |
prasannatāṃ samāgṛhyādāya nirbhayatāṃ prathām ||54||
yātaṃ svargamahaṃ krodhānalaṃ bhālākṣisaṃbhavam ||

iti kṛtvākṣipannetrānalaṃ vahnayaśrurūpiṇam ||
paścime’pāṃnidhau pūjāṃ gṛhītvobhakṛtāṃ tataḥ ||56

kṛtārthau ca guruśakrau svasvasthānaṃ prajagmatuḥ ||57||
atha kṣiptaṃ bhālanetrasamutthaṃ cātidāruṇam |
jalaṃ tejomalaṃ cāvilaṃ tu yallavaṇāmbhasi ||58||
bālabhāvaṃ samāpannaṃ sadya eva vyarājata ||
bālaśabdaṃ prakurvan sa bālo jalataraṅgake ||59||
dolārūḍha iva prāste jalakallolasevitaḥ ||
jātamātro yuvā kaścid vajrāṃga iva cādbhutaḥ ||1.324.60||
prahasan sa muhuḥ śabdaṃ prakurvan divibhedinam |
punaḥ punaḥ prahasam̐śca kurvan hāsyaparamparām ||61||

tena hāsyātiśabdena sabalenātalādayaḥ |
prākampan dānavāścāpi sarve lokāśca tatrasuḥ || 63||
lokapālā vihvalāśca cacāla sacarācaram |
agragaṇyā surā lokeśvarāścakampire drutam ||64||
militvā satyalokaṃ te brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ ||
ūcurbhayānvitāḥ sarve pitarbhayamupasthitam ||65||
mahāhāsyakṛtaścāyaṃ śabdo lokabhayaṃkaraḥ ||
trāsakṛtsarvathā bhāti mahākālasya kiṃ bhavet ||66||
kaścid brahmāṇḍayattuṃ vā samāyāto’suro mahān ||
iti bhāti prabho tasmādasmān rakṣaya pūrvaja ||67
śrutvaivaṃ surapālānāṃ vākyaṃ lokapitāmahaḥ |
bhayaṃ gato’pi sarveṣāṃ sāhāyyamabhigamya ca ||68||
gantumaicchat sthalaṃ yatra raudraṃ hāsyaṃ vitanyate |
śabdadiśāmabhilakṣyāvātaran vai surādayaḥ ||69||
śabdamūlamavācīsthaṃ kṣārasāgaravāriṣu |
abhisandhāya jagmuste vyomni vai paścimāṃ diśam ||1.324.70||

samudrāṃke niṣasāda pitaḥ pitariti gṛṇan ||73 ||

brahmāṇḍatrāsakṛd yasya hāsyaṃ vyāpnoti dikṣu ca ||74||

tāvad bālaḥ samutthāya dudrāva vedhasaṃ prati ||75||
brahmāṇamagrahīt kaṇṭhe nidhanāya yathā bhavet ||
vidheḥ kaṇṭhavidhūnanānnetrābhyāmagamajjalam ||76||
samudreṇa samākṛṣya brahmā tasmādviyojitaḥ ||
evaṃ balānvito bālo haraputraḥ surādibhiḥ ||77||
vilokito jalādhāro jalaṃdharābhidhaḥ kṛtaḥ ||
jalaṃdharaḥ samudro’sti jālaṃdharo’pi vārdhijaḥ ||78
jālaṃdhara iti jāto jālaṃdharo jalaṃdharaḥ |
rudraputro’styato raudro bhaviṣyati parākrame ||79||
śāstrajñaḥ sarvajetā ca śastrāstrajño bhaviṣyati ||
avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vinā rudraṃ bhaviṣyati ||1.324.80||
ayaṃ daityaguṇaścādya lokyate’tastathāvidhaḥ ||
daityeśvaro daityarājo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||81||
brahmā prāha punarbhāgyaṃ tasya dṛṣṭvā tu sāgaram ||
kṛṇapatnī tu yā rādhādveṣiṇī tasya dhāmani ||82||
goloke rādhikākṛṣṇaratyasahābhavat khalu |
sā golokādū bhagavatā bhūtale’tra nirākṛtā ||83||
kālanemigṛhe jātā putrī sāsya priyā satī |
pativratā śubhā patnī bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ ||84
jātamātro yuvā cāsāvabhiṣikto yathā bhavet |
daityānāṃ rājyakartā vai tathā sarvairvidhīyatām ||85||
ityājñāṃ brahmaṇaḥ prāpya cāhūya śukrameva ha|
ādiśya saritāṃ nāthaṃ taṃ rājye tvabhyaṣecayan ||86||
punarbhayaṃkaraṃ hāsyaṃ mā kurviti praśikṣayā |
śāntayantaḥ surāḥ saveṃ yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niketanam ||87||
samudraḥ sutamādāya svagehamagamanmudā |
apoṣayanmahopāyaiḥ kālanemiṃ samāhvayat ||88
vṛndābhidhāṃ sutāṃ tasya tadbhāryārthamayācata |
kālanemyasuro vārdheryāñcāṃ mene’tivāñcchitām ||89||
dadau sutāṃ vidhānena jālaṃdharāya tatkṣaṇam |
tadotsavo mahānāsīd vivāhe ca tayostadā ||1.324.90
samudro’pi sukhaṃ prāpa putraṃ dṛṣṭvā hi sastriyam |
daityāḥ pātālalokasthā jālaṃdharaṃ samāśritāḥ ||91||
bhuvamāgatya rājyāni sthāpayāmāsurīśvarāḥ ||
devajayāya ca sarve babhūvurdṛḍhamānasāḥ ||92||
itiśrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālandharavṛndākhyāne golokasthakṛṣṇapatnīvṛndāyāḥ rādhākṛṣṇaratiṃ vilokya sapatnīdveṣadoṣeṇa golokādapagatya kālanemiputratvaṃ śaṃkaradarśanārthaṃ samāgatābhyāṃ siṃhāraṇye śaṃkaraṃ dṛṣṭvāvātaradbhyāṃ bṛhaspatimahendrābhyāṃ kastvamitipraśnottarālabdhau śaṃkare vajraprakṣepāyottānitahastasahitendrasya staṃbhanottaraṃ śaṃbhulalāṭanetrajakrodhānalasya samudre prakṣepājjālaṃdharotpattiḥ vṛndayā saha vivāhaścetyādinirūpaṇanāmā caturviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ ||324||

śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmyekadā jālandharo vṛndāpatiḥ svayam |
asuraiḥ saha śukrasya pūjanārthaṃ samāyayau || 1 ||
tatrāyayuḥ pūjanārthamāṣāḍhapūrṇimātithau |
daityāśca dānavāḥ sarve rāhuketvādayo’pi ca || 2 ||
śukrācāryaḥ pūjitastairnamaskṛtaśca bhāvukaiḥ |
datvāśīrvacanaṃ tebhyaḥ papraccha kuśalādikam || 3 ||
dattāsaneṣu sarve te niṣeduḥ saṃsadīṣṭakṛt |
jalaṃdharo’tisaṃhṛṣṭo’paśyadrāhuṃ śiro vinā || 4 ||
papracchābdhisutastatrāścaryapūrvaṃ tu bhārgavam |
kenedaṃ kartitaṃ rāhośchiro brūhi kathaṃ kadā || 5 ||
ityākarṇya śivaṃ smṛtvā śukrācāryaḥ uvāca tam |
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putraḥ prahlādastasya putrakaḥ || 6 ||
virocanastasya putro balirājo mahābalaḥ |
vartate ca rasātalarājyaṃ kurvan prabhaktarāṭ || 7 ||
asurāṇāṃ tu sainyāni prabalānyasya saṃvaśe |
vartante iti jānanti surāḥ sarve savāsavāḥ || 8 ||
athaikadā tu durvāsā vaikuṇṭhāt samavātarat |
bhuvaṃ nārāyaṇadattapuṣpamālāṃ kare dadhan || 9 ||
dadarśendraṃ viharantaṃ hastinā vyomamārgake |
ṛṣirdevapatiṃ jñātvendrāya mālāṃ dadau tadā || 1.325.10 ||
vigaṇayanniva mālāṃ kare dhṛtvā tu vāsavaḥ |
sthāpitavān karikuṃbhe śuṇḍādaṇḍena tāṃ karī || 11 ||
dhṛtvā pattalake kṛtvā mardayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam |
durvāsāḥ krodhamāpannaḥ śaśāpa garvahārakaḥ || 12 ||

amṛta gaṇḍūṣamātraṃ gale’sya lagnatāṃ gatam |

phalaṃ śīghraṃ pradāsye’haṃ sajjo bhavāsureśvara |

dṛṣṭvādharo’karod devān jenumudyogamāsuraiḥ |

koṭyabjārbudasaṃkhyākā divaṃ jagmurjigīṣayā |

tayoḥ samabhavad yuddhaṃ surāsuraprasenayoḥ ||47||
bāṇairastraistathā mantrairmāyābhiścaindrajālikaiḥ |
pāṣāṇaiḥ parvatairvṛkṣairulkābhiśca śatacchadaiḥ ||48 ||
vajraiścakraiḥ śataghnībhirnārācaistomarairdrumaiḥ |

divyauṣadhairdroṇagirerānītairvividhairmuhuḥ ||54||
mṛtotthitān surān dṛṣṭvā jālaṃdharo’tiroṣavān |
śukraṃ prāha kathaṃ caitā mṛtā jīvanti devatāḥ || |55 ||
manye sañjīvinīvidyā sureṣvapi gatā tava |

tathā kṛte vijayaste bhaviṣyatyanyathā nahi ||59||
śrutvā jalaṃdharo gatvā drutaṃ cotpāṭya parvatam |
droṇācalaṃ samānīya prākṣipatsāgarāntare ||1.325.60 ||

hatāndevājjīvayitumoṣadhyarthaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || 6 1||
jagāma droṇabhūmiṃ ca tatrādriṃ na dadarśa saḥ |

devānprāha samāgatya palāyadhvaṃ surā itaḥ |

śaṃkhabherījayaghoṣairviviśustvamarāvatīm ||66||

kalidoṣavināśakṛtkalkirūpāya te namaḥ ||79||

kaṃbharāyāḥ suputrāya gopālasūnave namaḥ ||1.325.80||

sādhurūpāya kṛṣṇāya vallabhāya ca te namaḥ ||8 1 ||

uraḥ śiro lalāṭaṃ ca yasya tatāni te namaḥ ||1.325.90 ||

sūryaścandraśca vahniśca śeṣo dharmo nirākṛtāḥ || 99||

vayaṃ kṣudrā iva nātha vicarāmo’ṭavīsthalam || 1.325.100 ||
iti stutvā viremuste devā indrādayastataḥ |

devādīn saha nītvaiva kṛṣṇanārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || 108 ||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasahitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne āṣāḍhapūrṇimāyāṃ śukrācāryapūjakāsurasaṃgheṣu rāhuṃ viśirasaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatkāraṇaṃ samudramathanāmṛtapāne pakṣapātādi vijñāya suraviṣṇuprabhṛtināśārthaṃ jalaṃdharakṛtasurāsurayuddhottaraṃ suraparājaye vaikuṇṭhaviṣṇustavanādinirūpaṇanāmā pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 325 ||

śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇa hare viṣṇo mama bhrātrā taduttaram |
viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvācaritaṃ kiṃ viṣṇunā kiṃ ca me vada || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śrūyatāṃ ca tvayā lakṣmi pitā putrī sutastathā |
sarve’pi caṃcalā lolāstatra kiṃ kiṃ na jāyate || 2 ||
viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭvātisaṃkruddho balagarvasamanvitaḥ |
yuddhodyataṃ devasainyaṃ vilokyātiruṣā jvalan || 3 ||
daityānājñāpayāmāsa samarārthe jalaṃdharaḥ |
bho bho daityavarāḥ sarve yuddhārthamamaraiḥ saha || 4 ||
nirgacchantu mahāśastrā yuddhaṃ kurvantu dustaram |
yathā punarnāgaccheyurdevāstathāntakṛnmahat || 5 ||
tadā mauryā lakṣasaṃkhyā dhaumrāśca śatasaṃkhyakāḥ |
asurāḥ koṭisaṃkhyākāḥ kālakeyāśca koṭayaḥ || 6 ||
kaṃkā lakṣāstathā śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaparirakṣitāḥ |
tālajaṃghā mahādaityāḥ koṭiśastatra niryayuḥ || 7 ||
rākṣasā dānavāścāpi koṭyarbudapadātayaḥ |
sandhībhūya tadāyātāḥ suranāśārthaniścayāḥ || 8 ||
raṇadhvajāstadā vyomni vyadṛśyanta tu netravat |
bheryaśca raṇaśṛṃgāṇi cakruśurbhayadāni hi || 9 ||
jalaṃdharājñayā daityā yuyudhire suraiḥ saha |
astrairbāṇaiśca bhūśuṇḍīśataghnībhiśca dūrataḥ || 1.326.10 ||
dhāvanto’trita āgamya gadābhiḥ śūlatomaraiḥ |
paṭṭiśaiḥ paraśubhiśca khaḍgaiśca mūśalādibhiḥ || 11 ||
vṛkṣaiśca parvataiścāpi vajraiśca śaktibhistathā |
nārācaiścārdhacandraiśca sītābhiśca parasparam || 12 ||
nijaghnurdaityasaṃghāste cakraiśca devatā api |
yuyudhuste mahāvīrāḥ kurvantaḥ siṃhavad ravān || 13 ||
kecid bāṇairhatāścānye hatāḥ kṣatāśca tomaraiḥ |
kecitparaśuśūlaiśca hatā raṇavanāntare || 14||
daityānāṃ kadanaṃ jātaṃ mahad dṛṣṭvā jalaṃdharaḥ |
nādayitvā raṇaśṛṃgaṃ svayaṃ cākruśya vai balāt || 15 ||
sabalāndānavān kṛtvāvātarad raṇamūrdhani |
ato daityā mahāvīryāḥ samutsāhāstadābhavan || 16 ||
samāpetuśca saṃgrāme tvandhā bhūtvātidāruṇāḥ |
mārayantu cchedayantu dvaidhīkurvantu devatāḥ || 17||
mardayantu kūrcayantu cūrṇayantu tilāṃśavat |
māpasarpantu saṃgrāmād homaṃ kurvantu cātmanām || 18 ||
śūrāṇāṃ raṇayajño vai punarnāyāti nāpyate |
raktaṃ pibantu devānāṃ bhuñjantu tatpriyāstataḥ || 19 ||
ityākrośo mahānāsīttadānīṃ daityamaṇḍale |
prahārā sabalā hyāsan daityānāṃ suranāśakāḥ ||1.326.20||
na prahārastadā kaścit surānāśī pravartate |
yatra vai dṛśyate tatra dṛśyante devatā hatāḥ ||21 ||
ararāṭī tadā tvāsīdviṣṇorhṛdantare kṣaṇam |
vāsavo’pi vidudrāva surāḥ śeṣā vidudruvuḥ || 22|
palāyanaparān dṛṣṭvā viṣṇusteṣu viveśa ha |
sabalān sarvathā kṛtvā hataśeṣān surān hariḥ ||23||
yuddhārthamāhvayāñcakre garuḍasthaḥ punaḥ punaḥ |
jīvayiṣye surānsarvānnāśayiṣye tu dānavān || 24|||
mā palāyantu saṃgrāmādahaṃ yotsye’grago bhavan |
ityuktvā bhagavān viṣṇuḥ svasya sudarśanāttadā ||25||
sudarśanānāṃ lakṣāṇi racayāmāsa tatkṣaṇam |
prerayāmāsa tānyeva hantuṃ senāṃ tu dānavīm || 26||
agnīṃśca lakṣaśaḥ kṛtvā prerayāmāsa cāsurīm |

etadvilokya devāśca nijaghnurvai palāyitān ||28||

chinnā naṣṭāḥ kartitāśca dṛśyante’raṇyavattadā |

tacchrutvā ca tathāstviti jagād bhagavān hi tam |
tato lakṣmyā tathā parivāreṇa sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || 65 ||
jalaṃdharagṛhaṃ gatvā jalaṃdhareṇa pūjitaḥ |
uvāsa vacanād baddhaḥ pratīkṣan punarardanam ||6 1|||
jalaṃdhareṇa medinyāṃ puraṃ jālaṃdharaṃ kṛtam |
rājyaṃ ca bahulaṃ pṛthvyāmāsamudrāntamāsthitam || 67||
svargādau dānavāḥ sarve niyuktā adhikāriṇaḥ |
pātālādau kṛtā daityā adhikāraparāḥ svayam ||68 ||
pṛthvyāṃ paścimavārdheśca madhye dvīpe hyuvāsa saḥ |
devagandharvasiddheṣu yatkiṃcidratnamācitam ||6 9||
svāyattīkṛtya tatsarvaṃ bubhuje’kaṇṭakaṃ talam |
devagandharvasiddheśān sarparakṣonareśvarān ||1.326.7 0 ||
svadvīpe nāgarān kṛtvā śaśāsa bhuvanatrayam |
devā yuddhe mṛtā ye ye tānparyajīvayaddhariḥ ||7 1 ||
daityā ye ye hatāstām̐śca śukraḥ saṃparyajīvayat |
devāḥ punargatā mervādyaraṇyādau yathā purā ||72 ||
phalaṃ labdhaṃ na vai kiñcittuṣāvaghātavaddhyabhūt |
sarvatra bhuvaneṣvāsīd vārtā viṣṇuḥ parājitaḥ ||73 ||
bhaktyādhīno bhavatyeva vaśī nānyena kenacit |
lakṣmyā ca śālakenāpi snehena sa vaśīkṛtaḥ ||74||
devakāryaṃ vihāyaiva śālakagṛhamāśritaḥ |
devā nirāśrayā jātā duḥkhitāḥ śaraṇaṃ vinā ||75||
devyo’pi duḥkhamāpannā asurairbhūri cārditāḥ |
kiṃ kartavyaṃ kva gantavyaṃ viṣṇurvṛndālatāṃ śritaḥ ||76 ||
atha daityavināśo vai śīghraṃ syādityacintayat |
antarātmagatād devāt kṛṣgānārāyaṇātprabhoḥ ||77||
devā devyaśca ye jālaṃdharadvīpe tu nāgarāḥ |
abhavam̐ste tathā cānye yathā jñāyet nāsuraḥ ||78 ||
tathā vicārya śreṣṭhāste jagmuḥ śaṃkarasannidhau |
tuṣṭuvuḥ śaṃkaraṃ sveṣāṃ duḥkhasya vinivṛttaye ||7 9||
athāhūya mahādevo nāradaṃ kuśalakriyam |
preṣayāmāsa tatpūryāṃ devakāryacikīrṣayā ||1.326.80 ||
nārado’pi yayau śīghraṃ jālaṃdharapure tadā |
devānpūrvaṃ militvā ca jñātvā duḥkhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ ||8 1 ||
devakṛtaṃ pūjanaṃ ca gṛhītvātithisatkriyām |
śrutvā sūryaśaśidharmavahniniḥsāraṇādikam ||82||
viṣṇoḥ parājayaṃ śrutvā jalaṃdharasya cānayam |
surānāśvāsayitvā jñāpayitvā kāryasiddhaye ||8 3 ||
yathābuddhi devakāryaṃ kariṣye hyabhidhāya ca |
natvā devān yayau jalandharasabhāmṛṣiḥ svayam ||84||
āgataṃ muniṃ jalaṃdharo natvāsanaṃ dadau |
saṃpūjya vidhivad daityaḥ prahasyāha tu nāradam ||85||
kuśalaṃ te muniśreṣṭha kuta āgamyate itaḥ |
yadarthamiha cāyāto vijñāpaya karomi tat ||86 ||
prasannātmā nāradastacchrutvā provāca cāsuram |
dhanyastvaṃ balavān rājā rājendro vartase’dhunā ||87||
sarvaratnaprabhoktāsi tathāhaṃ śrutavān divi |
paścācca śrutavān bhogān śaṃkarasyottamottamān ||88 ||
yojanāyutavistīrṇe kalpadrumamahāvane |
kāmadhenuśatākīrṇe cintāmaṇisudīpite 89||
sarvarukmamaye divye sarvatrādbhutaśobhite |
yānavāhanadāsaiśca dāsībhiḥ paricārite ||1.326.90 ||
kailāśaśikhare tatra dṛṣṭavān śaṃkaraṃ hyaham |
sarvāṃgasundaraṃ gauraṃ trinetraṃ candraśekharam ||9 1 ||
ūnaṣoḍaśavarṣābhiryuvatībhiḥ susevitam |
candrapiṇḍakṛtābhirvā sūryasvarṇaniḥsṛtābhiḥ ||92||
naikasundarībhiḥ śivo modate tatra parvate |
athāvicārayaṃ paścācchrutaṃ jālaṃdharaṃ sukham ||93 ||
kīdṛg bhavettathā smṛrddhiretādṛśī bhavenna vā |
iti vitarkya sāścaryaṃ samāgato’smi te gṛham ||94||
tadvilokanakāmo’haṃ tvatsānnidhyamihāgataḥ |
dvīpaste subhagaścāsti hyudyānavanamaṇḍitaḥ ||95||
parīto jalakhātena śobhito’stīti sundaram |
ityuktavantaṃ daityaḥ sa darśayāmāsa sarvathā ||96||
smṛddhimantargṛhā bāhyagṛhā gahvarasaṃsthitām |
dṛṣṭvā śaśaṃsa munirāḍ vitarkya devalābhakṛt ||97||
viṣṇupreraṇayā prāha daityaṃ mohaṃ yathāviśet |
aho tava samṛddhestu pāraṃ nāsti jalaṃdhara ||98||
trailokyādhipatigṛhe bhavedeva na citrakam |
bhavanāni vicitrāṇi yānāni vāhanāni ca || 99||
upakaraṇāni ratnapūjāśca maṇiśevadhiḥ |
mauktikāni hīrakāśca suvarṇaśatabhūmayaḥ || 1.326.10 0||
gajādyā vājinaścāpi nānyatra santi te yathā |
śaktasyairāvataścātra sūryasyoccaiḥśravā hayaḥ || 10 1||
kalpamandāravṛkṣāśca nidhayo dhanadasya ca |
brahmaṇo haṃsayānaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ garuḍa ityapi || 102||
yamasya mahiṣaścāpi viṣṇoḥ sudarśanaṃ tathā |
śeṣarājamaṇiścāpi candrasya cāmṛtaṃ tathā || 1 03||
manvantarāṇāṃ chatrāṇi suvarṇayaṣṭayastathā |
cāmarāṇi digīśānāṃ devīnāṃ kaṃkaṇāni ca || 1 04||
evaṃ sarvāṇi ratnāni bhānti tāni gṛhe tava |
pramadānāṃ ca dāsīnāṃ śreṣṭhatvaṃ cāpi te’sti vai || 105 ||
kintu naikamapi jāyāratnaṃ tai bhāti tādṛśam |
yādṛśaṃ śaṃkarāgre’sti tāvān nyūno’sti vai bhavān || 106 ||
śreṣṭhena jāyāratnena sūryacandranibhena vai |
bhavanāni praśobhante rājño na smṛddhibhistathā || 1 07||
kirātībhistu lakṣābhiḥ śobhate na nṛpagṛham |
yathā tvaṃ digyaśā bhāsi na tvatpatnī tathāsti vai || 1 08||
yadvā kiṃ śubhradāsībhiryaśaścenna vivāhitā |
śuklāṃ jāyāṃ vinā sarvaṃ pherurājagṛhopamam || 1 09||
na vai vivāhitāṃ vinā śobhā rājño bhavetkvacit |
rājyamātā bhaved devī divyā vaṃśavivardhinī || 1.326.110 ||
nahi dāsīpralakṣāsu kumāro nṛpatermataḥ |
dāsījāḥ śataśaścāpi nābhiṣekārhaṇā matāḥ || 111 ||
tadānetuṃ kumārīṃ tvaṃ strīratnaṃ cārhasi dhruvam |
ahaṃ gacchāmi lokeṣu ratnānāṃ yatra saṃgrahaḥ || 11 2||
śrutvaivaṃ cāha devarṣiṃ jalaṃdharo’timānavān |
devarṣe ca yathāsarvaratnānāṃ śraiṣṭhyamasti me || 113 ||
caturdaśasu lokeṣu tādṛk śreṣṭhottamottamam |
bhavitā yadi vijñātaṃ bhaved darśaya me matam || 1 14||
bhavatā sarvato dṛṣṭā nāryo rājñyaśca kanyakāḥ |
vedhasāṃ śaṃkarāṇāṃ ca viṣṇūnāṃ cāpi kanyakāḥ || 115 ||
ṛṣīṇāṃ cāpi pitṝṇāṃ devānāṃ cāpi kanyakāḥ |
mānavānāṃ ca nāgānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām || 116 ||
sarvāśca kanyakā mune tvayā dṛṣṭāḥ samantataḥ |
sarvātiśayasaundaryarūpayauvanasadguṇāḥ || 117 ||
yatra vasanti tadratnaṃ pradarśaya nayāmi tat |
caturdaśabhuvanānāṃ rājñīnāṃ saṃsadi mama || 118 ||
patnīrūpaṃ prakāśyeta sūrya iva mahojjvalam |
yatsamaṃ na bhavedanyadadhikaṃ tu kathaṃ bhavet || 119 ||
tādṛśaṃ darśaya vidvan nayāmi vivahāmi ca |
yadagre sarvarājñyaśca pataṅgya iva sarvathā || 1.326.120 ||
bhaveyustādṛśaṃ kumārikāratnaṃ vahāmyaham |
śrutvaivaṃ nāradaḥ prāha vartate tādṛśaṃ khalu || 121 ||
ekamevātra brahmāṇḍe kumārīratnamuttamam |
yadagre sarvanārīṇāṃ saundaryaṃ bhasmitendhanam || 122 ||
mayāpi yaddināddṛṣṭaṃ taddināt tadavāptaye |
prayatyate punargatvā nidrāṃ labhe na śarmadām || 123 ||
hṛdaye cakṣuṣorvṛttau svapne tathā ca jāgare |
mastake’pi ca sā kanyā ramate smṛtimāgatā || 124 ||
kiṃ saundaryaṃ ca kiṃ rūpaṃ kīdṛśaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā |
yannakhāgre’pi tejo’sti yatra kṛṣṇāyate śaśī || 125 ||
yanmukhe gaṇḍayorbhāgau tathā cāpi kapolayoḥ |
klṛptāścatvāra evātra sūryāḥ kiṃ staśca tādṛśau || 126 ||
kiyanmadhyakaṭistasyāḥ kiyatkāmasthalaṃ tathā |
kiyatprodbhinnabhāvāḍhyastanadvayaṃ kiyat kiyat || 127 ||
vidyullatā yathā tatra tatra vasanti vai kimu |
mayā na prāpyate rājam̐stvayā kathaṃ sa cāpyate || 128 ||
tathāpi kuru yatnaṃ tvaṃ prāpsyate tajjayastava |
prāptavyaṃ vāpi martavyamiti kṛtvā prayatyatām || 129 ||
nānyathā tadbhavetkāryaṃ śūrāṇāṃ kimasādhyakam |
kailāse tadvartate’dya śaṃbhorhastatale sthitam || 1.326.130 ||
śaṃbhoḥ patnīsvarūpeṇa cākṣata tena yoginā |
śaṃbhustu vartate yogī samādhau tiṣṭhati dhruvam || 131 ||
na spṛśati tāṃ nārīṃ kanyārūpāṃ vicintya saḥ |
atyadbhutāṃ rakṣati sma sarvathā yogasiddhibhiḥ || 132 ||
jāyāratnena sadṛśastrilokyāṃ śaṃbhunā khalu |
nāsti kaściditi manye pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭavān yataḥ || 133 ||
yasyāḥ pādāvalokena brahmā reto hyavāsṛjat |
kāmo’pi tāṃ vilokyaiva mumoha bhasmatāṃ gataḥ || 1 34||
tadratnaṃ tvakṣataṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo bhavātra vai |
no cet prāṇān vihāyaiva paralokaṃ samāśraya || 1 35||
ityuktvā nārado devapūjyo devahitārthakṛt |
yayau devām̐śca vijñāpya kalāṃ daityavināśinīm || 136 ||
devā api sutuṣṭāśca viṣṇuṃ gatvā sa nāradaḥ |
sarvaṃ tadabravīnnatvā yayau satyaṃ svakaṃ sthalam || 1 37||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jalaṃdharavṛndākhyāne’surasurasainyayuddhaṃ mṛtāsurasurāṇāmujjīvanaṃ jalaṃdharaviṣṇvośca yuddhaṃ prasannena viṣṇunā jalaṃdharagṛhe vāsātmakavarapradānaṃ punardevānāṃ duḥkhaṃ śaṃkarāya nivedanaṃ nāradasya jalandharagṛhaṃ pratigamanaṃ surūpāyā bhāryāyā pārvatyā ānayanāya jalandharasya mohanamityādinirūpaṇanāmā ṣaḍaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 326 ||

<1.327>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
nārāyaṇa mahārāja jalaṃdhareṇa śatruṇā |
nārade tu prayāte vai tato’nuṣṭhitameva kim || 1 ||
vada vistarato nātha kṛṣṇanārāyaṇa prabho |
jalaṃdharo mahādaityaḥ pārvatyarthe kimācarat || 2 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
śṛṇu lakṣmi tato daityo nāradoktānusārataḥ |
prayatnaṃ kṛtavān samyak kathayāmi yathātatham || 3 ||
tāmeva cintayan tanvīmanaṃgaśarapīḍitaḥ |
kālādhīnālpabhāgyaḥ saḥ praṇaṣṭadhīrvimohitaḥ || 4 ||
sudūtamāhvayāmāsa saiṃhikeyaṃ vicakṣaṇam |
āgataṃ taṃ mahārāhuṃ prāha kāryaprasādhaka || 5 ||
mama kāryasya siddhyarthaṃ kailāsaṃ gaccha parvatam |
tatra yogī śaṃkaro’sti yo na spṛśati strīvarām || 6 ||
tasya hastagataṃ kanyāratnaṃ cāstīti nāradaḥ |
māmuvāca ca tadratnaṃ mayā prāptavyameva ha || 7 ||
pārvatītyabhidhānaṃ tanmayā prāptavyameva hi |
tatra gatvā tu vaktavyaṃ nirbhayena hṛdā tvayā || 8 ||
vanavāsinmahāyogin jāyāratnena kiṃ nu te |
dehi tanme jalaṃdharanāmne ratnabhuje hara || 9 ||
yāni yāni tu ratnāni trailokye tāni sarvaśaḥ |
mama gṛhe mayā rājñā cānītāni balāttataḥ || 1.327.10 ||
airāvata uccaiḥśravāḥ kalpaśca pārijātakaḥ |
haṃsayuktavimānaṃ ca vajra śaktiśca cāmaram || 11 ||
mauktikāni hīrakāśca chatraṃ prakhyātimacca yat |
tatsarvaṃ mama bhogyaṃ vai mayānītaṃ mama gṛhe || 1 2||
nidhayaśca mahāmālā pāśo daṇḍastathāmṛtam |
sarvaṃ tanmadgṛhe cāsti kanyāratnaṃ vinā hara || 13 ||
yoginaste navakanyā na spṛśyā dīyatāṃ hi me |
ityājñāṃ prāpya rāhuśca yayau yatra sa śaṃkaraḥ || 14||
nandinādiṣṭadūtatvāt sabhāmadhye praveśitaḥ |
śaṃkaraṃ divyasarvāṃgaṃ divyabhūṣaṇabhūṣitam || 15||
praṇanāma haraṃ tatra gatavān nikaṭaṃ tathā |
uvāca śaṃkaraṃ cāsmi dūto jalaṃdharasya vai || 1 6||
trailokyapatinā muktastvatsakāśamihāgataḥ |
yoginaṃ tvāṃ samudiśya sa yadāha śṛṇuṣva tat || 17||
kanyāratnaṃ svarṇakāntaṃ candrapiṇḍasamaṃ tava |
yogino nopayuktaṃ syād dehi me tvaṃ digambara || 18 ||
ahaṃ ratnaprabhoktāsmi tat strīratnaṃ na te bhavet |
bhikṣāśinaḥ kuto ratnaṃ bhāryāratnaṃ tu bhūbhṛtaḥ || 1 9||
trailokye yāni ratnāni tānyāhṛtāni sarvaśaḥ |
mayā ceyaṃ śubhā kanyā ceṣyate dīyatāṃ nu me || 1.327.20 ||
svastrīratnaṃ dehi mahyaṃ rājñaḥ sukhakarāḥ prajāḥ |
trailokyāntargatatvāt tvaṃ prajā bhavasi me hara || 21 ||
paśya lakṣmi hatabuddhiḥ pitaraṃ prāha mātaram |
pārvatīṃ me dehi ceti māyā vai kīdṛśī hareḥ || 22||
hatadhiyo’tra loke vai mātṛkāmābhicintakāḥ |
sarve jalandharā bodhyā viṣṇumāyāvimohitāḥ || 23 ||
satīṣvapi ca dāsīṣu parāṃganāṃ samīhate |
so’pi jalaṃdharo bodhyo vināśamukhamantritaḥ || 24||
śṛṇu paścāttu yajjātaṃ rāhau vadati tatkṣaṇam |
samutpanno mahāraudro gaṇastīvrāśanisvanaḥ || 25 ||
bhrūmadhyādīśaroṣādvā sajvālanayano mahān |
siṃhāsyapracalajjihvaścordhvakeśo bhayaṃkaraḥ || 26||
tālajaṃgho’bhidudrāva kṣudhayā rāhumāturaḥ |
khādituṃ tu samāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvādhāvacca rāhukaḥ || 27||
tathāpi taṃ saḥ prasahya rāhuṃ dadhāra khāditum |
ākruśya śaṃkaraṃ prāha rāhuḥ pāhi prapannakam ||28||
trāhi trāhi prabho pāhi rakṣa rakṣa kṛpānidhe |
khādatyayaṃ sevakaste dūtaṃ māṃ śaraṇāgatam || 29 ||
na khādettu yathāyaṃ māṃ tathā rakṣaya śaṃkara |
brāhmaṇaṃ māṃ na khādedvai namaste’stu kṛpāṃ kuru || 1.327.30 ||
brāhmaṇeti vacaḥśrutvā śaṃkaraḥ svagaṇaṃ tadā |
abravīd dūta mā khāda brāhmaṇaṃ rāhunāmakam || 31 ||
iti śrutvā dūtavaco mumoca taṃ subhojanam |
śaṃbhuṃ prāha kṣudhito’smi tyājitaṃ mama bhakṣyakam || 32 ||
kṣudhā māṃ bādhate śaṃbho dehi bhakṣyaṃ maheśvara |
śivaḥ prāha bubhukṣā te yadyatīva pravartate || 33 ||
kṣudhā tvāṃ bādhate’tyarthaṃ svamāṃsaṃ bhakṣayātra vai |
hastapādādikaṃ svasya bhakṣayātreti cājñayā || 34 ||
cakhāda sa gaṇaḥ sarvaṃ svamāṃsaṃ svakabandhajam |
yadābhavacchiraḥ śiṣṭaṃ prasannaḥ śaṃkarastadā || 35 ||
uvāca he mahābhakta madājñāpratipālaka |
santuṣṭo’smi vada tubhyaṃ kiṃ dadāmi bhayaṃkara || 36 ||
mayā saha prapūjyatvaṃ kīrtimukhābhidhānakam |
dadāmi te mahāvīra vasa dvāri mama gṛhe || 37 ||
tadāprabhṛti śaṃbhoścālayadvāri sa tiṣṭhati |
pūjanīyo viśeṣeṇa śaṃbhoḥ santoṣahetave || 38 ||
atha rāhurgato yatra jalaṃdharaḥ pratiṣṭhati |
svasva mṛtyuṃ nivedayāmāsa yathā ca jīvanam || 39 ||
jalaṃdharastu saṃkruddhaḥ śrutvā śaṃkaraceṣṭitam |
dūtāvamānaṃ gaṇayan svāvamānaṃ mahat kṛtam ||1.327.4 0 ||
uvāca daityamūrdhanyān sajjā bhavantu vai kṣaṇāt |
nirgacchantvakhilā daityāḥ kālanemyādayastathā || 41 ||
śuṃbhaniśuṃbhamukhyāśca koṭayo vīravaṃśajāḥ |
kaṃbuvaṃśyā daurhṛdāśca kālakeyāśca kālakāḥ || 42 ||
mauryā dhaumrāstathā cānye dānavāścāsurāstathā |
sajjāḥ samāgatāḥ sarve tānādāya jalaṃdharaḥ ||43 ||
nirjagāmāśu daityānāṃ koṭibhiḥ parivāritaḥ |
agre rāhuśchinnaśiro’maṃgalāya kṛto’bhavat || 44||
śukraḥ kāṇo’maṃgalāya dvitīyo’pyagrago’bhavat |
śuṃbhasya tu khaḍgo hastātpatito’maṃgalāya saḥ ||45 ||
niśuṃbhādeḥ kṣuvanaṃ ca gatau skhalanamityapi |
jalaṃdharasya śiraso mukuṭo’patadityapi ||46 ||
amaṃgalāya tatsarvaṃ prasthāne’bhavadārtikṛt |
mahānidrāsūcakāścāśakunānyabhavannapi |||47||
tadā trastāḥ surā guptā agacchan śaṃkaraṃ prati |
tuṣṭuvurduṣṭanāśāya devānāṃ sukhalabdhaye ||48 ||
dhyānamagna mahādeva samādhistha namo’stute |
jalaṃdharastava putro vināśāya samarpitaḥ ||49 ||
surāṇāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtvā pārvatyā dharṣaṇaṃ tathā |
tavāvamānaṃ kṛtvā ca tato nāśāya kalpitaḥ || 1.327.50 ||
kiṃ vā pūrvaṃ kṛpānātha daityo nāśāya kalpitaḥ |
kiṃ vai tvayā tathā lakṣmīpatināsti praṇiścitam ||5 1 ||
viṣaprāśottarāt pūrva varaṃ viṣavināśanam |
duṣṭakṛddharṣaṇāt pūrvaṃ varaṃ duṣṭe pradaṇḍanam |||52 ||
viṣṇustasya gṛhe śete vṛndayā parisevitaḥ |
śaṃkaraḥ svagṛhe śete brahmaṇi svasamādhinā ||53 ||
pārvatyāścātra kiṃ bhāvi vicāraya prabholaka |
devānāṃ durdaśāṃ cāpi vilokaya praśaṃkara ||54||
brahmā brahmāṇḍaracane nivṛttiṃ naiva yāti ca |
dikpālā lokapālāśca jalaṃdharavaśaṃgatāḥ ||55 ||
rakṣako vidyate naiva lakṣmīstasya sahāyinī |
tvaṃ bhava rakṣako’smākaṃ sthānabhraṣṭākṛtātmanām ||56 ||
jahi no rakṣaṇārthāya putra te sāgarātmajam |
sa cāyāti tvayā kartuṃ raṇaṃ balena garvitaḥ ||57 ||
hantumarhasyavilambāt taṃ viruddhārthagāminam |
duḥkhitaśca surān sarvān pāhi naḥ śaraṇāgatān ||58||
iti devavacaḥ śrutvā viṣṇuṃ sasmāra śaṃkaraḥ |
viṣṇuḥ śīghraṃ samāyāto na jānīyād yathāsuraḥ |||59||
śaṃbhuḥ prāha hariṃ viṣṇo jalaṃdharaḥ kathaṃ tvayā |
niṣūdito na cādyāpi kathaṃ vasasi tadgṛhe ||1.327.60 ||
viṣṇuḥ prāha mahādeva śrībhrātā ca tavātmajaḥ |
itihetorhato naiva tvamenaṃ jahi śaṃkara || 61 ||
mayā kṛto raṇastena prāṇagrāheṇa sarvathā |
lakṣmyā nivāritaścāhaṃ mārayāmāsa naiva tam || 62 ||
na sa vai māritaḥ śaṃbho tava gauravakāraṇāt |
vareṇa svālaye cāhaṃ vāsito’smi na pakṣagaḥ ||6 3 ||
tasya patnī mahābhāgā kṛṣṇagolokavāsinī |
vṛndā bhavati dharmāḍhyā satī pativratā sadā || 64||
tasyā balena daityo’sau mriyate neti vai mayā |
hetujijñāsayā cāpi vasatistadgṛhe kṛtā ||65||
tajjñātaṃ sarvathā śaṃbho kāraṇaṃ prabalaṃ yataḥ |
yuddhaṃ kuru mahādeva sāhāyye vicarāmyaham | 66 ||
vṛndāyāṃ tatra kāpaṭyaṃ kiṃcit kartuṃ bhaviṣyati |
nyāyenaiva kariṣyāmi nānyāyena kadācana || 67||
sa ca daityastava patnīṃ kāmenādātumicchati |
tatra chidre mayā kiṃcit kartavyamupatiṣṭhati || 68 ||
avaśyaṃ tasya nāśaḥ syānmātṛduṣṭārthagāminaḥ |
nāyaṃ putraḥ kintu śatrurindraṃ dṛṣṭvā tvayā kṛtaḥ || 69 ||
sa evānyāyago nāśyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā |
etasminnantare daityo mahāsenāsamanvitaḥ || 1.327.70 ||
kailāsaprāntamāyāto’varudhyādriṃ jagarja ha |
sainyakolāhalaṃ śrutvā cukrodha śaṃkarastadā || 71 ||
samādideśa yuddhārthaṃ nandyādigaṇapuṃgavān |
nandībhamukhasenānīmukhā yuddhaviśāradāḥ ||7 2 ||
avaterurgaṇāḥ sarve kailāsāt krodhasaṃbhṛtāḥ |
koṭiśaste gaṇāścaiva koṭiśo daityapuṃgavāḥ ||7 3 ||
kurvanto raṇaśabdām̐śca kailāsopatyakāsu vai |
garjanto bhairavaṃ vīrāḥ pramatheśāśca dānavāḥ || 74||
śaktitomarabāṇaughairmusalaiḥ pāśapaṭṭiśaiḥ |
vyarājanta triśūlāstravajramudgaraśastrakaiḥ ||75 ||
bherīmṛdaṃgaśaṃkhoghairniḥsvānairvīraharṣaṇaiḥ |
gajāśvarathaśabdaiśca nāditā bhūrvyakampata ||76 ||
senayorubhayostatrābhavan śabdā bhayaṃkarāḥ |
garjanayā samaṃ parasparaṃ hananamulbaṇam || 77||
prāvartata tadā lakṣmi nāśanaṃ cātidāruṇam |
hatā nāgā hatāścāśvā hatā vīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ ||78 ||
pramathāhatadaityaughā daityāhatagaṇāstathā |
mahānidrāṃgatāstaiśca bhūrvyarājata saṃvṛtā || 79 ||
vasāsṛṅmāṃsapaṃkāḍhyā bhūragamyābhavattadā |
daityānajīvayacchukro mṛtasaṃjīvanībalāt || 1.327.80 ||
gaṇā mṛtā nottiṣṭhanti bhayaṃkaramidaṃ mahat |
śaśaṃsuśca gaṇāstasmai śaṃkarāya vināśanam ||8 1 ||
śukrasya ceṣṭitaṃ sarvaṃ jñātvā tu cukradhe haraḥ |
tanmukhāt krodhatāmrākṣo kṛtyā babhūva bhīṣaṇā || 8 2||
tālajaṃghā darīvaktrā tāḍāṃgulī giristanī |
āsasāda raṇabhūmiṃ vicacārāsureṣu sā || 83 ||
bhakṣayamāṇā tāndaityān jagāma bhārgavo yataḥ |
śukrācāryaṃ gale dhṛtvā yonimadhye’kṣipaddhi sā ||84||
svabhage dhṛtvā jagāmāntarhitā nabhaḥ |
daityāḥ pramlānavadanā dṛṣṭvaitacchukranāśanam|| 85 ||
vinirjagmuryuddhabhūmeḥ prāṇarakṣāparāyaṇāḥ |
abhajyata mahāsainyaṃ gaṇaiḥ santāḍitaṃ tadā ||86||
śuṃbho niśuṃbhanāmā ca kālanemiśca te trayaḥ |
yuddhaṃ carantaḥ pramathapṛtanāṃ jaghnuraiśvarīm ||87||
muñcantaḥ śaravarṣāṇi gaṇasenāmakampayan |
rurudhuśca gaṇāścāpi daityān mārgaṇavṛṣṭibhiḥ ||88||
vasantakiṃśukābhāsā jātā gaṇāśca dānavāḥ |
atha dānavasainyaṃ tad vyomāśrayaṃ samācarat ||89||
rurodha gaṇasainyaṃ tad vyomavṛṣṭyātighorayā |
tadā pramathasainyaṃ saṃbhagnaṃ dudrāva gahvaram || 1.327.90 ||
dṛṣṭvā caitad vaiparītyaṃ nandībhamukhaṣaṇmukhāḥ |
anyegaṇāścātibalā ākāśamavalambya ca ||9 1 ||
sainyānyākāśamālambya nītvā pāṣāṇapuṃgavān |
āmarṣādabhyadhāvanta saṃhartuṃ daityapuṃgavān ||92|||
utplutya cotplutya vijaghnuraiśvarā
jālaṃdharārakṣitadaityapuṃgavān |
pāṣāṇaśastreratibhagnamastakā
nipetururvyāmapare tu dudruvuḥ ||93||
evamāsurasainyaṃ tadbhagnaṃ vyoma vihāya ca |
kailāsāraṇyamāśritya pracchannaṃ samabhūt kṣaṇam ||94||
iti śrīlakṣmīnārāyaṇīyasaṃhitāyāṃ prathame kṛtayugasantāne jālaṃdharavṛndākhyāne jālaṃdhareṇa rāhurdūtaḥ śaṃkaraṃ pratipreṣitaḥ sa kīrtimukhena vidrāvitaḥ tato jalandharasainyamāgatam śukrācāryaḥ kṛtyayā yonau nikṣiptaḥ ghoraṃ yuddhamabhūccetyādinirūpaṇanāmā saptaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo’dhyāyaḥ || 327 ||

<1.328>
śrīlakṣmīruvāca
kṛtyāyonau nihitasya śukrācāryasya vai tataḥ |
kimabhūt tatra yuddhaṃ ca kīdṛśaṃ ceti me vada || 1 ||
śrīnārāyaṇa uvāca
yāvajjālaṃdharanāśo bhavet tāvattu kṛtyayā |
svayonau marditaḥ śukro nirgantuṃ nāśakat tadā || 2 ||
yogamantrabalenāyaṃ mumurṣurapi saṃyamāt |
kathaṃcijjīvanaṃ dhṛtvā prasuptastatra mūrchitaḥ || 3 ||
jālaṃdhare vinaṣṭe ca kṛtyayā mūtrito bahiḥ |
mūrchitaścirakālānte jāgaraṃ sa ca labdhavān || 4 ||
atha prāsaṃgikaṃ yuddhaṃ śṛṇu lakṣmi parasparam |
dvandvātmakaṃ tato jātaṃ mahatormahatorati || 5 ||
abhyadhāvata nandyākhyaṃ kālanemirmahāsuraḥ |
śuṃbho lambodaraṃ cāpi niśuṃbhastu ṣaḍānanam || 6 ||
niśuṃbhaḥ pañcabhirbāṇairvivyādha śikhinaṃ hṛdi |
kārtikeyastato bāṇaiḥ pañcabhistvatisūlbaṇaiḥ || 7 ||
vivyādha vājinastasya sārathiṃ dhvajameva ca |
śareṇaikena tīkṣṇena niśuṃbhaṃ prajaghāna ha || 8 ||
jagarja ca niśuṃbho’pi garjantaṃ tu ṣaḍānanam |
jaghāna bahubhirbāṇaivivyādha varma dhāritam || 9 ||
kārtikeyastadā kraddhaḥ śaktiṃ jagrāha pāṇinā |
prasahya balavān vegāt prāhiṇot prāṇaghātinīm || 1.328.10 ||
niśuṃbho’pi samayajñaḥ svaśaktyā tāṃ vyapātayat |
tāvat skando dvitīyāṃ tāṃ tadā prāṇāntakāriṇīm || 11 ||
prāhiṇīdativegāt sā hṛllagnā tamapātayat |
atha nandīśvarastatra kālānemiṃ mahāsuram || 12 ||
avidhyata śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ pañcabhiḥ saptabhistathā |
caturbhiśca hayān dvābhyāṃ ketuṃ caikena sārathim || 13 ||
kālanemistato bāṇairdhanuściccheda nandinaḥ |
śilīmukhaistathā nandīśvaraṃ vivyādha mastake || 14||
nandīśo’pi triśūlena jaghāna hṛdi kālakam |
kālako hatasarvasvaḥ śūlabhinnahṛdantaraḥ || 15||
utpāṭya śikharaṃ cādrernandinaṃ samatāḍayat |
nandiḥ śaktiṃ samādāya jaghāna kālavakṣasi || 1 6||
kālaḥ papāta mūrchāyāṃ hastapādau prasārya vai |
atha hastyānanaḥ śubha vivyādha hṛdi patriṇā || 17||
aśvān vivyādhāṣṭabhiścaikena vivyādha sārathim |
śubhastadātivegādvai bāṇenaikena mūṣakam || 18 ||
vivyādha mastake cūcū kṛtvā hyālurapāsarat |
gaṇeśastaṃ parityajya padātirgaṇanāyakaḥ || 19 ||
śaktyā vivyādha śubha ca pṛthvyāmapātayat tadā |
atha mūrchā vihāyaiva kālanemirniśubhakaḥ || 1.328.20 ||
ubhau gaṇeśaṃ hantu 3 samājagmaturulbaṇau |
gṛhītvā pātayāmāsatuśca vivyadhatuḥ śaraiḥ ||2 1 ||
taṃ pīḍitamavālokya vīrabhadro’bhyadhāvata |
jagrāha dvau kukṣayośca mardayāmāsa vai muhuḥ || 22 ||
prakṣiptau pṛthvyāṃ tau dvau mṛtaprāyau mahāsurau |
kūṣmāṇḍā bhairavāstāvat pretā bhūtāḥ piśācakāḥ || 23 ||
vināyakāśca vetālā vīrāḥ pakṣāśca rākṣasāḥ |
yoginyaḥ kṛtyakā ḍākinyaśca sainyāni saṃyayuḥ ||24||
tataḥ kilakilāśabdaḥ siṃhanādāḥ saghargharāḥ |
ḍamarūjapraṇādāścākampayan pṛthivīṃ tadā ||25 ||
bhakṣayanti dānavām̐śca mārayanti triśūlakaiḥ |
chedayanti galām̐steṣāṃ mardayanti mahāsurān ||26 ||
jaghnurdaityāndānavām̐śca śikharaiḥ parvatopamaiḥ |
hastibhirvājibhiścaiva rathaiḥ śastrīkṛtaistadā |||27||
dānavaiścāpi daityaiśca śastrīkṛtairjaḍājaḍaiḥ |
padbhyāṃ padbhyāṃ pragṛhyaiva tāḍayanti sma tām̐śca taiḥ ||28||
evaṃ bhūtādisenābhiḥ kṛtaṃ vai kadanaṃ mahat |
ye yoddhāro’bhavandaityādayaste śastratāṃ gatāḥ ||22 ||
taireva śastratāṃ prāptairnaṣṭāḥ svasainyapuṃgavāḥ |
yatra bhūtā rākṣasāśca vetālāśca vināyakāḥ ||1.328.3 0 ||
yoddhārastatra kiṃkiṃ na saṃbhāvyate ghaṭāghaṭam |
jalaṃdharasya tatsainyaṃ chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ vināśitam ||3 1 ||
marditaṃ nāśitaṃ cāpi cūrṇitaṃ śakalīkṛtam |
nāvaśiṣṭo yadā tatra dṛśyate’suradānavaḥ || 32||
tadātikhedamāpannaścāśrūṇi vyāsṛjanmuhuḥ |
jalaṃdharo mahāvīraḥ śukranāśātiśokavān || 33||
ujjīvakasya nāśena sarvaṃ naṣṭaṃ mamādya vai |
mayāpi cātra martavyaṃ kṛtvā yuddhaparākramam ||34||
iti niścitya sahasā kṛtyāṃ jagrāha pādayoḥ |
vidāraṇāya tāvatsāmuñcacchukraṃ svamūtragam || 35||
rathe nikṣipya sa tatra viśaśrāma kṣaṇaṃ yadā |
tāvacchukraḥ samavāpa saṃjñāṃ tato’tha vidyayā || 36 ||
saṃjīvinyā punardaityānutthāpayan jagarja ca |
tāvadvai vīrabhadrastaṃ śukrācāryaṃ jalaṃdharam || 37||
rathaṃ sarvaṃ samānīya gahvaraṃ praviveśa ha |
śukrācāryaṃ tu kṛtyābhyo datvā nītvā jalaṃdharam || 38||
ānīnāya harasyāgre vīrabhadro jagarja ha |
tāvajjalaṃdharo rūpāṇyanekāni vidhāya tu || 39||
mūlarūpeṇa tatsthānādapāsaranmṛterbhiyā |
bhūtapretapiśācaiśca kūṣmāṇḍairgaṇanāyakaiḥ ||1.328.40 ||
chinnā bhinnā hatā daityā ye tu śukreṇa jīvitāḥ |
pravidhvastāṃ tataḥ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā jalaṃdharastadā ||41 ||
rathenātipatākena gaṇānabhiyayau punaḥ |
meghavadbāṇavṛṣṭiṃ sa mumoca śivasainyake ||42 ||
jalaṃdharaśarameghaiśchannaṃ vyomābhavattadā |
śailādiḥ pañcabhirviddho gaṇeśaḥ pañcasāyakaiḥ || 43 ||
vīrabhadraśca viṃśatyā kārtikeyastu saptabhiḥ |
viddhastena tu daityena kārtikeyo’pi satvaram || 44 ||
śaktyā vivyādha taṃ vīraṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale |
jalaṃdharastataḥ kṣaṇāt samutthāya ruṣā jvalan || 45 ||
gadayā tāḍayāmāsa kārtikeyamapothayat |
vīrabhadrastadā śaktyā pothayāmāsa vārdhijam ||46 ||
jalaṃdharaḥ samutthāya pupluve parighāyudhaḥ |
abhidhāvandrutaṃ gatvā vīrabhadraṃ jaghāna saḥ ||47 ||
vīrabhadraḥ papātorvyāṃ jalaṃdharo jagarja ha |
kolāhalo mahānāsīt bhūtānāṃ rudrasannidhau ||48 ||
śrutvā raudro mahārudro’bhyagāt saṃgrāmamāhasan |
daityā hi bhīṣaṇaṃ rudraṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vidudruvuḥ ||49 ||
jalaṃdharastadā daityo mṛtyarthaṃ kṛtaniścayaḥ |
abhyadhāvat sa caṇḍīśaṃ muñcan bāṇān sahasraśaḥ ||1.328.5 0 ||
ye tu śukreṇa punarujjīvitā daityapuṃgavāḥ |
hatāvaśeṣāste cānye’bhyadhāvan śaṃkaraṃ prati ||5 1 ||
śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaghasmarakālanemibalāhakāḥ |
pracaṇḍakhaḍgaromāṇau roṣātsaṃdṛṣṭadacchadāḥ ||52 ||
bāṇaiḥ saṃchodayāmāsū rudraṃ rudragaṇām̐śca te |
bāṇāndhakārasaṃchannamabhavadvyoma sarvataḥ ||5 3 ||
harastajjālamācchidya bāṇairāvavṛte nabhaḥ |
khaḍgaromaśiraḥ kāyādacchinacchaṃkarastadā || 54||
balāhakaṃ mārayitvā ghasmaraṃ cāpyamārayat |

evaṃ vai bahavastatra hatāḥ punarna cotthitāḥ |
jaladharaṃ mahāśaktiṃ prāhiṇocchaṃkaraḥ svayam || 56 ||

śaktiḥ sā niṣphalā pṛthvyāmanyāndaityān vyapothayat || 57 ||
tadā śeṣā mahādaityā bhayāt pradudruvuḥ raṇāt |

kiṃ yuṣmābhirmātṛdugdhapānakṛdbhiḥ palāyitaiḥ |

raṇamṛtyuḥ praśūrāṇāṃ svargado mokṣado’pi ca |
ābhimukhye’stu nidhanaṃ śastrairamṛtadāyakaiḥ ||1.328.60 ||
mā vaimukhye mṛtyurastu yo dadennārakīṃ gatim |

anivāryasya vai mṛtyorbhayaṃ kāryaṃ na vai budhaiḥ || 62 ||
utpattyā saha dehasya mṛtyurlagno’sti vai dhruvaḥ |
tanmṛtyorbhayamutsṛtya yudhyadhvaṃ samare’surāḥ ||6 3 ||
ityuktvā api daityāste bhītā vai śaṃkarāttadā |

athābhyadhāvajjaladhṛggadāṃ cikṣepa śaṃkare || 66||
śivaḥ śaktyā tu tāṃ dvedhā hyakarod vyomamārgagām |
tato daityo haraṃ muṣṭyā hantumabhyudyayau tadā || 67||
śaṃkareṇa triśūlena yojane sa vipothitaḥ |

āvirbhūya ca gandharvā jaguḥ śrutimanoharam || 69 ||
apsaraso nanṛtuśca miṣṭasvarapragītibhiḥ |
tālaveṇumṛdaṃgām̐śca vādayanti sma cāparāḥ || 1.328.70 ||
tatra śaṃbhostathā tasya gaṇānāṃ mohamāsa ha |
yuddhaṃ vismṛtya śuśruvustallīnāḥ śaṃbhuśāṃkarāḥ ||7 1 ||

kāmavyāpto jagāmāśu yatra gaurī gṛhe’bhavat ||72||

rudrākṣavāsukiśūlacarmāmbarādibhūṣitaḥ || 73 ||
